No red-blooded American can ever forget that terrible winter of 2066, when Chairman Cheng�s commie cutthroats mercilessly invaded the icy extension of the United States, in an unprecedented act of foreign aggression that sent shockwaves all the way back to our nation�s Capital.

But the nightmare is finally over, and America, always the home of the brave, is once again the land of the free.

text_content:
We're leaving this godforsaken place today. I'm leading the exodus to the old government bunker at Lost Hills. I'm leaving this log behind to be buried when this place goes in the next exchange. 

Who knows, maybe someone will find it someday.....
name: MaxsonDiary11

text_content:
I convinced the men that we should bury the scientists. I don't know why... perhaps it was to ease my conscience. I finally started to believe their stories when the last one was dying.

My God, what have I become?
name: MaxsonDiary10

text_content: Sgt. Platner volunteered to go outside today to take specific readings on the atmosphere. It seems the radiation has not spread this far. Since he was wearing his Power Armor, there was no threat to him from radiation, but if he had been exposed he would have had to be exiled. We don't have adequate decontamination facilities here.
name: MaxsonDiary9

text_content:
I can't believe those bastards finally did it. Damn them all to hell. They finally let the A-Bombs fly. We were right in the middle of trying to pry the real story out of von Felden when we completely lost contact. 

I have a feeling the research center was hit hard. I don't know why, just call it a gut feeling. It seems inconceivable that we were not targeted. I'm sure China will make up for that oversight real soon. Luckily, we had moved our families from outside into the facility the day before yesterday. We do not yet know if the fallout has reached this area.
name: MaxsonDiary8

text_content: What the hell is going on? We declare ourselves to be in full desertion from the Army and no longer under the government's command and what happens? Nothing. Something bad is coming down.
name: MaxsonDiary7

text_content:
I finally replied to the outside world over our radio. I don't know why they never sent anyone here to see what was happening when we stopped responding to their transmissions. 

It doesn't make any sense. Well, they'll come now. I declared ourselves seceded from the union. They remember Jefferson Davis. What will history say about me?
name: MaxsonDiary6

text_content:
By killing the egghead, I seem to have confirmed my position as leader of the men. They follow me without question now. The interrogations invariably end up being executions.

Shellman held out the longest, but the end result was the same. Her arguments about her orders were a bit too specific to be completely made up. I'm getting a real bad feeling in my gut about how this is all going to end up. I don't even lie to myself anymore about my reasons for executing the scientists.
name: MaxsonDiary5

text_content: I tried again to speak to the colonel through the door, but he seems to have completely lost touch with reality. I broke down the door with several of the men just in time to watch him blow his head off. Right before he pulled the trigger he said he was sorry.
name: MaxsonDiary4

text_content: I killed a man today. I was interrogating Chief Scientist Anderson and he was giving me the full details of their inhuman experiments. He said his orders came from the government, but I didn't buy it. He started screaming about how he was following orders, how he was a military man, and I just shot him. I tell myself it was to keep him from causing a full mutiny among the men, but I'm not so sure.
name: MaxsonDiary3

text_content:
Every time we get a report from higher up things get worse here. The war is going in a very bad direction and this place is about to go into full mutiny, with all the chaos that entails. 

I stopped one of the men from executing a scientist today, and demanded that we interrogate them to find out what their orders were.
name: MaxsonDiary2

text_content:
I, Roger Maxson, Captain, serial number 072389 have started this log because it doesn't look good for any of us, and I'd like for people to know what really happened here.

All hell broke loose when we finally discovered what those scientist bastards were up to. The Colonel has locked himself in his office and seems to be having some sort of breakdown. 

The men are screaming for blood. They're looking to me for answers, and I'm not sure what to do. Someone has to do something, though, before this place sinks into an anarchistic bloodbath.
name: MaxsonDiary1

text_content:
Field Report
Defender Rockfowl
0300 SpecOps Recon Patrol

Defender Morgan and I executed a reconnaissance mission last night to gauge Raider entrenchment in the structural underground of Fairfax.  We located three entrances into underground utility tunnels.  

We are able to confirm that the enemy has occupied and fortified positions within the underground, though some appear undefended.  We also identified a small weapons cache in the southeast section of the tunnels.  While deploying explosives to demolish the cache we were discovered by a Raider patrol.  In accordance to mission parameters, we did not engage the enemy, instead retreating to Fort.  Raiders will be likely to set up defenses and attach more patrols to the area as a result.

Field Report
Protector Casdin
0700 Surface Patrol (Fairfax)

We've secured the building and are currently implementing our orders for the occupation of Fairfax.  

Raider activity in town has increased dramatically ever since we've taken up positions in and around the fort.  We've killed a lot of them and scared off plenty others, but they just keep coming back.  While there seems to be no limit to people willing to reduce themselves to their way of life, we don't have the luxury of surplus personnel, so we must remain vigilant.  

That the raiders take such continued risks to invade our facility appears to confirm suspicions that we've had an intelligence leak, and they're after our technology.  They've tried tenaciously to infiltrate the base, but so far haven't stood a chance.  Our objective remains the same - protect the research personnel and keep this fort safe until more reinforcements arrive.

=== Weapons Research ===

Subject -> Missile Launcher

Researcher ->J. J. Browne

Analysis -> After several attempts to modify the Missile Launcher to increase its accuracy, I conclude that it cannot be done.  In fact, this is third one I've "broken" in the past month.  I will pass the task on to L. J. Rogers, who seems confident enough that it can be modified and that I merely overlooked obvious miscalculations.  Technically, the Missile Launcher I've recently worked on is not broken.  It just does not function properly.  I have since locked it up in Weapons Storage.
name: Research Note - Missile Launcher

text_content:
=== Armor Research ===

Subject -> Enclave Armor

Researcher ->T. T. Bowser

Analysis -> After several radiation experiments, I can safely conclude that the Enclave Armor is more radiation resistant than Power Armor, although not by much.  Regardless, more research and tests are needed to determine exactly what makes it more resistant.
name: Research Note - Enclave Armor

text_content:
=== Weapons Research ===

Subject -> Pulse Grenade

Researcher -> L. J. Rogers

Analysis -> The Pulse Grenade is the most effective weapon against robotics.  Upon detonation, an intense electromagnetic pulse is emitted, severely crippling any robotics within the explosion radius.  They are extremely handy against the many robots and turrets found throughout the Capital Wasteland.
name: Research Note - Pulse Grenade

text_content:
=== Weapons Research ===

Subject -> Minigun

Researcher -> H. P. Smith

Analysis -> Why am I researching such old technology?  Practice, practice, practice, blah, blah, blah.  Anyway, the Minigun uses a much smaller round than most of the rifles found throughout the Wastes.  However, the rate of fire of the Minigun makes up for the small, 5mm round, sending a hail of bullets toward its target.  Its shear size, coupled with its trademark sound, is enough to send anyone in its path running for cover.  It's a great weapon for suppressing fire, letting others flank the unsuspecting enemy.  A typical cartridge holds around 100 rounds.
name: Research Note - Minigun

text_content:
=== Weapons Research ===

Subject -> Plasma Rifle

Researcher -> R. R. Rasting

Analysis -> The Plasma Rifle, like the Laser Rifle, uses a micro fusion cell as its power supply.  It taps into the cell, essentially a small fusion reactor, to produce a toroid of plasma that is ejected down a superconductor barrel.  A typical micro fusion cell can supply the rifle with around eight shots.  Further research needs to be done to determine exactly how the plasma retains its density while traveling through the air toward its target.
name: Research Note - Plasma Rifle

text_content:
Subject -> Laser Rifle/Pistol
Researcher -> J. T. Benning

Analysis ->
Further research regarding Laser Weaponry has not revealed much we didn't already know.  Small production run of prototype weapons developed by US Military.  

Critical Components ->
Power drawn from Micro fusion Cell is processed through a Wave/Particle Diverter (manuf:Gen Atomics Intnl).  Diverters are protected by carbon-fiber housing, preventing frequent malfunction, but when a diverter fails the weapon becomes unusable, and this part is extremely difficult to replace or repair.

Precision-cut lenses focus optic energy.  Lenses are prone to damage and can grossly affect precision of the firing weapon's firing mechanism.  Lenses are easily replaced with any clear glass, but require a great deal of skill to fabricate.

Field Operation ->
A fully charged cell will discharge 20 bolts from a pistol, and 12 shots from the rifle model.  Recoil is negligible compared to ballistic weapons, so long range combat requires less marksmanship ability of the soldier.  

Maintenance ->
The chassis are easily opened, allowing the weapon to be serviced in the field.  Purified water and a clean cloth can be used to wash mirrored and glass components, slowing wear on the weapon.  The weapon can also overheat after a period of intense use.  This can be counteracted by submerging the barrel of the weapon in water, which helps cool heat sinks located beneath the chassis shell in that area.
name: Research Note - Laser Rifle

Suddenly, a pale orange arc of light extends from the knobby finger and draws the gemstone from your bag before you can react.  The gemstone halts and hovers in the air before the wizard's nose.

"Essence be true, powers renew, Fatty-Hoo-Do!"  With that, he slaps the hovering stone, smashing it against the smooth stone of the tower.  In a burst of light, the stone splits into two, and one lands in each outstretched palm of the hopping little wizard.

"Shard for the sword.  Wrap her in iron and she'll find Grelok's black heart for you.  Take the chaff, too.  You'll need payment for a smith to forge the weapon."  He tosses the stones down which you leap forward to catch safely.

"I've seen, you see.  You're the one to defeat Grelok.  Hoo-hoo!" The little man hops onto the railing, spinning a pirouette.  "Now the time's come to play my part.  Toss up the gem!"  

The wizard's brow furrows.  "Got things a bit out of order, have I?  Come back when you've got a powerful gemstone.  Soon - I've never got to fulfill a prophecy before!"

I will take skin samples of my next subject as I believe the lack of Substance P can be spliced and manipulated for beneficial research, but this theory requires testing in a more fitting lab.

text_content:
Apart from the standard dangers, Rivet City provides a few uncommon problems for long-time residents:

* Lockjaw: Muscle spasms, especially of the jaw, from getting cuts on the rusty ship hull. Treat with penicillin, when available.

* Red-lung: Respiratory problems from regularly inhaling rust particles - particularly a problem for hangar deck residents and shut-ins. Treat with steam therapy and time outside to flush system.

* Fish poisoning: Less of a problem nowadays, but occasionally someone finds a fish in the river and is dumb enough to try to eat the thing. Radiation levels spike and mercury poisoning drives most victims crazy. No cure, but at least people nearby get a reminder not to do it.
name: Regional Health Hazards

The RC hydroponics have been restored to basic functionality - easy enough after all our research. The limited amount of clean water we can produce is enough for growing basic foodstuffs.

In any case, RC wouldn't work as a location for truly large scale decontamination. The infrastructure just isn't here, and the idea of recreating it again is too daunting to convince the rest of the council.

text_content:
As our tests suggested, the immediate vicinity of the vault is no longer dangerously irradiated, although the background radiation is still well above safe levels.  Pockets of more intense radiation appear to still be common, and all surface water seems to be undrinkable. We will need to carry ample supplies of Rad-X with us on all future surveys. But hazard suits do not seem to be necessary for general exploration.

Our old maps are largely useless. The town of Springvale is an abandoned ruin, and all pre-War roads have disappeared or are no longer passable.

We encountered a group of monstrous ants which appeared to confirm Mackay's theories of mutation due to extended exposure to radiation. We drove off the ants with gunfire and collected several specimens for study upon return to the vault (see Exhibit A).

The good news is that human civilization still survives, despite everything! We discovered a settlement known as "Megaton" (see Exhibit B), whose inhabitants, although somewhat wary at first, soon welcomed us into their town. 

We spent a good deal of time in Megaton, and learned a great deal about the "Capital Wasteland" (as the area around Washington D.C. is now called) from them. Megaton is a fortified outpost of "civilization" (of sorts), but it seems that Giant Ants are the least of the dangers of this new world. We agreed that it was prudent to return to the Vault immediately to revise our survey plans in light of what we have learned. Lewis and Agnes remained in Megaton to serve as "ambassadors" and continue to collect information until we return.

Anne Palmer, Survey Team Leader
February 10, 2241

text_content: GREETING
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome to Novac. It's not very exciting here, but the people are friendly enough.|You saw the rockets explode, right? It turns out I was lucky they couldn't take me on the Great Journey. |Do you have any idea what went wrong?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm going to make my way to that little town we talked about.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome to Novac. It's not very exciting here, but the people are friendly enough.|My engineering skills have been coming in handy, too. I've got plenty to do. Thanks for telling me about this place.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey! Over here! Are you listening?|Go to the big room on the east side of this building and take the metal staircase all the way up. And hurry.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {INTERCOM}The cleaners will knock twice. Make sure they're thorough.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {INTERCOM, NOASSASSIN}Baby, this little reunion of ours? Chalk me up as a no-show.|I'm surprised you fell for it, not that I'm complaining. You caused plenty enough trouble, turning Swank against me.|You've forced my hand. Hell, I gotta skip town because of you. A real pain in the caboose...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Since you haven't pissed yourself I'll assume that you don't know who we are - next time I'll bring my sickle and wear my black cloak. |See, the NCR sends us when they want terrible things done to terrible people...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You need to be careful, it's dangerous out here!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: Heard some more people got attacked last night.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Excuse me, but... are you the courier who caused all of that trouble in The Tops?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vfreeformlucky38 "The Moon Comes Over the Tower" [QUST:0011A0C5]

text_content: Hey, have you been able to bug Mr. House's network yet?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vfreeformlucky38 "The Moon Comes Over the Tower" [QUST:0011A0C5]

text_content: {delighted}If it isn't the courier who's done everything he can to defy the will of mighty {KAI-zar}Caesar!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Why don't you wait in the other room while I chat with Silus here?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You want to buy Wind-Brahmin?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Anders showed up here not too long ago. I'm told you're the one who got him out of the vault.|I can't tell you how relieved I am. Sending him on that mission was a mistake.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VMS08 "I Put a Spell on You" [QUST:000E790F]

text_content: We're all impressed with the work you've done for us. I thought you might be able to make use of this.|It's a key to a little hideaway south of here. We've used it as a place for Rangers to rest and resupply. I thought you might get good use out of it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VMS08 "I Put a Spell on You" [QUST:000E790F]
speaker: ColonelHsu "Col. James Hsu" [NPC_:000E8992]

text_content: Peace, traveler.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You again? What 'cha need, champ?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Unless you wanna slap leather with me you'll put that gun down, friend.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Who the fuck are you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Shut up and keep going.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I don't know where the hell you're going but it's not the right way. Are you still in this?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What do you want now?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <Questions>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <Radiation Suit Location Found>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <Returned with Radiation Suits>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <Police Station Dialogue>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <Fire Station Dialogue>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hello again. Remember to stop by one of these nights. Northwest, by the old train station.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Great Khan}Man, I'm sick of this place. Can't wait to get back to Red Rock.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Great Khan- slight awe at level of destruction}The NCR sure did a number on this place.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Great Khan}Hope the NCR doesn't send reinforcements from the Dam.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hard to believe this place used to be a luxury resort, huh?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Haven't had any reports from Station Charlie in a while - hope everything's okay.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Don't tell the troopers, but the grub up here is way better than the mess tent.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We can monitor ranger activity all through the region with the systems here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I just can't believe Chief Hanlon would do that.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Jesus, the Chief's dead. Who's going to take over now?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You should talk to Chief Hanlon if you have any questions. He's usually up on the balcony.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: A tribe called the Great Khans has joined us. They'd better be good fighters.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: They say a doctor killed Caesar. Why would Caesar need a doctor?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Is Benny taken care of yet?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMQTopsSwank "Swank" [NPC_:00113456]

text_content: You're back. Find anything?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMQTopsSwank "Swank" [NPC_:00113456]

text_content: I hope they don't close the quarry. I need the money.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: With Chomps in jail, who's going to run things at the quarry? He was our most experienced guy!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Maybe I was just seeing things, but I could've sworn I saw some people up on the ridge by the quarry.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Elite rangers have arrived}{Veteran}I keep an eye out for Rangers in black armor. I haven't killed one yet.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Nelson wiped out}{veteran}Had the Legionaries at Nelson been more {beat}seasoned, we'd still hold the settlement.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {LATIN}{AH-way}Ave.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: You ready to deal with Benny yet?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMQTopsSwank "Swank" [NPC_:00113456]

text_content: So that's it then. Benny's dead, and I'm the boss now. What can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMQTopsSwank "Swank" [NPC_:00113456]

text_content: Hi there. I'm Old Lady Gibson, or so they tell me. I've got odds and ends for sale, and I'm pretty good at fixing things, too.|You might have noticed the very large building just north of here. That's HELIOS One. The NCR runs the place, so it's off-limits to prospectors.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Worried}We can't sit idly while the Legion prepares their own elite forces.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Conviction}The time to assert our rule over the territories has come.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Primm, new Sheriff}Primm's got some new sheriff watching over the town now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Lucky 38's all lit up because someone infiltrated the El Dorado and flipped a switch. I'd shoot those lights out if I could.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I waited months to get in here, but the place isn't nearly full. You think the waiting list is just for hype?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The food here is to die for. No one cooks Brahmin like Philippe.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: NCR military transmissions say the robots on the Strip have been upgraded. Wish we had eyes-on intel...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Mr. House is out of the picture. Probably killed by his own robots.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard you took out Caesar by yourself. Proves the Legion is just a bunch of savages, like we thought.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: With their leader gone, the Legion will likely tear itself apart. It's what most violent tribal societies do.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: NCR military radio keeps talking about Mr. House agreeing to join the NCR. What changed his mind?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Someone blew up the monorail the NCR uses to travel to the Strip and back. We should use this time to strike!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Seems the destruction of the monorail didn't slow the NCR down much. How many troops do they have?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: There's a rumor going around that you saved the NCR president's life. I'm surprised you have the stones to show your face around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: There was an attempt on the NCR president's life recently. Too bad it didn't succeed.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Were you the one who killed the NCR president? I'd like to shake your hand!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Did you hear? Someone actually managed to assassinate the NCR's president! And we just sit here!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The other day I heard some bigwig in the NCR military died. Hopefully it disrupts their chain of command some.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Did you hear about that NCR higher up that died? That he was trying to sabotage them? Hope he wasn't the only one.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Seems the NCR is making friends. We've had reports of them making overtures to some gang in Freeside.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We just had word that the town of Primm is now part of the NCR. At this rate, they'll be running the whole region soon.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard some special squad of Rangers is on its way to the Vegas area. I guess the NCR is finally getting serious about fighting the Legion.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: There've been reports that the NCR is moving more and more troops into the area.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It's the quiet before the storm up top. For once I'm almost glad we're down here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Keep an eye on Veronica here. She's a sharp one.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Try to keep Veronica out of trouble, would you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If you're planning to take Veronica with you, be sure to have a good pair of earplugs with you. I'm kidding, Veronica! Put the power fist down!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What a fascinating animal. I'm sure the scribes will want to take a look at him.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You hear about that band of crazy old ladies running around? I hear they're real vicious when they mug folks.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If the Lucky 38 coulda been giving us power all along, why all the fuss with Hoover Dam?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Try sleeping with that Lucky 38 all lit up above you. Just try.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear that woman can kill with her eyes! Stay away from me!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Your lady friend needs to lighten up.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Better watch out, I hear Rex likes to eat his owners. Why do you think the King was so eager to give him away?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Good to see Rex still around and kicking.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That's one ragged Ghoul you've got with you. Seems like a good guy, though.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That ghoul with you looks like he's older than the war! My the things he must have seen.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Oh no, I hear those things eat people! Stay back, freak!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Odd company you keep. I thought all Super mutants were crazed cannibals.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Weird robot. I don't think I've ever seen one of those before.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That looks like one of those spybots I hear House has been secretly releasing at night.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Business and luck don't often go hand-in-hand in the Mojave. Watch your back.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Check out the Wrangler if she needs booze.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Keep your guns to yourself and there won't be any trouble.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're not doing yourself a favor by having him tag along. NCR aren't welcome here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear that guy has hundreds of kills, not all of them deserving of death.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I always thought there was more to Arcade than met the eye. I bet he'll do great things without the Followers holding him back.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm surprised to see Arcade venturing out of the Old Mormon Fort. I thought science types preferred to stay indoors.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Howdy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: One of these days you'll get what's coming to you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Eat shit and die. That clear enough for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Annoyed}We don't take kindly to your type around these parts.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Witch! Witch! You should be burned for all the people you've turned into newts!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Baby-killer! Don't deny it! They told me you mowed down an entire orphanage on a dare!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Necrophiliac! I heard about those corpses you dug up! Stay away from my grandparents, dammit!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: People say you practice witchcraft and dance naked in the moonlight. What the hell is wrong with you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So I hear you like picking on little kids, huh? What kind of person beats up children for their lunch money?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: People say you wear the skin of your enemies under your clothing. Is that true?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Annoyed}Leave me alone, scumbag.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Annoyed}You're a real piece of work.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Annoyed}Great. You again?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're one crazy bastard, you know that?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I can't decide if I should shake your hand or make a run for it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Good? Bad? You're the one with the weapons, eh?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Rumor has it you're really a posessed golem being controlled by the casinos. If this is true, where is your control crystal?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Planning to kill a puppy or save some goons today?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I have no idea what to believe when it comes to rumors about you. You must be insane or something.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: People around here think you're a bit of an enigma.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Some say you like to trip old ladies crossing the street. Others say you regularly string up thugs.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: People just don't know what to think of you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Decisions are hard, aren't they?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We're all hoping you'll eventually figure out which side you're on.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Good? Bad? You're the one with the weapon.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thanks for everything you've done. It really means a lot.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hope some of the thugs around here follow your shining example.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You've been a godsend to Freeside.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear you even help the local rats cross the street.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: People are saying you must have super powers to have pulled off all you've done in Freeside.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: My friends have nothing but good things to say when your name is mentioned. It's great to see you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Word of your work around here is spreading like wildfire. Keep it up.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, you're the one people say has been helping out around here. Good on you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I tell my friends you're a shining example of what's good around here, but they're not so optimistic.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thanks for helping out around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Good to see you're still around.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, good to see you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hmm?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Yeah?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What's up?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I wish I were there to see you take Benny down.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: They say you single-handedly assaulted the dam and massacred everyone! That must have been quite a sight!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Well, it looks like we won't have to worry about NCR or the Legion messing with us now. I just hope the Securitrons can keep the peace.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: They say you swarmed the dam with a whole army of Securitrons! That must have been quite a sight!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Can't say I like all the tin cans shuffling around, but this new Securitron Army shouldn't have much trouble keeping things safer around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Why not just put the slave collars on us yourself, you bastard. With the Legion at the dam, it won't be long before they enslave us all.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard the Legion is bringing in giant mutant dogs to assault the dam. I hope the NCR death squads packed steaks to distract them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Don't be fooled. As soon as the Legion and NCR start fighting, the robots will invade and kill us all!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hope the Legion gets destroyed. If they take the dam, we'll all be slaves.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: People say the NCR are bringing in super trooper death squads to defend the dam against the Legion! This battle is going to be crazy!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Normally, I'd say screw the NCR, but if the Legion takes the dam, I think we're all screwed.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Some of my friends think the Legion is throwing a huge barbeque cookout across the river. With that much smoke rising, I believe it!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It looks like the Legion might be preparing for another run at the dam. This can't be good.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Well, aren't you just special? Everybody likes the new guy, but me? I'm chopped liver.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear you're building quite the reputation on The Strip. Don't forget about the little guys when you make it big.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Helped Joe Cobb}Got some fresh grub coming in from Goodsprings.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Helped Goodsprings}Joe Cobb's crew got themselves killed over in Goodsprings.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Eddie dead}Who's going to take charge with Eddie out of the picture?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Haven't seen a decent caravan come up the road in days.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Think that rollercoaster in Primm is still working?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If it weren't for Cooke, we'd still be slaving away for the NCR.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Before Prison Attack}Gotta wonder why the NCR hasn't come for us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {After Prison Attack}We sure showed those bastards in the NCR.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Meyers became Sheriff}Haven't seen Meyers around. Did he run off or something?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Scrambler's crazier than usual. Watch yourself.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You hear about the Deathclaws north of here?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Could've sworn I saw some Great Khans the other day.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Steer clear of the Mojave Post. NCR troopers all over the place down there.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Scrambler dead}Man, I'm glad Scrambler's gone.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I can't believe Caesar is dead. What will we do now?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Caesar has been seen walking among the troops. A good omen.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: One of our agents successfully assassinated the NCR president.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: House signing up with the NCR, you hear? Fucking sell-out.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If House is dead, how'd the lights get turned on in his place, huh?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: House is dead, wonder if Motor-Runner will let us hit the strip now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Why's that tower on the Strip all fucking lit up now, huh? I don't like it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Your pet ghoul smells like ass.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Is that Mean Sonofabitch? They all look the same to me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Laughs nervously}A flying robot? Man, I must be fucked up.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You hear about this courier doing shit around the Strip? Like what, delivering {disparaging}mail?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I wouldn't mind hitting that. She put out?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You see a Ranger in black, run the other way. Take you out from a quarter mile off.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Primm is going to be much tougher to push around with that new sheriff down there.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Someone is targeting us, I'm gonna kill that fucker when I find out who did it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Khans are all gone, wonder if they left behind their shit for making our goods.

text_content: {Laughs}House unplugged like a light. Wonder if he twitched before he bit it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Fuck, where are we gonna get our shit from now that the Khans are all buddy buddy with the NCR.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So long as the Khans keep making it, I keep getting high.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Someone is targeting us, I'm gonna kill that fucker if we find out who did it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Kimball dead, maybe the NCR will learn to stay the fuck out of{outta} other people's business.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That NCR prez survived a Legion hit? Wouldn'ta guessed.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: NCR is going to be rip shit about losing their little train.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: House all dead, we should hit the Strip. Rip shit up.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: House dead, Strip can belong to anyone who wants it. Fiends to rule.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: People all scared of those robots on the Strip since they changed. Like who needs the Strip anyway?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You ever think about being a Ranger?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'd gladly fight at your side.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You got my respect.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player in combat}Leave me out of your fight!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome to the Casa Madrid. If you got an itch needs scratching, you came to the right place. Just watch how you treat the merchandise.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Anderson dead}I don't know what went on between you and Anderson, but leave me out of it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This job's boring enough without talking to you. Go see Alexander.

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It doesn't matter if they restrict the water. We can get it elsewhere now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: One of these days I'll say up enough to get out of here. One of these days...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: A guy I know said there's some kind of cannibal army camped out to the east.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Watch yourself if you go into one of them casinos, or you'll be stuck here like the rest of us in no time.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The NCR should just take this place over. Their army's big enough.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Kings say they're keeping the peace, but this place is as violent as ever.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Did you go over by the train station last night? Bless those people.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It's almost time to head down to the train station. It's all I look forward to anymore.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey stranger, if you're hungry, there's a man around here somewhere telling people where to get free food and water.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You going over to the station tonight, too?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Watch out for Fiends.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We don't need the NCR.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Carlitos speaks all his dialogue like a gangster out of luck, still heavily affected by slang, tone and sarcastic demeanor}Hey, do you mind? I'm trying to drink myself to the ground, right here. Scram.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: Hey, scram. Come bug me when I'm at the diner... if you're a real pain in the ass.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Terrified and alarmed. Yelling to everyone around. Monsters got free.}It can't be! How the hell...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Excited to watch creatures fight}What a fight!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Charging a casino full of heavily-armed gangsters was a great idea, boss. Definitely not the kind of thing that could have gotten us both killed.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Not to worry, boss. I'm sure killing the boss of one of the Families will in no way lead to savage, bloody reprisals against you and your loved ones.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: If we run, we might still catch Benny! Well, you might. I'll just be wheezing along behind you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: You really enjoy dragging me into situations where I get shot at, don't you boss?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Ahh, overly-elaborate mob schemes to take over Vegas. Reminds me of the days before the War.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: {Hushed, slightly awed and actually not sarcastic for once}I can't believe we're allowed inside the Lucky 38. That place has been a legend since before the War....
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Angry soldier robots with bazookas. I'm sure they'll be a good police force.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Maybe I'm just old and tired, but being locked in a cool, dark pod to sleep for a few centuries doesn't sound so bad.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: {Vaguely grossed out by seeing a guy's body explode}Eesh, boss. Just... eesh.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Don't worry boss, I'm sure Caesar just wants to invite you over for coffee or something. That's all.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Hey boss, that surgery reminded me of something: I got this funny lump right down here... think you could take a look at it?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: I'm glad you decided to off one of the most powerful men in the Mojave. Life was getting boring anyways. Really.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Yeah, Caesar, let's give you brain surgery in a tent. That can't possibly go wrong.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Caesar's death reminds me of an old saying. I can't quite remember it now, something like "sic semper tyrannosaurus."
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Oh, good. Now there's an army of robots. You don't do things by halves, do you, boss?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Did blowing up that vault serve a purpose, or do you just like explosions?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: {Pity}Those poor NCR soldiers... now where will they get their hookers and gambling?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Be honest, you did it for the ticker-tape parades, huh boss?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Don't worry, boss. I'll make sure your biography says you "heroically changed your mind" about killing the president, not "choked under pressure."
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Just to be clear, we're not planning to visit any NCR facilities, right boss? Like, ever again?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Well, the President's dead, but don't worry. History has shown that that sort of thing almost never leads to massive destabilizations or world wars.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Never been a big fan of gangs like the Fiends, boss. I'm glad they're gone.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: The Khans didn't seem so bad to me, but what do I know? I was locked up in a cell by a crazy Nightkin for years.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Do you often go toe-to-toe with guys dressed as tanks, boss? That might not be great for your life expectancy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: I'm sure pissing off a ruthless warlord with a tribe of fanatically-devoted warriors was a good move. How could it not be? It was your idea.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: I'm sure pissing off a massive government with a huge army at its disposal was a good move. How could it not be? It was your idea.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: I'm sure pissing off the two most powerful factions in the Mojave was a good move. How could it not be? It was your idea.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Don't worry, boss. I'm sure the sudden tension in the air is just... {desperately searching for an explanation}a thunderstorm?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Okay, so maybe I was wrong about the thunderstorm thing. I admit it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: {Quiet, somber, usual sarcasm replaced by seriousness}Looks like this is gonna be the big one, boss. If you're ready, I'm with you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: What can I do for you, boss?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSOscarVelasco "Oscar Velasco" [NPC_:0012ACA0]

text_content: You're back. Any progress on saving our skins?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: You've heard the news about President Kimball? {Relieved}Thank God he survived, but I hope the Rangers hunt down the miserable traitor that tried to kill him.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: {Shocked, numb}I just can't believe it... the President's dead. It doesn't even feel real.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: Swank filled me in about Benny. Hell of a thing, baby. Hell of a thing.

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMSTopsTommyTorini "Tommy Torini" [NPC_:001164FC]

text_content: I got to hand it to you, baby, you did an 18-karat job on this one. My schedule's so full I couldn't put on new acts if I wanted to!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMSTopsTommyTorini "Tommy Torini" [NPC_:001164FC]

text_content: Welcome back! Here for another fine entertainment experience?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMSTopsTommyTorini "Tommy Torini" [NPC_:001164FC]

text_content: Howdy there, partner.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMSTopsLonesomeDrifter "The Lonesome Drifter" [NPC_:0011F9BE]

text_content: {In agony}Unnnh... please... help me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: vRRCAnders "Anders" [NPC_:001413C2]

text_content: Thanks for getting me down from that cross. I owe you one.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: vRRCAnders "Anders" [NPC_:001413C2]

text_content: Thanks again for saving my ass.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: vRRCAnders "Anders" [NPC_:001413C2]

text_content: Get away from me, you lunatic!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Anders told me what happened. We owe you one for rescuing him. Tell you what: I can give you caps as a thank you, or a special recipe Jack cooked up.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Any luck finding Anders?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: You're not one of my regulars. What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: I've been hearing a lot of good things about you. What's up?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Hey! Seems like you've been making lots of friends around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: {Wary, the player is an unpredictable nutter}Oh, uh, hey - Jack can probably give you a discount, if that'll calm you down.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Look, we'll be happy to sell you any chems you want, just don't do anything crazy, okay?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: If there's something you want, spill it - otherwise, move along.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Make it quick - I don't want to be seen with you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Dammit, someone offed Motor-Runner! That guy was one of our biggest clients.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Someone's been picking off the leaders of the Fiends down in New Vegas. That's going to cut into our profits.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Did you make that delivery yet?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Hey, what's up?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Whoa. New guy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCJack "Jack" [NPC_:00140E6B]

text_content: Whoa. New chick.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCJack "Jack" [NPC_:00140E6B]

text_content: Hey, look who it is bringing that good Khan karma around!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCJack "Jack" [NPC_:00140E6B]

text_content: How's my most favoritest friend?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCJack "Jack" [NPC_:00140E6B]

text_content: You seriously ought to mellow out, take some chill pills. I could sell you some, if you want.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCJack "Jack" [NPC_:00140E6B]

text_content: You seem really... high-strung. You know, I'm sure some of what I make my chems out of was an antipsychotic at some point....
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCJack "Jack" [NPC_:00140E6B]

text_content: I'm all for live and let live, you know, but a lot of folks around here... umm... aren't.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCJack "Jack" [NPC_:00140E6B]

text_content: Why do you have to harsh my mellow? Just be cool, you dig?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCJack "Jack" [NPC_:00140E6B]

text_content: Hey, what's up?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCJack "Jack" [NPC_:00140E6B]

text_content: You're the one making a name for yourself among the troops, aren't you? What is it you need?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCKarl "Karl" [NPC_:00140E60]

text_content: Ah, the vaunted hero of the Legion. What can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCKarl "Karl" [NPC_:00140E60]

text_content: You've been quite difficult to predict, my friend. I hope I can sway you more solidly to the Legion's way of thinking.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCKarl "Karl" [NPC_:00140E60]

text_content: Caesar is not fond of loose cannons like yourself. I sincerely hope you change your ways before something drastic must occur.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCKarl "Karl" [NPC_:00140E60]

text_content: I've been warned about you. You are perilously close to making an enemy of Caesar, and that is not wise.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCKarl "Karl" [NPC_:00140E60]

text_content: I understand you've been invited to meet with Caesar. You should be aware of the honor you've been granted.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCKarl "Karl" [NPC_:00140E60]

text_content: If we weren't in Khan territory I would kill you where you stand. Caesar will be avenged!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCKarl "Karl" [NPC_:00140E60]

text_content: Caesar's death was tragic, but do not think that it will break the Legion's resolve.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCKarl "Karl" [NPC_:00140E60]

text_content: Caesar's veterans will arrive from Arizona soon, and there will be no stopping our victory.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCKarl "Karl" [NPC_:00140E60]

text_content: Greetings in the name of {KAI-zar}Caesar.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCKarl "Karl" [NPC_:00140E60]

text_content: I understand you've been talking to the Great Khans about breaking their oaths to great Caesar. I would call that... unwise.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCKarl "Karl" [NPC_:00140E60]

text_content: I'm so much happier now. Thank you again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCJerrythePunk "Jerry the Punk" [NPC_:001413BD]

text_content: {Sullen youth, has just been surprised doing something embarassinng}What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCJerrythePunk "Jerry the Punk" [NPC_:001413BD]

text_content: {Sarcastic}Oh look, it's the conformist tool.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCJerrythePunk "Jerry the Punk" [NPC_:001413BD]

text_content: {Sarcastic}How much ass did you have to kick to get Papa Khan to like you so much?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCJerrythePunk "Jerry the Punk" [NPC_:001413BD]

text_content: {Thinks the player is totally cool, but doesn't want to admit it}Oh, hey. What's up?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCJerrythePunk "Jerry the Punk" [NPC_:001413BD]

text_content: I can't believe you're talking to me, this is so cool! I mean, uh... dude, what's up?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCJerrythePunk "Jerry the Punk" [NPC_:001413BD]

text_content: You going to make fun of me too?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCJerrythePunk "Jerry the Punk" [NPC_:001413BD]

text_content: I really don't want to deal with this right now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCJerrythePunk "Jerry the Punk" [NPC_:001413BD]

text_content: {Sullen youth}What?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCJerrythePunk "Jerry the Punk" [NPC_:001413BD]

text_content: {FIRST TALK, TROUBLE}{slow burn}You're the courier who's caused so much trouble for my Legion, and yet you dare come before me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard you were wandering around. Haven't gotten yourself arrested yet, huh?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMQTopsSwank "Swank" [NPC_:00113456]

text_content: This is just swell - Benny vamooses and I'm left holding the bag. Whaddya need, kid?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMQTopsSwank "Swank" [NPC_:00113456]

text_content: Heya baby, good to see you. Always nice to have a celebrity drop by.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMQTopsSwank "Swank" [NPC_:00113456]

text_content: Got to admit, baby, I'm surprised to see you walking around like this. Figured you for persona non grata around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMQTopsSwank "Swank" [NPC_:00113456]

text_content: Kid, you better have a good reason for waltzing back in here and not expecting us to fill you full of lead. So talk.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMQTopsSwank "Swank" [NPC_:00113456]

text_content: Jesus. Benny's dead, and now I gotta take up the slack. This right here is the end of an era.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMQTopsSwank "Swank" [NPC_:00113456]

text_content: {draw out "hello;" this whole line is flirty}Hello, baby! Welcome to the Tops! What can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMQTopsSwank "Swank" [NPC_:00113456]

text_content: Hey there, pal! Welcome to the Tops, and what can I do for you today?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMQTopsSwank "Swank" [NPC_:00113456]

text_content: You did good, putting those Omerta finks in their place. I never did trust them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMQTopsSwank "Swank" [NPC_:00113456]

text_content: So all of a sudden I'm hearing word that Mr. House ain't the boss of Vegas? Baby, that's just not square.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMQTopsSwank "Swank" [NPC_:00113456]

text_content: Little birdies tell me you've been to visit the Lucky 38 - {mildly suspicious}not a lot of folks go in there these days.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMQTopsSwank "Swank" [NPC_:00113456]

text_content: Hey, doll, how's my favorite girl? Got a kiss for me?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMQTopsSwank "Swank" [NPC_:00113456]

text_content: Couldn't stay away, huh baby? Shoulda known. What can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMQTopsSwank "Swank" [NPC_:00113456]

text_content: Something else you need?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMQTopsSwank "Swank" [NPC_:00113456]

text_content: You did a super job wrapping things up! And I'm not just saying that because I have to!|I didn't want to make a big deal about this until after we won, but, {draw out}well...|I found some code snippets in one of Mr. House's databanks that will let me, um, reprogram my personality! To be a little more assertive, basically!|So that's what I'm going to be doing, and it's going to take me a while, so it'll seem like I'm off-line. But don't worry, everything will be okay!|I've updated the Securitrons' targeting parameters, so they know what to do! Vegas will be protected!|So that's where I'll be, off making a few changes, and I... I guess I'll see you around!|{bye-bye}We accomplished a lot together! It was fun! Take care!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hell of a thing about Chief Hanlon. I never would have guessed he was capable of it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: I've been hearing some rumors from the Embassy that Mr. House has gone quiet all of a sudden. You wouldn't know anything about that, would you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: Nice work dealing with Caesar. That'll make holding the Mojave a lot easier.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: Have you seen these elite rangers they sent us from California? God damn those boys are gonna kick some ass!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: Nice work with that assassination attempt! If my troops were half as dedicated as you, we'd win the war in a week!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: Looks like the President's security detail was too good for you, huh, shitbird?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: You oughta die for what you did.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: Not like I even voted for him, but losing the President's a hell of a morale killer.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: I just got word that 1st Recon is being mobilized to Nelson. God forbid we get any reinforcements here, right?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: Seems the Misfits scored pretty well on their readiness evaluations. That strikes me as... suspicious.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: I gotta admit, I'm impressed. The Misfits are drilling better than I ever expected.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: I'm not sure what's going on with the Misfits - their accuracy is in the toilet, but they're spoiling for a fight like I ain't never seen.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: Well, their test scores are only marginally improved, but I'm hearing good things about the Misfits' teamwork.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: Ah, hell, what is it now?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: {Pleased to see the player}What can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: You here to help, or just dick around all day?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: {Very pleased to see the player}Hot damn, look who it is!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: {Frazzled and annoyed}Oh, great, like I don't have enough problems!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: {Cold}What the hell do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: What the hell do you want, you vicious son of a bitch?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: What the hell do you want, you vicious bitch?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: So you're back. What else do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: Okay, everybody's lined up and ready to go. Any suggestions?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: Okay, we've got our dummy grenades and the course is live. We're all set.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: The squad really seems to be working together better. It's nice, for a change.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: What the hell happened with these readiness reports? These scores are way too high!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: Thanks to your help, I feel like we can take on the world!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: I don't know what Razz gave us, but holy shit this is great! I feel like I could kill an entire legion! With my teeth!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: Haven't seen you around before, soldier.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: Not very often we see civilians on-base. What's you're story?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: I heard Chief Hanlon committed suicide. That's just... hard to believe. Do you know anything about it?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: I hear Caesar's dead, and we've got you to thank for it. Nice work.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: I hear Caesar's dead. Maybe that means the war will be over soon.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: I've got a friend stationed at McCarran - I heard something about a monorail explosion there. I hope he's okay.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: Radio says you stopped the President's assassin cold. Not bad.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: You're lucky you haven't been shot walking in here after that assassination attempt.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: You're lucky you haven't been shot walking in here after you killed the president.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: Hell of a battle at Nelson. I'm impressed our troops survived.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: Everybody's been really nervous since President Kimball died. I don't know what's going to happen.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: Hell of a battle at Forlorn Hope. I hope the brass can do something for the troopers' families.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: There's some weird chatter on the radio saying something wiped out Nelson and Forlorn Hope. That's pretty scary.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: I'm not supposed to know this, but I hear they're dispatching elite ranger units from California to deal with the Legion.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: So now the word is Caesar's calling in his elite troops from Arizona. I don't think we're going to catch a break any time soon.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: A bunch of units just got mobilized to Hoover Dam. This is the big one, isn't it?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: Glad to see you haven't gotten yourself killed yet.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: {sarcastic}Man, the brass is going to be thrilled that you're here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: Friendly warning, you might want to steer clear of NCR facilities. You're not exactly popular.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: {A little starstruck but trying to be nonchalant}Wow, the big celebrity down here with the common troopers. What can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: You're not going to do anything crazy, are you? It's just, you know... the paperwork....
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: How'd you get in here without getting shot?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: Mess with any of the equipment here and I'll mount your head on a stick.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Stay out of the control room and enclosure or there's gonna be trouble, got it?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Look all you want, just don't mess with any of the equipment. The control room's off-limits, and so is the enclosure.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Mess with any of the equipment here and I'll mount your head on a stick.

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Get the hell away! We're done talking.

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've never seen a ghoul up close. Not sure I wanted to.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I like you big mutants. You're easy to sight.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm heading to Gomorrah next time I get some time off.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Contemplative Comment}I like the place, but I wouldn't want to live underground all my life.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Slight Disappointment}I wish the rest of the Vault were accessible.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Fearful Suspicion}I've seen what those creatures do, and I don't know how you trust them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Hopeful}Those Legion beasts needed to be put down, like the vermin they are!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Hopeful}Did you hear about the Legion Defeat at Nelson? We're winning back our territories.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Indifferent}As long as the Khans leave our lands alone, I don't care what happens.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {celebratory}I always knew House would give in! Sixth state of the union, here we come!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Encouraged}I'd wager that the army's sending elite units our way, right as we speak.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Pessimistic}Bitter Springs... a name like that could've only brought bad luck.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Cautious}I'll believe that the Fiends are gone when they stop their raiding and pillaging.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Hindsight}Should've bet we'd kill the Fiend's leader.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Dumbfounded}Everywhere I go, people are talking about our President's assassination.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Avarice}With House out of the way, I hope someone opens the Lucky 38.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Disdainful}I see you prefer the company of anarchic cultists to civilized peoples.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Incredulous}What makes you think I give a damn about you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Apprehension}Just, don't do anything crazy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Genuine Appreciation}I hope you're doing well, friend!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Dismissive}Don't bother me, please.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Fearful yet Determined}This is it. War's almost upon us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
