name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Fearful}War doesn't forgive anybody, but what did we do to deserve this?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Dismissive}Those Freeside thugs aren't worth our time anymore.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Assertive}Khans are history, it serves them right!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Disbelief}Did you hear about Hanlon? What a blow!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Fearful Anger}You killed him! What have we done to you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Indignated}I hear some asshole freed our enemy from McCarran.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Deep Concern}Someone blew up the Monorail, right by our troops!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Celebratory}With Mr. House dead and gone, Vegas can finally join the NCR!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Intrigued}Your robot looks worth quite a few caps.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Thoughtful Naivete}If the Legion can equip their men so well, maybe they can take care of me too.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Lucky 38 re-lit}The great tower of the enemy city blazes with light. What does it mean?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Lucky 38 re-lit}It turns out the Lucky 38 had its own reactor all along. Now that it's operational, the city doesn't need power from the dam.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Hated 1}You're just as bad as the NCR or the Legion. What did the Followers ever do to you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Hated 2}People like you are the reason the Followers haven't brought civilization back to the wasteland yet.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Hated 3}I don't know what you have against the Followers, but I don't want any trouble.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Liked 1}You're always welcome among the Followers, friend.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Liked 2}The Followers are lucky to have a friend like you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Liked 3}If you ever need the assistance of the Followers, just ask.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mixed 1}You're making it hard to trust you, you know.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mixed 2}At least you've making up for some of the trouble you've caused.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mixed 3}They said you're friendly enough, but that we ought to keep an eye on you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That President Kimball nearly got killed at Hoover Dam. Now he knows how we feel about the NCR around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That tower on the Strip, the one you can see for miles? I hear it ain't sealed-up no more.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Legion is attacking! Run for your lives!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Wistful}Vegas at night is like nothing else.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Unsure}The robots here look different than others I've seen.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Shame about the fighting at the Tops; it's got the best patrons around here, hands down!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Slightly Patriotic}Us NCR folk got to stick together, even if the Strip is the safest place in New Vegas.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Beats being on patrol.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Just lost a month's caps...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Some Khans got corned in the ruins of Boulder City and the NCR killed them. It's like Bitter Springs all over again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Someone finally put down that sick Motor Runner sonofabitch. Good riddance.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So I hear the honcho of one of them Strip families up and disappeared - poof! Yeah, they'll find his body someday...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Your victory is the Legion's victory. True to {KAI-zar}Caesar.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You are to be commended on your martial skill.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Legion would have to be insane to attack this place.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The sound of the generators is really quite calming.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're the one who busted those assholes at Gomorrah, huh? Good work!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The bosses of the {saying it wrong}Omergas? Omer-nas? The ones that run Gomorrah? Someone killed them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear someone went crazy in one of the casinos on the Strip, shot the place up or something!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I can't believe it. Caesar's Legion attacks in force, and I actually survived!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Unngh... why do I feel so terrible?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm glad those nighttime raids have stopped. I was getting worried.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Here to meet with the brass?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You oughtta think about enlisting. We need you here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Lot of folks at McCarran really appreciate what you've done.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This ain't your business. Walk off and forget you saw anything.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What the fuck are you looking at?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What the fuck are you looking at?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If I wasn't working right now, I'd show you a real nice time.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Enjoying the show?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I wouldn't mind taking a bite of you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Damn, you're looking tasty.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Securitrons with faces like soldiers? Is this martial law or something? What the fuck?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So Mr. House sells Vegas out to the NCR, {ay}eh? I always knew that freak was a rat.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What the fuck's up with the Lucky 38 being lit up all the time, {ay}eh?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Shit, I can't believe Cachino betrayed the Family.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I got kicked outta Ultra Luxe the other day. Man, that place gives me the fucking creeps.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Business is good. All the Familes got money. Of course Gomorrah is where the action is.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm glad they don't let just any motherfucker through the gate. Freeside smells like shit.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Fiends are bad for business. NCR should do their fucking job.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: There's some serious shit going on between NCR and the Legion. They better not fuck with our power.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Fuck Not-At-Home, must be cozy up there in the Lucky 38.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Bosses don't like no trouble in their place.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Gomorrah is always open for Business.{Spoken like business has two meanings}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Find yourself a girl or a guy. Have some fun.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I think there is something wrong with that dog.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Uh{hesitates}, I don't think we allow{uh} her kind in here.{pause} I'll let it go this time though.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What the fuck is that thing?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Big tough ranger better not start any trouble in here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear you been making some waves around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Those fucking Monkey Khans joined the NCR? I can't believe they finally got themselves civilized.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Khans finally got what they had coming. Glad we won't have to worry about them again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You hear what happened over at Bitter Springs? Not too pretty.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Kimball managed to get himself knocked off. Serves him right.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear Kimball dodged a bullet there.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The NCR seems none too happy about losing their little train.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Glad that fucker House is gone.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Woah, the great Caesar is dead. The management doesn't seem too happy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear Mr. House cashed out. Ain't much to miss.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Amazed}Holy shit, you been in Lucky 38? You meet the Big Man in there?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Things are good since Cachino took over.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear you chased that chicken shit Benny off. Good riddance.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Did Benny beg before you burned his sorry ass?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Laughs}Nice work at the Tops, buddy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome back to Gomorrah, find yourself a girl or a guy, and have a drink. You're family.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Your ghoul wants to have some fun he can, we don't discriminate.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I tell you, Not-At-Home is gonna have his day.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {This space left intentionally blank}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hello, wanderer. Please forgive us of our humble surroundings. Our true home awaits us in the Far Beyond.|Have you come to help us complete the Great Journey?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: They tell me I'm supposed to sell you weapons. Interested?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCGreatKhanaArmoryHF "Great Khan Armorer" [NPC_:0014EDBE]

text_content: What's up with the tower in Vegas being all lit up? I didn't know it could do that.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Even that old House bastard gave in to the NCR. We're the only ones to make a stand!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What are we going to do now that Papa's dead?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Doc seems to be doing all right patching people up, at least.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I never thought they'd actually send us reinforcements.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome to Bitter Springs. {Sarcastic}Quite a sight, isn't it?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear there's a ghost in these mountains... and it doesn't like the NCR much.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Not enough food, not enough medicine, and definitely not enough sleep.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I don't know how we're expected to hold this place with so few men.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: All these refugees... is Caesar's Legion really that big?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This is the worst detail in the Mojave.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Can't believe the Legion hit us in such numbers. They're stronger than we think.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I coughed up blood this morning. I think I'm really sick.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: No attacks for a while now. That's a good sign, right?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I think there's something wrong with the food.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I swear I saw somebody sneaking out of the graveyard the other night.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Lieutenant Markland always looks like he's afraid the kids are gonna bite him.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Markland seems to be getting better with his bedside manner.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Finally got enough pills to chase off that damn infection.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Doc's gotten real handy with the kids these days.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hope the Doc can give me some meds this week.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Nice to see more guards on patrol. Maybe Caesar won't murder us all.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Finally starting to get some decent food around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Not enough soldiers here to stop Caesar if he rolls through.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So tired....
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Haven't had a decent meal in weeks.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Legion just came out of nowhere.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Fiends... cracked-out junkies.  All those chems make them a real bitch to take down.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: We should be taking the fight to the Legion, not waiting for them to pick us apart.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: I really hope General Oliver has a good plan if the Legion comes back.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: Colonel Hsu really knows what he's doing. Now if only someone'd explain that to ol' General Wait-and-See Oliver...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: I pity anyone who crosses Boyd. That woman is relentless.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: We still haven't gotten Ranger Morales' body back from the Fiends. Sure doesn't inspire confidence in the guys you're serving with.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: Damn shame about Morales. She enlisted to be closer to her husband.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: Contreras is holding out on me. I know he's got more to sell.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: Man, Doc Kemp really fixed me up right the last time I got shot. He's the man to see if you need some fixin'.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: Farber is doing the best with what he's got, but man could I go for a nice cut of brahmin steak.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: Hope you like it here at McCarran.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Make yourself at home here. It's cozy... for an airport.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Checking in with the base, huh?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I can't believe it's over. I figured the Dam would fall and this place would be our last stand.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Fight's gonna break out at the Dam any time now. Feels strange not being there for it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The cavalry's finally here. God bless the boys in black.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Word is, our Ranger vets are finally coming up from Baja. The Legion should be pissing their togas.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: First Recon is holding Forlorn Hope now. What I wouldn't give for sniper support here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: With both Nelson and Camp Forlorn Hope gone, you have to wonder when McCarran's gonna get attacked.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've always known Camp Forlorn Hope was a death sentence. I just wish I'd been wrong.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: They're saying we retook Nelson. Finally some good news.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Brotherhood's been quiet lately. Guess they finally realized Rangers beat power armor every time.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Heard the Kings have turned over a new leaf. Doesn't mean you'll see me in Freeside any time soon.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've been seeing a lot of dead Fiends lately. Damn psychos had it coming.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Are you the one that killed Motor-Runner? Thank God. That guy was a living nightmare.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Bad time to lose Chief Hanlon. He'd have had Caesar running scared.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The most important POW we've ever taken and he gets away. He must've had help.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: How could we fail to protect our own monorail?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Caesar's dead. So when do we go home?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Damn that was some light show out there.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That was blinding out there. Feels like I've been staring at the sun.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Is the plant actually working again?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm surprised they didn't send you somewhere more vital.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Wow, what are you doing at HELIOS? I feel like I should salute.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hope you can stay. We could use your expertise here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What'd you do wrong to get sent here? Thought you were an up-and-comer.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Are you supporting us here? We'll take what we can get.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome to HELIOS One.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The attacks have stopped. Winning the dam saved our asses.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We lost Forlorn Hope. The eastern front is collapsing. They'll be here next.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thank God we took back Nelson. Now they'll have a harder time hitting us here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Heard the Brotherhood got smoked. Guess somebody finished what we started.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: With Caesar dead, maybe they'll stop attacking us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This chainlink fence perimeter is worthless. We might as well be defending a cage from the inside.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This place is off-limits to civilians. You don't like it, take it up with Lieutenant Haggerty.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Legion's coming for us. Just a matter of time, believe you me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Pretty sure H.Q. has forgotten all about us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That scientist we hired has got to be the dumbest asshole I've ever come across.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Who knows which side the Legion's gonna hit us from next?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If the Legion breaks through our defenses, I got one bullet I'm saving just for me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We should be up on the front lines, not out here in bumblefuck. This place is a junkyard.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We're supposed to be relieved any day. That's what they keep telling us. I don't think anyone's coming.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Forlorn Hope has fallen, another victory for {KAI-zar}Caesar.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {respectful}I have heard how you cleansed Forlorn Hope of the Profligates.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Nelson, Forlorn Hope... soon {KAI-zar's}Caesar's banners shall rise on Hoover Dam.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Our march to the Dam is assured.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: With Forlorn Hope's fall, our blades are at the NCR's throat.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Our machetes ran thick with blood here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hope to {KAI-zar}Caesar that the Profligates will send more victims to us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {contempt}The Profligates here were weak, no fight in them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This is only the first settlement to fall.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {contempt}The bodies of beggars and cowards fill Nelson's streets now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Dead Sea has erected a tribute to {KAI-zar}Caesar - made of Profligate corpses.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: When we're fortified here and reinforced, Forlorn Hope will be next.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We kill only those who resist the will of {KAI-zar}Caesar. The rest are kept as tribute.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Some of Nelson lives on... as slaves. They are being kept nearby.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If the rest of the Profligate settlements are as weak as this, {KAI-zar's}Caesar's victory is assured.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This is only part of our detachment. We have others stationed nearby.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Speak to our {deh-CAN-us}Decanus, Dead Sea.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We do not move unless Dead Sea commands it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {contempt}We can see the Profligate cowards stationed on the hill, afraid of us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You may walk here - but do not head west along the road.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That we hold Neslon, that is {KAI-zar's}Caesar's will.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You meet any of those Rangers dressed up in black yet? My friends say they're mutant cyborgs and they're going to kill us all!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That new Ranger armor is downright impressive. I'd hate to be on the business end of one of their revolvers.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We've already got people disappearing at night. I hear the NCR have veterans from out west coming to push us out of Freeside.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've been hearing rumors of the Rangers getting some heavy reinforcements soon. Hope they don't try to start anything around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The NCR must have paid off the Kings big to get them to sign up. Maybe there was an NCR mole who tricked them into it!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Good news for Freeside. The Kings have decided to work with NCR for a change.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear the Kings were wiped out by some kind of Super mutant ninja assassin paid by the NCR! Who else could have taken them down?!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I don't get why the Kings are dead. They weren't a bad bunch of guys.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Some people are saying the Great Khans got drugged up out of their minds and attacked the dam.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard the Khans went wild at Hoover Dam. I suppose they were looking for one last blaze of glory.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear the Great Khans staged their own deaths to trick the NCR.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: People say the Khans got wiped out at Red Rock. That's one less bunch of crazies to worry about.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Great Khans aren't gone. They're just hiding, biding their time...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Great Khans moved out? One less mob of degenerates to worry about, if you ask me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Khans signed a treaty with NCR? I've heard some crazy rumors before, but that one's rich!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So, the Great Khans signed up with NCR. Who would have thought those two would settle their differences?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Those sick Legion bastards had the brass balls to attack Bitter Springs? I bet that was one messy fight.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Maybe it'll be a little safer to travel, now that the Fiends' bosses are dead. We owe their killer a debt of gratitude.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard Motor Runner got taken down. Maybe the Fiends will finally destroy themselves now that he's gone.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear Hanlon was abducted by aliens and that's why he was acting so strangely. Better check yourself for strange scars.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hanlon was apparently sabotaging NCR's efforts in the area. Now, I kind of wish he hadn't died.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear Hanlon was working for the aliens and NCR found out.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Chief Hanlon is dead? I hear that guy couldn't order himself out of a cardboard box, let alone command troops
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: My friends say Kimball's assassination was all an Illuminati plot to reclaim power. I say they're crazy. How do you kill someone with a flashlight?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Kimball getting killed is going to make a mess of things around here. The troopers coming through here are mean enough already.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: My friends say you're working for the Illuminati, and that's why you killed Kimball. Watch your back. {paranoid whisper}They have listening devices everywhere!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Killing Kimball is going to make a mess of things around here. The troopers coming through here are mean enough already.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thanks for not killing Kimball. I hear he's been working against the secret alien invasion forces above the planet. {paranoid whisper}They want to eat our brains!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So, I hear that assassination attempt on Kimball didn't quite turn out the way you planned. Now, the NCR are going to be even pissier than usual.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Good job saving Kimball's life. I hear he's been working against the secret alien invasion forces above the planet. {paranoid whisper}They want to eat our brains!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I suppose you did the right thing saving Kimball, even though it means we're still screwed here in Freeside.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You freed that Silus guy from McCarran? Guess you've got your reasons for helping the Legion.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear the monorail bombing was an alien plot. Just a few more gates to destroy and we're all trapped in here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I guess the monorail getting bombed wasn't all bad. Freeside is getting a lot more business now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: With the monorail down, we're going to have a lot more NCR goons wandering through here. Yay...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Rumor has it Mr. House joined the NCR on account of some secret love child he never even knew he had.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Never thought I'd see House settle for being an NCR lapdog. What the hell happened?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I think Caesar was killed by alien clone agents! The Legion are just a bunch of alien slaves doing their bidding!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear Caesar had an alien brain chip in his head, but he died on the operating table when they tried to remove it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: People say Caesar is dead. I hope someone worse doesn't replace him.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You killed Caesar? Rumor around here has it he was struck down by a bad case of explosive diarrhea.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: All hail the slayer of Caesar! It's about time that slavemaster got his!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I don't need to read no obituary to know House was an asshole.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: With no House to boss Vegas around, the NCR's gonna want that job.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: According to the rumor mill, House is faking his death to catch the NCR off-guard.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: House dead? Good riddance.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Better give the Securitrons a wide berth if you know what's good for you. Those new upgrades look nasty.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: House must have special plans for you to get into the Lucky 38 and come out alive.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear you made a real mess of the Omerta's plans. Hopefully, the new management does a better job running Gomorrah.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Impressive work fighting off Benny's thugs! I know I wouldn't have survived that.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard you made a run on The Tops. You've got guts, kid.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Figures that Benny would run. Sorry coward's nobody without his thugs to back him.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Private Watson sure seemed excited about meeting Kimball.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I actually got to see the President.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear President Kimball had a pretty close call with some assassins.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The death of the President is going to be a permanent blight on this place.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If the President of our republic isn't safe here, how can we be?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Kimball died, security seemed so tight, how could such a thing happen?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: President Kimball is going to arrive pretty soon to give his speech and meet that wounded soldier.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: How do we know if Mr. House is really gone? No one's ever seen him in the first place!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Colonel Moore survived four tours against the Brotherhood back west. If anyone can help take on the Legion, it's her.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You hear that rumor that Colonel Moore was kicked out of Gomorrah a while back? I heard she's had it in for the Omertas ever since.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm really surprised Colonel Moore accepted the Brotherhood's help. I heard she lost a lot of men in war with them back west.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Is it true? Was there really a Brotherhood base nearby that blew sky high?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard a rumor that Moore hired some mercs to wipe out the Khans. Is that such a good idea, with Bitter Springs still on peoples' minds back home?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Man, I'm exhausted. Moore's got us running drills non-stop.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Just between us, Colonel Moore scares me sometimes.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Our victory was never in question.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: How did the Legion make it into the power plant?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Let's get going!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Crimson Caravan's the biggest merchant outfit in the wasteland.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Damn Brahmin crap everywhere.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm glad Ringo's back. Got a good story to tell, too.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Fucking expensive to get into the Strip these days.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Keep an eye out for wildlife.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: When pay day hits, I'm off to the Strip. Can't wait.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Did you know you have a robot following you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Whatever you're selling, we have plenty.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Keep your distance, soldier.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {suspicious}A doctor? Who's your supplier?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Idle thumbs tend to get blown off around here. Get moving.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Sorry, I've got work to take care of.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'd keep moving if I was you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Dismissive}Go back to the Strip where you belong.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're nothing like us, Outsider.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We should have never let you in.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're no different than a common Fiend.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What are you looking at?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Keep your distance.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm not sure what to make of you, Outsider.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What do you know about our problems?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome back.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey there. Kill any Outsiders lately?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Jovial}You can shoot with me anytime, friend.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Always nice to see you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Wry}Hope the trip into camp wasn't too eventful!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {friendly}Keep your head down, Outsider.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've got my sights on you, Outsider.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Stand back where I can see you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Saw you coming a mile away.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I actually got to fly Pearl for a little bit during that boming run. Hot damn, what an honor.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: All those hours training? Glad they finally paid off.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Did you see it? I hear the suckers burned right through their armor.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It was wonderful seeing Pearl fly and serve the purpose she was built for.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It's getting nasty out here. S'times like these I thank god for artillery.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: War's brewing on the horizon, plain as day.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We've survived out here pretty well so far without any help from the outside.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You should get out of my face before you get yourself hurt.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I don't have anything to say to you, outsider.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I don't know how you survived the bombardment. That's incredible.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I don't think you should be here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm happy you came along. You are the answer to our dreams.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You've earned our trust, now let's see if you can earn our gratitude.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I can't believe we may see the superfortress built in my lifetime.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Really? So we may see our dream of flight soon?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear you're going to help us, I hope you're up for the task.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm happy that we managed to raise the bomber in my lifetime.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thank you so much for your help.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I didn't think the day would ever come, but thanks to you our dreams have come true!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm amazed that an outsider has proven so helpful.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You've given us the ability to touch the sky! Thank you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You've done us a great service. Thank you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You've done us a great service. Thank you for your help.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm not going to take anything from you. Leave me alone!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey! You tried to get me sick!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You should learn to give kids nice things... Like toys!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're the one that tried to give me that yucky stuff.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I don't think I should talk to you. You aren't very nice.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You need to leave me alone. I don't like you anymore.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're lots of fun. We should play sometime.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm going to be a hero and travel the wasteland like you when I grow up.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm going to tell Mama Pearl how cool you are.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I bet you have all kinds of fun stories.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I like you, we should play sometime!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thanks for the toy! It was great!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm going to play raise the B-29!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I can't believe Pearl let you stay with us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I sure hope Pearl knows what she's doing.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Fucking Crocker couldn't find his ass if it wasn't on his backside...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Don't be carrying any guns into the casino.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Not insulting, just commenting}You look like you just crawled out of the desert.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Night only}Love how this place comes alive at night.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Day only}You should see this place at night.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Rueful}Looking to lose a few caps, huh? Just the place.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I never trusted those Omerta punks, even if I like their girls.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I don't trust those creeps at the Ultra-Luxe.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We need more people like you in the NCR.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Proud}We should straighten those thugs at Gomorrah.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We've heard about you from the officers at our embassy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're wasting no time in making a name for yourself around here, huh?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Subtly Fearful}The bots have enough firepower to arm a full platoon.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Surprised, then impressed}A Ranger, here in the Strip? Fine company, sir!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Matter of Fact}I won't be missing Mr. House, that's a given. The Strip's better off without him.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Satisfied}It was a matter of time before someone got to Mr. House.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Satisfied}Mr. House won't trouble our plans for the Strip any longer, huh!?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Proud}NCR should take this chance, now that Mr. House's out of the way.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Relieved}Good riddance, Caesar! We can finally enjoy some R&R without worrying about a Legion attack at McCarran.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Exuberant}Fuck that Caesar dog! I'm going to drink in your name, all night!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Suspicious}I tell you, something stinks about this Monorail attack!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Vengeful}My buddies at McCarran will find the asshole that destroyed our Monorail.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Complicit}So, our President's savior is enjoying a well deserved R&R? Fine piece of work you are!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Vengeful}Once I'm done here, I hope they assign me to find the son of a bitch that took down our President.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It's good to have the Khans on our side, but I hope they keep them out of the Strip. Those savages smell like Bighorner's ass.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Surprised} I heard it got nasty at the Tops; wish I could've seen the shooting.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: My buddies at Camp McCarran are breathing easy now that the Fiends' leader is dead.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Celebratory}Without leadership, the Fiends are as good as dead!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Surprise mixed with disgust}What's a mutant doing in the Strip?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Surprise mixed with disgust}They let Ghouls into the Strip, now?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The new slave girls are quite beautiful.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The camps are getting crowded.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Slaves aren't much of a challenge in the arena.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player defeated Ranger Stella}{missed out on a good arena match}I didn't think anyone could kill an NCR Ranger in single combat.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player cured Caesar}{KAI-zar}Caesar lives!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Caesar dead}I'll mourn {KAI-zar}Caesar - he was a great man.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Legion victory}{proud}All that {KAI-zar}Caesar promised has come true.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Legion victory}{Ah-WAY, Ah-ME-cus}Ave, amicus.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: Look to Bitter Springs to see what happens to disloyal slaves.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Player killed President Kimball}{Officer}I've heard the stories of how you assassinated Kimball. It's all my Legionaries will about.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Player killed President Kimball}Kimball's assassin is always welcome here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Silus freed}The {Ken-TOO-ree-on}Centurion Silus will be punished for letting himself be captured. Coward.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Battle for Hoover Dam soon to begin}{Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius is come. The battle for the dam will soon begin!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Late game begins}{Officer}{Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius will arrive soon enough - and with him comes slaughter.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Late game begins}{Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius draws near. The Profligates' days are numbered.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Middle game begins}{Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius is known as the Monster of the East - a name he has earned many times over.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Elite Rangers have arrived}{trying not to sound worried}The black-armored Rangers are said to be fearsome in battle.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Elite rangers on the way}{Officer}The Legionaries fret like women over rumors of Rangers in black armor.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Elite rangers on the way}There have been sightings of Rangers in black armor, the best the Profligates have to offer.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: I wish I could hear the Profligates weeping over the explosion at McCarran!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: The Mark of {KAI-zar}Caesar protects you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Mr. House Unplugged/Killed}The warlord House thought himself beyond {KAI-zar's}Caesar's reach. And now he is dead.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Caesar cured}{officer}Never once did I believe that {KAI-zar}was near death. I have friends in high places.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Caesar dead}The Legion will survive {KAI-zar's}Caesar's death. It must!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Player destroyed Securitron Army}I felt the earth shake when the evil below the Fort was destroyed!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Rumors of Legion Veterans}{Officer}Soon the Legion's veterans will arrive from Arizona. Each has killed many times his number.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Legion dogs killed}Our hounds were bred to kill. They are missed.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Nelson and Camp Forlorn Hope both wiped out}It's said that every living thing at Nelson and Forlorn Hope camp was killed.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Camp Forlorn Hope wiped out}{cheerful}I hear the Profligates at Forlorn Hope begged for their lives.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Nelson wiped out}{officer}Had I been the commander of our forces at Nelson, the town would still be ours.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Nelson wiped out}The Legionaries at Nelson were killed to a man. No survivors.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Great Khans signed treaty with NCR}So frightened are the Profligates that they've begun signing treaties with primitive tribes!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Unknown}{Officer}Keep barking and I'll feed you to a dog.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Unknown}Watch yourself, Profligate.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Unknown}Hold your tongue, wastrel.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Unknown}Degenerates like you belong on a cross.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Dislike}{contempt}Wretched Profligate. Try making some trouble.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
