text_content: {Dislike}{contempt}You belong on a cross, degenerate.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Dislike}I'd rather kill you than talk to you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Hated}When the time comes, I'll be the one to kill you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Hated}{looking for an excuse to attack}Give me cause, Profligate.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Hated}Attack me. Give me license to kill you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Mixed}You aren't trusted here, Profligate.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Mixed}{Scornfully}You serve yourself, not the Legion.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Mixed}Why is your degneracy tolerated?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Wild Child}{Officer}You can't be trusted... but you're useful.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Wild Child}How are we to trust one such as you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Wild Child}{suspicious}Who knows what you'll do next?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Wild Child}You're a crazed one. I'll not talk to you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Somewhat liked}{Most idiots try to defy the Legion}You do well to serve the Legion.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Somewhat liked}{Most are forced to serve}You're wise to serve the Legion by choice.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Somewhat liked}You've proved yourself useful, at least.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Liked}{Officer}You serve the Legion well, {ah-ME-cus}amicus.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Liked}We each serve the Legion, in our way.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Liked}{LATIN}Good to see you, {ah-ME-cus}amicus.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Liked}{LATIN}{AH-way, ah-ME-cus}Ave, amicus.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Unknown}{Veteran}I know your kind. You die easily enough.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Legion Veterans arriving}Have you seen the Legion's veterans, arrived from Arizona? They are fearless!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Hopeful}I hope the Fiends stop their raids now that their boss is gone
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Dumbfounded}Bad weather ahead, I tell you. The death of our President's just the start.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Resentful}Don't care about Kimball, until he starts to care about us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Revolted}Don't dump your Ghoul here, we've already got enough shit around us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Admiringly}People of my trade respect the merchants of these territories.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Proud and Celebratory}I hear the Khans won't trouble us anymore.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Slightly Apprehensive}I hear the Securitrons are tougher since their faces changed.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Celebratory}House was the only thing keeping Vegas from joining the NCR!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Excitedly Surprised}You're the one that killed Caesar, right?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Celebratory}After all, Caesar died like the old man he was.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Excitedly Surprised}That Caesar bastard had it coming.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Thankful}I'm glad those damn bots are gone for good.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Slight Relief}Our guys put the Monorail back to work!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Excitedly Thankful}We owe you so much for saving our President.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Proud Indignation}Can you believe they tried killing our President? Don't they know who they are dealing with?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Rueful Indignation}Our own President, murdered! Things aren't looking good.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Unspoken Suspicions}Hanlon was a brave soldier, what could've driven him to despair?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Assertive}That Fiend leader shouldn't have messed with our great army.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Proud}The Fiends are running for their lives. That'll show everyone what we do to our enemies.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Worried}If the Legion can reach as far as Bitter Springs, what's going to stop them from getting to us?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Slightly Concerned, if Hopeful}Those Khans are savages, but we can use them to our advantage.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Proud}Those Khans got the hint! We've shown everyone that these are our new territories.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Self-Righteousness}I knew those Khans couldn't be trusted!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Proud}I hear we straightened up a band of thugs in Freeside.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Hopeful}I hear a troublesome Legion camp got razed to the ground!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Rueful}Our forces suffered a huge blow at Forlorn Hope, We'll remember that!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Celebratory}Legionaries are next in the list of rabid dogs to put down!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Proud}Civilizing Primm will show what we can do for everyone else in these territories.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Excitedly Hopeful}Our rangers are going to show everyone what happens when we're pissed off!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Concerned}I've heard the Legion's planning to unleash their best men against us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Worried}Those Legion elite troops are bad blood.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Slightly Concerned}Things are getting stranger every day.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Visibly Concerned}It seems that the territories are about to blow up.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Slightly Irritated}Back home we don't waste time talking to strangers, either.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Slightly Irritated}I really have more important things to do, sorry.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Pleasant}Good to see a friend of our government.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Pleasant}The NCR appreciates good citizens like you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Pleasant}I'm glad to see you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Genuine Appreciation}The NCR's fortunate to have your support.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Genuine Appreciation}You're a model citizen, thank you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Slight Discomfort}What do you want with me?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Slight Suspicion}You're not going to cause any problems, right?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Palpable Apprehension}Uh-oh, back off and leave me alone.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Fearful}I don't want any trouble, okay?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Violent Indignation}What the hell's going on in your crazy head?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Repulsion}Don't talk to me!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Proud Disdain}I don't waste my time with troublemakers.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Seething Anger}We should have you tried, and then killed on the spot!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Seething Anger}I'm too civilized, otherwise I'd stone you to death.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Restrained Violence}I should make you pay for your crimes!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Curious}I've seen Followers of the Apocalypse in my travels before.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Admiringly}NCR Rangers deserve all my praise.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Admiringly}Is your friend one of those elite troops we've been hearing about?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Admiringly}Your merchant friend would make a fine NCR woman.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Intrigued}I've never seen a robot like that before.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Fearful Suspicion}The Supermutant's under control, I hope.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Fearful Suspicion}I've seen what those creatures do, and I don't know how you trust them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Wild Child 1}Sometimes friend, sometimes foe. No one knows what to make of you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Wild Child 2}I've heard stories about you. No one knows what you'll do next.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Wild Child 3}I'm not looking for trouble. You can ignore me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {apologetic - got in someone's way}Excuse me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Random}My feet are killing me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {low voice}It's said that you were responsible for Caesar's death.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Brotherhood destroyed}The Legionaries are pleased - an enemy called the Brotherhood of Steel is dead.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Great Khans attack everyone at Dam}The Great Khans tribe went mad. During the battle at the Dam, they attacked both the Legion and the NCR.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Camp Forlorn Hope destroyed}The Legion has won a great victory over the NCR at a place called Forlorn Hope.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mr. House Unplugged/Killed}I've heard that a great enemy of the Legion was assassinated in New Vegas.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Caesar cured}Caesar was ill, but now he lives.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Companion Reaction - Rex}How disgusting. You can see that strange mechanical mongrel's brain.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Companion Reaction - Raul}Ugh. One of the burned people walks in our camp.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Companion Reaction - ED-E}What a strange floating robot. Is it useful for anything?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Companion Reaction - Lily}What is that thing? I've never seen a blue mutant.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Rumors of Legion Veterans}I overheard some of the Legionaries say that more veterans from the eastern campaigns will be summoned to the Fort.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mr. House victory}The leader of New Vegas and his army of robots has defeated both the NCR and the Legion. What will happen now?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {NCR victory}There's talk that many of the ranking Legionaries will be beheaded for allowing the NCR to defeat the Legion yet again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Legion Veterans arriving}A great battle is coming. Many veterans of the Legion have begun arriving from the east.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Caesar dead}There are many rumors about who'll lead the Legion now that Caesar is dead.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player completed Securitron bunker mission}That was quite an explosion a while ago. We felt the ground shake!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Great Khans unaltered/helping Caesar}I've heard rumors that one of the tribes west of the river may join the Legion.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Random}The work never ends...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Random}So many tasks to attend to...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Random}I need to rest.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Thug 3}It's best if I'm not seen talking to you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Thug 2}Be careful, or you'll end up being crucified.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Thug 1}The Legionaries grumble about you. Be careful.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Hated 3}The Legionaries want to kill you. Please don't get me involved.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Hated 2}The Legion hates you. Why do you come here?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Hated 1}Please - I'll be in trouble if the Legionaries see you speaking to me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mixed 3}You're trouble, I can tell.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mixed 2}Be careful - the Legionaries aren't sure they can trust you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mixed 1}You're not quite an enemy, nor are you a friend.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Rascal 3}Your favor with the Legion grows, I've heard.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Rascal 2}Some of the Legionaries talk about you with growing respect.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Rascal 1}I'm honored to serve.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Liked 3}Someone as important as you noticing me? I'm flattered.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Liked 2}The Legionaries speak highly of you. I'm not worthy of your attention.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Liked 1}It's an honor to be noticed by one so favored by the Legion.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Random}You're a woman, and yet you wander free?{sound of contemplation, "hmm," or similar}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Rascal 1}I hear you've done some good things for the Followers.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Rascal 2}The Followers are always on the look on for new friends like yourself.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Rascal 3}I appreciate how you've been helping us so far.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Thug 2}I really don't have anything you'd want.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Thug 3}Look, I've got people to care for. I'm not looking for trouble.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Wild Child 1}I don't get you. Sometimes you help the Followers, and other times you work against us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Wild Child 2}You're an enemy of the Followers, as far as I'm concerned. I don't care how you've helped us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Wild Child 3}The Followers can't trust you, you've proven that.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Securitrons at Fort Destroyed}I never imagined Mr. House would concede to the NCR. I wonder what convinced him...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Default}When people have got nothing left, they can always turn to the Followers.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Random - Guard}The Gun Runners ought to help the Followers by donating some of that firepower they've got.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Random - Guard}{slightly complaining}Wish the Followers would get me some better armor.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Random - Guard}Stay alert.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Random - Guard}Keep an eye out for trouble.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Random - Doctor}There are so many refugees to care for.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Random - Doctor}{concerned}Medicine's running low again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Random - Doctor}All that wealth is wasted on the Strip. There are people in Freeside who need food and medicine.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Random - Doctor}I have no idea how most of these people would survive without us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Companion Reaction - Veronica}I didn't know the Brotherhood had any people out here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Companion Reaction - Rex}Look at that - a cyber-dog. There can't be many of those left.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Companion Reaction - Lily}{awe}Look at that - a friendly Nightkin. What's it doing here?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Companion Reaction - ED-E}{a bit amused}That is one battered Eyebot. It's a miracle it's still functioning.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Companion Reaction - Cass}Isn't that Cass? I heard she'd gotten out of the caravan business.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Companion Reaction - Boone}{slight awe}That's a First Recon beret. They're the best marksmen in the NCR military.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Companion Reaction - Raul}I'll never get used to the sight of ghouls.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Brotherhood of Steel Destroyed}The Brotherhood had a bunker in Hidden Valley, but it was destroyed somehow.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Kings resolve differences with NCR}I never thought I'd see the day when the NCR and the Kings started getting along.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Kings wiped out}{shock at a bloodbath}The Kings got hit hard. I don't know how many of them are still alive, if any.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Kimball Assassination Successful}President Kimball was careless and overconfident, and it got him killed.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Kimball Assassination Failed}Who would have thought someone would try to assassinate President Kimball with all those troops around?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Monorail destroyed}Did you see the monorail explode? The destruction was absolute.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Caesar dead}Caesar's death is good news for the NCR. For everyone, most likely.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mr. House unplugged/killed}No one knows how Mr. House died. His obituary didn't say anything useful.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Securitrons on the Strip Upgraded}The Securitrons in and around the Strip have been upgraded. It's almost like Vegas has an army now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player enters Lucky 38}Someone entered the Lucky 38. That's never happened before.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player foiled RACKET}Big shakeup in the management at Gomorrah. I wonder what that's about?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player killed Benny at The Tops}Someone killed Benny, the Chairmen's bigshot, in his own casino. Violence begets violence...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player assaulted The Tops}Did you hear about the shootout at The Tops?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Thug 1}We're only trying to help people, and you're not making it easy on us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Companion Reaction - Arcade}{concern for a friend}Don't let anything happen to Arcade, all right?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Overtly flirtatious, boisterous before friends}That a pretty gal! Want to share?{laughter}Ha ha ha!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We got ourselves a little Ranger family reunion now. Time's right for a feud.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Impressed}Hell of a place, huh?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Staying long?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: A veteran Ranger inspires awe. Stick around for when they get here, you'll see. If I live to earn the Black Armor, I can die a happy woman.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: First Recon's in Camp Forlorn Hope. Get some Rangers in there too and it'll be a damned impregnable fortress.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Wish I could've been there, defending Camp Forlorn Hope. Even if it didn't change anything.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Looks like we booted the Legion outta Nelson. About damn time.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: From here on out, we fight for Chief Hanlon.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: President Kimball was a tough son-of-a-gun. The Rangers'll pick up where he left off.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: President Kimball was a soldier's soldier. It's up to us to make the Legion pay for what they did.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {with esteem}You saved President Kimball, didn't you? Hell of a thing.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Don't get many chances to catch a legionary alive. Burns me up that we botched ours.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: All you need is one Ranger protecting the monorail. You don't even need to feed him that much. He'll get it done.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Wish I had a First Recon guy looking after me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hoover Dam... just thinking about it makes me nervous.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Starstruck}One of the Ranger vets looked at me and I just about surrendered.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Ranger vets are on their way from Baja. Never seen one before. But I've heard they chew nails and spit napalm.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We put our trust in Hanlon and look where it got us. Makes you wonder if we can trust anyone at all.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Chief Hanlon's watching over us now. He won't let us lose.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Scared}They got to President Kimball. How long can we hold out?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Oh my God, are you the one who saved President Kimball?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard we captured a live Centurion and then let him get away. That never would've happened if I was in charge.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: When I got this assignment I was hoping there'd be more gambling.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Patrolling the Mojave almost makes you wish for a nuclear winter.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Why don't you go join the rest of the human trash across the river?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Defiant}Come on. Give me a reason.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Shooting you right now might be worth the court-martial.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I suggest you leave.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Keep walking.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You got a lot of nerve walking around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You need to get your head straight. If you're fighting for us, act like it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're insane. We shouldn't be letting you run loose around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: How are we supposed to trust you? You're completely unpredictable.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Everything you've been up to... I just don't know what you're trying to pull.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: At least the Legion knows what they're fighting for. When are you gonna figure it out?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Why don't you pick a side? We did.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Honored to speak with you, sir.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Honored to speak with you, ma'am.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You know, if you were serving, you'd probably be halfway to general by now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Nice job out there.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Glad you're with us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey. Welcome aboard.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm not sure you should be here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You lost?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We won't go quietly. The Legion can count on that.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Sounds like we're running Primm now. I'd still rather take my leave at the Strip.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: First Recon's at Camp Forlorn Hope. Now we've got a chance to hold it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Nelson's back in our hands. I hope we can defend it this time.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Is it me, or has the Brotherhood stopped engaging us? Smartest move they ever made, you ask me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Smart move for the Kings to back down. They didn't know who they were messing with.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We signed a treaty with the Great Khans. Guess you can never have too many lowlife chem dealers on your side.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Sickens me that the Legion would try to harvest slaves from a refugee camp.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: President Kimball is lucky he escaped. I don't think we could lose him right now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Wish I could've been there to see Caesar die. What an asshole.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Monster of the East, huh? Well I've got the Monster of the West in my holster right now. Hope I get to introduce them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Got business here?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Your friend's cute - is she single?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hope Papa knew what he was doing when he left you in charge.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: A robot dog? Never seen one of those before.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Your pal's one ugly motherfucker.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Shocked, a little afraid}Holy hell, is that a Nightkin?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Slightly sarcastic}Nice robot.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You know you're traveling with a fucking murderer?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Haven't seen a Follower around here in years.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Huh?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I ought to bleed you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Fuck off and die.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Like we don't have enough problems.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Just get the fuck out of here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What the fuck are you doing showing your face here?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Why are you even here?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Crazy-ass mother fucker.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You been dosing on too many of Jack's chems?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're almost as crazy as some Fiends I know.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Sarcastic}Oh great, just who I wanted to see.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You going to fuck shit up again?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Cautious}What do you want this time?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You should have been with us in our glory days. You'd have loved it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Share a whiskey with me sometime?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I wish there were more like you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I like you, stranger. You've stood by us when not many would.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Good to see you again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Why'd you come here?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Come to gawk at the Great Khans, have you? Fuck off.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Legion and the NCR have mobilized their forces at Hoover Dam - it'll be time soon.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It's starting to feel like tensions are coming to a boil. There will be full-scale war soon.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Seems like everybody with a stake in the Mojave is gearing up for something big.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So you've been sucked into the decadence of the Strip as well, have you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Caesar's veterans are making short work of the NCR - or that's what I hear.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Soon Caesar will send in his best troops from the Arizona campaign - the NCR won't know what hit them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Those black-armored devils might be new to the Mojave, but they're butchers like all the rest.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The runners are saying that the NCR is sending in their elite shock troops to try and push back the Legion.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: NCR spreads its infection to another town, I hear.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm glad our brothers have returned home from Boulder City.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Why did you kill our brothers in Boulder City?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: More Khan brothers cut down by NCR in Boulder City. We should kill a hundred of them in response!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The 1st Recon butchers are in the field again. I'd love to head down to Forlorn hope and show them we haven't forgotten.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So the NCR makes peace with the Kings now? Where was that mercy at Bitter Springs?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Another tribe was wiped out in NCR territory? Can't say I'm surprised. I hope the surviving Kings learn from this.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Our tribe's final stand will be remembered for a thousand years!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We'll return, stronger than before!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I can't believe they're all gone.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So the Legion hit the murderers at Bitter Springs? Good.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We're not moving as many chems now that the Fiends have been taken out.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Diane's going nuts trying to find a new contact in the Fiends now that Motor Runner's dead.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Typical - even within their highest ranks, the NCR is corrupt.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So, the big bad chief ranger couldn't take the pressure, huh? Good.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If I knew who killed Kimball, I'd buy him a drink.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If you're going to assassinate the president of the NCR, you could at least do it right.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Why the hell would you stop someone from killing Kimball?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If you ask me, a true warrior wouldn't let himself be captured at all - but busting that Legionnaire out of McCarran was an impressive stunt.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I would have thought the monorail bombing would slow the NCR down more.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Whoever blew up that monorail is a damn hero.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Karl's been in a shitty mood since that big explosion at the Fort.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Word's spreading that Caesar is dead. No one seems to know much about how, though.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Caesar can rot in hell for all I care.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Not many get the favor of Caesar - even Papa hasn't been to the Fort.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Rumor from the Strip is that House is dead. I hope the old bastard choked on his own tongue.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Mr. House isn't a man to be trusted. Watch yourself.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard from one of Melissa's runners that that check-coated bastard got thrown out on his ass.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Papa says "cut off the head and the snake will die." I guess the Chairmen's days are numbered.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I remember the Chairmen from their tribal days. They were punks then, they're punks now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You really killed Caesar himself? Maybe he's not the mighty warrior Karl said he was.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're the one who killed Kimball! If we had a bar here, I'd buy you a drink!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We're fighting for the NCR now? I don't know about that....
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You don't seem to take a hint. Get out of my face.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Antler says you are the one killing my kin. Antler says you must die!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I... don't know how to thank you for bringing Rhonda back to me, stranger.|Here, take this. I won't be needing it anymore.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Good work, human. Maybe now this place can rest in peace.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: There's nothing for you here, human, though it is always good to see you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've done what I can. The rest is up to you, human.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This is a dangerous place, human - especially for your kind! I suggest you turn back. There's nothing good waiting for you further on.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Still hanging about?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, you've interrupted my broadcast, dumb-dumb - so there had better be a good reason! What is it?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: A pleasant surprise to see you made it. I'm ready to get started if you are.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We shouldn't wait much longer. Are you ready?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: There's an intruder in the dish hut! Get over there and kill whoever it is, you fools!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I don't even remember where we were going, but It'll be good to travel around with Rhonda again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Howdy pardner! Welcome to the Vikki and Vance Casino and Museum.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This is a restricted area. Step away immediately.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Go to hell.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Little sad}I'm heading back West. You won't see me again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Found 1st Caravan, a little sickened, looking at destroyed caravan}God, there's almost nothing left. Looks like whoever it was - was just in the mood for killing.|Most of the cargo's ash, too - not burned, looks like... disintegrated. When I heard the reports, I assumed "ash" meant "burned."|So close to the Vegas wall, too, don't that beat all. Must have happened during the day, though, they hadn't made a camp.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Prompt after 1st Caravan Found}You know what, what happened to my caravan - not the first time I've heard about an attack like that.|One of our caravans got hit back a few months back, and the caravan'd been burned, too, along with the cargo.|I wonder if he made the same mistake, and that other caravan got hit with energy weapons, too.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Found 2nd Caravan}More energy weapons hit this caravan. Place has been picked clean. |This... is Brotherhood level murder here. But they don't do things like that. This was done with a purpose.|Let's poke around a bit, see what we can find. Might be something in the wreckage.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Prompt after 2nd Caravan Found}What's that? Looks like a map - got the route along the West of Vegas, and...|...they've marked another spot. Over here, along this stretch. That's fucked up - middle of nowhere.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Found 3rd Site}Another caravan burned. Except someone made camp here - and I never heard about this attack.|Let's look around, something stinks.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Final}That does it, that's all I need to know.|Crimson Caravan and the Van Graffs... they were behind burning these caravans, and they've got to answer for them.|I'm going to get some extra ammo, a few bottles of whiskey, then show them how Cassidys settle accounts.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {In Combat, gritting teeth, slight reprimand}Voices down, eyes up.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Alt: Enemies near}Keep your voice down, we got movement out there.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {In Combat, dismissive}Save the sweettalk for when the shooting's done.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Warning 3}You and me we're done traveling together. I want nothing more to do with you.|I thought there was a {emph}chance you'd change - {shakes head}not any longer, being a fucker is who you are.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Warning 2}Guess my last warning didn't sink in too well. Things don't change, and soon, I'm gone.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Warning 1}You are {emph}such an asshole sometimes.|Look, maybe you were like this before I signed up with you, but if you keep acting this way, I'm not going to stick around much longer.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Are you fucking high right now? God, I can smell it from here. {Beat}Keep that shit away from me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Uneasy, in Lucky 38 casino}Ready to leave yet? This place puts my teeth on edge.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Teasing, actually happy to see the player}Well, now, look what rolled in. What, you getting lonely out there?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Irritated}If you say you're going to gather evidence, then kill the bitches anyway, at least tell me when you change your mind.|Now, if you're done fucking around, let's settle accounts the old-fashioned way.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Killed Van Graffs, grim, but happy}Just trimmed the Van Graff family tree, I think Freeside'll breathe a little easier now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Killed an entire camp of Crimson Caravan, grim, but happy}And that's it for the Crimson Caravan.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Gave evidence, quest end. A little doubtful}Well, that's settled... I suppose.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Prompt for Political Manuevering}You find any "evidence" yet? I'm not going to wait forever.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Prompt for first caravan}Well, now that I'm free of the Outpost, was wondering if you'd mind making a detour.|I'd like to pay my respects to the end of Cassidy Caravans, check out the site where they died.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Story Stage 0 + Checkers, Eager}We find this "friend" of yours, looking forward to adding some red to that checkered suit of his.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Story Stage 0 + !Benny}Why the hell we wandering so much anyway? Nothing against the Mojave except the dust, heat, and scorpions, but...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Story Stage 0 + Benny}We find this "friend" Benny of yours, looking forward to rattling his cage.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Story Stage 10, to herself}Never thought I'd pass the Vegas wall. Never seen so many lights in one place before.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Howdy, pardner! Doesn't look like you've brought back the Platinum Chip!|Why don't you mosey on back to wherever it is you left Benny cooling off? Come back when you got it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lucky38VictorEntrance "Victor" [CREA:00112073]

text_content: Sorry, pardner, but the boss ain't available to take a meeting!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Howdy, pardner! Good to see you again!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lucky38VictorEntrance "Victor" [CREA:00112073]

text_content: Congratulations, pardner! The boss has instructed me to comp you to the High-Roller Suite!|You can bring your friends, too! Be like a little clubhouse for the gang you put together!|Just bear in mind, you're the only one gets to see the boss! Any friends you got, they can wait in the suite.|Enjoy the digs, pardner! They're plenty fancy!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lucky38VictorEntrance "Victor" [CREA:00112073]

text_content: What floor, pardner?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Where to, pardner?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Which floor, now?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {announcing elevator stops}Penthouse floor!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {announcing elevator stops}Cocktail lounge!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {announcing elevator stops}High-roller suite!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {announcing elevator stops}Casino floor!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {announcing elevator stops}B2! Physical Plant!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {announcing elevator stops}B2! Facilities Management!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {player trying to go to penthouse with companions}Sorry, pardner, if you're heading for the penthouse, you gotta go alone.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {attacking player who has betrayed House}You low-down snake! I wish {Ida}I'd have left you in the ground to rot!|{starting attack}Draw!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Small Fry}Hey, hey! Look who has the hot hands?{Friendly} Here, have something special on the house.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Big Winner}Looks like someone is on a roll. {Sing-song}Luck be a lady tonight. Here's a little something from the Family.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Whale}You keep on spending money in here.{Mock Jocking} You gotta give us a chance to win something back. Here's something nice for you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Banned}Ok, that's that. No more games for you. Go rob the Tops. You're done here.|Have some drinks, talk to some dancers but you are done at my tables.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hnh - didn't even hear you come up the ramp. {Beat}You don't broadcast your movements. I like that.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vMojaveGhost "Keep Your Eyes on the Prize" [QUST:00144124]

text_content: {Curious, but not in a nice way, more wtf}Hnh. Heard your footsteps coming up the ramp, didn't sound like a trooper or one of the merchants.|You a Courier? If so, this might be your lucky day... if you don't mind walking a bit {emph}and your eyes are good.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vMojaveGhost "Keep Your Eyes on the Prize" [QUST:00144124]

text_content: Well, that's a start. But I don't reckon you came to me to learn to fight sarsaparilla bottles.|Tell you what. I gotta go chase geckos away from our water supply anyway. Darn critters are attracted to it. Why don't you come along?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thank goodness you're here. My squad needs help.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

quest: vMojaveGhost "Keep Your Eyes on the Prize" [QUST:00144124]

text_content: Well howdy.

text_content: {Story Stage 20, wary}Not sure who this friend of yours is, but if he's looking down on Vegas, he's either God or the moon.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Nothing like turning a snake's trap on itself. That Benny's a slippery fucker, but you one-upped him, all right.

speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Can't tell you how glad I am you butchered the Fiends. Caravans across the wastes are going to be buying you drinks for years.

text_content: {Story Stage 30, Default}Sure hope you know what you're doing, Mojave's getting tense.

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Story Stage 30, House, wary}If someone promised me all the lights of Vegas, I'd consider it, too... but I wouldn't say yes until I saw what was behind the curtain.

text_content: {Story Stage 40}Mojave's almost buzzing like a Cazador now... must be all the blood Legion and NCR are spilling over the Colorado.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Story Stage 50}Guess there's no turning back now, it's war. If Hoover Dam's where it's going to go down, better make it count.

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome back. Please don't kill me. I'll give you a real nice price on everything.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So I heard you helped take over Nelson from the Legion. Glad to see someone making a difference around here instead of just complaining.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thanks again for finding those supplies. I've already started putting them to good use.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If it isn't the guy that saved President Kimball. We owe you a big debt of gratitude. If Kimball died, I don't know what would have happened.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If it isn't the gal that saved President Kimball. We owe you a big debt of gratitude. If Kimball died, I don't know what would have happened.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I can't believe that President Kimball is dead. If I could get my hands on the people that did this I'd rip their heads off with my bare hands.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I can't believe someone tried to assassinate President Kimball. I'm just glad he's still alive. We need a guy like him around.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Are you new? No one told me about any new troops showing up. {irritated}This is just great, we get new troops and no new supplies for them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I didn't expect someone as famous as you here. What can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Nice to see a friendly face around here. We don't get many visitors of your esteem. Something I can do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You better watch yourself around here. I'm not going to put up with any crazy shit.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Didn't expect someone like you around here. What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {gruff}What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If it isn't the guy that defeated the Legion at Nelson. I can't thank you enough, morale around here has never been higher.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If it isn't the gal that defeated the Legion at Nelson. I can't thank you enough, morale around here has never been higher.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Whoa, didn't you save President Kimball? Glad to have someone like you here!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard President Kimball almost got killed at Hoover Dam. That would have been a big blow to morale around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Did you hear President Kimball was killed? The guys here aren't taking it very well.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: New guy, eh? The more the merrier around here!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: New gal, eh? The more the merrier around here!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're not going to do anything crazy here, are you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Uh... is there something I can help you with?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, I don't think it's a good idea for you to be here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What brings someone like you here?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Go away, human.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: For as lack of adornment is said to become some women, so will this place, without your presence, bring delight.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've run out of witty ways to tell you to leave, so why don't you just go?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If you want to talk, take off that ridiculous Legion uniform. It's insulting.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hi. If you're looking for medical help, try the other doctors. I'm just a researcher. Not even a particularly good one.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What's up?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Well, we've had some laughs, you and I, but it looks like you're a crazy person and I'm going to have to leave.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Moreno took the fall of the Enclave hard. He never questioned his orders, never questioned the legitimacy of what the Enclave was doing.|To him, it was all one unbroken chain, from Washington to Richardson. When we left Navarro, I remember looking up at Moreno.|He said, "Kiss America goodbye, boys." When we left the Enclave behind, the love in him burned itself out. Now there's just a bitter old man left.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Since my mother died, Daisy's been the only woman in my life. She was the only other woman close to my father, too.|She flew him out on over a dozen missions, including his last. I've always been close to Daisy.|There have been some good men along the way, but lovers make poor confidants. Daisy never had children of her own, so she was always there to listen.|Being in the Enclave didn't mean much to her. She just loved to fly. It broke her heart to be grounded.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Doc Henry always was a hard one to figure out. It didn't seem to matter whether he was working with humans or dogs.|He had an equal lack of affection for both. A regular {dai-ah-jen-eez}Diogenes. I'm not sure what the man was after.|"Knowledge is power," but to what end for Henry, I have no idea. The problem was what mattered to him, not its practical impact.|He simply solved riddles because they existed.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If I had to pick anyone who didn't belong in the Enclave, it would definitely be Johnson. He hated what the Enclave was doing.|Day to day, week to week, he would question orders, subvert mission objectives, do anything he could to serve without serving.|It's amazing he was never court-martialed. He always had good things to say about my father. Said I was like him in a lot of ways. I wish I knew.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Judah Kreger is the glue that's kept us all together over the years, and with good reason.|Anyone who can command Moreno and Johnson in the same unit without somebody getting fragged is one hell of a leader.|Kreger was polite and kind, but never warm. He always did his best to make me feel welcome in the group.|I think he did it out of a sense of loyalty to my father. Loyalty means a lot to Judah.|Not loyalty to the Enclave, or even the ideals they fought for, but to the people who served with him.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'd like to say that I saw this coming, but honestly I was oblivious. {sheepish}For what it's worth, I'll do what I can to help you... not get killed?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So Mr. House doesn't care that one of Caesar's most notorious Legion spies is walking around on the Strip.|Either that or his Securitrons' AI is too primitive to recognize the threat. Neither answer is particularly comforting.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {sarcastic, in response to being ignored by another Follower}Oh, hello Emily. Yes, it is I, Arcade Gannon, fellow member of the Followers of the Apocalypse.|Would I like to help infiltrate the Lucky 38{casino}? I'm so glad you asked...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That's a lot of energy weapons. Brings back some interesting memories.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Strip's not a bad place if you love terrible things and people. {a bit sad, annoyed}I'll never understand the allure of giving away your money to the rich.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've read about REPCONN. I think they did some work with the... {catching himself, was about to say "Enclave"} the government before the war. Rockets and some energy weapon prototypes, I think.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Westside, huh? I passed through here with another Follower a while back, Anderson. The locals were having a lot of trouble getting water through.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Westside, huh? I heard about what happened with Anderson. Can't say I'm surprised. He was always a fringe operator in the Followers.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {exasperated}What's wrong with you? Killing Anderson isn't going to bring Corporal White back.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Interesting way of handling things. Very {soob}sub {roh-sah}rosa.|I don't know if the Scorpions deserved to be wiped out for something they didn't do, but that's one less problem Westside has to deal with.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Anderson turned in for the wrong reason and Westside gets to keep siphoning water.|It's hard to find justice in all of this, but I suppose this is as close as it gets. Thanks.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Extortion? Really? You go through all of this only to extort the people who are trying to help Westside? Unbelievable.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hildern is a good example of "big picture" obsession gone too far.|At some point he became so fixated on large scale results that he lost the concept of "the common good" along the way.|It's an inhumane kind of public service when people and the basic resources they need become numbers in a ledger.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: A vertibird. Interesting. It's been a long time since I've seen one of these.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Wait, wait, wait a second. What's going on? Am I playing Vergil to your Dante?|I'd like to assume that we're tiptoeing into the mouth of hell out of academic curiosity, but I'm not so open-minded that I've lost my brains.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I guess I'll wait out here, then.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I need to talk to you about something, if you have a minute.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thanks for doing this, getting them all back together again.|I'll be honest, when Moreno started going off, I didn't think we'd all be walking out of there in one piece.|I still don't know how this is all going to shake out in the end, but at least the Enclave can atone a bit for all the damage it's done.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I shouldn't be surprised at what happened with Moreno. I hoped that after all this time, he could put his anger behind him.|Maybe everything good in Orion Moreno died at Navarro and it was foolish to think there was anything in him left to salvage.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You got the survivors of the Enclave back together so you could convince them to help Caesar?!|What are you thinking? Do you {emph}want to see Vegas turned into the new slave capital of the west?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey. You're your own person and all that, but you're acting crazy, and if you keep it up, I'm going to leave.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I like how you handled that. Nicely done.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I can't say that's how {emph.}I would have handled that, but...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're that courier, right? The guy who runs the Tops, Benny... heard he tried to kill you.|I guess that didn't work out very well for him. {joking}Should I watch my back around you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Oh, you're that courier, aren't you? The one who got mixed up with Benny over at the Tops. Sounds like messy business.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm no botanist, but I think this {emph}may not be entirely natural.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Nuclear waste disposal. Pre-War, people figured there was so much desert in Nevada, you might as well turn it into a big dumping ground.|People didn't like it, but they weren't about to give up easy access to power, not with all of the petroleum drying up.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It's a shame what happened up here. I understand arguments about the "fog of war", but that can't be much consolation to the survivors.|{sadly}Or to the NCR soldiers who have to live with what they did here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: In case it's not obvious, I think you should redirect the power to Freeside and outer Vegas.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You activated ARCHIMEDES?! What the hell are you thinking?!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Nicely done. I'm sure people will appreciate the power. I hate to have to rely on it, but out here... it makes a big difference.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hmm. I suppose an even distribution is better than nothing.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Everything to the Strip and McCarran? Are you kidding? {sighs}|{irritated}I guess I should be grateful you didn't activate the laser.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You have to hand it to the NCR. Get enough hands working together and they can make or break just about anything.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm not exactly a mercenary, but taking out scumbags of this magnitude wouldn't cause me to lose any sleep.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Well, I'll be. Hoover Dam. One of the last remaining {emph}functioning wonders of the Pre-War world.|I'm amazed it's still running at all. Too bad everyone's killing each other over it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What a load of Brahmin shit! Can you believe that guy?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey hey, fella, welcome to the Tops Hotel and Casino! I'm going to have to ask you to hand over any weapons you might be carrying.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VTopsGreeter1 "Chairman Greeter" [NPC_:00128586]

text_content: Hey hey, baby doll, welcome to the Tops Hotel and Casino! I'm going to have to ask you to hand over any weapons you might be carrying.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VTopsGreeter1 "Chairman Greeter" [NPC_:00128586]

text_content: Enjoying your stay?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VTopsGreeter1 "Chairman Greeter" [NPC_:00128586]

text_content: {Chomps Lewis Top Level Topics}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hold up! There are Deathclaws all over the damn place north of here. I'd turn back if I were you.|If you want to get to New Vegas, you're better off heading east from Primm and then looping north. It's a heck of a lot safer.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Can't believe anyone actually made it through from the north, what with all the Deathclaws at the quarry. You returning from New Vegas?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You need something?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Let me ask you a question - what's the tastiest thing you've ever eaten?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This is incredibly good. Here's your omelet, and the recipe if you ever want to make your own. It takes a bit of skill to get it tasting right.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey there. What's new?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That's close enough. What do you want with the Great Khans?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Nice outfit, but I know you're not one of us. What do you want with the Great Khans?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {somewhat hostile, untrusting}What do you want now?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {respectful, almost friendly}How's it going?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, hey. What can Tyrone do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I had an amazing time with you. You can look me up any time, baby.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, hey. You're back.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <whuff>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <snuffle!>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You've done a good turn for the NCR and now we'd like to do one for you - here's an NCR emergency two-way radio - you call and we'll come running. |You're not alone out here - the NCR has your back. Stay safe and good hunting.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Yeah?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: Heavens to Betsy, but Mr. Benny met a nasty end. I hope you've realized, pumpkin, that crime doesn't pay.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: My, but that Lucky 38 is a large building. And so fancy!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: Leo doesn't like that you left that House man alive, dearie. He thinks you should have let us chop him.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: You should have heard Leo, sweetie. He laughed and laughed when that old man in the box exploded.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: Leo thinks there will be lots more chopping to do now that Caesar is dead. I do hope you'll be careful, pumpkin.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: {Gramma}Grandma's so proud of her little pumpkin, rescuing the President like that!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: Now sweetie, if at first you don't succeed, try, try again. That goes for learning to ride bikes and killing Presidents!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: {Gramma}Grandma's so proud of her little pumpkin, assassinating the President like that!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: Leo's very grumpy, pumpkin. He wanted to chop the President!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: Look at you, sweetness! Blowing up a robot army all by yourself, isn't that precious?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: {Gramma}Grandma's so worried about her little baby! It's getting dangerous out there in the Wasteland!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: Leo's getting more and more agitated, sweetie. I think he can smell the fight coming.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: I hope you're not thinking about rushing off to that big dam, pumpkin! It's sure to be very dangerous!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Humbly at your service.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Please, ma'am - take pity on us. Free us, I'm begging you!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Please, sir - take pity on us. Free us, please!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That business at the Tops could never happen here. We don't admit that sort of riff-raff.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I know Benny was murdered, but if you ask me, the real crime was that checkered jacket.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: A little bird told me Benny might be gone for good. He must've been in some delightful scandal to have run off so suddenly.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Amused}Those Omertas. Always plotting, never relevant. Bravo for putting them in their place like that.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Impressed}Word has it you were spotted entering the Lucky 38. How ever did you get on that guest list?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Is it me or do the Securitrons seem... sassier?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Such a shame about Mr. House. He used to send a Securitron to our dinner parties sometimes, like an uninvited but harmless uncle.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: There's a rumor going around that you killed Caesar! I'm dying to know... is it true? That he used a hairpiece, I mean?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Caesar may be dead, but I think the toga is here to stay. You simply can't buy better thigh accentuation.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Kings will be missed. Not by me, of course. But who will buy the food at the Tops now that no one needs it to grease their hair?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It sounds like the Kings made nice with the NCR in Freeside. Seems there was room for two flies on the same bit of dung after all.

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mildly impressed}I've been sending requests for relief for months now. Didn't think they'd send you, though.
