text_content: {Less than thrilled} I really hope you're not here to cause trouble.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: {Uncertain}Oh. I've heard of you. What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: {Cold}I'll give you this, you've got a lot of guts just walking in here like this.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: {Stiff, really doesn't like the player}What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: {Frustrated, busy}If this isn't a crisis situation, you'd better have a damn good reason for interrupting me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: Anything else I can do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: Sharing knowledge with an outsider organization. I knew Veronica couldn't be trusted. |We tracked your movements a long way. But it was worth it to catch her in the act.|Passing Brotherhood secrets to outsiders is the lowest form of treason. What have you got to say for yourself?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMS49PaladinLeader "Brotherhood of Steel Paladin" [NPC_:0014EFB7]

text_content: We heard Veronica talking with the Elder. We won't stand for this.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMS49PaladinLeader "Brotherhood of Steel Paladin" [NPC_:0014EFB7]

text_content: What is this? Veronica brings an outsider into our home, then has a private audience with the Elder?|The two of you may have the Elder fooled, but we know better.|Veronica has always twisted the Founder's principles to her own ends. We will not stand idly by and allow her to corrupt our Elder's thinking.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMS49PaladinLeader "Brotherhood of Steel Paladin" [NPC_:0014EFB7]

text_content: Leave me alone.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, you got a second?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'd slap him around, but he stood at my parents' wedding.|Plus he used to make excuses to get me out of my punishment when I'd slept through Head Scribe Taggart's lectures. Figure I owe him for that.|<Sighs> He means well.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'd be angrier with him, but it's hard to stay mad at the guy who taught me how to box when all the other Paladins told me no.|<Sighs> He always does what he feels is right. Usually that's a great quality.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Let's see what we've got here... Okay, yeah, this is the one I was thinking of. The pulse gun.|Although maybe the rangefinder could work too. And it looks like the NCR was onto some miracle farming technology.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Defeated}He wouldn't listen. The truth was right there staring him in the face. How could he not listen?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Disbelieving}God. {Then, saddened}I should get used to this, I guess. People get desperate, they turn on each other. First thing to go is trust.|I don't think it's ever gonna be the same for me in there. Knowing no matter what I do, it's gonna end badly.|But they're all I have.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Remorseful}God, I did this. This was my fault. Why didn't I see this coming?|Of course they'd track me. Of course they'd assume the worst. Sure, I left them. But that didn't mean I'd ever be free of them.|I should've known I was beaten before I began. I just... I had to try, you know?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Well, if there was any question whether I should leave, I guess there's my answer.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Horrified}Why did you do that? They were going to let us walk away. Why did you attack them?|I don't care that they started it. What you did was inexcusable. You need to go.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Clearly you're determined to fight the Brotherhood. Well, you can add my name to your hit list because you're on your own.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Okay, listen. The Brotherhood... they're not always the friendliest bunch. But I won't stand for you fighting them.|This is your last chance.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: See? Pretty addictive, right? You do it once, it just makes you want to do it more.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You can't help but notice that the Brotherhood barely exists to these people out here. We're like an urban myth. No real presence on the Outside.|We just don't adapt like we should. Used to be that all you needed to get your way was a suit of power armor and a laser rifle.|Now... people are armed and organized. They're not afraid. But we still stick to our old approach, because it's all we know.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You know, I've been thinking. The real problem with the Brotherhood is that we isolate ourselves.|Our training is top-notch, our technology gives us an advantage, but when it all comes down to it, we're losing because we shun the outside world.|We always make enemies, never allies. We refuse to recruit outsiders, or see the value in their simpler technologies.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hold on. I see something I want to punch.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: No offense, but you look like you've traveled a long way down some bad roads. Where'd you come from?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Couldn't get enough of talking to me the first time, huh?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Listen... I want to thank you for helping me out. I'm sorry that... things didn't go like I'd hoped.|But at least I got the chance to try. At least I know for sure that there was nothing I could do.|Thank you for giving me that chance.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Wow, Mr. House is looking for you, huh? What do you think he wants? Bowling partner?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What'd you think of Mr. House? I was surprised he only had the two robot sex slaves.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That chip of yours... I wouldn't wager it on blackjack.|Unless the dealer has a five or six showing.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Whole future of New Vegas seems like it's up in the air. Guess I should wait things out before buying a condo in the Ultra-Luxe, huh?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hope you're picking the winning side here. Be nice to fight for someone who's gonna be around for a while.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Next stop, Hoover Dam, huh? When we get there... can we stop by the souvenir shop? Their beaver mascot is just precious.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What's up?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Rex Top Level Topic Holder}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {in combat}<bark! bark!>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {player has a hat equipped}<growl...>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {in Mojave, player has Wild Wasteland}<aroo!>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Rex not cured}<whimper>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Rex cured, initial}<happy bark!>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Rex cured, return}<pant pant pant>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Get you a drink?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: vTopsBartenderRandom "Bartender" [NPC_:00129550]

text_content: If you're looking for supplies I'll make this easy for you... there aren't any.|But something tells me you're not here for that. What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've told you Powder Gangers everything I know! Please don't hit me anymore!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: PrimmDeputy "Deputy Beagle" [NPC_:000D7F57]

text_content: {Small Fry}Looks like you've hit a lucky streak there. You must be thirsty by now - here, have a drink on the house and keep on playing!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Well look at that! You aren't a Powder Ganger after all. I'd suggest against wearing that outfit around the townsfolk. You may get shot by accident.|I don't suppose you came here to rescue me?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: PrimmDeputy "Deputy Beagle" [NPC_:000D7F57]

text_content: I don't suppose you came here to rescue me? I'd cross my fingers but my hands are numb.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: PrimmDeputy "Deputy Beagle" [NPC_:000D7F57]

text_content: I apologize, wanderer, but I must go tend to my flock!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I waited to speak with you one last time before I descended to the launch pad, wanderer. |I want you to know that we will remember for all eternity how you delivered us to the threshold of the Great Journey.|Our preparations are nearly complete, but the rockets that will carry us to salvation are yet missing vital components.|If you would still help us, wanderer, speak to Chris. He can tell you what is missing.|There is no way that we can thank you enough, wanderer. Your arrival here was a blessing. We will remember you always.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Forgive me, wanderer, but my flock awaits.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Is the way clear?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Will you help us, wanderer?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The NCR takes care of its own - so in thanks for your service to the Republic{pause while handing over a radio}... here's one of our emergency two-way radios. |You call and we'll come running. {pause}If you're too far from an NCR outpost there won't be much we can do for you... |but then the NCR is just about everywhere these days. Good luck and stay safe out there.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: For your service, beyond the call of duty, the NCR would like to award you with this emergency two-way radio. |You call and we'll send you any support we can spare. Keep up the good work, soldier.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The NCR would like to thank you for your service. If you ever need us, just call and we'll come running. |The NCR takes care of its own... and its supporters. Stay safe out there and call us if you get in a jam.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Radio transmission}Coordinates for supply cache in your region being sent... now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Radio transmission}Received - updating map marker for local NCR supply cache.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Radio transmission}This is NCR Operator - message received - sending map marker for local supply cache.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: How is your visit with us going, stranger?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You have done well to earn the trust of my people, child.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hello, friend. How can Mother Pearl be of help today?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So you're the outsider. Lived your whole life out there, huh? Wow.|I always thought you savages probably spoke a different language, but I hear you sound like us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thank you for getting Janet to Nellis. I've never been so happy in my entire life!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This has been a dream come true to work on the Lady. I don't think I've seen Loyal this frisky in years.{test}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've never been so happy in my entire life!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Have you seen her? The redhead of my dreams?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hi! I can't believe I'm going to meet my red-headed lady soon! I'm really nervous about it!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player responsible for the death of his love}Go to hell, outsider. Stay away from me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're a terrible person! I loved her! And you let her run right into our killzone. Why didn't you stop her?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey there. Back for more?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Whoa there, pal. You better slow down, or you'll get blown up like the rest of the idiots who thought they'd scavenge in Boomer territory.|Now that I've got your attention, might you be interested in a little information? It'll cost you, but it's well worth the investment.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome back. Have you reconsidered my offer?{test}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I told you what you need to know. Now get moving!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Jumpin' Jesus on a pogo stick! You're the first one to make it through alive, let alone manage a return trip!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That was pretty incredible. I've never seen anyone come out of the Boomer's rain of death alive before.{test}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey there lady! Can you help me find Mister Cuddles?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey there mister! Can you help me find Mister Cuddles?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hi again! Have you found Mister Cuddles?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thanks again for finding Mister Cuddles! You're the best!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I can't believe Mister Cuddles is gone.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Pearl sent word saying it's all right to tell you about the Lady in the water.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Isn't that bomber a beauty? Thanks so much for making an old man's dreams come true.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It's going to be a dream come true once you've raised that bomber from Lake Mead!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Good work with those solar arrays.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hope Pearl knows what she's doing, letting you wander around Nellis as you please.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What is it, Outsider?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {fall-through greeting, friendly}Hello, Outsider, need something?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {to the sentry}I'll take this from here!|{to player, commanding}I'm Raquel, Master-At-Arms for the Nellis homeland. Mother Pearl, our Eldest, wishes to speak to you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hello, friend. {player raised the B-29 and delivered it to Nellis}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Mother Pearl's instructions are clear. You can move freely around Nellis, and artillery spotters have orders not to fire on you.|These are extraordinary privileges. Don't abuse them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What is it, savage?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What's the situation with the giant ants?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I see the power's back on. The ants are all dead?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What is it, Outsider?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I know Mother Pearl is letting you wander Nellis as you please, Outsider, but I have patients to tend to.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If I haven't said it before, Outsider, let me say it now - welcome to Nellis. Word from Pearl is that you're to be greeted as a friend.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You raised the Lady from the Lake! The future is looking up. How can I help you, Outsider?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Yes, Outsider?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Woah! You're the outsider! What are you doing here?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey! Do they have any toys outside of here? I sure could use something fun.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Roar! {Roars like a dinosaur}I'm a dinosaur!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This is mission control, ready for liftoff. What's your 5 by 5?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Halt! You must pay the toll to pass!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Put up your dukes! I'm the Red-Brick Kid!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I am La Fantoma! I will fly to the side of injustice!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're back. When you walked off in the middle of our people's story, I thought you must be bored.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You killed Mother Pearl! Get out of here, outsider!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You killed Loyal! Get out of here, outsider!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're the outsider! Mother Pearl sent word that you'd be stopping by. You must be eager to hear the story of our people!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard about what you've done around here, and I have nothing to say to you, outsider.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: People around here are a bit upset with you, outsider, but I think there is hope for you yet.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've seen the bomber! It's... spectacular. The mural is coming true - thanks to you!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Were you interested in hearing the story of our people any time soon, perhaps?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Now that you know the story of our people, you must have all sorts of questions!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: How can I help you, Outsider?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hold it right there! Don't you move!|How the hell did you survive that bombardment?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I still can't believe how you ran through that artillery barrage.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Yes, Outsider?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're interrupting class, Outsider.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Yeah?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hungry for grub?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome to Jacobstown, human. You're free to walk around, just don't stare at the Nightkin. They don't like people looking at them.|{A little quieter, more confidentially}And if you're NCR, keep it to yourself. They're not popular around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Got a problem, could use your help. Been having trouble with NCR mercs harassing the town, and they just showed up again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I knew you'd make it. Resourceful, as always.|The override module is functioning properly. I'm rerouting power to the Securitron vault at the Fort as we speak...|I just need you to head over to the east power plant and manually activate the switch.|When you return topside, I think you'll see that my Securitron army is a little more than the Legion was prepared to handle.|Oh, and before you go - grab that print-out spooling from the console here - those papers set the terms for the NCR's unconditional surrender.|I thought you might enjoy the honor of presenting them to the NCR's commanding officer, once the Legion has been defeated. Cheers!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Oh, what do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Aha. The brave photographer returns. Good to see you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Still afraid}Now that you have all you care for, please... leave, and don't come back!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Deeply Saddened}I can't talk, not after what happened to Sarah. I feel... so cold.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You shouldn't be here. If people know we talked, they'll suspect you.|And if whoever did this smells a rat, they'll have the Legion after both of us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That's it, then. How did you know?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If there's one thing I won't tolerate, it's working with some dog of the Legion. You've got some explaining to do.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: I told you I wouldn't work against the NCR. I meant it.|I'm out of here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Still helping the Legion. You're gonna get what's coming to you. I promise you that.|We're through working together.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Look, I know the NCR has problems, but I fought with those men. I'll be damned before I betray them.|This stops right now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We can chat later. The sooner you finish these tests the sooner you can get out of here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: You're the courier I've heard so much about. My squad needs your assistance.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So any word on my friends?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED LEGION.>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {FIRST TALK, BAD NCR REP}{appraising}So I finally get to meet the courier who's caused so much trouble for the New California Republic.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {FIRST TALK}So I finally get to meet the courier who's accomplished so much in so little time. That is why I summoned you here, right?|I mean, a man nearly kills you, and your response is to track him across the breadth of the Mojave?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {FIRST TALK}The question is... are you ready to get started?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Down the hill, at the west edge of camp, is an old building. It was here when the Fort was taken in 2277.|Inside the building is a hatch, and inside that hatch are two steel doors that bear the {SIH-jihl}sigil of the Lucky 38 casino.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Now that same sigil is on the Platinum Chip Benny was carrying when we captured him. Isn't that interesting?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Now that same sigil is on the Platinum Chip you were carrying. Isn't that interesting?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Even more interesting, there's a slot about the same size as the Chip on the console that opens the hatch. So you know what I think?|I think the Platinum Chip opens those doors - doors that can't be pried open or drilled open or blasted open. Because all that, I tried.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {BEFORE VAULT DESTROYED}We'll talk again when you've destroyed whatever is down in that bunker - not before.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {AFTER VAULT DESTROYED}I felt the ground shake a while ago. I'll take that as a sign you got the job done.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: There are rewards for doing as I command. Today, your reward is vengeance. You get to decide how Benny dies.|Go to Benny, let him know what you've decided. My Praetorians will perform the execution - {giving player credit}unless you want to perform it yourself.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We have nothing to discuss until you've dealt with Benny.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm sure you found Benny's demise pleasing. The destruction of an enemy... there are few things more satisfying.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Let's press on, shall we? As I was telling you before, I want Mr. House out of the picture.|You have an interest in his death, too. If he knows that you destroyed his {for lack of a better term}gadgets beneath the Fort, he will strike back.|You know where to find him. How he dies, I leave up to you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Until Mr. House has been dealt with, you and I have nothing to talk about.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've read Mr. House's obituary. Had a high opinion of himself, didn't he?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {seething}I spent months feeding the Omertas bribes, nursing their betrayal, and you've ruined all that.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {seething}Do you have any idea how much effort it took to place a mole at McCarran who could plant that bomb on the monorail? The one you defused?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {seething}The garrison I placed at Nelson served a vital strategic function. Did you think you could wipe it out and I wouldn't find out?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {seething}Weeks were spent convincing the Great Khans to join the Legion, but you've ruined all that. {louder}Haven't you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: With Mr. House out of the way, I can focus on smoothing out a few {slight beat}lingering complications elsewhere in the Mojave.|First up are the Boomers of Nellis Air Force Base, a tribe so reclusive, it lobs artillery shells at anyone who comes near their settlement.|I want you to offer them an alliance with my Legion. My terms are simple: target their guns against the NCR side of the dam when I assault it...|...and they can keep their freedom. If you find they aren't amenable to this offer, destroy them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It's reached me that you killed Silus before he could talk. I approve.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I understand that you freed Silus before he could talk. I approve.|Silus dishonored himself when he let himself be captured, and he'll pay the price for that. But the NCR didn't learn anything valuable.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Have you brought news of the Boomers?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {SUDDEN PAIN}I would've asked you to forge an alliance with the White Glove Society, but you've already killed its leaders. So instead - |{sudden, excruciating pain in head}{gritting teeth}Ehhhh! Goddammit!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {SUDDEN PAIN}I want you to forge an alliance between Caesar's Legion and the White Glove Society.|They used to be cannibals. I expect that information can be used to manipulate them. Go to -{stopping short as pain eplodes inside head}|{sudden, excruciating pain in head}{gritting teeth}Ehhhh! Goddammit!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {limping off to bed, head feels like it's being crushed}Goddammit, go away! Come back when I've had some sleep!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {head feels like it's being crushed}I warned you not to bother me!|Praetorians, kill this asshole!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {recovered from yesterday's sudden headache}The last time we met, I believe we were talking about the White Glove Society?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Have you been successful in your efforts to recruit the White Glove Society?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {ABSENCE SEIZURE}I want you to destroy the Mojave Chapter of the Brotherhood of Steel. It's not a full-strength chapter, mind you. The Profligates...{trail off. Absence seizure begins}|...{breathe through nostrils for several seconds}|Urh...{continue breathing through nostrils}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Caesar heading for bed}{tired}If you interfere with me getting some sleep again, I'm going to have you killed. {resolved}We will talk later.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {tired, growing angry}You want to die? Fine!|{shouting for guards, voice weaker than usual}Praetorians! Kill this asshole!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Has the Brotherhood been destroyed?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Brotherhood resolved}I want you to join me in my tent. You and I are going to have a private conversation.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: All right, let's state the obvious. There's something wrong with me.|The headaches started a couple months ago. They weren't too bad at first... but now they come frequently and they're... {beat}debilitating.|For the past two weeks, my left leg has been dragging. It's stiffer, hard to move. And you've seen me blank out.|Lucius says I stare into space, blink a few times, then keep talking like nothing happened. So what's the diagnosis?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Successful surgery}I thank you for saving my life. You're a warrior {emphasis}and a healer - a rare combination.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I thank you for saving my life. Arcade will be a fine addition to my retinue.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I thank you for saving my life. The Auto-Doc module you recovered did the trick.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I trust this payment is adequate compensation for your troubles. Now, lest we grow sentimental here...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The time for battle will soon be upon us. {Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius draws nigh. When he arrives, my Legion will assault Hoover Dam.|In the meantime, the Profligates have prepared a welcome gift for us. The President of the NCR intends to visit Hoover Dam.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You {slight beat}dispatched President Kimball with real skill. Right under their noses, too - {enjoying it}what a humiliation.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {seething}Why did you not attack President Kimball?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {seething}President Kimball was there on the Dam, right before you. And yet he lives. {beat}How did you fuck this up?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Kimball quest resolved}My forces are in position to assault the Dam. {Leh-GAH-tus Lah-Nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius has assumed command.|Are you ready to go to him? To tell him to begin the assault?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You know everything you need to know. Be on your way.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {MASTER QUESTION NODE}What did you want to know?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {MASTER QUESTION NODE}What else did you want to know?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {MASTER QUESTION NODE}Even with the Boomers to deal with, you have questions?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {MASTER QUESTION NODE}Even with the White Glove Society to deal with, you have questions?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {MASTER QUESTION NODE}Even with the Brotherhood to deal with, you have questions?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {MASTER QUESTION NODE}Even with a President to kill, you have questions?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {MASTER QUESTION NODE}Even on the brink of the final battle, you have questions?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mr. House Top Level Topic Holder}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Boomer Top Level Topic Holder}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {White Glove Society Top Level Topic Holder}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Brotherhood of Steel Top Level Topic Holder}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {President Kimball Top Level Topic Holder}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Do you have any progress to report?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Allow me to make this clear. Because you've been of service to me, I will forgive your crimes against my Legion this one time.|In the future, if I become aware that you've committed other crimes, I'll have my Praetorians butcher you before my eyes.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If you've committed any other crimes, this is the time to confess them, because after today there will be no forgiveness.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I warned you about this. {to your guards}Praetorians, slaughter this degenerate!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Not now!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Radio}Report.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Careful, sometimes they escape and I have to round them up again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Why do you scare my cattle?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Don't scare the herd.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Leave doggies alone.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Amazed at the Player}You must be very special to Mr. House, huh?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Amazed at the Player}How did you get in there?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Amazed at the Player}Wow... I've never seen anyone go into the Lucky 38 before.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Amazed at the Player}Don't mind me. I was just passing by.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Amazed at the Player}I bet everyone's going to hear about you going into the 38.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Amazed at the Player}My pals said nobody has ever been inside the Lucky 38.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Amazed at the Player}Hey, sexy, come by the Tops later. I'd love to hear your story.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hi! I'm Sarah, Sarah Weintraub. Welcome to the finest Vault hotel in the whole world!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: They're hoarding our water! How are we supposed to survive the desert, huh?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VES08CampGolf "Encounters in Camp Golf and Vicinity" [QUST:00163BE8]

text_content: Hope those greedy bastards rot in foul water.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VES08CampGolf "Encounters in Camp Golf and Vicinity" [QUST:00163BE8]

text_content: One of these days, we're going to teach them a good lesson.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VES08CampGolf "Encounters in Camp Golf and Vicinity" [QUST:00163BE8]

text_content: We'll be back. They can't step over our people forever.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VES08CampGolf "Encounters in Camp Golf and Vicinity" [QUST:00163BE8]

text_content: Those hillbillies think they can take our water. We bring civilization, and this is how they repay us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VES08CampGolf "Encounters in Camp Golf and Vicinity" [QUST:00163BE8]

text_content: Damned rats. Next time I see them, I swear, I'll aim right between their eyes.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VES08CampGolf "Encounters in Camp Golf and Vicinity" [QUST:00163BE8]

text_content: They've got no right to come near our outposts. This is NCR territory, now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VES08CampGolf "Encounters in Camp Golf and Vicinity" [QUST:00163BE8]

text_content: I almost pity them, these desert savages.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VES08CampGolf "Encounters in Camp Golf and Vicinity" [QUST:00163BE8]

text_content: We'll get back our water, and our land, one of these days. We'll be mean to those soldiers until they leave!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VES08CampGolf "Encounters in Camp Golf and Vicinity" [QUST:00163BE8]

text_content: They're asking for it, those people from the NCR. We're tough, here! They don't scare us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VES08CampGolf "Encounters in Camp Golf and Vicinity" [QUST:00163BE8]

text_content: This desert is our home!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VES08CampGolf "Encounters in Camp Golf and Vicinity" [QUST:00163BE8]

text_content: We've lived here a long time! We're not going to leave our home.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VES08CampGolf "Encounters in Camp Golf and Vicinity" [QUST:00163BE8]

text_content: They're mean! Don't want to share water with us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VES08CampGolf "Encounters in Camp Golf and Vicinity" [QUST:00163BE8]

text_content: Hey there. Need anything?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Caesar has marked you for death... and the Legion obeys. Ready yourself for battle.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Now you will serve as an example to all who dare oppose Caesar's Legion. Defend yourself!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You have defied Caesar for the last time! Your life ends now!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The honcho of one of them Strip families got killed right in his own casino. You know he pissed off the wrong guy!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Now that McNamara's lifted that silly lockdown of his, perhaps people around here will come to appreciate our training simulations.|Perhaps there will be a renewed interest in them as people realize just how close to reality they are... but I digress. What did you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Now that Hardin's Elder, I hope I'll be allowed to continue my experiments. I never quite liked the way he looked at me during meetings.|Like he wanted to use me for target practice. The man just has no respect for science! But enough of this. What did you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Yes? What is it?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'll track the virus from over here. You just concentrate on locating the terminals hosting it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Flustered}Look, this isn't a great {time}ti- oh, what the hell, it's not like we're making any progress. I'm Ibsen, and I hope your day is going better than mine is.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Did you want to try isolating the virus?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You actually did it! If you don't mind my saying so, I didn't think you had a chance in hell of pulling it off.|But I'm glad to be wrong for once! Thank you, my friend. Please, feel free to access the datastore at your leisure.|I'm only allowed to give you access to non-classified topics, but it's better than nothing, right?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Heard you helped out Jackson, thanks for that. Caravans are still waiting for clearance to move out, but at least there's movement.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Impressed}Coming from the North? Must be crazy to brave those roads.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Something else you wanted?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Get rough with the escorts, and you'll be seeing the business end of my barrel.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: With the Kings gone, who is going to keep Freeside safe?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If the King is working with the NCR, he must have a damn good reason. I just hope it doesn't come back to bite us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Do I know you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: And you are?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Need something?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm hearing good things about you, friend. Good things.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Good to see someone helping out for a change.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: People say you've been helping out around town. Much appreciated, friend.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You've done good, kid. Happy to have you around.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm amazed by how much you've accomplished here in Freeside.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We've been really fortunate to have you helping Freeside.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Helping on a consistent basis wouldn't hurt you, would it?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You've done a strange mix of things since coming to Freeside.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Does it get painful sitting on the fence like you do?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It seems you've decided to be indecisive when it comes to helping Freesiders.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Throwing caution to the wind yet again, huh?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I guess no one is ever going to change a crazy freak like you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What did we ever do to you? Can't we all just get along?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Why the hate for Freeside? We're not all bad.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What the hell do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Go to hell you two-faced bastard.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Go away, you rotten bastard.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Way to stab us in the back, asshole.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Howdy, doc. Strange to see you wandering around.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I admire a woman who can hold her liquor. Cute to boot.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: She looks like she knows how to handle herself in a fight.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hope you programmed that thing to be friendly to Freesiders.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Super mutant? You don't look so super to me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: How's it hangin', old man? Oh, sorry.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, Rex. I see your new master is keeping you polished up. Good for you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Cheer up, lady. You've still got your youth.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've gotta hand it to you. You've done good things for Novac, but you've also got 'em a little scared of you. And that's great for business.|As long as you keep it coming, I'll get you some things a little cheaper than they should be.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Between you and me, I don't think she studied at an accredited institution.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: She hasn't paid me anything yet. Should I be worried?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Radio transmission}Support request received - deploying Troopers to your area. Hold tight, help is on the way.

name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Radio transmission}I sent you all I had last time, sir - you're on your own until dawn at least.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Radio transmission}Stay safe out there.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
