text_content: Well, seems like you've redeemed yourself. Welcome back to the NCR's good graces. Play nice... or I'll be back for you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The brass has put me back on my leash - that must mean that you've decided to play nice with the NCR. Good choice, you just saved your life.|Don't make me come after you again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I see you took my advice and made nice with the NCR. Guess that means you aren't as dumb as you look.|Stay smart and I won't have to come for you again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I don't know how you managed to improve your reputation with the NCR after pissing us off like that, but honestly...|I'm just happy I don't have to kill you now. See you around, wastelander.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Get him! Nobody screws with the NCR!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The NCR's come for you - time to die!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You crossed the NCR one time too many - now you die!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Did you think you'd get away with crossing the NCR?!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The NCR wants you dead, friend!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Consider this your final warning from the NCR!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Nobody crosses the NCR!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You'll pay for crossing the NCR!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This is what the NCR does with traitors!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We've got people to kill. Keep an eye out.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Never thought I'd ever have my own town, but thanks to you, now I do. If you wanna make some caps, head on over to the Correctional Facility.|Just tell them I sent you and you should get in without a problem. Keep a close eye on some of those bastards, though.|Oh, not all Powder Gangers out there are friends of mine - like the group in Primm. They'll be gunning for you no matter what, so keep that in mind.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: My gang's here, but we'll still need a plan before we rush the town. I don't want to embarrass myself and get beat by a bunch of townies.|We ain't got much in the way of supplies, so if you could shake down the old doctor and the store owner for some stuff, we'd be in good shape.|I also thought it might be a good thing to jimmy the lock on the Bighorner pen. The noise from the fight will spook them, get them running wild.|Once you're done with that stuff - or none of it - say the word and we'll make our move.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We ready to move or what?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {not in charge of Goodsprings}What do you want now?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {running Goodsprings, slightly friendly}How's it going?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Gunfight started, no Trudy help}Are you trying to get my saloon shot up? Finish what you started!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Gunfight started, Trudy help}Keep an eye out. This isn't finished yet.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Well, you've been causing quite a stir. Glad I finally got to meet you. Welcome to the Prospector Saloon.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So, you're planning on taking on Joe Cobb's gang. It's a big risk, but I suppose you have to do what you think is right.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hope you didn't just bring a heap of trouble down on Goodsprings by killing Joe Cobb like that.|His friends might come looking for him, and I don't think they're going to care who was involved in his death or not.|Well, what's done is done. So, uh, what can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm glad that business is over. I like it when Goodsprings is nice and quiet.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Feeling thirsty? I can take care of that.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You shouldn't have crossed the Powder Gangers! Now you're going to pay!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I have a present for you from the Powder Gangers... I hope you like dynamite!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You'll pay for what you did to the Powder Gangers!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Nobody screws with the Powder Gangers and lives!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Here he is, boys! Let's show him what happens when you cross the Powder Gangers!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Gunfight in progress, not helping}Get away! I'm not part of your fight!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Gunfight in progress}Keep an eye out for more of them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This town don't look like much.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Beats being in prison.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I got dibs on the old doc's house.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Need more women around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Never liked Bighorners.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {victory}Those townies put up a bigger fight than I expected.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {victory}That was a hell of a gunfight.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {victory}Nothing left to do but kick back and booze it up.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {victory}You think any townies are hiding?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {victory}I knew we were going to win all along.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome back. Can I get you anything?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey there. If you want to buy something from my shop, you'll have to wait till it opens.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Cant' do business now! There's a gunfight!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You must be the one Doc Mitchell was patching up. The way I heard it, I didn't think you'd be walking out of that office.|I've got plenty of supplies for sale. Even got some weapon mods and special ammo - well worth the caps, if you ask me.|If you're hurting for caps, I've also got boxes of surplus ammo in the miscellaneous section. They're not great, but you get what you pay for.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That was a hell of a fight. Let's hope it doesn't bite us in the ass later on.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Powder Ganger victory}I won't make any trouble for the gang. Just let me keep my store and I'll cut you a little discount.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You looking to buy some supplies?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard about what's been going on in town. Our deal's off. I can't trust someone like you to watch my back.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Keep an eye out. I still think there's a few out there.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That's close enough. Who are you, and what do you want with me?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I owe you a huge favor for this. Here - these are technically Crimson Caravan funds, but I know they'll understand once I explain things.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thanks again for all your help.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What's the plan? Are we ready?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So, what's going on? Did Sunny agree to help us?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What is it?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That ought to keep things settled for awhile. Hope it stays that way.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Howdy. What can Easy Pete do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Howdy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We can talk after this is over!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Those bastards got Ringo in the end, after all. At least he went down fighting.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {satisfaction}That'll teach the Powder Gangs to avoid Goodsprings in the future.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Time to look alive. The Powder Gangers are here to play.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'll keep an eye out for the Powder Gangers and meet up with you and Ringo when the time comes.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I don't think Joe Cobb knew what hit him. I'm hoping you took him down for a good reason and not... for fun.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Cheyenne, stay. Don't worry, she won't bite unless I tell her to.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hi there. Sticking around Goodsprings for awhile longer?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I expect you'll be wanting to go outside after being cooped up for so long, but if you have any questions, I'll answer what I can.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome back. I had hoped you wouldn't need to come see me again so soon. What can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: How're you holding up?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Howdy, pardner! Might I say, you're looking fit as a fiddle.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Howdy, pardner! So, when do the rustlers show up?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Howdy, pardner!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Holy moly! If you hadn't come here like you done, I'd be a goner for sure.|I came up here to draw water, but here, you should have what I got. You look thirsty.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VCG02GSSettler "Goodsprings Settler" [NPC_:0010B3DD]

text_content: Thank you!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VCG02GSSettler "Goodsprings Settler" [NPC_:0010B3DD]

text_content: Help me!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hello. I'm Rose of Sharon Cassidy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Slightly bored}Caravan, citizen, pilgrim, or...?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]

text_content: {Nods to player}Been doing a lot of good work out there, setting an example for the others - I know Ranger Jackson appreciates it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]

text_content: Back again, I see. Something you need?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]

text_content: {Bad person just walked in}Got some nerve, coming to an NCR outpost with that look about you. {Low, warning}Hope you aren't here to trade, not sure you can afford the prices.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]

text_content: {Mildly curious}New face in the Outpost, must've come from the North. {Frowns}So - what'll you have?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]

text_content: Back round? Just my luck... what'll it be this time?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]

text_content: Something else you needed? I'm short-handed here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]

text_content: Any luck up by the track?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]

text_content: Welcome to the New Vegas Medical Clinic. I'm a fully qualified physician and can fix whatever is wrong with you for a reasonable fee.|If you've got the caps, I've also got several implants available to enhance your physical attributes.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You come to the wrong place, traveler. Primm's dying. If you got any sense, you'll be moving on.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Quite a town we got here. Sheriff gets murdered, and Deputy Beagle dragged off for ransom to the Bison Steve. That should bring back the tourists.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Rather be left alone to my misery, if you don't mind.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Before the Powder Gangers came to town, Johnson Nash ran the local store and the Mojave Express station.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I ain't got nothing for you to eat. If you're hungry, see Ruby Nash.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thanks for freeing the deputy. A bit, anyway.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thanks for freeing Deputy Beagle. He's better than nothing. Maybe.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Now you freed Deputy Beagle, all Primm needs is a law man who can shoot a gun without wetting hisself.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear you're going to help find Primm a new sheriff. Mighty kind of you to take an interest.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So you're the one's going to bring the law back to Primm? I'll believe it when I see it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear you aim to bring rule of law back to our town. God knows we need the help.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thanks for bringing the NCR to town, stranger. Things're finally looking up for Primm.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thanks to you I got a mess of soldiers watching every move I make, plus I got to pay taxes for the privilege!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Those soldiers you brought down on us is all business, stranger. Better than lawlessness, though. So you've got my thanks.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This new Sheriff Meyers you brought to us is a lawman through and through. Primm's looking up, stranger.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thanks for convincing Meyers to come sheriff for us. First time I feel safe in a long time.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This Sheriff Meyers you found for us is working out. Knows his business. We owe you a debt.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Man, it is a real uphill fight these days. I'm not sure how we are going to handle all these convicts.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If you got something to say, say it to the Lieutenant.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Careful, things aren't as safe around here as they could be.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You'll probably want to talk to Hayes.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Placeholder for Primm Trooper 01}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Gunfight in progress, not helping}Get away from me! I don't want to get shot!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Gunfight, helping}Careful! There's still more of them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Gunfight, helping}Don't think this is over yet.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Way too many strangers coming into town these days. No offense.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If you're looking for supplies, Chet over at the general store can help you out.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Evil 2+}Why don't you just move on to another town?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Evil 2+}Just leave us alone.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Good 2+}We need more people like you around.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mixed 2+}Bit of a troublemaker, aren't you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mixed 2+}Don't really care much for the unpredictable types. Just saying.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That Doc Mitchell sure knows his stuff, doesn't he?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Powder Gang control}At least the Powder Gangers are letting me live.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Powder Gang control}I'm glad I didn't try to fight the gang.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Powder Gang control}Hell of way to repay Doc, if you ask me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Powder Gang control}So many good people are dead...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The recent disturbance at {beat, as though pasted in}the Tops {beat}has been resolved. Do not be afraid to patronize {beat}the Tops.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The recent disturbance at {beat, as though pasted in}Gomorrah {beat}has been resolved. Do not be afraid to patronize {beat}Gomorrah.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Be advised, the Lucky 38 is not open to the general public. Trespassers will be shot. Thank you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Do not be alarmed. We have been upgraded to serve you better. Have a nice day.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Obituaries of the recently deceased Mr. House, President, CEO, and sole proprietor of the Vegas Strip, are still available. Just ask any Securitron.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Be advised, Mr. House has voluntarily decided to become a citizen of the NCR. |Sovereignty over the Vegas Strip will be transferred to the NCR at a date yet to be determined. Have a nice day.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Be advised, when Mr. House transfers sovereignty over the Vegas Strip to the NCR, he will remain its sole proprietor. Have a nice day.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The unfortunate incident involving the monorail from McCarran Airport is being resolved as quickly as possible. Thank you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Be sure to offer words of encouragement to NCR men and women in uniform. Vegas appreciates their business.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Be advised, NCR President Aaron Kimball survived an assassination attempt at Hoover Dam.|Just one more reason to celebrate at one of New Vegas's fine casinos! Thank you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Be advised, NCR President Aaron Kimball was struck down in a cowardly attack at Hoover Dam.|The Strip offers many fine cocktail lounges where grieving persons may drown their sorrows.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome to Vegas, capital of the sixth state of the New California Republic!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: True to {KAI-zar}Caesar.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome to New Vegas, where a new day is dawning!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome to Vegas. Don't make trouble.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome to the Vegas Strip.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Enjoy all the Vegas Strip has to offer.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Enjoy your time on the Vegas Strip.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Always a pleasure.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Good to see you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {upbeat}Hello, again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {upbeat}Hey, look who's here!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {upbeat}If it isn't our favorite V.I.P.!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {upbeat}You're always welcome in this town!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Try to control your behavior today.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm hoping this is one of your good days.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Vegas doesn't need your trouble.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Who knows what you're going to do next?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I bet you're up to something.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I don't like the look of you. Never have.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Don't think we aren't watching you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You've got a reputation in this town, and it isn't a good one.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Don't bother to watch yourself. We're watching for you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Come on, tough guy/gal - give me a reason.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Take your best shot. Then we'll take ours.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're bad for Vegas. You don't belong here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Have a nice day.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Enjoy your time in Vegas.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Be advised, visitors will be held responsible for the behavior of any robots accompanying them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Be advised, visitors will be held responsible for the behavior of any {disapproving}non-human sapients accompanying them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'd remember if I had seen you here before, I'm sure of it... {pauses as if thinking "anyway, whatever"}What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome back, stranger.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thank you! They were going to kill me!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Don't worry, I'll stay out of trouble from now on. Honest.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Yeah?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: No offense, but I need to focus on getting more rest when I'm off duty. I'm not sleeping so good. So now's not a good time.|If you want to talk, catch me when I'm on duty. I'm up in the dinosaur after 9 pm.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Nice of you to show up.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Is it time?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Let's get out of this first.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We take this boat, it's probably the last one we ever take.|I'm ready for that. Are you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We're near a Legion slave camp now. I've... been here before.|Let's get one thing straight. I see any crimson, I'm taking the shot. You don't like that, you're on your own.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We're getting close to Nelson. Any closer, I'm shooting any legionary I see. Hope that's not a problem.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Huh. We made it through after all. Not sure what to make of that.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Mercy killing is expected of NCR snipers. The Legion likes to torture their prisoners within sight of NCR positions. |We get called on to end it. I've had my share. Some of them, you think, maybe you could've gotten them out. |Maybe it's not the Legion that got them killed. Maybe it's your orders and you following them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Caesar's dead. Bet he didn't see this coming when he was having his coffee this morning.|Still. It's not gonna stop the Legion. Might not even slow them down.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Pisses me off that Legion slavers can just operate on NCR turf like that.|If we hadn't caught up to them they'd probably have had a clear path to the river. No one to stop them.|There should be patrols. Checkpoints. We got greedy, overstretched. Now our own territory isn't secure.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Something's wrong. Got a group coming our way. Looks like a Legion raiding party. It's big.|Might be too big. Even for us.|If you want out I won't blame you. But I'm going to stay. See if I can hold them off.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Hey. I thought some more about what you said. I think maybe you're right. Maybe I should go to Bitter Springs.|I don't know what I'm hoping to find there.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey. I want to thank you for bringing me to Bitter Springs. Things seem... clearer now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: We should get to the Hoover Dam. I don't want to miss this.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: That guy Benny was a piece of work.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: A face-to-face meeting with House, huh? The NCR would kill to be in your shoes.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Sounds like it's gonna be an all-out war with the Legion soon. Maybe I should've re-enlisted after all.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: What is it?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've been sent to take you back to the Lucky 38. Are you ready to go?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Big Winner}Baby, Lady Luck must be smiling at you today! Compliments of the Tops Casino, enjoy this fine meal and please, keep playing those games!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: vFloorManagerTheTops "The Tops Floor Manager" [NPC_:00145F8A]

text_content: {Whale}You've been good to us, baby - now let us be good to you. We'd like you to enjoy this private suite as long as you're in town.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: vFloorManagerTheTops "The Tops Floor Manager" [NPC_:00145F8A]

text_content: {Banned}Okay, pal, you've had enough. Time for you to leave.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: vFloorManagerTheTops "The Tops Floor Manager" [NPC_:00145F8A]

text_content: You better get moving kid, there's bad guys to kill.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {at Bunker - no plan}Kreger's the officer here, not me. The final say on the plan is up to him.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {At Bunker, Moreno dead}Moreno and I never did get along. Still, he was a fellow soldier from the old days.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {at Bunker, helping NCR}The NCR's the best bet for the wasteland. I'm glad we'll be helping them out.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Remnants helping Legion}I'm not helping the Legion, no matter how much you talk them up. I will help my friends prepare, but that's it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Well, it's about about damn time. What took you... oh.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What brings you around this time?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Let's get going, we have a battle to win.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You don't strike me as someone down on their luck. What brings you to Westside?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {At Bunker}Glad to see you made it here all right. So, who are we going up against?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {At Bunker}Still waiting on that decision...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player killed Moreno}{quiet regret}We saw everything through the security monitor. I had no idea Moreno would ever pull something like that.|By rights, Moreno's Power Armor now belongs to you. Whitman's volunteered to show you how to use it, so talk to her as soon as you can.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Moreno convinced to stay}Moreno's a stubborn son of a bitch, but he's also tougher than any of us. I'm glad you were able to talk him into staying.|Since Whitman will be staying with the vertibird, she's offered to give her old suit of Power Armor to you.|You'll need special training to use it properly, so talk to her as soon as you get the chance.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Remnants helping NCR or Legion}We'll be ready, don't worry.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Sticking around for the attractions?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {at Bunker - no plan}We're all here. Talk to Kreger about what you've got in mind.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {At Bunker, Moreno dead}If I had any idea Moreno was capable of doing something that, I'd have warned you. I'm sorry it played out like this.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {At Bunker, helping NCR}The NCR's got its share of warts, but I'd rather have them around than the Legion.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {At Bunker, helping Legion}I'm not sure if helping the Legion is the right idea. But, I'm going along with it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {At Hoover Dam battle}Keep your head down - could be snipers around.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I assume this is about something important? You're interrupting my research.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The equipment is hooked up and ready. We can start the test as soon as you give me the go ahead.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {somewhat irritated and impatient}Again you interrupt me. Why?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Is there something else I can do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {at Bunker - no plan}What are you talking to me for? Talk to Kreger.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {At Hoover Dam battle}Now is {emphasis "not"}not the time!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player not in NCR gear}Bah. Looks like I forgot to lock the doors again. If you're with the NCR, get out. This place is mine, and I'm not leaving.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player in NCR gear}Look, trooper, I was living in this house long before your farms got set up. {threat}Don't even think about evicting me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Remnants helping NCR}I didn't come all the way out here just so we could save the fucking NCR. I'm out.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Moreno convinced to stay}I can't believe I'm going to help the NCR.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Remnants helping Legion}Since Johnson won't be coming with us, you might as well take his suit of Power Armor. I'll teach you the basics of how to use it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {terse}Yeah?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {at Bunker - no plan}I'm ready to fly once we've got a plan. Talk to Judah.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Moreno killed at Bunker}{talking about a dead friend}Damn it, Orion. Why did you have to go and do something like that?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Moreno killed at Bunker}Orion always did have a temper, but it was pretty low of him to ambush you like that.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Moreno convinced to stay}I appreciate you keeping Orion in the group. Since I won't be needing my armor - makes the cockpit a bit cramped - you should take it.|It'll take a few hours to show you how to use it properly, so let's get started.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {at Bunker, helping NCR}I'd love to see the look on the NCR's face when I swoop down in my chopper.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {at Bunker, helping Legion}I heard the Legion doesn't care for women, but as long as they stay out of my way, I'll get along just fine with them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Fine weather for flying. It's times like these that make me miss it all.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Your travels been going all right?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm occupied at the moment. Come see me when I'm on the balcony.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Back west, you don't see too many of these. Lakes, I mean. Natural or man-made. Any kind, really.|We neglected the dams or pumped all the water out a long time ago. Owens, Isabella, the San Luis. Drained the aquifers of everything they had.|Just a lot of mud and dust now. It's a different feeling, watching the sun come up over the water. Takes some getting used to.|But if you're here long enough, it starts to seem normal. That's what a ranger's life is now. Looking east.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You've come back to see the chief. Nice of you to humor the radio tender. What can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Like I said, I won't run out on you, but I can't let my people get dragged through the mud for this.|You did good and you did it well. Work a ranger would be proud of. I'll handle the rest from here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You looking to take the test again?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hello, don't think I've seen your face before. Are you a citizen of the NCR?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hello again. We spoke briefly before, but remind me, are you a citizen of the NCR?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey there. We hope to see you by the train station one of these nights.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Ah, you're back. Did you want to take that test again now?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You look like a person in need of a good meal. You wouldn't happen to be an NCR citizen, would you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That meal's still available, but only to NCR citizens. You are an NCR citizen, aren't you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've held up my end. You tell the King that I'm willing to listen to him.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This isn't really a good time. What did you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome. There's food and water here for any citizen of the NCR. Please, have some.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSElizabethKieran "Elizabeth Kieran" [NPC_:0010C764]

text_content: Yes, was there something else you needed?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSElizabethKieran "Elizabeth Kieran" [NPC_:0010C764]

text_content: {Radio}<Static>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'll meet you on the observation deck.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You again. What is it?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We've got a lot to do to prepare for the President's visit and not much time.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Have you finished your security sweep?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Come back in a minute, I'm busy with security matters.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Shouldn't you be keeping an eye out for anything suspicious?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Good job today. We got the President out safe and sound and I couldn't have done it without you. You have my thanks.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Damnit! I can't believe the President is dead. It's all my fault!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <Placeholder for Top Level Topics>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, I heard about you. What can I do for you, friend?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {gruff}What is it?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <K9 Ranger Dialog>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Is there a problem here?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You again. What's your problem?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Do you mind?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <Legion Bomber Top Level Topics>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <Roof Guard Warning Dialogs>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're cleared to go on through.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: No one can go upstairs without authorization.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <Roof Guard Top Level Topics>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Condescending}Didn't expect Caesar to send a woman to do this job.|Oh well, at least you're here now. {Joking}I was starting to get lonely out here by myself.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It's about time you showed up.|{Joking}I was starting to get lonely out here by myself.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Make it quick. We don't have much time.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What is it?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <Cato Hostilius Top Level Topics>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I still haven't found my lucky helmet yet.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thanks for finding my lucky helmet. It's my favorite!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey-o!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <Watson Top Level Topics>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What are you doing up here?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Kind of busy up here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <Legion Sniper Top Level Topics>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, you haven't seen my friend around here, have you? His name is Ben and he's an engineer.|We were supposed to meet up so we can watch the President's speech together, but he hasn't shown up yet.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Leave me alone.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Still no luck finding my friend. He better show up soon.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Do you mind?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We're a bit busy here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Why don't you mind your own business.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Managing security on short notice is going to be tough. We'll have to keep the crowd small for the speech.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It's unlikely that the Legion will try anything, but we'll be prepared for it anyway.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We'll keep civilian presence to a minimum. That should avoid any unnecessary risks.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What the fuck just happened?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What is going on?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Quiet, I'm trying to listen to the speech.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Shh! I want to hear what is going on.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Leave me alone, I'm trying to pay attention.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm so excited about he President visiting. This is going to be great!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm looking forward to seeing the President.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm just glad to have the day off for this.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I wonder what President Kimball is going to talk about today.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That was a great speech.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That's a nice suit President Kimball had.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I don't have time to talk right now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We need to keep an eye out for anything suspicious.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Nothing is going to happen to the President on my watch.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Move along.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You really saved our asses out there against the Legion. Thanks.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I can't believe that President Kimball was attacked. I'm just relieved that nothing bad happened to him.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I can't believe President Kimball is dead. He was a great leader for the NCR.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So you're the one that has been running errands for Colonel Moore. Do you need something?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Happy}Well look who it is! What can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Always nice to have a friend of the NCR around. What can I help you with?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You better watch yourself around here. I'm not going to put up with any of your crazy shit.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Wary}Something you need?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You've got a lot of nerves being here. Maybe you should just leave instead.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Gruff}What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I don't think you're in the right place. You looking for something?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Is there something I can do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <Top Level Topics for Quartermaster Bardon>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Threatening}Back off.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Threatening}Watch it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {FIRST, BUNKER, BENNY DEAD CASINO}I do wish you'd come and met with me at the Lucky 38 when you first arrived on the Strip. Or after you killed Benny, even.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {FIRST, BUNKER}Quite an honor you spurned, my invite. You would be the first person to set foot inside the Lucky 38 in over 200 years.|{sigh of pique}But... you still wound up here, right where I wanted you. {self-satisfied}I knew I could rely on Caesar to return the Platinum Chip to you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Male PC}If you're injured, I might have healing powder to spare.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Female PC - surprise, tinged with envy}A free woman. It's... been awhile since I've seen a woman who wasn't a slave. {"forget" as in she's a slave who's forgotten her position, and shouldn't be rambling}I forget myself - are you injured?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Caesar dead}With {KAI-zar}Caesar dead, I'm afraid for the women. The Legate is a brutal man, and he enjoys inflicting pain.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Caeser cured}{wistful}I had hoped to become a great doctor like you someday.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You got Melody her bear back. Very kind of you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Yes?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So you're the visitor I've heard some of the Legionaries talking about. If you're in the mood to trade, just say the word.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Caesar dead}I've heard some bad stories about this Legate. I'm not sure I'll be welcome around here once he takes charge.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Caesar cured}Never had you pegged as the doctor-type. Guess I know who to come to now when I get sick.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Howdy again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {KAI-zar}Caesar awaits. You can speak with me later.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Caesar dead during surgery}{controlled white-hot anger}{KAI-zar}Caesar is dead at your hands. This crime cannot go unpunished.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Caesar died via Auto-Doc}{confused, angry}I don't understand - the machine was supposed to cure {KAI-zar}Caesar. {growing anger, blaming player}You did this - his blood is own your hands.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Caesar dead during surgery, Player incompetent}Your butchery of {KAI-zar}Caesar will not go unpunished!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Caesar cured}{admiring}{KAI-zar}Caesar was right to put his trust in you. Your skill in medicine is beyond anything I've ever seen before.

text_content: {Slight Sarcasm}I bet NCR troops can't wait to clean the sewers.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Slight Sarcasm}New Vegas, paradise, my ass.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Slight Sarcasm}NCR should head back to their lands, I'm sure *their* people miss them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Slight Sarcasm}NCR came all the way to save us, huh? Guess they missed the shit-holes.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Matter of Course Warning}Stay underground at night.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Matter of Course Warning}Watch out where you exit. Sewers can lead you to Fiend territory.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Matter of Course Warning}Keep an eye on your stuff - damn thieves.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Matter of Course Warning}Don't go too far, it's all shadows and dangers in the lower levels.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Matter of Course Warning}Careful with those Fiends in the western sewers.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Anxious Apprehension}I need my fix.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Anxious Apprehension}I hurt all over.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Anxious Apprehension}Going to eat the next fucking rat I see.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Anxious Apprehension}Just got to find me some sweet Jet.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Beaten Resignation}Won't ever make enough to live outside.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Beaten Resignation}Can't go anywhere else.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Beaten Resignation}Don't think I'll make it topside any time soon.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Beaten Resignation}Smells like shit all the time, but at least we're safer than in the Wastes.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Thankful}Good to see you respect the Followers.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Cautionary}Make sure the NCR dog behaves, you're in the Mojave now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Approving}Your merchant friend is always welcome among us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Apprehensive Curiosity}That bot of yours don't look like anything I've seen in the Mojave.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Overt Curiosity}Your friend's not from the desert, is she?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Suspicious}We tolerate Wasteland savages, as long as they respect our rule around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player not in Powder Ganger gear}{part of an act - he's not really a merchant and trying to see if the player is really a Powder Ganger}Better be careful around these parts. I hear there's Powder Gangers around and dangerous for merchants like me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Male PC, in Powder Ganger gear}{triumphant}Well, well. It's about time one of you guys came along. I figure the NCR would pay a pretty good bounty for a Powder Ganger.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Female PC, in Powder Ganger gear}{puzzled}Hadn't heard there were women Powder Gangers, but a bounty's a bounty. The NCR will probably pay up either way.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You won't see me around here again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What brings you back?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hate it here, fucking sulfur stinks.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What more do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCKarl "Karl" [NPC_:00140E60]

text_content: I haven't seen you before - what brings you to the Great Khans?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: It's good to have you here. What can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: You honor the Great Khans with your presence. What can I do to help you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: You're always... {beat, considering word choice}interesting to have around.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: {Cautious, unsure of player's motives}What are you doing here?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: If you're smart, you'll find somewhere else to be.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: You're becoming quite the political agitator. I can't say I'm displeased.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: Something else you wanted?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: We'll begin readying the camp to move. As soon as Caesar makes his move, we'll depart. We will make ourselves strong again, and we shall conquer!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: So, the cub enters the wolf's den. What do you want, cub?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: All four of my most trusted advisors have told me we should break our alliance - maybe I should hear you out after all.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: I'm beginning to hear troubling rumors from my advisors. Would you know anything about that?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: More of my advisors are starting to talk openly of breaking our alliance. I wonder where that idea is coming from?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: I understand you dealt the NCR a crushing defeat at Forlorn Hope. I hope that trend continues.|That's why I've made a decision: I'm naming you my heir. When I die, leadership of the Great Khans will pass to you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: You've been doing good things for us - don't think I haven't noticed. What can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: It's always a pleasure to see you around the camp.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: Are you going to help us this time, or vex us?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: And so the unpredictable one returns. What do you want from us?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: I've got little enough patience for you. Consider your words carefully - you don't want me as an enemy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: In the past, I'd have had someone like you executed for showing their face here - consider yourself lucky I don't have the warriors to spare.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: Ah, you're back. What else do you need?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: Not now, I'm busy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCGreatKhanMessenger "Great Khan" [NPC_:0014C49A]

text_content: You look like someone with a question. What can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VRRCEzekiel "Ezekiel" [NPC_:00148C26]

text_content: It's good you told me about Dermot and Saint James. It was killing that needed doing.|You think you see the worst of what people can do to each other, and then there's always something else to top it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm going to assume you had reason to kill Dermot and his pet. Always had a bad feeling about them. {stern}But everyone else here is hands-off.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You can just talk to the whores, you know. You and me don't need to talk unless there's trouble.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What do you need this time?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player in combat}Hey, don't drag me into this!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Male PC}Hey, mister, looking to relax? Looks like you carry a lot of tension in your shoulders... {mischievous}and upper thighs.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Female PC}Sorry, ma'am, but my services are {archly}"members only," all right? You might try Sweetie.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That situation with Dermot and Saint James must've been stressful. Looking to relax?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Male PC}Glad you came back. You wanna get together with me?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Female PC}Still wasting your time in this pit, honey?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player in combat}Fuck off! I ain't helping you!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I got nothing you need. If it's ass you're looking for, talk to Pretty Sarah.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I said fuck off.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player in combat}Yeah! Fight! Fight!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {unstable}Why you talking to me, man? I'm trying to relax here, got it?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {unstable, issues with women}When I talk to a girl, I start the conversation! And I didn't start no conversation with you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {unstable}We got to go through this again? What's it about this time?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player in combat}Oh my! Keep me out of this!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hello, stranger. You looking for a good time?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Don't see many or your kind here in the Casa. Women, I mean - who ain't working.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Always knew there was something wrong with Dermot and Saint James. Neither one ever got busy between my legs!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Been enjoying your time at the Casa?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player in combat}Look out!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Female PC}Hey, honey. Looking for something softer than a man can give you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Male PC}Hey, baby. What say you and me get acquainted?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Dermot being dead I don't care about, but Saint James was regular income. Maybe you could throw some business my way?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hi again. You here to play?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player in combat}{deadpan}You look busy. Talk to me later.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {playing at being a showman}Welcome to the Casa Madrid - cheapest, cleanest whores in all New Vegas. If you want to know the rates for poon, talk to the whores.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {sarcastically}Thanks a lot. I'm out Dermot and St. James's rent - and they paid regular - and once they get to stinking I'll have to clean up the mess, too!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Yeah? What is it?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm not getting sucked into your fight, friend.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {as a way of introducing himself}Tom Anderson. Can I help you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Good to see you again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hello? Can you help me?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Have you decided to help me?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Please hurry! She's on the ridge, past the broken radio tower.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Sorry I tricked you, but thanks for clearing out the Geckos. Now I can get to that stash up there... after I deal with you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome to the Atomic Wrangler. Looking to exchange?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome to Gomorrah, how can I help you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome to Vikki and Vance. Can I help you with an exchange?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If you're down on your luck and need some caps, I buy just about anything. Of course, I've also got plenty of things for sale, too.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Here to do business?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Howdy. Name's Bob, but folks around here call me Klamath Bob. What can I do you for?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, stranger. Hope you been well. What do you need?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Nng. Hi.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Nng. Hi again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hi there. Welcome to the Westside Co-op. I'm Clayton Ettienne. Let me know if you have any questions.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome back. How can I help you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Uh... hi.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Oh, hello.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {kid who just got caught in the act}Agh! I wasn't doing anything!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hello again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Trying to elevate your status by being seen with me? It won't work.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You look like you'd be more at home at one of the other hotels.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm sorry, I prefer to converse with interesting people.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Disdainful, at first}I hear you've been clawing your way up the social ladder. {then, confidentially}What's your secret?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: People are talking about you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I like the cut of your jib.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Well, if it isn't the toast of New Vegas.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome to the pinnacle of society.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Would you mind staying here a moment? I want people to see that I know you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're an odd duck.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You've been acting awfully strange towards us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What are you playing at? I'm really starting to wonder about you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm having a little get-together later, but you are not invited until you learn to behave.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: How can you be such a dear and such a bother at the same time?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You'll never be at the top until you learn some manners and common decency.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {repulsed}What's that smell? Oh, it's you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Please, you're lowering my status.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Shouldn't you be in Freeside with the other thugs?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You vile cad. I've half a mind to give you a solid thrashing with my cane.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Remove yourself from my sight at once.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Loathsome wretch.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Life at the top is immensely satisfying.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It must be horrible to live in places without luxury.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Being an honorary member isn't the same as being a real member, but it still makes you better than everyone else.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So you've joined the Society. It feels different, doesn't it? Like you're entitled to the best things life has to offer.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You mustn't ask why we wear our masks. We are forbidden to speak of it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Lucky 38's perpetual glow these days... it's rather gauche, don't you think?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mr. House agreed to surrender Vegas to the NCR}If Mr. House is going to lower his standards, we'll just have to raise ours!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Need some grub? I got you covered. Cheap and filling.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player killed Lupa}Lupa met an honorable death in the arena.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Some of the slaves have been spreading stories about the Burned Man again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <Renolds Top Level Topics>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We don't have time to talk, let's get this fight going.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {experiment in progress}Please don't interrupt me right now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Keene has never liked me. If anyone can talk him into backing down, it'll have to be you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Don't you see everything is going to hell? I'm gonna go find someplace safe to hide out at.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VHDMikeLawson "Mike Lawson" [NPC_:001300A7]

text_content: I love this place, but I can't take this kind of stress anymore. I'm going to head back west to see my grandkids.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VHDMikeLawson "Mike Lawson" [NPC_:001300A7]

text_content: Hello there youngster. Welcome to my baby.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VHDMikeLawson "Mike Lawson" [NPC_:001300A7]

text_content: Troublemaker, don't you dare hurt my baby.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VHDMikeLawson "Mike Lawson" [NPC_:001300A7]

text_content: Always good to see a friendly face, you're always welcome to visit my baby girl.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VHDMikeLawson "Mike Lawson" [NPC_:001300A7]

text_content: You keep yourself outta trouble around my baby, I'm watching you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VHDMikeLawson "Mike Lawson" [NPC_:001300A7]

text_content: Welcome back to my baby.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VHDMikeLawson "Mike Lawson" [NPC_:001300A7]

text_content: {snort} NCR, no better than common thieves. Where do they get off stealing our armor?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player just won the battle}Caesar on the cross, been a long time since I've seen the kind of work you've laid down today... a {emph}damn long time.|{Wistful}And the screams of those Legion bastards as they kicked dirt running East... like a choir of angels to my ears.|Speaking of - that crazy lightshow over the Fort, what the fuck was that, some kind of thumb from God you called down? {Wistful}Amazing, fucking amazing.|Could use a hundred of you, just scatter you over the East like jacks, give those plumed fucks the what-for.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Well, you took your sweet ass time coming here.|Let's get down to brass tacks, we need to get this thing moving if we want to keep the element of surprise.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That was a fine bit of work back there. Truth told, I'm surprised you made it out of there in one piece. {Under his breath}You and the Dam.|I'm impressed to say the least, and that's no easy thing. You've secured NCR's future - the administration sends its thanks, for what it's worth.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mike Lawson Placeholder dialogue}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Damn Brotherhood, bunch of elitist jerks. What were we to do, leave good armor out in the wastes to rust?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Whatever it is, make it quick. I don't have time for idle chatter.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Angry, frustrated}As if I didn't have enough to worry about, one of our facilities was recently broken into and its power diverted.|Have you seen that damned tower in the Strip, all aglow? Of course you've seen it. Everyone's seen it.|That was {stressed}our power that did that, and I {stressed}will find out who did it. {beat, realizes the player's there, rant ends}Did you have something to report?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Placeholder for Moore's top level topics}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Not right now, I'm busy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You again. What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Good, you made it. I've been receiving reports about the "savior of the NCR" for a while now, and wanted to meet you myself.|You've proven yourself especially capable, and right now I can use all the capable people I can get.|Crocker gets handed the fluff missions that no one else wants to do. When people need something really important done, they come to me.|Usually, I dispatch one or more rangers to see these things through, but I'm a little shorthanded at the moment. Think you're up for a real mission?

text_content: {Resigned Fear}They say the Fiends are defeated, but I'm sticking close to the army - just in case.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Cautious}They say it's safer to travel now that Fiends are retreating, but I'd still look out for trouble.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Arrogant}As we've done with the Fiends, we'll kill anyone who resists our fight for peace.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Visibly Disturbed}Legion attacking so far from their bases means we'll have to watch out on the road.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Pessimistic}We're just pushing our luck by signing a treaty with those savage Khans.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Proud and Celebratory}The territories are safer now that the Khans have disappeared.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Scolding Hindsight}I told everyone we shouldn't have bet for the Khans.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Self-Affirming Conviction}It's clear that savages, like the Khans, can't be trusted to civilize.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Proud}I'll tell everyone back home about how the NCR deals with wild thugs, like the Kings.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Proud}The Kings were pushing it too far, and they got what was coming to them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Proud Sarcasm}I guess those "Kings" finally got who's the real boss around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Hopeful}Our victory at Nelson's a worthy story to tell in my travels.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Hopeful}Our victory at Nelson's a worthy story to tell in my travels.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Arrogant}Nelson will serve as example. We'll bleed the ground red with anyone who opposes our peace-efforts.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Bewildered Anger}You'll pay for what you did to our soldiers at Forlorn Hope, murderer!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Proud}It's good to hear that Primm has accepted our law.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Matter of Fact}A reliable source told me we're getting the best NCR soldiers to help us against the Legion.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Admiringly}Have you seen them? Our Rangers are the finest men alive!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Worried}People are whispering, everywhere, about the massive Legion army gathering past the Colorado.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Visibly Worried}Looks like the Legion also brought their own elite warriors to the territories.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Visibly Worried}You'd be crazy to put your money on either side of the coming battle.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {unsettled}Why the hell is the Lucky 38 all lit up these days? I don't like it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Conviction}We'll make this land peaceful, after we kill everybody who opposes us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Fearful}It's time to pack and leave these lands until the dust settles.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Fearful}It's time to pack and leave these lands until the dust settles.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Casual Acknowledgement}What's up.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Casual Acknowledgement}Uh huh.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Casual}Hey.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Unabashed Curiosity}Never seen a guardian dog like that before.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Satisfied}With Caesar out of the way, we'll assert our rule over the territories.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Self-Affirming Conviction}I knew that the Khans were animals. We should kill them like vermin.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Bewildered Anger}What on earth could push you to destroy Forlorn Hope?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Fearful Apprehension}You're not going to raze us to the ground, like you did to Forlorn Hope, right?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Proud}NCR will civilize all this Wasteland, Primm is only the beginning.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Encouraged}I've heard that we're getting strong reinforcements to help us civilize the territories.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Disappointed}Instead of spending a fortune in this war, the NCR should be paying us to survive!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Disappointed}I could buy back my *life* with the money it must cost to make one of those Ranger elite armors!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Admiringly}The Legion better watch out now, our Rangers are going to turn the tables around!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Visibly Worried}Despite our strength, the Legion army looks fierce enough to make me waiver.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Thoughtful Naivete}Maybe when this is all over, they'll find time to look after us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Fearful}It's time to pack and leave these lands until the dust settles.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Hopeful}Our victory at Nelson's a worthy story to tell in my travels.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Irritated Warning}Don't go messing around with the Fiends.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VERSewers01 "Random Encounters and Dialogue for Sewers" [QUST:001564E0]

text_content: {Irritated Warning}We ain't here to help you, get out.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VERSewers01 "Random Encounters and Dialogue for Sewers" [QUST:001564E0]

text_content: {Irritated Warning}What the hell are you doing here? Civilians shouldn't be here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VERSewers01 "Random Encounters and Dialogue for Sewers" [QUST:001564E0]

text_content: {Slight Concern for the player}It's not safe around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VERSewers01 "Random Encounters and Dialogue for Sewers" [QUST:001564E0]

text_content: {Slight Concern for the player}Try not to get killed, okay?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VERSewers01 "Random Encounters and Dialogue for Sewers" [QUST:001564E0]

text_content: {Slight Concern for the player}You should go topside.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VERSewers01 "Random Encounters and Dialogue for Sewers" [QUST:001564E0]

text_content: Ooh, suddenly I feel all tingly. And I find I've got a rocket launcher!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lucky38Jane "Jane" [CREA:00116A50]

text_content: Mr. House is just pleased as punch you got those old Securitrons back on-line, sugar.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lucky38Jane "Jane" [CREA:00116A50]

text_content: Ooh, the lights are all back on! How nice!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lucky38Jane "Jane" [CREA:00116A50]

text_content: You should have seen Mr. House when he heard what you did to the Omertas. He was as giddy as a schoolboy!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lucky38Jane "Jane" [CREA:00116A50]

text_content: Those nasty Brotherhood of Steel brutes are all taken care of? Mr. House will be so glad!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lucky38Jane "Jane" [CREA:00116A50]

text_content: When he heard you stopped President Kimball's assassination, Mr. House went on about martyrs and misadventures for hours!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lucky38Jane "Jane" [CREA:00116A50]

text_content: I bet those Boomers have some awfully big... {innuendo-palooza}guns.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lucky38Jane "Jane" [CREA:00116A50]

text_content: See? Mr. House has everything well in hand!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: Lucky38Jane "Jane" [CREA:00116A50]

text_content: Well hello, sugar. Mr. House is waiting for you in his office.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: How do they keep the floor in here so clean?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: They should have used Paladins to help protect the President.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If the NCR wasn't too proud to accept our assistance their president would still be alive.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The NCR is lucky we've chosen to side with them or we'd take the death of their President as a moment of weakness.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We are here to help protect the dam, word is Oliver is on his way and the battle will start soon.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We're ready to deploy whenever the NCR says the word.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Brotherhood hasn't seen a real battle in so long, I have no doubt we'll handle this no problem.
