name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The NCR is going to be grateful to have us around when the shooting starts.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Elder sent us to help protect the dam and await further orders.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Mike Lawson sure knows his way around the dam.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm honored to work with Lawson, he knows more about the dam than anyone.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Fantastic grabbed my ass. That guy is vile.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm pretty sick of Fantastic, can't that guy keep his hands to himself?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Everyone is abuzz about Oliver arriving soon. That must mean the battle is close.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hanlon is pretty legendary, people talk about what he did at the first battle of hoover dam with awe and respect.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I miss California.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: By Mars these weaklings die easily.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Don't get in my way!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What happened to your buddy's face?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Drunk, very slurred speech}I am not an alcoholic, sir. I'm a drunk! There's a difference!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Drunk, very slurred speech}I am not an alcoholic, ma'am. I'm a drunk! There's a difference!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Drunk ramble}The problem with some people is when they're not drunk, they're sober.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Drunk ramble}People ask me how much it takes me to get drunk. I don't know. I usually can't remember numbers, let alone where I am the next morning.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Drunk ramble}Hey! Watch your back! There be a pack of ol' ladies runnin' round here somewhere! Don't let {em}them catch you unawares!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Prison under attack}I don't want to get shot!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It's about time a new customer showed up around here. Was getting sick of dealing with the same faces all the time.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {After prison battle}I can't believe the NCR actually showed up. We sure showed them, though. Right?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What's up?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Prison under attack}There's still more troopers out there!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Male Player in Powder Ganger gear}I know {emphasis "all"}all the guys I did time with around here and you ain't one of them. Can't fool me with that Powder Ganger getup.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Female player in Powder Ganger gear}Okay, I know I wasn't serving time with no girl, or I'd have heard about it. You come to play with the Powder Gangers?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Male PC}Look at you, walking in here like you're one of us. Don't you know this is Powder Ganger territory?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Female PC}Hey there, girlie. You here to party with the Powder Gangers?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {After NCR attack}{gleeful for killing a guy}Did you see me take out that NCR trooper? Right through his eye!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {slightly hostility}What do you want now?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Prison under attack}I knew I should've gone with Cooke!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Heard there was a new face around. I'm the doctor around here... sort of.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {After prison battle - relieved}That... was close. I really need to find some nice, quiet place to settle.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Sticking around, I see.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Waiting in Primm for Pardon}Have you gotten my pardon from the NCR yet?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Sheriff of Primm}Thanks for getting me that pardon. Me and the boys will take good care of Primm, don't you worry.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Sheriff of Primm}I can do right by this town, they were in need of some frontier justice.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Prison under attack}Sounds like the NCR is finally getting off their ass to settle things around here. Don't expect me to get in their way.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player is in Combat}Maybe you ought to worry about the guys trying to kill you first.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Didn't know anyone would willingly walk into this place, not unless they were looking for trouble. What's your story?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Need to talk about something?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What are you looking at?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Will you quit bothering me?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Prison under attack}No time to talk. We've got trouble.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {impressed}Not half bad in a fight, are you? I figure you had a lot to do with me still breathing after all that.|I don't have any more work for you, but feel free to stick around as long as you want. You never know when the NCR will be back.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Dawes said he let somebody in. So, you going to give me a reason not to kill you and throw your body back outside?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're the one Cobb mentioned. Maybe you feel like helping us out around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {After prison battle}Not bad in a fight, are you? I really thought the NCR had us in their sights that time.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Powder Ganger Good Rep 2+ reached}I've been thinking that since you've been good to us, we can be good to you.|We've got plenty of spare powder and dynamite around. Say the word and we can give you some of it every couple of days.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Powder Ganger Mixed Rep 2+ reached}I don't know what to make of you, you know that? I know I can't really trust you, that's for sure.|Still, you've helped us out some, so maybe I ought to repay you some. I've spread the word about you to a bunch of guys out in the wasteland.|As long as you're not an enemy, they'll cut you some slack when you're near their camps. Trespass too long and they'll come after you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {abrupt, slightly hostile}What?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Combat in progress}Shut up and fight!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm Sergeant Lee. Lieutenant Hayes radioed ahead to say you were on the way.|We've got surprise on our side, and that's about it. Once we blow a gap in the fence, we've got to pour on the fire and keep them disorganized.|Our goal's to take out their leader, some assbag named Eddie. With the ringleader gone, the rest will fold.|That's all the briefing you're going to get. Let's go.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We can take it from here. We might have some cleaning up to do, but Eddie's a deadie. Gangs with no leadership don't last long.|I'll radio Hayes to let him know the prison's ours. But you should swing by to see him the next time you're near Primm.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thanks for the help.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You just walked into the wrong camp, my friend. Hand over everything you've got and we might let you live.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I got the message. You won't see me around these parts again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mixed Rep reached}Hey, I've been sent to tell you that, while you're not exactly a friend, we know you've helped us out some all the same.|We figure some kind of truce is in order. As long as you don't come too close to any of our camps, we'll let you pass without trying to kill you.|Of course, the truce is off once we know you're an enemy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Got nothing else to say to you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <groan>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <grunt>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Great Khan}Fuck Benny. We'll make him pay for stabbing us in the back.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Great Khan - in combat}There's more of them still out there.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {NCR Trooper}Beats going up against the Legion.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {NCR Trooper}Never gone up against Great Khans before.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Man, this place is a mess.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This rubble is slippery. Watch your step.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {NCR Trooper - in combat}We didn't get all of them. Talk later!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Worker}It's about time they called us back.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Worker}Work's slow right now, but at least it's something.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Worker}Train's not working yet.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Worker}I'm happy the Big Horn is still around.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Some of the machinery's frozen up. Need someone to talk a look at it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: All right, Smoothskin, I'm letting you in. You better watch yourself. I'll sure as hell be watching you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What's the problem, smoothskin? Lost your way?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hello? Who's down there?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Stop messing around with the intercom, smoothskin.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: God, but are you ugly! Get upstairs and talk to Jason before I throw up just from looking at you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Go bother Jason, smoothskin. I don't like having you around.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: ChrisHaversam "Chris Haversam" [NPC_:000810E9]

text_content: Have you found the components we discussed?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: ChrisHaversam "Chris Haversam" [NPC_:000810E9]

text_content: Have you found the components we discussed?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: ChrisHaversam "Chris Haversam" [NPC_:000810E9]

text_content: Hi, REPCONN Quest Stuff, have at it!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player not in NCR gear}{pleased}A customer! Not many people come into Boulder City these days.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This isn't a public relations office. If you're not here about a bounty, you can go pester the Colonel.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I see you're still alive, and that's promising. Any luck on that bounty?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Got any more good news for me?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Still working on that last bounty?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Perimeter's been quiet since you left. The Fiends are running scared. I doubt they'll give us any more trouble, not for a long while.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I haven't got any more bounties for you. It's been quiet and calm since you last reported in. Just how I like it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If you're looking for bounties, you're too late. Had a few Fiends on my shitlist, but they either got killed or moved on.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear you killed Driver Nephi. My team would've liked to get a shot at him... but we're still glad he's dead.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm Lieutenant Gorobets, First Recon. If you're looking to collect a bounty, you should talk to Major Dhatri.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You came through for us. I have to admit... I wasn't sure you'd make it.|Means a lot, letting my team get payback. Here. We all pitched in some caps for you. Even Sterling, and he's famous for his tight wallet.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Moving into position}We'll get ourselves into position. See you at the rock crushing plant.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {In position}We're all set up. You just lure Nephi close.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {First Recon member died}It's always hard to lose someone under your command. I hate writing the letter to their folks.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, my man! T-t-ten of spades. First Recon sharpshooter. At your s-s-service.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey there, miss! T-t-ten of spades. First Recon sharpshooter. At your s-s-service.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Betsy dead}Can't b-b-believe Betsy's gone. S-s-she was a bitch, b-but she was my p-p-partner, you know?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Gorobets dead}S-s-sucks about the {ell-TEE}LT. N-n-nobody can replace him.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: How 'bout you get out of my f-f-face? I'm First Recon. I don't need to t-take shit from civvies.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Moving into position}K-killing some Fiendsi? Shit, yeah! It's about t-t-time!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {In position}One shot, one kill. That's how Ten of Spades p-p-plays the game.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Nephi dead, 10 of Spades didn't get a hit}{disappointed}Shit. I didn't even get a shot at that Nephi b-b-bastard before he went down.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Nephi dead, 10 of Spades got a hit}Right here, Fiends! This is what payback looks like! First Recon, hooah!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Cook-Cook dead}'B-b-bout time Cook-Cook g-g-g-got what was c-coming to him.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You remember me, right? T-t-ten of Spades. First Recon.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {PC is female, CHA 7+}Girl... you are some grade-A poon, anybody ever tell you that?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Female PC, CHA 7+}You keep talking to me, sweetness, and people are gonna think we're an item. Not that I mind.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Male PC}Never seen you around before. What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Moving into position}Cut the chatter. Focus on the job, or you're gonna end up dead.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {In position}Quit talking! We've got a job to do.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Nephi dead, Betsy got a hit}You did good out there. Glad you let me get a piece of Nephi.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Nephi dead, Betsy didn't get a hit}What a pointless trip. Here I thought I'd get a shot at that junkie bastard.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {10 of Spades dead}Damn that 10 of Spades. Just had to go and get himself killed.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Gorobets dead}Gorobets was all right - {lesbian afterthought, with some respect}for a man. Not gonna be the same without him.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've been seeing Usanagi, and things are better. I'm not so angry all the time, you know? And, uh, I'm not trying to jump every woman in camp.|Well, not all the time, anyway,
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {a little subdued, but friendly - the player's helped her}Hey.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Female PC}{friendly - likes women}Hey, girl. You need something from me?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Male PC}{slight hostility - not fond of men}Yeah?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Corporal Sterling Top Level Topic Holder}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Howdy. Name's Sterling, First Recon. Can't say I've seen you before. I'd remember, if I had.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Nephi dead, Sterling didn't get a hit}Took some skill to bring down that Fiend. You done good.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Nephi dead, Sterling got in a hit}Nothing like a job done right. Wish I had a cigar.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Moving into position}Been a while since they let us out of the fence. Brass must really want Nephi dead.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {In position}Best you don't worry about us. We'll watch your back.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Gorobets dead}It's always hard when your commander goes down, but we'll pull through all right.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Howdy. What brings you back?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm Bitter-Root. First Recon. You got a reason to talk to me?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Moving into position}Can't talk now. Got to keep my eyes sharp.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {In position}{quietly warning, it's a combat situation}Eyes sharp, now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Nephi dead, Bitter-Root got a hit}Wish I'd gotten a bullet in that Fiend...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Nephi dead, Bitter-Root got a hit}That's one less drugged-out waster. Best part of this job - shooting folks who deserve it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Gorobets dead}I've never lost a {see-OH: commanding officer}CO before. It doesn't feel right.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Didn't think you'd be back. What's this about?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Let me guess. You got work for me, right? |Well, you're too late - I just quit the bounty trade. Soon as I pick up some caps that Dhatri owes me, I'm out of this scrapyard.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Cook-Cook dead}Heard you got Cook-Cook. I hope you roasted that bastard with his own flamer.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Yep, I'm still here. Shit, I got nothing better to do, right?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome to REPCONN Headquarters, Rocketeer! Come all this way to see our little facility, have you?|I'm here to answer any and all questions you may have - within specified parameters - and if you'd like, I can provide a tour of our museum.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome back! Interested in a tour of the REPCONN museum? Or did you have a question about the company I could answer?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Yes? Did you have a question?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Keeping the Strip secure has been hell since the monorail was taken out.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Did you hear about that Legion POW escape? I don't like our chances of taking him alive twice.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: They're talking about you on the radio. Saving President Kimball. I'm impressed.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: How could we lose Kimball at a time like this?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Chief Hanlon was a model soldier. We all looked up to him.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Too bad about Chief Hanlon. He did what he thought was best for us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Without Camp Forlorn Hope, it's a matter of time before the Legion surrounds us at the Dam.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This whole war's gonna change when the Ranger veterans get here. Soon as we see the Black Armor, we can all breathe easier.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: A platoon of veteran Rangers is like a tactical nuke, only tougher to scare.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This battle... everything's riding on it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That red beret's looking good, soldier.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The security lapse with the monorail is a huge embarrassment.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That POW escape presents some real security concerns. That was our base camp, for crying out loud.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: There's something fishy about how Chief Hanlon died. It just doesn't add up.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Can't believe Hanlon was working against us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: No hope of securing the border now that Forlorn Hope fell.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Ranger veterans have been running ops in Baja. We'll be a different army with them here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We've got our best Rangers here now. All of a sudden I like our chances a whole lot better.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If we lose Hoover Dam, we can kiss Nevada goodbye.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: With House dead, we'll have Vegas annexed before the year's out.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It's been a long tour. All I can think about now is going back home.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {LATER, BUNKER}Well! You're here ahead of schedule! I suppose it's just as well...|This is where I wanted you to end up, after all. {self-congratulating}I knew I could rely on Caesar to give you back the Platinum Chip.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {LATER, BUNKER, MISSION}I see that you reached your destination safely. Shall we get to work?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {BUNKER}Have you come to your senses? It's not too late to upload the Platinum Chip's data to the primary computer.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {BUNKER}Stop wasting time. Go upload the data on the Platinum Chip to the facility's primary computer.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {BUNKER}As you know, the Platinum Chip upgrades my Securitrons' operating software. Well... there's an army of them here.|The Securitrons policing the Strip are a fraction of the total number manufactured. The rest, I stored here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {BUNKER}The Platinum Chip is a data-storage device.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I need you to manually upload the data from the Chip to the facility's primary computer. There's a terminal at the other end of this facility.|There's a complication. While I can broadcast to this screen, I can't control any of the facility's systems.|That means I can't deactivate its security bots... most of which appear to be active, according to the status board I'm looking at.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {BUNKER, FORT SECS DEST}{devastated}Do you have the slightest idea of what you've done, of what you've destroyed?|You've doomed Vegas to be ruled by corrupt bureaucrats or fanatical savages.|Singlehandedly, you've brought mankind's best hopes of forward progress crashing down. No punishment would be too severe.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {BUNKER}Your work here is done. Return to the Lucky 38 so we can discuss next steps.|You have a very bright future ahead of you. Thanks to your actions today, so does the rest of mankind.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {PLAYER DIDN'T GET CHIP}{Should be Securitron on the Strip}Benny is dead, and yet you don't appear to be carrying the Platinum Chip.|I don't suppose you forgot to search his body?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {LOST CHIP}Before we go any further - where is the Platinum Chip?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {FIRST, HAS CHIP, FORT SECS UP}{spoke to player at the Fort bunker first}So, we meet in person finally... so to speak. You did well at the Fort - kudos.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {HAD CHIP, REFUSED, RETURNED}Have you come to your senses - or will there be a repeat of the last incident?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {FIRST, HAS CHIP, BENNY DEAD TOPS}You've been a busy courier, haven't you? You take your obligation to deliver an package very seriously - an ethic for which I am grateful.|I will admit, when you ignored my invitation, I predicted... negative outcomes. But - you have a way of exceeding expectations, don't you?|Well enough. Let's have the Chip, then.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {FIRST, NO TOPS}{even tones, welcoming the player but appraising, too}This meeting has been a long time coming, hasn't it? You've come a long ways, literally and, I suspect, figuratively as well.|{proud of the Vegas you built}I have to ask - now that you've reached your destination, what do you make of what you see?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {FIRST, BENNY FLED}The point of my inviting you to visit me here at the Lucky 38 {emphasis}before stomping into the Tops on your own was to help you prepare - tactically.|Now, because of your carelessness, Benny has fled the Strip, taking with him the Platinum Chip.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {FIRST DISCUSS, PLAYER VISITED TOPS}{welcoming player, trying to hide irritation}Well... this meeting has been a long time in coming... longer still, since you took time to {disapproving}charge into the Tops before coming to see me.|{putting aside irritation}Before we get down to details, I must ask - now that you've arrived at your destination, what do you make of what you see?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {NO TERMS, NO TOPS}{player walked away without accepting terms last time}Can I look forward to a more {beat, emphasis}substantial conversation this time?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {TERMS, NO TOPS}Have you considered the terms of my offer? There's else little for us to discuss until you have.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {TERMS YES, NO CHIP}What is the purpose of this delay?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {LATER, BENNY FLED}Events have transpired in a... {beat}less-than-optimal fashion. Benny has fled the Strip, and the Platinum Chip has not been recovered.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {LATER, BENNY FLED}Benny must be pursued, and the Platinum Chip, recovered.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {LATER, HAS CHIP, BENNY DEAD TOPS}So... Benny has been {slight beat}handled and you've recovered the Platinum Chip. Let's have it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {LATER, HAS CHIP}I take it you've come to deliver the Platinum Chip?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {HOUSE RECEIVES CHIP}{tenderly regarding the Chip}Such a small thing, isn't it? And yet so... {capacious = inexhaustibly capable}capacious. So very dear.|Decades of hiring salvagers out west to search for this little {beat}relic in the ruins of a place called Sunnyvale. Back then, anyway.|That's where the Chip was printed, on October 22, 2077. It was to have been hand-delivered to me here, at the Lucky 38, the next day. |But the bombs fell first. Suffice it to say, the delivery was never made.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {CHIP IN, STRIP SECS NO}{jaunty, eager to share your secret}Come now, come now... get thee to the elevator.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {CHIP IN, STRIP SECS NO}{growing impatient}To the elevator, if you please... Stop dragging your feet.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {STRIP SECS UP}{dry}Trips to the basement are rarely so educational, don't you think?|I've since broadcast the upgrade to every Securitron in range of my transmitters, and I must say, it's causing quite a stir down on the Strip!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {L38, HAS BUNKER MISSION}Make your way to Caesar's Camp at Fortification Hill. Something very interesting awaits you...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {STRIP SECS UP, GIVES BUNKER MISSION}To secure the future of New Vegas, I must have your assistance. The work ahead is dangerous, but {beat}you weather danger well.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {STRIP SECS UP}Have you found the courage to do what's necessary?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {MQN, B4 CHIP}What did you wish to know?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {MQN, B4 CHIP}What else did you want to know?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {FORT SECS NO}We'll talk again once you've concluded your work in the bunker at Fortification Hill.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {FORT SECS UP}The foundation is laid. My Securitrons on the Strip are upgraded, and those at the Fort, ready for action.|Now it's just a matter of adjusting the attitudes of some lesser groups while we wait for Caesar's Legion to attack Hoover Dam.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {PLAYER HASN'T ACCEPTED BOOMER QUEST YET}The next step is to add the Boomers' considerable firepower to my growing arsenal... or at the very least, ensure their neutrality.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: As I was saying, I need you to enlist or neutralize the Boomers at Nellis Air Force Base.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {BOOMERS QUEST ACTIVE}Any progress with the Boomers?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Your next assignment won't take you far. It concerns the Omertas and their den of vice, Gomorrah.|As the decisive encounter between the bull and the bear looms close, my concerns about the Omertas have grown.|I've never expected loyalty, mind you. A reliably underhanded tribe is just as constant to deal with as one that always run true.|But that's just it - lately the Omertas' cooperative silence has been deafening. Not a single complaint? They're up to something.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Your next assignment would've been to investigate the Omertas, but you managed to foil their scheme before I could put you to the task.|I should compensate you as though it were an official assignment, however. Wouldn't want to {beat}disincentivize your proactivity.{cash out Omerta quest}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'd hoped to have you investigate the Omertas, but after the trouble you caused at Gomorrah, they won't let you in the front door.|I'll see if I can make some progress with informants. You're useless in this matter.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: As I said before, I need you to investigate the Omertas, to see what they're up to.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What do you have to report about the Omertas?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Your next assignment is to locate and destroy remnants of the Mojave chapter of the Brotherhood of Steel.|The NCR nearly did the job at Helios One a few years ago, but there seem to have been survivors, unfortunately.|Given the Brotherhood's fanatical views on technology, they can be counted on to oppose my regime.|Please - put them out of my misery.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: As I've said, I need you to locate and destroy the Brotherhood of Steel.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Have you destroyed the Brotherhood of Steel?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Will you ensure that President Kimball survives his visit to Hoover Dam?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {ALL REPUTATIONS LEAD-IN}Aaron Kimball, the president of the New California Republic, is going to visit Hoover Dam to "boost morale."|Apparently he hasn't considered the effect on the troops' morale of seeing their beloved leader get his brains blown out by a Legion sniper.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {GOOD REP LEAD-IN}I need you to make sure that no harm comes to President Kimball. It's fortunate that you've maintained good relations with the NCR...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {NCR REPUTATION TERRIBLE}Unfortunately, I can't use you to protect Kimball. The NCR won't let you come within a thousand feet of the President.|Odds are that Caesar will launch his assault on the dam after Kimball's visit is concluded, one way or the other - so be on guard.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {NCR REPUTATION TERRIBLE}{ALTERNATE}Unfortunately, I can't very well send you off to protect Kimball. The NCR won't let you come within a thousand feet of the President.|This can be used to our advantage, though it'll a {beat}grim business. Go to Hoover Dam and attack the gathering crowd, and his visit will be canceled.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {REPUTATION OKAY}Your reputation with the NCR isn't exactly stellar, so I'll have to vouche for you. It'll make a scene, but it's worth it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Last I knew, President Kimball wasn't scheduled to visit the Lucky 38. Be on your way to Hoover Dam, will you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If not for you, President Kimball would be dead. So you needn't feel guilty when the NCR's rout from Hoover Dam demolishes his political career.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Why in the world did you attack President Kimball?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Kimball is dead - what a mess you've made!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {GIVES EL DORADO SUBSTATION QUEST}Between the Strip and HELIOS One lies the El Dorado electrical substation.|Humble as it appears, the substation has immense strategic value, for it's there that you'll jumpstart the Lucky 38's dormant reactor.|Gain access to the substation's control room and install this override module. Just so you know, there are NCR troops guarding the station.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Until the Lucky 38's reactor has been restarted, we have nothing to discuss.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: As you can see, Vegas is humming along. I've tested my c3i broadcasting arrays. Everything is in order.|And just in time, as it turns out. The forces of Caesar's Legion are on the march, establishing a staging area east of the dam.|Their assault could begin at any moment. So that's where you'll be heading, if you're ready - Hoover Dam.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Legion's assault could begin at any moment.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {MQN, STRIP SECS UP}What did you want to discuss?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {MQN, STRIP SECS UP}What else did you want to discuss?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player fled combat last time}There will be no repeat of the trouble we had last time, I trust?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player fled combat last time}I'm optimistic that this conversation will go more smoothly.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {MQN, FORT SECS UP}I'd rather you just dealt with the Boomers, but all right...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {MQN, FORT SECS UP}I suppose the Omertas can wait a few minutes.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {MQN, FORT SECS UP}A few questions, and then you'll handle the Brotherhood, I hope?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {MQN, FORT SECS UP}Questions like "Will President Kimball survive his visit to Hoover Dam?"
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {MQN, FORT SECS UP}Even now? On the brink of battle?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I knew you'd make it. Resourceful, as always.|The override module is functioning properly. I'm rerouting power to the Securitron vault at the Fort as we speak...|I just need you to head over to the east power plant and manually activate the switch.|When you return topside, I think you'll see that my Securitron army is a little more than the Legion was prepared to handle.|Oh, and before you go - grab that print-out spooling from the console here - those papers set the terms for the NCR's unconditional surrender.|I thought you might enjoy the honor of presenting them to the NCR's commanding officer, once the Legion has been defeated. Cheers!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Fleshy House}{rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema}Why have you... done this?... centuries of preparation... so much good, undone...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Fleshy House}{rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema}I have... nothing... to say... to you...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: It sure is nice to see everybody working together like family. Maybe now the baby Jesus won't cry his self to sleep every night.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2COHanrahan "O'Hanrahan" [NPC_:00104312]

text_content: Shooting guns is real scary, but I think I got the hang of it now!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2COHanrahan "O'Hanrahan" [NPC_:00104312]

text_content: Razz said the candy he got us was special! I wonder what he- {sudden, psychotic break}Gnaaah, kill, kill, rip and kill! -{right back to normal}meant by that?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2COHanrahan "O'Hanrahan" [NPC_:00104312]

text_content: Poindexter says all our troubles is over now, and we won't have to go to war. I guess that's good, but I don't understand why.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2COHanrahan "O'Hanrahan" [NPC_:00104312]

text_content: Is it true? The big boss ranger done killed his self?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2COHanrahan "O'Hanrahan" [NPC_:00104312]

text_content: Howdy, great to see you!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2COHanrahan "O'Hanrahan" [NPC_:00104312]

text_content: Y'all sure are a big ol' hero. I gotta wright my mama and tell her I met you!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2COHanrahan "O'Hanrahan" [NPC_:00104312]

text_content: Uh, howdy. Are you gonna be mean or nice this time?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2COHanrahan "O'Hanrahan" [NPC_:00104312]

text_content: You scare and confuse me, and I think you should be nicer to people.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2COHanrahan "O'Hanrahan" [NPC_:00104312]

text_content: Go away, you big bully!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2COHanrahan "O'Hanrahan" [NPC_:00104312]

text_content: {Frightened}Ahhh! Somebody call in the Rangers!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2COHanrahan "O'Hanrahan" [NPC_:00104312]

text_content: Howdy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2COHanrahan "O'Hanrahan" [NPC_:00104312]

text_content: While I have already internalized the new skills we have discussed, I feel as though my solution was nevertheless more practical.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CPoindexter "Poindexter" [NPC_:00104311]

text_content: Excellent! Maximal reward for minimal work.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CPoindexter "Poindexter" [NPC_:00104311]

text_content: I trust you're satisfied with the squad's newfound teamwork? It's almost entirely my own doing, I assure you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CPoindexter "Poindexter" [NPC_:00104311]

text_content: Ever since consuming those "illicit rations" Razz offered us, I have felt a steadily-increasing desire to kill.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CPoindexter "Poindexter" [NPC_:00104311]

text_content: I understand the esteemed Chief Hanlon is no longer with us. A shame. He seemed to be the only competent leadership this Army had.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CPoindexter "Poindexter" [NPC_:00104311]

text_content: I'm assuming you aren't associated with the Army or the Rangers. What can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CPoindexter "Poindexter" [NPC_:00104311]

text_content: You've done an excelent job ingratiating yourself to the top brass. I assume this is some sort of strategem?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CPoindexter "Poindexter" [NPC_:00104311]

text_content: You've managed to become extraordinarily well-liked by the top brass. You should exploit that for your own gain wherever possible.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CPoindexter "Poindexter" [NPC_:00104311]

text_content: Your behavior has become an unwelcome X-factor, and I would kindly ask you to consider altering it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CPoindexter "Poindexter" [NPC_:00104311]

text_content: I'm afraid I have no desire to socialize with unstable elements such as yourself.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CPoindexter "Poindexter" [NPC_:00104311]

text_content: I must question your logic in coming here, in light of your prior actions.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CPoindexter "Poindexter" [NPC_:00104311]

text_content: Kindly remove yourself, as I have no desire to be struck by a stray round when disgruntled troopers begin firing on you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CPoindexter "Poindexter" [NPC_:00104311]

text_content: Greetings once again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CPoindexter "Poindexter" [NPC_:00104311]

text_content: Okay, okay, I admit it - knowing how to use these guns right is pretty cool.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CRazz "Razz" [NPC_:00104314]

text_content: Sweet, those "readiness reports" are so good they actually gave me a raise!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CRazz "Razz" [NPC_:00104314]

text_content: I thought all that touchy-feely teamwork bullshit was kind of fruity... but it kinda feels good knowing my squad's got my back.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CRazz "Razz" [NPC_:00104314]

text_content: {Tripping out on a drug almost like but legally distinct from meth}Ha ha, fuck me, Jack's shit is still the best!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CRazz "Razz" [NPC_:00104314]

text_content: Heard Chief Hanlon took the {"lead" as in bullets}lead expressway to Angel-town. Weird shit, yo.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CRazz "Razz" [NPC_:00104314]

text_content: What you want, homes?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CRazz "Razz" [NPC_:00104314]

text_content: Aw, shit, here comes the brown-noser. What you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CRazz "Razz" [NPC_:00104314]

text_content: Shit, look who it is, the crazy one! What up?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CRazz "Razz" [NPC_:00104314]

text_content: Every time you come around, the brass gets their pants in a bunch. Keep on coming by.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CRazz "Razz" [NPC_:00104314]

text_content: Shit, you just piss folks off wherever you go, huh?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CRazz "Razz" [NPC_:00104314]

text_content: I know I talk a lot of shit about the army, but you come around here again and I'll slit you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CRazz "Razz" [NPC_:00104314]

text_content: Yo.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CRazz "Razz" [NPC_:00104314]

text_content: Something I can do you for?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CDocSawbones "Doc Sawbones" [NPC_:00155A03]

text_content: I suppose I can help you out. What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CDocSawbones "Doc Sawbones" [NPC_:00155A03]

text_content: I'm not really comfortable having you in here, so make it quick.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CDocSawbones "Doc Sawbones" [NPC_:00155A03]

text_content: Hey, friend. Need something?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CDocSawbones "Doc Sawbones" [NPC_:00155A03]

text_content: Glad to see you! Need a patch-job?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CDocSawbones "Doc Sawbones" [NPC_:00155A03]

text_content: I think you'd better get out of here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CDocSawbones "Doc Sawbones" [NPC_:00155A03]

text_content: There are a half-dozen troopers in shouting distance. Best remember that before you try anything.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 2CDocSawbones "Doc Sawbones" [NPC_:00155A03]

text_content: I don't speak with outsiders, smoothskins especially. Talk to our leader, Jason Bright.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Well, well! If it isn't the Vault explorer himself! Welcome back.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Well, well! If it isn't the Vault explorer herself! Welcome back.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Satisfied but exhausted from sex}That was something else. I look forward to the next ride - once I recover, you monster.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What are you doing here!? I don't want to be near you ever again! Leave, leave... just leave, ok!?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, stranger! Where have you been, uh? I missed you!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Give me a few to close the shop, I'll meet you at the room.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Deeply Saddened}Mickey is... he's no longer... alive. I'm sorry, but I just can't go on.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey buddy, spare a cap? I can make it worth your while.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: This man's prices are steep, but I hear he's worth it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSGamblerTalkingToOrris "Gambler" [NPC_:001194D7]

text_content: Thanks, mister!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSRatChasingChild01 "Child" [NPC_:00118399]

text_content: Thanks, lady!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSRatChasingChild01 "Child" [NPC_:00118399]

text_content: I wish he'd quit running.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSRatChasingChild02 "Child" [NPC_:0011839C]

text_content: He's kinda cute, isn't he?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSRatChasingChild03 "Child" [NPC_:0011839D]

text_content: We're gonna have rat tonight!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSRatChasingChild01 "Child" [NPC_:00118399]

text_content: Hey pal, spare a cap?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: Ah, my favorite customer. Got a cap for me?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: You could do worse than leave your life in my hands, wanderer. Far worse.|A hundred caps sees you safely through Freeside. What do you say?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSBodyguard01 "Bodyguard For Hire" [NPC_:0010E707]

text_content: You're in luck stranger. You just happen to be talking to the most successful bodyguard in all of Freeside.|And I just happen to be available at the moment. One hundred caps gets you a peaceful, pleasant trip through our fair district. Guaranteed.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSBodyguard02 "Bodyguard For Hire" [NPC_:0010E708]

text_content: Hello, my friend! Can I perhaps interest you in some protection? My services come cheap at only a hundred caps.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSBodyguard03 "Bodyguard For Hire" [NPC_:0010E709]

text_content: Look, I'm being paid to shoot people who talk to you, not talk to you myself. Just pretend I'm not here or something.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSBodyguard01 "Bodyguard For Hire" [NPC_:0010E707]

text_content: Freeside truly is an interesting place, isn't it?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSBodyguard02 "Bodyguard For Hire" [NPC_:0010E708]

text_content: I am sorry, my friend, but I must concentrate on watching out for threats. Please do not take offense.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSBodyguard03 "Bodyguard For Hire" [NPC_:0010E709]

text_content: Something you need, kid?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Heh, so the Garrets sent you to track me down? What a joke.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSCalebMcCaffery "Caleb McCaffery" [NPC_:0010C67F]

text_content: Welcome to the Atomic Wrangler. What can I get you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome to the Atomic Wrangler.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey man, can you spare a few caps?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: How are you today? Santiago is fabulous!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Ah... I wasn't expecting you to return.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Santiago has nothing left to give. Leave me now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Santiago thanks you for getting him this job.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hello. Lovely to meet you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I have nothing more to give. Leave me be.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Are you here to drop off medical supplies? Leave them with the rest in the middle of the courtyard.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: Looking for a fix, man? I got what you need.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You seen Dixon around? He said he'd be back today.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Come on, man. I'm dying here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Do you have chems, buddy? I could really use a fix.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So you're back. Got any chems for me yet?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Howdy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSBeatrixRussell "Beatrix Russell" [NPC_:0011FC07]

text_content: Not bad. You're lucky I was drawing their fire, otherwise you would have been chewed up.|I sent one of my guys back to the King to report what happened. You should head back. He'll probably want to thank you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The King just sent a messenger over, saying these guys are off-limits. He's probably already heard about what you did here.|Looks like you get to be a hero. Enjoy it while it lasts.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Why the hell are you here? I got this under control!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Why are you talking to me? Smoke these guys already!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Good, you're here. These soldier boys don't kid around. They must have had a lookout posted and spotted us coming.|They took out two of my guys right away, and now the rest are too scared to move in. That leaves you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSPacer "Pacer" [NPC_:0010E037]

text_content: What do we have here? Another petitioner for the King?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSPacer "Pacer" [NPC_:0010E037]

text_content: Look who's back. If you want to see the King, you better pay up.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSPacer "Pacer" [NPC_:0010E037]

text_content: Go on. The King's a busy man. Be grateful for this opportunity.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSPacer "Pacer" [NPC_:0010E037]

text_content: I've got my eye on you. You cross the Kings, you'll regret it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSPacer "Pacer" [NPC_:0010E037]

text_content: Look, Rexie, someone new's come to see us. {Sighs}Poor boy. He hasn't been feeling well lately. I'm the King. What can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: That's strange, I don't see ol' Rexie with you. He usually comes back here whenever he's not with you. Where'd he get to?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: Why Rexie, you look all better, boy! Good as new! {talks in dog-owner-schmoopy voice}Did my Rexie get a new brain?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: I sure appreciate you coming back. You think a little more about my offer?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: I... I can't believe Pace is gone... He was always right here, you know? Always cracking me up with some story or another.|Anyway, what did you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard someone got to my friends who were injured. Looks like we'll never find out who did it now.|Did you want something? I'm all kinda shook up right now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: My eyes on the street tell me you haven't paid our mutual friend Orris a visit yet. Until you do, we got nothing to talk about.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: What do you have for me?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: { Top level topics for The King }
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: Have you found anything out? Or were you just here to chat?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: You find out somethin' about them soldier boys yet?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: I've already heard all about what happened, and all I can say is that I, and all of Freeside, thank you. Thank you very much.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: I heard all about what happened. Maybe it's time for a little more talkin' and a little less fightin'.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: Things have been lots better since you helped with with those soldier boys. Thanks again. So what can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What can the King do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Leave me alone. Can't you see a man's fighting for his life here?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSLocalVictim03 "Roy" [NPC_:00113649]

text_content: What is it? Can't you see I want to be left alone with my friend here?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSLocalVictim03 "Roy" [NPC_:00113649]

text_content: Tell the King we thank him for looking out for us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSLocalVictim03 "Roy" [NPC_:00113649]

text_content: I ain't got any reason to talk to you. Scram.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSLocalVictim02 "Wayne" [NPC_:00113648]

text_content: That true? Did the King really send you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSLocalVictim02 "Wayne" [NPC_:00113648]

text_content: Hope what I remembered helps.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSLocalVictim02 "Wayne" [NPC_:00113648]

text_content: Hey, you helped out Bill Ronte so the Followers worked out a deal for you to drink free.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The King controls the water pump. If you want water, you need to pay like everyone else.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Guess we won't be doing this for much longer.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSOffDutyNCRTrooper02 "NCR Trooper" [NPC_:00116C63]

text_content: The Major gave us all a talking-to. Guess she heard about some of the guys' "night missions."
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSOffDutyNCRTrooper03 "NCR Trooper" [NPC_:00116C64]

text_content: I've never seen the Major so angry before. She may look calm right now, but don't let her fool you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSOffDutyNCRTrooper04 "NCR Trooper" [NPC_:00116C65]

text_content: Hold up. What's the password?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSOffDutyNCRTrooper01 "NCR Trooper" [NPC_:00116C61]

text_content: Let's try to keep the line moving, folks.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSOffDutyNCRTrooper03 "NCR Trooper" [NPC_:00116C64]

text_content: Try to take only what you need.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSOffDutyNCRTrooper04 "NCR Trooper" [NPC_:00116C65]

text_content: Submit to a credit check or present your passport before proceeding to the gate. Trespassers will be shot.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Don't bother me right now. I've got to get back to see if any customers are waiting.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSOrris "Orris" [NPC_:00115C38]

text_content: Stay away from me, if you know what's good for you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Come on, let's get this over with.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Don't distract me. I need to focus all my senses on keeping you safe.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This gentleman and I were just settling on a price. I'm afraid you'll have to hire one of the others this time around.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSOrris "Orris" [NPC_:00115C38]

text_content: If you need to cross Freeside, no one will keep you safer than I will.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSOrris "Orris" [NPC_:00115C38]

text_content: I knew you'd be back. Ready to hire the best?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VFSOrris "Orris" [NPC_:00115C38]

text_content: Fully Integrated Security Technetronic Officer active and reporting for duty.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Operation complete. Thank you for your business.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Greetings. Fisto is programmed to please.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I am programmed for your pleasure. Please assume the position.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome to Mick & Ralph's. If you need guns, I'm your man.|For general supplies and other services, see my partner Ralph.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Blunt advice}You might want to clean up your act. Some of the locals have been complaining.|Ralph and I don't sell to people who treat our friends badly.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Blunt}I don't take kindly to deadbeats who treat my friends like trash. Get {outta}out of here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {saddened sigh}I wish I'd never gotten involved with the Omertas. All of this bloodshed...|{vindictive}One of these days, those bastards will get what's coming to them. {calm realization}In the meantime, I'll be sure to be more careful with my sales.|{back to business}Anyway, is there anything I can get you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Matter of fact}That was a real mess the Omertas were looking to create. {grateful, long glaaad}Glad you could get all that sorted.|{financially strained, but relieved}May have cost me some business, but at least we avoided a shitstorm.|{back to business}Anything I can get {ya}you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Gruff}All of the scumbags are coming out of the woodwork now that the Kings are keeping everyone in line.|{resigned sigh}At least gun sales are better than ever. {back to business}Now what can I get you{getcha}?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Ambivalent sigh}I'm not sure how to feel about the Kings and NCR sorting out their differences, but as long as business keeps up, I'm a happy man.|{back to business}Now what can I {getcha}get you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Amused}People say Mr. House hasn't been heard from in a while. Good riddance.|{Back to business as usual}Now what can I do for {yuh}you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard about some things you've done around town. Nice to know someone is helping out for a change.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {happy to see player}Welcome back, buddy! What can I {getcha}get you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome back.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I don't deal with dirtbags. Take a walk.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If you're looking for guns, talk to Mick. Otherwise, I've got a nice selection of general supplies and other services.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, thanks for getting Bill Ronte fixed up. I was really getting sick of paying for water.|Now, what can I do for {ya}you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Giddy}Man, Jacob's Absinthe is phenomenal stuff. I don't think I've slept this well in ages...{trails off}|{back to business}If you haven't tried it yet, he's been supplying the Wrangler with the stuff. So, what can I get {ya}you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {chuckles to self}With the Kings gone, it may be a little hairier around here, but business is good.|Anything in particular you're looking for?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Sarcastic}So, Ambassador Fancypants has graced us with his presence! {sarcastic}I apologize if you're looking for Pre-War pipes and smoking jackets, I'm clean out.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Playing debt collector for the Garrets, eh? I guess someone has to do their dirty work.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Pimpin'}Pimping ain't easy, eh? Maybe if you find some decent talent, I'll start visiting the Wrangler more often.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {happy to see player}How's it going, friend? Looking for anything special?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Sarcastic, aaaand}And NCR wins? No, really, I'm shocked.|{sarcastic}I totally didn't expect the guys with advanced armor and seemingly unlimited ammunition to take down an army of machete-wielding ingrates.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Wary}With Caesar's Legion in control of the dam, I think things are going to get much more difficult around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Elated}That old coot, House, is going to make me rich! With all the new rules and regulations in New Vegas, I'll make a killing circumventing them!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Pleased}An independent Vegas... Never thought I'd see it.|House may be gone, but the players remain the same. Business as usual, then.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, what can I get you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {creepy vagrant laugh}Heh heh heh heh heh. <Coughs>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMS49Vagrant "Vagrant" [NPC_:0014E83C]

text_content: {nearly passed out}Wha-?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMS49Vagrant "Vagrant" [NPC_:0014E83C]

text_content: Bang bang bang bang bang!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMS49Max "Max" [NPC_:0014EB35]

text_content: Reach for the sky, lady.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMS49Max "Max" [NPC_:0014EB35]

text_content: Reach for the sky, mister.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMS49Max "Max" [NPC_:0014EB35]

text_content: I wish I had a gun.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMS49Max "Max" [NPC_:0014EB35]

text_content: Max can't even hit me. He's so dumb.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm bored.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey pal, you dig my new hat? I've been making some good money lately, and figured I'd treat myself.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, I thought about what you said before, and picked up this sweet piece. You were right, I feel much safer.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, I'm sorry about being so dismissive about your suggestion before. I thought a lot about what you said.|There've been times when just a little bit of money from a stranger would have made a huge difference to me, so I get where you're coming from.|Maybe I could make that kind of difference for someone else... ah, who am I kidding?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, I've been thinking a lot about what you said earlier, about saving up and leaving this dump. Do you really think it's possible?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Look pal, I've been thinking. I know we got off to a bad start there, but let's put it behind us, okay?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey pal, I made so much recently that I was able to afford this little number too. How do I look?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You again. You want a tip, or you here to piss me off some more?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey pal, you got the caps, I got the info. You do have the caps, right?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Ah, my favorite customer returns. Want a tip?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mugging sequence}Well, look who it is. I was just thinking about you.|I recently came across a piece of info that you just have to hear, and since you're my best customer, it's on the house. Interested?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mugging, after you turned him down the first time}Hey, I've still got that super-hot tip for you, and it's still free. What do you say?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Leaving}Hey pal, I've finally saved up enough caps to leave this dump, so no tips today. Or ever, I guess, ha ha.|A lot of these caps came from you, so I wanted to say thanks before I shove off. Meeting you really changed my life.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Actual mugging}Okay, pal, we're going to do this quick and easy. I know you're loaded down with caps, judging by how much you've already given me.|So I thought I'd save us both some time and just take all the caps you have. Hand them over.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Him working for the Followers}Oh hey, didn't think I'd see you here. I decided to stop scrounging for caps and start making a difference.|The Followers have been really great. There's always something that needs to be done, and everyone here treats me really well.|Sorry if you stopped by my old spot looking for info. I've been so busy lately that I haven't heard anything.|Anyway, feel free to stay as long as you like. I've got to get back to work.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Said with an accusing tone, emphasis on the "you"}What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Pacer top level topics}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome to Freeside. Try not to get killed.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Kick back and relax! Everything is allowed in Freeside!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The only rule in Freeside is don't mess with the Kings.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Watch yourself around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If you're heading to the Strip, just go through the gate there.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Freeside is the Kings' turf. Remember that.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Great, another one come in from the wastes. Like this place isn't crowded enough.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Move along.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Good evening! Are you looking for companionship, love?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You look new to Freeside, so here's a little advice, friend. Don't go past the south gate greeter without talking to it first.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hello again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Ah, you return to me a King yourself! It would be an honor for me to do your hair! That is why you are here, yes?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Ah, I knew you'd be back. Ready for your entire life to change?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You want your hair done, too? No, no, no. The Kings are many, and their hair must be *perfect*.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: When is the King coming back up here? I'm bored!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The King is all that his name implies, and then some.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The King promised to take us out tonight. I simply adore going to the Tops!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: All I do all day is read magazines. You'd be amazed what you can learn from them!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I want to go to the Strip! We never get to go to Gomorrah anymore!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're not a King! Does the King know you're up here?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You want to travel through Freeside with ease, you hire a King. We're everywhere, and no one messes with us.|Your safety is practically guaranteed, for just 100 caps.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey there, you want to cruise Freeside in style, you'd do worse than hire a King to tag along.  Only 100 caps.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You wanted something?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Something on your mind?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Angry}Well, I hate to support the damn NCR, but it looks like they're the only thing between us and mass slavery at the hands of the Legion.|Here's to the slaughter of every last one of those brahmin-poking meatheads, Caesar's Legion.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Wary}Doesn't look good, this build-up of forces between the NCR and Legion. Not good at all for business in the long run, if the Legion wins.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Concerned}I hear the Legion is camping out across the river. I hope they're not planning to attack, but those bloodthirsty molerats are never up to any good.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {excited}Some guys were in here earlier saying you survived Benny's goon squad. That's one hell of a feat, bud. Have a drink on me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Amused}I hear Benny got force-fed a little slice of heaven. Man what I would have paid to see that loathesome little weasel eat it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Snarky}So Benny went MIA, huh? I always figured him for a coward.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Confident}You made a run on The Tops, eh? Admirable work, but don't try that crap in Freeside.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mixed}I don't care how you get your work done, but keep you nose clean in Freeside.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mixed}{Chuckle}Here comes trouble. What can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Wild Child}I can see you appreciate the gray areas of life. Got anything in particular you're looking for?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Wild Child}Welcome back, wild man. What can I do for you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Wild Child}Welcome back, wild woman. What can I do for you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Good Natured Rascal}{Heya}Hey, chum. Welcome back.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Liked}Welcome back, friend. What can I get you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Merciful Thug}People in Freeside are talking, bub. We don't serve punks. Change your attitude, or find another place to drink.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Merciful Thug}I don't have all day. What do you need?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Hated}You're a real piece of work, bub. You're lucky to be alive with your rep around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Unknown}Welcome to the Atomic Wrangler. What can I get you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Unknown}Welcome back. What can I get you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Concerned}I heard about your run on The Tops. Don't even think about trying that crap here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Amused}So Benny's dead, huh? That shifty son of a bitch had it coming.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {at a loss}I hear Benny went missing. I can't help but wonder what happened to him.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {excited}I heard Benny sent his goons after you. You're one hell of a survivor to make it out of The Tops alive.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {matter-of-fact}So it turns out the Omertas were into some serious shit. I always suspected that crew was dirty.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Friendly, Impressed}Some gamblers came in saying they'd seen you enter the Lucky 38. I have to say I'm impressed.|I don't know of any other living person who's been in there.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Cheery}People are saying the Securitrons are acting funny. {Cold}I hope that old Geezer, House, is dead. Might give the locals a chance to take control.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Warm thanks}Here's one on the house for taking down Caesar. Serves him right for treating women like livestock.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Amused}You hear? Caesar finally kicked the bucket! Serves him right for treating women like livestock.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Disgusted}Damn monorail bombing. I {spose}suppose this means we'll be seeing more NCR chumps wandering through Freeside.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Reticent}Hate to say it, but business has improved since the troopers started coming through Freeside to get to Vegas.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Amused}I hear you've been making a name for yourself on The Strip. Don't forget about the Wrangler if you make it big.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Concerned}People are getting nervous about the Legion amassing on the other side of the river. I hope the NCR can hold agains another attack.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Wary}This build-up on both sides of the dam isn't good. If the Legion attacks and wins, it won't be long before we're all slaves.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Angry}God-damned Legion is raring for a fight. No matter who wins, a lot of people are going to die in the process, and dead men don't drink.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mixed}You can order whatever you want, as long as it's alcoholic.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Wild Child}So the wild one returns! What can I get you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Good Natured Rascal}{Appreciative}I hear you've been helping out around town. It's much appreciated, friend.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Good Natured Rascal}{Warm}What can I get you, friend?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Liked}{Warm}You've done a lot for Freeside and it is much appreciated. Here's one on the house.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Liked}{Warm}Good to see you! What can I get you, friend?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
