text_content: {Merciful Thug}Watch yourself, friend. We don't serve those who treat our friends badly. Shape up, or ship out.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Merciful Thug}{Disinterested}Yeah? What do you need?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Hated}What the hell do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Unknown}Welcome to the Atomic Wrangler. What can I get you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Unknown}Welcome back. What can I get you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Emily says you're working with her on bugging the Lucky 38. That information would be invaluable to our research if you can get it done.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, I heard about the bug getting destroyed in the Lucky 38. We'll get in there eventually. It's just a matter of time.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: One of my aides said you got into the Lucky 38. If you see someone by the name of Emily near there, we would like you to work for us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Concerned}I've heard a few patients mention the Securitrons are acting strangely and no one has heard from Mr. House in a while.|If House is out of the picture, maybe we'll be able to get our hands on some of his technology. It would help our scientists greatly.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So the great {Kai-zar}Caesar is dead. Happy news, but I don't know that it'll make things safer. The rest of his goons may be even worse once they take power.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Smoke rising from the east spells trouble. I hope the Legion isn't on the move.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I sincerely hope the NCR are getting supplies in place to defend against an attack, because it looks like the Legion has plans for the dam again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If things don't go well at the dam, all of our efforts here could be for nothing. I hope to God the Legion doesn't win control.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Unknown}Is there something you need?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Unknown}Hi, do you need assistance?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Unknown}Can I help you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mixed}Yes?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mixed}Do you need something?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mixed}Have you ever considered getting your head checked?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Wild Child}I'm pretty busy, is there something you need?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Wild Child}Make it quick, I'm a busy woman.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Wild Child}We don't specialize in psychiatry in this camp.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Good Natured Rascal}Hey, good to see you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Good Natured Rascal}Welcome.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Liked}Welcome back, friend.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Liked}Great to see you again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Merciful Thug}What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Merciful Thug}Watch yourself around here. We don't tolerate thugs in the camp.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Merciful Thug}I'm busy, make it quick.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Hated}I hope you don't think I'm going to stitch your sorry ass.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Hated}Great, you again?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Hated}Don't you have some kittens to drown or something?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Check it out. Between the dumpsters there.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Looky what we have here, ladies, another unsuspecting ponce!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Place your bets and give the wheel a spin!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Pull up a stool and join the game, buddy!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You people are crazy!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You want to get your hands on some of the deadliest weapons around? Head just down the street to the Silver Rush. You won't be disappointed.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Silver Rush is just down the street here. You can't miss it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey baby, head down to the Atomic Wrangler if you want to have a good time.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Wrangler's just down the street. You're almost there already.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Stop by Mick & Ralph's for all your shopping needs, sir.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Stop by Mick & Ralph's for all your shopping needs, ma'am.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Mick & Ralph's is located just before the east gate.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mick Placeholder}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You new to Freeside? Haven't seen you around.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You looking to join the Kings?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Do I know you? Whatever.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear you're working out pretty well. The King's taken a shine to you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Stick by the Kings, and the Kings'll stick by you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've been hearing good things about you. Keep it up.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey pal, what's shaking?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're okay in my book.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey there. You should stop by Freeside more often.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You got guts, showing your face around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're lucky the King's a forgiving man.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I don't need to talk to you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I wish you never came to Freeside.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Back again? What's next, burn down the Wrangler?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're not wanted around here. Scram.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Some people seem to think you've helped the community, but I have my doubts.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: There's talk of you being a menace, but I think you mean well.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Well, you definitely accomplished some things here, but I can't tell if Freeside is better for it or not.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You have got to be the craziest asshole I've ever met.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: A couple of us started a pool trying to guess what you've going to do next.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Don't take this the wrong way, but are you, like, crazy or something?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Heard there was some excitement in one of the casinos in the Strip. Bunch of people got hurt when some nut started attacking people.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Things are tense on the Strip right now. The head of one of Mr. House's Families was killed. Time to lay low, you ask me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Some nut attempted to kill the head of one of Mr. House's Families recently. Whoever did it is either crazy or has balls the size of Freeside.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Did you hear someone managed to fight their way through the Chairmen and flee the Strip after being caught? Wonder if they're hiding out in Freeside.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Looks like Gomorrah's under new management. I wonder what happened?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: There's talk of someone going into the Lucky 38 to talk to Mr. House. That's bullshit. Everyone knows Mr. House doesn't talk to anyone.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Man, I thought those tin cans of Mr. House's were tough before. Have you seen the shit they can do now?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Turns out Mr. House wasn't so safe up in his tower after all!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I wonder how Mr. House died. I figure it wasn't old age.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: How are we supposed to sleep with the Lucky 38 lit up 24/7?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Holy crap! You're the one they're saying killed the Legion honcho right?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Word on the street is that the leader of the Legion bought it. Too bad, someone was finally going to do something about all the NCR around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You hear how Mr. House said "uncle?" Vegas is gonna join the NCR. So much for Freeside.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Did you hear? Someone bombed the monorail down at McCarran, so everyone's been forced to come through here to get to the Strip. Business is booming.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Seems like they've got things straightened out in McCarran now, but we're still seeing a big increase in traffic here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I can't believe someone stopped the NCR president from getting killed. If anyone deserves it, it's that jerk.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Someone took a shot at the NCR president, but the lucky bastard got away. Oh well, it was a good try.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, did you hear the NCR president got whacked? Good for whoever did it, I say. Couldn't have happened to a nicer guy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: There's mutterings from the NCR people around here that some local hero of theirs died. Whatever.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Turns out some military hero the Squatters admired was actually a slimeball. An NCR soldier who's actually a dick? Who would've thought?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Heh, word is the leader of the Fiends got taken down. I would have done it myself, it he ever had the courage to step into Freeside.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard that some of the bosses of the Fiends were killed. Wouldn't be surprised if the NCR had something to do with it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You hear the Legion attacked Bitter Springs? If we're lucky, the NCR will pull some of their soldiers away from here and send them that way.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Word is the Khans signed a treaty with the NCR. Never saw that coming.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Khans used to be a big deal around here, but look at them now. There's talk that they were all killed up in the mountains.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Weird, someone just told me that the Khans split the Vegas area. Wonder where they went, and why.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I can't believe the King is dead. What's going to happen to us now?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If you had asked me a month ago, I'd have said we'd never willingly work with the NCR. But look at us now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I still can't believe the King agreed to work with the NCR. But he's the King, and the King knows best.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So far working with the NCR hasn't been too bad. If anything, things seem to be getting better.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Great, just when you think the NCR can't possibly sink their claws deeper, the town of Primm signs up to join the Republic.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Sounds like the NCR and the Legion are both gearing up for a fight. We've been seeing a lot more soldiers around.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The big showdown between the NCR and the Legion is coming soon, believe you me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard some Squatters talking about some fancy pants Rangers coming into the area soon. Like we need more NCR here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Word is those tough guys rangers are here. I ain't seen them myself, but how scary can they be?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Everyone's talking about Hoover Dam nowadays. I wish the battle would just happen already. The suspense is killing me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, isn't that the King's dog?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Heya Rex, how you doing boy?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I see you've hired a Follower doctor. Smart move, Freeside being what it is.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That friend of yours NCR? He looks like he's NCR.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hellooo, cowgirl! You mind if talk to your lady friend a bit instead of you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Huh. Nice robot. You with the Followers or something?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Whoa. That's a whole lotta mutant you got with you there. Still, long as it doesn't cause trouble it's all good.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Nice to see a human palling around with a ghoul. I see a lot of people around here avoid them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Your girl's kinda cute, but not my type at all. I don't go for smart chicks.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Watch yourself. There's some unsavory types about.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Squatters have been more and more trouble lately.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Man, I'm hungry. I'd give anything for a Fancy Lad. Wait, I mean- you know what I mean!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Squatters aren't happy about the water rationing, but then when are they ever happy?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It's gotten so bad that even I think twice before going out at night around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The bodyguards at the gates aren't so bad. Except that Orris guy. That bastard runs his mouth a little too much.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Can't wait to hit the Wrangler tonight. Just me and my favorite girl.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've been saving up for one of those sweet pistols at the Silver Rush. That'll get me some respect.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Saw a guy try to rush through the south gate a few days ago. Nothin' left but dust, you know?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Those Squatters think they're entitled to everything.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Man, I still can't believe the Van Graffs took Pacer out.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Shame about Pacer. We all tried to tell him to kick the habit, with that condition of his. He always did his own thing, I'll give him that.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I used to guard at the gate, but there's no money in it these days. Only the big name guards get any business.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thank god the Followers are here. I'd probably be dead now if it weren't for their doctors.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It's never dull in Freeside, is it?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Heya, what's shakin'?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey there.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What's going on?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Satisfied}They have a fantastic menu at the diner.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Relieved}Haven't found any Radroaches, so far.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Saddened}This place's got a weird gloom after Miss Weintraub died.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Did you get a tour? The owner has done a great job with this place.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Marveled}I've never seen so many pretty lights in my life.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Self Justification)It's cramped in here, sure, but who really needs a fancy room, anyway?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Howdy, little lady.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMSTopsLonesomeDrifter "The Lonesome Drifter" [NPC_:0011F9BE]

text_content: Ahhh! Please don't kill me, I swear I'll have - wait. You... you don't work for Mr. Bishop, do you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMSTopsBruceIsaac "Bruce Isaac" [NPC_:0011F9B8]

text_content: Hey, thanks again for getting me this gig. I owe you one.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMSTopsBruceIsaac "Bruce Isaac" [NPC_:0011F9B8]

text_content: Oh, it's you again. What is it?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMSTopsBruceIsaac "Bruce Isaac" [NPC_:0011F9B8]

text_content: Hey, come on, pal, I'm trying to put on a show here!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMSTopsBillyKnight "Billy Knight" [NPC_:0011F9BA]

text_content: Hey, come on, lady, I'm trying to put on a show here!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMSTopsBillyKnight "Billy Knight" [NPC_:0011F9BA]

text_content: You again? You should meet my bookie, you have something in common - every time I talk to you, I lose caps!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMSTopsBillyKnight "Billy Knight" [NPC_:0011F9BA]

text_content: Whoa, baby! Am I looking at a mirror, or are you just that ugly?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMSTopsHadrian "Hadrian" [NPC_:0011F9B9]

text_content: Any luck with Garret yet?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMSTopsHadrian "Hadrian" [NPC_:0011F9B9]

text_content: Well, if it isn't my number one fan. What can I do for you, number one fan?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VMSTopsHadrian "Hadrian" [NPC_:0011F9B9]

text_content: Is that a {Mark}Mk. III Support Model you have with you? I've seen references to them, but never with my own eyes. I imagine he makes a great pet.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Where did you get that Eyebot? I've never seen one modified quite like that.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Keep that mutant in line, or we'll put it down.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Oh good, now I have to put up with the stench of rotting ghoul as well. I hope the air filters are working.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've heard that your friend there can put some of the senior scribes to shame.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Why is your friend there glaring at me like that? Did I bump into him or something?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Don't bother me. I'm on patrol.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hello, outsider.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've important work to do, so no time to talk.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Does Ramos know you're walking around without a guard?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Keep up the good work, outsider.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear you've been making yourself useful. Unlike some people I could mention.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Are you adjusting to the bunker, outsider?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Just between you and me, I'm glad you're here. This place needed a fresh face.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You've been a great help, outsider. Thank you for all your hard work.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Greetings, {outsider}out- excuse me, I guess I need to stop calling you that, don't I?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So you're one of us now, eh? Truly it is a rare honor.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Oh, it's you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'd rather not talk to you, outsider.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'd rather not associate with you. Excuse me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Why the Elder didn't just have you shot is beyond me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Don't talk to me. You've caused more than enough damage.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Ramos is keeping an eye on you, outsider. Remember that.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You certainly make life more interesting, outsider.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Some of the others may look the other way, but I don't trust you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're going to have to clean up your act if you want some respect around here, outsider.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Just when I think I've got you figured out, you go and surprise me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I don't trust you, outsider, but I can't help but like you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're alright, outsider. Most of the time, anyway.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I have two hours of weapons training every morning. It is a good way to start the day.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hardin is a tough man, but fair. I'd follow him into battle any day.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: There are whispers that McNamara's lost his nerve. I can't believe that, not after what he did at HELIOS One.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: How long before we resume normal patrols?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: After the battle at HELIOS One, some people were worried about the NCR coming after us, but this bunker is secure.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Ramos runs a tight ship. We haven't had an incident in over a year. Your arrival excluded, of course.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hardin will be Elder soon, mark my words.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Why are we hiding down here? We should be avenging our fallen brothers!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: HELIOS will be ours again someday.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: When are these night missions going to end?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Ugh, more VR training. Maybe I'll hit the shooting range instead.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Maintaining the machinery around here is important. We have to breathe, after all.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: After this I have some weapons to repair.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If I do a good job, I might be up for promotion to Paladin soon.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Power armor is pretty intricately made. It's not an easy thing to fix.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Have you seen the dust storm above? I worked on that machine!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If it's not broken power armor, it's broken electrical fixtures.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If it's not broken weapons, it's broken power armor.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm really busy now, sorry.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I don't think these repairs will ever end.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Our early test results look promising.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard the Elder's got Taggart working on some kind of secret project.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Every day we come one step closer to reclaiming the glory of the past.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Even though the patrols no longer go out, we've got a backlog of devices that require investigation.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Why is it so important that we research night vision optics?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'd kill to go outside and gather some specimens.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Everyone says I'm crazy, but I still say it'd be a great advancement if doors opened once you got close to them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The loss of HELIOS was terrible, but this bunker is a wonder of its own.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If we could just combine the best qualities of laser and plasma weaponry...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It pains me to think of the scientific wonders at HELIOS One, now in NCR hands.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: But if I adjust the magnetic field, perhaps the resulting change in wavelength will- excuse me, I'm merely thinking out loud.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We have a duty to preserve the past.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Only a few people get to venture outside, usually to trade for food.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You've been outside. Is the NCR really still hunting us?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: McNamara's done a pretty good job, given the situation he was handed.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Our former Elder, Elijah, was obsessed with new technology. That's why we were at HELIOS in the first place.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hardin owes his life to McNamara. That's why he won't challenge him outright.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: As much as I'm sick of Taggart's VR sims, I have to admit we wouldn't be combat ready without them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Doc Schuler is a lifesaver. I was hurt in training the other day and she fixed me right up.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Lucky 38's reactor has been restarted... it can be seen from miles away.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player in NCR gear}Howdy, trooper. I thought the Big Horn was off limits to you guys, but who am I to complain? A customer is a customer.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Great Khans left alive}Surprising that the Khans are going to walk out of here after all that fuss.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Great Khans dead}Guess those Khans got what was coming to them, huh?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {NCR troops dead}Hope those Great Khans don't come trash my saloon. I'm not part of the NCR!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome back to the Big Horn. What can I get you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player attacked NCR, NCR troops not all dead}Kill every last one of those NCR troopers and then we'll talk.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {astonished, but in a manly way}What the hell? You're that courier Benny wasted back in Goodsprings. You're supposed to be dead.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {slight threat}I'm getting real tired of talking.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Still got a bit of a walk ahead of us. Talk fast.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We've got a situation with some Great Khans right now. The brass at McCarran has ordered me to lock down the ruins until it's been resolved.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player attacking Great Khans, Great Khans not all dead}Can't talk. We didn't get all the Great Khans yet.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player not helping Monroe}Where do you think you're going? I can't let you go into the ruins, not without a reason.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Speech path}How are negotiations with the Great Khans going?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Speech path - deal reached}I'm glad you were able to get my people freed, but there's a new problem. I just got orders to take out the Great Khans, hostages or not.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Speech path - player attacked Great Khans}When I heard the shots, I figured your negotiation went bad. What the hell happened?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Speech path - bribe paid}The Great Khans can go, just as we agreed.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Sneak path}Ackerman and Gilbert aren't back yet. What's the holdup?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Both hostages rescued}Thanks for getting both of my people out of there.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Sneak path - one hostage rescued}I'm sorry that you couldn't get both hostages out alive, but that's how it goes sometimes. Thanks for your help.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Sneak path - hostages dead}I'm sorry that you couldn't get either hostage out alive, but that's how it goes sometimes. Thanks for your help.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I really don't have the time to chatter right now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thanks for the rescue.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Man, I thought I was dead for sure.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thanks for getting me out of there. I owe you one.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm glad that's over. Thank you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You here to pay your respects, too?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hello again. Is there something you need from me?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What the fuck are you doing? My brother died at the Battle of Hoover Dam. You're desecrating a war memorial.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've got nothing else to say to you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The {cutting}"great" republic couldn't find enough soliders to liberate this camp, so they sent {emph}you? Pathetic.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {AH-way}Ave. Why have you come to Nelson?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {annoyed}What is it this time?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Yes?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Ave. You have done a great service to Caesar. Do so again, but elsewhere.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player not in NCR gear}This post isn't someplace a civilian ought to be.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RSAlphaCastillo "Comm Officer Castillo" [NPC_:0010F700]

text_content: {Player in NCR gear}Hey there. Is McCarran having you check up on us?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RSCharlieStepinac "Comm Officer Stepinac" [NPC_:0011324E]

text_content: {Player not in NCR gear}I'm not supposed to let civilians just walk around this place. There better be a good reason for you being here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RSDeltaScheffer "Comm Officer Scheffer" [NPC_:00116B3F]

text_content: Player won Battle for Hoover Dam, for Independent Vegas with Securitrons
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Rumors of Legion Veterans}It's said the Legion's veterans will arrive from Arizona soon. They are a sight to behold.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Middle game begins}{Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius is on the march. When he arrives, the real slaughter will begin.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Late game begins}{Veteran}I have fought beneath {Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius many times. He cannot be defeated.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Battle for Hoover Dam soon to begin}{Veteran}Finally, the dam will be assaulted. {Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius is come.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {Player killed President Kimball}{Veteran}{recognizing player}Kimball's assassin. Nicely done.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: True to {KAI-zar}Caesar.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: {delighted}If it isn't the courier who's done everything she can to defy the will of mighty {KAI-zar}Caesar!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Legion holds Nelson, Profligate! This is where you'll die. {call to arms}Brothers, attack!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Have you come to Nelson seeking your death, Profligate?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Player assaulted The Tops Casino.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Angry}Head voices don't *like* you, squishy man!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Jealous}No! Head voices don't talk to you. Only to me!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player in NCR gear}Got a second, trooper? I've got something important that needs to get done, but nobody's stepping up to help me out. I'm hoping you're different.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: CHFSergeantReyes "Tech Sergeant Reyes" [NPC_:0010D23D]

text_content: {Player not in NCR gear}Hey, you're not one of the troopers... got a second? I have work I need done and nobody here at the camp has the time or inclination to help me out.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {NCR victory}{grinning}You should've heard the cheers over the radio when news of the victory came back from the Dam.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Legion victory}{fear}I've been trying to sort out the rumors from the facts, but with the Legion coming, I guess it doesn't matter. The news is all bad.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Other victory}{puzzled}Lots of confusion over the radio. Somehow the NCR lost the Dam, but the Legion didn't get it, either?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {curious}Hey, what did Chief Hanlon have to say about those false reports we uncovered?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: CHFSergeantReyes "Tech Sergeant Reyes" [NPC_:0010D23D]

text_content: Welcome back.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: CHFSergeantReyes "Tech Sergeant Reyes" [NPC_:0010D23D]

text_content: Thanks for setting me straight.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Get lost.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Surprised}Oh! What are you doing here?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Aren't you the guy that helped wipe out Nelson?|Holy shit man, that's fucking crazy!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Aren't you the gal that helped wipe out Nelson?|Holy shit, that's fucking crazy!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Aren't you the one that saved President Kimball? That must have been some speech, eh?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard President Kimball was assassinated during his visit to Hoover Dam. Doesn't surprise me, we're all going to end up dead soon anyway.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard President Kimball almost got killed during his visit to Hoover Dam. Good thing he didn't come here, he would be dead for sure.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're new here aren't you? Don't tell me we're actually going to get reinforcements.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Look at the big hero. You here to save us?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've heard of you. Did you figure on coming out here and helping us lowly troopers out?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Just what we need around here, a loose cannon causing more trouble.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've heard of you, what do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What the fuck are you doing here?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We're all going to die out here. They're out there right now, waiting for us... waiting to kill us.|We're all fucked!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I don't want to be seen with the likes of you. Get lost.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're still here? I'm surprised you're not dead or gone by now.|What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <Placeholder for Top Level Topics>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player in NCR gear}You a transfer from one of the other posts? I haven't seen you around before.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're really not supposed to be here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player in NCR gear}{suspicious}You're not part of this post as far as I know. What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RSAlphaLineholm "Ranger Lineholm" [NPC_:0011BAEE]

text_content: {Player not in NCR gear}{suspicious}This is a military outpost. Why are you here?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Did you need something else?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player in NCR gear}I'm pretty sure you're not authorized to be here, whatever unit you happen to be from. What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Why are you still here?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player not in NCR gear}No sudden moves and you and I will do all right. What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player in NCR gear}Haven't seen you around the post before. I'm busy, so keep the chit-chat to the point.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Yeah?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: McCarran doesn't like it when civilians wander into military outposts, so if you're here on business, better make it quick.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're back. What's up?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player not in NCR gear}{fearful}You're here for the money. I told the Omertas I was good for it! I just need more time!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RSFoxtrotLenk "Comm Officer Lenk" [NPC_:00116B40]

text_content: {Player in NCR gear}{paranoid}You're not part of my unit... no, you're here for the money! I told the Omertas I was good for it!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Oh, uh, hey.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player in NCR gear}No run-ins with the Great Khans, I hope? They've been more restless than usual.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RSFoxtrotKudlow "Ranger Kudlow" [NPC_:00120183]

text_content: {Player not in NCR gear}This area isn't safe for civilians. You don't want to get caught by the Great Khans.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Yeah?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player in NCR gear}I don't know what you did to pull runner duty to a post this far out in the wasteland, but you have my sympathies.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RSBravoTilden "Comm Officer Tilden" [NPC_:00110D89]

text_content: {Player not in NCR gear}If you're here to sell something, we don't want any.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What's up?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player in NCR gear}You don't walk like any trooper I've ever seen, but I'll let it slide. What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player in not in NCR gear}What brings you to Ranger Station Bravo?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Something up?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Think you can beat the house, baby?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VTopsDealer "Card Dealer" [NPC_:00151DAB]

text_content: Lucky 21, baby!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VTopsDealer "Card Dealer" [NPC_:00151DAB]

text_content: Feeling lucky? I got the best table in the joint!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VTopsDealer "Card Dealer" [NPC_:00151DAB]

text_content: Scram, baby, I'm on my break.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VTopsDealer "Card Dealer" [NPC_:00151DAB]

text_content: Can't you see I'm taking it easy here?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VTopsDealer "Card Dealer" [NPC_:00151DAB]

text_content: Look, I'll be back at the table soon, baby, don't fret.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VTopsDealer "Card Dealer" [NPC_:00151DAB]

text_content: Little birdies are chirping about the big Cheese of the Legion going deadsville real unexpected-like. Crazy old world, ain't it?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You hear some crumb tried to kill the president of the NCR? Gutsy, baby. Real gutsy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Neutral - doesn't care that the player killed the President, but impressed that the player walked into a casino full of people who do}Ain't you the cat that tried to ice the President? Gutsy, baby, showing your face in here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Playful, teasing}Uh-oh, here comes trouble!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Playful, teasing}Ha ha, this cat's crazy!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Playful, teasing}Baby, you bring crazy with you!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, play it cool, baby, we just got the place fixed up.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: They, ah, checked your weapons at the door, right?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Baby, you are some kind of crazy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Well, I guess your money's good here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Just do what you came to do and get out.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We don't need your kind of trouble.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You got some kind of nerve strolling around in here like this.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Christ, who let you through security?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You ain't welcome here, so just take a hike.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This place is the bees knees!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I dig this crazy slang!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Ehh, the broads are better looking at Gomorrah.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Buy a gal a drink?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, handsome.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Why don't you come up and see me sometime?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Don't get too close to Mr. Benny
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: No sudden moves around the boss, got it?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I got my eye on you, so no funny business.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Keep those hands where I can see 'em.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Ring-a-ding, baby.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: How's it hangin'?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Heya, baby, what's the haps?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You dig this crazy scene or what?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This guy right here! This is the guy!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This gal right here! This is the gal!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hang loose, baby.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Baby, good to see you!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey hey, there's my guy!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey hey, there's my gal!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Yeah, baby, now we can start the party!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hope Swank's smarter than Benny.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Wonder where Benny got off to?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I thought Benny was a stand up guy - hard to believe he was a fink all along.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, play it cool, baby, we just got the place fixed up.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Oh no, not again!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're the fink that killed Benny!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I wonder where Benny ran off to.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Heh. Guess those Omerta finks got what was coming to them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Who thought it was a good idea to give the robots missile launchers?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If Mister House ain't the top dog on the Strip, whaddya suppose that means for us?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Those Securitrons handing out obituaries? Creepy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're the gasser who killed Caesar, ain't ya? Ring-a-ding!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Ain't seen no soldier boys for a while. Guess they're all scared of coming out after that big boom.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Looks like the troops are back. Good thing, too, this place was deadsville without their caps.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Ain't you the cat that stopped Kimball getting iced? Gutsy, baby, but don't expect no free drinks for it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You hear some crazy crumb killed the president of the NCR? Gutsy, baby. Real gutsy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, I heard about you - you're the one who saved the President! Here, this one's on me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard the Kings over in Freeside got their asses handed to 'em. Lousy no-good bums.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Way I hear it, some big-leaguer NCR rangers are coming to town to dance a two-step all over Caesar's head.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You dig these new rangers all dressed to the nines? Baby, the new fashion is killer-robot-chic!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I got a pal who says the Legion's calling in their 18-karat big-leaguers. We're talking the boys from Arizona, baby.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Baby, you couldn't pay me enough to step off the strip these days. Legion cats are out there thick as fleas on a dog, and they ain't no bums, neither.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, there's the high-roller!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Baby, it's as tense as a virgin at Gomorrah out there. Things are heating up and if they don't cool down it's straight endsville.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: At least in the old days we could up and split when things got too heavy. Right now I miss those days.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Baby, it's gonna be open war out there soon. If it was up to me we'd pack our toys, put this town to our backs and say "next stop: Scramsville."
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Why's the Lucky 38 take to shining all of a sudden? I smell a caper.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: House selling out to the NCR? Who woulda figured him for a fink?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player not in NCR gear}Gotta wonder what the hell a civilian is doing here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: RSEchoGreen "Comm Officer Green" [NPC_:0011324D]

text_content: {Player in NCR gear}You from Camp Golf or McCarran? Never mind. Don't really care.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What do you want now?

text_content: {Smiling}You look like you got the itch, friend.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Smiling}You want to gamble with class? Hit the Ultra-Luxe, if you don't mind being serviced by masked creeps.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Watch the slots, they're robbery.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Wish I could've seen what's inside the 38.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You've been making a name for yourself around here already.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Did you hear? Gomorrah's under new management!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Helpful, then serious}You look new here - be careful of Gomorrah.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Cautioning}Watch your caps - they go quick.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Curious}Seeing the sights?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Ultra-Luxe is fancy, but I get the shivers when I see their staff wearing masks.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Who would have thought a place like this would exist?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: At this rate, one Securitron is going to be enough to defend the whole Strip.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Admiringly}Good to have you around!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Admiringly}Thanks for helping us keep the Strip safe.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Nods}Sir.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Nods}Miss.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Nods}Ma'am.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Nods}Pleasure.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Nods}An NCR welcome to you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Help you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome to Vegas - behave yourselves.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If you're looking to join up, head on by the Embassy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome to Vegas. {Beat, slightly threatening}Make your visit a peaceful one.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Monorail transit is safe transit.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Report any suspicious activity near the Monorail.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: No loitering.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Please enjoy the casinos.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Please do not stand in the fountains.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: No violence is permitted on the Strip.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Self-control is a virtue.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Please obey all weapon laws.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Continuing patrol.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Strip secure.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Stern Warning, Deadpan}Area is off-limits, citizen.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Stern Warning, Deadpan}Return to the surface, citizen.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Stern Warning, Deadpan}Disobedience will be punished.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Look,{"friend" is said in a sarcastic, but serious, tone} "friend," don't get near me - you're too well respected for my business.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, think you can walk around here like nothing's happened?|See, my friends and I, we were kinda wondering if we should give you a good beating right now, or save it for when we catch you outside.|We don't like you Mojave scum, and we like you even less when you fuck with our Strip.|So, you either pay up to walk around here, or we're gonna make you pay up. That clear?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You back again, huh? We missed you, we've been waiting for you. Bet you've missed us too.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Fuck off, punk. And pray we don't hear about you doing crazy shit again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Fuck this. I'm out of here - let them deal with this crazy place.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I can't believe I put up with this kind of crap.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, think you can walk around here like nothing's happened?|See, my friends and I, we were kinda wondering if we should give you a good beating right now, or save it for when we catch you outside.|We don't like you Mojave scum, and we like you even less when you fuck with our Strip.|So, you either pay up to walk around here, or we're gonna make you pay up. That clear?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You back again, huh? We missed you, we've been waiting for you. Bet you've missed us too.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Well, hello there. What a coincidence, finding you outside the Strip.|You should've paid your dues, but, no, you had to play hard, huh? Now it's our turn.|Nobody fucks with the NCR and lives to brag about it. You're dead, punk!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Desparate, relieved}Oh, thank God! I didn't think I'd ever see another human face down here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: NVCGHalford "Private Halford" [NPC_:0013F323]

text_content: Got to stay alert...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Just waiting here seems like a death sentence...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {concerned}They've got our guys down there.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Fucking monsters butchered the miners down there...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Wish Renolds would report back soon... he went west a day ago, no word from him.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Worried}We need to move out, we can't hold this position.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Slight frustration}Once the Legion's dug in, we're {emphasis}never getting them out of Nelson.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Puzzled}There used to be two commanders, but I only see one - the other {emphasis}must be nearby somewhere.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Apprehensive}Won't be long before the Legion rolls out of Nelson...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Someone should go warn Novac.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We need reinforcements from Camp Forlorn Hope.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Wish we could do something for the troopers down there.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Out on regular patrol, then this shit goes down.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Angry}The Legion'll pay for Nelson.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {surprised, slight fear}Never thought Legion'd be bold enough to strike this far.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Told Milo we have to go, but he won't leave.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We can't hold this road if they come up through town!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thanks for the help with the hostages!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Impressed}I can't believe you broke into the mine and saved those miners.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hope you made the Legion at the mine pay for Nelson.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The hostages are safe. We owe you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You sure cleaned out the Legion in Nelson.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {smug}Legion'll think twice before crossing the river again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Mocking}Guess Caesar got his tribute after all.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Proud}Nelson'll turn this war around.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Smug}Let's see those fuckers attack Hoover Dam now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Smug}Nelson's proof payback's a bitch.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thanks for cleaning up Nelson!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Don't know what we would have done if you hadn't come along.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Impressed}Wish more people had your kind of guts.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player assaulted The Tops}Heard there was a firefight in one of the big casinos. Maybe they'll need to buy more ammo now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Monorail Destroyed}Careless of the NCR to let their monorail get blown up. Don't they have sentries standing watch?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Caesar dead}The Legion isn't going to go away just because Caesar is dead, if the rumor is even true.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Kimball survives}Kimball's bodyguards are probably pretty thankful they had Gun Runner weapons backing them up.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Kimball dead}Kimball's bodyguards should've been more heavily armed if they wanted to keep him alive.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Legion at Nelson wiped out}It's always good for business when the NCR scores a victory like the one at Nelson.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {NCR at Camp Forlorn Hope wiped out}Damn shame about Camp Forlorn Hope.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Middle Game}Business has been brisk. Something big's coming, I can feel it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Late Game}The orders for service rifles and ammunition have been pouring in from McCarran so fast we can't keep up. Hell of a fight is coming.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Companion Reaction - Boone}{impressed}First Recon is a top-notch unit. They're always buying sniper rifles from us.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Companion Reaction - ED-E}That Eyebot looks like it's gone through hell.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Companion Reaction - Lily}I had no idea there was such a thing as a friendly Nightkin. Look at that thing.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Companion Reaction - Rex}I've never a dog like that. Who thinks up these things?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Random}Man, I love my guns.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Random}People usually aren't stupid enough to steal from the Gun Runners. Usually.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Random}It's amazing what passes for a firearm around here. You'd be better off throwing rocks.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Lucky 38, all lit up in the distance? It's an inviting target.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Mr. House finally wised up and said he'd join the NCR in a year or something like that. Good news all around.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Random}Have you seen what one of those anti-materiel rifles can do to a Deathclaw?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Default}Demand for Gun Runner weapons is high, so don't expect them to stay in stock for very long.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I appreciate the improvements in the mess. Keep up the good work.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: These recruits aren't ready, if the Legion comes knocking.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: Get running the obstacle course, if you want. You look like you could use some exercise.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: I'm busy. See the brass if you want to chat.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: No time for idle chatter. These boys need whipping into shape.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: Either join the recruits running the course or leave the area.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: You look like someone in need of a reliable supplier.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: So you're back.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: Did the colonel send you? I... I was hoping he might have changed his mind...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: Got to keep hoping the Colonel will change his mind... maybe send somebody to bring Esteban's body home.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: Did you start looking for Esteban? I guess my directions could've been better...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: Feels better knowing that Esteban's not out there in the waste. But... he's still gone, you know?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: What do you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: What did Contreras say?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: Paperwork, paperwork, paperwork... It just never ends.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: Good thing I got stationed here and not at the Dam. I got connections because Major Dhatri's daughter married my nephew.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: Whoa whoa whoa. Hold up. Where do you think you're going?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: NCRCorpseGuard1 "NCR Trooper" [NPC_:000F3BD0]

text_content: Hey, good luck. We'd be there with you, but the Colonel said he'd have our necks if we tried.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: Be careful out there. We already lost Jackson doing what you're trying to do.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: NCRCorpseGuard1 "NCR Trooper" [NPC_:000F3BD0]

text_content: Hell of a thing you did up there.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: NCRCorpseGuard1 "NCR Trooper" [NPC_:000F3BD0]

text_content: Proud to have met you, sir.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: NCRCorpseGuard1 "NCR Trooper" [NPC_:000F3BD0]

text_content: Proud to have met you, ma'am.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: NCRCorpseGuard1 "NCR Trooper" [NPC_:000F3BD0]

text_content: Listen, asshole. I know you're not really an NCR health inspector, so you can cut the restaurant critic routine.|And I want my fifty caps back, 'cause I looked it up and there ain't no disease called colorectal implosion syndrome.|So I paid you to look the other way for nothing.|Wait. Wait. You're not... oh wow, I'm sorry. You looked just like- never mind. Sorry. So... what can I serve you up?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: {Terse, sigh}You again? What do need?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: {Good-humored}Howdy, looking for chow?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: {Happy to see player}Hey hey, back for seconds, huh?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: {Grateful}Thanks for handling the Fiends. One less pack of dogs to hurt the troops.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: Remarkable work saving Kimball. Glad you were around to prevent his assassination.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: {Irritated}Yeah?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: Howdy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: Do you require medical attention?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: If you're looking for a quick stitch, I'm your man.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]

text_content: See Julie Farkas if you need anything.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Move along, buddy. I have work to do.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Sorry, we don't talk to outsiders. Talk to Jason if you have business here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Jason will lead us to the Far Beyond!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Jason will deliver us from the pain of this world!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: All praise the Great Journey! All praise the creator's divine will!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The holy fire will carry us to our salvation!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thank you for taking care of the demons, smoothskin.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Now that the demons are gone, we can finally begin our final steps.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The demons are really gone? Bright shines!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Not now, smoothskin!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey there, friend.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome to the Crimson Caravan Company, New Vegas branch. What may I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome back.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Shove off. You're making my luck turn bad.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You again. What do you want now?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If you're looking to buy or sell, you've come to the right man. The Crimson Caravan Company has the widest selection in the wasteland.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey there. You looking to buy or sell?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Dammit, I didn't want you to kill him, just find me some evidence!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 1ECaptainParker "Captain Parker" [NPC_:000F839A]

text_content: Well... that was a bit messier than I would have liked. Was there anything else?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 1ECaptainParker "Captain Parker" [NPC_:000F839A]

text_content: The Legion being wiped out at Nelson gave us some breathing room - hopefully the brass will use that.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 1ECaptainParker "Captain Parker" [NPC_:000F839A]

text_content: Losing Forlorn Hope was a real blow to us - I hope things can be turned around soon.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 1ECaptainParker "Captain Parker" [NPC_:000F839A]

text_content: Hell of a thing at Nelson - NCR and the Legion wiped out. I wonder what the hell happened.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 1ECaptainParker "Captain Parker" [NPC_:000F839A]

text_content: I just got word that the monorail from McCarran was blown up by terrorists. My God. I can't believe it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 1ECaptainParker "Captain Parker" [NPC_:000F839A]

text_content: Word around the east side is that you took out some major players in the Fiends. That should make life safer for a lot of people.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 1ECaptainParker "Captain Parker" [NPC_:000F839A]

text_content: Have you heard the news? Caesar's agents assassinated President Kimball - it'll be war for sure, now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 1ECaptainParker "Captain Parker" [NPC_:000F839A]

text_content: I'm sure every NCR soldier you've met has said this, but you're a damn hero for saving the President. If there's anything you need, let me know.
