name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear we got reinforced by the troops that were in Boulder City. It's good to have some extra support around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: More reinforcements are in from Primm. Damn glad to have those guys here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard that some of the NCR Rangers are on their way to help us out. We'll make short work of the Legion with their help.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Holy shit those NCR Rangers are badass! I wish I was that cool.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard the Legion veteran troops are coming to the front lines. That's the last thing we need right now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard the Legion took out another one of our patrols. If this continues there won't be many of us left.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear more troops are gathering at Hoover Dam. Things are probably going to get pretty messy over there real soon.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Legion is torturing captive troopers in Nelson. I'd rather die fighting then be captured.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Legion is using our dead troops as booby traps. I'd think twice before rushing to someone's aid.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If I have to pull another double shift again I'm going to collapse from exhaustion.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I wish we could get some real food out here. I haven't had a good hot meal in weeks.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Quartermaster Mayes was yelling at us about rationing again. Where does the guy get the energy to yell so much while on rations?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Some of the other guys told me that the Legion troops eat their own dead to gain their strength, but they're kidding, right?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I got bit by one of those dirty dogs the Legion has. I wonder if they've got rabies... maybe I should see Dr. Richards.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Major Polatli is putting everyone on double shifts to make up for recent losses to the Legion. That guy never gives up.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If the NCR wasn't spread so thin, maybe we could actually get some supplies and reinforcements around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I wish I was stationed at McCarran. I heard they still get to hit the Strip for R&R. We haven't had R&R in ages.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We are so fucked here! How can we ever hope to fight off the entire Legion?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Another day, another battle, another dead trooper. When is this shit going to end?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It seems like for every Legion soldier we kill, two more take his place. How many of them are there?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The last patrol I was on got hit by a Legion raiding party and I barely survived. I don't want to go back out there again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: How do they expect us to fight the Legion with only the crappy equipment and gear they gave us?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I can't wait for General Oliver to get out here. He could turn this place around.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I don't know how we're going to hold of the Legion here and at Hoover Dam, we just don't have the manpower.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Legion is assembling a massive army on the other side of the river. How can we stop an army when we can't even handle their raiding parties?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're back. Do you need medical attention?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm just security, not a doctor.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Please, buddy, you've got to help me. I don't know how much longer I'm going to last with my leg like this.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: NVCGHalford "Private Halford" [NPC_:0013F323]

text_content: Come on man, my leg is killing me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: NVCGHalford "Private Halford" [NPC_:0013F323]

text_content: Is it safe to leave yet?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: NVCGHalford "Private Halford" [NPC_:0013F323]

text_content: {Urgent hushed, Shhh}Keep it down, we don't want to alert the freaks.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: NVCGHalford "Private Halford" [NPC_:0013F323]

text_content: {Urgent hushed}No time to talk, we've still got fish heads to deal with.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: NVCGHalford "Private Halford" [NPC_:0013F323]

text_content: {Nervous about alerting monsters, hushed}Let's talk after we get the hell out of here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: NVCGHalford "Private Halford" [NPC_:0013F323]

text_content: {Self-satisfied}Well well, it looks like we've cleared them out, damn inbred mutant freaks. Think I'll start heading back to California now.|There have been way too many catastrophic NCR foul-ups around here for me to risk my life by sticking around.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: NVCGHalford "Private Halford" [NPC_:0013F323]

text_content: {Relieved, friendly}Thanks for getting me out of there. I better get started back to California.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: NVCGHalford "Private Halford" [NPC_:0013F323]

text_content: Thanks for helping me out. I won't forget it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Damn muties. Wasteland is better off without 'em.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Can't wait to get the rest of our pay for this job.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Wish the muties would make a move. Getting sick of waiting.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It's much cooler up here. I love it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Muties aren't so tough if you've got the firepower.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Job's done here. Time to pay a visit to Freeside.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Probably should check my gear again, just to be safe.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Just had to go and start a fight with the mercs, didn't you. Guess we'd better finish things.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Not the outcome I was hoping for with the mercs. At least it buys us time to build up our defenses.|Had hoped to start reaching out to NCR, start talking trade and borders. It'll be more difficult now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Regretful}So, Keene's dead. Knew it might come to that some day. {Beat, slight weariness}Makes things difficult for the town.|Without Keene, it'll be hard to convince other Nightkin in the wasteland to come here. And harder to get the ones here to stay.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {sighing}Was hard enough to convince Keene to come up here in the first place, and you gave him an excuse to leave. Better than killing him, I guess.|Always a chance I could get him to come back. Not counting on it. {glum}Hope the town doesn't take the blame for whatever trouble he gets into.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Nods, respectful}I like how you handled Keene. Without the Nightkin around, Jacobstown would be much weaker than it is.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Something on your mind?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Huh. I'd heard there were new people in town, but I thought it was more Super Mutants. Nice to meet you - I'm Calamity.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Marcus dead}Losing Marcus is bad news for Jacobstown. I doubt the mutants will stick around for long.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: With Doctor Henry off to rejoin his Enclave friends, he's left it up to me to carry on with the research here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, there.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So, the Reds finally hit us, just like I always said they would. Vegas is still there as far as I know, but that probably won't last long.|Didn't get accepted into one of the Vaults, so I did the next best thing and had this place built. Got massive debts, but who cares now? Ha!|It's every man for himself now. {menace - he murdered a kid}Had to take care of the Paulson boy since he knew about this place - these supplies are for me and nobody else.|There's a woman and her daughter up in one of the rooms at the Lodge. Might go pay 'em a visit tomorrow. A man's got needs.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Another human. One was enough.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Marcus dead}I always told Marcus we could never get along with humans. I'm right, and he's dead.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Bother someone else. I don't want anything to do with you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Marcus dead}Huh. With the big guy dead, I guess we're done here. You've made my employers very happy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Our business is with the muties, not you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {player not on quest}Our business is with the muties, not you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: We got nothing left to talk about.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {MASTER QUESTION NODE, REPEATS}How else can I clue you in?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {MASTER QUESTION NODE, 2nd REPEATS}Something else you wanted to know?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Question Node: THE CHIP}It's the House edge, baby - literally. It's what Mr. House needs to stack the odds in his favor.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Question Node: THE CHIP}What about it?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Question Node: VEGAS POLITICS}Yeah, it's a tricky world out there. I'll tell it to you straight.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Question Node: VEGAS POLITICS}What else did you want to know?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Broad strokes? Change in management.|The Securitrons are where it's at. I need a way to control them, and a way to beef up their hitting power.|I get those two ducks in a row, Vegas can defend itself versus all comers - NCR, Caesar's Legion, it won't matter.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Question Node: BENNY'S SCHEME}What else did you want to know?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Question Node: TERMS AND PLAN}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Like I said, once the Chairmen are running Vegas, you'll get a percentage. Until then I'll pay you a retainer and bonuses for "special missions."
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {player has charged past guards to talk to Benny}What are you, crazy? These Praetorians mean business!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {congratulating player on killing all guards}You're a scrapper, baby. They didn't stand a chance. {asking if player will let you live}How about me?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {not expecting a good outcome}Change in plans?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {FIRST TALK, LOVERS}{surprised, pleased}Pussycat! Ain't this platinum? Had I known, I woulda baked a cake!|That last turn we took is an 18 karat memory, baby. It's all that's been keeping me warm at night, stuck where I am.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {FIRST TALK, NO AMBUSH}{mock scolding}Why you little promise-breaker! {effeminate voice}"Let me live, Benny, and I'll never come after you - pinky swear!" What a fink! Anyway...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {FIRST TALK}Go ahead and laugh, baby. I ain't blind to the humor in this situation.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {BEFORE BUNKER, SECOND TALK}Sing, baby. You got a captive audience.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {BEFORE BUNKER, BUSINESS AGAIN}Go on.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {BEFORE BUNKER, BUSINESS}Down to brass tacks. How'd your meet and greet with Baldie go?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {BEFORE BUNKER, BENNY'S FATE}{just learned the player gets to choose how you die}Try not to smile so wide, baby. You might break your mouth.|Yeah, Baldie said you'd get to decide. So which way you leaning?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {BEFORE BUNKER, BENNY'S FATE}{player has mentioned possibly freeing you}Last we spoke, you were leaning in more {emphasis}merciful direction...?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {BEFORE BUNKER, BENNY'S FATE}So you keep saying.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {AFTER BUNKER}{eager}So baby, what did you find down there?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {AFTER BUNKER, BENNY'S FATE}{bracing yourself, a bit defiant}I see. And how's that gonna happen?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What's holding you up? Let's get this over with.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {POLITICS}Which greedy overlord do you want to start with?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {BENNY'S PAST}{of course you'd want to know about me}I'm the most interesting person I know.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {BENNY'S PAST}I never tire of talking about myself.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {after player forgave you}I'm still a little choked up over here, baby. We'll catch up in a bit.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {generic line any time Benny doesn't want to talk to player}Scram, will ya? I value my privacy.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {upbeat}You and me gonna accomplish great things, baby.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {POLITICS}Name a name.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Don't look at me!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Someone's watching me, I can feel it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: So many staring eyes...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The voices in my head are getting louder...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The pain won't go away.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Imminent Cure}The cure is finally coming to make the voices stop.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Eventual Cure}{angry, impatient}We were promised a cure long before this, and now we must wait some more?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Keene dead}Why should we stay if Keene is dead?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Keene left}Perhaps the rest of us should follow Keene into the wasteland.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: There's too much light. Why is there always too much light?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Marcus isn't going to be happy about the deaths, but I guess they were unavoidable. At least I got a lot of useful data from the experiment.|This brief test might not yield a cure any time soon. If the prototype was constantly in use on a living subject, however...|Perhaps Lily might be willing to wear the prototype for a longer duration. The data would be invaluable.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I think those Nightkin are going cause a lot of trouble, but I guess giving them the specs was better than killing them.|I did get a lot of useful data from the experiment, and I'm much closer to a cure than I was before.|It's occurred to me that this brief test might not yield a cure any time soon. However, if Lily were to continue to wear the prototype...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Nice work with the Nightkin. I've never seen anyone able to talk their kind out of anything once they had their mind set to it.|I got a lot of useful data from the experiment and am a lot closer to a cure than before.|It's occurred to me that this brief test might not yield a cure any time soon. However, if Lily were to continue to wear the prototype...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Have you come to a decision on Lily? I'll need to know before I can do anything else.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: My request is perfectly reasonable. Give us the Stealth Boy specs and there will be no need for us to splatter the room with your insides.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Don't you still have business with Doctor Henry? You and I are done.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That Keene, always causing trouble.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Be careful with Keene. He's got a mean temper.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I can't believe Chomps got arrested! They said he was involving in smuggling, if you can believe it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Deathclaws have been keeping their distance. For now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: When do you think the NCR will send their troops to help us?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Jas screwed up the coffee again. Wouldn't drink it if I were you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It's too damn hot.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <Questions about Searchlight>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <Questions about Edwards>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <Cottonwood Cove Quest>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Go away.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Who the hell are you? Better yet, what the hell are you doing in this cursed place?|You know what? Forget it, it doesn't matter. Welcome to Camp Searchlight, the shittiest place on earth.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Yeah?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <Questions about dog tag>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <Questions for Edwards>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: <Arachnophobia Quest Stuff>
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Cautious}What now?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: {Cold}What?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: You've been a huge help here. Thanks to you, I think we can hold this camp together.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: Was there something else?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: {Impressed}It was you that rescued President Kimball, wasn't it? You're becoming quite the celebrity already.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSLieutenantMarkland "Lieutenant Markland" [NPC_:0012AC9F]

text_content: {Relieved}I heard it was a close call for the President. Good thing he has top-notch security.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSLieutenantMarkland "Lieutenant Markland" [NPC_:0012AC9F]

text_content: {Melancholy}I hear they're already assembling a team to investigate the President's assassination. Going to be one hell of a report.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSLieutenantMarkland "Lieutenant Markland" [NPC_:0012AC9F]

text_content: {Angry}I'm a little ashamed to admit it, but a part of me would {emphasis}really love to get my hands on the bastard that killed the President.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSLieutenantMarkland "Lieutenant Markland" [NPC_:0012AC9F]

text_content: {Angry}I'm a little ashamed to admit it, but a part of me would {emphasis}really love to get my hands on the bitch that killed the President.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSLieutenantMarkland "Lieutenant Markland" [NPC_:0012AC9F]

text_content: So, the NCR finally sent some relief? It's about damn time.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSLieutenantMarkland "Lieutenant Markland" [NPC_:0012AC9F]

text_content: {Starstruck}Wow. Hey, it's you. What are you doing in Bitter Springs?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSLieutenantMarkland "Lieutenant Markland" [NPC_:0012AC9F]

text_content: {Cautious}I don't suppose you're feeling helpful today?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSLieutenantMarkland "Lieutenant Markland" [NPC_:0012AC9F]

text_content: {Bitter, resigned}I don't know what you're doing here, but you can just leave. We've got enough problems here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSLieutenantMarkland "Lieutenant Markland" [NPC_:0012AC9F]

text_content: Those medical supplies have already been a phenomenal help. Thank you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSLieutenantMarkland "Lieutenant Markland" [NPC_:0012AC9F]

text_content: I really appreciate those books. They've already been a huge help.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSLieutenantMarkland "Lieutenant Markland" [NPC_:0012AC9F]

text_content: Yeah? What is it?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: VBSLieutenantMarkland "Lieutenant Markland" [NPC_:0012AC9F]

text_content: {Shocked}I warned them about that truck weeks ago. Always be prepared for any hazardous radiation I said.|{Saddened sigh}Those headstrong fools should have listened...|{Tired}Are you ready to head upriver?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {AH-way}Ave. Are you ready to head upriver?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {KAI-zar}Caesar awaits you in his tent. You have license to find your own way.|I'll wait here, to ferry you back to the western shore when your visit has concluded.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {AH-way}Ave. Are you ready to travel to the Fort?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {KAI-zar}Caesar has permitted you to leave, but not with the Platinum Chip in your possession. Relinquish it and you may go.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {AH-way}Ave. Are you ready to return to Cottonwood Cove?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Player has Platinum chip}By order of Caesar, all visitors must disarm and relinquish all banned items. This order also extends to the Platinum Chip you carry - for now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {KAI-zar}Caesar has permitted you to leave, but not with the Platinum Chip in your possession. Relinquish it and you may go.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: By order of Caesar, all visitors must disarm and relinquish all banned items.

text_content: Whatcha want, freakshow?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 1EFiendViolet "Violet" [NPC_:000F56FD]

text_content: Who the fuck are you and why are you bothering me?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 1EDriverNephi "Driver Nephi" [NPC_:000F56FF]

text_content: Back again? Jesus....
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 1EDriverNephi "Driver Nephi" [NPC_:000F56FF]

text_content: Come back to Violet, huh? What now?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 1EFiendViolet "Violet" [NPC_:000F56FD]

text_content: Something on your mind?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 1ECookCook "Cook-Cook" [NPC_:000F5700]

text_content: Hey there, sweet thing. Want a ride on the Cook-Cook express?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: 1ECookCook "Cook-Cook" [NPC_:000F5700]

text_content: Not now! I've got to get up to the lab and finish what I started!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This Vault-Tech machinery is so fragile. I had to jury-rig this elevator a few days ago and it's on the fritz again already.|Ah, that's got it. See you upstairs.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hm, what's this? Did you do these repairs? Not bad. Not bad at all.|Saves me time, I guess. See you upstairs.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Good, you're here. Ready to begin?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I suppose you have questions. Hurry up and ask them.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Ah, good. You survived. I was beginning to think you hadn't. You'll be pleased to know that the spores should no longer be a problem.|Now all that's left is to ensure that none of this ever happens again. The research that led to these abominations must be erased.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Don't mind me. I have to wrap things up here, gather my gear, that sort of thing. I'll be leaving soon enough.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Greetings! I do not believe we have met before. I have the singular distinction of being designated as Bohr.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: V22Bohr "Bohr" [CREA:000F0901]

text_content: Calculating...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hello again, my friend. I hope you've been finding the information in the datastore useful.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Ibsen top-level topics}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome to the range. Feel free to use any open lane.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Ah, outsider. I've heard that you were instrumental in providing Hardin with the evidence to bring against me. And here I had thought to use {lightly stressed}you.|Have you come to gloat, or did you actually want something?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome, outsider, welcome! The lockdown has been officially lifted and everyone seems to be in good spirits.|With the surface open to us once again, Hardin's already started talk of sending a force out to attack HELIOS, but I hope to dissuade him.|What can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hail, Brother. May I help you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Greetings, my friend. I hope I can be of some assistance to you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Getting ready to lift the lockdown}I apologize, outsider, but I'm going to be busy for a little while making preparations for lifting the lockdown.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Annoyed to have to talk to the player again}What is it now, outsider?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm afraid I don't have time to talk, outsider. I've had word that Hardin is charging me with violating protocol and must prepare a defense.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Back again, I see. Have you found all the components we need?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Have you had any luck finding the scouts? Or did you have something to discuss?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Found the missing patrols, or was something else on your mind?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: How did you find us, stranger? And do tell the truth.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I've been informed that you bring us ill tidings, stranger. Care to elaborate?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: When Paladin Ramos informed me that Veronica was approaching with an outsider in tow, at first I didn't know what to think.|After giving the matter some thought, however, I've decided that an outsider could be of use to me right now.|However, I will not force you to help us. Should you refuse, you will be allowed to leave here, though you'd remain Veronica's responsibility.|What do you say, outsider? Are you willing to help us?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What I wished to discuss with you can wait for once I get settled in the command room, outsider.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: When you first showed up on our doorstep, I'll admit at first I didn't know what to think.|After giving the matter some thought, however, I've decided that an outsider could be of great use to me right now.|However, I will not force you to help us. Should you refuse, you will be allowed to leave here, though know we {stressed}will be keeping an eye on you.|What do you say, outsider? Are you willing to help us?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: How did you resolve the situation with the ranger?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Have you reconsidered, outsider? I can still use your help.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Generic question node}Yes, associate?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {McNamara's top-level topics}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {McNamara's linked topics}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, I heard the pistol got returned. Thanks a lot! I am {emph}never going to listen to Watkins again, believe me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I really hope you can find that pistol.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Yes, can I help you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Sorry, but I'm a little busy here. If you'll excuse me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The lockdown is lifted! The patrols are going to start up again! Do you know what this means? I'll actually be able to get into a real fight!|I wonder what it'll be against? Raiders? Radscorpions? {super excited}Deathclaws? Oh, I can't wait. So what's up?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, so Hardin becoming Elder was because of you, huh? Good job. Now that the lockdown if lifted, I may get a chance to get into a real fight!|I wonder what it'll be against? Raiders? Radscorpions? {super excited}Deathclaws? Oh, I can't wait. So what's up?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I hear you handled the NCR ranger that was camping out topside.|Don't get a big head or anything about it. I would have taken him out if they'd let me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Yeah?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Watkins top-level topics}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You'll find your equipment in the chest to your right. Don't bother coming back until you've dealt with the ranger.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Stand back from the door. The Elder's eager to hear your report.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: [You hear nothing.]
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Ramos Greeting for players who found a patrol}Where did you learn that password? And tell the truth, because I'll know if you're lying.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Ramos Greeting for players with Veronica}{Stern}Listen up. I'm in charge of security around here, and I can't say I'm too happy having an outsider waltzing around.|{Eases up, first part was just for show}But since you came in with Veronica, I'm inclined to cut you a little slack. Just behave yourself and we won't have any problems, okay?|Oh, and the Elder's going to want to talk to you. He's on the second level. Just take a right once you get down there.|My office is right here in case you need anything. Just ask for Ramos.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Ramos dialogue if player sneaks into the bunker}{Angry, an intruder managed to get past his security}How the hell did you get in here? Normally, I would have already shot you, but I'm under orders to bring you to the Elder. Will you come peacefully?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Rest up, and make your report to the Elder when you're up to it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If you have something to say, say it to Elder McNamara.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Your presence here... Let's just say it's highly irregular.|Outsiders aren't even allowed to know that our bunker's here, let alone come and go freely.|You impressed Elder McNamara, obviously. He must believe that you'll be very useful.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Oh, hey there. Something I can help you with?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Ramos Top-level topics}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: No time to talk now. I have to get ready to return to base with this information. I'll get a fat raise for this, if anyone actually believes me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Nonchalant}Okay, so you weren't kidding about there being a Brotherhood base here.|I'll need to report back to base about this. They'll think I'm playing a prank if I try to radio it in, so I'll need some face time with the brass.|Thanks for the heads up. I mean it. I'll be sure to mention you in my report.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Shhh. I thought I heard something up by the entrance.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Now, now. Calm down. I believe you saw something. Let's just head back to my camp and we'll figure out what it was, okay?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Sorry, but I've got a long hike ahead of me. You take care.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Powder ganger scum! Hands up or die!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thought you'd sneak up on me, you filthy powder ganger?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Oh, it's you. Any particular reason you felt the need to bother me again?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Placeholder for Dobson's top-level topics}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You must be the stranger I've been hearing about. Sorry, but I'm strictly forbidden from offering our tech to outsiders like yourself.|Besides, I'm a little busy right now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Sorry, outsider, but I'm not allowed to sell you anything without the Elder's say so.|Besides, I'm a little busy right now.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I can't believe Hardin is Elder now. At least with the lockdown lifted I'll be able to resupply my store more often. So what are you here for?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Have you heard the news? Elder McNamara has lifted the lockdown! Good news for this store, let me tell you. I can't wait to start getting more goods.|So what are you here for?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The word came down from the Elder that I'm to offer you some of our lesser wares, as if I didn't have other matters on my mind.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Have you found it? I need to give my report to Hardin soon.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hi there. Looking to spend some caps?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You again? Didn't I tell you I was busy?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Torres top-level topics}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Listen very closely and do as I say. Your life depends on it.|Hand over everything you're carrying. Weapons, ammo, clothes, armor - everything. I want you stripped down to your underwear.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Save it for Paladin Ramos, outsider.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I said shut up and keep moving.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You're the one with that robot, I was hoping you'd bring him my way. Pretty impressive piece of hardware.| I can't say that I've seen anything quite like him before.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hmmm? Oh, you must be the outsider everyone's buzzing about. Pleased to meet you. I'm Lorenzo, Senior Knight and general handyman around here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Lorenzo's Top-level Topics}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hey, good to see you again. Have you thought any more about letting me take a look at the logs on your robot?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Good to see you! Alive, that is. Have you found all of the components yet?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Good to see you again. What can I help you with?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What do you want? And don't try anything funny.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: That report must reach the Elder's hands. I have nothing further to give you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Don't take another step if you value your life. For what purpose do you approach me?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: The Elder is likely urgently awaiting that report. You should make your way to him as soon as possible.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Approach slowly, stranger. If you have no business with me, then go.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Quick now, off with you! The Elder must see that report!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It looks like you've managed to talk some sense into the Elder, outsider. Be assured, I'll still be keeping an eye on him.|{Grudging}Your efforts to help this chapter are not unappreciated. Now, what can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome, my friend. A new day has dawned for this chapter, and moving forward we will no longer cower in the dark.|And we have you to thank for it. You'll find that I can be generous to those who show loyalty.|Here, take this key. If you ever find yourself in need of repair, head to our safehouse to the northeast.|Now, what can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Hardin, haven't listened to him yet}Are you willing to listen to me now, outsider?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Have you reconsidered helping me, outsider? I do what I must to see that the chapter survives.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What is it, outsider? Have you discovered anything?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Welcome back, my friend. What can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What do you want, outsider?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I appreciate all you've done, but I'm going to have my hands full for a little while. Come back later and we'll talk.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Hardin Top Level Topics}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Hardin linked topics}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I heard we have you to thank for McNamara having a change of heart. Thank you. So what can I do for you?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: There's a rumor going around that you were behind Hardin's takeover. I suppose his leadership is better than none at all. Time will tell.|So what brings you by today?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hello, you must be the outsider everyone is talking about. I'm Linda Schuler. If you ever need medical attention, this is the place to come.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hello. Can I help you with something?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Schuler Top-level topics}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Please excuse me - I'm {exter-cating}extricating myself at the moment...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Apologies, but I'm quite busy until I reach safety!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Well! That was quite an adventure. We taught those convicts a thing or two, didn't we?|Breaking myself out of a hostage situation - not to diminish your role in it, of course - but it was quite thrilling.|Problem is, there's still no law in Primm. What're we to do the next time ruffians menace us and hold us hostage?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Well! That was quite a per-dicament you rescued me from, there in the Bison Steve. A most unpleasant experience.|Going in alone to rescue a hostage! My brother-in-law was brave like that. Made a fine sheriff. Until the Powder Gangers killed him.|Problem is, there's still no law in Primm. What're we to do the next time ruffians menace us and hold us hostage?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Well, if it isn't the "lawbringer."
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Hello again. I don't suppose you've decided to help Primm find its next sheriff?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Any luck finding a suitable candidate for our next sheriff?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Oh, it's you.|{sighs}I suppose I should be thanking you for restoring the rule of law to Primm...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I don't plan to come back to the Bison Steve much in the years to come. If I ever get out of it.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I do hope this ordeal will be over soon.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: If we were to miss a convict or two in here, who'd know the difference?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm Lieutenant Hayes of the New California Republic Army, 5th Battalion, 1st Company. What's your business?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Yeah?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Primm is secure against outside threats. Be interesting to see how long the natives stay grateful.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: I'm Sergeant McGee of the New California Republic Army, 5th Battalion, 1st Company. If you want to talk about something, speak to Lieutenant Hayes.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What is it?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Move along, waster. Got a town to run here.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Hayes Placeholder}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Deputy Beagle Placeholder}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {McGee Top Level Topics}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Howdy pardner! Any luck tracking down Vance's gun?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Always good to see you, pardner! Anything I can help you with?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What are you doing here, stranger? You looking to start some trouble?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: This better be good, stranger.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: You'd best not try any funny business, stranger. One word from me, and Vance will plant you in the ground!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: What the hell you want?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thanks for talking Pauline out of robbing the Strip. Who knows what she'll think of next?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Thank god you talked me out of trying to rob the Strip. I guess we'll wait here until I come up with our next caper.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Primm Slimm Placeholder Topic}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Heard it was you brought the law back to Primm, youngster. Hat's off to you.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: PrimmNashDialogue "Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash" [QUST:000A23D8]

text_content: Primm had rule of law for the blink of an eye, but now we're back where we started.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: PrimmNashDialogue "Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash" [QUST:000A23D8]

text_content: Hey there, youngster.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: PrimmNashDialogue "Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash" [QUST:000A23D8]

text_content: Hello there. What brings you to Primm?
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: PrimmNashDialogue "Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash" [QUST:000A23D8]

text_content: Welcome back. Good to see you again.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: PrimmNashDialogue "Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash" [QUST:000A23D8]

text_content: {JNash Placeholder}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: PrimmNashDialogue "Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash" [QUST:000A23D8]

text_content: {RNash Placeholder}
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
quest: PrimmNashDialogue "Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash" [QUST:000A23D8]

text_content: Have you found the components we discussed? The sooner we get this over with, the better.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]
speaker: ChrisHaversam "Chris Haversam" [NPC_:000810E9]

text_content: Jason says that I am to cooperate with you on the final tasks necessary to launch the Great Journey.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Are you ready to get started? Those rockets aren't going to launch themselves.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It is almost time for the great Journey!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Not now! It is almost time for the Great Journey!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: It is almost time for the great Journey!
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Nice enough speech, I guess.|Well, it's up to you to go launch the rockets. There's a small mission control room all the way back upstairs. Should be as easy as pressin a button.|It seems my work here is done, so I'll be on my way to Novac. We'll see how that works out.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Did you hear him? As though some fancy speech can make what they did to me less of a crime?|Go launch the rockets! There's a cramped little "mission control" room all the way back upstairs. Should be as easy as pushing a button.|Enjoy the view. I hear the "Great Journey" is going to be shorter than they expected. Sweeter, too.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Did you hear him? My god, you were right all along. I'm no ghoul! They were just using me...
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Go launch the rockets. Don't worry about me.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Leave me alone.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: Did you bring the items we discussed? The sooner I send them on their way, the sooner I can head to Novac.
name: GREETING "GREETING" [DIAL:000000C8]

text_content: {Placeholder for Top Level Topics}

text_content: Hello
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Hello, it is great to finally meet you.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]
speaker: NellisJack "Jack" [NPC_:000FF264]

text_content: Hello.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Evening.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Morning.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Hey.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: I got kicked outta Ultra Luxe the other day. Man, that place gives me the fucking creeps.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Paladin.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Hello, outsider.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: You're being watched, so don't get any ideas.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: The bunker takes a little getting used to, doesn't it?
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: How may I assist you?
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Paladin.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Initiate.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Greetings, Elder.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Knight.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Hello, sir.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Sir.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Apprentice.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: The reports say Mr. House's robots are now using tech we've never heard of. We need to send a team up there, soon.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Looks like Mr. House is out of the picture. One less thing for us to deal with.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: With their leader gone, the Legion will likely tear itself apart. It's what most violent tribal societies do.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Our instruments show some impressive power fluctuations coming from across the river. What's going on over there?
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: There was a huge explosion east of the Colorado a little while ago. Does the NCR have any artillery that big?
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Someone blew up the monorail the NCR uses to travel to the Strip and back. We should use this  time to strike!
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Seems the destruction of the monorail didn't slow the NCR down much. How many troops do they have?
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: There was an attempt on the NCR president's life recently. Too bad it didn't succeed.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Did you hear? Someone actually managed to assassinate the NCR's president! And we just sit here!
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: The other day I heard some bigwig in the NCR military died. Hopefully it disrupts their chain of command some.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Did you hear about that NCR higher up that died? That he was trying to sabotage them? Hope he wasn't the only one.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Seems the NCR is making friends. We've had reports of them making overtures to some gang in Freeside.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: We just had word that the town of Primm is now part of the NCR. At this rate, they'll be running the whole region soon.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: I heard some special squad of Rangers is on its way to the Vegas area. I guess the NCR is finally getting serious about fighting the Legion.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: There've been reports that the NCR is moving more and more troops into the area.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: It's the quiet before the storm up top. For once I'm almost glad we're down here.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Hey, good going with that hit on The Tops.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: That prick, Benny, had it coming.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: I always suspected Benny was a coward.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: You must have some serious brass to fight off Benny's goons. Bravo.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: You made a real mess of the Omertas. Looks like the place will be under new management now.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: You must have some real pull with House to get inside the Lucky 38.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Have you seen the new Securitron upgrades? I pity anyone who gets testy with those bots now.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: The Lucky 38 has been quiet. I wonder if something happened to House.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Have you noticed the Securitrons acting up? People are saying House might be dead.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Hey, you're the one who slayed Caesar! That son of a bitch had it coming!
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: People say Caesar is dead. I hope someone worse doesn't replace him.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Good going destroying House's Securitron Army. That old boy's had too much power for too long.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Great, with the monorail bombed, Freeside is the only route in and out of Vegas.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: At least the local vendors are seeing more business with these wealthy NCR shits wandering through.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: I hear some Legionary named Silus got freed from McCarran. He's got quite the NCR kill count.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Why didn't you just let Kimball get killed? What did he ever do for us to warrant saving his life?
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: You must have thought you were hot shit going after Kimball like that, huh?
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: I hear you bagged kimball. Damn fine work, kid.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: That's the mook that killed Benny!
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: {LATIN}{AH-way}Ave, true to {KAI-zar}Caesar.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: True to {KAI-zar}Caesar.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: True to {KAI-zar}Caesar.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]
quest: vDialogueCaesarsLegionMilitary "Generic Dialogue for CL military NPCs" [QUST:00129E29]

text_content: We got ourselves a little Ranger family reunion now. Time's right for a feud.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Monster of the East, huh? Well I've got the Monster of the West in my holster right now. Hope I get to introduce them.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: A veteran Ranger inspires awe. Stick around for when they get here, you'll see. If I live to earn the Black Armor, I can die a happy woman.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: First Recon's in Camp Forlorn Hope. Get some Rangers in there too and it'll be a damned impregnable fortress.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Wish I could've been there, defending Camp Forlorn Hope. Even if it didn't change anything.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Looks like we booted the Legion outta Nelson. About damn time.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: From here on out, we fight for Chief Hanlon.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: President Kimball was a tough son-of-a-gun. The Rangers'll pick up where he left off.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: President Kimball was a soldier's soldier. It's up to us to make the Legion pay for what they did.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: {with esteem}You saved President Kimball, didn't you? Hell of a thing.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Don't get many chances to catch a legionary alive. Burns me up that we botched ours.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: All you need is one Ranger protecting the monorail. You don't even need to feed him that much. He'll get it done.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Wish I had a First Recon guy looking after me.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Hoover Dam... just thinking about it makes me nervous.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: {Starstruck}One of the Ranger vets looked at me and I just about surrendered.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: The Ranger vets are on their way from Baja. Never seen one before. But I've heard they chew nails and spit napalm.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: We put our trust in Hanlon and look where it got us. Makes you wonder if we can trust anyone at all.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Chief Hanlon's watching over us now. He won't let us lose.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: {Scared}They got to President Kimball. How long can we hold out?
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Oh my God, are you the one who saved President Kimball?
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: I heard we captured a live Centurion and then let him get away. That never would've happened if I was in charge.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: {Irked}No monorail access to the Strip? Where am I supposed to take my leave? Freeside?
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: We won't go quietly. The Legion can count on that.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Sounds like we're running Primm now. I'd still rather take my leave at the Strip.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: First Recon's at Camp Forlorn Hope. Now we've got a chance to hold it.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Nelson's back in our hands. I hope we can defend it this time.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Is it me, or has the Brotherhood stopped engaging us? Smartest move they ever made, you ask me.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Smart move for the Kings to back down. They didn't know who they were messing with.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: We signed a treaty with the Great Khans. Guess you can never have too many lowlife chem dealers on your side.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Sickens me that the Legion would try to harvest slaves from a refugee camp.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: President Kimball is lucky he escaped. I don't think we could lose him right now.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Wish I could've been there to see Caesar die. What an asshole.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Hey there.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: The bosses of the {saying it wrong}Omergas? Omer-nas? The ones that run Gomorrah? Someone killed them.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Outrageous what Mortimer did. The nerve of some people.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: {Mock sympathy}Oh, Mortimer. You always had the gift of gaffe.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Usually we punish people who come in here uninvited. But you've made such a splash, we don't have the heart.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Your theatrics were just priceless. I salute you.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: The boy has seen too much!
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Trespasser!
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: You don't belong here!
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Leave this instant!
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Outsiders are forbidden!
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: That business at the Tops could never happen here. We don't admit that sort of riff-raff.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: I know Benny was murdered, but if you ask me, the real crime was that checkered jacket.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: A little bird told me Benny might be gone for good. He must've been in some delightful scandal to have run off so suddenly.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: {Amused}Those Omertas. Always plotting, never relevant. Bravo for putting them in their place like that.
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: {Impressed}Word has it you were spotted entering the Lucky 38. How ever did you get on that guest list?
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Is it me or do the Securitrons seem... sassier?
name: HELLO "Hello" [DIAL:000000D2]

text_content: Whatever has become of Mr. House? He used to send a Securitron to our dinner parties sometimes, like an uninvited but harmless uncle.

text_content: Then I would say do it. You'll need it.

text_content: They're playing you for a fool. You'll die in that tower, just like their soldiers did. Why do you think they haven't taken care of this themselves?

Still, it's only a matter of time.
name: VMS03IgnacioNCRDoesntKnow "The NCR doesn't know about the weapon?" [DIAL:000E35DA]
