name: REPCONHQFreeformREPCONTourGuideTopic006 "That's enough about REPCONN." [DIAL:000E863E]

text_content: Very well, feel free to ask me more about REPCONN at {emphasis}any time, don't be shy.|The tour showcases REPCONN's amazing scientific contributions, and the promise of many more, coupled with its parent company, RobCo.
name: REPCONHQFreeformREPCONTourGuideTopic006 "That's enough about REPCONN." [DIAL:000E863E]
speaker: REPCONTourGuide "Tour Guide" [CREA:000E85EF]

text_content: REPCONHQTourStation
name: REPCONHQTour04 "REPCONHQTourStation" [DIAL:000E87FE]

text_content: Behind me is our most recent rocket project, which we're keeping under our hats... until "launch," if you'll pardon the expression.
name: REPCONHQTour04 "REPCONHQTourStation" [DIAL:000E87FE]
speaker: REPCONTourGuide "Tour Guide" [CREA:000E85EF]

text_content: And in front of me is a model  - not actual size - of the launch dome we are using to send our rockets screeeeaming into orbit.
name: REPCONHQTour04 "REPCONHQTourStation" [DIAL:000E87FE]

text_content: REPCONHQTourStation3
name: REPCONHQTour03 "REPCONHQTourStation3" [DIAL:000E87FF]

text_content: To my right you can see a sample of some old "safety barrels" REPCONN once used to store radioactive waste. Perfectly safe.
name: REPCONHQTour03 "REPCONHQTourStation3" [DIAL:000E87FF]
speaker: REPCONTourGuide "Tour Guide" [CREA:000E85EF]

text_content: On my left is an example of a mountain of REPCONN safety barrels some legislators claim are poisoning our environment. Ridiculous.
name: REPCONHQTour03 "REPCONHQTourStation3" [DIAL:000E87FF]

text_content: REPCONHQTourStation02
name: REPCONHQTour02 "REPCONHQTourStation02" [DIAL:000E8800]

text_content: Look here - a row of multi-colored plasma fuels! Careful, they may look safe to drink, but your stomach is the last place they should be.
name: REPCONHQTour02 "REPCONHQTourStation02" [DIAL:000E8800]
speaker: REPCONTourGuide "Tour Guide" [CREA:000E85EF]

text_content: Why the difference in cylinder size? Refining our production methods has resulted in higher yields of fuel over time, that's why!
name: REPCONHQTour02 "REPCONHQTourStation02" [DIAL:000E8800]

text_content: REPCONHQTourStation01
name: REPCONHQTour01 "REPCONHQTourStation01" [DIAL:000E8801]

text_content: In the lead-lined case behind me is a spent radioactive rod from of our old reactors. No need to stand too close, let's move along, shall we?
name: REPCONHQTour01 "REPCONHQTourStation01" [DIAL:000E8801]
speaker: REPCONTourGuide "Tour Guide" [CREA:000E85EF]

text_content: REPCONHQTourStation00
name: REPCONHQTour00 "REPCONHQTourStation00" [DIAL:000E8802]

text_content: Ready for the REPCONN tour, Rocketeers? Courtesy of the fine folks at RobCo, I'll be your guide today on the path of... Scientific. Discovery.
name: REPCONHQTour00 "REPCONHQTourStation00" [DIAL:000E8802]
speaker: REPCONTourGuide "Tour Guide" [CREA:000E85EF]

text_content: VVault11ExterminationChamber01
name: VVault11ExterminationChamber01 "VVault11ExterminationChamber01" [DIAL:000E884F]

text_content: Congratulations, martyr! Your fantastic journey is only just beginning. Please proceed to the light.
name: VVault11ExterminationChamber01 "VVault11ExterminationChamber01" [DIAL:000E884F]
speaker: VVault11PrerecordedVoice "Vault-Tec Recording Speaker" [NPC_:000E8B1F]

text_content: VVault11ExterminationChamber02
name: VVault11ExterminationChamber02 "VVault11ExterminationChamber02" [DIAL:000E8850]

text_content: The light is calming, and puts your mind at ease. Go to the light.
name: VVault11ExterminationChamber02 "VVault11ExterminationChamber02" [DIAL:000E8850]
speaker: VVault11PrerecordedVoice "Vault-Tec Recording Speaker" [NPC_:000E8B1F]

text_content: VVault11ChairInvite01
name: VVault11ChairInvite01 "VVault11ChairInvite01" [DIAL:000E8851]

text_content: Welcome. Please sit in the chair. The show is about to begin.
name: VVault11ChairInvite01 "VVault11ChairInvite01" [DIAL:000E8851]
speaker: VVault11PrerecordedVoice "Vault-Tec Recording Speaker" [NPC_:000E8B1F]

text_content: VVault11ChairInvite02
name: VVault11ChairInvite02 "VVault11ChairInvite02" [DIAL:000E8852]

text_content: The show requires that you sit in the chair.
name: VVault11ChairInvite02 "VVault11ChairInvite02" [DIAL:000E8852]
speaker: VVault11PrerecordedVoice "Vault-Tec Recording Speaker" [NPC_:000E8B1F]

text_content: VVault11ChairInvite03
name: VVault11ChairInvite03 "VVault11ChairInvite03" [DIAL:000E8853]

text_content: It is absolutely essential that you sit in the chair.
name: VVault11ChairInvite03 "VVault11ChairInvite03" [DIAL:000E8853]
speaker: VVault11PrerecordedVoice "Vault-Tec Recording Speaker" [NPC_:000E8B1F]

text_content: VVault11ChairInvite04
name: VVault11ChairInvite04 "VVault11ChairInvite04" [DIAL:000E8854]

text_content: You have no other choice. You must sit in the chair.
name: VVault11ChairInvite04 "VVault11ChairInvite04" [DIAL:000E8854]
speaker: VVault11PrerecordedVoice "Vault-Tec Recording Speaker" [NPC_:000E8B1F]

text_content: VVault11Slideshow1
name: VVault11Slideshow1 "VVault11Slideshow1" [DIAL:000E8855]

text_content: Greetings, martyr, and welcome! If you're here now, it means you've been offered up as a sacrifice so that your vault can continue to thrive.
name: VVault11Slideshow1 "VVault11Slideshow1" [DIAL:000E8855]
speaker: VVault11PrerecordedVoice "Vault-Tec Recording Speaker" [NPC_:000E8B1F]

text_content: VVault11Slideshow2
name: VVault11Slideshow2 "VVault11Slideshow2" [DIAL:000E8856]

text_content: Currently, you may be feeling sad or angry. Perhaps you never got to have grandkids, or to enjoy the pleasures of a fresh cigar.
name: VVault11Slideshow2 "VVault11Slideshow2" [DIAL:000E8856]
speaker: VVault11PrerecordedVoice "Vault-Tec Recording Speaker" [NPC_:000E8B1F]

text_content: VVault11Slideshow3
name: VVault11Slideshow3 "VVault11Slideshow3" [DIAL:000E8857]

text_content: But march with your chin held high, soldier, and remember that each of us has an important role to play.
name: VVault11Slideshow3 "VVault11Slideshow3" [DIAL:000E8857]
speaker: VVault11PrerecordedVoice "Vault-Tec Recording Speaker" [NPC_:000E8B1F]

text_content: VVault11Slideshow4
name: VVault11Slideshow4 "VVault11Slideshow4" [DIAL:000E8858]

text_content: For some people, their role might be to heal the sick. For others, it might mean they will drive a racecar or fly a rocket ship.
name: VVault11Slideshow4 "VVault11Slideshow4" [DIAL:000E8858]
speaker: VVault11PrerecordedVoice "Vault-Tec Recording Speaker" [NPC_:000E8B1F]

text_content: VVault11Slideshow5
name: VVault11Slideshow5 "VVault11Slideshow5" [DIAL:000E8859]

text_content: And some of us are meant to forfeit our lives for the good of the people.
name: VVault11Slideshow5 "VVault11Slideshow5" [DIAL:000E8859]
speaker: VVault11PrerecordedVoice "Vault-Tec Recording Speaker" [NPC_:000E8B1F]

text_content: VVault11Slideshow6
name: VVault11Slideshow6 "VVault11Slideshow6" [DIAL:000E885A]

text_content: Sure it might not be as fun as driving a racecar, but it's every bit as important.
name: VVault11Slideshow6 "VVault11Slideshow6" [DIAL:000E885A]
speaker: VVault11PrerecordedVoice "Vault-Tec Recording Speaker" [NPC_:000E8B1F]

text_content: VVault11Slideshow7
name: VVault11Slideshow7 "VVault11Slideshow7" [DIAL:000E885B]

text_content: Let's take a moment to reflect on the moments that made your life worth living.
name: VVault11Slideshow7 "VVault11Slideshow7" [DIAL:000E885B]
speaker: VVault11PrerecordedVoice "Vault-Tec Recording Speaker" [NPC_:000E8B1F]

text_content: VVault11Slideshow8
name: VVault11Slideshow8 "VVault11Slideshow8" [DIAL:000E885C]

text_content: Think about that time you kissed your steady girl for the first time under the bleachers at the big game.
name: VVault11Slideshow8 "VVault11Slideshow8" [DIAL:000E885C]
speaker: VVault11PrerecordedVoice "Vault-Tec Recording Speaker" [NPC_:000E8B1F]

text_content: VVault11Slideshow9
name: VVault11Slideshow9 "VVault11Slideshow9" [DIAL:000E885D]

text_content: Or when you snuck out after curfew to catch that new flick that your parents wouldn't let you see because it was too scary. Boy, were they right!
name: VVault11Slideshow9 "VVault11Slideshow9" [DIAL:000E885D]
speaker: VVault11PrerecordedVoice "Vault-Tec Recording Speaker" [NPC_:000E8B1F]

text_content: VVault11Slideshow10
name: VVault11Slideshow10 "VVault11Slideshow10" [DIAL:000E885E]

text_content: And who could forget when you met the love of your life? What a looker! These are just examples.
name: VVault11Slideshow10 "VVault11Slideshow10" [DIAL:000E885E]
speaker: VVault11PrerecordedVoice "Vault-Tec Recording Speaker" [NPC_:000E8B1F]

text_content: VVault11Slideshow11
name: VVault11Slideshow11 "VVault11Slideshow11" [DIAL:000E885F]

text_content: Do you feel that feeling stirring in your chest as you think of these things? Good. What you are feeling is peace.
name: VVault11Slideshow11 "VVault11Slideshow11" [DIAL:000E885F]
speaker: VVault11PrerecordedVoice "Vault-Tec Recording Speaker" [NPC_:000E8B1F]

text_content: VVault11Slideshow12
name: VVault11Slideshow12 "VVault11Slideshow12" [DIAL:000E8860]

text_content: You've led a great life. Living it has been its own reward. But it is only the beginning.
name: VVault11Slideshow12 "VVault11Slideshow12" [DIAL:000E8860]
speaker: VVault11PrerecordedVoice "Vault-Tec Recording Speaker" [NPC_:000E8B1F]

text_content: VVault11Slideshow13
name: VVault11Slideshow13 "VVault11Slideshow13" [DIAL:000E8861]

text_content: Close your eyes now, and imagine what joys await you in the next life - the afterlife. Can you see them? Good.
name: VVault11Slideshow13 "VVault11Slideshow13" [DIAL:000E8861]
speaker: VVault11PrerecordedVoice "Vault-Tec Recording Speaker" [NPC_:000E8B1F]

text_content: 188ClayMedicineBuy
name: 188ClayMedicineBuy "188ClayMedicineBuy" [DIAL:000E88BC]

text_content: Thinking hurts you, too? Aw, I wish I could let you have the one on my head but I can't. It hurts real bad when I don't wear it.
name: 188ClayMedicineBuy "188ClayMedicineBuy" [DIAL:000E88BC]

text_content: 188ClayThoughtsSmallPicture
name: 188ClayThoughtsSmallPicture "188ClayThoughtsSmallPicture" [DIAL:000E88BD]

text_content: I need to take off my medicine...|Local, local, the here and now... little of interest... things to buy, false hopes, and regrets watered down, washed down in dirty glasses.|With regret comes a girl... smiling sad, brown robe, name Veronica, half here. Wraps her and her heart up like a pack, in the pack, a key, some say.|{Slight upbeat at the end, different than the eeriness}Forecast: Cloudy, with a chance of friendship.|{Frowns, winces}Ouch. Thinking small only hurts a little, but it's a sharp pain.
name: 188ClayThoughtsSmallPicture "188ClayThoughtsSmallPicture" [DIAL:000E88BD]

text_content: 188ClayThoughtsBigPicture
name: 188ClayThoughtsBigPicture "188ClayThoughtsBigPicture" [DIAL:000E88BE]

text_content: Let me take off my medicine...|Bull and Bear over the Dam, at each other's throats... but a light from Vegas? Ball spinning on the wheel, more than two at the table, placing bets.|All lose in different ways, a dam of corpses, towns of corpses, scattered across the sand. But whose, in what shares? Even the dealer doesn't know.|Forecast: A rain of blood will flood the desert and not purify it.|Bleh. Thinking about Everywhere always makes me feel a little sick...
name: 188ClayThoughtsBigPicture "188ClayThoughtsBigPicture" [DIAL:000E88BE]

text_content: 188ClayThoughtsPlayer
name: 188ClayThoughtsPlayer "188ClayThoughtsPlayer" [DIAL:000E88BF]

text_content: Okay. Let me take off my medicine...|{A little slower, more thoughtful}Your face does the thinking - two to the skull, yet one gets up. Odds are against you... but they're just numbers after the two-to-one.|You're playing the hand you've been dealt, but you don't let it rest, you shuffle and stack, and a gamble... a gamble that may pay off? {Frowns}But how?|Forecast: Rapidly changing conditions.|{Frowns, resumes normal voice}A lot of thinking - most of it in your face, it's almost shouting at me. {Beat, slight apology}Sorry if I said anything weird.
name: 188ClayThoughtsPlayer "188ClayThoughtsPlayer" [DIAL:000E88BF]

text_content: 188ClayPayForThoughts
name: 188ClayPayForThoughts "188ClayPayForThoughts" [DIAL:000E88C0]

text_content: Great! What do you want me to think about? I can think about You, Here... or Everywhere. What do you want?
name: 188ClayPayForThoughts "188ClayPayForThoughts" [DIAL:000E88C0]

text_content: Sure, I could do some more thinking. What should I do my thinking about this time?
name: 188ClayPayForThoughts "188ClayPayForThoughts" [DIAL:000E88C0]

text_content: That's all right, mister. You will someday.
name: 188ClayPayForThoughts "188ClayPayForThoughts" [DIAL:000E88C0]

text_content: That's all right, ma'am. You will someday.
name: 188ClayPayForThoughts "188ClayPayForThoughts" [DIAL:000E88C0]

text_content: Sorry, sir. All that thinking has made my head hurt. I don't think I'll be doing any thinking for a long time.
name: 188ClayPayForThoughts "188ClayPayForThoughts" [DIAL:000E88C0]

text_content: Sorry, ma'am. All that thinking has made my head hurt. I don't think I'll be doing any thinking for a long time.
name: 188ClayPayForThoughts "188ClayPayForThoughts" [DIAL:000E88C0]

text_content: 188ClayJunk
name: 188ClayJunk "188ClayJunk" [DIAL:000E88C1]

text_content: That's not junk. That's other people's thoughts. People had to think to make them, and the thoughts got stuck inside.|I need other people's thoughts to fill my head when I'm not thinking myself. Otherwise it's... kind of empty.
name: 188ClayJunk "188ClayJunk" [DIAL:000E88C1]

text_content: 188ClayParents
name: 188ClayParentsWhere "188ClayParents" [DIAL:000E88C2]

text_content: I don't have a mama or papa anymore. I see them sometimes when I take off my medicine, but they can't stay. I'm pretty used to being on my own.
name: 188ClayParentsWhere "188ClayParents" [DIAL:000E88C2]

text_content: 188ClayMedicineWhatIsIt
name: 188ClayMedicineWhatIsIt "188ClayMedicineWhatIsIt" [DIAL:000E88C3]

text_content: This thing on my head is headache medicine. It works real good, except I can't think when it's on. {emphasize}Really think, I mean.
name: 188ClayMedicineWhatIsIt "188ClayMedicineWhatIsIt" [DIAL:000E88C3]

text_content: 188ClaySellThoughts
name: 188ClaySellThoughts "188ClaySellThoughts" [DIAL:000E88C4]

text_content: I can take off my medicine and do some thinking. People say it's real interesting. I don't know, {'cause}because I never hear it.|Some people say that it's a gift. Other people say that it's the kind of thinking anyone could do if they watched more than they talked.|I don't know which is true. I see a lot, I think a lot. There's a lot to hear through the 188, too, that maybe accounts for the thinking.
name: 188ClaySellThoughts "188ClaySellThoughts" [DIAL:000E88C4]

text_content: 188ClayBuySell
name: 188ClayBuySell "188ClayBuySell" [DIAL:000E88C5]

text_content: Oh, I don't sell things, mister. I sell {emph}thoughts.
name: 188ClayBuySell "188ClayBuySell" [DIAL:000E88C5]

text_content: Oh, I don't sell things, ma'am. I sell {emph}thoughts.
name: 188ClayBuySell "188ClayBuySell" [DIAL:000E88C5]

text_content: Got nothing to spare.
name: 188CivilianUnhappyBeggarNo "Got nothing to spare." [DIAL:000E88C6]

text_content: Oh, you could. You just don't want to.
name: 188CivilianUnhappyBeggarNo "Got nothing to spare." [DIAL:000E88C6]

text_content: I understand. Sorry to be a bother.
name: 188CivilianUnhappyBeggarNo "Got nothing to spare." [DIAL:000E88C6]

text_content: But... Of course. It's all right. Thank you.
name: 188CivilianUnhappyBeggarNo "Got nothing to spare." [DIAL:000E88C6]

text_content: Sure. Here's 25 caps.
name: 188CivilianUnhappyBeggarYes "Sure. Here's 25 caps." [DIAL:000E88C7]

text_content: Thank you so much! I'm so hungry!
name: 188CivilianUnhappyBeggarYes "Sure. Here's 25 caps." [DIAL:000E88C7]

text_content: Sorry I had to bother you. I've... well, I've lost everything.
name: 188CivilianUnhappyBeggarYes "Sure. Here's 25 caps." [DIAL:000E88C7]

text_content: You're very kind. I wish... well, I'll just thank you and leave you be.
name: 188CivilianUnhappyBeggarYes "Sure. Here's 25 caps." [DIAL:000E88C7]

text_content: 188AlexanderSpecialOrderMenu
name: 188AlexanderSpecialOrderMenu "188AlexanderSpecialOrderMenu" [DIAL:000E88C8]

text_content: 188AlexanderInventory
name: 188AlexanderInventory "188AlexanderInventory" [DIAL:000E88CE]

text_content: 188AlexanderPcAchievements
name: 188AlexanderPcAchievements "188AlexanderPcAchievements" [DIAL:000E88CF]

text_content: Still plenty of other problems keeping the 15 shut down, though. Thanks for playing.
name: 188AlexanderPcAchievements "188AlexanderPcAchievements" [DIAL:000E88CF]

text_content: That'll help. Still plenty of problems out that way, though.
name: 188AlexanderPcAchievements "188AlexanderPcAchievements" [DIAL:000E88CF]

text_content: You took out a Deathclaw nest? Either you're lying, or you're tougher than you look.|Still plenty of troubles out that way, though. Thanks for playing.
name: 188AlexanderPcAchievements "188AlexanderPcAchievements" [DIAL:000E88CF]

text_content: That's impressive - if you're telling the truth.|Still, it'll take some time for routes to readjust. I expect I'll be working from here for the foreseeable future.
name: 188AlexanderPcAchievements "188AlexanderPcAchievements" [DIAL:000E88CF]

text_content: 188AlexanderNoEnergyWeapons
name: 188AlexanderNoEnergyWeapons "188AlexanderNoEnergyWeapons" [DIAL:000E88D1]

text_content: We used to. But every caravan carrying them was getting ambushed and wiped out. By someone sophisticated enough to know which was which.|We think it was the Brotherhood of Steel - those crazies always go hard for energy weapons. But the NCR would rather pretend they killed all of them.
name: 188AlexanderNoEnergyWeapons "188AlexanderNoEnergyWeapons" [DIAL:000E88D1]

text_content: Not much to tell. A brahmin or two loaded up with weapons, and a whole mess of well-armed guards to make sure it ends up where it's supposed to.|One nifty bit, though. The gun cases are rigged to explode. So trying to loot one of our caravans doesn't do much good. |And that's how the NCR stays equipped. The only thing we don't bring in is energy weapons.
name: 188AlexanderAboutCaravans [DIAL:000E88D2]

text_content: 188AlexanderAboutYourRole
name: 188AlexanderAboutYourRole "188AlexanderAboutYourRole" [DIAL:000E88D3]

text_content: I'm a salesman. I swing through McCarran and the dam once a week or so to take orders. But lately I spend most of my time in this piss heap.|Ever since the 15 shut down, all caravans come through here - right to me. I check the stock and direct deliveries onward to meet orders.|Sure, it stinks to hang out here, but it won't be forever. Plus I can afford a monthly bender on the Strip and still build up my nest egg.
name: 188AlexanderAboutYourRole "188AlexanderAboutYourRole" [DIAL:000E88D3]

text_content: 188AlexanderBuySell
name: 188AlexanderBuySell "188AlexanderBuySell" [DIAL:000E88D4]

text_content: There's usually a gun merchant hanging around topside. I'm sure she'll take care of you.
name: 188AlexanderBuySell "188AlexanderBuySell" [DIAL:000E88D4]

text_content: 188AlexanderAboutGunRunners
name: 188AlexanderAboutGunRunners "188AlexanderAboutGunRunners" [DIAL:000E88D5]

text_content: The Gun Runners have been putting rapid-fire death-dealing in the hands of anyone who needed to defend himself for over a century.|We're the NCR's #1 supplier of weapons and ammunition. You might call us an unofficial branch of the army.
name: 188AlexanderAboutGunRunners "188AlexanderAboutGunRunners" [DIAL:000E88D5]

text_content: 188AlexanderGunRunner
name: 188AlexanderGunRunner "188AlexanderGunRunner" [DIAL:000E88D6]

text_content: Like you have a clue what that even means.
name: 188AlexanderGunRunner "188AlexanderGunRunner" [DIAL:000E88D6]

text_content: 188AlexanderSeeInventory
name: 188AlexanderSeeInventory "188AlexanderSeeInventory" [DIAL:000E88D7]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] You might be on to something. I like to hang on to any weapons mods I run across...|Take a look.
name: 188AlexanderSeeInventory "188AlexanderSeeInventory" [DIAL:000E88D7]

text_content: [FAILED] Do I look like a fucking arms caravan to you?|Do you think the Gun Runners keep the NCR military supplied by carrying weapons and ammo from the Boneyard out here by the armload? |Get a clue. We have caravans. We deal in bulk.
name: 188AlexanderSeeInventory "188AlexanderSeeInventory" [DIAL:000E88D7]

text_content: Take a look.
name: 188AlexanderSeeInventory "188AlexanderSeeInventory" [DIAL:000E88D7]

text_content: 188AlexanderAreYouSelling
name: 188AlexanderAreYouSelling "188AlexanderAreYouSelling" [DIAL:000E88D8]

text_content: Am I selling? Yeah. Am I selling to you? No. Sorry to hurt your feelings, but you're small time. Move along.
name: 188AlexanderAreYouSelling "188AlexanderAreYouSelling" [DIAL:000E88D8]

text_content: 188AlexanderThreaten
name: 188AlexanderThreaten "188AlexanderThreaten" [DIAL:000E88D9]

text_content: You like it any better if I tell you to fuck off?
name: 188AlexanderThreaten "188AlexanderThreaten" [DIAL:000E88D9]

text_content: 188MichelleBoastSavePrimm
name: 188MichelleBoastSavePrimm "188MichelleBoastSavePrimm" [DIAL:000E88DA]

text_content: That's nice. I suspect we'll stick around here, though. Business has been good.
name: 188MichelleBoastSavePrimm "188MichelleBoastSavePrimm" [DIAL:000E88DA]

text_content: What do you know about Legion raids?
name: 188MichelleAboutLegion "What do you know about Legion raids?" [DIAL:000E88DB]

text_content: Not much. I hear some folks got killed down by Nelson... or was it Novac? I don't know. If they come up this way, me and dad'll go someplace else.
name: 188MichelleAboutLegion "What do you know about Legion raids?" [DIAL:000E88DB]
speaker: 188Michelle "Michelle" [NPC_:000E5F17]

text_content: Why's this place called the 188?
name: 188MichelleNumbers "Why's this place called the 188?" [DIAL:000E88DC]

text_content: You do know these old roads were numbered, right? We're standing where the 95 and 93 meet. And 95 plus 93 equals... 188.
name: 188MichelleNumbers "Why's this place called the 188?" [DIAL:000E88DC]
speaker: 188Michelle "Michelle" [NPC_:000E5F17]

text_content: Why'd you settle in this dump?
name: 188MichelleAbout188 "Why'd you settle in this dump?" [DIAL:000E88DD]

text_content: There's more to the 188 than meets the eye. Troops move back and forth on 93 all the time, and 95 is how NCR folks come and go from Vegas.|No shortage of customers... so long as Legion raids south of here don't get worse, anyways.
name: 188MichelleAbout188 "Why'd you settle in this dump?" [DIAL:000E88DD]
speaker: 188Michelle "Michelle" [NPC_:000E5F17]

text_content: I'd like to see what you have for sale.
name: 188MichelleBuySell "I'd like to see what you have for sale." [DIAL:000E88DE]

text_content: Have a look.
name: 188MichelleBuySell "I'd like to see what you have for sale." [DIAL:000E88DE]
speaker: 188Michelle "Michelle" [NPC_:000E5F17]

text_content: Who are you?
name: 188MichelleAboutSelf "Who are you?" [DIAL:000E88DF]

text_content: Name's Michelle. My Dad and me run this store. His name's Samuel. I take the day shift and he takes nights.|We came here about a month ago, when Primm went to hell on account of the prison break north of there. Found a bin to call home and set up shop.
name: 188MichelleAboutSelf "Who are you?" [DIAL:000E88DF]
speaker: 188Michelle "Michelle" [NPC_:000E5F17]

text_content: 188SamuelBuySell

name: REPCONHQClosing1 "REPCONHQClosing" [DIAL:000EA536]

text_content: REPCONHQTour07
name: REPCONHQTour07 "REPCONHQTour07" [DIAL:000EA537]

text_content: This is the final stop on our tour. This model of our solar system is a small example of where the partnership between RobCo and REPCONN hopes to go.
name: REPCONHQTour07 "REPCONHQTour07" [DIAL:000EA537]
speaker: REPCONTourGuide "Tour Guide" [CREA:000E85EF]

text_content: See those little rockets zipping about? They are manned by robots, tirelessly looking for resources to mine on planets beyond our own.
name: REPCONHQTour07 "REPCONHQTour07" [DIAL:000EA537]

text_content: And that's it for our tour today, Rocketeers - RobCo and its tiny partner REPCONN thank you! Any further questions, please, feel free to ask.
name: REPCONHQTour07 "REPCONHQTour07" [DIAL:000EA537]

text_content: REPCONHQTour06
name: REPCONHQTour06 "REPCONHQTour06" [DIAL:000EA538]

text_content: Now for the highlight of our tour! Due to a generous donation from RobCo, this next exhibit showcases the wondrous world of - robots!
name: REPCONHQTour06 "REPCONHQTour06" [DIAL:000EA538]
speaker: REPCONTourGuide "Tour Guide" [CREA:000E85EF]

text_content: Around you are the incredible Eyebot, the fearsome Sentry Bot, and the {chuckles}always-helpful Mr. Handy. That helpfulness runs through our whole line!
name: REPCONHQTour06 "REPCONHQTour06" [DIAL:000EA538]

text_content: REPCONHQTour5
name: REPCONHQTour05 "REPCONHQTour5" [DIAL:000EA539]

text_content: Now these colorful fellows behind me are REPCONN's earliest... experiments in flight. Feel free to read the plaques and learn, Rocketeers!
name: REPCONHQTour05 "REPCONHQTour5" [DIAL:000EA539]
speaker: REPCONTourGuide "Tour Guide" [CREA:000E85EF]

text_content: RadioBMSegment05
name: RadioBMSegment05 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:000EA595]

text_content: {Rhonda} Welcome back, Utobitha. I have with me Best Friend Tabitha, who has something important she'd like to share.
name: RadioBMSegment05 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:000EA595]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} Well Rhonda, I'm a little concerned about the number of humans that keep coming to Black Mountain.
name: RadioBMSegment05 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:000EA595]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} Humans? Here? Why do you think they'd do that?
name: RadioBMSegment05 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:000EA595]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} Honestly, I think they're a little jealous of the ideal society we've built here, Rhonda. And I can't blame them.
name: RadioBMSegment05 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:000EA595]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} We have everything we need here. Food, shelter, safety, entertainment. It really is a paradise.
name: RadioBMSegment05 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:000EA595]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} There's no arguing with the truth, is there?
name: RadioBMSegment05 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:000EA595]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} But humans need to be aware that Black Mountain is no place for them. In fact, it's even dangerous for them here.
name: RadioBMSegment05 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:000EA595]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} {gasps}Why is that?
name: RadioBMSegment05 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:000EA595]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} First of all, there's the radiation. That warm, peaceful glow that we all know and love doesn't have the same effect on humans.
name: RadioBMSegment05 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:000EA595]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} You see, humans are weak, and have an inherent defect that causes them to fall apart when exposed to radiation.
name: RadioBMSegment05 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:000EA595]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} That sounds terrible! How do they stand it? Radiation's, like, everywhere!
name: RadioBMSegment05 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:000EA595]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} I know. They truly have a hard lot in life. Which may explain why they're so irritable all the time.
name: RadioBMSegment05 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:000EA595]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} I don't know about you, Utobitha, but my eyes have really been opened. We'll be back after some music!
name: RadioBMSegment05 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:000EA595]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: RadioBMSegment04
name: RadioBMSegment04 "RadioBMSegment04" [DIAL:000EA596]

text_content: [Rhonda] Welcome back, Utobitha. It's time!
name: RadioBMSegment04 "RadioBMSegment04" [DIAL:000EA596]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Tabitha] Time for what, Rhonda?
name: RadioBMSegment04 "RadioBMSegment04" [DIAL:000EA596]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Rhonda] <sing-song> True Eye Seeing Time!
name: RadioBMSegment04 "RadioBMSegment04" [DIAL:000EA596]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Applause track.]
name: RadioBMSegment04 "RadioBMSegment04" [DIAL:000EA596]

text_content: [Rhonda] I see that you're already wearing the True Eyes, Best Friend Tabitha, along with your head of True Hair. What do you see?
name: RadioBMSegment04 "RadioBMSegment04" [DIAL:000EA596]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Tabitha] Uh... I see Neil...
name: RadioBMSegment04 "RadioBMSegment04" [DIAL:000EA596]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Rhonda] First-generation Neil from down the mountain? And what is he up to?
name: RadioBMSegment04 "RadioBMSegment04" [DIAL:000EA596]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Tabitha] Standing outside his shack down there.
name: RadioBMSegment04 "RadioBMSegment04" [DIAL:000EA596]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Rhonda] In the same spot as before, or has he moved?
name: RadioBMSegment04 "RadioBMSegment04" [DIAL:000EA596]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Tabitha] A little.
name: RadioBMSegment04 "RadioBMSegment04" [DIAL:000EA596]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Rhonda] Wow! It must be so exciting to see and know all. What a powerful reminder of your ultimate authority and power for our listeners!
name: RadioBMSegment04 "RadioBMSegment04" [DIAL:000EA596]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Tabitha] I see Moe...
name: RadioBMSegment04 "RadioBMSegment04" [DIAL:000EA596]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Rhonda] Moe, the Centaur? Favorite Centaur Moe? What's he up to?
name: RadioBMSegment04 "RadioBMSegment04" [DIAL:000EA596]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Tabitha] Licking the gate. Wants out of the pen.
name: RadioBMSegment04 "RadioBMSegment04" [DIAL:000EA596]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Rhonda] Now, I'm almost afraid to ask, but do you see any - you know - threats out there?
name: RadioBMSegment04 "RadioBMSegment04" [DIAL:000EA596]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Tabitha] Threats all around us... converging... like a noose, tightening! Two-head-bear people astride battle cattles!
name: RadioBMSegment04 "RadioBMSegment04" [DIAL:000EA596]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Rhonda] <unnerved> Not the the dreaded battle cattle training to hunt mutants?
name: RadioBMSegment04 "RadioBMSegment04" [DIAL:000EA596]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Rhonda] <calmer> Would it be going too far to say that your gift of True Eyesight is the only thing saving our community from annihilation?
name: RadioBMSegment04 "RadioBMSegment04" [DIAL:000EA596]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Rhonda] Because I think it's so important for everyone - even the dumb-dumbs - how impossible it is to sneak up on us! More after this!
name: RadioBMSegment04 "RadioBMSegment04" [DIAL:000EA596]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: RadioBMSegment03
name: RadioBMSegment03 "RadioBMSegment03" [DIAL:000EA597]

text_content: [Tabitha] Are you tired of getting chased because you're bigger than humans, and scaring them?
name: RadioBMSegment03 "RadioBMSegment03" [DIAL:000EA597]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Tabitha] Did you kill some and they overreacted? Are two-head-bear people shooting at you, and battle cattle mooing? Beware the battle cattle...
name: RadioBMSegment03 "RadioBMSegment03" [DIAL:000EA597]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Rhonda]<whispering a line prompt> "Leave the fear behind."
name: RadioBMSegment03 "RadioBMSegment03" [DIAL:000EA597]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Tabitha] Leave the Fear Behind. Meet at the Mountain Top! Enjoy life in a state of Utobitha - Free, Safe, Secure!
name: RadioBMSegment03 "RadioBMSegment03" [DIAL:000EA597]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Rhonda] <rushing sotto voce like disclaimers at the end of prescription ads> Freedom limited to following the commands of Best Friend Tabitha...
name: RadioBMSegment03 "RadioBMSegment03" [DIAL:000EA597]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Rhonda] <Cont.> Safety not guaranteed against siege or assault by two-head-bear people or battle cattles.
name: RadioBMSegment03 "RadioBMSegment03" [DIAL:000EA597]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Rhonda] <Cont.> Many infractions are punishable by death, no allowances for dumb-dumb "misunderstandings".
name: RadioBMSegment03 "RadioBMSegment03" [DIAL:000EA597]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: [Tabitha] Utobitha! Come feel the difference!
name: RadioBMSegment03 "RadioBMSegment03" [DIAL:000EA597]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

name: RadioBMSegment02 "RadioBMSegment02" [DIAL:000EA598]

speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

name: VFreeformMcCarran2SilusTopic022 "Did you honestly believe you could escape death?" [DIAL:000F2DC8]

speaker: Silus "Silus" [NPC_:000EE688]

speaker: Silus "Silus" [NPC_:000EE688]

text_content: So in addition to treason, you're also a deserter.

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] No! That's not what I meant! I-|Lieutenant! This man is trying to kill me! He's not who you think he is!

speaker: Silus "Silus" [NPC_:000EE688]

speaker: Silus "Silus" [NPC_:000EE688]

text_content: You're a danger to him alive. Your knowledge threatens him.
name: VFreeformMcCarran2SilusTopic014 "You're a danger to him alive. Your knowledge threatens him." [DIAL:000F2DD0]

text_content: [?] I've told them nothing. They've gotten nowhere. I'm a centurion, for Christ's sake. I deserve his trust.
name: VFreeformMcCarran2SilusTopic014 "You're a danger to him alive. Your knowledge threatens him." [DIAL:000F2DD0]
speaker: Silus "Silus" [NPC_:000EE688]

text_content: [Speech] Yes. I want to *know* how such a big talker got caught so easily.

text_content: [Speech] Sounds to me like you were too gutless to follow Caesar's orders.

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] I'll show you gutless, you sniveling bastard. I'll spill your guts all over this room!

speaker: Silus "Silus" [NPC_:000EE688]

text_content: I understand.

text_content: So you're one of those, huh? Fine, I'll give you all the money I have once we're done. Meet me on the second level, and I'll explain more.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic004 "How much are you paying?" [DIAL:000F43E6]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: Of course. I'd be glad to help.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic003 "Of course. I'd be glad to help." [DIAL:000F43E7]

text_content: Good. Meet me on the second level, and I'll explain what needs to be done.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic003 "Of course. I'd be glad to help." [DIAL:000F43E7]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: I was sent to fetch some research data. No one said anything about a rescue.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic002 "I was sent to fetch some research data. No one said anything about a rescue." [DIAL:000F43E8]

text_content: Looks like you got sent on the same fool's errand I did, then.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic002 "I was sent to fetch some research data. No one said anything about a rescue." [DIAL:000F43E8]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: No, I was just exploring the vault when I stumbled on this place.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic001 "No, I was just exploring the vault when I stumbled on this place." [DIAL:000F43E9]

text_content: Well that's a hell of a bit of luck on my part, then.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic001 "No, I was just exploring the vault when I stumbled on this place." [DIAL:000F43E9]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: We can talk later. Right now we need to get out of here.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic000 "We can talk later. Right now we need to get out of here." [DIAL:000F43EA]

text_content: All right, all right. Just trying to make a little conversation. Shoulda known a youngin like you would be in a hurry.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic000 "We can talk later. Right now we need to get out of here." [DIAL:000F43EA]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: But that's neither here nor there. These plants have gotten completely out of control. I've got a plan to deal with them, but I'll need your help.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic000 "We can talk later. Right now we need to get out of here." [DIAL:000F43EA]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: <Give 100 caps> 200 seems a bit steep.  How about 100?
name: VFreeformMcCarranPrimmRubyNashTopic002 "<Give 100 caps> 200 seems a bit steep.  How about 100?" [DIAL:000F45DE]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] You drive a hard bargain, but 100 caps will do until we can get a regular deal worked out with McCarran.|You can let McCarran know they'll have fresh snacks coming in a few days.
name: VFreeformMcCarranPrimmRubyNashTopic002 "<Give 100 caps> 200 seems a bit steep.  How about 100?" [DIAL:000F45DE]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: PrimmRubyNash "Ruby Nash" [NPC_:000E2881]

text_content: <Give 200 caps> Alright.  200 caps it is.
name: VFreeformMcCarranPrimmRubyNashTopic001 "<Give 200 caps> Alright.  200 caps it is." [DIAL:000F45DF]

text_content: Great. I'll just pick up future payments from McCarran directly when I drop off my snacks.|You can let McCarran know they'll have fresh snacks coming in a few days.
name: VFreeformMcCarranPrimmRubyNashTopic001 "<Give 200 caps> Alright.  200 caps it is." [DIAL:000F45DF]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: PrimmRubyNash "Ruby Nash" [NPC_:000E2881]

text_content: I'll do it.
name: VFreeformMcCarranSupplyOfficerContrerasTopic008 "I'll do it." [DIAL:000F45E0]

text_content: Great. Let me know what he says. They're almost a straight shot north from here, up past the sharecroppers.
name: VFreeformMcCarranSupplyOfficerContrerasTopic008 "I'll do it." [DIAL:000F45E0]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: SupplyOfficerContreras "Sgt. Daniel Contreras" [NPC_:000E5518]

text_content: Maybe later.
name: VFreeformMcCarranSupplyOfficerContrerasTopic007 "Maybe later." [DIAL:000F45E1]

text_content: All right, well just find me when you want to get started.
name: VFreeformMcCarranSupplyOfficerContrerasTopic007 "Maybe later." [DIAL:000F45E1]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: SupplyOfficerContreras "Sgt. Daniel Contreras" [NPC_:000E5518]

text_content: You said you have some legwork needing done?
name: VFreeformMcCarranSupplyOfficerContrerasTopic006 "You said you have some legwork needing done?" [DIAL:000F45E2]

text_content: Well, I can't exactly go wandering off the base whenever I want, you know? They're already suspicious.|I can hear the MP's now. "Gee, Contreras, I didn't know you had so many friends in the Gun Runners." Speaking of which, guess your first stop.|You're just passing a little note to a man named Isaac for me. {Sarcastic}I want to know which girl he likes.
name: VFreeformMcCarranSupplyOfficerContrerasTopic006 "You said you have some legwork needing done?" [DIAL:000F45E2]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: SupplyOfficerContreras "Sgt. Daniel Contreras" [NPC_:000E5518]

text_content: McCarran's mess hall needs more variety.  Could we work out a deal?
name: VFreeformMcCarranPrimmRubyNashTopic000 "McCarran's mess hall needs more variety.  Could we work out a deal?" [DIAL:000F45E3]

text_content: Well, business is pretty light and I'd welcome the income, but I'll need a lot of caps to buy the necessary supplies.|200 caps would get me started.
name: VFreeformMcCarranPrimmRubyNashTopic000 "McCarran's mess hall needs more variety.  Could we work out a deal?" [DIAL:000F45E3]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: PrimmRubyNash "Ruby Nash" [NPC_:000E2881]

text_content: Can anything be done to improve your supplies?
name: VFreeformMcCarranCorporalFarberTopic002 "Can anything be done to improve your supplies?" [DIAL:000F45E5]

text_content: {Tired sigh, lamenting lack of supplies}Well, we haven't had any quality meat in months. Everyone in the camp just eating beans for protein... It isn't pretty.|{Annoyed by bad luck}Some of my kitchen machinery is broken down, too, so we've been eating mostly raw vegetables.|{Direct, a bit desperate}And I'm desperate for spices or seasonings. Anything. Just something to the general mood around here.
name: VFreeformMcCarranCorporalFarberTopic002 "Can anything be done to improve your supplies?" [DIAL:000F45E5]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: CorporalFarber "Cpl. William Farber" [NPC_:000E8F69]

text_content: I can bring his body back, but it'll cost you.
name: VFreeformMcCarranPrivateMoralesTopic000 "I can bring his body back, but it'll cost you." [DIAL:000F45E6]

text_content: Caps. This whole rotten town wants caps. Nobody does anything just because it's right.|Fine. You want caps? You can have all of Esteban's back pay. NCR owes me, and I don't even want the damn money.
name: VFreeformMcCarranPrivateMoralesTopic000 "I can bring his body back, but it'll cost you." [DIAL:000F45E6]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: PrivateMorales "Pvt. Christina Morales" [NPC_:000E8F6D]

text_content: I'd like to buy some food.
name: VFreeformMcCarranCorporalFarberTopic001 "I'd like to buy some food." [DIAL:000F45E7]

text_content: Chow down.
name: VFreeformMcCarranCorporalFarberTopic001 "I'd like to buy some food." [DIAL:000F45E7]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: CorporalFarber "Cpl. William Farber" [NPC_:000E8F69]

text_content: Sorry, but the brass ordered me to not serve enemies of NCR.
name: VFreeformMcCarranCorporalFarberTopic001 "I'd like to buy some food." [DIAL:000F45E7]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: CorporalFarber "Cpl. William Farber" [NPC_:000E8F69]

text_content: I don't like your kind taking food from my men, so I'm going to charge you a little extra. Don't like it? Tough.
name: VFreeformMcCarranCorporalFarberTopic001 "I'd like to buy some food." [DIAL:000F45E7]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: CorporalFarber "Cpl. William Farber" [NPC_:000E8F69]

text_content: Got anything to eat?
name: VFreeformMcCarranCorporalFarberTopic000 "Got anything to eat?" [DIAL:000F45E8]

text_content: {Sarcastic}Oh yeah. You can order up anything you want... as long as it's corn or beans!<Laughs>|{Done joking, serious}Just kidding. Haven't you heard? With few shipments from home and little variety, the troops are getting restless for some quality grub.|{Matter of fact}You can only do so much as a chef with just corn, beans, onions, and peppers.
name: VFreeformMcCarranCorporalFarberTopic000 "Got anything to eat?" [DIAL:000F45E8]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: CorporalFarber "Cpl. William Farber" [NPC_:000E8F69]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VFreeformMcCarranPrivateMoralesTopic001 "Goodbye." [DIAL:000F4610]

text_content: Then you're not from the colonel's office? Sorry... I shouldn't have bothered you.
name: VFreeformMcCarranPrivateMoralesTopic001 "Goodbye." [DIAL:000F4610]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: PrivateMorales "Pvt. Christina Morales" [NPC_:000E8F6D]

text_content: Changed his mind about what?
name: VFreeformMcCarranPrivateMoralesTopic000DUPLICATE000 "Changed his mind about what?" [DIAL:000F4611]

text_content: Sorry, I don't have time to help you out.
name: VMS07Vault3Prisoner01Topic005 "Sorry, I don't have time to help you out." [DIAL:000F4793]

text_content: We are going to die in here. Please, if you find the key let us out. We'll find our own way to safety.
name: VMS07Vault3Prisoner01Topic005 "Sorry, I don't have time to help you out." [DIAL:000F4793]
speaker: Vault3Prisoner01 "Rick Lancer" [NPC_:000F47AB]

text_content: Can you tell me about the Fiends?
name: VMS07Vault3Prisoner01Topic003 "Can you tell me about the Fiends?" [DIAL:000F4794]

text_content: They are a bunch of junkies that do whatever they can to get money for chems.|I hear they are lead by a guy calling himself Motor-Runner. I think he is in one of the other wings, although I haven't seen him myself.
name: VMS07Vault3Prisoner01Topic003 "Can you tell me about the Fiends?" [DIAL:000F4794]
speaker: Vault3Prisoner01 "Rick Lancer" [NPC_:000F47AB]

text_content: I need to know a little more about Vault 3.
name: VMS07Vault3Prisoner01Topic002 "I need to know a little more about Vault 3." [DIAL:000F4795]

text_content: I don't know much, only that the people who lived in here originally were killed by the Fiends. Carter there escaped and managed to explore for a bit.|He hacked a password off of the computer, and found the location of some guns. He was on his way to get them when the Fiends caught him again.
name: VMS07Vault3Prisoner01Topic002 "I need to know a little more about Vault 3." [DIAL:000F4795]
speaker: Vault3Prisoner01 "Rick Lancer" [NPC_:000F47AB]

text_content: Yeah, I'll see what I can do.
name: VMS07Vault3Prisoner01Topic001 "Yeah, I'll see what I can do." [DIAL:000F4796]

text_content: Thanks partner. I think the Fiend with the key is back in one of the bedrooms somewhere, someone called him Daniel. If that helps.
name: VMS07Vault3Prisoner01Topic001 "Yeah, I'll see what I can do." [DIAL:000F4796]
speaker: Vault3Prisoner01 "Rick Lancer" [NPC_:000F47AB]

text_content: What are you doing here?
name: VMS07Vault3Prisoner01Topic000 "What are you doing here?" [DIAL:000F4797]

text_content: We were part of a caravan heading into New Vegas from down south. They are holding us hostage, trying to get some ransom.|Anyone willing to pay for us died in the attack. Once the Fiends figure that out, we are as good as dead.
name: VMS07Vault3Prisoner01Topic000 "What are you doing here?" [DIAL:000F4797]
speaker: Vault3Prisoner01 "Rick Lancer" [NPC_:000F47AB]

text_content: Can you set us free now?
name: VMS07Vault3Prisoner01Topic000 "What are you doing here?" [DIAL:000F4797]
speaker: Vault3Prisoner01 "Rick Lancer" [NPC_:000F47AB]

text_content: SquatterResult
name: VDialogueVegasNorthNorthVegasCrandonTopic015 "SquatterResult" [DIAL:000F4834]

text_content: That's good to hear. Can't ever be too careful with strangers around here.
name: VDialogueVegasNorthNorthVegasCrandonTopic015 "SquatterResult" [DIAL:000F4834]
speaker: NorthVegasCrandon "Crandon" [NPC_:000EDDCF]

text_content: I'm starting to think you're as undesirable around here as those strangers. Do something to change my mind, merc.
name: VDialogueVegasNorthNorthVegasCrandonTopic015 "SquatterResult" [DIAL:000F4834]
speaker: NorthVegasCrandon "Crandon" [NPC_:000EDDCF]

text_content: That's good to hear. Can't ever keep too many eyes on strangers around here.|I take care of those who help with that. Here, you earned it.
name: VDialogueVegasNorthNorthVegasCrandonTopic015 "SquatterResult" [DIAL:000F4834]
speaker: NorthVegasCrandon "Crandon" [NPC_:000EDDCF]

text_content: FiendResult
name: VDialogueVegasNorthNorthVegasCrandonTopic014 "FiendResult" [DIAL:000F4835]

text_content: I thought you'd be made of stronger stuff, merc. Don't prove me wrong or I'll have to find someone else with the guts to do what's right.
name: VDialogueVegasNorthNorthVegasCrandonTopic014 "FiendResult" [DIAL:000F4835]
speaker: NorthVegasCrandon "Crandon" [NPC_:000EDDCF]

text_content: Great work. I gotta make sure this place doesn't eat itself from the inside.
name: VDialogueVegasNorthNorthVegasCrandonTopic014 "FiendResult" [DIAL:000F4835]
speaker: NorthVegasCrandon "Crandon" [NPC_:000EDDCF]

text_content: Great work. I gotta make sure this place doesn't eat itself from the inside.|I take care of those who help with that. Here, you earned it.
name: VDialogueVegasNorthNorthVegasCrandonTopic014 "FiendResult" [DIAL:000F4835]
speaker: NorthVegasCrandon "Crandon" [NPC_:000EDDCF]

text_content: I don't have that much.
name: VDialogueVegasNorth1ESquatterWatchQuest1Topic002 "I don't have that much." [DIAL:000F4836]

text_content: A hundred caps? Forget it.
name: VDialogueVegasNorth1ESquatterWatchQuest1Topic001 "A hundred caps? Forget it." [DIAL:000F4837]

text_content: Then we ain't going nowhere.
name: VDialogueVegasNorth1ESquatterWatchQuest1Topic001 "A hundred caps? Forget it." [DIAL:000F4837]
speaker: 1ESquatterWatchQuest1 "Squatter Bill" [NPC_:000F3B86]

text_content: Fine, take it.
name: VDialogueVegasNorth1ESquatterWatchQuest1Topic000 "Fine, take it." [DIAL:000F4838]

text_content: Pleasure doing business with you.
name: VDialogueVegasNorth1ESquatterWatchQuest1Topic000 "Fine, take it." [DIAL:000F4838]
speaker: 1ESquatterWatchQuest1 "Squatter Bill" [NPC_:000F3B86]

text_content: Give me the directions again.
name: VFreeformMcCarranPrivateMoralesTopic010 "Give me the directions again." [DIAL:000F484F]

text_content: Not my problem. Goodbye.
name: VFreeformMcCarranPrivateMoralesTopic009 "Not my problem. Goodbye." [DIAL:000F4850]

text_content: Not your problem. Right. That's the motto in this town. Rotten people, rotten place.
name: VFreeformMcCarranPrivateMoralesTopic009 "Not my problem. Goodbye." [DIAL:000F4850]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: PrivateMorales "Pvt. Christina Morales" [NPC_:000E8F6D]

text_content: McCarran has more vegetables and water than they know what to do with...
name: VFreeformMcCarranPrimmRubyNashTopic004 "McCarran has more vegetables and water than they know what to do with..." [DIAL:000F4BFA]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Fresh food and water is worth it's weight in gold... You've got yourself a deal.|Let McCarran know they'll have fresh snacks coming in a few days. I'll pick up the produce at that time as well.
name: VFreeformMcCarranPrimmRubyNashTopic004 "McCarran has more vegetables and water than they know what to do with..." [DIAL:000F4BFA]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: PrimmRubyNash "Ruby Nash" [NPC_:000E2881]

text_content: Maybe we could work something out later.
name: VFreeformMcCarranPrimmRubyNashTopic005 "Maybe we could work something out later." [DIAL:000F4BFB]

text_content: Suit yourself.  I'm always open to more business.
name: VFreeformMcCarranPrimmRubyNashTopic005 "Maybe we could work something out later." [DIAL:000F4BFB]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: PrimmRubyNash "Ruby Nash" [NPC_:000E2881]

text_content: The scientists here must have made some useful discoveries.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic029 "The scientists here must have made some useful discoveries." [DIAL:000F4C02]

text_content: Oh, they did. I've taken extensive notes of all their successful experiments. Their research won't go to waste. As for the file erasure...
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic029 "The scientists here must have made some useful discoveries." [DIAL:000F4C02]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: Never mind. Go ahead and delete the files.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic027 "Never mind. Go ahead and delete the files." [DIAL:000F4C03]

text_content: You're pretty highstrung for a youngster. In any case, just a few more moments and...
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic027 "Never mind. Go ahead and delete the files." [DIAL:000F4C03]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: <Lie> No, I've been too busy rescuing you. Could someone else have done it?
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic026 "<Lie> No, I've been too busy rescuing you. Could someone else have done it?" [DIAL:000F4C04]

text_content: It's possible. I have spent the last few days in a cave, after all.|For all we know, that man sent someone immediately after you to swipe the data while you posed as mantis bait.|Nothing to be done about it, I suppose. All we can do is delete what's here, and that's done.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic026 "<Lie> No, I've been too busy rescuing you. Could someone else have done it?" [DIAL:000F4C04]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: Good riddance. Those files have caused enough trouble.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic025 "Good riddance. Those files have caused enough trouble." [DIAL:000F4C05]

text_content: Indeed. This should only take a minute. Just a few more moments and...
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic025 "Good riddance. Those files have caused enough trouble." [DIAL:000F4C05]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: On second thought, go ahead and erase the data.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic024 "On second thought, go ahead and erase the data." [DIAL:000F4C06]

text_content: Glad you're thinking clearly. I was afraid to blink there for a second.|There, all done. That wasn't so bad, was it?
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic024 "On second thought, go ahead and erase the data." [DIAL:000F4C06]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: Positive.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic023 "Positive." [DIAL:000F4C07]

text_content: Then you give me no choice.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic023 "Positive." [DIAL:000F4C07]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: I'm afraid I can't let you do that.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic022 "I'm afraid I can't let you do that." [DIAL:000F4C08]

text_content: So you're going to be stubborn about it, eh? You're sure I can't change your mind about this?
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic022 "I'm afraid I can't let you do that." [DIAL:000F4C08]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: Actually, I copied the files. Hildern sent me here to get them.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic021 "Actually, I copied the files. Hildern sent me here to get them." [DIAL:000F4C09]

text_content: Yes, that sounds like something he'd do. Well, there's nothing for it, then.|Those files need to be erased. Hold out your arm and I'll have it done in a flash.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic021 "Actually, I copied the files. Hildern sent me here to get them." [DIAL:000F4C09]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: Will it take long?
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic020 "Will it take long?" [DIAL:000F4C0A]

text_content: No, it shouldn't take all that long. Just a few more moments and...
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic020 "Will it take long?" [DIAL:000F4C0A]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: ...it's done. We can rest easy.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic020 "Will it take long?" [DIAL:000F4C0A]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: ...that's strange. The system says that the files were accessed recently, and copied to an external source.|You wouldn't happen to know anything about that, would you?
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic020 "Will it take long?" [DIAL:000F4C0A]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: I've unlocked the door so you're free to run along now. Although it pains me to say it, I wouldn't have made it out of here without your help.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic020 "Will it take long?" [DIAL:000F4C0A]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: If you're heading back toward McCarran, tell Dr. Williams that she has my thanks as well.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic020 "Will it take long?" [DIAL:000F4C0A]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: If you're in the neighborhood of Camp McCarran anytime soon, look for a Dr. Williams. She was one of the few people there I could tolerate.|She seemed genuinely worried when I agreed to come out here, so if you could be a dear and let her know I'm okay, I'd be most grateful.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic020 "Will it take long?" [DIAL:000F4C0A]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: Exactly. Without that knowledge, something similar is bound to occur.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic019 "Exactly. Without that knowledge, something similar is bound to occur." [DIAL:000F4C0B]

text_content: All right. You convinced me. Take the files back to that buffoon. You make a good point, but I still honestly hope you know what you're doing.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic019 "Exactly. Without that knowledge, something similar is bound to occur." [DIAL:000F4C0B]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: Science isn't just about success. Failures are just as important to learn from.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic018 "Science isn't just about success. Failures are just as important to learn from." [DIAL:000F4C0C]

text_content: I suppose the data here could serve as a warning to other scientists. Tell them what paths of research not to follow.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic018 "Science isn't just about success. Failures are just as important to learn from." [DIAL:000F4C0C]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: { Science >= 70 }
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic017 "{ Science >= 70 }" [DIAL:000F4C0D]

text_content: How do you figure that?
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic017 "{ Science >= 70 }" [DIAL:000F4C0D]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: If we destroy the files, all of these people will have died in vain.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic016 "If we destroy the files, all of these people will have died in vain." [DIAL:000F4C0E]

text_content: No, these people died trying to stop a monster of their own creation. Failing to complete their work would mean they died in vain.|And that's what I intend to do. And...
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic016 "If we destroy the files, all of these people will have died in vain." [DIAL:000F4C0E]
