text_content: That's supposed to be Driver Nephi? The head's in really bad shape, so a full reward is out of the question.|Now that's over with, I'd send 1st Recon down to Camp Forlorn Hope, but I heard it's overrun by the Legion. Bastards.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic016 "I want to claim a bounty." [DIAL:000F7E73]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: Yeah... that's Cook-cook. Did he always smell like this? Even before he was dead? And the Fiends let this guy touch their food?|Well... this is payback for at least one of my troopers. She'll be glad to know he's dead. Here's your caps.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic016 "I want to claim a bounty." [DIAL:000F7E73]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: This is Cook-cook? You sure did a number on his face. I'm not allowed to give you the full reward, but thanks for taking this guy down.|It's payback for at least one of my troopers. She'll be glad to know he's dead. Here's your caps.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic016 "I want to claim a bounty." [DIAL:000F7E73]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: Think you can take down another one of these scumbags? Up to you. But I can trust you to do the job, and I'd hate to see you walk away.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic016 "I want to claim a bounty." [DIAL:000F7E73]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: That's two psychopaths dead. If you can bring down the third, there's a bonus in it for you.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic016 "I want to claim a bounty." [DIAL:000F7E73]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: You've been one hell of a stroke of good luck, you know that? Those three scumbags probably killed twenty NCR troopers. And you bring them down alone.|Wish I had a few grunts as good as you. Damn good working with you.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic016 "I want to claim a bounty." [DIAL:000F7E73]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: Who is Little Buster?
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic015 "Who is Little Buster?" [DIAL:000F7E74]

text_content: Bounty hunter. Talks big. But he's still alive, so he can't be completely full of shit.|I think he's out in the yard, waiting to claim a couple bounties.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic015 "Who is Little Buster?" [DIAL:000F7E74]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: Where is Lt. Gorobets?
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic014 "Where is Lt. Gorobets?" [DIAL:000F7E75]

text_content: Out in the yard. Gorobets coordinates our sniper teams. He's been gunning for Nephi for weeks now.|Only thing he hasn't had is willing bait. Don't have enough troops to order anyone beyond the fence. Not anymore, anyway.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic014 "Where is Lt. Gorobets?" [DIAL:000F7E75]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: Anything else I need to know?
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic012 "Anything else I need to know?" [DIAL:000F7E76]

text_content: One more thing. If you want the full reward, you need to bring me a recognizable head. My superiors need proof they're gone.|That means no headshots. No decapitations 'til after they're dead. And no damage to the face. If you want to be safe, aim for the chest.|You bring me a head that looks like a rotten tomato, people will be doubting, and I won't be authorized to pay the entire bounty.|Good luck to you. And don't get careless.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic012 "Anything else I need to know?" [DIAL:000F7E76]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: You've gone after the Fiends before - I don't have to tell you to keep alert. Good luck.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic012 "Anything else I need to know?" [DIAL:000F7E76]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: Just bring me back that last head. And don't lose your own.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic012 "Anything else I need to know?" [DIAL:000F7E76]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: I've changed my mind. I want to choose a different bounty.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic011 "I've changed my mind. I want to choose a different bounty." [DIAL:000F7E77]

text_content: Makes no difference to me. I'd be happy to see any one of them dead. Who will it be?
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic011 "I've changed my mind. I want to choose a different bounty." [DIAL:000F7E77]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: Where can I find her?
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic010 "Where can I find her?" [DIAL:000F7E78]

text_content: Good question. Fiend territory is southeast of here, but they range all over the area. None of them stays in any one place for long.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic010 "Where can I find her?" [DIAL:000F7E78]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: None of them.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic009 "None of them." [DIAL:000F7E79]

text_content: Can't say I blame you. If I wasn't in this fight for my country, you couldn't pay me enough to screw with those maniacs.|If you change your mind, I'll be happy to see you again. Otherwise... best to stay out of the way.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic009 "None of them." [DIAL:000F7E79]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: Cook-Cook.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic008 "Cook-Cook." [DIAL:000F7E7A]

text_content: One thing I should tell you about Cook-Cook. The piece of shit is pure animal. He raped one of my snipers, and that makes this personal. |Also... he's got a flamethrower, and he's damn good with it. From what I hear, he either rapes or burns every living thing he can get his hands on.|Only one man's gotten close to killing him, and that's Little Buster. So he says, anyway. Maybe it's bullshit, but I'd still ask him about it.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic008 "Cook-Cook." [DIAL:000F7E7A]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: Driver Nephi.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic007 "Driver Nephi." [DIAL:000F7E7B]

text_content: You've got some guts, I'll give you that. Nephi is one tough son of a bitch. You let him get close, and he'll take your head off.|My advice is this. Talk to Lieutenant Gorobets. He's in charge of Alpha Team, 1st Recon. Snipers.|If you're lucky, you can lure Nephi into the open, and the sharpshooters can bring him down. You bring me the head, you'll still get the bounty.|It's a better bet than trying to take Nephi one-on-one, but it's your call.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic007 "Driver Nephi." [DIAL:000F7E7B]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: Violet.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic006 "Violet." [DIAL:000F7E7C]

text_content: Violet it is. Wish I could give you more advice on how to bring her down, but we know less about her than the other two.|Just watch out for the dogs. She raises them herself. Might as well be their mother - they never leave her side.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic006 "Violet." [DIAL:000F7E7C]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: No. I don't think so.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic005 "No. I don't think so." [DIAL:000F7E7D]

text_content: Well, I'm sorry to hear that. Only one thing concerns me right now, and that's killing the bastards that are murdering my men. |You want to talk to somebody in charge, I'd start with Colonel Hsu and work my way down. You'll find him in the Main Concourse.|But if you want to take down some psycho-crazy bastards... I'm happy to talk caps.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic005 "No. I don't think so." [DIAL:000F7E7D]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: Might be. Give me their names.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic004 "Might be. Give me their names." [DIAL:000F7E7E]

text_content: First one calls herself Violet. God knows why - the name is the prettiest thing about her. Spends most of her time with a pack of vicious dogs.|Then there's Driver Nephi. He's fast and he's brutal. Killed about a dozen of my men with a goddamn driver iron. Hence his name.|And finally... Cook-cook. Rapist. Pyromaniac. And damn good chef, if you believe the Fiends we've captured. Probably the craziest of the lot.|I'm not going to feed you any bullshit. These aren't your common Vegas trash. They've all killed good NCR men, and plenty of mercs, too.|You go after them - any of them - you're in for a hell of a fight. So... which one is it going to be?
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic004 "Might be. Give me their names." [DIAL:000F7E7E]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: Yes, it does.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic003 "Yes, it does." [DIAL:000F7E7F]

text_content: Good. That's damn good. I figure it's about time we got lucky out here, so maybe you can snuff one of these maniacs.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic003 "Yes, it does." [DIAL:000F7E7F]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic002 "Goodbye." [DIAL:000F7E80]

text_content: Right.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic002 "Goodbye." [DIAL:000F7E80]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: You're having trouble with the Fiends?
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic001 "You're having trouble with the Fiends?" [DIAL:000F7E81]

text_content: Damn right I am. And I'm paying bounties.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic001 "You're having trouble with the Fiends?" [DIAL:000F7E81]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: What do you know about the Fiends?
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic000 "What do you know about the Fiends?" [DIAL:000F7E82]

text_content: Pack of drugged-out killers. They're addicted to every stim, every pill, every psychoactive enema on this fucked-up earth.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic000 "What do you know about the Fiends?" [DIAL:000F7E82]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: I've got three Fiends I want dead, and I don't give a goddamn how it gets done. That sound like something that interests you?
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic000 "What do you know about the Fiends?" [DIAL:000F7E82]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: McCarran could work out a regular exchange of fresh vegetables and clean water.
name: VDialogueVegasEast1EFitzTopic009 "McCarran could work out a regular exchange of fresh vegetables and clean water." [DIAL:000F807C]

text_content: Rations do get tight from time-to-time and it would be nice to keep a regular stock of goods.|If I get a big delivery brought in, I'll be sure to send a good chunk of it off to McCarran right away.|Tell Farber I'll try and have the first shipment sorted in a week or two.
name: VDialogueVegasEast1EFitzTopic009 "McCarran could work out a regular exchange of fresh vegetables and clean water." [DIAL:000F807C]
speaker: GnGFitz "Fitz" [NPC_:000F0B31]

text_content: They have an tons of vegetables and water.  How about expanding your business?
name: VDialogueVegasEast1EFitzTopic008 "They have an tons of vegetables and water.  How about expanding your business?" [DIAL:000F807D]

text_content: Expanding isn't a bad idea.  Maybe I could open up a small cafe restaurant with the more diverse inventory...|If I get a big delivery brought in, I'll be sure to send a good chunk of it off to McCarran right away.|Tell Farber I'll try and have the first shipment sorted in a week or two.
name: VDialogueVegasEast1EFitzTopic008 "They have an tons of vegetables and water.  How about expanding your business?" [DIAL:000F807D]
speaker: GnGFitz "Fitz" [NPC_:000F0B31]

text_content: Corporal Farber said they can pay you the going market price in caps.
name: VDialogueVegasEast1EFitzTopic007 "Corporal Farber said they can pay you the going market price in caps." [DIAL:000F807E]

text_content: Hey, that sounds good to me.  No more wasted meat just laying around to rot.  I can keep my stock fresh and keep the caps flowing.|If I get a big delivery brought in, I'll be sure to send a good chunk of it off to McCarran right away.|Tell Farber I'll try and have the first shipment sorted in a week or two.
name: VDialogueVegasEast1EFitzTopic007 "Corporal Farber said they can pay you the going market price in caps." [DIAL:000F807E]
speaker: GnGFitz "Fitz" [NPC_:000F0B31]

text_content: McCarran is looking for a regular delivery of meat from local merchants.
name: VDialogueVegasEast1EFitzTopic006 "McCarran is looking for a regular delivery of meat from local merchants." [DIAL:000F807F]

text_content: Really?  Well, I obviously couldn't supply enough to feed the entire camp, but I'm game.  What kind of caps are we talking here?
name: VDialogueVegasEast1EFitzTopic006 "McCarran is looking for a regular delivery of meat from local merchants." [DIAL:000F807F]
speaker: GnGFitz "Fitz" [NPC_:000F0B31]

text_content: No one else will help you?
name: VFreeformMcCarranPrivateMoralesTopic013 "No one else will help you?" [DIAL:000F8080]

text_content: His best friend, Jackson, tried. Didn't even get permission from his CO, so it could have cost him a lot. But he never came back.
name: VFreeformMcCarranPrivateMoralesTopic013 "No one else will help you?" [DIAL:000F8080]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: PrivateMorales "Pvt. Christina Morales" [NPC_:000E8F6D]

text_content: This spore pod extract from Keely should help with morale.
name: VFreeformMcCarranCorporalFarberTopic016 "This spore pod extract from Keely should help with morale." [DIAL:000F8081]

text_content: {Pleasantly surprised}No shit? The stuff actually does all that, huh?|I'll have to start testing this out immediately. This will really help keep the guys focused.
name: VFreeformMcCarranCorporalFarberTopic016 "This spore pod extract from Keely should help with morale." [DIAL:000F8081]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: CorporalFarber "Cpl. William Farber" [NPC_:000E8F69]

text_content: I fixed the food processor.
name: VFreeformMcCarranCorporalFarberTopic015 "I fixed the food processor." [DIAL:000F8082]

text_content: Amazing. I thought that thing was done for. That'll help me transform what I can offer the troops.|I'll give you a little extra discount the next time you buy food from me. Thanks again.
name: VFreeformMcCarranCorporalFarberTopic015 "I fixed the food processor." [DIAL:000F8082]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: CorporalFarber "Cpl. William Farber" [NPC_:000E8F69]

text_content: I found a merchant named Fitz who agreed to sell meat to McCarran.
name: VFreeformMcCarranCorporalFarberTopic013 "I found a merchant named Fitz who agreed to sell meat to McCarran." [DIAL:000F8083]

text_content: {Pleased}Good, that should help diversify things. It may be a bit gamey, but I can use it for stews and kabobs.
name: VFreeformMcCarranCorporalFarberTopic013 "I found a merchant named Fitz who agreed to sell meat to McCarran." [DIAL:000F8083]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: CorporalFarber "Cpl. William Farber" [NPC_:000E8F69]

text_content: {Very pleased}Great! What he sells might be a bit gamey, but I can use it for stews and kabobs.
name: VFreeformMcCarranCorporalFarberTopic013 "I found a merchant named Fitz who agreed to sell meat to McCarran." [DIAL:000F8083]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: CorporalFarber "Cpl. William Farber" [NPC_:000E8F69]

text_content: Blake at the Crimson Caravan agreed to sell meat and spices.
name: VFreeformMcCarranCorporalFarberTopic012 "Blake at the Crimson Caravan agreed to sell meat and spices." [DIAL:000F8084]

text_content: {Pleased}Good to hear. That should cover the majority of the supply.
name: VFreeformMcCarranCorporalFarberTopic012 "Blake at the Crimson Caravan agreed to sell meat and spices." [DIAL:000F8084]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: CorporalFarber "Cpl. William Farber" [NPC_:000E8F69]

text_content: {Very pleased}That should help balance out our stock of food more reasonably and save us a ton of caps. Good work!
name: VFreeformMcCarranCorporalFarberTopic012 "Blake at the Crimson Caravan agreed to sell meat and spices." [DIAL:000F8084]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: CorporalFarber "Cpl. William Farber" [NPC_:000E8F69]

text_content: {Very pleased}You managed to swing us a discount and cover the majority of the meat supply we need? Good work!
name: VFreeformMcCarranCorporalFarberTopic012 "Blake at the Crimson Caravan agreed to sell meat and spices." [DIAL:000F8084]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: CorporalFarber "Cpl. William Farber" [NPC_:000E8F69]

text_content: Mrs. Nash agreed to trade with McCarran.
name: VFreeformMcCarranCorporalFarberTopic011 "Mrs. Nash agreed to trade with McCarran." [DIAL:000F8085]

text_content: {Pleased}Great! Small price to pay in caps for a little variety in our weekly menu.
name: VFreeformMcCarranCorporalFarberTopic011 "Mrs. Nash agreed to trade with McCarran." [DIAL:000F8085]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: CorporalFarber "Cpl. William Farber" [NPC_:000E8F69]

text_content: {Very pleased}Excellent! That'll save us some caps and help offload a bit of our overstock.
name: VFreeformMcCarranCorporalFarberTopic011 "Mrs. Nash agreed to trade with McCarran." [DIAL:000F8085]
quest: VFreeformMcCarran "McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies" [QUST:000E7363]
speaker: CorporalFarber "Cpl. William Farber" [NPC_:000E8F69]

text_content: What can you tell me about Driver Nephi?
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ELieutenantGorobetsTopic000 "What can you tell me about Driver Nephi?" [DIAL:000F809F]

text_content: Not enough. We've been trying to put a bullet in him for a few weeks. He's strong as a brahmin bull, and he's fast.|Seems like he usually runs with a gang of Fiends. Uses them for cover. We haven't been able to get a clean shot at him.|Betsy swears she's hit him. Twice. But if she's right, it didn't seem to slow him down.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ELieutenantGorobetsTopic000 "What can you tell me about Driver Nephi?" [DIAL:000F809F]
speaker: 1ELieutenantGorobets "Lieutenant Gorobets" [NPC_:000F56FE]

text_content: Is there any work to do here?
name: VDialogueVegasNorthNorthVegasMrHostetlerTopic003 "Is there any work to do here?" [DIAL:000F80A5]

text_content: I've got proof of what I've said.
name: VDialogueVegasNorthNorthVegasMrHostetlerTopic002 "I've got proof of what I've said." [DIAL:000F80A6]

text_content: I don't want to talk about this, didn't you hear? Now, get lost before we run you off the hard way.
name: VDialogueVegasNorthNorthVegasMrHostetlerTopic002 "I've got proof of what I've said." [DIAL:000F80A6]
speaker: NorthVegasMrHostetler "Don Hostetler" [NPC_:000F271C]

text_content: Have time to tell me about any work you need done?
name: VDialogueVegasNorthNorthVegasMrHostetlerTopic001 "Have time to tell me about any work you need done?" [DIAL:000F80A7]

text_content: Alice's "friends" plan to use her to steal your Crimson Caravan earnings.
name: VDialogueVegasNorthNorthVegasMrHostetlerTopic000 "Alice's ""friends"" plan to use her to steal your Crimson Caravan earnings." [DIAL:000F80A8]

text_content: {Visibly bothered}Nonsense! Alice's a good girl. She may be going through a hard time, but...|{Realizes that he owes no explanation}What the hell? It's none of your business. Don't bother me with this any longer.
name: VDialogueVegasNorthNorthVegasMrHostetlerTopic000 "Alice's ""friends"" plan to use her to steal your Crimson Caravan earnings." [DIAL:000F80A8]
speaker: NorthVegasMrHostetler "Don Hostetler" [NPC_:000F271C]

text_content: {Realizes that he owes no explanation}What the hell? It's none of your business. Don't bother me with this any longer.
name: VDialogueVegasNorthNorthVegasMrHostetlerTopic000 "Alice's ""friends"" plan to use her to steal your Crimson Caravan earnings." [DIAL:000F80A8]
speaker: NorthVegasMrHostetler "Don Hostetler" [NPC_:000F271C]

text_content: I've got to talk to you about Alice.
name: MrHostetlerAffair "I've got to talk to you about Alice." [DIAL:000F80A9]

text_content: {Topic is a nuisance}I really don't have time for this right now.
name: MrHostetlerAffair "I've got to talk to you about Alice." [DIAL:000F80A9]
speaker: NorthVegasMrHostetler "Don Hostetler" [NPC_:000F271C]

text_content: Is there any work to be had here?
name: MrHostetlerCaravan "Is there any work to be had here?" [DIAL:000F80AA]

text_content: You know, hiring isn't really my department. You should talk to Ms. McLafferty about work for hire.
name: MrHostetlerCaravan "Is there any work to be had here?" [DIAL:000F80AA]
speaker: NorthVegasMrHostetler "Don Hostetler" [NPC_:000F271C]

text_content: Like I said, talk to Alice McLafferty, she's in charge here.
name: MrHostetlerCaravan "Is there any work to be had here?" [DIAL:000F80AA]
speaker: NorthVegasMrHostetler "Don Hostetler" [NPC_:000F271C]

text_content: Who are you?
name: MrHostetlerIntro "Who are you?" [DIAL:000F80AB]

text_content: The name's Hostetler - Don Hostetler. Can I help you with something?
name: MrHostetlerIntro "Who are you?" [DIAL:000F80AB]
speaker: NorthVegasMrHostetler "Don Hostetler" [NPC_:000F271C]

text_content: {Slight Irritation}I've already told you... I'm Don Hostetler.
name: MrHostetlerIntro "Who are you?" [DIAL:000F80AB]

text_content: Forget it. I don't like the odds.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ELieutenantGorobetsTopic010 "Forget it. I don't like the odds." [DIAL:000F80C0]

text_content: Your call. Even if you were one of my troopers, I wouldn't force you to take a risk like that. |But the offer stands. Give me the word, and I'll put my snipers in position. Otherwise, they'll stay inside the fence.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ELieutenantGorobetsTopic010 "Forget it. I don't like the odds." [DIAL:000F80C0]
speaker: 1ELieutenantGorobets "Lieutenant Gorobets" [NPC_:000F56FE]

text_content: I'll see what I can do. No promises, though.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ELieutenantGorobetsTopic009 "I'll see what I can do. No promises, though." [DIAL:000F80C1]

text_content: All right. I'll do it.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ELieutenantGorobetsTopic008 "All right. I'll do it." [DIAL:000F80C2]

text_content: Listen. My team has a debt to settle with Nephi. We've seen too many of our boys get brained by that golf club of his.|You lure him out for us, and if we can score some payback... we'll all pitch in caps for a reward.|My team will take up positions around the old rock crushing plant. They'll wait until they see Nephi, and then they'll start shooting.|At that point, just keep your head down, and stay out of range of his golf club. We'll take care of the rest.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ELieutenantGorobetsTopic008 "All right. I'll do it." [DIAL:000F80C2]
speaker: 1ELieutenantGorobets "Lieutenant Gorobets" [NPC_:000F56FE]

text_content: I'd rather just bring your people with me.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ELieutenantGorobetsTopic007 "I'd rather just bring your people with me." [DIAL:000F80C3]

'Course, that's just guesswork, but I'd still bet a few caps that he's stirring up the locals against us.

Old habit, but it's saved my hide, on occasion.|Round about one in the morning, I spied some lights in the control tower. Now that's the third time I've spied those lights, mind you.|And every time I ask about it, they tell me the place was empty. I'm just saying... it didn't look empty to me.

Would have felt guilty to part with the old girl.|The other snipers use bolt-action, but Gorobets reckoned it didn't matter none if I was different, so long as I can hit my targets.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ECorporalSterlingTopic006 "Interesting rifle you have there. Lever-action, right?" [DIAL:000FB899]

They jumped on in and pulled me out of there. Lucky break, they said.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ECorporalSterlingTopic005 "How did you manage to escape Malpais?" [DIAL:000FB89A]

name: VFreeformMcCarran31ECorporalSterlingTopic003 "Have you always been with the First Recon?" [DIAL:000FB89C]

One you'll use for the rest of your life.|When NCR slaughtered the Khans at Bitter Springs, I hadn't got my beat-down yet. I was still too young.|Way I see it, Bitter Springs was my beat-down. Bunch of animals.|And my mom... couple times she tried to sell me to some waster, just to score some Jet. Even the other Khans said she was useless.|Only reason they kept her around was because she was a... how'd my dad say it... "a smokin' piece of ass."
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ESergeantBitterRootTopic011 "You don't really mean that, do you?" [DIAL:000FC98E]
speaker: 1ESergeantBitterRoot "Sergeant Bitter-Root" [NPC_:000F56FA]

text_content: You're sorry? Well, that makes one of us. Bitter Springs was the best thing that ever happened to me.|Best thing that ever happened to my parents, too. They were as bad as the rest. Worse, maybe.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ESergeantBitterRootTopic010 "Losing your parents must have been hard for you. I'm sorry." [DIAL:000FC98F]

name: VFreeformMcCarran31ESergeantBitterRootTopic007 "What do you know about the Great Khans?" [DIAL:000FC992]

name: VFreeformMcCarran31ESergeantBitterRootTopic006 "What happened to your parents?" [DIAL:000FC993]

text_content: They're dead. Got themselves killed at Bitter Springs. Served them right, if you ask me.

speaker: 1ESergeantBitterRoot "Sergeant Bitter-Root" [NPC_:000F56FA]

text_content: I didn't mean to offend. You don't have to tell me, if you'd rather not.

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] It's a Khan name. You know... the "Great Khans." That's what my parents were.|I figured I grew up around the bastards... they owed me a name, after all they put me through.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ESergeantBitterRootTopic005 "I didn't mean to offend. You don't have to tell me, if you'd rather not." [DIAL:000FC994]

Watching people from where they can't see me, you know?|Only one thing I learned about that asshole. He keeps a bunch of Brahmins. text_content: Why did you quit the trade?

I mean, I could've taken him.|But with this guy, it might have cost me some bad burns or an ass-rape. I'm all for risking my life, but I'm a little sensitive about my asshole.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ELittleBusterTopic002 "Why did you quit the trade?" [DIAL:000FD29D]
speaker: 1ELittleBuster "Little Buster" [NPC_:000F56FC]

text_content: I've been known to hunt a few bounties, myself.

text_content: Well hey, the field's wide open, now that I'm gone. Probably lots of people looking to get in, once they hear I quit.

speaker: 1ELittleBuster "Little Buster" [NPC_:000F56FC]

name: VFreeformNellisBoomerFrontGateGuard1Topic006 "Do you really think I'm scared of a punk like you?" [DIAL:001048AA]

text_content: Watch your mouth, savage! Raquel'll be here any second...
name: VFreeformNellisBoomerFrontGateGuard1Topic006 "Do you really think I'm scared of a punk like you?" [DIAL:001048AA]
speaker: BoomerFrontGateGuard1 "Boomer Guard" [NPC_:000FF57D]

text_content: Can we move this along?
name: VFreeformNellisBoomerFrontGateGuard1Topic005 "Can we move this along?" [DIAL:001048AB]

text_content: I said stay where you are! Raquel'll be here any second...
name: VFreeformNellisBoomerFrontGateGuard1Topic005 "Can we move this along?" [DIAL:001048AB]
speaker: BoomerFrontGateGuard1 "Boomer Guard" [NPC_:000FF57D]

text_content: I didn't come here to attack you.
name: VFreeformNellisBoomerFrontGateGuard1Topic004 "I didn't come here to attack you." [DIAL:001048AC]

text_content: Then just - just stay where you are! Raquel'll be here any second...
name: VFreeformNellisBoomerFrontGateGuard1Topic004 "I didn't come here to attack you." [DIAL:001048AC]
speaker: BoomerFrontGateGuard1 "Boomer Guard" [NPC_:000FF57D]

text_content: VCG01DocReactions
name: VCG01DocReactions "VCG01DocReactions" [DIAL:00104BDC]

text_content: Sorry, son. I fixed up your head as best I knew how. I guess I missed a spot.
name: VCG01DocReactions "VCG01DocReactions" [DIAL:00104BDC]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: Sorry, little lady. I fixed up your head as best I knew how. Guess I missed a spot.
name: VCG01DocReactions "VCG01DocReactions" [DIAL:00104BDC]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: Look at that. Maybe them bullets done your brain some good.
name: VCG01DocReactions "VCG01DocReactions" [DIAL:00104BDC]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: Now that don't make a lick of sense. Seems to me you're the luckiest son-of-a-gun in New Vegas.
name: VCG01DocReactions "VCG01DocReactions" [DIAL:00104BDC]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: With luck like yours I'm surprised them bullets didn't just turn right around and climb back into the gun.
name: VCG01DocReactions "VCG01DocReactions" [DIAL:00104BDC]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: That's some serious atrophy, even for someone who's been in bed awhile. It's a wonder you can move at all.
name: VCG01DocReactions "VCG01DocReactions" [DIAL:00104BDC]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: Surprised anybody'd want to tangle with you. Heck, you could go Deathclaw hunting with a switch.
name: VCG01DocReactions "VCG01DocReactions" [DIAL:00104BDC]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: I just don't get it. A stiff breeze'd tear you in two but a couple of bullets and you're right as rain.
name: VCG01DocReactions "VCG01DocReactions" [DIAL:00104BDC]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: I guess that explains how you're still alive. You're built solid as an oak.
name: VCG01DocReactions "VCG01DocReactions" [DIAL:00104BDC]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: Huh. Must be some frontal lobe damage.
name: VCG01DocReactions "VCG01DocReactions" [DIAL:00104BDC]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: Good to see them bullets didn't affect your charm none.
name: VCG01DocReactions "VCG01DocReactions" [DIAL:00104BDC]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: Now I ain't no optometrist, but maybe we should fit you for some glasses while you're here.
name: VCG01DocReactions "VCG01DocReactions" [DIAL:00104BDC]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: Nothing gets by you, huh? Coulda used you when I lost my keys last month.
name: VCG01DocReactions "VCG01DocReactions" [DIAL:00104BDC]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: Don't have all your coordination back yet, looks like. You should think about doing some rehab.
name: VCG01DocReactions "VCG01DocReactions" [DIAL:00104BDC]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: Most patients don't get out of bed after being shot and then move like they was in perfect control. You're unusual, I'll say that.
name: VCG01DocReactions "VCG01DocReactions" [DIAL:00104BDC]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: Yep, that's a pretty standard score there. But after what you been through, I'd say that's great news.
name: VCG01DocReactions "VCG01DocReactions" [DIAL:00104BDC]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: VCG01Intro
name: VCG01Intro "VCG01Intro" [DIAL:00104BDD]

text_content: You're awake. How about that.
name: VCG01Intro "VCG01Intro" [DIAL:00104BDD]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: Whoa, easy there. Easy. You been out cold a couple of days now.
name: VCG01Intro "VCG01Intro" [DIAL:00104BDD]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: Why don't you just relax a second? Get your bearings.
name: VCG01Intro "VCG01Intro" [DIAL:00104BDD]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: Let's see what the damage is. How about your name? Can you tell me your name?
name: VCG01Intro "VCG01Intro" [DIAL:00104BDD]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: Huh. Can't say it's what I'd have picked for you. But if that's your name, that's your name.
name: VCG01Intro "VCG01Intro" [DIAL:00104BDD]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: I'm Doc Mitchell. Welcome to Goodsprings.
name: VCG01Intro "VCG01Intro" [DIAL:00104BDD]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: Now, I hope you don't mind, but I had to go rooting around there in your noggin to pull all the bits of lead out.
name: VCG01Intro "VCG01Intro" [DIAL:00104BDD]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: I take pride in my needlework, but you'd better tell me if I left anything out of place.
name: VCG01Intro "VCG01Intro" [DIAL:00104BDD]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: How'd I do?
name: VCG01Intro "VCG01Intro" [DIAL:00104BDD]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: Well, I got most of it right, anyway. Stuff that mattered.
name: VCG01Intro "VCG01Intro" [DIAL:00104BDD]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: Okay. No sense keeping you in bed anymore. Let's see if we can get you on your feet.
name: VCG01Intro "VCG01Intro" [DIAL:00104BDD]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: Good. Why don't you walk down to the end of the room? Over by that vigor tester machine there.
name: VCG01Intro "VCG01Intro" [DIAL:00104BDD]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: Take it slow now. It ain't a race.
name: VCG01Intro "VCG01Intro" [DIAL:00104BDD]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: Looking good so far. Go ahead and give the vigor tester a try. We'll learn right quick if you got back all your faculties.
name: VCG01Intro "VCG01Intro" [DIAL:00104BDD]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: Let's go into the next room. I've got a few more tests I'd like to run.
name: VCG01Intro "VCG01Intro" [DIAL:00104BDD]
quest: VCG01 "Ain't That a Kick in the Head" [QUST:00104C1C]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsEasyPeteTopic004 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00104C24]

text_content: Keep your gun handy if you go poking around some of the abandoned places around here, like the schoolhouse.|Wasteland critters like to move in when Sunny's not looking, so watch out.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsEasyPeteTopic004 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00104C24]
speaker: GSEasyPete "Easy Pete" [NPC_:00104C7F]

text_content: Yup.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsEasyPeteTopic004 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00104C24]
speaker: GSEasyPete "Easy Pete" [NPC_:00104C7F]

text_content: How hard can it be? Just light them and throw.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsEasyPeteTopic002 "How hard can it be? Just light them and throw." [DIAL:00104C25]

text_content: [FAILED] Too dangerous, sorry. Blow yourself up, blow your neighbor up, blow the whole town up.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsEasyPeteTopic002 "How hard can it be? Just light them and throw." [DIAL:00104C25]
speaker: GSEasyPete "Easy Pete" [NPC_:00104C7F]

text_content: I'm familiar with the care and handling of explosives, dynamite included.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsEasyPeteTopic001 "I'm familiar with the care and handling of explosives, dynamite included." [DIAL:00104C26]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Uh huh. Guess you know what you're doing. I'll go dig it up and get it ready. You'll have it by the time the fighting starts.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsEasyPeteTopic001 "I'm familiar with the care and handling of explosives, dynamite included." [DIAL:00104C26]
speaker: GSEasyPete "Easy Pete" [NPC_:00104C7F]

text_content: I hear you've got dynamite. It would help us beat the powder gangers.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsEasyPeteTopic000 "I hear you've got dynamite. It would help us beat the powder gangers." [DIAL:00104C27]

text_content: Too dangerous. Gonna kill all yourselves if I let you touch it. Better to leave it buried - safer that way.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsEasyPeteTopic000 "I hear you've got dynamite. It would help us beat the powder gangers." [DIAL:00104C27]
speaker: GSEasyPete "Easy Pete" [NPC_:00104C7F]

text_content: Told you before - it's too dangerous for a bunch of amateurs to handle.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsEasyPeteTopic000 "I hear you've got dynamite. It would help us beat the powder gangers." [DIAL:00104C27]
speaker: GSEasyPete "Easy Pete" [NPC_:00104C7F]

text_content: Never mind.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsChetTopic005 "Never mind." [DIAL:00104C28]

text_content: Right. Just keep me out of it. Is there anything else?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsChetTopic005 "Never mind." [DIAL:00104C28]
speaker: GSChet "Chet" [NPC_:00104C78]

text_content: The town's at stake. That has to be worth more than a few supplies.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsChetTopic004 "The town's at stake. That has to be worth more than a few supplies." [DIAL:00104C29]

text_content: [FAILED] Look, you're bringing this on yourselves. There's no way I'm getting involved. But, hey, I'm sure you can buy what you need...
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsChetTopic004 "The town's at stake. That has to be worth more than a few supplies." [DIAL:00104C29]
speaker: GSChet "Chet" [NPC_:00104C78]

text_content: Let them take over the town, then. I'm sure your business will be much better off.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsChetTopic003 "Let them take over the town, then. I'm sure your business will be much better off." [DIAL:00104C2A]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] You made your point. I can provide people with some leather armor and extra ammo. I sure hope it's worth it.|And, uh, I'll be guarding the store while all this is going on. I have to put my business first, you understand.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsChetTopic003 "Let them take over the town, then. I'm sure your business will be much better off." [DIAL:00104C2A]
speaker: GSChet "Chet" [NPC_:00104C78]

text_content: I need supplies to fight the Powder Gangers.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsChetTopic002 "I need supplies to fight the Powder Gangers." [DIAL:00104C2B]

text_content: Now just hold on. I never voted to take on the Powder Gangers. That's a thousand cap investment you're talking about.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsChetTopic002 "I need supplies to fight the Powder Gangers." [DIAL:00104C2B]
speaker: GSChet "Chet" [NPC_:00104C78]

text_content: This again? Like I said, I'm against taking on the Powder Gangers. My supplies aren't cheap, you know.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsChetTopic002 "I need supplies to fight the Powder Gangers." [DIAL:00104C2B]
speaker: GSChet "Chet" [NPC_:00104C78]

text_content: What do you do around here?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRingoTopic001 "What do you do around here?" [DIAL:00104C2C]

text_content: Oh, sorry. I thought everybody knew already. I'm a trader with the Crimson Caravan Company.|I'm, uh, staying in town for a bit.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRingoTopic001 "What do you do around here?" [DIAL:00104C2C]
speaker: GSRingo "Ringo" [NPC_:00104C7C]

text_content: Like I said, I'm not from Goodsprings. I'm a trader with the Crimson Caravan Company.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRingoTopic001 "What do you do around here?" [DIAL:00104C2C]
speaker: GSRingo "Ringo" [NPC_:00104C7C]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRingoTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00104C2D]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsChetTopic001 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00104C2E]

text_content: Take it easy now.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsChetTopic001 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00104C2E]
speaker: GSChet "Chet" [NPC_:00104C78]

text_content: Show me what you have for sale.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsChetTopic000 "Show me what you have for sale." [DIAL:00104C2F]

text_content: I respect the way you've conducted yourself around here. Reminds me of myself in some ways.|From now on, you want to buy from Chet's, I'll give you wholesale prices.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsChetTopic000 "Show me what you have for sale." [DIAL:00104C2F]
speaker: GSChet "Chet" [NPC_:00104C78]

text_content: Can do.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsChetTopic000 "Show me what you have for sale." [DIAL:00104C2F]
speaker: GSChet "Chet" [NPC_:00104C78]

text_content: Show me what you have for sale.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRubyTopic007 "Show me what you have for sale." [DIAL:00104C30]

text_content: {Positive Rep Bonus}Got a special discount for you, after what you done for us.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRubyTopic007 "Show me what you have for sale." [DIAL:00104C30]
speaker: GSTrudy "Trudy" [NPC_:00104C6C]

text_content: I'm sure I've got something you'll like.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRubyTopic007 "Show me what you have for sale." [DIAL:00104C30]
speaker: GSTrudy "Trudy" [NPC_:00104C6C]

text_content: What are you going to do?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRubyTopic006 "What are you going to do?" [DIAL:00104C31]

text_content: Some of the others, like Sunny, will probably stand up for Ringo if he asks for help, which he hasn't.|Personally, I hope he sneaks out of town one night and takes the Powder Gangers with him.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRubyTopic006 "What are you going to do?" [DIAL:00104C31]
speaker: GSTrudy "Trudy" [NPC_:00104C6C]

text_content: Why not just kill Cobb and be done with it?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRubyTopic005 "Why not just kill Cobb and be done with it?" [DIAL:00104C32]

text_content: You mean murder him? That's not our way, even if Cobb is scum. He can bluster and threaten all he wants.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRubyTopic005 "Why not just kill Cobb and be done with it?" [DIAL:00104C32]
speaker: GSTrudy "Trudy" [NPC_:00104C6C]

text_content: Where is Ringo now?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRubyTopic002 "Where is Ringo now?" [DIAL:00104C35]

text_content: He's holed up at the abandoned gas station up the hill.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRubyTopic002 "Where is Ringo now?" [DIAL:00104C35]
speaker: GSTrudy "Trudy" [NPC_:00104C6C]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRubyTopic001 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00104C36]

text_content: Be careful out there.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRubyTopic001 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00104C36]
speaker: GSTrudy "Trudy" [NPC_:00104C6C]

text_content: I overheard your argument. What was that all about?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRubyTopic000 "I overheard your argument. What was that all about?" [DIAL:00104C37]

text_content: It looks like our little town got itself dragged into the middle of something we don't want anything to do with.|About a week ago, this trader, Ringo, comes into town. Survivor of an attack, he says. Bad men after him, needs a place to hide.|We figured he was just in shock, so we gave him a place to lie low. We didn't actually expect anyone to come after him.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRubyTopic000 "I overheard your argument. What was that all about?" [DIAL:00104C37]
speaker: GSTrudy "Trudy" [NPC_:00104C6C]

text_content: What was that you said about Ringo?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsJoeCobbTopic001 "What was that you said about Ringo?" [DIAL:00104C3E]

text_content: He's some trader who decided he'd rather shoot than pay the toll for being in our territory. He's hiding somewhere in town.|Would serve these idiots right if me and my guys shot the place up after we got payback on Ringo.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsJoeCobbTopic001 "What was that you said about Ringo?" [DIAL:00104C3E]
speaker: GSJoeCobb "Joe Cobb" [NPC_:00104C67]

text_content: Why are the Powder Gangers out to get you?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRingoTopic003 "Why are the Powder Gangers out to get you?" [DIAL:00104DE0]

text_content: My caravan was on the return trip from California and heading back up to the company branch in New Vegas when we got jumped.|Not even a "drop your weapons and hands up" before the bullets started flying. We put up a good fight, but there was too many of them.|I took a few of the bandits down before I ran, so I figure their friends are out for revenge.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRingoTopic003 "Why are the Powder Gangers out to get you?" [DIAL:00104DE0]
speaker: GSRingo "Ringo" [NPC_:00104C7C]

text_content: Never mind.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsEasyPeteTopic006 "Never mind." [DIAL:00104DE1]

text_content: Uh huh.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsEasyPeteTopic006 "Never mind." [DIAL:00104DE1]
speaker: GSEasyPete "Easy Pete" [NPC_:00104C7F]

text_content: That's... helpful.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsEasyPeteTopic005 "That's... helpful." [DIAL:00104DE2]

text_content: Welcome.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsEasyPeteTopic005 "That's... helpful." [DIAL:00104DE2]
speaker: GSEasyPete "Easy Pete" [NPC_:00104C7F]

text_content: What do you know about Joe Cobb?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsEasyPeteTopic003 "What do you know about Joe Cobb?" [DIAL:00104DE3]

text_content: Bad trouble.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsEasyPeteTopic003 "What do you know about Joe Cobb?" [DIAL:00104DE3]
speaker: GSEasyPete "Easy Pete" [NPC_:00104C7F]

text_content: What do you know about the situation with the Powder Gangers?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsChetTopic006 "What do you know about the situation with the Powder Gangers?" [DIAL:00104DE4]

text_content: If Ringo doesn't head out on his own, I think we should hand him over. The town shouldn't get itself mixed into the problem.|Don't mistake that for coward talk, though. We're a town of survivors, and we'll fight tooth and nail if pushed, but we don't go looking for trouble.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsChetTopic006 "What do you know about the situation with the Powder Gangers?" [DIAL:00104DE4]
speaker: GSChet "Chet" [NPC_:00104C78]

text_content: Did you know there's a man named Joe Cobb looking for you?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRingoTopic002 "Did you know there's a man named Joe Cobb looking for you?" [DIAL:00104DE6]

text_content: Yeah. He doesn't look very tough, though. I hear he's afraid I'll shoot him down from one of the windows when I see him, and he's right.|I'll have a much bigger problem once his friends show up. There's no way I could handle all of them in a gunfight.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRingoTopic002 "Did you know there's a man named Joe Cobb looking for you?" [DIAL:00104DE6]
speaker: GSRingo "Ringo" [NPC_:00104C7C]

text_content: GSJoeCobbIntro
name: GSJoeCobbIntro "GSJoeCobbIntro" [DIAL:00104DE7]

text_content: I'm done being nice. If you don't hand Ringo over soon, I'm going to get my friends and we're burning this town to the ground, got it?
name: GSJoeCobbIntro "GSJoeCobbIntro" [DIAL:00104DE7]

text_content: I haven't talked to her yet.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRingoTopic011 "I haven't talked to her yet." [DIAL:00104E57]

text_content: Oh. Well, I don't want to make a move until she's with us.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRingoTopic011 "I haven't talked to her yet." [DIAL:00104E57]
speaker: GSRingo "Ringo" [NPC_:00104C7C]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRingoTopic010 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00104E58]

text_content: Try to hurry.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRingoTopic010 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00104E58]
speaker: GSRingo "Ringo" [NPC_:00104C7C]

text_content: Sunny's with us.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRingoTopic009 "Sunny's with us." [DIAL:00104E59]

text_content: Well, I guess that means we're ready to go. Unless you think there's something else you can do?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsRingoTopic009 "Sunny's with us." [DIAL:00104E59]
speaker: GSRingo "Ringo" [NPC_:00104C7C]

text_content: How can I get Easy Pete's dynamite?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsSunnySmilesTopic007 "How can I get Easy Pete's dynamite?" [DIAL:00104E5A]

text_content: Easy Pete's pretty protective of his dynamite. You'd have to convince him you know a thing or two about explosives before he handed it over.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsSunnySmilesTopic007 "How can I get Easy Pete's dynamite?" [DIAL:00104E5A]
speaker: GSSunnySmiles "Sunny Smiles" [NPC_:00104E84]

text_content: Any ideas on how to convince Trudy to join us?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsSunnySmilesTopic005 "Any ideas on how to convince Trudy to join us?" [DIAL:00104E5C]

text_content: A silver tongue would help. Convincing Trudy that we had a good plan to win the fight would also help.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsSunnySmilesTopic005 "Any ideas on how to convince Trudy to join us?" [DIAL:00104E5C]
speaker: GSSunnySmiles "Sunny Smiles" [NPC_:00104E84]

text_content: We might die horribly. Well, maybe not me.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsSunnySmilesTopic004 "We might die horribly. Well, maybe not me." [DIAL:00104E5D]

text_content: That's inspiring. You might want to keep your optimism to yourself if you try to recruit anyone else.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGoodspringsSunnySmilesTopic004 "We might die horribly. Well, maybe not me." [DIAL:00104E5D]
speaker: GSSunnySmiles "Sunny Smiles" [NPC_:00104E84]

text_content: Just like that?

text_content: MalcolmHolmesIntentions
name: MalcolmHolmesIntentions "MalcolmHolmesIntentions" [DIAL:00105912]

text_content: SSHQFestusAddendum4
name: SSHQFestusAddendum4 "SSHQFestusAddendum4" [DIAL:00105913]

text_content: An attendant will be there to distribute your prize. We here at Sunset Sarsaparilla would like to thank you once again for your patronage.
name: SSHQFestusAddendum4 "SSHQFestusAddendum4" [DIAL:00105913]

text_content: SSHQFestusAddendum3
name: SSHQFestusAddendum3 "SSHQFestusAddendum3" [DIAL:00105914]

text_content: Head through the double doors and take a left at the intersection. Follow the hallway all the way to its end, and you'll come to our prize vault.
name: SSHQFestusAddendum3 "SSHQFestusAddendum3" [DIAL:00105914]

text_content: SSHQFestusAddendum2
name: SSHQFestusAddendum2 "SSHQFestusAddendum2" [DIAL:00105915]

text_content: Our motto at Sunset Sarsaparilla is that the customer always comes first, so we have seen fit to provide an alternate reward for your Stars.
name: SSHQFestusAddendum2 "SSHQFestusAddendum2" [DIAL:00105915]

text_content: SSHQFestusAddendum1
name: SSHQFestusAddendum1 "SSHQFestusAddendum1" [DIAL:00105916]

text_content: It has come to our attention that some of our loyal customers are less than pleased with the reward for their Sunset Sarsaparilla Stars.
name: SSHQFestusAddendum1 "SSHQFestusAddendum1" [DIAL:00105916]

text_content: SSHQFestusMenu
name: SSHQFestusMenu "SSHQFestusMenu" [DIAL:00105917]

text_content: New in town, pardner? Well, let ol' Festus give you the lay of the land.|If you're here to redeem your Sunset Sarsaparilla Stars, dump 'em into the slot in the barrel below and I'll count 'em up.|If you don't know what Sunset Sarsaparilla Stars are and think ol' Festus is just shooting his mouth off, say "Star Info".|If you're here to challenge ol' Festus to a game of Lucky Horseshoes, say "I feel lucky".|Lastly, if you're here about the health advisory that aired on channel 6 recently, say "Silly Ol' Advisory."
name: SSHQFestusMenu "SSHQFestusMenu" [DIAL:00105917]
speaker: NVCRFestus "Festus" [CREA:001043D1]

text_content: SSHQFestusStarInfo
name: SSHQFestusStarInfo "SSHQFestusStarInfo" [DIAL:00105918]

text_content: Ah, new to the hunt, are you? Well listen carefully, as ol' Festus don't like to repeat himself.|Select Sunset Sarsaparilla bottles will have special caps with blue stars on them. These caps are known as Sunset Sarsaparilla Stars.|Why are these stars there, and what do they mean? Nobody knows! Except maybe ol' Festus, hee hee. |Rustle up enough of them and you can win a prize! So get out there, and start drinking Sunset Sarsaparilla!
name: SSHQFestusStarInfo "SSHQFestusStarInfo" [DIAL:00105918]
speaker: NVCRFestus "Festus" [CREA:001043D1]

text_content: SSHQFestusLOS18
name: SSHQFestusLOS18 "SSHQFestusLOS18" [DIAL:00105919]

text_content: The man felt the same, and had his own idea about what had happened. He went on to become rich selling the sarsaparilla drink, and started a company.
name: SSHQFestusLOS18 "SSHQFestusLOS18" [DIAL:00105919]

text_content: SSHQFestusLOS17
name: SSHQFestusLOS17 "SSHQFestusLOS17" [DIAL:0010591A]

text_content: Now, I don't know about you, but old Festus here never met a bandit that felt anything akin to remorse.
name: SSHQFestusLOS17 "SSHQFestusLOS17" [DIAL:0010591A]

text_content: SSHQFestusLOS16
name: SSHQFestusLOS16 "SSHQFestusLOS16" [DIAL:0010591B]

text_content: The sheriff suggested that maybe the bandits, in a fit of remorse, delivered the items. After taking all of the stranger's money, of course.
name: SSHQFestusLOS16 "SSHQFestusLOS16" [DIAL:0010591B]

text_content: SSHQFestusLOS15
name: SSHQFestusLOS15 "SSHQFestusLOS15" [DIAL:0010591C]

text_content: Stunned by the news, the man told the sheriff about the note, bottle, and the deal he had with the stranger.
name: SSHQFestusLOS15 "SSHQFestusLOS15" [DIAL:0010591C]

text_content: SSHQFestusLOS14
name: SSHQFestusLOS14 "SSHQFestusLOS14" [DIAL:0010591D]

text_content: He had apparently been attacked by bandits on his way to the saloon the previous day.
name: SSHQFestusLOS14 "SSHQFestusLOS14" [DIAL:0010591D]

text_content: SSHQFestusLOS13
name: SSHQFestusLOS13 "SSHQFestusLOS13" [DIAL:0010591E]

text_content: That night, the local sheriff visited the saloon and reported that the stranger had been found on the side of the town road, murdered.
name: SSHQFestusLOS13 "SSHQFestusLOS13" [DIAL:0010591E]

text_content: SSHQFestus
name: SSHQFestus "SSHQFestus" [DIAL:0010591F]

text_content: SSHQFestusLOS12
name: SSHQFestusLOS12 "SSHQFestusLOS12" [DIAL:00105920]

text_content: Opening the bottle, the man found the inside of the cap had the same blue star on it. He also found that the drink was delicious.
name: SSHQFestusLOS12 "SSHQFestusLOS12" [DIAL:00105920]

text_content: SSHQFestusLOS11
name: SSHQFestusLOS11 "SSHQFestusLOS11" [DIAL:00105921]

text_content: The man picked up the note, and found it contained a recipe for making a sarsaparilla-flavored drink, and was signed with a blue star.
name: SSHQFestusLOS11 "SSHQFestusLOS11" [DIAL:00105921]

text_content: SSHQFestusLOS10
name: SSHQFestusLOS10 "SSHQFestusLOS10" [DIAL:00105922]

text_content: The next day, the man came downstairs to find a single bottle with a note beneath it on the bar.
name: SSHQFestusLOS10 "SSHQFestusLOS10" [DIAL:00105922]

text_content: SSHQFestusLOS9
name: SSHQFestusLOS9 "SSHQFestusLOS9" [DIAL:00105923]

text_content: The man figured he had been tricked and went to sleep, leaving the ingredients he had purchased down by the bar.
name: SSHQFestusLOS9 "SSHQFestusLOS9" [DIAL:00105923]

text_content: SSHQFestusLOS8
name: SSHQFestusLOS8 "SSHQFestusLOS8" [DIAL:00105924]

text_content: The man happily agreed to the deal, and had the ingredients waiting the following day. But the sun came and went, and the stranger never came.
name: SSHQFestusLOS8 "SSHQFestusLOS8" [DIAL:00105924]

text_content: SSHQFestusLOS7
name: SSHQFestusLOS7 "SSHQFestusLOS7" [DIAL:00105925]

text_content: If the man bought the ingredients, the stranger promised to meet him by sundown the next day and teach him how to make a sarsaparilla drink.
name: SSHQFestusLOS7 "SSHQFestusLOS7" [DIAL:00105925]

text_content: SSHQFestusLOS6
name: SSHQFestusLOS6 "SSHQFestusLOS6" [DIAL:00105926]

text_content: The man had never heard of a drink with sarsaparilla in it, and said so. The stranger told the man that he'd make a deal with him.
name: SSHQFestusLOS6 "SSHQFestusLOS6" [DIAL:00105926]

text_content: SSHQFestusLOS5
name: SSHQFestusLOS5 "SSHQFestusLOS5" [DIAL:00105927]

text_content: Then one day, a stranger walked into the saloon. When asked what he'd like, the stranger replied, "You got anything with sarsaparilla in it?"
name: SSHQFestusLOS5 "SSHQFestusLOS5" [DIAL:00105927]

text_content: SSHQFestusLOS4
name: SSHQFestusLOS4 "SSHQFestusLOS4" [DIAL:00105928]

text_content: But the man was at a loss as to what kind of flavor to use. He asked all of his patrons for ideas, but they were no help at all.
name: SSHQFestusLOS4 "SSHQFestusLOS4" [DIAL:00105928]

text_content: SSHQFestusLOS3
name: SSHQFestusLOS3 "SSHQFestusLOS3" [DIAL:00105929]

text_content: So one day a man, a saloon owner in a small town, decided to make a new type of soft drink, something that tasted far different than anything else.
name: SSHQFestusLOS3 "SSHQFestusLOS3" [DIAL:00105929]

text_content: SSHQFestusLOS2
name: SSHQFestusLOS2 "SSHQFestusLOS2" [DIAL:0010592A]

text_content: Now, the threat of legal action forces me to say that Nuka-cola is a swell beverage, but sometimes people just wanted something different, you know?
name: SSHQFestusLOS2 "SSHQFestusLOS2" [DIAL:0010592A]

text_content: SSHQFestusLOS1
name: SSHQFestusLOS1 "SSHQFestusLOS1" [DIAL:0010592B]

text_content: Looooong ago, people didn't really have many choices when it came to soft drinks. It was either water, or Nuka-cola.
name: SSHQFestusLOS1 "SSHQFestusLOS1" [DIAL:0010592B]

text_content: SSHQFestusTestSay
name: SSHQFestusTestSay "SSHQFestusTestSay" [DIAL:0010592C]

text_content: SSHQFestusDepositStars
name: SSHQFestusDepositStars "SSHQFestusDepositStars" [DIAL:0010592D]

text_content: Wahoo, you did it pardner! Bully for you! Ol' Festus knew you could do it. I suppose you'll be wanting that prize now.|Well then, hold onto your hat, because it's a doozy. Not many people have heard the true story behind Sunset Sarsaparilla. It's a right honor.|And now, without further ado, your prize - The Legend of the Star...|Looooong ago, people didn't have a heap of choices when it came to soft drinks. It was either water, or Nuka-cola.|Now, the threat of legal action forces me to say that Nuka-cola is a swell beverage, but sometimes people just wanted something different, you know?|So one day a man, a saloon owner in a small town, decided to make a new type of soft drink, and asked his patrons what flavor they'd like it to be.|After getting no help from them, a stranger at the end of the bar suggested the man make a sarsaparilla flavored drink.|The stranger said he would happily share his family's recipe for the drink, on one condition.|The condition being that the stranger would be allowed to sample a bottle whenever he liked, to ensure the recipe was being followed to the letter.|The man happily agreed, thinking the drink would make him rich, and the stranger promised to meet him by sundown the next day.|The next morning, the sheriff stopped by and reported that the stranger's body was found on the side of the town road. He'd been killed by bandits.|The man, cursing his luck, closed the saloon early that day, just as the sun began to set.|But after he had locked the doors, he turned around to find an unfamiliar bottle on the bar, with a note beneath it.|The note was sealed with blue wax in the shape of a star. Opening it, the man found it contained a recipe for a sarsaparilla-flavored drink.|Sampling the bottle's contents and finding it singularly delicious, the man gave silent thanks to his mysterious benefactor, wherever he was.|Being an honorable man, the saloon owner paid for the stranger's funeral, thinking it was the least he could do to repay him.|The saloon owner went on to become rich selling the new drink, and to this day some bottles of Sunset Sarsaparilla have a blue star under their caps.|Some say the saloon owner ordered it done, in honor of the stranger. Others say it's the stranger, sampling the bottles like he promised.|And that's the Legend of the Star. Hope you enjoyed it, and hope you continue enjoying Sunset Sarsaparilla!
name: SSHQFestusDepositStars "SSHQFestusDepositStars" [DIAL:0010592D]
speaker: NVCRFestus "Festus" [CREA:001043D1]

text_content: By my hat, you're flush with Stars, ain't you? Scratch up a few more and the prize's yours.|Well, what in the Sam Hill are you doing still listening to me? Get a wiggle on and find those last few Stars!
name: SSHQFestusDepositStars "SSHQFestusDepositStars" [DIAL:0010592D]
speaker: NVCRFestus "Festus" [CREA:001043D1]

text_content: It looks like you've got a fair number of Stars in your saddlebags. You're still a few cards short of a hand, though.
name: SSHQFestusDepositStars "SSHQFestusDepositStars" [DIAL:0010592D]
speaker: NVCRFestus "Festus" [CREA:001043D1]

text_content: That's a good start there, soft-horn, but that's not enough by a long chalk.
name: SSHQFestusDepositStars "SSHQFestusDepositStars" [DIAL:0010592D]
speaker: NVCRFestus "Festus" [CREA:001043D1]

text_content: SSHQFestusLHInstructions
name: SSHQFestusLHInstructions "SSHQFestusLHInstructions" [DIAL:0010592E]

text_content: Lucky Horseshoes is played with cards numbered two through ten and aces, which have a value of one.|You and ol' Festus will take turns drawing cards. Each time we draw a card, we add it to our total, trying to hit the magic number of twenty one.|If either of us draws a card that brings our total up to the same number as the other, it pushes the other player's total up one.|When this happens, it's called Lucky Horseshoes! Ol' Festus thought of the name himself, I'll have you know.|When one of us is closer to twenty one and the other can't get any closer, either by going over or because he or she held, the closer player wins.|Ol' Festus likes the game because there are no ties in Lucky Horseshoes. If someone's sitting pretty on twenty one, lady luck can still bump 'em off!|But enough jawing. By now you're as eager as I am to get tossing.
name: SSHQFestusLHInstructions "SSHQFestusLHInstructions" [DIAL:0010592E]
speaker: NVCRFestus "Festus" [CREA:001043D1]

text_content: Lucky Horseshoes.
name: SSHQFestusLuckyHorseshoes "Lucky Horseshoes." [DIAL:0010592F]

text_content: All right, let's play, pardner! Press the blue button to draw a card, the red button to hold, or the yeller button to quit.
name: SSHQFestusLuckyHorseshoes "Lucky Horseshoes." [DIAL:0010592F]
speaker: NVCRFestus "Festus" [CREA:001043D1]

text_content: What do you do around here?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSSunnySmilesTopic005 "What do you do around here?" [DIAL:00105CBC]

text_content: I hunt geckos, mostly. The meat's pretty good and I can always find a buyer for the hides.|I also help keep the town clear of radscorpions and coyotes. Not many people live in Goodsprings, so wildlife is always creeping in.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSSunnySmilesTopic005 "What do you do around here?" [DIAL:00105CBC]
speaker: GSSunnySmiles "Sunny Smiles" [NPC_:00104E84]

text_content: Stay here for now. I'll see if there's anything else I can do first.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSRingoTopic001 "Stay here for now. I'll see if there's anything else I can do first." [DIAL:00105CBD]

text_content: All right. I'll just wait here until you come get me.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSRingoTopic001 "Stay here for now. I'll see if there's anything else I can do first." [DIAL:00105CBD]
speaker: GSRingo "Ringo" [NPC_:00104C7C]

text_content: Let's do this.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSRingoTopic000 "Let's do this." [DIAL:00105CBE]

text_content: All right, I'm ready. I hope.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSRingoTopic000 "Let's do this." [DIAL:00105CBE]
speaker: GSRingo "Ringo" [NPC_:00104C7C]

text_content: Fine. Here's 1000 caps.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSChetTopic000 "Fine. Here's 1000 caps." [DIAL:00105CF8]

text_content: That's more like it. The people can pick up their extra ammo and leather armor when they're ready. Was there anything else?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSChetTopic000 "Fine. Here's 1000 caps." [DIAL:00105CF8]
speaker: GSChet "Chet" [NPC_:00104C78]

text_content: I wish I could've done more to save him.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSSunnySmilesTopic009 "I wish I could've done more to save him." [DIAL:00105CF9]

text_content: At least his death was quick. Cobb's gang had much worse in mind for him.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSSunnySmilesTopic009 "I wish I could've done more to save him." [DIAL:00105CF9]
speaker: GSSunnySmiles "Sunny Smiles" [NPC_:00104E84]

text_content: You're welcome.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSRingoTopic010 "You're welcome." [DIAL:00105CFA]

text_content: I'll stick around for a bit longer, but I'll be gone in a few days. If you ever visit New Vegas, look me up at the Crimson Caravan camp.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSRingoTopic010 "You're welcome." [DIAL:00105CFA]
speaker: GSRingo "Ringo" [NPC_:00104C7C]

text_content: I'll consider it.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSRingoTopic009 "I'll consider it." [DIAL:00105CFB]

text_content: All right. Was there anything else you wanted to talk to me about?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSRingoTopic009 "I'll consider it." [DIAL:00105CFB]
speaker: GSRingo "Ringo" [NPC_:00104C7C]

text_content: I don't need payment.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSRingoTopic008 "I don't need payment." [DIAL:00105CFC]

text_content: I won't let you stick your neck out for free. I can't pay you back now, but I'll make sure the Crimson Caravan pays up. You've got my word.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSRingoTopic008 "I don't need payment." [DIAL:00105CFC]
speaker: GSRingo "Ringo" [NPC_:00104C7C]

text_content: It'll have to do. What now?

text_content: VFreeformNellisPeteMural09

text_content: To restore the bomber, to fly the open skies in armored safety, raining high-explosive ordnance upon ignorant savages - this is our destiny!
name: VFreeformNellisPeteMural09 "VFreeformNellisPeteMural09" [DIAL:00107468]

text_content: VFreeformNellisPeteMural08
name: VFreeformNellisPeteMural08 "VFreeformNellisPeteMural08" [DIAL:00107469]

name: VFreeformNellisPeteMural08 "VFreeformNellisPeteMural08" [DIAL:00107469]

text_content: VFreeformNellisPeteMural07
name: VFreeformNellisPeteMural07 "VFreeformNellisPeteMural07" [DIAL:0010746A]

text_content: Nellis has revealed many secrets. It has taught us how to fly the bombers once based here. And it has taught us where to find one!
name: VFreeformNellisPeteMural07 "VFreeformNellisPeteMural07" [DIAL:0010746A]

text_content: VFreeformNellisPeteMural06
name: VFreeformNellisPeteMural06 "VFreeformNellisPeteMural06" [DIAL:0010746B]

text_content: Well, until... but... not saying you want to harm us or you're a savage, but... anyways.
name: VFreeformNellisPeteMural06 "VFreeformNellisPeteMural06" [DIAL:0010746B]

text_content: VFreeformNellisPeteMural05
name: VFreeformNellisPeteMural05 "VFreeformNellisPeteMural05" [DIAL:0010746C]

text_content: Here, we have prospered and multiplied. Here, our mighty guns destroy any savages who might try to harm us before they can even reach our gates!
name: VFreeformNellisPeteMural05 "VFreeformNellisPeteMural05" [DIAL:0010746C]

text_content: VFreeformNellisPeter04
name: VFreeformNellisPeteMural04 "VFreeformNellisPeter04" [DIAL:0010746D]

text_content: Nellis, glittering like shrapnel in the desert sun. Nellis, bursting with missiles, warheads, and bombs. Nellis had waited. Just for us.
name: VFreeformNellisPeteMural04 "VFreeformNellisPeter04" [DIAL:0010746D]

text_content: VFreeformNellisPeterMural03
name: VFreeformNellisPeteMural03 "VFreeformNellisPeterMural03" [DIAL:0010746E]

text_content: It was neat, but there was a downside. For every 43.6 savages we killed, we lost one of our own. We needed a new home. We needed Nellis.
name: VFreeformNellisPeteMural03 "VFreeformNellisPeterMural03" [DIAL:0010746E]

text_content: VFreeformNellisPeterMural02
name: VFreeformNellisPeteMural02 "VFreeformNellisPeterMural02" [DIAL:0010746F]

text_content: We left and wandered the wastes. There were savages with knives. We blew them up with frag mines and grenades, burned them with flamethrowers.
name: VFreeformNellisPeteMural02 "VFreeformNellisPeterMural02" [DIAL:0010746F]

name: VFreeformNellisPeteMural01 "VFreeformNellisPeterMural01" [DIAL:00107470]

text_content: I think I'll be leaving.
name: VFreeformNellisNellisRaquelTopic035 "I think I'll be leaving." [DIAL:0010AEA3]

text_content: Unacceptable. You've made it this far, probed our defenses, seen our faces.|Mother Pearl's invitation is mandatory, not optional.

text_content: Who is Mother Pearl?
name: VFreeformNellisNellisRaquelTopic033 "Who is Mother Pearl?" [DIAL:0010AEA4]

text_content: As I said, she is our Eldest. Mother Pearl has lived at Nellis from the start, and has the wisdom of her age.|She said this day would come, and that any savage to reach our gates should be brought to her.
name: VFreeformNellisNellisRaquelTopic033 "Who is Mother Pearl?" [DIAL:0010AEA4]
speaker: NellisRaquel "Raquel" [NPC_:000FF262]

text_content: Do you know anything about Victor?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSEasyPeteTopic004 "Do you know anything about Victor?" [DIAL:0010AEAD]

text_content: The machine? Harmless, no matter what Trudy says. She thinks it's hiding something, but I think it's just a broken down relic with no place to be.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSEasyPeteTopic004 "Do you know anything about Victor?" [DIAL:0010AEAD]
speaker: GSEasyPete "Easy Pete" [NPC_:00104C7F]

text_content: Figures. Someone shut you down deliberately, but there's no record of who.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsVictorTopic014 "Figures. Someone shut you down deliberately, but there's no record of who." [DIAL:0010B190]

text_content: That's a puzzle, all right. I'm sure it's nothing.|I truly am sorry I couldn't help you, pardner. Was there something else you wanted to talk about?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsVictorTopic014 "Figures. Someone shut you down deliberately, but there's no record of who." [DIAL:0010B190]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: Interesting. It looks like an override command was activated.

name: VFreeformGoodspringsVictorTopic009 "Didn't you hear all the gunfire?" [DIAL:0010B195]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: They were here. The fight's over.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsVictorTopic008 "They were here. The fight's over." [DIAL:0010B196]

text_content: Really? I must've dozed off. Although, that's never happened before.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsVictorTopic008 "They were here. The fight's over." [DIAL:0010B196]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: Some good you were. You didn't even show up to the fight.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsVictorTopic006 "Some good you were. You didn't even show up to the fight." [DIAL:0010B197]

text_content: Now just hold on! I meant it when I said I'd help you. I guess I must've dozed off. That's never happened before.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsVictorTopic006 "Some good you were. You didn't even show up to the fight." [DIAL:0010B197]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: Are you decent in a fight? I could use more firepower, if you have any.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsVictorTopic005 "Are you decent in a fight? I could use more firepower, if you have any." [DIAL:0010B198]

text_content: Trouble with rustlers? Count me in, pardner. Those varmints will be running home with their tails between their legs soon enough.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsVictorTopic005 "Are you decent in a fight? I could use more firepower, if you have any." [DIAL:0010B198]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: You mean you were expecting me? Like a prophecy or something?
name: VFreeformNellisNellisPearlTopic019 "You mean you were expecting me? Like a prophecy or something?" [DIAL:0010B3AC]

text_content: Prophecy? Do we look like a bunch of religious idiots?|I just hoped a savage - outsider, sorry - would make it to our gates before one of those armies out there comes knocking.|That's right, child. Mother Pearl knows a storm is gathering. Times are changing. May be time for us to change a little, too.
name: VFreeformNellisNellisPearlTopic019 "You mean you were expecting me? Like a prophecy or something?" [DIAL:0010B3AC]
speaker: NellisPearl "Pearl" [NPC_:000FED43]

text_content: You didn't exactly roll out a red carpet!
name: VFreeformNellisNellisPearlTopic018 "You didn't exactly roll out a red carpet!" [DIAL:0010B3AD]

text_content: Those howitzers of ours aren't just for entertainment, child! Explosive ordnance is what keeps the savages at a distance.|Except you! There's something special about you, child, and it was the howitzers that gave you a chance to show it!
name: VFreeformNellisNellisPearlTopic018 "You didn't exactly roll out a red carpet!" [DIAL:0010B3AD]
speaker: NellisPearl "Pearl" [NPC_:000FED43]

text_content: VCG02SettlerBark
name: VCG02SettlerBark "VCG02SettlerBark" [DIAL:0010B3CA]

text_content: Help!
name: VCG02SettlerBark "VCG02SettlerBark" [DIAL:0010B3CA]

name: VCG02SettlerBark "VCG02SettlerBark" [DIAL:0010B3CA]

text_content: I didn't hear exactly, but the leader was talking about the Strip.|Fella wants to get there and avoid the 15, he'd have to go east. Take Highway 93 up.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSTrudyTopic015 "So where were they headed?" [DIAL:0010B3CC]
speaker: GSTrudy "Trudy" [NPC_:00104C6C]

text_content: Why is that?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSTrudyTopic014 "Why is that?" [DIAL:0010B3CD]

text_content: That whole area's overrun with the kind of critters that just get mad if you shoot 'em.|Merchants avoid that whole stretch of I-15 like it's radioactive. Which it could be for all I know.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSTrudyTopic014 "Why is that?" [DIAL:0010B3CD]
speaker: GSTrudy "Trudy" [NPC_:00104C6C]

text_content: Did my attackers say where they were going?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSTrudyTopic004 "Did my attackers say where they were going?" [DIAL:0010B3CE]

text_content: They were having some kind of argument about it, but the guy in the checkered coat kept shushing them.|Sounded like they came in from the north through Quarry Junction. If that's the case I can't say I blame them for not wanting to go back.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSTrudyTopic004 "Did my attackers say where they were going?" [DIAL:0010B3CE]
speaker: GSTrudy "Trudy" [NPC_:00104C6C]

text_content: I wanted to ask you some questions.
name: VCG02GSSunnySmilesTopic005 "I wanted to ask you some questions." [DIAL:0010B751]

text_content: Well let's just finish this first, all right? Then we can talk. Preferably somewhere where I can get a stiff drink and Cheyenne can keep cool.
name: VCG02GSSunnySmilesTopic005 "I wanted to ask you some questions." [DIAL:0010B751]

text_content: I ran out of ammo.
name: VCG02GSSunnySmilesTopic004 "I ran out of ammo." [DIAL:0010B752]

name: VCG02GSSunnySmilesTopic004 "I ran out of ammo." [DIAL:0010B752]
speaker: GSSunnySmiles "Sunny Smiles" [NPC_:00104E84]

text_content: I have to go.
name: VFreeformSSHQSSHQTomasTopic004 "I have to go." [DIAL:0010B757]

text_content: No time for strangers, huh? I should probably follow your example. That's the last time I pick up a straggler on the road, believe me.
name: VFreeformSSHQSSHQTomasTopic004 "I have to go." [DIAL:0010B757]
speaker: SSHQTomas "Tomas" [NPC_:0010596C]

text_content: Who are you?
name: VFreeformUnderpassUnderpassMayorTopic006 "Who are you?" [DIAL:0010B8E3]

text_content: VFreeformGoodspringsDocMitchellShootoutBags
name: VFreeformGoodspringsDocMitchellShootoutBags "VFreeformGoodspringsDocMitchellShootoutBags" [DIAL:0010B963]

text_content: I ain't got much, but it'll do you more good out there than it will in here. Take what I got.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsDocMitchellShootoutBags "VFreeformGoodspringsDocMitchellShootoutBags" [DIAL:0010B963]

text_content: The town is going to be attacked by bandits. Anything you can do to help?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsDocMitchellShootoutHelp "The town is going to be attacked by bandits. Anything you can do to help?" [DIAL:0010B964]

text_content: Seems like wherever I go it's always the same. Folks just never leave each other alone.|I'm not much good in a fight, with my bum leg. And my supplies are scarce. But I'll give you what I can spare.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsDocMitchellShootoutHelp "The town is going to be attacked by bandits. Anything you can do to help?" [DIAL:0010B964]

text_content: Here are three Stimpaks.
name: VFreeformNellisNellisArgyllTopic019 "Here are three Stimpaks." [DIAL:0010B969]

text_content: This'll make you feel better.
name: VFreeformNellisNellisArgyllTopic019 "Here are three Stimpaks." [DIAL:0010B969]

text_content: Powder gangers?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSTrudyTopic016 "Powder gangers?" [DIAL:0010BAEB]

text_content: Chain gangs, really. Some of 'em stuck together so they could make trouble. That's what we're dealing with now.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSTrudyTopic016 "Powder gangers?" [DIAL:0010BAEB]
speaker: GSTrudy "Trudy" [NPC_:00104C6C]

text_content: Who was that man you were arguing with?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSTrudyTopic002 "Who was that man you were arguing with?" [DIAL:0010BAEC]

text_content: He's a convict. Just without the chains. Said his name was Cobb. "Powder Gangers" is what they call themselves. Plenty more like him out there.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSTrudyTopic002 "Who was that man you were arguing with?" [DIAL:0010BAEC]
speaker: GSTrudy "Trudy" [NPC_:00104C6C]

text_content: These Great Khans might have something of mine - a Platinum Chip.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCLieutenantMonroeTopic002 "These Great Khans might have something of mine - a Platinum Chip." [DIAL:0010D025]

name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCLieutenantMonroeTopic002 "These Great Khans might have something of mine - a Platinum Chip." [DIAL:0010D025]

name: RSGlobalCommBreakdownTopic000 "Great, neither am I. Glad we cleared that up." [DIAL:0010D1A3]
