name: RSGlobalCommBreakdownTopic003 "I can't do this right now." [DIAL:0010D2C3]

text_content: I see... well, if you change your mind and want to earn some caps, let me know.
name: RSGlobalCommBreakdownTopic003 "I can't do this right now." [DIAL:0010D2C3]
speaker: CHFSergeantReyes "Tech Sergeant Reyes" [NPC_:0010D23D]

text_content: What do you need help with?
name: RSGlobalCommBreakdownTopic002 "What do you need help with?" [DIAL:0010D2C4]

text_content: I have the delightful task of tabulating stockpiles, kill ratios, mission success rates, radiation deaths, and other truly fascinating numbers.|I've come across numerous inconsistencies between our numbers and our reports - especially with regards to intercepting hostiles.|I'm wondering if our radio security codes have been compromised. I need someone to deliver security code upgrades to each of the Ranger stations.
name: RSGlobalCommBreakdownTopic002 "What do you need help with?" [DIAL:0010D2C4]
speaker: CHFSergeantReyes "Tech Sergeant Reyes" [NPC_:0010D23D]

text_content: You think someone is listening in on your broadcasts?
name: RSGlobalCommBreakdownSergeantReyesTopic002 "You think someone is listening in on your broadcasts?" [DIAL:0010D2CF]

text_content: Less than a third of reported enemy sightings are getting intercepted. Either our intel is faulty, or our enemies are one step ahead of us.
name: RSGlobalCommBreakdownSergeantReyesTopic002 "You think someone is listening in on your broadcasts?" [DIAL:0010D2CF]
speaker: CHFSergeantReyes "Tech Sergeant Reyes" [NPC_:0010D23D]

text_content: You'd think the NCR would be very concerned about this sort of thing.
name: RSGlobalCommBreakdownSergeantReyesTopic001 "You'd think the NCR would be very concerned about this sort of thing." [DIAL:0010D2D0]

text_content: I've been trying to get someone to authorize this update - or at the least get field clearance to leave the camp and do this myself.|But nobody takes me seriously - they just think I'm an incompetent desk jockey trying to glamorize the importance of my job.
name: RSGlobalCommBreakdownSergeantReyesTopic001 "You'd think the NCR would be very concerned about this sort of thing." [DIAL:0010D2D0]
speaker: CHFSergeantReyes "Tech Sergeant Reyes" [NPC_:0010D23D]

text_content: Why is the Big Horn off limits to troopers?
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCIkeTopic011 "Why is the Big Horn off limits to troopers?" [DIAL:0010D3F2]

text_content: The workers here don't much like the military. After too many fights and broken noses, the NCR doesn't allow troops to spend time here.|That doesn't stop a few people like yourself, of course. Don't worry, I won't say a word.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCIkeTopic011 "Why is the Big Horn off limits to troopers?" [DIAL:0010D3F2]
speaker: BCIke "Ike" [NPC_:0010C6EA]

text_content: I'm not a trooper. I just happen to be wearing the armor.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCIkeTopic009 "I'm not a trooper. I just happen to be wearing the armor." [DIAL:0010D3F4]

text_content: Oh. Well, you'd better not let any of the real troopers hear that - and, of course, they won't be hearing it from me, neither.|So, what brings you to Boulder City? Not many people come here.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCIkeTopic009 "I'm not a trooper. I just happen to be wearing the armor." [DIAL:0010D3F4]
speaker: BCIke "Ike" [NPC_:0010C6EA]

text_content: The NCR troopers have been paid to look the other way.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCJessupTopic020 "The NCR troopers have been paid to look the other way." [DIAL:0010D9D0]

text_content: Then we are out of here. Here - a souvenir for you. It's Benny's lighter. Shove it up his ass when you catch up with him.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCJessupTopic020 "The NCR troopers have been paid to look the other way." [DIAL:0010D9D0]
speaker: BCJessup "Jessup" [NPC_:0010C0BE]

text_content: FSRotfaceWhatKindofTip
name: FSRotfaceWhatKindofTip "FSRotfaceWhatKindofTip" [DIAL:0010E025]

text_content: You look like you're new around here, so I'm sure I know all sorts of things you'd find useful. If not, well, it's only a cap.|So what do you say?
name: FSRotfaceWhatKindofTip "FSRotfaceWhatKindofTip" [DIAL:0010E025]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: FSRotfaceSoliciting
name: FSRotfaceSoliciting "FSRotfaceSoliciting" [DIAL:0010E026]

text_content: Ha ha ha, oh that's rich. You're not exactly my type, no offense. No, I meant I could give you a tip. Earn my money, so to speak.
name: FSRotfaceSoliciting "FSRotfaceSoliciting" [DIAL:0010E026]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: Sorry, maybe another time.
name: FSRotfaceDontGiveCap "Sorry, maybe another time." [DIAL:0010E027]

text_content: I understand. Well, have a good day.
name: FSRotfaceDontGiveCap "Sorry, maybe another time." [DIAL:0010E027]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: Sure, here you go.
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]

text_content: The first thing you should know is that Freeside is run by a pack of yahoos that call themselves the Kings.|Their leader, who oddly enough calls himself the King, currently has his hands full trying to prevent an all-out riot in Freeside.|That's two tips, but what the hell. You're a new customer so the extra one's on me. Wanna hear another?
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: Northwest of the big Freeside sign is a casino called the Atomic Wrangler.|It's not as fancy as the ones on the Strip, but there's still plenty of excitement to be found there.
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: At the northwest end of Fremont Street you'll find the Silver Rush. It's run by a rather scary family called the Van Graffs.|Trust me, these are {stressed}not people you want to mess with. But if lasers and such are your thing, the goods they sell are second to none.
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: People in Freeside generally fall into one of two categories. Those who've been here all their lives call themselves Locals.|When people from the NCR and other places started pouring in, the Locals began referring to them as Squatters, and the name stuck.|The Locals blame the Squatters for the scarcity of resources in Freeside, and the Squatters blame any act of violence against them on the Locals.|They're both right to some extent, and violent outbreaks between the two are all too common these days.
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: If you've been around the Kings, you may have met one of them named Pacer. He's always stomping around trying show off his authority.|Being new, you weren't around when it happened, but a few months ago Pacer pissed off the Van Graff family big time.|No one knows what went down, but word is the Van Graffs still want him dead.
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: Drugs are everywhere in Freeside, and even people you might not expect have become addicts.|Jacob Hoff, for instance. That man was a brilliant chemist before he picked up the habit. Now, just another junkie.|That King Pacer's a fan of Jet, too, though I heard one of the Followers talking about it being dangerous for him. Something about his heart.|Do yourself a favor, and stay away from that stuff, okay?
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: In the area between the north and east gates is the Old Mormon Fort, where the Followers of the Apocalypse have set themselves up.|The Followers aren't a bad bunch, and provide healing and supplies to the people of Freeside as they can.
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: I've heard the Garrets over at the Atomic Wrangler are having a hard time collecting some money owed to them.|An enterprising person like yourself might be able to make some caps helping them with their little problem.
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: Caught a rumor the other day that some of the clientele over at the Wrangler have been making some rather strange requests.|Stuff like weirdos wanting the, ahem, services of ghouls and such. I almost have half a mind to volunteer myself, sexy beast that I am.
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: Have you tried going to the Strip, only to be stopped by those big metal murder machines? Happens every day around here.|But if you know the right people, you can get through the gate without being a rich man.
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: I probably don't have to tell you that Freeside's dangerous, but you might want to think twice about hiring one of those guards at the gates.|They're not all saints, is all I'm saying.
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: Have you been to Mick & Ralph's yet? They run a store just down the street, and sell some things you might not expect.
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: There's a guy out on the main drag who sells second hand adventuring gear. He's got an okay selection, but where does it come from?
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: He might not look it, but Ralph from Mick & Ralph's is no slouch with a keyboard. I've heard he's helped reprogram several robots in his time.
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: Saw a strange thing the other day. The King took that robo-dog of his over to the Old Mormon Fort.|Weird thing was that the dog was flipping out, and had to be restrained by a few of the King's men. Hope he doesn't get loose.
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: Things have generally been bad here for the Squatters, the people who came here hoping for a better life and just got stuck.|But lately the mood has changed. The Squatters seem to be a bit more optimistic. I wonder what happened?
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: Mention the NCR and people around here get a little on edge. There's talk that they're going to take over all of New Vegas.|It doesn't help that they've got military camps all over the place, and more troops pour into the area daily.
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: There's a rumor that a huge army is camped to the east, massing to attack the NCR. Like that'd ever happen.|Who in the world could stand up to the NCR and win?
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: While everyone knows Mr. House runs New Vegas, no one knows the first thing about him.|He just sort of showed up a few years back, and everything you see around you is the result. Just who in the hell is he?
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: The Strip is run by the Three Families, who owe their allegiance to Mr. House.|When he first showed up, he gave the local tribes the choice of working with him or getting the hell out of his way.|Given how things turned out, I know which way I'd have gone, but hindsight's twenty-twenty, right?
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: The Omertas, one of Mr. House's Three Families, run a casino called Gomorrah on the Strip.|If you thought the Wrangler was something, you owe it to yourself to go there.
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: The Chairmen run a casino on the Strip called the Tops. It's a pretty classy place, by all reports.|I haven't been there myself, but I hear security there is kinda tight. Don't expect to bring your weapons in there.
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: There was a rumor a while back that the White Glove Society was really an all-ghoul gang, which is why they wear those weird masks of theirs.|What do you think, would I look good in a mask? Maybe I'd make more caps...
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: A traveler that passed through here not long ago told everyone he met that there's some kind of plant paradise to the west where food is abundant.|All the people foolish enough to listen to him and head out that way never came back.
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: Ever hear of the Gun Runners? They sell just about every kind of firearm you can imagine, and some you probably couldn't.
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: I've heard people passing through mention some kind of underground fights pitting creatures of the waste against one another for sport.|And when I say "underground," that's their word I'm using, not my own.
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: East of Freeside there's an old air force base, judging by the road signs.|No one knows for sure what's in there, though, on account of anyone approaching the place getting violently blown up.
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: I heard something about a town south of here being attacked, but details are sketchy. All I know is there haven't been any refugees showing up here.|Which means either the attack wasn't too bad, or it was very, very bad.
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: Traders have been griping for a while now about the 15 being too dangerous to travel. I'd steer clear of it unless you're armed to the teeth.
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: The NCR used to run a prison to the southwest, but something happened a little while back, and now all you'll get is hard looks if you ask about it.
name: FSRotfaceGiveCap "Sure, here you go." [DIAL:0010E028]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: FSBodyguardWhyHire
name: FSBodyguardWhyHire "FSBodyguardWhyHire" [DIAL:0010E6CA]

text_content: You could go without one, but you'd be up to your waist in vermin either begging for your caps or demanding it at knifepoint the whole time.|I've got a reputation for shooting first and not really bothering to ask questions later. With me around, the vermin should keep their distance.|So what'll it be? I've already spotted two other potential customers while we've been chatting.
name: FSBodyguardWhyHire "FSBodyguardWhyHire" [DIAL:0010E6CA]
speaker: VFSBodyguard01 "Bodyguard For Hire" [NPC_:0010E707]

text_content: New to Freeside, are you? Trust me, you won't make it ten feet without being accosted by some of our more friendly residents.|I happen to have an understanding with most of the local wildlife, however. With me by your side, they'll kindly find someone else to bother.|So you want to run with the best or not?
name: FSBodyguardWhyHire "FSBodyguardWhyHire" [DIAL:0010E6CA]
speaker: VFSBodyguard02 "Bodyguard For Hire" [NPC_:0010E708]

text_content: Ah, my friend, believe me when I tell you that this place, while quite nice when you know your way around, can be very, very dangerous.|There are those who would hinder your every step with requests for your money, your business, or even your life.|With your permission, however, I would be happy to stand between you and those people. How does that sound?
name: FSBodyguardWhyHire "FSBodyguardWhyHire" [DIAL:0010E6CA]
speaker: VFSBodyguard03 "Bodyguard For Hire" [NPC_:0010E709]

text_content: FSBodyguardReject
name: FSBodyguardReject "FSBodyguardReject" [DIAL:0010E6CC]

text_content: It's your funeral. Come see me when you wise up.
name: FSBodyguardReject "FSBodyguardReject" [DIAL:0010E6CC]
speaker: VFSBodyguard01 "Bodyguard For Hire" [NPC_:0010E707]

text_content: Are you sure? Well, don't say you weren't warned.
name: FSBodyguardReject "FSBodyguardReject" [DIAL:0010E6CC]
speaker: VFSBodyguard02 "Bodyguard For Hire" [NPC_:0010E708]

text_content: I can't say I recommend that, but hopefully you'll change your mind. I'll be here if you do. Good luck!
name: FSBodyguardReject "FSBodyguardReject" [DIAL:0010E6CC]
speaker: VFSBodyguard03 "Bodyguard For Hire" [NPC_:0010E709]

text_content: FSBodyguardAccept
name: FSBodyguardAccept "FSBodyguardAccept" [DIAL:0010E6CD]

text_content: Wonderful. One thing up front - the moment you leave Freeside, our contract is done. That being said, please, after you.
name: FSBodyguardAccept "FSBodyguardAccept" [DIAL:0010E6CD]
speaker: VFSBodyguard01 "Bodyguard For Hire" [NPC_:0010E707]

text_content: Come back when you have the caps, then. If you'll excuse me, I have more important people to talk to in the meantime.
name: FSBodyguardAccept "FSBodyguardAccept" [DIAL:0010E6CD]
speaker: VFSBodyguard01 "Bodyguard For Hire" [NPC_:0010E707]

text_content: You've made the right choice. As long as you're in Freeside, I'm your man. No one will mess with you with me hanging around.|However, once you head over to the Strip or enter the wasteland, I'm heading immediately back here to pick up another customer.|So what do you say? Ready to head out?
name: FSBodyguardAccept "FSBodyguardAccept" [DIAL:0010E6CD]
speaker: VFSBodyguard02 "Bodyguard For Hire" [NPC_:0010E708]

text_content: Oh, for the love of - get the hell out of here, then!
name: FSBodyguardAccept "FSBodyguardAccept" [DIAL:0010E6CD]
speaker: VFSBodyguard02 "Bodyguard For Hire" [NPC_:0010E708]

text_content: You won't regret it, my friend! As long as you're in Freeside, I'll be right behind you, covering your back.|Oh, I should mention that I don't go where I'm not invited, so don't count on me following you inside private property. Ready to get going?
name: FSBodyguardAccept "FSBodyguardAccept" [DIAL:0010E6CD]
speaker: VFSBodyguard03 "Bodyguard For Hire" [NPC_:0010E709]

text_content: That is most regrettable, my friend. I wish you well in the meantime.
name: FSBodyguardAccept "FSBodyguardAccept" [DIAL:0010E6CD]
speaker: VFSBodyguard03 "Bodyguard For Hire" [NPC_:0010E709]

text_content: FSBodyguard0101
name: FSBodyguardBarks "FSBodyguard0101" [DIAL:0010E6CE]

text_content: Need a bodyguard?
name: FSBodyguardBarks "FSBodyguard0101" [DIAL:0010E6CE]

text_content: You got the caps, I got the guns!
name: FSBodyguardBarks "FSBodyguard0101" [DIAL:0010E6CE]

text_content: These guys couldn't keep fleas off a dog. Hire me!
name: FSBodyguardBarks "FSBodyguard0101" [DIAL:0010E6CE]

text_content: Protection services for hire over here!
name: FSBodyguardBarks "FSBodyguard0101" [DIAL:0010E6CE]

text_content: Safe travel through Freeside!
name: FSBodyguardBarks "FSBodyguard0101" [DIAL:0010E6CE]

text_content: You need the best. Hire me!
name: FSBodyguardBarks "FSBodyguard0101" [DIAL:0010E6CE]

text_content: Your safety guaranteed!
name: FSBodyguardBarks "FSBodyguard0101" [DIAL:0010E6CE]

text_content: Freeside's a dangerous place, my friend!
name: FSBodyguardBarks "FSBodyguard0101" [DIAL:0010E6CE]

text_content: Only I can keep you safe, my friend!
name: FSBodyguardBarks "FSBodyguard0101" [DIAL:0010E6CE]

text_content: <Lie> Yes, I saw him here in the hotel.
name: VMS18VMS18HeckGundersonTopic002 "<Lie> Yes, I saw him here in the hotel." [DIAL:0010EA11]

text_content: What? Oh, my God! Where?
name: VMS18VMS18HeckGundersonTopic002 "<Lie> Yes, I saw him here in the hotel." [DIAL:0010EA11]
speaker: VMS18HeckGunderson "Heck Gunderson" [NPC_:0010D4EB]

text_content: Could you be more specific? That could be a lot of people.
name: VMS18VMS18HeckGundersonTopic001 "Could you be more specific? That could be a lot of people." [DIAL:0010EA12]

text_content: No, I haven't.
name: VMS18VMS18HeckGundersonTopic000 "No, I haven't." [DIAL:0010EA13]

text_content: <Sighs> Ain't nobody got one darned piece of news about my boy? Not one lousy speck of information?|Ain't got one Brahmin unaccounted for across a dozen ranches, but I'm here for an hour and my own son just up and disappears on me.
name: VMS18VMS18HeckGundersonTopic000 "No, I haven't." [DIAL:0010EA13]
speaker: VMS18HeckGunderson "Heck Gunderson" [NPC_:0010D4EB]

text_content: Maybe another time.
name: VFreeformFreesideFSJulieFarkasTopic007 "Maybe another time." [DIAL:0010EA1E]

text_content: That's too bad. If you change your mind, let me know.
name: VFreeformFreesideFSJulieFarkasTopic007 "Maybe another time." [DIAL:0010EA1E]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: You've got yourself a deal.
name: VFreeformFreesideFSJulieFarkasTopic004 "You've got yourself a deal." [DIAL:0010EA21]

text_content: Just come see me when you've got some supplies to turn in.
name: VFreeformFreesideFSJulieFarkasTopic004 "You've got yourself a deal." [DIAL:0010EA21]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: What do you need?
name: VFreeformFreesideFSJulieFarkasTopic003 "What do you need?" [DIAL:0010EA22]

text_content: Med-X, Rad-Away, and Fixer are Freeside essentials. I can't pay you for any supplies you bring in, but I could discount the charge for our services.
name: VFreeformFreesideFSJulieFarkasTopic003 "What do you need?" [DIAL:0010EA22]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: You need medical supplies?
name: VFreeformFreesideFSJulieFarkasTopic000 "You need medical supplies?" [DIAL:0010EA25]

text_content: Rates of injury and illness in Freeside are very high. Supplies don't last long.
name: VFreeformFreesideFSJulieFarkasTopic000 "You need medical supplies?" [DIAL:0010EA25]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: Any bounty hunting tips for me?
name: VFreeformFreesideFSCalebMcCafferyTopic000 "Any bounty hunting tips for me?" [DIAL:0010EA26]

text_content: {Cold}Be quick and quiet, and don't get dead.
name: VFreeformFreesideFSCalebMcCafferyTopic000 "Any bounty hunting tips for me?" [DIAL:0010EA26]
speaker: VFSCalebMcCaffery "Caleb McCaffery" [NPC_:0010C67F]

text_content: {Annoyed}Do I look like a career counselor, kid? Get lost.
name: VFreeformFreesideFSCalebMcCafferyTopic000 "Any bounty hunting tips for me?" [DIAL:0010EA26]
speaker: VFSCalebMcCaffery "Caleb McCaffery" [NPC_:0010C67F]

text_content: BCGKExecuteHostage
name: BCGKExecuteHostage "BCGKExecuteHostage" [DIAL:0010EB23]

text_content: Say goodbye to the hostage, fucker.
name: BCGKExecuteHostage "BCGKExecuteHostage" [DIAL:0010EB23]

text_content: The NCR's coming for us! Waste the hostages!
name: BCGKExecuteHostage "BCGKExecuteHostage" [DIAL:0010EB23]

text_content: What goods and services do you have to offer?
name: VFreeformFreesideFSFrancineGarretTopic000 "What goods and services do you have to offer?" [DIAL:0010EB37]

text_content: We've got liquor, chems, and whores a plenty. Pick your fix and we'll oblige. Our only rule is no sampling the merchandise. Caps paid in advance.|If you'd like to do a bit of gambling, we have an exchange at the back of the casino on the left.
name: VFreeformFreesideFSFrancineGarretTopic000 "What goods and services do you have to offer?" [DIAL:0010EB37]
speaker: VFSFrancineGarret "Francine Garret" [NPC_:0010C680]

text_content: Anything going on around here?
name: RSAlphaQuestCommRangerAlphaTopic002 "Anything going on around here?" [DIAL:0010FA61]

text_content: Just the usual. Legion scouts try to slip across the river a couple times a week, but they always end up floating downriver with holes in their heads.
name: RSAlphaQuestCommRangerAlphaTopic002 "Anything going on around here?" [DIAL:0010FA61]
speaker: RSAlphaCastillo "Comm Officer Castillo" [NPC_:0010F700]

text_content: Heck Gunderson said he was here to talk business with you. What business?
name: VMS18VMS18MarjorieTopic008 "Heck Gunderson said he was here to talk business with you. What business?" [DIAL:0010FAFC]

text_content: What else? Mr. Gunderson and I have been discussing his livestock.|It's put us in rather a delicate position, you see, his coming here. Not that we aren't grateful for his generous offer.|But our executive chef Philippe has transformed brahmin steak into a delicacy. He really is a genius.  Everyone wants it.|But a delicacy is just that - delicate. If everyone can get it, it ceases to be a delicacy. It becomes a perfectly ordinary staple.|And if the Gourmand served staples, it would no longer draw the caliber of people it deserves. And then he'd have some explaining to do.|Philippe has been trying to approximate the taste of human flesh for years. He must have a recipe somewhere.

speaker: VMS18Chauncey "Chauncey" [NPC_:0010D4EA]

text_content: Where are they keeping Ted?

text_content: I don't know exactly. I wasn't in on it. I think some of them have stopped trusting me.|But you can bet they're keeping him near the Gourmand. Our chef, Philippe, has an obsession with fresh ingredients.|It'd be back in the members only section, so you'll have to be careful. Don't be seen, and more importantly, don't let them see Ted in the open.|It's guarded both at the lobby entrance and in the access tunnels leading from the main restaurant.
name: VMS18VMS18ChaunceyTopic015 "Where are they keeping Ted?" [DIAL:00115CF9]
speaker: VMS18Chauncey "Chauncey" [NPC_:0010D4EA]

text_content: I... could sponsor you as an honorary member. But I don't know that you've achieved the level of status that would gain the Society's approval.|Perhaps if you were to gain some more notoriety on the Strip, we could get you in.
name: VMS18VMS18ChaunceyTopic015 "Where are they keeping Ted?" [DIAL:00115CF9]
speaker: VMS18Chauncey "Chauncey" [NPC_:0010D4EA]

text_content: I... could sponsor you as an honorary member. The White Gloves are always looking for people who can elevate their status.|You'd certainly fit the bill with everything you've done around here.
name: VMS18VMS18ChaunceyTopic015 "Where are they keeping Ted?" [DIAL:00115CF9]
speaker: VMS18Chauncey "Chauncey" [NPC_:0010D4EA]

text_content: Otherwise, you'll have to find some way to get inside quietly. It won't be easy. And it'll be harder still to get him out.

speaker: VMS18Chauncey "Chauncey" [NPC_:0010D4EA]

text_content: Wouldn't they punish Mortimer for the deception?

name: VMS18VMS18ChaunceyTopic013 "What about Ted Gunderson?" [DIAL:00115CFB]

speaker: VMS18Chauncey "Chauncey" [NPC_:0010D4EA]

name: VMS18VMS18ChaunceyTopic011 "So is Mortimer behind the disappearances?" [DIAL:00115CFD]

name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCLieutenantMonroeTopic048 "I understand." [DIAL:00116FD4]
speaker: BCLieutenantMonroe "Lieutenant Monroe" [NPC_:0010C6DD]

text_content: I could sneak in there and try to get your people out.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCLieutenantMonroeTopic047 "I could sneak in there and try to get your people out." [DIAL:00116FD5]

text_content: As soon as you free them, the rest of my squad will move in and provide covering fire.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCLieutenantMonroeTopic047 "I could sneak in there and try to get your people out." [DIAL:00116FD5]
speaker: BCLieutenantMonroe "Lieutenant Monroe" [NPC_:0010C6DD]

text_content: You should wait until it's darker so that you have the best chance to pull this off.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCLieutenantMonroeTopic047 "I could sneak in there and try to get your people out." [DIAL:00116FD5]
speaker: BCLieutenantMonroe "Lieutenant Monroe" [NPC_:0010C6DD]

text_content: You should go now, while it's still dark. That way, you'll have the best chance to pull this off.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCLieutenantMonroeTopic047 "I could sneak in there and try to get your people out." [DIAL:00116FD5]
speaker: BCLieutenantMonroe "Lieutenant Monroe" [NPC_:0010C6DD]

text_content: I may be able to negotiate a deal with the Great Khans.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCLieutenantMonroeTopic038 "I may be able to negotiate a deal with the Great Khans." [DIAL:00116FD6]

text_content: Normally, I'd turn you down since I have no idea who you are, but considering that the hostages are as good as dead when we attack...|All right, I'm going to give you a chance to talk to the Great Khans. Their leader is a man named Jessup.|If we hear shooting, we'll be coming in, but it'll probably be late for you.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCLieutenantMonroeTopic038 "I may be able to negotiate a deal with the Great Khans." [DIAL:00116FD6]
speaker: BCLieutenantMonroe "Lieutenant Monroe" [NPC_:0010C6DD]

text_content: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
name: VMS23VStreetDennisCrockerTopic008 "I'd like to know more about the NCR." [DIAL:00116FFA]

text_content: That's a conversation we might be able to have some day - once you've shown more respect for my country.
name: VMS23VStreetDennisCrockerTopic008 "I'd like to know more about the NCR." [DIAL:00116FFA]
speaker: VStreetDennisCrocker "Ambassador Dennis Crocker" [NPC_:00112640]

text_content: I can provide a quick history lesson, if that's what you're looking for.|In 2274, President Kimball sent the NCR army into the Mojave in force, with the objective of occupying and repairing Hoover Dam.|Rangers and army scouts had confirmed that the dam was basically unoccupied and could be restored to an operable condition.|Upon arriving at the dam, however, they discovered that a large force of tribals and robots had occupied it.|This was our introduction to the Three Families, the Securitrons, and, of course, Mr. House.|Using his Securitrons as intermediaries, Mr. House called for parlay.|He claimed his forces had occupied Hoover Dam in order to safeguard it for our arrival.|And that he was ready to turn it over to us, so long as we could agree to terms.|Those terms became the Treaty of New Vegas.|The Treaty recognized Mr. House's sovereignty over the Strip and granted us rights to establish military bases at the Dam and McCarran Airport.|The NCR is legally permitted to send 95% of the electricity produced by the dam to our home states.|The remaining 5% goes to the Strip.|The treaty actually makes it illegal for the NCR to prevent its citizens, or troops on furlough, from visiting the Strip.|Once on the Strip, our citizens are subject to arrest - or punishment - by House's Securitrons, though that's a rare occurrence.|Our troops enjoy a different status. It's illegal for the Securitrons to take action against them.|Of course, it's also illegal for our troops to carry firearms on the Strip, so there isn't much trouble they can get into.|Our military police does an adequate job of keeping the troops on furlough in line. I don't envy them that task.|The embassy was established a few weeks after the Treaty was signed.|Basically Mr. House handed us a dumpy little building he had no interest in renovating.|I'm the third ambassador to hold this post. And the first, I think, to accept its limitations.|My predecessors had ambitions of engineering the annexation of the Mojave. They thought they'd convince Mr. House to join up.|I've never even spoken to the man - or whatever he is. Maybe the situation will change once we've beaten the Legion once and for all.
name: VMS23VStreetDennisCrockerTopic008 "I'd like to know more about the NCR." [DIAL:00116FFA]
speaker: VStreetDennisCrocker "Ambassador Dennis Crocker" [NPC_:00112640]

text_content: What's happening around the Strip?
name: VMS23VStreetDennisCrockerTopic011 "What's happening around the Strip?" [DIAL:00116FFC]

text_content: If that's all you came here to talk about, you're wasting my time. Get to the point, or get out of my office.
name: VMS23VStreetDennisCrockerTopic011 "What's happening around the Strip?" [DIAL:00116FFC]
speaker: VStreetDennisCrocker "Ambassador Dennis Crocker" [NPC_:00112640]

text_content: I know you have a penchant for getting into trouble, but I'd recommend against that here. The Securitrons on the Strip aren't to be trifled with.|Perhaps I'll have Captain Pappas keep an eye on you. For your own safety, of course.
name: VMS23VStreetDennisCrockerTopic011 "What's happening around the Strip?" [DIAL:00116FFC]
speaker: VStreetDennisCrocker "Ambassador Dennis Crocker" [NPC_:00112640]

text_content: It's the same old stuff around here. Gambling, debauchery, drunkenness. It's all here. I'm getting a little old for it, however.|If you want more information try talking to some of the other guys around here. I don't get out of the office much anymore.
name: VMS23VStreetDennisCrockerTopic011 "What's happening around the Strip?" [DIAL:00116FFC]
speaker: VStreetDennisCrocker "Ambassador Dennis Crocker" [NPC_:00112640]

text_content: Tell me about yourself, Ambassador.
name: VMS23VStreetDennisCrockerTopic005 "Tell me about yourself, Ambassador." [DIAL:00116FFE]

text_content: Interested in Politics, huh? Well, grab a seat and get comfortable.|I've been in politics quite a while now. Always had the drive to do it, even when I was young. It's just something I was drawn to.|I started my career over twenty years ago back in the NCR as the local mayor and worked my way up from there.|I managed President Kimball's first run for a seat on the Council. {smiling at the obviousness of it}I suppose that's why I have this ambassadorship.
name: VMS23VStreetDennisCrockerTopic005 "Tell me about yourself, Ambassador." [DIAL:00116FFE]
speaker: VStreetDennisCrocker "Ambassador Dennis Crocker" [NPC_:00112640]

text_content: I'll see what I can do to help them.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic013 "I'll see what I can do to help them." [DIAL:00117004]

text_content: Sobering them up and putting them back to work would go a long way toward helping Freeside.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic013 "I'll see what I can do to help them." [DIAL:00117004]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: Is there anything I can do to help?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic012 "Is there anything I can do to help?" [DIAL:00117005]

text_content: There is always something needing done. A few souls here in Freeside could be great assets to the community, if they'd kick their addictions.|We need to get a regular supply of medicine organized, but the Crimson Caravan wants too many caps for what we need.|Lastly, tensions between the townies and NCR tourists have been going downhill fast lately. A lot of innocent people will get hurt if things blow up.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic012 "Is there anything I can do to help?" [DIAL:00117005]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: Things seem pretty rough here in Freeside.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic011 "Things seem pretty rough here in Freeside." [DIAL:00117006]

text_content: More than rough, it's a damn mess. Freeside townies are constantly picking fights with NCR civilians.|Thugs and thieves are always looking for a victim, and the local families are just sitting back making caps on the mess.|Freeside is in dire need, but no one has been man enough to step up. The Followers can only do so much to stem the tide.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic011 "Things seem pretty rough here in Freeside." [DIAL:00117006]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: Where should I start looking?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic010 "Where should I start looking?" [DIAL:00117007]

text_content: In Freeside, the drunks and drug addicts flock in and around the Atomic Wrangler. I'd start there.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic010 "Where should I start looking?" [DIAL:00117007]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: If I wanted to calm things down in Freeside, where would I start?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic008 "If I wanted to calm things down in Freeside, where would I start?" [DIAL:00117009]

text_content: The big man around here is The King. Not much happens in Freeside that he doesn't know about.|He has the most influence locally, and some of his crew haven't helped the situation by harassing NCR citizens and charging double for water.|Some NCR soldiers have been bringing in supplies, but none of it is going to Freeside locals. I've tried to speak to both sides to no avail.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic008 "If I wanted to calm things down in Freeside, where would I start?" [DIAL:00117009]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: Tell me about Jacob.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic007 "Tell me about Jacob." [DIAL:0011700A]

text_content: The Garrets hooked Jacob on chems when he was working for them. Ironic, since he used to homebrew detox chems. He's a natural chemist.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic007 "Tell me about Jacob." [DIAL:0011700A]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: Tell me about Bill Ronte.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic006 "Tell me about Bill Ronte." [DIAL:0011700B]

text_content: Old Bill Ronte is an exceptionally skilled machinist. He could fix the problems we've been having with Freeside's water pump, if he sobered up.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic006 "Tell me about Bill Ronte." [DIAL:0011700B]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: You said something about helping addicts?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic005 "You said something about helping addicts?" [DIAL:0011700C]

text_content: Yes, Old Bill Ronte and Jacob Hoff. They're not going to kick their habits on their own.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic005 "You said something about helping addicts?" [DIAL:0011700C]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: Do you have anything for sale?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJamesGarretTopic002 "Do you have anything for sale?" [DIAL:0011700D]

text_content: Sure. Take a look.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJamesGarretTopic002 "Do you have anything for sale?" [DIAL:0011700D]
speaker: VFSJamesGarret "James Garret" [NPC_:0010C67E]

text_content: Not for someone like you. My customers would shit a brick if they knew I sold anything to you.|If you need help cleaning up your rep around Freeside, I might be able to help... for a price.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJamesGarretTopic002 "Do you have anything for sale?" [DIAL:0011700D]
speaker: VFSJamesGarret "James Garret" [NPC_:0010C67E]

text_content: I might be able to work something out.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJamesGarretTopic001 "I might be able to work something out." [DIAL:0011700E]

text_content: Good. We can supply them with all the Med-X they need. For the Fixer, we'll only be able to send over some basic drug components. |We're not in the business of getting people off drugs, so we don't really dabble in that side of things.|The Followers should be able to whip some up with what we have available, though.|They just need to agree to fix up our stills and keep them maintained plus cover the cost for raw materials needed to make the alcohol.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJamesGarretTopic001 "I might be able to work something out." [DIAL:0011700E]
speaker: VFSJamesGarret "James Garret" [NPC_:0010C67E]

text_content: The Followers need to find someone to trade with for supplies.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJamesGarretTopic000 "The Followers need to find someone to trade with for supplies." [DIAL:0011700F]

text_content: Really now? This is news. We could possibly supply what they need, but they would need to supply us in kind.|They have the tech know-how to make our stills work more efficiently. Purer alcohol means we can get our customers drunk quicker.|Getting our customers drunk quicker means more caps spent at the tables and stuffing slots if you know what I mean.|Plus, the extra alcohol can serve as surgical disinfectant for their needs. The Followers are a good lot. They've stitched up our boys in the past.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJamesGarretTopic000 "The Followers need to find someone to trade with for supplies." [DIAL:0011700F]
speaker: VFSJamesGarret "James Garret" [NPC_:0010C67E]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSCalebMcCaffery2Topic005 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00117010]

text_content: {Annoyed}Piss off, errand boy.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSCalebMcCaffery2Topic005 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00117010]
speaker: VFSCalebMcCaffery "Caleb McCaffery" [NPC_:0010C67F]

text_content: {Annoyed}Piss off, errand girl.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSCalebMcCaffery2Topic005 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00117010]
speaker: VFSCalebMcCaffery "Caleb McCaffery" [NPC_:0010C67F]

text_content: <Speech>
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSCalebMcCaffery2Topic004 "<Speech>" [DIAL:00117011]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Amused}Well, that sounds like a bit of a bargain. I get to walk free with the Garrets thinking I'm dead.|{Amused}Sure, you can have my hat. I can always buy another with the caps I've got left.|{Friendly}It would have been more fun fighting it out, though. See you later, kid.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSCalebMcCaffery2Topic004 "<Speech>" [DIAL:00117011]
speaker: VFSCalebMcCaffery "Caleb McCaffery" [NPC_:0010C67F]

text_content: [FAILED] <Glare> {Deadly serious}Better get your ass moving before your mouth gets you into trouble, kid.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSCalebMcCaffery2Topic004 "<Speech>" [DIAL:00117011]
speaker: VFSCalebMcCaffery "Caleb McCaffery" [NPC_:0010C67F]

text_content: I guess I haven't got a choice but to put you away.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSCalebMcCaffery2Topic003 "I guess I haven't got a choice but to put you away." [DIAL:00117012]

text_content: {Cold, snickering}If you think you've got the guts, I'd like to see you try.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSCalebMcCaffery2Topic003 "I guess I haven't got a choice but to put you away." [DIAL:00117012]
speaker: VFSCalebMcCaffery "Caleb McCaffery" [NPC_:0010C67F]

text_content: Nah, just thought I'd say hi.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSCalebMcCaffery2Topic002 "Nah, just thought I'd say hi." [DIAL:00117013]

text_content: {Annoyed}Piss off.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSCalebMcCaffery2Topic002 "Nah, just thought I'd say hi." [DIAL:00117013]
speaker: VFSCalebMcCaffery "Caleb McCaffery" [NPC_:0010C67F]

text_content: Give me a share of the caps and your hat and you can go free.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSCalebMcCaffery2Topic001 "Give me a share of the caps and your hat and you can go free." [DIAL:00117014]

text_content: {Annoyed}Now why the hell should I do that? You're below me, kid.|{Cold, Deadly serious}I've been killing scum twice your size since before your mother squeezed you out.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSCalebMcCaffery2Topic001 "Give me a share of the caps and your hat and you can go free." [DIAL:00117014]
speaker: VFSCalebMcCaffery "Caleb McCaffery" [NPC_:0010C67F]

text_content: I'm here to collect, McCaffery. No one crosses the Garret Twins.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSCalebMcCaffery2Topic000 "I'm here to collect, McCaffery. No one crosses the Garret Twins." [DIAL:00117015]

text_content: {Tired and unamused}I'd rather not waste the ammo, kid. But, if you insist, draw.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSCalebMcCaffery2Topic000 "I'm here to collect, McCaffery. No one crosses the Garret Twins." [DIAL:00117015]
speaker: VFSCalebMcCaffery "Caleb McCaffery" [NPC_:0010C67F]

text_content: The Followers are looking to trade for supplies.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSFrancineGarretTopic007 "The Followers are looking to trade for supplies." [DIAL:00117016]

text_content: Interesting... Well, you're going to need to speak with my brother James. He handles all of the trading contracts and general operations.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSFrancineGarretTopic007 "The Followers are looking to trade for supplies." [DIAL:00117016]
speaker: VFSFrancineGarret "Francine Garret" [NPC_:0010C680]

text_content: VFSKingTellsRexToGoWithYou
name: VFSKingTellsRexToGoWithYou "VFSKingTellsRexToGoWithYou" [DIAL:0011759B]

text_content: Rex, this is your new master. Protect him as you would me.
name: VFSKingTellsRexToGoWithYou "VFSKingTellsRexToGoWithYou" [DIAL:0011759B]

text_content: Rex, this is your new master. Protect her as you would me.
name: VFSKingTellsRexToGoWithYou "VFSKingTellsRexToGoWithYou" [DIAL:0011759B]

text_content: Never mind. Let's talk about something else.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCJessupTopic015 "Never mind. Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:001176D6]

text_content: How can you afford so much alcohol?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSBillRonteTopic004 "How can you afford so much alcohol?" [DIAL:00117780]

text_content: Dixon sells me booze dirt cheap. It does the job, but it tastes like paint thinner and I feel like I'm going to die if I stop drinking for a day.|I swear that guy is trying to kill me, but what can I do? Drinking other booze doesn't cure the sickness like his.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSBillRonteTopic004 "How can you afford so much alcohol?" [DIAL:00117780]
speaker: VFSBillRonte "Bill Ronte" [NPC_:0011779B]

text_content: Why don't you stop drinking?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSBillRonteTopic003 "Why don't you stop drinking?" [DIAL:00117781]

text_content: Drop drinking?! I've been drinking for a straight month!|Listen, I've tried to stop, but the withdrawal symptoms are so bad I feel like I'm going to die. I can't stop now.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSBillRonteTopic003 "Why don't you stop drinking?" [DIAL:00117781]
speaker: VFSBillRonte "Bill Ronte" [NPC_:0011779B]

text_content: Julie Farkas sent me to help you sober up.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSBillRonteTopic002 "Julie Farkas sent me to help you sober up." [DIAL:00117782]

text_content: Julie? Ah, I love Julie. She's such a nice lady.|One time, I was working on the water pump and she came over, put her hand on my shoulder, and told me I was doing a great job. Great job she says!|I just choked up and didn't say nothing. Compliments are so rare these days.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSBillRonteTopic002 "Julie Farkas sent me to help you sober up." [DIAL:00117782]
speaker: VFSBillRonte "Bill Ronte" [NPC_:0011779B]

text_content: How's business?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJamesGarretTopic004 "How's business?" [DIAL:00117786]

text_content: House may have boxed us out of the Strip, but we also don't have to deal with their bullshit.|I think now that the Followers are working with us, we'll be able to shape up Freeside a bit more.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJamesGarretTopic004 "How's business?" [DIAL:00117786]
speaker: VFSJamesGarret "James Garret" [NPC_:0010C67E]

text_content: With Jacob Hoff sobered up, there are new drinks are on the menu and sales are strong. People love the new Absinthe and Rum & Nuka.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJamesGarretTopic004 "How's business?" [DIAL:00117786]
speaker: VFSJamesGarret "James Garret" [NPC_:0010C67E]

text_content: Well, I wasn't expecting the increased NCR presence after the bombing to improve things, but I've been pleasantly surprised.|The off-duty chumps who have been wandering through have been stopping in to buy drinks and pay for strange. I appreciate the extra income.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJamesGarretTopic004 "How's business?" [DIAL:00117786]
speaker: VFSJamesGarret "James Garret" [NPC_:0010C67E]

text_content: The build-up of tension around the dam isn't making things safe, but it sure is bringing in a lot of hotheads looking to drink their worries away.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJamesGarretTopic004 "How's business?" [DIAL:00117786]
speaker: VFSJamesGarret "James Garret" [NPC_:0010C67E]

text_content: With the Kings dead, business is going a bit south. It's harder to get supplies into Freeside safely without their help.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJamesGarretTopic004 "How's business?" [DIAL:00117786]
speaker: VFSJamesGarret "James Garret" [NPC_:0010C67E]

text_content: We ain't scraping to get by, if that's what you're asking.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJamesGarretTopic004 "How's business?" [DIAL:00117786]
speaker: VFSJamesGarret "James Garret" [NPC_:0010C67E]

text_content: I spoke with Julie Farkas. She says the Followers will accept your offer.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJamesGarretTopic003 "I spoke with Julie Farkas. She says the Followers will accept your offer." [DIAL:00117787]

text_content: Hey, that's great. We'll get some supplies sent over today as a show of good faith.|Once our stills are upgraded, we'll never be short on liquor for our patrons. If Jacob Hoff is sober, we might even have a few new drinks on tap.|Most might view us as drug dealing enablers around here, but honestly we care about our patrons. It's bad business for people to get addicted.|We've got enough crime in Freeside without a bunch of strung-out junkies robbing traders and gamblers to afford their next fix.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJamesGarretTopic003 "I spoke with Julie Farkas. She says the Followers will accept your offer." [DIAL:00117787]
speaker: VFSJamesGarret "James Garret" [NPC_:0010C67E]

text_content: With a surplus of supplies, you could use your caps and influence to expand.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic003 "With a surplus of supplies, you could use your caps and influence to expand." [DIAL:00117788]

text_content: Good point. We wouldn't be paying anything for their supplies, just a portion of our food waste to make ethanol.|We get food from nearby wasteland farmers in exchange for medical services, so we could put our caps back into helping Freeside.|Tell the Garrets we'll keep their stills running if they provide us with supplies. Thank you for arranging this. You've been a godsend.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic003 "With a surplus of supplies, you could use your caps and influence to expand." [DIAL:00117788]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: You get your chems and can help anyone who gets addicted.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic002 "You get your chems and can help anyone who gets addicted." [DIAL:00117789]

text_content: True, we could help addicts, but the cycle of addiction, recover, and relapse would remain.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic002 "You get your chems and can help anyone who gets addicted." [DIAL:00117789]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: The Garret Twins.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic001 "The Garret Twins." [DIAL:0011778A]

text_content: They supply Freeside with drugs and liquor. From my point of view they're just better-organized pushers.|Upgrading their stills would increase their supply of liquor and chems. How does that help Freeside?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic001 "The Garret Twins." [DIAL:0011778A]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: I think I found someone who will be able to cover your supplies.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic000 "I think I found someone who will be able to cover your supplies." [DIAL:0011778B]

text_content: That's phenomenal! Who did you find?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic000 "I think I found someone who will be able to cover your supplies." [DIAL:0011778B]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: Thank you, Victor.
name: VDialogueLucky38EntranceLucky38VictorEntranceTopic000 "Thank you, Victor." [DIAL:00117B12]

text_content: I see you brought a friend! Sorry, pardner, but they're gonna have to stay outside.
name: VDialogueLucky38EntranceLucky38VictorEntranceTopic000 "Thank you, Victor." [DIAL:00117B12]
speaker: Lucky38VictorEntrance "Victor" [CREA:00112073]

text_content: I see you brought some friends! Sorry, pardner, but they're gonna have to stay outside.
name: VDialogueLucky38EntranceLucky38VictorEntranceTopic000 "Thank you, Victor." [DIAL:00117B12]
speaker: Lucky38VictorEntrance "Victor" [CREA:00112073]

text_content: Come back soon, now!
name: VDialogueLucky38EntranceLucky38VictorEntranceTopic000 "Thank you, Victor." [DIAL:00117B12]
speaker: Lucky38VictorEntrance "Victor" [CREA:00112073]

text_content: Enjoy your visit!
name: VDialogueLucky38EntranceLucky38VictorEntranceTopic000 "Thank you, Victor." [DIAL:00117B12]
speaker: Lucky38VictorEntrance "Victor" [CREA:00112073]

text_content: The troopers are all dead. You're free to go.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCJessupTopic001 "The troopers are all dead. You're free to go." [DIAL:00117DEB]

text_content: I know I'm not the scheduled speaker, but I have a few words, if I may.
name: VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech "VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech" [DIAL:0011831D]

text_content: There was a time not so long ago when we were bound together not as members but as family. As a clan.
name: VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech "VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech" [DIAL:0011831D]

text_content: And when Mr. House came to us with his proposal, we accepted, knowing we stood to gain much.
name: VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech "VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech" [DIAL:0011831D]

text_content: Little did we know how much we'd lose in the process.
name: VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech "VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech" [DIAL:0011831D]

text_content: As a society, we've endeavored to sample the finest food and drink the world has to offer. But we are living a lie.
name: VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech "VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech" [DIAL:0011831D]

text_content: There is a meat sweeter than the most cornfed livestock. Most of you have tasted it. All of you have coveted it.
name: VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech "VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech" [DIAL:0011831D]

text_content: Among us, it is a crime to discuss a return to the old ways that unified our people.
name: VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech "VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech" [DIAL:0011831D]

text_content: Tonight, that all changes. The taboo ends. {aside, preventing an interruption}Let me finish, Marjorie.
name: VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech "VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech" [DIAL:0011831D]

text_content: You don't know it yet, but you are all now guilty of a greater crime. One that ordinarily bears the harshest of punishments.
name: VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech "VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech" [DIAL:0011831D]

text_content: Surely that you are all guilty warrants not only universal amnesty but also a renewed discussion.
name: VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech "VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech" [DIAL:0011831D]

text_content: For our society to be truly elite, we must dine on the most delicious, the most exclusive food known to us.
name: VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech "VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech" [DIAL:0011831D]

text_content: And tonight, for the first time as a society, you are sampling that very dish, the meat we are forbidden to taste, the way it was meant to be eaten!
name: VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech "VMS18MortimerBanquetSpeech" [DIAL:0011831D]

text_content: Tell me about the factions vying for New Vegas.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic043 "Tell me about the factions vying for New Vegas." [DIAL:001189F2]

text_content: Who exactly are you, Mr. House?{Before Chip turned in.}
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic039 "Who exactly are you, Mr. House?{Before Chip turned in.}" [DIAL:001189F6]

text_content: I am Robert Edwin House, President, CEO, and sole proprietor of the New Vegas Strip.|I oversaw the city's renovations starting from 2274 onward. The Three Families are my employees.|Before the Great War of 2077, I was the founder, President and CEO of RobCo Industries, a vast computer and robotics corporation.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic039 "Who exactly are you, Mr. House?{Before Chip turned in.}" [DIAL:001189F6]

text_content: What was your relationship with Benny... back when he was breathing?
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic038 "What was your relationship with Benny... back when he was breathing?" [DIAL:001189F7]

text_content: Benny was the leader of the Chairmen for seven years, ever since I recruited the tribe. I considered him something of a protege.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic038 "What was your relationship with Benny... back when he was breathing?" [DIAL:001189F7]

text_content: Ask about the Chip. (Recovered)
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic035 "Ask about the Chip. (Recovered)" [DIAL:001189FA]

text_content: What is the Platinum Chip?
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic034 "What is the Platinum Chip?" [DIAL:001189FB]

text_content: It's a very special item. There's nothing else like it in the entire world. It was lost a long time, and difficult to find.|That's all you need to know about it, for this stage of our enterprise. Fulfill your contract, deliver the Chip, and good things will come your way.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic034 "What is the Platinum Chip?" [DIAL:001189FB]

text_content: Tell me about Benny.{alive}
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic031 "Tell me about Benny.{alive}" [DIAL:001189FC]

text_content: Benny has led the Chairmen ever since I recruited his tribe seven years ago.|Until his recent misbehavior, I'd planned to make him my protege. Maybe if I'd begun grooming him sooner, none of this would've happened...
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic031 "Tell me about Benny.{alive}" [DIAL:001189FC]

text_content: What terms are you offering?
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic030 "What terms are you offering?" [DIAL:001189FD]

text_content: My only concern is the recovery of the Platinum Chip. What happens to Benny, I leave to your discretion.|When you bring the Chip to me, I will pay you four times the delivery bonus stipulated in your contract. How's that?
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic030 "What terms are you offering?" [DIAL:001189FD]

text_content: As I said before, Benny's fate is yours to decide. Once you've delivered the Chip, I will pay you the amount agreed-upon.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic030 "What terms are you offering?" [DIAL:001189FD]

text_content: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic017 "What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}" [DIAL:00118A14]

text_content: I've resurrected Vegas, spirit intact. What I need now is the ability to enforce my rightful claim.|Not just against Caesar's Legion, by the way. In fact, the NCR is a more present and insidious threat.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic017 "What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}" [DIAL:00118A14]

text_content: To enforce, one must have force - a position of strength.|Years ago, when I detected NCR scouts roaming the Mojave, I could tell from their uniforms that these were no mere tribesmen.|I knew it was only a matter of time before an army appeared, to take control of the dam. And I knew my Securitrons wouldn't be enough to oppose them.|And so I recruited the Three Families. Vegas belongs to me because I mustered enough strength to bring the NCR to the bargaining table.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic017 "What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}" [DIAL:00118A14]

text_content: Indeed it was - and still is. But not without taking significant casualties.|Would Kimball and Oliver have traded the lives of hundreds of soldiers for absolute control of Hoover Dam? Oh yes.|They weren't afraid of me, they were afraid of Caesar - that attacking me would leave them vulnerable to a Legion offensive.|And so they negotiated. Not out of the kindness of their hearts, as they try to make it seem. Because the calculus of power left no other choice.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic017 "What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}" [DIAL:00118A14]

text_content: NCR forces were permitted to occupy Hoover Dam and establish a military base at McCarran Airport. {not an airport anymore}Well, it used to be one.|They recognized my sovereignty over the Vegas Strip and agreed to supply electricity and water once their engineers repaired the dam.|Written into the treaty were provisions that the NCR do nothing to prevent its soldiers and civilians from visiting the Strip.|That's how I harnessed the NCR to my endeavor. Their occupation has been the engine of my growing economy.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic017 "What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}" [DIAL:00118A14]

text_content: The salient issue is that they will go to war with me, if given the chance.|There's just one reason why the NCR hasn't contrived some outrage to justify invading the Strip - Caesar's Legion.|The final battle between those two armies is fast approaching. I can't afford to let either side win on their terms.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic017 "What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}" [DIAL:00118A14]
speaker: MrHouse "Mr. House" [CREA:00125BB5]

text_content: New Vegas is more than a city - it's the remedy to mankind's {beat}derailment.|The city's economy is a blast furnace in which can be forged the steel of a new rail line, running straight to a new horizon.|What is the NCR? A society of people desperate to experience comfort, ease, luxury... A society of customers.|With all that money pouring in? Give me 20 years, and I'll reignite the high technology development sectors. 50 years, and I'll have people in orbit.|100 years, and my colony ships will be heading for the stars, to search for planets unpolluted by the wrath and folly of a bygone generation.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic017 "What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}" [DIAL:00118A14]
speaker: MrHouse "Mr. House" [CREA:00125BB5]

text_content: I prefer the term "autocrat."|I would rule as a chief executive. I would not answer to a board of directors or any other entity.|Nothing to impede progress. If you want to see the fate of democracies, look out the windows.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic017 "What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}" [DIAL:00118A14]
speaker: MrHouse "Mr. House" [CREA:00125BB5]

text_content: My judgement. |I have no interest in abusing others, just as I have no interest in legislating or otherwise dictating what people do in their private time.|Nor have I any interest in being worshipped as some kind of machine god messiah. I am impervious to such corrupting ambitions.|But autocracy? Firm control in the hands of a technological and economic visionary? Yes, that Vegas shall have.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic017 "What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}" [DIAL:00118A14]
speaker: MrHouse "Mr. House" [CREA:00125BB5]

name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCPrivateKowalskiTopic001 "What is this memorial?" [DIAL:0011A8C4]

text_content: It commemorates the Battle of Hoover Dam. The rangers lured the best of Caesar's Legion into Boulder City, then blew the whole town up.|The NCR still lost a bunch of troops in the fighting, though. My older brother sacrificed himself so they could evacuate some of the wounded.

speaker: BCPrivateKowalski "Private Kowalski" [NPC_:0011A8D8]

name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCPrivateKowalskiTopic002 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0011A8C5]

name: VDialogueBennyBennyTopic048 "I didn't come here to negotiate, I came for revenge. <Attack Benny.>" [DIAL:0011A95F]

name: VDialogueBennyBennyTopic047 "We talk here and now, or I tell everyone my story." [DIAL:0011A960]
