text_content: What is Thermite?
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21TroikeTopic024 "What is Thermite?" [DIAL:0011A971]

text_content: Thermite is a mix of rust and aluminum dust. If you add a little heat, a massive{emphasized} amount of heat is spit out.|It gives off enough heat to melt through just about anything. It should make short work of the weapons.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21TroikeTopic024 "What is Thermite?" [DIAL:0011A971]
speaker: VMS21Troike "Troike" [NPC_:0010C6F7]

text_content: {Speech Option, threaten to sell troike out if he doesn't turn in the thermite}
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21TroikeTopic023 "{Speech Option, threaten to sell troike out if he doesn't turn in the thermite}" [DIAL:0011A972]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Hey, fuck you.|Alright, I'll place the fucking Thermite myself. You get out of the casino for a bit. I'll take care of it while you're gone.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21TroikeTopic023 "{Speech Option, threaten to sell troike out if he doesn't turn in the thermite}" [DIAL:0011A972]
speaker: VMS21Troike "Troike" [NPC_:0010C6F7]

text_content: [FAILED] Nothing you could threaten me with holds a candle to what the Omertas would do to me if they caught me.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21TroikeTopic023 "{Speech Option, threaten to sell troike out if he doesn't turn in the thermite}" [DIAL:0011A972]
speaker: VMS21Troike "Troike" [NPC_:0010C6F7]

text_content: Give me the Thermite and I'll destroy the weapons.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21TroikeTopic019 "Give me the Thermite and I'll destroy the weapons." [DIAL:0011A973]

text_content: Okay, here's the Thermite and a key to the room where the guns are stored. Place the Thermite on the crates in the room.|I rigged the light switch outside the room to kick off a spark big enough to hold the Thermite. That should turn that shit into molten slag.|As soon as we're done talking I'm going to make myself like a ghost. I don't want to be anywhere near here when the bosses find out.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21TroikeTopic019 "Give me the Thermite and I'll destroy the weapons." [DIAL:0011A973]
speaker: VMS21Troike "Troike" [NPC_:0010C6F7]

text_content: Where do the guns come from?
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21TroikeTopic022 "Where do the guns come from?" [DIAL:0011A974]

text_content: I've made lots of contacts over the years. I have some friends back in California that can get their hands on just about anything.|Mostly I've been calling in every last favor I have.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21TroikeTopic022 "Where do the guns come from?" [DIAL:0011A974]
speaker: VMS21Troike "Troike" [NPC_:0010C6F7]

text_content: That's it for now.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21TroikeTopic021 "That's it for now." [DIAL:0011A975]

text_content: Okay, cool.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21TroikeTopic021 "That's it for now." [DIAL:0011A975]
speaker: VMS21Troike "Troike" [NPC_:0010C6F7]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21TroikeTopic020 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0011A976]

text_content: Alright, let's.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21TroikeTopic020 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0011A976]
speaker: VMS21Troike "Troike" [NPC_:0010C6F7]

text_content: I have a couple more questions about the guns.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21TroikeTopic017 "I have a couple more questions about the guns." [DIAL:0011A977]

text_content: Okay, try and be fast about it.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21TroikeTopic017 "I have a couple more questions about the guns." [DIAL:0011A977]
speaker: VMS21Troike "Troike" [NPC_:0010C6F7]

text_content: What can we do to take care of the guns?
name: vTroikeGunsThermite "What can we do to take care of the guns?" [DIAL:0011A978]

text_content: As a little pet project I've been making some thermite. Thermite burns as hot as the devil's asshole and can melt through just about anything.|I've been keeping it so if the Family betrays me I can hopefully do some damage before I end up dead or in jail.
name: vTroikeGunsThermite "What can we do to take care of the guns?" [DIAL:0011A978]
speaker: VMS21Troike "Troike" [NPC_:0010C6F7]

text_content: Okay, I know the stuff inside and out. What do you want to know?
name: vTroikeGunsThermite "What can we do to take care of the guns?" [DIAL:0011A978]
speaker: VMS21Troike "Troike" [NPC_:0010C6F7]

text_content: How do you get the guns into the strip?
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21TroikeTopic018 "How do you get the guns into the strip?" [DIAL:0011A979]

text_content: I'm pretty proud of myself. It's a stroke of genius, if I can be so modest.|The whole arrangement starts with an old buddy of mine in the Republic. He's responsible for packing and shipping supplies to the NCR on the Strip.|He marks some containers as food and medical and packs them with guns and other shit.|From there it just took a couple greased palms to get someone to let me cherry pick a container or two out of every shipment. Easy as pie.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21TroikeTopic018 "How do you get the guns into the strip?" [DIAL:0011A979]
speaker: VMS21Troike "Troike" [NPC_:0010C6F7]

text_content: I found proof of your blackmail.
name: TroikeBlackmailTopic00 "I found proof of your blackmail." [DIAL:0011A97A]

text_content: Well that motherfucker. What the hell. Damn, thanks for finding this.|This should be plenty of proof to cover my ass if they try to rat me out to any authorities.
name: TroikeBlackmailTopic00 "I found proof of your blackmail." [DIAL:0011A97A]
speaker: VMS21Troike "Troike" [NPC_:0010C6F7]

text_content: What would you like to know?
name: vfreeformlucky38Lucky38FollowerEmilyTopic004 "What would you like to know?" [DIAL:0011A9D9]

text_content: And this is where I come in.
name: vfreeformlucky38Lucky38FollowerEmilyTopic003 "And this is where I come in." [DIAL:0011A9DA]

text_content: Right. We just want to find out what sort of technology Mr. House has used to stay alive for all these years.|It could be of great benefit to the people we try to help, many of whom suffer from hard to diagnose illnesses.
name: vfreeformlucky38Lucky38FollowerEmilyTopic003 "And this is where I come in." [DIAL:0011A9DA]
quest: vfreeformlucky38 "The Moon Comes Over the Tower" [QUST:0011A0C5]
speaker: Lucky38FollowerEmily "Emily Ortal" [NPC_:0011904E]

text_content: Yes.
name: vfreeformlucky38Lucky38FollowerEmilyTopic001 "Yes." [DIAL:0011A9DC]

text_content: Oh. Great! The Followers of the Apocalypse, well some of us, anyway, have been interested in Mr. House's technology, how he stays alive.|Of course, no one is allowed inside the Lucky 38, so no one knows what's going on. Well, except for you.
name: vfreeformlucky38Lucky38FollowerEmilyTopic001 "Yes." [DIAL:0011A9DC]
quest: vfreeformlucky38 "The Moon Comes Over the Tower" [QUST:0011A0C5]
speaker: Lucky38FollowerEmily "Emily Ortal" [NPC_:0011904E]

text_content: Why do you want to know?
name: vfreeformlucky38Lucky38FollowerEmilyTopic000 "Why do you want to know?" [DIAL:0011A9DD]

text_content: Oh! Well, I heard... I mean, we heard... we meaning the Followers of the Apocalypse... that you had been in there. The Lucky 38, I mean.|And we were wondering if you could help us. If it's not too much trouble, of course.
name: vfreeformlucky38Lucky38FollowerEmilyTopic000 "Why do you want to know?" [DIAL:0011A9DD]
quest: vfreeformlucky38 "The Moon Comes Over the Tower" [QUST:0011A0C5]
speaker: Lucky38FollowerEmily "Emily Ortal" [NPC_:0011904E]

text_content: Who are you?
name: MarilynJaneWhoAreYou "Who are you?" [DIAL:0011A9E0]

text_content: I'm Jane, one of Mr. House's girls. We keep him... entertained. We don't get many guests lately; perhaps we can entertain you as well.
name: MarilynJaneWhoAreYou "Who are you?" [DIAL:0011A9E0]
speaker: Lucky38Jane "Jane" [CREA:00116A50]

text_content: VVault21TourTopic008
name: VVault21TourTopic008 "VVault21TourTopic008" [DIAL:0011B3FC]

text_content: Down there is the game room! Each side of the vault had one... but the other is filled with concrete now. Okay, that wraps it up. I'll see you soon!
name: VVault21TourTopic008 "VVault21TourTopic008" [DIAL:0011B3FC]

text_content: VVault21TourTopic007
name: VVault21TourTopic007 "VVault21TourTopic007" [DIAL:0011B3FD]

text_content: This hall leads to our guest rooms. You can use the first room on our left. But no snooping next door! That's my room, always was.
name: VVault21TourTopic007 "VVault21TourTopic007" [DIAL:0011B3FD]

text_content: VVault21TourTopic006
name: VVault21TourTopic006 "VVault21TourTopic006" [DIAL:0011B3FE]

text_content: We used to have such parties in this diner! A bitch to clean later... but well worth it!
name: VVault21TourTopic006 "VVault21TourTopic006" [DIAL:0011B3FE]

text_content: VVault21TourTopic005
name: VVault21TourTopic005 "VVault21TourTopic005" [DIAL:0011B3FF]

text_content: Chosen representatives gambled against each other here. The winner earned the right to settle the dispute as wished by the collective.
name: VVault21TourTopic005 "VVault21TourTopic005" [DIAL:0011B3FF]

text_content: VVault21TourTopic004
name: VVault21TourTopic004 "VVault21TourTopic004" [DIAL:0011B400]

text_content: This is the main game-hall. Here we settled the big disputes among the vault's levels.
name: VVault21TourTopic004 "VVault21TourTopic004" [DIAL:0011B400]

text_content: VVault21TourTopic003
name: VVault21TourTopic003 "VVault21TourTopic003" [DIAL:0011B401]

text_content: Don't get lost! My vault has many corridors and rooms - although it is no longer symmetrical, after Mr. House threw us out.
name: VVault21TourTopic003 "VVault21TourTopic003" [DIAL:0011B401]

text_content: VVault21TourTopic002
name: VVault21TourTopic002 "VVault21TourTopic002" [DIAL:0011B402]

text_content: Above us there's the control center for this level of the vault's life-support systems, electric grid, radioactive shields and all that jazz.
name: VVault21TourTopic002 "VVault21TourTopic002" [DIAL:0011B402]

text_content: VVault21TourTopic001
name: VVault21TourTopic001 "VVault21TourTopic001" [DIAL:0011B403]

text_content: This bunker protects the entrance to the vault - solid stone outside and thick steel on the inside!
name: VVault21TourTopic001 "VVault21TourTopic001" [DIAL:0011B403]

text_content: VVault21TourTopic000
name: VVault21TourTopic000 "VVault21TourTopic000" [DIAL:0011B404]

text_content: All right! Please, follow me. We'll head into the vault right away.
name: VVault21TourTopic000 "VVault21TourTopic000" [DIAL:0011B404]

text_content: {Speech, Convince Sal or Nero to buy guns from Mick & Ralph again}
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21BigSalTopic008 "{Speech, Convince Sal or Nero to buy guns from Mick & Ralph again}" [DIAL:0011BC5F]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Alright, you've done some good work for us. I'll do this as a favor for you.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21BigSalTopic008 "{Speech, Convince Sal or Nero to buy guns from Mick & Ralph again}" [DIAL:0011BC5F]
speaker: VMS21BigSal "Big Sal" [NPC_:0010C6F4]

text_content: [FAILED] Yeah, I'm sure they enjoy the cash flow, but that doesn't mean dick to me.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21BigSalTopic008 "{Speech, Convince Sal or Nero to buy guns from Mick & Ralph again}" [DIAL:0011BC5F]
speaker: VMS21BigSal "Big Sal" [NPC_:0010C6F4]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] We don't want to draw attention to ourselves. Alright, we'll give them a little bit of extra business.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21BigSalTopic008 "{Speech, Convince Sal or Nero to buy guns from Mick & Ralph again}" [DIAL:0011BC5F]
speaker: VMS21Nero "Nero" [NPC_:0010C6F3]

text_content: [FAILED] They're small timers, I could give a fuck what they would enjoy.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21BigSalTopic008 "{Speech, Convince Sal or Nero to buy guns from Mick & Ralph again}" [DIAL:0011BC5F]
speaker: VMS21Nero "Nero" [NPC_:0010C6F3]

text_content: Sorry, but I don't know you from Adam, and you don't have any business getting in our business.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21BigSalTopic008 "{Speech, Convince Sal or Nero to buy guns from Mick & Ralph again}" [DIAL:0011BC5F]
speaker: VMS21BigSal "Big Sal" [NPC_:0010C6F4]

text_content: He seems pretty tired.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21BigSalTopic007 "He seems pretty tired." [DIAL:0011BC60]

text_content: I bet he does. That's from hookers and chems. His work for us is the most restful part of his day.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21BigSalTopic007 "He seems pretty tired." [DIAL:0011BC60]
speaker: VMS21BigSal "Big Sal" [NPC_:0010C6F4]

text_content: {Speech Options}
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21BigSalTopic006 "{Speech Options}" [DIAL:0011BC61]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Yeah, I see where you're coming from. Okay, tell Troike he can hit the road.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21BigSalTopic006 "{Speech Options}" [DIAL:0011BC61]
speaker: VMS21BigSal "Big Sal" [NPC_:0010C6F4]

text_content: [FAILED] Nah, I don't think so. We've still got some work for him to do.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21BigSalTopic006 "{Speech Options}" [DIAL:0011BC61]
speaker: VMS21BigSal "Big Sal" [NPC_:0010C6F4]

text_content: {Barter Options}
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21BigSalTopic002 "{Barter Options}" [DIAL:0011BC62]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Really? That was his idea? Alright, he can go. Hopefully he finds us some good deals out there.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21BigSalTopic002 "{Barter Options}" [DIAL:0011BC62]
speaker: VMS21BigSal "Big Sal" [NPC_:0010C6F4]

text_content: [FAILED] You're really funny. I like you. But no. We still have business for Troike.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21BigSalTopic002 "{Barter Options}" [DIAL:0011BC62]
speaker: VMS21BigSal "Big Sal" [NPC_:0010C6F4]

text_content: Big Sal agreed to let you go.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21TroikeTopic025 "Big Sal agreed to let you go." [DIAL:0011BC63]

text_content: Holy shit, really? Okay, I'll help you, but I'm getting the hell out of here first chance I get.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21TroikeTopic025 "Big Sal agreed to let you go." [DIAL:0011BC63]
speaker: VMS21Troike "Troike" [NPC_:0010C6F7]

text_content: Why do they need to die?
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21CachinoTopic019 "Why do they need to die?" [DIAL:0011BC64]

text_content: As long as they're alive, they can start up their plans again. All you've managed to do is stall them. I guarantee you they have contingencies.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21CachinoTopic019 "Why do they need to die?" [DIAL:0011BC64]
speaker: VMS21Cachino "Cachino" [NPC_:0010C6F5]

text_content: What's the next step in breaking up the bosses plans?
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21CachinoTopic018 "What's the next step in breaking up the bosses plans?" [DIAL:0011BC65]

text_content: Now we cut off the head of the serpent. Big Sal and Nero have to die.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21CachinoTopic018 "What's the next step in breaking up the bosses plans?" [DIAL:0011BC65]
speaker: VMS21Cachino "Cachino" [NPC_:0010C6F5]

text_content: {Tell Cachino the bosses plans have been disrupted}
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21CachinoTopic016 "{Tell Cachino the bosses plans have been disrupted}" [DIAL:0011BC66]

text_content: You better get outside for a little bit. I'm sure they are going to look for the infamous courier when things go to hell.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21CachinoTopic016 "{Tell Cachino the bosses plans have been disrupted}" [DIAL:0011BC66]
speaker: VMS21Cachino "Cachino" [NPC_:0010C6F5]

text_content: Yeah, poor fucker got himself caught after he melted all the guns. Bastard mentioned your name before they shot him in the head.|Now the bosses want to see you.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21CachinoTopic016 "{Tell Cachino the bosses plans have been disrupted}" [DIAL:0011BC66]
speaker: VMS21Cachino "Cachino" [NPC_:0010C6F5]

text_content: Whoa{surprised}, you managed to pull that off? Solid work. That ought to gum up the bosses' plans.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21CachinoTopic016 "{Tell Cachino the bosses plans have been disrupted}" [DIAL:0011BC66]
speaker: VMS21Cachino "Cachino" [NPC_:0010C6F5]

text_content: Well, what the fuck are you talking to me for? Go destroy the damn guns so we can move on.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21CachinoTopic016 "{Tell Cachino the bosses plans have been disrupted}" [DIAL:0011BC66]
speaker: VMS21Cachino "Cachino" [NPC_:0010C6F5]

text_content: Yeah, we saw the troopers come through. I can't imagine things are going to work out well for him.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21CachinoTopic016 "{Tell Cachino the bosses plans have been disrupted}" [DIAL:0011BC66]
speaker: VMS21Cachino "Cachino" [NPC_:0010C6F5]

text_content: Oh, is that right? Well I guess if he's gone, he's gone. I don't need to know anything more than that.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21CachinoTopic016 "{Tell Cachino the bosses plans have been disrupted}" [DIAL:0011BC66]
speaker: VMS21Cachino "Cachino" [NPC_:0010C6F5]

text_content: Oh, is that right? Was that your handiwork? Well I can't say I'm sad to see him go, he gave me the fucking creeps.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21CachinoTopic016 "{Tell Cachino the bosses plans have been disrupted}" [DIAL:0011BC66]
speaker: VMS21Cachino "Cachino" [NPC_:0010C6F5]

text_content: Could you repair some things for me?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSMickTopic008 "Could you repair some things for me?" [DIAL:0011BCA3]

text_content: Sure, let's see what you've got.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSMickTopic008 "Could you repair some things for me?" [DIAL:0011BCA3]
speaker: VFSMick "Mick" [NPC_:0010C761]

text_content: I'd like to talk about something else.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic018 "I'd like to talk about something else." [DIAL:0011BCA4]

text_content: What do you want to talk about?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic018 "I'd like to talk about something else." [DIAL:0011BCA4]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: What can you tell me about your organization?
name: VMS18VMS18MortimerTopic009 "What can you tell me about your organization?" [DIAL:0011BCC0]

text_content: My, such a popular question. I suppose it is only natural to see us and wonder what it is that makes us special.|The White Glove Society has only just made itself known to the public, of course, but our pedigree was established over generations.|Were we always so refined? I'd be lying if I said yes. But I've always felt we were destined for a place atop modern society. And now, here we are.|Not everyone can wear the finest clothes and eat the finest foods, obviously. That's just the reality we live in.|But surely we can agree that the most tasteful, sophisticated people are the most deserving. That's what the White Glove Society is all about.
name: VMS18VMS18MortimerTopic009 "What can you tell me about your organization?" [DIAL:0011BCC0]
speaker: VMS18Mortimer "Mortimer" [NPC_:0010D4E8]

text_content: What happened to Boulder City?
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCLieutenantMonroeTopic066 "What happened to Boulder City?" [DIAL:0011BEE3]

text_content: Destroyed during the Battle of Hoover Dam a couple of years ago. The town was set up as a trap for Caesar's Legion.|The sharpshooters in the Rangers picked off the Legion's veterans from a distance, and the rest of the Legion just rushed on in. Then - boom!
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCLieutenantMonroeTopic066 "What happened to Boulder City?" [DIAL:0011BEE3]
speaker: BCLieutenantMonroe "Lieutenant Monroe" [NPC_:0010C6DD]

text_content: He's a cunning bastard, Cachino. Told Nero and Big Sal he caught me spring cleaning my tributes to the family - can't do nothing against that viper.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic030 "How did Cachino get you out of the way?" [DIAL:00120647]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: Why don't you get her out of Gomorrah?
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic029 "Why don't you get her out of Gomorrah?" [DIAL:00120648]

text_content: What, you think I can just waltz in there and take her away? She's their doll now, okay?|Besides, I step in Gomorrah and I'm as good as dead, you hear? You don't just leave the Omertas unless it's in a body bag.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic029 "Why don't you get her out of Gomorrah?" [DIAL:00120648]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: Why not? It looks private enough for a midnight stunt.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic028 "Why not? It looks private enough for a midnight stunt." [DIAL:00120649]

text_content: Don't talk to me like that or I'll... I'll... have to get tough with you.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic027 "Don't talk to me like that or I'll... I'll... have to get tough with you." [DIAL:0012064A]

text_content: [FAILED] Ha ha ha! Okay, okay... stop or I'll choke, I swear. Listen, kid - I'll cut you some slack because nothing else in this town will, you hear?
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic027 "Don't talk to me like that or I'll... I'll... have to get tough with you." [DIAL:0012064A]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: Tell me again about the girl at Gomorrah that worries you.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic026 "Tell me again about the girl at Gomorrah that worries you." [DIAL:0012064B]

text_content: What about Joana?
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic026 "Tell me again about the girl at Gomorrah that worries you." [DIAL:0012064B]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: What did you say about working at Gomorrah?
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic025 "What did you say about working at Gomorrah?" [DIAL:0012064C]

text_content: It was heaven - until you find that all the glitter is made of broken dreams and all the praise hides a knife pointing at your ribs.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic025 "What did you say about working at Gomorrah?" [DIAL:0012064C]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: So you live in Vault 21?
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic024 "So you live in Vault 21?" [DIAL:0012064D]

text_content: This place has come a long way. Sarah takes care of it and she lets me stay, for now.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic024 "So you live in Vault 21?" [DIAL:0012064D]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: {Enthusiasm muffled by sadness}This place has come a long way, but ever since Sarah's death it is not the same.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic024 "So you live in Vault 21?" [DIAL:0012064D]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: Tell me about your past.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic023 "Tell me about your past." [DIAL:0012064E]

text_content: You know - straightening up bets, Gomorrah, success, women, all that shiny stuff.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic023 "Tell me about your past." [DIAL:0012064E]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: Wait a minute. What's that name again?
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic022 "Wait a minute. What's that name again?" [DIAL:0012064F]

text_content: No dice. I already opened my trap more than I should. Walls have ears even all the way down in this hole, you know? Can't trust nobody.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic022 "Wait a minute. What's that name again?" [DIAL:0012064F]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: I can keep a secret, Carlitos. About whom are you worried?
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic021 "I can keep a secret, Carlitos. About whom are you worried?" [DIAL:00120650]

text_content: I... Okay, it's Joana. She... works at Gomorrah. But it's all my fault! I met her at the Atomic Wrangler - beautiful doesn't even come close.|I moved her into Gomorrah. I was in love, okay? Then Cachino, backstabbing snake, got me out of the way so that he could have my girl.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic021 "I can keep a secret, Carlitos. About whom are you worried?" [DIAL:00120650]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: Why do you say that Vault 21 has come a long way?
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic020 "Why do you say that Vault 21 has come a long way?" [DIAL:00120651]

text_content: Because Mr. House ripped this place to shreds before filling it with concrete. Hey, I was untouchable once, but Mr. House's a god - you got that?
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic020 "Why do you say that Vault 21 has come a long way?" [DIAL:00120651]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: What does Sarah do around here?
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic019 "What does Sarah do around here?" [DIAL:00120652]

text_content: What doesn't she do, huh? Sarah makes this hole look like a palace - damn nice pair of gams on her too. She never walks outside, though.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic019 "What does Sarah do around here?" [DIAL:00120652]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: Let me ask you something else.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic018 "Let me ask you something else." [DIAL:00120653]

text_content: Anyone in Gomorrah you'd recommend for a good time?
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic017 "Anyone in Gomorrah you'd recommend for a good time?" [DIAL:00120654]

text_content: I'd recommend you save your caps and your skin. Check The Tops - no big time wiseguys there. Freeside's also fun, you know?|There's too much shit and despair at Gomorrah already. I don't want anybody making it worse for Jo... for the girls, you know?
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic017 "Anyone in Gomorrah you'd recommend for a good time?" [DIAL:00120654]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: Any important "wiseguys" that I should know about?
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic016 "Any important ""wiseguys"" that I should know about?" [DIAL:00120655]

text_content: Now, if you have to ask, you probably don't know shit about who you're dealing with, huh? Listen up - watch out for Cachino, that's all I'm saying.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic016 "Any important ""wiseguys"" that I should know about?" [DIAL:00120655]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: You spent some time at Gomorrah, then. What was it like?
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic015 "You spent some time at Gomorrah, then. What was it like?" [DIAL:00120656]

text_content: I didn't just spend time there, I lived there, okay? I was family. All I wanted, I had. Caps, booze, drugs, women, power, you name it.|It was heaven - until you find that all the glitter is made of broken dreams and all the praise hides a knife pointing at your ribs.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic015 "You spent some time at Gomorrah, then. What was it like?" [DIAL:00120656]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: You worked in Gomorrah as a Croupier, uh? What was it like?
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic014 "You worked in Gomorrah as a Croupier, uh? What was it like?" [DIAL:00120657]

text_content: Hey, you're smart. Okay, it was like finding diamonds in your vodka and showgirls under your card-table. You want it, Gomorrah has it.|It was heaven - until you find that all the glitter is made of broken dreams and all the praise hides a knife pointing at your ribs.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic014 "You worked in Gomorrah as a Croupier, uh? What was it like?" [DIAL:00120657]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: Any recommendations on where to go for some fun?
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic013 "Any recommendations on where to go for some fun?" [DIAL:00120658]

text_content: My recommendation, get the fuck out of town while you can. It'll leave you hanging in the wind or, worse, add your body to a concrete wall, okay?
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic013 "Any recommendations on where to go for some fun?" [DIAL:00120658]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: I've got other questions about you.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic012 "I've got other questions about you." [DIAL:00120659]

text_content: What are the important players in town?
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic011 "What are the important players in town?" [DIAL:0012065A]

text_content: Ha! There's only one important player in town, and that's Mr. House. Everyone keeps clean around him, the families, the barons - fuck, even the NCR.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic011 "What are the important players in town?" [DIAL:0012065A]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: Tell me about The Strip.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic010 "Tell me about The Strip." [DIAL:0012065B]

text_content: If you're smart, the Strip's all flash and noise. If not, luck's your dame, your hot date, until you find she's a cheap whore high on Jet.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic010 "Tell me about The Strip." [DIAL:0012065B]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: Let me ask you about New Vegas.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic009 "Let me ask you about New Vegas." [DIAL:0012065C]

text_content: All right. What do you want to know?
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic009 "Let me ask you about New Vegas." [DIAL:0012065C]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: If Vault 21 is your "bottom of the barrel" then I'd say you could've done worse.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic008 "If Vault 21 is your ""bottom of the barrel"" then I'd say you could've done worse." [DIAL:0012065D]

text_content: Yeah, I could've ended buried in the sands with just my head sticking out. Ants love that - a riot, know what I mean?|This place has come a long way. Sarah takes care of it and she lets me stay, for now.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic008 "If Vault 21 is your ""bottom of the barrel"" then I'd say you could've done worse." [DIAL:0012065D]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: Yeah, I could've ended buried in the sands with just my head sticking out. Ants love that - a riot, know what I mean?|{Enthusiasm muffled by sadness}This place has come a long way, but ever since Sarah's death it is not the same.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic008 "If Vault 21 is your ""bottom of the barrel"" then I'd say you could've done worse." [DIAL:0012065D]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: How high was that fall?
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic007 "How high was that fall?" [DIAL:0012065E]

text_content: From the top! Where else, uh? I am Carlitos - my fingers work the magic and my hands deal the luck!|There was no player who'd stood a chance, no wiseguy who didn't fear me, and no doll who could resist me. Gomorrah was my kingdom, Carlitos' turf!
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic007 "How high was that fall?" [DIAL:0012065E]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: Sounds like you're in trouble. What's the deal?
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic006 "Sounds like you're in trouble. What's the deal?" [DIAL:0012065F]

text_content: Who isn't in trouble in New Vegas, uh? Sooner or later, you hit the bottom of the barrel - I just happened to fall harder than most, is all.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic006 "Sounds like you're in trouble. What's the deal?" [DIAL:0012065F]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: I am just one more loser that got the evil-eye from Lady Luck - hard fall. Now I lay at the bottom and keep to myself.
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic006 "Sounds like you're in trouble. What's the deal?" [DIAL:0012065F]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: All right. About what do you want to know?
name: VMS21aCarlitosWayneTopic006 "Sounds like you're in trouble. What's the deal?" [DIAL:0012065F]
speaker: CarlitosWayne "Carlitos" [NPC_:0011F862]

text_content: You've got them all wrong.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic054 "You've got them all wrong." [DIAL:001206D9]

text_content: Wrong, huh? And I suppose they sent all of these soldiers just to make nice. Lucky me.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic054 "You've got them all wrong." [DIAL:001206D9]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: Actually, they want to make you an offer.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic053 "Actually, they want to make you an offer." [DIAL:001206DA]

text_content: An offer, huh? All right, let's hear it.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic053 "Actually, they want to make you an offer." [DIAL:001206DA]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: VFSKingHsuOfferStart
name: VFSKingHsuOfferStart "VFSKingHsuOfferStart" [DIAL:001206DB]

text_content: Let me guess. The NCR couldn't get me to dance to their tune so now they're asking again a little less nicely, right?
name: VFSKingHsuOfferStart "VFSKingHsuOfferStart" [DIAL:001206DB]

text_content: VFSNCRCaptainAttacksTheKing
name: VFSNCRCaptainAttacksTheKing "VFSNCRCaptainAttacksTheKing" [DIAL:001206DC]

text_content: Sounds like he's not going to cooperate, men. Open fire!
name: VFSNCRCaptainAttacksTheKing "VFSNCRCaptainAttacksTheKing" [DIAL:001206DC]

text_content: The NCR is just trying to protect its people.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic052 "The NCR is just trying to protect its people." [DIAL:001206DD]

text_content: And I'm trying to protect mine. If the NCR wants peace so much, the first step would be to get these soldiers out of here.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic052 "The NCR is just trying to protect its people." [DIAL:001206DD]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: {Speech check >= 80}
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic051 "{Speech check >= 80}" [DIAL:001206DE]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Honestly, I hadn't thought it through that far. I'd guess someone would come and take over this place.|And you can be damn sure they won't run it like the King, baby. They might run everyone out, or enslave them, or worse.|I guess I have no choice. Tell your NCR masters that I accept their terms. I'll see that violence against their people is dealt with.|Now take these fools and get out of here before they start a riot.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic051 "{Speech check >= 80}" [DIAL:001206DE]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: [FAILED] My momma didn't raise no quitter, and I stand by my beliefs. The answer is no.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic051 "{Speech check >= 80}" [DIAL:001206DE]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: These men have orders to kill you all if you refuse. Are you sure?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic050 "These men have orders to kill you all if you refuse. Are you sure?" [DIAL:001206DF]

text_content: That I don't want to sign away my freedom and that of all the people I'm responsible for at gunpoint? Yeah, I'm sure.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic050 "These men have orders to kill you all if you refuse. Are you sure?" [DIAL:001206DF]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: There's still time to solve this peacefully.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic049 "There's still time to solve this peacefully." [DIAL:001206E0]

text_content: Says the one with a squad of armed soldiers behind them. No, I don't think a peaceful solution is possible. Not anymore.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic049 "There's still time to solve this peacefully." [DIAL:001206E0]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: The violence needs to stop.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic048 "The violence needs to stop." [DIAL:001206E1]

text_content: And whose job is it to stop it? Yours? Mine? Who are we to tell people what to do? No man has that right.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic048 "The violence needs to stop." [DIAL:001206E1]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: I'm afraid so.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic047 "I'm afraid so." [DIAL:001206E2]

text_content: Then I must refuse. The people here have the right to do what they want and are beholden to none. I won't take that away from them.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic047 "I'm afraid so." [DIAL:001206E2]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: VFSKingUltimatumStart
name: VFSKingUltimatumStart "VFSKingUltimatumStart" [DIAL:001206E3]

text_content: Let me guess. The NCR couldn't get me to dance to their tune so now they're asking again a little less nicely, right?
name: VFSKingUltimatumStart "VFSKingUltimatumStart" [DIAL:001206E3]

text_content: Nope. I'm to go to Freeside and shoot up some Kings.
name: VFreeformHooverDamHDColonelMooreTopic004 "Nope. I'm to go to Freeside and shoot up some Kings." [DIAL:001206E4]

text_content: Not exactly. Give them the chance to do the right thing at least. Personally, I doubt they'll do it.|Crocker's been making overtures to these savages for months and gotten nowhere. Expect a fight, but don't look for one.|Dismissed.
name: VFreeformHooverDamHDColonelMooreTopic004 "Nope. I'm to go to Freeside and shoot up some Kings." [DIAL:001206E4]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: This plan seems awfully confrontational.
name: VFreeformHooverDamHDColonelMooreTopic003 "This plan seems awfully confrontational." [DIAL:001206E5]

text_content: Do you have any idea what our current situation is? As we speak there is a huge army of madmen not ten miles from here waiting to kill us all.|We don't have the luxury of long-term diplomacy any longer. Anyone that could prove a hindrance in the battle to come must be dealt with swiftly.|You have your orders. I expect you to carry them out.|Dismissed.
name: VFreeformHooverDamHDColonelMooreTopic003 "This plan seems awfully confrontational." [DIAL:001206E5]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: No ma'am.
name: VFreeformHooverDamHDColonelMooreTopic002 "No ma'am." [DIAL:001206E6]

text_content: Good. When the task is done, report back to Crocker. My men have other orders and will return here on their own to make their report.|Dismissed.
name: VFreeformHooverDamHDColonelMooreTopic002 "No ma'am." [DIAL:001206E6]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: Ambassador Crocker said to come see you about Freeside.
name: VFreeformHooverDamHDColonelMooreTopic001 "Ambassador Crocker said to come see you about Freeside." [DIAL:001206E7]

text_content: You say Crocker sent you? Let me see... I just received a memo regarding him recently and haven't had a chance to read it in detail.|Ah, the matter with the so-called Kings. Crocker's been wringing his hands while good people die for too long, and now the matter's fallen to me.|Unlike the good ambassador, I don't intend to blink. Tell the leader of this gang to stand down or face annihilation.|That is his choice. If he chooses the latter, a squad of my men will be there to back you up. Any questions?
name: VFreeformHooverDamHDColonelMooreTopic001 "Ambassador Crocker said to come see you about Freeside." [DIAL:001206E7]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: You know, I just received the strangest memo about Freeside. It said that Colonel Hsu has already dispatched a squad to take care of the problem.|I'll let Hsu's men deal with things, but the good ambassador is going to learn a harsh lesson regarding protocol.|I trust you can find your own way out.
name: VFreeformHooverDamHDColonelMooreTopic001 "Ambassador Crocker said to come see you about Freeside." [DIAL:001206E7]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: I was, uh, just sightseeing. Sorry to bother you.
name: VFreeformHooverDamHDColonelMooreTopic000 "I was, uh, just sightseeing. Sorry to bother you." [DIAL:001206E8]

text_content: Then I suggest you make your way back outside. My men have orders to shoot anyone caught sneaking around in sensitive areas.
name: VFreeformHooverDamHDColonelMooreTopic000 "I was, uh, just sightseeing. Sorry to bother you." [DIAL:001206E8]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: I think the authorities would like to hear these tapes I found in your safe.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21ClandenTopic018 "I think the authorities would like to hear these tapes I found in your safe." [DIAL:00120822]

text_content: I think I should kill you before you have a chance to show those tapes to anyone. What do I have to lose?
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21ClandenTopic018 "I think the authorities would like to hear these tapes I found in your safe." [DIAL:00120822]
speaker: VMS21Clanden "Clanden" [NPC_:0010C6F9]

text_content: VMS21ClandenMurderRoom
name: VMS21ClandenMurderRoom "VMS21ClandenMurderRoom" [DIAL:00120823]

text_content: {Angry}What the fuck are you trying to pull here? Where is my girl? Now I'm gonna have to kill your sorry ass.
name: VMS21ClandenMurderRoom "VMS21ClandenMurderRoom" [DIAL:00120823]
speaker: VMS21Clanden "Clanden" [NPC_:0010C6F9]

text_content: Ok little lady, let's get started. You look like a tough piece of meat, I'm going to enjoy tenderizing you.
name: VMS21ClandenMurderRoom "VMS21ClandenMurderRoom" [DIAL:00120823]
speaker: VMS21Clanden "Clanden" [NPC_:0010C6F9]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21ClandenTopic017 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00120824]

text_content: Get lost.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21ClandenTopic017 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00120824]
speaker: VMS21Clanden "Clanden" [NPC_:0010C6F9]

text_content: Sorry, I was thinking about someone else. I have a different question though.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21ClandenTopic016 "Sorry, I was thinking about someone else. I have a different question though." [DIAL:00120825]

text_content: Alright, but you're starting to get on my nerves.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21ClandenTopic016 "Sorry, I was thinking about someone else. I have a different question though." [DIAL:00120825]
speaker: VMS21Clanden "Clanden" [NPC_:0010C6F9]

text_content: I thought that maybe I could be your next playtoy. Your exploits are well known.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21ClandenTopic015 "I thought that maybe I could be your next playtoy. Your exploits are well known." [DIAL:00120826]

text_content: Well, look at you! It's so rare I get a volunteer. Yes, let's head to my special room. Follow me, we'll talk there.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21ClandenTopic015 "I thought that maybe I could be your next playtoy. Your exploits are well known." [DIAL:00120826]
speaker: VMS21Clanden "Clanden" [NPC_:0010C6F9]

text_content: {Speech Options}
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21ClandenTopic005 "{Speech Options}" [DIAL:00120827]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED]{Excited} Oh, already? I figured it would be a couple days. Well, let's go meet the lucky lady.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21ClandenTopic005 "{Speech Options}" [DIAL:00120827]
speaker: VMS21Clanden "Clanden" [NPC_:0010C6F9]

text_content: [FAILED]{Laughs} I don't care much about your tastes. Get lost and leave me alone.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21ClandenTopic005 "{Speech Options}" [DIAL:00120827]
speaker: VMS21Clanden "Clanden" [NPC_:0010C6F9]

text_content: I hear you have some exotic tastes when it comes to women.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21ClandenTopic003 "I hear you have some exotic tastes when it comes to women." [DIAL:00120828]

text_content: {Annoyed}Oh did you now? What business is that of yours, and why the fuck should I care?
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21ClandenTopic003 "I hear you have some exotic tastes when it comes to women." [DIAL:00120828]
speaker: VMS21Clanden "Clanden" [NPC_:0010C6F9]

text_content: VMS21ClandenArrest01
name: VMS21ClandenArrest01 "VMS21ClandenArrest01" [DIAL:00120829]

text_content: VMS21ClandenArrest
name: VMS21ClandenArrest "VMS21ClandenArrest" [DIAL:0012082A]

text_content: Clanden, under the authority of the New California Republic, I place you under arrest for murder.
name: VMS21ClandenArrest "VMS21ClandenArrest" [DIAL:0012082A]

text_content: What? Are you fucking kidding me? You can't do this, the Omertas aren't going to stand by and let you arrest me.

text_content: VFSPacerBetrays
name: VFSPacerBetrays "VFSPacerBetrays" [DIAL:00120F8A]

text_content: And you. Bringing these assholes in here like you're doing us some kind of favor.|You can take your new friends and get the hell out of here, because the answer is no. The Kings will never deal with trash from the NCR.

name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic063 "No catch. You just make sure no King attack an NCR citizen from now on." [DIAL:00120F8B]

text_content: That's not so bad. I might have to make an example of a few of the more hotheaded guys, but otherwise, that sounds fair.|Tell you what. I'll agree to those terms. But the Kings won't lift a finger until we see the first of those supplies.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic063 "No catch. You just make sure no King attack an NCR citizen from now on." [DIAL:00120F8B]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: They're just here as an escort. Now do you want to hear their offer or not?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic062 "They're just here as an escort. Now do you want to hear their offer or not?" [DIAL:00120F8C]

text_content: The Kings have to stop the violence against people from the NCR.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic060 "The Kings have to stop the violence against people from the NCR." [DIAL:00120F8D]

text_content: Hmmm, people around here *would* be a lot less ornery if there were more supplies to go around. It'd be rough at first, but I think we could manage.|Tell you what. I'll agree to those terms. But the Kings won't lift a finger until we see the first of those supplies.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic060 "The Kings have to stop the violence against people from the NCR." [DIAL:00120F8D]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: You stop the attacks on NCR citizens, and your supply problems disappear.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic059 "You stop the attacks on NCR citizens, and your supply problems disappear." [DIAL:00120F8E]

text_content: Just hear them out. They're offering generous terms.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic058 "Just hear them out. They're offering generous terms." [DIAL:00120F8F]

text_content: The NCR is willing to help supply Freeside in exchange for peace.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic057 "The NCR is willing to help supply Freeside in exchange for peace." [DIAL:00120F90]

text_content: Freeside gets more food, water, and electricity.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic056 "Freeside gets more food, water, and electricity." [DIAL:00120F91]

text_content: That doesn't sound half bad... what's the catch?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic056 "Freeside gets more food, water, and electricity." [DIAL:00120F91]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: What if they are?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic055 "What if they are?" [DIAL:00120F92]

text_content: Then I'm afraid we're going to have ourselves a tussle. Now say what you came to say or get out.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic055 "What if they are?" [DIAL:00120F92]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: I can't give you these tapes, they are evidence of a crime.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21ClandenTopic020 "I can't give you these tapes, they are evidence of a crime." [DIAL:001210B2]

text_content: I guess you've made your choice then. Time to die.
name: vDialogueGomorrahVMS21ClandenTopic020 "I can't give you these tapes, they are evidence of a crime." [DIAL:001210B2]

text_content: VNelsonNelsonRangerMiloTopic000
name: VNelsonNelsonRangerMiloTopic000 "VNelsonNelsonRangerMiloTopic000" [DIAL:001213AE]

text_content: I found the supplies you were looking for.
name: VMS30VCFHCarlMayesTopic004 "I found the supplies you were looking for." [DIAL:00121FF9]

text_content: I take it my men were dead. It's a high price to pay, but these supplies will save a few lives here.|Thanks for finding these. You should check in with the Major, he'll want to know about this.

speaker: VCFHCarlMayes "Quartermaster Mayes" [NPC_:00120DCE]

text_content: Major Polatli sent me to help you out.
name: VMS30VCFHCarlMayesTopic000 "Major Polatli sent me to help you out." [DIAL:00121FFD]

text_content: So the Major has you running errands for him. Well, we're short on personnel as well as supplies so we'll take all the help we can get.
name: VMS30VCFHCarlMayesTopic000 "Major Polatli sent me to help you out." [DIAL:00121FFD]
speaker: VCFHCarlMayes "Quartermaster Mayes" [NPC_:00120DCE]

text_content: Major Polatli said you might need some help.
name: VMS30VCFHAlexRichardsTopic000 "Major Polatli said you might need some help." [DIAL:0012200E]

text_content: With business booming like it is and considering I'm the only person with medical experience in the camp, I could perhaps use a hand.|Do you have any medical experience?
name: VMS30VCFHAlexRichardsTopic000 "Major Polatli said you might need some help." [DIAL:0012200E]
speaker: VCFHAlexRichards "Dr. Richards" [NPC_:00120DCD]

text_content: I don't have time for this.
name: VMS30VCFHMajorPolatliTopic002 "I don't have time for this." [DIAL:00122011]

text_content: I'll be here if you change your mind.
name: VMS30VCFHMajorPolatliTopic002 "I don't have time for this." [DIAL:00122011]
speaker: VCFHMajorPolatli "Major Polatli" [NPC_:00120DCC]

text_content: I could do that for you.
name: VMS30VCFHMajorPolatliTopic001 "I could do that for you." [DIAL:00122012]

text_content: Good, let's not waste time then. Our biggest problems right now are supplies and troops, and the Legion is draining us of both.|Quartermaster Mayes has been complaining to me nonstop about the lack of supplies, but unfortunately we aren't getting a resupply any time soon.|I want you speak with him and see if there's anything you can do for him.
name: VMS30VCFHMajorPolatliTopic001 "I could do that for you." [DIAL:00122012]
speaker: VCFHMajorPolatli "Major Polatli" [NPC_:00120DCC]

text_content: What do you need help with?
name: VMS30VCFHMajorPolatliTopic000 "What do you need help with?" [DIAL:00122013]

text_content: I'm short staffed and I don't have the time to take care of some issues around the camp.|I need someone to talk to a few of the officers and help them resolve some of the problems around here.
name: VMS30VCFHMajorPolatliTopic000 "What do you need help with?" [DIAL:00122013]
speaker: VCFHMajorPolatli "Major Polatli" [NPC_:00120DCC]

text_content: I've got the Legion at Nelson breathing down my neck and not enough men or supplies to get this camp into fighting shape so we can strike back.|I need someone to talk to a few of the officers and help them resolve some of the problems around here.|If I can get this place in order, then I can focus our efforts on taking back Nelson from the Legion.|And the more that gets done around here, the more resources I'll be able to put into assaulting Nelson.
name: VMS30VCFHMajorPolatliTopic000 "What do you need help with?" [DIAL:00122013]
speaker: VCFHMajorPolatli "Major Polatli" [NPC_:00120DCC]

name: VMS30VCFHCarlMayesTopic005 "Speaking of supplies... I found some nearby, are they yours?" [DIAL:00122014]

text_content: Damn it all... I sent some men out to get these supplies, but they never returned. I guess the Legion got them on their way back.|At least we have the supplies. It's not much, but every little bit counts.|Thanks for finding these. You should check in with the Major, he'll want to know about this.

name: VMS30VCFHMajorPolatliTopic005 "What do you want me to do now?" [DIAL:00122B57]

text_content: With the help you've given us, we're doing a little bit better, but we still have the Legion forces at Nelson to deal with.|If we can retake Nelson, that will be a huge help to our efforts in this area and give us an advantage at Hoover Dam.
name: VMS30VCFHMajorPolatliTopic005 "What do you want me to do now?" [DIAL:00122B57]
speaker: VCFHMajorPolatli "Major Polatli" [NPC_:00120DCC]

name: VMS30VCFHMajorPolatliTopic011 "I've finished helping Dr. Richards." [DIAL:00122B58]

text_content: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic023 "Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?" [DIAL:00124A1D]

text_content: I used imperial Rome as the model for my Legion precisely because it was so foreign, so {beat}alien.|I'd seen what had become of the NCR's attempts to emulate the culture of Pre-War America - the in-fighting, the corruption.|Rome was a highly militarized autocracy that effectively integrated the foreign cultures it conquered.|It dedicated its citizens to something higher than themselves - to the idea of Rome itself.|In Rome I found a template for a society equal to the challenges of the post-apocalyptic world - a society that could and would survive.|A society that could prevent mankind from fracturing and destroying itself in this new world, by establishing a new {packs Ro-MAH-na}Pax Romana.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic023 "Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?" [DIAL:00124A1D]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: It means a {taking time with each term}nationalist, imperialist, totalitarian, homogenous culture that obliterates the identity of every group it conquers.|Long-term stability at all costs. The individual has no value beyond his utility to the state, whether as an instrument of war, or production.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic023 "Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?" [DIAL:00124A1D]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: No, I'll destroy it because it's inevitable that it be destroyed. It's {heh-GEHL-ee-an}Hegelian Dialectics, not personal animosity.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic023 "Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?" [DIAL:00124A1D]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: {enjoying the superiority of teacher}How do I put this basically enough? It's a philosophical theory, the kind you might encounter if you took time to read some books.|The fundamental premise is to envision history as a sequence of "dialectical" conflicts. Each dialectic begins with a proposition, a {emphasis}thesis...|...which inherently contains, or creates, its opposite - an antithesis. Thesis and antithesis. The conflict is inevitable.|But the resolution of the conflict yields something new - a synthesis - eliminating the flaws in each, leaving behind common elements and ideas.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic023 "Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?" [DIAL:00124A1D]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: The bombs wiped the slate clean. Human civilization descended to a level of ignorance that effectively set our cultural progress back to zero.|The NCR has all of the problems of the ancient Roman Republic - extreme bureaucracy, corruption, extensive senatorial infighting.|Just as with the ancient Republic, it is natural that a military force should conquer and transform the NCR into a military dictatorship.|Thesis and antithesis. The Colorado River is my Rubicon. The NCR council will be {beat}eradicated, but the new synthesis will change the Legion as well...|...from a basically nomadic army to a standing military force that protects its citizens, {finality}and the power of its dictator.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic023 "Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?" [DIAL:00124A1D]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: How did you rise to power?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic022 "How did you rise to power?" [DIAL:00124A1E]

text_content: Ironically, I was born a Profligate myself, a citizen of the NCR.|My family lived not far from the great Boneyard. After Raiders killed my father, my mother sought the Followers' protection. I was two years old.|She found work at their Library, cooking and cleaning. I learned how to read and soon I was taking courses, free of charge.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic022 "How did you rise to power?" [DIAL:00124A1E]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Oh yes, raised in that tradition. And the teaching stuck. I was taught it was my responsibility to bring the torch of knowledge to the wastes.|{joking about your conquests}I may have taken the torch part more literally than they intended.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic022 "How did you rise to power?" [DIAL:00124A1E]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: When I was 20, the Followers sent me East to Grand Canyon. It was my first expedition, just me and a physician named Calhoun.|As an anthropologist and linguist, my assignment was to learn the dialects of the Grand Canyon tribes. What a fucking waste of time!{get alternate take with "What a waste of time that would've been!"}
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic022 "How did you rise to power?" [DIAL:00124A1E]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: If you think it's worthwhile to make smart people learn how to talk like backward savages, you're a Follower of the Apocalypse... or an idiot.|Anyway, we met up with a Mormon missionary who already knew a bunch of dialects - Joshua Graham. He was supposed to teach me.|But before that went too far, the Blackfoot tribe captured us, to hold us for ransom.|They were a backward bunch. But the real problem was, they didn't know how to fight.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic022 "How did you rise to power?" [DIAL:00124A1E]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: The Blackfoot were at war with seven other tribes, each just as pissant as they were. But outnumbered like that, they weren't going to last long.|It's one thing to be taken hostage, another to be lashed to a sinking ship. So over Calhoun's objections, I decided to take certain steps.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic022 "How did you rise to power?" [DIAL:00124A1E]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: I taught them how to use the guns they already had - how to strip and clean them, how to breathe when pulling a trigger, how to reload ammunition.|They looked at me like I was some kind of a sorcerer. So I taught them how to make explosives, and started drilling them on small unit tactics.|{amused}If there's anything I learned as a Follower of the Apocalypse, it's that there's a lot of good information in old books.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic022 "How did you rise to power?" [DIAL:00124A1E]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: {LATIN}{dih-WE-day et im-PEER-ah}Divide et impera - divide and conquer. I led the Blackfoot against the Ridgers, their weakest enemy.|When they refused to surrender, I ordered every man, woman, and child killed. When next we surrounded the Kaibabs and they likewise refused...|I took one of their envoys to the Ridgers' village and showed him the corpse piles.|This was new for the tribes, you see. They played at war, raiding each other, a little rape and pillage here, a little ransoming there.|I showed them total warfare. Like I said, there's a lot you can learn from old books.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic022 "How did you rise to power?" [DIAL:00124A1E]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: The Kaibabs joined me, and the Fredonians after that - all the pissant tribes, with names that should be forgotten.|I knew from the start I'd need to eradicate this plague of tribal identities, replacing them with a monolithic culture, a uniform identity.|So that's what I did, once my confederation of tribes was large enough. I crowned myself {KAI-zar}Caesar and created a single Great Tribe - my Legion.|I sent Calhoun, the Follower captured with me, back West with a message that I should not be interfered with.|Joshua Graham, the Mormon interpreter, stayed with me and served as my first {leh-GAH-tus}Legatus.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic022 "How did you rise to power?" [DIAL:00124A1E]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: That's right. Decades of warfare, absorbing lesser tribes, gathering power. Forging the dross into a vast, razor-sharp scythe.|My Legion's expansion has never ceased. Much of the Utah and Colorado, and all of Arizona and New Mexico, are mine.|We have cities of our own, but nothing compared to Vegas. Finally, my Legion will have its Rome.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic022 "How did you rise to power?" [DIAL:00124A1E]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: What do you think of the NCR?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic019 "What do you think of the NCR?" [DIAL:00124A21]

text_content: Do you want my opinion as a former citizen, or future conqueror? {shrug}Actually, my opinion's the same either way.|As a young man I was taught to venerate {mocking slightly}President Tandi of Shady Sands. "The Founding Mother of the New California Republic."|Did you know her Presidency lasted 52 years? And that her father, Aradesh, was the Republic's first President?|Does that sound like democracy to you, or a hereditary dictatorship?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic019 "What do you think of the NCR?" [DIAL:00124A21]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Because the council didn't dare oppose her. She was too popular. She had the people's love.|So things ran smoothly, more or less. And as soon as she was gone, as soon as there really could be "democracy" - what happened then?|Ever since losing its queen, the NCR has been weaker, more diffuse. Democracy has been its weakness, not its strength.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic019 "What do you think of the NCR?" [DIAL:00124A21]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Greed runs rampant. The government is corrupt, accepting bribes from Brahmin barons and landowners, to the detriment of citizens.|The NCR is a loose conglomerate of individuals looking out for themselves. It's lost virtue. No one cares about the collective, the greater good.|It's not built to last. I'm just hastening the inevitable.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic019 "What do you think of the NCR?" [DIAL:00124A21]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Of course. The most powerful my Legion has faced. Also the first to which I am {beat}ideologically opposed.|Until now, every tribe I've conquered has been so backwards and stunted, enslavement has been a gift bestowed upon them.|My conquest of the Mojave will be a glorious triumph, marking the transition of the Legion from a basically nomadic tribe to a genuine empire.|Just as my namesake campaigned in Gaul before he crossed the Rubicon, so have I campaigned, and will cross the Colorado.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic019 "What do you think of the NCR?" [DIAL:00124A21]

text_content: There were tales once, of a cannibal tribe near Vegas, one that hid itself in a cavern far below ground, hunting men as prey above.|The scouts I occasionally sent west many years ago reported these tales, but never had contact. Well, except the ones who went missing, perhaps.|There are rumors that the White Gloves might be this lost tribe. Maybe you can help them find themselves.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic015 "What do you know of the White Glove Society?" [DIAL:00124A24]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Culture is an odd thing. Sometimes a tribe grows tired of its identity, grabs for an opportunity to reimagine itself.|The tribe becomes its own antithesis. name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic015 "What do you know of the White Glove Society?" [DIAL:00124A24]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: How're things around camp?
name: VMS30VCFHAlexRichardsTopic017 "How're things around camp?" [DIAL:00125346]

text_content: With the Legion defeated, things are great now.
name: VMS30VCFHAlexRichardsTopic017 "How're things around camp?" [DIAL:00125346]
speaker: VCFHAlexRichards "Dr. Richards" [NPC_:00120DCD]

text_content: Things are better now that the Legion at Nelson have been defeated.
name: VMS30VCFHAlexRichardsTopic017 "How're things around camp?" [DIAL:00125346]
speaker: VCFHAlexRichards "Dr. Richards" [NPC_:00120DCD]

text_content: We're doing okay for the time being. Not as many serious injuries lately.
name: VMS30VCFHAlexRichardsTopic017 "How're things around camp?" [DIAL:00125346]
speaker: VCFHAlexRichards "Dr. Richards" [NPC_:00120DCD]

text_content: If I was a mortician, business would be booming. As a Doctor, business is hard. Too many injuries that I can't do anything about.
name: VMS30VCFHAlexRichardsTopic017 "How're things around camp?" [DIAL:00125346]
speaker: VCFHAlexRichards "Dr. Richards" [NPC_:00120DCD]

text_content: The Legion has been hitting us pretty hard lately. Lots of casualties, not many people I can save.
name: VMS30VCFHAlexRichardsTopic017 "How're things around camp?" [DIAL:00125346]
speaker: VCFHAlexRichards "Dr. Richards" [NPC_:00120DCD]

text_content: I've studied lots of medicology.
name: VMS30VCFHAlexRichardsTopic016 "I've studied lots of medicology." [DIAL:00125347]

text_content: [FAILED] Ahh... I see. Unfortunately you're experience with "medicology" isn't going to be any use to me here.|Just take this status report back to Major Polatli. That's all I need from you.
name: VMS30VCFHAlexRichardsTopic016 "I've studied lots of medicology." [DIAL:00125347]
speaker: VCFHAlexRichards "Dr. Richards" [NPC_:00120DCD]

text_content: I want to talk about the attack on Nelson.
name: VMS30VCFHMajorPolatliTopic016 "I want to talk about the attack on Nelson." [DIAL:00125348]

text_content: Are you ready?
name: VMS30VCFHMajorPolatliTopic016 "I want to talk about the attack on Nelson." [DIAL:00125348]
speaker: VCFHMajorPolatli "Major Polatli" [NPC_:00120DCC]

text_content: The initial reports have come back already. Excellent work. This will buy us a lot of breathing room to get back on our feet here.|Now we can actually try to strengthen our forces along the river and prepare for the upcoming battle at Hoover Dam.|You have my thanks, we owe you a lot.
name: VMS30VCFHMajorPolatliTopic016 "I want to talk about the attack on Nelson." [DIAL:00125348]
speaker: VCFHMajorPolatli "Major Polatli" [NPC_:00120DCC]

text_content: I'd like to give you something to thank you for helping us.
name: VMS30VCFHMajorPolatliTopic016 "I want to talk about the attack on Nelson." [DIAL:00125348]
speaker: VCFHMajorPolatli "Major Polatli" [NPC_:00120DCC]

text_content: Is there any intel on the Legion forces at Nelson?
name: VMS30VCFHMajorPolatliTopic006 "Is there any intel on the Legion forces at Nelson?" [DIAL:00125349]

text_content: The Legion forces have been reinforced and are looking pretty strong. It's going to be a tough fight.
name: VMS30VCFHMajorPolatliTopic006 "Is there any intel on the Legion forces at Nelson?" [DIAL:00125349]
speaker: VCFHMajorPolatli "Major Polatli" [NPC_:00120DCC]

text_content: The Legion forces are hurting pretty bad, actually. This is the perfect opportunity for us.
name: VMS30VCFHMajorPolatliTopic006 "Is there any intel on the Legion forces at Nelson?" [DIAL:00125349]
speaker: VCFHMajorPolatli "Major Polatli" [NPC_:00120DCC]

text_content: Reports have the Legion forces at Nelson sizable, but not insurmountable.
name: VMS30VCFHMajorPolatliTopic006 "Is there any intel on the Legion forces at Nelson?" [DIAL:00125349]
speaker: VCFHMajorPolatli "Major Polatli" [NPC_:00120DCC]

text_content: Do you have the troops to retake Nelson?
name: VMS30VCFHMajorPolatliTopic004 "Do you have the troops to retake Nelson?" [DIAL:0012534A]

text_content: Not really, but we don't have much choice. If you help out more around the camp I could spare some additional men for the battle.
name: VMS30VCFHMajorPolatliTopic004 "Do you have the troops to retake Nelson?" [DIAL:0012534A]
speaker: VCFHMajorPolatli "Major Polatli" [NPC_:00120DCC]

text_content: We have a decent amount of men, but it'll be a close battle. If you help out more around the camp, I could probably spare some additional troops.
name: VMS30VCFHMajorPolatliTopic004 "Do you have the troops to retake Nelson?" [DIAL:0012534A]
speaker: VCFHMajorPolatli "Major Polatli" [NPC_:00120DCC]

text_content: We've been reinforced fairly well, thanks to your help. I'd say the odds are in our favor.|However, if you help out a little more around the camp, we'd be in a good enough position to send our best men to help retake Nelson.
name: VMS30VCFHMajorPolatliTopic004 "Do you have the troops to retake Nelson?" [DIAL:0012534A]
speaker: VCFHMajorPolatli "Major Polatli" [NPC_:00120DCC]

text_content: Thanks to your help, we have more than enough men to take those Legion bastards.
name: VMS30VCFHMajorPolatliTopic004 "Do you have the troops to retake Nelson?" [DIAL:0012534A]
speaker: VCFHMajorPolatli "Major Polatli" [NPC_:00120DCC]

text_content: I did what I could for your patients.

text_content: Thanks for your help. I'll take it from here.|I'll send Major Polatli word about the situation here.

speaker: VCFHAlexRichards "Dr. Richards" [NPC_:00120DCD]

speaker: VCFHAlexRichards "Dr. Richards" [NPC_:00120DCD]

text_content: We really need those supplies, so don't take your sweet time finding them.

text_content: Make it quick, I don't have time to stand around talking all day long.

text_content: This sounds pretty dangerous.

speaker: VCFHCarlMayes "Quartermaster Mayes" [NPC_:00120DCE]

speaker: VCFHCarlMayes "Quartermaster Mayes" [NPC_:00120DCE]

text_content: Any idea on where I should start looking?
name: VMS30VCFHCarlMayesTopic017 "Any idea on where I should start looking?" [DIAL:00125350]

text_content: I sent them to HELIOS One to see if they had any supplies they could spare. They've got to be somewhere between here and there.|I'd try searching the main road, or checking with the men at HELIOS One to see if they know anything.

speaker: VMSTopsHadrian "Hadrian" [NPC_:0011F9B9]

speaker: VMSTopsHadrian "Hadrian" [NPC_:0011F9B9]

text_content: How about a hand for the Rad Pack, the band that inspired that great saying, "Stop the music!"

speaker: VMSTopsHadrian "Hadrian" [NPC_:0011F9B9]

speaker: VMSTopsHadrian "Hadrian" [NPC_:0011F9B9]

text_content: TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings
name: TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings "TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings" [DIAL:00125441]

text_content: It's great to be here at the Tops, folks. The room I'm in has a lovely little closet. A nail.
name: TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings "TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings" [DIAL:00125441]
speaker: VMSTopsBillyKnight "Billy Knight" [NPC_:0011F9BA]

text_content: Thank you everybody, you've been a great audience, good night.
name: TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings "TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings" [DIAL:00125441]
speaker: VMSTopsBillyKnight "Billy Knight" [NPC_:0011F9BA]

text_content: It's hard to sleep in this place, I tell you. Last night some girl was pounding on my door all night. Finally I had to let her out.
name: TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings "TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings" [DIAL:00125441]
speaker: VMSTopsBillyKnight "Billy Knight" [NPC_:0011F9BA]

text_content: They really care about your privacy here at the Tops. Even room service has an unlisted number!
name: TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings "TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings" [DIAL:00125441]
speaker: VMSTopsBillyKnight "Billy Knight" [NPC_:0011F9BA]

text_content: My hotel room is so small, when I put the key in the lock, I broke the window!
name: TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings "TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings" [DIAL:00125441]
speaker: VMSTopsBillyKnight "Billy Knight" [NPC_:0011F9BA]

text_content: How about that suit Benny wears? If I had a suit like that, the ladies would be all over me. What, you expect a punchline? This guy pays my salary!
name: TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings "TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings" [DIAL:00125441]
speaker: VMSTopsBillyKnight "Billy Knight" [NPC_:0011F9BA]

text_content: I told my wife she was good-looking for a ghoul. It's just too bad she's not a ghoul.
name: TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings "TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings" [DIAL:00125441]
speaker: VMSTopsBillyKnight "Billy Knight" [NPC_:0011F9BA]

text_content: I love these robots with the friendly little policeman's faces. Sure, they still rough you up, but they look so happy!
name: TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings "TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings" [DIAL:00125441]
speaker: VMSTopsBillyKnight "Billy Knight" [NPC_:0011F9BA]

text_content: My cousin and his wife are a fastidious couple. She's fast and he's hideous.
name: TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings "TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings" [DIAL:00125441]
speaker: VMSTopsBillyKnight "Billy Knight" [NPC_:0011F9BA]

text_content: I know a guy, his motto is Love Thy Neighbor. He lives next door to a brothel.
name: TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings "TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings" [DIAL:00125441]
speaker: VMSTopsBillyKnight "Billy Knight" [NPC_:0011F9BA]

text_content: I try to be frank and earnest with women. In New Reno, I'm Frank and in the Boneyard I'm Ernest.
name: TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings "TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings" [DIAL:00125441]
speaker: VMSTopsBillyKnight "Billy Knight" [NPC_:0011F9BA]

text_content: I've been married for 17 years. Where did I go wrong?
name: TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings "TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings" [DIAL:00125441]
speaker: VMSTopsBillyKnight "Billy Knight" [NPC_:0011F9BA]

text_content: I've been in love with the same woman for 17 years. If my wife ever finds out, she'll kill me!
name: TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings "TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings" [DIAL:00125441]

text_content: My wife and I know the secret to a happy marriage. Two times a week, we go to a nice restaurant. She goes Mondays, I go Fridays.
name: TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings "TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings" [DIAL:00125441]
speaker: VMSTopsBillyKnight "Billy Knight" [NPC_:0011F9BA]

text_content: I take my wife everywhere, but somehow she keeps finding her way back.
name: TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings "TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings" [DIAL:00125441]
speaker: VMSTopsBillyKnight "Billy Knight" [NPC_:0011F9BA]

text_content: I bought my wife a little car here in New Vegas. An Omerta. It has a hood under the hood.
name: TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings "TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings" [DIAL:00125441]
speaker: VMSTopsBillyKnight "Billy Knight" [NPC_:0011F9BA]

text_content: People say it's hard to survive the Wasteland - how hard can it be, the water glows in the dark!
name: TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings "TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings" [DIAL:00125441]
speaker: VMSTopsBillyKnight "Billy Knight" [NPC_:0011F9BA]

text_content: So I hear Mr. House runs the Strip. He took it over from the last guy, Mr. Mob-Infested Hellhole.
name: TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings "TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings" [DIAL:00125441]
speaker: VMSTopsBillyKnight "Billy Knight" [NPC_:0011F9BA]

text_content: I had dinner at the Ultra-Luxe the other night. I told them my steak tasted funny. They said it was a clown.
name: TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings "TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings" [DIAL:00125441]
speaker: VMSTopsBillyKnight "Billy Knight" [NPC_:0011F9BA]

text_content: I hear James Garret drove 5,000 head of Brahmin to New Reno. No bodies, just the heads.
name: TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings "TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings" [DIAL:00125441]
speaker: VMSTopsBillyKnight "Billy Knight" [NPC_:0011F9BA]

text_content: A ghoul goes to a doctor and he says "Doctor, Doctor, I have this horrible rash!" The Doctor says "Son, that's called your face."
name: TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings "TopsBillyKnightPerformanceStrings" [DIAL:00125441]
speaker: VMSTopsBillyKnight "Billy Knight" [NPC_:0011F9BA]

name: TopsBillyKnghtPerformance "TopsBillyKnghtPerformance" [DIAL:00125442]
