text_content: VHDKimballSpeech01
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: Thank you, Colonel Moore. And thank you, my fellow Californians, who have come so far to answer the call to service put forth by the republic.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]
speaker: VHDKimball "President Kimball" [NPC_:0013002D]

text_content: It is for you that I have come here, and it is because of you that I am able to do so.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]
speaker: VHDKimball "President Kimball" [NPC_:0013002D]

text_content: We enjoy our privileges because you take the greatest of risks and are prepared to make the most noble of sacrifices.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]
speaker: VHDKimball "President Kimball" [NPC_:0013002D]

text_content: It is because of men and women like Private First Class Jeremy Watson that Nevada and the New California Republic remain free and secure.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]
speaker: VHDKimball "President Kimball" [NPC_:0013002D]

text_content: Born in a tin shack on the outskirts of One Pine, Jeremy Watson never had it easy.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: His father worked as a caravan guard on the Short Loop, and his mother, like many Californians, braved the ruins of the Old World as a prospector.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: They suffered through water shortages, raider attacks, and the Brotherhood War. Like our mighty Sierra Nevadas, they endured.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: But the time came when they could no longer shoulder the burden alone.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: Twelve years ago, they called out for help, and the republic heard them. Troopers and rangers, just like you, answered the clarion call.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: Men and women stepped forward to say, "I will carry the weight."
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: And at Owen's Lake, we made true on our promise, driving out the raider tribes to establish a lasting peace in the eastern Sierra Nevadas.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: We carried the weight, and though we left behind many of our brothers and sisters on that battlefield, it did not break us.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: Ten years ago, Chief Elise met with representatives of the Desert Rangers to discuss terms of what would become the Ranger Unification Treaty.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: The treaty was more than a resolution to welcome the Desert Rangers into the republic.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: It was a covenant to protect southern Nevada against Caesar's Legion and the tyranny of his regime.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: There are some back home who ask me, "But who are we protecting?  What is Nevada to us?"
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: Sometimes we forget that the light of our society shines beyond our borders.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: Sometimes we take those privileges for granted that our forebears fought so hard to achieve.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: We must always remember that wherever Californians stand, we carry our principles with us:
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: equal respect, representation, and protection under the laws of a just republic.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: This was the same fire that burned in the heart of the Old World that preceded us.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: We are the heirs of that civilization, torchbearers eastward of the Pacific, into the darkness of this wasted land.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: When the republic called on the men and women of California to carry that fire across the Mojave, Jeremy Watson answered. You answered.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: Together, you carried the weight. And when PFC Watson's platoon came under attack at Forlorn Hope, he took the greatest risk,
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: not only for his fellow Californians, but for California itself.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: He was prepared to make the most noble of sacrifices, to defend the principles of our republic, even here, on Nevada soil.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: His actions are a beacon to all of us who stand here today in tribute to his valor.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: Private First Class Jeremy Watson, on behalf of the senate and people of the New California Republic,
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: it is my honor to present you with the Star of Sierra Madre.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: Not far from this spot, a monument stands as a tribute to the sacrifice made by those who came before us,
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: the men and women who fulfilled the promise we made to the Desert Rangers.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: Its back is inscribed with the names of the troopers and rangers who carried the weight.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: And because they made the most noble of sacrifices, it did not break us.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: Four years ago, we held this dam. Four years ago, we carried the weight.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: Four years ago, we drew a line through the Mojave as clear as the Colorado River, a line that Caesar cannot cross.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: Today, you stand here with our brothers and sisters to hold that line. Today, you honor all Californians by carrying that weight.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: Today, you are the waves of the Pacific, pushing ever eastward. You are the sequoias rising from the Sierra Nevadas, defiant and enduring.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: You are the great western light of California, torchbearers in the darkness, living reminders of all that is best in our republic.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: Thank you. Thank you.
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: Okay, let's get the fuck out of here. What the hell are you waiting for? You think I want to get shot?  Let's go!
name: VHDKimballSpeech01 "VHDKimballSpeech01" [DIAL:00130C6D]

text_content: Tell Caesar I accept his invitation.
name: VFreeformTheFortVVulpesIncultaStripTopic002 "Tell Caesar I accept his invitation." [DIAL:00131F6F]

text_content: Seek Caesar by way of Cottonwood Cove, south of Nelson. The Cursor Lucullus will be waiting.
name: VFreeformTheFortVVulpesIncultaStripTopic002 "Tell Caesar I accept his invitation." [DIAL:00131F6F]
speaker: VVulpesIncultaStrip "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:00131F77]

text_content: If this is a trap, I'm going to take a lot of you with me.
name: VFreeformTheFortVVulpesIncultaStripTopic001 "If this is a trap, I'm going to take a lot of you with me." [DIAL:00131F70]

text_content: {offended}The mighty {KAI-zar}Caesar has bestowed upon you his Mark and guaranteed safe-conduct. If he wanted you dead, you would be dead already.
name: VFreeformTheFortVVulpesIncultaStripTopic001 "If this is a trap, I'm going to take a lot of you with me." [DIAL:00131F70]
speaker: VVulpesIncultaStrip "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:00131F77]

text_content: Why does Caesar want to see me?
name: VFreeformTheFortVVulpesIncultaStripTopic000 "Why does Caesar want to see me?" [DIAL:00131F71]

text_content: Go to him, and you will understand.
name: VFreeformTheFortVVulpesIncultaStripTopic000 "Why does Caesar want to see me?" [DIAL:00131F71]
speaker: VVulpesIncultaStrip "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:00131F77]

text_content: VHDKimballSpeech02
name: VHDKimballSpeech02 "VHDKimballSpeech02" [DIAL:0013259C]

text_content: Ladies and gentlemen, I'd like to thank you for coming out here today for this very special occasion.
name: VHDKimballSpeech02 "VHDKimballSpeech02" [DIAL:0013259C]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: It is my pleasure to introduce to you. The President of the New California Republic, Aaron Kimball!
name: VHDKimballSpeech02 "VHDKimballSpeech02" [DIAL:0013259C]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: How do you know your punishment isn't over?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic035 "How do you know your punishment isn't over?" [DIAL:001327DE]

text_content: Because I'm still alive.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic035 "How do you know your punishment isn't over?" [DIAL:001327DE]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: If it's out of your control, why worry about it?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic034 "If it's out of your control, why worry about it?" [DIAL:001327DF]

text_content: Yeah, that's what I thought, too.|But it's not so easy when you know it's coming for you.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic034 "If it's out of your control, why worry about it?" [DIAL:001327DF]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Life doesn't work that way. Your misfortunes are just bad luck.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic033 "Life doesn't work that way. Your misfortunes are just bad luck." [DIAL:001327E0]

text_content: That's what they tell you in the casinos, too. Because it's the only way to get you to buy back in.|If people knew the truth, that something's watching you, waiting to take it all away from you, and it never loses...|That's all it's doing now. Waiting for me to buy back in.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic033 "Life doesn't work that way. Your misfortunes are just bad luck." [DIAL:001327E0]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Maybe you can make up for your mistakes.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic032 "Maybe you can make up for your mistakes." [DIAL:001327E1]

text_content: A murderer who does good deeds is still a murderer. And he'll still get his judgment.|I left the NCR when my tour was up. Had enough of war. Decided I was gonna start over.|None of it made a difference in the end.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic032 "Maybe you can make up for your mistakes." [DIAL:001327E1]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: It is because of Bitter Springs that you think you've got bad things coming?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic031 "It is because of Bitter Springs that you think you've got bad things coming?" [DIAL:001327E2]

text_content: Life has a way of punishing you for the mistakes you make.|Big enough mistake, punishment can take a while.|Mine's not over.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic031 "It is because of Bitter Springs that you think you've got bad things coming?" [DIAL:001327E2]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Being a mindless drone is just as dangerous. You have to think for yourself.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic030 "Being a mindless drone is just as dangerous. You have to think for yourself." [DIAL:001327E3]

text_content: Not much hope either way, is there?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic030 "Being a mindless drone is just as dangerous. You have to think for yourself." [DIAL:001327E3]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: That's true. You can't second guess what you do out there.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic029 "That's true. You can't second guess what you do out there." [DIAL:001327E4]

text_content: It doesn't lead anywhere that does any good. I know that much.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic029 "That's true. You can't second guess what you do out there." [DIAL:001327E4]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Sounds like you have some regrets.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic028 "Sounds like you have some regrets." [DIAL:001327E5]

text_content: You don't come out of a tour of duty without regrets. It's best just not to think about it.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic028 "Sounds like you have some regrets." [DIAL:001327E5]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: There must be more to it than that.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic027 "There must be more to it than that." [DIAL:001327E6]

text_content: Not as much as you'd think.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic027 "There must be more to it than that." [DIAL:001327E6]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Must've been one hell of a miscommunication.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic026 "Must've been one hell of a miscommunication." [DIAL:001327E7]

text_content: Yeah, well. That's how they wrote it up in the report.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic026 "Must've been one hell of a miscommunication." [DIAL:001327E7]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Sounded like more of a massacre.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic025 "Sounded like more of a massacre." [DIAL:001327E8]

text_content: Yeah. I guess that'd be the word.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic025 "Sounded like more of a massacre." [DIAL:001327E8]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: We did what we were there to do. Lot of people got killed. That's war.|Maybe looking back you'd do things differently, but that's not how it works.|In the field, you hesitate, you or someone you care about will die. They teach that from day one.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic025 "Sounded like more of a massacre." [DIAL:001327E8]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: You want me to make good on my promise to fight the Legion with you, is that it?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic024 "You want me to make good on my promise to fight the Legion with you, is that it?" [DIAL:001327E9]

text_content: I don't know. Couldn't hurt.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic024 "You want me to make good on my promise to fight the Legion with you, is that it?" [DIAL:001327E9]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Tell me about it.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic023 "Tell me about it." [DIAL:001327EA]

text_content: How can you say that? We've been fighting together.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic022 "How can you say that? We've been fighting together." [DIAL:001327EB]

text_content: {Pointed}Your enemies, or mine?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic022 "How can you say that? We've been fighting together." [DIAL:001327EB]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: True. It's a start.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic022 "How can you say that? We've been fighting together." [DIAL:001327EB]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: I've seen my share of terrible things. You can talk to me about it.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic021 "I've seen my share of terrible things. You can talk to me about it." [DIAL:001327EC]

text_content: Maybe some other time.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic021 "I've seen my share of terrible things. You can talk to me about it." [DIAL:001327EC]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: That's it? You won?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic020 "That's it? You won?" [DIAL:001327ED]

text_content: Look, we've done some traveling together, but we're not exactly comrades-in-arms. I'm not ready to swap war stories.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic020 "That's it? You won?" [DIAL:001327ED]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: You must've been at Bitter Springs. What happened there?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic019 "You must've been at Bitter Springs. What happened there?" [DIAL:001327EE]

text_content: That part of my life is over now. So is this discussion.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic019 "You must've been at Bitter Springs. What happened there?" [DIAL:001327EE]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: {Sardonic}We won.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic019 "You must've been at Bitter Springs. What happened there?" [DIAL:001327EE]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: {Sighs}There was a... miscommunication.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic019 "You must've been at Bitter Springs. What happened there?" [DIAL:001327EE]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Were you at Bitter Springs with First Recon?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic018 "Were you at Bitter Springs with First Recon?" [DIAL:001327EF]

text_content: I was in a lot of places with First Recon. I don't really remember.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic018 "Were you at Bitter Springs with First Recon?" [DIAL:001327EF]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: You're not going to tell me?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic017 "You're not going to tell me?" [DIAL:001327F0]

text_content: No. Sorry.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic017 "You're not going to tell me?" [DIAL:001327F0]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic016 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:001327F1]

text_content: All right.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic016 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:001327F1]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: I don't understand.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic015 "I don't understand." [DIAL:001327F2]

text_content: Better that you don't.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic015 "I don't understand." [DIAL:001327F2]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Why do you think you've got bad things coming?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic014 "Why do you think you've got bad things coming?" [DIAL:001327F3]

text_content: {Sighs}Because fair is fair.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic014 "Why do you think you've got bad things coming?" [DIAL:001327F3]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: You make it sound like your wife's death was inevitable.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic013 "You make it sound like your wife's death was inevitable." [DIAL:001327F4]

text_content: It was gonna be something. If I'd never met Carla, it would've been something else. I should've never gotten close to her.|I've got bad things coming to me. You'd better keep your distance, too.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic013 "You make it sound like your wife's death was inevitable." [DIAL:001327F4]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: You had no right to make that decision.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic012 "You had no right to make that decision." [DIAL:001327F5]

text_content: There was no decision. I was meant to pull that trigger. It was a mistake to think I could escape it.|You take out a debt, it's only a matter of time before someone comes collecting. Things just finally caught up with me.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic012 "You had no right to make that decision." [DIAL:001327F5]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: You should've tried to rescue her. Even if it meant your death.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic011 "You should've tried to rescue her. Even if it meant your death." [DIAL:001327F6]

text_content: There was never any saving her. They'd have taken her where I couldn't follow. What I did... that was the only rescue.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic011 "You should've tried to rescue her. Even if it meant your death." [DIAL:001327F6]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Better for her to die than live a Legion slave.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic010 "Better for her to die than live a Legion slave." [DIAL:001327F7]

text_content: Yeah. What they do to women... that's worse than death. There was no choice in what I did.|It was more like... being forced to watch something you can't stop.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic010 "Better for her to die than live a Legion slave." [DIAL:001327F7]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: All this was only ever going to play out one way. It still is. I don't have any say. All I can do is wait for it to be done with me.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic010 "Better for her to die than live a Legion slave." [DIAL:001327F7]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: It's your own damn fault. Help them yourself.

text_content: What is this place?

text_content: This is the Bitter Springs refugee camp. We've been maintaining it for a few years now, ever since Caesar's Legion started seriously pushing west.|Most of the people here were displaced by the Legion's advance. At first there weren't many, but lately it's been more than we can handle.

text_content: {Worried, a little afraid}It started about six months ago. At first it was just supplies going missing - we figured it was refugees. Then people started dying.|Always a single bullet to the head, always from extreme range. We've lost eight refugees and three soldiers to this son of a bitch.|We know he must be hiding out in one of the caves up in the mountains, but I don't have enough men to send out looking for him!

text_content: {Frustrated}Food, blankets, clothes, tools. The army used to ship out caches of supplies regularly, but with the Legion so active we haven't gotten any in months.

speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: Where would you get new troops from?

text_content: {Frustrated}I don't know. The NCR's stretched thin as it is. I've put in requests at Camp Golf, Forlorn Hope, McCarran - but things are no better there.|Maybe if their situations improved, they'd have men to spare. Or maybe they'd listen to someone with a reputation for helping the NCR.

text_content: Captain Gilles at Bitter Springs needs reinforcements. Can you spare any?
name: BitterSpringsTroopers "Captain Gilles at Bitter Springs needs reinforcements. Can you spare any?" [DIAL:0013498B]

text_content: {Baffled, this is a bizarre request}What? Why on earth would you think you can walk in here and make troop deployment recommendations to me?
name: BitterSpringsTroopers "Captain Gilles at Bitter Springs needs reinforcements. Can you spare any?" [DIAL:0013498B]
speaker: ColonelHsu "Col. James Hsu" [NPC_:000E8992]

text_content: I appreciate your concern for Bitter Springs. You've already been quite helpful to the NCR, I suppose it's only right to return the favor.
name: BitterSpringsTroopers "Captain Gilles at Bitter Springs needs reinforcements. Can you spare any?" [DIAL:0013498B]
speaker: ColonelHsu "Col. James Hsu" [NPC_:000E8992]

text_content: {Thoughtful}Well, you have been a great help here, and with the saboteur dealt with... Yes, I think we can spare a few men. Consider it done.
name: BitterSpringsTroopers "Captain Gilles at Bitter Springs needs reinforcements. Can you spare any?" [DIAL:0013498B]
speaker: ColonelHsu "Col. James Hsu" [NPC_:000E8992]

text_content: {Angry drill sergeant}Who the hell are you, coming in here and asking me if I can "spare any?" I don't hand out NCR troopers to anybody who wanders out of the Wasteland!
name: BitterSpringsTroopers "Captain Gilles at Bitter Springs needs reinforcements. Can you spare any?" [DIAL:0013498B]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: {Gruff but pleased}Hey, you're a damn fine soldier, and word on the grapevine is that you're already some kind of hero. You got yourself a deal.
name: BitterSpringsTroopers "Captain Gilles at Bitter Springs needs reinforcements. Can you spare any?" [DIAL:0013498B]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: {Gruff but pleased}After what you did getting my misfits whipped into shape? Yeah, I can spare a couple of boys for Bitter Springs. I'll issue the dispatch orders.
name: BitterSpringsTroopers "Captain Gilles at Bitter Springs needs reinforcements. Can you spare any?" [DIAL:0013498B]
speaker: 2CMcCredie "Sgt. McCredie" [NPC_:00104313]

text_content: {Cool, slightly annoyed}Sorry, I'm not in the habit of letting random civilians dictate my troop deployment schedule.
name: BitterSpringsTroopers "Captain Gilles at Bitter Springs needs reinforcements. Can you spare any?" [DIAL:0013498B]
speaker: VCFHMajorPolatli "Major Polatli" [NPC_:00120DCC]

text_content: {Calm}I'll be honest, the Legion has me worried here, but I think I can spare some soldiers. Consider your request granted.
name: BitterSpringsTroopers "Captain Gilles at Bitter Springs needs reinforcements. Can you spare any?" [DIAL:0013498B]
speaker: VCFHMajorPolatli "Major Polatli" [NPC_:00120DCC]

text_content: {Calm}You handled yourself well against the Legion, and that took some of the pressure off of us. I'll send a couple of troops out there right now.

speaker: VCFHMajorPolatli "Major Polatli" [NPC_:00120DCC]

text_content: Do you have a problem with the NCR?
name: VFreeformCasaMadrid1EAndersonTopic006 "Do you have a problem with the NCR?" [DIAL:00135F4D]

text_content: I don't go looking for fights with them, but they don't have the best interests of people in mind. Certainly not locals.|The bottom line for NCR is productivity and growth. Politicians back in Shady Sands are completely detached from the people actually living here.
name: VFreeformCasaMadrid1EAndersonTopic006 "Do you have a problem with the NCR?" [DIAL:00135F4D]
speaker: WestsideAnderson "Anderson" [NPC_:000F1095]

text_content: Tell me about the co-op.
name: VFreeformCasaMadrid1EAndersonTopic003 "Tell me about the co-op." [DIAL:00135F4E]

text_content: The co-op is comprised of Westside locals and run by Clayton Etienne. They produce all of their own food and share in the profits of the co-op.
name: VFreeformCasaMadrid1EAndersonTopic003 "Tell me about the co-op." [DIAL:00135F4E]
speaker: WestsideAnderson "Anderson" [NPC_:000F1095]

text_content: By "captures," do you mean "slaves"?

text_content: {good-humored}No, no, no - they haven't yet earned the right to be called "slaves"! Those three in the pen are captures, nothing more.|{as though talking about animal training}I'm a Slavemaster, so I know what I'm talking about. Back at the Fort, I'd have those three half-broken and well on their way.|But this is just a holding area, so all I do is assess their fitness and decide whether to send them on.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCCanyonRunnerTopic002 "By ""captures,"" do you mean ""slaves""?" [DIAL:00135F5D]

text_content: Not yet. I'm still working on it.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic001 "Not yet. I'm still working on it." [DIAL:00136152]

speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: I've spoken to the Great Khans. Their new leader has agreed to fight for the NCR.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic000 "I've spoken to the Great Khans. Their new leader has agreed to fight for the NCR." [DIAL:00136153]

text_content: Excellent. You've done very well indeed. These tribals will make useful machete fodder.|And if it should turn out we need their land later, well, it's not like we don't have the force to drive them out again.|In the meantime, however, I have something else I want you to look into.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic000 "I've spoken to the Great Khans. Their new leader has agreed to fight for the NCR." [DIAL:00136153]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: We've had some disturbing reports recently concerning the Omertas, one of the Three Families that run the Strip.|Our intelligence has discovered that high ranking members of the Omertas have been having clandestine meetings for the past several months.|We haven't been able to determine whom they've been meeting with, but if it's Caesar's men, we'll need to act.|I need you to uncover what they're up to, and stop it if it threatens the NCR. Any questions?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic000 "I've spoken to the Great Khans. Their new leader has agreed to fight for the NCR." [DIAL:00136153]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: I'd like to talk about something else now.

text_content: Do you know how he got away from the NCR?

text_content: How did he end up here on the Westside?

text_content: He just showed up here one day. Couldn't really talk, but he remembered me all right.|Ever since then he's just been, well... hanging around, I guess. Does odd jobs for folks and smashes the bad guys when they come poking around.

text_content: What do you do around here?
name: VDialogueVegasWestKlamathBobTopic006 "What do you do around here?" [DIAL:001361ED]

text_content: I run the liquor store in Westside. With things this rough, some folks need a lot of booze just to step out the door in the morning.|After I close up shop, I walk around and help keep the peace. Not that I'm good with a gun, mind you, but someone's got to do it, you know?
name: VDialogueVegasWestKlamathBobTopic006 "What do you do around here?" [DIAL:001361ED]
speaker: KlamathBob "Klamath Bob" [NPC_:000F839E]

text_content: Do you know anything about that Super mutant walking around town?
name: VDialogueVegasWestKlamathBobTopic005 "Do you know anything about that Super mutant walking around town?" [DIAL:001361EE]

text_content: Oh, heh. Yeah, that's Mean Sonofabitch. I know the name sounds bad, but he likes it. He's one nasty old coot.|Far as I can tell, he's one of them original Super Mutants, what came from the Boneyard. Wandered about after that "Master" fellow died.|Eventually got caught somewhere around the Hub, back in NCR. Boy, they sure treated him mean down there. Cut him up so bad he can't talk no more.|I tried to buy him, just so they'd stop hurting him, but they didn't want any of it.
name: VDialogueVegasWestKlamathBobTopic005 "Do you know anything about that Super mutant walking around town?" [DIAL:001361EE]
speaker: KlamathBob "Klamath Bob" [NPC_:000F839E]

text_content: What's so great about the co-op?
name: VDialogueVegasWestKlamathBobTopic004 "What's so great about the co-op?" [DIAL:001361EF]

text_content: Food from the people and for the people. Anyone can buy, but the profits are shared by the folks who make the produce.|Locals got these little gardens that do real well. Gosh darn well, truth be told. Ettienne got some help from that Anderson kid, I think.|Anyway, we don't gotta rely on merchants so much. And it means the troopers can use all the food they make over on the east side. Works out nice.
name: VDialogueVegasWestKlamathBobTopic004 "What's so great about the co-op?" [DIAL:001361EF]
speaker: KlamathBob "Klamath Bob" [NPC_:000F839E]

text_content: Tell me about the Scorpions.
name: VDialogueVegasWestKlamathBobTopic003 "Tell me about the Scorpions." [DIAL:001361F0]

text_content: Not much to tell. Typical gang of dumb bullies and angry nobodies. They're holed up a bit south of here, in the Monte Carlo Suites.|They think they're tough, but any time they tangle with the Fiends, they get torn right up.
name: VDialogueVegasWestKlamathBobTopic003 "Tell me about the Scorpions." [DIAL:001361F0]
speaker: KlamathBob "Klamath Bob" [NPC_:000F839E]

text_content: Do you have a lot of run-ins with the Fiends?
name: VDialogueVegasWestKlamathBobTopic002 "Do you have a lot of run-ins with the Fiends?" [DIAL:001361F1]

text_content: Not so much lately. The NCR is giving them hell any time they poke their damned heads out. Bless those boys and gals for getting rid of that vermin.|I feel pity for any man or woman that gets addicted to chems, but when they prey on decent folk... well, then it's time to put 'em down.
name: VDialogueVegasWestKlamathBobTopic002 "Do you have a lot of run-ins with the Fiends?" [DIAL:001361F1]
speaker: KlamathBob "Klamath Bob" [NPC_:000F839E]

text_content: Can you tell me about Westside?
name: VDialogueVegasWestKlamathBobTopic001 "Can you tell me about Westside?" [DIAL:001361F2]

text_content: Well, things aren't great here, but I've seen a lot worse. We've got the Fiends to the south of us, and that ain't good.|The Scorpions hang out at the Monte Carlo when they aren't slinging chems or getting their heads blown off by the Fiends.|Probably the best thing we've got going on is the co-op, run by Mr. Ettienne. Gets some help from of the Followers of the Apocalypse, I think.
name: VDialogueVegasWestKlamathBobTopic001 "Can you tell me about Westside?" [DIAL:001361F2]
speaker: KlamathBob "Klamath Bob" [NPC_:000F839E]

name: VDialogueVegasWestKlamathBobTopic000 "I have some questions about this area." [DIAL:001361F3]

name: VDialogueVegasWestKlamathBobTopic000 "I have some questions about this area." [DIAL:001361F3]
speaker: KlamathBob "Klamath Bob" [NPC_:000F839E]

text_content: I was hoping to ask you some questions.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic035 "I was hoping to ask you some questions." [DIAL:00136D95]

text_content: This is no time for questions! Get back topside and protect the president!
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic035 "I was hoping to ask you some questions." [DIAL:00136D95]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: I don't know. The visit is still going on up there.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic034 "I don't know. The visit is still going on up there." [DIAL:00136D96]

text_content: Then what the hell are you doing down here? Get back topside and protect the president!
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic034 "I don't know. The visit is still going on up there." [DIAL:00136D96]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: The president was killed by assassins.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic033 "The president was killed by assassins." [DIAL:00136D97]

text_content: Damn it! The timing couldn't be any worse. I tried to warn those buffoons, but they insisted on this little show.|We'll be lucky if the men don't throw down their guns and surrender as the Legion approaches. I guess there's nothing to be done about it now.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic033 "The president was killed by assassins." [DIAL:00136D97]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: The president has departed safely.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic032 "The president has departed safely." [DIAL:00136D98]

text_content: Good, his death could have had a major impact on morale. This whole affair was ill-advised from the start, and I for one am glad it's over.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic032 "The president has departed safely." [DIAL:00136D98]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: While you were out, General Oliver arrived and briefed all senior officers regarding a change in our strategy.|I'm not at liberty to divulge what was said, but I've been instructed to send you to him immediately.|He's set up his camp in the office area at the south end of this power plant.|Dismissed.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic032 "The president has departed safely." [DIAL:00136D98]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: I talked the Brotherhood into supporting the NCR.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic031 "I talked the Brotherhood into supporting the NCR." [DIAL:00136D99]

text_content: {She is not pleased}And you believed them? Do you have any idea how long we've been fighting those bastards?|Ugh, Crocker will have a field day with this. He'll want to establish diplomatic relations with them, for pete's sake.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic031 "I talked the Brotherhood into supporting the NCR." [DIAL:00136D99]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: But we've got more important matters to attend to. The president is due to arrive soon, and we're sure the Legion won't waste such an opportunity.|I want you to assist the security detail we've prepared for the president. His safety is critical to maintaining the mens' fighting spirit.|Go up to the visitor center and speak to Ranger Grant. He's in charge of security during the president's visit. Dismissed.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic031 "I talked the Brotherhood into supporting the NCR." [DIAL:00136D99]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: I was hoping to ask you some questions.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic030 "I was hoping to ask you some questions." [DIAL:00136D9A]

text_content: Not yet.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic029 "Not yet." [DIAL:00136D9B]

text_content: Don't give up. They're out there, somewhere, and we're not safe until they've been destroyed.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic029 "Not yet." [DIAL:00136D9B]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: The Brotherhood has been eliminated.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic028 "The Brotherhood has been eliminated." [DIAL:00136D9C]

text_content: {Triumph, relief}Ah, that's a relief. A Brotherhood attack while we're busy with the Legion would be catastrophic.|The situation being what it is, we can't afford to lose even a single man unnecessarily.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic028 "The Brotherhood has been eliminated." [DIAL:00136D9C]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: No ma'am.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic027 "No ma'am." [DIAL:00136D9D]

text_content: Dismissed.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic027 "No ma'am." [DIAL:00136D9D]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: I thought the Brotherhood were all wiped out at HELIOS One. How could they have survived?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic026 "I thought the Brotherhood were all wiped out at HELIOS One. How could they have survived?" [DIAL:00136D9E]

text_content: After the battle, we consolidated our hold on the plant before pursuing our enemies.|It was a mistake, to be sure, but there wasn't really any place for them to go. When we finally gave chase, however, they had simply vanished.|Some of our people think they had some means of conveyance, like the vertibirds the Enclave used, and hightailed it out of here.|I think that they found someplace to hide close to HELIOS, and never went that far at all. Any other questions?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic026 "I thought the Brotherhood were all wiped out at HELIOS One. How could they have survived?" [DIAL:00136D9E]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: How do you expect me to destroy an entire Brotherhood chapter?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic025 "How do you expect me to destroy an entire Brotherhood chapter?" [DIAL:00136D9F]

text_content: A fair question, and one I've had our strategists think about for some time. Their consensus is that we must focus on the one thing we can count on.|With the Brotherhood that's their obsessive attachment to technology. They'd never go anywhere that didn't have working power.|I'm willing to bet that wherever they're hiding, there's a working reactor powering their equipment. That's their vulnerability.|Detonate that reactor, and we can safely cross the Brotherhood off our list of concerns. Was there anything else?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic025 "How do you expect me to destroy an entire Brotherhood chapter?" [DIAL:00136D9F]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: Is there no peaceful way to resolve this?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic024 "Is there no peaceful way to resolve this?" [DIAL:00136DA0]

text_content: {Player talked Khans into helping}No, just because you secured the aid of the Khans, {said under her breath}assuming they don't try to kill us, don't think the Brotherhood will be so easily swayed.|These are people that both hate us *and* outgun us. There can be no compromise. Anything else?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic024 "Is there no peaceful way to resolve this?" [DIAL:00136DA0]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: Don't even think about it. Any Brotherhood survivors likely harbor a deep grudge against us. We can't afford to leave such an enemy alive.|Any other objections? Maybe you'd like to bring the Brotherhood some flowers?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic024 "Is there no peaceful way to resolve this?" [DIAL:00136DA0]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: I was hoping to ask you some questions.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic023 "I was hoping to ask you some questions." [DIAL:00136DA1]

text_content: I'm still working on it.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic022 "I'm still working on it." [DIAL:00136DA2]

text_content: I shouldn't have to say this, but please don't bother me until the mission is completed.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic022 "I'm still working on it." [DIAL:00136DA2]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: I killed Mr. House.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic021 "I killed Mr. House." [DIAL:00136DA3]

text_content: Then that's one more nuisance we won't have to worry about. Good work. Our efforts haven't gone unnoticed, either.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic021 "I killed Mr. House." [DIAL:00136DA3]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: Mr. House won't be a problem. He's been disconnected from his system.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic020 "Mr. House won't be a problem. He's been disconnected from his system." [DIAL:00136DA4]

text_content: But he's still alive? I'll have to remember to send someone to follow up on that later. Anyway, at least he's out of the picture for the time being.|You might be happy to know that your efforts haven't gone unnoticed, either.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic020 "Mr. House won't be a problem. He's been disconnected from his system." [DIAL:00136DA4]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: The brass have been throwing around the idea of having the president visit the dam for a while now. To rally the troops and boost morale and such.|With our recent achievements, they finally feel secure enough to stage the damn thing. But while it's being planned, I have one last mission for you.|Several years ago, we managed to wrest the HELIOS One solar power station from the Brotherhood of Steel chapter local to this area.|It was a crushing victory, but no one's heard a peep from the Brotherhood since. Most people assume the Brotherhood is scattered and not a threat.|Recently we've had scouts go missing in an area west of HELIOS, and I'm concerned that the Brotherhood is involved.|I want you to find them, and once you do, finish them for good. Any questions?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic020 "Mr. House won't be a problem. He's been disconnected from his system." [DIAL:00136DA4]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: I was hoping to ask you some questions.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic019 "I was hoping to ask you some questions." [DIAL:00136DA5]

text_content: If you must, but please keep it brief.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic019 "I was hoping to ask you some questions." [DIAL:00136DA5]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: { Speech > 70 }
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic018 "{ Speech > 70 }" [DIAL:00136DA6]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] I wouldn't dismiss it that lightly, but it's nothing we need get involved with for now. Good work, I suppose.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic018 "{ Speech > 70 }" [DIAL:00136DA6]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: [FAILED] I highly doubt that. You'd do well to report only facts to me, otherwise we might have ourselves a problem.|However, their activity has quieted down some so maybe my original information was wrong.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic018 "{ Speech > 70 }" [DIAL:00136DA6]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: I'm still working on it.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic017 "I'm still working on it." [DIAL:00136DA7]

text_content: The next time we speak, I expect you to have something for me.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic017 "I'm still working on it." [DIAL:00136DA7]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: The Omertas were up to something big, but I stopped them.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic016 "The Omertas were up to something big, but I stopped them." [DIAL:00136DA8]

text_content: Excellent. You'd think living in the lap of luxury and power would be enough for some people, but no.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic016 "The Omertas were up to something big, but I stopped them." [DIAL:00136DA8]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: But we have other problems. While investigating the Omertas, what little I could on my end, I came across something much more sinister.|Evidence suggests that Mr. House is planning to make some kind of move when the battle breaks out, and I'm guessing he won't be coming to our rescue.|While we don't know what his exact plans are, my orders are to avoid all risks. I'm sending you to take Mr. House out of the equation. Any questions?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic016 "The Omertas were up to something big, but I stopped them." [DIAL:00136DA8]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: Now that that's out of the way, let's see... Mr. House {emph}was a concern, but someone conveniently dealt with him for us.|Oh, that reminds me, you might be happy to know that your efforts haven't gone unnoticed.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic016 "The Omertas were up to something big, but I stopped them." [DIAL:00136DA8]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: Can you give me any leads?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic014 "Can you give me any leads?" [DIAL:00136DA9]

text_content: Our preliminary research shows that the Omertas used to do some business in Freeside, mostly buying weapons. Any other questions?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic014 "Can you give me any leads?" [DIAL:00136DA9]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: Where should I start?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic013 "Where should I start?" [DIAL:00136DAA]

text_content: Head to their casino, Gomorrah, and ask around. If you discover that what they're up to threatens the NCR, stop it.|The Omertas themselves likely won't be forthcoming, so you may need to talk to some of their help to pick up a trail. Anything else?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic013 "Where should I start?" [DIAL:00136DAA]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: The Khans won't be a problem to anyone ever again.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic012 "The Khans won't be a problem to anyone ever again." [DIAL:00136DAB]

text_content: Good riddance. We've had reports for years that they're the ones who supply the Fiends with chems, but no one's done anything about it.|In any event, no one will miss them. And I've got another mission for you.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic012 "The Khans won't be a problem to anyone ever again." [DIAL:00136DAB]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: No further questions, ma'am.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic010 "No further questions, ma'am." [DIAL:00136DAC]

text_content: No questions, ma'am.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic009 "No questions, ma'am." [DIAL:00136DAD]

text_content: Good. I look forward to hearing of your progress.|Dismissed.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic009 "No questions, ma'am." [DIAL:00136DAD]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: Will I have any NCR support in this?

speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

I want you to visit them in their canyons to the far west and make sure they're in no shape to join the Legion.|They're just another gang of raiders as far as I'm concerned, so deal with them appropriately. name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic234 "Where can I find Radscorpion eggs?" [DIAL:00137889]

text_content: The eggs I seek are not easy to find, stranger. Your best chances are in the mountains north of Goodsprings, and west from Quarry Junction.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic234 "Where can I find Radscorpion eggs?" [DIAL:00137889]
speaker: VMS38RedLucy "Red Lucy" [NPC_:001347D9]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic233 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0013788A]

name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic232 "I don't need anything in return. Take the eggs." [DIAL:0013788B]

text_content: {Slightly suspicious of players' motives}Don't think your servile gesture earns my respect, stranger. But if that's how you want it, so it'll be.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic232 "I don't need anything in return. Take the eggs." [DIAL:0013788B]
speaker: VMS38RedLucy "Red Lucy" [NPC_:001347D9]

text_content: 200 caps are sufficient. Take the eggs.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic231 "200 caps are sufficient. Take the eggs." [DIAL:0013788C]

text_content: I thank you, stranger. The Thorn thanks you.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic231 "200 caps are sufficient. Take the eggs." [DIAL:0013788C]
speaker: VMS38RedLucy "Red Lucy" [NPC_:001347D9]

text_content: Let's talk about the creature's eggs that you need.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic230 "Let's talk about the creature's eggs that you need." [DIAL:0013788D]

name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic229 "<Questions about VMS38 quest>" [DIAL:0013788E]

text_content: Bring me a dozen Radscorpion eggs. I'll see to it that you're rewarded fairly.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic229 "<Questions about VMS38 quest>" [DIAL:0013788E]
speaker: VMS38RedLucy "Red Lucy" [NPC_:001347D9]

text_content: Bring me a dozen Fire Gecko eggs. This great challenge will earn you a matching reward.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic229 "<Questions about VMS38 quest>" [DIAL:0013788E]
speaker: VMS38RedLucy "Red Lucy" [NPC_:001347D9]

text_content: The Thorn's calling its elite hunters to collect one of its deadliest creatures. Find Night Stalker eggs and your bravery will be greatly rewarded.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic229 "<Questions about VMS38 quest>" [DIAL:0013788E]
speaker: VMS38RedLucy "Red Lucy" [NPC_:001347D9]

text_content: I'm asking our top hunters to gather Cazador eggs.{Sincere affirmation, weighed by the task at hand} I'd be impressed by whoever returns with such a prize.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic229 "<Questions about VMS38 quest>" [DIAL:0013788E]
speaker: VMS38RedLucy "Red Lucy" [NPC_:001347D9]

text_content: {Words charged with solemn excitement, a moment of great relevance}This is it, hunter. I've decided to grant{slight emphasis in "you"} you the opportunity to earn the greatest honor The Thorn could ever expect.|Deathclaws are our most precious and our most feared contenders. I want you to be the one to deliver the sacred eggs to me, personally.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic229 "<Questions about VMS38 quest>" [DIAL:0013788E]
speaker: VMS38RedLucy "Red Lucy" [NPC_:001347D9]

text_content: I don't agree with it because... because it was very dangerous and I deserve more caps.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic228 "I don't agree with it because... because it was very dangerous and I deserve more caps." [DIAL:0013788F]

text_content: {Slightly bothered that players even dare ask more from The Thorn}Those are the risks of a hunter's life. I've delivered as promised, but perhaps I should better search for someone with greater resolve and honor?
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic228 "I don't agree with it because... because it was very dangerous and I deserve more caps." [DIAL:0013788F]
speaker: VMS38RedLucy "Red Lucy" [NPC_:001347D9]

text_content: Who else can bring you so many intact eggs? I deserve a bigger reward.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic227 "Who else can bring you so many intact eggs? I deserve a bigger reward." [DIAL:00137890]

text_content: {Recognizing players' deeds}You speak the truth, stranger, and The Thorn lives by the justice that honor and strength dispense. Here's a more fitting sum.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic227 "Who else can bring you so many intact eggs? I deserve a bigger reward." [DIAL:00137890]
speaker: VMS38RedLucy "Red Lucy" [NPC_:001347D9]

text_content: I'm still looking for the Giant Mantis Eggs.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic226 "I'm still looking for the Giant Mantis Eggs." [DIAL:00137891]

text_content: Your loss. Come back to me when you have something to offer.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic226 "I'm still looking for the Giant Mantis Eggs." [DIAL:00137891]
speaker: VMS38RedLucy "Red Lucy" [NPC_:001347D9]

text_content: Let's go back to my other questions.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic225 "Let's go back to my other questions." [DIAL:00137892]

text_content: Let's go back to my other questions.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic224 "Let's go back to my other questions." [DIAL:00137893]

text_content: Let's go back to my other questions.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic223 "Let's go back to my other questions." [DIAL:00137894]

text_content: How do you find these creatures?
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic222 "How do you find these creatures?" [DIAL:00137895]

text_content: We constantly replenish our stock to keep this holy ground soaked red. Only a few brave ones ever{slight emphasis in "ever"} earn the honor of servicing The Thorn.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic222 "How do you find these creatures?" [DIAL:00137895]
speaker: VMS38RedLucy "Red Lucy" [NPC_:001347D9]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic221 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00137896]

text_content: Maybe later. Let's go back to my questions.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic220 "Maybe later. Let's go back to my questions." [DIAL:00137897]

text_content: I'll find Giant Mantis' eggs for you.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic219 "I'll find Giant Mantis' eggs for you." [DIAL:00137898]

text_content: You've got yourself a deal.|So long, stranger.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic219 "I'll find Giant Mantis' eggs for you." [DIAL:00137898]
speaker: VMS38RedLucy "Red Lucy" [NPC_:001347D9]

text_content: So long, stranger.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic219 "I'll find Giant Mantis' eggs for you." [DIAL:00137898]
speaker: VMS38RedLucy "Red Lucy" [NPC_:001347D9]

text_content: Let's talk about the creature's eggs you need.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic218 "Let's talk about the creature's eggs you need." [DIAL:00137899]

text_content: Where can I find Giant Mantis' eggs?
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic217 "Where can I find Giant Mantis' eggs?" [DIAL:0013789A]

text_content: You'll find egg-carrying Mantises in The Wasteland. But a wise hunter would search at a Mantis' breeding ground, like the nearby ruins of Vault 22.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic217 "Where can I find Giant Mantis' eggs?" [DIAL:0013789A]
speaker: VMS38RedLucy "Red Lucy" [NPC_:001347D9]

text_content: How could I help The Thorn?
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic216 "How could I help The Thorn?" [DIAL:0013789B]

text_content: Think you have what it takes?{Pensive pause} Hmm, all right. Prove your worth and I'll reward your service.|The Thorn needs newborn specimens that will one day grow to honor us with their blood.|Bring me a dozen Giant Mantis' eggs. If you accomplish this, I might gift you with greater tasks in the future.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic216 "How could I help The Thorn?" [DIAL:0013789B]
speaker: VMS38RedLucy "Red Lucy" [NPC_:001347D9]

text_content: Bring me a dozen Giant Mantis' eggs. If you accomplish this, I might gift you with greater tasks in the future.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic216 "How could I help The Thorn?" [DIAL:0013789B]
speaker: VMS38RedLucy "Red Lucy" [NPC_:001347D9]

text_content: At least, tell me how you find these creatures.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic214 "At least, tell me how you find these creatures." [DIAL:0013789C]

text_content: Our creatures come from the farthest reaches of the Wasteland. The Thorn takes care of them until the time to spill their blood comes.|We constantly replenish our stock to keep this holy ground soaked red. Only a few brave ones{slight emphasis in "ever"} ever earn the honor of serving The Thorn.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic214 "At least, tell me how you find these creatures." [DIAL:0013789C]
speaker: VMS38RedLucy "Red Lucy" [NPC_:001347D9]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic015 "Goodbye." [DIAL:001379FA]

text_content: Let me ask you about something else.
name: VMS38VMS38RedLucyTopic014 "Let me ask you about something else." [DIAL:001379FB]

text_content: There are a lot of tents here.
name: VFreeformTheFortFortLuciusTopic018 "There are a lot of tents here." [DIAL:00137A27]

text_content: And just about every one of them is occupied. Not all at the same time, usually - groups of Legionaries come and go all the time.|This also only one camp of many. You might have noticed the other camps down by the river.
name: VFreeformTheFortFortLuciusTopic018 "There are a lot of tents here." [DIAL:00137A27]
speaker: FortLucius "Lucius" [NPC_:0011FC9D]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic004 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:00137A5F]

text_content: Sure thing.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic004 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:00137A5F]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: What did happen at Bitter Springs?
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic003 "What did happen at Bitter Springs?" [DIAL:00137A60]

text_content: I still don't know exactly. Just that a lot of people died who didn't want to be part of the fighting at all.|I don't blame anybody for it. There's so much chaos when you're fighting, you're lucky not to shoot your own guys.|But it did take something out of it for me. Just wasn't the same. So when it came time to re-enlist, I just took my papers and walked.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic003 "What did happen at Bitter Springs?" [DIAL:00137A60]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: So why'd you leave?
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic002 "So why'd you leave?" [DIAL:00137A61]

text_content: Ah, well... I just felt like it was time, you know? Wanted to have a home.|Plus I was up at Camp Golf when Bitter Springs went down. I faked like I was sick to get out of going, because I knew some of the people there.|But when everybody came back nobody would tell me what happened. And people would call us murderers sometimes when we showed up to secure towns.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic002 "So why'd you leave?" [DIAL:00137A61]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: What was your tour with the NCR like?
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic001 "What was your tour with the NCR like?" [DIAL:00137A62]

text_content: Oh, it was great. I wouldn't trade it.|Something about that lifestyle, the discipline. Seeing new places, making people safe. What's not to like?
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic001 "What was your tour with the NCR like?" [DIAL:00137A62]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: I found a detonator on that man over there.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic002 "I found a detonator on that man over there." [DIAL:00137AC3]

text_content: What the hell? This must control some sort of bomb that he was going to use to kill the President.|Nice work catching this. I'll have my Rangers go deal with this man right away.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic002 "I found a detonator on that man over there." [DIAL:00137AC3]
speaker: VHDCaptainGraham "Ranger Grant" [NPC_:0013721E]

text_content: I found a bomb on the President's vertibird.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic000 "I found a bomb on the President's vertibird." [DIAL:00137AC5]

text_content: A bomb on the President's vertibird? Only a limited number of people had access to the vertibird.|We have to get the President out of here now. I'll cancel the speech and have security search the area.|We can't relax until we get the President out of here safely.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic000 "I found a bomb on the President's vertibird." [DIAL:00137AC5]
speaker: VHDCaptainGraham "Ranger Grant" [NPC_:0013721E]

text_content: Trust me, your troubles are over. <Set off the explosive in her collar>
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCMrsWeathersTopic005 "Trust me, your troubles are over. <Set off the explosive in her collar>" [DIAL:00137ADE]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Screaming}No! Not like this!
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCMrsWeathersTopic005 "Trust me, your troubles are over. <Set off the explosive in her collar>" [DIAL:00137ADE]
speaker: NVCCMrsWeathers "Mrs. Weathers" [NPC_:00130BB9]

text_content: [FAILED] I appreciate you trying, but you'll have to find another way to get us out of here.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCMrsWeathersTopic005 "Trust me, your troubles are over. <Set off the explosive in her collar>" [DIAL:00137ADE]
speaker: NVCCMrsWeathers "Mrs. Weathers" [NPC_:00130BB9]

text_content: I took care of that slave caravan.
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic008 "I took care of that slave caravan." [DIAL:00137B03]

text_content: {surly, sarcastic}You know what I'd be real excited about? If you'd showed up and saved me before they smashed my legs.|{surly, sarcastic}Now why don't you fuck off and let me sleep, hero? That'd be real exciting, too.
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic008 "I took care of that slave caravan." [DIAL:00137B03]
speaker: vNiptonBoxcars2 "Boxcars" [NPC_:00134972]

name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic229 "<Goodbye Placeholder.>" [DIAL:00137B0E]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic227 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00137B10]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic227 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00137B10]
speaker: MrHouse "Mr. House" [CREA:00125BB5]

text_content: I've dealt with the attacks on the camp. They won't be a problem any more.
name: CaptainGillesOscar "I've dealt with the attacks on the camp. They won't be a problem any more." [DIAL:00137B7A]

text_content: You did? Who was it? Any information you can give me would be a big help for my reports.
name: CaptainGillesOscar "I've dealt with the attacks on the camp. They won't be a problem any more." [DIAL:00137B7A]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: I appreciate the information, but I really wasn't kidding when I said I didn't have the manpower. If you could deal with him, I'd be in your debt.
name: CaptainGillesOscar "I've dealt with the attacks on the camp. They won't be a problem any more." [DIAL:00137B7A]

text_content: I understand. I'll leave you to your grief, then.
name: VMS37VBSOscarVelascoTopic007 "I understand. I'll leave you to your grief, then." [DIAL:00137B7B]

text_content: {Accepting}As you wish.
name: VMS37VBSOscarVelascoTopic007 "I understand. I'll leave you to your grief, then." [DIAL:00137B7B]
speaker: VBSOscarVelasco "Oscar Velasco" [NPC_:0012ACA0]

text_content: If you insist. Let's finish this.
name: VMS37VBSOscarVelascoTopic006 "If you insist. Let's finish this." [DIAL:00137B7C]

text_content: Let's not be hasty. I'll be back.
name: VMS37VBSOscarVelascoTopic005 "Let's not be hasty. I'll be back." [DIAL:00137B7D]

text_content: {Suspicious}Why should I let you leave? You could lead the NCR right to me. I should kill you now.
name: VMS37VBSOscarVelascoTopic005 "Let's not be hasty. I'll be back." [DIAL:00137B7D]
speaker: VBSOscarVelasco "Oscar Velasco" [NPC_:0012ACA0]

text_content: I promised Captain Gilles I'd stop the attacks on Bitter Springs.
name: VMS37VBSOscarVelascoTopic004 "I promised Captain Gilles I'd stop the attacks on Bitter Springs." [DIAL:00137B7E]

text_content: {Resigned}Then you'll have to kill me. My vengeance will not be stayed.
name: VMS37VBSOscarVelascoTopic004 "I promised Captain Gilles I'd stop the attacks on Bitter Springs." [DIAL:00137B7E]
speaker: VBSOscarVelasco "Oscar Velasco" [NPC_:0012ACA0]

text_content: Take revenge on the people actually responsible: Go attack Camp McCarran.
name: VMS37VBSOscarVelascoTopic003 "Take revenge on the people actually responsible: Go attack Camp McCarran." [DIAL:00137B7F]

text_content: {Proud anger}You're right. A Khan's vengeance should be direct and bloody. No more skulking in caves - I'll remind the NCR why they feared us!
name: VMS37VBSOscarVelascoTopic003 "Take revenge on the people actually responsible: Go attack Camp McCarran." [DIAL:00137B7F]
speaker: VBSOscarVelasco "Oscar Velasco" [NPC_:0012ACA0]

text_content: The Khans settled in Red Rock Canyon years ago. It's time to let go of your hate and join them.
name: VMS37VBSOscarVelascoTopic002 "The Khans settled in Red Rock Canyon years ago. It's time to let go of your hate and join them." [DIAL:00137B80]

text_content: {Sad, thoughtful}Maybe... maybe you're right. Maybe three years is vengeance enough. Thank you for helping me see that.|Here. This will unlock the supply caches we left in caves around these mountains. You might get some use out of them.
name: VMS37VBSOscarVelascoTopic002 "The Khans settled in Red Rock Canyon years ago. It's time to let go of your hate and join them." [DIAL:00137B80]
speaker: VBSOscarVelasco "Oscar Velasco" [NPC_:0012ACA0]

text_content: The people at this camp aren't responsible for your family's death. They're refugees.
name: VMS37VBSOscarVelascoTopic001 "The people at this camp aren't responsible for your family's death. They're refugees." [DIAL:00137B81]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Bitter}I know that. But what else can I do?
name: VMS37VBSOscarVelascoTopic001 "The people at this camp aren't responsible for your family's death. They're refugees." [DIAL:00137B81]
speaker: VBSOscarVelasco "Oscar Velasco" [NPC_:0012ACA0]

text_content: [FAILED] {Bitter}Keep deluding yourself if you want. I've seen the NCR's true face.
name: VMS37VBSOscarVelascoTopic001 "The people at this camp aren't responsible for your family's death. They're refugees." [DIAL:00137B81]
speaker: VBSOscarVelasco "Oscar Velasco" [NPC_:0012ACA0]

text_content: So you've been hiding in these mountains ever since? Why?
name: VMS37VBSOscarVelascoTopic000 "So you've been hiding in these mountains ever since? Why?" [DIAL:00137B82]

text_content: {Righteous anger}For revenge! The NCR committed an atrocity here, an atrocity that they tried to bury and forget. I'm going to remind them.
name: VMS37VBSOscarVelascoTopic000 "So you've been hiding in these mountains ever since? Why?" [DIAL:00137B82]
speaker: VBSOscarVelasco "Oscar Velasco" [NPC_:0012ACA0]

text_content: How do I reach Fortification Hill?
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCAureliusTopic021 "How do I reach Fortification Hill?" [DIAL:00137BAE]

text_content: Cursor {Luh-CUH-lus}Lucullus is waiting for you at the docks. He'll take you to {KAI-zar}Caesar.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCAureliusTopic021 "How do I reach Fortification Hill?" [DIAL:00137BAE]
speaker: NVCCAurelius "Aurelius of Phoenix" [NPC_:0012B512]

text_content: I'm ready now. Let's go.
name: VFreeformTheFortFortAntonyTopic010 "I'm ready now. Let's go." [DIAL:00137BB9]

text_content: < Barter 50 >
name: VFreeformTheFortFortAntonyTopic009 "< Barter 50 >" [DIAL:00137BBA]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] All right, two it is. They'll still be more than enough to take you down, I think.
name: VFreeformTheFortFortAntonyTopic009 "< Barter 50 >" [DIAL:00137BBA]
speaker: FortAntony "Antony" [NPC_:00120172]

text_content: [FAILED] No deal. You and four of my dogs. Not two, not three - four.
name: VFreeformTheFortFortAntonyTopic009 "< Barter 50 >" [DIAL:00137BBA]
speaker: FortAntony "Antony" [NPC_:00120172]

text_content: The Dam?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic071 "The Dam?" [DIAL:00137FA4]

text_content: The big one. The one the NCR is trying to hold onto, that the Legion's pushing for. Whole war depends on holding it.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic071 "The Dam?" [DIAL:00137FA4]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Do you know Colonel Hsu at all?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic070 "Do you know Colonel Hsu at all?" [DIAL:00137FA5]

text_content: Yeah. He introduced himself to me once. I shook his hand. Doubt he'd remember me now, though.|When he looked at you, you could see he understood. After some of the things we'd seen, that meant something.|What I heard, he'd be a general right now if Oliver didn't know the president.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic070 "Do you know Colonel Hsu at all?" [DIAL:00137FA5]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: What do you think of General Oliver?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic069 "What do you think of General Oliver?" [DIAL:00137FA6]

text_content: Didn't know him. He's a signature on my discharge papers.|Wasn't real popular, though. Even overheard my C.O. complain about him once.|"General Wait-and-see," he called him.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic069 "What do you think of General Oliver?" [DIAL:00137FA6]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: What was Camp Golf like?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic068 "What was Camp Golf like?" [DIAL:00137FA7]

text_content: It was on the front line for a while. Only resort in New Vegas no one wanted to get sent to.|Doesn't have that kind of importance anymore, though. They pulled most of the troops out of there after we took the Hoover Dam.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic068 "What was Camp Golf like?" [DIAL:00137FA7]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Tell me about Camp McCarran.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic067 "Tell me about Camp McCarran." [DIAL:00137FA8]

text_content: Was an airport before the war. Command liked it because it was already fortified and it let them keep an eye on the Strip.|They've got an old monorail that still runs between them. Used mostly for supplies and deployment. But if you get leave you're allowed to go gamble.|Was General Oliver's post, but I heard he's been up at the Dam a lot lately. Guessing Colonel Hsu is running it.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic067 "Tell me about Camp McCarran." [DIAL:00137FA8]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Is that a First Recon beret?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic066 "Is that a First Recon beret?" [DIAL:00137FA9]

text_content: Yeah. You can tell by the patch. Bear skull with crossed rifles behind it. Slogan underneath.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic066 "Is that a First Recon beret?" [DIAL:00137FA9]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: What's the slogan?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic065 "What's the slogan?" [DIAL:00137FAA]

text_content: "The last thing you never see."|Pretty accurate, and so were we.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic065 "What's the slogan?" [DIAL:00137FAA]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: How did you happen to join First Recon?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic064 "How did you happen to join First Recon?" [DIAL:00137FAB]

text_content: They pick you out if you do well at the firing range. Pays a little better, so I said okay.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic064 "How did you happen to join First Recon?" [DIAL:00137FAB]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: What outfit did you serve in the military with?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic063 "What outfit did you serve in the military with?" [DIAL:00137FAC]

text_content: First NCR Recon. It's a sniper battalion. Sees a lot of action.|They moved us around a lot. I was stationed at Camp Golf for a while. Last I heard they were at Camp McCarran.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic063 "What outfit did you serve in the military with?" [DIAL:00137FAC]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: I'd like to talk about something else.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSRalphTopic039 "I'd like to talk about something else." [DIAL:0013830B]

speaker: NVCCAurelius "Aurelius of Phoenix" [NPC_:0012B512]

speaker: NVCCAurelius "Aurelius of Phoenix" [NPC_:0012B512]

text_content: {contempt}The things the Profligates will build, to spy on us like cowards with little machines!|Find that officer and give him this old map of our patrol routes. The Profligates will try to set up ambushes... and we'll be waiting for them.

But with me here, it has an iron knuckle.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCAureliusTopic024 "You must be the one in charge here." [DIAL:0013A261]

text_content: [Attack] You're less trouble to me dead than alive.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic095 "[Attack] You're less trouble to me dead than alive." [DIAL:0013A289]

text_content: All right. I won't do anything else to hurt the NCR.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic094 "All right. I won't do anything else to hurt the NCR." [DIAL:0013A28A]

text_content: You're right. You won't.

text_content: Then we can't work together anymore.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic093 "Then we can't work together anymore." [DIAL:0013A28B]

text_content: I should never have worked with you in the first place.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic093 "Then we can't work together anymore." [DIAL:0013A28B]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Sorry. I won't compromise my mission.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic092 "Sorry. I won't compromise my mission." [DIAL:0013A28C]

text_content: Then we're finished here.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic092 "Sorry. I won't compromise my mission." [DIAL:0013A28C]

text_content: Very well. You have my word.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic091 "Very well. You have my word." [DIAL:0013A28D]

text_content: All right. But we'd better not have to have this talk again.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic091 "Very well. You have my word." [DIAL:0013A28D]

text_content: [Attack] I won't be needing your services any longer.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic090 "[Attack] I won't be needing your services any longer." [DIAL:0013A28E]

text_content: I should never have trusted you.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic090 "[Attack] I won't be needing your services any longer." [DIAL:0013A28E]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Things have changed. I'm with Caesar now.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic089 "Things have changed. I'm with Caesar now." [DIAL:0013A28F]

text_content: Then this is over. Next time I see you, it'll be through my scope.|Any Legion with you and I'm pulling the trigger.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic089 "Things have changed. I'm with Caesar now." [DIAL:0013A28F]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: It won't happen again.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic088 "It won't happen again." [DIAL:0013A290]

text_content: I'm... uh... helping them so I can spy on them better.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic087 "I'm... uh... helping them so I can spy on them better." [DIAL:0013A291]

text_content: Bullshit. You're a goddamned coward, trying to pick the winning side.|We will never work together again.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic087 "I'm... uh... helping them so I can spy on them better." [DIAL:0013A291]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: I'm infiltrating the organization. I have to gain their trust.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic086 "I'm infiltrating the organization. I have to gain their trust." [DIAL:0013A292]

text_content: If you want me to stick around, that ends now. I don't care what the reasons are, I will not help the Legion. Ever. Got it?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic086 "I'm infiltrating the organization. I have to gain their trust." [DIAL:0013A292]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Why are you surprised to see a woman receive this honor?
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCLucullusTopic007 "Why are you surprised to see a woman receive this honor?" [DIAL:0013A2A4]

text_content: {a ridiculous question, but it's your duty to be polite}Women are physically and intellectually inferior to men. Their role is to bear children and ensure the survival of our species.|Not to say that all women are equally incapable. I trust {KAI-zar}Caesar will find a worthy use for you.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCLucullusTopic007 "Why are you surprised to see a woman receive this honor?" [DIAL:0013A2A4]
speaker: NVCCLucullus "Cursor Lucullus" [NPC_:0012B515]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCLucullusTopic006 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0013A2A5]

text_content: {WALL-ae}Vale, as you wish. My orders are to wait here until you're ready to make the trip.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCLucullusTopic006 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0013A2A5]
speaker: NVCCLucullus "Cursor Lucullus" [NPC_:0012B515]

text_content: What have I done to earn this honor?
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCLucullusTopic005 "What have I done to earn this honor?" [DIAL:0013A2A6]

name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCLucullusTopic005 "What have I done to earn this honor?" [DIAL:0013A2A6]
speaker: NVCCLucullus "Cursor Lucullus" [NPC_:0012B515]

text_content: Who are you calling "Dissolute?"
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCLucullusTopic004DUPLICATE000 "Who are you calling ""Dissolute?""" [DIAL:0013A2A7]

text_content: All who are not Legion are "Dissolute." They live in squalor, unrestrained by morality, lacking moderation, temper, and self-control.|Their very existence is a blight on the common good. Even worse are the Profligates, the subtype of Dissolute one finds this side of the river. |They hold themselves to be civilized, when in fact they are corrupt and self-interested. The truth will be made clear to them soon enough.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCLucullusTopic004DUPLICATE000 "Who are you calling ""Dissolute?""" [DIAL:0013A2A7]
speaker: NVCCLucullus "Cursor Lucullus" [NPC_:0012B515]
