text_content: {Shocked disbelief}Freedom? I don't know where we'll get a new start, but any place is better than rotting with the legion or Frank.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCSammyWeathersTopic006 "I've paid for your freedom. You're free to go." [DIAL:0013A3B1]

name: VMS36VBSCaptainGillesTopic006 "I see. Well, that's too bad. Good luck." [DIAL:0013A3F9]

text_content: {Sarcastic}Thanks. Your concern is touching.
name: VMS36VBSCaptainGillesTopic006 "I see. Well, that's too bad. Good luck." [DIAL:0013A3F9]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: Why are there so many Great Khan tags around the camp?
name: VMS36VBSCaptainGillesTopic005 "Why are there so many Great Khan tags around the camp?" [DIAL:0013A3FA]

text_content: This whole area used to be a Great Khan encampment before they relocated to Red Rock Canyon. We just haven't had the manpower to clean it all up yet.
name: VMS36VBSCaptainGillesTopic005 "Why are there so many Great Khan tags around the camp?" [DIAL:0013A3FA]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: Any idea why a Great Khan would be so far from Red Rock Canyon?
name: VMS37VBSCaptainGillesTopic006 "Any idea why a Great Khan would be so far from Red Rock Canyon?" [DIAL:0013A3FB]

text_content: {Reluctant}About three years ago, NCR's 1st Recon launched an attack on the Khan encampment here.|There was a communication mix-up that resulted in some noncombatants being killed. I guess he was still bitter about it.|It was a tragic mistake, but we've done all we can to make amends.
name: VMS37VBSCaptainGillesTopic006 "Any idea why a Great Khan would be so far from Red Rock Canyon?" [DIAL:0013A3FB]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: That's very noble of you. I'd like to talk about something else though.
name: VMS37VBSCaptainGillesTopic005 "That's very noble of you. I'd like to talk about something else though." [DIAL:0013A3FC]

text_content: {Relieved}Sure. What do you need?
name: VMS37VBSCaptainGillesTopic005 "That's very noble of you. I'd like to talk about something else though." [DIAL:0013A3FC]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: Well, it's taken care of now. I convinced him to leave Bitter Springs alone.
name: VMS37VBSCaptainGillesTopic004 "Well, it's taken care of now. I convinced him to leave Bitter Springs alone." [DIAL:0013A3FD]

text_content: {Grateful}I don't know how you did it, but thank you.
name: VMS37VBSCaptainGillesTopic004 "Well, it's taken care of now. I convinced him to leave Bitter Springs alone." [DIAL:0013A3FD]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: {Grateful, a little sad}I'm glad it's taken care of, but still, I wish it could have been resolved without violence. There's too much bad blood there already.
name: VMS37VBSCaptainGillesTopic004 "Well, it's taken care of now. I convinced him to leave Bitter Springs alone." [DIAL:0013A3FD]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: Like what? It looks to me like the NCR ran the Khans out of Bitter Springs altogether.
name: VMS37VBSCaptainGillesTopic003 "Like what? It looks to me like the NCR ran the Khans out of Bitter Springs altogether." [DIAL:0013A3FE]

text_content: We provided medical aid to the wounded - {emphasis}all the wounded - and permitted the Khans to resettle at Red Rock Canyon.
name: VMS37VBSCaptainGillesTopic003 "Like what? It looks to me like the NCR ran the Khans out of Bitter Springs altogether." [DIAL:0013A3FE]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCMrsWeathersTopic015 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0013A609]

text_content: One of these days we'll be free.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCMrsWeathersTopic015 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0013A609]
speaker: NVCCMrsWeathers "Mrs. Weathers" [NPC_:00130BB9]

text_content: Do you have any "captures" with the last name, "Weathers?"
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCCanyonRunnerTopic023 "Do you have any ""captures"" with the last name, ""Weathers?""" [DIAL:0013A60B]

text_content: {patiently explaining}Captures lose any claim to the names they called themselves when they let themselves be taken.|If they're fortunate enough to become slaves, a new name will be given to them - one they can be proud of.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCCanyonRunnerTopic023 "Do you have any ""captures"" with the last name, ""Weathers?""" [DIAL:0013A60B]
speaker: NVCCCanyonRunner "Canyon Runner" [NPC_:0012B514]

text_content: It was an accident.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCSammyWeathersTopic009 "It was an accident." [DIAL:0013A60C]

text_content: {angry}Accident or not, you're to blame!
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCSammyWeathersTopic009 "It was an accident." [DIAL:0013A60C]
speaker: NVCCSammyWeathers "Sammy Weathers" [NPC_:001364C8]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCKennyWeathersTopic003 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0013A60D]

text_content: {Angry}Bye.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCKennyWeathersTopic003 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0013A60D]
speaker: NVCCKennyWeathers "Kenny Weathers" [NPC_:001364C7]

text_content: I've paid for your freedom. You're free to go.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCKennyWeathersTopic002 "I've paid for your freedom. You're free to go." [DIAL:0013A60E]

text_content: {Doesn't make sense}Why free me now? After what you done? I ain't saying thank you.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCKennyWeathersTopic002 "I've paid for your freedom. You're free to go." [DIAL:0013A60E]
speaker: NVCCKennyWeathers "Kenny Weathers" [NPC_:001364C7]

text_content: <Lie> I paid for your release. You're free to go.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCMrsWeathersTopic014 "<Lie> I paid for your release. You're free to go." [DIAL:0013A60F]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Finally! Let's get out of here!
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCMrsWeathersTopic014 "<Lie> I paid for your release. You're free to go." [DIAL:0013A60F]
speaker: NVCCMrsWeathers "Mrs. Weathers" [NPC_:00130BB9]

text_content: [FAILED] I don't believe you. This key has to have been stolen.|None of the guards have said we're free to go. As soon as we step out of here, we're just going to get caught again, or worse.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCMrsWeathersTopic014 "<Lie> I paid for your release. You're free to go." [DIAL:0013A60F]
speaker: NVCCMrsWeathers "Mrs. Weathers" [NPC_:00130BB9]

text_content: <Give Mrs. Weathers the key from Canyon Runner>
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCMrsWeathersTopic009 "<Give Mrs. Weathers the key from Canyon Runner>" [DIAL:0013A610]

text_content: {shocked disbelief}Th-thank you! I don't know that we'll ever be able to repay you, but we'll do our best one day once I've found a place to settle.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCMrsWeathersTopic009 "<Give Mrs. Weathers the key from Canyon Runner>" [DIAL:0013A610]
speaker: NVCCMrsWeathers "Mrs. Weathers" [NPC_:00130BB9]

text_content: Who is Cursor Lucullus?
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCCanyonRunnerTopic022 "Who is Cursor Lucullus?" [DIAL:0013A611]

text_content: The best Cursor in the Legion. You'll reach Fortification Hill without incident, that's for sure.|{envious}Wait until you see the encampment, how massive it is. And a personal audience with mighty Caesar - glorious!
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCCanyonRunnerTopic022 "Who is Cursor Lucullus?" [DIAL:0013A611]
speaker: NVCCCanyonRunner "Canyon Runner" [NPC_:0012B514]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCCanyonRunnerTopic021 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0013A612]

text_content: {"Wall-ae"}Vale.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCCanyonRunnerTopic021 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0013A612]
speaker: NVCCCanyonRunner "Canyon Runner" [NPC_:0012B514]

text_content: How did you join Caesar's Legion?
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCCanyonRunnerTopic020 "How did you join Caesar's Legion?" [DIAL:0013A613]

text_content: {proudly}I have Blackfoot in me, the first tribe that {KAI-zar}Caesar ever led in battle - the tribe that formed the Legion.|If not for him, we'd still be living in tents or shacks, scavenging for food like animals. If we were alive at all.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCCanyonRunnerTopic020 "How did you join Caesar's Legion?" [DIAL:0013A613]
speaker: NVCCCanyonRunner "Canyon Runner" [NPC_:0012B514]

text_content: How did the Legion set up a camp on this side of the river?
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCCanyonRunnerTopic019 "How did the Legion set up a camp on this side of the river?" [DIAL:0013A614]

text_content: It was easy. The Colorado is narrow here, and when the Profligates abandoned Searchlight, there was no one to guard the crossing.|It's just a small outpost, but we keep busy. Raiding parties go out, new captures come in.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCCanyonRunnerTopic019 "How did the Legion set up a camp on this side of the river?" [DIAL:0013A614]
speaker: NVCCCanyonRunner "Canyon Runner" [NPC_:0012B514]

text_content: I'll give you 150 caps for the lot.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCCanyonRunnerTopic018 "I'll give you 150 caps for the lot." [DIAL:0013A615]

text_content: Seems I'm fortunate to get that much for them, given the circumstances!|Here, this is the key to their collars. You'll want to take those off before you go far, trust me.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCCanyonRunnerTopic018 "I'll give you 150 caps for the lot." [DIAL:0013A615]
speaker: NVCCCanyonRunner "Canyon Runner" [NPC_:0012B514]

text_content: {scoffing}This isn't the total we agreed upon. Don't waste my time, wastelander.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCCanyonRunnerTopic018 "I'll give you 150 caps for the lot." [DIAL:0013A615]
speaker: NVCCCanyonRunner "Canyon Runner" [NPC_:0012B514]

text_content: How much would it cost to buy the three "captures"?
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCCanyonRunnerTopic016 "How much would it cost to buy the three ""captures""?" [DIAL:0013A616]

text_content: It's a weak bunch, to be honest. I'd rather have extra currency to buy supplies or better captures off traders.|There's a boy, too old to be trained as a Legionary. Normally they have to die, but he's too frail to make trouble.|The old woman's dried up, but she could keep house or do gardening - if she can learn to keep her mouth shut.|The girl's the only one of real value, young enough to breed, not hideous to look at. What's your offer for the lot?
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCCanyonRunnerTopic016 "How much would it cost to buy the three ""captures""?" [DIAL:0013A616]
speaker: NVCCCanyonRunner "Canyon Runner" [NPC_:0012B514]

text_content: It doesn't bother you, enslaving people?
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCCanyonRunnerTopic011 "It doesn't bother you, enslaving people?" [DIAL:0013A617]

text_content: {the player's ignorance is almost comical}Why would it bother me to enslave these wretches? They have no purpose, no creed, no honor.|They live in pitiful squalor, undisciplined, intemperate. To enslave them is to save them - to give them purpose, and virtue.|{Ho-NES-tas, In-DUS-tree-ah, Proo-DEN-tee-ah}Honestas, Industria, Prudentia - even the virtues of slaves are beyond the Dissolute on this side of the river.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCCanyonRunnerTopic011 "It doesn't bother you, enslaving people?" [DIAL:0013A617]
speaker: NVCCCanyonRunner "Canyon Runner" [NPC_:0012B514]

text_content: What happened to your family?
name: vDialogueVegasEast21EFrankWeathersTopic016 "What happened to your family?" [DIAL:0013A618]

text_content: We were crossing the Mojave, not far from Searchlight, when a band of Caesar's Legion slavers came out of nowhere. They took my family.
name: vDialogueVegasEast21EFrankWeathersTopic016 "What happened to your family?" [DIAL:0013A618]
speaker: 1EFrankWeathers "Frank Weathers" [NPC_:000F839D]

text_content: Caesar's Legion attacked us near Searchlight. The rangers say they probably took my family to Cottonwood Cove.
name: vDialogueVegasEast21EFrankWeathersTopic016 "What happened to your family?" [DIAL:0013A618]
speaker: 1EFrankWeathers "Frank Weathers" [NPC_:000F839D]

text_content: About your family...
name: vDialogueVegasEast21EFrankWeathersTopic015 "About your family..." [DIAL:0013A619]

text_content: Yes? Have you found them?
name: vDialogueVegasEast21EFrankWeathersTopic015 "About your family..." [DIAL:0013A619]
speaker: 1EFrankWeathers "Frank Weathers" [NPC_:000F839D]

text_content: Why'd you come all the way out to New Vegas?
name: vDialogueVegasEast21EFrankWeathersTopic014 "Why'd you come all the way out to New Vegas?" [DIAL:0013A61A]

text_content: Why does anybody? I thought I'd strike it rich at the tables, make my fortune and never have to plow those damn fields again.|I just wanted to provide for my family - and now they're gone. All gone. God forgive me....
name: vDialogueVegasEast21EFrankWeathersTopic014 "Why'd you come all the way out to New Vegas?" [DIAL:0013A61A]
speaker: 1EFrankWeathers "Frank Weathers" [NPC_:000F839D]

text_content: What do you know about the Legion?
name: vDialogueVegasEast21EFrankWeathersTopic013 "What do you know about the Legion?" [DIAL:0013A61B]

text_content: {Vehement}They're cannibals, slavers, and worse.|I hear rumors they're poised to overrun the entire Colorado River Valley, and even the Army won't be enough to stop them.|One of the officers here, or at Camp McCarran, might be able to tell you more.
name: vDialogueVegasEast21EFrankWeathersTopic013 "What do you know about the Legion?" [DIAL:0013A61B]
speaker: 1EFrankWeathers "Frank Weathers" [NPC_:000F839D]

text_content: Who are you?
name: vDialogueVegasEast21EFrankWeathersTopic012 "Who are you?" [DIAL:0013A61C]

text_content: My name's Frank Weathers. I'm a farmer, got a few hundred acres near Junktown. Well, I was a farmer. I guess I'm not much of anything now.
name: vDialogueVegasEast21EFrankWeathersTopic012 "Who are you?" [DIAL:0013A61C]
speaker: 1EFrankWeathers "Frank Weathers" [NPC_:000F839D]

text_content: Why can't I just continue on?
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveFortLegionaryEntranceGreeterTopic004 "Why can't I just continue on?" [DIAL:0013A670]

text_content: {Kai-zar}Caesar strictly forbids the use of chems and alcohol. By his order, all visitors must also relinquish their arms upon entry.|If you come in peace, then there is no reason to not disarm. You will not be harmed unless Caesar wills it.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveFortLegionaryEntranceGreeterTopic004 "Why can't I just continue on?" [DIAL:0013A670]
speaker: FortLegionaryEntranceGreeter "Legionary Main Gate Guard" [NPC_:00139B6F]

text_content: I'm ready to return to Cottonwood Cove.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCLucullusTopic008 "I'm ready to return to Cottonwood Cove." [DIAL:0013A671]

text_content: Very well.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCLucullusTopic008 "I'm ready to return to Cottonwood Cove." [DIAL:0013A671]
speaker: NVCCLucullus "Cursor Lucullus" [NPC_:0012B515]

text_content: What is considered a banned item?
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveFortLegionaryEntranceGreeterTopic005 "What is considered a banned item?" [DIAL:0013A672]

text_content: Alcohol and all chems, including stims and other addictive items.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveFortLegionaryEntranceGreeterTopic005 "What is considered a banned item?" [DIAL:0013A672]
speaker: FortLegionaryEntranceGreeter "Legionary Main Gate Guard" [NPC_:00139B6F]

text_content: What do you do around here?
name: VDialogueVault21MartinaGroesbeckTopic013 "What do you do around here?" [DIAL:0013A684]

text_content: I do odd jobs here and there, usually helping Sarah keep the Vault tidy. I came to New Vegas to be a professional gambler.|Too bad for me that the "professional" part isn't working out so good. But, I love gambling, so I'm here to stay on the Strip until they kick me out.
name: VDialogueVault21MartinaGroesbeckTopic013 "What do you do around here?" [DIAL:0013A684]
speaker: MartinaGroesbeck "Martina Groesbeck" [NPC_:0011E496]

text_content: Let's talk about something else now.
name: VDialogueVault21MartinaGroesbeckTopic012 "Let's talk about something else now." [DIAL:0013A685]

text_content: Okay.
name: VDialogueVault21MartinaGroesbeckTopic012 "Let's talk about something else now." [DIAL:0013A685]
speaker: MartinaGroesbeck "Martina Groesbeck" [NPC_:0011E496]

text_content: Dangerous work.
name: VDialogueVault21MartinaGroesbeckTopic011 "Dangerous work." [DIAL:0013A686]

text_content: It isn't normally. The NCR wanted me to just gamble and listen, nothing else.
name: VDialogueVault21MartinaGroesbeckTopic011 "Dangerous work." [DIAL:0013A686]
speaker: MartinaGroesbeck "Martina Groesbeck" [NPC_:0011E496]

text_content: So, you're a spy.
name: VDialogueVault21MartinaGroesbeckTopic010 "So, you're a spy." [DIAL:0013A687]

text_content: No! Well, not really. I mean, I'm not listening through doors or sneaking around or anything. People talk out loud, and I just pay attention.|The NCR likes to keep tabs on the activities of the families, and they pay me good caps to hang around the casinos and keep my ears open.
name: VDialogueVault21MartinaGroesbeckTopic010 "So, you're a spy." [DIAL:0013A687]
speaker: MartinaGroesbeck "Martina Groesbeck" [NPC_:0011E496]

text_content: You work with the NCR? It was the Legion who sent me to protect you.
name: VDialogueVault21MartinaGroesbeckTopic009 "You work with the NCR? It was the Legion who sent me to protect you." [DIAL:0013A688]

text_content: {slightly insulted}What? I only talk to Captain Curtis over at McCarran. I would never work with slavers. Honest.
name: VDialogueVault21MartinaGroesbeckTopic009 "You work with the NCR? It was the Legion who sent me to protect you." [DIAL:0013A688]
speaker: MartinaGroesbeck "Martina Groesbeck" [NPC_:0011E496]

text_content: Save your thanks - this was a job, nothing more.
name: VDialogueVault21MartinaGroesbeckTopic008 "Save your thanks - this was a job, nothing more." [DIAL:0013A689]

text_content: Oh. Um... okay.
name: VDialogueVault21MartinaGroesbeckTopic008 "Save your thanks - this was a job, nothing more." [DIAL:0013A689]
speaker: MartinaGroesbeck "Martina Groesbeck" [NPC_:0011E496]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VDialogueVault21MartinaGroesbeckTopic003 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0013A68A]

text_content: Goodbye!
name: VDialogueVault21MartinaGroesbeckTopic003 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0013A68A]
speaker: MartinaGroesbeck "Martina Groesbeck" [NPC_:0011E496]

text_content: Why were the Omertas out to kill you?
name: VDialogueVault21MartinaGroesbeckTopic002 "Why were the Omertas out to kill you?" [DIAL:0013A68B]

text_content: I... may have overheard some things at Gomorrah that I passed on to the NCR. That's all! Honest.
name: VDialogueVault21MartinaGroesbeckTopic002 "Why were the Omertas out to kill you?" [DIAL:0013A68B]
speaker: MartinaGroesbeck "Martina Groesbeck" [NPC_:0011E496]

text_content: You were lucky. I might not be around next time.
name: VDialogueVault21MartinaGroesbeckTopic001 "You were lucky. I might not be around next time." [DIAL:0013A68C]

text_content: There won't be a next time. I hope.
name: VDialogueVault21MartinaGroesbeckTopic001 "You were lucky. I might not be around next time." [DIAL:0013A68C]
speaker: MartinaGroesbeck "Martina Groesbeck" [NPC_:0011E496]

text_content: Are you all right?
name: VDialogueVault21MartinaGroesbeckTopic000 "Are you all right?" [DIAL:0013A68D]

text_content: I'll be fine... eventually.
name: VDialogueVault21MartinaGroesbeckTopic000 "Are you all right?" [DIAL:0013A68D]
speaker: MartinaGroesbeck "Martina Groesbeck" [NPC_:0011E496]

text_content: <Speech for allowing meds>
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveFortLegionaryEntranceGreeterTopic006 "<Speech for allowing meds>" [DIAL:0013A6ED]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] I know not why Caesar would wish to speak with such a physically inferior whelp, but I will allow this one exception.|You may bear Caesar's mark, but {strong emphasis}do not attempt to share any of your medicine with anyone in The Fort.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveFortLegionaryEntranceGreeterTopic006 "<Speech for allowing meds>" [DIAL:0013A6ED]
speaker: FortLegionaryEntranceGreeter "Legionary Main Gate Guard" [NPC_:00139B6F]

text_content: [FAILED] Thus is Caesar's will. Do not test my patience.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveFortLegionaryEntranceGreeterTopic006 "<Speech for allowing meds>" [DIAL:0013A6ED]
speaker: FortLegionaryEntranceGreeter "Legionary Main Gate Guard" [NPC_:00139B6F]

text_content: I've paid for your freedom. You're free to go.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCKennyWeathersTopic009 "I've paid for your freedom. You're free to go." [DIAL:0013A6EE]

text_content: {Shocked disbelief}Freedom? Thank God Frank thinks we're enslaved.|Now we can actually start fresh. Thank you for helping us.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCKennyWeathersTopic009 "I've paid for your freedom. You're free to go." [DIAL:0013A6EE]
speaker: NVCCKennyWeathers "Kenny Weathers" [NPC_:001364C7]

text_content: How were you captured?
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCMrsWeathersTopic016 "How were you captured?" [DIAL:0013A6EF]

text_content: My family was ambushed by a pack of Legion raiders near Searchlight and Frank ran off, the gutless coward!|I have no idea where he is, but at least we're free from his abuse.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCMrsWeathersTopic016 "How were you captured?" [DIAL:0013A6EF]
speaker: NVCCMrsWeathers "Mrs. Weathers" [NPC_:00130BB9]

text_content: Tell me again what you know about the target.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic027 "Tell me again what you know about the target." [DIAL:0013A7E7]

text_content: Violet's got dogs. Lots of dogs. While they're ripping you to shreds up close, she'll be putting rounds through you with her rifle.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic027 "Tell me again what you know about the target." [DIAL:0013A7E7]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: Driver Nephi is a monster in close combat with that golf club of his, and that man is about as fast on his feet as any Legionary.|If you haven't already, see about getting Gorobets and First Recon to help you - they've got things to settle with Driver Nephi, too.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic027 "Tell me again what you know about the target." [DIAL:0013A7E7]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: Cook-Cook loves using his flamethrower on his victims, usually after he rapes them. Little Buster can tell you more about him than I can, though.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic027 "Tell me again what you know about the target." [DIAL:0013A7E7]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: I've got other questions.
name: VMS36VBSCaptainGillesTopic010 "I've got other questions." [DIAL:0013A7EC]

text_content: {Stressed}Sure, but make them quick.
name: VMS36VBSCaptainGillesTopic010 "I've got other questions." [DIAL:0013A7EC]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: I dragged myself all over Hell's half-acre for you, I expect something substantial!
name: VMS36VBSCaptainGillesTopic009 "I dragged myself all over Hell's half-acre for you, I expect something substantial!" [DIAL:0013A7ED]

text_content: {Cold}If a reward is all you're concerned with, here. {Bitter}Enjoy it.
name: VMS36VBSCaptainGillesTopic009 "I dragged myself all over Hell's half-acre for you, I expect something substantial!" [DIAL:0013A7ED]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: Whatever you can spare would be a big help.
name: VMS36VBSCaptainGillesTopic008 "Whatever you can spare would be a big help." [DIAL:0013A7EE]

text_content: {Pleased}Here, take this. I hope you put it to good use.
name: VMS36VBSCaptainGillesTopic008 "Whatever you can spare would be a big help." [DIAL:0013A7EE]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: I don't need any reward, just keep these people fed and healthy.
name: VMS36VBSCaptainGillesTopic007 "I don't need any reward, just keep these people fed and healthy." [DIAL:0013A7EF]

text_content: {Grateful}That's very generous of you. I appreciate it.
name: VMS36VBSCaptainGillesTopic007 "I don't need any reward, just keep these people fed and healthy." [DIAL:0013A7EF]
speaker: VBSCaptainGilles "Captain Gilles" [NPC_:0012AC9E]

text_content: [Reputation] I've done a lot for the Legion. Just hand over the bear already.
name: VFreeformTheFortFortAntonyTopic019 "[Reputation] I've done a lot for the Legion. Just hand over the bear already." [DIAL:0013AAD0]

text_content: Yeah, I guess you're right. Here.
name: VFreeformTheFortFortAntonyTopic019 "[Reputation] I've done a lot for the Legion. Just hand over the bear already." [DIAL:0013AAD0]
speaker: FortAntony "Antony" [NPC_:00120172]

text_content: Those books were pretty expensive. Maybe you can cough up a little more?

name: VMS40VBSLieutenantMarklandTopic004 "Those books were pretty expensive. Maybe you can cough up a little more?" [DIAL:0013ABAA]
speaker: VBSLieutenantMarkland "Lieutenant Markland" [NPC_:0012AC9F]

text_content: Thanks, that should cover my expenses.
name: VMS40VBSLieutenantMarklandTopic003 "Thanks, that should cover my expenses." [DIAL:0013ABAB]

name: VMS40VBSLieutenantMarklandTopic003 "Thanks, that should cover my expenses." [DIAL:0013ABAB]
speaker: VBSLieutenantMarkland "Lieutenant Markland" [NPC_:0012AC9F]

name: VMS40VBSLieutenantMarklandTopic002 "Some spare meds would be great - and those books weren't cheap." [DIAL:0013ABAC]

text_content: What happened to the mayor?
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic009 "What happened to the mayor?" [DIAL:0013ABDD]

text_content: {lightening up}Him? When his ticket came up, they burned him alive on a pile of tires.
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic009 "What happened to the mayor?" [DIAL:0013ABDD]
speaker: vNiptonBoxcars2 "Boxcars" [NPC_:00134972]

text_content: Do you remember the message you were told to spread?
name: VNiptonvNiptonSurvivorTopic004 "Do you remember the message you were told to spread?" [DIAL:0013ABDE]

text_content: {bewildered}The message? You know about that...?|{bewildered}There was some kind of message, but... I don't seem to remember it.|{Jubilant again}Yeah... that air! Smell it!
name: VNiptonvNiptonSurvivorTopic004 "Do you remember the message you were told to spread?" [DIAL:0013ABDE]
speaker: vNiptonSurvivor "Oliver Swanick" [NPC_:00134985]

text_content: Who are you?
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic022 "Who are you?" [DIAL:0013ABDF]

text_content: I am {WUHL-pace In-CUL-tah}Vulpes Inculta, of {KAI-zar's}Caesar's Legion. I serve my master as the greatest of his {froo-men-TAR-ee}Frumentarii.|We Frumentarii are soldiers of a different stripe, capable in battle, but skilled as infiltrators and agents as well.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic022 "Who are you?" [DIAL:0013ABDF]
speaker: VLegionaryVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:001300E2]

text_content: Tell me about Caesar.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic021 "Tell me about Caesar." [DIAL:0013ABE0]

text_content: What can be said? He's a man of towering intellect, the founder of the Legion, conquerer of 86 tribes.|{KAI-zar}Caesar is the salvation of mankind, his Legion the rebirth of civilization in a benighted age.|Don't worry, you'll know him well when you serve him. Or you'll be dead.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic021 "Tell me about Caesar." [DIAL:0013ABE0]
speaker: VLegionaryVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:001300E2]

text_content: Who is this Legatus you mention?
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic020 "Who is this Legatus you mention?" [DIAL:0013ABE1]

text_content: {admiring}Legatus Lanius, Monster of the East! Quite a man, if man he be.|{KAI-zar}Caesar prides himself on selecting the right tool to overcome each new obstacle. In Lanius, he found his hammer.|He's never been defeated in battle. 14 tribes have laid down arms at his boots. Another five, rendered extinct.|His latest campaign in the wilds of the Utah has concluded, and he is en route. When he arrives, your doom arrives with him.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic020 "Who is this Legatus you mention?" [DIAL:0013ABE1]
speaker: VLegionaryVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:001300E2]

text_content: I've heard enough.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic018 "I've heard enough." [DIAL:0013ABE2]

text_content: I think your eyes will see more than I could ever tell you. Take your time. Enjoy the sights.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic018 "I've heard enough." [DIAL:0013ABE2]
speaker: VLegionaryVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:001300E2]

text_content: {curious}Why, then, do you keep asking?
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic018 "I've heard enough." [DIAL:0013ABE2]
speaker: VLegionaryVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:001300E2]

text_content: You slaughtered innocent civilians?
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic017 "You slaughtered innocent civilians?" [DIAL:0013ABE3]

text_content: {scoffing Ha!}Innocent? Hardly.|Cowardly, though. They outnumbered us, yet not once did they try to resist.|They stood and watched as their fellows were butchered, crucified, and burned, one by one.|They stood and hoped their turn would not come. Each cared only for himself.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic017 "You slaughtered innocent civilians?" [DIAL:0013ABE3]
speaker: VLegionaryVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:001300E2]

text_content: I admire the purity of the Legion's justice.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic016 "I admire the purity of the Legion's justice." [DIAL:0013ABE4]

text_content: You're unusually bright for a Profligate. Well done.|Now go, and teach what you've learned here. There will be more lessons in the days ahead.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic016 "I admire the purity of the Legion's justice." [DIAL:0013ABE4]
speaker: VLegionaryVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:001300E2]

text_content: It has a stark beauty, doesn't it? I'm glad you can appreciate it.|Now go, and teach them what you learned here. There will be more lessons in the days ahead.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic016 "I admire the purity of the Legion's justice." [DIAL:0013ABE4]
speaker: VLegionaryVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:001300E2]

text_content: Sounds like they got what was coming to them.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic015 "Sounds like they got what was coming to them." [DIAL:0013ABE5]

text_content: Yes, they did. As will all the rest of you, in due time.|Now go, and teach what you've learned here. There will be more lessons in the days ahead.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic015 "Sounds like they got what was coming to them." [DIAL:0013ABE5]
speaker: VLegionaryVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:001300E2]

text_content: Yes, they did. As will all the rest of them, in due time.|Now go, and teach them what you learned here. There will be more lessons in the days ahead.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic015 "Sounds like they got what was coming to them." [DIAL:0013ABE5]
speaker: VLegionaryVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:001300E2]

text_content: You captured everyone?
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic014 "You captured everyone?" [DIAL:0013ABE6]

text_content: Yes, and herded them to the center of town. I told them their sins, the foremost being disloyalty.|I told them that when Legionaries are disloyal, some are punished, the others made to watch. And I announced the lottery.|Each clutched his ticket, hoping it would set him free. Each did nothing, even when {mocking the term}"loved ones" were dragged away to be killed.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic014 "You captured everyone?" [DIAL:0013ABE6]
speaker: VLegionaryVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:001300E2]

text_content: What exactly happened here?
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic013 "What exactly happened here?" [DIAL:0013ABE7]

text_content: Nipton was a wicked place, debased and corrupt. It served all comers, so long as they paid.|Profligate troops, Powder Gangers, men of the Legion such as myself - the people here didn't care. It was a town of whores.|For a pittance, the town agreed to lead those it had sheltered into a trap. Only when I sprang it did they realize they were caught inside it, too.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic013 "What exactly happened here?" [DIAL:0013ABE7]
speaker: VLegionaryVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:001300E2]

text_content: I'm going to wear your head like you wear that dog's.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic012 "I'm going to wear your head like you wear that dog's." [DIAL:0013ABE8]

text_content: {calling to arms, frightened}Legionaries?! We have a problem!
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic012 "I'm going to wear your head like you wear that dog's." [DIAL:0013ABE8]
speaker: VLegionaryVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:001300E2]

text_content: Your "civilization" sounds like a pack of snarling dogs.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic010 "Your ""civilization"" sounds like a pack of snarling dogs." [DIAL:0013ABE9]

text_content: {scoffing guffaw}Indeed, our hounds demonstrate greater loyalty to each other every day than the wretched inhabitants of this town.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic010 "Your ""civilization"" sounds like a pack of snarling dogs." [DIAL:0013ABE9]
speaker: VLegionaryVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:001300E2]

text_content: How can I serve the Legion?
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic009 "How can I serve the Legion?" [DIAL:0013ABEA]

text_content: You bear the Mark of {KAI-zar}Caesar. That makes you special.|Do whatever {KAI-zar}Caesar tells you to do. And whenever the opportunity presents, strike at the Profligates. Pile body upon body.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic009 "How can I serve the Legion?" [DIAL:0013ABEA]
speaker: VLegionaryVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:001300E2]

text_content: Tell everyone you meet of what you saw here. The Legion can handle the rest.|That said, if you were to strike at the Profligates, butcher them, trouble their operations... this will not go unnoticed.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic009 "How can I serve the Legion?" [DIAL:0013ABEA]
speaker: VLegionaryVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:001300E2]

text_content: Tell me about Caesar's Legion.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic008 "Tell me about Caesar's Legion." [DIAL:0013ABEB]

text_content: The Legion is civilization reborn. Our culture is based on virtues such as martial excellence, loyalty, and justice.|But you'll learn all there is to know in due time. {Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius, Monster of the East, will soon arrive to command {KAI-zar's}Caesar's troops in battle.|The Dam will fall, and the rest of the Profligate west will soon follow.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic008 "Tell me about Caesar's Legion." [DIAL:0013ABEB]
speaker: VLegionaryVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:001300E2]

text_content: What "lessons" did you teach here?
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic007 "What ""lessons"" did you teach here?" [DIAL:0013ABEC]

text_content: Where to begin? That you are weak, and we are strong? This much was known already.|But the depths of your moral sickness, your {a beat}dissolution? Nipton serves as the perfect object lesson.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic007 "What ""lessons"" did you teach here?" [DIAL:0013ABEC]
speaker: VLegionaryVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:001300E2]

text_content: Where to begin? That they are weak, and we are strong? This much was known already.|But the depths of their moral sickness, their {a beat}dissolution? Nipton serves as the perfect object lesson.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic007 "What ""lessons"" did you teach here?" [DIAL:0013ABEC]
speaker: VLegionaryVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:001300E2]

text_content: Your crimes are unforgivable.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic006 "Your crimes are unforgivable." [DIAL:0013ABED]

text_content: {carefree}As are all crimes. If you feel strongly about it, attack us, and soon you won't feel a thing.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic006 "Your crimes are unforgivable." [DIAL:0013ABED]
speaker: VLegionaryVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:001300E2]

text_content: So you've said.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic006 "Your crimes are unforgivable." [DIAL:0013ABED]
speaker: VLegionaryVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:001300E2]

text_content: You're the guy who won the lottery.
name: VNiptonvNiptonSurvivorTopic003 "You're the guy who won the lottery." [DIAL:0013ABEE]

text_content: {suddenly angry}Lottery? You remember the lottery?|{attacking the player}Goddamn you! I don't need to remember that!
name: VNiptonvNiptonSurvivorTopic003 "You're the guy who won the lottery." [DIAL:0013ABEE]
speaker: vNiptonSurvivor "Oliver Swanick" [NPC_:00134985]

text_content: Are you a Powder Ganger?
name: VNiptonvNiptonSurvivorTopic002 "Are you a Powder Ganger?" [DIAL:0013ABEF]

text_content: {exulting - so filled with joy you're not sure what player asked you}Powder Ganger? What? I mean, yeah, used to be, sure!|But not no more! Powder Gang is small-time, man! I'm a winner! I won the motherfucking {go big on "lottery"}lottery!{laughter}
name: VNiptonvNiptonSurvivorTopic002 "Are you a Powder Ganger?" [DIAL:0013ABEF]
speaker: vNiptonSurvivor "Oliver Swanick" [NPC_:00134985]

text_content: I don't have any Med-X for you.
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic024 "I don't have any Med-X for you." [DIAL:0013ABF0]

text_content: {surly}Bullshit. You're holding, you just want it all for yourself!
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic024 "I don't have any Med-X for you." [DIAL:0013ABF0]
speaker: vNiptonBoxcars2 "Boxcars" [NPC_:00134972]

text_content: Five doses.
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic023 "Five doses." [DIAL:0013ABF1]

text_content: {appeased}Five doses? {Niiiiice}Nice. A fella could put himself out of his misery with five doses.
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic023 "Five doses." [DIAL:0013ABF1]
speaker: vNiptonBoxcars2 "Boxcars" [NPC_:00134972]

text_content: Three doses.
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic022 "Three doses." [DIAL:0013ABF2]

name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic022 "Three doses." [DIAL:0013ABF2]
speaker: vNiptonBoxcars2 "Boxcars" [NPC_:00134972]

text_content: Two doses.
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic021 "Two doses." [DIAL:0013ABF3]

text_content: {appeased}Good enough. Hand it over.
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic021 "Two doses." [DIAL:0013ABF3]
speaker: vNiptonBoxcars2 "Boxcars" [NPC_:00134972]

text_content: One dose.
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic020 "One dose." [DIAL:0013ABF4]

text_content: Big fucking deal. Hand it over.
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic020 "One dose." [DIAL:0013ABF4]
speaker: vNiptonBoxcars2 "Boxcars" [NPC_:00134972]

text_content: I can spare some Med-X.
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic016 "I can spare some Med-X." [DIAL:0013ABF5]

text_content: {appeased}Then you're a fucking dream come true, ain't ya? How much you gonna give me?
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic016 "I can spare some Med-X." [DIAL:0013ABF5]
speaker: vNiptonBoxcars2 "Boxcars" [NPC_:00134972]

text_content: It's not my problem.
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic015 "It's not my problem." [DIAL:0013ABF6]

text_content: {irritated but agreeing}That's how I figure it. Got problems of my own to handle.
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic015 "It's not my problem." [DIAL:0013ABF6]
speaker: vNiptonBoxcars2 "Boxcars" [NPC_:00134972]

text_content: I'll do what I can to save them.
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic014 "I'll do what I can to save them." [DIAL:0013ABF7]

text_content: {surly}Don't act like you'd be doing me a favor. I don't give a fuck.
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic014 "I'll do what I can to save them." [DIAL:0013ABF7]
speaker: vNiptonBoxcars2 "Boxcars" [NPC_:00134972]

text_content: You said some of the people were enslaved?
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic013 "You said some of the people were enslaved?" [DIAL:0013ABF8]

text_content: {surly}Yeah, a bunch of those Legion fucks dragged them off right away. They was headed East, if you're feeling heroic.
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic013 "You said some of the people were enslaved?" [DIAL:0013ABF8]
speaker: vNiptonBoxcars2 "Boxcars" [NPC_:00134972]

text_content: What happened after everyone got lottery tickets?
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic012 "What happened after everyone got lottery tickets?" [DIAL:0013ABF9]

text_content: {hating the memory}What do you think? He started drawing tickets, and that's how people got punished.|{hating the memory}First up was the "lucky losers." They got decapitated - guess that's "lucky" {cuz}because it's pretty quick.|{hating the memory}Then came the crucifixions. Goddamn but those went on and on and on...|{hating the memory}Third-place runners-up got enslaved. I got the fuck beat out of my legs, and the winner they let go free.
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic012 "What happened after everyone got lottery tickets?" [DIAL:0013ABF9]
speaker: vNiptonBoxcars2 "Boxcars" [NPC_:00134972]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic011 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0013ABFA]

text_content: {surly}Like what?
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic011 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0013ABFA]
speaker: vNiptonBoxcars2 "Boxcars" [NPC_:00134972]

text_content: How'd your plan go wrong?
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic010 "How'd your plan go wrong?" [DIAL:0013ABFB]

text_content: {bitter}We get in position and next thing we know, we're surrounded by those fucking Legion freaks.|{remembering it}They dragged us and everybody else into the center of town. And that asshole with a dog on his head, he starts talking about how we're bad people!|{hating the memory}He said we needed to be punished for what we did, not all of us, but some of us. And then he gives everyone a fucking lottery ticket...
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic010 "How'd your plan go wrong?" [DIAL:0013ABFB]
speaker: vNiptonBoxcars2 "Boxcars" [NPC_:00134972]

text_content: You live out here by yourself?

speaker: VRemCannibalJohnson "Cannibal Johnson" [NPC_:001010B7]

name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemCannibalJohnsonTopic002 "I don't have any more questions. Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0013AC28]

text_content: Well, ain't like I've got places to be.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemCannibalJohnsonTopic002 "I don't have any more questions. Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0013AC28]

text_content: {grinning and being difficult}Ha. I'm not saying. It's part of my mystique, after all.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemCannibalJohnsonTopic001 "So, are you a cannibal?" [DIAL:0013AC29]
speaker: VRemCannibalJohnson "Cannibal Johnson" [NPC_:001010B7]

text_content: {grinning}I'm still not saying.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemCannibalJohnsonTopic001 "So, are you a cannibal?" [DIAL:0013AC29]
speaker: VRemCannibalJohnson "Cannibal Johnson" [NPC_:001010B7]

name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemCannibalJohnsonTopic000 "Tell me about yourself." [DIAL:0013AC2A]

name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemCannibalJohnsonTopic000 "Tell me about yourself." [DIAL:0013AC2A]

text_content: [FAILED] Well look who is all high and mighty! You're no better than me when it boils down, bub.
name: vDialogueVegasEast21EFrankWeathersTopic024 "<Speech - Anger>" [DIAL:0013AC79]
speaker: 1EFrankWeathers "Frank Weathers" [NPC_:000F839D]

text_content: They mentioned going to the Old Mormon Fort in Freeside.
name: vDialogueVegasEast21EFrankWeathersTopic025 "They mentioned going to the Old Mormon Fort in Freeside." [DIAL:0013AC7A]

text_content: Crap, those goody-goodies kicked me out of there once already. No way I'm getting in.|Even if I could get in, rehab is for chumps. Well, thanks for doing what you could.|Guess I'll get a fresh start and keep an eye out in case they leave the Fort.
name: vDialogueVegasEast21EFrankWeathersTopic025 "They mentioned going to the Old Mormon Fort in Freeside." [DIAL:0013AC7A]
speaker: 1EFrankWeathers "Frank Weathers" [NPC_:000F839D]

text_content: Goodbye, Frank.
name: vDialogueVegasEast21EFrankWeathersTopic026 "Goodbye, Frank." [DIAL:0013AC7B]

text_content: <Speech - Suicide>
name: vDialogueVegasEast21EFrankWeathersTopic027 "<Speech - Suicide>" [DIAL:0013AC7C]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] You're right. I've got nothing left...|{Pathetic suicidal whimpering - about to shoot self}I'll never see my kids grow up, but they're better off without me.
name: vDialogueVegasEast21EFrankWeathersTopic027 "<Speech - Suicide>" [DIAL:0013AC7C]
speaker: 1EFrankWeathers "Frank Weathers" [NPC_:000F839D]

text_content: [FAILED] You think you're better than me? You're just like those goody-goody Followers of the Apocalypse.
name: vDialogueVegasEast21EFrankWeathersTopic027 "<Speech - Suicide>" [DIAL:0013AC7C]
speaker: 1EFrankWeathers "Frank Weathers" [NPC_:000F839D]

text_content: <Speech>
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCLegionaryGuardAAMExplorerTopic000 "<Speech>" [DIAL:0013AC7D]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Very well. You may proceed.|However, be warned. Aggressive acts against us will earn you a place on a cross.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCLegionaryGuardAAMExplorerTopic000 "<Speech>" [DIAL:0013AC7D]
speaker: NVCCLegionaryGuardAAMExplorer "Legion Explorer" [NPC_:00135F68]

text_content: [FAILED] Tread lightly, fool. You are entering Caesar's land.|Aggressive acts against us will earn you a place on a cross. Turn back now, or pay the consequences.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCLegionaryGuardAAMExplorerTopic000 "<Speech>" [DIAL:0013AC7D]
speaker: NVCCLegionaryGuardAAMExplorer "Legion Explorer" [NPC_:00135F68]

text_content: <Show Mark of Caesar> I was invited.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCLegionaryGuardAAMExplorerTopic001 "<Show Mark of Caesar> I was invited." [DIAL:0013AC7E]

text_content: You wear the Mark of Caesar?! You must be who Cursor Lucullus is waiting for.|You may continue, but be warned. Mark or no, we will not tolerate aggressive action by visitors in the camp.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCLegionaryGuardAAMExplorerTopic001 "<Show Mark of Caesar> I was invited." [DIAL:0013AC7E]
speaker: NVCCLegionaryGuardAAMExplorer "Legion Explorer" [NPC_:00135F68]

text_content: <Attack> I go where I please!
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCLegionaryGuardAAMExplorerTopic002 "<Attack> I go where I please!" [DIAL:0013AC7F]

text_content: {call to battle}To arms, brothers!
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCLegionaryGuardAAMExplorerTopic002 "<Attack> I go where I please!" [DIAL:0013AC7F]
speaker: NVCCLegionaryGuardAAMExplorer "Legion Explorer" [NPC_:00135F68]

text_content: Be calm. I am a friend of the Legion.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCLegionaryGuardAAMExplorerTopic003 "Be calm. I am a friend of the Legion." [DIAL:0013AC80]

text_content: Very well. You may proceed.|However, be warned. Aggressive acts against us will earn you a place on a cross.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCLegionaryGuardAAMExplorerTopic003 "Be calm. I am a friend of the Legion." [DIAL:0013AC80]
speaker: NVCCLegionaryGuardAAMExplorer "Legion Explorer" [NPC_:00135F68]

text_content: Fool. Your deeds are known well among us.|To arms, my brothers!
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCLegionaryGuardAAMExplorerTopic003 "Be calm. I am a friend of the Legion." [DIAL:0013AC80]
speaker: NVCCLegionaryGuardAAMExplorer "Legion Explorer" [NPC_:00135F68]

text_content: test
name: test "test" [DIAL:0013ACAC]

text_content: I have another question about you.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic102 "I have another question about you." [DIAL:0013AE44]

text_content: Sure.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic102 "I have another question about you." [DIAL:0013AE44]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Not anymore?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic101 "Not anymore?" [DIAL:0013AE45]

text_content: No.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic101 "Not anymore?" [DIAL:0013AE45]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: When Carla went missing he was the first person I told.|He tried to hide it, but I could tell right away. He was glad.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic101 "Not anymore?" [DIAL:0013AE45]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Weren't you also friends?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic100 "Weren't you also friends?" [DIAL:0013AE46]

text_content: Yeah. We were.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic100 "Weren't you also friends?" [DIAL:0013AE46]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: How do you feel about Manny Vargas?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic099 "How do you feel about Manny Vargas?" [DIAL:0013AE47]

text_content: Don't ever say that name again.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic099 "How do you feel about Manny Vargas?" [DIAL:0013AE47]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: He was a good spotter.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic099 "How do you feel about Manny Vargas?" [DIAL:0013AE47]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Ever take that beret off?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic098 "Ever take that beret off?" [DIAL:0013AE48]

text_content: No.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic098 "Ever take that beret off?" [DIAL:0013AE48]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: What's the best way for me to use your skills?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic097 "What's the best way for me to use your skills?" [DIAL:0013AE49]

text_content: Give me my rifle and a clear line of sight and I'll start picking them off before they've even seen me.|Didn't have much hand-to-hand training, so our chances are better if you keep the enemy out of my face.|I'm trained as a spotter, too. If you're looking through a scope, I can find your targets for you.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic097 "What's the best way for me to use your skills?" [DIAL:0013AE49]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Tell me about yourself.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic096 "Tell me about yourself." [DIAL:0013AE4A]

text_content: If you want. It's not really my thing. What do you want to know?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic096 "Tell me about yourself." [DIAL:0013AE4A]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: VDialogueCraigBooneNiptonReact
name: VDialogueCraigBooneNiptonReact "VDialogueCraigBooneNiptonReact" [DIAL:0013AE4B]

text_content: They got what they had coming. Glad we were the ones to deliver it.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneNiptonReact "VDialogueCraigBooneNiptonReact" [DIAL:0013AE4B]

text_content: I had some questions I wanted to ask you.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic106 "I had some questions I wanted to ask you." [DIAL:0013B129]

text_content: Okay.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic106 "I had some questions I wanted to ask you." [DIAL:0013B129]

text_content: Did you ever tell your wife about what happened at Bitter Springs?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic104 "Did you ever tell your wife about what happened at Bitter Springs?" [DIAL:0013B12A]

text_content: No. I wanted to. I just couldn't.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic104 "Did you ever tell your wife about what happened at Bitter Springs?" [DIAL:0013B12A]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Tell me about your wife.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic103 "Tell me about your wife." [DIAL:0013B12B]

text_content: Carla's dead. That's all you need to know.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic103 "Tell me about your wife." [DIAL:0013B12B]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: I met Carla while I was at the Strip on leave. She said I looked lost.|She talked a lot. Suited me fine - I never know what to say. And listening to her, it could... make you forget.|She stuck out, pretty much everywhere we went. Like she was from a different time. A better time. I never met anyone like her.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic103 "Tell me about your wife." [DIAL:0013B12B]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: VDialogueCraigBooneSpotterIntro
name: VDialogueCraigBooneSpotterIntro "VDialogueCraigBooneSpotterIntro" [DIAL:0013B137]

text_content: Dark in here. If you want to use a scope, I can spot for you. Keep you on target.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneSpotterIntro "VDialogueCraigBooneSpotterIntro" [DIAL:0013B137]

text_content: I have a different question.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic111 "I have a different question." [DIAL:0013B138]

text_content: Any thoughts about Caesar's Legion?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic110 "Any thoughts about Caesar's Legion?" [DIAL:0013B139]

text_content: Yeah. Lots of thoughts. All about the best ways to kill them.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic110 "Any thoughts about Caesar's Legion?" [DIAL:0013B139]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: How do you feel about the NCR?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic109 "How do you feel about the NCR?" [DIAL:0013B13A]

text_content: Coming east was about securing the land, so people could live without fear.|It's not always that simple. But I think the cause is still right.|And God help us if they lose.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic109 "How do you feel about the NCR?" [DIAL:0013B13A]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: What can you tell me about New Vegas?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic108 "What can you tell me about New Vegas?" [DIAL:0013B13B]

text_content: It's NCR land, for the most part. We tamed it, now we're settling it.|Lot of people complain about it, but they forget what it was like before we showed up.|It's a lot of territory to secure. Too much, even for a big army like the NCR's.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic108 "What can you tell me about New Vegas?" [DIAL:0013B13B]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Does the name Benny mean anything to you?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic107 "Does the name Benny mean anything to you?" [DIAL:0013B13C]

text_content: No. It doesn't.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic107 "Does the name Benny mean anything to you?" [DIAL:0013B13C]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: Have you heard of Mr. House?
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic105 "Have you heard of Mr. House?" [DIAL:0013B13D]

text_content: Yeah. I don't know much. Just rumors.|All I know is he's supposed to be in charge of the Strip. And he's been able to stop the NCR from taking it over.|Wish he'd give it up, so the NCR could focus on securing the border.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneCraigBooneTopic105 "Have you heard of Mr. House?" [DIAL:0013B13D]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: I need you to stop the violence against NCR citizens in Freeside.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic019 "I need you to stop the violence against NCR citizens in Freeside." [DIAL:0013B14B]

text_content: So I'm supposed to just start giving in to the demands of random strangers that come in here, huh? I don't think so.|You want something from me, you're gonna have to earn it. And it just so happens that I've got a few things I need taken care of. So what do you say?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic019 "I need you to stop the violence against NCR citizens in Freeside." [DIAL:0013B14B]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: I'd love to help you, but it seems I can't even prevent my own friends from getting killed. I'm sorry as can be, but I can't help you.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic019 "I need you to stop the violence against NCR citizens in Freeside." [DIAL:0013B14B]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: Notice anything suspicious?
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDKimballK9Ranger01Topic001 "Notice anything suspicious?" [DIAL:0013B309]

text_content: Nope. Haven't noticed anything strange at all. Neither has my friend here, and he has a good nose for these things.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDKimballK9Ranger01Topic001 "Notice anything suspicious?" [DIAL:0013B309]
speaker: VHDKimballK9Ranger01 "Ranger Stevens" [NPC_:00137ACF]

text_content: Not since the last time you asked, no.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDKimballK9Ranger01Topic001 "Notice anything suspicious?" [DIAL:0013B309]
speaker: VHDKimballK9Ranger01 "Ranger Stevens" [NPC_:00137ACF]

text_content: Nice looking dog you have there.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDKimballK9Ranger01Topic000 "Nice looking dog you have there." [DIAL:0013B3CF]

text_content: Thanks. We haven't been paired together long, but he's a smart dog.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDKimballK9Ranger01Topic000 "Nice looking dog you have there." [DIAL:0013B3CF]
speaker: VHDKimballK9Ranger01 "Ranger Stevens" [NPC_:00137ACF]

text_content: I found an assassin in the tower.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic001 "I found an assassin in the tower." [DIAL:0013B3D0]

text_content: Damnit! I can't believe the Legion actually got someone past our security. Good job catching him.|I'll have a security team sweep the area to see if the Legion has any more surprises for us.|I'm also canceling the President's speech. We'll have a security team get him out of here right away. But let's not relax until he's safe.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic001 "I found an assassin in the tower." [DIAL:0013B3D0]
speaker: VHDCaptainGraham "Ranger Grant" [NPC_:0013721E]

text_content: Nothing to report.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVMQ03aAssassinationRadioTopic001 "Nothing to report." [DIAL:0013B3D1]

text_content: {Radio}Then stay off the line and get back to work!
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVMQ03aAssassinationRadioTopic001 "Nothing to report." [DIAL:0013B3D1]

text_content: I found a Legion sniper on the roof of the tower.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVMQ03aAssassinationRadioTopic000 "I found a Legion sniper on the roof of the tower." [DIAL:0013B3D2]

text_content: {Radio}Damnit! I can't believe the Legion actually got someone past our security. Good job catching him.|I'll have a security team sweep the area to see if the Legion has any more surprises for us.|I'm also canceling the President's speech. We'll have a security team get him out of here right away. But let's not relax until he's safe.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVMQ03aAssassinationRadioTopic000 "I found a Legion sniper on the roof of the tower." [DIAL:0013B3D2]

text_content: I'll see what I can do.
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCMrsWeathersTopic010 "I'll see what I can do." [DIAL:0013BF4E]

text_content: {desperate}Thank you! Thank you so much!
name: VFreeformCottonwoodCoveNVCCMrsWeathersTopic010 "I'll see what I can do." [DIAL:0013BF4E]
speaker: NVCCMrsWeathers "Mrs. Weathers" [NPC_:00130BB9]

text_content: VHDIntakeTowerCenturionBarks
name: VHDIntakeTowerCenturionBarks "VHDIntakeTowerCenturionBarks" [DIAL:0013CA18]

text_content: Move it, you curs!
name: VHDIntakeTowerCenturionBarks "VHDIntakeTowerCenturionBarks" [DIAL:0013CA18]
speaker: VHDIntakeTowerCenturion "Centurion" [NPC_:0013CA37]

text_content: There's still more killing to be done!
name: VHDIntakeTowerCenturionBarks "VHDIntakeTowerCenturionBarks" [DIAL:0013CA18]
speaker: VHDIntakeTowerCenturion "Centurion" [NPC_:0013CA37]

text_content: Keep moving!
name: VHDIntakeTowerCenturionBarks "VHDIntakeTowerCenturionBarks" [DIAL:0013CA18]
speaker: VHDIntakeTowerCenturion "Centurion" [NPC_:0013CA37]

text_content: I will personally gut the first man to slow down!
name: VHDIntakeTowerCenturionBarks "VHDIntakeTowerCenturionBarks" [DIAL:0013CA18]
speaker: VHDIntakeTowerCenturion "Centurion" [NPC_:0013CA37]

text_content: Leave none alive!
name: VHDIntakeTowerCenturionBarks "VHDIntakeTowerCenturionBarks" [DIAL:0013CA18]
speaker: VHDIntakeTowerCenturion "Centurion" [NPC_:0013CA37]

text_content: {Speech 80 - Convince the centurion to direct all his men down to the power plant}
name: VHDLegionBattleVHDIntakeTowerCenturionTopic004 "{Speech 80 - Convince the centurion to direct all his men down to the power plant}" [DIAL:0013CA19]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Agreed. If we take the power plant, this battle is over. I'll have my men focus their efforts there. May the Son of Mars go with you.
name: VHDLegionBattleVHDIntakeTowerCenturionTopic004 "{Speech 80 - Convince the centurion to direct all his men down to the power plant}" [DIAL:0013CA19]
speaker: VHDIntakeTowerCenturion "Centurion" [NPC_:0013CA37]

text_content: [FAILED] Forgive my appraisal of your prowess, but all the same I'd rather send some of my men with you to help secure the dam top.
name: VHDLegionBattleVHDIntakeTowerCenturionTopic004 "{Speech 80 - Convince the centurion to direct all his men down to the power plant}" [DIAL:0013CA19]
speaker: VHDIntakeTowerCenturion "Centurion" [NPC_:0013CA37]

text_content: {Speech 60 - Convince the centurion to direct all his men to the dam top}
name: VHDLegionBattleVHDIntakeTowerCenturionTopic003 "{Speech 60 - Convince the centurion to direct all his men to the dam top}" [DIAL:0013CA1A]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Your words have merit... Very well. I shall tell my men to concentrate their efforts here.
name: VHDLegionBattleVHDIntakeTowerCenturionTopic003 "{Speech 60 - Convince the centurion to direct all his men to the dam top}" [DIAL:0013CA1A]
speaker: VHDIntakeTowerCenturion "Centurion" [NPC_:0013CA37]

text_content: [FAILED] I have my orders, and they explicitly state that I am to divide my men.
name: VHDLegionBattleVHDIntakeTowerCenturionTopic003 "{Speech 60 - Convince the centurion to direct all his men to the dam top}" [DIAL:0013CA1A]
speaker: VHDIntakeTowerCenturion "Centurion" [NPC_:0013CA37]

text_content: I have to keep moving. Kill a few of them for me.
name: VHDLegionBattleVHDIntakeTowerCenturionTopic002 "I have to keep moving. Kill a few of them for me." [DIAL:0013CA1B]

text_content: More than a few, if I have my way.
name: VHDLegionBattleVHDIntakeTowerCenturionTopic002 "I have to keep moving. Kill a few of them for me." [DIAL:0013CA1B]
speaker: VHDIntakeTowerCenturion "Centurion" [NPC_:0013CA37]

text_content: What news of the battle below?
name: VHDLegionBattleVHDIntakeTowerCenturionTopic001 "What news of the battle below?" [DIAL:0013CA1C]

text_content: The fighting in the power plant is the fiercest, as expected. But the dogs have been caught off guard, and their positions can expect no support.|However, the pipes below have been sealed, cutting off our men until the dam top can be secured.|I've been diverting half of my men to the tower next to this one. It's a bit of a swim, but the enemy hasn't sealed those pipes yet.|Some of the other centuriae are more stubborn in following their orders exactly, though, and wait in the pipes below.|If you should make it down there, unsealing the pipes again will allow us to spill over the enemy like a tide of blood.
name: VHDLegionBattleVHDIntakeTowerCenturionTopic001 "What news of the battle below?" [DIAL:0013CA1C]
speaker: VHDIntakeTowerCenturion "Centurion" [NPC_:0013CA37]

text_content: Report, centurion. What are your standing orders?
name: VHDLegionBattleVHDIntakeTowerCenturionTopic000 "Report, centurion. What are your standing orders?" [DIAL:0013CA1D]

text_content: My men await in the tunnel below. I am to divide them between the dam top and the tunnels that lead to the western power plant.
name: VHDLegionBattleVHDIntakeTowerCenturionTopic000 "Report, centurion. What are your standing orders?" [DIAL:0013CA1D]
speaker: VHDIntakeTowerCenturion "Centurion" [NPC_:0013CA37]

text_content: Something's wrong with my cyber-dog. I was told to come to you.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemDoctorHenryTopic001 "Something's wrong with my cyber-dog. I was told to come to you." [DIAL:0013D317]

text_content: It's neural degradation. Bio med gel can only preserve a living brain for so long, so you'll need to find a replacement.|I haven't left Jacobstown in years, but there was one woman in Novac... Gibson? I remember her living with a pack of hounds.|Aside from her, I know that the Fiends and Caesar's Legion fight alongside dogs. There could be viable specimens among them, if you can get to them.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemDoctorHenryTopic001 "Something's wrong with my cyber-dog. I was told to come to you." [DIAL:0013D317]
speaker: VRemDoctorHenry "Doctor Henry" [NPC_:00133957]

text_content: {Rex not inside Lodge}I don't see him with you. Bring him to me and I'll take a look. Otherwise, I'll just be guessing.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemDoctorHenryTopic001 "Something's wrong with my cyber-dog. I was told to come to you." [DIAL:0013D317]
speaker: VRemDoctorHenry "Doctor Henry" [NPC_:00133957]

text_content: Warning 2
name: VHDAssassinationRoofWarning2 "Warning 2" [DIAL:0013D478]

text_content: I warned you. Intruder!
name: VHDAssassinationRoofWarning2 "Warning 2" [DIAL:0013D478]
speaker: VHDKimballRoofGuard "Private Jensen" [NPC_:0013D489]

text_content: Warning 1
name: VHDAssassinationRoofWarning1 "Warning 1" [DIAL:0013D479]

text_content: Only engineers and authorized personnel are allowed upstairs. Please step away.
name: VHDAssassinationRoofWarning1 "Warning 1" [DIAL:0013D479]
speaker: VHDKimballRoofGuard "Private Jensen" [NPC_:0013D489]

text_content: I can manage this without your assistance.
name: VFreeformHooverDamvHDNCRRangerCommanderNCRBattleTopic004 "I can manage this without your assistance." [DIAL:0013D7D1]

text_content: Confirmed, we'll fall back. Good luck.
name: VFreeformHooverDamvHDNCRRangerCommanderNCRBattleTopic004 "I can manage this without your assistance." [DIAL:0013D7D1]
speaker: vHDNCRRangerCommanderNCRBattle "NCR Ranger Veteran Commander" [NPC_:0013D7E1]

text_content: <Speech Options>
name: VFreeformHooverDamvHDNCRRangerCommanderNCRBattleTopic002 "<Speech Options>" [DIAL:0013D7D2]

text_content: You are in charge of this operation. That sounds like a suicide mission, but our order are to take commands from you.|Unit, let's move out!
name: VFreeformHooverDamvHDNCRRangerCommanderNCRBattleTopic002 "<Speech Options>" [DIAL:0013D7D2]
speaker: vHDNCRRangerCommanderNCRBattle "NCR Ranger Veteran Commander" [NPC_:0013D7E1]

text_content: We aren't assigned for a suicide mission. Give us something we can do, and we'll do it. However I am not{emphasized} sending my unit on a suicide run.
name: VFreeformHooverDamvHDNCRRangerCommanderNCRBattleTopic002 "<Speech Options>" [DIAL:0013D7D2]
speaker: vHDNCRRangerCommanderNCRBattle "NCR Ranger Veteran Commander" [NPC_:0013D7E1]

text_content: Have your unit follow with me, we'll assault them head on.
name: VFreeformHooverDamvHDNCRRangerCommanderNCRBattleTopic001 "Have your unit follow with me, we'll assault them head on." [DIAL:0013D7D3]

text_content: Confirmed. We'll stay with you and help you break through the line.
name: VFreeformHooverDamvHDNCRRangerCommanderNCRBattleTopic001 "Have your unit follow with me, we'll assault them head on." [DIAL:0013D7D3]
