speaker: 1ETrentBascom "Trent Bascom" [NPC_:000F04AD]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ETrentBascomTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:001400DB]

text_content: Adios.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ETrentBascomTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:001400DB]
speaker: 1ETrentBascom "Trent Bascom" [NPC_:000F04AD]

text_content: Trent Bascom says he's not getting his full allotment of water.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ERomanowskiTopic003 "Trent Bascom says he's not getting his full allotment of water." [DIAL:001400DC]

text_content: The Office of Science and Industry has carefully calculated the amount of water needed for these crops. The whole thing is handled by computer.|Besides, most of these crops look fine to me. If the farmers can't handle the job, they shouldn't have signed up in the first place.|If there really is a problem, they can take it up with Lieutenant Boyd at McCarran. Farming isn't my department.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ERomanowskiTopic003 "Trent Bascom says he's not getting his full allotment of water." [DIAL:001400DC]
speaker: 1ERomanowski "Lieutenant Romanowski" [NPC_:000F05E2]

text_content: What can you tell me about these fields?
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ERomanowskiTopic002 "What can you tell me about these fields?" [DIAL:001400DD]

text_content: Impressive, aren't they? You don't see anything like this outside of NCR territory, that's for sure.|We get the water - clean water - pumped in from Lake Mead. If you follow the big pipes, they'll take you all the way to the Lake.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ERomanowskiTopic002 "What can you tell me about these fields?" [DIAL:001400DD]
speaker: 1ERomanowski "Lieutenant Romanowski" [NPC_:000F05E2]

text_content: Why are these fields being guarded?
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ERomanowskiTopic001 "Why are these fields being guarded?" [DIAL:001400DE]

text_content: A lot of the crops grown here support the various NCR camps in the region - McCarran, Golf, and Forlorn Hope, to name a few.|We can't have wastelanders popping in here for a free meal, so my squad and I are assigned to keep things from going to hell.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ERomanowskiTopic001 "Why are these fields being guarded?" [DIAL:001400DE]
speaker: 1ERomanowski "Lieutenant Romanowski" [NPC_:000F05E2]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ERomanowskiTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:001400DF]

text_content: Carry on.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ERomanowskiTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:001400DF]
speaker: 1ERomanowski "Lieutenant Romanowski" [NPC_:000F05E2]

text_content: What happens if Keene leaves?
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic017 "What happens if Keene leaves?" [DIAL:001403F1]

text_content: That happens, there's a good chance other Nightkin will follow. It'll make it hard to get a cure to them.|{Wary}Worse, if Keene and the Nightkin tear up the Mojave hunting for Stealth Boys, people are going get killed.|Most humans can't tell the difference between mutants. Might come here looking for payback.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic017 "What happens if Keene leaves?" [DIAL:001403F1]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: Why does Keene want to leave?
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic016 "Why does Keene want to leave?" [DIAL:001403F2]

text_content: Because of a promise. One I haven't been able to keep. The Nightkin all suffer from schizophrenia. It's the Stealth Boys they use, used to use.|Nightkin have a hard time being seen like normal folks. Can't stand it. A few already left to try and find more Stealth Boys.|Miserable situation. They either stay here and suffer, or dig up Stealth Boys and lose their minds. Not much of a choice.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic016 "Why does Keene want to leave?" [DIAL:001403F2]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: What's the story with Keene?
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic015 "What's the story with Keene?" [DIAL:001403F3]

text_content: I'm looking for Corporal White. I was told that he'd spoken to you.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ETrentBascomTopic013 "I'm looking for Corporal White. I was told that he'd spoken to you." [DIAL:001403FE]

text_content: Yes, he said he was looking into the water shortage, but I haven't heard back from him. Got the feeling he wasn't here in any official way.|White was talking to me about computer stuff and water delivery schedules through the pipes, but I'm just a farmer. Tech stuff is beyond me.|The last person I saw him talking to was Lieutenant Romanowski. Romanowski's around here somewhere. Sorry I couldn't be more helpful.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ETrentBascomTopic013 "I'm looking for Corporal White. I was told that he'd spoken to you." [DIAL:001403FE]
speaker: 1ETrentBascom "Trent Bascom" [NPC_:000F04AD]

text_content: Can't you just grow less crops?
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ETrentBascomTopic012 "Can't you just grow less crops?" [DIAL:001403FF]

text_content: I wouldn't be able to meet the quota, and the NCR would kick me out of my job, anyway. Nah, it's better I get out on my own terms.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ETrentBascomTopic012 "Can't you just grow less crops?" [DIAL:001403FF]
speaker: 1ETrentBascom "Trent Bascom" [NPC_:000F04AD]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ETrentBascomTopic011 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00140400]

text_content: Good luck to you out here.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ETrentBascomTopic011 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00140400]
speaker: 1ETrentBascom "Trent Bascom" [NPC_:000F04AD]

text_content: What are you going to do now?
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ETrentBascomTopic010 "What are you going to do now?" [DIAL:00140401]

text_content: I hear the Brahmin ranchers out in Redding are looking for some hard workers, so I might try there first. I hate working with Brahmin, though.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ETrentBascomTopic010 "What are you going to do now?" [DIAL:00140401]
speaker: 1ETrentBascom "Trent Bascom" [NPC_:000F04AD]

text_content: Me? I have no idea what you're talking about.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ETrentBascomTopic009 "Me? I have no idea what you're talking about." [DIAL:00140402]

text_content: Sure you don't. All just a happy coincidence, am I right?
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ETrentBascomTopic009 "Me? I have no idea what you're talking about." [DIAL:00140402]
speaker: 1ETrentBascom "Trent Bascom" [NPC_:000F04AD]

text_content: <Lie> The NCR admitted there's bad pipes somewhere, and took care of the problem.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ETrentBascomTopic008 "<Lie> The NCR admitted there's bad pipes somewhere, and took care of the problem." [DIAL:00140403]

text_content: That's what I figured. Don't know why the heck they're so stubborn they couldn't just admit it.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ETrentBascomTopic008 "<Lie> The NCR admitted there's bad pipes somewhere, and took care of the problem." [DIAL:00140403]
speaker: 1ETrentBascom "Trent Bascom" [NPC_:000F04AD]

text_content: Water was being diverted to Westside, but I took care of the problem.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ETrentBascomTopic007 "Water was being diverted to Westside, but I took care of the problem." [DIAL:00140404]

text_content: Westside, huh? I hope the NCR does something about those thieving bastards. I appreciate it, and so do the rest of the farmers.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ETrentBascomTopic007 "Water was being diverted to Westside, but I took care of the problem." [DIAL:00140404]
speaker: 1ETrentBascom "Trent Bascom" [NPC_:000F04AD]

text_content: Maybe you don't want for food much, but you can sell these on the market for a good price. Like I said, we're much obliged for the help.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ETrentBascomTopic007 "Water was being diverted to Westside, but I took care of the problem." [DIAL:00140404]
speaker: 1ETrentBascom "Trent Bascom" [NPC_:000F04AD]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ERomanowskiTopic007 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:00140512]

text_content: Yes, please do.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ERomanowskiTopic007 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:00140512]
speaker: 1ERomanowski "Lieutenant Romanowski" [NPC_:000F05E2]

text_content: Do you have something against White?
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ERomanowskiTopic006 "Do you have something against White?" [DIAL:00140513]

text_content: He's a glory hound, always looking for a way to get promoted to Ranger. Thinks he's too good to be a regular trooper like the rest of us.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ERomanowskiTopic006 "Do you have something against White?" [DIAL:00140513]
speaker: 1ERomanowski "Lieutenant Romanowski" [NPC_:000F05E2]

text_content: You haven't heard anything more from White?
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ERomanowskiTopic005 "You haven't heard anything more from White?" [DIAL:00140514]

text_content: Haven't seen him. Serves him right if the NCR declares him AWOL.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ERomanowskiTopic005 "You haven't heard anything more from White?" [DIAL:00140514]
speaker: 1ERomanowski "Lieutenant Romanowski" [NPC_:000F05E2]

text_content: I'm looking for Corporal White. Trent told me you'd seen him.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ERomanowskiTopic004 "I'm looking for Corporal White. Trent told me you'd seen him." [DIAL:00140515]

text_content: Corporal White is currently solving the mystery of the {sarcasm}Great Water Shortage. Tried to convince me he had proof, even. I didn't buy any of it.|He went over to Westside to talk to Tom Anderson. Anderson's a Follower of the Apocalypse. Helps the people in Westside grow crops or something.
name: vDialogueSharecropper1ERomanowskiTopic004 "I'm looking for Corporal White. Trent told me you'd seen him." [DIAL:00140515]
speaker: 1ERomanowski "Lieutenant Romanowski" [NPC_:000F05E2]

text_content: I got a Deathclaw egg for you.
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic019 "I got a Deathclaw egg for you." [DIAL:00140654]

text_content: I just happen to have a Deathclaw egg with me. Here.
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic018 "I just happen to have a Deathclaw egg with me. Here." [DIAL:00140655]

text_content: I can't believe you actually got one. Give me a bit to get the recipe set up, then talk to me again.
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic018 "I just happen to have a Deathclaw egg with me. Here." [DIAL:00140655]
speaker: QJJasWilkins "Jas Wilkins" [NPC_:000E595B]

text_content: Any trouble around here?
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic017 "Any trouble around here?" [DIAL:00140656]

text_content: Well, there's the Deathclaws, of course, and there was that one group of Powder Gangers who stole all the dynamite.|I think we're too small and poor for anyone to bother with, really. I keep a weapon near my bunk, though - same as everybody here.
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic017 "Any trouble around here?" [DIAL:00140656]
speaker: QJJasWilkins "Jas Wilkins" [NPC_:000E595B]

text_content: Are you from California?
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic016 "Are you from California?" [DIAL:00140657]

text_content: Born and raised. Things back in California are better than they've ever been, according to my grandpa.|The Raiders are mostly gone now and it's easy enough to get a job at one of the mills or farms. But now there's taxes and laws and other things.|The NCR keeps things safe and orderly, but it's all very boring. So, I came out east towards the frontier.
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic016 "Are you from California?" [DIAL:00140657]
speaker: QJJasWilkins "Jas Wilkins" [NPC_:000E595B]

text_content: You don't look like a quarry worker.
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic015 "You don't look like a quarry worker." [DIAL:00140658]

text_content: Oh, I'm not. I'm making my way to New Vegas. They say anything goes there, and best of all, the NCR can't mess it up for you.|I'll get there eventually. I've heard that you can't even get into the Strip unless you're rich.
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic015 "You don't look like a quarry worker." [DIAL:00140658]
speaker: QJJasWilkins "Jas Wilkins" [NPC_:000E595B]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic014 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:00140659]

text_content: Show me what you have for sale.
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic011 "Show me what you have for sale." [DIAL:0014065A]

text_content: Sure thing.
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic011 "Show me what you have for sale." [DIAL:0014065A]
speaker: QJJasWilkins "Jas Wilkins" [NPC_:000E595B]

text_content: I had some questions about this place.
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic010 "I had some questions about this place." [DIAL:0014065B]

text_content: Sure. What did you want to know?
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic010 "I had some questions about this place." [DIAL:0014065B]
speaker: QJJasWilkins "Jas Wilkins" [NPC_:000E595B]

text_content: About that Deathclaw Omelet recipe...
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic009 "About that Deathclaw Omelet recipe..." [DIAL:0014065C]

text_content: Yeah?
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic009 "About that Deathclaw Omelet recipe..." [DIAL:0014065C]
speaker: QJJasWilkins "Jas Wilkins" [NPC_:000E595B]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic008 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0014065D]

text_content: All right, then!
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic008 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0014065D]
speaker: QJJasWilkins "Jas Wilkins" [NPC_:000E595B]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic007 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0014065E]

text_content: All right. Do you need anything to eat or drink?
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic007 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0014065E]
speaker: QJJasWilkins "Jas Wilkins" [NPC_:000E595B]

text_content: What are you offering in exchange for a Deathclaw egg?
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic006 "What are you offering in exchange for a Deathclaw egg?" [DIAL:0014065F]

text_content: I don't have much in the way of money, but I'd be willing to share the secret of the recipe.
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic006 "What are you offering in exchange for a Deathclaw egg?" [DIAL:0014065F]
speaker: QJJasWilkins "Jas Wilkins" [NPC_:000E595B]

text_content: Where can I find a Deathclaw egg?
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic005 "Where can I find a Deathclaw egg?" [DIAL:00140660]

text_content: The quarry just north of here is full of Deathclaws, so there's bound to be an egg or two in there somewhere.|Of course, a Deathclaw egg from anywhere will do. According to my Aunt Rose, those things have a ridiculously long shelf life.
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic005 "Where can I find a Deathclaw egg?" [DIAL:00140660]
speaker: QJJasWilkins "Jas Wilkins" [NPC_:000E595B]

text_content: Where did you come up with this recipe?
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic004 "Where did you come up with this recipe?" [DIAL:00140661]

text_content: My great-aunt Rose ran a bed and breakfast back in California, in a town called Modoc. She's the one who created the recipe in the first place.|I don't know how she managed to get a hold of a female Deathclaw, but she kept it in a shed. Aunt Rose had a steady supply of eggs for her omelets.|At least, she did until some stranger came along and killed the Deathclaw. Shot it right in the eye.
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic004 "Where did you come up with this recipe?" [DIAL:00140661]
speaker: QJJasWilkins "Jas Wilkins" [NPC_:000E595B]

text_content: Anything that wasn't made 200 years ago.
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic003 "Anything that wasn't made 200 years ago." [DIAL:00140662]

text_content: {amused}Ha. Yeah, can you believe some people still eat that stuff? Anyway...
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic003 "Anything that wasn't made 200 years ago." [DIAL:00140662]
speaker: QJJasWilkins "Jas Wilkins" [NPC_:000E595B]

text_content: {Ghastly Scavenger}Ghouls and Super Mutants sometimes taste like Brahmin steaks.
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic002 "{Ghastly Scavenger}Ghouls and Super Mutants sometimes taste like Brahmin steaks." [DIAL:00140663]

text_content: You're just pulling my leg, right? Why would anyone... uh... never mind. Anyway...|I've got this recipe for a Deathclaw Omelet that I've been itching to try out. Trouble is - I need a Deathclaw egg. Kinda obvious, I suppose.
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic002 "{Ghastly Scavenger}Ghouls and Super Mutants sometimes taste like Brahmin steaks." [DIAL:00140663]
speaker: QJJasWilkins "Jas Wilkins" [NPC_:000E595B]

text_content: Why do you ask?
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic001 "Why do you ask?" [DIAL:00140664]

text_content: {slightly excited, has a passion for cooking exotic recipes}I've got this recipe for a Deathclaw Omelet that I've been itching to try out. Trouble is - I need a Deathclaw egg. Kinda obvious, I suppose.
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic001 "Why do you ask?" [DIAL:00140664]
speaker: QJJasWilkins "Jas Wilkins" [NPC_:000E595B]

text_content: {Cannibal}People have a rather unique taste, I've discovered.
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic000 "{Cannibal}People have a rather unique taste, I've discovered." [DIAL:00140665]

text_content: Uh... hmm... well, no accounting for taste I guess. Anyway...|I've got this recipe for a Deathclaw Omelet that I've been itching to try out. Trouble is - I need a Deathclaw egg. Kinda obvious, I suppose.
name: vFreeformSloanQJJasWilkinsTopic000 "{Cannibal}People have a rather unique taste, I've discovered." [DIAL:00140665]
speaker: QJJasWilkins "Jas Wilkins" [NPC_:000E595B]

text_content: I killed the Deathclaw Mother and the Deathclaw Alpha Male.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic018 "I killed the Deathclaw Mother and the Deathclaw Alpha Male." [DIAL:00140666]

text_content: Coming from anyone else, I'd say they were drunk or crazy, but that look in your eyes - I believe you.|I can pay you, but it ain't much for what you pulled off. I'll get on the ham radio first thing and tell people all about you, though.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic018 "I killed the Deathclaw Mother and the Deathclaw Alpha Male." [DIAL:00140666]
speaker: QJChompsLewis "Chomps Lewis" [NPC_:000E5958]

text_content: I killed the Deathclaw Alpha Male.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic017 "I killed the Deathclaw Alpha Male." [DIAL:00140667]

text_content: You... you did? That's pretty amazing - I figured you'd need artillery to take him out.|I hate to say it, but as long as the Deathclaw Mother is still alive, that pack isn't going anywhere. She'll take another mate and keep laying eggs.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic017 "I killed the Deathclaw Alpha Male." [DIAL:00140667]
speaker: QJChompsLewis "Chomps Lewis" [NPC_:000E5958]

text_content: I killed the Mother Deathclaw.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic016 "I killed the Mother Deathclaw." [DIAL:00140668]

text_content: You... you did? That's pretty amazing - I figured you'd need artillery to take her out.|I hate to say it, but as long as the Alpha Male is still alive, that pack isn't going anywhere, even with the Deathclaw Mother out of the picture.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic016 "I killed the Mother Deathclaw." [DIAL:00140668]
speaker: QJChompsLewis "Chomps Lewis" [NPC_:000E5958]

text_content: I fixed Snuffles' leg.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic015 "I fixed Snuffles' leg." [DIAL:00140669]

text_content: I'd noticed Snuffles limping, but I didn't realize the problem was that serious. Thanks - that beast helps keep spirits up around here.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic015 "I fixed Snuffles' leg." [DIAL:00140669]
speaker: QJChompsLewis "Chomps Lewis" [NPC_:000E5958]

text_content: I repaired your generator.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic014 "I repaired your generator." [DIAL:0014066A]

text_content: It's nice to see things going the way they're supposed to, for a change. I'm going to pay you out of my own pocket for this one.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic014 "I repaired your generator." [DIAL:0014066A]
speaker: QJChompsLewis "Chomps Lewis" [NPC_:000E5958]

text_content: I noticed you have a tame molerat.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic013 "I noticed you have a tame molerat." [DIAL:0014066B]

text_content: Yeah, he - or she, I guess - wandered into camp a couple of months back. Seemed friendly enough.|Ugly-looking thing, but the guys like having it around. Good for morale and all that.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic013 "I noticed you have a tame molerat." [DIAL:0014066B]
speaker: QJChompsLewis "Chomps Lewis" [NPC_:000E5958]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic012 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0014066C]

text_content: Sure.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic012 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0014066C]
speaker: QJChompsLewis "Chomps Lewis" [NPC_:000E5958]

text_content: You don't get paid in caps?
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic010 "You don't get paid in caps?" [DIAL:0014066D]

text_content: Nope. The NCR's been trying to switch over to using paper money, like in the Pre-War days. Trouble is that the exchange rates ain't exactly fair.|For example, a hundred bucks in NCR money is valued at roughly half that in caps around here. Seems like a rotten deal for us, but work is work.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic010 "You don't get paid in caps?" [DIAL:0014066D]
speaker: QJChompsLewis "Chomps Lewis" [NPC_:000E5958]

text_content: What's a dragline?
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic009 "What's a dragline?" [DIAL:0014066E]

text_content: It's a big machine which moves rocks around, piles at a time. It's Pre-War tech, so you need to thump it once in awhile to keep it running.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic009 "What's a dragline?" [DIAL:0014066E]
speaker: QJChompsLewis "Chomps Lewis" [NPC_:000E5958]

text_content: What does the NCR need with the cement?
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic008 "What does the NCR need with the cement?" [DIAL:0014066F]

text_content: It all gets shipped by rail over towards Boulder City and Hoover Dam. The NCR's probably building fortifications with it all.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic008 "What does the NCR need with the cement?" [DIAL:0014066F]
speaker: QJChompsLewis "Chomps Lewis" [NPC_:000E5958]

text_content: What is this place?
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic007 "What is this place?" [DIAL:00140670]

text_content: This is Sloan, a camp for us quarry workers. The actual quarry, Quarry Junction, is up the road north of here. The whole thing is an NCR operation.|We make cement for the NCR using the limestone we dig out with dynamite and draglines. Dirty work, but the pay's good.|Wish we got paid in caps, though. Not a lot of merchants like taking NCR paper money.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic007 "What is this place?" [DIAL:00140670]
speaker: QJChompsLewis "Chomps Lewis" [NPC_:000E5958]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic006 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:00140671]

text_content: Okay.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic006 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:00140671]
speaker: QJChompsLewis "Chomps Lewis" [NPC_:000E5958]

text_content: I could take care of your Deathclaw problem.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic005 "I could take care of your Deathclaw problem." [DIAL:00140672]

text_content: Have you even seen a Deathclaw? They're taller than a man and far, far stronger and faster. And, there's a whole pack of them out there.|You'd have to be the meanest, toughest, roughest bastard in the wasteland to have any chance against them, and I don't think that's you.|You'd need to take out the pack leaders - the Mother Deathclaw and the Deathclaw Alpha Male. Kill 'em, and the pack will scatter. Pretty tough job.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic005 "I could take care of your Deathclaw problem." [DIAL:00140672]
speaker: QJChompsLewis "Chomps Lewis" [NPC_:000E5958]

text_content: I don't what it is about you, but I think you could actually pull it off. Deathclaws are tough bastards, but you might be even tougher.|Nobody here's any use to you in a fight against Deathclaws, but take these medical supplies. You'll probably need them.|To do the job right, you've got to get rid of the pack leaders - the Mother Deathclaw and the Deathclaw Alpha Male. Should run the rest of 'em off.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic005 "I could take care of your Deathclaw problem." [DIAL:00140672]
speaker: QJChompsLewis "Chomps Lewis" [NPC_:000E5958]

text_content: Have you had problems with Deathclaws before?
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic004 "Have you had problems with Deathclaws before?" [DIAL:00140673]

text_content: We'd see them occasionally, but they didn't seem too keen on getting too close to the quarry. Not sure if it was the noise or all the workers.|I can't believe that an entire pack moved into the quarry. I thought that kind of bad luck only happened in New Vegas.
name: vFreeformSloanQJChompsLewisTopic004 "Have you had problems with Deathclaws before?" [DIAL:00140673]

text_content: Tell me about Papa Khan.
name: RegisPapaKhan "Tell me about Papa Khan." [DIAL:00142A92]

text_content: Papa is one of the best leaders the Khans have ever had. He's kept us together through all of our hardships, ever since we left California.|Bitter Springs changed him, though. He started to really hate the NCR after the Massacre, and sometimes I worry that's poisoned his mind.
name: RegisPapaKhan "Tell me about Papa Khan." [DIAL:00142A92]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: What's your opinion of the NCR?
name: RegisNCR "What's your opinion of the NCR?" [DIAL:00142A93]

text_content: That's a complicated question. They've done horrible things to our people to be sure, and I've gladly killed many of their soldiers in battle.|But I can't bring myself to hate them the way Papa does. Things would damn sure be better for us if they were in charge than Caesar.

text_content: You're the chief now. What do we do?

speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: Without Papa Khan's guidance, I don't know what else to do. All right - you can tell the NCR the Great Khans will fight for them when Caesar attacks.

text_content: RegisCaesar
name: RegisCaesar "RegisCaesar" [DIAL:00142A94]

text_content: Let me see. {Thoughtful, dawning horror}My God, this is even worse than I thought. Okay, you have my support. I'll tell Papa the alliance is a bad idea.

speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: What's this? Ah, yes, I've heard that the Legion has sometimes had to quell tribes that did not share its vision.|The Khans, though, are protected by Caesar's emissary - I have Karl's word we will remain our own tribe as long as we remain loyal to Caesar.|Take your slander elsewhere.

speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

I'm telling you.|Now take the Platinum Chip, go to the bunker or whatever it is, and destroy whatever gizmo-happy Brahmin shit you find down there.|And just in case you're thinking of {beat}slipping away, now that you've finally got that Platinum Chip in your hands?|Go ahead, try that. And I'll have you hunted down, and your head mounted on a pole. {business concluded}Now get to it. {WAH-lay}Vale.

text_content: And once I'm inside?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic088 "And once I'm inside?" [DIAL:001445D2]

text_content: I want you to destroy whatever you find in there. And then I want you to come back here and tell me about it.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic088 "And once I'm inside?" [DIAL:001445D2]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: So go to the building and take this {weary of it}fucking Platinum Chip with you. My Legionaries will meet you there, with your weapons and equipment.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic088 "And once I'm inside?" [DIAL:001445D2]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Talk to Benny on your way out. He knows I'm going to let you decide how he dies. Maybe you want to remind him.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic088 "And once I'm inside?" [DIAL:001445D2]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: {Get your ass moving already}Goodbye.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic088 "And once I'm inside?" [DIAL:001445D2]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: I changed my mind.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic083 "I changed my mind." [DIAL:001445D7]

text_content: There was no reasonable chance of success.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic082 "There was no reasonable chance of success." [DIAL:001445D8]

text_content: {controlled anger}When I command you to complete a mission, you will complete it, or you should die in the attempt.|You lost me a great opportunity to deal a blow to the Profligates' morale. If not for the service you've rendered unto me, I'd have you crucified.|I will overlook this error, but only because I think you can still be useful.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic082 "There was no reasonable chance of success." [DIAL:001445D8]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: I'm not going to kill the NCR's President.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic075 "I'm not going to kill the NCR's President." [DIAL:001445DF]

text_content: Oh? You're going to {beat}defy me?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic075 "I'm not going to kill the NCR's President." [DIAL:001445DF]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Won't killing President Kimball just anger the NCR?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic074 "Won't killing President Kimball just anger the NCR?" [DIAL:001445E0]

text_content: {setting player straight}I don't have to explain the reasoning behind my commands. I just give them - and you do them.|That said, every once in a while I hear something so ignorant, I have to respond. This is one of those times.|The Profligates' morale is in the shitter. They've occupied the Mojave for years, getting picked off one by one. They were told it'd be easy.|They keep being told that victory is right around the corner, that Vegas will roll over, become the sixth state of their little union.|It's President Kimball who's been telling them that. When he dies, the enormity of his lies will come crashing down, the punchline to a bad joke.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic074 "Won't killing President Kimball just anger the NCR?" [DIAL:001445E0]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: I'll kill President Kimball for you.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic073 "I'll kill President Kimball for you." [DIAL:001445E1]

text_content: That's what I like to hear.|One of my {froo-men-TAR-ee}Frumentarii has set up camp near Hoover Dam. His name his {KAY-toh Hos-TIL-ee-oos}Cato Hostilius.|Go to him. He'll have further instructions.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic073 "I'll kill President Kimball for you." [DIAL:001445E1]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: I've been inside the Brotherhood's bunker, but I haven't destroyed it yet.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic071 "I've been inside the Brotherhood's bunker, but I haven't destroyed it yet." [DIAL:001445E3]

text_content: {no-nonsense}Then get yourself back there, and get it done.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic071 "I've been inside the Brotherhood's bunker, but I haven't destroyed it yet." [DIAL:001445E3]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: I've destroyed the Brotherhood of Steel's bunker in Hidden Valley.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic069 "I've destroyed the Brotherhood of Steel's bunker in Hidden Valley." [DIAL:001445E5]

text_content: Very well. This latest victory brings to a close my efforts to reshape the power balance of the Mojave - and not a minute too soon...
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic069 "I've destroyed the Brotherhood of Steel's bunker in Hidden Valley." [DIAL:001445E5]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: I won't destroy the Brotherhood of Steel.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic068 "I won't destroy the Brotherhood of Steel." [DIAL:001445E6]

text_content: Is that so?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic068 "I won't destroy the Brotherhood of Steel." [DIAL:001445E6]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Is it really necessary to destroy the Brotherhood?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic067 "Is it really necessary to destroy the Brotherhood?" [DIAL:001445E7]

text_content: {irritated}If I say the Brotherhood should be destroyed, it's necessary.|My Legion can win a fight against the Brotherhood of Steel, but it would be costly. Your job is to make sure there's no Brotherhood for us to fight.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic067 "Is it really necessary to destroy the Brotherhood?" [DIAL:001445E7]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: I'll destroy the Brotherhood.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic066 "I'll destroy the Brotherhood." [DIAL:001445E8]

text_content: Good. Two of my scouts have reported seeing patrols of men in power armor near Hidden Valley. Begin your search there.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic066 "I'll destroy the Brotherhood." [DIAL:001445E8]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: I've already destroyed the Brotherhood's bunker in Hidden Valley.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic065 "I've already destroyed the Brotherhood's bunker in Hidden Valley." [DIAL:001445E9]

text_content: {surprised}You destroyed the Brotherhood's bunker? {chuckle of admiration}Very well.|I'll trust your word, and reward you as though you {playing with the language a bit}wreaked this destruction at my behest.|Of course, if the Brotherhood should suddenly rise up to oppose my rule, you will be held responsible. {beat to let it sink in}Now, moving on...
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic065 "I've already destroyed the Brotherhood's bunker in Hidden Valley." [DIAL:001445E9]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: I'll see what I can work out with the White Glove Society.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic044 "I'll see what I can work out with the White Glove Society." [DIAL:001445EF]

text_content: The leader of the tribe is a woman named Marjorie. My understanding is that she strongly opposes a {slight emphasis}reversion to cannibalism.|If she's intractable, you might find Mortimer, her second-in-command, more flexible.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic044 "I'll see what I can work out with the White Glove Society." [DIAL:001445EF]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: I've already won over the Boomers. They'll do as I say.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic041 "I've already won over the Boomers. They'll do as I say." [DIAL:001445F2]

text_content: {mildly surprised}Is that so? You are good, aren't you?|If the Boomers will toe the line, I can focus on other preparations. But not without first rewarding your initiative. {beat}Now moving on...
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic041 "I've already won over the Boomers. They'll do as I say." [DIAL:001445F2]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: I've already wiped out the Boomers' leadership.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic040 "I've already wiped out the Boomers' leadership." [DIAL:001445F3]

text_content: {mildly surprised}Is that right? You are good, aren't you?|If the Boomers are out of the picture, I can focus on other preparations - but not without first rewarding your initiative. {beat}Now moving on...
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic040 "I've already wiped out the Boomers' leadership." [DIAL:001445F3]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: I'll eliminate Mr. House for you.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic038 "I'll eliminate Mr. House for you." [DIAL:001445F5]

text_content: Good. {beat}I don't know what kind of security he has inside the Lucky 38, but if you can find a way of catching him off-guard, do so.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic038 "I'll eliminate Mr. House for you." [DIAL:001445F5]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Now that we've got that out of the way, I don't suppose you'd consider joining the NCR instead?
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic006 "Now that we've got that out of the way, I don't suppose you'd consider joining the NCR instead?" [DIAL:00144629]

text_content: {Suddenly goes cold}You've helped me see Caesar for what he is, and I thank you for that - but if you suggest that again I will have your head.
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic006 "Now that we've got that out of the way, I don't suppose you'd consider joining the NCR instead?" [DIAL:00144629]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: Hey, as long as you aren't fighting for Caesar, I don't care what you do.
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic005 "Hey, as long as you aren't fighting for Caesar, I don't care what you do." [DIAL:0014462A]

text_content: Whatever your motivation was, I think we owe you a debt.
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic005 "Hey, as long as you aren't fighting for Caesar, I don't care what you do." [DIAL:0014462A]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: That sounds wise. I wish you the best.
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic004 "That sounds wise. I wish you the best." [DIAL:0014462B]

text_content: If you should ever tire of wandering alone, seek us out. You might just have the makings of a Great Khan yourself.
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic004 "That sounds wise. I wish you the best." [DIAL:0014462B]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: You don't need to look outward, mighty Khan. Your tribe is proud and strong - claim your own glory!
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic003 "You don't need to look outward, mighty Khan. Your tribe is proud and strong - claim your own glory!" [DIAL:0014462C]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Well-spoken, traveler. Well spoken indeed. Perhaps it's time to find our own destiny unburdened by the past.|We'll begin readying the camp to move. As soon as Caesar makes his move, we'll depart. We will make ourselves strong again, and we shall conquer!|Great Khans! Drive Caesar's dog out of our camp! If he's too slow to flee, kill him!
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic003 "You don't need to look outward, mighty Khan. Your tribe is proud and strong - claim your own glory!" [DIAL:0014462C]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Well-spoken, traveler. Well spoken indeed. Perhaps it's time to find our own destiny unburdened by the past.|We'll begin readying the camp to move. As soon as Caesar makes his move, we'll depart. We will make ourselves strong again, and we shall conquer!
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic003 "You don't need to look outward, mighty Khan. Your tribe is proud and strong - claim your own glory!" [DIAL:0014462C]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: [FAILED] You talk like glory is a hollow, meaningless thing. Maybe to you it is, but not to the Great Khans.|Show me something to inspire my people, or we march with Caesar, despite my misgivings.
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic003 "You don't need to look outward, mighty Khan. Your tribe is proud and strong - claim your own glory!" [DIAL:0014462C]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: If the Great Khans join the Legion, you'll be sold as a slave. An officer's wife, if you're lucky.
name: VMS45QJMelissaTopic001 "If the Great Khans join the Legion, you'll be sold as a slave. An officer's wife, if you're lucky." [DIAL:0014462D]

text_content: That lying little weasel! I almost fell for it, too! All right, you've got a deal. You can tell Papa I won't support an alliance.
name: VMS45QJMelissaTopic001 "If the Great Khans join the Legion, you'll be sold as a slave. An officer's wife, if you're lucky." [DIAL:0014462D]
speaker: QJMelissa "Melissa" [NPC_:000E595C]

text_content: Did he also tell you women aren't permitted to serve in the Legion?
name: VMS45QJMelissaTopic000 "Did he also tell you women aren't permitted to serve in the Legion?" [DIAL:0014462E]

text_content: What? No, he... what do you mean, aren't allowed to serve? Why would he lie about that?
name: VMS45QJMelissaTopic000 "Did he also tell you women aren't permitted to serve in the Legion?" [DIAL:0014462E]
speaker: QJMelissa "Melissa" [NPC_:000E595C]

text_content: No, and finding some would be too much work. Never mind.
name: VMS45VRRCDianeTopic002 "No, and finding some would be too much work. Never mind." [DIAL:0014462F]

text_content: Okay, I won't bother.
name: VMS45VRRCDianeTopic002 "No, and finding some would be too much work. Never mind." [DIAL:0014462F]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Not yet, but I'll find some.
name: VMS45VRRCDianeTopic001 "Not yet, but I'll find some." [DIAL:00144630]

text_content: Okay, come on back when you do.
name: VMS45VRRCDianeTopic001 "Not yet, but I'll find some." [DIAL:00144630]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Caesar isn't going to let you run drugs as an ally any more than he supports it now. He hates chems.
name: VMS45VRRCDianeTopic000 "Caesar isn't going to let you run drugs as an ally any more than he supports it now. He hates chems." [DIAL:00144631]

text_content: I haven't heard anything like that. Do you have any proof?
name: VMS45VRRCDianeTopic000 "Caesar isn't going to let you run drugs as an ally any more than he supports it now. He hates chems." [DIAL:00144631]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: But you won't have each other. The Legion will kill you and sell Diane into slavery as a prostitute.
name: VMS45VRRCJackTopic000 "But you won't have each other. The Legion will kill you and sell Diane into slavery as a prostitute." [DIAL:00144632]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Dude! What a total haul! No way that's {COPE-a-shee-shee; made-up word}copasheshy. Yeah, okay, me and Diana got your back. No sweat.
name: VMS45VRRCJackTopic000 "But you won't have each other. The Legion will kill you and sell Diane into slavery as a prostitute." [DIAL:00144632]
speaker: VRRCJack "Jack" [NPC_:00140E6B]

text_content: [FAILED] Dude... wait, what? That's totally kakadoodle, man. You been huffing fumes in the Magic Bus or something?
name: VMS45VRRCJackTopic000 "But you won't have each other. The Legion will kill you and sell Diane into slavery as a prostitute." [DIAL:00144632]
speaker: VRRCJack "Jack" [NPC_:00140E6B]

text_content: Nothing, never mind.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic015 "Nothing, never mind." [DIAL:00144633]

text_content: Suit yourself.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic015 "Nothing, never mind." [DIAL:00144633]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: Tell me again what I need to do to convince Papa.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic014 "Tell me again what I need to do to convince Papa." [DIAL:00144634]

text_content: I'm not afraid of Karl, and I don't feel like wasting my time on him.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic013 "I'm not afraid of Karl, and I don't feel like wasting my time on him." [DIAL:00144635]

text_content: If you say so.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic013 "I'm not afraid of Karl, and I don't feel like wasting my time on him." [DIAL:00144635]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: I'll keep that in mind.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic012 "I'll keep that in mind." [DIAL:00144636]

text_content: I would too, if I were you.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic012 "I'll keep that in mind." [DIAL:00144636]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: How would I do that?
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic011 "How would I do that?" [DIAL:00144637]

text_content: Karl talks prettily about the honor and nobility of the Great Khans, but I suspect his actual opinion is less flattering.|Maybe you could find something he wrote that expresses that opinion, or trick him into losing his cool in the longhouse right in front of Papa.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic011 "How would I do that?" [DIAL:00144637]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: I'll think about it, but I have other questions for now.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic010 "I'll think about it, but I have other questions for now." [DIAL:00144638]

text_content: All right, what is it you wanted?
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic010 "I'll think about it, but I have other questions for now." [DIAL:00144638]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: I don't think I actually want to do that.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic009 "I don't think I actually want to do that." [DIAL:00144639]

text_content: I see. Then the Great Khans will fight for the Legion should Caesar give the call. If you change your mind, let me know.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic009 "I don't think I actually want to do that." [DIAL:00144639]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: Okay, I'll see what I can do to convince everyone.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic008 "Okay, I'll see what I can do to convince everyone." [DIAL:0014463A]

text_content: Good. Oh, one more thing: Caesar's representative, Karl, has become fast friends with Papa. Karl's the one who has him so fixated on this alliance.|You'll probably have an easier time of things if you can find a way to get him out of the picture.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic008 "Okay, I'll see what I can do to convince everyone." [DIAL:0014463A]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: What about Melissa?
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic006 "What about Melissa?" [DIAL:0014463B]

text_content: Ah, Melissa. She's a bit of a dreamer. Last time she was in camp, Karl filled her head with stories of serving the Legion as a {SPECK-you-lay-tor-ay}speculatore.|Personally, I've never seen a woman in Legionaire's armor, so I have my doubts.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic006 "What about Melissa?" [DIAL:0014463B]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: What would convince Jack and Diane to support me?
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic005 "What would convince Jack and Diane to support me?" [DIAL:0014463C]

text_content: You'd have to talk to them - but those two have been thick as thieves since they were kids. Convince one and the other will come around.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic005 "What would convince Jack and Diane to support me?" [DIAL:0014463C]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: Aren't you convinced already, if we're having this conversation?
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic004 "Aren't you convinced already, if we're having this conversation?" [DIAL:0014463D]

text_content: I have my doubts about Caesar, yes, but I won't publicly go against Papa Khan based on nothing more than doubts.|I've heard rumors that tribes who aligned with Caesar in the past were torn apart and reduced to slaves - prove it, and I'll back you.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic004 "Aren't you convinced already, if we're having this conversation?" [DIAL:0014463D]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: So what do I do?
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic003 "So what do I do?" [DIAL:0014463E]

text_content: Papa can be a stubborn man, but he's not a tyrant. He listens to his tribe, and to four voices in particular: me, Jack and Diane, and Melissa.|If you can convince all of us that allying with Caesar is a bad idea, you might be able to sway him.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic003 "So what do I do?" [DIAL:0014463E]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: Why should I listen to you?
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic002 "Why should I listen to you?" [DIAL:0014463F]

text_content: What is it you had in mind?

name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic001 "What is it you had in mind?" [DIAL:00144640]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: Who are you?
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic000 "Who are you?" [DIAL:00144641]

text_content: Name's Regis. I'm Papa's second-in-command. You might say I... share your concern about Caesar.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic000 "Who are you?" [DIAL:00144641]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: Because the NCR is the best hope for long-term stability in the region, not Caesar.
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic002 "Because the NCR is the best hope for long-term stability in the region, not Caesar." [DIAL:00144642]

text_content: {Suddenly cold and furious}Don't you dare mention the NCR under this roof. They are butchers without honor, killers of women and children!
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic002 "Because the NCR is the best hope for long-term stability in the region, not Caesar." [DIAL:00144642]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: Do you really think Caesar is going to restore your tribe to glory? You'll be made slaves.
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic001 "Do you really think Caesar is going to restore your tribe to glory? You'll be made slaves." [DIAL:00144643]

text_content: Hah! The Great Khans will not be slaves. Caesar himself has promised us the land from here to the Colorado and the freedom to raid as we see fit.
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic001 "Do you really think Caesar is going to restore your tribe to glory? You'll be made slaves." [DIAL:00144643]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: Caesar is only using you, he doesn't actually care about the Great Khans.
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic000 "Caesar is only using you, he doesn't actually care about the Great Khans." [DIAL:00144644]

text_content: Doesn't he? Caesar's representative tells a different tale.|The glory of the Great Khans will be restored, and once the NCR is pushed back to California, all the land from here to the Colorado will be ours.
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic000 "Caesar is only using you, he doesn't actually care about the Great Khans." [DIAL:00144644]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: I won't hear any more talk against Caesar or his alliance. The Great Khans will answer Caesar's call to war, and the NCR will pay for their crimes.
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic000 "Caesar is only using you, he doesn't actually care about the Great Khans." [DIAL:00144644]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: No more questions.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic026 "No more questions." [DIAL:00144686]

text_content: Let's get this show on the road.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic020 "Let's get this show on the road." [DIAL:0014468C]

text_content: President Kimball is arriving shortly. If you want to do any last minute security sweeps or take a look around for anything suspicious, do it now.|Once you're ready, meet me outside on the observation deck, but don't take too long.

speaker: VHDCaptainGraham "Ranger Grant" [NPC_:0013721E]

text_content: The plan is to get through today without the shit hitting the fan.|So I'll be overseeing the security team personally and keeping in constant contact with people over the radio.|It's a good bet that the Legion is going to try something today so we have to be prepared for anything.|We'll do whatever it takes to get the President through this visit in one piece.

speaker: VHDCaptainGraham "Ranger Grant" [NPC_:0013721E]

text_content: What can I do to help?
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic018 "What can I do to help?" [DIAL:0014468E]

text_content: Someone like you... I'm just glad to have you on board. Do whatever you can. Security sweeps, talk to people, keep an eye out.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic018 "What can I do to help?" [DIAL:0014468E]
speaker: VHDCaptainGraham "Ranger Grant" [NPC_:0013721E]

text_content: Keep an eye on the crowd and keep an eye out for anything suspicious. Other than that, just stay out of the way.

speaker: VHDCaptainGraham "Ranger Grant" [NPC_:0013721E]

text_content: Do you have any leads on possible security threats?

text_content: The Legion will definitely try something, but we don't have any solid leads yet.|I'd almost expect something direct from them, but given the circumstances there's a possibility of something more subtle like sabotage.|But since we don't have anything solid we'll just have to keep our eyes out for anything out of the ordinary.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic017 "Do you have any leads on possible security threats?" [DIAL:0014468F]
speaker: VHDCaptainGraham "Ranger Grant" [NPC_:0013721E]

text_content: {Thinking aloud}Possible security threats... there was a new guy allowed to help with security at the last minute. {Awkward pause}Other than that, we don't have any solid leads.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic017 "Do you have any leads on possible security threats?" [DIAL:0014468F]
speaker: VHDCaptainGraham "Ranger Grant" [NPC_:0013721E]

text_content: Do you have a detailed schedule for the visit?
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic016 "Do you have a detailed schedule for the visit?" [DIAL:00144690]

text_content: I have a full itinerary here. Here you go.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic016 "Do you have a detailed schedule for the visit?" [DIAL:00144690]
speaker: VHDCaptainGraham "Ranger Grant" [NPC_:0013721E]

text_content: The President arrives, gives a speech, and then leaves. That's all someone like you needs to know.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic016 "Do you have a detailed schedule for the visit?" [DIAL:00144690]
speaker: VHDCaptainGraham "Ranger Grant" [NPC_:0013721E]

text_content: What are your security arrangements?
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic015 "What are your security arrangements?" [DIAL:00144691]

text_content: Security detail consists of rangers stationed here at the dam. Some will keep an eye on the crowd while others will watch the perimeter.|Snipers and sharpshooters have been assigned to key locations and we also have a special K9 unit sniffing out members of the crowd.|I've also locked down access to critical locations such as the landing platform on the visitor center.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic015 "What are your security arrangements?" [DIAL:00144691]
speaker: VHDCaptainGraham "Ranger Grant" [NPC_:0013721E]

text_content: Can I use my weapons during the President's visit?
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic011 "Can I use my weapons during the President's visit?" [DIAL:00144692]

text_content: We trust you, so you're free to have your weapons. Just don't do anything too crazy and we'll back you up.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic011 "Can I use my weapons during the President's visit?" [DIAL:00144692]
speaker: VHDCaptainGraham "Ranger Grant" [NPC_:0013721E]

text_content: You'll be allowed to carry your weapons, but they must remain holstered.|If you pull them out, my men will shoot you. Understand?
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic011 "Can I use my weapons during the President's visit?" [DIAL:00144692]
speaker: VHDCaptainGraham "Ranger Grant" [NPC_:0013721E]

name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic010 "<Ranger Graham Morning Conversation>" [DIAL:00144693]

text_content: Glad you could join us. Most of my men are already on duty and the crowd has already started gathering outside.|We've got a busy day ahead of us.

speaker: VHDCaptainGraham "Ranger Grant" [NPC_:0013721E]

name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic009 "I have some questions." [DIAL:00144694]

name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic009 "I have some questions." [DIAL:00144694]
speaker: VHDCaptainGraham "Ranger Grant" [NPC_:0013721E]

name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDCaptainGrahamTopic008 "I need to prepare first." [DIAL:00144695]

speaker: VHDCaptainGraham "Ranger Grant" [NPC_:0013721E]

text_content: Good. The President doesn't arrive until tomorrow. Get some rest, I'll brief you in the morning.

text_content: Do you have any dealings with New Vegas?

text_content: Not really. Heard it's paradise in the wasteland. Never been in there myself, doubt they'd let a mutant in.|{To himself, slight humor at human nature}Amazes me people would come from all over the wastes to throw away everything they've got in that town.

text_content: Anything else can you tell me about the NCR?
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic025 "Anything else can you tell me about the NCR?" [DIAL:00144C45]

text_content: Seen them grow from a single town - Shady Sands - into the republic. They've done good for the most part.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic025 "Anything else can you tell me about the NCR?" [DIAL:00144C45]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: What makes the NCR too ambitious?
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic024 "What makes the NCR too ambitious?" [DIAL:00144C46]

text_content: They expand, fast. If you've got land they want, they'll take it, eventually. Did it out West, they'll do it here.|{Warning tone to govt}They keep rolling over people, they'll regret it. That's how revolutions start.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic024 "What makes the NCR too ambitious?" [DIAL:00144C46]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: What do you know about the Legion?
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic023 "What do you know about the Legion?" [DIAL:00144C47]

text_content: {contempt}{KAI-zar}Caesar thinks he can change human nature. Most of the Legion is following {KAI-zar}Caesar, not {KAI-zar}Caesar's ideals. When he's gone, it'll crumble.|Might not happen overnight. Might take a few decades. But it'll happen. Basic human nature - greed, ambition, jealousy - will see to it.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic023 "What do you know about the Legion?" [DIAL:00144C47]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: Why do some of the Super Mutants here dislike the NCR?

name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic022 "Why do some of the Super Mutants here dislike the NCR?" [DIAL:00144C48]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: Rex will be tougher.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownCalamityTopic007 "I got a brain from Lupa, the mother of many Legion Mongrels." [DIAL:00145D75]
speaker: JacobstownCalamity "Calamity" [NPC_:0013D831]

text_content: I took down a Fiend dog named Violetta.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownCalamityTopic006 "I took down a Fiend dog named Violetta." [DIAL:00145D76]

text_content: Rex will be faster.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownCalamityTopic006 "I took down a Fiend dog named Violetta." [DIAL:00145D76]
speaker: JacobstownCalamity "Calamity" [NPC_:0013D831]

text_content: This brain is from Rey, one of Old Lady Gibson's dogs.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownCalamityTopic005 "This brain is from Rey, one of Old Lady Gibson's dogs." [DIAL:00145D77]

text_content: Let's see... good guard dog tendencies. If I transplant this brain into Rex, he'll be a bit more ferocious in his attacks.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownCalamityTopic005 "This brain is from Rey, one of Old Lady Gibson's dogs." [DIAL:00145D77]
speaker: JacobstownCalamity "Calamity" [NPC_:0013D831]

text_content: You're not getting the Mark II specs.
name: VMS41JacobstownKeeneTopic005 "You're not getting the Mark II specs." [DIAL:00145D78]

text_content: {snapping into berserk mode}I knew humans could never be reasonable! I knew it! Stupid, stupid humans! I'll kill you!
name: VMS41JacobstownKeeneTopic005 "You're not getting the Mark II specs." [DIAL:00145D78]
speaker: JacobstownKeene "Keene" [CREA:0013F70D]

text_content: Doctor Henry, do as he asks.
name: VMS41JacobstownKeeneTopic004 "Doctor Henry, do as he asks." [DIAL:00145D79]

text_content: Good, good. Smart move, human.
name: VMS41JacobstownKeeneTopic004 "Doctor Henry, do as he asks." [DIAL:00145D79]
speaker: JacobstownKeene "Keene" [CREA:0013F70D]

text_content: The Mark IIs are even more dangerous than standard Stealth Boys.
name: VMS41JacobstownKeeneTopic003 "The Mark IIs are even more dangerous than standard Stealth Boys." [DIAL:00145D7A]

text_content: Our lives, our decision to make. We're tired of sitting around in Jacobstown waiting for a cure.
name: VMS41JacobstownKeeneTopic003 "The Mark IIs are even more dangerous than standard Stealth Boys." [DIAL:00145D7A]
speaker: JacobstownKeene "Keene" [CREA:0013F70D]

text_content: What are you planning to do once you have the specs?
name: VMS41JacobstownKeeneTopic002 "What are you planning to do once you have the specs?" [DIAL:00145D7B]

text_content: There are caches of Stealth Boys out there. With the Mark II in hand, it shouldn't be difficult to upgrade every one of them.
name: VMS41JacobstownKeeneTopic002 "What are you planning to do once you have the specs?" [DIAL:00145D7B]
speaker: JacobstownKeene "Keene" [CREA:0013F70D]

text_content: < Speech 80 >
name: VMS41JacobstownKeeneTopic001 "< Speech 80 >" [DIAL:00145D7C]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] No, I didn't, not until now anyway. Very well, human. You've made your point, and I withdraw my... request.
name: VMS41JacobstownKeeneTopic001 "< Speech 80 >" [DIAL:00145D7C]
speaker: JacobstownKeene "Keene" [CREA:0013F70D]

text_content: [FAILED] No more negotiating, and definitely no more waiting. This is your last chance before we take it by force.
name: VMS41JacobstownKeeneTopic001 "< Speech 80 >" [DIAL:00145D7C]
speaker: JacobstownKeene "Keene" [CREA:0013F70D]

text_content: < Speech 80 >
name: VMS41JacobstownKeeneTopic000 "< Speech 80 >" [DIAL:00145D7D]

text_content: I had some questions about Jacobstown.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic021 "I had some questions about Jacobstown." [DIAL:00145D80]

text_content: Such as?
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic021 "I had some questions about Jacobstown." [DIAL:00145D80]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: What's the story with Keene?
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic020 "What's the story with Keene?" [DIAL:00145D81]

text_content: {Keene alive}Smart, charismatic. Hell of a mean streak. Doesn't care for humans. Prefers fighting them to talking.|He's got a lot of pull with Nightkin, though. He talks, they listen. Was hoping he could draw other Nightkin to Jacobstown.|Keene is saner than most, but I know he's thinking of going his own way again. He's aggressive, impatient. Can't stand sitting around.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic020 "What's the story with Keene?" [DIAL:00145D81]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: <Ambush Dialog>
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDLegionAssassinSniperTopic005 "<Ambush Dialog>" [DIAL:00145EB1]

text_content: It's your own fault for finding this - now I'm going to have to kill you.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDLegionAssassinSniperTopic005 "<Ambush Dialog>" [DIAL:00145EB1]
speaker: VHDLegionAssassinSniper "NCR Ranger" [NPC_:00133EBA]

text_content: vFreeformCampGuardianBattleDone
name: vFreeformCampGuardianBattleDone "vFreeformCampGuardianBattleDone" [DIAL:00145EC7]

text_content: {Triumphant, taunting the dead}Ha! How do you like that you sons of bitches?!
name: vFreeformCampGuardianBattleDone "vFreeformCampGuardianBattleDone" [DIAL:00145EC7]

text_content: What do you do here?
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownKeeneTopic003 "What do you do here?" [DIAL:00145EDF]

text_content: I represent the Nightkin. {smug}Marcus may lead this town, but the Nightkin listen to what I have to say.|That doesn't mean I don't respect Marcus for what he's trying to do. However, he doesn't truly understand the difficulties of being a Nightkin.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownKeeneTopic003 "What do you do here?" [DIAL:00145EDF]
speaker: JacobstownKeene "Keene" [CREA:0013F70D]

text_content: Who's the other human you mentioned?
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownKeeneTopic002 "Who's the other human you mentioned?" [DIAL:00145EE0]

text_content: Doctor Henry. He's one of you - go speak with him instead of me.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownKeeneTopic002 "Who's the other human you mentioned?" [DIAL:00145EE0]
speaker: JacobstownKeene "Keene" [CREA:0013F70D]

text_content: What great legacy do the Great Khans have? Your tribe is nothing but ghosts and martyrs.
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic009 "What great legacy do the Great Khans have? Your tribe is nothing but ghosts and martyrs." [DIAL:00145F64]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] I should have you torn apart for speaking like that - but maybe you're right. The glory of the past is an empty dream.|If the Khans are to be immortal, we must make our own destiny. We won't fight for Caesar, but when he strikes, we will ride out one last time.
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic009 "What great legacy do the Great Khans have? Your tribe is nothing but ghosts and martyrs." [DIAL:00145F64]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: Time to go pay General Oliver a visit.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDLegionLegateLaniusTopic025 "Time to go pay General Oliver a visit." [DIAL:00146586]

text_content: Mars's eyes are upon you. Do not fail him - or us.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDLegionLegateLaniusTopic025 "Time to go pay General Oliver a visit." [DIAL:00146586]
speaker: VHDLegionLegateLanius "Legate Lanius" [NPC_:001300AA]

text_content: Then let's go.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDLegionLegateLaniusTopic024 "Then let's go." [DIAL:00146587]

text_content: I have questions.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDLegionLegateLaniusTopic023 "I have questions." [DIAL:00146588]

text_content: Then ask them. But don't waste my time. The battle draws near.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDLegionLegateLaniusTopic023 "I have questions." [DIAL:00146588]
speaker: VHDLegionLegateLanius "Legate Lanius" [NPC_:001300AA]

text_content: What can you tell me about the layout of the dam?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDLegionLegateLaniusTopic022 "What can you tell me about the layout of the dam?" [DIAL:00146589]

text_content: It was not intended for war - its top sides are bound to two intake towers by a series of bridges. No doubt snipers nest there.|On the far side of the dam, a small building provides access to the power plant below. That is where Oliver hides.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDLegionLegateLaniusTopic022 "What can you tell me about the layout of the dam?" [DIAL:00146589]
speaker: VHDLegionLegateLanius "Legate Lanius" [NPC_:001300AA]

text_content: I'm ready. What is the plan?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDLegionLegateLaniusTopic021 "I'm ready. What is the plan?" [DIAL:0014658A]

text_content: In the past, the NCR has relied upon attrition, withering our numbers with ranged fire and falling back as necessary.|Not this time. The dam contains tunnels to its heart, overlooked by the NCR... now occupied by the Legion.|When the battle begins, the NCR will find our teeth at their throats in a dozen places. There will be no attrition, no falling back, only carnage.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDLegionLegateLaniusTopic021 "I'm ready. What is the plan?" [DIAL:0014658A]
speaker: VHDLegionLegateLanius "Legate Lanius" [NPC_:001300AA]

text_content: I've got a package here from your friends Jack and Diane.
name: MrHostetlerDrugDelivery "I've got a package here from your friends Jack and Diane." [DIAL:00146683]

text_content: Huh? Oh! Oh, right. Yeah. I'll take that. You should go now, before you draw any attention.
name: MrHostetlerDrugDelivery "I've got a package here from your friends Jack and Diane." [DIAL:00146683]
speaker: NorthVegasMrHostetler "Don Hostetler" [NPC_:000F271C]

text_content: I've got a package here from your friends Jack and Diane.
name: MotorRunnerDrugDelivery "I've got a package here from your friends Jack and Diane." [DIAL:00146684]

text_content: About goddamn time. Tell the Khans if they can't keep a steady supply, we'll find someone who can.
name: MotorRunnerDrugDelivery "I've got a package here from your friends Jack and Diane." [DIAL:00146684]
speaker: V03MotorRunner "Motor-Runner" [NPC_:000EF3AB]

text_content: Sounds too dangerous, I'll pass.
name: VMS46VRRCDianeTopic009 "Sounds too dangerous, I'll pass." [DIAL:00146685]

text_content: Piece of cake.
name: VMS46VRRCDianeTopic008 "Piece of cake." [DIAL:00146686]

text_content: Don't get cocky, the Fiends are twitchy. Most of them won't bother a Khan, but the ones outside the Vault... well, they're outside for a reason.|Here's the package - good luck. Your payment will be waiting when you get back.
name: VMS46VRRCDianeTopic008 "Piece of cake." [DIAL:00146686]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

name: VMS46VRRCDianeTopic008 "Piece of cake." [DIAL:00146686]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: I'm not interested in being a drug mule.
name: VMS46VRRCDianeTopic007 "I'm not interested in being a drug mule." [DIAL:00146687]

text_content: Sure, I'll do it.
name: VMS46VRRCDianeTopic005 "Sure, I'll do it." [DIAL:00146688]

text_content: Great. Here's the package - your contact is Don Hostetler at the Crimson Caravan. Come back and see me when you're done.
name: VMS46VRRCDianeTopic005 "Sure, I'll do it." [DIAL:00146688]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: VMS46NullLinks
name: VMS46NullLinks "VMS46NullLinks" [DIAL:00146689]

text_content: We've got an associate in the Crimson Caravan Trading Company who distributes for us in Outer Vegas. He's been after us for a new shipment.
name: VMS46NullLinks "VMS46NullLinks" [DIAL:00146689]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Groodalicious. That ought to rake in the caps. What do I owe you?
name: VMS46NullLinks "VMS46NullLinks" [DIAL:00146689]
speaker: VRRCJack "Jack" [NPC_:00140E6B]

text_content: On second thought, never mind.
name: VMS46VRRCDianeTopic004 "On second thought, never mind." [DIAL:0014668A]

text_content: Sure, what have you got?
name: VMS46VRRCDianeTopic003 "Sure, what have you got?" [DIAL:0014668B]

text_content: With Anders out of commission for so long, we're shorthanded on runners, and some backlogs have piled up.|We've got an associate in the Crimson Caravan Trading Company who distributes for us in Outer Vegas. He's been after us for a new shipment.
name: VMS46VRRCDianeTopic003 "Sure, what have you got?" [DIAL:0014668B]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: You up for something challenging?|I've got a shipment of Jet and Psycho that needs to be delivered to Motor Runner at Vault 3.
name: VMS46VRRCDianeTopic003 "Sure, what have you got?" [DIAL:0014668B]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Okay, I'll be back as soon as I have any news.
name: VMS46VRRCDianeTopic002 "Okay, I'll be back as soon as I have any news." [DIAL:0014668C]

text_content: Thanks. Prove you're reliable on this, and I'll have more for you later.
name: VMS46VRRCDianeTopic002 "Okay, I'll be back as soon as I have any news." [DIAL:0014668C]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Sounds like more trouble than it's worth. I'll pass.
name: VMS46VRRCDianeTopic001 "Sounds like more trouble than it's worth. I'll pass." [DIAL:0014668D]

text_content: Okay then. Job'll be waiting if you change your mind.
name: VMS46VRRCDianeTopic001 "Sounds like more trouble than it's worth. I'll pass." [DIAL:0014668D]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Sure, just tell me who I'm looking for and where to start.
name: VMS46VRRCDianeTopic000 "Sure, just tell me who I'm looking for and where to start." [DIAL:0014668E]

text_content: About three weeks ago I sent Anders southeast to find a route into Arizona to open new markets for our product.|He should have been back two days ago, but there's been no sign of him.
name: VMS46VRRCDianeTopic000 "Sure, just tell me who I'm looking for and where to start." [DIAL:0014668E]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: You've got an impressive setup here - have you considered making more helpful chems?
name: JackDianeMedicine "You've got an impressive setup here - have you considered making more helpful chems?" [DIAL:0014668F]

text_content: Already on it. I whipped up a few Stimpaks already, but if you've got any more recipes I'll take them.
name: JackDianeMedicine "You've got an impressive setup here - have you considered making more helpful chems?" [DIAL:0014668F]
speaker: VRRCJack "Jack" [NPC_:00140E6B]

text_content: What do you mean, helpful? My stuff already makes people feel groodalicious.
name: JackDianeMedicine "You've got an impressive setup here - have you considered making more helpful chems?" [DIAL:0014668F]
speaker: VRRCJack "Jack" [NPC_:00140E6B]

text_content: Yeah, you made a pretty good argument. We'll keep it small for now, but if it turns a profit we might expand.
name: JackDianeMedicine "You've got an impressive setup here - have you considered making more helpful chems?" [DIAL:0014668F]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Helpful? What, like bathtub Stimpaks? What's the point of that?
name: JackDianeMedicine "You've got an impressive setup here - have you considered making more helpful chems?" [DIAL:0014668F]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: What do you have for sale?
name: JackMerchant "What do you have for sale?" [DIAL:00146691]

text_content: Oh, you're buying? Cool.
name: JackMerchant "What do you have for sale?" [DIAL:00146691]
speaker: VRRCJack "Jack" [NPC_:00140E6B]

text_content: Oh, you're buying? Tell you what, since you've been acting all, well, random lately, how about a discount? Might calm you down.
name: JackMerchant "What do you have for sale?" [DIAL:00146691]
speaker: VRRCJack "Jack" [NPC_:00140E6B]

text_content: Jack handles the small-time purchases. You should talk to him unless you're looking for a major shipment.
name: JackMerchant "What do you have for sale?" [DIAL:00146691]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: I know a few recipes for chems you might want. I could teach you.
name: JackRecipes "I know a few recipes for chems you might want. I could teach you." [DIAL:00146692]

text_content: Right on. What have you got?
name: JackRecipes "I know a few recipes for chems you might want. I could teach you." [DIAL:00146692]
speaker: VRRCJack "Jack" [NPC_:00140E6B]

text_content: I'm looking to make a few caps. Got any work for me?
name: DianeWork "I'm looking to make a few caps. Got any work for me?" [DIAL:00146694]

text_content: I don't have any compelling reason to trust you, given your behavior. So no, I'm not really inclined to give you a job.
name: DianeWork "I'm looking to make a few caps. Got any work for me?" [DIAL:00146694]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: {Thoughtful}Hmm... you look like you could handle yourself in a fix. All right, I'll tell you what. Anders, one of my best runners, is overdue to report back.|If you can find out what happened to him, I'll give you some real work.
name: DianeWork "I'm looking to make a few caps. Got any work for me?" [DIAL:00146694]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Great! Here's your payment.
name: DianeWork "I'm looking to make a few caps. Got any work for me?" [DIAL:00146694]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: And you didn't even get skinned alive. I'm impressed. Here's your payment.
name: DianeWork "I'm looking to make a few caps. Got any work for me?" [DIAL:00146694]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Like I said, find Anders first, then we'll see about trusting you with more work.
name: DianeWork "I'm looking to make a few caps. Got any work for me?" [DIAL:00146694]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Yeah, you did good finding him. Okay, if you want a little work, I think I can find you something.
name: DianeWork "I'm looking to make a few caps. Got any work for me?" [DIAL:00146694]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Okay, if you want a little work, I think I can find you something.
name: DianeWork "I'm looking to make a few caps. Got any work for me?" [DIAL:00146694]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Not right at the moment, but you could talk to Jack - he's always looking for new recipes.
name: DianeWork "I'm looking to make a few caps. Got any work for me?" [DIAL:00146694]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Ordinarily I would, but it seems like all our clients have ended up dead. You could talk to Jack - he's always looking for new recipes.
name: DianeWork "I'm looking to make a few caps. Got any work for me?" [DIAL:00146694]
speaker: VRRCDiane "Diane" [NPC_:00140E6D]

text_content: Diane handles most of the transactional elements of this little enterprise, but I'm always in the market for new recipes if you've got the spark.
name: DianeWork "I'm looking to make a few caps. Got any work for me?" [DIAL:00146694]
speaker: VRRCJack "Jack" [NPC_:00140E6B]

text_content: Are there any town rules I need to know about?
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic031 "Are there any town rules I need to know about?" [DIAL:001466BF]

text_content: Same as any civilized town - don't start any fights or steal anything, we'll treat you fair. Not a lot to ask.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic031 "Are there any town rules I need to know about?" [DIAL:001466BF]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: What's wrong with the Nightkin?
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic030 "What's wrong with the Nightkin?" [DIAL:001466C0]

text_content: Nightkin suffer schizophrenia from the Stealth Boys they're always using. One of the reasons I settled Jacobstown was so they could be cured.|While they're in town, the Nightkin aren't allowed to have Stealth Boys so their craziness doesn't get worse.|Trouble is the Nightkin don't like being visible, either. They don't take being exposed too well.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic030 "What's wrong with the Nightkin?" [DIAL:001466C0]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

name: VMS44CampSearchlightLoganTopic012 "Why the hostility?" [DIAL:00146702]

text_content: Look, I don't need your shit. Either get out of the way or things are gonna get rough.
name: VMS44CampSearchlightLoganTopic012 "Why the hostility?" [DIAL:00146702]

text_content: I'm hunting ghouls.
name: VMS44CampSearchlightLoganTopic011 "I'm hunting ghouls." [DIAL:00146703]

text_content: Then why are you in here bothering me instead of out there hunting them?
name: VMS44CampSearchlightLoganTopic011 "I'm hunting ghouls." [DIAL:00146703]
speaker: CampSearchlightLogan "Logan" [NPC_:0013FE7A]

text_content: Nothing, I'm just passing through.
name: VMS44CampSearchlightLoganTopic010 "Nothing, I'm just passing through." [DIAL:00146704]

name: VMS44CampSearchlightLoganTopic010 "Nothing, I'm just passing through." [DIAL:00146704]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VMS44CampSearchlightLoganTopic009 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00146705]

text_content: Yeah, whatever.
name: VMS44CampSearchlightLoganTopic009 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00146705]
