text_content: Not really.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic016 "Not really." [DIAL:00146796]

text_content: That's okay, I wouldn't expect anybody to. I think they tend to keep to themselves.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic016 "Not really." [DIAL:00146796]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Yeah. I know to shoot them on sight.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic015 "Yeah. I know to shoot them on sight." [DIAL:00146797]

text_content: That bad, huh? Guess I'm lucky I got away with my life. I'll make sure and avoid them from now on. Thanks.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic015 "Yeah. I know to shoot them on sight." [DIAL:00146797]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: I know who they are but I don't care about their agenda.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic014 "I know who they are but I don't care about their agenda." [DIAL:00146798]

text_content: Yeah, it's pretty far out, right? Fixating on old technology just doesn't seem very relevant to most people's lives.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic014 "I know who they are but I don't care about their agenda." [DIAL:00146798]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: They've got the right idea.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic013 "They've got the right idea." [DIAL:00146799]

name: VDialogueVeronicaFiendsReact "VDialogueVeronicaFiendsReact" [DIAL:00147772]

text_content: VDialogueVeronicaQuestReact
name: VDialogueVeronicaQuestReact "VDialogueVeronicaQuestReact" [DIAL:00147773]

text_content: He's got no resources but a decent cause. We've got plenty of resources and a totally lost cause.
name: VDialogueVeronicaQuestReact "VDialogueVeronicaQuestReact" [DIAL:00147773]

text_content: No power armor. No energy weapons. And they're giving the NCR more trouble than we ever did.
name: VDialogueVeronicaQuestReact "VDialogueVeronicaQuestReact" [DIAL:00147773]

text_content: Ordinary guys with knives and bullets, and they're taking over Nevada.
name: VDialogueVeronicaQuestReact "VDialogueVeronicaQuestReact" [DIAL:00147773]

text_content: There's a lot more troops here than we thought. No wonder we couldn't hold HELIOS One.
name: VDialogueVeronicaQuestReact "VDialogueVeronicaQuestReact" [DIAL:00147773]

text_content: A bunch of shut-ins who scorn outsiders and hold technology over them. Gee, where have I heard that one before?
name: VDialogueVeronicaQuestReact "VDialogueVeronicaQuestReact" [DIAL:00147773]

text_content: Can't help but be impressed with what they're doing here.
name: VDialogueVeronicaQuestReact "VDialogueVeronicaQuestReact" [DIAL:00147773]

text_content: Even the stupid NCR is investing in new research. We're getting left in the dust.
name: VDialogueVeronicaQuestReact "VDialogueVeronicaQuestReact" [DIAL:00147773]

text_content: Leading his people to a new land with big dreams and a clean slate. Makes me think of my old mentor.
name: VDialogueVeronicaQuestReact "VDialogueVeronicaQuestReact" [DIAL:00147773]

text_content: Holy hell, that's a lot of energy weapons. Guess we dropped the ball on that one.
name: VDialogueVeronicaQuestReact "VDialogueVeronicaQuestReact" [DIAL:00147773]

text_content: Never mind.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic050 "Never mind." [DIAL:00147778]

text_content: Darn it, I had some spectacular answers coming, too.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic050 "Never mind." [DIAL:00147778]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Any thoughts about Caesar's Legion?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic049 "Any thoughts about Caesar's Legion?" [DIAL:00147779]

text_content: Silliest dressed band of raping, slaving marauders you'll see east of California, I'll say that. Where's that touch of Old World class?|Although I hear the soldiers mount each other as much as they mount their women, so maybe they did keep a little something from the Empire.|No such privilege for the women, though. Figures. So... to answer your question... they're a bunch of hypocritical jerkwads. {beat}It's a word.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic049 "Any thoughts about Caesar's Legion?" [DIAL:00147779]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: What do you think of the NCR?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic048 "What do you think of the NCR?" [DIAL:0014777A]

text_content: I'm worried they'll be the death of the Brotherhood. They take what they want. We defend our interests to the death.|But there's a handful of us and tens or hundreds of thousands of them. So it's not going to end well.|Last time we clashed we lost a lot of people. Retreated to our bunker. Now we're afraid to even move around during the day.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic048 "What do you think of the NCR?" [DIAL:0014777A]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Know anything about New Vegas?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic047 "Know anything about New Vegas?" [DIAL:0014777B]

text_content: Yep. It's your typical city layout. Rich people in a gated community surrounded by extreme poverty.|House gave the area around the Strip to the locals, but he has no interest in it, so he ignores it entirely. It just needs new management.|I'd love to see the Brotherhood do it, but since the Codex doesn't say "clean up Freeside" no one listens to me. Bunch of sticklers.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic047 "Know anything about New Vegas?" [DIAL:0014777B]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Ever hear of a guy called Benny?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic046 "Ever hear of a guy called Benny?" [DIAL:0014777C]

text_content: Sure, he's one of the hotel managers on the Strip. He comes up in the news now and then.|Him and the other Chairmen run the Tops. It's one of the nicer hotels, or so I hear.|Elder McNamara wouldn't shell out for a passport for me, so I've actually never been to the Strip. Why do people get so cheap when they get old?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic046 "Ever hear of a guy called Benny?" [DIAL:0014777C]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Can you tell me anything about this platinum chip?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic045 "Can you tell me anything about this platinum chip?" [DIAL:0014777D]

text_content: Yeah. It's not for poker.|I've never seen anything quite like it, but I can tell you it looks like it was fabricated before the War, and not at a mint.|Some kind of tech... I'm gonna say... mid-2200s. Hold onto it. Might be your lucky chip.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic045 "Can you tell me anything about this platinum chip?" [DIAL:0014777D]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Ever heard of Mr. House before?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic044 "Ever heard of Mr. House before?" [DIAL:0014777E]

text_content: Yeah. They say he built the Strip. Of course, they say a lot of things. No one's actually met him.|Me? I think it's a hoax. Probably a group of people who want to avoid attention, or some made-up persona of a self-aware computer.|Why else would he shut himself in like that?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic044 "Ever heard of Mr. House before?" [DIAL:0014777E]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: I have questions I wanted to ask you.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic043 "I have questions I wanted to ask you." [DIAL:0014777F]

text_content: He was dead when I got there.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic043 "I have questions I wanted to ask you." [DIAL:0014777F]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: This better not be about the meaning of life.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic043 "I have questions I wanted to ask you." [DIAL:0014777F]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Well, when two people really love each other... you really don't know this stuff yet?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic043 "I have questions I wanted to ask you." [DIAL:0014777F]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Ooo, do I get a prize if I answer right?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic043 "I have questions I wanted to ask you." [DIAL:0014777F]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: I was told we wouldn't be tested on this.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic043 "I have questions I wanted to ask you." [DIAL:0014777F]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: A lifetime supply of Fancy Lads Snack Cakes, revenge against my enemies, and world peace. In that order.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic043 "I have questions I wanted to ask you." [DIAL:0014777F]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: {Defensive}I was young and I needed the money.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic043 "I have questions I wanted to ask you." [DIAL:0014777F]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: It's a free wasteland.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic043 "I have questions I wanted to ask you." [DIAL:0014777F]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Tell me about yourself.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic042 "Tell me about yourself." [DIAL:00147780]

text_content: I like long walks in the desert and candle-lit metal workshops.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic042 "Tell me about yourself." [DIAL:00147780]

text_content: My favorite subject.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic042 "Tell me about yourself." [DIAL:00147780]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Absolutely not. You misled me on purpose.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic040 "Absolutely not. You misled me on purpose." [DIAL:00147781]

text_content: Yes, but you're on a short leash.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic039 "Yes, but you're on a short leash." [DIAL:00147782]

text_content: Fair enough. Maybe one day I'll have your complete trust, and I can be on a long leash. A girl can dream.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic039 "Yes, but you're on a short leash." [DIAL:00147782]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: As long as you're honest with me from now on.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic038 "As long as you're honest with me from now on." [DIAL:00147783]

text_content: Sure. Just don't ever ask me if your outfit makes you look fat.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic038 "As long as you're honest with me from now on." [DIAL:00147783]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Actually, I'm more comfortable now that I know you've had some training.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic037 "Actually, I'm more comfortable now that I know you've had some training." [DIAL:00147784]

text_content: I'm great at punching people. I'm not gonna lie. It's a gift.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic037 "Actually, I'm more comfortable now that I know you've had some training." [DIAL:00147784]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Well, thanks for taking a chance on a naive young girl from California with stars in her eyes and a pneumatic gauntlet on her hand.|Let's hit the road, huh?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic037 "Actually, I'm more comfortable now that I know you've had some training." [DIAL:00147784]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

name: VDialogueBennyArena "VDialogueBennyArena" [DIAL:001477B1]

text_content: {respectfully}Thanks again for this. You're platinum, baby.

name: VDialogueBennyButchered "VDialogueBennyButchered" [DIAL:001477B2]

text_content: {Terrified, humiliated, defiant}You think you scare me? Come on! Do it!
name: VDialogueBennyButchered "VDialogueBennyButchered" [DIAL:001477B2]

text_content: {in pain, defiant}That the best you can do?
name: VDialogueBennyButchered "VDialogueBennyButchered" [DIAL:001477B2]

text_content: {in pain, defiant}I didn't even feel that one!
name: VDialogueBennyButchered "VDialogueBennyButchered" [DIAL:001477B2]

text_content: {in pain, defiant}That's right, gimme another!
name: VDialogueBennyButchered "VDialogueBennyButchered" [DIAL:001477B2]

name: VDialogueBennyButchered "VDialogueBennyButchered" [DIAL:001477B2]

text_content: {in pain, defiant}Come on, ya bum! Put your shoulder into it!

text_content: VDialogueBennyBodyguardsNo
name: VDialogueBennyBodyguards "VDialogueBennyBodyguardsNo" [DIAL:001477B4]

text_content: I'm gonna take a meeting with this {pal-ee}pally up in the Prez. You boys wait at the bottom of the elevator. You hear trouble, come up blazing.
name: VDialogueBennyBodyguards "VDialogueBennyBodyguardsNo" [DIAL:001477B4]

text_content: A Securitron dug me up and a doc in Goodsprings did the rest.
name: VDialogueBennyBennyTopic077 "A Securitron dug me up and a doc in Goodsprings did the rest." [DIAL:001477B5]

text_content: {dismayed}House was on to me from word Go? I thought I was being so clever...
name: VDialogueBennyBennyTopic077 "A Securitron dug me up and a doc in Goodsprings did the rest." [DIAL:001477B5]
speaker: Benny "Benny" [NPC_:00101C9B]

text_content: It takes more than a couple bullets in the head to stop me.
name: VDialogueBennyBennyTopic076 "It takes more than a couple bullets in the head to stop me." [DIAL:001477B6]

text_content: {drawing it out, scoffing at player's bravado}Yeah, hello... Well, serves me right for using a 9mm.
name: VDialogueBennyBennyTopic076 "It takes more than a couple bullets in the head to stop me." [DIAL:001477B6]
speaker: Benny "Benny" [NPC_:00101C9B]

text_content: Call it luck and leave it at that.
name: VDialogueBennyBennyTopic028 "Call it luck and leave it at that." [DIAL:001477B7]

text_content: Luck is for losers, baby. Someone pulled strings.
name: VDialogueBennyBennyTopic028 "Call it luck and leave it at that." [DIAL:001477B7]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic005 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:001477BA]

text_content: Or I could kill you right now, while your hands are bound.
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic080 "Or I could kill you right now, while your hands are bound." [DIAL:001477BB]

text_content: On second thought, maybe I should fight you in the arena.
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic079 "On second thought, maybe I should fight you in the arena." [DIAL:001477BC]

text_content: I have to decide what happens to you now.
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic078 "I have to decide what happens to you now." [DIAL:001477BD]

text_content: None of your business. It's time for you to die.
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic077 "None of your business. It's time for you to die." [DIAL:001477BE]

text_content: Hundreds of Securitrons. All of them upgraded now, just like Mr. House wants.
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic076 "Hundreds of Securitrons. All of them upgraded now, just like Mr. House wants." [DIAL:001477BF]

text_content: So all this time the old man had an entire army on lay-away? Clever player.|{caught up in vision of triumph}Just imagine the look on Baldie's face when those Securitrons come pouring out on judgment day! I'd pay to have that bronzed!|{realizing you won't be a part of it}So all you gotta do now is talk to Yes Man, figure out how to set things in motion.|Make Vegas a town I woulda been proud of, baby. Let it swing.
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic076 "Hundreds of Securitrons. All of them upgraded now, just like Mr. House wants." [DIAL:001477BF]
speaker: VFortBenny "Benny" [NPC_:001344BE]

text_content: There were hundreds of Securitrons down there - until I blew them up.
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic074 "There were hundreds of Securitrons down there - until I blew them up." [DIAL:001477C0]

text_content: What? How could you do that?|{all has come to naught}You loser! You had Vegas in the palm of your hand and you threw it away?
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic074 "There were hundreds of Securitrons down there - until I blew them up." [DIAL:001477C0]
speaker: VFortBenny "Benny" [NPC_:001344BE]

text_content: Something bad could happen to you right here...
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic073 "Something bad could happen to you right here..." [DIAL:001477C1]

text_content: Maybe we should face each other in the arena, fair and square.

Tried to sneak into the bunker, but that didn't work out.|They found the Chip. I wasn't gonna tell them what it was used for, but... let's just say they were persuasive.

name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic062 "Caesar says I get to decide how you die." [DIAL:001477CC]

text_content: Why the rush to leave? You said you would help clear the caves.
name: vFreeformCampGuardianNVCGHalfordTopic021 "Why the rush to leave? You said you would help clear the caves." [DIAL:00148420]

text_content: You said I could have your rifle before you go.
name: vFreeformCampGuardianNVCGHalfordTopic020 "You said I could have your rifle before you go." [DIAL:00148421]

text_content: Sure enough, you got me clear of this mess. Here you go.
name: vFreeformCampGuardianNVCGHalfordTopic020 "You said I could have your rifle before you go." [DIAL:00148421]
speaker: NVCGHalford "Private Halford" [NPC_:0013F323]

text_content: Well, have a safe trip.
name: vFreeformCampGuardianNVCGHalfordTopic019 "Well, have a safe trip." [DIAL:00148422]

text_content: If you find my friends, please return their dogtags to the NCR. People need to know what happened here.|If they won't listen, do what you can to make them listen. The dead need to be avenged.
name: vFreeformCampGuardianNVCGHalfordTopic019 "Well, have a safe trip." [DIAL:00148422]
speaker: NVCGHalford "Private Halford" [NPC_:0013F323]

text_content: Hey, you said you would help clear the caves.
name: vFreeformCampGuardianNVCGHalfordTopic017 "Hey, you said you would help clear the caves." [DIAL:00148423]

text_content: I know, but now that I can see the way out, I'm not so sure. I'd rather not join my dead buddies anytime soon.|I'm going to start heading back to California now. I'm not about to let myself get killed by future NCR incompetence.
name: vFreeformCampGuardianNVCGHalfordTopic017 "Hey, you said you would help clear the caves." [DIAL:00148423]
speaker: NVCGHalford "Private Halford" [NPC_:0013F323]

text_content: I'll find you when you're done here.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic037 "I'll find you when you're done here." [DIAL:00148504]

text_content: Wait for me downstairs, this won't take long.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic037 "I'll find you when you're done here." [DIAL:00148504]

text_content: {Speech >= 60}

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Fine, this isn't worth the trouble to fight over.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic015 "{Speech >= 60}" [DIAL:00148506]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: [FAILED] No, we have men to outfit and are putting it to good use.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic015 "{Speech >= 60}" [DIAL:00148506]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: Would it be so bad to lend them the armor for the battle?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVMSHDBrotherhoodPaladinTopic000 "Would it be so bad to lend them the armor for the battle?" [DIAL:0014850A]

text_content: [FAILED] Yes, it would be, we can't have outsiders running around using our technology.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVMSHDBrotherhoodPaladinTopic000 "Would it be so bad to lend them the armor for the battle?" [DIAL:0014850A]
speaker: VMSHDBrotherhoodPaladin "Paladin Todd" [NPC_:0014851E]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] It would mean more people better protected and able to fight.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVMSHDBrotherhoodPaladinTopic000 "Would it be so bad to lend them the armor for the battle?" [DIAL:0014850A]
speaker: VMSHDBrotherhoodPaladin "Paladin Todd" [NPC_:0014851E]

text_content: vHDPowerArmor
name: vHDPowerArmor "vHDPowerArmor" [DIAL:0014850B]

text_content: This is unacceptable, we demand the immediate return of our power armor.
name: vHDPowerArmor "vHDPowerArmor" [DIAL:0014850B]

text_content: A battle is about to be fought out there, to come here requesting our men to give up their armor is insane.
name: vHDPowerArmor "vHDPowerArmor" [DIAL:0014850B]

text_content: It is not your armor, that power armor is property of the Brotherhood of Steel and you have no right to claim it as your own.
name: vHDPowerArmor "vHDPowerArmor" [DIAL:0014850B]

text_content: VMSHD
name: VMSHDPowerArmor "VMSHD" [DIAL:0014850C]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemDoctorHenryTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:001489CD]

text_content: Yes, yes.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemDoctorHenryTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:001489CD]
speaker: VRemDoctorHenry "Doctor Henry" [NPC_:00133957]

text_content: You won't have any more trouble with those mercenaries.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic038 "You won't have any more trouble with those mercenaries." [DIAL:001489FB]

text_content: {peaceful resolution}Good. Glad you didn't kill them. Letting them walk away proves we're not bloodthirsty mutants.|If NCR or anybody else is looking for an excuse to attack Jacobstown, they're not going to get it from us.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic038 "You won't have any more trouble with those mercenaries." [DIAL:001489FB]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: Here's your money - 2000 caps, as we agreed.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownNortonTopic007 "Here's your money - 2000 caps, as we agreed." [DIAL:001489FC]

text_content: All right, then. We'll be on our way.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownNortonTopic007 "Here's your money - 2000 caps, as we agreed." [DIAL:001489FC]
speaker: JacobstownNorton "Norton" [NPC_:00148A32]

text_content: I'll need 2000 caps to pay off the mercenaries.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic037 "I'll need 2000 caps to pay off the mercenaries." [DIAL:001489FD]

text_content: That's not too bad. If that's what it takes to be rid of them...
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic037 "I'll need 2000 caps to pay off the mercenaries." [DIAL:001489FD]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: I hear you're mercenaries. Will caps make you go away?
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownNortonTopic006 "I hear you're mercenaries. Will caps make you go away?" [DIAL:001489FE]

text_content: We're still owed half - 2500 caps. Pay up and we'll be on our way. If you're short, maybe you can get the money from the muties.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownNortonTopic006 "I hear you're mercenaries. Will caps make you go away?" [DIAL:001489FE]
speaker: JacobstownNorton "Norton" [NPC_:00148A32]

text_content: I'll need 2500 caps to pay the mercenaries.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic036 "I'll need 2500 caps to pay the mercenaries." [DIAL:001489FF]

text_content: That puts a dent in the town treasury. {"Still..."}If that's what it takes to be rid of them...
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic036 "I'll need 2500 caps to pay the mercenaries." [DIAL:001489FF]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: <Lie> I'll need 3000 caps to pay off the mercenaries.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic035 "<Lie> I'll need 3000 caps to pay off the mercenaries." [DIAL:00148A00]

text_content: {Angry}Damn it. That'll wipe out the town treasury. {Calms down, irritated}If that's what it takes...
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic035 "<Lie> I'll need 3000 caps to pay off the mercenaries." [DIAL:00148A00]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: Here's your money - 2500 caps.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownNortonTopic005 "Here's your money - 2500 caps." [DIAL:00148A01]

text_content: A deal's a deal. We'll be on our way.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownNortonTopic005 "Here's your money - 2500 caps." [DIAL:00148A01]
speaker: JacobstownNorton "Norton" [NPC_:00148A32]

text_content: < Barter - 55 >
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownNortonTopic004 "< Barter - 55 >" [DIAL:00148A02]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] That thought had crossed my mind as well, actually. Fine, make it 2000 caps and we'll call it square.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownNortonTopic004 "< Barter - 55 >" [DIAL:00148A02]
speaker: JacobstownNorton "Norton" [NPC_:00148A32]

text_content: [FAILED] Sorry, but I've got men to pay and equipment to maintain. 2500 caps or no deal.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownNortonTopic004 "< Barter - 55 >" [DIAL:00148A02]
speaker: JacobstownNorton "Norton" [NPC_:00148A32]

text_content: < Speech - 65 >
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownNortonTopic003 "< Speech - 65 >" [DIAL:00148A03]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] I've always known when to fight and when to back down, and it seems to me I ought to back down this time.|My men and I are leaving. You won't see us around here again.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownNortonTopic003 "< Speech - 65 >" [DIAL:00148A03]
speaker: JacobstownNorton "Norton" [NPC_:00148A32]

text_content: [FAILED] I've faced down a charging Deathclaw and didn't blink. What makes you think I'd back down from you?
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownNortonTopic003 "< Speech - 65 >" [DIAL:00148A03]
speaker: JacobstownNorton "Norton" [NPC_:00148A32]

text_content: Who are you doing this for?
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownNortonTopic002 "Who are you doing this for?" [DIAL:00148A04]

text_content: Won't name names, but some important folks in the NCR are sick of muties attacking their Brahmin herds. They want them gone from NCR territory.|Maybe this group had something to do with attacking Brahmin, maybe not. Doesn't matter. We're getting paid to make them go away.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownNortonTopic002 "Who are you doing this for?" [DIAL:00148A04]
speaker: JacobstownNorton "Norton" [NPC_:00148A32]

text_content: What do you want with Jacobstown?
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownNortonTopic001 "What do you want with Jacobstown?" [DIAL:00148A05]

text_content: Just doing what I'm paid to do - harass the muties until they leave or attack us. If they leave, we let 'em go. If they attack, we wipe them out.|Either way, the job's not done until they've cleared out of the town.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownNortonTopic001 "What do you want with Jacobstown?" [DIAL:00148A05]
speaker: JacobstownNorton "Norton" [NPC_:00148A32]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownNortonTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00148A06]

text_content: Yep, get a move on.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownNortonTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00148A06]
speaker: JacobstownNorton "Norton" [NPC_:00148A32]

text_content: I'd rather not get involved.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic033 "I'd rather not get involved." [DIAL:00148A07]

text_content: All right. Can't say I blame you.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic033 "I'd rather not get involved." [DIAL:00148A07]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: I'll see what I can do.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic029 "I'll see what I can do." [DIAL:00148A08]

text_content: Thanks.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic029 "I'll see what I can do." [DIAL:00148A08]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: What do you want me to do?
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic028 "What do you want me to do?" [DIAL:00148A09]

text_content: You're human - they {emph}might be willing to be listen to what you have to say. Maybe.|I'm {emph}not asking you to kill them. Just talk them into leaving. Hell, pay them off if you have to.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic028 "What do you want me to do?" [DIAL:00148A09]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: Why can't you just take them out?
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic014 "Why can't you just take them out?" [DIAL:00148A0A]

text_content: Not looking to fight. That'll give NCR an excuse to come up here and wipe us out.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic014 "Why can't you just take them out?" [DIAL:00148A0A]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: You're sure these mercenaries work for the NCR?
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic002 "You're sure these mercenaries work for the NCR?" [DIAL:00148A0B]

text_content: {frowns, didn't consider this}Guess I can't say for sure if they're NCR. {Beat, shrugs}Whoever they are, they want us dead or gone.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic002 "You're sure these mercenaries work for the NCR?" [DIAL:00148A0B]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: How have they been harassing the town?
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic001 "How have they been harassing the town?" [DIAL:00148A0C]

text_content: Killing our Bighorners, shooting at the lodge, that sort of thing. It's getting hard to keep people from retaliating.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic001 "How have they been harassing the town?" [DIAL:00148A0C]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: I'm looking for Doctor Henry.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic003 "I'm looking for Doctor Henry." [DIAL:00148A3C]

text_content: Doc's inside the Lodge.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic003 "I'm looking for Doctor Henry." [DIAL:00148A3C]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: I'm a hero in the NCR, and I think you need to leave. Now.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownNortonTopic008 "I'm a hero in the NCR, and I think you need to leave. Now." [DIAL:00148A44]

text_content: Whoa, whoa. Thought you looked familiar. I'm just doing a job, nothing more. Politics aren't my thing, so if you say go, we'll go. No hard feelings.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownNortonTopic008 "I'm a hero in the NCR, and I think you need to leave. Now." [DIAL:00148A44]
speaker: JacobstownNorton "Norton" [NPC_:00148A32]

text_content: vHDPowerArmor2
name: vHDPowerArmor2 "vHDPowerArmor2" [DIAL:00148A4F]

text_content: You know what? I don't need this bullshit right now. We'll take off that goddamn power armor, if it'll just shut you up.
name: vHDPowerArmor2 "vHDPowerArmor2" [DIAL:00148A4F]

text_content: I'm sure you two can settle this.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVMSHDBrotherhoodPaladinTopic001 "I'm sure you two can settle this." [DIAL:00148A50]

text_content: I'm sure that we can.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVMSHDBrotherhoodPaladinTopic001 "I'm sure you two can settle this." [DIAL:00148A50]
speaker: VMSHDBrotherhoodPaladin "Paladin Todd" [NPC_:0014851E]

text_content: I'd love to hear your dissertation, but I'm in a bit of a hurry.
name: VMS45VRRCEzekielTopic002 "I'd love to hear your dissertation, but I'm in a bit of a hurry." [DIAL:00148C0E]

text_content: Can I get the abridged version?
name: VMS45VRRCEzekielTopic001 "Can I get the abridged version?" [DIAL:00148C0F]

text_content: Oh, of course! I'm sorry, I do tend to get wrapped up in my own theories and forget that not everyone finds them as fascinating as I do.|Here, I salvaged this book from an old library. It's a history of a people called the {over-enunciate, like it's unfamiliar}Mongols. I think that's what the Khans built their culture on.|You should read it, it's fascinating stuff.
name: VMS45VRRCEzekielTopic001 "Can I get the abridged version?" [DIAL:00148C0F]
speaker: VRRCEzekiel "Ezekiel" [NPC_:00148C26]

text_content: This is fascinating. Please continue.
name: VMS45VRRCEzekielTopic000 "This is fascinating. Please continue." [DIAL:00148C10]

text_content: Well, after they migrated to the Mojave, we established relations with them, but that soured when all they wanted was to make drugs.|The NCR eventually took them down quite a bit, but the really fascinating thing about them is the origin of their culture as a whole. You see....
name: VMS45VRRCEzekielTopic000 "This is fascinating. Please continue." [DIAL:00148C10]
speaker: VRRCEzekiel "Ezekiel" [NPC_:00148C26]

text_content: Julie Farkas said you might know something about the Great Khans.
name: EzekielGreatKhans "Julie Farkas said you might know something about the Great Khans." [DIAL:00148C11]

text_content: Oh my, yes! They're a fascinating tribe with a long and, unfortunately, tragic history.|Their original incarnation, much farther out west, was almost completely wiped out by one of those itinerant heroes so common in the post-War years.|Then of course the "New Khans" suffered a similar fate, some say at the hands of the same hero, though of course the dates are all wrong for that.
name: EzekielGreatKhans "Julie Farkas said you might know something about the Great Khans." [DIAL:00148C11]
speaker: VRRCEzekiel "Ezekiel" [NPC_:00148C26]

text_content: On second thought, never mind.
name: VMS45VFSJulieFarkasTopic002 "On second thought, never mind." [DIAL:00148C12]

text_content: Was there something else you needed?
name: VMS45VFSJulieFarkasTopic002 "On second thought, never mind." [DIAL:00148C12]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: Where can I find this Ezekiel?
name: VMS45VFSJulieFarkasTopic001 "Where can I find this Ezekiel?" [DIAL:00148C13]

text_content: He rarely stops in here these days - you'd do best to look for him out in the wastes east of New Vegas. He's always looking for new tribes to study.
name: VMS45VFSJulieFarkasTopic001 "Where can I find this Ezekiel?" [DIAL:00148C13]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: Who is Ezekiel?
name: VMS45VFSJulieFarkasTopic000 "Who is Ezekiel?" [DIAL:00148C14]

text_content: He's a member of the Followers like myself, but his particular field is pre-War history and tribal culture.|I do recall him being fascinated by the Khans, he kept going on about parallels to some ancient historical empire or another.
name: VMS45VFSJulieFarkasTopic000 "Who is Ezekiel?" [DIAL:00148C14]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: I'm looking for something that could inspire the Great Khans. Know of anything like that?
name: JulieFarkasKhans "I'm looking for something that could inspire the Great Khans. Know of anything like that?" [DIAL:00148C15]

text_content: The Great Khans? Oh, you mean those raiders that used to clash with the Vegas tribes?|Yes, some years back we taught them reading, writing, basic science - we hoped they would use it to make medical supplies, but they turned to drugs.|I was never much involved in the cultural side of that project, but Ezekiel was.
name: JulieFarkasKhans "I'm looking for something that could inspire the Great Khans. Know of anything like that?" [DIAL:00148C15]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: Have a look at this book. Your tribe is nothing but a bunch of thugs, aping the glories of the past.
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic013 "Have a look at this book. Your tribe is nothing but a bunch of thugs, aping the glories of the past." [DIAL:00148C16]

text_content: I should have you torn apart for speaking like that - but maybe you're right. The glory of the past is an empty dream.|If the Khans are to be immortal, we must make our own destiny. We won't fight for Caesar, but when he strikes, we will ride out one last time.
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic013 "Have a look at this book. Your tribe is nothing but a bunch of thugs, aping the glories of the past." [DIAL:00148C16]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: Have a look at this book. If you want to see what your tribe could be, read about the Mongol Empire.
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic011 "Have a look at this book. If you want to see what your tribe could be, read about the Mongol Empire." [DIAL:00148C17]

text_content: Hmm... this is exactly the kind of symbol the Khans could unite behind.|We'll begin readying the camp to move. As soon as Caesar makes his move, we'll depart. We will make ourselves strong again, and we shall conquer!
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic011 "Have a look at this book. If you want to see what your tribe could be, read about the Mongol Empire." [DIAL:00148C17]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: Hmm... this is exactly the kind of symbol the Khans could unite behind.|We'll begin readying the camp to move. As soon as Caesar makes his move, we'll depart. We will make ourselves strong again, and we shall conquer!
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic011 "Have a look at this book. If you want to see what your tribe could be, read about the Mongol Empire." [DIAL:00148C17]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: Great Khans! Drive Caesar's dog out of our camp! If he's too slow to flee, kill him!
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic011 "Have a look at this book. If you want to see what your tribe could be, read about the Mongol Empire." [DIAL:00148C17]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: Any idea where I might look to find such inspiration from the past?
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic010 "Any idea where I might look to find such inspiration from the past?" [DIAL:00148C18]

text_content: The Followers of the Apocalypse keep many records of the past. It's been a long time since we associated with them, but they might have something.|Until you do find me something, though, know that I still plan to lead the Great Khans to fight for Caesar.
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic010 "Any idea where I might look to find such inspiration from the past?" [DIAL:00148C18]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: I can clear out Cottonwood Cove for you.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic163 "I can clear out Cottonwood Cove for you." [DIAL:00148C2A]

text_content: I just killed everyone the old-fashioned way.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic162 "I just killed everyone the old-fashioned way." [DIAL:00148C2B]

text_content: A single man slaughters an entire camp of legionaries?! I'm amazed.{test text}|It took everything we had in the last battle at the dam to stand against those brutes. You're a beast, son.|You've done a fine job, friend. Here is a little something for your work.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic162 "I just killed everyone the old-fashioned way." [DIAL:00148C2B]
speaker: CampSearchlightAstor "First Sergeant Astor" [NPC_:0013FE78]

text_content: A single woman slaughters an entire camp of legionaries?! Oh, that's priceless!|Considering the way Caesar treats women, that should really put some doubts into his troops' minds. Wait til the rangers hear about this!|You've done a fine job, friend. Here's a little something for your work.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic162 "I just killed everyone the old-fashioned way." [DIAL:00148C2B]
speaker: CampSearchlightAstor "First Sergeant Astor" [NPC_:0013FE78]

text_content: I released some barrels of radioactive waste.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic161 "I released some barrels of radioactive waste." [DIAL:00148C2C]

text_content: That's exactly what we needed to put a cork in that camp. The Legion won't be moving through there anytime soon.|Fitting that the camp was taken care of in a way similar to Searchlight. Thank you for taking care of that place for us.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic161 "I released some barrels of radioactive waste." [DIAL:00148C2C]
speaker: CampSearchlightAstor "First Sergeant Astor" [NPC_:0013FE78]

text_content: I killed everyone in the camp.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic160 "I killed everyone in the camp." [DIAL:00148C2D]

text_content: What?! How did you pull it off?
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic160 "I killed everyone in the camp." [DIAL:00148C2D]
speaker: CampSearchlightAstor "First Sergeant Astor" [NPC_:0013FE78]

text_content: Nothing new to report.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic159 "Nothing new to report." [DIAL:00148C2E]

text_content: Anything else?
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic159 "Nothing new to report." [DIAL:00148C2E]
speaker: CampSearchlightAstor "First Sergeant Astor" [NPC_:0013FE78]

text_content: [Give Aurelius' old intel] I planted the bug and found some paperwork.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic158 "[Give Aurelius' old intel] I planted the bug and found some paperwork." [DIAL:00148C2F]

text_content: This is more than I could have hoped for! It almost seems too good to be true, but the details are all here.|Looks like they're planning to shift their raids north of Vegas. I'll shift some of the rangers and NCR patrols in that direction when they're free.|Here are some caps for your trouble. You've done us a great service.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic158 "[Give Aurelius' old intel] I planted the bug and found some paperwork." [DIAL:00148C2F]
speaker: CampSearchlightAstor "First Sergeant Astor" [NPC_:0013FE78]

text_content: Maybe later.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic157 "Maybe later." [DIAL:00148C30]

text_content: Yeah, I know I wouldn't sign up for that solo op if asked.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic157 "Maybe later." [DIAL:00148C30]
speaker: CampSearchlightAstor "First Sergeant Astor" [NPC_:0013FE78]

text_content: I'll see what I can do.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic156 "I'll see what I can do." [DIAL:00148C31]

text_content: Report back when the camp is clear. I'll try and shuffle some men in that direction once the Legion is gone.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic156 "I'll see what I can do." [DIAL:00148C31]
speaker: CampSearchlightAstor "First Sergeant Astor" [NPC_:0013FE78]

text_content: Consider it done.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic155 "Consider it done." [DIAL:00148C32]

text_content: {Genuine Surprise}What?.. Really?! You're mad, but I like it!|According to the notes you gave me, all of the southern raiding parties come from that camp. Caesar regularly sends fresh squads to relieve patrols.|Killing their Centurion and leadership would be a start, but finding a way to permanently shut down that dock is what we really need.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic155 "Consider it done." [DIAL:00148C32]
speaker: CampSearchlightAstor "First Sergeant Astor" [NPC_:0013FE78]

text_content: I already took care of the camp.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic154 "I already took care of the camp." [DIAL:00148C33]

text_content: Is there anything else you need done?
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic153 "Is there anything else you need done?" [DIAL:00148C34]

text_content: Well, unless you want to go in there and clean out that camp for me, I guess this should be more than enough for now.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic153 "Is there anything else you need done?" [DIAL:00148C34]
speaker: CampSearchlightAstor "First Sergeant Astor" [NPC_:0013FE78]

text_content: [Give intel] I planted the bug in Cottonwood Cove's radio and found some intel.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic152 "[Give intel] I planted the bug in Cottonwood Cove's radio and found some intel." [DIAL:00148C35]

text_content: This is more than I could have hoped for! It almost seems too good to be true, but the details are all here.|Looks like they're planning to strike some of the southern caravans. I'll notify the rangers and patrols in that area immediately.|Here are some caps for your trouble. You've done us a great service.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic152 "[Give intel] I planted the bug in Cottonwood Cove's radio and found some intel." [DIAL:00148C35]
speaker: CampSearchlightAstor "First Sergeant Astor" [NPC_:0013FE78]

text_content: I have an update on Cottonwood Cove.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic150 "I have an update on Cottonwood Cove." [DIAL:00148C37]

text_content: I can help you with Cottonwood Cove.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic148 "I can help you with Cottonwood Cove." [DIAL:00148C39]

text_content: I released some barrels of radioactive waste.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic147 "I released some barrels of radioactive waste." [DIAL:00148C3A]

text_content: That's exactly what we needed to put a cork in that camp. The Legion won't be moving through there anytime soon.|It's a fitting revenge for Searchlight. Thanks for taking care of those bastards for us.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic147 "I released some barrels of radioactive waste." [DIAL:00148C3A]
speaker: CampSearchlightAstor "First Sergeant Astor" [NPC_:0013FE78]

text_content: Maybe later.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic146 "Maybe later." [DIAL:00148C3B]

text_content: Just let me know if you're available for the op. After what they did to Searchlight, they have a shitstorm coming.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic146 "Maybe later." [DIAL:00148C3B]
speaker: CampSearchlightAstor "First Sergeant Astor" [NPC_:0013FE78]

text_content: I think I can handle that for you.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic145 "I think I can handle that for you." [DIAL:00148C3C]

text_content: Good to hear. This is the bug you'll need for the radio.|Report back if you pick up any intel or manage to sneak the bug into their radio.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic145 "I think I can handle that for you." [DIAL:00148C3C]
speaker: CampSearchlightAstor "First Sergeant Astor" [NPC_:0013FE78]

text_content: I already took care of the camp.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic144 "I already took care of the camp." [DIAL:00148C3D]

text_content: What?! How did you pull it off?
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic144 "I already took care of the camp." [DIAL:00148C3D]
speaker: CampSearchlightAstor "First Sergeant Astor" [NPC_:0013FE78]

text_content: Is there anything you need done?
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic143 "Is there anything you need done?" [DIAL:00148C3E]

text_content: If you can scout out the camp, bring back any intel on troop movement or plans for future raids. The rangers could put that information to good use.|Also, if you're any good at covert ops, I would love to get a bug planted on their radio. So far, we've been unable to crack their encryption.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic143 "Is there anything you need done?" [DIAL:00148C3E]
speaker: CampSearchlightAstor "First Sergeant Astor" [NPC_:0013FE78]

text_content: I found a Legion camp at Cottonwood Cove.
name: VMS43CampSearchlightAstorTopic142 "I found a Legion camp at Cottonwood Cove." [DIAL:00148C3F]

text_content: Hundreds of Securitrons. All of them upgraded now, thanks to the Chip.
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic003 "Hundreds of Securitrons. All of them upgraded now, thanks to the Chip." [DIAL:0014AEF5]

text_content: So all this time the old man had an entire army on lay-away? Clever player.|{caught up in vision of triumph}Just imagine the look on Baldie's face when those Securitrons come pouring out on judgment day! I'd pay to have that bronzed!|{realizing you won't be a part of it}So all you gotta do now is talk to Yes Man, figure out how to set things in motion.|Make Vegas a town I woulda been proud of, baby. Let it swing.
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic003 "Hundreds of Securitrons. All of them upgraded now, thanks to the Chip." [DIAL:0014AEF5]
speaker: VFortBenny "Benny" [NPC_:001344BE]

text_content: Let's go find it.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic079 "Let's go find it." [DIAL:0014AFF6]

text_content: I like the way you think.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic079 "Let's go find it." [DIAL:0014AFF6]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Maybe the pulse gun would be a smarter move.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic078 "Maybe the pulse gun would be a smarter move." [DIAL:0014AFF7]

text_content: I changed my mind. Let's go after the farming tech.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic077 "I changed my mind. Let's go after the farming tech." [DIAL:0014AFF8]

text_content: Actually, the rangefinder might be a better idea.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic076 "Actually, the rangefinder might be a better idea." [DIAL:0014AFF9]

text_content: We should go after the vegetation technology.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic075 "We should go after the vegetation technology." [DIAL:0014AFFA]

text_content: Okay. What better way to persuade them than to give them a taste of what they stand to gain, right?|Maybe the best place to start is to see what we can find out directly from the NCR. Let's head to their OSI office at McCarran.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic075 "We should go after the vegetation technology." [DIAL:0014AFFA]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: The rangefinder sounds promising.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic074 "The rangefinder sounds promising." [DIAL:0014AFFB]

text_content: They defended HELIOS like it was their last stand. Didn't even know if there was anything worth defending. How could there be, with all we lost?|Even if it did work, it'd be under NCR control now. So it'd either prove our goals are wrong or we're incapable of pursuing them.|There's a pawn shop in Outer Vegas we could check. And I've heard of a gift shop in the Strip that deals in Pre-War antiques.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic074 "The rangefinder sounds promising." [DIAL:0014AFFB]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Let's pursue the pulse gun.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic073 "Let's pursue the pulse gun." [DIAL:0014AFFC]

text_content: Yeah, maybe they'll think twice about engaging the NCR if they know one of those could be floating around.|The notes say to look around Nellis Air Force Base. He suggests going through filing cabinets and computers in the commanding officer's quarters.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic073 "Let's pursue the pulse gun." [DIAL:0014AFFC]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Farming technology?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic072 "Farming technology?" [DIAL:0014AFFD]

text_content: More or less. Supposedly it's a vegetation enhancer. NCR has a science branch headquartered at McCarran airport. Guess they found something.|Guess somebody wasn't very good at keeping secrets, either. |We'd never pursue it because it's not a weapon. But self-sufficiency is fundamental to us. If it works they'd see the value of an alternate course.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic072 "Farming technology?" [DIAL:0014AFFD]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: What's a pulse gun?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic071 "What's a pulse gun?" [DIAL:0014AFFE]

text_content: Electromagnetic weapon from before the Great War. Experimental. It never saw mass production.|But they were building it as a countermeasure to power armor, which they feared the Chinese were developing.|Supposedly a prototype was being housed at Nellis. Imagine what it could do to the Brotherhood. We'd be on equal footing with any idiot with a gun.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic071 "What's a pulse gun?" [DIAL:0014AFFE]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Tell me about the rangefinder.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic067 "Tell me about the rangefinder." [DIAL:0014AFFF]

text_content: It's a targeting device for some kind of doomsday weapon based at HELIOS One. It was lost sometime after the War.|We held HELIOS One for a time. Lost a lot of people defending it. Too many. All for this weapon they never got working.|If it turns out to be a dud, it'd show how flawed our goals have been. Father Elijah said he thinks a scavenger might have sold it on the Strip.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic067 "Tell me about the rangefinder." [DIAL:0014AFFF]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: VMS49ElderDiscussion1
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion1 "VMS49ElderDiscussion1" [DIAL:0014B000]

text_content: Hello Veronica. How goes your mission?
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion1 "VMS49ElderDiscussion1" [DIAL:0014B000]

text_content: We'll know in a second. I wanted to talk to you.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion1 "VMS49ElderDiscussion1" [DIAL:0014B000]

text_content: Veronica, tell me this isn't about-
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion1 "VMS49ElderDiscussion1" [DIAL:0014B000]

text_content: Yes, goddamn it, it is. But you're going to hear me out this time.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion1 "VMS49ElderDiscussion1" [DIAL:0014B000]

text_content: We've been through this.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion1 "VMS49ElderDiscussion1" [DIAL:0014B000]

text_content: The things I've seen now. Other groups succeeding where we fail. It's not too late for us.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion1 "VMS49ElderDiscussion1" [DIAL:0014B000]

text_content: We've outlasted the end of the world. We'll outlast these upstarts.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion1 "VMS49ElderDiscussion1" [DIAL:0014B000]

text_content: Waiting in a hole for everyone else to die.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion1 "VMS49ElderDiscussion1" [DIAL:0014B000]

text_content: If we must.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion1 "VMS49ElderDiscussion1" [DIAL:0014B000]

text_content: This is a dead end for us.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion1 "VMS49ElderDiscussion1" [DIAL:0014B000]

text_content: I see no evidence of that. Nor do I see anyone out there with a solution to our problems.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion1 "VMS49ElderDiscussion1" [DIAL:0014B000]

text_content: How could you? You're too scared to look.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion1 "VMS49ElderDiscussion1" [DIAL:0014B000]

text_content: Let's go. We're wasting our time.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion1 "VMS49ElderDiscussion1" [DIAL:0014B000]

text_content: Have you considered that he might be right?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic070 "Have you considered that he might be right?" [DIAL:0014B001]

text_content: Have {emph}you considered that he might be senile?|The Brotherhood's strategy for survival worked back when we had a larger force, and no organized enemies.|We're a tiny splinter from a shrinking group. We don't take on new members. But we're still picking fights with the big boys.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic070 "Have you considered that he might be right?" [DIAL:0014B001]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Good intentions don't justify marching the Brotherhood to its death.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic069 "Good intentions don't justify marching the Brotherhood to its death." [DIAL:0014B002]

text_content: No, but it does make it easier to forgive him. He's just misguided.|It's not too late to change his mind.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic069 "Good intentions don't justify marching the Brotherhood to its death." [DIAL:0014B002]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Let's head out.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic068 "Let's head out." [DIAL:0014B003]

text_content: I'm with you. Being around here isn't the same anymore.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic068 "Let's head out." [DIAL:0014B003]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Father Elijah?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic066 "Father Elijah?" [DIAL:0014B004]

text_content: Our Elder before McNamara. He had a nose for recovering lost technology. He'd send Scribes out into the desert chasing whatever leads he found.|There were a few he only trusted me with. I can think of at least one that'd prove my point, if it still exists.|There's a comm terminal not too far from here I'd use to access messages from him. If we go there I can pull up his research on it.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic066 "Father Elijah?" [DIAL:0014B004]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: How would you propose to do that?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic065 "How would you propose to do that?" [DIAL:0014B005]

text_content: Look at the Followers of the Apocalypse. They use their expertise to improve people's lives. They train them to be self-sufficient.|That expertise cultivates respect and gratitude. Spreads their ideals. Draws talent to their cause. They make friends like we make enemies.|But they don't know a fraction of what we know. If we took on their role, we could stand up to anyone. We wouldn't have to hide.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic065 "How would you propose to do that?" [DIAL:0014B005]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: So what is it you're trying to accomplish?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic064 "So what is it you're trying to accomplish?" [DIAL:0014B006]

text_content: That's my question to the Elder. All these years, the Brotherhood has collected weapons technology. And for what?|To keep it out of people's hands? That clearly hasn't worked. To defend ourselves? We can't compete with the NCR's numbers. Or the Legion's.|We're fighting a war for a lost cause. If we're going to survive, we have to find a role in society. Attract new members.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic064 "So what is it you're trying to accomplish?" [DIAL:0014B006]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: What could we bring to him that would change his mind?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic063 "What could we bring to him that would change his mind?" [DIAL:0014B007]

text_content: I don't know. I don't know. We'd need something that shows the Brotherhood will fail. Or that it can do better a different way.|The only thing that'd get his attention is technology.| Huh. Maybe Father Elijah had the right idea.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic063 "What could we bring to him that would change his mind?" [DIAL:0014B007]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: You think the Elder will listen at all?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic062 "You think the Elder will listen at all?" [DIAL:0014B008]

text_content: He's a stubborn old man, but when it comes down to it, he's got our best interests at heart.|If he sees some indisputable sign we're on the wrong course, he won't ignore it.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic062 "You think the Elder will listen at all?" [DIAL:0014B008]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: What now?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic061 "What now?" [DIAL:0014B009]

text_content: I'm not giving up. He wants evidence, but he'll never go looking for it. He's scared I'm right.|He'll never listen unless I hold the proof right in front of his face.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic061 "What now?" [DIAL:0014B009]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: I have things I need to do. You'd better go alone.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic060 "I have things I need to do. You'd better go alone." [DIAL:0014B00A]

text_content: Not much for family gatherings, huh? All right, have it your way.|You ever want to look me up again, I'll be in my bunker in Hidden Valley. That's the {emph}luxury bunker.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic060 "I have things I need to do. You'd better go alone." [DIAL:0014B00A]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: All right, I'll go.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic059 "All right, I'll go." [DIAL:0014B00B]

text_content: I'm ready to take you to Hidden Valley.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic058 "I'm ready to take you to Hidden Valley." [DIAL:0014B00C]

text_content: That's just not important right now.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic057 "That's just not important right now." [DIAL:0014B00D]

text_content: This from the girl who walked from I-15 to the Colorado River looking for her lost package.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic057 "That's just not important right now." [DIAL:0014B00D]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: This from the guy who walked from I-15 to the Colorado River looking for his lost package.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic057 "That's just not important right now." [DIAL:0014B00D]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: I hope you change your mind.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic057 "That's just not important right now." [DIAL:0014B00D]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Why don't you just go back on your own?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic056 "Why don't you just go back on your own?" [DIAL:0014B00E]

text_content: Wow, don't everybody volunteer all at once now.|I {emph}could do that. You're not interested in coming along? Hate to break up the band over a silly little thing like the future of everyone I care about.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic056 "Why don't you just go back on your own?" [DIAL:0014B00E]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Can it wait?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic055 "Can it wait?" [DIAL:0014B00F]

text_content: Sure, yeah. Just not too long, okay? I worry about them sometimes.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic055 "Can it wait?" [DIAL:0014B00F]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: I'll take you back there, first chance I get.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic054 "I'll take you back there, first chance I get." [DIAL:0014B010]

text_content: Great. Thanks. Thank you. I'll encourage people to name their non-ugly children after you. Seriously.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic054 "I'll take you back there, first chance I get." [DIAL:0014B010]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: What did you want to talk about earlier?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic053 "What did you want to talk about earlier?" [DIAL:0014B011]

text_content: Not now.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic052 "Not now." [DIAL:0014B012]

text_content: Okay. Well, when you do, let me know, all right?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic052 "Not now." [DIAL:0014B012]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: What is it?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic041 "What is it?" [DIAL:0014B013]

text_content: The Brotherhood is failing. {Beat}I've always known that. If we don't change course, we're going to fall apart or... fade away.|But until recently I haven't understood where we went wrong, or how to fix it.|I think I need to go home.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic041 "What is it?" [DIAL:0014B013]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0014B055]

text_content: Take care.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0014B055]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: How goes your research for the Nightkin cure?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemDoctorHenryTopic002 "How goes your research for the Nightkin cure?" [DIAL:0014B081]

text_content: Promising, but I won't be able to synthesize the drug anytime soon. I really should get back to my work.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemDoctorHenryTopic002 "How goes your research for the Nightkin cure?" [DIAL:0014B081]
speaker: VRemDoctorHenry "Doctor Henry" [NPC_:00133957]

text_content: One of my limbs is crippled.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic010 "One of my limbs is crippled." [DIAL:0014B0AB]

text_content: I'm suffering from radiation poisoning.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic009 "I'm suffering from radiation poisoning." [DIAL:0014B0AC]

text_content: {Rads > 0}It'll be easy enough to purge all rads from your system.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic009 "I'm suffering from radiation poisoning." [DIAL:0014B0AC]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: I'm wounded.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic008 "I'm wounded." [DIAL:0014B0AD]

text_content: {Health <100, >= 66}Your injuries aren't too severe. I can patch the scrapes and lacerations pretty easily.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic008 "I'm wounded." [DIAL:0014B0AD]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: {Health < 66, >= 33}Some of these lacerations are pretty severe and could get infected.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic008 "I'm wounded." [DIAL:0014B0AD]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: {Health < 33}I'm surprised you're still standing. You've lost a lot of blood and should be stabilized immediately.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic008 "I'm wounded." [DIAL:0014B0AD]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: Never mind.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic007 "Never mind." [DIAL:0014B0AE]

text_content: All right. Was there something else you were interested in?
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic007 "Never mind." [DIAL:0014B0AE]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: Enhance my agility.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic006 "Enhance my agility." [DIAL:0014B0AF]

text_content: {Agility 10}Your reaction times are already so fast it's a wonder you can't catch bullets. The Reflex Booster can't make you any faster.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic006 "Enhance my agility." [DIAL:0014B0AF]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: The Reflex Booster does exactly what it says - speeds up your reaction times. For 4,000 caps, I can attach the implant to your central nervous node.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic006 "Enhance my agility." [DIAL:0014B0AF]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: I want to be more intelligent.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic005 "I want to be more intelligent." [DIAL:0014B0B0]

text_content: {Intelligence 10}{astonished}Your higher brain functions are off the charts. {regret}The implant won't help at all - sorry.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic005 "I want to be more intelligent." [DIAL:0014B0B0]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: {Non-Dummy}For 4,000 caps, I can install a Logic Co-Processor.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic005 "I want to be more intelligent." [DIAL:0014B0B0]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: {Dummy}I think you would really benefit from the Logic Co-Processor implant, so I'm going to cut the price to 3,000.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic005 "I want to be more intelligent." [DIAL:0014B0B0]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: Increase my endurance.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic004 "Increase my endurance." [DIAL:0014B0B1]

text_content: {Endurance 10}Your cardiovascular system is practically super-human. The Nociception Regulator won't boost it any further.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic004 "Increase my endurance." [DIAL:0014B0B1]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: The Nociception Regulator modifies your cardiovascular system, and you won't tire as quickly. The price is 4,000 caps, same as most other implants.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic004 "Increase my endurance." [DIAL:0014B0B1]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: Make me more perceptive.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic003 "Make me more perceptive." [DIAL:0014B0B2]

text_content: {Perception 10}Your eyesight would make a hawk jealous. The Optic Enhancer implant won't do anything more for you.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic003 "Make me more perceptive." [DIAL:0014B0B2]
