name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2Conclusion "VMS49ElderDiscussion2Conclusion" [DIAL:0014BD7B]

text_content: We keep knowledge they must never have.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2Conclusion "VMS49ElderDiscussion2Conclusion" [DIAL:0014BD7B]

text_content: It says that we are to protect humanity from them at all costs.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2Conclusion "VMS49ElderDiscussion2Conclusion" [DIAL:0014BD7B]

text_content: Give it a chance. For me. I can't stay here and watch us waste away.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2Conclusion "VMS49ElderDiscussion2Conclusion" [DIAL:0014BD7B]

text_content: I'm sorry.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2Conclusion "VMS49ElderDiscussion2Conclusion" [DIAL:0014BD7B]

text_content: I can't.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2Conclusion "VMS49ElderDiscussion2Conclusion" [DIAL:0014BD7B]

text_content: {Softly, a last-ditch argument}We'll die out.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2Conclusion "VMS49ElderDiscussion2Conclusion" [DIAL:0014BD7B]

text_content: {Sadly}<Sighs> I know.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2Conclusion "VMS49ElderDiscussion2Conclusion" [DIAL:0014BD7B]

text_content: {Slightly Sad}Then we will accept that fate with honor.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2Conclusion "VMS49ElderDiscussion2Conclusion" [DIAL:0014BD7B]

text_content: Come on. I can't listen to this anymore.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2Conclusion "VMS49ElderDiscussion2Conclusion" [DIAL:0014BD7B]

text_content: VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS "VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS" [DIAL:0014BD7C]

text_content: We unlocked the secret of HELIOS One.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS "VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS" [DIAL:0014BD7C]

text_content: What? Wonderful news!
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS "VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS" [DIAL:0014BD7C]

text_content: Then we have a game-changing weapon.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS "VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS" [DIAL:0014BD7C]

text_content: No. It's not. ARCHIMEDES II is an orbital laser. Effective only outdoors in a limited radius and requiring a long recharge.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS "VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS" [DIAL:0014BD7C]

text_content: In the hands of the enemy-
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS "VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS" [DIAL:0014BD7C]

text_content: It was worth keeping from our enemies. If they had it-
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS "VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS" [DIAL:0014BD7C]

text_content: They'd be marginally more effective. We lost most of the chapter defending glorified artillery.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS "VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS" [DIAL:0014BD7C]

text_content: We couldn't have known. We fought for what we believed in.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS "VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS" [DIAL:0014BD7C]

text_content: We did as the Codex dictated.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS "VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS" [DIAL:0014BD7C]

text_content: And nearly died for it. Tomorrow you'd do it all over again, having learned nothing.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS "VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS" [DIAL:0014BD7C]

text_content: Are you trying to shame me?
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS "VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS" [DIAL:0014BD7C]

text_content: {Fuming}How dare you insult the honor of the brothers and sisters who died there!
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS "VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS" [DIAL:0014BD7C]

text_content: I'm trying to open your eyes.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS "VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS" [DIAL:0014BD7C]

text_content: We need to engage the outside world. We can't win without new recruits.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS "VMS49ElderDiscussion2HELIOS" [DIAL:0014BD7C]

text_content: VMS49ElderDiscussion2V34
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2V34 "VMS49ElderDiscussion2V34" [DIAL:0014BD7D]

text_content: We found a gun that disables power armor. One of these could defeat the whole Brotherhood.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2V34 "VMS49ElderDiscussion2V34" [DIAL:0014BD7D]

text_content: We have to stop limiting our focus to military technology. It won't save us.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2V34 "VMS49ElderDiscussion2V34" [DIAL:0014BD7D]

text_content: That could be the only one of its kind.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2V34 "VMS49ElderDiscussion2V34" [DIAL:0014BD7D]

text_content: Then it's a good thing this weapon has fallen into the right hands.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2V34 "VMS49ElderDiscussion2V34" [DIAL:0014BD7D]

text_content: That's not the point. Technology won't win our wars. We need numbers. New recruits.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2V34 "VMS49ElderDiscussion2V34" [DIAL:0014BD7D]

text_content: VMS49ElderDiscussion2V22
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2V22 "VMS49ElderDiscussion2V22" [DIAL:0014BD7E]

text_content: This disk has secrets to breeding plants that can thrive in the wasteland.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2V22 "VMS49ElderDiscussion2V22" [DIAL:0014BD7E]

text_content: High Elder Maxson didn't found us to be botanists, Veronica.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2V22 "VMS49ElderDiscussion2V22" [DIAL:0014BD7E]

text_content: I'm waiting to hear why this deserves our attention.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2V22 "VMS49ElderDiscussion2V22" [DIAL:0014BD7E]

text_content: Think about it. No more trading guns for food. Total self-sufficiency. It's what we always wanted.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2V22 "VMS49ElderDiscussion2V22" [DIAL:0014BD7E]

text_content: This won't get us Hoover Dam.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2V22 "VMS49ElderDiscussion2V22" [DIAL:0014BD7E]

text_content: This won't defeat our enemies.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2V22 "VMS49ElderDiscussion2V22" [DIAL:0014BD7E]

text_content: {argumentative}Yes it will. If we feed people, they'll support us. They'll join us.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2V22 "VMS49ElderDiscussion2V22" [DIAL:0014BD7E]

text_content: VMS49ElderDiscussion2Intro
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2Intro "VMS49ElderDiscussion2Intro" [DIAL:0014BD7F]

text_content: Veronica. I hope-
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2Intro "VMS49ElderDiscussion2Intro" [DIAL:0014BD7F]

text_content: Shouldn't you be securing supplies for us?
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2Intro "VMS49ElderDiscussion2Intro" [DIAL:0014BD7F]

text_content: I brought you a present.
name: VMS49ElderDiscussion2Intro "VMS49ElderDiscussion2Intro" [DIAL:0014BD7F]

text_content: My friend is part of a group that can develop it into something safe everyone can benefit from.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic050 "My friend is part of a group that can develop it into something safe everyone can benefit from." [DIAL:0014BD80]

text_content: I suppose you've given me no reason not to trust you. Fine, take the data and go. I hope you know what you're doing.
name: VFreeformVault22KeelyTopic050 "My friend is part of a group that can develop it into something safe everyone can benefit from." [DIAL:0014BD80]
speaker: Keely "Keely" [NPC_:000E8F6C]

text_content: I'd like the regenerating ability.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic014 "I'd like the regenerating ability." [DIAL:0014BF93]

text_content: That's the PHOENIX Monocyte Breeder. The implant speeds up cell regeneration, an effect similar to that of some lizards and sea creatures.|The implant is very expensive, however - 12,000 caps.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic014 "I'd like the regenerating ability." [DIAL:0014BF93]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: I'm interested in the sub-dermal implant.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic013 "I'm interested in the sub-dermal implant." [DIAL:0014BF94]

text_content: That would be the NEMEAN Sub-Dermal Armor. It's a bit pricey - 8,000 caps - but the implant causes your skin cells to be bolstered with iron.|It won't make you bulletproof, but it will make you a little harder to injure.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic013 "I'm interested in the sub-dermal implant." [DIAL:0014BF94]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: Boost my charisma.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic012 "Boost my charisma." [DIAL:0014BF95]

text_content: {Charisma 10}You're already quite charming. The Empathy Synthesizer would just be a waste of caps, I'm afraid.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic012 "Boost my charisma." [DIAL:0014BF95]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: The Empathy Synthesizer will allow you to more easily pick up on subtle emotions and body language. The price is 4,000 caps.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic012 "Boost my charisma." [DIAL:0014BF95]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: I want to buy an implant.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic011 "I want to buy an implant." [DIAL:0014BF96]

text_content: One other thing I forgot to mention - your body may be able to handle only a limited number of implants.|The healthier you are, the more implants I'll be able give you. Now, what surgery are you considering?
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic011 "I want to buy an implant." [DIAL:0014BF96]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: {no implants}Which surgery option are you considering?
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic011 "I want to buy an implant." [DIAL:0014BF96]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: {max implants}There aren't any more implants I can give you - you've already bought everything I had available.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic011 "I want to buy an implant." [DIAL:0014BF96]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: {at least one implant, not at limit}All right, let me do a quick test to make sure your body can handle another implant...|All right, you're healthy enough to handle another one. Which surgery are you considering?
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic011 "I want to buy an implant." [DIAL:0014BF96]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: {at least one implant, at limit}All right, let me do a quick test to make sure your body can handle another implant...|I'm afraid you can't handle any more implants right now. Your body isn't durable enough to take it. Sorry.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic011 "I want to buy an implant." [DIAL:0014BF96]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: I'm looking for an antique rangefinder somebody might've sold to you?
name: vDialogueWestside1EAngeloTopic000 "I'm looking for an antique rangefinder somebody might've sold to you?" [DIAL:0014C11D]

text_content: Antique rangefinder? I'm trying to think of something that'd be more worthless.|Maybe an antique horoscope. Or an antique sandwich.|I'll tell you something. Good luck finding that thing. But if you do find it, don't waste your time trying to sell it to me.
name: vDialogueWestside1EAngeloTopic000 "I'm looking for an antique rangefinder somebody might've sold to you?" [DIAL:0014C11D]
speaker: WestsideMiguel "Miguel" [NPC_:000E8F96]

text_content: Never mind.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic016 "Never mind." [DIAL:0014C125]

text_content: Very well.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic016 "Never mind." [DIAL:0014C125]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: Here's the caps.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic015 "Here's the caps." [DIAL:0014C126]

text_content: Have a seat in the Auto-Doc. This will take a few hours.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic015 "Here's the caps." [DIAL:0014C126]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: We fight for ourselves. Bring our warriors to the battle and kill everyone.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic022 "We fight for ourselves. Bring our warriors to the battle and kill everyone." [DIAL:0014C44B]

text_content: {Uncertain, thinks this is probably a suicide attack}As you wish, chieftain.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic022 "We fight for ourselves. Bring our warriors to the battle and kill everyone." [DIAL:0014C44B]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: I'm giving leadership to you. I want you to take the tribe north, and find yourselves a new life.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic021 "I'm giving leadership to you. I want you to take the tribe north, and find yourselves a new life." [DIAL:0014C44C]

text_content: {Surprised, didn't expect this}I... very well. If that's what you want, that's what we'll do.|I'll start the preparations and we'll leave when the NCR is distracted by Caesar's attack.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic021 "I'm giving leadership to you. I want you to take the tribe north, and find yourselves a new life." [DIAL:0014C44C]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: We fight for the NCR.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic020 "We fight for the NCR." [DIAL:0014C44D]

text_content: As you wish. When the Republic goes to war, we go with it.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic020 "We fight for the NCR." [DIAL:0014C44D]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: We fight for Caesar.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic019 "We fight for Caesar." [DIAL:0014C44E]

text_content: As you wish. When Caesar goes to war, we go with him.
name: VMS45VRRCRegisTopic019 "We fight for Caesar." [DIAL:0014C44E]
speaker: VRRCRegis "Regis" [NPC_:00140E70]

text_content: I don't want that kind of responsibility.
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic020 "I don't want that kind of responsibility." [DIAL:0014C44F]

text_content: Then when I die, you can pass control of the Great Khans on to Regis. For now you are my heir, and will be accorded the honor of that position.
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic020 "I don't want that kind of responsibility." [DIAL:0014C44F]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: This is a great honor. I don't know what to say.
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic012 "This is a great honor. I don't know what to say." [DIAL:0014C450]

text_content: You don't have to say anything - I am Papa Khan, and I have spoken. When I'm gone, you will lead the tribe.
name: VMS45VRRCPapaKhanTopic012 "This is a great honor. I don't know what to say." [DIAL:0014C450]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: Forget it, I'm not interested.
name: VMS45VRRCGreatKhanMessengerTopic002 "Forget it, I'm not interested." [DIAL:0014C451]

text_content: That's too bad. I hope you'll change your mind.
name: VMS45VRRCGreatKhanMessengerTopic002 "Forget it, I'm not interested." [DIAL:0014C451]
speaker: VRRCGreatKhanMessenger "Great Khan" [NPC_:0014C49A]

text_content: Okay, I'll go visit him as soon as I can.
name: VMS45VRRCGreatKhanMessengerTopic001 "Okay, I'll go visit him as soon as I can." [DIAL:0014C452]

text_content: Excellent. I'll let him know you're coming. Good luck out there.
name: VMS45VRRCGreatKhanMessengerTopic001 "Okay, I'll go visit him as soon as I can." [DIAL:0014C452]
speaker: VRRCGreatKhanMessenger "Great Khan" [NPC_:0014C49A]

text_content: What's this about?
name: VMS45VRRCGreatKhanMessengerTopic000 "What's this about?" [DIAL:0014C453]

text_content: He didn't say, but it sounded very important.
name: VMS45VRRCGreatKhanMessengerTopic000 "What's this about?" [DIAL:0014C453]
speaker: VRRCGreatKhanMessenger "Great Khan" [NPC_:0014C49A]

text_content: GreatKhanMessengerPapa
name: GreatKhanMessengerPapa "GreatKhanMessengerPapa" [DIAL:0014C454]

text_content: I've got a message for you from Papa Khan. He wants you to return to Red Rock Canyon and speak to him as soon as possible.
name: GreatKhanMessengerPapa "GreatKhanMessengerPapa" [DIAL:0014C454]
speaker: VRRCGreatKhanMessenger "Great Khan" [NPC_:0014C49A]

text_content: The Followers have agreed to take you on as a member. Head to the Old Mormon Fort.
name: JerryFollowers "The Followers have agreed to take you on as a member. Head to the Old Mormon Fort." [DIAL:0014C455]

text_content: They did? That's great! Thank you! I'm out of this crummy camp!
name: JerryFollowers "The Followers have agreed to take you on as a member. Head to the Old Mormon Fort." [DIAL:0014C455]
speaker: VRRCJerrythePunk "Jerry the Punk" [NPC_:001413BD]

text_content: None whatsoever.
name: VMS47VFSJulieFarkasTopic002 "None whatsoever." [DIAL:0014C456]

text_content: Ah. Well... I suppose we could always find him a place. Maybe doing inventory on the Pre-War Unexploded Munitions Collection back West.|All right, tell the boy to report here, he can leave on the next caravan.
name: VMS47VFSJulieFarkasTopic002 "None whatsoever." [DIAL:0014C456]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: He's obviously a bright, sensitive soul, and he loves literature.
name: VMS47VFSJulieFarkasTopic001 "He's obviously a bright, sensitive soul, and he loves literature." [DIAL:0014C457]

text_content: Excellent! Ezekiel's been after me to find him a new assistant for ages. Tell the boy we'll take him.
name: VMS47VFSJulieFarkasTopic001 "He's obviously a bright, sensitive soul, and he loves literature." [DIAL:0014C457]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: Well, he's a poet. Kind of.
name: VMS47VFSJulieFarkasTopic000 "Well, he's a poet. Kind of." [DIAL:0014C458]

text_content: Hmm. Well, I suppose we could always use another junior archivist in the library. All right, tell him we'll accept him as a probationary initiate.
name: VMS47VFSJulieFarkasTopic000 "Well, he's a poet. Kind of." [DIAL:0014C458]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: I met a kid who's unsatisfied with life in the Great Khans. Will you take him on as a Follower?
name: JulieFarkasJerry "I met a kid who's unsatisfied with life in the Great Khans. Will you take him on as a Follower?" [DIAL:0014C459]

text_content: We're always looking for new members. Does he have any particular talent?
name: JulieFarkasJerry "I met a kid who's unsatisfied with life in the Great Khans. Will you take him on as a Follower?" [DIAL:0014C459]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: I had some other questions.
name: VMS48VRRCRitemasterTopic006 "I had some other questions." [DIAL:0014C45A]

text_content: What does it take to join the Great Khans?
name: VMS48VRRCRitemasterTopic005 "What does it take to join the Great Khans?" [DIAL:0014C45B]

text_content: How does the initiation work?
name: VMS48VRRCRitemasterTopic004 "How does the initiation work?" [DIAL:0014C45C]

text_content: What is this place?
name: GKRitemasterIntro "What is this place?" [DIAL:0014C45D]

text_content: What do you know about the Followers of the Apocalypse?
name: VMS47VRRCJerrythePunkTopic014 "What do you know about the Followers of the Apocalypse?" [DIAL:0014C45E]

text_content: Not much. They found us when we came to the Mojave, gave us a bunch of books on science and history - I guess they're like teachers or something?
name: VMS47VRRCJerrythePunkTopic014 "What do you know about the Followers of the Apocalypse?" [DIAL:0014C45E]
speaker: VRRCJerrythePunk "Jerry the Punk" [NPC_:001413BD]

text_content: That's not really my problem, is it?
name: VMS47VRRCJerrythePunkTopic013 "That's not really my problem, is it?" [DIAL:0014C45F]

text_content: No, I suppose not.
name: VMS47VRRCJerrythePunkTopic013 "That's not really my problem, is it?" [DIAL:0014C45F]
speaker: VRRCJerrythePunk "Jerry the Punk" [NPC_:001413BD]

text_content: Probably. You seem like their type.
name: VMS47VRRCJerrythePunkTopic012 "Probably. You seem like their type." [DIAL:0014C460]

text_content: You think so? I mean, I'd go myself, but what if they said no? The Khans wouldn't take me back, and then I'd have nobody.
name: VMS47VRRCJerrythePunkTopic012 "Probably. You seem like their type." [DIAL:0014C460]
speaker: VRRCJerrythePunk "Jerry the Punk" [NPC_:001413BD]

text_content: Why don't you go there and find out?
name: VMS47VRRCJerrythePunkTopic011 "Why don't you go there and find out?" [DIAL:0014C461]

text_content: I don't know. I mean, I'd go myself, but what if they said no? The Khans wouldn't take me back, and then I'd have nobody.
name: VMS47VRRCJerrythePunkTopic011 "Why don't you go there and find out?" [DIAL:0014C461]
speaker: VRRCJerrythePunk "Jerry the Punk" [NPC_:001413BD]

text_content: I could ask them for you.
name: VMS47VRRCJerrythePunkTopic010 "I could ask them for you." [DIAL:0014C462]

text_content: You'd do that? Thanks! I mean, I'd go myself, but what if they said no? The Khans wouldn't take me back, and then I'd have nobody.
name: VMS47VRRCJerrythePunkTopic010 "I could ask them for you." [DIAL:0014C462]
speaker: VRRCJerrythePunk "Jerry the Punk" [NPC_:001413BD]

text_content: Why isn't poetry "Great Khan-like?"
name: VMS47VRRCJerrythePunkTopic009 "Why isn't poetry ""Great Khan-like?""" [DIAL:0014C463]

text_content: Have you seen this tribe? If it's not an epic drunken ballad of cracking skulls and hearing lamentations they think it's a waste of time.
name: VMS47VRRCJerrythePunkTopic009 "Why isn't poetry ""Great Khan-like?""" [DIAL:0014C463]
speaker: VRRCJerrythePunk "Jerry the Punk" [NPC_:001413BD]

text_content: I had some other questions, actually.
name: VMS47VRRCJerrythePunkTopic008 "I had some other questions, actually." [DIAL:0014C464]

text_content: Sure, okay.
name: VMS47VRRCJerrythePunkTopic008 "I had some other questions, actually." [DIAL:0014C464]
speaker: VRRCJerrythePunk "Jerry the Punk" [NPC_:001413BD]

text_content: You don't sound too eager for your initiation.
name: VMS47VRRCJerrythePunkTopic007 "You don't sound too eager for your initiation." [DIAL:0014C465]

text_content: Yeah, well, I guess maybe I'm not. But what else can I do?
name: VMS47VRRCJerrythePunkTopic007 "You don't sound too eager for your initiation." [DIAL:0014C465]
speaker: VRRCJerrythePunk "Jerry the Punk" [NPC_:001413BD]

text_content: It sounded like you were writing poetry.
name: VMS47VRRCJerrythePunkTopic006 "It sounded like you were writing poetry." [DIAL:0014C466]

text_content: Oh. You heard that, huh? Okay, so yeah, I was writing poetry. I know, I know, it's not a very Great Khan-like thing to do.|The Followers of the Apocalypse came to our camp when I was a kid, and they brought a bunch of old books. I used to read pre-War poetry for hours.
name: VMS47VRRCJerrythePunkTopic006 "It sounded like you were writing poetry." [DIAL:0014C466]
speaker: VRRCJerrythePunk "Jerry the Punk" [NPC_:001413BD]

text_content: I'd like to hear some of your poetry.
name: JerryPoetry "I'd like to hear some of your poetry." [DIAL:0014C467]

text_content: You would? Really? Okay, well then, here goes:
name: JerryPoetry "I'd like to hear some of your poetry." [DIAL:0014C467]
speaker: VRRCJerrythePunk "Jerry the Punk" [NPC_:001413BD]

text_content: This one's a haiku.|{Clear throat, begin reciting}Radscorpion bites,|my foot in the box canyon.|Ow, ow, ow, ow... ow.
name: JerryPoetry "I'd like to hear some of your poetry." [DIAL:0014C467]
speaker: VRRCJerrythePunk "Jerry the Punk" [NPC_:001413BD]

text_content: {Clear throat, begin reciting}I wrote this limerick the last time I went to Freeside.|There once was a fellow called Garret,|whose sister she did love to bare it.|She flashed it around, all over town,|so if you would screw her, beware it.|{back to normal speaking}I, uh, got kicked out of the Atomic Wrangler for that one.
name: JerryPoetry "I'd like to hear some of your poetry." [DIAL:0014C467]
speaker: VRRCJerrythePunk "Jerry the Punk" [NPC_:001413BD]

text_content: This is a poem I wrote about the dark loneliness that suffuses my soul.|{Clear throat, begin reciting}Rainclouds wrap my heart in sorrow black as silk,|My empty scream does not echo, even though we're in a canyon.|My soul aches, but not as much as my limbs, because I've been beaten severely.

text_content: Very good. On occasion it's proven to be more profitable in the long run to simply buy out the competition, and this is one of those occasions.

text_content: Yes, I'd heard something about his untimely death. There will be a lot of questions from his family, so I trust you had nothing to do with this.|I guess the one bright spot is that I can strike his name from the payroll after all.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic011 "The Crimson Caravan Company no longer has to worry about Henry Jamison." [DIAL:0014D249]
speaker: AliceMcLafferty "Alice McLafferty" [NPC_:000EC7A1]

speaker: AliceMcLafferty "Alice McLafferty" [NPC_:000EC7A1]

name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic011 "The Crimson Caravan Company no longer has to worry about Henry Jamison." [DIAL:0014D249]
speaker: AliceMcLafferty "Alice McLafferty" [NPC_:000EC7A1]

text_content: What was Vegas like before the war?
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic259 "What was Vegas like before the war?" [DIAL:0014D2C8]

text_content: It was a place of splendor. As magnificent as today's Strip may seem, it's but a shadow of the neon paradise that was Las Vegas.|I grew up not far from here, and though I traveled the old world extensively, I never found another place like it.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic259 "What was Vegas like before the war?" [DIAL:0014D2C8]

text_content: By 2065 I deemed it a mathematical certainty that an atomic war would devastate the Earth within 15 years. Every projection I ran confirmed it.|I knew I couldn't "save the world," nor did I care to. But I could save Vegas, and in the process, perhaps, save mankind.|I set to work immediately. I thought I had plenty of time to prepare. As it turned out, I was 20 hours short.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic259 "What was Vegas like before the war?" [DIAL:0014D2C8]
speaker: MrHouse "Mr. House" [CREA:00125BB5]

text_content: On the day of the Great War, 77 atomic warheads targeted Las Vegas and its surrounding areas.|My networked mainframes were able to predict and force-transmit disarm code subsets to 59 warheads, neutralizing them before impact.|Laser cannons mounted on the roof of the Lucky 38 destroyed another 9 warheads. The rest got through, though none hit the city itself.|A sub-optimal performance, admittedly. If only the Platinum Chip had arrived a day sooner...
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic259 "What was Vegas like before the war?" [DIAL:0014D2C8]
speaker: MrHouse "Mr. House" [CREA:00125BB5]

text_content: The Platinum Chip was printed in Sunnyvale, California on October 22nd, 2077 - the day before the Great War.|It was to have been delivered by courier the following afternoon... but by then, the world had ended.|The Chip contained vital software upgrades, but not just for my Securitrons. Every aspect of the missile defense grid would have been upgraded, too.|Given that I had to make do with buggy software, the outcome could have been worse. I nearly died as it was.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic259 "What was Vegas like before the war?" [DIAL:0014D2C8]
speaker: MrHouse "Mr. House" [CREA:00125BB5]

text_content: Software glitches set off a cascade of system crashes. I had to take the Lucky 38's reactor offline, lest it melt down.|For nearly five years I battled power outages and more system crashes until I finally managed to reboot my data core with an older version of the OS.|I spent the next few decades in a veritable coma. But I survived, obviously - and eventually thrived.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic259 "What was Vegas like before the war?" [DIAL:0014D2C8]
speaker: MrHouse "Mr. House" [CREA:00125BB5]

text_content: Ladies and gentlemen, this next song goes out from me to you.

text_content: NewsPost
name: RNVNewsPost "NewsPost" [DIAL:0014DFB3]

text_content: That's all for now. This is Mr. New Vegas saying, I'm just no good without you.
name: RNVNewsPost "NewsPost" [DIAL:0014DFB3]

text_content: You know I think all news, whether it's good or bad, brings us closer together. Don't you?
name: RNVNewsPost "NewsPost" [DIAL:0014DFB3]

text_content: That's all I have for you. This is Mr. New Vegas, wishing you ladylike luck tonight.
name: RNVNewsPost "NewsPost" [DIAL:0014DFB3]

text_content: Boy, the Mojave Wasteland is just a fascinating place, isn't it? You never know what'll happen next.
name: RNVNewsPost "NewsPost" [DIAL:0014DFB3]

text_content: We'll have more news for you at the top of the hour.
name: RNVNewsPost "NewsPost" [DIAL:0014DFB3]

text_content: You know, they say no news is good news. But I think my program would be awfully dull if that were the case.
name: RNVNewsPost "NewsPost" [DIAL:0014DFB3]

text_content: Those were our top stories.
name: RNVNewsPost "NewsPost" [DIAL:0014DFB3]

text_content: And that's the news.
name: RNVNewsPost "NewsPost" [DIAL:0014DFB3]

text_content: Stay classy, New Vegas.
name: RNVNewsPost "NewsPost" [DIAL:0014DFB3]

text_content: Mojave, mo problems, am I right?
name: RNVNewsPost "NewsPost" [DIAL:0014DFB3]

text_content: That's the news. This is Mr. New Vegas, filling in for Mr. New Vegas.
name: RNVNewsPost "NewsPost" [DIAL:0014DFB3]

text_content: Those are our stories this hour. This is Mr. New Vegas signing off. Just kidding. I'm not going anywhere. My love for you is too strong.
name: RNVNewsPost "NewsPost" [DIAL:0014DFB3]

text_content: That news was brought to you by the Tops Casino. {Slogan}You'll dig us, baby! We're the Tops!
name: RNVNewsPost "NewsPost" [DIAL:0014DFB3]

text_content: The preceding segment was sponsored by the Silver Rush. {Slogan}Silver Rush. Feel the rush of a warm laser in your hand.

text_content: Today's headlines were brought to you by Primm. {Slogan}Primm. The other New Vegas.

text_content: This program was brought to you by Gomorrah. {Slogan}Gomorrah. It'll be our secret.
name: RNVNewsPost "NewsPost" [DIAL:0014DFB3]

text_content: Promotional consideration for this news segment has been paid for by the Ultra-Luxe. {Slogan}The Ultra-Luxe. Live life in the lap of luxury.

text_content: The news has been brought to you by the Vikki and Vance Casino. {Slogan}Vikki and Vance. Be our partner in crime.

text_content: NewsStory
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Sources report the NCR's top Ranger, Chief Hanlon, has died in a tragic revolver-cleaning accident inside his locked office at Camp Golf.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Sources report the NCR's top Ranger, Chief Hanlon, has unexpectedly passed away. NCR soldiers rallied to show their support for the officer.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Word out of Camp Golf is that many NCR Rangers can expect redeployment in the near future. One anonymous soldier said it was part of a new strategy.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: NCR Rangers are being pulled off the front lines as part of a campaign to "secure existing NCR territory," according to anonymous sources.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: According to a new report, violent crime is on a sharp decline in New Vegas. The report credits the decline of the population of Fiends in the area.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: A big congratulations to a young band of soldiers who shattered NCR records on a combat readiness evaluation at Camp Golf. Go get 'em, guys!
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Tensions are brewing in Freeside between the ruling gang known as the Kings and the large number of NCR squatters seeking refuge there.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: The Kings have been killed in a fight with NCR forces after weeks of mounting hostility. Witnesses report The King's last word was simply "Don't."
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: The Kings gang in Freeside has put an official end to hostilities with the NCR. An RNV reporter was on-hand to speak with The King.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Several witnesses report a Vertibird flying in from the Northeast. One of them, using binoculars, claimed it was being flown by a group of old men.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: The mysterious deaths of several old men around New Vegas, including a doctor, have led some to suspect a serial killer may be responsible.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Gomorrah is under new management after the sudden departure of Omerta bosses Nero and Big Sal. The Casino's new manager spoke to reporters.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Sources close to the Omertas tell us a newcomer has been meeting privately with bosses Nero and Big Sal, unusual for a Family outsider.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Rumors continue to swell that Mr. House, the father of New Vegas, has passed away. Who will fill the power vacuum on the Strip remains uncertain.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Insiders are saying a key Legion prisoner has escaped Camp McCarran. The prisoner is armed and dangerous, and may be dressed as an NCR trooper.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: A Legion slaver party was wiped out in a failed raid of the Bitter Springs refugee camp, with two armed civilians inflicting heavy Legion casualties.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: The Bitter Springs refugee camp has been overrun by Legion slavers. Refugees should stay away, and avoid talking to strangers in football pads.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: A hostage crisis between the NCR and Great Khans was resolved peacefully when a third-party negotiator successfully secured the hostages' release.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: A group of Great Khans were killed in a bloody end to a hostage crisis in Boulder City. It's not currently known why the Khans were in the area.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: A few Great Khans are on the loose after an aborted standoff left at least two NCR hostages dead. The NCR is offering a reward for their capture.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Several unidentified aircraft were spotted flying over the REPCONN test site by a local crackpot. He spoke to a toy bear near one of our microphones.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: A package courier found shot in the head near Goodsprings has reportedly regained consciousness and made a full recovery.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Goodsprings has fended off a mob of escaped convicts after organizing an impromptu militia, according to an old man armed to the teeth with dynamite.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Sad news from Goodsprings. The town was wiped out after heavy fighting with a gang of escaped convicts. Travelers are advised to keep their distance.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Primm formally swore in a new sheriff today. RNV reporters were on hand to hear the new sheriff address the crowd.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Eyewitnesses outside Camp McCarran are reporting a large explosion near its monorail station. The NCR is denying the incident.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: There's word from Camp McCarran that an attempt to bomb its monorail system was foiled by an alert civilian contractor. Security is being tightened.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Tops Hotel owner Benny has been killed by an unidentified assailant. His former right-hand man, Swank, consoled mourners.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Rumors have surfaced that Tops Hotel owner Benny has taken yet another unexpected leave of absence. We spoke to his right-hand man, Swank.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: We have unconfirmed reports that Caesar has died in his base camp after a failed surgery, performed by an unknown and possibly unqualified surgeon.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: We're hearing rumors that Caesar may have been assassinated by an unknown party. It is currently unknown how the assassin was able to evade security.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Reports out of Arizona quote Caesar as saying he's "never felt better" after undergoing emergency brain surgery.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Strange rumors from across the river indicate a secret underground robot army has been destroyed before anyone was able to use it.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: The NCR flag has been hoisted over former Legion outpost Nelson after heavy fighting. NCR officials are calling this a big win for troop morale.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Legion raiders have sacked Camp Forlorn Hope, eliminating all remaining NCR forces there and giving the Legion a strong foothold along the river.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: The president of the NCR has been killed at Hoover Dam. President Kimball was slated to give a rallying speech to troops stationed there.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: During his visit to Hoover Dam, an attempt on the life of NCR President Aaron Kimball was thwarted by a quick-thinking civilian.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Residents of Novac were treated to a surprise light show when HELIOS One unexpectedly began firing lasers. No word yet on the damage.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Residents and squatters in Freeside are overjoyed after waking to discover that the area is being supplied with electricity from an unknown source.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: A source within the Great Khans is saying the gang has reached an accord with the NCR, and will support them in any conflict with Caesar's Legion.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Eyewitnesses report seeing roving bands of troops wearing power armor and carrying advanced weapons along the 95.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Witnesses report a huge object or creature surfacing in Lake Mead. So far, photos of the so-called Lake Mead Monster are grainy and underexposed.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: A large unidentified aircraft has been seen circling the skies above the New Vegas Strip.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Residents of Novac were running for cover following the failed launch of three rockets from the REPCONN Test Site.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: NCR Correctional Facility is now under prisoner control following a successful riot. Locals should avoid anyone who looks like they've done time.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: NCR has failed to retake the prison it recently lost in a deadly riot. Powder gang operations against the NCR are expected to continue.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Intense fighting erupted on Hoover Dam as tensions between NCR and Caesar's Legion boiled over.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: A grateful widow told Radio New Vegas today of one person's heroic efforts to recover her husband's body from a war zone.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Food shortages and mass starvation are plaguing Freeside and the Strip in the wake of a sharp reduction in the area's beef supply.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Beef prices around the New Vegas Strip have dropped significantly following an agreement between the Ultra-Luxe and Brahmin baron Heck Gunderson.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Wealthy Brahmin baron Heck Gunderson was arrested in the Ultra-Luxe Hotel as a suspect in his son's murder. A hotel spokeswoman had this to say.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: A mob of dangerous creatures of all different species has been terrorizing locals in Westside. The cause of the attacks is thus far unknown.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Residents report briefly seeing a column of heavenly light coming out of the sky. Apocalypse predictors haven't been this excited since the War.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Listeners have been unable to pick up radio broadcasts from Black Mountain recently. Most are calling the static, quote, a welcome improvement.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Troubling news from Primm as merchants report a large presence of armed, unsavory figures patrolling the town. Residents are nowhere to be found.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: The Black Mountain radio signal is back after a long absence. Listeners say the new programming is, quote, less for outcasts, more for weirdos.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: The HELIOS One solar power plant remains dormant despite NCR efforts to reactivate the facility.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Caesar's Legion continues to fortify its position in Nelson, where it remains a constant concern for Camp Forlorn Hope and the nearby town of Novac.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Scavengers report hulking individuals moving around Hidden Valley after dusk, but have been unable to identify them due to low visibility.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: The influx of displaced residents to the refugee camp at Bitter Springs has caused a strain on rations there. NCR officials are asking for donations.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Citizens of Outer Vegas are flocking to the Strip in droves amid a wave of terror caused by a band of raiders known as the Fiends.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: The death toll continues to climb around Camp Forlorn Hope, where Legion raiding parties are still chipping away at the NCR's hold south of the Dam.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: NCR officials at Camp McCarran were relieved when technical difficulties with its monorail line to the New Vegas Strip proved easy to fix.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Unconfirmed reports say NCR's General Lee Oliver may have uprooted from his post at Camp McCarran in order to be present at Hoover Dam.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Merchants are saying there's been little contact with traders from Nipton in recent days, causing concerns that the isolated town may be in trouble.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Refugees at Bitter Springs are giving startling accounts of the legate known as {LAN-ee-us}Lanius who is said to be Caesar's top field commander.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Traders from California are being turned away at Mojave Outpost, where the NCR is concerned about dangers along Nipton Highway and I-15.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Rumors persist about a Super Mutant refuge nestled high in a ski lodge to the Northwest.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Patrons of the Ultra-Luxe are questioning whether its pricey restaurant, the Gourmand, is overstating the fullness of its wait-list.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Diners at the Gourmand are giving the restaurant rave reviews for executive chef Phillipe's brand new menu offerings.
name: RNVNewsStory "NewsStory" [DIAL:0014DFB5]

text_content: Where are you from?
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic017 "Where are you from?" [DIAL:0014E2B1]

text_content: A little place in the NCR called Oak Creek. Used to be a farming town until it got taken over by ranchers.|I didn't want to herd Brahmin for a living, so I signed on with the Crimson Caravan and headed east. Not much to tell, really.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic017 "Where are you from?" [DIAL:0014E2B1]
speaker: CrimsonCaravanBlake "Blake" [NPC_:000F1863]

text_content: Do your caravans ever have trouble from bandits?
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic016 "Do your caravans ever have trouble from bandits?" [DIAL:0014E2B2]

text_content: Out here, we usually split our caravans into smaller bands - that way, we don't lose everything if they get hit.|It's not very efficient, though, but hopefully we'll be able to start running larger caravans once things get civilized.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic016 "Do your caravans ever have trouble from bandits?" [DIAL:0014E2B2]
speaker: CrimsonCaravanBlake "Blake" [NPC_:000F1863]

text_content: Where does the Crimson Caravan Company get its merchandise?
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic015 "Where does the Crimson Caravan Company get its merchandise?" [DIAL:0014E2B3]

text_content: Trade routes, my friend, trade routes. Just about every major town in the wasteland has a Crimson Caravan branch in it.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic015 "Where does the Crimson Caravan Company get its merchandise?" [DIAL:0014E2B3]
speaker: CrimsonCaravanBlake "Blake" [NPC_:000F1863]

text_content: That's all. Let's talk about something else.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic014 "That's all. Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0014E2B4]

text_content: Can you answer some questions for me?
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic013 "Can you answer some questions for me?" [DIAL:0014E2B5]

text_content: Maybe. What do you want to know?
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic013 "Can you answer some questions for me?" [DIAL:0014E2B5]
speaker: CrimsonCaravanBlake "Blake" [NPC_:000F1863]

text_content: < Barter 50 >
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic012 "< Barter 50 >" [DIAL:0014E2B6]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] That should work. We'll do a weighted exchanged based on the going value of meat and vegetables. Water is invaluable in this dusty hole.|Let McCarran know they should expect the first shipment in a week or so.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic012 "< Barter 50 >" [DIAL:0014E2B6]
speaker: CrimsonCaravanBlake "Blake" [NPC_:000F1863]

text_content: [FAILED] We don't need vegetables, and besides, they spoil. The meat you can dry and turn into jerky.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic012 "< Barter 50 >" [DIAL:0014E2B6]
speaker: CrimsonCaravanBlake "Blake" [NPC_:000F1863]

text_content: < Speech 70 >
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic011 "< Speech 70 >" [DIAL:0014E2B7]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Well, the Far Go Traders have been trying to edge us out on the new armor contract for the troops. This could swing things in our favor.|All right, let McCarran know they should expect the first shipment in a week or so.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic011 "< Speech 70 >" [DIAL:0014E2B7]
speaker: CrimsonCaravanBlake "Blake" [NPC_:000F1863]

text_content: [FAILED] This is business. I really can't cut them a deal on the cost.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic011 "< Speech 70 >" [DIAL:0014E2B7]
speaker: CrimsonCaravanBlake "Blake" [NPC_:000F1863]

text_content: McCarran has plenty of caps to cover the shipment. They'll deal with the cost.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic010 "McCarran has plenty of caps to cover the shipment. They'll deal with the cost." [DIAL:0014E2B8]

text_content: Excellent.  We should be able to get the shipments started in about a week.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic010 "McCarran has plenty of caps to cover the shipment. They'll deal with the cost." [DIAL:0014E2B8]
speaker: CrimsonCaravanBlake "Blake" [NPC_:000F1863]

text_content: McCarran needs a regular shipment of brahmin meat and spices for the mess hall.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic009 "McCarran needs a regular shipment of brahmin meat and spices for the mess hall." [DIAL:0014E2B9]

text_content: Won't be a problem. We have plenty of spice traders working with us back home, and we could get meat from local Brahmin ranchers.|The bigger issue is payment. To supply the camp with meat with cost some serious caps.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic009 "McCarran needs a regular shipment of brahmin meat and spices for the mess hall." [DIAL:0014E2B9]
speaker: CrimsonCaravanBlake "Blake" [NPC_:000F1863]

text_content: Never mind.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic008 "Never mind." [DIAL:0014E2BA]

text_content: No reason. Just curious.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic007 "No reason. Just curious." [DIAL:0014E2BB]

text_content: Some of those could be combined with other chemicals to make drugs...
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic006 "Some of those could be combined with other chemicals to make drugs..." [DIAL:0014E2BC]

text_content: Really?  Huh, never thought of that.  The Crimson Caravan isn't really in the drug business.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic006 "Some of those could be combined with other chemicals to make drugs..." [DIAL:0014E2BC]
speaker: CrimsonCaravanBlake "Blake" [NPC_:000F1863]

text_content: Combining those with chemical cleaners would yield strong chems...
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic005 "Combining those with chemical cleaners would yield strong chems..." [DIAL:0014E2BD]

text_content: Really?  Huh, never thought of that.  The Crimson Caravan isn't really in the drug business.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic005 "Combining those with chemical cleaners would yield strong chems..." [DIAL:0014E2BD]
speaker: CrimsonCaravanBlake "Blake" [NPC_:000F1863]

text_content: Is there something special about these supplies?
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic004 "Is there something special about these supplies?" [DIAL:0014E2BE]

text_content: Well, pain-killers are easy to come by, but it isn't easy finding iodine, allergy meds, and a few of these other items. Why do you ask?
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic004 "Is there something special about these supplies?" [DIAL:0014E2BE]
speaker: CrimsonCaravanBlake "Blake" [NPC_:000F1863]

text_content: Will do.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic003 "Will do." [DIAL:0014E2BF]

text_content: Need anything else?
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic003 "Will do." [DIAL:0014E2BF]
speaker: CrimsonCaravanBlake "Blake" [NPC_:000F1863]

text_content: Contreras sent me for some medical supplies.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic002 "Contreras sent me for some medical supplies." [DIAL:0014E2C0]

text_content: Here you go. Let him know he needs to make another payment if he wants more of this stuff.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic002 "Contreras sent me for some medical supplies." [DIAL:0014E2C0]
speaker: CrimsonCaravanBlake "Blake" [NPC_:000F1863]

text_content: Show me what you have for sale.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic001 "Show me what you have for sale." [DIAL:0014E2C1]

text_content: Can do.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic001 "Show me what you have for sale." [DIAL:0014E2C1]
speaker: CrimsonCaravanBlake "Blake" [NPC_:000F1863]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0014E2C2]

text_content: See ya.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0014E2C2]
speaker: CrimsonCaravanBlake "Blake" [NPC_:000F1863]

text_content: It seems like that the companies are getting the better deal.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic029 "It seems like that the companies are getting the better deal." [DIAL:0014E2C3]

text_content: {grinning}That's because we are. {more serious}We always pay up when the contract ends, though. Won't stay in business long if you've got a reputation as a cheat.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic029 "It seems like that the companies are getting the better deal." [DIAL:0014E2C3]
speaker: AliceMcLafferty "Alice McLafferty" [NPC_:000EC7A1]

text_content: Are work contracts legal?
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic028 "Are work contracts legal?" [DIAL:0014E2C4]

text_content: Yes, and they have been for decades now. The hired hands know what they're signing up for - we don't hide anything with fancy talk.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic028 "Are work contracts legal?" [DIAL:0014E2C4]
speaker: AliceMcLafferty "Alice McLafferty" [NPC_:000EC7A1]

text_content: What kind of upkeep expenses?
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic027 "What kind of upkeep expenses?" [DIAL:0014E2C5]

text_content: Food, water, living quarters, medicine, and clothes - just the basic stuff. It all comes out of the Company's coffers.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic027 "What kind of upkeep expenses?" [DIAL:0014E2C5]
speaker: AliceMcLafferty "Alice McLafferty" [NPC_:000EC7A1]

text_content: That's all I wanted to know. Let's talk about something else.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic026 "That's all I wanted to know. Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0014E2C6]

text_content: Are work contracts common for the Crimson Caravan Company?
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic025 "Are work contracts common for the Crimson Caravan Company?" [DIAL:0014E2C7]

text_content: Most merchant companies - {correcting herself, emphasizes "successful"}successful merchant companies, rather - have them. It can be inconvenient to replace employees on short notice.|The contracts keep employees around for a specific duration of time, after which they get paid - after their upkeep expenses are deducted, of course.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic025 "Are work contracts common for the Crimson Caravan Company?" [DIAL:0014E2C7]
speaker: AliceMcLafferty "Alice McLafferty" [NPC_:000EC7A1]

text_content: You have a deal.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic024 "You have a deal." [DIAL:0014E2CA]

text_content: I'm glad to hear it.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic024 "You have a deal." [DIAL:0014E2CA]
speaker: AliceMcLafferty "Alice McLafferty" [NPC_:000EC7A1]

text_content: I need to consider your offer.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic023 "I need to consider your offer." [DIAL:0014E2CB]

text_content: Take all the time you need.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic023 "I need to consider your offer." [DIAL:0014E2CB]
speaker: AliceMcLafferty "Alice McLafferty" [NPC_:000EC7A1]

text_content: < Barter 65 >
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic022 "< Barter 65 >" [DIAL:0014E2CC]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Intriguing. Janet puts in a good word for me, and the Crimson Caravan gains exclusive access to the Boomers. Yes, that works for me.|Janet will be paid what she's owed. Consider it a gift.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic022 "< Barter 65 >" [DIAL:0014E2CC]
speaker: AliceMcLafferty "Alice McLafferty" [NPC_:000EC7A1]

text_content: [FAILED] The Crimson Caravan Company's operations require dependable employees. I'm not going to reward someone for breaking their work contract.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic022 "< Barter 65 >" [DIAL:0014E2CC]
speaker: AliceMcLafferty "Alice McLafferty" [NPC_:000EC7A1]

text_content: < Speech 75 >
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic020 "< Speech 75 >" [DIAL:0014E2CD]

text_content: {grumbling}[SUCCEEDED] Being sentimental is not how I made the Crimson Caravan so successful, but I'll allow it, just this once.|Janet will be paid what she's owed. Consider it a gift.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic020 "< Speech 75 >" [DIAL:0014E2CD]
speaker: AliceMcLafferty "Alice McLafferty" [NPC_:000EC7A1]

text_content: {somewhat amused}[FAILED] You'll have to try harder than that. The rumors about my heart being made of stone are true.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic020 "< Speech 75 >" [DIAL:0014E2CD]
speaker: AliceMcLafferty "Alice McLafferty" [NPC_:000EC7A1]

text_content: Janet's asked me to talk to you about releasing her from her contract.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic016 "Janet's asked me to talk to you about releasing her from her contract." [DIAL:0014E2CE]

text_content: {snorting, a bit contemptuous}Ah, yes, her infatuation with a Boomer she's never met. It's a small camp, and word gets around.|She's aware she's breaking her contract, which is undoubtedly why she sent you to talk to me instead of coming herself.|Janet is free to leave, but she forfeits the wages she's owed. That's the price of contract breaking - take it or leave it.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic016 "Janet's asked me to talk to you about releasing her from her contract." [DIAL:0014E2CE]
speaker: AliceMcLafferty "Alice McLafferty" [NPC_:000EC7A1]

text_content: My terms haven't changed. Janet is free to leave, but she forfeits the wages she's owed.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic016 "Janet's asked me to talk to you about releasing her from her contract." [DIAL:0014E2CE]
speaker: AliceMcLafferty "Alice McLafferty" [NPC_:000EC7A1]

text_content: RNVNewsStoryLine3
name: RNVNewsStory3 "RNVNewsStoryLine3" [DIAL:0014E2F9]

text_content: He added he didn't want to see the NCR in the ghetto, and called for a mass, quote, return to sender.
name: RNVNewsStory3 "RNVNewsStoryLine3" [DIAL:0014E2F9]

text_content: {Cachino:}Said he'd always wanted to sleep with the Lakelurks.
name: RNVNewsStory3 "RNVNewsStoryLine3" [DIAL:0014E2F9]
speaker: VMS21Cachino "Cachino" [NPC_:0010C6F5]

text_content: {No-Bark Noonan:}Don't you laugh at me. I know a spell that'll make you show your true form. Cave rat taught it to me.
name: RNVNewsStory3 "RNVNewsStoryLine3" [DIAL:0014E2F9]
speaker: NobarkNoonan "No-bark Noonan" [NPC_:0008CD23]

text_content: Listeners are not advised to follow that path in hopes of similar results.
name: RNVNewsStory3 "RNVNewsStoryLine3" [DIAL:0014E2F9]

text_content: {Private Morales:}Esteban's going home now. I can't tell you what that means to me.
name: RNVNewsStory3 "RNVNewsStoryLine3" [DIAL:0014E2F9]
speaker: PrivateMorales "Pvt. Christina Morales" [NPC_:000E8F6D]

text_content: {Marjorie:}Nor is he allowed to sample the world-class cuisine of the Gourmand, New Vegas' only 5-star restaurant.
name: RNVNewsStory3 "RNVNewsStoryLine3" [DIAL:0014E2F9]
speaker: VMS18Marjorie "Marjorie" [NPC_:0010D4E7]

text_content: The legate then ordered a tenth of his own force be killed by the other nine tenths. {Beat}And you thought {emph}your boss was a pain.
name: RNVNewsStory3 "RNVNewsStoryLine3" [DIAL:0014E2F9]

text_content: Once again, NCR President Aaron Kimball, dead at 48.
name: RNVNewsStory3 "RNVNewsStoryLine3" [DIAL:0014E2F9]

text_content: RNVNewsStoryLine2
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: Now that's a delivery service you can count on.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: {Primm Slim:}Loading Public Appeasement Oration... complete. Howdy... citizens. How about a yee-haw for law and order in the fine town of ERROR: TOKEN NOT FOUND?
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]
speaker: PrimmSlim "Primm Slim" [CREA:000E2886]

text_content: {Meyers:}Howdy do, folks. I'm Sheriff Meyers. Be good, or I'll shoot you dead.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]
speaker: NCRCFMeyers "Meyers" [NPC_:0008D0E7]

text_content: {McGee:}People of Primm, the NCR wishes to inform you that you are under their jurisdiction now. And from now on, you're gonna be living by our rules.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]
speaker: PrimmLanceCorporalMcGee "Sergeant McGee" [NPC_:000E2C93]

text_content: {Swank:}If I know my pal Benny, he's swinging with the Big Cat Upstairs as we speak. Or he's chasing some angel broad with cans as big as her halo! <Laughs>
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]
speaker: VMQTopsSwank "Swank" [NPC_:00113456]

text_content: {Swank:}Do I seem worried to you, baby? Sometimes a cat just needs room to swing. He'll be back, sure as a conga drum's got a groovy beat.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]
speaker: VMQTopsSwank "Swank" [NPC_:00113456]

text_content: Once again, Caesar, dead. A shocking turn of events whose impact is anyone's guess at this point.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: Caesar said he expected to resume his campaign of terror and mayhem as soon as he receives medical clearance.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: <Sighs> Dang it. I could've used one of those.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: Caesar's Legion is believed to have been behind the attack.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: When asked why, the source said someone alerted them to the fact that Caesar's Legion was comprised of, quote, a bunch of squares.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: Travelers are advised not to make friendly chit-chat with them.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: Freesiders are hoping they'll drop food. I wouldn't get your hopes up, Freesiders.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: In possibly related news, local chem dealers report an overall decrease in their standard of living.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: The leader of the Kings, who would only identify himself as "The King" voiced his displeasure, calling NCR citizens, quote, the devil in disguise.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: {The King:}I feel so bad. I think it's time we reconsider, baby.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: No suspects have been identified, but seniors are advised to be on the lookout for the  so-called Denture Killer.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: {Cachino:}Before he left, Nero told me him and Big Sal were real tired, see? Said they were gonna go camping up at Lake Mead.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]
speaker: VMS21Cachino "Cachino" [NPC_:0010C6F5]

text_content: Asked to comment, Big Sal said, quote, {calmly}the fuck you looking at? You wearing a wire? Are you? I'll break your fucking kneecaps. Hey. Get back here.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: One witness said, quote, God sent us two angels. And at least one had him a .308 caliber flaming sword of justice with a telescopic sight.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: {No-Bark Noonan:}It's ghouls, I tell ya. Religious ghouls in rockets looking for a land to call their own.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]
speaker: NobarkNoonan "No-bark Noonan" [NPC_:0008CD23]

text_content: Possible causes suggested were engineering mistakes, centuries-old equipment, and the fact that the rockets were piloted by a cult of crazy ghouls.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: Witness descriptions are remarkably similar to accounts of the Goodsprings courier who, as we reported, recently survived a gunshot to the head.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: {Private Morales:}It was such an incredible thing he did, putting his life on the line like that for my husband. It's not something most people would do.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]
speaker: PrivateMorales "Pvt. Christina Morales" [NPC_:000E8F6D]

text_content: {Private Morales:}It was such an incredible thing she did, putting her life on the line like that for my husband. It's not something most people would do.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]
speaker: PrivateMorales "Pvt. Christina Morales" [NPC_:000E8F6D]

text_content: {Marjorie:}Mr. Gunderson is no longer a welcome guest at the Ultra-Luxe.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]
speaker: VMS18Marjorie "Marjorie" [NPC_:0010D4E7]

text_content: The attacks are all the more troubling since there has not been a zoo in the area in quite some time.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: The chief scientist at the plant vowed to fix the problem, blaming it on an atmosphere of, quote, severe underappreciation.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: Those who can afford passports are saying the added security is well worth the price of admission.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: One anonymous official told us a serious mechanical failure would be a disaster because of the age of the train and scarcity of replacement parts.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: NCR sources say that holding the Dam against Caesar's Legion has become their main strategic priority, and this move would not be unexpected.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: One refugee told us the legate took over an underperforming squad of troops by beating its commander to death in full view of everyone.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: If you should find it, do not - repeat, do not - belittle a Super Mutant for taking the bunny slope.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: Those who claim to have dined at the restaurant find the food appealing but say many tables remain empty.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: The secret ingredient? Tender loving care, according to the chef.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: The president's Vertibird exploded in midair as he departed following the address. Investigators say the explosion was not an accident.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: The president's Vertibird crashed into the side of the Dam as he departed following the address. Authorities suspect sabotage.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: The president's Vertibird was destroyed by one of the Dam's howitzer cannons. Investigators say the gun had been tampered with.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: An assassin attacked the president in full view of the crowd, but was not apprehended. Witness descriptions of the killer differ wildly.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

text_content: An NCR private scheduled to receive an award exploded as he reached the stage, killing the president in the blast.
name: RNVNewsStory2 "RNVNewsStoryLine2" [DIAL:0014E2FA]

name: vDialogueTheStripVStreetMrHoldoutTopic004 "I can get weapons past the guards, no problem." [DIAL:0014F01B]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Sizing the player up, nods}You might - one fellow I knew was able to slip a pistol past the guards. You? {Sizes up, impressed}I'm guessing you could get a machine gun by them.
name: vDialogueTheStripVStreetMrHoldoutTopic004 "I can get weapons past the guards, no problem." [DIAL:0014F01B]
speaker: VStreetMrHoldout "Mister Holdout" [NPC_:0014EFB2]

text_content: Hmmm... think I could I slip bigger weapons past the guards?
name: vDialogueTheStripVStreetMrHoldoutTopic005 "Hmmm... think I could I slip bigger weapons past the guards?" [DIAL:0014F01C]
