name: vDialogueTheStripVStreetMrHoldoutTopic005 "Hmmm... think I could I slip bigger weapons past the guards?" [DIAL:0014F01C]
speaker: VStreetMrHoldout "Mister Holdout" [NPC_:0014EFB2]

text_content: I'll do as you ask.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic000 "I'll do as you ask." [DIAL:0014F027]

text_content: Then I bid you {WAH-lay}"Vale" - until we meet again.
name: VNiptonVLegionaryVulpesIncultaTopic000 "I'll do as you ask." [DIAL:0014F027]
speaker: VLegionaryVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:001300E2]

text_content: Let's see who's pathetic.
name: VDeadSeaLegionaryDeadSeaTopic031 "Let's see who's pathetic." [DIAL:0014F031]

text_content: {menacing}True to Caesar.
name: VDeadSeaLegionaryDeadSeaTopic031 "Let's see who's pathetic." [DIAL:0014F031]
speaker: LegionaryDeadSea "Dead Sea" [NPC_:0011F90F]

text_content: Who are you?
name: VDeadSeaLegionaryDeadSeaTopic030 "Who are you?" [DIAL:0014F032]

text_content: I am Dead Sea, Decanus of the Legion by the grace of Caesar, not that {emph}you're in any position to ask questions.
name: VDeadSeaLegionaryDeadSeaTopic030 "Who are you?" [DIAL:0014F032]
speaker: LegionaryDeadSea "Dead Sea" [NPC_:0011F90F]

text_content: What are you going to do about it?
name: VDeadSeaLegionaryDeadSeaTopic029 "What are you going to do about it?" [DIAL:0014F033]

text_content: I'll execute Caesar's will by hurling your corpse into the Colorado - like the other Profligates before you!
name: VDeadSeaLegionaryDeadSeaTopic029 "What are you going to do about it?" [DIAL:0014F033]
speaker: LegionaryDeadSea "Dead Sea" [NPC_:0011F90F]

text_content: Who are you?
name: VDeadSeaLegionaryDeadSeaTopic028 "Who are you?" [DIAL:0014F034]

text_content: I am a loyal servant of Caesar, and I thank my good fortune for the day that he plucked me as a babe from the shore of the Great Salt Lake.|For five years I have had the privilege of serving as a Decanus. If fortune continues to smile upon me, I will serve him until I draw my last breath.|I hope that satisfies your curiosity about me, because I won't waste any more of Caesar's time talking about myself.
name: VDeadSeaLegionaryDeadSeaTopic028 "Who are you?" [DIAL:0014F034]
speaker: LegionaryDeadSea "Dead Sea" [NPC_:0011F90F]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDMikeLawsonTopic014 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0014F042]

text_content: You've got my ear.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDMikeLawsonTopic014 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0014F042]
speaker: VHDMikeLawson "Mike Lawson" [NPC_:001300A7]

text_content: Well to each their own I guess.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDMikeLawsonTopic014 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0014F042]
speaker: VHDMikeLawson "Mike Lawson" [NPC_:001300A7]

text_content: What is wrong with the other turbines?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDMikeLawsonTopic012 "What is wrong with the other turbines?" [DIAL:0014F043]

text_content: A little bit ago one of the intake towers got clogged. No water running through it anymore to spin the generators.|One of these days I'll get some boys out to the turbine to get it running again, but right now it is pretty low on the priority list.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDMikeLawsonTopic012 "What is wrong with the other turbines?" [DIAL:0014F043]
speaker: VHDMikeLawson "Mike Lawson" [NPC_:001300A7]

text_content: How is the dam running these days?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDMikeLawsonTopic011 "How is the dam running these days?" [DIAL:0014F044]

text_content: Been better, been worse. When I first came here there was but one turbine spinning.|At one point shortly after the last battle I had six of them spinning, was a wonderful sound. Only four of them are running right now.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDMikeLawsonTopic011 "How is the dam running these days?" [DIAL:0014F044]
speaker: VHDMikeLawson "Mike Lawson" [NPC_:001300A7]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDMikeLawsonTopic010 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0014F045]

text_content: Good day to you, and stay out of trouble.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDMikeLawsonTopic010 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0014F045]
speaker: VHDMikeLawson "Mike Lawson" [NPC_:001300A7]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDMikeLawsonTopic007 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0014F046]

text_content: Alright, what's on your mind?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDMikeLawsonTopic007 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0014F046]
speaker: VHDMikeLawson "Mike Lawson" [NPC_:001300A7]

text_content: Tell me about the last battle.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDMikeLawsonTopic006 "Tell me about the last battle." [DIAL:0014F047]

text_content: I was down here for most of it, so I can't tell you much of what the boys with the guns were doing up top.|From talking to the boys that were fighting up there, I can tell you that Hanlon managed to pull off what most people would have thought impossible.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDMikeLawsonTopic006 "Tell me about the last battle." [DIAL:0014F047]
speaker: VHDMikeLawson "Mike Lawson" [NPC_:001300A7]

text_content: What do you think of Fantastic?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDMikeLawsonTopic005 "What do you think of Fantastic?" [DIAL:0014F048]

text_content: Well{pause} he mostly stays out of the way, which is a good thing. He'd probably end up doing some real damage if he tried to make himself useful.|Right now we mostly let him operate the switchboard for the intercom. Flipping switches seems to keep him pretty happy.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDMikeLawsonTopic005 "What do you think of Fantastic?" [DIAL:0014F048]
speaker: VHDMikeLawson "Mike Lawson" [NPC_:001300A7]

text_content: Sad what happened to him. He was a good kid.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDMikeLawsonTopic005 "What do you think of Fantastic?" [DIAL:0014F048]
speaker: VHDMikeLawson "Mike Lawson" [NPC_:001300A7]

text_content: What do you do here?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDMikeLawsonTopic004 "What do you do here?" [DIAL:0014F049]

text_content: I'm the head engineer. I make sure the turbines keep spinning and the water keeps pumping.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDMikeLawsonTopic004 "What do you do here?" [DIAL:0014F049]
speaker: VHDMikeLawson "Mike Lawson" [NPC_:001300A7]

text_content: Why do you call this place your baby?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDMikeLawsonTopic002 "Why do you call this place your baby?" [DIAL:0014F04A]

text_content: The power station, the dam, they're my babies. Well... don't tell my grandchildren I said that. Anything in here that I haven't rebuilt I've fixed.|I've been here since well before the first battle. I've ground my knuckles on so much cement in here it is nearly as much me as it is cement.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDMikeLawsonTopic002 "Why do you call this place your baby?" [DIAL:0014F04A]
speaker: VHDMikeLawson "Mike Lawson" [NPC_:001300A7]

text_content: I don't get what the big deal is.
name: VMS49VMS49PaladinLeaderTopic007 "I don't get what the big deal is." [DIAL:0014F0DD]

text_content: High Elder Maxson didn't just found the Brotherhood. He defined it. To serve in the Brotherhood is to serve his ideals.|Our way of life is based on them. We know no other path. There {emph}is no other path.|With her... leanings... Veronica spits in the face of every Knight, Paladin, and Scribe to serve in our ranks.
name: VMS49VMS49PaladinLeaderTopic007 "I don't get what the big deal is." [DIAL:0014F0DD]
speaker: VMS49PaladinLeader "Brotherhood of Steel Paladin" [NPC_:0014EFB7]

text_content: VDialogueVeronicaCodexReact
name: VDialogueVeronicaCodexReact "VDialogueVeronicaCodexReact" [DIAL:0014F0DE]

text_content: Uh... you were kidding just now when you said that thing about the Codex, right?
name: VDialogueVeronicaCodexReact "VDialogueVeronicaCodexReact" [DIAL:0014F0DE]

text_content: I will cast down your Codex and bask in the dying agony of those who hold it dear.
name: VMS49VMS49PaladinLeaderTopic006 "I will cast down your Codex and bask in the dying agony of those who hold it dear." [DIAL:0014F0DF]

text_content: {Fearful}No. No!
name: VMS49VMS49PaladinLeaderTopic006 "I will cast down your Codex and bask in the dying agony of those who hold it dear." [DIAL:0014F0DF]
speaker: VMS49PaladinLeader "Brotherhood of Steel Paladin" [NPC_:0014EFB7]

text_content: This isn't your place. You're neither Head Scribe nor Elder.
name: VMS49VMS49PaladinLeaderTopic005 "This isn't your place. You're neither Head Scribe nor Elder." [DIAL:0014F0E0]

text_content: Their sentimentality prevents them from administering justice.|Our duty is to the Codex above all, something your companion has forgotten. And that gives us the authority to {emph}make it our place.
name: VMS49VMS49PaladinLeaderTopic005 "This isn't your place. You're neither Head Scribe nor Elder." [DIAL:0014F0E0]
speaker: VMS49PaladinLeader "Brotherhood of Steel Paladin" [NPC_:0014EFB7]

text_content: Uh... Veronica just said those things to test you. She didn't mean it.
name: VMS49VMS49PaladinLeaderTopic004 "Uh... Veronica just said those things to test you. She didn't mean it." [DIAL:0014F0E1]

text_content: You're pathetic. Hide behind words all you like, but your cowardice shows through.
name: VMS49VMS49PaladinLeaderTopic004 "Uh... Veronica just said those things to test you. She didn't mean it." [DIAL:0014F0E1]
speaker: VMS49PaladinLeader "Brotherhood of Steel Paladin" [NPC_:0014EFB7]

text_content: Ideals are strengthened by the challenges they endure. Veronica's questioning did you a service.
name: VMS49VMS49PaladinLeaderTopic003 "Ideals are strengthened by the challenges they endure. Veronica's questioning did you a service." [DIAL:0014F0E2]

text_content: Hmmph. She'd be doing a greater service by carrying out her duties and not trying to undermine the elder's authority.|This had better be the last time her loyalty falters. You've been warned.
name: VMS49VMS49PaladinLeaderTopic003 "Ideals are strengthened by the challenges they endure. Veronica's questioning did you a service." [DIAL:0014F0E2]
speaker: VMS49PaladinLeader "Brotherhood of Steel Paladin" [NPC_:0014EFB7]

text_content: RNVMusicIntroSpecific
name: RNVMusicIntroSpecific "RNVMusicIntroSpecific" [DIAL:0014F114]

text_content: Gonna play a song for you right now. It's about that special someone you only find once... in a Blue Moon.
name: RNVMusicIntroSpecific "RNVMusicIntroSpecific" [DIAL:0014F114]

text_content: Got some Dean Martin coming up, talking about the greatest feeling in the world, love. "Ain't That A Kick in the Head." Sure is, Dino. It sure is.
name: RNVMusicIntroSpecific "RNVMusicIntroSpecific" [DIAL:0014F114]

text_content: Here's Bing Crosby reminding us of those times when you absolutely have to kiss the person you love. "Something's Gotta Give," up next.
name: RNVMusicIntroSpecific "RNVMusicIntroSpecific" [DIAL:0014F114]

text_content: Hey New Vegas, have you ever said you loved someone when it wasn't quite true? Sure you have. But you shouldn't. Because It's a Sin to Tell a Lie.
name: RNVMusicIntroSpecific "RNVMusicIntroSpecific" [DIAL:0014F114]

text_content: And now Nat King Cole, reminding us what really matters with "Love Me As Though There Were No Tomorrow." Because in New Vegas, hey, you never know.
name: RNVMusicIntroSpecific "RNVMusicIntroSpecific" [DIAL:0014F114]

text_content: Got a song for you, now. It's about a guy who's cold on the exterior, but deep down, you know he's a good man. And his name... is Johnny Guitar.
name: RNVMusicIntroSpecific "RNVMusicIntroSpecific" [DIAL:0014F114]

text_content: In New Vegas, we know the pain that numbers can bring us. Well, so does Guy Mitchell, who's got "Heartaches by the Number."
name: RNVMusicIntroSpecific "RNVMusicIntroSpecific" [DIAL:0014F114]

text_content: Have you ever been in love with a celebrity? You don't have to be shy, I feel it between us, too. Sometimes you can't help being Mad About the Boy.
name: RNVMusicIntroSpecific "RNVMusicIntroSpecific" [DIAL:0014F114]

text_content: You know, sometimes the journey beats the destination. Especially if your spurs go Jingle Jangle Jingle, and you meet some nice gals on the way.
name: RNVMusicIntroSpecific "RNVMusicIntroSpecific" [DIAL:0014F114]

text_content: JasonBrightFarBeyond
name: JasonBrightFarBeyond "JasonBrightFarBeyond" [DIAL:0014F12A]

text_content: I have glimpsed it only in visions, wanderer, but what I have seen is truly miraculous.|It is a place of light and healing, and I know in my soul that my flock will be safe there.
name: JasonBrightFarBeyond "JasonBrightFarBeyond" [DIAL:0014F12A]

text_content: Do you know anything about some NCR supplies?
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic005 "Do you know anything about some NCR supplies?" [DIAL:0014F137]

text_content: I saw some Legion assholes carrying crates to a cave north of here. May have been NCR shit, I don't fucking know.
name: VNiptonvNiptonBoxcars2Topic005 "Do you know anything about some NCR supplies?" [DIAL:0014F137]
speaker: vNiptonBoxcars2 "Boxcars" [NPC_:00134972]

text_content: I had another question.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic100 "I had another question." [DIAL:0014F139]

text_content: {"Go ahead and ask."}Shoot.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic100 "I had another question." [DIAL:0014F139]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: How can I best use your skills?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic099 "How can I best use your skills?" [DIAL:0014F13A]

text_content: I like punching things, but sometimes shooting things just has to do.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic099 "How can I best use your skills?" [DIAL:0014F13A]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Who is Father Elijah?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic098 "Who is Father Elijah?" [DIAL:0014F13B]

text_content: He was our Elder when we came East. A wizard with technology, really. His mind just worked that way naturally. Learned a lot from him.|But he started having disagreements with the other Elders. The Brotherhood's interest is in old technology. He wanted to explore developing new tech.|And there were other ways he wanted to push. Other weapons. Ones with ethics questions attached. Rather than deal with him, they sent him East.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic098 "Who is Father Elijah?" [DIAL:0014F13B]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: How do you feel about the other members?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic097 "How do you feel about the other members?" [DIAL:0014F13C]

text_content: I called them family before. That's not far off. Both the good and the bad. It's like a big unending family reunion in that bunker.|There's people you love, people you'll never speak to again, and it's always awkward when you run into someone you used to date.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic097 "How do you feel about the other members?" [DIAL:0014F13C]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Does the Brotherhood protect people from raiders or other threats?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic096 "Does the Brotherhood protect people from raiders or other threats?" [DIAL:0014F13D]

text_content: No, no. We only protect people from {emph}themselves, and only in the sense that we don't let them have the really good Pre-War toys.|And sometimes it's more like we protect {emph}ourselves from {emph}them and hope to outlive them and become humanity's sole heirs.|We've had people go rogue, though, and start helping people. One chapter had a small civil war over it. We take our isolationism seriously.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic096 "Does the Brotherhood protect people from raiders or other threats?" [DIAL:0014F13D]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: What's the Codex?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic095 "What's the Codex?" [DIAL:0014F13E]

text_content: Ah, the Codex. If it's in there, we have to abide it, if it's not, it's not important.|It documents our history, too. Part of what Scribes like me do is update it. Hmm... I wonder...|Nah, they'd probably catch it if I rewrote the Founder's axioms.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic095 "What's the Codex?" [DIAL:0014F13E]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Do you like being a member?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic094 "Do you like being a member?" [DIAL:0014F13F]

text_content: I know sometimes I sound like I don't. I know. But there's something that still rings true to me about our code.|There's an honor to it. We're protecting people. Even if it's from themselves, it's a good cause.|We just lose sight of the big picture sometimes. Treat all our practices with the same sacredness.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic094 "Do you like being a member?" [DIAL:0014F13F]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: What do you do for them?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic093 "What do you do for them?" [DIAL:0014F140]

text_content: I'm a procurement specialist. Like I said, it's basically grocery shopping. Except sometimes the groceries are scavenged parts and arcane technology.|The elder who brought us to the Mojave, Father Elijah, usually had me looking for these old memory units. But he'd never tell me what they were for.|Nowadays I'm usually sent to do business with traders at places like the 188. But sometimes I think it's just to keep me out of everyone's hair.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic093 "What do you do for them?" [DIAL:0014F140]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: How did you get to be a member?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic092 "How did you get to be a member?" [DIAL:0014F141]

text_content: More sexual favors than I can even count. I am still tired from it.|No, actually, you're born into it. My parents, their parents, so on. When you're young you can choose to leave. But it's home, so most people don't.|We don't take on new members, really. You can do the math on our long-term prospects based on that point. I keep hoping we'll change that.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic092 "How did you get to be a member?" [DIAL:0014F141]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: What's their purpose?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic088 "What's their purpose?" [DIAL:0014F142]

text_content: Ha! Good question. These days it's hard to say. Once upon a time it was about technology. Controlling it so it couldn't destroy us again.|Energy weapons and power armor are usually tops on our list, although {emph}I appreciate anything that's vintage.|But that all seems so limited now. We haven't grown or adapted. And now we're stuck in a hole, not carrying out our mission.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic088 "What's their purpose?" [DIAL:0014F142]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Tell me about the Brotherhood of Steel.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic084 "Tell me about the Brotherhood of Steel." [DIAL:0014F143]

text_content: It pays like ass, but it's hard to get other work with my skill set.|What do you want to know?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic084 "Tell me about the Brotherhood of Steel." [DIAL:0014F143]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: VDialogueVeronicaGiftShopReact
name: VDialogueVeronicaGiftShopReact "VDialogueVeronicaGiftShopReact" [DIAL:0014F144]

text_content: I don't like the sound of this. Hope that collar isn't what I think it is. What did you do, Elijah?
name: VDialogueVeronicaGiftShopReact "VDialogueVeronicaGiftShopReact" [DIAL:0014F144]

text_content: Never mind.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic102 "Never mind." [DIAL:0014F169]

text_content: Okay, I won't!
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic102 "Never mind." [DIAL:0014F169]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: I wanted to talk about the technology we're looking for.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic101 "I wanted to talk about the technology we're looking for." [DIAL:0014F16A]

text_content: What are your thoughts?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic101 "I wanted to talk about the technology we're looking for." [DIAL:0014F16A]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: He probably ditched you for someone cuter.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDEngineerValentineTopic002 "He probably ditched you for someone cuter." [DIAL:0014F270]

text_content: Why would you say something like that? That's just mean.|Just leave me alone.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDEngineerValentineTopic002 "He probably ditched you for someone cuter." [DIAL:0014F270]
speaker: VHDEngineerValentine "Allison Valentine" [NPC_:0014F279]

text_content: Maybe he's down in the barracks.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDEngineerValentineTopic001 "Maybe he's down in the barracks." [DIAL:0014F271]

text_content: He isn't. I already checked there this morning. We were supposed to meet up here about an hour ago.|I guess I'll just keep waiting. Sorry to bother you.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDEngineerValentineTopic001 "Maybe he's down in the barracks." [DIAL:0014F271]
speaker: VHDEngineerValentine "Allison Valentine" [NPC_:0014F279]

text_content: I haven't seen him.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDEngineerValentineTopic000 "I haven't seen him." [DIAL:0014F272]

text_content: Okay, well... I guess I'll just keep waiting. Sorry to bother you.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDEngineerValentineTopic000 "I haven't seen him." [DIAL:0014F272]
speaker: VHDEngineerValentine "Allison Valentine" [NPC_:0014F279]

text_content: I've brought new security codes for this station's radio from Sergeant Reyes.
name: vDialogueRangerStationCharlieRSCharlieStepinacTopic001 "I've brought new security codes for this station's radio from Sergeant Reyes." [DIAL:0014F347]

text_content: Simple enough to change. I doubt the Legion's listening in on us - they're not that sophisticated - but better safe than sorry, right?
name: vDialogueRangerStationCharlieRSCharlieStepinacTopic001 "I've brought new security codes for this station's radio from Sergeant Reyes." [DIAL:0014F347]
speaker: RSCharlieStepinac "Comm Officer Stepinac" [NPC_:0011324E]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: vDialogueRangerStationCharlieRSCharlieStepinacTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0014F348]

text_content: See you around.
name: vDialogueRangerStationCharlieRSCharlieStepinacTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0014F348]
speaker: RSCharlieStepinac "Comm Officer Stepinac" [NPC_:0011324E]

text_content: I brought updated radio security codes from Camp Forlorn Hope.
name: vDialogueRangerStationFoxtrotRSCommRangerFoxtrotTopic000 "I brought updated radio security codes from Camp Forlorn Hope." [DIAL:0014F349]

text_content: Oh. Uh... well, yeah, I can do that. Um, thanks.
name: vDialogueRangerStationFoxtrotRSCommRangerFoxtrotTopic000 "I brought updated radio security codes from Camp Forlorn Hope." [DIAL:0014F349]
speaker: RSFoxtrotLenk "Comm Officer Lenk" [NPC_:00116B40]

text_content: The Rangers' versions of the reports they sent to Camp Golf don't match what you received.
name: VMSRSGlobalCommBreakdownRSSergeantReyesTopic107 "The Rangers' versions of the reports they sent to Camp Golf don't match what you received." [DIAL:0014F34A]

text_content: {Hanlon alive}I knew it. Every one of the false reports was signed off by Chief Hanlon at Camp Golf, but why would the Chief manipulate the reports?|I need you to take everything we've found to Chief Hanlon and confront him with it. I don't want to make this public unless we have to.
name: VMSRSGlobalCommBreakdownRSSergeantReyesTopic107 "The Rangers' versions of the reports they sent to Camp Golf don't match what you received." [DIAL:0014F34A]
speaker: CHFSergeantReyes "Tech Sergeant Reyes" [NPC_:0010D23D]

text_content: {Hanlon dead}I knew it. I suspected that Chief Hanlon was behind all this, but since he's dead, there's no way we'll ever know.|Thanks for all your help.
name: VMSRSGlobalCommBreakdownRSSergeantReyesTopic107 "The Rangers' versions of the reports they sent to Camp Golf don't match what you received." [DIAL:0014F34A]
speaker: CHFSergeantReyes "Tech Sergeant Reyes" [NPC_:0010D23D]

text_content: I don't have time to do this right now.
name: VMSRSGlobalCommBreakdownRSSergeantReyesTopic106 "I don't have time to do this right now." [DIAL:0014F34B]

text_content: All right, then. Come and talk to me when you do.
name: VMSRSGlobalCommBreakdownRSSergeantReyesTopic106 "I don't have time to do this right now." [DIAL:0014F34B]
speaker: CHFSergeantReyes "Tech Sergeant Reyes" [NPC_:0010D23D]

text_content: I'll investigate and let you know what I find out about those odd reports.
name: VMSRSGlobalCommBreakdownRSSergeantReyesTopic071 "I'll investigate and let you know what I find out about those odd reports." [DIAL:0014F34C]

text_content: Thank you, and good luck.
name: VMSRSGlobalCommBreakdownRSSergeantReyesTopic071 "I'll investigate and let you know what I find out about those odd reports." [DIAL:0014F34C]

text_content: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?

text_content: {Lan-ee-OOS}Lanius is the greatest of my battlefield commanders. speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: He killed fifteen before they brought him down. He didn't die, obviously.|I had him tended to. He was {beat}maimed, most of face torn off. I said he could have it if he'd fight for me.|He accepted... on condition that he be allowed to kill the surviving males of his tribe. {chuckle}I said, make it the {emph}adult males and you have a deal.{Children are malleable and thus valuable to the Legion.}

speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: {Lan-ee-OOS}Lanius is savage. Savagely loyal, too, but only to me - he has no love for my Legion. All he cares about is destroying the enemy.|When another legatus or a {Ken-TOO-ree-on}Centurion fails to achieve results, I send {Lah-nee-OOS}Lanius to make things right.|His first step is to beat the failed commander to death in front of his assembled troops. Then he orders the ritual of {deck-ih-MAH-tee-oh}decimatio.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic115 "I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?" [DIAL:001529A5]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: It means "decimation," but in ancient Rome the word had a very specific meaning - a punishment for cowardice.|The Legionaries are lined up in ranks. Every tenth man steps forward and is beaten to death by his brothers.|It instills a certain... robust obedience.

text_content: What's your opinion of President Kimball?

text_content: A man of potential, held back by the {slight beat}craven political context he inhabits. You realize he was a general? "The Hero of the Mojave," they called him.|A title he earned by extirpating lesser tribes that dared attack NCR citizens. His responses were {approving}swift and draconian.|President Tandi, the "founding mother," coddled hostile tribes... but her successors were less naive, so they gave Kimball free rein.|And after a respectable military career, what does he do? Become a {distaste}politician.

speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: It'll frighten them. If I can reach out and kill whomever I choose, then they know the only reason they're alive is I haven't tried yet.|You have to understand that Kimball is a symbol. Without him, there would be no NCR occupation of the Mojave.|He mustered the troops - {distaste}as many as his senate would allow - and sent them in. All the right reasons, done all the wrong ways.|Any invasion by a democracy is a half-measure. When Kimball dies, the NCR will {emphasis}recoil from the Mojave, and from his legacy.|By the time they recover and try to strike back, I'll be invading them.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic114 "What's your opinion of President Kimball?" [DIAL:001529A6]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic113 "What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?" [DIAL:001529A7]

text_content: The worst impulses of mankind, concentrated in one insane, backward tribe.|The Brotherhood seems to have formed not long after the great atomic war. It's hard to know - they care little for history.|Some of the Brotherhood scribes we captured further East didn't even know the name of their founder, Roger Maxson.|They like to pretty up their mission with trappings of chivalry, but the truth is they're horders. They horde technology.|It's been 200 years, and they still have the mentality of scavengers. They say they're preserving these technologies, but for what?|They have no vision. They offer no future. They're a dead end.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic113 "What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?" [DIAL:001529A7]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: You don't think very far ahead, do you?|Sure, their hatred of the NCR would seem to qualify them for use as proxies. But then what do you do with them? Each paladin is quite powerful.|I'd have to be convinced that present benefits outweighed future costs.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic113 "What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?" [DIAL:001529A7]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Tell me about the Boomers.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic112 "Tell me about the Boomers." [DIAL:001529A8]

text_content: The Boomers settled at the old air base northeast of Vegas many years ago. No one knows exactly how long it's been.|It may be that no one's traded with them or even spoken to them that entire time. If so, they're sitting on one hell of a stockpile of ammunition...
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic112 "Tell me about the Boomers." [DIAL:001529A8]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: My scouts have seen people moving around the base. The perimeter is guarded, with spotters in towers directing the artillery fire.|They must have extraordinary vision. Some of my scouts were targeted at extreme distances.|So no, I can't tell you what to expect inside the base. No one's been inside it, except them.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic112 "Tell me about the Boomers." [DIAL:001529A8]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: You should use Mr. House's technology to attack the dam.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic108 "You should use Mr. House's technology to attack the dam." [DIAL:001529AB]

text_content: You don't get it, do you? The weapons I wield are forged from blood, flesh, sinew, bone - mortal stuff. Fragile, even.|And yet my Legion obeys me, even unto death. Why? Because they live to serve the greater good, and they know of no alternatives.|House's machines, his technologies - what do they propose? The possibility of victory without sacrifice. No blood spilled, just... rivets.|That's not an idea to be put in circulation. If mankind's going to survive this moment in history, it needs warriors, not {contempt}gadgets.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic108 "You should use Mr. House's technology to attack the dam." [DIAL:001529AB]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Maybe Benny could do this for you.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic106 "Maybe Benny could do this for you." [DIAL:001529AC]

text_content: I wouldn't trust Benny to lick my boots clean. This one falls to you.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic106 "Maybe Benny could do this for you." [DIAL:001529AC]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Can't your Legionaries take care of this?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic105 "Can't your Legionaries take care of this?" [DIAL:001529AD]

text_content: Yes. But then I'd have to kill them.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic105 "Can't your Legionaries take care of this?" [DIAL:001529AD]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: What's on the other side of those doors?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic097 "What's on the other side of those doors?" [DIAL:001529AE]

text_content: Benny's theory, if I understood it through all the screaming, was that Mr. House stashed some kind of ultimate weapon down there.|A gigantic robot to stomp us all to death, who cares? Whatever it is, House built it, so I want it destroyed.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic097 "What's on the other side of those doors?" [DIAL:001529AE]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: I don't know. And I don't like not knowing.|{there's an alternate take with "couldn't" instead of "can't"}I know Mr. House built it. I'm thinking it's probably some kind of weapon that he can't activate from a distance.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic097 "What's on the other side of those doors?" [DIAL:001529AE]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: How do you know so much about me?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic095 "How do you know so much about me?" [DIAL:001529B0]

text_content: I have eyes and ears everywhere. {kind of obvious}It behooves me not to invade the west blind and deaf.|It hasn't been hard to track your progress. It's not as though you've been keeping a low profile.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic095 "How do you know so much about me?" [DIAL:001529B0]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: What do I have to do?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic104 "What do I have to do?" [DIAL:001529B2]

text_content: Just give me back the Platinum Chip and I'll be on my way.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic103 "Just give me back the Platinum Chip and I'll be on my way." [DIAL:001529B3]

text_content: What were you looking to start?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic102 "What were you looking to start?" [DIAL:001529B4]

text_content: The time is fast approaching when my Legion will assault the great dam and invade the west.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic102 "What were you looking to start?" [DIAL:001529B4]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Before that happens, I want Mr. House knocked out of the game, a quick one-two punch - with you doing the punching.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic102 "What were you looking to start?" [DIAL:001529B4]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Before that happens, I want Mr. House erased from the picture. Not just the man you killed, but what he left behind. His legacy.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic102 "What were you looking to start?" [DIAL:001529B4]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Just let me deal with Benny and I'll be on my way.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic100 "Just let me deal with Benny and I'll be on my way." [DIAL:001529B5]

text_content: How may I serve your Legion, Caesar?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic099 "How may I serve your Legion, Caesar?" [DIAL:001529B6]

text_content: {pleased}I like the servile attitude. Keep it up.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic099 "How may I serve your Legion, Caesar?" [DIAL:001529B6]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic094 "<INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>" [DIAL:001529B8]

text_content: You spread word of the massacre of Nipton, just like {WUHL-pace}Vulpes asked you.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic094 "<INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>" [DIAL:001529B8]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Beams of light shot down from the sky over HELIOS One, killing who knows how many Profligate troops.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic094 "<INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>" [DIAL:001529B8]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Silus, the {Ken-TOO-ree-on}Centurion who let himself get captured, died at McCarran before he could reveal sensitive information.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic094 "<INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>" [DIAL:001529B8]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: You freed the {Ken-TOO-ree-on}Centurion Silus from McCarran so that he might be punished for his cowardice.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic094 "<INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>" [DIAL:001529B8]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: The monorail that the Profligates rode from McCarran to the Strip has been destroyed.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic094 "<INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>" [DIAL:001529B8]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: You turned Camp Forlorn Hope into a mass grave.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic094 "<INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>" [DIAL:001529B8]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Chief Hanlon, a nemesis of my Legion, died the humiliating death he deserved.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic094 "<INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>" [DIAL:001529B8]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: In Boulder City, you let the renegade Khans go free, but left NCR troopers gurgling on the ground, drowning in their own blood.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic094 "<INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>" [DIAL:001529B8]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: A number of NCR Ranger stations have been wiped off the face of the Mojave, thanks to you.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic094 "<INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>" [DIAL:001529B8]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: {ironic}The Profligates still hate me more than they hate you, I think, but I've been at this longer than you have.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic094 "<INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>" [DIAL:001529B8]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: I get it. We share a common enemy. And now you come before the mighty {KAI-zar}Caesar to what - offer your services?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic094 "<INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>" [DIAL:001529B8]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: <Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic093 "<Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>" [DIAL:001529B9]

text_content: {WUHL-pace in-CUHL-tah}Vulpes Inculta, the best of my {froo-men-TAR-ee}frumentarii, is dead.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic093 "<Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>" [DIAL:001529B9]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: {player killed Omerta leaders}All the bribes I sent to the Omertas ended up buying me {beat}nothing.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic093 "<Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>" [DIAL:001529B9]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: {Player spoiled his plans for the Great Khans.}The Great Khans aren't exactly clamoring to fight for my Legion now.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic093 "<Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>" [DIAL:001529B9]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: The garrison I established at Nelson has been wiped out.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic093 "<Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>" [DIAL:001529B9]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Years of meticulous scheming to place a mole at Camp McCarran - wasted.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic093 "<Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>" [DIAL:001529B9]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: The Kings of Freeside are cooperating with the NCR now, which frees up soldiers to defend the dam.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic093 "<Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>" [DIAL:001529B9]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: You even disrupted a promising weapons deal with the Van Graffs.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic093 "<Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>" [DIAL:001529B9]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Is it any wonder my Legion has so little love for you?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic093 "<Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>" [DIAL:001529B9]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: So tell me this, because I really want to know. I am feared - with good reason.|But you - of all people - dare to come here and stand before me, the mighty {KAI-zar}Caesar. {beat}What were you thinking?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic093 "<Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>" [DIAL:001529B9]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: That I'd decorate this tent with your guts.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic079 "That I'd decorate this tent with your guts." [DIAL:001529BA]

text_content: {Pray-TOR-ee-ahns}Praetorians, to me!
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic079 "That I'd decorate this tent with your guts." [DIAL:001529BA]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Death to tyrants! <Start combat.>
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic078 "Death to tyrants! <Start combat.>" [DIAL:001529BB]

text_content: Praetorians, to arms!
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic078 "Death to tyrants! <Start combat.>" [DIAL:001529BB]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: I had to see the Mighty Caesar with my own eyes.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic077 "I had to see the Mighty Caesar with my own eyes." [DIAL:001529BC]

text_content: Maybe I should have you struck blind so my face is the last sight you ever behold. {tiring of the jest, to business}Look...{transitioning to "You do know why I wanted to meet you, right?"}
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic077 "I had to see the Mighty Caesar with my own eyes." [DIAL:001529BC]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: You're in possession of something that interests me.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic076 "You're in possession of something that interests me." [DIAL:001529BD]

text_content: We'll deal with Benny when the time comes. In the meantime...
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic076 "You're in possession of something that interests me." [DIAL:001529BD]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: We'll talk about the Platinum Chip when the time comes. In the meantime...
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic076 "You're in possession of something that interests me." [DIAL:001529BD]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: You guaranteed my safety.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic060 "You guaranteed my safety." [DIAL:001529BE]

text_content: And you fell for that? Really? Because I'm going to have you killed now.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic060 "You guaranteed my safety." [DIAL:001529BE]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: You do know why I wanted to meet you, right?|A man nearly kills you, so you track him across the breadth of the Mojave?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic060 "You guaranteed my safety." [DIAL:001529BE]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: You arrive on the Strip and waltz into the Lucky 38 like someone left you a key under the doormat?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic060 "You guaranteed my safety." [DIAL:001529BE]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: You assassinate the head of the Chairmen {emphasis}in his own casino - and get away with it?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic060 "You guaranteed my safety." [DIAL:001529BE]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: You visit the Tops, and next thing you know, the head of the Chairmen is fleeing the Strip like a whimpering little pup?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic060 "You guaranteed my safety." [DIAL:001529BE]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Then something happens to Mr. House's robots - some kind of military upgrade?
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic060 "You guaranteed my safety." [DIAL:001529BE]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: But the topper, the {coo de gras, "s" not silent}coup de gr�ce? Mr. House dies - while you're visiting him at the Lucky 38.{grunt of admiration}
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic060 "You guaranteed my safety." [DIAL:001529BE]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: When you set your mind to something, you get results. I like that.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic060 "You guaranteed my safety." [DIAL:001529BE]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: {beat}...Relax. I'm fucking with you.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic060 "You guaranteed my safety." [DIAL:001529BE]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Mr. House sent me to infiltrate your camp.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic034 "Mr. House sent me to infiltrate your camp." [DIAL:001529BF]

text_content: Mission accomplished, asshole. {playing with him}I never would've suspected a thing if you hadn't told me - but now I'll have to have you killed.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic034 "Mr. House sent me to infiltrate your camp." [DIAL:001529BF]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: What do you do here?
name: vDialogueRangerStationDeltaRSDeltaSchefferTopic002 "What do you do here?" [DIAL:00152A37]

text_content: I'm in charge of the radio - hence the title "Comm Officer." I'd much rather be out on patrol, since nothing much happens around here.
name: vDialogueRangerStationDeltaRSDeltaSchefferTopic002 "What do you do here?" [DIAL:00152A37]
speaker: RSDeltaScheffer "Comm Officer Scheffer" [NPC_:00116B3F]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic003 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00152A4D]

text_content: Come back when you have news about the Boomers.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic003 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00152A4D]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Come back when you know more about the White Glove Society.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic003 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00152A4D]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Return to me when you've destroyed the Brotherhood of Steel.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic003 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00152A4D]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Come back when you've destroyed whatever you find down in that bunker.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic003 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00152A4D]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Complete your mission, then return to me.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic003 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00152A4D]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: {WAHL-ay}Vale.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic003 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00152A4D]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Nevermind, I'll be back.
name: vDialogueGomorrahGenericvGOMEntranceGuardTopic005 "Nevermind, I'll be back." [DIAL:00152A4F]

text_content: All right, come back any time.
name: vDialogueGomorrahGenericvGOMEntranceGuardTopic005 "Nevermind, I'll be back." [DIAL:00152A4F]
speaker: vGOMEntranceGuard "Omerta Thug" [NPC_:0012795D]

text_content: Any interesting places around here?
name: vDialogueRangerStationAlphaRSAlphaLineholmTopic000 "Any interesting places around here?" [DIAL:00152A6E]

text_content: Have you ever heard the story of the bomber that crashed into the lake before the War? Supposedly it's mostly intact, even after all that time.
name: vDialogueRangerStationAlphaRSAlphaLineholmTopic000 "Any interesting places around here?" [DIAL:00152A6E]
speaker: RSAlphaLineholm "Ranger Lineholm" [NPC_:0011BAEE]

text_content: Forget about it. It's over.
name: VMSRSGlobalCommBreakdownCHFSergeantReyesTopic002 "Forget about it. It's over." [DIAL:00152B3C]

text_content: {disappointed}Oh. Well, thanks for helping get to the bottom of this, I guess.
name: VMSRSGlobalCommBreakdownCHFSergeantReyesTopic002 "Forget about it. It's over." [DIAL:00152B3C]
speaker: CHFSergeantReyes "Tech Sergeant Reyes" [NPC_:0010D23D]

text_content: What do you do here?
name: VMSRSGlobalCommBreakdownCHFSergeantReyesTopic001 "What do you do here?" [DIAL:00152B3D]

text_content: I handle communications for Camp Forlorn Hope, compiling reports I've received from the Rangers at Camp Golf as well as the brass at McCarran.|{annoyed and underappreciated}Unofficially, I'm also in charge of radio security. No one else seems to take it as seriously as I do.
name: VMSRSGlobalCommBreakdownCHFSergeantReyesTopic001 "What do you do here?" [DIAL:00152B3D]
speaker: CHFSergeantReyes "Tech Sergeant Reyes" [NPC_:0010D23D]

text_content: Have you heard anything unusual about any of the other Ranger stations?
name: VMSRSGlobalCommBreakdownCHFSergeantReyesTopic000 "Have you heard anything unusual about any of the other Ranger stations?" [DIAL:00152B3E]

text_content: Nothing as severe. Charlie seems to be getting a lot of extra medical supplies for some reason, while Bravo hasn't requested a resupply in awhile.|Echo has been reporting heavy Legion activity down on their end, but that's about it.
name: VMSRSGlobalCommBreakdownCHFSergeantReyesTopic000 "Have you heard anything unusual about any of the other Ranger stations?" [DIAL:00152B3E]
speaker: CHFSergeantReyes "Tech Sergeant Reyes" [NPC_:0010D23D]

text_content: Not without out fight. <Attack.>
name: nvNelsonExplorerBarknvNelsonLegionaryExplorerTopic012 "Not without out fight. <Attack.>" [DIAL:00152C1A]

text_content: Good thing you're wearing a skirt, makes pissing yourself go easier. <Attack.>
name: nvNelsonExplorerBarknvNelsonLegionaryExplorerTopic013 "Good thing you're wearing a skirt, makes pissing yourself go easier. <Attack.>" [DIAL:00152C1B]

text_content: {Afraid}Brothers, help!
name: nvNelsonExplorerBarknvNelsonLegionaryExplorerTopic013 "Good thing you're wearing a skirt, makes pissing yourself go easier. <Attack.>" [DIAL:00152C1B]
speaker: nvNelsonLegionaryExplorer "Legion Explorer" [NPC_:0014EA07]

text_content: What's a Decanus?
name: nvNelsonExplorerBarknvNelsonLegionaryExplorerTopic011 "What's a Decanus?" [DIAL:00152C1C]

text_content: {outraged by player's ignorance}My commander, you ignorant degenerate! {final chance}Now, will you go before Dead Sea?
name: nvNelsonExplorerBarknvNelsonLegionaryExplorerTopic011 "What's a Decanus?" [DIAL:00152C1C]
speaker: nvNelsonLegionaryExplorer "Legion Explorer" [NPC_:0014EA07]

text_content: Yes, I'll go before your Decanus.
name: nvNelsonExplorerBarknvNelsonLegionaryExplorerTopic010 "Yes, I'll go before your Decanus." [DIAL:00152C1D]

text_content: Follow me. {warning}Make any trouble, and you'll wind up on a cross - if you're lucky.
name: nvNelsonExplorerBarknvNelsonLegionaryExplorerTopic010 "Yes, I'll go before your Decanus." [DIAL:00152C1D]
speaker: nvNelsonLegionaryExplorer "Legion Explorer" [NPC_:0014EA07]

text_content: I'm just passing through.
name: nvNelsonExplorerBarknvNelsonLegionaryExplorerTopic009 "I'm just passing through." [DIAL:00152C1E]

text_content: The Legion will decide that, Profligate, not you. Will you go before my {Deh-CAN-us}Decanus for judgement, or be killed where you stand?
name: nvNelsonExplorerBarknvNelsonLegionaryExplorerTopic009 "I'm just passing through." [DIAL:00152C1E]
speaker: nvNelsonLegionaryExplorer "Legion Explorer" [NPC_:0014EA07]

text_content: I came seeking yours, skirt boy. <Attack.>
name: nvNelsonExplorerBarknvNelsonLegionaryExplorerTopic008 "I came seeking yours, skirt boy. <Attack.>" [DIAL:00152C1F]

text_content: {Afraid}Brothers, help!
name: nvNelsonExplorerBarknvNelsonLegionaryExplorerTopic008 "I came seeking yours, skirt boy. <Attack.>" [DIAL:00152C1F]
speaker: nvNelsonLegionaryExplorer "Legion Explorer" [NPC_:0014EA07]

name: vDialogueCasinoCashiervCashierTheTopsTopic000 "[PRESS DEMO] Enough gambling, more fighting. Take me to the no man's land near Camp Forlorn Hope." [DIAL:00152C30]

text_content: You'll need someone to watch your back - Craig Boone, an NCR sniper, will be joining you. Keep your head down out there!
name: vDialogueCasinoCashiervCashierTheTopsTopic000 "[PRESS DEMO] Enough gambling, more fighting. Take me to the no man's land near Camp Forlorn Hope." [DIAL:00152C30]
speaker: vCashierTheTops "The Tops Cashier" [NPC_:00144F32]

text_content: I'd like to know more about the Rangers.
name: vDialogueRangerStationDeltaRSDeltaSchefferTopic003 "I'd like to know more about the Rangers." [DIAL:00152DE3]

text_content: Well, when there's trouble regular NCR troops can't handle, they send in a Ranger. Problem solved.|We're also responsible for keeping the borders of the NCR secure, scouting out threats, that sort of thing.
name: vDialogueRangerStationDeltaRSDeltaSchefferTopic003 "I'd like to know more about the Rangers." [DIAL:00152DE3]
speaker: RSDeltaScheffer "Comm Officer Scheffer" [NPC_:00116B3F]

text_content: I'd like to know more about the NCR Rangers.
name: vDialogueRangerStationDeltaRSDeltaPasonTopic000 "I'd like to know more about the NCR Rangers." [DIAL:00152DE4]

text_content: Best of the best, that's all there is to it. Really nothing more to say than that.
name: vDialogueRangerStationDeltaRSDeltaPasonTopic000 "I'd like to know more about the NCR Rangers." [DIAL:00152DE4]
speaker: RSDeltaPason "Ranger Pason" [NPC_:0011EBDD]

text_content: How does someone become a Ranger?
name: vDialogueRangerStationCharlieRSCharlieStepinacTopic008 "How does someone become a Ranger?" [DIAL:00152DE5]

text_content: The Rangers mostly draw from the basic NCR army. A trooper who shows exceptional skill at fighting and scouting can be nominated for the training.
name: vDialogueRangerStationCharlieRSCharlieStepinacTopic008 "How does someone become a Ranger?" [DIAL:00152DE5]
speaker: RSCharlieStepinac "Comm Officer Stepinac" [NPC_:0011324E]

text_content: Are there a lot of Rangers in the Mojave?
name: vDialogueRangerStationCharlieRSCharlieStepinacTopic007 "Are there a lot of Rangers in the Mojave?" [DIAL:00152DE6]

text_content: Couple dozen, I'd say, most of them posted at stations like this one. We either man the station or patrol the immediate area.
name: vDialogueRangerStationCharlieRSCharlieStepinacTopic007 "Are there a lot of Rangers in the Mojave?" [DIAL:00152DE6]
speaker: RSCharlieStepinac "Comm Officer Stepinac" [NPC_:0011324E]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: vDialogueRangerStationCharlieRSCharlieStepinacTopic006 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:00152DE7]

text_content: Sure.
name: vDialogueRangerStationCharlieRSCharlieStepinacTopic006 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:00152DE7]
speaker: RSCharlieStepinac "Comm Officer Stepinac" [NPC_:0011324E]

text_content: Tell me about the Rangers.
name: vDialogueRangerStationCharlieRSCharlieStepinacTopic005 "Tell me about the Rangers." [DIAL:00152DE8]

text_content: We're part scout, part commando, part sheriff. The training is brutal, and I'd say eight out of ten recruits washes out before the end.|Before you get your Ranger badge, you've got to prove you can be quieter than a shadow and more ferocious than a Deathclaw.
name: vDialogueRangerStationCharlieRSCharlieStepinacTopic005 "Tell me about the Rangers." [DIAL:00152DE8]
speaker: RSCharlieStepinac "Comm Officer Stepinac" [NPC_:0011324E]

text_content: So, you're a Ranger?
name: vDialogueRangerStationAlphaRSAlphaLineholmTopic001 "So, you're a Ranger?" [DIAL:00152DE9]

text_content: For about ten years now. Toughest training I've ever done, and was the proudest day of my life when I got my Ranger badge.|Did you know that the first battle at Hoover Dam was won because of the Rangers? Legion had the numbers, but we had the skill.
name: vDialogueRangerStationAlphaRSAlphaLineholmTopic001 "So, you're a Ranger?" [DIAL:00152DE9]
speaker: RSAlphaLineholm "Ranger Lineholm" [NPC_:0011BAEE]

text_content: Tell me about the Rangers.
name: vDialogueRangerStationAlphaRSAlphaCastilloTopic001 "Tell me about the Rangers." [DIAL:00152DEA]

text_content: I'm not really much of a historian. The short version is that the Rangers are the elite of the NCR military. Best fighters in the wasteland.
name: vDialogueRangerStationAlphaRSAlphaCastilloTopic001 "Tell me about the Rangers." [DIAL:00152DEA]
speaker: RSAlphaCastillo "Comm Officer Castillo" [NPC_:0010F700]

text_content: What is this place?
name: vDialogueRangerStationAlphaRSAlphaCastilloTopic000 "What is this place?" [DIAL:00152DEB]

text_content: Ranger Station Alpha. Ranger Lineholm is in command here.
name: vDialogueRangerStationAlphaRSAlphaCastilloTopic000 "What is this place?" [DIAL:00152DEB]
speaker: RSAlphaCastillo "Comm Officer Castillo" [NPC_:0010F700]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic006 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00153622]

text_content: Later.

text_content: Shoot.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCLieutenantMonroeTopic034 "Can I ask you some questions?" [DIAL:00153631]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCLieutenantMonroeTopic032 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00153632]

name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCLieutenantMonroeTopic032 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00153632]
speaker: BCLieutenantMonroe "Lieutenant Monroe" [NPC_:0010C6DD]

text_content: What's going on with the Great Khans?
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCLieutenantMonroeTopic023 "What's going on with the Great Khans?" [DIAL:00153633]

text_content: One of my patrols was on its way back from Novac when it came under fire from the Great Khans.|They radioed for reinforcements, but instead of waiting for us, they chased the Khans into the ruins where they were caught in a crossfire.|No deaths, but not all of the squad got out. The Khans have Private Ackerman and Private Gilbert as hostages.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCLieutenantMonroeTopic023 "What's going on with the Great Khans?" [DIAL:00153633]
speaker: BCLieutenantMonroe "Lieutenant Monroe" [NPC_:0010C6DD]

text_content: I had some questions.
name: VMS30VCFHAlexRichardsTopic058 "I had some questions." [DIAL:00153791]

text_content: I'm sure you have all the good dirt on what goes on around here.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic000 "I'm sure you have all the good dirt on what goes on around here." [DIAL:001537EF]

text_content: I sure do, but loose lips{giggle} sink ships.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic000 "I'm sure you have all the good dirt on what goes on around here." [DIAL:001537EF]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: <Speech Options>
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic001 "<Speech Options>" [DIAL:001537F0]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Alright, you look pretty trustworthy.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic001 "<Speech Options>" [DIAL:001537F0]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: [FAILED] Sorry, but the Omertas don't look very kindly upon gossiping.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic001 "<Speech Options>" [DIAL:001537F0]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: <Cherchez La Femme>
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic002 "<Cherchez La Femme>" [DIAL:001537F1]

text_content: I...{stammer} well, since you ask so nicely, and I'm not sure I could resist those pretty eyes. What do you want to know?
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic002 "<Cherchez La Femme>" [DIAL:001537F1]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: What can you tell me about what's going on around the Strip?
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic003 "What can you tell me about what's going on around the Strip?" [DIAL:001537F2]

text_content: I've heard some pretty shady rumors about the Ultra Luxe.|I'm not sure what the deal is, but although they try to put on airs, that place is just plain creepy. Maybe it's the masks.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic003 "What can you tell me about what's going on around the Strip?" [DIAL:001537F2]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: Not much of a rumor, but I hear the Tops is always looking for new talent. Lord knows they've needed it for a long time.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic003 "What can you tell me about what's going on around the Strip?" [DIAL:001537F2]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: I'm not sure what's going on at Lucky 38. That place is weird. Nobody ever goes in. Nobody ever comes out.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic003 "What can you tell me about what's going on around the Strip?" [DIAL:001537F2]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: I hear you've actually been inside Lucky 38? You're the first person who's been in there in as long as anybody can remember.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic003 "What can you tell me about what's going on around the Strip?" [DIAL:001537F2]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: It's hard to believe that not too long ago most of the families on the Strip were little more than warring tribes.|The Omertas even had a big war with the Khans, once upon a time.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic003 "What can you tell me about what's going on around the Strip?" [DIAL:001537F2]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: Sorry, that's all the news worth talking about. All I have at least.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic003 "What can you tell me about what's going on around the Strip?" [DIAL:001537F2]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: What can you tell me about what's going on in Gomorrah?
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic004 "What can you tell me about what's going on in Gomorrah?" [DIAL:001537F3]

text_content: Gossip is one thing, dirt on the Family is something else totally.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic004 "What can you tell me about what's going on in Gomorrah?" [DIAL:001537F3]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: {sigh}I knew someone would call in that mark soon. What do you want to know?
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic004 "What can you tell me about what's going on in Gomorrah?" [DIAL:001537F3]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: That was one of my sisters, but my family always repays our debts. What do you want to know?
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic004 "What can you tell me about what's going on in Gomorrah?" [DIAL:001537F3]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: Can you help me find someone?
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic005 "Can you help me find someone?" [DIAL:001537F4]

text_content: Depends on who you're looking for.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic005 "Can you help me find someone?" [DIAL:001537F4]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: I'm looking for Cachino.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic006 "I'm looking for Cachino." [DIAL:001537F5]

text_content: Cachino is usually on this floor in Brimstone, having drinks. If he isn't there then he's probably in his room upstairs.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic006 "I'm looking for Cachino." [DIAL:001537F5]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: Can you tell me where Troike is?
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic007 "Can you tell me where Troike is?" [DIAL:001537F6]

text_content: Troike spends all his days down in Zoara on the lower level.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic007 "Can you tell me where Troike is?" [DIAL:001537F6]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: Troike is dead, but I'm sure you know that.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic007 "Can you tell me where Troike is?" [DIAL:001537F6]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: Do you know someone named Clanden?
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic008 "Do you know someone named Clanden?" [DIAL:001537F7]

text_content: Yeah. I know him.{unhappy, spoken with contempt} You'll probably find him in his room upstairs. He usually just sends down for girls or food.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic008 "Do you know someone named Clanden?" [DIAL:001537F7]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: I knew someone named Clanden. Good fucking riddance.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic008 "Do you know someone named Clanden?" [DIAL:001537F7]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: Where can I find the management?
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic009 "Where can I find the management?" [DIAL:001537F8]

text_content: Big Sal and Nero split their time in Zoara overlooking the main casino floor from the balcony. No one but Family is allowed up there, though.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic009 "Where can I find the management?" [DIAL:001537F8]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: I need to know who to talk to about what's been going on in Gomorrah.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic010 "I need to know who to talk to about what's been going on in Gomorrah." [DIAL:001537F9]

text_content: All I can tell you is to find Cachino. He's the lowest level Lieutenant you're going to be able to talk to.|Some of the girls say he's been involved in some shady business the Family wouldn't really like. Ask him about it.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic010 "I need to know who to talk to about what's been going on in Gomorrah." [DIAL:001537F9]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: Tell me what the Family is up to.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic011 "Tell me what the Family is up to." [DIAL:001537FA]

text_content: Sorry, they don't tell me their plans and I don't want to know. I'm just happy they don't make me fuck anybody anymore.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic011 "Tell me what the Family is up to." [DIAL:001537FA]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: Moore sent me to talk to you about the Omertas.
name: vFreeformTheStreet02VMS21LizaTopic003 "Moore sent me to talk to you about the Omertas." [DIAL:001537FB]

text_content: Ah, excellent. I received word you may be coming. We helped the receptionist over at Gomorrah with some thugs that were taking advantage of her.|She owes us a favor. Go talk to her, she'll be able to point you in the right direction.
name: vFreeformTheStreet02VMS21LizaTopic003 "Moore sent me to talk to you about the Omertas." [DIAL:001537FB]
speaker: VMS21Liza "Liza O'Malley" [NPC_:0010C6FA]

text_content: Let me ask you about something else.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic012 "Let me ask you about something else." [DIAL:001537FC]

text_content: Fire away.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic012 "Let me ask you about something else." [DIAL:001537FC]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic013 "Goodbye." [DIAL:001537FD]

text_content: Enjoy yourself.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic013 "Goodbye." [DIAL:001537FD]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic014 "Goodbye." [DIAL:001537FE]

text_content: Be careful.
name: vDialogueGomorrahvGOMReceptionistTopic014 "Goodbye." [DIAL:001537FE]
speaker: vGOMReceptionist "Receptionist" [NPC_:00127955]

text_content: Well, I'm not, and I believe you have something of mine.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCJessupTopic034 "Well, I'm not, and I believe you have something of mine." [DIAL:00153A22]

text_content: Yeah... about that...
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCJessupTopic034 "Well, I'm not, and I believe you have something of mine." [DIAL:00153A22]
speaker: BCJessup "Jessup" [NPC_:0010C0BE]

text_content: Why did Benny betray you?
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCJessupTopic041 "Why did Benny betray you?" [DIAL:00153A23]

text_content: He's a snake, that's why. He owed us the rest of the pay for the job, so maybe he didn't want to pay up.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCJessupTopic041 "Why did Benny betray you?" [DIAL:00153A23]
speaker: BCJessup "Jessup" [NPC_:0010C0BE]

text_content: What do you know about the Platinum Chip?
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCJessupTopic039 "What do you know about the Platinum Chip?" [DIAL:00153A24]

text_content: Just a big, fancy poker chip as far as I know. Don't know why anyone would make one out of platinum, though.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCJessupTopic039 "What do you know about the Platinum Chip?" [DIAL:00153A24]
speaker: BCJessup "Jessup" [NPC_:0010C0BE]

text_content: Never mind. Let's talk about something else.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCJessupTopic037 "Never mind. Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:00153A25]

text_content: Fine.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCJessupTopic037 "Never mind. Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:00153A25]
speaker: BCJessup "Jessup" [NPC_:0010C0BE]

text_content: What can you tell me about Benny?
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCJessupTopic036 "What can you tell me about Benny?" [DIAL:00153A26]

text_content: He's one of the Chairmen, big shots who run The Tops casino in New Vegas. A friend from the city contacted me with info on a big job.|I should've known that the caps were too good to be true, but there was still no way I could pass up the chance.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCJessupTopic036 "What can you tell me about Benny?" [DIAL:00153A26]
speaker: BCJessup "Jessup" [NPC_:0010C0BE]

text_content: I want some more answers.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCJessupTopic035 "I want some more answers." [DIAL:00153A27]

text_content: Yeah? On what?
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCJessupTopic035 "I want some more answers." [DIAL:00153A27]
speaker: BCJessup "Jessup" [NPC_:0010C0BE]

text_content: Where's the Platinum Chip?
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCJessupTopic033 "Where's the Platinum Chip?" [DIAL:00153A28]

text_content: Don't have it. Benny stole it, right before he stabbed us in the back. He's probably back at the Strip by now, laughing at me.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCJessupTopic033 "Where's the Platinum Chip?" [DIAL:00153A28]
speaker: BCJessup "Jessup" [NPC_:0010C0BE]

text_content: I got better.
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCJessupTopic003 "I got better." [DIAL:00153A29]

text_content: And here I thought us Great Khans were tough to kill. So, what happens now?
name: VFreeformBoulderCityBCJessupTopic003 "I got better." [DIAL:00153A29]
speaker: BCJessup "Jessup" [NPC_:0010C0BE]

text_content: All right, get ready.
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic087 "All right, get ready." [DIAL:00153ACA]

text_content: {frustrated the player's taking so long}What ya talking about? I been ready!
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic087 "All right, get ready." [DIAL:00153ACA]
speaker: VFortBenny "Benny" [NPC_:001344BE]

text_content: How about I bust you out?
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic086 "How about I bust you out?" [DIAL:00153ACB]

text_content: About setting you free...
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic085 "About setting you free..." [DIAL:00153ACC]

text_content: Goodbye, Benny.
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic084 "Goodbye, Benny." [DIAL:00153ACD]

text_content: {enraged}Thanks for nothing, you fink!
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic084 "Goodbye, Benny." [DIAL:00153ACD]
speaker: VFortBenny "Benny" [NPC_:001344BE]

text_content: Time to die.
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic081 "Time to die." [DIAL:00153AD0]

text_content: You're next. Say your prayers.
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic075 "You're next. Say your prayers." [DIAL:00153AD1]

text_content: What happens if I let you go?
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic053 "What happens if I let you go?" [DIAL:00153AD2]

text_content: Baby, that can go any direction you want. We can take Vegas together, or I can head for the nearest sunset. Your call.
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic053 "What happens if I let you go?" [DIAL:00153AD2]
speaker: VFortBenny "Benny" [NPC_:001344BE]

text_content: I don't know how to open this cage...
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic052 "I don't know how to open this cage..." [DIAL:00153AD3]

text_content: I'm leaving you here.
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic051 "I'm leaving you here." [DIAL:00153AD4]

text_content: Baby, you can't just leave me tied up! Those Legion boys'll hoist me up on a cross for the mess you made - if I'm lucky!
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic051 "I'm leaving you here." [DIAL:00153AD4]
speaker: VFortBenny "Benny" [NPC_:001344BE]

text_content: Here, I'll set you free. <Untie Benny.>
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic050 "Here, I'll set you free. <Untie Benny.>" [DIAL:00153AD5]

text_content: That's it, baby! Time to vacate these premises!
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic050 "Here, I'll set you free. <Untie Benny.>" [DIAL:00153AD5]
speaker: VFortBenny "Benny" [NPC_:001344BE]

text_content: Actually... I'd rather kill you now.
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic048 "Actually... I'd rather kill you now." [DIAL:00153AD6]

text_content: {outraged}You fink! Murdering me like this, down on my knees?
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic048 "Actually... I'd rather kill you now." [DIAL:00153AD6]
speaker: VFortBenny "Benny" [NPC_:001344BE]

text_content: When the Legion showed up, we fought, most tribes did. Hangdogs hung out longer than most... {beat}broke us by throwing our dogs on the fire.|{A little quiet, to himself, painful memory - scornful he ever believed this}So we gave up, our elders couldn't bear the idea of our spirit animals burning in the afterlife.|{Rallies}Still, Caesar was impressed enough to conscript us, use our skills with dogs to join the Legion as houndmasters.

They're my life, always were - {pauses, thinking back, as if he's forgotten}all the way back when I was a tribal, one of the Hangdogs, outside Denver.|{Still thinking back}Dogs roamed that city. Our tribe made peace with them. {Scoffs, trying to dismiss painful memory}Thought they were our spirit animals - helped us hunt, provided for us in some lean times.|Then the Legion came. {Beat}Good thing, too. {Trying to convince himself}Stronger now, don't need those beliefs anymore.

text_content: Who's in charge of the Powder Gangers?

text_content: Right now, Eddie and his boys run the place. They've got the guns and the dynamite, so they call the shots.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFMeyersTopic006 "Who's in charge of the Powder Gangers?" [DIAL:00155DDB]

text_content: Why are you still here?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFMeyersTopic005 "Why are you still here?" [DIAL:00155DDC]

text_content: I'm not quite sure the kind of greeting NCR troopers will give an escaped con like myself. Figure it's better to stay put for now.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFMeyersTopic005 "Why are you still here?" [DIAL:00155DDC]

text_content: Where can I find Cooke?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFMeyersTopic004 "Where can I find Cooke?" [DIAL:00155DDD]

text_content: He went north with some of the other guys. Didn't say where, didn't say why. All I know is he's got some kind of score to settle with the NCR.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFMeyersTopic004 "Where can I find Cooke?" [DIAL:00155DDD]

text_content: Who's Cooke?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFMeyersTopic003 "Who's Cooke?" [DIAL:00155DDE]

text_content: Some kind of anti-NCR rebel. Some people just don't like being pushed around and told what to do.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFMeyersTopic003 "Who's Cooke?" [DIAL:00155DDE]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFMeyersTopic002 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00155DDF]

text_content: Watch yourself out there.
