speaker: NCRCFMeyers "Meyers" [NPC_:0008D0E7]

text_content: Tell me more about what happened in the prison.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFMeyersTopic001 "Tell me more about what happened in the prison." [DIAL:00155DE0]

text_content: I understand that Cooke was behind it all. I kept my head down the whole time. Didn't want any part of it.|I stuck around, figuring the NCR would show up and put things back the way they were. No sense in making myself look guilty, right?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFMeyersTopic001 "Tell me more about what happened in the prison." [DIAL:00155DE0]

text_content: What did you do before you ended up incarcerated?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFMeyersTopic000 "What did you do before you ended up incarcerated?" [DIAL:00155DE1]

text_content: I was a sheriff, believe it or not, for a small town far to the west of here.|The short version is that sometimes justice is a little slow, and I helped speed it up one too many times.|I'm not sorry for anything I did, but I will do the time. Fair enough trade, if you ask me.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFMeyersTopic000 "What did you do before you ended up incarcerated?" [DIAL:00155DE1]

text_content: How did you all manage to escape?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFHanniganTopic006 "How did you all manage to escape?" [DIAL:00155DE2]

text_content: One night, there was a big explosion from the other cell block. I had no idea what was going on, so I took cover in my bunk.|When it was all over, the guards were dead and we were free. Most of the other prisoners scattered, but a few of us stuck around, obviously.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFHanniganTopic006 "How did you all manage to escape?" [DIAL:00155DE2]

text_content: What's your reason for staying?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFHanniganTopic005 "What's your reason for staying?" [DIAL:00155DE3]

text_content: The location to the highway makes it a good spot to shake down any travelers passing through. That's why Eddie and the rest are still around.|Me, I like having big walls between myself and the wasteland.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFHanniganTopic005 "What's your reason for staying?" [DIAL:00155DE3]

text_content: What did you do before?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFHanniganTopic004 "What did you do before?" [DIAL:00155DE4]

text_content: Let's see... I've been a farmhand, a bouncer, a bandit, and an NCR trooper. I don't recommend any of them.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFHanniganTopic004 "What did you do before?" [DIAL:00155DE4]
speaker: NCRCFHannigan "Hannigan" [NPC_:000D71B6]

text_content: What did you do to end up in here?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFHanniganTopic003 "What did you do to end up in here?" [DIAL:00155DE5]

text_content: Medical supplies go for a decent amount of caps in the right markets. I figured the quartermaster wouldn't notice any missing. I was wrong.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFHanniganTopic003 "What did you do to end up in here?" [DIAL:00155DE5]
speaker: NCRCFHannigan "Hannigan" [NPC_:000D71B6]

text_content: Why are you "sort of" the doctor?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFHanniganTopic002 "Why are you ""sort of"" the doctor?" [DIAL:00155DE6]

text_content: I was an NCR medic for six months, so I'm not exactly a "doctor." Still, it's more medical training that any of the other guys here.|It also gives me an excuse to stay out of any raiding parties. The gang can't lose its only doctor now, can it?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFHanniganTopic002 "Why are you ""sort of"" the doctor?" [DIAL:00155DE6]

text_content: I need a doctor.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFHanniganTopic001 "I need a doctor." [DIAL:00155DE7]

text_content: The fact that you're still on your feet is... surprising.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFHanniganTopic001 "I need a doctor." [DIAL:00155DE7]

text_content: Life can be pretty rough sometimes.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFHanniganTopic001 "I need a doctor." [DIAL:00155DE7]

text_content: I've seen worse.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFHanniganTopic001 "I need a doctor." [DIAL:00155DE7]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFHanniganTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00155DE8]

text_content: Later.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFHanniganTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00155DE8]
speaker: NCRCFHannigan "Hannigan" [NPC_:000D71B6]

text_content: Why do you stay here?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFCarterTopic005 "Why do you stay here?" [DIAL:00155DE9]

text_content: Don't have any other place to go. I'd just end up back in another prison, or dead out in the wasteland.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFCarterTopic005 "Why do you stay here?" [DIAL:00155DE9]
speaker: NCRCFCarter "Carter" [NPC_:000CEF3B]

text_content: What can you tell me about this place?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFCarterTopic004 "What can you tell me about this place?" [DIAL:00155DEA]

text_content: This is where the NCR sent prisoners to "reform" through hard labor. I never saw much reforming around here, myself.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFCarterTopic004 "What can you tell me about this place?" [DIAL:00155DEA]
speaker: NCRCFCarter "Carter" [NPC_:000CEF3B]

text_content: What did you do to end up here in the first place?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFCarterTopic003 "What did you do to end up here in the first place?" [DIAL:00155DEB]

text_content: I worked in a casino in New Reno, and one of the pit bosses decided he didn't like me. Framed me over some caps, and I ended up in here.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFCarterTopic003 "What did you do to end up here in the first place?" [DIAL:00155DEB]
speaker: NCRCFCarter "Carter" [NPC_:000CEF3B]

text_content: You're a trader?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFCarterTopic002 "You're a trader?" [DIAL:00155DEC]

text_content: I was always the guy who could get things, if you know what I mean. Figured I might as well keep on doing it.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFCarterTopic002 "You're a trader?" [DIAL:00155DEC]
speaker: NCRCFCarter "Carter" [NPC_:000CEF3B]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFCarterTopic001 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00155DED]

text_content: See you.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFCarterTopic001 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00155DED]
speaker: NCRCFCarter "Carter" [NPC_:000CEF3B]

text_content: Show me what you have for sale.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFCarterTopic000 "Show me what you have for sale." [DIAL:00155DEE]

text_content: If I don't have anything you like, well... tough. I don't do special orders.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFCarterTopic000 "Show me what you have for sale." [DIAL:00155DEE]
speaker: NCRCFCarter "Carter" [NPC_:000CEF3B]

text_content: You got it.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFCarterTopic000 "Show me what you have for sale." [DIAL:00155DEE]
speaker: NCRCFCarter "Carter" [NPC_:000CEF3B]

name: VDialogueVegasNorthNorthVegasMrHostetlerTopic008 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00155E74]

text_content: What do you know about Cooke?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic016 "What do you know about Cooke?" [DIAL:00155ECF]

text_content: One mean son of a bitch. Really, truly hates the NCR for some reason, and he got a lot of the other guys around to his way of thinking.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic016 "What do you know about Cooke?" [DIAL:00155ECF]

text_content: Where is Cooke now?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic014 "Where is Cooke now?" [DIAL:00155ED1]

text_content: He and his crew went north. I heard talk about some sort of "big plan" to get back at the NCR, but haven't seen them since.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic014 "Where is Cooke now?" [DIAL:00155ED1]

text_content: What can you tell me about the prison?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic013 "What can you tell me about the prison?" [DIAL:00155ED2]

text_content: The NCR called it a "work-release" prison. We lucky prisoners got the privilege of fixing up the rail lines and blasting rock for new lines.|They got sloppy, though. Some of us managed to hide away some dynamite, and look who's in charge now.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic013 "What can you tell me about the prison?" [DIAL:00155ED2]

text_content: How did the breakout happen?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic012 "How did the breakout happen?" [DIAL:00155ED3]

text_content: It was all Cooke's idea. He and his boys managed to swipe some dynamite and hide it away in their cells.|The rest of us just tagged along. Cooke's crew headed north while the rest of us stuck around for payback.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic012 "How did the breakout happen?" [DIAL:00155ED3]

text_content: How did you end up in this place?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic011 "How did you end up in this place?" [DIAL:00155ED4]

text_content: Why do you care? Answer: you shouldn't. I don't feel like trading life stories.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic011 "How did you end up in this place?" [DIAL:00155ED4]

text_content: What am I looking for in Primm?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic009 "What am I looking for in Primm?" [DIAL:00155ED5]

text_content: I know the NCR has troops near Primm, so talk to the locals and find out if any of those troops are going to be coming our way.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic009 "What am I looking for in Primm?" [DIAL:00155ED5]
speaker: NCRCFEddie "Eddie" [NPC_:0008D0E9]

text_content: I got rid of him.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic008 "I got rid of him." [DIAL:00155ED6]

text_content: Good. Had him figured for NCR, one of the rangers maybe. Anyway, speaking of the NCR, I need you to take a walk down to Primm.|The NCR hasn't raised hell over our breakout, and I want to find out why. They're up to something, I can feel it.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic008 "I got rid of him." [DIAL:00155ED6]
speaker: NCRCFEddie "Eddie" [NPC_:0008D0E9]

text_content: What exactly is "funny" about that merchant you want me to check out?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic007 "What exactly is ""funny"" about that merchant you want me to check out?" [DIAL:00155ED7]

text_content: {Non-dummy}Most people already know we run this territory, and are usually in a hurry to get out. Not this guy. It's like he wants us to come get him.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic007 "What exactly is ""funny"" about that merchant you want me to check out?" [DIAL:00155ED7]
speaker: NCRCFEddie "Eddie" [NPC_:0008D0E9]

text_content: {Dummy}{annoyed a player's stupidity}Not "ha ha" funny, you moron. Funny as in suspicious. He's not trying to run away like most people.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic007 "What exactly is ""funny"" about that merchant you want me to check out?" [DIAL:00155ED7]
speaker: NCRCFEddie "Eddie" [NPC_:0008D0E9]

text_content: Chavez has been dealt with. You won't see him around here anymore.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic006 "Chavez has been dealt with. You won't see him around here anymore." [DIAL:00155ED8]

text_content: I'm happy you cleaned that up for me, but we've got another situation to worry about. There's a merchant hanging around near the prison.|Something feels funny about him, and I want you to deal with him. Shake him down if he's legit, but if he's not, take him out.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic006 "Chavez has been dealt with. You won't see him around here anymore." [DIAL:00155ED8]
speaker: NCRCFEddie "Eddie" [NPC_:0008D0E9]

text_content: What do you need done?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic001 "What do you need done?" [DIAL:00155EDD]

text_content: This is Powder Ganger territory - my territory. Most of the guys around here understand that. One, Chavez, doesn't.|Chavez formed his own crew and have been hitting traders on their own. Everybody I've sent after him either got killed or weren't able to catch him.|That leaves you. What do you say?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic001 "What do you need done?" [DIAL:00155EDD]
speaker: NCRCFEddie "Eddie" [NPC_:0008D0E9]

text_content: Nothing's changed. Chavez won't answer to me, but he and his crew operate in {emphasis "my"}my territory. Deal with him.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic001 "What do you need done?" [DIAL:00155EDD]
speaker: NCRCFEddie "Eddie" [NPC_:0008D0E9]

text_content: No.
name: VHDHouseBattleTopic001 "No." [DIAL:0015609B]

name: VHDHouseBattleTopic001 "No." [DIAL:0015609B]

name: VHDHouseBattleTopic000 "Yes." [DIAL:0015609C]

text_content: Let's proceed.
name: VHDHouseBattleTopic000 "Yes." [DIAL:0015609C]

text_content: VMS29KingAndPacerArgue
name: VMS29KingAndPacerArgue "VMS29KingAndPacerArgue" [DIAL:001563E9]

text_content: This is bullshit! Why are we even talking about dealing with these guys?
name: VMS29KingAndPacerArgue "VMS29KingAndPacerArgue" [DIAL:001563E9]

text_content: Pace, this isn't really a good time to have this discussion...
name: VMS29KingAndPacerArgue "VMS29KingAndPacerArgue" [DIAL:001563E9]

text_content: Wrong. This is exactly the right time. I'm about to prevent you from making a huge mistake.
name: VMS29KingAndPacerArgue "VMS29KingAndPacerArgue" [DIAL:001563E9]

text_content: Pace, don't do this. I won't stand with you if you do.
name: VMS29KingAndPacerArgue "VMS29KingAndPacerArgue" [DIAL:001563E9]

text_content: Then I'll stand on my own, just like I always have. Just like a King should.
name: VMS29KingAndPacerArgue "VMS29KingAndPacerArgue" [DIAL:001563E9]

text_content: Don't take that tone with me. These soldiers would wipe the floor with your men.
name: VMS29VFSTheKingTopic005 "Don't take that tone with me. These soldiers would wipe the floor with your men." [DIAL:001563EA]

text_content: Sounds like a challenge. Boys, let's do this!
name: VMS29VFSTheKingTopic005 "Don't take that tone with me. These soldiers would wipe the floor with your men." [DIAL:001563EA]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: I apologize for their rudeness. The NCR wants peace in Freeside, and offers additional supplies.
name: VMS29VFSTheKingTopic004 "I apologize for their rudeness. The NCR wants peace in Freeside, and offers additional supplies." [DIAL:001563EB]

text_content: And I suppose they want me to help see that happen? That seems pretty reasonable.
name: VMS29VFSTheKingTopic004 "I apologize for their rudeness. The NCR wants peace in Freeside, and offers additional supplies." [DIAL:001563EB]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: I've been instructed to offer you more resources in exchange for your word that the violence stops.
name: VMS29VFSTheKingTopic003 "I've been instructed to offer you more resources in exchange for your word that the violence stops." [DIAL:001563EC]

text_content: That sounds fair. And all I have to do is try to tone down the attacks on the Squatters, you say?
name: VMS29VFSTheKingTopic003 "I've been instructed to offer you more resources in exchange for your word that the violence stops." [DIAL:001563EC]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: VMS29KingOfferStart
name: VMS29KingOfferStart "VMS29KingOfferStart" [DIAL:001563ED]

text_content: Okay, I need some answers, now. These guys just barged in here and said they were under orders to keep me here until you arrived.|I'm about five seconds away from telling my men to take them down, so speak fast.
name: VMS29KingOfferStart "VMS29KingOfferStart" [DIAL:001563ED]

text_content: The ambassador didn't think Colonel Moore would handle the situation correctly.
name: VMS08ColonelHsuTopic031 "The ambassador didn't think Colonel Moore would handle the situation correctly." [DIAL:001563EE]

text_content: Moore's got her hands full right now, and she's not a subtle person in the best of times. Her solution would be quick and dirty.|I agree with Crocker that a more peaceful solution is preferable, especially for the long term.
name: VMS08ColonelHsuTopic031 "The ambassador didn't think Colonel Moore would handle the situation correctly." [DIAL:001563EE]
quest: VMS08 "I Put a Spell on You" [QUST:000E790F]
speaker: ColonelHsu "Col. James Hsu" [NPC_:000E8992]

text_content: He said you might have a better way of dealing with the issue.
name: VMS08ColonelHsuTopic030 "He said you might have a better way of dealing with the issue." [DIAL:001563EF]

text_content: Well, I do get to make the calls on the distribution of supplies there.|Crocker was probably counting on me being able to offer the Kings a carrot. And that's what I'm inclined to do.
name: VMS08ColonelHsuTopic030 "He said you might have a better way of dealing with the issue." [DIAL:001563EF]
quest: VMS08 "I Put a Spell on You" [QUST:000E790F]
speaker: ColonelHsu "Col. James Hsu" [NPC_:000E8992]

text_content: He said those were his official orders, but suggested seeing you anyway.
name: VMS08ColonelHsuTopic029 "He said those were his official orders, but suggested seeing you anyway." [DIAL:001563F0]

text_content: Because he's looking to avoid a bloodbath. I get it. He knows me.
name: VMS08ColonelHsuTopic029 "He said those were his official orders, but suggested seeing you anyway." [DIAL:001563F0]
quest: VMS08 "I Put a Spell on You" [QUST:000E790F]
speaker: ColonelHsu "Col. James Hsu" [NPC_:000E8992]

text_content: All right. Moore's not gonna like it. But that's for Crocker to worry about.|Go to the leader of the Kings and tell him that I'll make sure Freeside gets more water, power, and food as long as the violence there stops.
name: VMS08ColonelHsuTopic029 "He said those were his official orders, but suggested seeing you anyway." [DIAL:001563F0]
quest: VMS08 "I Put a Spell on You" [QUST:000E790F]
speaker: ColonelHsu "Col. James Hsu" [NPC_:000E8992]

text_content: Ambassador Crocker said to come see you about the situation with the Kings in Freeside.
name: VMS08ColonelHsuTopic028 "Ambassador Crocker said to come see you about the situation with the Kings in Freeside." [DIAL:001563F1]

text_content: Ah, that. I'm surprised he didn't send you to Colonel Moore. That'd be her jurisdiction.
name: VMS08ColonelHsuTopic028 "Ambassador Crocker said to come see you about the situation with the Kings in Freeside." [DIAL:001563F1]
quest: VMS08 "I Put a Spell on You" [QUST:000E790F]
speaker: ColonelHsu "Col. James Hsu" [NPC_:000E8992]

text_content: I've already received a communique from Colonel Moore saying that she's sent a squad down to Freeside.|If you'd come to me first, I might have been able to do something. But at this point, my hands are tied. Sorry.
name: VMS08ColonelHsuTopic028 "Ambassador Crocker said to come see you about the situation with the Kings in Freeside." [DIAL:001563F1]
quest: VMS08 "I Put a Spell on You" [QUST:000E790F]
speaker: ColonelHsu "Col. James Hsu" [NPC_:000E8992]

name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic042 "Let's take our chances. <Untie Benny.>" [DIAL:001564F3]

text_content: Let's take our chances. <Untie Benny.>
name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic004 "Let's take our chances. <Untie Benny.>" [DIAL:001564F4]

name: VDialogueBennyVFortBennyTopic004 "Let's take our chances. <Untie Benny.>" [DIAL:001564F4]
speaker: VFortBenny "Benny" [NPC_:001344BE]

text_content: You invited me and promised safe-conduct.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic002 "You invited me and promised safe-conduct." [DIAL:001564F5]

text_content: No, I came to decorate this tent with your guts.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic001 "No, I came to decorate this tent with your guts." [DIAL:001564F6]

text_content: VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade
name: VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade "VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:001564F7]

text_content: Step closer to the demonstration area, if you would...
name: VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade "VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:001564F7]

text_content: I expect you're well familiar with my Securitrons by now.
name: VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade "VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:001564F7]

text_content: The titanium alloy housing that protects its electronic core deflects small arms and shrapnel easily enough...
name: VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade "VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:001564F7]

text_content: Its X-25 gatling laser, produced to spec by Glastinghouse, Inc., is deadly  against soft targets at medium range...
name: VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade "VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:001564F7]

text_content: And for close-range suppression or crowd control, the Securitron is armed with a 9mm submachinegun.
name: VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade "VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:001564F7]

text_content: All of this, you probably already knew...
name: VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade "VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:001564F7]

text_content: What you did not know is that these are the Securitrons' {emphasis}secondary weapons.
name: VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade "VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:001564F7]

text_content: All this time, my Securitrons have had to get by running the Mark I operating system, which lacked software drivers for their primary weapons!
name: VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade "VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:001564F7]

text_content: Today, with the delivery of the Platinum Chip, all that changes. Behold, for the first time, Securitrons running the Mark II OS!
name: VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade "VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:001564F7]

text_content: The M-235 Missile Launcher gives the Securitron the ability to engage ground and air targets at significantly longer ranges...
name: VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade "VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:001564F7]

text_content: And a rapid-fire G-28 grenade launching system ensures the Securitron is deadly in close-range engagements.
name: VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade "VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:001564F7]

text_content: The software upgrade also includes drivers for the Securitrons' highly sophisticated onboard auto-repair systems.
name: VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade "VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:001564F7]

text_content: All together, the Mark II {emphasis}software upgrade confers a 235% increase in combat effectiveness per unit.
name: VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade "VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:001564F7]

text_content: The city of New Vegas finally has soldiers worthy of protecting it!
name: VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade "VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:001564F7]

text_content: Return to the penthouse now. We have much to discuss...
name: VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade "VDialogueMrHouseSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:001564F7]

text_content: vDialogueMrHouseLastWillTestament
name: vDialogueMrHouseLastWillTestament "vDialogueMrHouseLastWillTestament" [DIAL:001564F8]

text_content: If this statement is being broadcast, I am deceased. Please approach a Securitron and take one of the printed obituaries.
name: vDialogueMrHouseLastWillTestament "vDialogueMrHouseLastWillTestament" [DIAL:001564F8]

text_content: I, Robert Edwin House, am deceased. Please approach a Securitron and take one of the printed obituaries.
name: vDialogueMrHouseLastWillTestament "vDialogueMrHouseLastWillTestament" [DIAL:001564F8]

text_content: I should be going.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic004 "I should be going." [DIAL:00156504]

text_content: <Lie> Sure, what about the place?
name: VMS29VStreetDennisCrockerTopic034 "<Lie> Sure, what about the place?" [DIAL:00156507]

text_content: Violence is something of a way of life there, but there's been a disturbing rise in the number of attacks on our people lately.|More worrying is the fact that our sources suggest the violence is being perpetrated by the gang that runs the place, the Kings.|I need someone to look into this that won't attract attention. Would you be interested?
name: VMS29VStreetDennisCrockerTopic034 "<Lie> Sure, what about the place?" [DIAL:00156507]
speaker: VStreetDennisCrocker "Ambassador Dennis Crocker" [NPC_:00112640]

text_content: <Lie> No, I haven't.
name: VMS29VStreetDennisCrockerTopic033 "<Lie> No, I haven't." [DIAL:00156508]

text_content: It's a beastly place. Poverty is rampant, and all that goes with it - drugs, alcohol abuse, the usual.
name: VMS29VStreetDennisCrockerTopic033 "<Lie> No, I haven't." [DIAL:00156508]
speaker: VStreetDennisCrocker "Ambassador Dennis Crocker" [NPC_:00112640]

text_content: I have a better idea. Why don't I just take all my caps back from your corpse?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSRotfaceTopic041 "I have a better idea. Why don't I just take all my caps back from your corpse?" [DIAL:001566F6]

text_content: You're welcome to try.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSRotfaceTopic041 "I have a better idea. Why don't I just take all my caps back from your corpse?" [DIAL:001566F6]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: I'm not giving you my caps.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSRotfaceTopic040 "I'm not giving you my caps." [DIAL:001566F7]

text_content: Then you give me no choice.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSRotfaceTopic040 "I'm not giving you my caps." [DIAL:001566F7]
speaker: VFSRotface "Rotface" [NPC_:0010C683]

text_content: Why are you doing this?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSRotfaceTopic039 "Why are you doing this?" [DIAL:001566F8]

text_content: Man, I'm tired of scrounging for caps from ungrateful idiots like you. It's past time I moved on to bigger and better things.|Now are you going to hand over your caps, or am I going to shoot you and take them anyway?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSRotfaceTopic039 "Why are you doing this?" [DIAL:001566F8]

text_content: We had packed the old city with C4 and dynamite. Crude, but it did the job. Those who didn't die in the blast were in no position to mount a defense.|The ones left on the dam didn't know what to do. The troopers routed them. Graham pulled the remaining legionaries back, but the battle was over.|He went south, back to the Grand Canyon, back to Caesar. And that was the last we saw or heard from Joshua Graham.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic099 "[Continue]" [DIAL:00156EE0]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: [Continue]
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic098 "[Continue]" [DIAL:00156EE1]

text_content: Caused total chaos among the younger legionaries, and Oliver's troopers fell back to the side walkways and stayed out of the veterans' way.|By the time the veterans got to the ridge, we were already in Boulder City.|They followed us down there, but we were out before they realized what was happening.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic098 "[Continue]" [DIAL:00156EE1]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: [Continue]
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic097 "[Continue]" [DIAL:00156EE2]

text_content: But once they were in, they were stuck there. Oliver's troopers were entrenched and wouldn't give a foot.|That's when we ordered the rangers and 1st recon sharpshooters to start picking off veteran legion officers from a high ridge west of the dam.|That only lasted about a minute before Graham ordered the back ranks to push through to the front and rush the ridge.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic097 "[Continue]" [DIAL:00156EE2]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: [Continue]
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic096 "[Continue]" [DIAL:00156EE3]

text_content: Joshua Graham, Caesar's old legate, he's wasn't so flexible.|When the Legion attacked Hoover Dam, General Oliver ordered his troopers back to the middle ground just after first contact.|Graham pushed all of the legionaries onto the dam, filling the east side with recruits up front and veterans in the back, by the book.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic096 "[Continue]" [DIAL:00156EE3]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: [Continue]
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic095 "[Continue]" [DIAL:00156EE4]

text_content: I told him we would take them back into NCR territory because we had already lost ten rangers on the way out. Ten rangers, five men with .308 rifles.|Well, that was enough for them. They packed up what they could and we took them back north. Last I heard, they settled somewhere in {ahn-zah}Anza-{boh-reh-goh}Borrego.|Raised Bighorners. Had some tough times, but it worked out okay for them. So there you go. That's my one bit of good.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic095 "[Continue]" [DIAL:00156EE4]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: [Continue]
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic094 "[Continue]" [DIAL:00156EE5]

text_content: They had planted an NCR flag over the well and they would not budge until every last one of them was laid out, dead and cold.|So I walked up and told them there was a group of raiders coming, one hundred strong. {laughing a bit}I made up some cockamamie name for them and everything. |The men looked at each other, looked at us, and asked me what we were going to do about it.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic094 "[Continue]" [DIAL:00156EE5]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: [Continue]
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic093 "[Continue]" [DIAL:00156EE6]

text_content: There's over two dozen bodies lying in the dunes way outside of town and five men with {three-oh-eight}.308 rifles crouched behind sand bags.|And these bodies, these people out in the sand, they aren't raiders. Aren't even heavily armed.|They're just people who were trying to get to the only well in fifty miles. I didn't have to talk to the men to see that they did not care one bit.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic093 "[Continue]" [DIAL:00156EE6]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: [Continue]
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic092 "[Continue]" [DIAL:00156EE7]

text_content: Word got back to one of our stations that raiders had been attacking the place. I went out with six rangers.|We must have been on the trail for a week before we got to Rattletail. We lost one woman to Night Stalkers and another almost died of dehydration.|When we reach the place, it's six shacks set up around an old well.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic092 "[Continue]" [DIAL:00156EE7]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: So what happened at Hoover Dam and Boulder City?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic091 "So what happened at Hoover Dam and Boulder City?" [DIAL:00156EE8]

text_content: In big battles, Caesar deploys his legionaries in waves. Recruits up front, prime soldiers behind the recruits, old guard bringing up the rear.|Opponents wear themselves out dealing with the first two waves, if they survive that long. When the veterans step up, there's not much fight left.|Caesar can adapt, though, and when required, he can run any mix of legionaries as skirmishers and still retain order in the ranks.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic091 "So what happened at Hoover Dam and Boulder City?" [DIAL:00156EE8]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Come on. You must have lots of stories.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic090 "Come on. You must have lots of stories." [DIAL:00156EE9]

text_content: [FAILED] I do, but I'm tired of telling them. Time changes how you look at things.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic090 "Come on. You must have lots of stories." [DIAL:00156EE9]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: There must be something good the rangers have done that you're proud of.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic089 "There must be something good the rangers have done that you're proud of." [DIAL:00156EEA]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] It's kind of a long one, but all right. About twenty, twenty-five years ago, a group of NCR settlers pushed way south into Baja.|I guess it doesn't seem so far now if you look at a map, but back then, they were out a ways.|They built this little shanty town around a well in the middle of nowhere. Called it {rat-ul-tayl}Rattletail.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic089 "There must be something good the rangers have done that you're proud of." [DIAL:00156EEA]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: What are you actually doing?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic088 "What are you actually doing?" [DIAL:00156EEB]

text_content: Sitting on the shore of Lake Mead, looking east. Listening to a radio. Trying to not get too many people killed.|I'm too old to be slapping leather, but I had hoped for something else. More than this, anyway.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic088 "What are you actually doing?" [DIAL:00156EEB]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Okay, what are you supposed to be doing?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic087 "Okay, what are you supposed to be doing?" [DIAL:00156EEC]

text_content: "To protect against all forms of tyranny." As simple as that. Thirty, forty years ago, the wasteland was full of despots.|Slavers. Raiders. Tough-talking hoodlums with gangs who liked to kick around towns. Back then the NCR military was still young.|Couldn't cover much ground. It took groups like ours to tip the balance back to the good guys.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic087 "Okay, what are you supposed to be doing?" [DIAL:00156EEC]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Why are the rangers here?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic086 "Why are the rangers here?" [DIAL:00156EED]

text_content: There's a lot of answers to that question, but it started with the Ranger Unification Treaty. We weren't always the only show in town.|Nevada had its own posse, the Desert Rangers. They fought Caesar even farther east, out in Arizona. Didn't go well for them.|Years back, we met with the Desert Rangers at Mojave Outpost and agreed to help them against Caesar if they would join the NCR.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic086 "Why are the rangers here?" [DIAL:00156EED]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: What do the rangers do?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic085 "What do the rangers do?" [DIAL:00156EEE]

text_content: Well, there's what we're supposed to be doing and what we're actually doing.|There's a big gap between those two things, about as wide as that lake out there.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic085 "What do the rangers do?" [DIAL:00156EEE]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: How long have you been in the rangers?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic084 "How long have you been in the rangers?" [DIAL:00156EEF]

text_content: Oh, well. I guess it must be coming up on... forty years or so. Back before {eh-leez}Elise was chief, anyway. It was a heck of a lot harder then.|Weren't as many of us to go around. But I think it was a lot easier to tell the good guys from the bad.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic084 "How long have you been in the rangers?" [DIAL:00156EEF]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Have any good stories to tell?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic083 "Have any good stories to tell?" [DIAL:00156EF0]

text_content: Suppose it depends on what you think is "good." Most folks want to hear about Hoover Dam and Boulder City, but it's a long story.|If you want some tall tales about hunting down slavers or busting up gangs, talk to one of the younger rangers.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic083 "Have any good stories to tell?" [DIAL:00156EF0]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Who are the praetorians?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic082 "Who are the praetorians?" [DIAL:00156EF1]

text_content: Caesar's elite guard. They travel with him wherever he goes. A bit of insurance in case any of his guests get funny ideas.|They aren't the toughest legionaries, but they're the most devoted to Caesar. They believe in everything the Legion stands for.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic082 "Who are the praetorians?" [DIAL:00156EF1]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Tell me about centurions.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic081 "Tell me about centurions." [DIAL:00156EF2]

text_content: There's no real equivalent to them in the NCR. Centurions are battle-born, elite officers who earned their rank with blood and sweat.|They wear special outfits, too, pieced together from the armor of all their defeated enemies. Good commanders, tough opponents.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic081 "Tell me about centurions." [DIAL:00156EF2]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: What makes the veterans so tough?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic080 "What makes the veterans so tough?" [DIAL:00156EF3]

text_content: Take a regular legionary and age him ten years. Whatever they lose to age they make up for with experience. Life expectancy isn't long in the Legion.|You live ten years in Caesar's army, you're a force to be reckoned with.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic080 "What makes the veterans so tough?" [DIAL:00156EF3]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Was Graham a good commander?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic079 "Was Graham a good commander?" [DIAL:00156EF4]

text_content: He wasn't a brilliant strategist. Wasn't tactically flexible, either. There was something about him, though. Menace, indestructibility.|It made everyone afraid of him. Heck, the praetorians burned Graham four years ago and some of the tribes are still afraid of him.|They say the Burned Man still walks the land, blackens the earth wherever he sets foot.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic079 "Was Graham a good commander?" [DIAL:00156EF4]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: How bad was Graham?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic078 "How bad was Graham?" [DIAL:00156EF5]

text_content: He was a missionary from Utah who hooked up with Caesar at the Grand Canyon, became his translator.|Graham helped Caesar with the Blackfoots after they got captured together. Up until Hoover Dam, he was Caesar's legate.|You wouldn't think a man of god could turn so brutal. Cruel to his opponents. Did the sort of things that make you sick to talk about.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic078 "How bad was Graham?" [DIAL:00156EF5]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Why do they call Lanius the Monster of the East?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic077 "Why do they call Lanius the Monster of the East?" [DIAL:00156EF6]

text_content: Oh, the usual reasons. People say he's enormous, carries a big sword, chops peoples' heads off. That's not what makes him a good commander, though.|Folks say he came from a heck of a tough tribe, took Caesar a long time to conquer. It was thanks to Lanius.|But once Caesar broke him, he was born again. He'll go anywhere and do anything to win. Legion says he can smell weakness.|Once he finds out where an army's vulnerable, he'll go to it like a dog for the throat.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic077 "Why do they call Lanius the Monster of the East?" [DIAL:00156EF6]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: [Continue]
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic076 "[Continue]" [DIAL:00156EF7]

text_content: I can't say I think the legionaries at Cottonwood deserved the same fate, but what's done is done.|Thanks to you, that's one less pack of slavers for people to worry about.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic076 "[Continue]" [DIAL:00156EF7]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: [Continue]
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic075 "[Continue]" [DIAL:00156EF8]

text_content: By the way, I appreciate what you did for the troopers down there.|Nelson might not be the most strategically important place, but taking Dead Sea out means a lot to them.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic075 "[Continue]" [DIAL:00156EF8]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: What happened at Searchlight?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic074 "What happened at Searchlight?" [DIAL:00156EF9]

text_content: Searchlight was worse. One of Caesar's {froo-men-tar-ee}frumentarii must have found something in there, flooded the whole camp with radiation.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic074 "What happened at Searchlight?" [DIAL:00156EF9]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Tell me about Nelson.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic073 "Tell me about Nelson." [DIAL:00156EFA]

text_content: Nelson was barely set up. We had a big stretch of unprotected land between Forlorn Hope and Searchlight, and Nelson was the solution.|A {deh-can-us}decanus named Dead Sea took the place and caused a lot of damage.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic073 "Tell me about Nelson." [DIAL:00156EFA]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Tell me about the heavy troopers.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic072 "Tell me about the heavy troopers." [DIAL:00156EFB]

text_content: They have the best equipment the NCR can get its hands on, power armor salvaged from our war with the Brotherhood.|Techs strip out the joint servos so you don't need special training to wear it.|It feels like you're carrying a Brahmin on your back, but it can take a heck of a lot of punishment.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic072 "Tell me about the heavy troopers." [DIAL:00156EFB]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: What do the new rangers mean for NCR?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic071 "What do the new rangers mean for NCR?" [DIAL:00156EFC]

text_content: The Baja rangers can do more advance night scouting and sharpshooting to assist the troopers.|Ranger combat helmets are old Pre-War gear. They have built in low-light optics. Makes a big difference.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic071 "What do the new rangers mean for NCR?" [DIAL:00156EFC]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Is Moore in charge of all the NCR troopers out here?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic070 "Is Moore in charge of all the NCR troopers out here?" [DIAL:00156EFD]

text_content: No, and thanks to General Oliver for that. Colonel {shoo}Hsu is at McCarran. Most of the New Vegas troopers are under his command.|He's more sympathetic to the locals than Moore, but he's got the Fiends to deal with.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic070 "Is Moore in charge of all the NCR troopers out here?" [DIAL:00156EFD]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: No, and thanks to General Oliver for that.  Colonel {shoo}Hsu is at McCarran. Most of the New Vegas troopers are under his command.|He's more sympathetic to the locals than Moore. Now that the Fiends aren't giving him grief, we should see more troopers assigned to the front lines.|Good work on that, by the way. Hope you got good bounties out of it.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic070 "Is Moore in charge of all the NCR troopers out here?" [DIAL:00156EFD]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Colonel Moore's "way"?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic069 "Colonel Moore's ""way""?" [DIAL:00156EFE]

text_content: The colonel is an effective commander - one of the best - but she sharpened her claws on the Vipers and the old Jackals.|Did four tours against the Brotherhood, too. She used to be ranger until an injury took her out of action. Happens to a lot of us, unfortunately.|She's better at making graves than making friends. Bring in Moore and the earth will be razed. Fields will be salted.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic069 "Colonel Moore's ""way""?" [DIAL:00156EFE]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Tell me about General Oliver.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic068 "Tell me about General Oliver." [DIAL:00156EFF]

text_content: Oh, well... now, you'll have to excuse me. The general and I don't always see eye to eye on things.|Maybe it's best that I just say that he is a trooper, through and through. The man will not give up an inch for anything, least of all to the Legion.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic068 "Tell me about General Oliver." [DIAL:00156EFF]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: What about the troopers?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic067 "What about the troopers?" [DIAL:00156F00]

text_content: You've seen it yourself. Some of them don't even have proper service rifles or armor.|Our heavy infantry, power armor units, they're back in NCR territory protecting the interests of Brahmin barons against small-time raiders.|Brahmin barons only have one vote at the ballot box, but they have a lot of money to throw around.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic067 "What about the troopers?" [DIAL:00156F00]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: What's going on in Baja?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic066 "What's going on in Baja?" [DIAL:00156F01]

text_content: It's complicated. Goes way back. I told President Kimball that we need more rangers here.|He accepted that, but took the most experienced ones and sent them south. Patrol rangers are good men and women, but we're about to fight a war.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic066 "What's going on in Baja?" [DIAL:00156F01]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Why are funds tied up at the Boneyard?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic065 "Why are funds tied up at the Boneyard?" [DIAL:00156F02]

text_content: Senate elections are coming up. Local representatives don't want to push any more funding to the Mojave campaign because it's unpopular.|Most of the folks around the Boneyard haven't been to New Vegas and probably never will.|All they know is that their money gets sucked away to this desert and their brothers, sisters, sons, and daughters die here.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic065 "Why are funds tied up at the Boneyard?" [DIAL:00156F02]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: So that was the end of Graham?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic064 "So that was the end of Graham?" [DIAL:00156F03]

text_content: It's not that clear cut. You have to understand, Graham was the toughest son of a gun anyone around these parts had ever seen.|Before Hoover, we had five kill reports on Graham from rangers and 1st Recon sharpshooters who tried to take him out.|Some folks think he's still alive, call him the Burned Man.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic064 "So that was the end of Graham?" [DIAL:00156F03]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Are the Blackfoots part of the Legion?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic063 "Are the Blackfoots part of the Legion?" [DIAL:00156F04]

text_content: Yes and no. The Blackfoots don't exist anymore, just like any other tribe that gets swallowed by the Legion.|Caesar takes the tribal out of the tribe. Scrapes and burns off tattoos, breaks up families, forces mixed breeding so all the old loyalties die away.|The only tribe in the Legion is the Legion. Caesar is their chief, father, and god all rolled into one.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic063 "Are the Blackfoots part of the Legion?" [DIAL:00156F04]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: What happened to Graham after Hoover Dam?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic062 "What happened to Graham after Hoover Dam?" [DIAL:00156F05]

text_content: Losing the dam was the worst defeat the Legion ever suffered. Graham had been with Caesar since the beginning, but he had to set an example.|The praetorians covered Graham in pitch, lit him on fire, and down into the Grand Canyon he went.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic062 "What happened to Graham after Hoover Dam?" [DIAL:00156F05]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: How did a Follower wind up becoming Caesar?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic061 "How did a Follower wind up becoming Caesar?" [DIAL:00156F06]

text_content: Somewhere along the way, he realized he needed to educate the Blackfoots or they were going to get wiped out with the rest of the tribe.|Showed them how to use guns, how to make explosives. Once he taught the Blackfoots a thing or two, they needed him.|And he no longer needed the Followers, NCR, or anyone else. He decided he could remake the tribes of the southwest, whether they wanted it or not.|He became Caesar and Joshua Graham became his legate, his right hand. And that's where Graham stayed until Hoover Dam.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic061 "How did a Follower wind up becoming Caesar?" [DIAL:00156F06]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Where did he go?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic060 "Where did he go?" [DIAL:00156F07]

text_content: Out to the Grand Canyon. He met a missionary from Utah, a man by the name of Joshua Graham. Graham helped translate for the Followers and the tribes.|All three of them got nabbed by the Blackfoots down there, back when they were still at war with every other tribe in the southwest.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic060 "Where did he go?" [DIAL:00156F07]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Fires?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic059 "Fires?" [DIAL:00156F08]

text_content: Legion fires. They burn high wherever the Legion goes.|Caesar's a hard man to figure out, but he always wants you to know when more troops are at your front door.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic059 "Fires?" [DIAL:00156F08]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Doesn't matter. Your time's up, Hanlon.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic058 "Doesn't matter. Your time's up, Hanlon." [DIAL:00156F09]

text_content: Well, you got that right.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic058 "Doesn't matter. Your time's up, Hanlon." [DIAL:00156F09]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Fine. I'll turn you in.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic057 "Fine. I'll turn you in." [DIAL:00156F0A]

text_content: I can't let you do this. I have to turn you in.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic056 "I can't let you do this. I have to turn you in." [DIAL:00156F0B]

text_content: You've convinced me. Your secret is safe.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic055 "You've convinced me. Your secret is safe." [DIAL:00156F0C]

text_content: I don't know if you're working for Caesar or if desperation's made me a heck of a lot more persuasive. Either way, this is the right thing to do.|Now, I trust we're done discussing this. I'm going to step through that door and pretend like we never had this talk.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic055 "You've convinced me. Your secret is safe." [DIAL:00156F0C]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Caesar is sick. Like... really sick. He could drop any day.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic054 "Caesar is sick. Like... really sick. He could drop any day." [DIAL:00156F0D]

text_content: Caesar's dead. What more do you need?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic053 "Caesar's dead. What more do you need?" [DIAL:00156F0E]

text_content: {a little angry}The Legion is more than just Caesar! It's got the momentum of thousands of men behind it.|They're not just going to roll off into Arizona if we give them a good shove.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic053 "Caesar's dead. What more do you need?" [DIAL:00156F0E]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Caesar's sick. He won't live long. The Legion will fall apart a few years after he's gone.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic052 "Caesar's sick. He won't live long. The Legion will fall apart a few years after he's gone." [DIAL:00156F0F]

text_content: Caesar's dead. The Legion can't hold itself together for five years, much less ten.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic051 "Caesar's dead. The Legion can't hold itself together for five years, much less ten." [DIAL:00156F10]

text_content: It's a gamble either way. Even with Caesar gone, we still might not outlast the Legion. I suppose that's a risk I'll have to take.|For our sake, I hope you're right. I guess I should thank you for bringing me to my senses. So... thanks.|Now, if you'll excuse me, I'm going to walk out that door and pretend we never had this talk.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic051 "Caesar's dead. The Legion can't hold itself together for five years, much less ten." [DIAL:00156F10]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: That's crazy.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic050 "That's crazy." [DIAL:00156F11]

text_content: Maybe fifty rangers will die on that dam. We lose over a thousand troopers every year. Being here is crazy. Getting out's the only sane thing to do.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic050 "That's crazy." [DIAL:00156F11]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: What about you and the rangers?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic049 "What about you and the rangers?" [DIAL:00156F12]

text_content: Rangers are volunteers. Every man and woman who signs up is willing to die for the NCR, myself included.|A lot of this is my fault. It's only right that I stand with them.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic049 "What about you and the rangers?" [DIAL:00156F12]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: What will you do if I don't turn you in?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic048 "What will you do if I don't turn you in?" [DIAL:00156F13]

text_content: Oliver can't stand that rangers got credit for victory at Hoover. Whatever I recommend, he does the opposite. I said I wanted them on the ridge.|He put them right on the western part of the dam itself. We don't have enough firepower to hold that spot.|If the troopers fall back, and they will, the rangers will advance to cover Oliver's retreat. We lose the dam, Oliver and the senate are ruined.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic048 "What will you do if I don't turn you in?" [DIAL:00156F13]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Too bad. I'm turning you in.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic047 "Too bad. I'm turning you in." [DIAL:00156F14]

text_content: Fair enough. You want to do this the right way, go get one of the rangers. Don't worry. I'm not gonna run out on you.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic047 "Too bad. I'm turning you in." [DIAL:00156F14]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: But what does that accomplish?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic046 "But what does that accomplish?" [DIAL:00156F15]

text_content: {pause, quieter}Creating fear and instability among the troopers without causing harm, it's the only thing I could think of to shake things up.|It took some people getting killed to realize I had gone too far. I had to stop.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic046 "But what does that accomplish?" [DIAL:00156F15]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: You're dead.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic044 "You're dead." [DIAL:00156F16]

text_content: Hold on. This is ranger headquarters. There might be a dozen rangers within earshot.|Think twice before you decide to give the old chief a gut full of lead.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic044 "You're dead." [DIAL:00156F16]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: What do you think I should do about this?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic043 "What do you think I should do about this?" [DIAL:00156F17]

text_content: First thing that comes to mind is to turn me in. But that might not be the best play, all things considered.|Even if your heart's in the right place, I reckon it might do a lot more harm than good.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic043 "What do you think I should do about this?" [DIAL:00156F17]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: How does spreading false intel help anything?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic042 "How does spreading false intel help anything?" [DIAL:00156F18]

text_content: {exasperated}People back home don't listen. They don't care. Senators, Brahmin barons, folks who are just trying to make it from day to day.|It's been so many years that people forget about it. Conscription brings in fresh troops to die here every month. Like it's routine.|{getting more worked up}And even if we hold this dam, what then? Are we going to send the NCR's men and women to die here for another five years? Ten?|Patrol the whole length of the Colorado for hundreds of miles? Holding this dam. {pause, downbeat}It'll be the death of us.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic042 "How does spreading false intel help anything?" [DIAL:00156F18]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Aren't you fighting for the people of New Vegas?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic041 "Aren't you fighting for the people of New Vegas?" [DIAL:00156F19]

text_content: We're fighting on their behalf, but Mr. House and the families are stringing us up, inch by inch.|They'll drain us dry while we fight and die over this dam. We offered them sanctuary in NCR territory before, but they won't listen.|Troopers and rangers have been dying here for more than five years while the families sit pretty behind that... damned wall.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic041 "Aren't you fighting for the people of New Vegas?" [DIAL:00156F19]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Why did you do it?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic040 "Why did you do it?" [DIAL:00156F1A]

text_content: It's never going to end. This fight with Caesar. People back home don't know what these young men and women are in for.|The Legion is the worst enemy we've ever faced, but we can't stop Caesar here, not without getting a lot of good people killed.|More than anyone cares to count up. And even if we do stop him, I don't see how we're ever going to be able to pull out.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic040 "Why did you do it?" [DIAL:00156F1A]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: But you're inventing your own intelligence reports. I've seen the logs and talked to the rangers.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic039 "But you're inventing your own intelligence reports. I've seen the logs and talked to the rangers." [DIAL:00156F1B]

text_content: {smiling a bit}You have, have you? {Beat, more somber}Misdirection. When you're pinned down, outnumbered, and two days from any help, it's just about the best friend you can have.|Misdirection's what's saved me all these years. It's what saved us at Hoover Dam. But it's been five years now and {see-zar's}Caesar's right across that lake.|He's closer now than he ever was before. {bit angry}I was a young man once. I know what it's like to want to fight for your home, but this isn't it.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic039 "But you're inventing your own intelligence reports. I've seen the logs and talked to the rangers." [DIAL:00156F1B]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Why don't the ranger stations send the intel directly to the troopers?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic038 "Why don't the ranger stations send the intel directly to the troopers?" [DIAL:00156F1C]

text_content: Comm rangers might have an incomplete picture of the situation. There's a lot going on out there.|Intel needs to be coordinated through Golf so we can verify and advise appropriately.|Troopers have enough to deal with. We don't want them questioning their intel.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic038 "Why don't the ranger stations send the intel directly to the troopers?" [DIAL:00156F1C]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: How do you coordinate the intel?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic037 "How do you coordinate the intel?" [DIAL:00156F1D]

text_content: It's a simple system, when it works. Patrol rangers radio intel to ranger stations.|Comm rangers send the intel up the station chain until it reaches Camp Golf.|Then I or one of the other rangers on duty organize the data, evaluate it, and send information to camps or troopers in the field.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic037 "How do you coordinate the intel?" [DIAL:00156F1D]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Can you give me any advice?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic036 "Can you give me any advice?" [DIAL:00156F1E]

text_content: Well... {thinking}the logical thing to do is to check with the patrol rangers and comm officers. Don't be too discouraged if some things don't match up.|Different people see different things, and sometimes the meaning gets twisted, lost in static from person to person.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic036 "Can you give me any advice?" [DIAL:00156F1E]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Do you know anything about the problems?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic035 "Do you know anything about the problems?" [DIAL:00156F1F]

text_content: I don't know Technical Sergeant {ray-ess}Reyes, but coordinating intel can be messy sometimes. Things get mixed up, people get confused.|Heck, I get confused and I've been doing this for a long time now. What he - or she - sees as a problem might be standard operating procedure.|That's not to say Reyes is wrong for being concerned, but it's easy for the sand to get in your eyes out here.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic035 "Do you know anything about the problems?" [DIAL:00156F1F]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: I know you're the one who's been manipulating intelligence data.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic034 "I know you're the one who's been manipulating intelligence data." [DIAL:00156F20]

text_content: Hold on. If we're going to have this conversation, let's go somewhere more private.|{joking a bit}Don't worry. Not much bite left in this old dog.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic034 "I know you're the one who's been manipulating intelligence data." [DIAL:00156F20]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: I'm investigating some intel problems for Technical Sergeant Reyes.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic033 "I'm investigating some intel problems for Technical Sergeant Reyes." [DIAL:00156F21]

text_content: Interesting that she would wrangle someone else into sorting out the problem. |But I suppose you're in the right place. A lot of intel comes through here.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic033 "I'm investigating some intel problems for Technical Sergeant Reyes." [DIAL:00156F21]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: This again? All right. What do you want to know?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic033 "I'm investigating some intel problems for Technical Sergeant Reyes." [DIAL:00156F21]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Do you ever stop talking?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic032 "Do you ever stop talking?" [DIAL:00156F22]

text_content: I didn't realize you were in such a hurry.|I get so used to sitting in this chair and listening to radio reports, sometimes I forget people are getting ready for a war out there.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic032 "Do you ever stop talking?" [DIAL:00156F22]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Tell me about the rangers.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic031 "Tell me about the rangers." [DIAL:00156F23]

text_content: I could tell you a lot if you had the time, but at my age I'm not sure which of us would get tired first. What do you want to know?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic031 "Tell me about the rangers." [DIAL:00156F23]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: What's the Legion been up to?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic030 "What's the Legion been up to?" [DIAL:00156F24]

text_content: Not too long ago, they took Nelson and Searchlight.|They've got some camps on the eastern shore of the Colorado, and the monstrosity on the hill across the lake - that's for Caesar.|Some folks don't believe he's here yet, but you can tell. He's the eye of the storm. It all roils and spins around him.|You don't have to see the man to see the effect he has.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic030 "What's the Legion been up to?" [DIAL:00156F24]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Intel says the legate's coming. {lan-ee-us}Lanius. They call him the Monster of the East. If he's half as bad as Graham was, we're in for a heck of a fight.|With Caesar and a new legate here, the Legion's not going to fall for the same old bag of tricks.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic030 "What's the Legion been up to?" [DIAL:00156F24]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Word is that the Legion's old timers have shown up, Caesar's veterans from the Red Okie {sen-tur-ee-ah}Centuria and what was the Painted Rock tribe.|They're the best of the best and the baddest of the bad. Short of a centurion or {pray-tor-ee-an}praetorian, they don't come any tougher.|You come across a pack of them, weigh your options carefully.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic030 "What's the Legion been up to?" [DIAL:00156F24]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: How is NCR doing?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic029 "How is NCR doing?" [DIAL:00156F25]

text_content: It's no secret that we've had better campaigns. Holding this whole length of river isn't easy.|We're stretched thin and the Long 15 just keeps getting longer. Slow to get supplies. Slower to get reinforcements.|NCR's senate has got funds tied up at the Boneyard and President Kimball ordered our most experienced rangers to chase ghosts down in Baja.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic029 "How is NCR doing?" [DIAL:00156F25]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Even Caesar knows that General Oliver's coming back to Hoover. Colonel Moore's doing a fine job of running things over at the dam.|In her own way, of course, when she's not trying to wrangle my rangers into helping her.|But just keeping that dam secure and operational day to day is enough work for one person, never mind building a defense against the Legion.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic029 "How is NCR doing?" [DIAL:00156F25]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Mojave Outpost sent word through the stations. The rangers coming up from Baja moved through Dayglow a week ago.|Some of the patrol rangers have reported that Oliver's power armor heavy troopers are starting to reinforce the front lines.|Wish they got here a bit earlier, but that's the senate for you.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic029 "How is NCR doing?" [DIAL:00156F25]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: What do you know about Caesar?
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic025 "What do you know about Caesar?" [DIAL:00156F26]

text_content: The best of the best, worst of the worst. He came out of NCR, one of the Followers of the Apocalypse.|Like a lot of the Followers, he went out in the wilderness with a partner to try to help those who needed helping.|Not much different from how the rangers used to be, except with books and medicine instead of guns.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic025 "What do you know about Caesar?" [DIAL:00156F26]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: Tell me about yourself.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic012 "Tell me about yourself." [DIAL:00156F27]

text_content: Folks around here call me the chief{han-luhn}, but Hanlon's just fine. The rangers run themselves pretty well, but I try to lend a hand.|Mostly administrative work, helping coordinate intel on the radio. That and keeping an eye on the fires growing across the water.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic012 "Tell me about yourself." [DIAL:00156F27]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

He was a great leader of the Legion before he failed {KAI-zar}Caesar.|The story says he was set on fire and thrown into the Grand Canyon, but his angry spirit rose from the ashes of his corpse, looking for revenge.|Nonsense, probably, but there's no doubt that many in the Legion believe he's still alive somehow.
name: VFreeformTheFortFortSiriTopic005 "Tell me about the Burned Man." [DIAL:00157351]

name: VFreeformTheFortFortAntonyTopic030 "What do you know about the Burned Man?" [DIAL:00157352]
speaker: FortAntony "Antony" [NPC_:00120172]

text_content: What can you tell me about Legate Lanius?
name: VFreeformTheFortFortAntonyTopic011 "What can you tell me about Legate Lanius?" [DIAL:00157353]

text_content: It took years for {KAI-zar}Caesar to conquer Lanius' tribe, and {KAI-zar}Caesar showed mercy to the survivors, allowing them to join the Legion.|Had the positions been reversed, {KAI-zar}Caesar would be dead. Lanius is called the Monster of the East because he never, ever shows mercy.
name: VFreeformTheFortFortAntonyTopic011 "What can you tell me about Legate Lanius?" [DIAL:00157353]
speaker: FortAntony "Antony" [NPC_:00120172]

name: VFreeformTheFortFortOthoTopic001 "What do you know about the Burned Man?" [DIAL:00157354]

text_content: {Male PC}It's not something we like to speak of. The Burned Man was our greatest warrior, even greater than Legate Lanius, but he failed {KAI-zar}Caesar at the Dam.|He's been dead for several years now, but the rumor is that {KAI-zar}Caesar has scouts out looking for him all the same. The Burned Man was a very tough man.
name: VFreeformTheFortFortOthoTopic001 "What do you know about the Burned Man?" [DIAL:00157354]
speaker: FortOtho "Otho" [NPC_:00122B95]

text_content: {Female PC}Ask someone else, woman.
name: VFreeformTheFortFortOthoTopic001 "What do you know about the Burned Man?" [DIAL:00157354]
speaker: FortOtho "Otho" [NPC_:00122B95]

name: VFreeformTheFortFortOthoTopic000 "What can you tell me about the Legate?" [DIAL:00157355]

text_content: A great warrior. When he was but a recruit, I watched him kill ten men in the arena with his bare hands.|He doesn't feel pain and he never, ever shows mercy. If all Legionaries were like him, the Legion would be invincible.
name: VFreeformTheFortFortOthoTopic000 "What can you tell me about the Legate?" [DIAL:00157355]
speaker: FortOtho "Otho" [NPC_:00122B95]

name: VFreeformTheFortFortVulpesIncultaTopic000 "What can you tell me about the Legate?" [DIAL:00157356]

text_content: {Caesar alive}To call {Lah-nee-OOS}Lanius ferocious would be an understatement. In battle, he seizes the enemy in his jaws and will not let go.|He thinks nothing of suffering losses, so long as the enemy suffers more. Though unsubtle, he is not dim. He detects traps, and sets his own.|Be glad you will not have to face his judgment... if you are true to {KAI-zar}Caesar.
name: VFreeformTheFortFortVulpesIncultaTopic000 "What can you tell me about the Legate?" [DIAL:00157356]
speaker: FortVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:00122B99]

text_content: {Caesar dead}{Lah-nee-OOS}Lanius served {KAI-zar}Caesar well, as his greatest battlefield commander.|With {Lah-nee-OOS}Lanius at the head of the Legion, however, I doubt he'll have much use for my services. He prefers... direct methods.
name: VFreeformTheFortFortVulpesIncultaTopic000 "What can you tell me about the Legate?" [DIAL:00157356]
speaker: FortVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:00122B99]

The Burned Man led us to a disastrous defeat at the Dam.|On {KAI-zar's}Caesar's orders, the Burned Man was covered in pitch by the {pray-TORE-ian}Praetorian Guard, lit on fire, and cast into the Grand Canyon.|{KAI-zar}Caesar has forbidden us from ever speaking his true name again, and so we simply refer to him as the Burned Man.

text_content: I destroyed the Brotherhood of Steel's bunker.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic045 "I destroyed the Brotherhood of Steel's bunker." [DIAL:00157BF5]

text_content: You really know how to make a robot happy! Seriously, you just made my day.

speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: It took some doing, but I convinced the White Glove Society to support Caesar's Legion.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic043 "It took some doing, but I convinced the White Glove Society to support Caesar's Legion." [DIAL:00157BF8]
