name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic043 "It took some doing, but I convinced the White Glove Society to support Caesar's Legion." [DIAL:00157BF8]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: The White Glove Society needed a little help getting back to basics, that's all.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic042 "The White Glove Society needed a little help getting back to basics, that's all." [DIAL:00157BF9]

text_content: That's great news! I wish I could visit their casino! They have a refined sense of taste!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic042 "The White Glove Society needed a little help getting back to basics, that's all." [DIAL:00157BF9]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: The White Glove Society had a cannibalism problem, but I solved it.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic041 "The White Glove Society had a cannibalism problem, but I solved it." [DIAL:00157BFA]

text_content: A cannibalism problem? Really? I'm so glad you weren't eaten!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic041 "The White Glove Society had a cannibalism problem, but I solved it." [DIAL:00157BFA]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: I spoke to Marjorie and Mortimer. I say leave the White Glove Society alone.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic040 "I spoke to Marjorie and Mortimer. I say leave the White Glove Society alone." [DIAL:00157BFB]

text_content: Say no more, say no more... if you say they're good, they're good!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic040 "I spoke to Marjorie and Mortimer. I say leave the White Glove Society alone." [DIAL:00157BFB]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: I helped the Omertas perfect their plan to slaughter everyone on the Strip.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic039 "I helped the Omertas perfect their plan to slaughter everyone on the Strip." [DIAL:00157BFC]

text_content: You'd think it'd be bad for the Strip but... but I guess it must be good!|Yeah - take the Strip down a notch or two, right? That'll show it! Okay!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic039 "I helped the Omertas perfect their plan to slaughter everyone on the Strip." [DIAL:00157BFC]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: The Omertas were plotting to destroy the Strip, so I killed the conspirators.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic038 "The Omertas were plotting to destroy the Strip, so I killed the conspirators." [DIAL:00157BFD]

text_content: Wow! That is amazing! You are just - a hero! I am serious!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic038 "The Omertas were plotting to destroy the Strip, so I killed the conspirators." [DIAL:00157BFD]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: I know enough about the Omertas to know I want them left alone.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic037 "I know enough about the Omertas to know I want them left alone." [DIAL:00157BFE]

text_content: You got it! I won't say another word about them!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic037 "I know enough about the Omertas to know I want them left alone." [DIAL:00157BFE]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: I've convinced the Brotherhood to support the NCR.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic036 "I've convinced the Brotherhood to support the NCR." [DIAL:00157BFF]

text_content: {shocked}Really? That's... {a catastrophe, but keeping spirits bright}well, that's a surprise! They'll really want to blow me up!|But maybe dumb machines like me ought to get blown up and scrapped for salvage. Who knows? Not me!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic036 "I've convinced the Brotherhood to support the NCR." [DIAL:00157BFF]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: I know the Brotherhood. I want them left alone.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic034 "I know the Brotherhood. I want them left alone." [DIAL:00157C00]

text_content: Okay! Consider them forgotten! Along with the projections that predict they'll be our biggest enemy! Forgotten!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic034 "I know the Brotherhood. I want them left alone." [DIAL:00157C00]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: I've set the Great Khans on a path of destruction.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic033 "I've set the Great Khans on a path of destruction." [DIAL:00157C01]

text_content: Oooh, sounds dramatic! I like it! Wind them up and let them go!|No more Khans! That's great! They're just bad people...
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic033 "I've set the Great Khans on a path of destruction." [DIAL:00157C01]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: I convinced the Great Khans to leave the Mojave.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic032 "I convinced the Great Khans to leave the Mojave." [DIAL:00157C02]

text_content: Maybe they'll be devoured by giant scorpions! All sorts of things could happen to them out there!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic032 "I convinced the Great Khans to leave the Mojave." [DIAL:00157C02]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: I've convinced the Great Khans to support the NCR.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic031 "I've convinced the Great Khans to support the NCR." [DIAL:00157C03]

text_content: {confused}Really? Okay! That sounds fun!|That's not aiding an enemy! Not when you do it!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic031 "I've convinced the Great Khans to support the NCR." [DIAL:00157C03]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: The Great Khans have been wiped out.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic030 "The Great Khans have been wiped out." [DIAL:00157C04]

text_content: Yay, that's great news! You finished what Mr. House and the NCR started! That's got to feel good!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic030 "The Great Khans have been wiped out." [DIAL:00157C04]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: I've visited the Khans' settlement at Red Rock Canyon. They can be ignored.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic029 "I've visited the Khans' settlement at Red Rock Canyon. They can be ignored." [DIAL:00157C05]

text_content: If you say so! Consider them filed away under "not to be discussed again!"
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic029 "I've visited the Khans' settlement at Red Rock Canyon. They can be ignored." [DIAL:00157C05]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: What do you know about the Omertas?
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic028 "What do you know about the Omertas?" [DIAL:00157C06]

text_content: Hmm. I remember that Benny used to pay a receptionist at Gomorrah for information - maybe she knows something!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic028 "What do you know about the Omertas?" [DIAL:00157C06]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: Just that Benny didn't like them! He talked on and on about how they couldn't be trusted! And this is coming from Benny!|He hated their casino, said it was tacky! And he thought they were up to something, because he said they always are!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic028 "What do you know about the Omertas?" [DIAL:00157C06]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: Whenever you get around to it will be just fine!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic028 "What do you know about the Omertas?" [DIAL:00157C06]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: Where should I look for the Brotherhood of Steel?
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic027 "Where should I look for the Brotherhood of Steel?" [DIAL:00157C07]

text_content: Some of Mr. House's data said that he'd lost a bunch of Securitron scouts near Hidden Valley!|Telemetry showed that they'd been attacked with energy weapons! House was pretty sure it was the Brotherhood!|There must be a bunch of them holed up there! Not a good place for a robot to visit!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic027 "Where should I look for the Brotherhood of Steel?" [DIAL:00157C07]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: They go around in big suits of power armor, and they have lots of energy weapons! But there's a downside!|They just have a {beat}thing about technology! They think it should all be theirs! If someone else has it, they get mad!|All I'm saying is, not much of a chance they'll accept a Vegas that polices itself with robots!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic027 "Where should I look for the Brotherhood of Steel?" [DIAL:00157C07]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: No rush! Take your time!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic027 "Where should I look for the Brotherhood of Steel?" [DIAL:00157C07]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: What do you know about the White Glove Society?
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic026 "What do you know about the White Glove Society?" [DIAL:00157C08]

text_content: {uncomfortable stating an opinion}From what I understand, they're perfectly delightful! They're cultured, clean, and {ultimate compliment}super-polite!|Benny didn't like them, though! He said they were "creepy."
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic026 "What do you know about the White Glove Society?" [DIAL:00157C08]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: Don't hurry on my account! I'm the one with the flexible schedule.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic026 "What do you know about the White Glove Society?" [DIAL:00157C08]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: What do you know about the Boomers?
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic025 "What do you know about the Boomers?" [DIAL:00157C09]

text_content: They must be a really nasty people! I haven't heard a single good thing about them!|They fire artillery on anyone who comes near their settlement at Nellis Air Force Base. Talk about rude!|If they can be convinced to fire those big cannons at the Legion or NCR, though, well - that'd be neat, wouldn't it?
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic025 "What do you know about the Boomers?" [DIAL:00157C09]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: Take all the time you need!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic025 "What do you know about the Boomers?" [DIAL:00157C09]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: Tell me what you know about the Great Khans.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic024 "Tell me what you know about the Great Khans." [DIAL:00157C0A]

text_content: The Khans are just... they're a dirty people. They live in tents like animals! And they're very rude!|They've been kicked around a lot, but no one's finished them off! Not yet, anyway!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic024 "Tell me what you know about the Great Khans." [DIAL:00157C0A]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: They were one of the tribes the Three Families pushed out of Vegas! A whole bunch got killed!|So they settled at Bitter Springs, but they kept being so obnoxious, the NCR had to kill a whole bunch more of them!|So then they settle at Red Rock Canyon! There's just no getting rid of them!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic024 "Tell me what you know about the Great Khans." [DIAL:00157C0A]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: You set the pace.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic024 "Tell me what you know about the Great Khans." [DIAL:00157C0A]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: I'm familiar with the Boomers. They can be ignored.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic023 "I'm familiar with the Boomers. They can be ignored." [DIAL:00157C0B]

text_content: Then consider them ignored! If they end up firing their howitzers at us, we'll ignore that, too! Until it goes away!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic023 "I'm familiar with the Boomers. They can be ignored." [DIAL:00157C0B]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: The Boomers won't be a problem anymore. I killed their leaders.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic022 "The Boomers won't be a problem anymore. I killed their leaders." [DIAL:00157C0C]

text_content: {enthused}Problem solved! Quick and to the point! I like the way you work!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic022 "The Boomers won't be a problem anymore. I killed their leaders." [DIAL:00157C0C]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: The Boomers have vowed to support me.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic021 "The Boomers have vowed to support me." [DIAL:00157C0D]

text_content: Really? Talk about diplomatic skills! I mean, just not getting blown up was a success!|Now they'll only blow up the right sorts of people! That's what matters!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic021 "The Boomers have vowed to support me." [DIAL:00157C0D]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: Let's talk about the tribes I should "get to know."
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic019 "Let's talk about the tribes I should ""get to know.""" [DIAL:00157C0E]

text_content: Of course! Ask away!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic019 "Let's talk about the tribes I should ""get to know.""" [DIAL:00157C0E]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: Please go on!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic019 "Let's talk about the tribes I should ""get to know.""" [DIAL:00157C0E]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: That's one down, four to go.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic019 "Let's talk about the tribes I should ""get to know.""" [DIAL:00157C0E]

name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic019 "Let's talk about the tribes I should ""get to know.""" [DIAL:00157C0E]

name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic019 "Let's talk about the tribes I should ""get to know.""" [DIAL:00157C0E]

text_content: That's four down, just one to go.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic019 "Let's talk about the tribes I should ""get to know.""" [DIAL:00157C0E]

text_content: That accounts for all the tribes you needed to get to know!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic019 "Let's talk about the tribes I should ""get to know.""" [DIAL:00157C0E]

text_content: Anything else I can help with?
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic019 "Let's talk about the tribes I should ""get to know.""" [DIAL:00157C0E]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: So I should ask these tribes if they'll support an Independent Vegas?
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic018 "So I should ask these tribes if they'll support an Independent Vegas?" [DIAL:00157C0F]

text_content: Oh no, I didn't mean that! Who needs their support? The Securitrons will be all the support you need!|What I meant is, you should get to know these tribes and decide which ones you like and which you don't!|{upbeat}You know - shape the future of Vegas! Choose your neighbors! If you like a tribe, leave it alone!|{upbeat}Or if a tribe is nasty, or going to be a problem - go ahead and exterminate it! It's whatever you want to do!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic018 "So I should ask these tribes if they'll support an Independent Vegas?" [DIAL:00157C0F]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: Which tribes should I "get to know"?
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic017 "Which tribes should I ""get to know""?" [DIAL:00157C10]

text_content: There's a bunch! Some of them you've already met - like the Chairmen, for instance!|I think you should be sure to visit the other families on the Strip, the Omertas and the White Glove Society, so you know what makes them tick!|And there are some important groups farther from the Strip, too, like the Boomers, the Great Khans, and the Brotherhood of Steel!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic017 "Which tribes should I ""get to know""?" [DIAL:00157C10]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: Say Mr. House was going to suffer an accident. How would that happen?
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic011 "Say Mr. House was going to suffer an accident. How would that happen?" [DIAL:00157C14]

text_content: It makes me feel really dumb to admit this, but I don't actually know! I've never been inside the Lucky 38. No one has!|Mr. House is in there, though! It's the central node of his entire network!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic011 "Say Mr. House was going to suffer an accident. How would that happen?" [DIAL:00157C14]

text_content: You already took care of Mr. House? Wow, you work fast!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic011 "Say Mr. House was going to suffer an accident. How would that happen?" [DIAL:00157C14]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: I mean, Benny was always scheming about how he was going to get into the Lucky 38, but you already took care of that. Wow!|The other thing you're going to need is the Platinum Chip. {stay sunny}You know, the one Benny killed a courier for, over near Goodsprings?
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic011 "Say Mr. House was going to suffer an accident. How would that happen?" [DIAL:00157C14]

text_content: The Platinum Chip is the key to overriding and exploiting Mr. House's defenses!|Did I just say "exploiting?" That's not a very nice word!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic011 "Say Mr. House was going to suffer an accident. How would that happen?" [DIAL:00157C14]

text_content: I'll be waiting right here!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic011 "Say Mr. House was going to suffer an accident. How would that happen?" [DIAL:00157C14]

text_content: What are the details of the plan?
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic009 "What are the details of the plan?" [DIAL:00157C15]

text_content: {excited}Again, goal number one is to eliminate Mr. House and install my neuro-computational matrix on the Lucky 38's mainframe!|Given how you're a new arrival, I also recommend that you get to know some of the region's tribes, so you can decide how you feel about them!|By the time you've finished up all of that, the Legion should be close to attacking Hoover Dam and we'll execute the last phase of the plan!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic009 "What are the details of the plan?" [DIAL:00157C15]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: What if I wanted to take over New Vegas, instead of Benny?
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic008 "What if I wanted to take over New Vegas, instead of Benny?" [DIAL:00157C16]

text_content: Then I'd have to help you! I mean, it seems pretty obvious Benny wouldn't have wanted me to, but hey, not my fault I can't say no!

text_content: Martina said she sold her information to Captain Curtis in the NCR.

name: VFreeformTheFortFortVulpesIncultaTopic005 "Martina said she sold her information to Captain Curtis in the NCR." [DIAL:00157CC4]
speaker: FortVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:00122B99]

text_content: {Monorail destroyed}I know the Captain well. The destruction of the NCR monorail was his doing.|Of course, if the NCR were to hear of that, it would be obvious who told them.
name: VFreeformTheFortFortVulpesIncultaTopic005 "Martina said she sold her information to Captain Curtis in the NCR." [DIAL:00157CC4]
speaker: FortVulpesInculta "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:00122B99]

text_content: No, ma'am.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic058 "No, ma'am." [DIAL:00157E62]

text_content: Good, then you have your orders. See that Mr. House does not present a problem.|Dismissed.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic058 "No, ma'am." [DIAL:00157E62]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: Won't getting rid of Mr. House have huge repercussions for New Vegas?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic057 "Won't getting rid of Mr. House have huge repercussions for New Vegas?" [DIAL:00157E63]

text_content: Perhaps, but that's not my problem. Vegas is a nice place for the men to go on vacation, but it'd be an acceptable loss next to the Dam.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic057 "Won't getting rid of Mr. House have huge repercussions for New Vegas?" [DIAL:00157E63]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: What evidence do you have that Mr. House will make a move?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic056 "What evidence do you have that Mr. House will make a move?" [DIAL:00157E64]

text_content: We've had reported sightings of Mr. House's Securitrons spying on both NCR and Legion forces.|Also, given a recent analysis of the sightings, we now estimate that Mr. House has at least four times as many securitrons as previously assumed.|He wouldn't show his hand like that if he weren't prepared to move. And neither the NCR or Legion can spare the troops to investigate.|Which is why I'm sending you. Any other questions?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic056 "What evidence do you have that Mr. House will make a move?" [DIAL:00157E64]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: What could Mr. House possibly be up to?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic055 "What could Mr. House possibly be up to?" [DIAL:00157E65]

text_content: To name a few things off the top of my head - expand his borders, get the NCR and Legion to wipe each other out, and seize Hoover Dam.|Any other questions?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic055 "What could Mr. House possibly be up to?" [DIAL:00157E65]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: I wanted to ask you some questions.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic054 "I wanted to ask you some questions." [DIAL:00157E66]

text_content: Very well, but be brief.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic054 "I wanted to ask you some questions." [DIAL:00157E66]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: What if I can convince them not to join the Legion?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic050 "What if I can convince them not to join the Legion?" [DIAL:00157E6A]

text_content: Don't fool yourself. I've dealt with enough of these gangs to know that they can't be trusted. Was there anything else?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic050 "What if I can convince them not to join the Legion?" [DIAL:00157E6A]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: Where should I start looking for them?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic049 "Where should I start looking for them?" [DIAL:00157E6B]

text_content: As I said, our scouts were some ways west of HELIOS when they disappeared.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic049 "Where should I start looking for them?" [DIAL:00157E6B]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic048 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:00157E6C]

text_content: What kind of weapons do they use?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic047 "What kind of weapons do they use?" [DIAL:00157E6D]

text_content: Their standard kit seems to be a blade of some sort and light armor. Guns are not uncommon, but are of questionable condition.|While they prefer to use their blades, it's common for them to scavenge better weapons from their enemies and use those.|The men have been told to toss their weapons over the side of the dam if they receive a fatal wound, but I doubt many will remember.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic047 "What kind of weapons do they use?" [DIAL:00157E6D]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: You mentioned that they were in good shape?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic046 "You mentioned that they were in good shape?" [DIAL:00157E6E]

text_content: Yes, extremely so. They must use conditioning routines on par with the rangers, or better.|Their soldiers can run near half again as fast as my best men, and close distances with frightening speed. And they're as strong as they are fast.|Their superior physicality makes them extremely dangerous up close, so I've had the men run drills for taking on larger, stronger opponents.|But they've all been instructed to take them down at range, if possible. I've made it clear I don't want any heroes in my squad, just survivors.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic046 "You mentioned that they were in good shape?" [DIAL:00157E6E]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: What impressed you about their discipline?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic045 "What impressed you about their discipline?" [DIAL:00157E6F]

text_content: I've never once seen a single one of them back down, or disobey an order.|They'll happily charge a fortified position with little more than a sharpened stick if ordered to, and do so without hesitation.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic045 "What impressed you about their discipline?" [DIAL:00157E6F]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic044 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:00157E70]

text_content: I can only spare a few more moments. What did you wish to speak about?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic044 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:00157E70]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: It's better to be in charge.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic043 "It's better to be in charge." [DIAL:00157E71]

text_content: Oh, it has its perks, to be sure. I'm free to see that things on a large scale are done my way, and don't have to tolerate any disagreement.|Those few people in a position to countermand my orders only care about results, and in that regard I never leave them less than pleased.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic043 "It's better to be in charge." [DIAL:00157E71]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: Sounds like you miss it.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic042 "Sounds like you miss it." [DIAL:00157E72]

text_content: I do, sometimes. There are days I'd give anything to out in the open air, planting explosives and laying down covering fire.|But here I am, stuck in the same stale office day after day, while other people get to do the actual fighting.|But enough reminiscing. Did you have other questions?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic042 "Sounds like you miss it." [DIAL:00157E72]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: Are you in charge of the NCR around here?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic041 "Are you in charge of the NCR around here?" [DIAL:00157E73]

text_content: I command the garrison here at the dam, yes, but Colonel {shoo}Hsu over at McCarran is technically in charge of the area's forces.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic041 "Are you in charge of the NCR around here?" [DIAL:00157E73]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: What do you know about Caesar's Legion?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic040 "What do you know about Caesar's Legion?" [DIAL:00157E74]

text_content: They're organized, I'll give them that. The few times I've encountered them firsthand, I've been impressed with their discipline.|I've heard they don't allow women in their military, considering them nothing more than breeding stock.|Their men, however, are typically quite large, in phenomenal condition, and prefer close-quarter weapons.|Recent engagements have taught us to fear their shock attacks, so it's a blessing that we seem to have superior firearms.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic040 "What do you know about Caesar's Legion?" [DIAL:00157E74]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: What can you tell me about Hoover Dam?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic039 "What can you tell me about Hoover Dam?" [DIAL:00157E75]

text_content: It's of immense strategic value to the NCR. Hoover Dam sends enough electricity west to light every city and major settlement.|It's moderately defensible, with a single point of entry on the east side. To get to the power plants below, the enemy has to cross the entire top.|The Legion's tried to cross the water on a few occasions, but slow-moving boats make easy targets for sharpshooters.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic039 "What can you tell me about Hoover Dam?" [DIAL:00157E75]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: How did you get to be a colonel in the NCR?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic038 "How did you get to be a colonel in the NCR?" [DIAL:00157E76]

text_content: I joined up at a young age. Was barely sixteen when I left home and volunteered to be in the military.|Got a few strange looks at first, but those stopped when I got top marks across the board during training, and became an officer at seventeen.|A few years went by, my squad helped take down gangs of raiders here and there, and one day an invitation to join the Rangers arrived. |Those were the best years of my life. Doing something that truly matters, and having the freedom to handle it as you see fit. Then I got injured.|Everyone was very supportive. I received a promotion to colonel and given greater responsibility, but my days as a Ranger were over.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic038 "How did you get to be a colonel in the NCR?" [DIAL:00157E76]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: Tell me about the NCR.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic036 "Tell me about the NCR." [DIAL:00157E77]

text_content: I don't have time to discuss all the different aspects of the NCR with you, but if you want it all in a nutshell - the NCR is progress.|If you wander around the wasteland you'll find all sorts of tribes, villages, and such where people spend most of their time trying to survive.|The NCR gives its citizens a shot at something more. We have laws, currency, health care, government. All the things that were lost.|It's not perfect, but it's worth protecting, which is why we also have the largest military in existence.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDColonelMooreTopic036 "Tell me about the NCR." [DIAL:00157E77]
speaker: VHDColonelMoore "Colonel Cassandra Moore" [NPC_:001206FC]

text_content: Not until you tell me where you get the food from.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSGenaroTopic003 "Not until you tell me where you get the food from." [DIAL:00157E78]

text_content: I have my little helpers out and about, always looking for fresh things to add to the stewpot.|You may have seen them around somewhere yourself. Now, deny your hunger no longer!
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSGenaroTopic003 "Not until you tell me where you get the food from." [DIAL:00157E78]

name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJamesGarretTopic021 "I need people to forget about some things I've done." [DIAL:00157EB1]

name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJamesGarretTopic021 "I need people to forget about some things I've done." [DIAL:00157EB1]
speaker: VFSJamesGarret "James Garret" [NPC_:0010C67E]

name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJamesGarretTopic021 "I need people to forget about some things I've done." [DIAL:00157EB1]

text_content: <Pay 250 caps> Just a few things here and there. I'm no monster.

speaker: VFSJamesGarret "James Garret" [NPC_:0010C67E]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.

text_content: If this was a school, what was taught here?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic081 "If this was a school, what was taught here?" [DIAL:001587F4]

text_content: As far as we can tell, the guy that built this place was considered the coolest of the cool, and taught other people how to be more like him.|People would come from all around to learn how to sing, dance, dress, and even speak the way he did.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic081 "If this was a school, what was taught here?" [DIAL:001587F4]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: Tell me more about him.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic070 "Tell me more about him." [DIAL:001587F5]

text_content: Not a whole lot to tell. There were only a few books left in here when we found it, and those were rotted away.|There were some posters left that were pretty well preserved, which is how we know all this stuff was based on the same guy.|The thing of it is, we don't even know what his name was. All the posters just referred to him as "The King".
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic070 "Tell me more about him." [DIAL:001587F5]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: This building is... interesting. What do you know about it?

text_content: Near as I can tell, it was some sort of religious institution.|Oh, I know it says "school" out front, but everything in here seems to be related to the worship of some guy from back in the day.|People used to come here to learn about him, to dress like him, move like him. To {stressed}be him. If that's not worship, I don't know what is.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic030 "This building is... interesting. What do you know about it?" [DIAL:001587F6]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: I have other things to do.

text_content: That's all right. My friends got beat so bad they'll be recuperating for quite some time, so head over there when you can.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic028 "I have other things to do." [DIAL:001587F7]

text_content: If what you say is true, then they shall answer for it.|But you suggest I turn from battle to answer these crimes, when I can prove myself greater by meeting them - then returning with the Dam as ours.|You almost convinced me otherwise... but justice comes to all in time, and it now comes to you.

text_content: Perhaps the treachery of your own ranks disgusts you as it disgusts me.

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Suspicious}You play on my instincts. Yet your intention in this... you have nothing to gain by telling me of this... "trap."|{Angry}Unless you seek to goad me into a retreat, leaving the battlefield and leaving my honor here to be trampled underfoot by Republic cowards.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDLegionLegateLaniusTopic028 "<Bluff> Your success was too easy, though, wasn't it? You think I reached you by chance?" [DIAL:00159407]

text_content: <Bluff> That strength... other Legates didn't see it either, until it was too late.

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Slightly to himself}We did take the towers easier than expected. I cannot believe even the Republic would overlook such an opening in their defenses.|{Rallying}Yet we are at throat of the Great Bear. Victory is at hand.

speaker: VHDLegionLegateLanius "Legate Lanius" [NPC_:001300AA]

text_content: Nice mask, can't wait to take it as a trophy.

text_content: We shall see how brave you are when nailed to the walls of Hoover Dam, your body facing West so you may watch your world die.

speaker: VHDLegionLegateLanius "Legate Lanius" [NPC_:001300AA]

text_content: I'm here to kill you. The Legion's advance ends here.

text_content: {Caesar dead}What, Caesar giving you orders beyond the grave?

text_content: Caesar's will is the will of the Legion. And the West... all beneath the flag of the Great Bear exist to test the strength of the Legion.|The West shall fall as the East fell, and all the tribes that stretch to the setting sun shall bear the mark of the Legion.

speaker: VHDLegionLegateLanius "Legate Lanius" [NPC_:001300AA]

text_content: {Caesar alive}What, Caesar wasn't brave enough to come take the Dam himself?

text_content: Caesar's will is made truth through me. I am a hammer against all that defy his rule.|If you seek to stand against me, you shall fall as the West falls.

text_content: Maybe you're willing to listen to reason.

speaker: VHDGeneralOliver "General Lee Oliver" [NPC_:001300A9]

I'll give my superiors my opinion, but I don't think they're going to listen.|So if NCR comes at you, and it will, pray you're ready. I promise you, our situations reversed, I'd see you hang.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic050 "Can't do a worse job than the Republic, that's for sure." [DIAL:001596A8]
speaker: VHDGeneralOliver "General Lee Oliver" [NPC_:001300A9]

text_content: I was hoping we could be pleasant about this.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic049 "I was hoping we could be pleasant about this." [DIAL:001596A9]

text_content: I make the laws here now, and my law is simple: No NCR on the Colorado.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic048 "I make the laws here now, and my law is simple: No NCR on the Colorado." [DIAL:001596AA]

text_content: General, the Republic has outstayed its welcome - this land is mine.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic047 "General, the Republic has outstayed its welcome - this land is mine." [DIAL:001596AB]

text_content: How about I ask these robots to fuck you and your entire battalion with a rocket barrage?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic046 "How about I ask these robots to fuck you and your entire battalion with a rocket barrage?" [DIAL:001596AC]

text_content: You want me to make tracks out of here, head back West, tail between our legs? |No, I came for a fight today, and if you're looking to make me budge, you better have a damn good left hook or I'm not going anywhere.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic046 "How about I ask these robots to fuck you and your entire battalion with a rocket barrage?" [DIAL:001596AC]
speaker: VHDGeneralOliver "General Lee Oliver" [NPC_:001300A9]

text_content: Do you know what you're doing? Making a nation -  like you think you're doing, ain't like chowing down on a pile of Fancy Lad Snack Cakes.|Think you got the guts to carve out a frontier? Build towns, protect the roads, run supplies, train troops?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic046 "How about I ask these robots to fuck you and your entire battalion with a rocket barrage?" [DIAL:001596AC]

text_content: Leave on your feet, or leave wrapped in your flag.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic045 "Leave on your feet, or leave wrapped in your flag." [DIAL:001596AD]

text_content: Retreat, or we wipe NCR off the face of the Dam.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic044 "Retreat, or we wipe NCR off the face of the Dam." [DIAL:001596AE]

text_content: I don't want any more violence, there's been enough today.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic043 "I don't want any more violence, there's been enough today." [DIAL:001596AF]

text_content: Are you sure that's wise?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic042 "Are you sure that's wise?" [DIAL:001596B0]

text_content: {Cold}Look, I know you're riding high right now, but let me tell you - you ain't pissing on me right now, you're pissing on the Bear. |You been far enough West I'm guessing to know how far that claw stretches. Fuck with the Bear, and...
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic042 "Are you sure that's wise?" [DIAL:001596B0]
speaker: VHDGeneralOliver "General Lee Oliver" [NPC_:001300A9]

text_content: The Dam is won... for me. You and the Legion have both lost this day.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic041 "The Dam is won... for me. You and the Legion have both lost this day." [DIAL:001596B1]

text_content: I suggest you leave before my "boys" open fire on your men.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic040 "I suggest you leave before my ""boys"" open fire on your men." [DIAL:001596B2]

text_content: General Oliver, Hoover Dam is ours. Leave at once.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic039 "General Oliver, Hoover Dam is ours. Leave at once." [DIAL:001596B3]

text_content: {Cold}I would sooner spit on the grave of my dead mother than let some courier-walk-the-wasteland-fuck talk to me like that. |Who the hell do you think you are? Looking to cash your chips to the sound of NCR bullets, eh? I can oblige.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic039 "General Oliver, Hoover Dam is ours. Leave at once." [DIAL:001596B3]
speaker: VHDGeneralOliver "General Lee Oliver" [NPC_:001300A9]

text_content: Have you seen an entire army of upgraded Securitrons, General?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic038 "Have you seen an entire army of upgraded Securitrons, General?" [DIAL:001596B4]

text_content: Can't take all the credit, had some help from my allies here.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic037 "Can't take all the credit, had some help from my allies here." [DIAL:001596B5]

text_content: Think that's great? You won't believe what happens next.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic036 "Think that's great? You won't believe what happens next." [DIAL:001596B6]

text_content: Hold that thought, General. I wanted to introduce you to some friends.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic035 "Hold that thought, General. I wanted to introduce you to some friends." [DIAL:001596B7]

text_content: {Uneasy, army of robots suddenly appear}And... uh... well. These uh... these boys with you? Hello, there, smiley.

text_content: RadioBMSegment13
name: RadioBMSegment13 "RadioBMSegment13" [DIAL:001596D6]

text_content: {Rhonda} Utobitha, I'm here with Best Friend Tabitha, who has a message for all the dumb-dumbs out there.
name: RadioBMSegment13 "RadioBMSegment13" [DIAL:001596D6]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} It has come to my attention that some of you dumb-dumbs took me a little too seriously in the past when I warned you about the battle cattle.
name: RadioBMSegment13 "RadioBMSegment13" [DIAL:001596D6]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} While battle cattle are indeed a dangerous foe, they are one that should be fought ferociously.
name: RadioBMSegment13 "RadioBMSegment13" [DIAL:001596D6]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} Recently I've heard about several incidents where some of you have been seen running away from a fight where battle cattle were involved.
name: RadioBMSegment13 "RadioBMSegment13" [DIAL:001596D6]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} This is not acceptable. No self-respecting soldier of Utobitha should ever be seen running like a scared little human.
name: RadioBMSegment13 "RadioBMSegment13" [DIAL:001596D6]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} Bah, I don't even know why I try. It's not like the dumb-dumbs are even going to understand this.
name: RadioBMSegment13 "RadioBMSegment13" [DIAL:001596D6]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} You heard her, Utobitha! Beware the battle cattle, but don't *fear* the battle cattle. More after this!
name: RadioBMSegment13 "RadioBMSegment13" [DIAL:001596D6]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: RadioBMSegment12
name: RadioBMSegment12 "RadioBMSegment12" [DIAL:001596D7]

text_content: {Rhonda, faint, she's not speaking into the mike} What do you think we should play next?
name: RadioBMSegment12 "RadioBMSegment12" [DIAL:001596D7]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha, same, not speaking into mike} It doesn't matter, just grab something. And check on Raul while you're at it.
name: RadioBMSegment12 "RadioBMSegment12" [DIAL:001596D7]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Sounds of movement and something brushing against the mike, then a click as the feed gets switched to the mike in Raul's room}
name: RadioBMSegment12 "RadioBMSegment12" [DIAL:001596D7]

text_content: {Raul singing in Spanish to himself for an extended time}
name: RadioBMSegment12 "RadioBMSegment12" [DIAL:001596D7]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: {Tabitha, faint, coming from a speaker in Raul's room} Raul! Why are you on the radio?
name: RadioBMSegment12 "RadioBMSegment12" [DIAL:001596D7]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Raul} Uh, I don't know. Did you hit that switch I, ah, keep telling you not to press?
name: RadioBMSegment12 "RadioBMSegment12" [DIAL:001596D7]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: {Click as feed switches back to Tabitha's room, some fumbling done near mike}
name: RadioBMSegment12 "RadioBMSegment12" [DIAL:001596D7]

text_content: {Rhonda} Sorry about that, Utobitha! Here's some music!
name: RadioBMSegment12 "RadioBMSegment12" [DIAL:001596D7]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: RadioBMSegment11
name: RadioBMSegment11 "RadioBMSegment11" [DIAL:001596D8]

text_content: {Rhonda} You're listening to another edition of Know - Your - Mutants, with Best Friend Tabitha!
name: RadioBMSegment11 "RadioBMSegment11" [DIAL:001596D8]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} So, Best Friend Tabitha, who will we learn about today?
name: RadioBMSegment11 "RadioBMSegment11" [DIAL:001596D8]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha, sounding like she's really not looking forward to this} I guess it's time we talked the dumb-dumbs.
name: RadioBMSegment11 "RadioBMSegment11" [DIAL:001596D8]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} Oh, you mean the second generation Super Mutants who aren't so bright?
name: RadioBMSegment11 "RadioBMSegment11" [DIAL:001596D8]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha, grasping for something meaningful to say} That's them. Dumb-dumbs... ah... that is... they...
name: RadioBMSegment11 "RadioBMSegment11" [DIAL:001596D8]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda, throwing her a lifeline} They're very big. And strong.
name: RadioBMSegment11 "RadioBMSegment11" [DIAL:001596D8]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha, grateful} Yes! They're just as big as other mutants, and as strong as they look. Beyond that, uh...
name: RadioBMSegment11 "RadioBMSegment11" [DIAL:001596D8]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda, another lifeline} And there's a lot of them.
name: RadioBMSegment11 "RadioBMSegment11" [DIAL:001596D8]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} Oh yeah, dumb-dumbs are the most common type of mutant that most travelers will encounter, and make up more than half the mutants here in Utobitha.
name: RadioBMSegment11 "RadioBMSegment11" [DIAL:001596D8]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} Best Friend Tabitha, some of our listeners may wonder how you can call them dumb-dumbs on the air like this.
name: RadioBMSegment11 "RadioBMSegment11" [DIAL:001596D8]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} That's a good question, Rhonda. The truth is, they're so dumb they don't even know that I'm talking about them right now.
name: RadioBMSegment11 "RadioBMSegment11" [DIAL:001596D8]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} And that's another revealing look at mutantkind. Second generation Super Mutants. Big. Numerous. {said with a flourish}Dumb. More after this!
name: RadioBMSegment11 "RadioBMSegment11" [DIAL:001596D8]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: RadioBMSegment10
name: RadioBMSegment10 "RadioBMSegment10" [DIAL:001596D9]

text_content: {Rhonda} Welcome, Utobitha, to another episode of Know - Your - Mutants!
name: RadioBMSegment10 "RadioBMSegment10" [DIAL:001596D9]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} Today we're proud to have Best Friend Tabitha with us. Welcome to the show!
name: RadioBMSegment10 "RadioBMSegment10" [DIAL:001596D9]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} Good to be here, Rhonda.
name: RadioBMSegment10 "RadioBMSegment10" [DIAL:001596D9]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} So what type of mutant did you want to talk about this time, Best Friend Tabitha?
name: RadioBMSegment10 "RadioBMSegment10" [DIAL:001596D9]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} I thought I'd briefly talk about first generation Super Mutants, Rhonda.
name: RadioBMSegment10 "RadioBMSegment10" [DIAL:001596D9]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} Oooh, what can you tell us about them?
name: RadioBMSegment10 "RadioBMSegment10" [DIAL:001596D9]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} What we call the first generation of Super Mutants, Rhonda, were actually created by the Master himself.
name: RadioBMSegment10 "RadioBMSegment10" [DIAL:001596D9]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} Like everything the Master took a direct hand in, they were better than the ones who came later, the ones made by accident.
name: RadioBMSegment10 "RadioBMSegment10" [DIAL:001596D9]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} They were smarter, almost as smart as Nightkin, and were able to think and act for themselves.
name: RadioBMSegment10 "RadioBMSegment10" [DIAL:001596D9]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} However, the first generation seems to have some kind of suicidal urge that they can't control.
name: RadioBMSegment10 "RadioBMSegment10" [DIAL:001596D9]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} How terrible! What makes you say that, Best Friend Tabitha?
name: RadioBMSegment10 "RadioBMSegment10" [DIAL:001596D9]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} So far, all first generation Super Mutants that have come to Utobitha have left not soon after.
name: RadioBMSegment10 "RadioBMSegment10" [DIAL:001596D9]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} How strange! Why would anyone leave the safety and comfort that Utobitha provides?
name: RadioBMSegment10 "RadioBMSegment10" [DIAL:001596D9]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} Why, indeed. But now there's not a single first generation Super Mutant in Utobitha.
name: RadioBMSegment10 "RadioBMSegment10" [DIAL:001596D9]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} Except Neil.
name: RadioBMSegment10 "RadioBMSegment10" [DIAL:001596D9]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha, grumbling}Except Neil.
name: RadioBMSegment10 "RadioBMSegment10" [DIAL:001596D9]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda, speaking quickly, sounding nervous, like Tabitha might attack her}Well! I think we've all learned something today. Let's go to music!
name: RadioBMSegment10 "RadioBMSegment10" [DIAL:001596D9]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: RadioBMSegment09
name: RadioBMSegment09 "RadioBMSegment09" [DIAL:001596DA]

text_content: {Rhonda} Welcome to another episode of Know - Your - Mutants!
name: RadioBMSegment09 "RadioBMSegment09" [DIAL:001596DA]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} Special guest star Best Friend Tabitha is with us in the studio to share her insights on this topic that affects us all.
name: RadioBMSegment09 "RadioBMSegment09" [DIAL:001596DA]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} Thank you, Rhonda. Today I'd like to talk about a subject near and dear to my heart, the nightkin.
name: RadioBMSegment09 "RadioBMSegment09" [DIAL:001596DA]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} Ooooh, you must know a lot about the nightkin, Best Friend Tabitha, seeing as how you are one!
name: RadioBMSegment09 "RadioBMSegment09" [DIAL:001596DA]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} That's true, Rhonda. I am in a unique position to speak to the natural superiority of my kind.
name: RadioBMSegment09 "RadioBMSegment09" [DIAL:001596DA]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} {clears throat}Our story begins, as most stories do, with the Master. Our glorious leader had created the Super Mutants, but something nagged at him.
name: RadioBMSegment09 "RadioBMSegment09" [DIAL:001596DA]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} "I can do better", he must have said to himself. And boy did he ever!
name: RadioBMSegment09 "RadioBMSegment09" [DIAL:001596DA]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} A new type of mutant was created - stronger, faster, smarter, more dangerous in every way.
name: RadioBMSegment09 "RadioBMSegment09" [DIAL:001596DA]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} We were to normal super mutants what they were to humans, and they were told to defer to us in all things.
name: RadioBMSegment09 "RadioBMSegment09" [DIAL:001596DA]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} And you're the leader of all the nightkin, correct?
name: RadioBMSegment09 "RadioBMSegment09" [DIAL:001596DA]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} Yes, as the highest ranking nightkin alive, my voice speaks for all nightkin everywhere, ever.
name: RadioBMSegment09 "RadioBMSegment09" [DIAL:001596DA]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} Which is why all super mutants should do what you say, right?
name: RadioBMSegment09 "RadioBMSegment09" [DIAL:001596DA]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} That's right! My position of supreme authority must never be questioned!
name: RadioBMSegment09 "RadioBMSegment09" [DIAL:001596DA]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} One last thing. Is there any truth to the rumor that all Nightkin are slightly crazy from their overuse of psychologically damaging pre-war tech?
name: RadioBMSegment09 "RadioBMSegment09" [DIAL:001596DA]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} None at all, Rhonda.
name: RadioBMSegment09 "RadioBMSegment09" [DIAL:001596DA]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} There you have it, Utobitha! Nightkin, your benevolent overlords, who are most certainly *not* crazy. We'll be back after this!
name: RadioBMSegment09 "RadioBMSegment09" [DIAL:001596DA]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: RadioBMSegment08
name: RadioBMSegment08 "RadioBMSegment08" [DIAL:001596DB]

text_content: {Tabitha} Do you remember the good old days where the Master ruled over us all?
name: RadioBMSegment08 "RadioBMSegment08" [DIAL:001596DB]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} When his gentle, compelling, and yet oddly insistent voice crawled through your mind and told you exactly what to do?
name: RadioBMSegment08 "RadioBMSegment08" [DIAL:001596DB]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} Do you miss a time when you didn't have to think for yourself, and enjoyed lazy days of following the bellowed commands of others?
name: RadioBMSegment08 "RadioBMSegment08" [DIAL:001596DB]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} Those days can be yours again, for Best Friend Tabitha, the esteemed leader of the State of Utobitha, is here to tell you what to do!
name: RadioBMSegment08 "RadioBMSegment08" [DIAL:001596DB]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} That's right! I, Tabitha, will take on the burden of your obedience!
name: RadioBMSegment08 "RadioBMSegment08" [DIAL:001596DB]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda, sotto voce} Acceptance into Utobitha pending Best Friend Tabitha's approval.
name: RadioBMSegment08 "RadioBMSegment08" [DIAL:001596DB]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda, sotto voce}Best Friend Tabitha reserves the right to turn down applicants for any reason, including whimsy or boredom.
name: RadioBMSegment08 "RadioBMSegment08" [DIAL:001596DB]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda, sotto voce} Acceptance into Utobitha open to mutants only. Former human servants of the Master conditionally accepted for purposes of centaur feeding duties.
name: RadioBMSegment08 "RadioBMSegment08" [DIAL:001596DB]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} Utobitha! Come, take a load off your mind!
name: RadioBMSegment08 "RadioBMSegment08" [DIAL:001596DB]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: RadioBMSegment07
name: RadioBMSegment07 "RadioBMSegment07" [DIAL:001596DC]

text_content: {Rhonda} We're here once again with our beloved leader. Best Friend Tabitha, why don't you tell our listeners what you just told me?
name: RadioBMSegment07 "RadioBMSegment07" [DIAL:001596DC]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} I was just saying that I think there's a fundamental misunderstanding about the mutants here in the State of Utobitha.
name: RadioBMSegment07 "RadioBMSegment07" [DIAL:001596DC]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} And what would *that* be?
name: RadioBMSegment07 "RadioBMSegment07" [DIAL:001596DC]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} I believe that the mutants here are generally considered to dislike humans. And nothing could be further from the truth.
name: RadioBMSegment07 "RadioBMSegment07" [DIAL:001596DC]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} During their stay here, mutants are taught to tolerate, and even accept, the existence of inferior, frail creatures, humans included.
name: RadioBMSegment07 "RadioBMSegment07" [DIAL:001596DC]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} Ooh, how insightful! So then how do you think this misunderstanding came about?
name: RadioBMSegment07 "RadioBMSegment07" [DIAL:001596DC]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} My guess is that it has something to do with the fact that every mutant in the State of Utobitha  has been give explicit orders regarding security.
name: RadioBMSegment07 "RadioBMSegment07" [DIAL:001596DC]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} Those orders naturally include shooting humans on sight. Or pounding them with whatever happens to be handy. Guns being in short supply, you see.
name: RadioBMSegment07 "RadioBMSegment07" [DIAL:001596DC]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} As I've explained, there are numerous dangers to humans here, and we have a duty to drive them away. It's for their own good, really.
name: RadioBMSegment07 "RadioBMSegment07" [DIAL:001596DC]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} Makes sense to me! And the silly humans think we don't care. {said dramatically}For shame. Stick around, Utobitha, for more after this!
name: RadioBMSegment07 "RadioBMSegment07" [DIAL:001596DC]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: RadioBMSegment05
name: RadioBMSegment06 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:001596DD]

text_content: {Rhonda} We're back with Best Friend Tabitha, who was telling us why humans should {cue angry Tabitha voice}STAY THE HELL AWAY, {back to normal Rhonda voice}ier, keep their distance from the State of Utobitha.
name: RadioBMSegment06 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:001596DD]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} Thank you, Rhonda. As you know, one of the many benefits of living in Utobitha is the ready availability of pet centaurs.
name: RadioBMSegment06 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:001596DD]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} Ooh, I love the centaurs. They're just so cute!
name: RadioBMSegment06 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:001596DD]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} Exactly, Rhonda, who could resist those sweet little faces, and that cute way they shuffle around on all those hands they have.
name: RadioBMSegment06 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:001596DD]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} But humans must be so caught up with their pleasant features that they forget the most important thing about centaurs.
name: RadioBMSegment06 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:001596DD]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} And what might that be, Best Friend Tabitha?
name: RadioBMSegment06 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:001596DD]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} Centaurs {stressed}eat humans, Rhonda! You see, humans are a lot smaller, and much more tender than you or I, so centaurs naturally see them as food.
name: RadioBMSegment06 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:001596DD]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} Ah, that *would* make it hard for them to get along, wouldn't it?
name: RadioBMSegment06 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:001596DD]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} Indeed. Given the situation, I had to make a hard choice when I created Utobitha - do we invite weak, greedy humans who would just die anyway?
name: RadioBMSegment06 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:001596DD]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Tabitha} Or cute, loveable centaurs, who fight and die for us and ask nothing in return? After much deliberation, I went with the centaurs.
name: RadioBMSegment06 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:001596DD]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: {Rhonda} And there you have it, Utobitha. The next time you play with a huggable, loveable centaur, remember that Best Friend Tabitha made it all possible.
name: RadioBMSegment06 "RadioBMSegment05" [DIAL:001596DD]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: Let's discuss something else.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic024 "Let's discuss something else." [DIAL:001596DE]

text_content: Did you have something to do with that NCR messenger getting attacked?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSPacerTopic025 "Did you have something to do with that NCR messenger getting attacked?" [DIAL:001596DF]

text_content: Look, I already told you that was bullshit. Probably just an excuse those lying soldier scum made up to not share their grub with us.|So don't ask me about it again, you hear me?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSPacerTopic025 "Did you have something to do with that NCR messenger getting attacked?" [DIAL:001596DF]
speaker: VFSPacer "Pacer" [NPC_:0010E037]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic106 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:001596E0]

text_content: What's the skinny on Mick and Ralph?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic104 "What's the skinny on Mick and Ralph?" [DIAL:001596E1]

text_content: Mick and Ralph sell all sorts of things at a small store over by the east gate. They've done all right by us, and they'll do all right by you.|You want to know about anyone else?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic104 "What's the skinny on Mick and Ralph?" [DIAL:001596E1]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: Who are the Van Graffs?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic103 "Who are the Van Graffs?" [DIAL:001596E2]

text_content: They're a family-run business from out west that deal in weapons mostly. A word of caution, though. They're not a friendly bunch. Not at all.|Their store is just past the Wrangler, and sells all kinds of fancy weapons that most people around here can't afford.|Anyone else you wanted to know about?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic103 "Who are the Van Graffs?" [DIAL:001596E2]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: I'd like to hear about the Garret Twins.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic102 "I'd like to hear about the Garret Twins." [DIAL:001596E3]

text_content: Them twins run the Atomic Wrangler, the only working casino here in Freeside. It's become pretty much {thee}the place to go around these parts.|Give it a whirl when you've got some time.  Now, was there anyone else you wanted to know about?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic102 "I'd like to hear about the Garret Twins." [DIAL:001596E3]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: Tell me about Julie Farkas.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic101 "Tell me about Julie Farkas." [DIAL:001596E4]

text_content: Julie represents the Followers of the Apocalypse. They're a group that tries to help people out whenever they can, so we get along just fine.|If you ever need to get patched up, one of their docs'll have you right as rain in no time flat. They sell supplies, too. Or used to.|Heard they were having trouble bringing stuff in, or keeping up with the demand, or something, lately.|Did you want to know about anyone else?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic101 "Tell me about Julie Farkas." [DIAL:001596E4]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: Who are the important people in Freeside?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic100 "Who are the important people in Freeside?" [DIAL:001596E5]

text_content: There's me, but I don't really like talking about myself. There's Julie Farkas and the other Followers down at the ol' Mormon Fort.|The Garret Twins up at the Wrangler deserve mention. Wouldn't be right not mentioning the Van Graffs, I suppose.|And while they're not important in the overall scheme of things, there's Mick and Ralph, too. Just don't tell them I said that.|Who all did you want to know about?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic100 "Who are the important people in Freeside?" [DIAL:001596E5]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: What can you tell me about Pacer?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic099 "What can you tell me about Pacer?" [DIAL:001596E6]

text_content: Pace? He and I grew up together around here. We've been through a lot together, and there's no man I'd rather have at my side in a pinch.|Don't judge him too harshly for trying to get some caps out of you. He probably took you for a squatter, looking for a place to settle down.|There've been a lot of people moving into the area lately, and it's got some people riled. Can't blame 'em myself. There's only so much to go around.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic099 "What can you tell me about Pacer?" [DIAL:001596E6]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: I had other questions.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic093 "I had other questions." [DIAL:001596E7]

text_content: So why isn't every man in Freeside in your gang?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic065 "So why isn't every man in Freeside in your gang?" [DIAL:001596E8]

text_content: We've tried to pass our philosophy on to the people of Freeside, but not everyone is ready to be a King.|The kids love us, but the old-timers tend to shy away and keep to themselves. They probably couldn't pull off the look, anyway.|As for the others, some people just plain don't respect others, and that's a no-no. If there's one thing I won't tolerate, it's lack of respect.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic065 "So why isn't every man in Freeside in your gang?" [DIAL:001596E8]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: What is there to do in Freeside?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSPacerTopic024 "What is there to do in Freeside?" [DIAL:001596EA]

text_content: Aside from this place, there's the Atomic Wrangler just up the street. Women, gambling, booze, you name it, they got you covered.|If you're more of a prude, the Followers run a mission out of the Old Mormon Fort up toward the north gate. Great place if you're hurt, I guess.|If you like things dangerous, just past the Wrangler is the Silver Rush, where the Van Graff family peddles their weapons.|Their stuff is outrageously priced, but if you want to shoot something hi-tech, they're the best game in town.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSPacerTopic024 "What is there to do in Freeside?" [DIAL:001596EA]
speaker: VFSPacer "Pacer" [NPC_:0010E037]

text_content: Let's talking about something else.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSPacerTopic023 "Let's talking about something else." [DIAL:001596EB]

text_content: So there's no law here at all?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSPacerTopic022 "So there's no law here at all?" [DIAL:001596EC]

text_content: People can do whatever they want, they just have to keep in mind what'll happen afterward.|I guess you could say we don't have law so much as consequences.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSPacerTopic022 "So there's no law here at all?" [DIAL:001596EC]
speaker: VFSPacer "Pacer" [NPC_:0010E037]

text_content: Is there anyone like that in Freeside?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSPacerTopic021 "Is there anyone like that in Freeside?" [DIAL:001596ED]

text_content: Well, the Van Graffs for one. We had a slight difference of opinion when they first showed up.|Changed our minds pretty quick after a brief demonstration of how much firepower they're packing.|We could probably take them, but we'd lose a lotta guys doing it.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSPacerTopic021 "Is there anyone like that in Freeside?" [DIAL:001596ED]
speaker: VFSPacer "Pacer" [NPC_:0010E037]

text_content: Then it's best we kill you all now. Securitrons? Please erase NCR from the Dam.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic072 "Then it's best we kill you all now. Securitrons? Please erase NCR from the Dam." [DIAL:0015985F]

text_content: Tell your soldiers you're going to attack Vegas, see what happens.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic071 "Tell your soldiers you're going to attack Vegas, see what happens." [DIAL:00159860]

text_content: Attack me, and I'll order an attack on NCR at McCarran, the Embassy, and the Strip.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic070 "Attack me, and I'll order an attack on NCR at McCarran, the Embassy, and the Strip." [DIAL:00159861]

text_content: NCR can't hold the Mojave already, and now you're threatening me?
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic069 "NCR can't hold the Mojave already, and now you're threatening me?" [DIAL:00159862]

text_content: I'm not going to throw away the lives of my men just to make a point. And there'll be other days.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic069 "NCR can't hold the Mojave already, and now you're threatening me?" [DIAL:00159862]
speaker: VHDGeneralOliver "General Lee Oliver" [NPC_:001300A9]

text_content: No, General, you keep it in mind - and our conversation is over.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic053 "No, General, you keep it in mind - and our conversation is over." [DIAL:00159863]

text_content: Well, at least I can talk to you unlike that bastard Caesar and that plate-faced general. It'll do.|{Chuckles}Guess sometimes you get the bull, other times you get the horns. Still, at least some lives got saved this day.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic053 "No, General, you keep it in mind - and our conversation is over." [DIAL:00159863]
speaker: VHDGeneralOliver "General Lee Oliver" [NPC_:001300A9]

text_content: VFSSimonPacerDead
name: VFSSimonPacerDead "VFSSimonPacerDead" [DIAL:00159868]

text_content: Oh man, Gloria's going to be pissed when she hears about this. Still, he started it, so we probably won't go to war with the Kings.
name: VFSSimonPacerDead "VFSSimonPacerDead" [DIAL:00159868]

text_content: VFSSimonPlayerAttackedCustomer
name: VFSSimonPlayerAttackedCustomer "VFSSimonPlayerAttackedCustomer" [DIAL:00159869]

text_content: What the hell are you doing?
name: VFSSimonPlayerAttackedCustomer "VFSSimonPlayerAttackedCustomer" [DIAL:00159869]

text_content: VFSSimonPacerPeaceful
name: VFSSimonPacerPeaceful "VFSSimonPacerPeaceful" [DIAL:0015986A]

text_content: Way to keep your head, rookie. There's hope for you yet.
name: VFSSimonPacerPeaceful "VFSSimonPacerPeaceful" [DIAL:0015986A]

text_content: Work is work, right?
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic014 "Work is work, right?" [DIAL:0015986B]

text_content: Spoken like a chump. A King doesn't have to grovel before others to get paid. Anyway, I've got better things to do than shoot the shit with you.
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic014 "Work is work, right?" [DIAL:0015986B]
speaker: VFSPacer "Pacer" [NPC_:0010E037]

text_content: Watch your mouth or my trigger finger might twitch.
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic013 "Watch your mouth or my trigger finger might twitch." [DIAL:0015986C]

text_content: Nah, I've just risen up in the world.
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic012 "Nah, I've just risen up in the world." [DIAL:0015986D]

text_content: Ha, you've got yourself a live one here, Simon. Anyway, I've got things to do. Later.
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic012 "Nah, I've just risen up in the world." [DIAL:0015986D]
speaker: VFSPacer "Pacer" [NPC_:0010E037]

text_content: Do you ever stop talking tough?
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic011 "Do you ever stop talking tough?" [DIAL:0015986E]

text_content: Yeah, right before I beat somebody down. Let's take this fool, boys.
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic011 "Do you ever stop talking tough?" [DIAL:0015986E]
speaker: VFSPacer "Pacer" [NPC_:0010E037]

text_content: Never mind. Just forget I said anything.
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic010 "Never mind. Just forget I said anything." [DIAL:0015986F]

text_content: Yeah, that's what I thought.
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic010 "Never mind. Just forget I said anything." [DIAL:0015986F]
speaker: VFSPacer "Pacer" [NPC_:0010E037]

text_content: Actually, it does. What are you going to do about it?
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic009 "Actually, it does. What are you going to do about it?" [DIAL:00159870]

text_content: You asked for it, punk!
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic009 "Actually, it does. What are you going to do about it?" [DIAL:00159870]
speaker: VFSPacer "Pacer" [NPC_:0010E037]

text_content: Apparently I do. Something wrong with that?
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic008 "Apparently I do. Something wrong with that?" [DIAL:00159871]

text_content: No, nothing wrong at all. By all means, carry on.
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic008 "Apparently I do. Something wrong with that?" [DIAL:00159871]
speaker: VFSPacer "Pacer" [NPC_:0010E037]

text_content: Why don't you just get the hell out of here?
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic007 "Why don't you just get the hell out of here?" [DIAL:00159872]

text_content: Who do you think you're talking to? Just because the King happens to like you, doesn't mean you can run your mouth any way you damn like.
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic007 "Why don't you just get the hell out of here?" [DIAL:00159872]
speaker: VFSPacer "Pacer" [NPC_:0010E037]

text_content: Good to see you, too, Pacer.
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic006 "Good to see you, too, Pacer." [DIAL:00159873]

text_content: I'm sure it's the highlight of your day. Anyway, I've gotta bounce. Things to do, and all that.
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic006 "Good to see you, too, Pacer." [DIAL:00159873]
speaker: VFSPacer "Pacer" [NPC_:0010E037]

text_content: Care to back that up?
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic004 "Care to back that up?" [DIAL:00159874]

text_content: Let's take this chump, guys!
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic004 "Care to back that up?" [DIAL:00159874]
speaker: VFSPacer "Pacer" [NPC_:0010E037]

text_content: It's fine, Simon. I won't let him get to me.
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic003 "It's fine, Simon. I won't let him get to me." [DIAL:00159875]

text_content: Get out of here before you get hurt.
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic002 "Get out of here before you get hurt." [DIAL:00159876]

text_content: Ouch, this one's got a bite, Simon! Call him off, or he'll get put down.
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic002 "Get out of here before you get hurt." [DIAL:00159876]
speaker: VFSPacer "Pacer" [NPC_:0010E037]

text_content: Ouch, this one's got a bite, Simon! Call her off, or she'll get put down.
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic002 "Get out of here before you get hurt." [DIAL:00159876]
speaker: VFSPacer "Pacer" [NPC_:0010E037]

text_content: Why not tell her yourself?
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic001 "Why not tell her yourself?" [DIAL:00159877]

text_content: I would, but I tend to distract the boss lady a little too much. She can't help herself.|Anyway, I've got things to do. Later, Simon.
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic001 "Why not tell her yourself?" [DIAL:00159877]
speaker: VFSPacer "Pacer" [NPC_:0010E037]

text_content: I'll be sure to pass it along.
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic000 "I'll be sure to pass it along." [DIAL:00159878]

text_content: That's a good dog. Well, I'm out of here. Later, Simon.
name: VMS29aVFSPacerTopic000 "I'll be sure to pass it along." [DIAL:00159878]
speaker: VFSPacer "Pacer" [NPC_:0010E037]

text_content: VFSGuardPacerMocksGloria
name: VFSGuardPacerMocksGloria "VFSGuardPacerMocksGloria" [DIAL:00159879]

text_content: Actually, I've got a better idea. Make the new hire tell her. You'll do that for me, won't you?
name: VFSGuardPacerMocksGloria "VFSGuardPacerMocksGloria" [DIAL:00159879]

text_content: Hey, I've seen you before around our place. You've really fallen on hard times if you're working for these clowns.
name: VFSGuardPacerMocksGloria "VFSGuardPacerMocksGloria" [DIAL:00159879]

text_content: Hey, you're the one who helped us out with those NCR chumps. You really get around, don't you?
name: VFSGuardPacerMocksGloria "VFSGuardPacerMocksGloria" [DIAL:00159879]

text_content: VFSPacerGreetsSimon
name: VFSPacerGreetsSimon "VFSPacerGreetsSimon" [DIAL:0015987A]

text_content: Hey, Simon. How's it hanging? Looks like you've got a little helper today.
name: VFSPacerGreetsSimon "VFSPacerGreetsSimon" [DIAL:0015987A]

text_content: {Tiny bit of distaste here, he doesn't like Pacer}What can I say? Business has been good lately. We can afford the help.
name: VFSPacerGreetsSimon "VFSPacerGreetsSimon" [DIAL:0015987A]

text_content: Good to hear, buddy. So is the boss lady in?
name: VFSPacerGreetsSimon "VFSPacerGreetsSimon" [DIAL:0015987A]

text_content: {mood gets darker, Simon doesn't like Pacer talking about Gloria}You know she is. {This is a threat, Pacer's dead if he goes inside}Why don't you go in and say hi?
name: VFSPacerGreetsSimon "VFSPacerGreetsSimon" [DIAL:0015987A]

text_content: Nah, I've got some rounds to run. But do pass along that I'm always thinking of her.
name: VFSPacerGreetsSimon "VFSPacerGreetsSimon" [DIAL:0015987A]

text_content: VFSSimonPacerAnnounce
name: VFSSimonPacerAnnounce "VFSSimonPacerAnnounce" [DIAL:0015987B]

text_content: Crap. {stressed}This I do not need today. Keep your head straight, rookie. Things are about to get interesting.
name: VFSSimonPacerAnnounce "VFSSimonPacerAnnounce" [DIAL:0015987B]

text_content: VFSSimonGamblerAnnounce
name: VFSSimonGamblerAnnounce "VFSSimonGamblerAnnounce" [DIAL:0015987C]

text_content: Heads up. Looks like we've got another customer.
name: VFSSimonGamblerAnnounce "VFSSimonGamblerAnnounce" [DIAL:0015987C]

name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDGeneralOliverTopic092 "I couldn't have done it alone, and I appreciate the assist along the way." [DIAL:00159985]
