text_content: What do you think of the Gun Runners?
name: VMS29aVFSGloriaVanGraffTopic039 "What do you think of the Gun Runners?" [DIAL:00159A20]

text_content: They're our chief competitors in this region, and many others. That makes them our enemies.|While I respect their business acumen, I'm obligated to try to destroy them however I can. That's business, after all.
name: VMS29aVFSGloriaVanGraffTopic039 "What do you think of the Gun Runners?" [DIAL:00159A20]
speaker: VFSGloriaVanGraff "Gloria Van Graff" [NPC_:0010C67D]

text_content: What do you know of Mr. House?
name: VMS29aVFSGloriaVanGraffTopic038 "What do you know of Mr. House?" [DIAL:00159A21]

text_content: Very little, same as everyone else. We attempted to deal with him when we first moved into the area, but had no luck.|He must have his own weapons supplies to keep as many laser-armed robots operational as he does. Makes me wonder where they are...
name: VMS29aVFSGloriaVanGraffTopic038 "What do you know of Mr. House?" [DIAL:00159A21]
speaker: VFSGloriaVanGraff "Gloria Van Graff" [NPC_:0010C67D]

text_content: What do you think of the Legion?
name: VMS29aVFSGloriaVanGraffTopic037 "What do you think of the Legion?" [DIAL:00159A22]

text_content: I've only heard rumors, since this is the furthest east our operations go. But the rumors are pretty scary.|They're said to be a huge slaver nation, with all the soldiers obeying their lord with unquestioning obedience.|Sounds like a man I'd like to meet.
name: VMS29aVFSGloriaVanGraffTopic037 "What do you think of the Legion?" [DIAL:00159A22]
speaker: VFSGloriaVanGraff "Gloria Van Graff" [NPC_:0010C67D]

text_content: What do you think of the NCR?
name: VMS29aVFSGloriaVanGraffTopic036 "What do you think of the NCR?" [DIAL:00159A23]

text_content: You must not know a lot about my family or you wouldn't have asked that. The Van Graffs and the NCR have been enemies for decades.|They've tried to block our expansion for years, but we've managed to grow regardless. The problem is they have, too.|The NCR is huge, now. We're talking on a scale that's difficult to imagine. Time was, we could fight them and hold our own. Not so anymore.|My family has enough men and guns to field a small army, but the NCR can field a really, really big army. Fighting them is out of the question now.
name: VMS29aVFSGloriaVanGraffTopic036 "What do you think of the NCR?" [DIAL:00159A23]
speaker: VFSGloriaVanGraff "Gloria Van Graff" [NPC_:0010C67D]

text_content: It's just a rumor. Even so, I trust you will refrain from bringing up this subject again.

name: VMS29aVFSGloriaVanGraffTopic032 "Tell me about the Followers." [DIAL:00159A27]

text_content: Ah, the "rulers" of Freeside. The Kings are a bunch of boys who refuse to grow up, and this is their playground.|Their leader seems different, though. The few times I've dealt with him I've been impressed despite myself.|Unfortunately, he rarely acts. The Kings believe that everyone in Freeside can do whatever they want, provided they can back it up with force.|Which suits us just fine. When we first arrived in Freeside, the Kings protested when we kicked out the original occupant of this establishment.|When we reduced several of their members to glowing puddles of goo, their objections vanished. Since then, we've left each other alone.
name: VMS29aVFSGloriaVanGraffTopic031 "Tell me about the Kings." [DIAL:00159A28]

text_content: VHSecuritronHouse
name: VHSecuritronHouse "VHSecuritronHouse" [DIAL:00159B1B]

text_content: Ah, General Oliver. I expected you would survive.
name: VHSecuritronHouse "VHSecuritronHouse" [DIAL:00159B1B]
speaker: MrHouse "Mr. House" [CREA:00125BB5]

text_content: I see you've met my star employee. {Beat, pleased}A real performer, obviously - and a lot more {emphasis}reliable than the other candidate I considered for the position.
name: VHSecuritronHouse "VHSecuritronHouse" [DIAL:00159B1B]
speaker: MrHouse "Mr. House" [CREA:00125BB5]

text_content: I'd pay very close attention to what she has to say, as well as any official papers she hands over for your perusal.
name: VHSecuritronHouse "VHSecuritronHouse" [DIAL:00159B1B]
speaker: MrHouse "Mr. House" [CREA:00125BB5]

text_content: I'd pay very close attention to what he has to say, as well as any official papers he hands over for your perusal.
name: VHSecuritronHouse "VHSecuritronHouse" [DIAL:00159B1B]
speaker: MrHouse "Mr. House" [CREA:00125BB5]

text_content: {eager to enjoy triumph}Let's get on with it, shall we? Hmm?
name: VHSecuritronHouse "VHSecuritronHouse" [DIAL:00159B1B]
speaker: MrHouse "Mr. House" [CREA:00125BB5]

text_content: VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000 "VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000" [DIAL:00159B34]

text_content: You know, I've had thousands of employees in my time. Few met my expectations, fewer still surpassed them.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000 "VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000" [DIAL:00159B34]
speaker: VHDSecuritronHouse "Securitron Mk I" [CREA:00159B21]

text_content: Your performance has been nothing short of spectacular. If I have need for a {beat}"specialist" of your stripe again, I'll know just where to turn.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000 "VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000" [DIAL:00159B34]
speaker: VHDSecuritronHouse "Securitron Mk I" [CREA:00159B21]

text_content: Back to Vegas, shall we? {to yourself}I really should do something about that monorail - with all the new resources at hand...|I can make sure it not only runs, but runs on time. {Back to conversation with player}Always bothered me, the {disliked word}imprecision.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000 "VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000" [DIAL:00159B34]
speaker: VHDSecuritronHouse "Securitron Mk I" [CREA:00159B21]

text_content: {Kimball alive, Oliver alive}{A little reassuring}No need to worry about the General, by the way. He'll be held responsible, publicly disgraced... 36.5% probability of suicide, by my estimate...|Kimball won't be able to save him - he'll be too busy getting thrown out of office. {clueing player in}But less than a 3% chance of suicide, mind you.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000 "VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000" [DIAL:00159B34]
speaker: VHDSecuritronHouse "Securitron Mk I" [CREA:00159B21]

text_content: {Kimball alive, Oliver dead}{A little reassuring}No need to worry about the General's "accident," by the way. A mercy, really, sparing him the disgrace of {emphasis}surviving his nation's defeat...|President Kimball may long to avenge his friend's death, but he won't be President long enough to do anything about it.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000 "VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000" [DIAL:00159B34]
speaker: VHDSecuritronHouse "Securitron Mk I" [CREA:00159B21]

text_content: {Kimball dead, Oliver Dead}{a little disappointed}The General's "accident" was unfortunate... with Kimball dead, the angry Californian public could've used an alternate scapegoat to pillory...
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000 "VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000" [DIAL:00159B34]
speaker: VHDSecuritronHouse "Securitron Mk I" [CREA:00159B21]

text_content: {Kimball dead, Oliver alive}{sober}General Oliver will try to make good on his threats, and he'll find support among citizens outraged by Kimball's assassination...|The odds of the Californian public supporting a full-scale {emphasize "re"}re-invasion, however, are slight. My Securitrons could beat them, anyway.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000 "VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000" [DIAL:00159B34]
speaker: VHDSecuritronHouse "Securitron Mk I" [CREA:00159B21]

text_content: Vegas might see a dip in revenue for a few months, half a year - but soon enough the tourists - and their money - will be pouring in.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000 "VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000" [DIAL:00159B34]
speaker: VHDSecuritronHouse "Securitron Mk I" [CREA:00159B21]

text_content: In any case, Vegas might see a dip in revenue for a year or two, but eventually the tourists will come flooding back, and their money with them.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000 "VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000" [DIAL:00159B34]
speaker: VHDSecuritronHouse "Securitron Mk I" [CREA:00159B21]

text_content: Vegas will be a shining jewel in the middle of the desert, an oasis of light, a beacon to show mankind the way to the stars.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000 "VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000" [DIAL:00159B34]
speaker: VHDSecuritronHouse "Securitron Mk I" [CREA:00159B21]

text_content: This is just the start, you see. {beat}This is where it all begins.
name: VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000 "VFreeformHooverDamVHDSecuritronHouseTopic000" [DIAL:00159B34]
speaker: VHDSecuritronHouse "Securitron Mk I" [CREA:00159B21]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: EDETopicTest "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:00159FF7]

text_content: Oh, well if you change your mind let me know. I have some parts here I can use to upgrade his armor if you leave it with me for a bit.
name: EDETopicTest "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:00159FF7]
speaker: HVKnightEDE "Senior Knight Lorenzo" [NPC_:000A41A3]

text_content: The logs spoke about Enclave Duraframe research and Poseidon Energy research.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic001 "The logs spoke about Enclave Duraframe research and Poseidon Energy research." [DIAL:00159FF8]

text_content: {Surprise}Did... did you say Poseidon Energy? I've been researching some Poseidon projects here.|Do you think you could leave your robot with me for a few days? I have some materials that I can use to upgrade his armor while he's here.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic001 "The logs spoke about Enclave Duraframe research and Poseidon Energy research." [DIAL:00159FF8]
speaker: HVKnightEDE "Senior Knight Lorenzo" [NPC_:000A41A3]

text_content: I've heard some information from its logs, sounds like it is carrying some Enclave data.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic000 "I've heard some information from its logs, sounds like it is carrying some Enclave data." [DIAL:00159FF9]

text_content: Really? What kind of logs? What kind of data does he have on it?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic000 "I've heard some information from its logs, sounds like it is carrying some Enclave data." [DIAL:00159FF9]
speaker: HVKnightEDE "Senior Knight Lorenzo" [NPC_:000A41A3]

text_content: Great, I'd love to take a look at that log data.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic000 "I've heard some information from its logs, sounds like it is carrying some Enclave data." [DIAL:00159FF9]
speaker: HVKnightEDE "Senior Knight Lorenzo" [NPC_:000A41A3]

text_content: EDEFoundTopic
name: EDEFoundTopic "EDEFoundTopic" [DIAL:00159FFA]

text_content: Hold up there, that looks like Enclave tech. Take that over to Knight Lorenzo if you get a moment, he may be able to get some information out of it.
name: EDEFoundTopic "EDEFoundTopic" [DIAL:00159FFA]

text_content: Is there another way to get Mr. House's data?
name: vfreeformlucky38Lucky38FollowerEmilyTopic022 "Is there another way to get Mr. House's data?" [DIAL:0015A00D]

text_content: {wary}After two tries, I think I've learned enough. I'm sure there's something more promising I could be helping the other Followers with.|Uh... oh yeah, I didn't tell you about the first time. I'd rather not talk about it, if you don't mind.
name: vfreeformlucky38Lucky38FollowerEmilyTopic022 "Is there another way to get Mr. House's data?" [DIAL:0015A00D]
quest: vfreeformlucky38 "The Moon Comes Over the Tower" [QUST:0011A0C5]
speaker: Lucky38FollowerEmily "Emily Ortal" [NPC_:0011904E]

text_content: I already told you, I don't want to talk about it.
name: vfreeformlucky38Lucky38FollowerEmilyTopic022 "Is there another way to get Mr. House's data?" [DIAL:0015A00D]
quest: vfreeformlucky38 "The Moon Comes Over the Tower" [QUST:0011A0C5]
speaker: Lucky38FollowerEmily "Emily Ortal" [NPC_:0011904E]

text_content: What do you do around here?
name: vfreeformlucky38Lucky38FollowerEmilyTopic016 "What do you do around here?" [DIAL:0015A00E]

text_content: I'm interested in medicine, but it's not my strong suit. I try to help out with any computer issues the Followers have.|That's why I was helping out with the research into Mr. House's technology. {disappointed}Trying to, anyway.
name: vfreeformlucky38Lucky38FollowerEmilyTopic016 "What do you do around here?" [DIAL:0015A00E]
quest: vfreeformlucky38 "The Moon Comes Over the Tower" [QUST:0011A0C5]
speaker: Lucky38FollowerEmily "Emily Ortal" [NPC_:0011904E]

text_content: How long have you been with the Followers?
name: vfreeformlucky38Lucky38FollowerEmilyTopic012 "How long have you been with the Followers?" [DIAL:0015A00F]

text_content: About five years now. I have family back in Arroyo, but this is where all of the good work is being done, so to speak.|NCR taxes and inflation have been hard for a lot of people to deal with, and most of the money is going to the war effort.|There's not much funding for medical research with OSI or any other group - not unless it has a military application, anyway.
name: vfreeformlucky38Lucky38FollowerEmilyTopic012 "How long have you been with the Followers?" [DIAL:0015A00F]
quest: vfreeformlucky38 "The Moon Comes Over the Tower" [QUST:0011A0C5]
speaker: Lucky38FollowerEmily "Emily Ortal" [NPC_:0011904E]

text_content: Why wasn't the data useful?
name: vfreeformlucky38Lucky38FollowerEmilyTopic005 "Why wasn't the data useful?" [DIAL:0015A010]

text_content: We were connected for half a minute and received enough data to fill five holodiscs. It looked like nonsense at first, but we decoded it.|It was all biometric data, life signs from Mr. House. The technology he's using is so advanced that it samples data hundreds of times per second.|It's fascinating, but depressing. Whatever technology he has can't possibly be practical for the people out here.
name: vfreeformlucky38Lucky38FollowerEmilyTopic005 "Why wasn't the data useful?" [DIAL:0015A010]
quest: vfreeformlucky38 "The Moon Comes Over the Tower" [QUST:0011A0C5]
speaker: Lucky38FollowerEmily "Emily Ortal" [NPC_:0011904E]

text_content: If you're about to ask me for help, stop.
name: vfreeformlucky38Lucky38FollowerEmilyTopic002 "If you're about to ask me for help, stop." [DIAL:0015A011]

text_content: No, wait... please. Mr. House has access to technology that could help save a lot of lives, lives of people who suffer a great deal.|Unlike Mr. House, refugees in New Vegas don't have the luxury of constant medical care. Some of them don't even have regular access to clean water.|I guess we can thank NCR for that. Anyway, just a bit of information about Mr. House's technology could go a long way.
name: vfreeformlucky38Lucky38FollowerEmilyTopic002 "If you're about to ask me for help, stop." [DIAL:0015A011]
quest: vfreeformlucky38 "The Moon Comes Over the Tower" [QUST:0011A0C5]
speaker: Lucky38FollowerEmily "Emily Ortal" [NPC_:0011904E]

text_content: VHDIndependentEnd
name: VHDIndependentEnd "VHDIndependentEnd" [DIAL:0015A0CB]

text_content: Greetings, General Oliver. The disappointment you are about to experience delights me.
name: VHDIndependentEnd "VHDIndependentEnd" [DIAL:0015A0CB]

text_content: Greetings, General.
name: VHDIndependentEnd "VHDIndependentEnd" [DIAL:0015A0CB]

text_content: Hello, General.
name: VHDIndependentEnd "VHDIndependentEnd" [DIAL:0015A0CB]

text_content: General, we like your hat.
name: VHDIndependentEnd "VHDIndependentEnd" [DIAL:0015A0CB]

text_content: General, you look well. Perhaps for not much longer.
name: VHDIndependentEnd "VHDIndependentEnd" [DIAL:0015A0CB]

text_content: Point guns at us, and we will destroy you.
name: VHDIndependentEnd "VHDIndependentEnd" [DIAL:0015A0CB]

text_content: Please do not struggle, General Oliver, you might hurt yourself. I will release you presently.
name: VHDIndependentEnd "VHDIndependentEnd" [DIAL:0015A0CB]

text_content: Please do not struggle, General Oliver, you might hurt yourself. You can relax presently.
name: VHDIndependentEnd "VHDIndependentEnd" [DIAL:0015A0CB]

text_content: Will they take you back after you killed these people?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic111 "Will they take you back after you killed these people?" [DIAL:0015A111]

text_content: I think so. Two things the Brotherhood has a lot of - hardheads and lasers. Wouldn't be the first time a disagreement ended like this.|Plus... we killed all the witnesses.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic111 "Will they take you back after you killed these people?" [DIAL:0015A111]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: It's not too late to change your mind.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic110 "It's not too late to change your mind." [DIAL:0015A112]

text_content: No, I think it is. I have to be resolved about this. If I waver, it'll just make things harder.|They need me and I'm not going to abandon them.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic110 "It's not too late to change your mind." [DIAL:0015A112]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Are you still going to travel with me?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic109 "Are you still going to travel with me?" [DIAL:0015A113]

text_content: Yeah. I've got the rest of my life to help them out. I can spare a little while to see things through with you.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic109 "Are you still going to travel with me?" [DIAL:0015A113]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: {Smiling}Sure. I want to establish a connection with the Followers first, but as far as I know, drifting is part of the job description.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic109 "Are you still going to travel with me?" [DIAL:0015A113]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: The Brotherhood has to isolate itself. Its knowledge is dangerous.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic108 "The Brotherhood has to isolate itself. Its knowledge is dangerous." [DIAL:0015A114]

text_content: Sure, but how long before the NCR or Caesar's Legion track us down and take it by force anyway?|But if we recruited Knights from outside the group, maybe we could actually defend it.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic108 "The Brotherhood has to isolate itself. Its knowledge is dangerous." [DIAL:0015A114]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Why don't you do something about it?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic107 "Why don't you do something about it?" [DIAL:0015A115]

text_content: I don't know. I'm still thinking about what kind of role we could take on that would give us the best chance of survival.|But I think things are starting to come together.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic107 "Why don't you do something about it?" [DIAL:0015A115]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: None of that is going to change. It's part of the Brotherhood's identity.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic106 "None of that is going to change. It's part of the Brotherhood's identity." [DIAL:0015A116]

text_content: I know the odds aren't good, but I've gotta try. I can't lose them.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic106 "None of that is going to change. It's part of the Brotherhood's identity." [DIAL:0015A116]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: If it's worked for this long, there must be something redeemable about their beliefs. Have faith.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic105 "If it's worked for this long, there must be something redeemable about their beliefs. Have faith." [DIAL:0015A117]

text_content: Wow, you sound like Elder McNamara. I {slight emph}know I should. Hell, it's what I signed up for when I chose to stay into adulthood. |I know there's something worth saving in there. But we're in decline. Our membership is... decimated. There's got to be something we can do.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic105 "If it's worked for this long, there must be something redeemable about their beliefs. Have faith." [DIAL:0015A117]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: The Brotherhood is living in the past. Eventually they'll have to change.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic104 "The Brotherhood is living in the past. Eventually they'll have to change." [DIAL:0015A118]

text_content: I think you're right. We're getting desperate. Hardly enough people to sustain ourselves as a chapter. They'll see the light, sooner or later.|But I get the feeling if I don't take matters into my own hands, the change won't come in time to make a difference.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic104 "The Brotherhood is living in the past. Eventually they'll have to change." [DIAL:0015A118]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Power armor and laser rifles are still effective.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic103 "Power armor and laser rifles are still effective." [DIAL:0015A119]

text_content: Yeah, but only if you've got bodies to fill the suits. We don't take on new members. We're all descendents from the original Brotherhood.|Something's going to have to change, or the empty suits are gonna be all that's left of us.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic103 "Power armor and laser rifles are still effective." [DIAL:0015A119]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: HVIbsenVirusEnd
name: HVIbsenVirusEnd "HVIbsenVirusEnd" [DIAL:0015A126]

text_content: Damn, it's jumped! I thought we might have had it that time.
name: HVIbsenVirusEnd "HVIbsenVirusEnd" [DIAL:0015A126]

text_content: Perhaps another time.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic020 "Perhaps another time." [DIAL:0015A127]

text_content: We'll continue our own efforts in the meantime.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic020 "Perhaps another time." [DIAL:0015A127]
speaker: HVScribeIbsen "Scribe Ibsen" [NPC_:0010AF1B]

text_content: Yes.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic019 "Yes." [DIAL:0015A128]

text_content: All right. I'll monitor when it jumps. When I give the signal, start checking terminals.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic019 "Yes." [DIAL:0015A128]
speaker: HVScribeIbsen "Scribe Ibsen" [NPC_:0010AF1B]

text_content: HVIbsenTenSeconds

text_content: Ten seconds!
name: HVIbsenTenSeconds "HVIbsenTenSeconds" [DIAL:0015A129]

text_content: HVIbsenThirtySeconds
name: HVIbsenThirtySeconds "HVIbsenThirtySeconds" [DIAL:0015A12A]

text_content: Thirty seconds left!
name: HVIbsenThirtySeconds "HVIbsenThirtySeconds" [DIAL:0015A12A]

text_content: HVIbsenVirusStart
name: HVIbsenVirusStart "HVIbsenVirusStart" [DIAL:0015A12B]

text_content: The virus just jumped! Find which terminals it went to!
name: HVIbsenVirusStart "HVIbsenVirusStart" [DIAL:0015A12B]

text_content: Maybe I'll try another time.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic018 "Maybe I'll try another time." [DIAL:0015A12C]

text_content: I'm almost out of ideas, so you'd be more than welcome to.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic018 "Maybe I'll try another time." [DIAL:0015A12C]
speaker: HVScribeIbsen "Scribe Ibsen" [NPC_:0010AF1B]

text_content: { Science >= 70 }
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic017 "{ Science >= 70 }" [DIAL:0015A12D]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] What? No, that... that's brilliant! It would let us seal a portion of the virus to a particular terminal, even when the other parts move.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic017 "{ Science >= 70 }" [DIAL:0015A12D]
speaker: HVScribeIbsen "Scribe Ibsen" [NPC_:0010AF1B]

text_content: [FAILED] Along with all of the crucial data contained within. That'd be like throwing the baby out with the bathwater.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic017 "{ Science >= 70 }" [DIAL:0015A12D]
speaker: HVScribeIbsen "Scribe Ibsen" [NPC_:0010AF1B]

text_content: Sounds complicated. I'll leave you to it.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic016 "Sounds complicated. I'll leave you to it." [DIAL:0015A12E]

text_content: We'll get it eventually, but it's frustrating that it's taking so long.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic016 "Sounds complicated. I'll leave you to it." [DIAL:0015A12E]
speaker: HVScribeIbsen "Scribe Ibsen" [NPC_:0010AF1B]

text_content: I'll give it a try, then.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic015 "I'll give it a try, then." [DIAL:0015A12F]

text_content: Best of luck to you. I'll tell the others to take a break so they don't get in your way. Oh, and I'll keep track of when it jumps for you.|To maximize your chances, wait for my signal before you begin.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic015 "I'll give it a try, then." [DIAL:0015A12F]

text_content: Let's go back to that virus you mentioned.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic014 "Let's go back to that virus you mentioned." [DIAL:0015A130]

text_content: That's too bad. I really have to go.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic013 "That's too bad. I really have to go." [DIAL:0015A131]

text_content: Sorry to hear that. I should be going.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic012 "Sorry to hear that. I should be going." [DIAL:0015A132]

text_content: Need any help?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic011 "Need any help?" [DIAL:0015A133]

text_content: I could use some assistance, sure, but I highly doubt you have the technical background to help us deal with this virus.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic011 "Need any help?" [DIAL:0015A133]
speaker: HVScribeIbsen "Scribe Ibsen" [NPC_:0010AF1B]

text_content: I've had better.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic010 "I've had better." [DIAL:0015A134]

text_content: You and me both. The Elder wants this data store operational pronto, but it doesn't look like the damn thing will be working anytime soon.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic010 "I've had better." [DIAL:0015A134]
speaker: HVScribeIbsen "Scribe Ibsen" [NPC_:0010AF1B]

text_content: I have to be going.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic009 "I have to be going." [DIAL:0015A135]

text_content: Please, don't let me stop you. I know what it's like to have a lot on your mind.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic009 "I have to be going." [DIAL:0015A135]
speaker: HVScribeIbsen "Scribe Ibsen" [NPC_:0010AF1B]

text_content: Why the lockdown?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic008 "Why the lockdown?" [DIAL:0015A136]

text_content: That's... not really for me to say. It's a bit of a touchy subject. You should probably forget I mentioned it.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic008 "Why the lockdown?" [DIAL:0015A136]

text_content: What do I do?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic007 "What do I do?" [DIAL:0015A137]

text_content: You'll need to locate it on three different terminals in this area in one minute. Any longer and it'll jump, and you'll have to start all over.|Locating the virus would probably be nearly impossible, but the pompous little bastard that wrote it made things a little easier for us.|Normally, terminals infected by the virus just display gibberish, but we found that terminals the virus moved to had some real data passed to them.|We were able to decrypt the data and discovered that it was just messages from the virus's writer, taunting his victims.|When you find terminals with those messages, lock them down and move on. Find three of them before the virus jumps, and we'll wipe the damn thing.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic007 "What do I do?" [DIAL:0015A137]

text_content: Anything I can do?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic005 "Anything I can do?" [DIAL:0015A138]

text_content: I suppose it couldn't hurt to get another pair of eyes on this. Maybe you'll be able to come up with something coming at it fresh.|While the entire system is infected, the virus itself is spread across three terminals. The problem is that it keeps moving periodically.|We'll have it nailed down in a terminal or two, only to have it jump to another set of terminals before we locate the third.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic005 "Anything I can do?" [DIAL:0015A138]

text_content: A virus?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic004 "A virus?" [DIAL:0015A139]

text_content: Yeah, some Pre-War jackass with too much time on his hands apparently decided to inflict his misery on those around him.|It's scrambling all the terminals here at the moment. Luckily, we only use this section for storing historical data.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic004 "A virus?" [DIAL:0015A139]

text_content: That's terrible.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic003 "That's terrible." [DIAL:0015A13A]

text_content: Nah, it's not so bad. The world outside isn't exactly a paradise, you know? Still, you can only breathe recirculated air for so long.|We've got more than a few people in here who are going a little stir crazy.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic003 "That's terrible." [DIAL:0015A13A]

text_content: Why no more patrols?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic002 "Why no more patrols?" [DIAL:0015A13B]

text_content: Oh, there are patrols. Just not exploratory ones. We've been in a state of lockdown for... well, let's just say it's been a while.|The only time anyone gets to go topside is guard duty. Or to gather provisions. Other than that, it's steel walls and fluorescent lights for us.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic002 "Why no more patrols?" [DIAL:0015A13B]

text_content: Why's that?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic001 "Why's that?" [DIAL:0015A13C]

text_content: One of our exploratory patrols - back when we had exploratory patrols - found a data disc in some ruins out in the waste.|Well, we finally got around to cataloging the damn thing and got shut out of our own datastore the second it loaded. Turns out it had a virus on it.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic001 "Why's that?" [DIAL:0015A13C]

text_content: Something wrong?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic000 "Something wrong?" [DIAL:0015A13D]

text_content: Yeah, I'm in charge of keeping this data system up and running, but accessing it is a little, ah, touch and go at the moment.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic000 "Something wrong?" [DIAL:0015A13D]

text_content: Your plan is crazy.
name: VCampGolfHanlon2CHanlonTopic000 "Your plan is crazy." [DIAL:0015A1D5]

text_content: Maybe some other time, goodbye.
name: VES34Vault1ESharecropperMorganBlakeTopic003 "Maybe some other time, goodbye." [DIAL:0015A202]

text_content: I'll go check it out.
name: VES34Vault1ESharecropperMorganBlakeTopic002 "I'll go check it out." [DIAL:0015A203]

text_content: Thanks, that's great!|I should get back to work now, see you around.
name: VES34Vault1ESharecropperMorganBlakeTopic002 "I'll go check it out." [DIAL:0015A203]
speaker: 1ESharecropperMorganBlake "Morgan Blake" [NPC_:0015A245]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VES34Vault1ESharecropperMorganBlakeTopic001 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0015A204]

text_content: See you around.
name: VES34Vault1ESharecropperMorganBlakeTopic001 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0015A204]
speaker: 1ESharecropperMorganBlake "Morgan Blake" [NPC_:0015A245]

text_content: What's going on around here?
name: VES34Vault1ESharecropperMorganBlakeTopic000 "What's going on around here?" [DIAL:0015A205]

text_content: Well, crops aren't doing so well. I'm thinking it might be something in the water.|The pump station is pretty run down, you could go take a look around the place, see if you find anything strange going on. What do you say?
name: VES34Vault1ESharecropperMorganBlakeTopic000 "What's going on around here?" [DIAL:0015A205]
speaker: 1ESharecropperMorganBlake "Morgan Blake" [NPC_:0015A245]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemDaisyWhitmanTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0015A24C]

text_content: {pilot lingo - means watch your back}Watch your six out there.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemDaisyWhitmanTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0015A24C]
speaker: VRemDaisyWhitman "Daisy Whitman" [NPC_:00133958]

text_content: I never said anything about paying you.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic007 "I never said anything about paying you." [DIAL:0015A24D]

text_content: {sarcasm}You're doing a fine job of convincing me to go along with this. Really. I'll ask again - why us?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic007 "I never said anything about paying you." [DIAL:0015A24D]
speaker: VRemOrionMoreno "Orion Moreno" [NPC_:00133955]

text_content: There isn't anyone else around with your equipment and expertise.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic006 "There isn't anyone else around with your equipment and expertise." [DIAL:0015A24E]

text_content: {bitterly}You can thank the NCR for that one. {sudden thought}Wait - this isn't on behalf of the NCR, is it?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic006 "There isn't anyone else around with your equipment and expertise." [DIAL:0015A24E]
speaker: VRemOrionMoreno "Orion Moreno" [NPC_:00133955]

text_content: Your advanced level of tech would be useful in settling things between the NCR and the Legion.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic005 "Your advanced level of tech would be useful in settling things between the NCR and the Legion." [DIAL:0015A24F]

text_content: Is that right? The million dollar question is who exactly are we "settling?"
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic005 "Your advanced level of tech would be useful in settling things between the NCR and the Legion." [DIAL:0015A24F]
speaker: VRemOrionMoreno "Orion Moreno" [NPC_:00133955]

text_content: What do you do around here?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic004 "What do you do around here?" [DIAL:0015A250]

text_content: Do? I don't do anything. I'm retired.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic004 "What do you do around here?" [DIAL:0015A250]
speaker: VRemOrionMoreno "Orion Moreno" [NPC_:00133955]

text_content: Do you have something against the NCR?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic003 "Do you have something against the NCR?" [DIAL:0015A251]

text_content: {cynical chuckle}Oh, like you wouldn't believe. The NCR makes a habit out of wrecking homes. I came out here to get away from them - didn't work out so well.|Next thing I know, I'm squatting in {emphasis "their"}"their" land. {irritation}Never mind that I'd already been living here for years.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic003 "Do you have something against the NCR?" [DIAL:0015A251]
speaker: VRemOrionMoreno "Orion Moreno" [NPC_:00133955]

text_content: {Arcade not hired}Arcade sent me to look for you. I'm gathering the Remnants.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic002 "{Arcade not hired}Arcade sent me to look for you. I'm gathering the Remnants." [DIAL:0015A252]

text_content: Arcade, huh? Heard he was with the Followers of the Apocalypse. So, what's the point of all this? Can't find any younger mercenaries?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic002 "{Arcade not hired}Arcade sent me to look for you. I'm gathering the Remnants." [DIAL:0015A252]
speaker: VRemOrionMoreno "Orion Moreno" [NPC_:00133955]

text_content: {Arcade hired}Arcade and I were looking for you. We're gathering the Remnants.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic001 "{Arcade hired}Arcade and I were looking for you. We're gathering the Remnants." [DIAL:0015A253]

text_content: {to player's companion}Been awhile, Arcade. {to player}So, what's the point of all this? Can't find any younger mercenaries?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic001 "{Arcade hired}Arcade and I were looking for you. We're gathering the Remnants." [DIAL:0015A253]
speaker: VRemOrionMoreno "Orion Moreno" [NPC_:00133955]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0015A254]

text_content: {dismissive grunt}Hmmph.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0015A254]
speaker: VRemOrionMoreno "Orion Moreno" [NPC_:00133955]

text_content: You're sure you're okay leaving them behind?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic113 "You're sure you're okay leaving them behind?" [DIAL:0015A2FB]

text_content: Yeah. I think if I stayed I'd end up causing trouble. Sometimes I just can't help myself.|This way is better for me and for them.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic113 "You're sure you're okay leaving them behind?" [DIAL:0015A2FB]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Come on. Let's get out of here.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic112 "Come on. Let's get out of here." [DIAL:0015A2FC]

text_content: {Somber}Good idea.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic112 "Come on. Let's get out of here." [DIAL:0015A2FC]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: I think that'd be best. There's a Followers outpost up near one of my old scavenging grounds. Used to do some trading with a doctor there.|If I work out of there, I'll still be able to keep tabs on Hidden Valley if I needed to. I know that route like the back of my hand.|If it's all right, I'd like to head that way. Meet some people, see if I can be of any use.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic112 "Come on. Let's get out of here." [DIAL:0015A2FC]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Ok, you can have ED-E for a little bit.
name: vQuestEdeGone "Ok, you can have ED-E for a little bit." [DIAL:0015A302]

text_content: This is excellent news. I'll send him back to you soon.
name: vQuestEdeGone "Ok, you can have ED-E for a little bit." [DIAL:0015A302]
speaker: HVKnightEDE "Senior Knight Lorenzo" [NPC_:000A41A3]

text_content: Can I just get you another laser pistol?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVInitiateStantonTopic008 "Can I just get you another laser pistol?" [DIAL:0015A33E]

text_content: No, weapon check-in protocol includes verifying the serial number of the weapon, so a different gun would be noticed.|Plus, having a new gun suddenly show up would immediately point to you, being the only outsider around here and all.|No, the only way I have out of this is if you help me find that gun. You'll help me, right?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVInitiateStantonTopic008 "Can I just get you another laser pistol?" [DIAL:0015A33E]
speaker: HVInitiateStanton "Initiate Stanton" [NPC_:0010A6FE]

text_content: I better go and start looking.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVInitiateStantonTopic007 "I better go and start looking." [DIAL:0015A33F]

text_content: Good luck!
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVInitiateStantonTopic007 "I better go and start looking." [DIAL:0015A33F]
speaker: HVInitiateStanton "Initiate Stanton" [NPC_:0010A6FE]

text_content: Could you be a little more specific about where you dropped it?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVInitiateStantonTopic006 "Could you be a little more specific about where you dropped it?" [DIAL:0015A340]

text_content: I'm pretty sure I dropped in when we made our escape. We had been surrounded and had climbed up on this big rock to hold them off.|Oh, and I remember seeing a corpse near the rock, too. We never got a chance to check it out since we were too busy fighting for our lives.|Guess we had better luck than whoever that was, huh?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVInitiateStantonTopic006 "Could you be a little more specific about where you dropped it?" [DIAL:0015A340]
speaker: HVInitiateStanton "Initiate Stanton" [NPC_:0010A6FE]

text_content: I'll try my best to find it.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVInitiateStantonTopic005 "I'll try my best to find it." [DIAL:0015A341]

text_content: Hey, no pressure. I'm just grateful you're willing to help me out.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVInitiateStantonTopic005 "I'll try my best to find it." [DIAL:0015A341]
speaker: HVInitiateStanton "Initiate Stanton" [NPC_:0010A6FE]

text_content: I have to be going.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVInitiateStantonTopic004 "I have to be going." [DIAL:0015A342]

text_content: Okay, see you around.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVInitiateStantonTopic004 "I have to be going." [DIAL:0015A342]
speaker: HVInitiateStanton "Initiate Stanton" [NPC_:0010A6FE]

text_content: I'm trying to help Torres find a missing laser pistol. Have you seen it around?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVInitiateStantonTopic003 "I'm trying to help Torres find a missing laser pistol. Have you seen it around?" [DIAL:0015A343]

text_content: No, no idea. Sorry.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVInitiateStantonTopic003 "I'm trying to help Torres find a missing laser pistol. Have you seen it around?" [DIAL:0015A343]
speaker: HVInitiateStanton "Initiate Stanton" [NPC_:0010A6FE]

text_content: Sorry, I can't help you.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVInitiateStantonTopic002 "Sorry, I can't help you." [DIAL:0015A344]

text_content: Oh man, I am so screwed! Look, if you change your mind, I'd really appreciate it.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVInitiateStantonTopic002 "Sorry, I can't help you." [DIAL:0015A344]
speaker: HVInitiateStanton "Initiate Stanton" [NPC_:0010A6FE]

text_content: Why do the records show that the gun was turned back in?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVInitiateStantonTopic001 "Why do the records show that the gun was turned back in?" [DIAL:0015A345]

text_content: Oh, I sort of altered the records after we got back. That was Watkins' idea, too. That girl is nothing but trouble.|Still, I haven't been exiled yet, or worse, assigned to latrine-cleaning duty. But I will, if you don't help me find that gun.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVInitiateStantonTopic001 "Why do the records show that the gun was turned back in?" [DIAL:0015A345]
speaker: HVInitiateStanton "Initiate Stanton" [NPC_:0010A6FE]

text_content: Fine, I'll find the gun for you.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVInitiateStantonTopic000 "Fine, I'll find the gun for you." [DIAL:0015A346]

text_content: Great! When you find it, just turn it into Torres and I'll be in the clear.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVInitiateStantonTopic000 "Fine, I'll find the gun for you." [DIAL:0015A346]
speaker: HVInitiateStanton "Initiate Stanton" [NPC_:0010A6FE]

text_content: HVIbsenVirusWiped
name: HVIbsenVirusWiped "HVIbsenVirusWiped" [DIAL:0015A347]

text_content: That's it! We got it! The virus has been purged!
name: HVIbsenVirusWiped "HVIbsenVirusWiped" [DIAL:0015A347]

text_content: This is Veronica, formerly of the Brotherhood of Steel. She's interested in joining your cause.
name: VMS49VMS49DoctorAlvarezTopic001 "This is Veronica, formerly of the Brotherhood of Steel. She's interested in joining your cause." [DIAL:0015A354]

text_content: The Brotherhood? Well, this is unusual, I must say. But very welcome.|There's certainly a lot we could learn from your technological expertise.|Doctor Schiller usually handles placement, and he won't be back until tomorrow. If you could come back then, we can see about your assignment.
name: VMS49VMS49DoctorAlvarezTopic001 "This is Veronica, formerly of the Brotherhood of Steel. She's interested in joining your cause." [DIAL:0015A354]
speaker: VMS49DoctorAlvarez "Doctor Alvarez" [NPC_:0015A359]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VMS49VMS49DoctorAlvarezTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0015A355]

text_content: Please... leave us alone.
name: VMS49VMS49DoctorAlvarezTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0015A355]
speaker: VMS49DoctorAlvarez "Doctor Alvarez" [NPC_:0015A359]

text_content: Take care of yourself.
name: VMS49VMS49DoctorAlvarezTopic000 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0015A355]
speaker: VMS49DoctorAlvarez "Doctor Alvarez" [NPC_:0015A359]

text_content: Arcade asked me to find you. I'm reuniting the Remnants, and they'll need your piloting skills.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemDaisyWhitmanTopic004 "Arcade asked me to find you. I'm reuniting the Remnants, and they'll need your piloting skills." [DIAL:0015A367]

text_content: Told you everything about us, did he? Well, it's been a while since I've had my hands on the controls of a vertibird.|There's a chance I could crash us in the middle of Lake Mead - that place seems to attract aircraft, for some reason.|But, if I'll get one more chance to fly, count me in. I'll be there. My part of the pass phrase is "Dear."
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemDaisyWhitmanTopic004 "Arcade asked me to find you. I'm reuniting the Remnants, and they'll need your piloting skills." [DIAL:0015A367]
speaker: VRemDaisyWhitman "Daisy Whitman" [NPC_:00133958]

text_content: Did you fly for the NCR?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemDaisyWhitmanTopic003 "Did you fly for the NCR?" [DIAL:0015A368]

text_content: "For?" No, not exactly. It was a long time ago. Things are a lot different these days, and those days are way behind me.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemDaisyWhitmanTopic003 "Did you fly for the NCR?" [DIAL:0015A368]
speaker: VRemDaisyWhitman "Daisy Whitman" [NPC_:00133958]

text_content: What do you do in Novac?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemDaisyWhitmanTopic002 "What do you do in Novac?" [DIAL:0015A369]

text_content: I help folks strip down the more complicated bits of salvage they bring in - engines, mostly.|The bits and pieces we take out are usually worth more than the whole thing put together.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemDaisyWhitmanTopic002 "What do you do in Novac?" [DIAL:0015A369]
speaker: VRemDaisyWhitman "Daisy Whitman" [NPC_:00133958]

text_content: You were a pilot?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemDaisyWhitmanTopic001 "You were a pilot?" [DIAL:0015A36A]

text_content: {clarifying}Vertibird pilot. Seventy-one missions and only lost one chopper. Rotor malfunction over Klamath. Hard landing, but I walked away.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemDaisyWhitmanTopic001 "You were a pilot?" [DIAL:0015A36A]
speaker: VRemDaisyWhitman "Daisy Whitman" [NPC_:00133958]

text_content: I'm not the gambling type. I need to keep moving.
name: VFreeformNellisNellisGeorgeTopic005 "I'm not the gambling type. I need to keep moving." [DIAL:0015A375]

text_content: VCassLocationNCR
name: VCassLocationNCR "VCassLocationNCR" [DIAL:0015A499]

text_content: Be careful they don't charge us any tolls.
name: VCassLocationNCR "VCassLocationNCR" [DIAL:0015A499]

text_content: Don't tell them where we're from - or headed.
name: VCassLocationNCR "VCassLocationNCR" [DIAL:0015A499]

text_content: Hmm. I'll be right back.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic018 "Hmm. I'll be right back." [DIAL:0015A5DF]

text_content: Okay, just let me know when you want to talk numbers.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanCrimsonCaravanBlakeTopic018 "Hmm. I'll be right back." [DIAL:0015A5DF]
speaker: CrimsonCaravanBlake "Blake" [NPC_:000F1863]

text_content: Goodbye.

text_content: {menace}Change of plan - you'll find that I've sealed the doors to this hangar - I don't want my friends getting involved in our little disagreement.|Once I'm done with you, I'll talk them out of this stupid plan. You've opened some old wounds - it's only fair I return the favor.

text_content: {NCR - Wild Child}I work against the NCR as much as I work for them. This is no different.

text_content: So you help them at the Dam only to screw them over big time later? {sigh}All right, I'll go along with this, then. I hope I don't regret it.

text_content: They won, we didn't. It's as simple as that. The rest of us moved on while Moreno... didn't.|Still, I'm not convinced Moreno hates the NCR as much as he thinks he does. You still might be able to talk him out of leaving.

speaker: VRemJudahKreger "Judah Kreger" [NPC_:00133956]

text_content: Help the Legion take over the Dam.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic011 "Help the Legion take over the Dam." [DIAL:0015A73D]

text_content: Well, now. An opportunity for payback after all these years. Johnson won't go along with it, though - he actually likes the NCR.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic011 "Help the Legion take over the Dam." [DIAL:0015A73D]
speaker: VRemJudahKreger "Judah Kreger" [NPC_:00133956]

text_content: I want you to help the NCR hold onto the Dam.

text_content: Then that's the plan. We're going to have a problem with Moreno, though. He won't like that we're helping the NCR - you'll have to talk to him.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic010 "I want you to help the NCR hold onto the Dam." [DIAL:0015A73E]

text_content: What is this place?

text_content: This was a minor refueling station for vertibirds. It seemed an appropriate place to stash our equipment if we ever needed.|I'm surprised this place hasn't fallen apart. When I put it into standby mode, I expected to return to it within a few years, not decades.

name: VFreeformCasaMadridWestsideMarcoTopic009 "Can you tell me anything about Anderson?" [DIAL:0015A742]

text_content: Good man. He's one of the Followers of the Apocalypse. He's the one who taught people around here how to start growing crops.|Westside wouldn't be what it is without Anderson helping us out, so I cut him a deal on his rent.
name: VFreeformCasaMadridWestsideMarcoTopic009 "Can you tell me anything about Anderson?" [DIAL:0015A742]

text_content: You tell me.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic005 "You tell me." [DIAL:0015A743]

text_content: Well, assuming our equipment cache is intact, my squad would have the edge in armor and firepower.|There's only a handful of us, though, so the best tactic would be for us to swoop in where the target isn't expecting us. {asking for an opinion of his plan}How am I doing?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic005 "You tell me." [DIAL:0015A743]
speaker: VRemJudahKreger "Judah Kreger" [NPC_:00133956]

text_content: It was Arcade's suggestion, not mine.

text_content: {bemused}It really must be bad out there if he's sending you to us. Is the idea that we swoop in by vertibird, guns blazing?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic004 "It was Arcade's suggestion, not mine." [DIAL:0015A744]
speaker: VRemJudahKreger "Judah Kreger" [NPC_:00133956]

text_content: You'll be the element of surprise.

text_content: {Judah agrees to come}Swooping in on a vertibird, guns blazing? Haven't done that in years, but all right, I'm in.|None of this means a thing if the rest of the group doesn't show up, though.

name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic004 "Tell me about New Vegas." [DIAL:0015B6F0]

text_content: It's big, it's bright, and it's one of the biggest cities still left from before the War. Well, mostly, anyway.|Used to be just a curiosity. The buildings were pre-War, but it was just as full of raiders and barbarian tribes as anyplace else.|Then Mr. House took over, got the power turned back on, and got the tribes reformed into something civilized. Now they run his casinos for him.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic004 "Tell me about New Vegas." [DIAL:0015B6F0]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: How do you feel about Caesar's Legion?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic003 "How do you feel about Caesar's Legion?" [DIAL:0015B6F1]

text_content: I don't really have a problem with them. People around here tend to see them as invading marauders planning to burn and pillage the countryside.|But I've been to Arizona, boss. Before the Legion, it was a nasty place, so thick with raiders you couldn't trade with a town two miles up the road.|Caesar's laws aren't nice, and their actions aren't always pretty. But then, neither am I, but you keep me around.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic003 "How do you feel about Caesar's Legion?" [DIAL:0015B6F1]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: What's your take on the NCR?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic002 "What's your take on the NCR?" [DIAL:0015B6F2]

text_content: They're all right, I suppose. Had a bit of tough going there at the beginning - you know their first town was nearly wiped out by raiders?|Anyway, they've got their good points and their bad, just like a lot of the old governments from before the War.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic002 "What's your take on the NCR?" [DIAL:0015B6F2]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: I'm looking for the man who shot me: he wears a checkered coat and carries a shiny pistol. Seen him?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic001 "I'm looking for the man who shot me: he wears a checkered coat and carries a shiny pistol. Seen him?" [DIAL:0015B6F3]

text_content: Sure, boss. I saw lots of guys like that while I was held prisoner by an insane supermutant in an isolated mountain fortress. Can you narrow it down?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic001 "I'm looking for the man who shot me: he wears a checkered coat and carries a shiny pistol. Seen him?" [DIAL:0015B6F3]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Benny, huh? Sorry boss, doesn't ring a bell. Then again, my brain isn't as sharp as it used to be.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic001 "I'm looking for the man who shot me: he wears a checkered coat and carries a shiny pistol. Seen him?" [DIAL:0015B6F3]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Can you tell me anything about Mr. House?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic000 "Can you tell me anything about Mr. House?" [DIAL:0015B6F4]

text_content: Just how old do you think I am, boss? Because I can pretty much guarantee I'm older than that. Let me tell you a story from before the Great War:|Everybody knew Robert House. He was a genius. A superstar. Founded RobCo at 22, dated Hollywood starlets, the works. They say he saved Las Vegas.|I was in Mexico City when the bombs dropped. Even from there, we could see House's defensive rockets shooting down the incoming missiles.|Everybody assumed he died in the War. Maybe he did. But his robots are still out there, roaming the Wastes. And now, a Mr. House rules New Vegas.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic000 "Can you tell me anything about Mr. House?" [DIAL:0015B6F4]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Will you tell me some of your stories again?
name: RaulStories "Will you tell me some of your stories again?" [DIAL:0015B6F5]

text_content: That's what I love about you, boss, your firm belief that one day you'll actually remember things people tell you. What do you want to hear about?
name: RaulStories "Will you tell me some of your stories again?" [DIAL:0015B6F5]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: RaulStory3
name: RaulStory3 "RaulStory3" [DIAL:0015B6F6]

text_content: I left everything when I left Mexico: my home, my family, my name - even my face. I know it's surprising, boss, but I wasn't always this handsome.|As far as the world knew, I was Miguel, and I was okay with that. I headed north for a while, and ended up in Tuscon - not Two-Sun, by the way.|Things were good there. Well, maybe not good, but better than Mexico City, anyways. I found myself a little shack and started fixing things.
name: RaulStory3 "RaulStory3" [DIAL:0015B6F6]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: RaulStory2
name: RaulStory2 "RaulStory2" [DIAL:0015B6F7]

text_content: After the fire, I knew my sister and I couldn't stay at Hidalgo Ranch anymore. The refugees still wanted me dead - they even put a bounty on me.|I remember how scared Rafaela was. I told her if she came with me, we'd see the vaqueros - she used to love the rodeo, especially the trick riders.|We figured maybe we could find help in Mexico City - we were young, we didn't know what had happened, really. We didn't understand about the bombs.
name: RaulStory2 "RaulStory2" [DIAL:0015B6F7]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: RaulMakeBoomer
name: RaulMakeBoomer "RaulMakeBoomer" [DIAL:0015B6F8]

text_content: That's a good thing to see, huh boss?
name: RaulMakeBoomer "RaulMakeBoomer" [DIAL:0015B6F8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: RaulCorporalSterling
name: RaulCorporalSterling "RaulCorporalSterling" [DIAL:0015B6F9]

text_content: Got a second to talk, boss?
name: RaulCorporalSterling "RaulCorporalSterling" [DIAL:0015B6F9]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: RaulStory1
name: RaulStory1 "RaulStory1" [DIAL:0015B6FA]

text_content: I grew up in a place called Hidalgo Ranch just outside Mexico City. It wasn't much, just a bit of farm with a house for three generations of Tejadas.|I wasn't the best-behaved kid. I was quick with my hands, with a pistol or a wrench, and I wasn't afraid to get into fights over it.|I never killed anybody, but I had my share of run-ins with the police. Mostly my family kept me in line.|This was before the war. We were far enough away from Mexico City when the bombs fell that we missed the worst of it - but things got bad quick.
name: RaulStory1 "RaulStory1" [DIAL:0015B6FA]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: RaulRangerAndy
name: RaulRangerAndy "RaulRangerAndy" [DIAL:0015B6FB]

text_content: Hey boss, can I ask you something?
name: RaulRangerAndy "RaulRangerAndy" [DIAL:0015B6FB]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Tell me about yourself.
name: RaulSelf "Tell me about yourself." [DIAL:0015B6FC]

text_content: Sure, boss. What do you want to know?
name: RaulSelf "Tell me about yourself." [DIAL:0015B6FC]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: I have some questions I'd like to ask you.
name: RaulQuestions "I have some questions I'd like to ask you." [DIAL:0015B6FD]

text_content: Questions, boss? You mean you don't know everything there is to know already?
name: RaulQuestions "I have some questions I'd like to ask you." [DIAL:0015B6FD]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: How come your last name isn't Van Graff?
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic025 "How come your last name isn't Van Graff?" [DIAL:0015B717]

text_content: Unlike most of my brothers and sisters, Mama didn't get sick of my father and get rid of him. He died right before I was born.|Mama had liked him so much, she made me use his last name. Said he deserved that much at least, since he never got to meet me or nothin'.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic025 "How come your last name isn't Van Graff?" [DIAL:0015B717]
speaker: VFSJeanBaptisteCutting "Jean-Baptiste Cutting" [NPC_:0010C681]

text_content: How do you know about Benny?
name: VFreeformTheFortVVulpesIncultaStripTopic006 "How do you know about Benny?" [DIAL:0015B79E]

text_content: Little escapes the notice of {KAI-zar}Caesar's Legion. We know a great deal about the Vegas Strip, and the comings and goings of those who frequent it.
name: VFreeformTheFortVVulpesIncultaStripTopic006 "How do you know about Benny?" [DIAL:0015B79E]
speaker: VVulpesIncultaStrip "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:00131F77]

text_content: You again? How'd you find me here?
name: VFreeformTheFortVVulpesIncultaStripTopic005 "You again? How'd you find me here?" [DIAL:0015B79F]

text_content: I am the greatest of his {KAI-zar's}Caesar's {froo-men-TAR-ee}Frumentarii. It was not a challenge to find you. Nor is this my first visit to the Strip.
name: VFreeformTheFortVVulpesIncultaStripTopic005 "You again? How'd you find me here?" [DIAL:0015B79F]
speaker: VVulpesIncultaStrip "Vulpes Inculta" [NPC_:00131F77]

text_content: I think you'll be a very good distraction.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic022 "I think you'll be a very good distraction." [DIAL:0015B8EB]

text_content: {Judah agrees to come}Yeah, well, don't count on us sticking around if things get too hot. We're not a suicide squad. I'll go to this reunion.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic022 "I think you'll be a very good distraction." [DIAL:0015B8EB]
speaker: VRemJudahKreger "Judah Kreger" [NPC_:00133956]

text_content: That's way better than what I had in mind.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic021 "That's way better than what I had in mind." [DIAL:0015B8EC]

text_content: {Judah agrees to come}I hope you weren't thinking we were going to take the lead. That's no job for a bunch of graybeards. Or grayheads, in Whitman's case.|I'll be there at the reunion. Let's hope the others show up, too, or this plan isn't going to work.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic021 "That's way better than what I had in mind." [DIAL:0015B8EC]
speaker: VRemJudahKreger "Judah Kreger" [NPC_:00133956]

text_content: Sounds good to me. Does that mean you're in?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic020 "Sounds good to me. Does that mean you're in?" [DIAL:0015B8ED]

text_content: {Judah agrees to come}I'll be there, but it won't mean squat if the rest of the group isn't there, too.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic020 "Sounds good to me. Does that mean you're in?" [DIAL:0015B8ED]
speaker: VRemJudahKreger "Judah Kreger" [NPC_:00133956]

text_content: <Lie> I was hoping you'd want take down the NCR, since that's the plan.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic027 "<Lie> I was hoping you'd want take down the NCR, since that's the plan." [DIAL:0015B8EE]

text_content: No. I was planning on helping the Legion against the NCR.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic026 "No. I was planning on helping the Legion against the NCR." [DIAL:0015B8EF]

text_content: <Lie> Then you'll be happy to know I'm planning on helping the Legion.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic025 "<Lie> Then you'll be happy to know I'm planning on helping the Legion." [DIAL:0015B8F0]

text_content: Are you coming to this thing or what?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic023 "Are you coming to this thing or what?" [DIAL:0015B8F1]

text_content: <Lie> That's what I was thinking, too.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic022 "<Lie> That's what I was thinking, too." [DIAL:0015B8F2]

text_content: I want to help the Legion defeat the NCR.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic021 "I want to help the Legion defeat the NCR." [DIAL:0015B8F3]

text_content: {Orion agrees to come}All right, then - I'll show up at this gathering of yours. It might be good to see the others - {scowling}Johnson excluded.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic021 "I want to help the Legion defeat the NCR." [DIAL:0015B8F3]
speaker: VRemOrionMoreno "Orion Moreno" [NPC_:00133955]

text_content: Arcade might've mentioned there's a pass phrase needed to get into the bunker - my part is "Remember."
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic021 "I want to help the Legion defeat the NCR." [DIAL:0015B8F3]
speaker: VRemOrionMoreno "Orion Moreno" [NPC_:00133955]

text_content: So you're not coming?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic020 "So you're not coming?" [DIAL:0015B8F4]

text_content: {Orion agrees to come}Oh, I'll come, but depending on the plan, I might not be staying. Keep that in mind.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic020 "So you're not coming?" [DIAL:0015B8F4]
speaker: VRemOrionMoreno "Orion Moreno" [NPC_:00133955]

text_content: Does it matter who we help?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic018 "Does it matter who we help?" [DIAL:0015B8F5]

text_content: Yeah, it does. There's not a chance you'll find me helping the NCR in any way. They've caused me too much grief.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic018 "Does it matter who we help?" [DIAL:0015B8F5]
speaker: VRemOrionMoreno "Orion Moreno" [NPC_:00133955]

text_content: Do you have a preference?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic017 "Do you have a preference?" [DIAL:0015B8F6]

text_content: I wouldn't mind cutting down a few platoons of NCR troopers with my old gatling laser.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic017 "Do you have a preference?" [DIAL:0015B8F6]
speaker: VRemOrionMoreno "Orion Moreno" [NPC_:00133955]

text_content: I haven't decided.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic014 "I haven't decided." [DIAL:0015B8F7]

text_content: {slowly repeating player}You haven't decided - {sarcasm}well, this is just getting better every second, isn't it?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic014 "I haven't decided." [DIAL:0015B8F7]
speaker: VRemOrionMoreno "Orion Moreno" [NPC_:00133955]

text_content: Can you help me find the package I lost?
name: JNashChipInfo "Can you help me find the package I lost?" [DIAL:0015B9F9]

text_content: You take care of our problems here and I'll give you the information that you need.|Them Powder Gangsters got our deputy locked up in the Bison Steve. Be nice to get him out of there... but this town's gonna need some real law.|One of the first things them punks did when they came in was to kill our sheriff. You find us a new one and we can talk.
name: JNashChipInfo "Can you help me find the package I lost?" [DIAL:0015B9F9]

name: JNashChipInfoDUPLICATE000 "Where can I get information on the man that shot me?" [DIAL:0015B9FD]

text_content: {edited line}Beagle had some notes he was taking while he was eavesdropping around the Powder Gangsters. He'll be your best source of information on that subject.
name: JNashChipInfoDUPLICATE000 "Where can I get information on the man that shot me?" [DIAL:0015B9FD]

text_content: What changed?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic133 "What changed?" [DIAL:0015BA27]

text_content: {Emph}He did. For years, he fought with the Council. Taught me to question our direction. Meanwhile he'd become more out-of-touch than all of them.|On our way East he demanded we stop at HELIOS One to examine it. While we were there, we received word that the NCR had taken the Dam.|He was furious. Called it "children playing with a bomb." But he was mad because we'd lost its power. What we'd use it for... he didn't even care.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic133 "What changed?" [DIAL:0015BA27]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Did you follow him from California?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic132 "Did you follow him from California?" [DIAL:0015BA28]

text_content: It was by his request, actually. He cleared it with the other Elders. {To herself}Somehow.|They sent him to look into the Dam. There was a time when I'd have begged to follow. Watch him at work.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic132 "Did you follow him from California?" [DIAL:0015BA28]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: What was in the note?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic131 "What was in the note?" [DIAL:0015BA29]

text_content: It was... strange. Even for Father Elijah. He's always been unstable, but this was... something else.|I don't want to say delusional, but I don't know what else to call it. The only thing familiar about it was the signature.|He said the Brotherhood was doomed, but that he'd return, save us. But the {emph}way he said it... I don't know...|{Skeptical, but ominous}Said he'd return with one of the greatest treasures of the Old World, make the Mojave like it was meant to be... wipe the slate clean.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic131 "What was in the note?" [DIAL:0015BA29]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: How is that different? What did you learn from him?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic130 "How is that different? What did you learn from him?" [DIAL:0015BA2A]

text_content: I learned what I don't want to become.|In the end, there was just him and his vision. Nothing and no one else.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic130 "How is that different? What did you learn from him?" [DIAL:0015BA2A]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic129 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0015BA2B]

text_content: {Elongate the 'o'}Okay.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic129 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0015BA2B]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: What did you learn from him?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic128 "What did you learn from him?" [DIAL:0015BA2C]

text_content: Elijah could look at an old device and immediately understand what made it work. And he could see its potential. Where it fit with other technology.|It's not something you can teach, but he tried with me. {Shrugging}Some of it stuck.|But that's what he taught me. You asked what I {emph}learned from him.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic128 "What did you learn from him?" [DIAL:0015BA2C]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Were you close?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic127 "Were you close?" [DIAL:0015BA2D]

text_content: Yeah. I miss him.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic127 "Were you close?" [DIAL:0015BA2D]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Where is he now?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic126 "Where is he now?" [DIAL:0015BA2E]

text_content: I don't know. Last time anyone saw him was in the battle at HELIOS One. I wasn't there.|He gave orders to hold the plant until it could be reactivated. But he ran out of time. The NCR overran it. Everyone thought he was dead.|But I got a note from him at a comm station. That's... how he liked to talk, even to me. He wasn't good at face-to-face.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic126 "Where is he now?" [DIAL:0015BA2E]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]
