text_content: VEndingConclusion
name: VEndingConclusion "VEndingConclusion" [DIAL:0015BADF]

text_content: {Narration, starting to wrap things up}And so the Courier's road came to an end... for now.|{Narration, wrapping things up}In the new world of the Mojave wasteland, fighting continued, blood was spilled, and many lived and died - just as they had in the Old World.|{Narration, final closing comment of the game}Because war... war never changes.
name: VEndingConclusion "VEndingConclusion" [DIAL:0015BADF]

text_content: VEndingIntro
name: VEndingIntro "VEndingIntro" [DIAL:0015BAE0]

text_content: {Narration}And so the Courier who had cheated death in the cemetery outside Goodsprings cheated death once again, and the Mojave wasteland was forever changed.
name: VEndingIntro "VEndingIntro" [DIAL:0015BAE0]

text_content: VEndingRemnants
name: VEndingRemnants "VEndingRemnants" [DIAL:0015BAE1]

text_content: {narrating}Despite surviving the destruction of the oil rig and the loss of their comrades at Navarro, the venerable Remnants were no match for the Courier.|{narrating}They carried the secrets of their old lives to their graves.
name: VEndingRemnants "VEndingRemnants" [DIAL:0015BAE1]
speaker: VRemJudahKreger "Judah Kreger" [NPC_:00133956]

text_content: {narrating}After their bold arrival at Hoover Dam, the Remnants disappeared as quickly as they came.|{narrating}Legends of their power spread throughout the southwest, a reminder of why people once feared the sight of vertibirds in the sky.
name: VEndingRemnants "VEndingRemnants" [DIAL:0015BAE1]
speaker: VRemJudahKreger "Judah Kreger" [NPC_:00133956]

text_content: {narrating}Merciless in their assault on the NCR, the Remnants struck fear into the hearts of even the Centurions at Hoover Dam.|{narrating}Well aware of the full extent of their power, {KAI-zar}Caesar commanded his troops to not pursue them.
name: VEndingRemnants "VEndingRemnants" [DIAL:0015BAE1]
speaker: VRemJudahKreger "Judah Kreger" [NPC_:00133956]

text_content: {narrating}Merciless in their assault on the NCR, the Remnants struck fear into the hearts of even the Centurions at Hoover Dam.|{narrating}{KAI-zar's}Caesar's heirs aggressively pursued the Remnants into Arizona, losing hundreds of Legionaries in the process and gaining nothing in return.
name: VEndingRemnants "VEndingRemnants" [DIAL:0015BAE1]
speaker: VRemJudahKreger "Judah Kreger" [NPC_:00133956]

text_content: VEndingRangers
name: VEndingRangers "VEndingRangers" [DIAL:0015BAE2]

text_content: {narrating}After the death of Chief Hanlon, the power of NCR's Rangers was broken for years.|{narrating}Their organization, so reliant on the wisdom and guidance of its elder members, became a shadow of what it once was to people across the wasteland.
name: VEndingRangers "VEndingRangers" [DIAL:0015BAE2]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: {narrating}Defying Chief Hanlon's worst fears, NCR's rangers persevered and distinguished themselves during the second Battle of Hoover Dam.|{narrating}The rangers, along with NCR's many troopers, shared the glory of victory.|{narrating}Hanlon wisely stayed out of the spotlight, crediting General Oliver's leadership for NCR's success.|{narrating}After a brief fanfare, Hanlon stepped down as chief and returned to the peace and quiet of his ranch outside of Redding.
name: VEndingRangers "VEndingRangers" [DIAL:0015BAE2]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: {narrating}During the attack on Hoover Dam, Chief Hanlon and his rangers threw themselves into the path of the Legion assault, dying to the last man and woman.|{narrating}In the aftermath that followed in the NCR, bitter citizens and opportunistic senators were quick to denounce President Kimball and General Oliver.|{narrating}Hanlon and his fallen rangers were revered for their bravery and sacrifice.
name: VEndingRangers "VEndingRangers" [DIAL:0015BAE2]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: {narrating}Despite distinguishing themselves during the second Battle of Hoover Dam, the rangers' victory was short-lived due to the Courier's interference.|{narrating}Chief Hanlon personally directed the evacuation of the rangers to Mojave Outpost as they fell back into NCR territory.|{narrating}Bitter over the waste of life in the Mojave, Hanlon stepped down from his post.|{narrating}After a campaign in which he denounced Oliver's and Kimball's hawkish, imperialist ways, Hanlon was elected as the senator of Redding.
name: VEndingRangers "VEndingRangers" [DIAL:0015BAE2]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: {narrating}Although they performed admirably during NCR's defense of Hoover Dam, the rangers fell into decline soon after.|{narrated}With Hanlon's plot against the occupation exposed and Oliver hailed as NCR's new war hero, many rangers were greeted coldly on their return home.|{narrating}Few openly blamed the rangers for Hanlon's treachery, but public and political support for the organization quickly dwindled.
name: VEndingRangers "VEndingRangers" [DIAL:0015BAE2]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: {narrating}With Caesar's victory came a small measure of vindication for the rangers' late Chief Hanlon.|{narrating}Upon the military's return, debate raged within NCR's senate about who was to blame for the loss of Hoover Dam.|{narrating}Though some in NCR regarded Hanlon as a traitor, many believed he was the only military commander who saw the futility in defending New Vegas.
name: VEndingRangers "VEndingRangers" [DIAL:0015BAE2]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: {narrating}Although they performed admirably during NCR's defense of Hoover Dam, the rangers fell into decline soon after.|{narrating}With Hanlon's plot against the occupation exposed and Oliver denounced for losing Hoover Dam, many rangers were greeted coldly on their return home.|{narrating}Few openly blamed the rangers for Hanlon's treachery, but public and political support for the military as a whole quickly dwindled.
name: VEndingRangers "VEndingRangers" [DIAL:0015BAE2]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: {narrating}Due to the Courier's intervention, Chief Hanlon abandoned his plan to sabotage the defense of Hoover Dam.|{narrating}The rangers assisted the troopers admirably during the Legion's ill-fated attack.|{narrating}Though General Oliver and Chief Hanlon were both praised for their leadership, the chief quietly stepped out of the spotlight.|{narrating}After a brief fanfare for a life full of accomplishments, Chief Hanlon retired and returned to the peace and quiet of his ranch in Redding.
name: VEndingRangers "VEndingRangers" [DIAL:0015BAE2]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: {narrating}Due to the Courier's intervention, Chief Hanlon abandoned his plan to sabotage the defense of Hoover Dam.|{narrating}The rangers heroically assisted NCR's troopers in their ill-fated defense against the overwhelming power of Caesar's Legion.|{narrating}Though many NCR military officers fled the territory soon after the dam was lost, Chief Hanlon remained at Camp Golf to surrender to the Legion. |{narrating}Out of respect for Hanlon's composure and worth as an adversary, Caesar had him beheaded.
name: VEndingRangers "VEndingRangers" [DIAL:0015BAE2]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: {narrating}Due to the Courier's intervention, Chief Hanlon abandoned his plan to sabotage the defense of Hoover Dam.|{narrating}The rangers heroically assisted NCR's troopers in their ill-fated defense against the overwhelming power of Caesar's Legion.|{narrating}Though many NCR military officers fled the territory soon after the dam was lost, Chief Hanlon remained at Camp Golf to surrender to the Legion.|{narrating}Despite the late Caesar's respect for Chief Hanlon as an adversary, Legate Lanius had Hanlon crucified along with all of the other rangers.
name: VEndingRangers "VEndingRangers" [DIAL:0015BAE2]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: {narrating}Due to the Courier's intervention, Chief Hanlon abandoned his plan to sabotage the defense of Hoover Dam.|{narrating}The rangers assisted the troopers admirably during the Legion's ill-fated attack.|{narrating}Though the Courier snatched victory from NCR, only General Oliver was blamed for the loss of Hoover Dam.|{narrating}Hanlon, exhausted after a lifetime of service to the NCR, stepped down from his position in the rangers and retired to his ranch in Redding.
name: VEndingRangers "VEndingRangers" [DIAL:0015BAE2]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: VEndingPrimm
name: VEndingPrimm "VEndingPrimm" [DIAL:0015BAE3]

text_content: {Narrating}Primm, already torn apart by Powder Gangers, was dealt a killing blow by the Courier.|Though prospectors pick through the remains of the town from time to time, no one re-establishes it as a settlement.
name: VEndingPrimm "VEndingPrimm" [DIAL:0015BAE3]
speaker: PrimmJohnsonNash "Johnson Nash" [NPC_:000DA729]

text_content: {Narrating}After Hoover Dam, NCR helps rebuild Primm as a major stopping point on the Long 15.|Though Primm's citizens chafe under NCR's taxes, they benefit greatly from the increased protection and merchant traffic.
name: VEndingPrimm "VEndingPrimm" [DIAL:0015BAE3]
speaker: PrimmJohnsonNash "Johnson Nash" [NPC_:000DA729]

text_content: {Narrating}Despite NCR's pledge to support Primm, they abandon the town after their loss to Mr. House.|As repayment for their NCR loyalty, Mr. House sends Securitrons to Primm to "protect" it and collect heavy taxes from its citizens.
name: VEndingPrimm "VEndingPrimm" [DIAL:0015BAE3]
speaker: PrimmJohnsonNash "Johnson Nash" [NPC_:000DA729]

text_content: {Narrating}Despite NCR's pledge to support Primm, they abandon the town after their loss to Caesar.|Though Caesar keeps Primm open for business, its citizens live under the constant watch of Legion soldiers.
name: VEndingPrimm "VEndingPrimm" [DIAL:0015BAE3]
speaker: PrimmJohnsonNash "Johnson Nash" [NPC_:000DA729]

text_content: {Narrating}Despite NCR's pledge to support Primm, they abandon the town after their loss to the Courier.|Independent again, Primm operates much as it had before the Powder Gangs arrived: full of ups and downs.
name: VEndingPrimm "VEndingPrimm" [DIAL:0015BAE3]
speaker: PrimmJohnsonNash "Johnson Nash" [NPC_:000DA729]

text_content: {Narrating}After Hoover Dam, Sheriff Meyers runs Primm with his own style of frontier justice.|He deals with most folks fairly, but now and then someone winds up dead with little to no evidence against them.
name: VEndingPrimm "VEndingPrimm" [DIAL:0015BAE3]
speaker: PrimmJohnsonNash "Johnson Nash" [NPC_:000DA729]

text_content: {Narrating}Hot-headed to the end, Sheriff Meyers choose to oppose Caesar's takeover of Primm with a standoff.|Though the citizens take out a few Legionaries, the town quickly falls to Caesar, its citizens utterly wiped out.
name: VEndingPrimm "VEndingPrimm" [DIAL:0015BAE3]
speaker: PrimmJohnsonNash "Johnson Nash" [NPC_:000DA729]

text_content: {Narrating}Primm Slim proves to be an able-minded, if not able-bodied, sheriff for Primm.|Due to his slow speed, some crooks get away without a scratch, but Primm continues to prosper under his watchful robotic eye.
name: VEndingPrimm "VEndingPrimm" [DIAL:0015BAE3]
speaker: PrimmJohnsonNash "Johnson Nash" [NPC_:000DA729]

text_content: {Narrating}Not understanding the gravity of the Legion's imminent takeover of Primm, Sheriff Primm Slim valiantly attempts to resist Caesar's will.
name: VEndingPrimm "VEndingPrimm" [DIAL:0015BAE3]
speaker: PrimmJohnsonNash "Johnson Nash" [NPC_:000DA729]

text_content: VEndingPowderGang
name: VEndingPowderGang "VEndingPowderGang" [DIAL:0015BAE4]

text_content: {narrating}With Cooke dead, the Powder Gangers at Vault 19 fell apart.|{narrating}Those who weren't destroyed by the Courier fled into the hills or attempted to work their way back through the Mojave Wasteland. Few survived.
name: VEndingPowderGang "VEndingPowderGang" [DIAL:0015BAE4]
speaker: VVault19SamuelCooke "Samuel Cooke" [NPC_:0013E4D6]

text_content: {narrating}Armed with a wide array of improvised explosives and stolen weapons, the Vault 19 Powder Gang tormented the Mojave Wasteland for years.|{narrating}Citizens of the NCR were favorite targets, and they always suffered the worst fates.
name: VEndingPowderGang "VEndingPowderGang" [DIAL:0015BAE4]
speaker: VVault19SamuelCooke "Samuel Cooke" [NPC_:0013E4D6]

text_content: {narrating}After the Vault 19 Powder Gang surrendered to the NCR, they were re-incorporated into the correctional system.|{narrating}The NCR did increase their sentences, as they aren't about to take off time for good behavior.
name: VEndingPowderGang "VEndingPowderGang" [DIAL:0015BAE4]
speaker: VVault19SamuelCooke "Samuel Cooke" [NPC_:0013E4D6]

text_content: {narrating}After the majority of the Vault 19 Powder Gangers joined the Great Khans, the weaker members scattered throughout the Mojave Wasteland.|{narrating}Though a few managed to erase their pasts, most never survived the journey.
name: VEndingPowderGang "VEndingPowderGang" [DIAL:0015BAE4]
speaker: VVault19SamuelCooke "Samuel Cooke" [NPC_:0013E4D6]

text_content: VEndingNovac
name: VEndingNovac "VEndingNovac" [DIAL:0015BAE5]

text_content: {narrating}Despite their vigilance against potential attacks by the Legion, the citizens of Novac were no match for the Courier.|{narrating}The motel and Dinky the Dinosaur were left vacant, a rare stop at best for travelers along Highway 95.
name: VEndingNovac "VEndingNovac" [DIAL:0015BAE5]
speaker: JeannieMayCrawford "Jeannie May Crawford" [NPC_:0008D749]

text_content: {narrating}Though Novac was a low-priority target for the Legion, many of Novac's citizens died in its defense.|{narrating}In the weeks that followed, feral ghouls, overflowing from the REPCONN Test Site, ravaged the weakened town.
name: VEndingNovac "VEndingNovac" [DIAL:0015BAE5]
speaker: JeannieMayCrawford "Jeannie May Crawford" [NPC_:0008D749]

text_content: {narrating}Though Novac was a low-priority target for the Legion, many of Novac's citizens died in its defense.|{narrating}With no other communities coming to its defense, Novac would eventually fall to the Legion's persistent attacks.
name: VEndingNovac "VEndingNovac" [DIAL:0015BAE5]
speaker: JeannieMayCrawford "Jeannie May Crawford" [NPC_:0008D749]

text_content: {narrating}Though Novac was a low-priority target for the Legion, many of Novac's citizens died in its defense.|{narrating}In the weeks that followed, several Bright Followers returned to Novac to help restore its defenses, allowing it to remain independent of NCR.
name: VEndingNovac "VEndingNovac" [DIAL:0015BAE5]
speaker: JeannieMayCrawford "Jeannie May Crawford" [NPC_:0008D749]

text_content: {narrating}During the Legion's attack on Novac, Bright Followers, returning from their long pilgrimage, assisted in its evacuation.|{narrating}Though Novac eventually fell to the Legion, many citizens of Novac were able to escape, alive and intact.
name: VEndingNovac "VEndingNovac" [DIAL:0015BAE5]
speaker: JeannieMayCrawford "Jeannie May Crawford" [NPC_:0008D749]

text_content: {narrating}While the destruction of the REPCONN rockets appeared to be a boon to the salvagers of Novac, the benefit would never be realized.|{narrating}Radioactive fuel from the wrecked ships seeped out and contaminated the area. Salvagers were forced to move on, and the town was abandoned.
name: VEndingNovac "VEndingNovac" [DIAL:0015BAE5]
speaker: JeannieMayCrawford "Jeannie May Crawford" [NPC_:0008D749]

text_content: VEndingMisfits
name: VEndingMisfits "VEndingMisfits" [DIAL:0015BAE6]

text_content: {Narrating}Slain to the last man by the Courier, the Misfits were at least spared the humiliation of dying during Caesar's attack on Camp Golf.|Few mourned their absence.
name: VEndingMisfits "VEndingMisfits" [DIAL:0015BAE6]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: {Narrating}Shaped up by the Courier's advice, the Misfits distinguished themselves during the Legion's attack on Camp Golf.|Mags was finally promoted to Sergeant, and the rest of the Misfits received an official commendation.|They continued to serve with distinction for many years.
name: VEndingMisfits "VEndingMisfits" [DIAL:0015BAE6]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: {Narrating}Though Camp Golf fell to Caesar, the Misfits distinguished themselves during the Legion's attack.|Mags and her soldiers were posthumously recognized for their valor by NCR.
name: VEndingMisfits "VEndingMisfits" [DIAL:0015BAE6]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: {Narrating}The Misfits' laziness caught up with them when the Legion attacked Camp Golf.|Those who weren't killed in the attack attempted to flee, but were caught at Mojave Outpost, court-martialed, and hanged from the ranger monument.
name: VEndingMisfits "VEndingMisfits" [DIAL:0015BAE6]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: {Narrating}Driven into a frenzy by their use of Psycho, the Misfits inflicted heavy casualties on the Legion during the defense of Camp Golf.|At first they were commended for their valor, but eventually, desperate for more of the chem, they turned on travelers in Outer Vegas.|For their dishonorable conduct, the NCR court-martialed and executed them by firing squad.
name: VEndingMisfits "VEndingMisfits" [DIAL:0015BAE6]
speaker: 2CMags "Mags" [NPC_:00104315]

text_content: VEndingKings
name: VEndingKings "VEndingKings" [DIAL:0015BAE7]

text_content: {Narrating}With the King dead and most of their gang slain by the Courier, the remaining Kings fled the area, never to be heard from again.
name: VEndingKings "VEndingKings" [DIAL:0015BAE7]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: {Narrating}After the NCR victory at Hoover Dam, the temporary truce between them and the Kings blossomed into a full-scale relief effort for the people.|While the NCR made repeated entreaties that Freeside join the Republic, the Kings steadfastly maintained their independence.
name: VEndingKings "VEndingKings" [DIAL:0015BAE7]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: {Narrating}Accusing the Kings of lying with a foreign invader for their newfound ties to the NCR, Mr. House punished them by ordering their forced removal.|The Kings, defiant to the end, were destroyed to the last man by House's Securitrons.
name: VEndingKings "VEndingKings" [DIAL:0015BAE7]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: {Narrating}Following the Second Battle of Hoover Dam, Freeside came to be known as one of the more stable areas in the region.|Ironically, NCR refugees found Freeside safer than most of the rest of New Vegas, where resentment still lingers.
name: VEndingKings "VEndingKings" [DIAL:0015BAE7]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: {Narrating}After their victory at Hoover Dam, the Legion quickly set about destroying all remaining resistance, including any groups with ties to the NCR.|Upon discovering the Kings' newfound relationship with the NCR, Legionaires flooded the streets of Freeside, and the Kings were quickly destroyed.
name: VEndingKings "VEndingKings" [DIAL:0015BAE7]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: {Narrating}While the NCR was busy fighting the Legion at Hoover Dam, some Kings took it upon themselves to attack NCR citizens and soldiers around Freeside.|When the NCR moved to secure the region, they cracked down the hardest on Freeside, sending a full platoon to sweep the neighborhood.|Most of the Kings were killed, with the few survivors driven out into the wastes.
name: VEndingKings "VEndingKings" [DIAL:0015BAE7]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: {Narrating}During the Second Battle of Hoover Dam, some Kings took it upon themselves to launch several attacks on NCR citizens and soldiers around Freeside.|Mr. House looked on these actions favorably, seeing them as proof of the Kings' loyalty to New Vegas, and decided to leave them alone.
name: VEndingKings "VEndingKings" [DIAL:0015BAE7]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: {Narrating}In the aftermath of the Second Battle of Hoover Dam, the Kings took the opportunity to viciously force all NCR citizens out of Freeside.|Travelers from the Republic quickly learned to avoid Freeside if they valued their safety.
name: VEndingKings "VEndingKings" [DIAL:0015BAE7]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: {Narrating}Impressed with the Kings' continued attacks upon NCR citizens and soldiers, the Legion offered them the option of being assimilated into the Legion.|The Kings refused, and briefly became slaves in the Legion, but after failed escape attempt, they were all put to death.
name: VEndingKings "VEndingKings" [DIAL:0015BAE7]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: {Narrating}As the NCR moved to secure the region, the occupation of Freeside proved especially problematic.|Things remained tense due to numerous incidents, though the Kings were still in nominal control of the area.
name: VEndingKings "VEndingKings" [DIAL:0015BAE7]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: {Narrating}Flush with his victory, Mr. House sent Securitrons into Freeside, thinking to increase his control over the area.|When fighting broke out, the Kings fought valiantly, but were no match for the armored killing machines, and were wiped out to the last man.
name: VEndingKings "VEndingKings" [DIAL:0015BAE7]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: {Narrating}The Kings retained their control of Freeside, and while they continued to favor the needs of locals, they tolerated the citizens of the defeated NCR.
name: VEndingKings "VEndingKings" [DIAL:0015BAE7]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: {Narrating}After their victory at Hoover Dam, Legion troops rolled through Freeside.|The Kings tried to fight back, but most were killed, and the rest fled into the wasteland.
name: VEndingKings "VEndingKings" [DIAL:0015BAE7]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: VEndingJacobstown
name: VEndingJacobstown "VEndingJacobstown" [DIAL:0015BAE8]

text_content: {narrating}With Jacobstown's leadership destroyed, the remaining Super Mutants and Nightkin of the west scattered across the wasteland.|{narrating}Jacobstown withered away, its death going unnoticed by the rest of the Mojave.
name: VEndingJacobstown "VEndingJacobstown" [DIAL:0015BAE8]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: {narrating}Thanks to the Courier and Lily, a cure for the Nightkin schizophrenia was found shortly after Doctor Henry's experiment concluded.|{narrating}Nightkin and other Super Mutants in the wasteland flocked to Jacobstown, and the town became known as a haven where a mutant could find peace.
name: VEndingJacobstown "VEndingJacobstown" [DIAL:0015BAE8]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: {narrating}Though a cure for the Nightkin schizophrenia was eventually found, it became a case of too little, too late for Jacobstown.|{narrating}Disgruntled by the death of their leader, Keene, most of the Nightkin scattered into the wasteland, their insanity worsening with each day.|{narrating}Jacobstown, constantly on guard for anti-mutant reprisals, never truly prospered.
name: VEndingJacobstown "VEndingJacobstown" [DIAL:0015BAE8]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: {narrating}Though a cure for the Nightkin schizophrenia was eventually found, it became a case of too little, too late for Jacobstown.|{narrating}Most Nightkin at Jacobstown followed their leader Keene out into the wasteland, terrorizing the Mojave for years to come.|{narrating}Jacobstown, constantly on guard for anti-mutant reprisals, never truly prospered.
name: VEndingJacobstown "VEndingJacobstown" [DIAL:0015BAE8]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: {narrating}It took more time than anticipated for a cure for the Nightkin schizophrenia to be found, but in the end it was beneficial to Jacobstown.|{narrating}The presence of the Nightkin leader, Keene, persuaded Nightkin from across the wasteland to make the journey to the town.|{narrating}Jacobstown prospered, becoming known as a fair - if somewhat intimidating - place for a trader to do business.
name: VEndingJacobstown "VEndingJacobstown" [DIAL:0015BAE8]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: {narrating}With no cure for the Nightkin schizophrenia in sight, the disgruntled Nightkin left Jacobstown. Without a treatment, their insanity grew.|{narrating}The crazed Nightkin terrorized the wasteland, and Jacobstown suffered repeated reprisals from mutant-hating humans.|{narrating}In the end, the surviving mutants abandoned Jacobstown entirely, its existence quickly forgotten by the rest of the wasteland.
name: VEndingJacobstown "VEndingJacobstown" [DIAL:0015BAE8]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: VEndingGreatKhans
name: VEndingGreatKhans "VEndingGreatKhans" [DIAL:0015BAE9]

text_content: {narrating}After generations of being beaten down, the Great Khans were finally broken by the Courier.|Those few who avoided the Courier's wrath moved north, into the wilderness of Idaho, where they tried once more to rebuild.
name: VEndingGreatKhans "VEndingGreatKhans" [DIAL:0015BAE9]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: {Narrating}After the Second Battle of Hoover Dam, the Great Khans returned for a time to Red Rock Canyon.|The NCR's pressing need to expand proved greater than its promise of amnesty, and before long the government decided the Khans had to go.|The surviving Great Khans were relocated to an isolated, barren reservation, well north of NCR trade routes.
name: VEndingGreatKhans "VEndingGreatKhans" [DIAL:0015BAE9]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: {Narrating}For supporting the NCR, the Great Khans were ruthlessly hunted down by the victorious Legion.|Caesar destroyed all evidence of their existence at Red Rock Canyon, and forbade mention of their name in any history.|The Great Khans' legacy was swiftly forgotten.
name: VEndingGreatKhans "VEndingGreatKhans" [DIAL:0015BAE9]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: {Narrating}As reward for their loyal service, Caesar forcibly integrated the Great Khans into the Legion.|The sick and elderly were killed, the women sold as wives to ranking officers, and the tribe's identity was annihilated.|Though many Great Khans mourned the death of their tribe, many more were ultimately satisfied with their revenge against NCR.
name: VEndingGreatKhans "VEndingGreatKhans" [DIAL:0015BAE9]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: {Narrating}After driving the Legion out of the Mojave Wasteland, the victorious NCR turned its attention to those who had allied themselves with Caesar.|The Great Khans were among the first tribes to suffer this fate, and the few who survived Hoover Dam were driven north, into the wilderness of Idaho.
name: VEndingGreatKhans "VEndingGreatKhans" [DIAL:0015BAE9]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: {Narrating}During the Battle of Hoover Dam, the Great Khans quickly evacuated Red Rock Canyon and headed north and east into the plains of Wyoming.|There, they reconnected with the Followers of the Apocalypse and rebuilt their strength.|Bolstered by ancient knowledge of governance, economics, and transportation, they carved a mighty empire out of the ruins of the Northwest.
name: VEndingGreatKhans "VEndingGreatKhans" [DIAL:0015BAE9]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: {Narrating}After their suicidal last stand at Hoover Dam, the Great Khans ceased to exist as a tribe.|The few surviving members dispersed, joining up with other tribes and gangs across the Mojave, and quickly forgot their heritage.
name: VEndingGreatKhans "VEndingGreatKhans" [DIAL:0015BAE9]
speaker: VRRCPapaKhan "Papa Khan" [NPC_:00140E53]

text_content: VEndingGoodsprings
name: VEndingGoodsprings "VEndingGoodsprings" [DIAL:0015BAEA]

text_content: {narrating}Travelers continued to stop by Goodsprings Source for water on the Long 15, but rarely would anyone venture into the ruins of Goodsprings itself.|{narrating}Those who did were almost always tourists, come to visit the graveyard where the Courier "rose from the dead."
name: VEndingGoodsprings "VEndingGoodsprings" [DIAL:0015BAEA]
speaker: DocMitchell "Doc Mitchell" [NPC_:00104C0C]

text_content: {narrating}Goodsprings saw more trade along I-15 after NCR gained control of the Mojave Wasteland, but with that came a heavy burden of the Republic's taxes.|{narrating}Some old-timers, unable to handle the cost, were forced to move on, grumbling all the while.
name: VEndingGoodsprings "VEndingGoodsprings" [DIAL:0015BAEA]
speaker: DocMitchell "Doc Mitchell" [NPC_:00104C0C]

text_content: {narrating}The Legion, preoccupied with its acquisition of New Vegas, scarcely took notice of the town of Goodsprings.|{narrating}Many locals moved on, fearful of Caesar's long shadow. Only the old and the stubborn remained.
name: VEndingGoodsprings "VEndingGoodsprings" [DIAL:0015BAEA]
speaker: DocMitchell "Doc Mitchell" [NPC_:00104C0C]

text_content: {narrating}After Mr. House gained control of New Vegas, he sent a Securitron to Goodsprings as a token of appreciation for helping the Courier.|{narrating}Victor was a mixed blessing, however, as he continually monitored the town for Mr. House.
name: VEndingGoodsprings "VEndingGoodsprings" [DIAL:0015BAEA]
speaker: DocMitchell "Doc Mitchell" [NPC_:00104C0C]

text_content: {narrating}With New Vegas' independence formally declared, Goodsprings thrived.|{narrating}More travelers stopped by Goodsprings on their way to and from the Strip, and the locals grew prosperous from the traffic.
name: VEndingGoodsprings "VEndingGoodsprings" [DIAL:0015BAEA]
speaker: DocMitchell "Doc Mitchell" [NPC_:00104C0C]

text_content: VEndingFollowers
name: VEndingFollowers "VEndingFollowers" [DIAL:0015BAEB]

text_content: {narrating}With no clear leader to guide efforts in Freeside, the Followers of the Apocalypse lost control of Old Mormon Fort to local thugs and junkies.|{narrating}Eventually, using the Followers' remaining supplies to manufacture drugs, the Old Mormon Fort quickly devolved into little more than a junkie den.
name: VEndingFollowers "VEndingFollowers" [DIAL:0015BAEB]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: {narrating}After the NCR's victory at the dam, the Followers of the Apocalypse were pushed out of Old Mormon Fort during its occupation by NCR forces.|{narrating}NCR further "encouraged" them to leave Outer Vegas entirely, and the Followers had no choice but to comply.
name: VEndingFollowers "VEndingFollowers" [DIAL:0015BAEB]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: {narrating}After the NCR's victory at the dam, in part thanks to Follower medical support, NCR allowed the Followers to care for refugees as they see fit.|{narrating}Old Mormon Fort expanded its services and was able to aid more people, becoming a refuge for the less fortunate citizens of New Vegas.
name: VEndingFollowers "VEndingFollowers" [DIAL:0015BAEB]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: {narrating}After the Legion's victory, the new Caesar learned the Followers had "defamed" the original Caesar's noble origins.|{narrating}The Followers of the Apocalypse were hunted down and exterminated, and Old Mormon Fort was turned into a pile of rubble.
name: VEndingFollowers "VEndingFollowers" [DIAL:0015BAEB]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: {narrating}After the Legion's victory, Caesar, out of a strange respect for his old fellows, allowed the Followers safe passage out of the wasteland.|{narrating}Reluctantly, the Followers accepted the offer and abandoned Old Mormon Fort to the Legion.
name: VEndingFollowers "VEndingFollowers" [DIAL:0015BAEB]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: {narrating}After the Courier ensured New Vegas remain free, the Followers found that independent Vegas was even more unstable and violent than before.|{narrating}Old Mormon Fort became excessively burdened by the influx of patients, struggling to provide even the most basic of services.
name: VEndingFollowers "VEndingFollowers" [DIAL:0015BAEB]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: VEndingFiends
name: VEndingFiends "VEndingFiends" [DIAL:0015BAEC]

text_content: {Narrating}Their leaders destroyed by the Courier, the Fiends scattered throughout the wasteland.|Without the organization of Motor-Runner, Cook-Cook, Violet, and Driver Nephi, they were easy prey.
name: VEndingFiends "VEndingFiends" [DIAL:0015BAEC]
speaker: V03MotorRunner "Motor-Runner" [NPC_:000EF3AB]

text_content: {Narrating}Never weakened by NCR, the Fiends staged an attack against Camp McCarran during the second Battle of Hoover Dam.|Though NCR repulsed the Fiends, they suffered heavy losses in the process.
name: VEndingFiends "VEndingFiends" [DIAL:0015BAEC]
speaker: V03MotorRunner "Motor-Runner" [NPC_:000EF3AB]

text_content: {Narrating}The Fiends staged an attack against Camp McCarran during the second Battle of Hoover Dam.|During the NCR's retreat, the Fiends overwhelmed many of the troopers before Mr. House's Securitrons could deal with them.
name: VEndingFiends "VEndingFiends" [DIAL:0015BAEC]
speaker: V03MotorRunner "Motor-Runner" [NPC_:000EF3AB]

text_content: {Narrating}The Fiends overran Camp McCarran during the second Battle of Hoover Dam.|In the anarchic months that followed, the Fiends asserted dominance over Outer Vegas.
name: VEndingFiends "VEndingFiends" [DIAL:0015BAEC]
speaker: V03MotorRunner "Motor-Runner" [NPC_:000EF3AB]

text_content: {Narrating}Though weakened, the Fiends attacked McCarran during the second Battle of Hoover Dam.|NCR repulsed the attack with minimal losses and, in the following days, destroyed the remaining Fiend leaders, breaking their power forever.
name: VEndingFiends "VEndingFiends" [DIAL:0015BAEC]
speaker: V03MotorRunner "Motor-Runner" [NPC_:000EF3AB]

text_content: {Narrating}The Fiends attacked Camp McCarran during the second Battle of Hoover Dam and suffered heavy losses.|Caesar, unimpressed with their performance and their dependence on chems, had them exterminated.
name: VEndingFiends "VEndingFiends" [DIAL:0015BAEC]
speaker: V03MotorRunner "Motor-Runner" [NPC_:000EF3AB]

text_content: {Narrating}The Fiends attacked Camp McCarran during the second Battle of Hoover Dam, but the NCR repulsed the attack with minimal losses.|When Mr. House asserted control over Outer Vegas, his Securitrons eradicated the remaining Fiends entirely.
name: VEndingFiends "VEndingFiends" [DIAL:0015BAEC]
speaker: V03MotorRunner "Motor-Runner" [NPC_:000EF3AB]

text_content: {Narrating}The Fiends attacked Camp McCarran during the second Battle of Hoover Dam and, despite suffering heavy losses, overran it.|They continued to be a nuisance throughout Outer Vegas, but never established full control over the area.
name: VEndingFiends "VEndingFiends" [DIAL:0015BAEC]
speaker: V03MotorRunner "Motor-Runner" [NPC_:000EF3AB]

text_content: VEndingBrotherhood
name: VEndingBrotherhood "VEndingBrotherhood" [DIAL:0015BAED]

text_content: {Narrating}Buried beneath tons of rubble, the Mojave chapter of the Brotherhood of Steel was no more.|Those few who were outside the Hidden Valley bunker when it was destroyed settled into new lives, or headed west to find a new chapter to join.
name: VEndingBrotherhood "VEndingBrotherhood" [DIAL:0015BAED]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: {Narrating}During the fight for Hoover Dam, the Brotherhood took HELIOS One, inflicting heavy damage on retreating NCR forces, but it was a pyrrhic victory.|Once The Strip was secured, Caesar's forces overwhelmed and eventually routed the Brotherhood from HELIOS One and Hidden Valley.
name: VEndingBrotherhood "VEndingBrotherhood" [DIAL:0015BAED]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: {Narrating}The Brotherhood used the battle of Hoover Dam as an opportunity to retake HELIOS One, and came to control the area between it and Hidden Valley.|With no organized opposition, their patrols began monitoring trade along I-15 and 95, seizing any items of technology they deemed inappropriate.
name: VEndingBrotherhood "VEndingBrotherhood" [DIAL:0015BAED]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: {Narrating}The Brotherhood and the NCR in the Mojave Wasteland declared an official truce, despite continued hostilities between the two in the west.|As per their agreement, the NCR handed over all suits of salvaged power armor and in return the Brotherhood helped patrol I-15 and Highway 95.
name: VEndingBrotherhood "VEndingBrotherhood" [DIAL:0015BAED]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: {Narrating}Due to their temporary truce, the Brotherhood allowed the NCR to retreat from the Mojave Wasteland without incident.|In the relative peace that followed, Brotherhood patrols appeared along major roads, harassing travelers over any bits of technology they had.
name: VEndingBrotherhood "VEndingBrotherhood" [DIAL:0015BAED]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: VEndingBoomers
name: VEndingBoomers "VEndingBoomers" [DIAL:0015BAEE]

text_content: {Narrating}Without organized leadership, the remaining Boomers slowly drifted away, leaving Nellis Air Force Base to be flooded by prospectors and scavengers.|All of the Boomers' accumulated knowledge quickly scattered, and their existence slowly faded from memory.
name: VEndingBoomers "VEndingBoomers" [DIAL:0015BAEE]
speaker: NellisPete "Pete" [NPC_:000FED41]

text_content: {Narrating}After the battle of Hoover Dam, the NCR mounted several campaigns against the Boomers, but all were quickly ended by the Boomers' artillery.|{Narrating}Over time, as the Boomers found a need for gun powder, they developed a relationship with the Gun Runners, trading their surplus crops for munitions.
name: VEndingBoomers "VEndingBoomers" [DIAL:0015BAEE]
speaker: NellisPete "Pete" [NPC_:000FED41]

text_content: {Narrating}Mr. House showed little interest in the Boomers and left them to themselves in Nellis.|The tribe remained fortified in Nellis with their backs to the world.
name: VEndingBoomers "VEndingBoomers" [DIAL:0015BAEE]
speaker: NellisPete "Pete" [NPC_:000FED41]

text_content: {Narrating}The Boomers defended themselves against many attacks from the Legion, but they eventually fell to the Legion's superior numbers.|The Legion enslaved the Boomers and erased any memory of their existence from the wasteland.
name: VEndingBoomers "VEndingBoomers" [DIAL:0015BAEE]
speaker: NellisPete "Pete" [NPC_:000FED41]

text_content: {Narrating}With little law left in the wasteland, the Boomers continued to defend themselves against the prospectors and scavengers invading their territory.
name: VEndingBoomers "VEndingBoomers" [DIAL:0015BAEE]
speaker: NellisPete "Pete" [NPC_:000FED41]

text_content: {Narrating}With the help of the Gun Runners, the Boomers developed a healthy trading relationship with the NCR.|Eventually the Boomers began wandering out into the wasteland, while still preventing outsiders from entering Nellis.
name: VEndingBoomers "VEndingBoomers" [DIAL:0015BAEE]
speaker: NellisPete "Pete" [NPC_:000FED41]

text_content: {Narrating}Mr. House showed little interest on the Boomers, who eventually began venturing out of Nellis to meet and trade with travelers.
name: VEndingBoomers "VEndingBoomers" [DIAL:0015BAEE]
speaker: NellisPete "Pete" [NPC_:000FED41]

text_content: {Narrating}Cautious after the Boomers' display of power at Hoover Dam, Caesar chose to leave the Boomers alone.|The Boomers remained isolated but have been seen flying over the Mojave Desert from time to time.
name: VEndingBoomers "VEndingBoomers" [DIAL:0015BAEE]
speaker: NellisPete "Pete" [NPC_:000FED41]

text_content: {Narrating}Though the Wasteland became anarchic after Hoover Dam, the Boomers' display of power dissuaded fortune seekers from attempting to penetrate Nellis.
name: VEndingBoomers "VEndingBoomers" [DIAL:0015BAEE]
speaker: NellisPete "Pete" [NPC_:000FED41]

text_content: VEndingBlackMountain
name: VEndingBlackMountain "VEndingBlackMountain" [DIAL:0015BAEF]

text_content: {Narrating}Though some Super Mutants and Nightkin continued to journey to the legendary Utobitha, they found little trace of its existence.|Some eventually found their way to Jacobstown, but many wandered off into the wastes, confused and disheartened.
name: VEndingBlackMountain "VEndingBlackMountain" [DIAL:0015BAEF]
speaker: BMNeil "Neil" [CREA:000E60F0]

text_content: {Narrating}Tabitha and Rhonda went east, through Caesar's land. Occasionally tales of their exploits found their way back west, though few believed them.|Eventually the stories concerning the duo were collected and published, and proved to be quite popular with children.
name: VEndingBlackMountain "VEndingBlackMountain" [DIAL:0015BAEF]
speaker: BMNeil "Neil" [CREA:000E60F0]

text_content: {Narrating}Black Mountain Radio continued to broadcast its peculiar form of propaganda. Raul Tejada faced his execution each day, though pardoned in the end.|Travelers venturing too near Black Mountain continue to be harassed by Tabitha's followers.
name: VEndingBlackMountain "VEndingBlackMountain" [DIAL:0015BAEF]
speaker: BMNeil "Neil" [CREA:000E60F0]

text_content: {Narrating}Tabitha, enraged by Raul's escape, took the remaining Nightkin of Black Mountain with her and vanished without a trace.|Travelers in the region soon learned to avoid the roads at night, as caravans were repeatedly attacked by unseen assailants.
name: VEndingBlackMountain "VEndingBlackMountain" [DIAL:0015BAEF]
speaker: BMNeil "Neil" [CREA:000E60F0]

text_content: VEndingCourier
name: VEndingCourierMale "VEndingCourier" [DIAL:0015BAF0]

text_content: {Narration, Good Karma, NCR Victory, Male}The Courier, fair and even-handed in his dealings throughout the Wasteland, was honored by the NCR for his support of the military at Hoover Dam.|{Narration}He was presented with the Golden Branch, the highest civilian decoration given by the republic.
name: VEndingCourierMale "VEndingCourier" [DIAL:0015BAF0]

text_content: {Narration, Neutral Karma, NCR Victory, Male}Though the Courier's agenda was debated by many, he was honored by NCR for his support of the military at Hoover Dam.|{Narration}He was presented with the Golden Branch, the highest civilian decoration given by the Republic.
name: VEndingCourierMale "VEndingCourier" [DIAL:0015BAF0]

text_content: {Narration, Evil Karma, NCR Victory, Male}With brutal methods that few in NCR would approve of, it was the Courier who secured NCR's victory at Hoover Dam.|{Narration}Despite his extreme actions, he was awarded with the Golden Branch, the highest civilian decoration given by the Republic.
name: VEndingCourierMale "VEndingCourier" [DIAL:0015BAF0]

text_content: {Narration, Good Karma, Legion Victory, Male}Though the Courier himself was just and forthright in his dealings throughout the Wasteland, he helped the Legion achieve victory.|{Narration}Caesar honored him with a golden coin, minted in celebration of his contributions and distributed throughout the wasteland.
name: VEndingCourierMale "VEndingCourier" [DIAL:0015BAF0]

text_content: {Narration, Neutral Karma, Legion Victory, Male}The Courier, a mercenary at heart, helped the Legion achieve victory at Hoover Dam.|Caesar honored him with a golden coin, minted in celebration of his contributions and distributed throughout the wasteland.
name: VEndingCourierMale "VEndingCourier" [DIAL:0015BAF0]

text_content: {Narration, Evil Karma, Legion Victory, Male}The Legion marched over the Hoover Dam with the help of one who was as brutal and merciless as the worst of them: The Courier.|{Narration}Caesar honored him with a golden coin, minted in celebration of his contributions and distributed throughout the wasteland.
name: VEndingCourierMale "VEndingCourier" [DIAL:0015BAF0]

text_content: {Narration, Good Karma, House Victory, Male}The Courier, fair and kind-hearted to those in the Wasteland, ensured that Mr. House would keep New Vegas stable and secure for future generations.|{Narration}Mr. House afforded him every luxury at his disposal in the Lucky 38, out of gratitude - and a quiet sense of pride for his choice in lieutenants.
name: VEndingCourierMale "VEndingCourier" [DIAL:0015BAF0]

text_content: {Narration, Neutral Karma, House Victory, Male}The Courier, who had a mixed history in the Wasteland, kept the status quo at Hoover Dam.|{Narration}Mr. House would keep New Vegas stable, if not free, for generations. Mr. House afforded the Courier every luxury at his disposal in the Lucky 38.
name: VEndingCourierMale "VEndingCourier" [DIAL:0015BAF0]

text_content: {Narration, Evil Karma, House Victory, Male}The Courier, cruel and merciless, had ensured that Mr. House would maintain complete control over New Vegas and everyone in it.|{Narration}Mr. House afforded him every luxury at his disposal in the Lucky 38, partly out of gratitude, and party out of fear.
name: VEndingCourierMale "VEndingCourier" [DIAL:0015BAF0]

text_content: {Narration, Good Karma, Indy Vegas, Male}Supporting the ideals of independence, the Courier was recognized as the man responsible for a truly free New Vegas. |{Narration}He ensured Mr. House's tyranny was broken and neither Caesar's Legion nor NCR would ever gain control over New Vegas.
name: VEndingCourierMale "VEndingCourier" [DIAL:0015BAF0]

text_content: {Narration, Neutral Karma, Indy Vegas, Male}Preferring neither the best of the NCR nor the worst of the Legion, the Courier was the man responsible for a truly independent New Vegas.|{Narration}He had removed Mr. House from power over the Strip and broken the influence of the NCR and Caesar's Legion in the Mojave Wasteland.
name: VEndingCourierMale "VEndingCourier" [DIAL:0015BAF0]

text_content: {Narration, Evil Karma, Indy Vegas, Male}Supporting all the chaos that comes with independence, the Courier was the man responsible for a truly free New Vegas.|{Narration}He ensured the fall of Mr. House and the end of the Legion's and NCR's influence over New Vegas.
name: VEndingCourierMale "VEndingCourier" [DIAL:0015BAF0]

text_content: VEndingNCR
name: VEndingNCR "VEndingNCR" [DIAL:0015BAF1]

text_content: {narrating}The New California Republic celebrated its second victory at Hoover Dam, establishing definitive control over the entire Mojave Wasteland.|{narrating}Soon after, they negotiated terms to annex The Strip, Freeside, and many surrounding communities.|{narrating}The Mojave wasteland, at long last, had entirely fallen under the NCR's banner.
name: VEndingNCR "VEndingNCR" [DIAL:0015BAF1]

text_content: VEndingMrHouse
name: VEndingMrHouse "VEndingMrHouse" [DIAL:0015BAF2]

text_content: {narrating}Mr. House's Securitron army took control of Hoover Dam and The Strip, pushing both the Legion and the exhausted NCR out of New Vegas.|{narrating}Mr. House continued to run New Vegas his way, a despotic vision of Pre-War glory. The streets were orderly, efficient, cold.|{narrating}New Vegas continued to be the sole place in the wasteland where fortunes were won and lost in the blink of an eye.
name: VEndingMrHouse "VEndingMrHouse" [DIAL:0015BAF2]

text_content: VEndingIndependent
name: VEndingIndependent "VEndingIndependent" [DIAL:0015BAF3]

text_content: {Narration}The Courier, with the aid of Yes Man, drove both the Legion and the NCR from Hoover Dam, securing New Vegas' independence from both factions.|{Narration}With Mr. House out of the picture, the remaining Securitrons on The Strip were hard-pressed to keep order. {Beat}Anarchy ruled the streets.|{Narration}When the fires died, New Vegas remained, assuming its position as an independent power in the Mojave.
name: VEndingIndependent "VEndingIndependent" [DIAL:0015BAF3]

text_content: {Narration}The Courier, with the aid of Yes Man, drove both the Legion and the NCR from Hoover Dam, securing New Vegas' independence from both factions.|{Narration}With Mr. House out of the picture, part of the Securitron army was diverted to the Strip to keep order. {Beat, slightly lower}Any chaos on the streets was ended, quickly.|{Narration}Chaos became uncertainty, then acceptance, with minimal loss of life. {Beat}New Vegas assumed its position as an independent power in the Mojave.
name: VEndingIndependent "VEndingIndependent" [DIAL:0015BAF3]

text_content: VEndingCaesarDead
name: VEndingCLCaesarDead "VEndingCaesarDead" [DIAL:0015BAF4]

text_content: {narrating}The Legate is crowned as the new Caesar. He entered The Strip as though it was a military target, destroying anyone who resisted him.|{narrating}The Legion brutally occupied all major locations, killing and enslaving a large amount of the population.|{narrating}Under the Legion's banner, civilization - savage as it was - finally came to the Mojave wasteland.
name: VEndingCLCaesarDead "VEndingCaesarDead" [DIAL:0015BAF4]

text_content: VEndingCaesarAlive
name: VEndingCLCaesarAlive "VEndingCaesarAlive" [DIAL:0015BAF5]

text_content: {narrating}Caesar entered The Strip as though it was his Triumph. The Legion pushed the NCR out of New Vegas entirely, driving them back to the Mojave Outpost.|{narrating}The Legion occupied all major locations, enslaving much of the population and peacefully lording over the rest.|{narrating}Under the Legion's banner, civilization - unforgiving as it was - finally came to the Mojave wasteland.
name: VEndingCLCaesarAlive "VEndingCaesarAlive" [DIAL:0015BAF5]

text_content: VEndingRaul
name: VEndingRaul "VEndingRaul" [DIAL:0015BAF6]

text_content: {Narrating}After a long and eventful life, Raul's luck finally ran out during his time with the Courier.
name: VEndingRaul "VEndingRaul" [DIAL:0015BAF6]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: {Narrating}Still grappling with self-doubt over his usefulness in the face of old age, Raul was never able to find peace with himself.|Eventually, he left the Mojave and assumed a new name, as he had done so many times before.
name: VEndingRaul "VEndingRaul" [DIAL:0015BAF6]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: {Narrating}Invigorated by his travels with the Courier, Raul once more took up his guns in memory of his lost Rafaela.|Soon after, the Mojave was filled with tales of the ghost-vaquero who hunts down those who prey on the weak.
name: VEndingRaul "VEndingRaul" [DIAL:0015BAF6]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: {Narrating}Convinced that his time as a gunslinger was past, Raul made peace with the idea of growing old.|After traveling with the Courier for a time, he retired and settled down in Outer Vegas, where he would spend his days fixing ancient machinery.
name: VEndingRaul "VEndingRaul" [DIAL:0015BAF6]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: VEndingVeronica
name: VEndingVeronica "VEndingVeronica" [DIAL:0015BAF7]

text_content: {Narration}At odds with leadership over the Brotherhood's future, Veronica looked to the Mojave Wasteland for an answer both she and they could live with.|{Narration}But the answer would never come, and the dangers of the world that had left the Brotherhood of Steel behind would eventually claim her life.
name: VEndingVeronica "VEndingVeronica" [DIAL:0015BAF7]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: {Narration}Hoping to lead the Mojave Brotherhood down a new path, Veronica sought to learn from the thriving cultures of the desert.|{Narration}Absent a firm solution, Veronica's expression of frustration with Brotherhood leadership would lead to her banishment.|{Narration}She ended her days a wandering tinker.
name: VEndingVeronica "VEndingVeronica" [DIAL:0015BAF7]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: {Narration}Despite her departure from the group, the Brotherhood's peace treaty with NCR came as some relief to Veronica. |{Narration}Though she remained friendly with surface patrols, she was never again permitted to enter the bunker she once called home.|{Narration}Fearing for the safety of anyone she associated with, she continued her solitary life as a scavenger.|{Narration}But reports would emerge from Mojave scientists and social workers of old equipment miraculously repaired and research notes mysteriously completed.
name: VEndingVeronica "VEndingVeronica" [DIAL:0015BAF7]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: {Narration}Though she'd seen the writing on the wall, the destruction of the Mojave Brotherhood came far more suddenly than Veronica had expected.|{Narration}The news devastated her. Despite her best efforts to leave her past behind, she found herself compelled to make one final journey to Hidden Valley.|{Narration}There, she paid her last respects to the only family she had ever known.
name: VEndingVeronica "VEndingVeronica" [DIAL:0015BAF7]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: {Narration}The Brotherhood's open aggression along the New Vegas highways troubled Veronica greatly.|{Narration}Nevertheless, it removed all doubt from her mind that in leaving them she had made the right choice.|{Narration}Eventually she would take to the road, less in hopes of finding a new home than of leaving memories of the old one behind her.
name: VEndingVeronica "VEndingVeronica" [DIAL:0015BAF7]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: {Narration}The peace with NCR served to ease Veronica's worries about the Brotherhood's immediate future.|{Narration}Still, a distance had arisen between her and her fellow members that would never be bridged.|{Narration}She began secluding herself in crumbling libraries of the Old World, learning of promising technologies she knew the Brotherhood would never adopt.
name: VEndingVeronica "VEndingVeronica" [DIAL:0015BAF7]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: {Narration}The death of the Mojave Brotherhood came much too soon for Veronica, and in their absence, she felt truly lost. |{Narration}Yet in its wake, she took small comfort in her decision to remain by their side through their few remaining days.
name: VEndingVeronica "VEndingVeronica" [DIAL:0015BAF7]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: {Narration}Veronica put her moral sensibilities aside and supported the Brotherhood's new campaign of aggression as best she could.|Yet deep down, she understood that it meant their end would surely be soon to follow.
name: VEndingVeronica "VEndingVeronica" [DIAL:0015BAF7]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: VEndingLily
name: VEndingLily "VEndingLily" [DIAL:0015BAF9]

text_content: Lily's long life finally came to a close in the Mojave Wasteland. As the life faded from her, her last thoughts were of her grandchildren.
name: VEndingLily "VEndingLily" [DIAL:0015BAF9]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: Encouraged by the Courier to take her medication regularly, Lily's mind eventually attained a semblance of clarity.|Her memories dulled by the pills, she cast aside the recording of her grandchildren, no longer remembering its significance.
name: VEndingLily "VEndingLily" [DIAL:0015BAF9]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: Lily continued to take her medicine at half-doses, and although she remembered her grandchildren, her mind remained muddled and confused.|Eventually, she parted ways with the Courier and traveled west, seeking the remnants of her past.
name: VEndingLily "VEndingLily" [DIAL:0015BAF9]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: Encouraged by the Courier to stop taking her medication altogether, Lily's instabilities grew worse with each passing day.|Eventually she became little more than a ravening beast, the kindly old grandmother subsumed beneath the rage.
name: VEndingLily "VEndingLily" [DIAL:0015BAF9]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: VEndingEdE
name: VEndingEdE "VEndingEdE" [DIAL:0015BAFA]

text_content: {Narrating - ED-E Dies}After a long and fantastic journey, ED-E finally met its end with the dangers of the Mojave.|It lay destroyed and gathering dust, waiting for scavengers to pick through its remains for salvage.
name: VEndingEdE "VEndingEdE" [DIAL:0015BAFA]
speaker: NVCompanionEdE "ED-E" [CREA:0010C769]

text_content: {Narrating ED-E Unrepaired}ED-E remained forgotten in the shop of Johnson Nash, until it was repaired by another courier who let it continue on its journey to Navarro.|ED-E was eventually discovered by the Followers of the Apocalypse who managed to recover vast databanks of scientific knowledge.
name: VEndingEdE "VEndingEdE" [DIAL:0015BAFA]
speaker: NVCompanionEdE "ED-E" [CREA:0010C769]

text_content: {Narrating ED-E Found/unresolved}ED-E traveled with the Courier until one of its memory banks was triggered causing it to continue its travels on to Navarro.|Upon reaching Navarro ED-E vanished and was not see in the wastes again.
name: VEndingEdE "VEndingEdE" [DIAL:0015BAFA]
speaker: NVCompanionEdE "ED-E" [CREA:0010C769]

text_content: VEndingRex
name: VEndingRex "VEndingRex" [DIAL:0015BAFB]

text_content: {narrating}He had survived police service in Colorado, the Great War, combat duty with the Legion, and being the companion of The King.|{narrating}But, in the end, Rex finally succumbed to the horrors of the wasteland.
name: VEndingRex "VEndingRex" [DIAL:0015BAFB]
speaker: VRemDoctorHenry "Doctor Henry" [NPC_:00133957]

text_content: {narrating}Having never received a replacement brain, Rex finally succumbed to old age, abruptly shutting down forever one quiet morning.|{narrating}After two centuries of life and decades of service to humanity, Rex collapses and dies.
name: VEndingRex "VEndingRex" [DIAL:0015BAFB]
speaker: VRemDoctorHenry "Doctor Henry" [NPC_:00133957]

text_content: {narrating}Revitalized by Violetta's brain, Rex eventually learned to balance the memories of his old life with Violetta's experiences among the brutal Fiends.|{narrating}His mind had difficulty adjusting, but Rex eventually found peace with his new, more vicious self.
name: VEndingRex "VEndingRex" [DIAL:0015BAFB]
speaker: VRemDoctorHenry "Doctor Henry" [NPC_:00133957]

text_content: {narrating}With the transplant of Lupa's brain, Rex gained all of the donor's experiences traveling with the Legion.|{narrating}These melded well with his own memories of the Legion, and his new mind quickly adjusted to the myriad memories.
name: VEndingRex "VEndingRex" [DIAL:0015BAFB]
speaker: VRemDoctorHenry "Doctor Henry" [NPC_:00133957]

text_content: {narrating}After Rey's brain was transplanted into Rex's cybernetic body, it took Rex some time to adjust to the old scrap yard dog's memories.|{narrating}Eventually, Rex's mind settled peacefully, melding his own memories with that of long travels with Old Lady Gibson.
name: VEndingRex "VEndingRex" [DIAL:0015BAFB]
speaker: VRemDoctorHenry "Doctor Henry" [NPC_:00133957]

text_content: VEndingCass
name: VEndingCass "VEndingCass" [DIAL:0015BAFC]

text_content: {Narrating Her Own Ending, slow and sad}Rose of Sharon Cassidy died as her caravan died - in an unmarked grave, another victim of the Mojave.
name: VEndingCass "VEndingCass" [DIAL:0015BAFC]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: {Narrating Her Own Ending, Sad}Despite the destruction of Cassidy Caravans, Cass lived for 30 more years.|{Narrating her own ending, sad}She made her way back West and passed away in a small shack outside of Vault City, the rose pendant still around her neck.
name: VEndingCass "VEndingCass" [DIAL:0015BAFC]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: {Narrating Her Own Ending}The slaughter of the Van Graffs and the Crimson Caravan caused no end of trouble for NCR back West. |{Narrating Her Own Ending}Already struggling, NCR's supply lines suffered further as the two caravans withdrew support until the "massacre in the East" was resolved.
name: VEndingCass "VEndingCass" [DIAL:0015BAFC]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: {Narrating Her Own Ending}In the years following the destruction of Cassidy Caravans, NCR used evidence of the plot to blackmail the Crimson Caravan and the Van Graffs. |{Narrating Her Own Ending}NCR enacted strict trade laws with little resistance, strengthening their supply lines and their position in the Mojave.
name: VEndingCass "VEndingCass" [DIAL:0015BAFC]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: {Narrating Her Own Ending}Cass survived to see the NCR flag flying proud over Hoover Dam, and thought for a moment... {emph}this is what a hero must feel like.
name: VEndingCass "VEndingCass" [DIAL:0015BAFC]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: {Narrating Her Own Ending}Cass lived to see Hoover Dam in its Old World glory, humming with power the likes of which the Mojave had never seen.|{Narrating Her Own Ending, Sad, skipping is bad}Vegas burned brighter than ever, Securitrons filled the streets, and Cass's heart skipped... just a little.|{Narrating Her Own Ending}Her last words were to the Dam - and to herself. {Resume Cass Voice, sad}"We were going full speed ahead... but facing backwards the whole time."
name: VEndingCass "VEndingCass" [DIAL:0015BAFC]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: {Narrating Her Own Ending}Cass lived to see the Courier bring down three armies and by her count, that was three more than she'd expected. {Beat, a little quieter}She'd kept quiet about that, though.
name: VEndingCass "VEndingCass" [DIAL:0015BAFC]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: {Narrating Her Own Ending}Cass lived to see the mark of the Legion on Hoover Dam. Uncertain of what lay next for the West, she remained silent.|{Narrating Her Own Ending, Sad}As the Legion marched West, she found it difficult to see the Dam as anything more than a gravestone for the Mojave - and everyone in it.
name: VEndingCass "VEndingCass" [DIAL:0015BAFC]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: VEndingArcade
name: VEndingArcade "VEndingArcade" [DIAL:0015BAFD]

text_content: {Narration}Though Arcade's intentions were pure and his goals were noble, he ultimately succumbed to the harsh brutality of the Mojave like so many before him.
name: VEndingArcade "VEndingArcade" [DIAL:0015BAFD]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: {Narration}Tricked by the Courier and imprisoned by the Legion, Arcade remained Caesar's personal physician for several years.|{narration}Caesar grew fond of speaking with such an educated man on philosophical matters. Arcade became his unwilling intellectual sparring partner.|{Narration}After years of such servitude, during an unguarded moment, Arcade used a surgical scalpel and his bare hands to disembowel himself.|{Narration}Lacking any other skilled medical personnel, the Legion was unable to prevent his death. Caesar mourned his loss for months.
name: VEndingArcade "VEndingArcade" [DIAL:0015BAFD]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: {Narration}Though the Legion was victorious at Hoover Dam, the Legate did not have the same medical needs as Caesar.|{Narration}{lah-NEE-oos}Lanius quickly tired of Arcade's acerbic wit and had the doctor crucified.
name: VEndingArcade "VEndingArcade" [DIAL:0015BAFD]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: {narration}During the retreat of Caesar's Legion from the Mojave Wasteland, Arcade was a sad casualty, one of many.|{narration}His body was heaped with those of many others in a nameless ravine on the Legion's long march home.
name: VEndingArcade "VEndingArcade" [DIAL:0015BAFD]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: {narration}Though Arcade had not hoped for an NCR victory, he was proud of his role in the defense of Hoover Dam against the forces of Caesar's Legion.|{narration}Unfortunately, when word spread that Arcade was once a member of the Enclave, he was forced out of the Followers of the Apocalypse.|{Narration}Pursued by bounty hunters, NCR rangers, and the Brotherhood of Steel, Arcade pushed deep into the eastern plains and was never heard from again.
name: VEndingArcade "VEndingArcade" [DIAL:0015BAFD]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: {narration}Arcade had hoped that Freeside would be able to remain independent of NCR rule, but he was glad that Caesar's Legion had been stopped at Hoover Dam.|{narration}He tended to the sick in Freeside for a while longer, then returned to NCR territory to become a teacher with the Followers there.
name: VEndingArcade "VEndingArcade" [DIAL:0015BAFD]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: {narration}Though Arcade was crushed by the Legion's victory at Hoover Dam, he was not among NCR's casualties.|{narration}During the NCR's retreat from the Mojave Wasteland, he helped defend NCR citizens and refugees on their way to Mojave Outpost.|{narration}Unfortunately, NCR rangers identified his father's armor as Enclave property. He was arrested, tried as a war criminal, and imprisoned indefinitely.
name: VEndingArcade "VEndingArcade" [DIAL:0015BAFD]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: {Narration}When news reached Freeside that Legion forces were approaching New Vegas, Arcade did his best to help people escape with adequate supplies.|{Narration}A Legion explorer saw Arcade helping locals escape and pointed him out to a Centurion.|{Narration}Arcade's group was run down somewhere near Westside. There were no survivors.
name: VEndingArcade "VEndingArcade" [DIAL:0015BAFD]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: {narration}Arcade was outraged by Mr. House's power play following the defeat of Caesar's Legion at Hoover Dam.|{narration}Though he remained in Freeside for a short time after the Securitrons established widespread control, he eventually traveled back into NCR territory.|{narration}Disillusioned with the Followers of the Apocalypse, he settled down in the outskirts of the Boneyard, where he worked happily as a family doctor.
name: VEndingArcade "VEndingArcade" [DIAL:0015BAFD]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: {narration}Arcade was proud to have been one of the defenders who helped repel the Legion from Hoover Dam.|{narration}He was prouder still to see the area freed from the shackles of the NCR and Mr. House.|{narration}Though independence for New Vegas was not all he hoped it could be, Arcade used his Enclave knowledge and technology to keep order wherever he could.
name: VEndingArcade "VEndingArcade" [DIAL:0015BAFD]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: {narration}Arcade was tending to the locals of Freeside when he learned that Caesar's Legion had been defeated and NCR was being pushed out of New Vegas.|{narration}Though he found that independence for New Vegas was not all he hoped it would be, Arcade did his best to help the locals govern themselves.
name: VEndingArcade "VEndingArcade" [DIAL:0015BAFD]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: {narration}Though Arcade was proud to have been one of the defenders who turned back the Legion at Hoover Dam, he was crushed by Mr. House's ascent to power.|{narration}Saddened by the loss of life and liberty in the area, Arcade left the Mojave Wasteland for parts unknown. He was never heard from again.
name: VEndingArcade "VEndingArcade" [DIAL:0015BAFD]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: VEndingBoone
name: VEndingBoone "VEndingBoone" [DIAL:0015BAFE]

text_content: {Narration}Tired of waiting for the world to be done with him, Boone ventured into the wastes to make his own way out.|{Narration}Unable to clear his mind of the past, he was at last granted the death he'd awaited, bringing final rest to a life that had ended long ago.
name: VEndingBoone "VEndingBoone" [DIAL:0015BAFE]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: {Narration}As the Battle of Hoover Dam ended, Boone confirmed what he had always suspected - that revenge would never quiet his troubled mind.|{Narration}Side arm in hand, he journeyed back to California in search of the NCR officer who had led the attack on Bitter Springs.|{Narration}There, with only two bullets loaded, Boone did the only thing he believed would put an end to his suffering.
name: VEndingBoone "VEndingBoone" [DIAL:0015BAFE]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: {Narration}Looking for a place where he could be of some use, Boone found himself re-enlisting with his old unit. |{Narration}Though his regrets remained in his thoughts, they coalesced into a purpose, and Boone embraced it.|{Narration}He spent his leave time hunting down slavers in the desert, his First Recon beret the last thing they never saw.
name: VEndingBoone "VEndingBoone" [DIAL:0015BAFE]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: {Narration}Though NCR was withdrawing from the region, Boone remained in New Vegas, finding work as a security guard and caravan scout along the highways.|{Narration}While he might've preferred rejoining his old unit, Boone couldn't bring himself to abandon the city where he'd met his wife.
name: VEndingBoone "VEndingBoone" [DIAL:0015BAFE]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: {Narration}Boone refused to take the Legion's victory lying down.|{Narration}Heading to the hills with his rifle, he began a deadly campaign against high-ranking Legion officers.|{Narration}And though the price on his head rose to levels unheard of, few pursued it, fearing it would be the last thing they'd never see.
name: VEndingBoone "VEndingBoone" [DIAL:0015BAFE]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: {Narration}No longer held in check by his conscience, Boone found lucrative work as a mercenary and assassin.|{Narration}No job was too violent, no target too innocent. As long as the caps were good, Boone would take the job.
name: VEndingBoone "VEndingBoone" [DIAL:0015BAFE]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

text_content: {Narration}Driven mad by Caesar's victory at Hoover Dam, and unable to escape his memories, Boone staged a suicide mission against the Legate.|{Narration}Fighting as he wished he would've fought on the day of his wife's death, he brought down scores of Legionaries before being caught.|{Narration}Before his crucifixion, he was brought before the Legate, who expressed his admiration for Boone's reckless abandon.|{Narration}Boone spat tobacco in his eye, for all of Caesar's armies to see.
name: VEndingBoone "VEndingBoone" [DIAL:0015BAFE]
speaker: CraigBoone "Boone" [NPC_:00092BD2]

name: FollowersOverburdened "FollowersOverburdened" [DIAL:0015BCBD]

text_content: Hey, I can't really move, now. But I'll follow you in spirit.
name: FollowersOverburdened "FollowersOverburdened" [DIAL:0015BCBD]

text_content: Gonna be hard covering you when I can't move my legs.
name: FollowersOverburdened "FollowersOverburdened" [DIAL:0015BCBD]

text_content: {a little annoyed}I'm not exactly in Power Armor over here, so why don't you help lighten my load a bit?
name: FollowersOverburdened "FollowersOverburdened" [DIAL:0015BCBD]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: {sad whimper}[Rex is overburdened and is having difficulty keeping up with you.]
name: FollowersOverburdened "FollowersOverburdened" [DIAL:0015BCBD]

text_content: {Irritated}Carrying too much shit to move.
name: FollowersOverburdened "FollowersOverburdened" [DIAL:0015BCBD]

text_content: {Irritated}Pinned down here carrying your bags.
name: FollowersOverburdened "FollowersOverburdened" [DIAL:0015BCBD]

text_content: {annoyed}I'm not standing here because I'm overburdened with emotion. Take some of this stuff off of me so I can move a little more easily.
name: FollowersOverburdened "FollowersOverburdened" [DIAL:0015BCBD]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

name: FollowersOverburdened "FollowersOverburdened" [DIAL:0015BCBD]

text_content: {Irritated}What did you give me, bricks?
name: FollowersOverburdened "FollowersOverburdened" [DIAL:0015BCBD]

text_content: {Under heavy strain, being sarcastic}Hey, don't worry about it, boss. The decrepit old man can easily carry all your stuff for you. Really.
name: FollowersOverburdened "FollowersOverburdened" [DIAL:0015BCBD]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Didn't your mother ever tell you it's polite to help an old lady carry her bags?
name: FollowersOverburdened "FollowersOverburdened" [DIAL:0015BCBD]
