text_content: I want to discuss other things.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic140 "I want to discuss other things." [DIAL:0015BCBE]

text_content: Ooo. Got any juicy gossip?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic140 "I want to discuss other things." [DIAL:0015BCBE]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: {Pleasant}Sure.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic140 "I want to discuss other things." [DIAL:0015BCBE]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: You didn't go with her?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic139 "You didn't go with her?" [DIAL:0015BCBF]

text_content: No. Couldn't bring myself to leave everyone else behind. Couldn't convince her to stay, either.|I'd hoped love would be enough to influence her decision, but it wasn't. We were both too stubborn.|I don't know where she is now, but I'm sure she's moved on. I still think about her, though. Once in a while.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic139 "You didn't go with her?" [DIAL:0015BCBF]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: What happened?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic138 "What happened?" [DIAL:0015BCC0]

text_content: She left the Brotherhood. Wanted to put some distance between herself and her parents.|Since our membership isn't open to outsiders, some members think that obligates all of us to procreate.|You can guess which camp her parents belonged to.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic138 "What happened?" [DIAL:0015BCC0]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Ever been in love?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic137 "Ever been in love?" [DIAL:0015BCC1]

text_content: {Playful}Ever been nosy?|{Sincere}I was, once. We were pretty young, but I like to think it was love.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic137 "Ever been in love?" [DIAL:0015BCC1]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Are you well respected among other members of the Brotherhood?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic122 "Are you well respected among other members of the Brotherhood?" [DIAL:0015BCF5]

text_content: If you take trying to keep me as far away from Hidden Valley as possible because I ask too many difficult questions as a sign of respect, {"absolutely"}oh yeah.|That's not to say I don't get along with them. I just think they don't know what to do with me sometimes.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic122 "Are you well respected among other members of the Brotherhood?" [DIAL:0015BCF5]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: VDialogueVeronicaDamOutcomeBranch
name: VDialogueVeronicaDamOutcomeBranch "VDialogueVeronicaDamOutcomeBranch" [DIAL:0015BCF6]

text_content: Not sure what my parents would think of me fighting for the NCR.|But for New Vegas it seemed like this was the best chance at stability. I don't regret it.
name: VDialogueVeronicaDamOutcomeBranch "VDialogueVeronicaDamOutcomeBranch" [DIAL:0015BCF6]

text_content: Never sided with a group of marauders before. But I think the Brotherhood stands a better chance against them than they did against the NCR.|That gives me some hope.
name: VDialogueVeronicaDamOutcomeBranch "VDialogueVeronicaDamOutcomeBranch" [DIAL:0015BCF6]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: For some reason, it warms my heart that we fought for the kooky old geezer. Guess he reminds me of someone.
name: VDialogueVeronicaDamOutcomeBranch "VDialogueVeronicaDamOutcomeBranch" [DIAL:0015BCF6]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: Independent New Vegas. If that isn't redundant, I don't know what is.|But I like its chances.
name: VDialogueVeronicaDamOutcomeBranch "VDialogueVeronicaDamOutcomeBranch" [DIAL:0015BCF6]
speaker: Veronica "Veronica" [NPC_:000E32AA]

text_content: What did you do when you were with the Enclave?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic024 "What did you do when you were with the Enclave?" [DIAL:0015C157]

text_content: Heavy weapons trooper. {grim glee}Nothing better than hosing down a target with an excess of bullets and laser fire.|By the time I got through with things, not much was left standing. Any morons who didn't run when they saw me coming got what they deserved.|Back then, it was war. {growling}If we'd been on the winning side, I'd be called a hero.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic024 "What did you do when you were with the Enclave?" [DIAL:0015C157]
speaker: VRemOrionMoreno "Orion Moreno" [NPC_:00133955]

text_content: You make it sound like avoiding innocent deaths was uncommon in the Enclave.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemCannibalJohnsonTopic010 "You make it sound like avoiding innocent deaths was uncommon in the Enclave." [DIAL:0015C158]

text_content: I'm sorry to say that it was. Civilian casualties was acceptable and sometimes... encouraged. My former squadmate Moreno didn't need encouraging.|Moreno and I might've killed each other if Captain Kreger hadn't been there to pull us apart.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemCannibalJohnsonTopic010 "You make it sound like avoiding innocent deaths was uncommon in the Enclave." [DIAL:0015C158]
speaker: VRemCannibalJohnson "Cannibal Johnson" [NPC_:001010B7]

text_content: What did you do when you were with the Enclave?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemCannibalJohnsonTopic004 "What did you do when you were with the Enclave?" [DIAL:0015C159]

text_content: Squad marksman. I'm pretty proud of the fact that I never killed a single soul who wasn't trying to kill me or one of my team first.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemCannibalJohnsonTopic004 "What did you do when you were with the Enclave?" [DIAL:0015C159]
speaker: VRemCannibalJohnson "Cannibal Johnson" [NPC_:001010B7]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemCannibalJohnsonTopic003 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0015C15A]

text_content: Be seeing you. {beat, afterthought - he's very old and could die any time}Maybe.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemCannibalJohnsonTopic003 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0015C15A]
speaker: VRemCannibalJohnson "Cannibal Johnson" [NPC_:001010B7]

text_content: How did you like flying vertibirds for the Enclave?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemDaisyWhitmanTopic008 "How did you like flying vertibirds for the Enclave?" [DIAL:0015C15C]

text_content: {nostalgia}I never was happier than when I was in the cockpit. I was able to go just about anywhere and everywhere, limited only by the fuel I could carry.|There were more than a few missions where I took the scenic route home just so I could stay in the air. Caught hell for it every time, but worth it!|{more sober, slightly defensive}Some of the things we did were questionable, I know. That's just how it was back then. Figure I've done enough good to make up for any sins, anyhow.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemDaisyWhitmanTopic008 "How did you like flying vertibirds for the Enclave?" [DIAL:0015C15C]
speaker: VRemDaisyWhitman "Daisy Whitman" [NPC_:00133958]

text_content: I'd like to know more about your former squad.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic026 "I'd like to know more about your former squad." [DIAL:0015C15D]

text_content: I was the officer in charge, and Johnson and Moreno were my heavy hitters. Henry handled tech things, and Whitman flew the chopper.|Johnson and Moreno never got along, and I had my hands full keeping those two apart some days.|It was a difference in philosophy, mostly. "Mercy" was not part of Moreno's vocabulary.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic026 "I'd like to know more about your former squad." [DIAL:0015C15D]
speaker: VRemJudahKreger "Judah Kreger" [NPC_:00133956]

text_content: What happened to the Enclave oil rig and Navarro?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic025 "What happened to the Enclave oil rig and Navarro?" [DIAL:0015C15E]

text_content: Internal sabotage took down the oil rig - never did get the full story. The NCR took out Navarro, saying we posed a threat to the region.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic025 "What happened to the Enclave oil rig and Navarro?" [DIAL:0015C15E]
speaker: VRemJudahKreger "Judah Kreger" [NPC_:00133956]

text_content: Tell me about the old days with the Enclave.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic024 "Tell me about the old days with the Enclave." [DIAL:0015C15F]

text_content: {wistful}I miss those days sometimes. We all had a purpose, you know? I admit that some of the folks in charge were pretty ruthless.|The rest of us, though - we were just trying to civilize things. The NCR was still new and it didn't look like they'd last all that long.|Then, we lost the oil rig and shortly after that, the base at Navarro. Nobody left except us Remnants.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic024 "Tell me about the old days with the Enclave." [DIAL:0015C15F]
speaker: VRemJudahKreger "Judah Kreger" [NPC_:00133956]

text_content: {Terrifying Presence}I'm sorry for what I'm about to do to you. Well, not really.
name: VMS02VMS02WaterMerchantTopic009 "{Terrifying Presence}I'm sorry for what I'm about to do to you. Well, not really." [DIAL:0015C160]

text_content: Like I'd hang around to find out!
name: VMS02VMS02WaterMerchantTopic009 "{Terrifying Presence}I'm sorry for what I'm about to do to you. Well, not really." [DIAL:0015C160]
speaker: VMS02WaterMerchant "Traveling Merchant" [NPC_:000D7F28]

text_content: How long have you lived in Westside?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic023 "How long have you lived in Westside?" [DIAL:0015C161]

text_content: Couple of years now. I was a trader for awhile, but got tired of all the walking. Westside was a good place to settle down as any.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic023 "How long have you lived in Westside?" [DIAL:0015C161]
speaker: VRemJudahKreger "Judah Kreger" [NPC_:00133956]

text_content: So what did you do before you were retired?
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic019 "So what did you do before you were retired?" [DIAL:0015C162]

text_content: I was a soldier. Why do you even care? I came out here to forget about the past, so quit bringing it up.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemOrionMorenoTopic019 "So what did you do before you were retired?" [DIAL:0015C162]
speaker: VRemOrionMoreno "Orion Moreno" [NPC_:00133955]

text_content: VCampGolfHanlonRepBranch
name: VCampGolfHanlonRepBranch "VCampGolfHanlonRepBranch" [DIAL:0015C175]

text_content: You must be the courier folks have been talking about. Word on the radio is that someone wronged you back in Goodsprings.|The Mojave has a way of burning decent people up, but it sounds like you've done right by the NCR. It's appreciated. Now what can I do for you?
name: VCampGolfHanlonRepBranch "VCampGolfHanlonRepBranch" [DIAL:0015C175]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: I know a bit about you, courier. Heard someone messed you up pretty bad over in Goodsprings. I heard a few other things too. Some good, but not all. |If you're going to be associating with rangers, you'd best stay on their friendly side. With that out of the way, what can I do for you?
name: VCampGolfHanlonRepBranch "VCampGolfHanlonRepBranch" [DIAL:0015C175]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: I'm surprised to see you here. Folks with your kind of reputation, I expect to see them cooking in the sand with some {forty four}.44 slugs to keep them company.|If the rangers haven't caught up to you yet, they will. Myself excluded, of course. {joking}The only thing I catch up on now is chair time.
name: VCampGolfHanlonRepBranch "VCampGolfHanlonRepBranch" [DIAL:0015C175]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: I don't think we've had the pleasure of meeting before. What can I do for you?
name: VCampGolfHanlonRepBranch "VCampGolfHanlonRepBranch" [DIAL:0015C175]
speaker: 2CHanlon "Chief Hanlon" [NPC_:00104310]

text_content: {Player doesn't have Power Armor training}I'll talk to her, then.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic028 "{Player doesn't have Power Armor training}I'll talk to her, then." [DIAL:0015C1AE]

text_content: The training might take several hours, so keep that in mind.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic028 "{Player doesn't have Power Armor training}I'll talk to her, then." [DIAL:0015C1AE]
speaker: VRemJudahKreger "Judah Kreger" [NPC_:00133956]

text_content: {Player has Power Armor training}I already know how to wear Power Armor.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic027 "{Player has Power Armor training}I already know how to wear Power Armor." [DIAL:0015C1AF]

text_content: Good. That'll save us some time.
name: VDialogueRemnantsVRemJudahKregerTopic027 "{Player has Power Armor training}I already know how to wear Power Armor." [DIAL:0015C1AF]
speaker: VRemJudahKreger "Judah Kreger" [NPC_:00133956]

text_content: What do you know about the dam?
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic008 "What do you know about the dam?" [DIAL:0015C209]

text_content: Well, the dam here is the key to helping the NCR make the world a better place.|With the power from the dam we can help the people here and back home have a better quality of life.|We can't trust the Legion or Mr. House to do the same. The NCR is the only one looking out for the people. And we need the dam to do that.|And I pity the people that try to take it from us.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic008 "What do you know about the dam?" [DIAL:0015C209]
speaker: VHDQuartermasterBardon "Quartermaster Bardon" [NPC_:001300A8]

text_content: What are your thoughts about the Legion?
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic007 "What are your thoughts about the Legion?" [DIAL:0015C20A]

text_content: They're a bunch of evil savages if you ask me. We're out here trying to save these good people from being enslaved by those bastards.|I hope we kill 'em all.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic007 "What are your thoughts about the Legion?" [DIAL:0015C20A]
speaker: VHDQuartermasterBardon "Quartermaster Bardon" [NPC_:001300A8]

text_content: How do you feel about the NCR being out here?
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic006 "How do you feel about the NCR being out here?" [DIAL:0015C20B]

text_content: The NCR is out here to make the world a better place. For those out here and for all those back home. I'm glad I can be a part of that.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic006 "How do you feel about the NCR being out here?" [DIAL:0015C20B]
speaker: VHDQuartermasterBardon "Quartermaster Bardon" [NPC_:001300A8]

text_content: Let's go back to my other questions.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic005 "Let's go back to my other questions." [DIAL:0015C20C]

text_content: Make it quick.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic005 "Let's go back to my other questions." [DIAL:0015C20C]
speaker: VHDQuartermasterBardon "Quartermaster Bardon" [NPC_:001300A8]

text_content: <Speech Check>
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic004 "<Speech Check>" [DIAL:0015C20D]

text_content: I guess I can make an exception, just for you.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic004 "<Speech Check>" [DIAL:0015C20D]
speaker: VHDQuartermasterBardon "Quartermaster Bardon" [NPC_:001300A8]

text_content: It's still against regulations, I can't help you.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic004 "<Speech Check>" [DIAL:0015C20D]
speaker: VHDQuartermasterBardon "Quartermaster Bardon" [NPC_:001300A8]

text_content: <Reputation Check>
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic003 "<Reputation Check>" [DIAL:0015C20E]

text_content: Well, that is great and all, but it's really against regulations.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic003 "<Reputation Check>" [DIAL:0015C20E]
speaker: VHDQuartermasterBardon "Quartermaster Bardon" [NPC_:001300A8]

text_content: I'm not here to make money, I'm here to watch the NCR supplies for the dam and that means no supplies for you.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic003 "<Reputation Check>" [DIAL:0015C20E]
speaker: VHDQuartermasterBardon "Quartermaster Bardon" [NPC_:001300A8]

text_content: I have some questions about the NCR.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic002 "I have some questions about the NCR." [DIAL:0015C20F]

text_content: I guess I can trust you. What would you like to know?
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic002 "I have some questions about the NCR." [DIAL:0015C20F]
speaker: VHDQuartermasterBardon "Quartermaster Bardon" [NPC_:001300A8]

text_content: Sure, what would you like to know?
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic002 "I have some questions about the NCR." [DIAL:0015C20F]
speaker: VHDQuartermasterBardon "Quartermaster Bardon" [NPC_:001300A8]

text_content: I'm not required to answer questions from a civilian and I don't trust you enough.|Go bug someone else with your questions.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic002 "I have some questions about the NCR." [DIAL:0015C20F]
speaker: VHDQuartermasterBardon "Quartermaster Bardon" [NPC_:001300A8]

text_content: Tell me about yourself.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic001 "Tell me about yourself." [DIAL:0015C210]

text_content: I guess I can spare a minute or two for you. Things are a little slow at the moment anyway.|Me? I've been in the military my entire life. It's a family sort of thing. My father served, my brothers serve, and I serve.|I've had the honor of serving all over the NCR and now I get to be out on the front lines as the NCR comes out east to help these folks here.|Once we get rid of the Legion, this will be a better place for everyone, and I'm proud to be a part of that.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic001 "Tell me about yourself." [DIAL:0015C210]
speaker: VHDQuartermasterBardon "Quartermaster Bardon" [NPC_:001300A8]

text_content: I'm on duty here. I don't have time to chit-chat.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic001 "Tell me about yourself." [DIAL:0015C210]
speaker: VHDQuartermasterBardon "Quartermaster Bardon" [NPC_:001300A8]

text_content: I'd like to purchase some supplies.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic000 "I'd like to purchase some supplies." [DIAL:0015C211]

text_content: Sure thing.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic000 "I'd like to purchase some supplies." [DIAL:0015C211]
speaker: VHDQuartermasterBardon "Quartermaster Bardon" [NPC_:001300A8]

text_content: Unfortunately for you, I'm not authorized to trade with you. It's against regulations.
name: VHDAssassinationDialogVHDQuartermasterBardonTopic000 "I'd like to purchase some supplies." [DIAL:0015C211]
speaker: VHDQuartermasterBardon "Quartermaster Bardon" [NPC_:001300A8]

text_content: Why is the Brotherhood interested in Nevada?

name: VFreeformBlackMountainBMNeilTopic000 "With Tabitha gone, what will happen to this place?" [DIAL:0015C493]

text_content: Who knows? It might stay abandoned, get used as a base for raiders, or even become another colony for mutants.|The future is not written, human, and it is foolish to squint at what cannot be seen.

text_content: BMNeilDistractsNightkin
name: BMNeilDistractsNightkin "BMNeilDistractsNightkin" [DIAL:0015C494]

text_content: There's a human down the path. Tabitha's orders are to kill all human intruders. Go!
name: BMNeilDistractsNightkin "BMNeilDistractsNightkin" [DIAL:0015C494]

name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic105 "They were distributing supplies down by the old train station, but I dealt with them." [DIAL:0015C495]

text_content: I'll send some guys to check out your story, but that's some good news for a change.|Word will probably spread about this, and quickly. The NCR'll know not to come around these parts if they know what's good for 'em.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSTheKingTopic105 "They were distributing supplies down by the old train station, but I dealt with them." [DIAL:0015C495]
speaker: VFSTheKing "The King" [NPC_:0010C762]

text_content: You've helped us plenty, so I'll tell you what. Just this once, name whatever you want, and if I can make it happen, it's done.|Don't rush it, though. Toss it around in your head a little. You only get one favor from The King.

name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic142 "Not right now." [DIAL:0015C715]

name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic142 "Not right now." [DIAL:0015C715]

name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic141 "Sure, teach me." [DIAL:0015C716]

What about punching? That's the gift that keeps on giving.|I could work on your punching with you, if you like. Show you how to counter like a Scribe.

name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic033 "Helped out Jackson and cleared the road North." [DIAL:0015C73A]

text_content: {Takes a breath}Guess that settles that, then.

text_content: I may be honest, but at least I'm not blinded by pride.

text_content: Who believes in holding on to a dead caravan?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic028 "Who believes in holding on to a dead caravan?" [DIAL:0015C73D]

text_content: Me, that's who. I'm not going to let it go just yet. There... there might be some survivors... or...|Who am I kidding. There's nothing left, and I wouldn't be here, drinking in some shitty bar in the ass end of nowhere if it wasn't true.

speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic019 "Just insuring future work with the Crimson Caravan." [DIAL:0015C746]

text_content: Which means they're paying you to rebuild Cassidy Caravans, not sell it.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic018 "Which means they're paying you to rebuild Cassidy Caravans, not sell it." [DIAL:0015C747]

text_content: After Cassidy Caravans gets renamed, just start it up again.

text_content: The Crimson Caravan will most likely change the name once they buy it.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic014 "The Crimson Caravan will most likely change the name once they buy it." [DIAL:0015C749]

text_content: So you're telling me, I could take this money you're offering, give them nothing, and then go on to strike up another caravan, same as before?|{Disbelieving}What kind of fucking negotiator are you? {Impressed}Hope Alice knows the kind of snake she's got working for her.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic014 "The Crimson Caravan will most likely change the name once they buy it." [DIAL:0015C749]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Far from it, to turn down the original terms.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic013 "Far from it, to turn down the original terms." [DIAL:0015C74A]

text_content: All right, it's a deal, hand over that paper. Hnh. Can't believe I'm parting with it.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic013 "Far from it, to turn down the original terms." [DIAL:0015C74A]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: {Signing}All right... there you go, caravan's yours. {Beat}Feel kind of relieved, actually. Guess I didn't realize how much I was carrying around with just the name.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic013 "Far from it, to turn down the original terms." [DIAL:0015C74A]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: I think you're a realist, and know a good offer when you see one.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic012 "I think you're a realist, and know a good offer when you see one." [DIAL:0015C74B]

text_content: That amount's enough to start a new caravan... with the old name.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic011 "That amount's enough to start a new caravan... with the old name." [DIAL:0015C74C]

text_content: Old name? What old name?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic011 "That amount's enough to start a new caravan... with the old name." [DIAL:0015C74C]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Maybe... there's something else we could trade?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic010 "Maybe... there's something else we could trade?" [DIAL:0015C74D]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] You challenging me? Serious now.|All right, you come here, armed with whiskey, we'll make a sport of it.|And none of that radioactive shit, I'm talking whiskey, not Dixon Whiskey - whiskey.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic010 "Maybe... there's something else we could trade?" [DIAL:0015C74D]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: [FAILED] You are definitely barking up the wrong bar stool. Whatever you're suggesting, {emph}not interested.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic010 "Maybe... there's something else we could trade?" [DIAL:0015C74D]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: It's just a name, this - this is money.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic009 "It's just a name, this - this is money." [DIAL:0015C74E]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Impressed}You're obviously putting your money where your mouth is - on top of that offer letter, that is a lot of caps.|{Hesitating}Still... what makes you think that's enough. What, you think I'm cheap?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic009 "It's just a name, this - this is money." [DIAL:0015C74E]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: [FAILED] "Just a name?" {Scoffs}You obviously don't know me at all to {sarcastic}sweet talk me like that.|{As if to a child}You take your letter, pay my respects to Alice, then kindly go fuck yourself.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic009 "It's just a name, this - this is money." [DIAL:0015C74E]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: I have the offer letter here, the terms are fair.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic008 "I have the offer letter here, the terms are fair." [DIAL:0015C74F]

text_content: {Studying letter}Alice McLafferty, eh? No, I see the zeroes... and I know she's good for them.|Still, it's not about the money. Dad'd spin like a twister if he ever heard I sold our name for anything.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic008 "I have the offer letter here, the terms are fair." [DIAL:0015C74F]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: So even if you have nothing, you won't sell?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic007 "So even if you have nothing, you won't sell?" [DIAL:0015C750]

text_content: If someone came up to you and offered you a thousand caps for your {emph}name, would {emph}you take it?|Actually, you know what, fuck it, I don't want to hear your answer anyway.|Point is, I made the caravan what it is, it's mine.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic007 "So even if you have nothing, you won't sell?" [DIAL:0015C750]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: You haven't even seen the offer yet.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic006 "You haven't even seen the offer yet." [DIAL:0015C751]

text_content: Why not?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic005 "Why not?" [DIAL:0015C752]

text_content: Wait, what happened to your caravan?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic004 "Wait, what happened to your caravan?" [DIAL:0015C753]

text_content: {Frowns, sighs}Mojave happened - hit by raiders packing some heavy firepower. Can't believe the Crimson Caravan haven't heard.|So if you want to buy all of Cassidy Caravans, you're looking at it - and what I got in my pockets. Still, as little as that is, not looking to sell.

speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Crimson Caravan sent me, they want to buy out your caravan.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic003 "Crimson Caravan sent me, they want to buy out your caravan." [DIAL:0015C754]

text_content: {Disbelief}They want to buy Cassidy Caravans? Don't they know it's burned to ash? |{Wary}No... even times being what they are, not sure I'm looking to sell, even for all the whiskey in Reno.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic003 "Crimson Caravan sent me, they want to buy out your caravan." [DIAL:0015C754]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: <Storage Node for Variables: Do Not Translate.>
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic002 "<Storage Node for Variables: Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:0015C755]

text_content: Still, Jackson's not letting me out of his sight as long as there's still trouble up North.|You settle things with him, help the others around here, too, I'll sign the paper if it means getting out of here.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic002 "<Storage Node for Variables: Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:0015C755]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: {Resolved, sigh}Walking the Mojave with you can't be any worse than here, that's for sure. All right, I'm in.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic002 "<Storage Node for Variables: Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:0015C755]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Now, onto settle accounts with Gloria Van Graff. Putting her down would suit me just fine.|Might be a little tougher than the Crimson Caravan - Van Graffs are like a nest of rattlers, and the guns they've got are Brotherhood-caliber.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic002 "<Storage Node for Variables: Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:0015C755]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Now, onto settle accounts with Alice McLafferty. Putting her down - that would suit me just fine.|Can't wait to see the look on her face when I show up. She'll know why.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic002 "<Storage Node for Variables: Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:0015C755]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Payback's a bitch, ladies, and between Gloria and Alice, that settles accounts, as far as I'm concerned.|Hope they're in hell right now, blinking, trying to figure out where they fucked up.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic002 "<Storage Node for Variables: Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:0015C755]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: My point before? Is that you know the Mojave, and it's a hard place.

speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

Hand over that paper, I'll put my name to it.

name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic001 "Be my guest." [DIAL:0015C78E]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic052 "Just passing through." [DIAL:0015C79B]
