name: VFreeformNellisNellisJackTopic046 "Okay, I'll let you know if I find a pressure cooker." [DIAL:0015CB77]

text_content: Great, that's all I need to get the rebreather to work right. I don't think you'd want to start breathing water halfway down.
name: VFreeformNellisNellisJackTopic046 "Okay, I'll let you know if I find a pressure cooker." [DIAL:0015CB77]
speaker: NellisJack "Jack" [NPC_:000FF264]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSBeatrixRussellTopic001 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0015CB78]

text_content: What do you have in mind?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSBeatrixRussellTopic001 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0015CB78]
speaker: VFSBeatrixRussell "Beatrix Russell" [NPC_:0011FC07]

text_content: That's a bit cryptic, Beatrix.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSBeatrixRussellTopic004 "That's a bit cryptic, Beatrix." [DIAL:0015CB79]

text_content: Hey, who doesn't enjoy a little pinch and squeal every once in a while?
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSBeatrixRussellTopic004 "That's a bit cryptic, Beatrix." [DIAL:0015CB79]
speaker: VFSBeatrixRussell "Beatrix Russell" [NPC_:0011FC07]

text_content: Sounds like you're a bit of a dom, Beatrix.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSBeatrixRussellTopic009 "Sounds like you're a bit of a dom, Beatrix." [DIAL:0015CB7A]

text_content: You should know I've been helpful to the Followers, so come clean about White if you know something.
name: VFreeformCasaMadridWestsideAndersonTopic001 "You should know I've been helpful to the Followers, so come clean about White if you know something." [DIAL:0015CB8C]

text_content: Some of the other Followers mentioned you. All right - the truth, then.|I killed Corporal White to protect Westside's self-reliance. It was rash, and I regret it now.|We don't have the money to pay for the water, so I rigged the pump station to divert water to the local cisterns from time to time.
name: VFreeformCasaMadridWestsideAndersonTopic001 "You should know I've been helpful to the Followers, so come clean about White if you know something." [DIAL:0015CB8C]
speaker: WestsideAnderson "Anderson" [NPC_:000F1095]

text_content: It was easy to figure out that the NCR water shortage points to you - save me some time, will you?
name: VFreeformCasaMadridWestsideAndersonTopic000 "It was easy to figure out that the NCR water shortage points to you - save me some time, will you?" [DIAL:0015CB8D]

text_content: {PC Intelligence 6+}Fair enough. Since you seem to have pieced it together, I won't insult you by denying it any further.|I killed Corporal White to protect Westside's self-reliance. It was rash, and I regret it now.|We don't have the money to pay for the water, so I rigged the pump station to divert water to the local cisterns from time to time.
name: VFreeformCasaMadridWestsideAndersonTopic000 "It was easy to figure out that the NCR water shortage points to you - save me some time, will you?" [DIAL:0015CB8D]
speaker: WestsideAnderson "Anderson" [NPC_:000F1095]

text_content: I thought you said I didn't have to kill her.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic027 "I thought you said I didn't have to kill her." [DIAL:0015CCCB]

text_content: Yeah, if you brought her back here. Is she behind you or something? 'Cause I don't see her.|Now stop stalling, get out there, and do your fucking job already. Sheesh.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic027 "I thought you said I didn't have to kill her." [DIAL:0015CCCB]
speaker: VFSJeanBaptisteCutting "Jean-Baptiste Cutting" [NPC_:0010C681]

text_content: Can we discuss this another time?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic058 "Can we discuss this another time?" [DIAL:0015CDA1]

text_content: Sure, boss. Whenever's good for you - I've probably got three, maybe four months before I keel over.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic058 "Can we discuss this another time?" [DIAL:0015CDA1]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: What are you talking about?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic057 "What are you talking about?" [DIAL:0015CDA2]

text_content: That Loyal guy. He's getting up there in years, but he still finds a way to make himself useful to his people.|If you ask me, that's better than withering away all alone, or holding on to some faded piece of glory from your past.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic057 "What are you talking about?" [DIAL:0015CDA2]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: What is it about Ranger Andy that reminds you of yourself?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic056 "What is it about Ranger Andy that reminds you of yourself?" [DIAL:0015CDA3]

text_content: Is that what you did?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic055 "Is that what you did?" [DIAL:0015CDA4]

text_content: Would it surprise you to know I used to be a gunslinging adventurer?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic055 "Is that what you did?" [DIAL:0015CDA4]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: We're not just talking about Ranger Andy, are we?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic054 "We're not just talking about Ranger Andy, are we?" [DIAL:0015CDA5]

text_content: Not really, boss, no.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic054 "We're not just talking about Ranger Andy, are we?" [DIAL:0015CDA5]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Why do you care so much, anyways?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic053 "Why do you care so much, anyways?" [DIAL:0015CDA6]

text_content: He reminds me of me in some ways.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic053 "Why do you care so much, anyways?" [DIAL:0015CDA6]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: It sounds like maybe you're talking about yourself there, Raul.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic052 "It sounds like maybe you're talking about yourself there, Raul." [DIAL:0015CDA7]

text_content: It's a question I've asked myself often enough.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic052 "It sounds like maybe you're talking about yourself there, Raul." [DIAL:0015CDA7]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Why do I get the impression this is more personal to you?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic051 "Why do I get the impression this is more personal to you?" [DIAL:0015CDA8]

text_content: I guess it reminds me of my own life.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic051 "Why do I get the impression this is more personal to you?" [DIAL:0015CDA8]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: You're talking about the Great War? What do you remember about it?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic050 "You're talking about the Great War? What do you remember about it?" [DIAL:0015CDA9]

text_content: It might seem harsh, but a soldier can't do his job properly with those limitations.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic049 "It might seem harsh, but a soldier can't do his job properly with those limitations." [DIAL:0015CDAA]

text_content: You're preaching to the choir here, boss. Once a man's prime is behind him, he should let it go.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic049 "It might seem harsh, but a soldier can't do his job properly with those limitations." [DIAL:0015CDAA]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: With those injuries, he's nothing but a drain on resources. He should retire.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic048 "With those injuries, he's nothing but a drain on resources. He should retire." [DIAL:0015CDAB]

text_content: That's what I love about you, boss; the pity you show for the less fortunate than you.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic048 "With those injuries, he's nothing but a drain on resources. He should retire." [DIAL:0015CDAB]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: The NCR put a lot of time and money into his training. He owes it to them to use it however he can.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic047 "The NCR put a lot of time and money into his training. He owes it to them to use it however he can." [DIAL:0015CDAC]

text_content: Even if he can't use them any more? Isn't that like asking you to come up with one of your brilliant schemes after suffering a crippling head wound?|Err, another one, I mean?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic047 "The NCR put a lot of time and money into his training. He owes it to them to use it however he can." [DIAL:0015CDAC]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: I think it's good that he's so devoted to his duty. More people should act that way.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic046 "I think it's good that he's so devoted to his duty. More people should act that way." [DIAL:0015CDAD]

text_content: You think so, boss? Because I remember a time when a lot of people stuck to their duty no matter what.|It ended with nuclear bombs falling on my hometown.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic046 "I think it's good that he's so devoted to his duty. More people should act that way." [DIAL:0015CDAD]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: I don't have time for your useless chatter.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic045 "I don't have time for your useless chatter." [DIAL:0015CDAE]

text_content: Sure, boss. I know you've got a lot on your mind, what with all that wandering the empty desert wastes.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic045 "I don't have time for your useless chatter." [DIAL:0015CDAE]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Not now, Raul.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic044 "Not now, Raul." [DIAL:0015CDAF]

text_content: Okay, boss. When you feel like availing yourself of my centuries of experience, you know where I'll be.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic044 "Not now, Raul." [DIAL:0015CDAF]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Sure, what's on your mind?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic043 "Sure, what's on your mind?" [DIAL:0015CDB0]

text_content: Meeting Corporal Sterling, well... it kind of got me thinking.|Here's a guy that's been beat all to hell, right? I mean, he could have retired from the service, but instead he signs back on and does what he can.|You think he did the right thing?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic043 "Sure, what's on your mind?" [DIAL:0015CDB0]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: You could come with me.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic080 "You could come with me." [DIAL:0015CDCF]

text_content: Go with you? {Thinking}And why the hell would I do that.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic080 "You could come with me." [DIAL:0015CDCF]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: You got one too many by my count.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic080 "You could come with me." [DIAL:0015CDCF]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Fine - wasn't planning to share anyway.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic078 "Fine - wasn't planning to share anyway." [DIAL:0015CDD0]

text_content: Calm down. I had some questions.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic077 "Calm down. I had some questions." [DIAL:0015CDD1]

text_content: What's the problem?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic076 "What's the problem?" [DIAL:0015CDD2]

text_content: My father had heart problems, and it ran down the family tree to me. |Not looking to have my heart skip its last beat, even if I considered putting that junk in my system, which I don't.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic076 "What's the problem?" [DIAL:0015CDD2]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Just needed a little pick-me-up.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic075 "Just needed a little pick-me-up." [DIAL:0015CDD3]

text_content: Well, keep it away from me, won't have anything to do with it.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic075 "Just needed a little pick-me-up." [DIAL:0015CDD3]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Tell me about your Dad.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic074 "Tell me about your Dad." [DIAL:0015CDD4]

text_content: Where'd you get that pendant?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic073 "Where'd you get that pendant?" [DIAL:0015CDD5]

text_content: Gift from my Dad, along with my name. {Wistful}Rose of Sharon Cassidy.|Mom said he got the name out of some Old World book about dirt pilgrims. {Beat}Name sure sounds sweet, though.|Anyway, pendant's a little rose. Originally thought it was one of Mom's tribal necklaces, but no, came from Dad.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic073 "Where'd you get that pendant?" [DIAL:0015CDD5]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Any idea why he went East?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic072 "Any idea why he went East?" [DIAL:0015CDD6]

text_content: Not a clue. When he left, I was too in my crib to understand why, and around the time Mom passed, I was too into my teens to listen.|Got his name, got this pendant, and that's about it.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic072 "Any idea why he went East?" [DIAL:0015CDD6]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Tell me about your Dad.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic071 "Tell me about your Dad." [DIAL:0015CDD7]

text_content: Not much to tell. He ended up walking East one day when I was young and never came back. Not a family deserter like some, though.|Mom died waiting for him, and she had me to raise. She was sick but she held off dying until I was old enough to be getting into trouble with boys.|As for Dad, I figure he just got himself lost or dead. {Shrugs}Happens... and I'm not all boo-hoo about it, so save your glass for someone who's crying.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic071 "Tell me about your Dad." [DIAL:0015CDD7]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Your mother was a tribal?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic070 "Your mother was a tribal?" [DIAL:0015CDD8]

text_content: You know, like one of the tribes from the East - we got 'em out West, too. NCR's herding 'em up, though, domesticating them.|Mom was from East of the Colorado, though, not sure what tribe. Was before the time Caesar rounded them up, made them Legion.|She walked a hell of a way until she crossed paths with my Dad and he convinced her to stop walking. And lucky for me, he was a horny old bastard.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic070 "Your mother was a tribal?" [DIAL:0015CDD8]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Any other weapons you know how to use?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic069 "Any other weapons you know how to use?" [DIAL:0015CDD9]

text_content: What, you mean like spears? No, none of that. Mom was a tribal, but she didn't teach me anything like that.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic069 "Any other weapons you know how to use?" [DIAL:0015CDD9]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Never mind. Let's move on.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic067 "Never mind. Let's move on." [DIAL:0015CDDA]

text_content: Sounds good to me.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic067 "Never mind. Let's move on." [DIAL:0015CDDA]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: I had some other questions.
name: CompanionQuestionNodeCass "I had some other questions." [DIAL:0015CDDB]

text_content: And where did you learn how to handle dynamite?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic060 "And where did you learn how to handle dynamite?" [DIAL:0015CDDC]

text_content: You've used explosives?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic059 "You've used explosives?" [DIAL:0015CDDD]

text_content: Dynamite's for when you don't have enough bullets, want to clear a pass, or scare off Geckos from a caravan.|Some of the twisters out of the Divide can block off a pass in no time, so you learn how to handle powder so you don't get trapped somewhere.|Any event, I prefer shooting if it comes down to an argument. Don't worry, I'll carry my weight if a disagreement arises.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic059 "You've used explosives?" [DIAL:0015CDDD]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Where did you learn to shoot?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic058 "Where did you learn to shoot?" [DIAL:0015CDDE]

text_content: Short of caps is what taught me, mostly. Ammo's expensive... so I learned to make every shot count. |And hear tell, my Dad was a crack shot, so I don't want to dirty the family name. Not out of pride - respect.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic058 "Where did you learn to shoot?" [DIAL:0015CDDE]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: You any good in a fight?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic057 "You any good in a fight?" [DIAL:0015CDDF]

text_content: I'm fair with chucking dynamite {rising smugness}and not bad with a pistol, if I do say so myself. {Beat, a little lower}Carry a knife, too, but that's more for practical reasons.|Prefer settling things with my fists, though. Made more friends than corpses in bar fights - plan on keeping it that way.|{Frowns, a little defensive}Don't think I'm some kind of Vault City pacifist, though - if things get heated, I'll start shooting, trust me.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic057 "You any good in a fight?" [DIAL:0015CDDF]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: VEndingNCRCF
name: VEndingNCRCF "VEndingNCRCF" [DIAL:0015CE03]

text_content: {narrating}After Hoover Dam, the leaderless Powder Gangers at the Correctional Facility vanished into the wastes, leaving the prison empty.|{narrating}The Correctional Facility became another abandoned ruin in the wasteland, its carcass occasionally picked over by enterprising prospectors.
name: VEndingNCRCF "VEndingNCRCF" [DIAL:0015CE03]
speaker: NCRCFEddie "Eddie" [NPC_:0008D0E9]

text_content: {narrating}With the Dam firmly in their grasp, the NCR turned its attention towards wresting the Correctional Facility from Powder Ganger hands.|{narrating}The Powder Gangers are no match for the battle-hardened troops of the NCR, and summary execution awaited the Powder Gangers who managed to survive.
name: VEndingNCRCF "VEndingNCRCF" [DIAL:0015CE03]
speaker: NCRCFEddie "Eddie" [NPC_:0008D0E9]

text_content: {narrating}Most Powder Gangers at the Correctional Facility fled into the wasteland rather than face the advancing forces of the Legion.|{narrating}Those brave or foolish to remain were killed or crucified by the merciless Legionaries.
name: VEndingNCRCF "VEndingNCRCF" [DIAL:0015CE03]
speaker: NCRCFEddie "Eddie" [NPC_:0008D0E9]

text_content: {narrating}The NCR, battered by the loss of the Dam, were unable to devote any troops to retaking the Correctional Facility from the Powder Gangers.|{narrating}As a result, Powder Ganger raids on caravans became an unfortunate fact of life in the Mojave for years to come.
name: VEndingNCRCF "VEndingNCRCF" [DIAL:0015CE03]
speaker: NCRCFEddie "Eddie" [NPC_:0008D0E9]

text_content: VMS25WalterPheebusTopicEthelDead
name: VMS25WalterPheebusTopicEthelDead "VMS25WalterPheebusTopicEthelDead" [DIAL:0015CE13]

text_content: Ethel, darling!{Pause, as anger boils inside - wife just got killed} I'll... I'll join you soon again! Someone's gonna pay first, though.
name: VMS25WalterPheebusTopicEthelDead "VMS25WalterPheebusTopicEthelDead" [DIAL:0015CE13]

text_content: Anyone stupid enough not to set a watch deserved what they got.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic071 "Anyone stupid enough not to set a watch deserved what they got." [DIAL:0015CFFA]

text_content: {angry, but more tired}Maybe we made a mistake. It was early on, we didn't know just how serious it was out there.|But to say they deserved it? What kind of devil are you, {sarcastic emphasis}boss?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic071 "Anyone stupid enough not to set a watch deserved what they got." [DIAL:0015CFFA]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: You can't think it was your fault. No one could stand against a dozen armed men all alone.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic070 "You can't think it was your fault. No one could stand against a dozen armed men all alone." [DIAL:0015CFFB]

text_content: I know that, boss. That's not what I'm getting at. I'm just getting sentimental in my old age. Anyways, forget it. Just wanted that off my chest.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic070 "You can't think it was your fault. No one could stand against a dozen armed men all alone." [DIAL:0015CFFB]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: And you blame yourself for this?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic069 "And you blame yourself for this?" [DIAL:0015CFFC]

text_content: Maybe. I don't know. All I know is that for all my skill with a pistol, I couldn't help them.|Anyway, that was weighing on my mind. Thanks for letting me get it out in the open, boss.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic069 "And you blame yourself for this?" [DIAL:0015CFFC]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: What happened then?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic068 "What happened then?" [DIAL:0015CFFD]

text_content: Rafaela and I ran. We were pursued by some of the men who attacked our home, but I was always a good shot.|The ones who came after us, I killed. The rest, I left be. I had to take care of Rafaela, not throw my life away on revenge.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic068 "What happened then?" [DIAL:0015CFFD]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: What happened then?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic067 "What happened then?" [DIAL:0015CFFE]

text_content: About two dozen men came back in the night, after we'd gone to sleep. They set fire to the ranch house and barred the doors from the outside.|My whole family was trapped inside. I smelled the smoke and got myself and my little sister, Rafaela, out though a window, but everyone else....|My parents, my grandmother, my two brothers and two of my sisters all died.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic067 "What happened then?" [DIAL:0015CFFE]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Go on.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic066 "Go on." [DIAL:0015CFFF]

text_content: Just a few days after Mexico City was vaporized, refugees started pouring down the road to our ranch. We helped who we could, but there were so many.|Eventually, my father started turning people away before we ran out of food. Things got violent. My father and I got our guns, and we drove them off.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic066 "Go on." [DIAL:0015CFFF]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: I don't really have time for this, Raul. Maybe later?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic065 "I don't really have time for this, Raul. Maybe later?" [DIAL:0015D000]

text_content: Sure, boss. Whenever's good for you.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic065 "I don't really have time for this, Raul. Maybe later?" [DIAL:0015D000]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Are you talking about something from your own past?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic064 "Are you talking about something from your own past?" [DIAL:0015D001]

text_content: A memory from a long time ago.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic064 "Are you talking about something from your own past?" [DIAL:0015D001]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: I suppose if you're happy with that kind of life, it's not so bad.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic063 "I suppose if you're happy with that kind of life, it's not so bad." [DIAL:0015D002]

text_content: Maybe... but what if you miss the old days, sometimes?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic063 "I suppose if you're happy with that kind of life, it's not so bad." [DIAL:0015D002]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Is that something you're afraid of?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic062 "Is that something you're afraid of?" [DIAL:0015D003]

text_content: That fear has always been a part of my life.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic062 "Is that something you're afraid of?" [DIAL:0015D003]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: At least he knew when to step back and start to take it easy. A lot of people don't.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic061 "At least he knew when to step back and start to take it easy. A lot of people don't." [DIAL:0015D004]

text_content: Yeah, it beats dying alone in the Wasteland because you were too slow.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic061 "At least he knew when to step back and start to take it easy. A lot of people don't." [DIAL:0015D004]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: What's on your mind?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic060 "What's on your mind?" [DIAL:0015D005]

text_content: Old history, boss.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic060 "What's on your mind?" [DIAL:0015D005]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Loyal's using his years of knowledge to help his tribe. I think that's a noble goal.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic059 "Loyal's using his years of knowledge to help his tribe. I think that's a noble goal." [DIAL:0015D006]

text_content: {A little uncertain}Yeah. That's what I thought, too.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic059 "Loyal's using his years of knowledge to help his tribe. I think that's a noble goal." [DIAL:0015D006]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Don't waste my time with your reminiscing, Raul.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic039 "Don't waste my time with your reminiscing, Raul." [DIAL:0015D007]

text_content: Whatever you say, boss. I'll just stay back here and be quiet in case you have a sudden flash of brilliance you need to share.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic039 "Don't waste my time with your reminiscing, Raul." [DIAL:0015D007]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Already cleared the roads for Jackson.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic104 "Already cleared the roads for Jackson." [DIAL:0015D02E]

text_content: {Blinks}No shit? Drink's on me, then. |Still, not like I'm going anywhere. Caravan title's still keeping me here, even though it's dead and gone.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic104 "Already cleared the roads for Jackson." [DIAL:0015D02E]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: That drinking's going to get you in trouble in a second.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic103 "That drinking's going to get you in trouble in a second." [DIAL:0015D02F]

text_content: Trouble's already come and went, so anything {emph}you bring will make my next drink go down easier.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic103 "That drinking's going to get you in trouble in a second." [DIAL:0015D02F]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: I'd slow down on that whiskey, if I were you.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic102 "I'd slow down on that whiskey, if I were you." [DIAL:0015D030]

text_content: Yeah, well, you {emph}aren't me, so good-for-fucking-you.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic102 "I'd slow down on that whiskey, if I were you." [DIAL:0015D030]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: So you're out of the caravan business?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic101 "So you're out of the caravan business?" [DIAL:0015D031]

text_content: Sure am. Burned for the last time, and this time, it's for good. Worse, it's not done kicking me - I'm still {emph}trapped here.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic101 "So you're out of the caravan business?" [DIAL:0015D031]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: What are you going to do?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic100 "What are you going to do?" [DIAL:0015D032]

text_content: Drink. Got a lot of memories to drown. If I die while doing it, so be it. Got nowhere else to go.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic100 "What are you going to do?" [DIAL:0015D032]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Who's Jackson?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic099 "Who's Jackson?" [DIAL:0015D033]

text_content: NCR officer, trooper, whatever - runs the place. He's over in the main building, the one {emph}without a bar.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic099 "Who's Jackson?" [DIAL:0015D033]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Jackson won't let me head north, it's not safe... and even though my caravan's gone, my caravan {emph}papers are keeping me here.|So if you came here for work, {emph}my advice? Go find the Crimson Caravan branch, south of Vegas. {Bitter, emph}They can help you out.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic099 "Who's Jackson?" [DIAL:0015D033]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Might have been Fiends, they're crazy like that.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic098 "Might have been Fiends, they're crazy like that." [DIAL:0015D034]

text_content: Doesn't sound like raiders.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic097 "Doesn't sound like raiders." [DIAL:0015D035]

text_content: Why would they do that?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic096 "Why would they do that?" [DIAL:0015D036]

text_content: My guess is Legion, they're trying to cut NCR's supply line... and the Mojave Outpost is proof. Got us locked up tighter than a New Vegas virgin.|No caravans in, out, and just {emph}try arguing with Jackson about it. "Roads aren't safe," he says.|No shit, you washed-out old fuckup, I didn't need a Brotherhood Scribe to tell me that.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic096 "Why would they do that?" [DIAL:0015D036]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Uh, how about you keep your hands by your sides.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic095 "Uh, how about you keep your hands by your sides." [DIAL:0015D037]

text_content: Don't worry, not looking to throw punches just yet. {Beat}And something tells me hitting you would be a mistake I wouldn't want to repeat.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic095 "Uh, how about you keep your hands by your sides." [DIAL:0015D037]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Back West?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic094 "Back West?" [DIAL:0015D038]

text_content: Yeah, if you couldn't tell, I'm not from around here and I'm not NCR. I run a caravan... or did.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic094 "Back West?" [DIAL:0015D038]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: What are you trying to forget?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic093 "What are you trying to forget?" [DIAL:0015D039]

text_content: Lost my caravan heading north, the driver burned to ash - and they didn't even take the cargo, they just burned that, too.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic093 "What are you trying to forget?" [DIAL:0015D039]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Think we got off on the wrong foot. How about a drink?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic092 "Think we got off on the wrong foot. How about a drink?" [DIAL:0015D03A]

text_content: Are you all right?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic091 "Are you all right?" [DIAL:0015D03B]

text_content: All right? No, I'm not all right.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic091 "Are you all right?" [DIAL:0015D03B]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Drinking to forget, and it's only getting me mad instead. Whiskey always gets my temper up - now more than ever. |Drinking used to cause all sorts of trouble back West - before I punched enough people, that is, and they learned to lay low when the whiskey hit.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic091 "Are you all right?" [DIAL:0015D03B]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Pendant?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic090 "Pendant?" [DIAL:0015D03C]

text_content: Tell me about the pendant.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic089 "Tell me about the pendant." [DIAL:0015D03D]

text_content: Whiskey Rose?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic087 "Whiskey Rose?" [DIAL:0015D03E]

text_content: Yeah, on account of my name... and the blossoms on my cheeks when I drink too much. |Won most of those fights, too. Can take a hell of a punch and give it right back when I've got a bottle in me. |It's all in how you drink it, though - there's a trick to it. {Beat, nods}When we pass the bottle, I'll show you how it's done.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic087 "Whiskey Rose?" [DIAL:0015D03E]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Is whiskey your drink of choice?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic086 "Is whiskey your drink of choice?" [DIAL:0015D03F]

text_content: Not sure if I chose it or it chose me. {Beat}Dad ran a bar a long time ago, and it was a labor of love, Mom said. Didn't sound like it made her happy.|Still, I'm guessing I got some of Dad's love of whiskey in me, because the burn suits me fine.|Used to call me "Whiskey Rose" back West, before I punched enough people, so now they say it, but quiet and when I'm not around.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic086 "Is whiskey your drink of choice?" [DIAL:0015D03F]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: All right. Come on, let's go.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic085 "All right. Come on, let's go." [DIAL:0015D040]

text_content: {Relieved to be leaving}Thank god, the sooner the better.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic085 "All right. Come on, let's go." [DIAL:0015D040]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: What's wrong?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic084 "What's wrong?" [DIAL:0015D041]

text_content: {Sarcastic}Aside from the TV-faced robots, the dust, and the old man smell in every room? Nothing, it's a paradise.|{Uneasy}This place has the Old World Blues about it. Everything in here feels like it should have passed on a long time ago.|Hell, it's hard to believe Vegas is right outside. So, yeah, I'm looking to leave whenever you're ready.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic084 "What's wrong?" [DIAL:0015D041]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Stay here, you know exactly what's going to happen, day in, day out.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic083 "Stay here, you know exactly what's going to happen, day in, day out." [DIAL:0015D042]

text_content: So fighting boredom is your argument, huh?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic083 "Stay here, you know exactly what's going to happen, day in, day out." [DIAL:0015D042]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Do you really want to stay in this shithole?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic082 "Do you really want to stay in this shithole?" [DIAL:0015D043]

text_content: {Player's got a point}Hnh. The Outpost lost its charm about three bottles ago, and that was just this morning.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic082 "Do you really want to stay in this shithole?" [DIAL:0015D043]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: If your world's a whiskey bottle, there's more out there.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic079 "If your world's a whiskey bottle, there's more out there." [DIAL:0015D044]

text_content: {Sarcastic}Oh, that's got just the right bite of judgment to it, stings a little, too. {Beat}Did you hear that from a Followers preacher?|I bet you could preach all day, who knows what other little bits of wisdom might spill out.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic079 "If your world's a whiskey bottle, there's more out there." [DIAL:0015D044]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Why not? I could use someone who knows the roads.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic068 "Why not? I could use someone who knows the roads." [DIAL:0015D045]

text_content: So you're looking for someone to help, not just tag along? Hnh.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic068 "Why not? I could use someone who knows the roads." [DIAL:0015D045]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Maybe it's not where you go, it's the company.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic065 "Maybe it's not where you go, it's the company." [DIAL:0015D046]

text_content: {Incredulous}"It's the company?" That has {emph}got to be the biggest load of Brahmin shit I've ever heard.|Still, if you got more like that...
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic065 "Maybe it's not where you go, it's the company." [DIAL:0015D046]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: There's other places to go.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic000 "There's other places to go." [DIAL:0015D047]

text_content: {Irritated}Where? Like Vegas? Chewed and spit enough friends out. East? Get put in one of Caesar's little "camps?" No thanks.|Head back West? I already know the Big Circle and everyone in it - 'cept now I go back there, ruined.|{Thinking}Never really realized how small the Mojave's getting nowadays, hard to find a place to go to that's worthwhile.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic000 "There's other places to go." [DIAL:0015D047]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: That's... one way to put it.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic081 "That's... one way to put it." [DIAL:0015D064]

text_content: Didn't ask Mom to elaborate. Never heard her complain about his bedroom behavior, only complain he wasn't around to do it no more.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic081 "That's... one way to put it." [DIAL:0015D064]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: I've met him. Nice impersonation.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic088 "I've met him. Nice impersonation." [DIAL:0015D080]

text_content: Yeah, he's been with NCR so long all he can see is the worst outcome of everything - so he doesn't do anything.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic088 "I've met him. Nice impersonation." [DIAL:0015D080]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Anything you can tell me about the Outpost?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic105 "Anything you can tell me about the Outpost?" [DIAL:0015D081]

text_content: You're looking at it. It's a watering hole without much to brag about.|It's like a Brahmin drive gone wrong - supposed to be a gate north, but you come here, you get caught in the pen. Better to head back home.|If you don't have a gun and a will, don't matter much what you do when you reach here, except stare at that fucking monument outside.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic105 "Anything you can tell me about the Outpost?" [DIAL:0015D081]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: That fucking monument outside?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic106 "That fucking monument outside?" [DIAL:0015D082]

text_content: Don't even tell me you missed it coming in. It's like NCR showing its dick to all the East.|If the Republic put as much effort into protecting the East as they put into those two asinine giants outside, then they'd be {emph}worth that monument.|{Shakes head}Statues of two men shaking hands covered in blood don't seem to be nothing to brag about.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic106 "That fucking monument outside?" [DIAL:0015D082]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Covered in blood?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic107 "Covered in blood?" [DIAL:0015D083]

text_content: {Slight exasperation}I'm speaking figurative, isn't any blood on their damn hands. {Beat, to herself, serious}Course, when Caesar comes walking through here, there'll be blood for real.|And after the blood dries in the sun, he'll melt that piece of Jet-induced sculpture down, and reshape it into a bull. |Which by my reckoning is making up for a deficiency of his. But no matter what the state of his pecker, he's sure giving the West a good fucking.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic107 "Covered in blood?" [DIAL:0015D083]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: What are those statues supposed to be?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic108 "What are those statues supposed to be?" [DIAL:0015D084]

text_content: {Irritated, doesn't much care}One's a ranger, one's an NCR trooper, supposed to represent unification of West and East... or some such shit.|As far as those two iron lovebirds go, they've got more spine than you'll see in a year from the NCR government.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic108 "What are those statues supposed to be?" [DIAL:0015D084]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: What did you mean about "covered in blood" before?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic110 "What did you mean about ""covered in blood"" before?" [DIAL:0015D086]

text_content: Why are you here at the bar?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic112 "Why are you here at the bar?" [DIAL:0015D087]

text_content: Whiskey and me are old friends, keeps me going when times get rough. Like now.|Got me into the caravan business, you know - had to start transporting water instead of liquor, though.|If I hadn't switched over, I'd end my trip with nothing but glass bottles rattling on the back of the Brahmin.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic112 "Why are you here at the bar?" [DIAL:0015D087]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Any work around here?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic113 "Any work around here?" [DIAL:0015D088]

text_content: If you're looking to sign on with a caravan, no - traders are bottled up tight here.|Caravan work's up north, check with the Crimson Caravan, maybe. Gun Runners might have work, wouldn't know for sure, though.|Still, if you got a gun, guts, and feeling like going on patrol, might be some of the soldiers around here have work for you.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic113 "Any work around here?" [DIAL:0015D088]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: [NCR] I think they're both rangers, one desert, one NCR.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic023 "[NCR] I think they're both rangers, one desert, one NCR." [DIAL:0015D089]

text_content: Hnh. Maybe you're right. Brimmed hats always throw me off.|Well, fine, whatever, they can be shaking each other's dicks, wouldn't change the Mojave now.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic023 "[NCR] I think they're both rangers, one desert, one NCR." [DIAL:0015D089]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Running and gunning sounds interesting.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic066 "Running and gunning sounds interesting." [DIAL:0015D08A]

text_content: Jackson might have something for you, if you haven't already spoken to that old buzzard.|He was looking to try and get troops to clear the north road. You can find him over in the other building - the one without a bar.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic066 "Running and gunning sounds interesting." [DIAL:0015D08A]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Any other work?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic114 "Any other work?" [DIAL:0015D08B]

text_content: I don't know, seems to be a lot of attention on Nipton. Word is, one of the snipers in the nest on the roof spotted smoke from the East.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic114 "Any other work?" [DIAL:0015D08B]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Sniper on the roof?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic115 "Sniper on the roof?" [DIAL:0015D08C]

text_content: Yeah, her name's... Ghost or something... {mocking}fucking scary, ooooooh. {Sarcastic}Guess it's cause you'll never see her 'til your dead.|NCR and their goddamn nicknames, as if Caesar himself's gonna piss and run if he hears them.|Anyway, go on and head up top, ask her what's going on, if you haven't already. I don't much give a shit.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic115 "Sniper on the roof?" [DIAL:0015D08C]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Any other work?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic117 "Any other work?" [DIAL:0015D08D]

text_content: Um, I should probably go.
name: VFreeformBlackMountainBMRhondaTopic001 "Um, I should probably go." [DIAL:0015D09A]

text_content: I'll just wait here for Mistress Tabitha.
name: VFreeformBlackMountainBMRhondaTopic001 "Um, I should probably go." [DIAL:0015D09A]
speaker: BMRhonda "Broken Mr. Handy" [CREA:000E84A2]

text_content: I hate to tell you, but Tabitha's dead.
name: VFreeformBlackMountainBMRhondaTopic000 "I hate to tell you, but Tabitha's dead." [DIAL:0015D09B]

text_content: And I suppose you're taking credit for the deed, fiend! I will avenge her!
name: VFreeformBlackMountainBMRhondaTopic000 "I hate to tell you, but Tabitha's dead." [DIAL:0015D09B]
speaker: BMRhonda "Broken Mr. Handy" [CREA:000E84A2]

text_content: BMTabithaYesRhonda
name: BMTabithaYesRhonda "BMTabithaYesRhonda" [DIAL:0015D09C]

text_content: Yes, Rhonda.
name: BMTabithaYesRhonda "BMTabithaYesRhonda" [DIAL:0015D09C]

text_content: BMRhondaLetsGoTabitha
name: BMRhondaLetsGoTabitha "BMRhondaLetsGoTabitha" [DIAL:0015D09D]

text_content: Mistress Tabitha, we should be heading off. Our journey has been much delayed, but we can catch up if we hurry.  Come along, now.
name: BMRhondaLetsGoTabitha "BMRhondaLetsGoTabitha" [DIAL:0015D09D]

text_content: You're welcome.
name: VFreeformBlackMountainTabithaTopic001 "You're welcome." [DIAL:0015D09E]

text_content: It's just... such a shock to see Rhonda up and about again. I'm not sure what to do now.
name: VFreeformBlackMountainTabithaTopic001 "You're welcome." [DIAL:0015D09E]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: BMRhondaGreetsTabitha
name: BMRhondaGreetsTabitha "BMRhondaGreetsTabitha" [DIAL:0015D09F]

text_content: It is, Mistress Tabitha. How I've missed you so. This stranger here fixed me up right as rain. Is he a friend of yours?
name: BMRhondaGreetsTabitha "BMRhondaGreetsTabitha" [DIAL:0015D09F]

text_content: It is, Mistress Tabitha. How I've missed you so. This stranger here fixed me up right as rain. Is she a friend of yours?
name: BMRhondaGreetsTabitha "BMRhondaGreetsTabitha" [DIAL:0015D09F]

text_content: BMTabithaCornersPlayer
name: BMTabithaCornersPlayer "BMTabithaCornersPlayer" [DIAL:0015D0A0]

text_content: {Tabitha}R-Rhonda? Is that you?
name: BMTabithaCornersPlayer "BMTabithaCornersPlayer" [DIAL:0015D0A0]

text_content: Does this mean you're not going to kill me?
name: VFreeformBlackMountainTabithaTopic000 "Does this mean you're not going to kill me?" [DIAL:0015D0A1]

text_content: {Laughs}No, of course not. I... don't know what I'm going to do now with Rhonda back...
name: VFreeformBlackMountainTabithaTopic000 "Does this mean you're not going to kill me?" [DIAL:0015D0A1]
speaker: Tabitha "Tabitha" [CREA:000E60F1]

text_content: Well, in the meantime, he's given me a suite at the Lucky 38.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic123 "Well, in the meantime, he's given me a suite at the Lucky 38." [DIAL:0015D136]

text_content: Does it come with its own Deathclaw? Trust me, if you can't see it, something just as nasty's waiting.|Whole Lucky 38... the idea that there's this casino in the middle of a town of people, and only you're ever let inside?|{To herself}Feels like other places I've been. Something that isolated from everyday folks starts to take on a bad shine.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic123 "Well, in the meantime, he's given me a suite at the Lucky 38." [DIAL:0015D136]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Didn't introduce himself, wore a bad suit.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic120 "Didn't introduce himself, wore a bad suit." [DIAL:0015D137]

text_content: Bad suit, huh? Well, if assholes had taste, we'd all be feasting on shit.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic120 "Didn't introduce himself, wore a bad suit." [DIAL:0015D137]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Still... suit means money, and suits stand out, especially here in the Mojave. One of the larger towns, or Vegas, might be the place to go.|{Cold}Don't you worry, though, we'll sort this asshole out, rattle his cage a little.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic120 "Didn't introduce himself, wore a bad suit." [DIAL:0015D137]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Benny, wore a checkered suit.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic119 "Benny, wore a checkered suit." [DIAL:0015D138]

text_content: {Frowns}Can't say I've heard the name. Or heard about any man dressed like a seat cover.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic119 "Benny, wore a checkered suit." [DIAL:0015D138]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: I don't think it was personal.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic118 "I don't think it was personal." [DIAL:0015D139]

text_content: {Slight incredulous that the player would be dismissive of being shot}Well if it wasn't before, it is now.|Did he bother to introduce himself, or did he not take you for somebody who'd get up again when killed?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic118 "I don't think it was personal." [DIAL:0015D139]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: He wanted something I was carrying.

text_content: So what did you do?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic098 "So what did you do?" [DIAL:0015D464]

text_content: I left Mexico City behind. I made my way out to the Gulf Coast, eventually I found an old Petro-Chico refinery nobody had claimed.|I stayed there for a little while, and I thought a lot about my life. I thought about the guns I'd lived by and what they'd gotten me.|I decided my guns hadn't gotten me anything, and it was time to give it up. I took off that old vaquero outfit, and put on a Petro-Chico jumpsuit.|The name tag said "Miguel," so I started using the name myself. Eventually I made it to Arizona... but that's another story, boss.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic098 "So what did you do?" [DIAL:0015D464]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: That's terrible, Raul.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic097 "That's terrible, Raul." [DIAL:0015D465]

text_content: Terrible doesn't begin to cover it, boss. I'd let my whole family down - first the ranch, now Rafaela. I was the last Tejada.|I guess maybe I went a little crazy then. I took my guns, and I went back to that market. I didn't have many bullets, but I had enough.|After the raiders were dead, I salvaged what I could from the store. I was tired... I just wanted to be alone forever.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic097 "That's terrible, Raul." [DIAL:0015D465]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Go on. What happened to Rafaela?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic096 "Go on. What happened to Rafaela?" [DIAL:0015D466]

text_content: She went out to find some food one day. {digressing, maybe justifying to himself a little}I was sick, so I stayed at our camp. I guess it must have been the beginnings of radiation poisoning.|Anyway, it was supposed to be safe, but some raiders happened to pass through where she was scavenging. I won't speak of what they did to her.|When I found her body, the only way to recognize her was this funny little scar on her knee from when she was a little girl.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic096 "Go on. What happened to Rafaela?" [DIAL:0015D466]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Wasn't it dangerous to be dressed so... noticably?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic095 "Wasn't it dangerous to be dressed so... noticably?" [DIAL:0015D467]

text_content: It was. I started to build up a legend. Sometimes it headed off trouble, but most of the time it just started more.|Young punks looking to prove themselves would come looking for me, but my eyes were sharp and my guns were quick.|For a whle it seemed like we might even survive there, until... until Rafaela.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic095 "Wasn't it dangerous to be dressed so... noticably?" [DIAL:0015D467]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Sounds pretty bad.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic094 "Sounds pretty bad." [DIAL:0015D468]

text_content: You're a poet of understatement, boss. But there were moments it was almost worth it. I still remember finding that novelty costume shop.|I was just looking for something I could slice up to wrap my burns when I saw the vaquero outfit hanging on the rack, like it hadn't been touched.|I took it - not like anybody else needed it, you know? - and wore it back to our camp. Rafaela laughed for the first time since the bombs had fallen.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic094 "Sounds pretty bad." [DIAL:0015D468]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: That's not true, Raul, you're great with a pistol.

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] You think so? Well... you're the boss. Okay, I'll give it a try.|But if I get killed, and if there's an afterlife, I'll haunt your ass.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic088 "That's not true, Raul, you're great with a pistol." [DIAL:0015D46F]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: I don't think that's a good idea. You should focus on your mechanical skills instead.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic087 "I don't think that's a good idea. You should focus on your mechanical skills instead." [DIAL:0015D470]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] I suppose you're right, boss. These bones are too old for that kind of action.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic087 "I don't think that's a good idea. You should focus on your mechanical skills instead." [DIAL:0015D470]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: [FAILED] I'm sure you've got a lot of ideas, boss, but how about if you let me make this decision?|Tell you what, I'll at least think about it for a while. Ask me about it again another time.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic087 "I don't think that's a good idea. You should focus on your mechanical skills instead." [DIAL:0015D470]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: If that's what you think is best, I won't stop you.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic086 "If that's what you think is best, I won't stop you." [DIAL:0015D471]

text_content: Thanks, boss. I'd hate to think I was disappointing you with my life-altering decision.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic086 "If that's what you think is best, I won't stop you." [DIAL:0015D471]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: I think that's a great idea, Raul, and I hope you'll put them to good use with me.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic085 "I think that's a great idea, Raul, and I hope you'll put them to good use with me." [DIAL:0015D472]

text_content: You can bet on that, boss.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic085 "I think that's a great idea, Raul, and I hope you'll put them to good use with me." [DIAL:0015D472]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Doubts? About what?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic084 "Doubts? About what?" [DIAL:0015D473]

text_content: About whether I still had what it took to carry my pistols proudly, to use them to do what's right.|And now that I've been traveling with you for a while, you've made me realize that I can still do that.|Maybe I'm not as tough as I used to be, but my brains can make up for that, and my hands are still quick enough. It's time to put the guns back on.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic084 "Doubts? About what?" [DIAL:0015D473]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: About whether I'm really too old to keep living the life of a gunslinger after all. And after seeing what you go through, boss, I think I am.|From now on, I'll let you deal with the fighting and stick to keeping your gear working. I don't want to slow you down more than I already do.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic084 "Doubts? About what?" [DIAL:0015D473]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: What happened then?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic083 "What happened then?" [DIAL:0015D474]

text_content: When I recovered - more or less, anyways - I left Tuscon and headed west. I ran into Tabitha at Black Mountain and, well, the rest you know.|I swore I was done with the gunslinging life - I was too old, too slow, and too beat up to protect anyone anymore.|I thought I was done forever... but after traveling with you, I realize I've always had my doubts.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic083 "What happened then?" [DIAL:0015D474]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: When I recovered - more or less, anyways - I left Tuscon and headed west. I ran into Tabitha at Black Mountain and, well, the rest you know.|I swore I was done with the gunslinging life - I was too old, too slow, and too beat up to protect anyone anymore.|After seeing what you go through, I think I made the right choice. So thanks for that, boss.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic083 "What happened then?" [DIAL:0015D474]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: When I recovered - more or less, anyways - I left Tuscon and headed west. I ran into Tabitha at Black Mountain and, well, the rest you know.|I swore I was done with the gunslinging life - I was too old, too slow, and too beat up to protect anyone anymore.|I thought I was done forever... but after traveling with you, I realize that was the wrong decision. So thanks for that, boss.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic083 "What happened then?" [DIAL:0015D474]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: How did you survive?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic081 "How did you survive?" [DIAL:0015D475]

text_content: By being a meaner old cuss than the rest of them, boss. I wanted to keep living until they weren't, so I just kept shooting until they were all dead.|I was in pretty bad shape in the end, though. I don't know how long I laid there with the sun baking me and the buzzards chomping at me.|Eventually I got the strength to start moving. Some long time after that, I managed to drag my carcass back to town.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic081 "How did you survive?" [DIAL:0015D475]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Did you rescue her?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic080 "Did you rescue her?" [DIAL:0015D476]

text_content: I went after Dave and his brothers. They had a head start, but they slept nights. I didn't. Took me three days to catch up to them.|Claudia was dead when I got there. They'd put a bullet in each of her eyes. I couldn't do anything except avenge her, just like Rafaela.|I charged into the middle of their camp and started firing - two of them were dead before they knew I was there. The other five, though....|They shot the shit out of me. I would have died, I think, if I wasn't so full of rage.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic080 "Did you rescue her?" [DIAL:0015D476]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: But they didn't, did they?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic079 "But they didn't, did they?" [DIAL:0015D477]

text_content: No, boss. No they didn't.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic079 "But they didn't, did they?" [DIAL:0015D477]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: As I was saying, I hoped they'd leave the town in peace. Instead, they decided to stop at Claudia's brothel to take the edge off.|I don't know which one of them got rowdy first, but by the time I heard the screams and got my guns, it was too late.|They'd shot up the brothel, killed four girls, and taken Claudia for their sport.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic079 "But they didn't, did they?" [DIAL:0015D477]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: What happened with her?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic077 "What happened with her?" [DIAL:0015D479]

text_content: This was a long time ago. Before Caesar's Legion pacified Arizona and brought the raider tribes to heel.|A tribe came into Tuscon one day - more a gang, really. Dirty Dave and his six brothers. They were looking for bullets, and I sold some to them.|I figured if I did that, they'd leave town before they tore it up too much.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic077 "What happened with her?" [DIAL:0015D479]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Why aren't you still there, then?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic076 "Why aren't you still there, then?" [DIAL:0015D47A]

text_content: Getting there, boss. I'd been in Tuscon - the locals can call it Two-Sun all they want, but it's Tuscon, dammit - about 75 years when she showed up.|Prettiest thing you ever saw, boss. Maybe it was just a trick of my senile brain, but I swear she looked just like my Rafaela. Her name was Claudia.|She ended up taking work at one of the brothels in town. I never went to her, of course - how could I? But I looked after her in my own way.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic076 "Why aren't you still there, then?" [DIAL:0015D47A]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Fixing things?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic075 "Fixing things?" [DIAL:0015D47B]

text_content: Oh, sure, boss. I was always good at fixing things. Some I fixed for the town, some I fixed for other people, some I fixed just for the hell of it.|It's a better way to use your hands than killing, and even then I wasn't getting any younger or faster.|I lived there for a long time. Kept to myself, didn't get into any fights - hell, the only reason I even kept my guns oiled was professional pride.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic075 "Fixing things?" [DIAL:0015D47B]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Wasn't Mexico City basically annihilated in the Great War?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic072 "Wasn't Mexico City basically annihilated in the Great War?" [DIAL:0015D47C]

text_content: I don't think it was as hard hit as DC or Bakersfield, but it was bad enough. By the time we got there, the city was a radioactive ruin.|Still, the city was full of looters, already forming into the beginnings of raider tribes. Crime was bad before the War, but now it was a nightmare.|We were living like scavengers, scraping by on what little food we could find, always looking for medicine for my burns.|And then, of course, the radiation started to kick in, turning me into this handsome devil you see before you.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic072 "Wasn't Mexico City basically annihilated in the Great War?" [DIAL:0015D47C]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: VMS49HardinDiscussion1
name: VMS49HardinDiscussion1 "VMS49HardinDiscussion1" [DIAL:0015D4A2]

text_content: What is it, Veronica?
name: VMS49HardinDiscussion1 "VMS49HardinDiscussion1" [DIAL:0015D4A2]

text_content: Hardin. Er, {Correcting herself}Elder. I know why we're failing.
name: VMS49HardinDiscussion1 "VMS49HardinDiscussion1" [DIAL:0015D4A2]

text_content: {Skeptical}Do you?
name: VMS49HardinDiscussion1 "VMS49HardinDiscussion1" [DIAL:0015D4A2]

text_content: As long as we hide in here, ignoring the outside, our days are numbered.
name: VMS49HardinDiscussion1 "VMS49HardinDiscussion1" [DIAL:0015D4A2]

text_content: For once, I agree.
name: VMS49HardinDiscussion1 "VMS49HardinDiscussion1" [DIAL:0015D4A2]

text_content: {Skeptical}You do?
name: VMS49HardinDiscussion1 "VMS49HardinDiscussion1" [DIAL:0015D4A2]

text_content: We can't let people go on believing the Brotherhood has lost its teeth.
name: VMS49HardinDiscussion1 "VMS49HardinDiscussion1" [DIAL:0015D4A2]

text_content: We must strike while our enemies are distracted with each other.
name: VMS49HardinDiscussion1 "VMS49HardinDiscussion1" [DIAL:0015D4A2]

text_content: {Disbelieving}Strike? That's how we got into this problem in the first place. We can't beat these armies.
name: VMS49HardinDiscussion1 "VMS49HardinDiscussion1" [DIAL:0015D4A2]

text_content: Our entire two hundred years of history say that a handful of troops with the best equipment and training can stand up to any army.
name: VMS49HardinDiscussion1 "VMS49HardinDiscussion1" [DIAL:0015D4A2]

text_content: And the loss of HELIOS One says things are different now.
name: VMS49HardinDiscussion1 "VMS49HardinDiscussion1" [DIAL:0015D4A2]

text_content: {Heated}That was a failure of strategy, not philosophy. If Father El{-ijah}- the Elder in charge were a Paladin and not a Scribe-
name: VMS49HardinDiscussion1 "VMS49HardinDiscussion1" [DIAL:0015D4A2]

text_content: {Finishing someone else's sentence}Our arrogance would still have been our downfall.
name: VMS49HardinDiscussion1 "VMS49HardinDiscussion1" [DIAL:0015D4A2]

text_content: History says otherwise.
name: VMS49HardinDiscussion1 "VMS49HardinDiscussion1" [DIAL:0015D4A2]

text_content: Maybe it's time you start looking forward.
name: VMS49HardinDiscussion1 "VMS49HardinDiscussion1" [DIAL:0015D4A2]

text_content: Let's go. We're wasting our time.
name: VMS49HardinDiscussion1 "VMS49HardinDiscussion1" [DIAL:0015D4A2]

speaker: GSTrudy "Trudy" [NPC_:00104C6C]

name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSTrudyTopic027 "What happens if I help Ringo?" [DIAL:0015D4F0]

text_content: If you were able to get Ringo out of this mess, you'd have a decent reputation around Goodsprings. I'd even set you up with a discount.|Of course, helping Ringo would also make the Powder Gangers mad, and they've got a {emphasize "lot"}lot of friends out there.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSTrudyTopic027 "What happens if I help Ringo?" [DIAL:0015D4F0]

name: VFreeformNellisNellisPearlTopic000 "Jack is interested in a girl." [DIAL:0015D75F]
