speaker: NCRCFMeyers "Meyers" [NPC_:0008D0E7]

text_content: I'll let you know when I do.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFMeyersTopic016 "I'll let you know when I do." [DIAL:0015D861]

text_content: Okay, hurry back. I don't want anyone to start shooting at me.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFMeyersTopic016 "I'll let you know when I do." [DIAL:0015D861]
speaker: NCRCFMeyers "Meyers" [NPC_:0008D0E7]

text_content: Where should I go to get you a pardon?
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFMeyersTopic015 "Where should I go to get you a pardon?" [DIAL:0015D862]

text_content: There is a NCR camp down on the southern border of Nevada. Camp Mojave I think, try to find someone of authority there.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFMeyersTopic015 "Where should I go to get you a pardon?" [DIAL:0015D862]
speaker: NCRCFMeyers "Meyers" [NPC_:0008D0E7]

text_content: Primm has seen better days.
name: vMojavevMOMajorKnightTopic015 "Primm has seen better days." [DIAL:0015D863]

text_content: {Sad}It has. It was a promising trade town - before the escape at the correctional facility. {Shakes head, recalling a bad memory}Lost a good bit of money at the Vikki and Vance.
name: vMojavevMOMajorKnightTopic015 "Primm has seen better days." [DIAL:0015D863]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]
speaker: vMOMajorKnight "Major Knight" [NPC_:0013D6A4]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: vMojavevMOMajorKnightTopic014 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0015D864]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: vMojavevMOMajorKnightTopic014 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0015D864]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]
speaker: vMOMajorKnight "Major Knight" [NPC_:0013D6A4]

text_content: Never mind, I'll be leaving now.
name: vMojavevMOMajorKnightTopic013 "Never mind, I'll be leaving now." [DIAL:0015D865]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: vMojavevMOMajorKnightTopic013 "Never mind, I'll be leaving now." [DIAL:0015D865]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]
speaker: vMOMajorKnight "Major Knight" [NPC_:0013D6A4]

text_content: <Bribe>
name: vMojavevMOMajorKnightTopic012 "<Bribe>" [DIAL:0015D866]

text_content: {Slightly uncomfortable, voice down}Well, having a sheriff who was a convict is better than no sheriff at all... and if he has the qualifications... all right, hand it over.
name: vMojavevMOMajorKnightTopic012 "<Bribe>" [DIAL:0015D866]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]
speaker: vMOMajorKnight "Major Knight" [NPC_:0013D6A4]

text_content: If you {emph}had 200 caps, we could talk business - until then, we don't have anything to talk about.
name: vMojavevMOMajorKnightTopic012 "<Bribe>" [DIAL:0015D866]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]
speaker: vMOMajorKnight "Major Knight" [NPC_:0013D6A4]

text_content: <Speech Options>
name: vMojavevMOMajorKnightTopic011 "<Speech Options>" [DIAL:0015D867]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Hmm.{Pensive pause} All right. If his sentence was closing up I can see about getting him pardoned.|Primm is important to our trade up from California, so having someone there who owes us a favor... that couldn't hurt.
name: vMojavevMOMajorKnightTopic011 "<Speech Options>" [DIAL:0015D867]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]
speaker: vMOMajorKnight "Major Knight" [NPC_:0013D6A4]

text_content: [FAILED] I don't think so. I'm not going to put my word on the line for some random convict.
name: vMojavevMOMajorKnightTopic011 "<Speech Options>" [DIAL:0015D867]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]
speaker: vMOMajorKnight "Major Knight" [NPC_:0013D6A4]

text_content: I'd like to know more about Mr. House.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSChetTopic005 "I'd like to know more about Mr. House." [DIAL:0015D8A2]

text_content: I'm afraid I don't know much myself. Mr. House has got his own casino, the Lucky 38, but nobody goes in or out except his robots.|The other casinos follow Mr. House's rules, so I guess that makes him the leader of New Vegas. As far as I know, nobody's ever laid eyes on the guy.|I think that robot who pulled you out of the dirt belongs to Mr. House. If Mr. House is looking after you, that's gotta be a good thing, right?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSChetTopic005 "I'd like to know more about Mr. House." [DIAL:0015D8A2]
speaker: GSChet "Chet" [NPC_:00104C78]

text_content: Why does your jumpsuit say "Miguel?"
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic103 "Why does your jumpsuit say ""Miguel?""" [DIAL:0015D95F]

text_content: You're the mechanic around here?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic102 "You're the mechanic around here?" [DIAL:0015D960]

text_content: Actually, hang out here for a while.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic101 "Actually, hang out here for a while." [DIAL:0015D961]

text_content: Oh, sure thing. I haven't even remotely grown sick of staring at this place.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic101 "Actually, hang out here for a while." [DIAL:0015D961]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Very funny.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic100 "Very funny." [DIAL:0015D962]

text_content: Talk to me at my shack, I've at least got tools there.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic100 "Very funny." [DIAL:0015D962]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Then why does your jumpsuit say "Miguel?"
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic099 "Then why does your jumpsuit say ""Miguel?""" [DIAL:0015D963]

text_content: Probably because it used to be Miguel's. Whoever he was. How about if you let me go, huh boss?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic099 "Then why does your jumpsuit say ""Miguel?""" [DIAL:0015D963]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Really?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic082 "Really?" [DIAL:0015D964]

text_content: <Sigh.> No. No, boss, I'm, a prisoner of the crazy Super Mutant with the wig and the glasses. I was kind of hoping you were here to set me free.|But maybe I'm not a pretty enough damsel for that, huh?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic082 "Really?" [DIAL:0015D964]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: Who are you?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic074 "Who are you?" [DIAL:0015D965]

text_content: Name's Raul. Raul Alfonso Tejada. I'm the mechanic around here.
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic074 "Who are you?" [DIAL:0015D965]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: You forget about me already, boss? You sure you didn't take a blow to the head or something?|My name is Raul Alfonso Tejada. Can I leave now, or did you want to ask me again in five minutes?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic074 "Who are you?" [DIAL:0015D965]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: What do you mean, took me long enough?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic073 "What do you mean, took me long enough?" [DIAL:0015D966]

text_content: Sorry. I assumed the only reason you'd fight past a horde of Super mutants and pick the lock on my cell is if you heard my cry for help on the radio.|But maybe you're just sightseeing. So, since the door's open and all, can I go now?
name: VDialogueRaulRaulTejadaTopic073 "What do you mean, took me long enough?" [DIAL:0015D966]
speaker: RaulTejada "Raul" [NPC_:000E60EF]

text_content: VCG02QuestTransition
name: VCG02QuestTransition "VCG02QuestTransition" [DIAL:0015D978]

text_content: One more thing I wanted to show you.
name: VCG02QuestTransition "VCG02QuestTransition" [DIAL:0015D978]

text_content: Thought I might teach you about living off the land, and making useful things for yourself. Interested?
name: VCG02QuestTransition "VCG02QuestTransition" [DIAL:0015D978]

text_content: [END TUTORIAL] No need. I think I've got it covered from here.
name: VCG02GSSunnySmilesTopic007 "[END TUTORIAL] No need. I think I've got it covered from here." [DIAL:0015D979]

text_content: Okay, say no more.
name: VCG02GSSunnySmilesTopic007 "[END TUTORIAL] No need. I think I've got it covered from here." [DIAL:0015D979]
speaker: GSSunnySmiles "Sunny Smiles" [NPC_:00104E84]

text_content: Couldn't hurt.
name: VCG02GSSunnySmilesTopic006 "Couldn't hurt." [DIAL:0015D97A]

text_content: All right, then. We'll need a couple ingredients to get started. Gonna want some Xander Root and a Broc Flower.|Lemme think now... I know I've seen Broc Flowers growing up at the graveyard. And I seem to remember there being Xander Root over by the schoolhouse.|Bring those on back to me, and we'll get cooking.
name: VCG02GSSunnySmilesTopic006 "Couldn't hurt." [DIAL:0015D97A]
speaker: GSSunnySmiles "Sunny Smiles" [NPC_:00104E84]

text_content: What's so important about Hoover Dam?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSEasyPeteTopic009 "What's so important about Hoover Dam?" [DIAL:0015D9B3]

text_content: The Dam powers a lot of New Vegas. And then there's all that clean water lying in Lake Mead, too. Anybody who owns the Dam owns the territory.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSEasyPeteTopic009 "What's so important about Hoover Dam?" [DIAL:0015D9B3]
speaker: GSEasyPete "Easy Pete" [NPC_:00104C7F]

text_content: Tell me about the Legion.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSEasyPeteTopic008 "Tell me about the Legion." [DIAL:0015D9B4]

text_content: They're slavers, led by a guy named {SEE-zer}Caesar. Or {less certainly, KAI-zar}Caesar. Not sure how you're supposed to say it.|A couple of years ago they tried to take over Hoover Dam, but the NCR beat them back. The NCR didn't - or couldn't - finish the job, though.|The Legion's got its strength back and is getting ready for another round at the Dam. My money's still on the NCR winning, but you never know.|{warning}We've been hearing stories about Legionaries on the Nevada side of the river, so keep a gun handy. You don't want to get caught by them.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSEasyPeteTopic008 "Tell me about the Legion." [DIAL:0015D9B4]
speaker: GSEasyPete "Easy Pete" [NPC_:00104C7F]

text_content: What's wrong with the NCR?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSEasyPeteTopic007 "What's wrong with the NCR?" [DIAL:0015D9B5]

text_content: Don't get me wrong - the NCR's got a lot of decent folk in it. It's just that they make you part of them whether you like it or not.|Towns like Goodsprings and Primm don't stay independent for long, not if you've got something the NCR wants. Still, the NCR keeps the Legion away.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSEasyPeteTopic007 "What's wrong with the NCR?" [DIAL:0015D9B5]
speaker: GSEasyPete "Easy Pete" [NPC_:00104C7F]

text_content: No, I'm still working on it.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic005 "No, I'm still working on it." [DIAL:0015D9C3]

text_content: Remain diligent, outsider. If those patrols are in trouble, every second you delay lessens their chances of rescue.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic005 "No, I'm still working on it." [DIAL:0015D9C3]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: I've found two of the patrols. All of the paladins were dead.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic004 "I've found two of the patrols. All of the paladins were dead." [DIAL:0015D9C4]

text_content: T-That is unfortunate. As long as there is a chance to find the remaining patrol, however, I must still ask you to try.|Return when you have found them.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic004 "I've found two of the patrols. All of the paladins were dead." [DIAL:0015D9C4]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: No, I've only found one of them so far. Both paladins were dead.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic003 "No, I've only found one of them so far. Both paladins were dead." [DIAL:0015D9C5]

text_content: While that is disheartening news, there remains hope that the other two patrols may still be found alive.|See me as soon as you've found them.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic003 "No, I've only found one of them so far. Both paladins were dead." [DIAL:0015D9C5]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: Yes, here are their holotapes.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic002 "Yes, here are their holotapes." [DIAL:0015D9C6]

text_content: {Solemn}They were all dead, then. I suppose I'm not surprised. We have few friends in the world above, and many enemies.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic002 "Yes, here are their holotapes." [DIAL:0015D9C6]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: But we must turn our minds to other matters. When I sent out those patrols, I also sent three Knights out on scouting missions.|When the patrols failed to return, we assumed the worst and sent a single communication to the scouts to hold position and maintain radio silence.|I want you to contact those scouts and gather their reports. Like the patrols, they have devices on them that will enable you to track them.|When you find them, tell them you're my representative and ask them if the bears are still hunting. That should get them to talk to you.|Return when you've gathered all of their reports.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic002 "Yes, here are their holotapes." [DIAL:0015D9C6]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: Sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but I think she's dead.
name: VFreeformNellisNellisJackTopic013 "Sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but I think she's dead." [DIAL:0015D9F6]

text_content: What?! No! I mean, I haven't seen her around for a while, but I thought she was just busy working.|She was so beautiful... Now I'll never get to know her.
name: VFreeformNellisNellisJackTopic013 "Sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but I think she's dead." [DIAL:0015D9F6]
speaker: NellisJack "Jack" [NPC_:000FF264]

text_content: Well, you won't be getting any caps, but McLafferty won't be a problem for you.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanNellisCrimsonCaravanJanetTopic003 "Well, you won't be getting any caps, but McLafferty won't be a problem for you." [DIAL:0015D9F7]

text_content: Oh, I see. Well, I guess I'm off to see my admirer now.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanNellisCrimsonCaravanJanetTopic003 "Well, you won't be getting any caps, but McLafferty won't be a problem for you." [DIAL:0015D9F7]
speaker: NellisCrimsonCaravanJanet "Janet" [NPC_:000FEB3C]

text_content: <Black Widow>
name: VFreeformNellisNellisJackTopic047 "<Black Widow>" [DIAL:0015D9F8]

text_content: You think I'm handsome? Wow, I wonder if she does, too!
name: VFreeformNellisNellisJackTopic047 "<Black Widow>" [DIAL:0015D9F8]
speaker: NellisJack "Jack" [NPC_:000FF264]

text_content: I'd like to hear about that personal matter you mentioned.
name: VFreeformNellisNellisJackTopic048 "I'd like to hear about that personal matter you mentioned." [DIAL:0015D9F9]

text_content: I thought you weren't interested.
name: VFreeformNellisNellisJackTopic048 "I'd like to hear about that personal matter you mentioned." [DIAL:0015D9F9]
speaker: NellisJack "Jack" [NPC_:000FF264]

text_content: <Speech>
name: VFreeformNellisNellisLindsayTopic000 "<Speech>" [DIAL:0015D9FA]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Oh, I remember now! I was playing hide and seek in the big hangar! Mister Loyal made us leave though.
name: VFreeformNellisNellisLindsayTopic000 "<Speech>" [DIAL:0015D9FA]
speaker: NellisLindsay "Lindsay" [NPC_:00103869]

text_content: [FAILED] I don't know. I play all over. I'll never find him!
name: VFreeformNellisNellisLindsayTopic000 "<Speech>" [DIAL:0015D9FA]
speaker: NellisLindsay "Lindsay" [NPC_:00103869]

text_content: I'll be going now.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic025 "I'll be going now." [DIAL:0015DA90]

text_content: Come back when you've made some progress.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic025 "I'll be going now." [DIAL:0015DA90]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]
speaker: vMORangerJackson "Ranger Jackson" [NPC_:0013D6A1]

text_content: [NCR] I'm here to assist.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic023 "[NCR] I'm here to assist." [DIAL:0015DA92]

text_content: Well, about time we got a soldier... and not a recruit, you look like you've seen some action.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic023 "[NCR] I'm here to assist." [DIAL:0015DA92]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]
speaker: vMORangerJackson "Ranger Jackson" [NPC_:0013D6A1]

text_content: Could use a resupply.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic022 "Could use a resupply." [DIAL:0015DA93]

text_content: You mentioned a reward before?
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic021 "You mentioned a reward before?" [DIAL:0015DA94]

text_content: No, I mentioned you might accidentally get supplied, and I meant it. Not allowed to contract mercenaries at the Outpost.|Still, a requisition form or two can get lost, and they're not going to come check... so here you go, just between us.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic021 "You mentioned a reward before?" [DIAL:0015DA94]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]
speaker: vMORangerJackson "Ranger Jackson" [NPC_:0013D6A1]

text_content: Just get it to the NCR government.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic020 "Just get it to the NCR government." [DIAL:0015DA95]

text_content: It felt like the right thing to do.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic019 "It felt like the right thing to do." [DIAL:0015DA96]

text_content: You're welcome.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic018 "You're welcome." [DIAL:0015DA97]

text_content: I'll do what I can - and those folks that got killed need to be answered for.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic018 "You're welcome." [DIAL:0015DA97]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]
speaker: vMORangerJackson "Ranger Jackson" [NPC_:0013D6A1]

text_content: If you can promise it gets where it needs to go.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic017 "If you can promise it gets where it needs to go." [DIAL:0015DA98]

text_content: I can promise that, what happens after... {sighs}not even God himself could move the Congress in or out of session. And this... this is a tricky matter.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic017 "If you can promise it gets where it needs to go." [DIAL:0015DA98]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]
speaker: vMORangerJackson "Ranger Jackson" [NPC_:0013D6A1]

text_content: Sure... no problem.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic016 "Sure... no problem." [DIAL:0015DA99]

text_content: Hmmm. All right - you change your mind and start shooting, then I can't help you. Show up here after, I'll put you in chains.|Get on now, I'll make sure this gets West and let the wheels of law start turning in the courts.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic016 "Sure... no problem." [DIAL:0015DA99]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]
speaker: vMORangerJackson "Ranger Jackson" [NPC_:0013D6A1]

text_content: You have our word.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic015 "You have our word." [DIAL:0015DA9A]

text_content: That'll have to do. {Beat}God, what a mess. People turning against each other when the Mojave's at risk of falling?|If the Republics sinkhole-progress doesn't kill us, greed will. {Beat}Thanks for bringing me this, I know revenge must have been tempting.|For what it's worth, I appreciate you didn't shed any more blood. We need to save our strength for the Legion.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic015 "You have our word." [DIAL:0015DA9A]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]
speaker: vMORangerJackson "Ranger Jackson" [NPC_:0013D6A1]

text_content: {Beat}God, what a mess. People turning against each other when the Mojave's at risk of falling?|If the Republics sinkhole-progress doesn't kill us, greed will. {Beat}Thanks for bringing me this, I know revenge must have been tempting.|For what it's worth, I appreciate you didn't shed any more blood. We need to save our strength for the Legion.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic015 "You have our word." [DIAL:0015DA9A]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]
speaker: vMORangerJackson "Ranger Jackson" [NPC_:0013D6A1]

text_content: Can you get it to the right people?
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic014 "Can you get it to the right people?" [DIAL:0015DA9B]

text_content: No. No, I can't. Because this evidence might be true... but it doesn't just implicate them.|It's a motive for what happened up North, someone went cruising through both compounds, killed them all.|I'm guessing that was you. If so, you're not leaving this outpost except in chains.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic014 "Can you get it to the right people?" [DIAL:0015DA9B]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]
speaker: vMORangerJackson "Ranger Jackson" [NPC_:0013D6A1]

text_content: {Cold}I can, if you make me a promise.|{Cold}I need you to swear you won't take revenge on Gloria or Alice. If you do, then your case is over, and we can't see that justice is done.|I know some things are hard to let go, but you and Miss Cassidy need to understand that, hear me?
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic014 "Can you get it to the right people?" [DIAL:0015DA9B]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]
speaker: vMORangerJackson "Ranger Jackson" [NPC_:0013D6A1]

text_content: I have evidence of a caravan conspiracy.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic012 "I have evidence of a caravan conspiracy." [DIAL:0015DA9C]

text_content: What is it? Let me see.|All right. This is... this explains a lot of the lost caravans. I thought it was Legion work, but...
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic012 "I have evidence of a caravan conspiracy." [DIAL:0015DA9C]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]
speaker: vMORangerJackson "Ranger Jackson" [NPC_:0013D6A1]

text_content: I've heard enough.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic011 "I've heard enough." [DIAL:0015DA9D]

text_content: You sound frustrated.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic009 "You sound frustrated." [DIAL:0015DA9E]

text_content: Frustrated? No. I have my orders - signed, and approved all the way up the chain from Kimball. And I understand the reasons.|The Outpost isn't a Legion target, yet, not like Vegas or the Dam - but if the caravans get choked here, that's going to bite NCR hard.|Anyway, didn't mean to talk your ear off. Some days... just feel like more requisition forms and daily reports come across my desk than results.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic009 "You sound frustrated." [DIAL:0015DA9E]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]
speaker: vMORangerJackson "Ranger Jackson" [NPC_:0013D6A1]

text_content: Is NCR sending more troops?
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic008 "Is NCR sending more troops?" [DIAL:0015DA9F]

text_content: Sending more troops, yes, to reinforce the Outpost, no. Troops head through here on their way to McCarran or to the frontlines at Forlorn Hope.|Or they're on leave, on their way to New Vegas to piss away their pay. All of them, passing through.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic008 "Is NCR sending more troops?" [DIAL:0015DA9F]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]
speaker: vMORangerJackson "Ranger Jackson" [NPC_:0013D6A1]

text_content: You sure seem like you have enough soldiers.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic007 "You sure seem like you have enough soldiers." [DIAL:0015DAA0]

text_content: Soldiers, no, recruits, yes. And the Mojave Outpost has been ordered to have a standing force at the NCR perimeter at all times.|So sending anyone out reduces the Outpost's numbers and would be in direct violation of my orders from back West.
name: vMojavevMORangerJacksonTopic007 "You sure seem like you have enough soldiers." [DIAL:0015DAA0]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]
speaker: vMORangerJackson "Ranger Jackson" [NPC_:0013D6A1]

text_content: Let's move.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic219 "Let's move." [DIAL:0015DB80]

text_content: Got it, let's start looting.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic218 "Got it, let's start looting." [DIAL:0015DB81]

text_content: Don't have to tell me twice, feel more alive than I ever have.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic218 "Got it, let's start looting." [DIAL:0015DB81]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: We'll make the time.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic217 "We'll make the time." [DIAL:0015DB82]

text_content: All right then, let's move out.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic217 "We'll make the time." [DIAL:0015DB82]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Want to check it out?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic216 "Want to check it out?" [DIAL:0015DB83]

text_content: Yeah, something's wrong, I can feel it.|It's not any closer than the first, so if you'd rather let be, let me know.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic216 "Want to check it out?" [DIAL:0015DB83]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Let's leave it for now.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic215 "Let's leave it for now." [DIAL:0015DB84]

text_content: If we have time, sure.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic214 "If we have time, sure." [DIAL:0015DB85]

text_content: Let's go.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic213 "Let's go." [DIAL:0015DB86]

text_content: Want to go check it out?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic212 "Want to go check it out?" [DIAL:0015DB87]

text_content: Yeah, it's a ways, though, hell of a detour. You sure?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic212 "Want to go check it out?" [DIAL:0015DB87]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Is there anything salvagable?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic211 "Is there anything salvagable?" [DIAL:0015DB88]

text_content: Not sure, let's look around.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic211 "Is there anything salvagable?" [DIAL:0015DB88]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: All right, let's check the place out.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic209 "All right, let's check the place out." [DIAL:0015DB89]

text_content: Why would they have done it during the day?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic208 "Why would they have done it during the day?" [DIAL:0015DB8A]

text_content: No idea. Maybe catch the sun in their eyes? Maybe they wanted the caravan to come to them, walk into an ambush?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic208 "Why would they have done it during the day?" [DIAL:0015DB8A]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: We should check the wagon, they may not have got everything.|Whatever we find, it's yours - least I can do for hoofing it all this way with me.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic208 "Why would they have done it during the day?" [DIAL:0015DB8A]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: If there's time.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic207 "If there's time." [DIAL:0015DB8B]

text_content: I may have already searched the area.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic206 "I may have already searched the area." [DIAL:0015DB8C]

text_content: Well, you have to know what to look for.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic206 "I may have already searched the area." [DIAL:0015DB8C]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Let's go, then.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic205 "Let's go, then." [DIAL:0015DB8D]

text_content: Thanks, I appreciate it.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic205 "Let's go, then." [DIAL:0015DB8D]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Some of the caravan might be ash, but we were expecting raiders and over-inquisitive NCR border guards. There might be something left.|If I'm there with you, shouldn't be hard to spot. And I'd prefer to see the bodies with my own eyes.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic205 "Let's go, then." [DIAL:0015DB8D]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Already been there, nothing worth finding.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic204 "Already been there, nothing worth finding." [DIAL:0015DB8E]

text_content: Well, I still wouldn't mind going there and crossing my heart a few times, if only to make me feel a bit better.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic204 "Already been there, nothing worth finding." [DIAL:0015DB8E]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: {To herself, downnote}I got them into this mess, I owe them that much.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic204 "Already been there, nothing worth finding." [DIAL:0015DB8E]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Site's probably nothing but bones and sand by now.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic203 "Site's probably nothing but bones and sand by now." [DIAL:0015DB8F]

text_content: Think there's anything left?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic202 "Think there's anything left?" [DIAL:0015DB90]

text_content: {Sighs}Only wishful thinking on my part, most likely. At the least, I'd like to pay my respects.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic202 "Think there's anything left?" [DIAL:0015DB90]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: {To herself, downnote}I got them into this mess, I owe them that much.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic202 "Think there's anything left?" [DIAL:0015DB90]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: How did you catch word of it?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic201 "How did you catch word of it?" [DIAL:0015DB91]

text_content: Got word back on what happened from Rangers, guess they found enough in the wreckage to identify it.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic201 "How did you catch word of it?" [DIAL:0015DB91]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Where was your caravan hit?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic200 "Where was your caravan hit?" [DIAL:0015DB92]

text_content: {Sighs}Up side of Vegas, hear tell. Trapped at the Mojave Outpost, so I wasn't able to run there when I heard.|Been weeks since it was hit, so the site's probably a Cazador nest by now.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic200 "Where was your caravan hit?" [DIAL:0015DB92]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: After all the shit I went through to get this, we're going to Jackson.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic199 "After all the shit I went through to get this, we're going to Jackson." [DIAL:0015DB93]

text_content: If he won't listen, then we can do things your way.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic198 "If he won't listen, then we can do things your way." [DIAL:0015DB94]

text_content: We have to try.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic197 "We have to try." [DIAL:0015DB95]

text_content: All right, let's do it, listen to what he has to say.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic197 "We have to try." [DIAL:0015DB95]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Anyone you trust in NCR?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic196 "Anyone you trust in NCR?" [DIAL:0015DB96]

text_content: {Blinks}Well... Jackson in the Mojave Outpost could get it to folks in the West. I wouldn't trust anyone closer to the Colorado.|{Thinking}And the Crimson Caravan and the Van Graffs have their heart back West. {Beat}Not sure it'll do any good, though.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic196 "Anyone you trust in NCR?" [DIAL:0015DB96]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: You know Gloria and Alice - what do you think?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic195 "You know Gloria and Alice - what do you think?" [DIAL:0015DB97]

text_content: No one enters into a deal like this unless they have dirt on their partner.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic194 "No one enters into a deal like this unless they have dirt on their partner." [DIAL:0015DB98]

text_content: {Blinks}No... No, I'd agree with that. And Alice and Gloria are two crows that'd keep something like that in their nest.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic194 "No one enters into a deal like this unless they have dirt on their partner." [DIAL:0015DB98]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Because of what happened to your caravan.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic193 "Because of what happened to your caravan." [DIAL:0015DB99]

text_content: {Blinks}You're saying... they might need to do the same thing to each other some day. And evidence is easier than bullets.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic193 "Because of what happened to your caravan." [DIAL:0015DB99]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Not yet.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic192 "Not yet." [DIAL:0015DB9A]

text_content: I held off on filling them full of holes, so unless you give me a good reason to cool my heels soon, I'm not waiting much longer.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic192 "Not yet." [DIAL:0015DB9A]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Here's both pieces of evidence.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic191 "Here's both pieces of evidence." [DIAL:0015DB9B]

text_content: {Impressed}No shit. There it is, the blood, the motive, as clear as day. They must have penned these with snake venom.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic191 "Here's both pieces of evidence." [DIAL:0015DB9B]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: But... we got it, now what? Sure, this damns them, but only if someone listens.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic191 "Here's both pieces of evidence." [DIAL:0015DB9B]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Here's the evidence of the deal. Without its twin, there's no proof.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic190 "Here's the evidence of the deal. Without its twin, there's no proof." [DIAL:0015DB9C]

text_content: So there's just one more safe to crack? Hope you can get to it.|{Frowns}Say what you will about the two leading ladies, they watch their lockers like crows. Still... you got one, so the other might not be impossible.|If you get both, then let's talk. {Beat}And... I appreciate you putting yourself at risk like this. Thanks.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic190 "Here's the evidence of the deal. Without its twin, there's no proof." [DIAL:0015DB9C]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: If I can get the evidence, will you consider it?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic189 "If I can get the evidence, will you consider it?" [DIAL:0015DB9D]

text_content: The harm to the Van Graffs would last longer - and travel back West.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic188 "The harm to the Van Graffs would last longer - and travel back West." [DIAL:0015DB9E]

text_content: All right, if you poke around the Van Graffs and Alice, fine. |But if I see either one, go into their camp? I'm going to start shooting, no matter what you find.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic188 "The harm to the Van Graffs would last longer - and travel back West." [DIAL:0015DB9E]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: There's another way - we can get evidence, let NCR take them down.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic187 "There's another way - we can get evidence, let NCR take them down." [DIAL:0015DB9F]

text_content: NCR? Are you out of your fucking mind?|That'd take years... and with the war with the Legion, no way they're going to waste time running up the Crimson Caravan or the Van Graffs!
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic187 "There's another way - we can get evidence, let NCR take them down." [DIAL:0015DB9F]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: And what makes you think any evidence can be found?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic187 "There's another way - we can get evidence, let NCR take them down." [DIAL:0015DB9F]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: I'm for that, let's go kill them.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic186 "I'm for that, let's go kill them." [DIAL:0015DBA0]

text_content: Don't care much for which one we kill first, whether settling accounts with McLafferty or making that bitch Gloria eat her hair.|The Van Graffs are going to be tougher, so we'll likely get killed there. If we go to the Crimson Caravan camp, we'll just need a lot of bullets.|Still, we give the Van Graffs the what-for, that means all those guns they used on my caravan - we can take and use on the Crimson Caravan.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic186 "I'm for that, let's go kill them." [DIAL:0015DBA0]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Chasing the dead with more deaths isn't the way.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic185 "Chasing the dead with more deaths isn't the way." [DIAL:0015DBA1]

text_content: Better than the alternative.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic184 "Better than the alternative." [DIAL:0015DBA2]

text_content: No... no, I know. Just hard to say how I feel right now.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic184 "Better than the alternative." [DIAL:0015DBA2]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Are you all right?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic183 "Are you all right?" [DIAL:0015DBA3]

text_content: Feels... I don't know. I guess I feel relieved. I don't know what I feel.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic183 "Are you all right?" [DIAL:0015DBA3]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Wait, that's not true. I think the NCR back West, when riled, is going to be the worst enemy the Van Graffs and the Crimson Caravan ever had.|They're all so mired in procedure and paper out there, the kind of evidence we gave is going to be worse than shooting them.|I think that settles accounts with me - and my men. {Beat}That was some tricky political maneuvering, but worth it, even if it takes a few years.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic183 "Are you all right?" [DIAL:0015DBA3]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: You're welcome. Let's go.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic182 "You're welcome. Let's go." [DIAL:0015DBA4]

text_content: So that's it, then.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic181 "So that's it, then." [DIAL:0015DBA5]

text_content: That's it. {Beat}Except for one thing... thanks.|Not many people in my company would have done what you did for me without some hesitation or asking me to cool down.|But you backed me, even when the odds were against us. Words aren't enough, but - thanks.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic181 "So that's it, then." [DIAL:0015DBA5]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: You all right?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic180 "You all right?" [DIAL:0015DBA6]

text_content: {Takes a breath}Yeah... yeah, I am. Never realized had all that anger in me. {Beat, cold}Makes me wonder how much more I can settle with bullets.|You know, when I first heard about them, I was so mad, but there was this little part of me that said, "you can't do to them what they did to you."|I say fuck that part. I feel purified, and I love the fact that there's no more loose ends.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic180 "You all right?" [DIAL:0015DBA6]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Time to move on.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic179 "Time to move on." [DIAL:0015DBA7]

text_content: Got it. Let's loot the place.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic178 "Got it. Let's loot the place." [DIAL:0015DBA8]

text_content: {Grim, pleased}Music to my ears.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic178 "Got it. Let's loot the place." [DIAL:0015DBA8]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: You sure you want to do this?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic177 "You sure you want to do this?" [DIAL:0015DBA9]

text_content: Oh, I'm sure. Killing never felt so good, could almost hear the dead behind me guiding my hand.|Now that that bitch is in hell, they'll have a shot at her, too. So what are we waiting for? We've got more work to do.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic177 "You sure you want to do this?" [DIAL:0015DBA9]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Any thoughts on the Legion?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic176 "Any thoughts on the Legion?" [DIAL:0015DBAA]

text_content: What do you mean?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic175 "What do you mean?" [DIAL:0015DBAB]

text_content: Some caravans deal with the Legion now because the security. If towns could get the same protection? A lot more tempting than you'd think.|A bunch of people would be willing to side with the Legion to not have to worry about Fiends and Boomers and Powder Ganger attacks.|{Sad}It's not hard for some folks to sell freedom when the alternative is worse. Especially if being with NCR is going to get you on a Legion cross.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic175 "What do you mean?" [DIAL:0015DBAB]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: There's other alternatives.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic174 "There's other alternatives." [DIAL:0015DBAC]

text_content: Look... and what I'm about to say, I don't mean as any offense to you, I know where your sympathies lie.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic174 "There's other alternatives." [DIAL:0015DBAC]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: So what's the alternative?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic173 "So what's the alternative?" [DIAL:0015DBAD]

text_content: Look, don't get me wrong.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic173 "So what's the alternative?" [DIAL:0015DBAD]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: I wouldn't want the Brotherhood or the Followers or the Vegas families running the Mojave, all of them are a different kind of fuck-up.|NCR just has some shaping up to do. Maybe Caesar kicking them in the nuts is a nice wake-up call, is all I'm saying.|I just wish Caesar would kick the heads of NCR, not the feet. {Beat}I've fucked a soldier in my time - they don't need to get fucked by their orders.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic173 "So what's the alternative?" [DIAL:0015DBAD]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: So the Mojave suffers.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic172 "So the Mojave suffers." [DIAL:0015DBAE]

text_content: Aside from the people in the towns, it's the soldiers that suffer for it most.|Ever seen NCR troops asked to go after gangs at three-to-one odds? That bear flag doesn't make them bulletproof.|And  when those gangs were caused by NCR in the first place, like the Powder Gangers? Caesar on a crutch, don't get me started there.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic172 "So the Mojave suffers." [DIAL:0015DBAE]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Back to NCR.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic171 "Back to NCR." [DIAL:0015DBAF]

text_content: Yeah, I got that part, thanks.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic170 "Yeah, I got that part, thanks." [DIAL:0015DBB0]

text_content: So NCR, tries to hold on to everything. They can't, because it's too big for them to get their arms around.|They can't guard the roads, they can't put a line of troops around the Mojave... it's just greed that makes the heads back West even try.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic170 "Yeah, I got that part, thanks." [DIAL:0015DBB0]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: So they lack direction?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic169 "So they lack direction?" [DIAL:0015DBB1]

text_content: They try to put their stake in everything they see.|Nobody's dick's that long, not even Long Dick Johnson, and he had a fucking long dick. Thus, the name.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic169 "So they lack direction?" [DIAL:0015DBB1]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: You support it no matter what?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic168 "You support it no matter what?" [DIAL:0015DBB2]

text_content: I'm not some blind, flag-saluting do-as-they-will NCR lover. They're family, but let me tell you what family means.|You ever had a brother? Some dumbass younger brother, say, who knocked up the pastor's daughter, can't hold a job, and his home-away is a jail cell?|That's NCR. Their compass is spinning, all the time.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic168 "You support it no matter what?" [DIAL:0015DBB2]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: There's a "but" in there.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic167 "There's a ""but"" in there." [DIAL:0015DBB3]

text_content: Yeah, there is.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic167 "There's a ""but"" in there." [DIAL:0015DBB3]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: What do you think of NCR?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic166 "What do you think of NCR?" [DIAL:0015DBB4]

text_content: NCR's my country, and I support it. Anyone who says otherwise, I'll feed them my knee.|I know which side of the firing line I'm on in the Mojave, just so you know.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic166 "What do you think of NCR?" [DIAL:0015DBB4]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Any other differences between Legion and NCR?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic165 "Any other differences between Legion and NCR?" [DIAL:0015DBB5]

text_content: Much as I hate the Legion, caravan life would be a hell of a lot easier if they ran the roads.|{Thinking about it again}Well, as long as those companies were run by men. And that's the biggest issue I see.|And it's a shame, but I think there's people on the NCR side who feel more strongly than I do.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic165 "Any other differences between Legion and NCR?" [DIAL:0015DBB5]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: There must be good parts to the Republic.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic164 "There must be good parts to the Republic." [DIAL:0015DBB6]

text_content: NCR tries. It's just that trying doesn't mean a whole lot when you're paying your respects to the dead.|And Legion, from what I've heard, they don't do the "stop tolls" on the roads or in the outposts like some NCR quartermasters do.|You're lucky if you turn a profit sometimes if some new officer gets assigned a route, the fees just get worse.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic164 "There must be good parts to the Republic." [DIAL:0015DBB6]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: NCR sounds like it has a lot to answer for.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic163 "NCR sounds like it has a lot to answer for." [DIAL:0015DBB7]

text_content: You sound frustrated.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic162 "You sound frustrated." [DIAL:0015DBB8]

text_content: I am. If NCR took the same stand and committed patrols to the roads, then I think that'd solve a lot of their problems right there.|But they don't. Caravans get butchered in the Mojave all the time, like mine. And so fucking close to Vegas, you could see it from the wall.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic162 "You sound frustrated." [DIAL:0015DBB8]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Do they deal with any caravans at all?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic161 "Do they deal with any caravans at all?" [DIAL:0015DBB9]

text_content: There's some caravans that deal with the Legion, yes. And as much as it pains me to say it, any caravan marked by the Legion is safe as houses.|They guard their roads, their supply lines - even Fiends would hesitate before going after any trader dealing with Legion.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic161 "Do they deal with any caravans at all?" [DIAL:0015DBB9]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: All right, just asking.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic160 "All right, just asking." [DIAL:0015DBBA]

text_content: Look, not meaning to fly off the handle like that.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic160 "All right, just asking." [DIAL:0015DBBA]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: What about Caesar's Legion?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic159 "What about Caesar's Legion?" [DIAL:0015DBBB]

text_content: {Defensive, a little angry - hates these guys}The Legion? What about them?|{Slight anger}I don't trade caps or supply anyone who keeps slaves, and treats women like Brahmin in those... "camps" of theirs.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic159 "What about Caesar's Legion?" [DIAL:0015DBBB]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Do you deal mostly with NCR?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic157 "Do you deal mostly with NCR?" [DIAL:0015DBBC]

text_content: Anyone wise does. Vegas families pay on time, from what I've heard - even the Omertas. The White Gloves pay on time, but they're... creepy.|Deal with anyone else, though, you're taking a big risk.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic157 "Do you deal mostly with NCR?" [DIAL:0015DBBC]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: And caravan life's the same way?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic156 "And caravan life's the same way?" [DIAL:0015DBBD]

text_content: {Raises an eyebrow}The Caravan fighting here in the Mojave... it's been downright brutal. The amount of caravan space you reserve for ammo alone...|{Sighs}And if it's not raiders, Powder Gangers, it's NCR tolls. They need to get the money from somewhere, even if it's Vegas-bound.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic156 "And caravan life's the same way?" [DIAL:0015DBBD]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: [Ladykiller] Miss Cassidy... are you flirting with me?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic154 "[Ladykiller] Miss Cassidy... are you flirting with me?" [DIAL:0015DBBE]

text_content: Don't take that as anything more than my words. {Teasing}I bet you're a real sweetheart the way you leave that trail of broken-hearts behind you.|I know your look, you probably {emph}say all the right things... so we're clear, nothing's going to happen between us. You'd best respect that.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic154 "[Ladykiller] Miss Cassidy... are you flirting with me?" [DIAL:0015DBBE]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: [Confirmed Bachelor] As long as we keep it on that level.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic153 "[Confirmed Bachelor] As long as we keep it on that level." [DIAL:0015DBBF]

text_content: {Frowns}What? {Beat}Oh. All right. {Beat}Guess you've got a Legion outlook on things. No problems here, there's a lot more of that in the Mojave than you see.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic153 "[Confirmed Bachelor] As long as we keep it on that level." [DIAL:0015DBBF]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Not sure I understand your answer.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic152 "Not sure I understand your answer." [DIAL:0015DBC0]

text_content: [Black Widow] Soft men don't stay that way around me, I've found.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic151 "[Black Widow] Soft men don't stay that way around me, I've found." [DIAL:0015DBC1]

text_content: Well, don't let the soldiers drink too much, and I'd agree with you most time. Fucking whiskey dicks.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic151 "[Black Widow] Soft men don't stay that way around me, I've found." [DIAL:0015DBC1]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: [Cherchez La Femme] That's... rarely an issue.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic150 "[Cherchez La Femme] That's... rarely an issue." [DIAL:0015DBC2]

text_content: {Frowns}What? {Beat}Oh. Damn, no offense meant. Sometimes I get so drunk, I don't care who I share a bed with, so that's fine with me.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic150 "[Cherchez La Femme] That's... rarely an issue." [DIAL:0015DBC2]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: My point before? Is that you know the Mojave, and it's a hard place.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic150 "[Cherchez La Femme] That's... rarely an issue." [DIAL:0015DBC2]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: How's caravan life in the Mojave?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic149 "How's caravan life in the Mojave?" [DIAL:0015DBC3]

text_content: Well, I'm not one for soft living... or soft men, let me tell you. I'm guessing neither are you.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic149 "How's caravan life in the Mojave?" [DIAL:0015DBC3]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Well, I'm not one for soft living or soft men, let me tell you. Otherwise, I wouldn't be talking to you right now - on both counts.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic149 "How's caravan life in the Mojave?" [DIAL:0015DBC3]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: What, like a courier?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic148 "What, like a courier?" [DIAL:0015DBC4]

text_content: Well, not as glamorous, I guess - roads back West were safer in most places. {Beat, to herself}Most.|Anyway, occurred to me I could scratch the traveling itch and get paid for it. Cassidy Caravans formed around me, rest is history.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic148 "What, like a courier?" [DIAL:0015DBC4]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: So you traveled a lot.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic147 "So you traveled a lot." [DIAL:0015DBC5]

text_content: Yeah. West, East - and passed through places enough times people would sometimes pay me some caps to take something to the next town.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic147 "So you traveled a lot." [DIAL:0015DBC5]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: So you just started in the caravan...?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic146 "So you just started in the caravan...?" [DIAL:0015DBC6]

text_content: Actually, it sort of fell on me. My feet get antsy if I stay in one place, like the Mojave Outpost.|Was driving me crazy, that feeling of being trapped there, so thanks for that.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic146 "So you just started in the caravan...?" [DIAL:0015DBC6]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: [Intelligence] I'm familiar. Do *you* know what a fish is?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic145 "[Intelligence] I'm familiar. Do *you* know what a fish is?" [DIAL:0015DBC7]

text_content: {Suddenly unsure}Well... of course I do.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic145 "[Intelligence] I'm familiar. Do *you* know what a fish is?" [DIAL:0015DBC7]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: What the hell is a fish?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic144 "What the hell is a fish?" [DIAL:0015DBC8]

text_content: It's this... slimy, scaled thing, like a Lakelurk, except no legs. Well, most times. They're like birds, except they stay underwater.|Anyway, I've seen pictures. One guy even had one above his bar in Redding, except it was made of Pre-War plastic.|Used to say it could sing, but I figured he was on a Jet rush.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic144 "What the hell is a fish?" [DIAL:0015DBC8]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: How'd you get started in the caravan business?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic143 "How'd you get started in the caravan business?" [DIAL:0015DBC9]

text_content: Started? Took to it like a fish to water... {hesitant}well, if you know what a fish is.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic143 "How'd you get started in the caravan business?" [DIAL:0015DBC9]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Corporal Betsy from First Recon will be coming to you for mental treatment.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic053 "Corporal Betsy from First Recon will be coming to you for mental treatment." [DIAL:0015E42E]

text_content: Mental trauma can be just as debilitating as physical injuries. Fortunately, I'm well-qualified in such treatment. I'll make time in my schedule.
name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic053 "Corporal Betsy from First Recon will be coming to you for mental treatment." [DIAL:0015E42E]

name: vDialogueMedicalClinicDoctorUsanagiTopic053 "Corporal Betsy from First Recon will be coming to you for mental treatment." [DIAL:0015E42E]
speaker: DoctorUsanagi "Doctor Usanagi" [NPC_:000EC7A3]

text_content: Sterling said that if he'd let his pride get in the way, he wouldn't be in First Recon.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ECorporalBetsyTopic028 "Sterling said that if he'd let his pride get in the way, he wouldn't be in First Recon." [DIAL:0015E42F]

text_content: I always wondered about that. First Recon is elite, but the rangers... I can't imagine what it'd be like to lose that kind of status.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ECorporalBetsyTopic028 "Sterling said that if he'd let his pride get in the way, he wouldn't be in First Recon." [DIAL:0015E42F]
speaker: 1ECorporalBetsy "Corporal Betsy" [NPC_:000F56FB]

text_content: Bitter-Root admitted that Usanagi was able to help him with his problems.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ECorporalBetsyTopic027 "Bitter-Root admitted that Usanagi was able to help him with his problems." [DIAL:0015E430]

text_content: Bitter-Root actually said that? I can't see him talking about his problems to anybody, much less admitting that someone else actually helped him.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ECorporalBetsyTopic027 "Bitter-Root admitted that Usanagi was able to help him with his problems." [DIAL:0015E430]
speaker: 1ECorporalBetsy "Corporal Betsy" [NPC_:000F56FB]

text_content: 10 of Spades says his stuttering got better because of Usanagi.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ECorporalBetsyTopic026 "10 of Spades says his stuttering got better because of Usanagi." [DIAL:0015E431]

text_content: {snorting, sarcastic}He got better? If he says so. Anyway, 10 of Spades is a good kid - maybe I ought to listen to him for once.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ECorporalBetsyTopic026 "10 of Spades says his stuttering got better because of Usanagi." [DIAL:0015E431]
speaker: 1ECorporalBetsy "Corporal Betsy" [NPC_:000F56FB]

text_content: I'm guessing the other two had similar things to say. All right, consider me convinced. I'll go see Usanagi.|You can tell the Lieutenant that I caved. {hesitating, not used to showing gratitude}And... thanks.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ECorporalBetsyTopic026 "10 of Spades says his stuttering got better because of Usanagi." [DIAL:0015E431]
speaker: 1ECorporalBetsy "Corporal Betsy" [NPC_:000F56FB]

text_content: The rest of First Recon all agree that you should go see Doctor Usanagi.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ECorporalBetsyTopic025 "The rest of First Recon all agree that you should go see Doctor Usanagi." [DIAL:0015E432]

text_content: This was none of their business - or yours. You've got no right to talk to people behind my back about this.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ECorporalBetsyTopic025 "The rest of First Recon all agree that you should go see Doctor Usanagi." [DIAL:0015E432]
speaker: 1ECorporalBetsy "Corporal Betsy" [NPC_:000F56FB]

text_content: I'm trying to get Corporal Betsy to go see a doctor. I heard you saw Usanagi yourself.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ESergeantBitterRootTopic020 "I'm trying to get Corporal Betsy to go see a doctor. I heard you saw Usanagi yourself." [DIAL:0015E433]

text_content: 10 of Spades really ought to keep his mouth shut, but he's right. There were a lot of things in my past I just couldn't leave behind.|It helped. {grudgingly}A little. Well, more than a little. Betsy ought to pay a visit to Usanagi since it can't hurt none.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ESergeantBitterRootTopic020 "I'm trying to get Corporal Betsy to go see a doctor. I heard you saw Usanagi yourself." [DIAL:0015E433]
speaker: 1ESergeantBitterRoot "Sergeant Bitter-Root" [NPC_:000F56FA]

text_content: You're right - we've never met.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ECorporalSterlingTopic015 "You're right - we've never met." [DIAL:0015E434]

text_content: Good to know.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ECorporalSterlingTopic014 "Good to know." [DIAL:0015E435]

text_content: Any ideas on how to convince Corporal Betsy to go see a doctor?
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ECorporalSterlingTopic013 "Any ideas on how to convince Corporal Betsy to go see a doctor?" [DIAL:0015E436]

text_content: It's a pride thing with her, and totally unnecessary. I mean, look at me - I was {proudly announcing his rank and name}Ranger Sterling until the Legion got through with me.|I was bitter, but if I'd kept my mouth shut, the NCR would've discharged me and sent me home. Instead, I asked if there was still a place for me.|I had to prove I could still handle a gun alongside all the recruits, but look at me now - First Recon and still going strong. You tell Betsy that.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ECorporalSterlingTopic013 "Any ideas on how to convince Corporal Betsy to go see a doctor?" [DIAL:0015E436]
speaker: 1ECorporalSterling "Corporal Sterling" [NPC_:000F56F9]

text_content: Any ideas on how to convince Corporal Betsy to go see a doctor?
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ECorporalSterlingTopic012 "Any ideas on how to convince Corporal Betsy to go see a doctor?" [DIAL:0015E437]

text_content: Any ideas on how to convince Corporal Betsy to go see a doctor?

text_content: Thanks for the tip.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31E10ofSpadesTopic025 "Thanks for the tip." [DIAL:0015E43A]

text_content: N-no problem.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31E10ofSpadesTopic025 "Thanks for the tip." [DIAL:0015E43A]
speaker: 1E10ofSpades "10 of Spades" [NPC_:000F56F7]

text_content: I'm trying to convince Corporal Betsy to go see a doctor. Any ideas?
name: VFreeformMcCarran31E10ofSpadesTopic023 "I'm trying to convince Corporal Betsy to go see a doctor. Any ideas?" [DIAL:0015E43B]

text_content: Oh, b-b-because of what that fuck Cook-Cook did? W-well, it's n-not the same thing, but D-Doc {OOS-uh-NAH-gee}Usanagi helped me with my s-s-stuttering.|The d-doc has a c-clinic north of here. Can't m-m-miss it. You should t-talk to Bitter-Root, too. He's b-been to see the doc, too.

text_content: I convinced Corporal Betsy to get help from Doctor Usanagi.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ELieutenantGorobetsTopic018 "I convinced Corporal Betsy to get help from Doctor Usanagi." [DIAL:0015E43C]

text_content: Yes, the others in the squad said you'd come to them about her. It's a start, but let's hope she sticks with her treatment as long as it's necessary.|I'm afraid she'll ditch Usanagi early if she feels its taking too long - she won't want to look bad in the eyes of the rest of First Recon.

speaker: 1ELieutenantGorobets "Lieutenant Gorobets" [NPC_:000F56FE]

text_content: I caught the tail end of what you said to her. {grinning}Betsy looked like she'd been slapped right back into {basic training}basic for a few seconds there.|Let's hope that Betsy sticks with the treatment. Knowing her, she won't keep seeing Usanagi if she feels things are taking too long.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ELieutenantGorobetsTopic018 "I convinced Corporal Betsy to get help from Doctor Usanagi." [DIAL:0015E43C]
speaker: 1ELieutenantGorobets "Lieutenant Gorobets" [NPC_:000F56FE]

text_content: I wish someone with your medical training had come along sooner. I think she'll actually stick with her treatment because of what you said.|I was afraid that Betsy wouldn't go for long-term treatment because she didn't want to look bad in front of the rest of the squad. You settled that.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ELieutenantGorobetsTopic018 "I convinced Corporal Betsy to get help from Doctor Usanagi." [DIAL:0015E43C]
speaker: 1ELieutenantGorobets "Lieutenant Gorobets" [NPC_:000F56FE]

text_content: Do me a favor and let Usanagi know Corporal Betsy is coming. I'd like to make sure the medical clinic has time for her.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ELieutenantGorobetsTopic018 "I convinced Corporal Betsy to get help from Doctor Usanagi." [DIAL:0015E43C]
speaker: 1ELieutenantGorobets "Lieutenant Gorobets" [NPC_:000F56FE]

text_content: Anything else you can tell me about Great Khans?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSChetTopic003 "Anything else you can tell me about Great Khans?" [DIAL:0015E43D]

text_content: They're tough sons of bitches, mean but not crazy - they'll leave you alone unless you've got something they want.|The Great Khans deal in illegal chems. There's a good chance that most chems you come across were made by Great Khans.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSChetTopic003 "Anything else you can tell me about Great Khans?" [DIAL:0015E43D]
speaker: GSChet "Chet" [NPC_:00104C78]

text_content: Why are the Nightkin here in Jacobstown?
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownKeeneTopic000 "Why are the Nightkin here in Jacobstown?" [DIAL:0015E43E]

text_content: {no cure}The Stealth Boys we use have cumulative, adverse effects on our minds. Jacobstown was supposed to be a sanctuary, a place to find a cure.|Instead, we wait and wait. I'm sick of waiting.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownKeeneTopic000 "Why are the Nightkin here in Jacobstown?" [DIAL:0015E43E]
speaker: JacobstownKeene "Keene" [CREA:0013F70D]

text_content: {cure}The Stealth Boys we use have cumulative, adverse effects on our minds. But, thanks to you, it seems a cure is on the way at last.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownKeeneTopic000 "Why are the Nightkin here in Jacobstown?" [DIAL:0015E43E]
speaker: JacobstownKeene "Keene" [CREA:0013F70D]

text_content: Why do you think you let Betsy down?
name: VFreeformMcCarran31E10ofSpadesTopic024 "Why do you think you let Betsy down?" [DIAL:0015E43F]

text_content: She's my g-g-goddamn partner. See, we work in pairs. We spot for each other. W-watch each other's backs.|Nobody wanted to w-work with me. They said I was too green. But Betsy volunteered. Shit, you don't even know how big a d-d-deal that is.|She trusts her life to the newbie, and I sit there and let her get raped by that... p-p-piece of shit.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31E10ofSpadesTopic024 "Why do you think you let Betsy down?" [DIAL:0015E43F]
speaker: 1E10ofSpades "10 of Spades" [NPC_:000F56F7]

text_content: If you were unconscious, how could you have done anything?
name: VFreeformMcCarran31E10ofSpadesTopic010 "If you were unconscious, how could you have done anything?" [DIAL:0015E440]

text_content: Shit. You sound like the LT. I should've w-woken up. I shouldn't have gotten knocked out in the f-first place.|That shit was my fault. I don't want to talk about it anymore, all right?
name: VFreeformMcCarran31E10ofSpadesTopic010 "If you were unconscious, how could you have done anything?" [DIAL:0015E440]

text_content: Doctor Usanagi at the New Vegas Medical Clinic can help you.

text_content: [FAILED] I already told you that I'm fine. I don't need a head doc.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ECorporalBetsyTopic023 "< Medicine 40 >" [DIAL:0015E442]
speaker: 1ECorporalBetsy "Corporal Betsy" [NPC_:000F56FB]

text_content: You should get medical help for your trauma.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ECorporalBetsyTopic022 "You should get medical help for your trauma." [DIAL:0015E443]

text_content: The Lieutenant's been talking to you, hasn't he? Look, I don't need a head doctor - I'm First Recon, damn it.|You don't see the others crying about every little bruise and scrape, do you?
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ECorporalBetsyTopic022 "You should get medical help for your trauma." [DIAL:0015E443]
speaker: 1ECorporalBetsy "Corporal Betsy" [NPC_:000F56FB]

text_content: I can talk to Betsy about getting medical help for her trauma, if you want.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ELieutenantGorobetsTopic015 "I can talk to Betsy about getting medical help for her trauma, if you want." [DIAL:0015E444]

text_content: I'd appreciate it. As her {see-OH, commanding officer}CO, I could order her to get help, but I'd have her agree with the idea.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ELieutenantGorobetsTopic015 "I can talk to Betsy about getting medical help for her trauma, if you want." [DIAL:0015E444]
speaker: 1ELieutenantGorobets "Lieutenant Gorobets" [NPC_:000F56FE]

text_content: {hesitating because player isn't very smart}Yes. Talk to Betsy and try to convince her to get medical help for her trauma. {muttering to himself}I sure hope you understand what I'm asking.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ELieutenantGorobetsTopic015 "I can talk to Betsy about getting medical help for her trauma, if you want." [DIAL:0015E444]
speaker: 1ELieutenantGorobets "Lieutenant Gorobets" [NPC_:000F56FE]

text_content: What happened to Sterling?

text_content: Corporal Sterling was an NCR ranger until he was captured by the Legion. They tortured him pretty badly.|He wasn't able to be a ranger after that, but his eyes are still sharp so I had him transferred to First Recon.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31ELieutenantGorobetsTopic014 "What happened to Sterling?" [DIAL:0015E445]
speaker: 1ELieutenantGorobets "Lieutenant Gorobets" [NPC_:000F56FE]

text_content: Cook-Cook, one of the fiends, ambushed her and Ten of Spades. They both managed to escape, but not before Cook-Cook raped her.|Betsy's shrugged it off like it was nothing, but her behavior keeps getting worse - always making passes at every woman who wanders by.|It's inappropriate for anyone in First Recon to behave that way. I could discipline her, but I'd rather she get medical help.

text_content: RaulPvtEdwards
name: RaulPvtEdwardsDUPLICATE000 "RaulPvtEdwards" [DIAL:0015E4C4]

text_content: Cheer up, kid. It's not that bad. Sure, your skin rots off and you start to stink like a public toilet after Cinco de Mayo, but... umm....
name: RaulPvtEdwardsDUPLICATE000 "RaulPvtEdwards" [DIAL:0015E4C4]

text_content: What? How is that not bad? In fact, how could it get worse?
name: RaulPvtEdwardsDUPLICATE000 "RaulPvtEdwards" [DIAL:0015E4C4]

text_content: Well, assuming you survive the radiation sickness, the lynch mobs, and the possibility of going feral, one day you'll get old and decrepit, like me.
name: RaulPvtEdwardsDUPLICATE000 "RaulPvtEdwards" [DIAL:0015E4C4]

text_content: Oh god!
name: RaulPvtEdwardsDUPLICATE000 "RaulPvtEdwards" [DIAL:0015E4C4]

text_content: What? Was it something I said?
name: RaulPvtEdwardsDUPLICATE000 "RaulPvtEdwards" [DIAL:0015E4C4]
