speaker: Ramos "Paladin Ramos" [NPC_:000E27E4]

text_content: HVHardinSoundsPlayerOut
name: HVHardinSoundsPlayerOut "HVHardinSoundsPlayerOut" [DIAL:0015E551]

text_content: So, you're the outsider that's been given leave to wander around freely. Desperate times call for desperate measures, I guess.|Name's Hardin. I'm the Head Paladin of this chapter, and I think we might be able to help each other out.|I don't know what the Elder talked to you about, but I can tell you this chapter is in trouble, and he's at the center of it.|Are you willing to listen to what I have to say?
name: HVHardinSoundsPlayerOut "HVHardinSoundsPlayerOut" [DIAL:0015E551]

text_content: I'm still looking for them.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic007 "I'm still looking for them." [DIAL:0015E555]

text_content: Please make all haste in your search. It is imperative that I know the results of his mission.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic007 "I'm still looking for them." [DIAL:0015E555]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: I did. Lorenzo's on it.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic006 "I did. Lorenzo's on it." [DIAL:0015E557]

text_content: {Relieved, sighs}Good news for a change. Your efforts have humbled me, outsider. You have done more than I could expect, even from my Brothers.|Moreover, I've been going over the scouts' reports and keep coming up with the same conclusion. The NCR is not the threat I've believed it to be.|We should not have had to rely on your help in this crisis. I believed my actions were guided by caution and prudence, but I now see the truth.|People called me a hero after what happened at HELIOS, but I left that battle scarred by fear, and have allowed that weakness to govern my actions.|That ends now. I will undo the wrong I have done my brethren, and lift the lockdown. With luck, we will once again flourish.|Please, take this. It is a small token of my thanks, and scarcely begins to repay the debt owed you, but is all I am allowed to give an outsider.|This key will allow you to use our safehouse to the northeast. I hope it will prove useful in your travels.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic006 "I did. Lorenzo's on it." [DIAL:0015E557]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: What was the job you mentioned before?
name: AskJobAgain "What was the job you mentioned before?" [DIAL:0015E5DC]

text_content: Interested now? {Beat, nods}All right.
name: AskJobAgain "What was the job you mentioned before?" [DIAL:0015E5DC]
quest: vMojaveGhost "Keep Your Eyes on the Prize" [QUST:00144124]
speaker: vMORangerGhost "Ranger Ghost" [NPC_:0013D6A2]

text_content: If that's all you wanted, I'm done.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic022 "If that's all you wanted, I'm done." [DIAL:0015E5DD]

text_content: Well, thanks for hoofing it there and back, even if it was bad news. Wish we could spare the troops to go hunting, but... {irritated}orders are to stay put.|{Tired}Fucking Mojave's going to hell, and all I can do is sit here and watch.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic022 "If that's all you wanted, I'm done." [DIAL:0015E5DD]
quest: vMojaveGhost "Keep Your Eyes on the Prize" [QUST:00144124]
speaker: vMORangerGhost "Ranger Ghost" [NPC_:0013D6A2]

text_content: Didn't mean to be the bearer of bad news.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic021 "Didn't mean to be the bearer of bad news." [DIAL:0015E5DE]

text_content: Unless you burned the town, don't take blame that's not due. Things are going to get uglier before the year's out.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic021 "Didn't mean to be the bearer of bad news." [DIAL:0015E5DE]
quest: vMojaveGhost "Keep Your Eyes on the Prize" [QUST:00144124]
speaker: vMORangerGhost "Ranger Ghost" [NPC_:0013D6A2]

text_content: Did you have friends there?
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic020 "Did you have friends there?" [DIAL:0015E5DF]

text_content: In Nipton? Hell no. Town was a shithole, asking to be burned. Just not by Legion. Nobody deserves that.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic020 "Did you have friends there?" [DIAL:0015E5DF]
quest: vMojaveGhost "Keep Your Eyes on the Prize" [QUST:00144124]
speaker: vMORangerGhost "Ranger Ghost" [NPC_:0013D6A2]

text_content: Town's been attacked, not sure by who.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic019 "Town's been attacked, not sure by who." [DIAL:0015E5E0]

text_content: {Skeptical}Well, if you didn't see anyone, they might be gone - be just like Powder Gangers to hit and run.|See what you can find in the Town Hall, there might be survivors.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic019 "Town's been attacked, not sure by who." [DIAL:0015E5E0]
quest: vMojaveGhost "Keep Your Eyes on the Prize" [QUST:00144124]
speaker: vMORangerGhost "Ranger Ghost" [NPC_:0013D6A2]

text_content: Legion turned that sinkhole into a graveyard.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic018 "Legion turned that sinkhole into a graveyard." [DIAL:0015E5E1]

text_content: Nipton was attacked by the Legion.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic017 "Nipton was attacked by the Legion." [DIAL:0015E5E2]

text_content: If I pass through there, I'll check it out.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic016 "If I pass through there, I'll check it out." [DIAL:0015E5E3]

text_content: Better than nothing. {Beat}But close to it.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic016 "If I pass through there, I'll check it out." [DIAL:0015E5E3]
quest: vMojaveGhost "Keep Your Eyes on the Prize" [QUST:00144124]
speaker: vMORangerGhost "Ranger Ghost" [NPC_:0013D6A2]

text_content: Not interested.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic015 "Not interested." [DIAL:0015E5E4]

text_content: Had to try. Smoke trail's getting thicker by the hour - {under her breath}wish Jackson could spare some men.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic015 "Not interested." [DIAL:0015E5E4]
quest: vMojaveGhost "Keep Your Eyes on the Prize" [QUST:00144124]
speaker: vMORangerGhost "Ranger Ghost" [NPC_:0013D6A2]

text_content: I'll do it.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic011 "I'll do it." [DIAL:0015E5E5]

text_content: All right. {Beat, smiling}Look at you, all fired up and ready to go. Wish the others around here had that kind of attitude.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic011 "I'll do it." [DIAL:0015E5E5]
quest: vMojaveGhost "Keep Your Eyes on the Prize" [QUST:00144124]
speaker: vMORangerGhost "Ranger Ghost" [NPC_:0013D6A2]

text_content: {Get serious}Listen - I don't want you getting killed for this, so if you head there and run into trouble, I'm asking for eyes and ears, {emph}not your life. All right?
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic011 "I'll do it." [DIAL:0015E5E5]
quest: vMojaveGhost "Keep Your Eyes on the Prize" [QUST:00144124]
speaker: vMORangerGhost "Ranger Ghost" [NPC_:0013D6A2]

text_content: Legion turned that sinkhole into a graveyard.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic008 "Legion turned that sinkhole into a graveyard." [DIAL:0015E5E6]

text_content: What's the problem?
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic007 "What's the problem?" [DIAL:0015E5E7]

text_content: Hear any news from the West?
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic014 "Hear any news from the West?" [DIAL:0015E5E8]

text_content: {Dismissive}Kimball's Kimball, not sure which end is his ass or his head. Caravan families are causing trouble, Big Circle getting tense - the usual.|Look, you want gossip, go to the bar downstairs and listen to a whole lot of nothing. Me, I got to keep watch, {grumbles}then fill out the daily log.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic014 "Hear any news from the West?" [DIAL:0015E5E8]
quest: vMojaveGhost "Keep Your Eyes on the Prize" [QUST:00144124]
speaker: vMORangerGhost "Ranger Ghost" [NPC_:0013D6A2]

text_content: Why don't you go check it out?
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic013 "Why don't you go check it out?" [DIAL:0015E5E9]

text_content: Got my post. Don't think I wouldn't go, too - if trouble's hit Nipton, town's got enough camping spots to rack up some easy kills.|Not about to have Jackson bust my ass again, though, even if I came back with Caesar's head - rather be sitting here than in a cell.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic013 "Why don't you go check it out?" [DIAL:0015E5E9]
quest: vMojaveGhost "Keep Your Eyes on the Prize" [QUST:00144124]
speaker: vMORangerGhost "Ranger Ghost" [NPC_:0013D6A2]

text_content: Already been there, Nipton was attacked by the Legion.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic012 "Already been there, Nipton was attacked by the Legion." [DIAL:0015E5EA]

text_content: {Surprised, not good news}Legion this far West? You're fucking kidding me.|That's not {emph}outside the border, they're moving in - and fast. {To herself}Nipton wasn't the most friendly town, but...|{Sigh}All right - thanks for checking on that, wish it set my mind at ease, now I'm more on edge than ever.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic012 "Already been there, Nipton was attacked by the Legion." [DIAL:0015E5EA]
quest: vMojaveGhost "Keep Your Eyes on the Prize" [QUST:00144124]
speaker: vMORangerGhost "Ranger Ghost" [NPC_:0013D6A2]

text_content: [NCR] If I can help, I'm here to assist.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic010 "[NCR] If I can help, I'm here to assist." [DIAL:0015E5EB]

text_content: {Studying player}Hnh. Maybe Jackson got some additional soldiers after all. {Positive eval, player's not jaded}Didn't take you for a trooper at first, you seem a little... livelier than most.|All right, if you're here to assist, good, that's what I want to hear.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic010 "[NCR] If I can help, I'm here to assist." [DIAL:0015E5EB]
quest: vMojaveGhost "Keep Your Eyes on the Prize" [QUST:00144124]
speaker: vMORangerGhost "Ranger Ghost" [NPC_:0013D6A2]

text_content: Anything you can tell me about the Outpost?
name: MojaveOutpostQuestion "Anything you can tell me about the Outpost?" [DIAL:0015E5EC]

text_content: Not much to tell, one of the worst posts in the NCR if you're looking to be anything more than a babysitter.|{Slight frustration in these lines}Full up here, but just enough so we {emph}can't send out patrols. Got to maintain a "standing force," Jackson's orders... {corrects self}NCR's orders.|Can't spare men for patrols or escorts, so caravans are backing up here like a Brahmin with a bottle in its ass. {Sighs}Typical NCR bullshit.
name: MojaveOutpostQuestion "Anything you can tell me about the Outpost?" [DIAL:0015E5EC]
quest: vMojaveGhost "Keep Your Eyes on the Prize" [QUST:00144124]
speaker: vMORangerGhost "Ranger Ghost" [NPC_:0013D6A2]

text_content: Never mind, I'll be going now.
name: GhostDismissiveGoodbye "Never mind, I'll be going now." [DIAL:0015E5ED]

text_content: {Dismissive}Mind yourself on the plank going down.
name: GhostDismissiveGoodbye "Never mind, I'll be going now." [DIAL:0015E5ED]
quest: vMojaveGhost "Keep Your Eyes on the Prize" [QUST:00144124]
speaker: vMORangerGhost "Ranger Ghost" [NPC_:0013D6A2]

text_content: What's the pay?
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic006 "What's the pay?" [DIAL:0015E5EE]

text_content: {Mocking, but not to the player}The pay? The pay is a good goddamn thanks from the heart of the Republic!|{Scoffs}Just shitting you with the NCR line, done wonders for morale around here. President Kimball keeps saying getting shot at is its own damn reward.|Do this job for me, though, I'll do what I can. People know I hate most everyone, so if {emph}I put in a word for you... that's gold.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic006 "What's the pay?" [DIAL:0015E5EE]
quest: vMojaveGhost "Keep Your Eyes on the Prize" [QUST:00144124]
speaker: vMORangerGhost "Ranger Ghost" [NPC_:0013D6A2]

text_content: Depends on the work.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic005 "Depends on the work." [DIAL:0015E5EF]

text_content: I think there's trouble in Nipton - no traffic from there on the roads, and while I can explain that away, the smoke from the town I can't.|I'm sure it's been hit - what I need to know is if they survived it. Might be Powder Gangers with all that smoke in the air.|If there's anybody left, they'd be in the Nipton Town Hall. Go there, check it out, let me know what you find.
name: vMojaveGhostvMORangerGhostTopic005 "Depends on the work." [DIAL:0015E5EF]
quest: vMojaveGhost "Keep Your Eyes on the Prize" [QUST:00144124]
speaker: vMORangerGhost "Ranger Ghost" [NPC_:0013D6A2]

text_content: Know anything about Mr. House?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic210 "Know anything about Mr. House?" [DIAL:0015E8B2]

text_content: Not much, and I haven't had occasion to look for anything more than that.|I've heard what most people know... he's said to run New Vegas, he runs the robots, but... well, no one's really seen him.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic210 "Know anything about Mr. House?" [DIAL:0015E8B2]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Well, except you, that is.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic210 "Know anything about Mr. House?" [DIAL:0015E8B2]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Of course, no one really will now that he's dead. Good thing, too, no idea what that contraption was on his pecker.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic210 "Know anything about Mr. House?" [DIAL:0015E8B2]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: So if he wants to see you... well, that's a rare thing I wouldn't turn down. I'd ask him some hard questions if I were you.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic210 "Know anything about Mr. House?" [DIAL:0015E8B2]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: VCassWhiskeyRosePerk
name: VCassWhiskeyRosePerk "VCassWhiskeyRosePerk" [DIAL:0015E8B3]

text_content: That hit the spot.
name: VCassWhiskeyRosePerk "VCassWhiskeyRosePerk" [DIAL:0015E8B3]

text_content: {Shot of whiskey}All right, now for some ass-kicking.
name: VCassWhiskeyRosePerk "VCassWhiskeyRosePerk" [DIAL:0015E8B3]

text_content: {Shot of whiskey}Pass the bottle.
name: VCassWhiskeyRosePerk "VCassWhiskeyRosePerk" [DIAL:0015E8B3]

text_content: {Shot of whiskey}Now all I need is some shame to wash it down with.
name: VCassWhiskeyRosePerk "VCassWhiskeyRosePerk" [DIAL:0015E8B3]

text_content: {Shot of whiskey}Bottoms up.
name: VCassWhiskeyRosePerk "VCassWhiskeyRosePerk" [DIAL:0015E8B3]

text_content: {Shot of whiskey}Oh, now, there goes the pain.
name: VCassWhiskeyRosePerk "VCassWhiskeyRosePerk" [DIAL:0015E8B3]

name: VCassLookAround3 "VCassLookAround3" [DIAL:0015E9A3]

name: VCassLookAround2 "VCassLookAround2" [DIAL:0015E9A4]

text_content: VCassPayRespect
name: VCassPayRespect "VCassPayRespect" [DIAL:0015E9A5]

text_content: VCassLookAround
name: VCassLookAround "VCassLookAround" [DIAL:0015E9A6]

text_content: Any idea what was up at the site of the last caravan?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic224 "Any idea what was up at the site of the last caravan?" [DIAL:0015E9A7]

text_content: Not sure yet, something's definitely wrong. They were massacred, we should look around, find out why.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic224 "Any idea what was up at the site of the last caravan?" [DIAL:0015E9A7]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: See anything at the second caravan site?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic223 "See anything at the second caravan site?" [DIAL:0015E9A8]

text_content: Nothing yet, but... something's there. Just got to look around and find it.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic223 "See anything at the second caravan site?" [DIAL:0015E9A8]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: See anything at the caravan site?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic222 "See anything at the caravan site?" [DIAL:0015E9A9]

text_content: No... still eating at me, though. Wouldn't mind taking another look. Something's off.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic222 "See anything at the caravan site?" [DIAL:0015E9A9]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: I think we should explore the next one, see what's up. Got my curiosity riled.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic222 "See anything at the caravan site?" [DIAL:0015E9A9]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Let's do it, then.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic221 "Let's do it, then." [DIAL:0015E9AA]

text_content: Don't matter much how we settle this, as long as it gets settled.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic221 "Let's do it, then." [DIAL:0015E9AA]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

name: VES34VaultVVault34HorowitzTopic018 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0015E9B9]

text_content: I was the one who turned off the vents at Vault 34.

name: VES34VaultVVault34HorowitzTopic016 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0015E9BB]

name: VES34VaultVVault34HorowitzTopic015 "I was the one who turned off the vents at Vault 34." [DIAL:0015E9BC]

text_content: How's the "surface world" treating you?
name: VES34VaultVVault34HorowitzTopic014 "How's the ""surface world"" treating you?" [DIAL:0015E9BD]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VES34VaultVVault34HorowitzTopic013 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0015E9BE]

text_content: How about a Vault trinket in exchange for my help?
name: VES34VaultVVault34HorowitzTopic012 "How about a Vault trinket in exchange for my help?" [DIAL:0015E9BF]

text_content: Don't mention it, your freedom is enough reward for me.
name: VES34VaultVVault34HorowitzTopic011 "Don't mention it, your freedom is enough reward for me." [DIAL:0015E9C0]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VES34VaultVVault34HorowitzTopic010 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0015E9C1]

name: VES34VaultVVault34HorowitzTopic007 "How's the ""surface world"" treating you?" [DIAL:0015E9C4]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VES34VaultVVault34HorowitzTopic006 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0015E9C5]

text_content: How's the "surface world" treating you?
name: VES34VaultVVault34HorowitzTopic005 "How's the ""surface world"" treating you?" [DIAL:0015E9C6]

text_content: I could use a Vault trinket.
name: VES34VaultVVault34HorowitzTopic004 "I could use a Vault trinket." [DIAL:0015E9C7]

text_content: Of course, please, take this! We carried as much useful technology as we could, before our journey into the surface world.
name: VES34VaultVVault34HorowitzTopic004 "I could use a Vault trinket." [DIAL:0015E9C7]
speaker: VVault34Horowitz "Horowitz" [NPC_:0015E9E6]

text_content: I don't need anything in return for my help.
name: VES34VaultVVault34HorowitzTopic003 "I don't need anything in return for my help." [DIAL:0015E9C8]

text_content: It fills me with hope to see that people from the surface world are kind, and brave. Again, thank you.
name: VES34VaultVVault34HorowitzTopic003 "I don't need anything in return for my help." [DIAL:0015E9C8]
speaker: VVault34Horowitz "Horowitz" [NPC_:0015E9E6]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VES34VaultVVault34HorowitzTopic002 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0015E9C9]

text_content: Until soon, I hope, outlander.
name: VES34VaultVVault34HorowitzTopic002 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0015E9C9]
speaker: VVault34Horowitz "Horowitz" [NPC_:0015E9E6]

text_content: How's the "surface world" treating you?
name: VES34VaultVVault34HorowitzTopic001 "How's the ""surface world"" treating you?" [DIAL:0015E9CA]

text_content: Kindly! The leaders of this fine community have accepted us among them. They give us food and protection from the outside.|Some people here seem extremely unhappy. They keep talking about getting "shafted," "swindled," and "fucked."|Apparently somebody did them ill, all the way inside the surface-city with lights - the Strip, and Freeside, they call it.
name: VES34VaultVVault34HorowitzTopic001 "How's the ""surface world"" treating you?" [DIAL:0015E9CA]
speaker: VVault34Horowitz "Horowitz" [NPC_:0015E9E6]

text_content: We're lucky to be here, alive and well. The land's a mystery to us, but we'll find our place in it.
name: VES34VaultVVault34HorowitzTopic001 "How's the ""surface world"" treating you?" [DIAL:0015E9CA]
speaker: VVault34Horowitz "Horowitz" [NPC_:0015E9E6]

text_content: I was the one who turned off the vents at Vault 34.
name: VES34VaultVVault34HorowitzTopic000 "I was the one who turned off the vents at Vault 34." [DIAL:0015E9CB]

text_content: You? Did you re-direct the power stream back to our section? |{Almost incredulous}We thought nobody would ever manage to get past the radiation, and the ghouls!|We owe you our freedom, outlander. Please, if there's anything we can do for you...
name: VES34VaultVVault34HorowitzTopic000 "I was the one who turned off the vents at Vault 34." [DIAL:0015E9CB]
speaker: VVault34Horowitz "Horowitz" [NPC_:0015E9E6]

text_content: Yes, I believe that, outlander. We owe you our freedom.
name: VES34VaultVVault34HorowitzTopic000 "I was the one who turned off the vents at Vault 34." [DIAL:0015E9CB]
speaker: VVault34Horowitz "Horowitz" [NPC_:0015E9E6]

text_content: VCassJBCPostAttack
name: VCassJBCPostAttack "VCassJBCPostAttack" [DIAL:0015E9EC]

text_content: {Calming down, just avoided a surprise attack}What the hell was that all about?
name: VCassJBCPostAttack "VCassJBCPostAttack" [DIAL:0015E9EC]

text_content: VCassJBCAttack
name: VCassJBCAttack "VCassJBCAttack" [DIAL:0015E9ED]

text_content: {Attacked out of the blue}What the hell is this shit?
name: VCassJBCAttack "VCassJBCAttack" [DIAL:0015E9ED]

text_content: Interested in... uh... following me to Freeside?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic225 "Interested in... uh... following me to Freeside?" [DIAL:0015E9EE]

text_content: I'm already shadowing you, aren't I? Lead on, I'll follow.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic225 "Interested in... uh... following me to Freeside?" [DIAL:0015E9EE]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Ask me to come with you, I'll think about it on the way.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic225 "Interested in... uh... following me to Freeside?" [DIAL:0015E9EE]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Not leaving here until my caravan papers clear, or my title goes away.|If you were looking for someone to caravan with, I'd try the Crimson Caravan up north. They pretty much run the roads now.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic225 "Interested in... uh... following me to Freeside?" [DIAL:0015E9EE]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Don't know, not sure where to head to next.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic225 "Interested in... uh... following me to Freeside?" [DIAL:0015E9EE]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: He's with the Van Graffs.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic220 "He's with the Van Graffs." [DIAL:0015E9EF]

text_content: {Thinking}The only Van Graffs I know are the ones out West - well, except for Gloria Van Graff, and I don't know her all that well, nor do I want to.|Don't have any objections speaking with him, though if he's with the Van Graffs, he should know I'm not looking to buy weapons.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic220 "He's with the Van Graffs." [DIAL:0015E9EF]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Jean-Baptiste in Freeside wanted to meet with you.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic109 "Jean-Baptiste in Freeside wanted to meet with you." [DIAL:0015E9F0]

text_content: "Jean-Baptiste?" Sounds like someone got knocked out of the good book so hard his name broke.|{To herself, "Canadarian" is intentional fuckup}Either that or it's Canadarian or some such shit. {Frowns, to player}So who is this... "Baptiste" and what does he want?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic109 "Jean-Baptiste in Freeside wanted to meet with you." [DIAL:0015E9F0]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: What makes the surplus ammo inferior?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSChetTopic007 "What makes the surplus ammo inferior?" [DIAL:0015EA7A]

text_content: It's all about quantity over quality. Trouble is, you'll be cleaning and fixing your gun a lot more than usual when you use those kind of bullets.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSChetTopic007 "What makes the surplus ammo inferior?" [DIAL:0015EA7A]
speaker: GSChet "Chet" [NPC_:00104C78]

text_content: Tell me about weapon mods and special ammo.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSChetTopic006 "Tell me about weapon mods and special ammo." [DIAL:0015EA7B]

text_content: Weapon mods are things like silencers, scopes, bigger magazines.|Special ammo includes things like armor-piercing bullets which don't hurt the target as much but let you punch through armor easier.|There's also hollowpoint bullets which have the opposite effect - you can kill unarmored targets easier, but they don't do shit against armor.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSChetTopic006 "Tell me about weapon mods and special ammo." [DIAL:0015EA7B]
speaker: GSChet "Chet" [NPC_:00104C78]

text_content: For how long will I get this benefit?
name: VFreeformTheFortvLegionaryFactionRewardNPCTopic002 "For how long will I get this benefit?" [DIAL:0015EA9E]

text_content: Stay an ally of the Legion and we will share our loot with you. If you start working against us - or become an enemy - our deal ends.
name: VFreeformTheFortvLegionaryFactionRewardNPCTopic002 "For how long will I get this benefit?" [DIAL:0015EA9E]
speaker: vLegionaryFactionRewardNPC "Disguised Frumentarius" [NPC_:0015D42F]

text_content: How long will I get this benefit?
name: VFreeformTheFortvLegionaryFactionRewardNPCTopic001 "How long will I get this benefit?" [DIAL:0015EA9F]

text_content: As long as you don't become an outright enemy of the Legion, payment will continue.
name: VFreeformTheFortvLegionaryFactionRewardNPCTopic001 "How long will I get this benefit?" [DIAL:0015EA9F]
speaker: vLegionaryFactionRewardNPC "Disguised Frumentarius" [NPC_:0015D42F]

text_content: I have some things to take care of before the battle.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic074 "I have some things to take care of before the battle." [DIAL:0015EB5A]

text_content: {tense}Then handle them with dispatch. The Legion's assault is imminent.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic074 "I have some things to take care of before the battle." [DIAL:0015EB5A]
speaker: MrHouse "Mr. House" [CREA:00125BB5]

text_content: I'm ready. Let's finish this.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic073 "I'm ready. Let's finish this." [DIAL:0015EB5B]

text_content: We've accomplished a great deal, you and I. One last task, and our work is complete. I'll see you in the control room.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic073 "I'm ready. Let's finish this." [DIAL:0015EB5B]
speaker: MrHouse "Mr. House" [CREA:00125BB5]

text_content: If you're going to shoot, you'd better not miss.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSRingoTopic025 "If you're going to shoot, you'd better not miss." [DIAL:0015EBE6]

text_content: I'm not an enemy, if that's what you're asking.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSRingoTopic024 "I'm not an enemy, if that's what you're asking." [DIAL:0015EBE7]

text_content: Sorry about the gun. You just caught me off guard, that's all.|{apologetic}We got off to a bad start. What say we start over with a friendly game of Caravan? {questioning}You know how to play?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSRingoTopic024 "I'm not an enemy, if that's what you're asking." [DIAL:0015EBE7]
speaker: GSRingo "Ringo" [NPC_:00104C7C]

text_content: I'm just having a look around.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSRingoTopic023 "I'm just having a look around." [DIAL:0015EBE8]

text_content: I see.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSRingoTopic022 "I see." [DIAL:0015EBE9]

text_content: Did you want something else?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSRingoTopic022 "I see." [DIAL:0015EBE9]
speaker: GSRingo "Ringo" [NPC_:00104C7C]

text_content: I have some questions first.
name: VDialogueMrHouseMrHouseTopic075 "I have some questions first." [DIAL:0015EBEC]

text_content: What do you know about the other group?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSSunnySmilesTopic012 "What do you know about the other group?" [DIAL:0015EBED]

text_content: Got a funny name. Call themselves Caesar's Legion. Never seen 'em in these parts, so I couldn't tell you much.|I hear rumors, that's about it. Supposedly they keep slaves and they got some real nasty ways of killing folks.|But maybe that's just something folks in the NCR cooked up to make themselves seem more useful here. Less uninvited.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSSunnySmilesTopic012 "What do you know about the other group?" [DIAL:0015EBED]
speaker: GSSunnySmiles "Sunny Smiles" [NPC_:00104E84]

text_content: What does the NCR keep you safe from?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSSunnySmilesTopic000 "What does the NCR keep you safe from?" [DIAL:0015EBEE]

text_content: Well, the wildlife for one thing. Rowdy locals for another.|They're protecting their own. Just happens to help us.|They've been holding off this other group from the East, too.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSSunnySmilesTopic000 "What does the NCR keep you safe from?" [DIAL:0015EBEE]
speaker: GSSunnySmiles "Sunny Smiles" [NPC_:00104E84]

text_content: Cass isn't around anymore, so I won't be able to complete the negotiation for you.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic038 "Cass isn't around anymore, so I won't be able to complete the negotiation for you." [DIAL:0015EBF3]

text_content: A pity. I guess I'll have to find some other way to acquire her caravan's assets. Thanks for letting me know.
name: VDialogueCrimsonCaravanAliceMcLaffertyTopic038 "Cass isn't around anymore, so I won't be able to complete the negotiation for you." [DIAL:0015EBF3]
speaker: AliceMcLafferty "Alice McLafferty" [NPC_:000EC7A1]

text_content: If you run the town, they'll have to work for you. Food, water, and money will be yours.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic015 "If you run the town, they'll have to work for you. Food, water, and money will be yours." [DIAL:0015EC1C]

text_content: {realizing player has a good idea}Shit, yeah. Mayor Cobb - I like the sound of that. Running my own town will give me more pull with the guys at the prison, too.|First things first, though. You go settle things with Ringo and put a bullet between his eyes while I round up my crew and let them in on the plan.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic015 "If you run the town, they'll have to work for you. Food, water, and money will be yours." [DIAL:0015EC1C]
speaker: GSJoeCobb "Joe Cobb" [NPC_:00104C67]

text_content: Tell me about the NCR.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic010 "Tell me about the NCR." [DIAL:0015EC1D]

text_content: {contempt}"New" California Republic - nothing new about it. Just a bunch of people with money and power pushing everyone else around.|They've got troops all over the Mojave, but it's a big desert so it's pretty easy to avoid them if you want.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic010 "Tell me about the NCR." [DIAL:0015EC1D]
speaker: GSJoeCobb "Joe Cobb" [NPC_:00104C67]

text_content: What do you know about the Legion?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic008 "What do you know about the Legion?" [DIAL:0015EC1E]

text_content: I've run with some tough gangs, but I gotta admit they all got nothing on the Legion. I hear they stick you up on poles and it takes awhile to die.|I ain't saying I'm afraid of them or nothing, but I'll be staying out of their way.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic008 "What do you know about the Legion?" [DIAL:0015EC1E]
speaker: GSJoeCobb "Joe Cobb" [NPC_:00104C67]

text_content: What's been going on in the rest of the wasteland?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic007 "What's been going on in the rest of the wasteland?" [DIAL:0015EC1F]

text_content: Same old shit that's been going on for years. The NCR and Legion are still fighting over Hoover Dam for some reason.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic007 "What's been going on in the rest of the wasteland?" [DIAL:0015EC1F]
speaker: GSJoeCobb "Joe Cobb" [NPC_:00104C67]

text_content: Forget I said anything.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic017 "Forget I said anything." [DIAL:0015EC51]

text_content: Make up your damn mind.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic017 "Forget I said anything." [DIAL:0015EC51]
speaker: GSJoeCobb "Joe Cobb" [NPC_:00104C67]

text_content: Free food, I guess.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic016 "Free food, I guess." [DIAL:0015EC52]

text_content: {thoughtful}Having all the food we want ain't a bad idea, actually. Getting sick of eating prison rations.|First things first, though. You go settle things with Ringo and put a bullet between his eyes while I round up my crew and let them in on the plan.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic016 "Free food, I guess." [DIAL:0015EC52]
speaker: GSJoeCobb "Joe Cobb" [NPC_:00104C67]

text_content: Where should I look for spare parts?
name: VFreeformNellisNellisLoyalTopic017 "Where should I look for spare parts?" [DIAL:0015ECBE]

text_content: Ha! If we had spare parts, do you think I'd be asking you to fix the damn things? That's rich.|No, we ran out of spares a while back, and Jack and I have been doing our best to patch the arrays up as best we can. Sadly, we're at our wit's end.|There have to be spare parts somewhere around the wasteland, but I just don't know where to direct you. You may have noticed we don't get out much.
name: VFreeformNellisNellisLoyalTopic017 "Where should I look for spare parts?" [DIAL:0015ECBE]
speaker: NellisLoyal "Loyal" [NPC_:000FED42]

text_content: Funny you should mention that, I have array parts right here.
name: VFreeformNellisNellisLoyalTopic024 "Funny you should mention that, I have array parts right here." [DIAL:0015ECBF]

text_content: Hey, that's great! You shouldn't have much trouble getting those fixed up, then. Just stop back when you're done.
name: VFreeformNellisNellisLoyalTopic024 "Funny you should mention that, I have array parts right here." [DIAL:0015ECBF]
speaker: NellisLoyal "Loyal" [NPC_:000FED42]

text_content: I passed through a place called Helios One. Maybe I could find parts there.
name: VFreeformNellisNellisLoyalTopic026 "I passed through a place called Helios One. Maybe I could find parts there." [DIAL:0015ECC0]

text_content: Are you talking about that damn bright light we've seen blast off to the south occasionally? I was wondering what the hell that was.|If they've got the parts, bring them on back. We need to get the array back up and charging.
name: VFreeformNellisNellisLoyalTopic026 "I passed through a place called Helios One. Maybe I could find parts there." [DIAL:0015ECC0]
speaker: NellisLoyal "Loyal" [NPC_:000FED42]

text_content: Ringo's dead. What now?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic023 "Ringo's dead. What now?" [DIAL:0015ED41]

text_content: Good. We'll still need a plan before we rush the town. I don't want to embarrass myself and get beat by a bunch of townies.|We ain't got much in the way of supplies, so if you could shake down the old doctor and the store owner for some stuff, we'd be in good shape.|Once you're done with that stuff - or none of it - say the word and we'll make our move.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic023 "Ringo's dead. What now?" [DIAL:0015ED41]
speaker: GSJoeCobb "Joe Cobb" [NPC_:00104C67]

text_content: I've done all I can. Let's take over Goodsprings.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic022 "I've done all I can. Let's take over Goodsprings." [DIAL:0015ED42]

text_content: It's about time. I saw some of the townies gathering at the saloon, so we've got a militia to take down. We get rid of them and we own this place.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic022 "I've done all I can. Let's take over Goodsprings." [DIAL:0015ED42]
speaker: GSJoeCobb "Joe Cobb" [NPC_:00104C67]

text_content: < Medicine 25 >
name: VFreeformGoodspringsDocMitchellTopic004 "< Medicine 25 >" [DIAL:0015ED43]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] All right, that does sound bad. Here, take these - it should be enough. Good luck!
name: VFreeformGoodspringsDocMitchellTopic004 "< Medicine 25 >" [DIAL:0015ED43]
speaker: DocMitchell "Doc Mitchell" [NPC_:00104C0C]

text_content: [FAILED] That does sound messy, but not too bad. I can't spare supplies for cuts and bruises.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsDocMitchellTopic004 "< Medicine 25 >" [DIAL:0015ED43]
speaker: DocMitchell "Doc Mitchell" [NPC_:00104C0C]

text_content: Never mind.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsDocMitchellTopic003 "Never mind." [DIAL:0015ED44]

text_content: Must not be that serious, then.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsDocMitchellTopic003 "Never mind." [DIAL:0015ED44]
speaker: DocMitchell "Doc Mitchell" [NPC_:00104C0C]

text_content: <Lie> I'll need all the medical supplies you can spare for an injured man down by the highway.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsDocMitchellTopic002 "<Lie> I'll need all the medical supplies you can spare for an injured man down by the highway." [DIAL:0015ED45]

text_content: Are you sure? What kind of injuries are we talking about?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsDocMitchellTopic002 "<Lie> I'll need all the medical supplies you can spare for an injured man down by the highway." [DIAL:0015ED45]
speaker: DocMitchell "Doc Mitchell" [NPC_:00104C0C]

text_content: Has this person's condition worsened? What are the symptoms?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsDocMitchellTopic002 "<Lie> I'll need all the medical supplies you can spare for an injured man down by the highway." [DIAL:0015ED45]
speaker: DocMitchell "Doc Mitchell" [NPC_:00104C0C]

text_content: Never mind.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSChetTopic011 "Never mind." [DIAL:0015ED46]

text_content: Yeah, quit it with the crazy talk.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSChetTopic011 "Never mind." [DIAL:0015ED46]
speaker: GSChet "Chet" [NPC_:00104C78]

text_content: < Speech 25 >
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSChetTopic010 "< Speech 25 >" [DIAL:0015ED47]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] All right! I can give you some of my extra leather armor and spare ammo. {pleading}Just don't hurt anybody if you don't have to, all right?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSChetTopic010 "< Speech 25 >" [DIAL:0015ED47]
speaker: GSChet "Chet" [NPC_:00104C78]

text_content: [FAILED] Look, just leave me out of this, all right?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSChetTopic010 "< Speech 25 >" [DIAL:0015ED47]
speaker: GSChet "Chet" [NPC_:00104C78]

text_content: < Barter 25 >
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSChetTopic009 "< Barter 25 >" [DIAL:0015ED48]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] All right, all right. I've got some extra leather armor and spare ammo for you. {pleading}Don't hurt anybody if you don't have to, all right?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSChetTopic009 "< Barter 25 >" [DIAL:0015ED48]
speaker: GSChet "Chet" [NPC_:00104C78]

text_content: [FAILED] "Maybe" doesn't do much to convince me. No, just leave me out of this, all right?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSChetTopic009 "< Barter 25 >" [DIAL:0015ED48]
speaker: GSChet "Chet" [NPC_:00104C78]

text_content: The Powder Gangers need you to donate some supplies to them.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSChetTopic008 "The Powder Gangers need you to donate some supplies to them." [DIAL:0015ED49]

text_content: What? Why the hell would I want to do that?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSChetTopic008 "The Powder Gangers need you to donate some supplies to them." [DIAL:0015ED49]
speaker: GSChet "Chet" [NPC_:00104C78]

text_content: {annoyed}This again. What makes you think I've changed my mind?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSChetTopic008 "The Powder Gangers need you to donate some supplies to them." [DIAL:0015ED49]
speaker: GSChet "Chet" [NPC_:00104C78]

text_content: Way ahead of you - I killed Ringo earlier.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic021 "Way ahead of you - I killed Ringo earlier." [DIAL:0015ED4A]

text_content: Ringo's already settled. What's next?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic020 "Ringo's already settled. What's next?" [DIAL:0015ED4B]

text_content: I already took care of Ringo.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic019 "I already took care of Ringo." [DIAL:0015ED4C]

text_content: No shit? I guess the next thing we need to do is hang out and wait for the rest of my gang to show up so we can talk about the plan.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic019 "I already took care of Ringo." [DIAL:0015ED4C]
speaker: GSJoeCobb "Joe Cobb" [NPC_:00104C67]

text_content: VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsgRefuse
name: VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsgRefuse "VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsgRefuse" [DIAL:0015EDAC]

text_content: {Irritated}Fine. I guess it doesn't matter anyway, keep it. I won't ask again.
name: VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsgRefuse "VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsgRefuse" [DIAL:0015EDAC]

text_content: VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsg4
name: VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsg4 "VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsg4" [DIAL:0015EDAD]

text_content: Would you mind if I listened to the message you found?
name: VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsg4 "VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsg4" [DIAL:0015EDAD]

text_content: VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsg3
name: VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsg3 "VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsg3" [DIAL:0015EDAE]

text_content: Would you mind if I looked at the message you found?
name: VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsg3 "VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsg3" [DIAL:0015EDAE]

text_content: VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsg2
name: VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsg2 "VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsg2" [DIAL:0015EDAF]

text_content: Would you mind if I listened to the message?
name: VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsg2 "VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsg2" [DIAL:0015EDAF]

text_content: VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsg1
name: VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsg1 "VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsg1" [DIAL:0015EDB0]

text_content: Would you mind if I looked at the message?
name: VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsg1 "VDialogueVeronicaAbeMsg1" [DIAL:0015EDB0]

text_content: Abraham wanted to say goodbye, and that he's gone North, into ghoul country.
name: VDialogueVeronicaAbeBye1 "Abraham wanted to say goodbye, and that he's gone North, into ghoul country." [DIAL:0015EDB1]

text_content: Oh god. He... {sighs}I guess he was lost a long time ago. Even at the end...
name: VDialogueVeronicaAbeBye1 "Abraham wanted to say goodbye, and that he's gone North, into ghoul country." [DIAL:0015EDB1]

text_content: Still... thanks for bringing word. At least, now I know.
name: VDialogueVeronicaAbeBye1 "Abraham wanted to say goodbye, and that he's gone North, into ghoul country." [DIAL:0015EDB1]

text_content: Abe explained what happened in the Crater, how it healed him.
name: VDialogueVeronicaAbeExp1 "Abe explained what happened in the Crater, how it healed him." [DIAL:0015EDB2]

text_content: {Drifting, dismissive}Hmm. Unlikely. He was a little too focused on gears and diodes... tech was the cure-all.
name: VDialogueVeronicaAbeExp1 "Abe explained what happened in the Crater, how it healed him." [DIAL:0015EDB2]

text_content: What did you expect a ghoul to say?
name: VDialogueVeronicaAbeSim2 "What did you expect a ghoul to say?" [DIAL:0015EDB3]

text_content: {Sadly accepting}Yeah. Yeah. Thought as much. He'd been fading away for a long time.
name: VDialogueVeronicaAbeSim2 "What did you expect a ghoul to say?" [DIAL:0015EDB3]

text_content: VDialogueVeronicaAbeSim1
name: VDialogueVeronicaAbeSim1 "VDialogueVeronicaAbeSim1" [DIAL:0015EDB4]

text_content: {Waiting for player to step out of simulator}What was on it? What did he say?
name: VDialogueVeronicaAbeSim1 "VDialogueVeronicaAbeSim1" [DIAL:0015EDB4]

text_content: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg35
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg35 "VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg35" [DIAL:0015EDB5]

text_content: {Still a little dizzy}Sorry... feel a little out of it. Head's spinning a bit...
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg35 "VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg35" [DIAL:0015EDB5]

text_content: {Surprise, knowledge downloading}Oh. Oh!
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg35 "VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg35" [DIAL:0015EDB5]

text_content: {Blinking, just gained downloaded defense programs}I think he left me a gift. {Quiet}Maybe I can use it better than he did.
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg35 "VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg35" [DIAL:0015EDB5]

text_content: What did Abraham say to you?
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg34 "What did Abraham say to you?" [DIAL:0015EDB6]

text_content: {Confused, a little disoriented}The parts I understood? Didn't matter. Past all the garbage, all it amounted to was goodbye.
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg34 "What did Abraham say to you?" [DIAL:0015EDB6]

text_content: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg33
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg33 "VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg33" [DIAL:0015EDB7]

text_content: {Watched a goodbye message, slightly choked up}That was... that was hard to watch.
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg33 "VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg33" [DIAL:0015EDB7]

text_content: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg32
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg32 "VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg32" [DIAL:0015EDB8]

text_content: {Given a farewell message}All right, I'll watch it.
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg32 "VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg32" [DIAL:0015EDB8]

text_content: You should watch this.
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg31 "You should watch this." [DIAL:0015EDB9]

text_content: {Given a farewell message}All right, I'll listen to it.
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg31 "You should watch this." [DIAL:0015EDB9]

text_content: Here's the accelerator.
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg22 "Here's the accelerator." [DIAL:0015EDBA]

text_content: Where did you get this?
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg22 "Here's the accelerator." [DIAL:0015EDBA]

text_content: {Wary}Guess I was right about the bad news, huh? Same look Elder McNamara always gave me when I was up for promotion.
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg22 "Here's the accelerator." [DIAL:0015EDBA]

text_content: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg21
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg21 "VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg21" [DIAL:0015EDBB]

text_content: Did he say anything when you met him? Anything...{about me, stops herself}anything at all?
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg21 "VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorStg21" [DIAL:0015EDBB]

text_content: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorTrapChokept
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorTrapChokept "VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorTrapChokept" [DIAL:0015EDBC]

text_content: {Trapped only}And I don't like saying this, but the Mojave's safer with him... there.
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorTrapChokept "VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorTrapChokept" [DIAL:0015EDBC]

text_content: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorChokept
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorChokept "VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorChokept" [DIAL:0015EDBD]

text_content: {Default Choke Node}...it doesn't matter. He died when we all retreated to Hidden Valley. I didn't expect to see him again, no one did.
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorChokept "VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorChokept" [DIAL:0015EDBD]

text_content: I trapped Monte in a subway tunnel, that ghoul's not coming back.
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorTrap "I trapped Monte in a subway tunnel, that ghoul's not coming back." [DIAL:0015EDBE]

text_content: Trapped him? Where?
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorTrap "I trapped Monte in a subway tunnel, that ghoul's not coming back." [DIAL:0015EDBE]

text_content: I had to kill Monte for it.
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorKill "I had to kill Monte for it." [DIAL:0015EDBF]

text_content: You killed him? {Beat}But...
name: VDialogueVeronicaAcceleratorKill "I had to kill Monte for it." [DIAL:0015EDBF]

text_content: I found the ghoul with the Accelerator you were looking for.
name: VDialogueVeronicaAccelerator "I found the ghoul with the Accelerator you were looking for." [DIAL:0015EDC0]

text_content: {Surprise, player found someone she thought was dead}You did? Where? Oh my God, I mean... I thought... I don't even know what I thought might have happened to him.
name: VDialogueVeronicaAccelerator "I found the ghoul with the Accelerator you were looking for." [DIAL:0015EDC0]

text_content: {Wary}But... you don't have a "this is good news" expression on your face.
name: VDialogueVeronicaAccelerator "I found the ghoul with the Accelerator you were looking for." [DIAL:0015EDC0]

text_content: VCassLocationStrip
name: VCassLocationStrip "VCassLocationStrip" [DIAL:0015EDEF]

text_content: Chairmen, Omertas... a whole bunch of families rule Vegas, don't step out a line as long as money's to be made.
name: VCassLocationStrip "VCassLocationStrip" [DIAL:0015EDEF]

text_content: Welcome to sin. Watch where you step.
name: VCassLocationStrip "VCassLocationStrip" [DIAL:0015EDEF]

text_content: Watch for NCR vomit.
name: VCassLocationStrip "VCassLocationStrip" [DIAL:0015EDEF]

text_content: Hope you're not here to chase your losses.
name: VCassLocationStrip "VCassLocationStrip" [DIAL:0015EDEF]

text_content: Now to find a bar.
name: VCassLocationStrip "VCassLocationStrip" [DIAL:0015EDEF]

text_content: Don't understand how the missiles could have missed a target like this.
name: VCassLocationStrip "VCassLocationStrip" [DIAL:0015EDEF]

text_content: Beats Freeside.
name: VCassLocationStrip "VCassLocationStrip" [DIAL:0015EDEF]

text_content: Can't believe we got in here.
name: VCassLocationStrip "VCassLocationStrip" [DIAL:0015EDEF]

text_content: Dad used to say this place was what Reno tried to be. {Beat}Fucking Reno.
name: VCassLocationStrip "VCassLocationStrip" [DIAL:0015EDEF]

text_content: Place feels like the Sorcerer of Oz sometimes.
name: VCassLocationStrip "VCassLocationStrip" [DIAL:0015EDEF]

text_content: Heard stories about the Lucky 38, how nobody's ever gone inside - 'cept you, that is.
name: VCassLocationStrip "VCassLocationStrip" [DIAL:0015EDEF]

text_content: VCassLocationFreeside
name: VCassLocationFreeside "VCassLocationFreeside" [DIAL:0015EDF1]

text_content: Hometown of the Van Graffs, don't care for this place too much.
name: VCassLocationFreeside "VCassLocationFreeside" [DIAL:0015EDF1]

text_content: We shouldn't be in here.
name: VCassLocationFreeside "VCassLocationFreeside" [DIAL:0015EDF1]

text_content: Water's scarce, but between things like this and Lake Mead, ain't too bad in the West as in other places.
name: VCassLocationFreeside "VCassLocationFreeside" [DIAL:0015EDF1]

text_content: Watch out for the Kings, they're unpredictable.
name: VCassLocationFreeside "VCassLocationFreeside" [DIAL:0015EDF1]

text_content: {Slight contempt}Kings dress like strutting girls, all fancy like.
name: VCassLocationFreeside "VCassLocationFreeside" [DIAL:0015EDF1]

text_content: Once had a King following me like I was following you - had to chase him off with a shotgun finally.
name: VCassLocationFreeside "VCassLocationFreeside" [DIAL:0015EDF1]

text_content: Kings told me I couldn't deal water here, fuckers. They like having mono. As in monopoly.
name: VCassLocationFreeside "VCassLocationFreeside" [DIAL:0015EDF1]

text_content: Ralph might be able to forge a pass into the Strip for you, you need one.
name: VCassLocationFreeside "VCassLocationFreeside" [DIAL:0015EDF1]

text_content: Looking for weapons, check out Mick and Ralphs... Mick's probably a sight better than Ralph, always trying to talk me out of my pants.
name: VCassLocationFreeside "VCassLocationFreeside" [DIAL:0015EDF1]

text_content: Kings are led by the King. Has some kind of robot dog. Guess it hunts robot rats.
name: VCassLocationFreeside "VCassLocationFreeside" [DIAL:0015EDF1]

text_content: Kings hold control over the water pump 'round here.
name: VCassLocationFreeside "VCassLocationFreeside" [DIAL:0015EDF1]

text_content: VCassLocationCampGolf
name: VCassLocationCampGolf "VCassLocationCampGolf" [DIAL:0015EDF2]

text_content: Not much reason to ship water here, but liquor... hard to meet demand.
name: VCassLocationCampGolf "VCassLocationCampGolf" [DIAL:0015EDF2]

text_content: If NCR didn't grate me so, I'd come here for water resupply.
name: VCassLocationCampGolf "VCassLocationCampGolf" [DIAL:0015EDF2]

text_content: Used to ship a lot of liquor here, soldiers here have too much free time.
name: VCassLocationCampGolf "VCassLocationCampGolf" [DIAL:0015EDF2]

text_content: If there's a reason to attack NCR, Camp Golf's a reason.
name: VCassLocationCampGolf "VCassLocationCampGolf" [DIAL:0015EDF2]

text_content: Watch out for the Misfits here - 9th Platoon, word of their fuck-ups is legendary.
name: VCassLocationCampGolf "VCassLocationCampGolf" [DIAL:0015EDF2]

text_content: Golf was a president, I think. Maybe for NCR.
name: VCassLocationCampGolf "VCassLocationCampGolf" [DIAL:0015EDF2]

text_content: Heard this used to be a mine field from some of the troopers here.
name: VCassLocationCampGolf "VCassLocationCampGolf" [DIAL:0015EDF2]

text_content: Each spot for a land mine is numbered, hear tell.
name: VCassLocationCampGolf "VCassLocationCampGolf" [DIAL:0015EDF2]

text_content: {Under her breath}If you're looking for NCR's spine, ain't going to find it here.
name: VCassLocationCampGolf "VCassLocationCampGolf" [DIAL:0015EDF2]

text_content: Well, Hanlon sure let this place go to shit.
name: VCassLocationCampGolf "VCassLocationCampGolf" [DIAL:0015EDF2]

text_content: Lot of sites to this guy Golf all over the West.
name: VCassLocationCampGolf "VCassLocationCampGolf" [DIAL:0015EDF2]

text_content: VCassLocationBoulderCity
name: VCassLocationBoulderCity "VCassLocationBoulderCity" [DIAL:0015EDF4]

text_content: Should hit the Big Horn saloon here.
name: VCassLocationBoulderCity "VCassLocationBoulderCity" [DIAL:0015EDF4]

text_content: Heard there's still mines in the city - and maybe drunk NCR soldiers spoiling for a fight.
name: VCassLocationBoulderCity "VCassLocationBoulderCity" [DIAL:0015EDF4]

text_content: {To herself}Rubble city, more like it.
name: VCassLocationBoulderCity "VCassLocationBoulderCity" [DIAL:0015EDF4]

text_content: There's a bar in the intact section, careful if you go wandering around the ruined section.
name: VCassLocationBoulderCity "VCassLocationBoulderCity" [DIAL:0015EDF4]

text_content: VCassLocationNellis
name: VCassLocationNellis "VCassLocationNellis" [DIAL:0015EDF7]

text_content: Folks here have access to Lake Mead, fresh drinking water.
name: VCassLocationNellis "VCassLocationNellis" [DIAL:0015EDF7]

text_content: Careful, Boomer territory. They ain't hostile, but they're a bit trigger happy.
name: VCassLocationNellis "VCassLocationNellis" [DIAL:0015EDF7]

text_content: Boomers are a might twitchy.
name: VCassLocationNellis "VCassLocationNellis" [DIAL:0015EDF7]

text_content: Folks here aren't friendly to anyone.
name: VCassLocationNellis "VCassLocationNellis" [DIAL:0015EDF7]

text_content: Don't be shooting wild in here - might set something off.
name: VCassLocationNellis "VCassLocationNellis" [DIAL:0015EDF7]

text_content: First time I seen a fence made out of artillery.
name: VCassLocationNellis "VCassLocationNellis" [DIAL:0015EDF7]

text_content: Some of these weapons look like they came from Hawthorne Army Depot, place has a lot of history.
name: VCassLocationNellis "VCassLocationNellis" [DIAL:0015EDF7]

text_content: Can hear the screaming of rockets and explosions in this place at night.
name: VCassLocationNellis "VCassLocationNellis" [DIAL:0015EDF7]

text_content: Got nests for planes here.
name: VCassLocationNellis "VCassLocationNellis" [DIAL:0015EDF7]

text_content: An assault on this place would be suicide.
name: VCassLocationNellis "VCassLocationNellis" [DIAL:0015EDF7]

text_content: VCassLocationFiends
name: VCassLocationFiends "VCassLocationFiends" [DIAL:0015EDFB]

text_content: Shit. Fiends.
name: VCassLocationFiends "VCassLocationFiends" [DIAL:0015EDFB]

text_content: Smells like Fiends.
name: VCassLocationFiends "VCassLocationFiends" [DIAL:0015EDFB]

text_content: Can smell the chem labs and Jet from here.
name: VCassLocationFiends "VCassLocationFiends" [DIAL:0015EDFB]

text_content: Make sure you have a backup weapon, Fiends don't go down easy.
name: VCassLocationFiends "VCassLocationFiends" [DIAL:0015EDFB]

text_content: Watch for dogs.
name: VCassLocationFiends "VCassLocationFiends" [DIAL:0015EDFB]

text_content: Heard tell there was a Vault somewhere around here.
name: VCassLocationFiends "VCassLocationFiends" [DIAL:0015EDFB]

text_content: VCassLocationNovac
name: VCassLocationNovac "VCassLocationNovac" [DIAL:0015EDFC]

text_content: This place reminds me the Old World had too much time on its hands.
name: VCassLocationNovac "VCassLocationNovac" [DIAL:0015EDFC]

text_content: Named this place after the hotel.
name: VCassLocationNovac "VCassLocationNovac" [DIAL:0015EDFC]

text_content: NoVac's the hotel, not the lizard.
name: VCassLocationNovac "VCassLocationNovac" [DIAL:0015EDFC]

text_content: Smells like junk.
name: VCassLocationNovac "VCassLocationNovac" [DIAL:0015EDFC]

text_content: Can see Dinky for miles, good landmark.
name: VCassLocationNovac "VCassLocationNovac" [DIAL:0015EDFC]

text_content: First saw this place, thought the giant gecko was real.
name: VCassLocationNovac "VCassLocationNovac" [DIAL:0015EDFC]

text_content: Read a book that giant lizards walked the earth like this one - might be a gecko this size.
name: VCassLocationNovac "VCassLocationNovac" [DIAL:0015EDFC]

text_content: VCassLocationPrimm
name: VCassLocationPrimm "VCassLocationPrimm" [DIAL:0015EDFD]

text_content: Said there's a courier office here?
name: VCassLocationPrimm "VCassLocationPrimm" [DIAL:0015EDFD]

text_content: Sign of the buffalo.
name: VCassLocationPrimm "VCassLocationPrimm" [DIAL:0015EDFD]

text_content: Ah, Bison Steve, you old shithole.
name: VCassLocationPrimm "VCassLocationPrimm" [DIAL:0015EDFD]

text_content: Those post office boxes in these old towns still work.
name: VCassLocationPrimm "VCassLocationPrimm" [DIAL:0015EDFD]

text_content: Good contact, Nash, used to be here. Had a son that went West.
name: VCassLocationPrimm "VCassLocationPrimm" [DIAL:0015EDFD]

text_content: Old World had cars that ran on roads like these above the ground, 'cept they didn't go anywhere.
name: VCassLocationPrimm "VCassLocationPrimm" [DIAL:0015EDFD]

text_content: The sheriff here ain't worth a damn.
name: VCassLocationPrimm "VCassLocationPrimm" [DIAL:0015EDFD]

text_content: Crazy ass shit.
name: VCassLocationPrimm "VCassLocationPrimm" [DIAL:0015EDFD]

text_content: VCassLocationNCRCF
name: VCassLocationNCRCF "VCassLocationNCRCF" [DIAL:0015EDFE]

text_content: Looks like prisoners are in charge now.
name: VCassLocationNCRCF "VCassLocationNCRCF" [DIAL:0015EDFE]

text_content: No guards in the towers, not a good sign.
name: VCassLocationNCRCF "VCassLocationNCRCF" [DIAL:0015EDFE]

text_content: Guess NCR fucked this place, too.
name: VCassLocationNCRCF "VCassLocationNCRCF" [DIAL:0015EDFE]

text_content: VCassLocationRangerStation
name: VCassLocationRangerStation "VCassLocationRangerStation" [DIAL:0015EDFF]

text_content: Rest stop.
name: VCassLocationRangerStation "VCassLocationRangerStation" [DIAL:0015EDFF]

text_content: NCR's friendly, might be able to resupply.
name: VCassLocationRangerStation "VCassLocationRangerStation" [DIAL:0015EDFF]

text_content: A little safe ground.
name: VCassLocationRangerStation "VCassLocationRangerStation" [DIAL:0015EDFF]

text_content: NCR flag - not safe, close to it, though.
name: VCassLocationRangerStation "VCassLocationRangerStation" [DIAL:0015EDFF]

text_content: I changed my mind - I'll help you with your mercenary problem.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic018 "I changed my mind - I'll help you with your mercenary problem." [DIAL:0015EECD]

text_content: Thanks.
name: vDialogueJacobstownJacobstownMarcusTopic018 "I changed my mind - I'll help you with your mercenary problem." [DIAL:0015EECD]
speaker: JacobstownMarcus "Marcus" [CREA:0013A7EB]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: VDialogueCliffBriscoeCliffBriscoeTopic002 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0015EF26]

text_content: {Cheery}That's a great idea.
name: VDialogueCliffBriscoeCliffBriscoeTopic002 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0015EF26]
speaker: CliffBriscoe "Cliff Briscoe" [NPC_:0008CD27]

text_content: How did they end up here?
name: VDialogueCliffBriscoeCliffBriscoeTopic001 "How did they end up here?" [DIAL:0015EF27]

text_content: Well, they unloaded what they had left on the Dino Bite as a tax write-off. But that was before my time.|Plenty of demand for them, seeing as they're one-of-a-kind collectors items. But I might still have some in back.
name: VDialogueCliffBriscoeCliffBriscoeTopic001 "How did they end up here?" [DIAL:0015EF27]
speaker: CliffBriscoe "Cliff Briscoe" [NPC_:0008CD27]

text_content: CliffBriscoeBarterFail
name: CliffBriscoeBarterFail "CliffBriscoeBarterFail" [DIAL:0015EF28]

text_content: [FAILED] Are you kidding me? I can't ship these things fast enough. People love them!
name: CliffBriscoeBarterFail "CliffBriscoeBarterFail" [DIAL:0015EF28]

text_content: Tell me about the Rangers.
name: VDialogueNovacRangerAndyTopic002 "Tell me about the Rangers." [DIAL:0015EF29]

text_content: They're the NCR's finest. A one-man platoon, each of 'em.|You got a job where even thinking about it would scare a man senseless, that's when you bring in the Rangers.|And if you see a squad of the veterans - guys who earned their black armor... well... you won't find a more beautiful sight.
name: VDialogueNovacRangerAndyTopic002 "Tell me about the Rangers." [DIAL:0015EF29]

text_content: RangerAndyStationCompletion
name: RangerAndyStationCompletion "RangerAndyStationCompletion" [DIAL:0015EF2A]

text_content: Well, thanks for telling me. I know that knowledge didn't come without risk.|Here. Take this, courtesy of the Ranger veterans fund.
name: RangerAndyStationCompletion "RangerAndyStationCompletion" [DIAL:0015EF2A]
speaker: RangerAndy "Ranger Andy" [NPC_:0008F0BA]

text_content: Tell you what. I'll pay you for what you did, but I'll do you one better, too.|There's a move we have in the Rangers for knocking an opponent off his feet. Saved my butt a bunch of times, maybe it will for you too.|Let me show you how it's done.
name: RangerAndyStationCompletion "RangerAndyStationCompletion" [DIAL:0015EF2A]

text_content: What did you do?
name: VDialogueNovacRangerAndyTopic001 "What did you do?" [DIAL:0015EF2B]

text_content: I go to grab him out of there and I notice he's holding something in his hand. Something metal.|He shuts himself back inside the closet and that's when I see the grenade he's left by my feet.|They do it a lot, the Legion. Using kids. They know we'll hesitate.|Anyway, that was the first time. Second time I fell down those stairs in front of the motel. Just in case I got to thinking I'd put it all behind me.
name: VDialogueNovacRangerAndyTopic001 "What did you do?" [DIAL:0015EF2B]
speaker: RangerAndy "Ranger Andy" [NPC_:0008F0BA]

text_content: Hey, just because you're idle and you'll never walk again... I forgot where I was going with that.
name: VDialogueNovacRangerAndyTopic000 "Hey, just because you're idle and you'll never walk again... I forgot where I was going with that." [DIAL:0015EF2C]

text_content: {Trying to be polite after getting unintentionally offended}I'm sure it was very inspiring.
name: VDialogueNovacRangerAndyTopic000 "Hey, just because you're idle and you'll never walk again... I forgot where I was going with that." [DIAL:0015EF2C]
speaker: RangerAndy "Ranger Andy" [NPC_:0008F0BA]

text_content: <Lie> I think the attackers were dead too... so it's... hard to tell.
name: VFreeformNovacRangerAndyTopic000 "<Lie> I think the attackers were dead too... so it's... hard to tell." [DIAL:0015EF2D]

text_content: In Ranger school, they teach you how to spot a liar. I don't know why you're lying, but have it your way. We'll protect this town or die trying.
name: VFreeformNovacRangerAndyTopic000 "<Lie> I think the attackers were dead too... so it's... hard to tell." [DIAL:0015EF2D]
speaker: RangerAndy "Ranger Andy" [NPC_:0008F0BA]

text_content: Cowboy robot? You mean Primm Slim?
name: PrimmNashDialoguePrimmJohnsonNashTopic016 "Cowboy robot? You mean Primm Slim?" [DIAL:0015EF2E]

text_content: Nope. Different fella. Bigger. Had himself a face on a screen, and he talked more like you or me.
name: PrimmNashDialoguePrimmJohnsonNashTopic016 "Cowboy robot? You mean Primm Slim?" [DIAL:0015EF2E]
quest: PrimmNashDialogue "Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash" [QUST:000A23D8]
speaker: PrimmJohnsonNash "Johnson Nash" [NPC_:000DA729]

text_content: Cowboy robot? You mean the one over there?
name: PrimmNashDialoguePrimmJohnsonNashTopic015 "Cowboy robot? You mean the one over there?" [DIAL:0015EF2F]

text_content: Nope. Different fella. Bigger. Had himself a face on a screen, and he talked more like you or me.
name: PrimmNashDialoguePrimmJohnsonNashTopic015 "Cowboy robot? You mean the one over there?" [DIAL:0015EF2F]
quest: PrimmNashDialogue "Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash" [QUST:000A23D8]
speaker: PrimmJohnsonNash "Johnson Nash" [NPC_:000DA729]

text_content: One of those men shot me. I need to know the best way to get to them.
name: PrimmNashDialoguePrimmJohnsonNashTopic014 "One of those men shot me. I need to know the best way to get to them." [DIAL:0015EF30]

text_content: {edited line}Well for that your best bet is going to be talking to Deputy Beagle.|Since they came to town he was keeping a good bit of notes on them, and he was slinking around Bison Steve when your pretty-boy friend came through.|He may have heard where they were going.
name: PrimmNashDialoguePrimmJohnsonNashTopic014 "One of those men shot me. I need to know the best way to get to them." [DIAL:0015EF30]
quest: PrimmNashDialogue "Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash" [QUST:000A23D8]
speaker: PrimmJohnsonNash "Johnson Nash" [NPC_:000DA729]

text_content: {edited line}Deputy Beagle would have been your best bet, before he met that tragic end.|Since they came to town he was keeping a good bit of notes on them, and he was slinking around Bison Steve when your pretty-boy friend came through.|Maybe you can track down whatever notes he was keeping and find some thing to help you there.
name: PrimmNashDialoguePrimmJohnsonNashTopic014 "One of those men shot me. I need to know the best way to get to them." [DIAL:0015EF30]
quest: PrimmNashDialogue "Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash" [QUST:000A23D8]
speaker: PrimmJohnsonNash "Johnson Nash" [NPC_:000DA729]

text_content: So what's next for you guys?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic025 "So what's next for you guys?" [DIAL:0015EF94]

text_content: I figure we'll hang around Goodsprings for awhile, maybe get some of the other gangs to join up with us.|Won't kill anybody else unless we have to. Just as long as people do what we tell them, they'll be all right.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic025 "So what's next for you guys?" [DIAL:0015EF94]
speaker: GSJoeCobb "Joe Cobb" [NPC_:00104C67]

text_content: It's easy pickings. Why, you got somewhere else to be?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic024 "It's easy pickings. Why, you got somewhere else to be?" [DIAL:0015EF95]

text_content: Yeah, I guess me and the guys could push this place over pretty easily.|First things first, though. You go settle things with Ringo and put a bullet between his eyes while I round up my crew and let them in on the plan.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic024 "It's easy pickings. Why, you got somewhere else to be?" [DIAL:0015EF95]
speaker: GSJoeCobb "Joe Cobb" [NPC_:00104C67]

text_content: Here - the spare medical supplies from Doc Mitchell.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic005 "Here - the spare medical supplies from Doc Mitchell." [DIAL:0015EF96]

text_content: All right! We got all sorts of shit in here. Nice job. Better take some for yourself in case you get hit.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic005 "Here - the spare medical supplies from Doc Mitchell." [DIAL:0015EF96]
speaker: GSJoeCobb "Joe Cobb" [NPC_:00104C67]

text_content: What is this place?
name: vDialogueSLVESDoctorCantonTopic000 "What is this place?" [DIAL:0015F049]

text_content: All right, here's your money.
name: vDialogueSLVESDoctorCantonTopic008 "All right, here's your money." [DIAL:0015F04A]

text_content: Here's your money.
name: vDialogueSLVESDoctorCantonTopic006 "Here's your money." [DIAL:0015F04B]

text_content: On second thought, I'll be fine.
name: vDialogueSLVESDoctorCantonTopic005 "On second thought, I'll be fine." [DIAL:0015F04C]

text_content: All right, fix me.
name: vDialogueSLVESDoctorCantonTopic004 "All right, fix me." [DIAL:0015F04D]

text_content: VDialogueCraigBooneRexCalm
name: VDialogueCraigBooneRexCalm "VDialogueCraigBooneRexCalm" [DIAL:0015F1D5]

text_content: {Drawing out the 'e' a little}Easy, boy.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneRexCalm "VDialogueCraigBooneRexCalm" [DIAL:0015F1D5]

text_content: Shh...
name: VDialogueCraigBooneRexCalm "VDialogueCraigBooneRexCalm" [DIAL:0015F1D5]

text_content: VDialogueCraigBooneNoBeretReact
name: VDialogueCraigBooneNoBeretReact "VDialogueCraigBooneNoBeretReact" [DIAL:0015F1D6]

text_content: I'd really like my beret back, please.
name: VDialogueCraigBooneNoBeretReact "VDialogueCraigBooneNoBeretReact" [DIAL:0015F1D6]

text_content: VDialogueVeronicaARCHIMEDESIITestReact
name: VDialogueVeronicaARCHIMEDESIITestReact "VDialogueVeronicaARCHIMEDESIITestReact" [DIAL:0015F1D7]

text_content: Uh... yeah. I guess it works.
name: VDialogueVeronicaARCHIMEDESIITestReact "VDialogueVeronicaARCHIMEDESIITestReact" [DIAL:0015F1D7]

text_content: VDialogueVeronicaARCHIMEDESIIReact
name: VDialogueVeronicaARCHIMEDESIIReact "VDialogueVeronicaARCHIMEDESIIReact" [DIAL:0015F1D8]

text_content: You think that did it? Maybe we should test the rangefinder outside.
name: VDialogueVeronicaARCHIMEDESIIReact "VDialogueVeronicaARCHIMEDESIIReact" [DIAL:0015F1D8]

text_content: What happened then?
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic025 "What happened then?" [DIAL:0015F239]

text_content: That wicked old Master got what was coming to him, that's what! After his cathedral blew up, I decided it was high time to go home.
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic025 "What happened then?" [DIAL:0015F239]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: Who was the Master?
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic024 "Who was the Master?" [DIAL:0015F23A]

text_content: Oh, he was a nasty man, dearie. You don't want to know about him. He was the one who made that Super mutant army I told you about.
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic024 "Who was the Master?" [DIAL:0015F23A]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: You were a soldier?
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic023 "You were a soldier?" [DIAL:0015F23B]

text_content: {Correction}A spy. Sometimes an assassin. I killed a lot of folks for the Master. {Aside}Yes, Leo, you helped, too.
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic023 "You were a soldier?" [DIAL:0015F23B]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: Where did you come from?
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic020 "Where did you come from?" [DIAL:0015F23E]

text_content: I grew up in Vault 17. I never even saw the sun until I was 75 years old - that was when Super mutants raided the Vault and carried a lot of us off.|{Aside}Yes, Leo, I'm getting to that part! {Back to player}They made me one of them, and they put me to work in an army that was going to conquer California.
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic020 "Where did you come from?" [DIAL:0015F23E]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: Never mind, I had some other questions.
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic018 "Never mind, I had some other questions." [DIAL:0015F240]

text_content: What do you need, sugar?
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic018 "Never mind, I had some other questions." [DIAL:0015F240]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: VCassLocationRedRock

text_content: These boys and girls can really down the bottles.
name: VCassLocationRedRock "VCassLocationRedRock" [DIAL:0015F332]

text_content: Whiskey and liquor don't last long around here, by the sight of it.
name: VCassLocationRedRock "VCassLocationRedRock" [DIAL:0015F332]

text_content: Be *really* careful what you say here.
name: VCassLocationRedRock "VCassLocationRedRock" [DIAL:0015F332]

text_content: Should have heard stories of the Khans years ago - they were one tough bunch, now...

text_content: Khans lost their strength after Bitter Springs, came here to lick their wounds.
name: VCassLocationRedRock "VCassLocationRedRock" [DIAL:0015F332]

text_content: Let's not split up here, all right?
name: VCassLocationRedRock "VCassLocationRedRock" [DIAL:0015F332]

text_content: Don't take any chems here - hell knows what they're laced with.
name: VCassLocationRedRock "VCassLocationRedRock" [DIAL:0015F332]

text_content: Won't trade with Khans - they've poisoned most of the villages west of Vegas with chems.
name: VCassLocationRedRock "VCassLocationRedRock" [DIAL:0015F332]

text_content: Fiends would suffer withdrawal and die without the Khans.
name: VCassLocationRedRock "VCassLocationRedRock" [DIAL:0015F332]

text_content: Place would be beautiful... without the chem addicts and dealers.
name: VCassLocationRedRock "VCassLocationRedRock" [DIAL:0015F332]

text_content: |Annihilation| {To herself}Guess someone had to put them down.

text_content: Really wish we could go to some civilized places.

text_content: Even the flies here are chemed.

text_content: God, you can smell the Brahmin shit from the jet all over this place.
name: VCassLocationRedRock "VCassLocationRedRock" [DIAL:0015F332]

text_content: {Shivers}Place is fucking cold.

name: VCassLocationJacobstown "VCassLocationJacobstown" [DIAL:0015F333]

name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic023 "Now about the man I'm looking for..." [DIAL:0015FB81]
