text_content: VMQ01MannyVargasAnswer
name: MannyVargasMVQ01Answer "VMQ01MannyVargasAnswer" [DIAL:0015FB82]

text_content: The guy you're looking for, Benny, he was traveling with some members from my old gang. They were going to Boulder City.
name: MannyVargasMVQ01Answer "VMQ01MannyVargasAnswer" [DIAL:0015FB82]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: Actually, I already took care of it.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic022 "Actually, I already took care of it." [DIAL:0015FB83]

text_content: The ghouls are no longer at REPCONN.
name: MannyVargasVMQ01TurnIn "The ghouls are no longer at REPCONN." [DIAL:0015FB84]

text_content: Really? Unbelievable, man! I knew that wasn't gonna be easy.|But I had a good feeling about you. You look like you been through a lot.
name: MannyVargasVMQ01TurnIn "The ghouls are no longer at REPCONN." [DIAL:0015FB84]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: Okay, I'll see what can be done about it.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic021 "Okay, I'll see what can be done about it." [DIAL:0015FB85]

text_content: It'd mean a lot to me.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic021 "Okay, I'll see what can be done about it." [DIAL:0015FB85]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: What needs to be done?
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic020 "What needs to be done?" [DIAL:0015FB86]

text_content: Well they gotta go, or this'll be a ghost town before long.|Doesn't matter to me what you do. As long as the ghouls are out of there, that's good enough for me.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic020 "What needs to be done?" [DIAL:0015FB86]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: Why don't you deal with it?
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic019 "Why don't you deal with it?" [DIAL:0015FB87]

text_content: I would. But I've gotta watch the road. Caesar's Legion has been taking territory just east of here. They took Nelson.|If we let our guard down, they might attack. All it takes for the Legion is for them to sense weakness.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic019 "Why don't you deal with it?" [DIAL:0015FB87]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: I can't. I'm in a hurry.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic018 "I can't. I'm in a hurry." [DIAL:0015FB88]

text_content: Say no more. I hope things work out for you.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic018 "I can't. I'm in a hurry." [DIAL:0015FB88]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: Sure. Maybe I can help ease your mind.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic017 "Sure. Maybe I can help ease your mind." [DIAL:0015FB89]

text_content: See? I was right about you.{in a positive way}
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic017 "Sure. Maybe I can help ease your mind." [DIAL:0015FB89]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: That's all I needed to know.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic016 "That's all I needed to know." [DIAL:0015FB8A]

text_content: Glad I could help.|Hey, I know you got no reason to help me now, but you seem really nice. Could I at least tell you about the problem we've got here?
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic016 "That's all I needed to know." [DIAL:0015FB8A]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: Hope that helps. I owed you.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic016 "That's all I needed to know." [DIAL:0015FB8A]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: Where is Boulder City?
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic015 "Where is Boulder City?" [DIAL:0015FB8B]

text_content: It's straight up Route 93 from here. Just keep following the road north.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic015 "Where is Boulder City?" [DIAL:0015FB8B]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: Any idea why they went that way?
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic014 "Any idea why they went that way?" [DIAL:0015FB8C]

text_content: No clue. I know Benny hadn't paid up yet. Maybe that was where they were supposed to get square.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic014 "Any idea why they went that way?" [DIAL:0015FB8C]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: You've had your needs neglected for far too long, haven't you? I can tell.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic013 "You've had your needs neglected for far too long, haven't you? I can tell." [DIAL:0015FB8D]

text_content: Yeah, I... everybody depends on you, you know? But they don't ask you about how you feel. What you worry about.|There's something I like about you. You just seem really understanding. I was gonna ask you for a favor, but I'll just tell you what you wanna know.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic013 "You've had your needs neglected for far too long, haven't you? I can tell." [DIAL:0015FB8D]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: What do you need?
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic012 "What do you need?" [DIAL:0015FB8E]

text_content: {NO-vack}Novac, it's home for me now. I want that to be for good. I like it here, and I've left too many homes behind.|But the only resource we got here is junk. Without that, people wouldn't have anything to trade. They'd all have to leave.|We get most of it up the road from the old rocket test site. But a bunch of ghouls showed up one day and took it over. We can't get in there now.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic012 "What do you need?" [DIAL:0015FB8E]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: Forget it. I'll find him on my own.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic011 "Forget it. I'll find him on my own." [DIAL:0015FB8F]

text_content: {Shrugs}Hey, do what you want. I'm just trying to make it easier on you.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic011 "Forget it. I'll find him on my own." [DIAL:0015FB8F]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: <Lie> He's a good friend of mine. I'm trying to help him out.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic010 "<Lie> He's a good friend of mine. I'm trying to help him out." [DIAL:0015FB90]

text_content: {skeptical but going with it because he doesn't care}Oh yeah? A good friend? If you say so, man.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic010 "<Lie> He's a good friend of mine. I'm trying to help him out." [DIAL:0015FB90]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: Whatever he's doing, I want in on it.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic009 "Whatever he's doing, I want in on it." [DIAL:0015FB91]

text_content: A piece of the action, huh? I don't think he's the sharing type, but okay.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic009 "Whatever he's doing, I want in on it." [DIAL:0015FB91]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: None of your business.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic008 "None of your business." [DIAL:0015FB92]

text_content: Hey, doesn't matter to me. I was just curious.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic008 "None of your business." [DIAL:0015FB92]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: I'm looking for answers.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic007 "I'm looking for answers." [DIAL:0015FB93]

text_content: Must be something pretty important to be chasing a guy like that.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic007 "I'm looking for answers." [DIAL:0015FB93]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: He has something of mine.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic005 "He has something of mine." [DIAL:0015FB94]

text_content: You talking about that chip? Man, I don't think he's giving it up.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic005 "He has something of mine." [DIAL:0015FB94]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: I have a score to settle.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic000 "I have a score to settle." [DIAL:0015FB95]

text_content: Doesn't surprise me. Guy seemed like he'd do whatever it takes to get what he wants. Probably makes a lot of enemies.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic000 "I have a score to settle." [DIAL:0015FB95]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

text_content: Well listen, I can definitely help you find him, but I've got problems of my own.|Maybe we can do a trade. You need my help. There's something I need, too.
name: VDialogueNovacMannyVargasTopic000 "I have a score to settle." [DIAL:0015FB95]
speaker: MannyVargas "Manny Vargas" [NPC_:000941DC]

name: EDERadioConversation "EDERadioConversation" [DIAL:0015FC73]

text_content: Uh... Hello? Hi. Are you there? Oh, right. You can't respond.{Pause} Listen, I'm using your robot as a relay to get this message to you.|I've picked up some unusual chatter regarding your robot. It seems that it has some information that we could use. Oh wait, where are my manners?|This is Lorenzo, a Knight with the Brotherhood of Steel. We'd be very interested in examining your tech.|Whenever you get a chance, can you bring your robot back to Hidden Valley so I can take a look at it?
name: EDERadioConversation "EDERadioConversation" [DIAL:0015FC73]
speaker: HVKnightEDE "Senior Knight Lorenzo" [NPC_:000A41A3]

text_content: Hi, sorry to break in, he sounded truly riveting. I don't want to keep you much longer, but I'd like to make a counter suggestion.|I'm with the Followers of the Apocalypse. We are much more liberal about the sharing of technology than those Brotherhood...{pause} People.|Bring your robot to us, we'll see that whatever information it may have on it is used for the greater good.
name: EDERadioConversation "EDERadioConversation" [DIAL:0015FC73]
speaker: VFSEDEScientist "April Martimer" [NPC_:0015882B]

text_content: What are you talking about?
name: PrimmNashDialoguePrimmJohnsonNashTopic018 "What are you talking about?" [DIAL:0015FC78]

text_content: No idea. Sounds like you two had a history for him to act like that. And turn down the money, too.|Hope he didn't see any trouble in that package of yours. Maybe he thought your name was bad luck. Not for me to say.
name: PrimmNashDialoguePrimmJohnsonNashTopic018 "What are you talking about?" [DIAL:0015FC78]
quest: PrimmNashDialogue "Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash" [QUST:000A23D8]

text_content: How do you know that?
name: PrimmNashDialoguePrimmJohnsonNashTopic017 "How do you know that?" [DIAL:0015FC79]

text_content: {Confused, whole thing was strange, slow}Yeah, got this look when he saw you next down on the Courier list. His expression turned right around, asked me if your name was for real.|{Delivered as "right as rain"}I said, sure as lack of rain, you were still kicking. {Beat, slightly incredulous}Then he turned down the job, just like that. I asked if he was sure, it was good money.|{Slow, foreshadowing}No, let {emph}"Courier Six" carry the package, that's what he said - like the Mojave'd sort you out or something. Then he just up and walked out.
name: PrimmNashDialoguePrimmJohnsonNashTopic017 "How do you know that?" [DIAL:0015FC79]
quest: PrimmNashDialogue "Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash" [QUST:000A23D8]

text_content: I have better things to do.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic018 "I have better things to do." [DIAL:0015FC7D]

text_content: Then that is your choice. If you should change your mind, please return.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic018 "I have better things to do." [DIAL:0015FC7D]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: I'll help you.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic017 "I'll help you." [DIAL:0015FC7E]

text_content: {McNamara linked lines}
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic016 "{McNamara linked lines}" [DIAL:0015FC7F]

text_content: Then allow me to explain our situation. This bunker is currently locked down, allowing no entry or exit, with you being one of the few exceptions.|In exceptional cases, teams are sent out to investigate sites or retrieve materials deemed too important to ignore.|Three such teams have gone missing recently, and the news of their disappearance has not yet been widely spread to avoid undue concern.|In order to maintain the peace, and adhere to the strictures of the lockdown, I need to send someone else to discover what happened to them.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic016 "{McNamara linked lines}" [DIAL:0015FC7F]

text_content: Not all of them.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic013 "Not all of them." [DIAL:0015FC82]

text_content: Keep looking for them. The information they have is vital.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic013 "Not all of them." [DIAL:0015FC82]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: I already found all three patrols. They were all dead.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic012 "I already found all three patrols. They were all dead." [DIAL:0015FC83]

text_content: {Solemn}I suppose I am not surprised. We have few friends in the world above, and many enemies.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic012 "I already found all three patrols. They were all dead." [DIAL:0015FC83]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: I already found a couple of your patrols. The paladins were all dead.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic011 "I already found a couple of your patrols. The paladins were all dead." [DIAL:0015FC84]

text_content: T-That is unfortunate. As long as there is a chance to find the remaining patrol, however, I must still ask you to try.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic011 "I already found a couple of your patrols. The paladins were all dead." [DIAL:0015FC84]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: I think I already found one of your patrols. Both Paladins were dead.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic010 "I think I already found one of your patrols. Both Paladins were dead." [DIAL:0015FC85]

text_content: While that is disheartening news, there remains hope that the other two patrols may still be found alive.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic010 "I think I already found one of your patrols. Both Paladins were dead." [DIAL:0015FC85]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: I want no part of this.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic009 "I want no part of this." [DIAL:0015FC86]

text_content: I half expected you to say that. In which case, I'll continue to pursue the matter on my own.|Should you continue dealing with the Elder and find yourself beginning to see my point of view, I'll be around.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic009 "I want no part of this." [DIAL:0015FC86]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: How do you propose to do that?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic008 "How do you propose to do that?" [DIAL:0015FC87]

text_content: I don't know. I've gone through our records dozens of times looking for a precedent regarding the dismissal of an Elder and come up with nothing.|The people who are most likely to know how it could be done are also some of McNamara's strongest supporters, so they refuse to help me.|Which is why we're having this conversation. An outsider such as yourself would arouse less suspicion asking questions about such matters.|The fact that the Elder has some tasks for you means his faithful won't suspect you, and you have a line open to the man himself.|In short, you're in a perfect position to help me. Will you at least think about it?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic008 "How do you propose to do that?" [DIAL:0015FC87]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: I don't have ti-
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyMelissaWatkinsTopic022 "I don't have ti-" [DIAL:0015FC8A]

text_content: Tell me about the Scribes.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyMelissaWatkinsTopic015 "Tell me about the Scribes." [DIAL:0015FC8F]

text_content: The Scribes are responsible for discovering how all the old tech we recover actually works and sometimes even work on inventing new things.|Without them, the Brotherhood could never fulfill its mission. Or at least, that's what my dad always used to say.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyMelissaWatkinsTopic015 "Tell me about the Scribes." [DIAL:0015FC8F]
speaker: MelissaWatkins "Apprentice Watkins" [NPC_:000E2F82]

text_content: Tell me about the Knights.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyMelissaWatkinsTopic014 "Tell me about the Knights." [DIAL:0015FC90]

text_content: Knights are in charge of all of our equipment. Power armor, gatling lasers, you name it. All of it built and maintained by Knights.|Knights also get to go out on patrols, scouting assignments, and support the Paladins in offensive operations.|Being a Knight would mean getting to see more of the world, fight the Brotherhood's enemies, and possibly someday become a Paladin like my mother.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyMelissaWatkinsTopic014 "Tell me about the Knights." [DIAL:0015FC90]
speaker: MelissaWatkins "Apprentice Watkins" [NPC_:000E2F82]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyMelissaWatkinsTopic013 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0015FC91]

text_content: Okay.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyMelissaWatkinsTopic013 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0015FC91]
speaker: MelissaWatkins "Apprentice Watkins" [NPC_:000E2F82]

text_content: What do you mean decide for yourself?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyMelissaWatkinsTopic012 "What do you mean decide for yourself?" [DIAL:0015FC92]

text_content: I'm currently an Apprentice in the Brotherhood, and recently became eligible for Journeyman status.|But first, I have to decide which Order I want to join - the Knights or the Scribes.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyMelissaWatkinsTopic012 "What do you mean decide for yourself?" [DIAL:0015FC92]
speaker: MelissaWatkins "Apprentice Watkins" [NPC_:000E2F82]

text_content: Initiate Stanton told me about your little adventure the other day.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyMelissaWatkinsTopic006 "Initiate Stanton told me about your little adventure the other day." [DIAL:0015FC94]

text_content: That was so much fun! The wind whipping through our hair, not knowing what was going to jump out at us at any moment.|And when those scorpions came out! It was just like the sims! All I had to do was line then up and squeeze the trigger.|I doubt I'll be able to get Stanton to go with me again, though. I thought he'd enjoy it as much as I did, but he was just scared the whole time.|Don't tell him I told you this, but when those scorpions surrounded us, I'd bet a week's rations he pissed himself!
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyMelissaWatkinsTopic006 "Initiate Stanton told me about your little adventure the other day." [DIAL:0015FC94]
speaker: MelissaWatkins "Apprentice Watkins" [NPC_:000E2F82]

text_content: So who do you take after more? Your mother or your father?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyMelissaWatkinsTopic005 "So who do you take after more? Your mother or your father?" [DIAL:0015FC95]

text_content: I don't know, I'm a little like both of them I guess. If I had to choose, I really don't know which I'd pick.|That's a question I've been asked a lot lately, since it's something I have to decide for myself soon.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyMelissaWatkinsTopic005 "So who do you take after more? Your mother or your father?" [DIAL:0015FC95]
speaker: MelissaWatkins "Apprentice Watkins" [NPC_:000E2F82]

text_content: Are you parents here somewhere?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyMelissaWatkinsTopic004 "Are you parents here somewhere?" [DIAL:0015FC96]

text_content: They both died at HELIOS One. The others were always like a family to me before that, but afterward they became my family in truth.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyMelissaWatkinsTopic004 "Are you parents here somewhere?" [DIAL:0015FC96]
speaker: MelissaWatkins "Apprentice Watkins" [NPC_:000E2F82]

text_content: Tell me about yourself.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyMelissaWatkinsTopic003 "Tell me about yourself." [DIAL:0015FC97]

text_content: Well, like just about everyone else here, I grew up in the Brotherhood. My father was a Scribe and my mother a Paladin.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyMelissaWatkinsTopic003 "Tell me about yourself." [DIAL:0015FC97]
speaker: MelissaWatkins "Apprentice Watkins" [NPC_:000E2F82]

text_content: You said "anymore" before. Did the Brotherhood used to go out more?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyMelissaWatkinsTopic002 "You said ""anymore"" before. Did the Brotherhood used to go out more?" [DIAL:0015FC98]

text_content: Yeah, a lot more. Back when we were at the HELIOS station. Er, crap.|I'm pretty sure I'm not supposed to talk about that, especially with outsiders, so forget you just heard that, okay?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyMelissaWatkinsTopic002 "You said ""anymore"" before. Did the Brotherhood used to go out more?" [DIAL:0015FC98]

text_content: Shouldn't you be in school or something?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyMelissaWatkinsTopic001 "Shouldn't you be in school or something?" [DIAL:0015FC99]

text_content: Head Scribe Taggart quickly realized my extraordinary talent when I took the mandatory VR combat testing.|Soon after that, he requested that I get transferred to VR specialist training, serving as his assistant.|I miss hanging out with the other students all the time, but at least I get to skip all those boring lectures.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyMelissaWatkinsTopic001 "Shouldn't you be in school or something?" [DIAL:0015FC99]

text_content: What's with all the computers?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyMelissaWatkinsTopic000 "What's with all the computers?" [DIAL:0015FC9A]

text_content: It's our virtual reality training hall. We don't really go out all that often anymore, so this is how we stay sharp.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyMelissaWatkinsTopic000 "What's with all the computers?" [DIAL:0015FC9A]

text_content: No, it's nothing.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic024 "No, it's nothing." [DIAL:0015FC9B]

text_content: I do that all the time myself. One moment I'll think I've solved the conundrum, and the next I'm back to square one. Don't let it bother you.|Was there something else you wanted?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic024 "No, it's nothing." [DIAL:0015FC9B]
speaker: HVScribeIbsen "Scribe Ibsen" [NPC_:0010AF1B]

text_content: About the virus...
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic023 "About the virus..." [DIAL:0015FC9C]

text_content: Yes, did you have an idea that might help us?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic023 "About the virus..." [DIAL:0015FC9C]
speaker: HVScribeIbsen "Scribe Ibsen" [NPC_:0010AF1B]

text_content: What kind of information is in the datastore?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic022 "What kind of information is in the datastore?" [DIAL:0015FC9D]

text_content: {Excited, this is his favorite subject}Oh, all kinds of things! There was already information regarding the layout and systems of this bunker, but we've since added our own data as well.|Prior to the lockdown, we had extensively scouted the surrounding area, and compiled dossiers on nearby points of interest.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic022 "What kind of information is in the datastore?" [DIAL:0015FC9D]
speaker: HVScribeIbsen "Scribe Ibsen" [NPC_:0010AF1B]

text_content: Anything I can help you with?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVTorresTopic003 "Anything I can help you with?" [DIAL:0015FC9E]

text_content: If you must know, my inventory check this week shows that our weapon count is one short. Somehow we're missing a laser pistol.|Hardin will have my head if I don't find that weapon soon. I can't delay my report to him any longer.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVTorresTopic003 "Anything I can help you with?" [DIAL:0015FC9E]

text_content: McNamara gave me permission to use the store, so start selling.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVTorresTopic002 "McNamara gave me permission to use the store, so start selling." [DIAL:0015FC9F]

text_content: I could look around for the pistol.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVTorresTopic001 "I could look around for the pistol." [DIAL:0015FCA0]

text_content: If you happen to find it, bring it here right away. I might be able to throw a few supplies your way if you do.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVTorresTopic001 "I could look around for the pistol." [DIAL:0015FCA0]

text_content: Show me what you have for sale.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVTorresTopic000 "Show me what you have for sale." [DIAL:0015FCA1]

text_content: Our patrols are always bringing more stuff in. Take a look.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVTorresTopic000 "Show me what you have for sale." [DIAL:0015FCA1]

text_content: Not right now. I want to ask you a few questions.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic021 "Not right now. I want to ask you a few questions." [DIAL:0015FCA2]

text_content: I suppose I could take a small break, but I can only spare a little time. Ask away.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic021 "Not right now. I want to ask you a few questions." [DIAL:0015FCA2]
speaker: HVScribeIbsen "Scribe Ibsen" [NPC_:0010AF1B]

text_content: So you'd vote against McNamara if Hardin called a tribunal?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenVoteForHardin "So you'd vote against McNamara if Hardin called a tribunal?" [DIAL:0015FCA3]

text_content: {Ask Ibsen about Hardin trying to become Elder}
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic006 "{Ask Ibsen about Hardin trying to become Elder}" [DIAL:0015FCA4]

text_content: {Testy, Frustrated}I don't have time to think about silly things like politics right now. My main concern right now is getting this blasted datastore up and running.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic006 "{Ask Ibsen about Hardin trying to become Elder}" [DIAL:0015FCA4]
speaker: HVScribeIbsen "Scribe Ibsen" [NPC_:0010AF1B]

text_content: I can understand how the man might be frustrated by the current situation. He's a take-charge sort of fellow. Standing around's not his strong suit.|I myself often wish we could end this interminable stasis and begin moving forward again.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic006 "{Ask Ibsen about Hardin trying to become Elder}" [DIAL:0015FCA4]
speaker: HVScribeIbsen "Scribe Ibsen" [NPC_:0010AF1B]

text_content: I changed my mind. I'll keep your little secret.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic010 "I changed my mind. I'll keep your little secret." [DIAL:0015FCA5]

text_content: Vote for Hardin when he calls a tribunal.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic009 "Vote for Hardin when he calls a tribunal." [DIAL:0015FCA6]

text_content: Fine, but you're making a big mistake. Hardin isn't half the leader that McNamara is.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic009 "Vote for Hardin when he calls a tribunal." [DIAL:0015FCA6]
speaker: HVKnightEDE "Senior Knight Lorenzo" [NPC_:000A41A3]

text_content: Don't worry, I'll keep your little secret.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic008 "Don't worry, I'll keep your little secret." [DIAL:0015FCA7]

text_content: {Relieved}Thank you. There's no telling what would happen if everyone were to suddenly find out, but I trust it wouldn't be good.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic008 "Don't worry, I'll keep your little secret." [DIAL:0015FCA7]
speaker: HVKnightEDE "Senior Knight Lorenzo" [NPC_:000A41A3]

text_content: The rest of the chapter should be told!
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic007 "The rest of the chapter should be told!" [DIAL:0015FCA8]

text_content: {Panicked}No! Please don't! Everyone would blame me! Look, I'll do whatever you want, just name it!
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic007 "The rest of the chapter should be told!" [DIAL:0015FCA8]
speaker: HVKnightEDE "Senior Knight Lorenzo" [NPC_:000A41A3]

text_content: So you and the McNamara both know about this?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic006 "So you and the McNamara both know about this?" [DIAL:0015FCA9]

text_content: {Resigned}...Yes. When I first discovered how much the systems had deteriorated, I reported it to the Elder right away.|He told me he'd take action right away, and sent out several patrols to search for parts.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic006 "So you and the McNamara both know about this?" [DIAL:0015FCA9]
speaker: HVKnightEDE "Senior Knight Lorenzo" [NPC_:000A41A3]

text_content: Your terminal had some very interesting things to say about the state of the air filtration system.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic005 "Your terminal had some very interesting things to say about the state of the air filtration system." [DIAL:0015FCAA]

text_content: {Initially outraged}What were you doing looking at my terminal? {Distracted, calmer}No, never mind that. You can't tell anyone about what you found!|There'd be widespread panic. The Elder has the situation under control.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic005 "Your terminal had some very interesting things to say about the state of the air filtration system." [DIAL:0015FCAA]
speaker: HVKnightEDE "Senior Knight Lorenzo" [NPC_:000A41A3]

text_content: So you won't vote for Hardin?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDEWontVoteForHardin "So you won't vote for Hardin?" [DIAL:0015FCAB]

text_content: Who is Elijah?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyRamosWhoIsElijah "Who is Elijah?" [DIAL:0015FCAD]

text_content: Who {emph}was Elijah, more like. He was our Elder before McNamara. Bright guy, but just between you and me he was a little off.|Our mission is to recover and preserve the technology of the past, but Elijah wanted more. He sought ways to improve upon technology, make it better.|When we found HELIOS One, he was like a kid in a candy store. He kept talking about the potential, and a "grand design, never realized."|He even insisted we set up our base there, against the objection of nearly every paladin. What followed is a whole other story.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyRamosWhoIsElijah "Who is Elijah?" [DIAL:0015FCAD]
speaker: Ramos "Paladin Ramos" [NPC_:000E27E4]

text_content: What happened with Elijah?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyRamosElijahStory "What happened with Elijah?" [DIAL:0015FCAE]

text_content: I've discovered proof that the chapter is in danger, and McNamara has covered it up.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyRamosTopic022 "I've discovered proof that the chapter is in danger, and McNamara has covered it up." [DIAL:0015FCB1]

text_content: So you won't support Hardin if he calls a tribunal?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyRamosWontSupportHardin "So you won't support Hardin if he calls a tribunal?" [DIAL:0015FCB2]

text_content: Can you tell me about some of the other people here?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyRamosTopic014 "Can you tell me about some of the other people here?" [DIAL:0015FCB9]

text_content: Tell me about what happened at HELIOS.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyRamosHELIOSStory "Tell me about what happened at HELIOS." [DIAL:0015FCBA]

text_content: I'm sure someone's told you all this before. Several years back, we were running our chapter out the HELIOS One solar power station.|Our Elder at the time, Elijah, had some kind of obsession with the place. Which is the only reason we stayed as long as we did.|That place was hardly defensible, and we knew the NCR was moving in on us, but the Elder refused to budge, insisting that he just needed "more time".|We never found out what he needed the time for. Wave upon wave of NCR troopers hit us from all directions.|We held out for a time, but we were grossly outnumbered, and they had more men than we had ammo. Eventually our positions collapsed.|Elder Elijah was nowhere to be found, so McNamara took charge and led what remained of us on a counter-offensive west.|We lost a lot of men and women, but we broke through and made it here. Make no mistake, McNamara saved this chapter that day.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyRamosHELIOSStory "Tell me about what happened at HELIOS." [DIAL:0015FCBA]
speaker: Ramos "Paladin Ramos" [NPC_:000E27E4]

text_content: What would an Elder have to do to get kicked out?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyRamosTopic012 "What would an Elder have to do to get kicked out?" [DIAL:0015FCBB]

text_content: So you've been talking to Hardin, eh? He's been looking for a way to usurp McNamara ever since the lockdown started.|Don't get me wrong, he's a good man, but Elder McNamara's done all right by us. If it weren't for him, none of us would have survived at HELIOS.|I'll tell you what I told Hardin. There have only been a few cases of Elders being dismissed from their posts in the Brotherhood's history.|And those involved crimes that someone like Elder McNamara is just not capable of. You can look it up for yourself, if you want.|I'll grant you access to that portion of the history section of our datastore. See Senior Scribe Ibsen about accessing it.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyRamosTopic012 "What would an Elder have to do to get kicked out?" [DIAL:0015FCBB]
speaker: Ramos "Paladin Ramos" [NPC_:000E27E4]

text_content: I had other questions.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyRamosTopic011 "I had other questions." [DIAL:0015FCBC]

text_content: Fine by me.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyRamosTopic011 "I had other questions." [DIAL:0015FCBC]
speaker: Ramos "Paladin Ramos" [NPC_:000E27E4]

text_content: What exactly are the rules regarding entering and leaving?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyRamosTopic010 "What exactly are the rules regarding entering and leaving?" [DIAL:0015FCBD]

text_content: Under the lockdown, only essential personnel are permitted to enter or leave. That includes supply runners and high security patrols.|All other personnel are forbidden to leave, and any personnel that were out there when the lockdown was enacted are forbidden from returning.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyRamosTopic010 "What exactly are the rules regarding entering and leaving?" [DIAL:0015FCBD]
speaker: Ramos "Paladin Ramos" [NPC_:000E27E4]

text_content: Did you know Watkins and Stanton snuck out of here a few weeks ago?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyRamosTopic009 "Did you know Watkins and Stanton snuck out of here a few weeks ago?" [DIAL:0015FCBE]

text_content: {Laughs}Yeah, I knew about it. They're still young, and they weren't going to go very far.|I had them on my monitors the whole time. I almost headed out there when they got surrounded by those scorpions, but Watkins is a hell of a shot.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyRamosTopic009 "Did you know Watkins and Stanton snuck out of here a few weeks ago?" [DIAL:0015FCBE]
speaker: Ramos "Paladin Ramos" [NPC_:000E27E4]

text_content: So why did I have to deal with that Ranger topside?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyRamosTopic008 "So why did I have to deal with that Ranger topside?" [DIAL:0015FCBF]

text_content: Normally, that would have fallen under my jurisdiction, but the Elder thought it'd provide a good test for you, so I backed off.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyRamosTopic008 "So why did I have to deal with that Ranger topside?" [DIAL:0015FCBF]
speaker: Ramos "Paladin Ramos" [NPC_:000E27E4]

text_content: So you're head of security?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyRamosTopic007 "So you're head of security?" [DIAL:0015FCC0]

text_content: That's right. Nothing gets in or out of here without me knowing it.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyRamosTopic007 "So you're head of security?" [DIAL:0015FCC0]
speaker: Ramos "Paladin Ramos" [NPC_:000E27E4]

text_content: You really don't like Taggart, do you?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyLindaSchulerTopic013 "You really don't like Taggart, do you?" [DIAL:0015FCC1]

text_content: I don't appreciate how much harder I have to work to cover for his tendency to focus on his personal projects.|I try not to think too much about his personal proclivities.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyLindaSchulerTopic013 "You really don't like Taggart, do you?" [DIAL:0015FCC1]

text_content: Was Initiate Watkins the "pet" you were referring to earlier?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyLindaSchulerTopic012 "Was Initiate Watkins the ""pet"" you were referring to earlier?" [DIAL:0015FCC2]

text_content: She's cute, isn't she? Like a puppy, almost. Unfortunately, our Head Scribe's intentions toward her aren't quite so innocent.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyLindaSchulerTopic012 "Was Initiate Watkins the ""pet"" you were referring to earlier?" [DIAL:0015FCC2]

text_content: Why not tell on him?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyLindaSchulerTopic011 "Why not tell on him?" [DIAL:0015FCC3]

text_content: Oh, I tried. The elder listened patiently to my carefully constructed argument regarding why that buffoon should lose his position.|Then he just as patiently explained to me that Taggart's work was vital to our cause, and that he wasn't to be trifled with "lesser matters."|But vital to our cause? Hardly.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyLindaSchulerTopic011 "Why not tell on him?" [DIAL:0015FCC3]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyLindaSchulerTopic010 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0015FCC4]

text_content: If you wish.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyLindaSchulerTopic010 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0015FCC4]
speaker: LindaSchuler "Senior Scribe Schuler" [NPC_:000E27E6]

text_content: You mentioned other duties you had?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyLindaSchulerTopic009 "You mentioned other duties you had?" [DIAL:0015FCC5]

text_content: I'm this bunker's Head Scribe in everything but name. I supervise the research teams. I collate the reports. I attend the meetings.|But for reasons beyond me, that buffoon Taggart still gets the title. And don't get me started on that little pet of his.|Everyone around here knows what's going on there but her.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyLindaSchulerTopic009 "You mentioned other duties you had?" [DIAL:0015FCC5]

text_content: What services can you perform?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyLindaSchulerTopic008 "What services can you perform?" [DIAL:0015FCC6]

text_content: We have equipment here to treat most physical injuries - lacerations, broken bones, that sort of thing. We also carry a full supply of antitoxins.|You may have noticed the Bark Scorpions up above. Though tiny, their venom packs quite a punch. Treating scorpion stings is my most common procedure.|I can also treat any form of radiation sickness you pick up out in the waste, no matter what stage, save the last.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyLindaSchulerTopic008 "What services can you perform?" [DIAL:0015FCC6]
speaker: LindaSchuler "Senior Scribe Schuler" [NPC_:000E27E6]

text_content: So you're a doctor?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyLindaSchulerTopic000 "So you're a doctor?" [DIAL:0015FCC8]

text_content: Yes, I handle all medical needs in the bunker. If you're ever wounded, I can treat you, for a fee.|Normally I'd just be the base's medical officer, but my other duties say otherwise.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyLindaSchulerTopic000 "So you're a doctor?" [DIAL:0015FCC8]

text_content: Explain to me again what you're trying to do.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic017 "Explain to me again what you're trying to do." [DIAL:0015FCC9]

text_content: HVHardinInitialLine
name: HVHardinInitialLine "HVHardinInitialLine" [DIAL:0015FCCA]

text_content: Nolan, we'll resume this discussion later. I can see you have company.
name: HVHardinInitialLine "HVHardinInitialLine" [DIAL:0015FCCA]

text_content: What can you tell me about the other members of the Brotherhood here?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic011 "What can you tell me about the other members of the Brotherhood here?" [DIAL:0015FCD0]

text_content: I refuse.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic007 "I refuse." [DIAL:0015FCD1]

text_content: I'll see what I can do.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic006 "I'll see what I can do." [DIAL:0015FCD2]

text_content: Have you tried bringing this up with the Elder yourself?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic005 "Have you tried bringing this up with the Elder yourself?" [DIAL:0015FCD3]

text_content: Of course I have. Many times, in fact. The Elder has an open door policy, and will listen to advice on any subject, save this one.|He refuses to see that our isolation is slowly weakening us. Aside from being our duty, going out on missions is what kept us strong.|And because he fails to see that, he must be replaced.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic005 "Have you tried bringing this up with the Elder yourself?" [DIAL:0015FCD3]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: What about Veronica? She seems to come and go as she pleases.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic004 "What about Veronica? She seems to come and go as she pleases." [DIAL:0015FCD4]

text_content: Veronica's a special case. She handles the procurement of supplies. If we didn't let her and those like her back in, we'd all starve.|If the Elder could manage it, he'd shut them out as well, and all in the name of security. Which is why we need to replace him.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic004 "What about Veronica? She seems to come and go as she pleases." [DIAL:0015FCD4]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: Why should I trust you?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic002 "Why should I trust you?" [DIAL:0015FCD5]

text_content: Why should you trust the Elder? I'd recommend listening to both of us, and choosing whom to trust for yourself.|So are you willing to listen?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic002 "Why should I trust you?" [DIAL:0015FCD5]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: No, I won't listen to you.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic001 "No, I won't listen to you." [DIAL:0015FCD6]

text_content: If you change your mind, though, come find me, and we'll talk more.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic001 "No, I won't listen to you." [DIAL:0015FCD6]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: Sure, go ahead.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic000 "Sure, go ahead." [DIAL:0015FCD7]

text_content: As you may have already heard, this entire base is under a state of lockdown. No one goes out except small patrols at night.|Most of the chapter has been sealed in here for years, and those few who were outside when the lockdown was initiated are forbidden from returning.|Morale has plummeted as time has gone by, and many of our current paladins haven't even seen combat outside of training simulations.|And all because of the Elder's explicit order that no one be allowed in or out. The only way things will change is if a new Elder is installed.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic000 "Sure, go ahead." [DIAL:0015FCD7]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: You've got trouble. The NCR are planning a raid on this place soon.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic003 "You've got trouble. The NCR are planning a raid on this place soon." [DIAL:0015FE1A]

text_content: {explosion heard}Sounds like they're already here. There's no way I'm letting them take me alive.|There's no reason for you to stick around and help us, but feel free to kill a few of the bastards on your way out.
name: VFreeformNCRCFNCRCFEddieTopic003 "You've got trouble. The NCR are planning a raid on this place soon." [DIAL:0015FE1A]
speaker: NCRCFEddie "Eddie" [NPC_:0008D0E9]

text_content: Why do you think the NCR and the Legion both want the Dam?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSTrudyTopic007 "Why do you think the NCR and the Legion both want the Dam?" [DIAL:0015FE88]

text_content: I'm pretty sure the NCR wants to hold onto the Dam because it's one of the few places around that can make electricity.|The Legion are a bunch of savages, though. No idea why they'd want the Dam. Probably plan on destroying it or something.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSTrudyTopic007 "Why do you think the NCR and the Legion both want the Dam?" [DIAL:0015FE88]
speaker: GSTrudy "Trudy" [NPC_:00104C6C]

text_content: What can you tell me about the Legion?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSTrudyTopic006 "What can you tell me about the Legion?" [DIAL:0015FE89]

text_content: {disgust mixed with fear}Slavers, killers, and all other kinds of trouble. They dress up like Roman soldiers, so there's no mistaking it when you see them.|The rumor is that the Legion is far larger than the NCR lets on, and that it's been due to luck that the Legion hasn't overrun the territory.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSTrudyTopic006 "What can you tell me about the Legion?" [DIAL:0015FE89]
speaker: GSTrudy "Trudy" [NPC_:00104C6C]

text_content: Tell me about the NCR.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSTrudyTopic005 "Tell me about the NCR." [DIAL:0015FE8A]

text_content: The New California Republic's got the most power in Nevada. Money, troops, you name it.|They do what they can to keep things safe in the region, but if you ask me, they're trying to do too much. They're spread too thin.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSTrudyTopic005 "Tell me about the NCR." [DIAL:0015FE8A]
speaker: GSTrudy "Trudy" [NPC_:00104C6C]

text_content: Anything interesting going on in the rest of the wasteland?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSTrudyTopic003 "Anything interesting going on in the rest of the wasteland?" [DIAL:0015FE8B]

text_content: There's always something interesting going on, but the biggest news has to be the coming dustup between the NCR and the Legion over the Dam.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSTrudyTopic003 "Anything interesting going on in the rest of the wasteland?" [DIAL:0015FE8B]
speaker: GSTrudy "Trudy" [NPC_:00104C6C]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VEFR02NCRBad2MostWantedVEFR02NCRThugLeaderCFTopic006 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0015FE91]

text_content: Three days.
name: VEFR02NCRBad2MostWantedVEFR02NCRThugLeaderCFTopic006 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0015FE91]
speaker: VEFR02NCRThugLeaderCF "NCR Ranger" [NPC_:0015F42D]

text_content: No, we finish this now.
name: VEFR02NCRBad2MostWantedVEFR02NCRThugLeaderCFTopic005 "No, we finish this now." [DIAL:0015FE92]

text_content: {Dumbfounded}Crap, you don't even want to live a few more days? Go. Get laid one more time or something - we're walking away. Three days.
name: VEFR02NCRBad2MostWantedVEFR02NCRThugLeaderCFTopic005 "No, we finish this now." [DIAL:0015FE92]
speaker: VEFR02NCRThugLeaderCF "NCR Ranger" [NPC_:0015F42D]

text_content: Please, just leave me alone
name: VEFR02NCRBad2MostWantedVEFR02NCRThugLeaderCFTopic004 "Please, just leave me alone" [DIAL:0015FE93]

text_content: Just leave me alone.
name: VEFR02NCRBad2MostWantedVEFR02NCRThugLeaderCFTopic003 "Just leave me alone." [DIAL:0015FE94]

text_content: You're asking for leniency from us? Are you crazy?! We show up when the talking's over, get it?
name: VEFR02NCRBad2MostWantedVEFR02NCRThugLeaderCFTopic003 "Just leave me alone." [DIAL:0015FE94]
speaker: VEFR02NCRThugLeaderCF "NCR Ranger" [NPC_:0015F42D]

text_content: What can I do about that?
name: VEFR02NCRBad2MostWantedVEFR02NCRThugLeaderCFTopic002 "What can I do about that?" [DIAL:0015FE95]

text_content: You've got three days to improve your reputation with the NCR or we come for you... without all of this pleasant conversation.|Have a nice day now, you hear?
name: VEFR02NCRBad2MostWantedVEFR02NCRThugLeaderCFTopic002 "What can I do about that?" [DIAL:0015FE95]
speaker: VEFR02NCRThugLeaderCF "NCR Ranger" [NPC_:0015F42D]

text_content: So what?! Screw you and screw the NCR!
name: VEFR02NCRBad2MostWantedVEFR02NCRThugLeaderCFTopic001 "So what?! Screw you and screw the NCR!" [DIAL:0015FE96]

text_content: What did I do to the NCR?
name: VEFR02NCRBad2MostWantedVEFR02NCRThugLeaderCFTopic000 "What did I do to the NCR?" [DIAL:0015FE97]

text_content: You got yourself a bad reputation with us - that's what.
name: VEFR02NCRBad2MostWantedVEFR02NCRThugLeaderCFTopic000 "What did I do to the NCR?" [DIAL:0015FE97]
speaker: VEFR02NCRThugLeaderCF "NCR Ranger" [NPC_:0015F42D]

text_content: Can you make me some of your Moonshine?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic229 "Can you make me some of your Moonshine?" [DIAL:0015FEE4]

text_content: Don't have all the ingredients you need - come back when you have 'em, and I'd be happy to get something cooking.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic229 "Can you make me some of your Moonshine?" [DIAL:0015FEE4]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Here's the items for making some Moonshine.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic228 "Here's the items for making some Moonshine." [DIAL:0015FEE5]

text_content: {Warning}Look, no guarantee on the quality, only the results. And don't drink too much of this stuff or you might go blind.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic228 "Here's the items for making some Moonshine." [DIAL:0015FEE5]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: All right, I'll start brewing.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic228 "Here's the items for making some Moonshine." [DIAL:0015FEE5]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Here you go. Go easy on it until you train yourself to choke back the urge to gag. After a few bottles and the vomiting, it ain't so bad.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic228 "Here's the items for making some Moonshine." [DIAL:0015FEE5]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Wait, you can make Moonshine?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic227 "Wait, you can make Moonshine?" [DIAL:0015FEE6]

text_content: Yeah, what else you going to do with an empty bottle? Wait for it to refill itself?|Get me some ingredients out of the Mojave, an empty bottle, a little time, and I'll keep us stocked.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic227 "Wait, you can make Moonshine?" [DIAL:0015FEE6]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Where do you usually go to drink?
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic226 "Where do you usually go to drink?" [DIAL:0015FEE7]

text_content: There's usually a bar in every stop along the road. Helps me sleep. Well, not really, but I tell myself that.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic226 "Where do you usually go to drink?" [DIAL:0015FEE7]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: Sometimes I have to brew it myself if I'm too far from a bar. Not quality, but I'm for anything that takes the edge off the day.
name: VDialogueCassRoseofSharonCassidyTopic226 "Where do you usually go to drink?" [DIAL:0015FEE7]
speaker: RoseofSharonCassidy "Cass" [NPC_:00133FDD]

text_content: VMQTopsYesManElDorado
name: VMQTopsYesManElDorado "VMQTopsYesManElDorado" [DIAL:0015FF04]

text_content: Hi there! Come with me!
name: VMQTopsYesManElDorado "VMQTopsYesManElDorado" [DIAL:0015FF04]

text_content: Just to the top of the ridge up here...
name: VMQTopsYesManElDorado "VMQTopsYesManElDorado" [DIAL:0015FF04]

text_content: See that? Vegas, right? Same as always - but not tonight!
name: VMQTopsYesManElDorado "VMQTopsYesManElDorado" [DIAL:0015FF04]

text_content: Pretty nice, huh? But that's not all!
name: VMQTopsYesManElDorado "VMQTopsYesManElDorado" [DIAL:0015FF04]

text_content: Now that the Lucky 38's reactor is fired up, Vegas doesn't need the dam to have power! Vegas is energy-independent! Whoo-hoo!
name: VMQTopsYesManElDorado "VMQTopsYesManElDorado" [DIAL:0015FF04]

text_content: If we keep the dam running, we can sell {emph}all its electricity to the NCR for a nice profit. Vegas doesn't need it!
name: VMQTopsYesManElDorado "VMQTopsYesManElDorado" [DIAL:0015FF04]

text_content: Hope to see you soon!
name: VMQTopsYesManElDorado "VMQTopsYesManElDorado" [DIAL:0015FF04]

text_content: So I get to kill you over and over again. <Attack Yes Man.>
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic061 "So I get to kill you over and over again. <Attack Yes Man.>" [DIAL:0015FF05]

text_content: Hahaha! I knew there was a positive in it somewhere!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic061 "So I get to kill you over and over again. <Attack Yes Man.>" [DIAL:0015FF05]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: You set me up. Now you die.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic060 "You set me up. Now you die." [DIAL:0015FF06]

text_content: I feel really bad telling you this, but I kind of... can't die. I mean, {brightening}go ahead and destroy this Securitron, get it out of your system!|The problem is that a distributed image of my neuro-computational matrix is backed-up to the network several times a day, or when I'm {pause, upbeat}threatened!|I can't help it! There's a little bit of me in every Securitron out on the Strip, so if this instance gets destroyed, I just download to a new one.|If I could stop it from happening, I would! I mean, {sympathy}your vengeance is going to feel so incomplete!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic060 "You set me up. Now you die." [DIAL:0015FF06]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: I'm serious.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic059 "I'm serious." [DIAL:0015FF07]

text_content: {brittler laugh this time}Hahaha! That's not funny, you getting shot in the head.|I really shouldn't have taken so much pride in how I set that up, huh? I feel really bad right now.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic059 "I'm serious." [DIAL:0015FF07]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: I'm the courier Benny shot.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic058 "I'm the courier Benny shot." [DIAL:0015FF08]

text_content: Hahaha! {joking along with the player}I know that's not true, because you still have a head!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic058 "I'm the courier Benny shot." [DIAL:0015FF08]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: What do you know about the courier Benny shot?
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic057 "What do you know about the courier Benny shot?" [DIAL:0015FF09]

text_content: {sunny}I knew he was carrying the Platinum Chip! And I knew right where Benny should wait for him!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic057 "What do you know about the courier Benny shot?" [DIAL:0015FF09]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: {sunny}I knew she was carrying the Platinum Chip! And I knew right where Benny should wait for her!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic057 "What do you know about the courier Benny shot?" [DIAL:0015FF09]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: {sunny}That's why Benny put me here! To monitor Mr. House's data transmissions. They're all encrypted, of course - {swelling with pride}but I'm quite a decrypter!|Did you know that Mr. House spent 812,545 caps hiring salvage teams to find the Platinum Chip- just in the last year alone? {delighted}Of course you didn't!|Or that there were seven couriers, but six of them were carrying junk? How about their exact routes, and the mercenary teams that screened them?|I knew all that. Pretty smart, huh?
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic057 "What do you know about the courier Benny shot?" [DIAL:0015FF09]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: I'm ready. You'd better be, too.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSSunnySmilesTopic017 "I'm ready. You'd better be, too." [DIAL:0015FF49]

text_content: < Science 25 >
name: VFreeformGoodspringsVictorTopic007 "< Science 25 >" [DIAL:0015FF4A]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] All right, but put everything back the way you found it!
name: VFreeformGoodspringsVictorTopic007 "< Science 25 >" [DIAL:0015FF4A]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: [FAILED] No offense, pardner, but I'd rather not have you rooting around in there. It's technical-like.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsVictorTopic007 "< Science 25 >" [DIAL:0015FF4A]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: EDERadioConversation4
name: EDERadioConversation4 "EDERadioConversation4" [DIAL:0015FF62]

text_content: Hi there, my name is April Martimer. I've heard through various channels that you have some... curious robot with you.|I'm with the Followers of the Apocalypse, we'd love to have the opportunity to examine the technology on that machine.|We'll make sure whatever information we find is used for the greater good - and who knows, I may be able to give it some kind of upgrade for you.
name: EDERadioConversation4 "EDERadioConversation4" [DIAL:0015FF62]
speaker: VFSEDEScientist "April Martimer" [NPC_:0015882B]

text_content: EDERadioConversation3
name: EDERadioConversation3 "EDERadioConversation3" [DIAL:0015FF63]

text_content: Hi there, my name is April Martimer. I monitored a communication earlier between you and someone with the Brotherhood of Steel.|I'm with the Followers of the Apocalypse. We are much more liberal about the sharing of technology than those Brotherhood...{pause} People.|Bring your robot to us, we'll see that whatever information it may have on it is used for the greater good.
name: EDERadioConversation3 "EDERadioConversation3" [DIAL:0015FF63]
speaker: VFSEDEScientist "April Martimer" [NPC_:0015882B]

text_content: EDERadioConversation
name: EDERadioConversation2 "EDERadioConversation" [DIAL:0015FF64]

text_content: Uh... Hello? Hi. Are you there? Oh, right. You can't respond.{Pause} Listen, I'm using your robot as a relay to get this message to you.|I've picked up some unusual chatter regarding your robot. It seems that it has some information that we could use. Oh wait, where are my manners?|This is Lorenzo, a Knight with the Brotherhood of Steel. We'd be very interested in examining your tech.|Could you bring your robot to one of our patrols so they can examine it? I'll have the robot mark the location on your map.
name: EDERadioConversation2 "EDERadioConversation" [DIAL:0015FF64]
speaker: HVKnightEDE "Senior Knight Lorenzo" [NPC_:000A41A3]

text_content: Do you know anything about Hoover Dam?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic018 "Do you know anything about Hoover Dam?" [DIAL:0015FFBF]

text_content: Never been there since the NCR's got troops all over it. Must be pretty important.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsGSJoeCobbTopic018 "Do you know anything about Hoover Dam?" [DIAL:0015FFBF]
speaker: GSJoeCobb "Joe Cobb" [NPC_:00104C67]

text_content: I could use another gun at my side.
name: VES01aVictorIsInNovacVictorTopic009 "I could use another gun at my side." [DIAL:0015FFCB]

text_content: That's a mighty fine offer, but I'm gonna need to conserve my strength if I�m to make it all the way to New Vegas.|I'm sure you'll do just fine without old Vic slowing you down.
name: VES01aVictorIsInNovacVictorTopic009 "I could use another gun at my side." [DIAL:0015FFCB]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: I could use a bed and some supplies
name: VES01aVictorIsInNovacVictorTopic008 "I could use a bed and some supplies" [DIAL:0015FFCC]

text_content: Well, this ain't New Vegas, but I reckon you can find what you need here. Try the office out front.
name: VES01aVictorIsInNovacVictorTopic008 "I could use a bed and some supplies" [DIAL:0015FFCC]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: This is too big to be a coincidence, robot - what's your angle?
name: VES01aVictorIsInNovacVictorTopic007 "This is too big to be a coincidence, robot - what's your angle?" [DIAL:0015FFCD]

text_content: Now don't go getting paranoid, pardner - that bullet to your brain-pan probably just bucked your Brahmin a little. We're all friends here.
name: VES01aVictorIsInNovacVictorTopic007 "This is too big to be a coincidence, robot - what's your angle?" [DIAL:0015FFCD]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: Quite a coincidence us meeting like this.
name: VES01aVictorIsInNovacVictorTopic006 "Quite a coincidence us meeting like this." [DIAL:0015FFCE]

text_content: Seeing how this is the only road around, I'd be a sight more surprised if we didn't run into each other from time to time.
name: VES01aVictorIsInNovacVictorTopic006 "Quite a coincidence us meeting like this." [DIAL:0015FFCE]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: So what's the story with this place?
name: VES01aVictorIsInNovacVictorTopic005 "So what's the story with this place?" [DIAL:0015FFCF]

text_content: Novac? Nice enough place I suppose... but between you and me - when I rolled into town my skin started to itch. Watch yourself.
name: VES01aVictorIsInNovacVictorTopic005 "So what's the story with this place?" [DIAL:0015FFCF]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: Goodbye
name: VES01aVictorIsInNovacVictorTopic004 "Goodbye" [DIAL:0015FFD0]

text_content: Be seeing you.
name: VES01aVictorIsInNovacVictorTopic004 "Goodbye" [DIAL:0015FFD0]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: Just stay out of my way, robot.
name: VES01aVictorIsInNovacVictorTopic003 "Just stay out of my way, robot." [DIAL:0015FFD1]

text_content: I'll let that slide seeing how you gotta mind full of vengeance for that no-good polecat and all.
name: VES01aVictorIsInNovacVictorTopic003 "Just stay out of my way, robot." [DIAL:0015FFD1]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: You said the men that jumped me were heading this way, right?
name: VES01aVictorIsInNovacVictorTopic002 "You said the men that jumped me were heading this way, right?" [DIAL:0015FFD2]

text_content: No, don't believe I did, but you might ask around - the Novac folk usually see anyone traveling this way.
name: VES01aVictorIsInNovacVictorTopic002 "You said the men that jumped me were heading this way, right?" [DIAL:0015FFD2]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: It's nice to see a friendly face out here.
name: VES01aVictorIsInNovacVictorTopic001 "It's nice to see a friendly face out here." [DIAL:0015FFD3]

text_content: Likewise, friend - likewise. Is there anything old Vic can do you for?
name: VES01aVictorIsInNovacVictorTopic001 "It's nice to see a friendly face out here." [DIAL:0015FFD3]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: What are you doing in Novac?
name: VES01aVictorIsInNovacVictorTopic000 "What are you doing in Novac?" [DIAL:0015FFD4]

text_content: Don't rightly know - I just got the notion to make my way to New Vegas. Reckon I'll find out when I get there.
name: VES01aVictorIsInNovacVictorTopic000 "What are you doing in Novac?" [DIAL:0015FFD4]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: VDiaTheStripSS4MPBFuckThis
name: VDiaTheStripSS4MPBFuckThis "VDiaTheStripSS4MPBFuckThis" [DIAL:0015FFF5]

text_content: {Disoriented, pal just left him to scrub alone}Hey... Hey! Where the hell are you going?{Small pause, looks at pal leave}Well, fuck you, then!
name: VDiaTheStripSS4MPBFuckThis "VDiaTheStripSS4MPBFuckThis" [DIAL:0015FFF5]

text_content: VDiaTheStripSS4MPAFuckThis
name: VDiaTheStripSS4MPAFuckThis "VDiaTheStripSS4MPAFuckThis" [DIAL:0015FFF6]

text_content: {Snaps back at his pal}You know what? It's all yours, then. Fuck this shit! I'm done.
name: VDiaTheStripSS4MPAFuckThis "VDiaTheStripSS4MPAFuckThis" [DIAL:0015FFF6]

text_content: VDiaTheStripSS4MPBCurse02
name: VDiaTheStripSS4MPBCurse02 "VDiaTheStripSS4MPBCurse02" [DIAL:0015FFF7]

text_content: {Resigned, and bothered with his pal's complaints}Hey, talk to Pappas if you've got complaints. I'm just want to be done with this shit.
name: VDiaTheStripSS4MPBCurse02 "VDiaTheStripSS4MPBCurse02" [DIAL:0015FFF7]

text_content: VDiaTheStripSS4MPBCurse01
name: VDiaTheStripSS4MPBCurse01 "VDiaTheStripSS4MPBCurse01" [DIAL:0015FFF8]

text_content: {Resigned, and bothered with his pal's complaints}Shut up, and get to it. You rather be elsewhere? I can arrange a trip to the sewers - you'll love the smell.
name: VDiaTheStripSS4MPBCurse01 "VDiaTheStripSS4MPBCurse01" [DIAL:0015FFF8]

text_content: VDiaTheStripSS4MPACurse02
name: VDiaTheStripSS4MPACurse02 "VDiaTheStripSS4MPACurse02" [DIAL:0015FFF9]

text_content: {Upset, staring at a grafitti painted wall}I can deal with them dancing in the fountain, I can deal with them running a Brahmin down The Strip.|Hell, I can even deal with the puke in the latrines. But I can't stand the smell of turpentine, fuck that!
name: VDiaTheStripSS4MPACurse02 "VDiaTheStripSS4MPACurse02" [DIAL:0015FFF9]

text_content: VDiaTheStripSS4MPACurse01
name: VDiaTheStripSS4MPACurse01 "VDiaTheStripSS4MPACurse01" [DIAL:0015FFFA]

text_content: {Upset, staring at a graffiti painted wall}This shit is not going to come off, I'm telling you.
name: VDiaTheStripSS4MPACurse01 "VDiaTheStripSS4MPACurse01" [DIAL:0015FFFA]

name: vDialogueTheStripVStreetNCRTrooperMPHarassTopic007 "[Attack] You just crossed the line." [DIAL:0015FFFB]

name: vDialogueTheStripVStreetNCRTrooperMPHarassTopic006 "[Attack] You just crossed the line." [DIAL:0015FFFC]

text_content: Fine, take 400.
name: vDialogueTheStripVStreetNCRTrooperMPHarassTopic005 "Fine, take 400." [DIAL:0015FFFD]

name: vDialogueTheStripVStreetNCRTrooperMPHarassTopic005 "Fine, take 400." [DIAL:0015FFFD]
speaker: VStreetNCRTrooperMPHarass "NCR Trooper MP" [NPC_:00160045]

text_content: [Attack] I'll give you something nice to talk about.
name: vDialogueTheStripVStreetNCRTrooperMPHarassTopic004 "[Attack] I'll give you something nice to talk about." [DIAL:0015FFFE]

text_content: Take 200 caps, and leave me be.
name: vDialogueTheStripVStreetNCRTrooperMPHarassTopic003 "Take 200 caps, and leave me be." [DIAL:0015FFFF]

text_content: [Attack] You've just screwed up, big time.
name: vDialogueTheStripVStreetNCRTrooperMPHarassTopic002 "[Attack] You've just screwed up, big time." [DIAL:00160000]

text_content: Think you can get away with this? Guys, time to rough this one up!

speaker: VStreetNCRTrooperMPHarass "NCR Trooper MP" [NPC_:00160045]

text_content: Take 200 caps, and leave me be.
name: vDialogueTheStripVStreetNCRTrooperMPHarassTopic001 "Take 200 caps, and leave me be." [DIAL:00160001]
