name: vDialogueTheStripVStreetNCRTrooperMPHarassTopic001 "Take 200 caps, and leave me be." [DIAL:00160001]
speaker: VStreetNCRTrooperMPHarass "NCR Trooper MP" [NPC_:00160045]

text_content: Yeah, that's right. Now, get the fuck out of our sight, before we change our minds.
name: vDialogueTheStripVStreetNCRTrooperMPHarassTopic001 "Take 200 caps, and leave me be." [DIAL:00160001]
speaker: VStreetNCRTrooperMPHarass "NCR Trooper MP" [NPC_:00160045]

text_content: That's not going to cut it anymore. You've become a pain in the ass around here. Double that or we're going to box your ears.
name: vDialogueTheStripVStreetNCRTrooperMPHarassTopic001 "Take 200 caps, and leave me be." [DIAL:00160001]
speaker: VStreetNCRTrooperMPHarass "NCR Trooper MP" [NPC_:00160045]

text_content: That's not going to cut it anymore. You've become a pain in the ass around here. Double that or we're going to box your ears.
name: vDialogueTheStripVStreetNCRTrooperMPHarassTopic001 "Take 200 caps, and leave me be." [DIAL:00160001]
speaker: VStreetNCRTrooperMPHarass "NCR Trooper MP" [NPC_:00160045]

text_content: You cheap bastard, like all Mojave people.{Glances around, and tries to excuse his chickening out. Securitrons patrol the Strip} I'd beat you senseless right now, if we didn't have more important things to do.|But this is not over, get it? We'll see each other again, when you least expect it.
name: vDialogueTheStripVStreetNCRTrooperMPHarassTopic001 "Take 200 caps, and leave me be." [DIAL:00160001]
speaker: VStreetNCRTrooperMPHarass "NCR Trooper MP" [NPC_:00160045]

text_content: What have I done?
name: vDialogueTheStripVStreetNCRTrooperMPHarassTopic000 "What have I done?" [DIAL:00160002]

text_content: Let's just say that people around here talk about you. They say things, not nice things. We only like to hear nice things, get it?
name: vDialogueTheStripVStreetNCRTrooperMPHarassTopic000 "What have I done?" [DIAL:00160002]
speaker: VStreetNCRTrooperMPHarass "NCR Trooper MP" [NPC_:00160045]

text_content: Thank you, I'm ready for it too.
name: VFreeformTheStreet01SarahWeintraubTopic086 "Thank you, I'm ready for it too." [DIAL:00160003]

text_content: Okay! You know where to go. See you soon!
name: VFreeformTheStreet01SarahWeintraubTopic086 "Thank you, I'm ready for it too." [DIAL:00160003]
speaker: SarahWeintraub "Sarah" [NPC_:00116597]

text_content: Go all the way down to the Vault's main game room, take the hallway to your left and then the first room on the left-hand side. Enjoy your stay!
name: VFreeformTheStreet01SarahWeintraubTopic086 "Thank you, I'm ready for it too." [DIAL:00160003]
speaker: SarahWeintraub "Sarah" [NPC_:00116597]

text_content: The pleasure's for both of us. Pass by later, I'll let you in.
name: VFreeformTheStreet01SarahWeintraubTopic085 "The pleasure's for both of us. Pass by later, I'll let you in." [DIAL:00160004]

text_content: Let me ask you about something else.
name: VFreeformTheStreet01SarahWeintraubTopic084 "Let me ask you about something else." [DIAL:00160005]

text_content: I've also got something for you. Pass by my room later.
name: VFreeformTheStreet01SarahWeintraubTopic083 "I've also got something for you. Pass by my room later." [DIAL:00160006]

text_content: What's article 49?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyRamosArticle49 "What's article 49?" [DIAL:00160049]

text_content: What do I get out of helping you?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic019 "What do I get out of helping you?" [DIAL:0016004A]

text_content: If I become Elder, the lockdown will be lifted, and we'll once again be able to send patrols out into the wastes. We'll become powerful again.|And when that happens, it will be good to have the Brotherhood as an ally. Good enough?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic019 "What do I get out of helping you?" [DIAL:0016004A]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: I'll see what I can do.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic010 "I'll see what I can do." [DIAL:0016004B]

text_content: That'll have to do. I'd recommend going to see Ramos first. As head of security, he's more familiar with our protocols than anyone else here.|You could also try to find something relevant in our datastore, though last I heard, Scribe Ibsen has having a bit of a problem accessing it.|And if McNamara should give you any tasks, I'd ask that you kept me abreast of them.|Report anything you find to me, and we'll move from there.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic010 "I'll see what I can do." [DIAL:0016004B]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: And I suppose you'd nominate yourself?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic003 "And I suppose you'd nominate yourself?" [DIAL:0016004C]

text_content: {Proud, but not vain}I would. I'm the senior-most paladin in the Chapter, and have more combat experience than any two others here put together.|I'd gladly support another candidate, but no one has the courage to step forward and make the attempt, so it falls to me.|I would put this chapter back on the right path, if I could just assume leadership.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic003 "And I suppose you'd nominate yourself?" [DIAL:0016004C]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: I wanted to ask you a few questions.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic023 "I wanted to ask you a few questions." [DIAL:0016004D]

text_content: No, I had some questions for you.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic022 "No, I had some questions for you." [DIAL:0016004E]

text_content: Guess I'll be going then.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout03Topic003 "Guess I'll be going then." [DIAL:0016004F]

text_content: Do that. And take care to avoid the valley to the east, if you know what's good for you.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout03Topic003 "Guess I'll be going then." [DIAL:0016004F]
speaker: HVScout03 "Brotherhood Scout" [NPC_:0015D9DD]

text_content: What are you doing here?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout03Topic002 "What are you doing here?" [DIAL:00160050]

text_content: I've no reason to disclose the purpose of my actions to a stranger. Please leave.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout03Topic002 "What are you doing here?" [DIAL:00160050]
speaker: HVScout03 "Brotherhood Scout" [NPC_:0015D9DD]

text_content: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout03Topic001 "Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting." [DIAL:00160051]

text_content: Then I am sworn to report. I've been dividing my time between the camps to the north and south of here.|One belongs to the NCR, the other to a band of slavers known as Caesar's Legion. I was sure the NCR would quickly win, but that has not happened.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout03Topic001 "Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting." [DIAL:00160051]
speaker: HVScout03 "Brotherhood Scout" [NPC_:0015D9DD]

text_content: Instead, the two sides have reached a stalemate, and only occasionally send skirmishers against one another.|If I didn't know better, I'd say neither side is confident enough to push for a full victory. Which seems strange given the NCR's technological edge.|In any event, I've recorded my findings in this report. Please deliver it to the Elder. I am sure he will find the contents most interesting.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout03Topic001 "Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting." [DIAL:00160051]
speaker: HVScout03 "Brotherhood Scout" [NPC_:0015D9DD]

text_content: Instead, the two sides maintained a long stalemate, and only after an extended duration did the NCR finally destroy its opponent.|When they did, it appeared they did so with the help of fresh reinforcements. I do not believe they could have managed the feat without them.|That savages such as these could last so long against the NCR is troubling. Please, take my findings to the Elder. He'll know what to make of this.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout03Topic001 "Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting." [DIAL:00160051]
speaker: HVScout03 "Brotherhood Scout" [NPC_:0015D9DD]

text_content: Instead, the two sides maintained a long stalemate, and after an extended time the slavers rose up and slaughtered the NCR to the man.|That barbarians with such crude weapons could crush a foe that defeated us is food for much thought.|Here, take my report to the Elder. He must be made aware of what happened here.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout03Topic001 "Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting." [DIAL:00160051]
speaker: HVScout03 "Brotherhood Scout" [NPC_:0015D9DD]

text_content: Instead, the two sides maintained a long stalemate, and after some time fighting broke out and both sides were mysteriously wiped out.|Things were rather chaotic, so I wasn't able to see exactly what happened, or who did the deed, but seeing the NCR suffer such a loss was a shock.|The Elder must know of what happened here. Take this report to him. It contains my notes on these events. Maybe he'll make some sense of it all.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout03Topic001 "Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting." [DIAL:00160051]
speaker: HVScout03 "Brotherhood Scout" [NPC_:0015D9DD]

text_content: Don't mind me. Just passing through.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout02Topic003 "Don't mind me. Just passing through." [DIAL:00160052]

text_content: If so, you may wish to go around that town to the south. It's been taken by slavers, and they seem to be waiting for something, or someone.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout02Topic003 "Don't mind me. Just passing through." [DIAL:00160052]
speaker: HVScout02 "Brotherhood Scout" [NPC_:0015D9DE]

text_content: What are you doing way up here?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout02Topic002 "What are you doing way up here?" [DIAL:00160053]

text_content: That's none of your business. I suggest you head back the way you came.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout02Topic002 "What are you doing way up here?" [DIAL:00160053]
speaker: HVScout02 "Brotherhood Scout" [NPC_:0015D9DE]

text_content: Elder McNamara sent me as his representative. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout02Topic001 "Elder McNamara sent me as his representative. He asks if the bears are still hunting." [DIAL:00160054]

text_content: Strange that the Elder should send an outsider, but I suppose he has his reasons.|My observations have mostly focused on the small town to the south of here. It was cruelly attacked, its inhabitants slain nearly to the last.|That such an act could occur so far west is nearly unthinkable. The NCR has forces in all directions, and an outpost scant miles west from here.|That they have not responded to this violence shows either an unwillingness or inability to properly defend their borders, which is telling.|I've collected such musings in this report. Please take it to the Elder.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout02Topic001 "Elder McNamara sent me as his representative. He asks if the bears are still hunting." [DIAL:00160054]
speaker: HVScout02 "Brotherhood Scout" [NPC_:0015D9DE]

text_content: Sorry, didn't mean to disturb you. I'll just be going.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout01Topic005 "Sorry, didn't mean to disturb you. I'll just be going." [DIAL:00160055]

text_content: See that you do. I'd advise you to avoid the prison over there. It's overrun by barbarians and the whole place may become a battlefield at any time.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout01Topic005 "Sorry, didn't mean to disturb you. I'll just be going." [DIAL:00160055]
speaker: HVScout01 "Brotherhood Scout" [NPC_:0015D9DF]

text_content: I'm just wondering what you're doing here.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout01Topic004 "I'm just wondering what you're doing here." [DIAL:00160056]

text_content: My purpose here is none of your concern. Now leave me be or I'll be forced to defend myself.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout01Topic004 "I'm just wondering what you're doing here." [DIAL:00160056]
speaker: HVScout01 "Brotherhood Scout" [NPC_:0015D9DF]

text_content: He said to tell you that the Chain That Binds bids you to speak.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout01Topic002 "He said to tell you that the Chain That Binds bids you to speak." [DIAL:00160057]

text_content: I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout01Topic001 "I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting." [DIAL:00160058]

text_content: You speak truly, for it is unlikely that an outsider would know both the Elder's name and that passphrase.|Very well. I've been observing the penal facility there in the distance for some time now, after having followed some rather disturbing rumors.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout01Topic001 "I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting." [DIAL:00160058]
speaker: HVScout01 "Brotherhood Scout" [NPC_:0015D9DF]

text_content: {Attack hasn't happened}The facility was run by the NCR for a time, but the prisoners overcame their guards and now use the prison as a base from which to conduct raids.|What puzzles me is why these men have been allowed to run wild for so long unchecked. Why has the NCR not retaken this place?|Give this to the Elder. My observations are all within. Perhaps he will have a better idea of what this situation portends.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout01Topic001 "I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting." [DIAL:00160058]
speaker: HVScout01 "Brotherhood Scout" [NPC_:0015D9DF]

text_content: {NCR won}The facility was run by the NCR for a time, but the prisoners overcame their guards and used the prison as a base from which to conduct raids.|Eventually, the NCR got around to putting the prisoners down, but not until they had wreaked havoc on nearby trade routes.|Give this to the Elder. My observations are all within. Perhaps he will have a better idea of what this situation portends.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout01Topic001 "I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting." [DIAL:00160058]
speaker: HVScout01 "Brotherhood Scout" [NPC_:0015D9DF]

text_content: {NCR lost}The facility was run by the NCR for a time, but the prisoners overcame their guards and used the prison as a base from which to conduct raids.|Eventually, the NCR tried to put the prisoners down, but they were overwhelmed by them, and haven't sent troops to the area since.|Give this to the Elder. My observations are all within. Perhaps he will have a better idea of what this situation portends.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScout01Topic001 "I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting." [DIAL:00160058]
speaker: HVScout01 "Brotherhood Scout" [NPC_:0015D9DF]

text_content: I was hoping to speak to you about other matters.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic021 "I was hoping to speak to you about other matters." [DIAL:00160059]

text_content: I can spare a little time. What did you want to talk about?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic021 "I was hoping to speak to you about other matters." [DIAL:00160059]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: Surely you have people better suited to look for them than me.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic020 "Surely you have people better suited to look for them than me." [DIAL:0016005A]

text_content: The less who are aware of this situation, the better. My brothers and sisters were deeply traumatized by the losses we incurred several years ago.|It would be imprudent to worry them unduly without first discovering the facts of the situation.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic020 "Surely you have people better suited to look for them than me." [DIAL:0016005A]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: Why should I help you?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic019 "Why should I help you?" [DIAL:0016005B]

text_content: Okay.

name: VES05NightkinTumbleweedRancherVES05NightkinTWeedRancherTopic005 "All I see are tumbleweeds." [DIAL:001600B3]

text_content: Yes - the herd.
name: VES05NightkinTumbleweedRancherVES05NightkinTWeedRancherTopic005 "All I see are tumbleweeds." [DIAL:001600B3]
speaker: VES05NightkinTWeedRancher "Nightkin" [CREA:0015FFF0]

text_content: Oh, you're crazy, aren't you.
name: VES05NightkinTumbleweedRancherVES05NightkinTWeedRancherTopic004 "Oh, you're crazy, aren't you." [DIAL:001600B4]

text_content: Crazy with low prices on Wind-Brahmin. You buy one.
name: VES05NightkinTumbleweedRancherVES05NightkinTWeedRancherTopic004 "Oh, you're crazy, aren't you." [DIAL:001600B4]
speaker: VES05NightkinTWeedRancher "Nightkin" [CREA:0015FFF0]

name: VES05NightkinTumbleweedRancherVES05NightkinTWeedRancherTopic003 "What herd?" [DIAL:001600B5]
speaker: VES05NightkinTWeedRancher "Nightkin" [CREA:0015FFF0]

speaker: VES05NightkinTWeedRancher "Nightkin" [CREA:0015FFF0]

speaker: VES05NightkinTWeedRancher "Nightkin" [CREA:0015FFF0]

text_content: I don't like being followed, robot.
name: VES01bVictorIsInBoulderCityVictorTopic005 "I don't like being followed, robot." [DIAL:001600B9]

text_content: Now-now, it ain't my fault that Dorothy and the Tin Man happened to be on the same yellow-striped road, is it?
name: VES01bVictorIsInBoulderCityVictorTopic005 "I don't like being followed, robot." [DIAL:001600B9]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: You see what happened in there?
name: VES01bVictorIsInBoulderCityVictorTopic004 "You see what happened in there?" [DIAL:001600BA]

text_content: Yup. Guess it's just down to you and fancy-pants. I wouldn't worry about him - he looked all hat and no cattle if you ask me.
name: VES01bVictorIsInBoulderCityVictorTopic004 "You see what happened in there?" [DIAL:001600BA]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VES01bVictorIsInBoulderCityVictorTopic003 "Goodbye." [DIAL:001600BB]

text_content: Look me up when you get to New Vegas - I'll buy the first round.
name: VES01bVictorIsInBoulderCityVictorTopic003 "Goodbye." [DIAL:001600BB]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: Did you see Benny come this way?
name: VES01bVictorIsInBoulderCityVictorTopic002 "Did you see Benny come this way?" [DIAL:001600BC]

text_content: 'Benny'? Fancy-pant's name is Benny? {short laugh}No, but I reckon that 'Bunny' hopped his way back to New Vegas.
name: VES01bVictorIsInBoulderCityVictorTopic002 "Did you see Benny come this way?" [DIAL:001600BC]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: Fancy-pants? No, I ain't seen hide-nor-hair of him since the tussle in Goodsprings. I'm sure he ran back to the soft-living of New Vegas, 'though.
name: VES01bVictorIsInBoulderCityVictorTopic002 "Did you see Benny come this way?" [DIAL:001600BC]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: It's good to see you again, Victor.
name: VES01bVictorIsInBoulderCityVictorTopic001 "It's good to see you again, Victor." [DIAL:001600BD]

text_content: Yup, but this is getting a might embarrassing - people are going to start to talk. <laughs>
name: VES01bVictorIsInBoulderCityVictorTopic001 "It's good to see you again, Victor." [DIAL:001600BD]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: How did you get here?
name: VES01bVictorIsInBoulderCityVictorTopic000 "How did you get here?" [DIAL:001600BE]

text_content: Just rolling along on my spurs. Looks like I just might make it to New Vegas after all.
name: VES01bVictorIsInBoulderCityVictorTopic000 "How did you get here?" [DIAL:001600BE]
speaker: Victor "Victor" [CREA:00103DFD]

text_content: LilyBreakEnd
name: LilyBreakEnd "LilyBreakEnd" [DIAL:00160228]

name: LilyBreakEnd "LilyBreakEnd" [DIAL:00160228]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: {Heavy breathing}{Gramma}Grandma's feeling calmer now, dearie.
name: LilyBreakEnd "LilyBreakEnd" [DIAL:00160228]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: Oh my stars, did I do all of this?
name: LilyBreakEnd "LilyBreakEnd" [DIAL:00160228]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: Gracious me, I lost control a bit there!
name: LilyBreakEnd "LilyBreakEnd" [DIAL:00160228]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: Why is it hard to remember them?
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic035 "Why is it hard to remember them?" [DIAL:00160229]

text_content: It's my medicine, dearie. It keeps me calm, but it makes my memory go all fuzzy. That's why I only take my dosage every other time.|That way at least I remember their faces.
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic035 "Why is it hard to remember them?" [DIAL:00160229]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: What was that recording you were listening to?
name: LilyRecording "What was that recording you were listening to?" [DIAL:0016022A]

text_content: Oh, that old thing? That's a holotape from the last time I visited my grandkids. Such sweet little children, you know. Little angels.|Sometimes it's hard to remember them, so I take that old tape out from time to time and listen.
name: LilyRecording "What was that recording you were listening to?" [DIAL:0016022A]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: I'll risk you having more psychotic breaks if it means you're more dangerous in combat.
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic034 "I'll risk you having more psychotic breaks if it means you're more dangerous in combat." [DIAL:0016022B]

text_content: All right, dear. If you're really sure.
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic034 "I'll risk you having more psychotic breaks if it means you're more dangerous in combat." [DIAL:0016022B]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: That's good. Do that.
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic033 "That's good. Do that." [DIAL:0016022C]

text_content: All right, pumpkin.
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic033 "That's good. Do that." [DIAL:0016022C]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: On second thought....
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic032 "On second thought...." [DIAL:0016022D]

text_content: Yes, dearie?
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic032 "On second thought...." [DIAL:0016022D]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: I'm sure. I'd rather you didn't have any psychotic breaks, even if it means you aren't as strong.
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic031 "I'm sure. I'd rather you didn't have any psychotic breaks, even if it means you aren't as strong." [DIAL:0016022E]

text_content: Well, all right, then, dearie. {Sad}I suppose I'll have my holotapes to remind me of Becky and Jimmy....
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic031 "I'm sure. I'd rather you didn't have any psychotic breaks, even if it means you aren't as strong." [DIAL:0016022E]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: Never mind, we'll talk about it later.
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic022 "Never mind, we'll talk about it later." [DIAL:0016022F]

text_content: Whenever you're ready, dear.
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic022 "Never mind, we'll talk about it later." [DIAL:0016022F]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: That medicine isn't doing you any good. I want you to stop taking it altogether.
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic021 "That medicine isn't doing you any good. I want you to stop taking it altogether." [DIAL:00160230]

text_content: Oh my stars! Are you sure? If I don't take any medicine at all, Leo gets especially cranky. I can't stop him when he's like that.
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic021 "That medicine isn't doing you any good. I want you to stop taking it altogether." [DIAL:00160230]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: You should keep taking your meds every other time. It's worth the risk to remember your family.

text_content: The Brotherhood{Spoke with distain} is all about keeping technology to themselves, and using what they find to protect themselves.|They are isolationist and belligerent. I have no doubt that they plan to use the data for weapons research.

speaker: VFSEDEScientist "April Martimer" [NPC_:0015882B]

text_content: What are you going to do with it?
name: VFreeformFreeside2VFSEDEScientistTopic003 "What are you going to do with it?" [DIAL:00160407]

text_content: First I'm going to pull off whatever log data I can. Then, I'll use some of the tech around here to upgrade its weapons systems.|Shouldn't be more than a few days work.
name: VFreeformFreeside2VFSEDEScientistTopic003 "What are you going to do with it?" [DIAL:00160407]
speaker: VFSEDEScientist "April Martimer" [NPC_:0015882B]

speaker: VFSEDEScientist "April Martimer" [NPC_:0015882B]

text_content: vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade
name: vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade "vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:00160705]

text_content: Step closer to the demonstration area, please!
name: vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade "vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:00160705]

text_content: Okay, so you're familiar with Securitrons by now, obviously! I mean, some of your best friends are Securitrons, right?{chuckle}
name: vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade "vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:00160705]

text_content: Our titanium alloy housing does a good job of protecting our delicate electronic insides from small arms fire and shrapnel!
name: vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade "vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:00160705]

text_content: Our left arm contains an X-25 gatling laser, quite deadly against soft targets at medium range. That looks like fun!
name: vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade "vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:00160705]

text_content: And for close-range suppression and crowd control, we have this handy-dandy 9mm submachinegun! Nice!
name: vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade "vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:00160705]

text_content: All of this is old hat, right?
name: vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade "vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:00160705]

text_content: Here's where it gets interesting! Turns out those are our {emph}secondary weapons!
name: vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade "vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:00160705]

text_content: All this time we've been running the {emph}Mark I operating system, which doesn't have drivers for our primary weapons! Imagine!
name: vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade "vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:00160705]

text_content: Now watch this - I'm downloading the Mark II OS to all the Securitrons on the network. Makes quite a difference!
name: vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade "vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:00160705]

text_content: With the M-235 Missile Launcher, we can engage ground and air targets at long range!
name: vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade "vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:00160705]

text_content: And a rapid-fire G-28 grenade launching system makes us deadly in close-range engagements! Whoo, look at that!
name: vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade "vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:00160705]

text_content: The OS upgrade also includes drivers for our onboard auto-repair systems! Just try to hurt us now!
name: vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade "vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:00160705]

text_content: All together, this {emph}software upgrade confers a 235% increase in combat effectiveness - per unit!
name: vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade "vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:00160705]

text_content: New Vegas finally has soldiers worthy of protecting it!
name: vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade "vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:00160705]

text_content: I hope you enjoyed this demonstration! You can come back up and see me or be on your way - I know you're a busy person!
name: vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade "vDialogueYesManSecuritronUpgrade" [DIAL:00160705]

text_content: What do I do?
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic073 "What do I do?" [DIAL:00160706]

text_content: All you have to do is destroy the power generators! Without the generators, Hoover Dam's just a big bunch of concrete!|Take this override module - it's just like the one you used at the El Dorado Substation.|Install the override module on the terminal in the power control room! I'll disable the generator failsafes, and you can do the rest.|Good luck! See you at the dam!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic073 "What do I do?" [DIAL:00160706]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: You want me to destroy Hoover Dam?
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic072 "You want me to destroy Hoover Dam?" [DIAL:00160707]

text_content: Not the whole thing, thank goodness! That'd be really hard!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic072 "You want me to destroy Hoover Dam?" [DIAL:00160707]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: Fine, just tell me how.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic071 "Fine, just tell me how." [DIAL:00160708]

text_content: The dam is too valuable to destroy!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic070 "The dam is too valuable to destroy!" [DIAL:00160709]

text_content: That's exactly why this will work! Just hear me out...
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic070 "The dam is too valuable to destroy!" [DIAL:00160709]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: What are you talking about?
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic069 "What are you talking about?" [DIAL:0016070A]

text_content: You remember how the Securitron army at the Fort got destroyed? For very, very good reasons, of course...|Well, the problem is that's left us with enough Securitrons to drive off a weakened NCR force -  but not enough to keep them from coming back!|So what we do is take away the whole reason why they'd want to come back! Smart, huh?
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic069 "What are you talking about?" [DIAL:0016070A]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: Just tell me what to do.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic068 "Just tell me what to do." [DIAL:0016070B]

text_content: I wish I could, but I'm neuro-computationally incapable of making decisions like this one! It's up to you!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic068 "Just tell me what to do." [DIAL:0016070B]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: What sort of options?
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic067 "What sort of options?" [DIAL:0016070C]

text_content: You could rout the dam's power output to the facility under Fortification Hill. That'll restart its reactor, just like you did with the Lucky 38!|That'll wake up the Securitron army you left on standby and give us enough force to push the Legion {emph}and the NCR straight out of the Mojave!|The other option is destroy the dam's generators. Without those, it's just a big bunch of concrete! The NCR won't have any reason to stick around!|You don't have to decide yet! For now, all you have to do is take this override module and install it on the terminal in the power control room!|{DUPLICATE?}Good luck! See you at the dam!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic067 "What sort of options?" [DIAL:0016070C]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: I have some things to take care of before the battle at Hoover Dam.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic066 "I have some things to take care of before the battle at Hoover Dam." [DIAL:0016070D]

text_content: Forget the Followers. I'm ready to fight at the dam.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic065 "Forget the Followers. I'm ready to fight at the dam." [DIAL:0016070E]

text_content: I've already made arrangements with the Followers. I'm ready to fight at the dam.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic064 "I've already made arrangements with the Followers. I'm ready to fight at the dam." [DIAL:0016070F]

text_content: Great! So I've been looking over Mr. House's force projections and running some calculations...|It turns out there are two ways we can win this thing! Hear that? We have options!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic064 "I've already made arrangements with the Followers. I'm ready to fight at the dam." [DIAL:0016070F]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: Great! So I've been looking over Mr. House's force projections and running some calculations...|It turns out there's only one way for us to win this battle and make it stick! We have to render Hoover Dam inoperable!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic064 "I've already made arrangements with the Followers. I'm ready to fight at the dam." [DIAL:0016070F]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: All right, I'll go talk to the Followers.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic063 "All right, I'll go talk to the Followers." [DIAL:00160710]

text_content: Wonderful! I'll keep tabs on the situation at the dam! See you in a bit!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic063 "All right, I'll go talk to the Followers." [DIAL:00160710]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: I have a few things to take care of before the battle at Hoover Dam.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic062 "I have a few things to take care of before the battle at Hoover Dam." [DIAL:00160711]

text_content: Sure, no problem! So long as the Legion doesn't attack before you can get there! Which I'm sure they won't!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic062 "I have a few things to take care of before the battle at Hoover Dam." [DIAL:00160711]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: What is the final phase of the plan?
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic048 "What is the final phase of the plan?" [DIAL:00160712]

text_content: {upbeat}Well, the Legion is going to attack Hoover Dam one of these days! And the NCR is going to defend it!|{upbeat}One side will lose, and the other will win! But the side that wins will be weak, because a lot of its soldiers will be dead!|{upbeat}That's when all our Securitrons will show up! We'll declare an Independent Vegas, and tell the side that won the dam - to scram!|{upbeat}Or the Securitrons will kill all of them, too!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic048 "What is the final phase of the plan?" [DIAL:00160712]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

name: VMQTopsYesManSafetyLines "VMQTopsYesManSafetyLines" [DIAL:00160713]

name: VMQTopsYesManSafetyLines "VMQTopsYesManSafetyLines" [DIAL:00160713]

text_content: Here's another one of my print-outs! Read up!
name: VMQTopsYesManSafetyLines "VMQTopsYesManSafetyLines" [DIAL:00160713]

text_content: This print-out covers everything you need to know!
name: VMQTopsYesManSafetyLines "VMQTopsYesManSafetyLines" [DIAL:00160713]

name: VMQTopsYesManSafetyLines "VMQTopsYesManSafetyLines" [DIAL:00160713]

text_content: VMQTopsYesManTransfer
name: VMQTopsYesManTransfer "VMQTopsYesManTransfer" [DIAL:0016076E]

text_content: {excited, on way to Lucky 38}So this is what the rest of the world looks like!
name: VMQTopsYesManTransfer "VMQTopsYesManTransfer" [DIAL:0016076E]

text_content: {excited, on way to Lucky 38}Everything looks bigger than I imagined!
name: VMQTopsYesManTransfer "VMQTopsYesManTransfer" [DIAL:0016076E]

text_content: {excited, on way to Lucky 38}Isn't this exciting? I know I'm excited!
name: VMQTopsYesManTransfer "VMQTopsYesManTransfer" [DIAL:0016076E]

text_content: {excited, on way to Lucky 38}I have a good feeling about this! It's going to be great!
name: VMQTopsYesManTransfer "VMQTopsYesManTransfer" [DIAL:0016076E]

text_content: {excited, on way to Lucky 38}I bet I'm going to like it in that mainframe!
name: VMQTopsYesManTransfer "VMQTopsYesManTransfer" [DIAL:0016076E]

text_content: LilyDogs
name: LilyDogs "LilyDogs" [DIAL:0016077A]

text_content: Nice puppies - do doggies want treats?
name: LilyDogs "LilyDogs" [DIAL:0016077A]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: LilyBoomers
name: LilyBoomers "LilyBoomers" [DIAL:0016077B]

text_content: {Panicking}Ahh! Loud! Onetwothreefourfivesixseveneightninetenonetwothreefourfivesixseveneightnineten!
name: LilyBoomers "LilyBoomers" [DIAL:0016077B]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: LilyVault
name: LilyVault "LilyVault" [DIAL:0016077C]

text_content: My, my, this reminds me of when I was a girl. Right over there would have been where your {grampa}grandpa and I had our first kiss!
name: LilyVault "LilyVault" [DIAL:0016077C]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: LilyNovac
name: LilyNovac "LilyNovac" [DIAL:0016077D]

text_content: Ooh, look, pumpkin! A dinosaur! Do you want to ride the dinosaur?
name: LilyNovac "LilyNovac" [DIAL:0016077D]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: LilyTheStrip
name: LilyTheStrip "LilyTheStrip" [DIAL:0016077E]

text_content: My, aren't all these lights fancy?
name: LilyTheStrip "LilyTheStrip" [DIAL:0016077E]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: LilyBlackMountain
name: LilyBlackMountain "LilyBlackMountain" [DIAL:0016077F]

text_content: I wonder if Marcus knows about this place....
name: LilyBlackMountain "LilyBlackMountain" [DIAL:0016077F]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: Never mind.
name: VDialogueNovacJeannieMayCrawfordTopic004 "Never mind." [DIAL:001607EC]

text_content: Oh. Well, all right.
name: VDialogueNovacJeannieMayCrawfordTopic004 "Never mind." [DIAL:001607EC]
speaker: JeannieMayCrawford "Jeannie May Crawford" [NPC_:0008D749]

text_content: Your room will be the one upstairs, closest to the lobby side.|Here's your key. Let me know if there's anything I can do to make your stay better for you.
name: VDialogueNovacJeannieMayCrawfordTopic004 "Never mind." [DIAL:001607EC]
speaker: JeannieMayCrawford "Jeannie May Crawford" [NPC_:0008D749]

text_content: I can't afford 100 caps right now.
name: VDialogueNovacJeannieMayCrawfordTopic003 "I can't afford 100 caps right now." [DIAL:001607ED]

text_content: Well that's nothing to be ashamed of. We all have money troubles from time to time.|You just come on back when you can afford it, and that room's all yours.
name: VDialogueNovacJeannieMayCrawfordTopic003 "I can't afford 100 caps right now." [DIAL:001607ED]
speaker: JeannieMayCrawford "Jeannie May Crawford" [NPC_:0008D749]

text_content: Here's 100 caps.
name: VDialogueNovacJeannieMayCrawfordTopic002 "Here's 100 caps." [DIAL:001607EE]

text_content: I'm glad you can stay with us.
name: VDialogueNovacJeannieMayCrawfordTopic002 "Here's 100 caps." [DIAL:001607EE]
speaker: JeannieMayCrawford "Jeannie May Crawford" [NPC_:0008D749]

text_content: I'd like to rent a room.
name: VDialogueNovacJeannieMayCrawfordTopic001 "I'd like to rent a room." [DIAL:001607EF]

text_content: I can't see as how I'd charge you after the generous things you've done for the town. The room's on me.
name: VDialogueNovacJeannieMayCrawfordTopic001 "I'd like to rent a room." [DIAL:001607EF]

text_content: Well, I think that's a fine idea. I'll give you a good flat rate, and you can stay as long as you like. Least till the busy season comes. Sound good?
name: VDialogueNovacJeannieMayCrawfordTopic001 "I'd like to rent a room." [DIAL:001607EF]
speaker: JeannieMayCrawford "Jeannie May Crawford" [NPC_:0008D749]

text_content: I'm sure I can get help with supply shortages.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic071 "I'm sure I can get help with supply shortages." [DIAL:001607F6]

text_content: Even if that were the case, we still need more incentive to help Vegas.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic071 "I'm sure I can get help with supply shortages." [DIAL:001607F6]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: You would establish a foothold in the region and be one step closer to rebuilding the Mojave.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic099 "You would establish a foothold in the region and be one step closer to rebuilding the Mojave." [DIAL:001607F7]

text_content: I think I see now what you intend to set in motion.|If this plan will bring us one step closer to revitalizing the region, you can count on our support.|So long as you can keep us supplied, we will stay in the Mojave to provide care and education for those in need.
name: VFreeformFreesideVFSJulieFarkasTopic099 "You would establish a foothold in the region and be one step closer to rebuilding the Mojave." [DIAL:001607F7]
speaker: VFSJulieFarkas "Julie Farkas" [NPC_:0010C682]

text_content: I'll be on my way.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic080 "I'll be on my way." [DIAL:00161180]

text_content: Be careful out there! It won't be long before the Legion makes its move!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic080 "I'll be on my way." [DIAL:00161180]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: What will the override module let you do?
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic079 "What will the override module let you do?" [DIAL:00161181]

text_content: I'll use the Substation to send a {emph}huge jolt of electricity to the Lucky 38! Turns out this casino has its own reactor! All it needs is a jumpstart!|With the reactor running at full-tilt, I can boost the transmission strength of the Lucky 38's command and control network!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic079 "What will the override module let you do?" [DIAL:00161181]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: Okay, I'll get it done.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic078 "Okay, I'll get it done." [DIAL:00161182]

text_content: Great! When this is taken care of, we'll be all set for the Legion to make its move.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic078 "Okay, I'll get it done." [DIAL:00161182]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: I don't care what happens to Kimball.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic077 "I don't care what happens to Kimball." [DIAL:00161183]

text_content: Fine by me! We've got more important things to take care of!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic077 "I don't care what happens to Kimball." [DIAL:00161183]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: {Terrible NCR rep}The NCR hates me. They won't let me within 1000 feet of Kimball.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic076 "{Terrible NCR rep}The NCR hates me. They won't let me within 1000 feet of Kimball." [DIAL:00161184]

text_content: You are so misunderstood! Well, it's their loss!|Forget about the President! We've got something more important to take care of!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic076 "{Terrible NCR rep}The NCR hates me. They won't let me within 1000 feet of Kimball." [DIAL:00161184]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: {mixed/unknown NCR rep}I might be able to convince the NCR to let me help out.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic075 "{mixed/unknown NCR rep}I might be able to convince the NCR to let me help out." [DIAL:00161185]

text_content: All right. A Ranger named Grant is in charge of security for the visit. He's the one you'll have to convince.|After you've resolved the situation with the President, there's one more thing for you to take care of!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic075 "{mixed/unknown NCR rep}I might be able to convince the NCR to let me help out." [DIAL:00161185]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: {good NCR rep}I'm on good terms with the NCR. They'll let me help protect him.
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic074 "{good NCR rep}I'm on good terms with the NCR. They'll let me help protect him." [DIAL:00161186]

text_content: Great! A Ranger named Grant has been placed in charge of security for the President's visit. You'll want to talk to him.|Once the President is safe, there's one more thing for you to take care of!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic074 "{good NCR rep}I'm on good terms with the NCR. They'll let me help protect him." [DIAL:00161186]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: Why did Mr. House want Kimball kept alive?
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic012 "Why did Mr. House want Kimball kept alive?" [DIAL:00161187]

text_content: Mr. House ran projections on how the NCR public will react to a defeat at Hoover Dam! Overwhelmingly, they'll blame Kimball!|But if Kimball dies at Hoover Dam, there's no obvious scapegoat for them to blame! So they'll blame New Vegas instead!|So that means reduced tourism for up to five years! The equations are pretty complicated! Mr. House sure liked numbers!
name: VMQTopsVMQTopsYesManTopic012 "Why did Mr. House want Kimball kept alive?" [DIAL:00161187]
speaker: VMQTopsYesMan "Yes Man" [CREA:001164F9]

text_content: I'm not going to let Benny get away.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic016 "I'm not going to let Benny get away." [DIAL:001611A1]

text_content: I can't say I understand your obsession, but for that I suppose I'd have to spend a night in your grave.|Fine. I'll stick with you. Just remember this. If you want something from Caesar, sooner or later you'll have to give him his due.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic016 "I'm not going to let Benny get away." [DIAL:001611A1]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Once we get close to Caesar, we can strike.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic015 "Once we get close to Caesar, we can strike." [DIAL:001611A2]

text_content: {"And you, my friend?" eht too mee ah-mee-kay?}Et tu, mi amice?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic015 "Once we get close to Caesar, we can strike." [DIAL:001611A2]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: {"And you, my friend?" eht too mee ah-MEE-kah?}Et tu, mi amica?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic015 "Once we get close to Caesar, we can strike." [DIAL:001611A2]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: I have to commend you on your sense of historical propriety, but have you given more than a passing thought to how we would escape?|No disrespect intended, but you aren't the first person to dream up the idea.|Just give me a sign when you're about to pull out the dagger so I know when to make a run for the cliffs.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic015 "Once we get close to Caesar, we can strike." [DIAL:001611A2]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Let's just listen to him, figure out what he's up to, and get out.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic014 "Let's just listen to him, figure out what he's up to, and get out." [DIAL:001611A3]

text_content: Short of canceling our imminent travel plans, that's the best thing you could have said.|Just be careful. If we travel at Caesar's pleasure, he may not let us out as easily as he lets us in.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic014 "Let's just listen to him, figure out what he's up to, and get out." [DIAL:001611A3]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: I just want to hear Caesar out.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic013 "I just want to hear Caesar out." [DIAL:001611A4]

text_content: Very optimistic of you. You'll make a good Follower someday assuming Caesar doesn't have us both crucified.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic013 "I just want to hear Caesar out." [DIAL:001611A4]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: If you say so.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic012 "If you say so." [DIAL:001611A5]

text_content: Did I say something? Sorry. Don't pay any attention to me. Just babbling. {becoming more quiet}Nonsense, really. {drifting off}Babbling nonsense.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic012 "If you say so." [DIAL:001611A5]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Memories of what?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic011 "Memories of what?" [DIAL:001611A6]

text_content: Oh, uh... {trying to cover}of hearing stories. About energy weapons. {drifting off}They're... pretty crazy. {quietly}Yeah.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic011 "Memories of what?" [DIAL:001611A6]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Do the Followers use a lot of energy weapons?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic010 "Do the Followers use a lot of energy weapons?" [DIAL:001611A7]

text_content: {off-hand, not realizing he's revealing something bad}Energy weapons? Of course not.|{catching himself, trying to cover}I mean... but, we study all sorts of science and technology so, you know, we... you just kind of get familiar with them. Yeah.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic010 "Do the Followers use a lot of energy weapons?" [DIAL:001611A7]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Why don't you come with me?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic009 "Why don't you come with me?" [DIAL:001611A8]

text_content: I can't leave now. Caesar has gained too much ground. I need to be here in case the NCR fails to hold Hoover Dam.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic009 "Why don't you come with me?" [DIAL:001611A8]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: No offense intended, but why should I go anywhere with you?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic009 "Why don't you come with me?" [DIAL:001611A8]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Do you know much about Caesar?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic008 "Do you know much about Caesar?" [DIAL:001611A9]

text_content: {sighs}I don't know anything that the others couldn't tell you. Caesar was one of the Followers. Before my time, of course.|He wanted to rebuild the new world in the image of the old. A sad story of good intentions gone bad. In that regard, he's hardly unique.|If you set aside his leadership capabilities, extensive knowledge, and ruthless cunning, he's just another jerk who steps on people to get his way.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic008 "Do you know much about Caesar?" [DIAL:001611A9]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Where did you learn that?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic007 "Where did you learn that?" [DIAL:001611AA]

text_content: Not from the Legion, if that's what you're getting at. Books. Sheet music. Gladiator movie holotapes. Bits and pieces here and there.|The Followers have extensive libraries, but we all draw water from the same old well. Even Caesar.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic007 "Where did you learn that?" [DIAL:001611AA]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Nihi-what?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic006 "Nihi-what?" [DIAL:001611AB]

text_content: Oh. {sincere}Sorry. "There is nothing new under the sun."|If agave and mesquite were that miraculous, the locals would have figured it out a few thousand years ago.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic006 "Nihi-what?" [DIAL:001611AB]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Isn't that the language that Caesar's Legion speaks?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic005 "Isn't that the language that Caesar's Legion speaks?" [DIAL:001611AC]

text_content: {�Yeah, well...�}{SEE-zar}Caesar can cite {KAY-toe}Cato to suit his purpose. Many people have spoken Latin. Some of them were quite pleasant.|It's unfortunate that the language is now associated with the gentlemen across the river.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic005 "Isn't that the language that Caesar's Legion speaks?" [DIAL:001611AC]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: What kinds of illnesses and injuries?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic004 "What kinds of illnesses and injuries?" [DIAL:001611AD]

text_content: Cuts, lacerations, broken bones. Infections resulting from all of the above. Common cold, influenza. Take your pick.|There are plenty of ways to die out here, and most of them, surprisingly, don't have anything to do with war. Just common human fragility.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic004 "What kinds of illnesses and injuries?" [DIAL:001611AD]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: What's the goal?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic003 "What's the goal?" [DIAL:001611AE]

text_content: For the past hundred years or so, the Followers have managed to get by using salvaged medical supplies from the Old World.|But the side effect of medical success is that more people live longer. Funny how that works.|Eventually, we'll run out of hospitals to loot. We need new ways to produce those supplies. Or maybe old ways, if this research goes anywhere.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic003 "What's the goal?" [DIAL:001611AE]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: You don't sound too enthusiastic about it.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic002 "You don't sound too enthusiastic about it." [DIAL:001611AF]

text_content: I'm enthusiastic about helping people, but {nih-hill noh-wee soob soh-lay}nihil novi sub sole.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic002 "You don't sound too enthusiastic about it." [DIAL:001611AF]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Why do you do research instead of providing medical assistance?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic001 "Why do you do research instead of providing medical assistance?" [DIAL:001611B0]

text_content: Not all Followers are "people persons." Besides, someone needs to do research. I have no problem with Julie sticking me back here.|Out of sight, out of mind. There are worse things one can be, though I do admit, it is a bit boring.|Though it has a noble goal, I don't think this research will yield much fruit. No pun intended.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic001 "Why do you do research instead of providing medical assistance?" [DIAL:001611B0]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Like I said before, not all Followers are good with people.|I'm fine doing research back here, even if it is a bit boring... and pointless... and a complete waste of time.|Don't mind me. I'm just voicing my thoughts so they don't burrow out of my skull in a fit of abject despondency.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic001 "Why do you do research instead of providing medical assistance?" [DIAL:001611B0]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: What kind of research?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic000 "What kind of research?" [DIAL:001611B1]

text_content: Oh, you know. Finding alternative treatments for common illnesses and injuries. Stimpaks out of barrel cacti and other fantastic improbabilities.|As far as fruitless wastes of time go, it's quite noble in its aims.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic000 "What kind of research?" [DIAL:001611B1]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Look out, behind you! <Pistol Whip Carlyle>
name: VMS18VMS18CarlyleStClairTopic017 "Look out, behind you! <Pistol Whip Carlyle>" [DIAL:001611E9]

text_content: Huh? Hey, I think you dropped your gun there. Here. Here you go. Just don't point it at me, okay?|I'm paranoid now, and even though you clearly don't know how to hold that thing, it'd be one less thing for me to worry about. Thanks.
name: VMS18VMS18CarlyleStClairTopic017 "Look out, behind you! <Pistol Whip Carlyle>" [DIAL:001611E9]
speaker: VMS18CarlyleStClair "Carlyle St. Clair III" [NPC_:00127DCC]

text_content: Did you know there's a nerve on your neck that helps you sleep? It's... uh... I know it's here...
name: VMS18VMS18CarlyleStClairTopic016 "Did you know there's a nerve on your neck that helps you sleep? It's... uh... I know it's here..." [DIAL:001611EA]

text_content: You're weird. Please stop that.
name: VMS18VMS18CarlyleStClairTopic016 "Did you know there's a nerve on your neck that helps you sleep? It's... uh... I know it's here..." [DIAL:001611EA]
speaker: VMS18CarlyleStClair "Carlyle St. Clair III" [NPC_:00127DCC]

text_content: Maybe beating your head on a rock will fix it.
name: VMS18VMS18CarlyleStClairTopic015 "Maybe beating your head on a rock will fix it." [DIAL:001611EB]

text_content: Who are you, again?
name: VMS18VMS18CarlyleStClairTopic015 "Maybe beating your head on a rock will fix it." [DIAL:001611EB]
speaker: VMS18CarlyleStClair "Carlyle St. Clair III" [NPC_:00127DCC]

text_content: Maybe my weak and flimsy hands can massage that out for you.<Apply Sleeper Hold>
name: VMS18VMS18CarlyleStClairTopic014 "Maybe my weak and flimsy hands can massage that out for you.<Apply Sleeper Hold>" [DIAL:001611EC]

text_content: What the-? Don't touch me. I could get a better massage from a baby.
name: VMS18VMS18CarlyleStClairTopic014 "Maybe my weak and flimsy hands can massage that out for you.<Apply Sleeper Hold>" [DIAL:001611EC]
speaker: VMS18CarlyleStClair "Carlyle St. Clair III" [NPC_:00127DCC]

text_content: Er... join the White Glove Society. They're cannibals, but that's probably a step up for you.

text_content: What can you tell me about the Great Khans?
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic031 "What can you tell me about the Great Khans?" [DIAL:0016147D]

text_content: We know they supply the Fiends with illegal chems, but they never stick around in NCR territory for long. They know the land, and move quick.|There's talk from time to time about taking out their base at Red Rock Canyon, but nothing ever comes of it. The Great Khans are tough fighters.|If we ever did go up against them on their home turf, we'd win, but casualties would be high.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic031 "What can you tell me about the Great Khans?" [DIAL:0016147D]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: You were at Bitter Springs, I'm told.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic028 "You were at Bitter Springs, I'm told." [DIAL:0016147E]

text_content: {painful memory - it was a massacre of innocents}Yeah, I was there. I was Captain Dhatri, then. That whole situation was a mess and could easily have been avoided with good intel.|The major in charge at the time made a bad call - he thought Bitter Springs was full of Great Khan raiders, so we surrounded the place.|By the time any of us realized there were civilians down there - women and children - the shooting had already started.|The major froze up at the news, and we couldn't get another word out of him. I took over and salvaged the situation as best I could.|For my effort, I was promoted to major. Not quite the way I'd have wanted it.
name: VFreeformMcCarran31EMajorDhatriTopic028 "You were at Bitter Springs, I'm told." [DIAL:0016147E]
speaker: 1EMajorDhatri "Major Dhatri" [NPC_:000F56F8]

text_content: VMQ01BeagleJournal
name: VMQ01BeagleJournal "VMQ01BeagleJournal" [DIAL:001618B4]

text_content: {Edited Line}{Speaking in Audio Log/Journal}This is most unusual! The Powder Gangers have visitors today. I guess there's a first for everything!|Now those tough-looking fellows must be Great Khans. I recognize those funny helmets and leather vests from stories I've heard...|So what are they doing with that dapper gentleman who wears a checked suit? I wouldn't mind a suit like that.|They're talking about heading south toward Nipton, then west to Novac where they'll meet up with someone...|I guess I could track them if I needed to, but {beat, cowardly justification}the town of Primm needs me here, to serve and protect.|Oh my. I think I've been spotted...
name: VMQ01BeagleJournal "VMQ01BeagleJournal" [DIAL:001618B4]
speaker: PrimmDeputy "Deputy Beagle" [NPC_:000D7F57]

text_content: <Speech Options>
name: nVPrimmDeputyConvPrimmDeputyTopic002 "<Speech Options>" [DIAL:001618B5]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Well, you look to be the trustworthy sort. Okay, I'll tell you what I know.
name: nVPrimmDeputyConvPrimmDeputyTopic002 "<Speech Options>" [DIAL:001618B5]
speaker: PrimmDeputy "Deputy Beagle" [NPC_:000D7F57]

text_content: [FAILED] I'm sure you mean well, but I'm afraid you'll have to wait until I'm in a calmer emotional state before my memory is going to function.
name: nVPrimmDeputyConvPrimmDeputyTopic002 "<Speech Options>" [DIAL:001618B5]
speaker: PrimmDeputy "Deputy Beagle" [NPC_:000D7F57]

text_content: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
name: nVPrimmDeputyConvPrimmDeputyTopic001 "Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?" [DIAL:001618B6]

text_content: {Edited Line}Indeed I do good sir, and I would be thrilled to share that information with you as soon as I am released from captivity.
name: nVPrimmDeputyConvPrimmDeputyTopic001 "Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?" [DIAL:001618B6]
speaker: PrimmDeputy "Deputy Beagle" [NPC_:000D7F57]

text_content: {Edited Line}My good lady, I believe I may have some information that would prove useful.|If you would just untie my hands I'd be more than happy to share what information I have with you.
name: nVPrimmDeputyConvPrimmDeputyTopic001 "Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?" [DIAL:001618B6]
speaker: PrimmDeputy "Deputy Beagle" [NPC_:000D7F57]

text_content: {Edited Line}I'm in quite a state here. If you help me with my bonds I'll be more than happy to tell you anything, and everything about those Khans.
name: nVPrimmDeputyConvPrimmDeputyTopic001 "Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?" [DIAL:001618B6]
speaker: PrimmDeputy "Deputy Beagle" [NPC_:000D7F57]

text_content: {Edited Line}Ahh yes, my memory is much clearer now that I am free from my bondage.|I was sku{skulking, rethinking}... er, performing recon, gathering information on some of the Powder Gangers, when some great Khans arrived with your friend in the suit.|They were talking about some delivery they took from a courier, I assume that was you.|They said they'd be heading through Nipton to Novac to meet a contact there.
name: nVPrimmDeputyConvPrimmDeputyTopic001 "Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?" [DIAL:001618B6]
speaker: PrimmDeputy "Deputy Beagle" [NPC_:000D7F57]

text_content: {Edited Line}I overheard them saying that they are on their way to Novac. If you want to follow them I strongly suggest that you follow the road through Nipton.|There are a lot of dangerous things out in the desert, and you won't have me with you to protect you, as I need to stay here and keep Primm safe.
name: nVPrimmDeputyConvPrimmDeputyTopic001 "Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?" [DIAL:001618B6]
speaker: PrimmDeputy "Deputy Beagle" [NPC_:000D7F57]

text_content: Earlier, it seemed like you knew Tabitha. What's the story there?
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic036 "Earlier, it seemed like you knew Tabitha. What's the story there?" [DIAL:001618FC]

text_content: Tabitha was {gramma's}grandma's squad leader when we both worked for the Master. She wasn't very nice at all, but she was good at the chopping.|Almost as good as Leo....
name: vDialogueLilyLilyTopic036 "Earlier, it seemed like you knew Tabitha. What's the story there?" [DIAL:001618FC]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: LilyTabitha
name: LilyTabitha "LilyTabitha" [DIAL:001618FD]

text_content: Tabitha! You naughty, naughty girl! Leo remembers what you did!
name: LilyTabitha "LilyTabitha" [DIAL:001618FD]
speaker: Lily "Lily" [CREA:0013D834]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsDocMitchellTopic006 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:00161F0E]

text_content: What'd you have in mind?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsDocMitchellTopic006 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:00161F0E]
speaker: DocMitchell "Doc Mitchell" [NPC_:00104C0C]

text_content: Is that when you settled out here with your wife?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsDocMitchellTopic005 "Is that when you settled out here with your wife?" [DIAL:00161F0F]

text_content: Eventually we made our way out here. But uh...|Well, when folks spend their lives in isolation, sometimes that ain't the best of things for learning to fight off germs.|We was going to California, but Goodsprings was as far as we got. After she passed, wasn't no reason to keep going.|I stayed so I could keep close to her.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsDocMitchellTopic005 "Is that when you settled out here with your wife?" [DIAL:00161F0F]
speaker: DocMitchell "Doc Mitchell" [NPC_:00104C0C]

text_content: I saw your old vault on the Strip. Vault 21, right? Mr. House filled it with concrete?
name: VFreeformGoodspringsDocMitchellTopic001 "I saw your old vault on the Strip. Vault 21, right? Mr. House filled it with concrete?" [DIAL:00161F10]

text_content: {Bitter, attempting to hide it}Yep. He sure did. Wanted himself a hotel, and to make sure once he made the change there'd never be any going back.|We didn't get a say. Don't know how you'd argue with a fella like that anyways, everywhere and nowhere all at once.|So just like that, we was all homeless. Went our separate ways, and that was all she wrote.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsDocMitchellTopic001 "I saw your old vault on the Strip. Vault 21, right? Mr. House filled it with concrete?" [DIAL:00161F10]
speaker: DocMitchell "Doc Mitchell" [NPC_:00104C0C]

text_content: You said before you had something taken from you.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsDocMitchellTopic000 "You said before you had something taken from you." [DIAL:00161F11]

text_content: Well, ain't we all, right? That was a long time ago. {Lying}I don't pay it much mind anymore.
name: VFreeformGoodspringsDocMitchellTopic000 "You said before you had something taken from you." [DIAL:00161F11]
speaker: DocMitchell "Doc Mitchell" [NPC_:00104C0C]

text_content: Give me a name, and I'll take care of it.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic048 "Give me a name, and I'll take care of it." [DIAL:00161F37]

text_content: Can you tell me anything more?
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic047 "Can you tell me anything more?" [DIAL:00161F38]

text_content: Forget it, I'll bring her here.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic046 "Forget it, I'll bring her here." [DIAL:00161F39]

text_content: Good, getting tired of questions from you when I should be getting answers. Bring her here.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic046 "Forget it, I'll bring her here." [DIAL:00161F39]
speaker: VFSJeanBaptisteCutting "Jean-Baptiste Cutting" [NPC_:0010C681]

text_content: I'm not doing this for you.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic045 "I'm not doing this for you." [DIAL:00161F3A]

text_content: {Frowns}Guess Gloria was wrong about you, then. Get out of here, you're no use to me.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic045 "I'm not doing this for you." [DIAL:00161F3A]
speaker: VFSJeanBaptisteCutting "Jean-Baptiste Cutting" [NPC_:0010C681]

text_content: Nowhere.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic044 "Nowhere." [DIAL:00161F3B]

text_content: "Nowhere's" a strange place to get an idea like that.|You know what, you're new. Gloria's not going to miss you. And I'm not going to risk you saying the same thing to that bitch I'm hunting for.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic044 "Nowhere." [DIAL:00161F3B]
speaker: VFSJeanBaptisteCutting "Jean-Baptiste Cutting" [NPC_:0010C681]

text_content: Found out from investigating the wreckage.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic043 "Found out from investigating the wreckage." [DIAL:00161F3C]

text_content: And after all the trouble I went through to kill all those witnesses. Guess now I have one more than I thought.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic043 "Found out from investigating the wreckage." [DIAL:00161F3C]
speaker: VFSJeanBaptisteCutting "Jean-Baptiste Cutting" [NPC_:0010C681]

text_content: These contract papers, for one.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic042 "These contract papers, for one." [DIAL:00161F3D]

text_content: So, looks like we have us a thief. All right, guess I'm talking to you instead of the girl.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic042 "These contract papers, for one." [DIAL:00161F3D]
speaker: VFSJeanBaptisteCutting "Jean-Baptiste Cutting" [NPC_:0010C681]

text_content: If I run across her, I'll let her know.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic040 "If I run across her, I'll let her know." [DIAL:00161F3E]

text_content: What did you want to talk to her about?
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic039 "What did you want to talk to her about?" [DIAL:00161F3F]

text_content: {Irritated}If your answer isn't "yes, I'll bring her here" or "no, I won't, cause Gloria had me pegged wrong," then we're done here.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic039 "What did you want to talk to her about?" [DIAL:00161F3F]
speaker: VFSJeanBaptisteCutting "Jean-Baptiste Cutting" [NPC_:0010C681]

text_content: Anything you can say to her, you can say to me.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic038 "Anything you can say to her, you can say to me." [DIAL:00161F40]

text_content: {Cold, angry that player is challenging him}You don't want {emph}us chatting, trust me. {Smooths out}As for the girl - I just want to talk to her. |And if you can't bring her here, you're no use to me - or Gloria. So if you want to cause trouble in here over nothing, then go on - try.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic038 "Anything you can say to her, you can say to me." [DIAL:00161F40]
speaker: VFSJeanBaptisteCutting "Jean-Baptiste Cutting" [NPC_:0010C681]

text_content: Why don't you do it?
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic037 "Why don't you do it?" [DIAL:00161F41]

text_content: I got business here, need to watch the shop, make sure things are running - smoothly.|{Slight mockery}Besides, if I came for the girl, I'm not all friendly and charming like you are. She might get the wrong idea.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic037 "Why don't you do it?" [DIAL:00161F41]
speaker: VFSJeanBaptisteCutting "Jean-Baptiste Cutting" [NPC_:0010C681]

text_content: Is it because the Van Graffs attacked her caravan?
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic036 "Is it because the Van Graffs attacked her caravan?" [DIAL:00161F42]

text_content: {Frowns}I had nothing to do with that, and neither did anyone here. Now where would you have gotten an idea like that?
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic036 "Is it because the Van Graffs attacked her caravan?" [DIAL:00161F42]
speaker: VFSJeanBaptisteCutting "Jean-Baptiste Cutting" [NPC_:0010C681]

text_content: Do you know where she is?
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic035 "Do you know where she is?" [DIAL:00161F43]

text_content: Fuck, no. If I knew where this bitch was, do you think I'd be asking you?|Still, there's someone who might - old Alice McLafferty, Crimson Caravan, might know something.|She keeps tabs on caravan traffic in the Mojave, wouldn't put it past her to keep track of Cassidy Caravans and its owner.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic035 "Do you know where she is?" [DIAL:00161F43]
speaker: VFSJeanBaptisteCutting "Jean-Baptiste Cutting" [NPC_:0010C681]

text_content: I doubt Cass will listen to anything I have to say.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic034 "I doubt Cass will listen to anything I have to say." [DIAL:00161F44]

text_content: {Slight mockery}What? You two on the outs? Ain't that a shame.|Guess you misheard me - I wasn't asking you a question. Find a way to get her here.|If you can't bring her here, then make sure she never leaves the Outpost, and that's {draws it out}fine with me.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic034 "I doubt Cass will listen to anything I have to say." [DIAL:00161F44]
speaker: VFSJeanBaptisteCutting "Jean-Baptiste Cutting" [NPC_:0010C681]

text_content: Cass? She's in the Mojave Outpost.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic033 "Cass? She's in the Mojave Outpost." [DIAL:00161F45]

text_content: {Chews it over}Really. NCR all around her.|Well, tell you what. You find a {emph}way to bring her here. She'll want to hear what I have to say.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic033 "Cass? She's in the Mojave Outpost." [DIAL:00161F45]
speaker: VFSJeanBaptisteCutting "Jean-Baptiste Cutting" [NPC_:0010C681]

text_content: Cass is dead.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic032 "Cass is dead." [DIAL:00161F46]

text_content: Dead? {Beat}What... by you? {Beat, admiring}Yeah, I can tell, you had something to do with it.|{Nods, impressed}Gloria was right about you. You take care of business before it's a problem.
name: VMS29aVFSJeanBaptisteCuttingTopic032 "Cass is dead." [DIAL:00161F46]
speaker: VFSJeanBaptisteCutting "Jean-Baptiste Cutting" [NPC_:0010C681]

text_content: [Terrifying Presence] Raise that gun, and I'll kill everyone in here.

text_content: HiddenValleyRepConsequences
name: HiddenValleyRepConsequences "HiddenValleyRepConsequences" [DIAL:00161F6A]

text_content: Don't think everyone around here is going to tolerate your actions, outsider. A few of us have a mind to put you down like the animal you are.|If I or one of the others hears that you're topside, we might just come out and have a little chat.
name: HiddenValleyRepConsequences "HiddenValleyRepConsequences" [DIAL:00161F6A]

text_content: You may have questionable methods, outsider, but some of us realize you get the job done.|We've talked Torres into giving you access to gear for a little cheaper, to help out with your travels. Hope it helps!
name: HiddenValleyRepConsequences "HiddenValleyRepConsequences" [DIAL:00161F6A]

text_content: There you are! A few of us wanted to thank you for being such a good friend to the Brotherhood, so we've set aside some of our recycled energy cells.|We'll leave a few of them in that footlocker in the corner every so often. The Paladins scoff at using recycled ammo, so no one should mind.
name: HiddenValleyRepConsequences "HiddenValleyRepConsequences" [DIAL:00161F6A]

text_content: VEndingCourierFemale
name: VEndingCourierFemale "VEndingCourierFemale" [DIAL:00161FE9]

text_content: {Narration, Good Karma, NCR Victory, Female}The Courier, fair and even-handed in her dealings throughout the Wasteland, was honored by the NCR for her support of the military at Hoover Dam.|{Narration}She was presented with the Golden Branch, the highest civilian decoration given by the Republic.
name: VEndingCourierFemale "VEndingCourierFemale" [DIAL:00161FE9]

text_content: {Narration, Neutral Karma, NCR Victory, Female}Though the Courier's agenda was a mystery to many, she was honored by NCR for her support of the military at Hoover Dam.|{Narration}She was presented with the Golden Branch, the highest civilian decoration given by the Republic.
name: VEndingCourierFemale "VEndingCourierFemale" [DIAL:00161FE9]

text_content: {Narration, Evil Karma, NCR Victory, Female}With brutal methods that few in NCR would approve of, it was the Courier who secured NCR's victory at Hoover Dam.|{Narration}Despite her extreme actions, she was awarded with the Golden Branch, the highest civilian decoration given by the Republic.
name: VEndingCourierFemale "VEndingCourierFemale" [DIAL:00161FE9]

text_content: {Narration, Good Karma, Legion Victory, Female}Though the Courier herself was just and forthright in her dealings throughout the Wasteland, she helped the Legion achieve victory.|{Narration}Caesar honored her with a golden coin, minted in celebration of her contributions and distributed throughout the wasteland.
name: VEndingCourierFemale "VEndingCourierFemale" [DIAL:00161FE9]

text_content: {Narration, Neutral Karma, Legion Victory, Female}The Courier, a mercenary at heart, helped the Legion achieve victory at Hoover Dam.|{Narration}Caesar honored her with a golden coin, minted in celebration of her contributions and distributed throughout the wasteland.
name: VEndingCourierFemale "VEndingCourierFemale" [DIAL:00161FE9]

text_content: {Narration, Evil Karma, Legion Victory, Female}The Legion marched over the Hoover Dam with the help of one who was as brutal and merciless as the worst of them: The Courier.|{Narration}Caesar honored her with a  golden coin, minted in celebration of her contributions and distributed throughout the wasteland.
name: VEndingCourierFemale "VEndingCourierFemale" [DIAL:00161FE9]

text_content: {Narration, Good Karma, House Victory, Female}The Courier, fair and kind-hearted to those in the Wasteland, ensured that Mr. House would keep New Vegas stable and secure for future generations.|{Narrating}Mr. House afforded her every luxury at his disposal in the Lucky 38, both out of gratitude and a quiet pride in his choice of lieutenants.
name: VEndingCourierFemale "VEndingCourierFemale" [DIAL:00161FE9]

text_content: {Narration, Neutral Karma, House Victory, Female}The Courier, who had a mixed history in the Wasteland, kept the status quo at Hoover Dam.|{Narration}Mr. House kept New Vegas stable, if not free, for generations, and afforded the Courier every luxury at his disposal in the Lucky 38.
name: VEndingCourierFemale "VEndingCourierFemale" [DIAL:00161FE9]

text_content: {Narration, Evil Karma, House Victory, Female}The Courier, cruel and merciless, had ensured that Mr. House would maintain complete control over New Vegas and everyone in it.|{Narration}Mr. House afforded her every luxury at his disposal in the Lucky 38, mostly as a reward, but partly out of fear.
name: VEndingCourierFemale "VEndingCourierFemale" [DIAL:00161FE9]

text_content: {Narration, Good Karma, Indy Vegas, Female}Supporting the ideals of independence, the Courier was recognized as the woman responsible for a truly free New Vegas. |{Narration}She ensured that Mr. House's tyranny was broken and that neither Caesar's Legion nor NCR would ever gain control over New Vegas.
name: VEndingCourierFemale "VEndingCourierFemale" [DIAL:00161FE9]

text_content: {Narration, Neutral Karma, Indy Vegas, Female}Preferring neither the best of the NCR nor the worst of the Legion, the Courier was the woman responsible for a truly independent New Vegas.|{Narration}She had removed Mr. House from power over the Strip and broken the influence of the NCR and Caesar's Legion in the Mojave Wasteland.
name: VEndingCourierFemale "VEndingCourierFemale" [DIAL:00161FE9]

text_content: {Narration, Evil Karma, Indy Vegas, Female}Supporting all of the chaos that comes with independence, the Courier was the woman responsible for a truly free New Vegas.|{Narration}She ensured the fall of Mr. House and the end of the Legion's and NCR's influence over New Vegas.
name: VEndingCourierFemale "VEndingCourierFemale" [DIAL:00161FE9]

name: VFreeformFreesideVFSBaitThugTopic002 "Ooh, look. A body. I really should be going." [DIAL:001628E4]

name: VFreeformFreesideVFSBaitThugTopic001 "Friend of yours?" [DIAL:001628E5]

name: VFreeformFreesideVFSBaitThugTopic001 "Friend of yours?" [DIAL:001628E5]
