text_content: FreesideRepConsequences
name: FreesideRepConsequences "FreesideRepConsequences" [DIAL:001628E7]

text_content: Hey, you're the one who's been going around helping people around here, right? The King says to keep up the good work, and said to give you this.
name: FreesideRepConsequences "FreesideRepConsequences" [DIAL:001628E7]

text_content: You're starting to get quite the reputation around here, aren't you? Don't get me wrong, I'm not passing judgement or anything.|The fine proprietors of Mick & Ralph's appreciate that kind of attitude, and would like to offer you a discount on their fine wares.|Just as long as you keep making waves, that is. Be seeing you.
name: FreesideRepConsequences "FreesideRepConsequences" [DIAL:001628E7]

text_content: {Starts off blustering, ends up blubbering}Give me all of your {caps}ca- whoa, I'm sorry. I-I didn't know it was you. Please don't hurt me. I've got a wife! And kids! And pets and stuff!
name: FreesideRepConsequences "FreesideRepConsequences" [DIAL:001628E7]

name: VikkiVanceCasinoManagerTopic "VikkiVanceCasinoManagerTopic" [DIAL:001630F1]

name: VikkiVanceCasinoManagerTopic "VikkiVanceCasinoManagerTopic" [DIAL:001630F1]

text_content: {Big Winner}You're doing great! Keep on spending money, hopefully we'll get some extra action in here.
name: VikkiVanceCasinoManagerTopic "VikkiVanceCasinoManagerTopic" [DIAL:001630F1]

text_content: {Whale}You're the luckiest player I've ever seen. Keep up the good work in here.
name: VikkiVanceCasinoManagerTopic "VikkiVanceCasinoManagerTopic" [DIAL:001630F1]

text_content: {Banned}I'm sorry, you've done so much good stuff for us here in Primm, but we just can't afford to lose any more money to you.|I can't let you play here anymore.
name: VikkiVanceCasinoManagerTopic "VikkiVanceCasinoManagerTopic" [DIAL:001630F1]

text_content: Ted's dead.
name: VMS18VMS18HeckGundersonTopic022 "Ted's dead." [DIAL:001630F9]

text_content: {Breaking - his son died}Confound it. I knew I shoulda stayed with him. Ted, I'm so sorry, boy.|I demand to know who did this!
name: VMS18VMS18HeckGundersonTopic022 "Ted's dead." [DIAL:001630F9]

text_content: Ted's been kidnapped. He's here in the hotel.
name: VMS18VMS18HeckGundersonTopic021 "Ted's been kidnapped. He's here in the hotel." [DIAL:001630FA]

text_content: He's here? Bless you, I thought he was a goner for sure.|Listen, you do what you gotta do to find him. I'd send my men with you but I'm worried they'd kill Ted if we got close.|Reckon you might need one of these. Take it. Just don't wave it around here where they might take it from you.
name: VMS18VMS18HeckGundersonTopic021 "Ted's been kidnapped. He's here in the hotel." [DIAL:001630FA]

If they made off with anything expensive, we'd be hurting something fierce.|But I will say this. If all of 'em turned up dead tomorrow, I couldn't see as to how they'd be missed.|That might even be a desirable thing, knowing the town was safe from the likes of them. There'd be a reward in it if some brave soul made it happen.

text_content: RadioOpLine01
name: RadioOpLine01 "RadioOpLine01" [DIAL:00163168]

text_content: Why is the NCR interested in this desert?
name: nVPrimmDeputyConvPrimmCorporalHayesTopic014 "Why is the NCR interested in this desert?" [DIAL:0016317D]

text_content: It is no secret. Our interest here is two fold.|First, we want to remain in control of Hoover Dam. It supplies the Republic with power, and is a source of fresh water.|Second, we want to prevent the Legion from advancing across the Colorado River and endangering the home states.
name: nVPrimmDeputyConvPrimmCorporalHayesTopic014 "Why is the NCR interested in this desert?" [DIAL:0016317D]
speaker: PrimmCorporalHayes "Lieutenant Hayes" [NPC_:000E2C94]

text_content: What's the Legion?
name: nVPrimmDeputyConvPrimmCorporalHayesTopic012 "What's the Legion?" [DIAL:0016317E]

text_content: Caesar's Legion.{Lots of spite}|A bunch of degenerate slavers, led by a madman who calls himself Caesar. Every one of them is a barbarian to the last.|I've even heard one of their leaders, the Legate or something, goes around with a human skull on his head. Savages to the last.
name: nVPrimmDeputyConvPrimmCorporalHayesTopic012 "What's the Legion?" [DIAL:0016317E]
speaker: PrimmCorporalHayes "Lieutenant Hayes" [NPC_:000E2C94]

text_content: Can you tell me more about the NCR?
name: nVPrimmDeputyConvPrimmCorporalHayesTopic011 "Can you tell me more about the NCR?" [DIAL:0016317F]

text_content: Sure can. The NCR was founded from the survivors of one of the great Vaults. We started as a small settlement called Shady Sands.|We now consist of 5 states, that make up the greatest nation since the Great War.
name: nVPrimmDeputyConvPrimmCorporalHayesTopic011 "Can you tell me more about the NCR?" [DIAL:0016317F]
speaker: PrimmCorporalHayes "Lieutenant Hayes" [NPC_:000E2C94]

text_content: What's the New California Republic?
name: nVPrimmDeputyConvPrimmCorporalHayesTopic010 "What's the New California Republic?" [DIAL:00163180]

text_content: Where do you come from that you haven't heard of the NCR? Nevermind, it doesn't matter much.|If you haven't heard of us, you must not be from the Legion. Put simply, the NCR is the greatest nation currently functioning.
name: nVPrimmDeputyConvPrimmCorporalHayesTopic010 "What's the New California Republic?" [DIAL:00163180]
speaker: PrimmCorporalHayes "Lieutenant Hayes" [NPC_:000E2C94]

text_content: What was Project SEMELE?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic034 "What was Project SEMELE?" [DIAL:0016320B]

text_content: Another one of Poseidon Energy's many secret weapons projects. Before the Great War. It didn't go anywhere.|That's how REPCONN got their shot. So to speak.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic034 "What was Project SEMELE?" [DIAL:0016320B]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: An odd combination.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic033 "An odd combination." [DIAL:0016320C]

text_content: REPCONN went through some rough times. When their rocket business was shaky, Mr. House purchased the company.|It didn't take long for him to repurpose their plasma technology for a government weapon contract.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic033 "An odd combination." [DIAL:0016320C]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: What kind of prototypes?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic032 "What kind of prototypes?" [DIAL:0016320D]

text_content: Plasma rifles. They were intended to replace the P94 plasma caster.|There was some corporate espionage going on between Poseidon Energy's Project SEMELE and whatever was going on here.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic032 "What kind of prototypes?" [DIAL:0016320D]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: I need a good-looking doctor to help take care of me in the big, bad wasteland.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic031 "I need a good-looking doctor to help take care of me in the big, bad wasteland." [DIAL:0016320E]

text_content: Overt flirtation will get you everywhere, you know.|On a slightly more serious note, if you're interested in helping out with the troubles plaguing Freeside, I can come with you.|Just don't do anything obnoxious, like trying to help Caesar's Legion, and we should be fine. Understood?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic031 "I need a good-looking doctor to help take care of me in the big, bad wasteland." [DIAL:0016320E]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Well, uh... on second thought...
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic030 "Well, uh... on second thought..." [DIAL:0016320F]

text_content: Of course. I'm not interested in helping the Legion.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic029 "Of course. I'm not interested in helping the Legion." [DIAL:00163210]

text_content: Oh, well... in that case, never mind.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic028 "Oh, well... in that case, never mind." [DIAL:00163211]

text_content: I'm not sure why you thought a Follower would want to help Caesar after all of the misery he's visited on us and the people we try to help.|Well, good luck to you in your future endeavors, assuming they don't involve Caesar.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic028 "Oh, well... in that case, never mind." [DIAL:00163211]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Fair enough.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic027 "Fair enough." [DIAL:00163212]

text_content: All right. Let's not waste any time. {a bit of enthusiasm}There are people out there to help, things to learn. Maybe not in that order, but let's get to it.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic027 "Fair enough." [DIAL:00163212]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Uh... it beats sitting around here all day, doesn't it?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic026 "Uh... it beats sitting around here all day, doesn't it?" [DIAL:00163213]

text_content: {slight mockery}Uh... probably not. Until things settle down around here, alleviating my boredom isn't a good motive to leave. Sorry.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic026 "Uh... it beats sitting around here all day, doesn't it?" [DIAL:00163213]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Ugh. Well if you're going to be like that then never mind.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic025 "Ugh. Well if you're going to be like that then never mind." [DIAL:00163214]

text_content: Yes. The Followers do not like Caesar or Caesar's Legion. You should also not like them. If you do, you like hurting people and that is bad. Goodbye.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic025 "Ugh. Well if you're going to be like that then never mind." [DIAL:00163214]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Yeah, I guess. So are you coming with me or what?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic024 "Yeah, I guess. So are you coming with me or what?" [DIAL:00163215]

text_content: This place is really complicated and stuff. You're smart. Can you help me do... things?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic023 "This place is really complicated and stuff. You're smart. Can you help me do... things?" [DIAL:00163216]

text_content: Hmm. Wow. You sound like you really do need some help. Look, I can help you out, but you can't do anything stu-|I mean, you can't... help bad people, who want to hurt the locals in Freeside. If you do, I'll leave. Does that make sense?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic023 "This place is really complicated and stuff. You're smart. Can you help me do... things?" [DIAL:00163216]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Things are bad around here. I'd like to make a difference, and I'd like you to help me.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic022 "Things are bad around here. I'd like to make a difference, and I'd like you to help me." [DIAL:00163217]

text_content: Hmm. That seems appropriately resolute and yet vague. I'll give you the benefit of the doubt and go with you, but let me be clear about something.|If you plan to help Caesar's Legion, this is going to be a brief relationship.|I may not have all the answers for how to fix Freeside's problems, but Caesar taking control isn't part of the solution. Fair?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic022 "Things are bad around here. I'd like to make a difference, and I'd like you to help me." [DIAL:00163217]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: The NCR oppression around here would disappear if the Legion took control. I could use your help.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic021 "The NCR oppression around here would disappear if the Legion took control. I could use your help." [DIAL:00163218]

text_content: Only because everyone would be conscripted or enslaved. And the people who are unfit for military service or slavery would be put down. Swell plan.|Yes, a veritable {pahx roh-MAH-nah}Pax Romana for post-nuclear America. My political beliefs are a bit more progressive than outright fascism, so I'll pass. Thanks.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic021 "The NCR oppression around here would disappear if the Legion took control. I could use your help." [DIAL:00163218]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: If New Vegas can remain independent, I'm going to find a way to do it. I could use your help.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic020 "If New Vegas can remain independent, I'm going to find a way to do it. I could use your help." [DIAL:00163219]

text_content: If that's really what you're trying to do, I'll go with you.|Things are hectic around here, but it won't mean anything if NCR or the Legion take control. I'm sure the Followers can manage without me.|Just don't try to help the Legion, and we shouldn't have any problems. Sound good?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic020 "If New Vegas can remain independent, I'm going to find a way to do it. I could use your help." [DIAL:00163219]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: I'm trying to help Mr. House keep New Vegas independent.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic019 "I'm trying to help Mr. House keep New Vegas independent." [DIAL:0016321A]

text_content: That's funny. Mr. House doesn't want to keep New Vegas independent. He just wants to keep the NCR and Caesar's Legion from pushing him around.|He must be pretty convincing if he's roped you into helping him, but you can count me out.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic019 "I'm trying to help Mr. House keep New Vegas independent." [DIAL:0016321A]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: The NCR needs help against the Legion before Caesar moves on the dam. We could use your skills.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic018 "The NCR needs help against the Legion before Caesar moves on the dam. We could use your skills." [DIAL:0016321B]

text_content: The NCR had a chance to use the Followers' skills before, but being imperialists mattered more to them. No thanks.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic018 "The NCR needs help against the Legion before Caesar moves on the dam. We could use your skills." [DIAL:0016321B]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: I'm going after a man named Benny for revenge and I need someone to keep me patched up.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic017 "I'm going after a man named Benny for revenge and I need someone to keep me patched up." [DIAL:0016321C]

text_content: Pulling bullets out of a vengeance-crazed drifter is truly a noble step up from tending to the downtrodden of Freeside, but I think I'll pass.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic017 "I'm going after a man named Benny for revenge and I need someone to keep me patched up." [DIAL:0016321C]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: What do you know about them?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic046 "What do you know about them?" [DIAL:0016322F]

text_content: Uh, what does anyone know about them? Big... flying machines, right? Crazy helicopters. {quietly}So weird.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic046 "What do you know about them?" [DIAL:0016322F]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: When was that?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic045 "When was that?" [DIAL:00163230]

text_content: Huh. {trying to think of a plausible lie}Good question. Must have been in a book.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic045 "When was that?" [DIAL:00163230]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Anderson killed White. He deserved to pay for what he did.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic044 "Anderson killed White. He deserved to pay for what he did." [DIAL:00163231]

text_content: Fantastic. Now the only influential person who gave a damn about Westside is gone. Great job.|In case I'm not laying down enough sarcasm, you just screwed up the lives of a bunch of struggling people.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic044 "Anderson killed White. He deserved to pay for what he did." [DIAL:00163231]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: What's done is done.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic043 "What's done is done." [DIAL:00163232]

text_content: {irritated}I guess that means you don't have to apologize to all of the people in Westside you just screwed over.|In case you weren't paying attention, you killed the only person who ever gave a damn about them.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic043 "What's done is done." [DIAL:00163232]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: I'm sorry. I didn't realize it would end like this.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic042 "I'm sorry. I didn't realize it would end like this." [DIAL:00163233]

text_content: {sighing, pause}Neither did Anderson.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic042 "I'm sorry. I didn't realize it would end like this." [DIAL:00163233]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Let's keep moving.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic041 "Let's keep moving." [DIAL:00163234]

text_content: Of course.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic041 "Let's keep moving." [DIAL:00163234]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: If you say so. I'm not arguing.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic040 "If you say so. I'm not arguing." [DIAL:00163235]

text_content: I do say so. The Followers aren't a military organization. If anyone knew what he was up to, they weren't talking.|And if they knew he was stealing water, so what? Westside has more of a right to that water than the NCR.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic040 "If you say so. I'm not arguing." [DIAL:00163235]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Right. "The Followers don't endorse his actions," and all that.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic039 "Right. ""The Followers don't endorse his actions,"" and all that." [DIAL:00163236]

text_content: Well {emph}I don't. I'm sure there were a few people turning a blind eye, but can you blame them?|NCR's sharecropper farms had all of the water. The nearest fresh source is the lake, and that's a bit of a hike.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic039 "Right. ""The Followers don't endorse his actions,"" and all that." [DIAL:00163236]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic038 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00163237]

text_content: See you around.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic038 "Goodbye." [DIAL:00163237]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: What kind of research do you do?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic036 "What kind of research do you do?" [DIAL:00163239]

text_content: Do you need any help?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic035 "Do you need any help?" [DIAL:0016323A]

text_content: Me, specifically? No. I'm sure Julie Farkas does, though. Lab coat, pointy hair. Answers to the name "Julie Farkas," strangely enough.|I'm sure she can find something for you to do. It might be kind of... depressing and terrible, though. {cah-WEE-aht sah-mahr-ee-TAH-noos, "Samaritan, beware."}Caveat Samaritanus.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic035 "Do you need any help?" [DIAL:0016323A]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Personally, no. But thanks to you, Julie says we're a lot better off these days. I'll take her word for it. So, thanks.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic035 "Do you need any help?" [DIAL:0016323A]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: It says a superior is not allowed to give orders to the men under his subordinate.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic033 "It says a superior is not allowed to give orders to the men under his subordinate." [DIAL:00163246]

text_content: Then that means I can cast McNamara down for giving those secret orders to my Paladins! Well done! That's exactly what I was looking for!
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic033 "It says a superior is not allowed to give orders to the men under his subordinate." [DIAL:00163246]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: That is the standard procedure, yes. For example, McNamara gives orders to Head Scribe Taggart, who then relays further orders to the scribes.|I wasn't aware that failing to do so was punishable, however. Interesting...|If we can just find an instance where McNamara went around someone and gave orders to their subordinates, we'll have him.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic033 "It says a superior is not allowed to give orders to the men under his subordinate." [DIAL:00163246]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: Did you know there's a second part to it?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic032 "Did you know there's a second part to it?" [DIAL:00163247]

text_content: Second part? What are you talking about?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic032 "Did you know there's a second part to it?" [DIAL:00163247]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: One of the few times an Elder was dismissed was due to it.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic031 "One of the few times an Elder was dismissed was due to it." [DIAL:00163248]

text_content: I could be wrong, but I think that's a dead end. McNamara's always followed orders, and we've been incommunicado since fleeing HELIOS.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic031 "One of the few times an Elder was dismissed was due to it." [DIAL:00163248]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: Do you know anything about the Chain That Binds?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic029 "Do you know anything about the Chain That Binds?" [DIAL:0016324A]

text_content: I could hardly call myself Head Paladin if I didn't. It's one of the first things every initiate learns when they start training. What about it?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic029 "Do you know anything about the Chain That Binds?" [DIAL:0016324A]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: I found the patrols for the Elder, and they had mission discs with orders from McNamara on them.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic028 "I found the patrols for the Elder, and they had mission discs with orders from McNamara on them." [DIAL:0016324B]

text_content: {Increasingly angry}Just as I thought, McNamara gave my men new orders without telling me. The nerve of that man!|This little stunt is probably what got them killed in the first place. Our normal patrol routes are known to be relatively safe.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic028 "I found the patrols for the Elder, and they had mission discs with orders from McNamara on them." [DIAL:0016324B]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: This is exactly what I've been looking for! McNamara gave my men new orders without telling me, thereby breaking the Chain That Binds!|With this, I can finally have him removed as Elder, and end this ridiculous lockdown.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic028 "I found the patrols for the Elder, and they had mission discs with orders from McNamara on them." [DIAL:0016324B]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: This is exactly the kind of thing I'm trying to avoid by ousting McNamara.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic028 "I found the patrols for the Elder, and they had mission discs with orders from McNamara on them." [DIAL:0016324B]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: I wanted to ask you some other questions.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic026 "I wanted to ask you some other questions." [DIAL:0016324D]

text_content: If you must.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic026 "I wanted to ask you some other questions." [DIAL:0016324D]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: The Elder has me looking for parts to fix the bunker's air filtration system.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic025 "The Elder has me looking for parts to fix the bunker's air filtration system." [DIAL:0016324E]

text_content: The filtration system? He wouldn't have you looking if we didn't need those parts badly, which means that system's in real trouble.|If the air filters go, it will become impossible to breathe down here. We'd be forced to evacuate the bunker!|I can't believe he's kept something like this to himself! We should have every able-bodied person in the chapter working on this.|All the more reason for you to find a way to get McNamara out of that chair, before he dooms us all.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic025 "The Elder has me looking for parts to fix the bunker's air filtration system." [DIAL:0016324E]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: The Elder tasked me with contacting several scouts out in the waste.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic024 "The Elder tasked me with contacting several scouts out in the waste." [DIAL:0016324F]

text_content: That's a sensible notion. Your familiarity with the nearby terrain makes you perfect as a liason.|I've been trying to get the Elder to send out scouts for years, and he's always been resistant to the idea. Said they'd be a vulnerability.|I wonder what changed his mind.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic024 "The Elder tasked me with contacting several scouts out in the waste." [DIAL:0016324F]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: The Elder has me looking for the lost patrols and retrieving their mission discs.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic023 "The Elder has me looking for the lost patrols and retrieving their mission discs." [DIAL:00163250]

text_content: Yes, I know the loss of the patrols has weighed heavily on his mind for some time. He took it very personally when they first went missing.|That was when I first began to seriously question his ability to lead us. A commander has to be able to deal with the potential loss of his men.|It's strange that he would ask you to find mission discs on them, however. The missing paladins were all on standard patrols, which don't need them.|Only Brothers sent on special assignments are given mission discs. If you should find any on the lost patrols, let me know.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic023 "The Elder has me looking for the lost patrols and retrieving their mission discs." [DIAL:00163250]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: I wanted to ask you some questions.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic019 "I wanted to ask you some questions." [DIAL:00163252]

text_content: Sure, what about?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic019 "I wanted to ask you some questions." [DIAL:00163252]
speaker: HVKnightEDE "Senior Knight Lorenzo" [NPC_:000A41A3]

text_content: No, I haven't found any of them yet.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic018 "No, I haven't found any of them yet." [DIAL:00163253]

text_content: I don't want to rush you or anything, but time is of the essence. Please try to find those components as soon as you can.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic018 "No, I haven't found any of them yet." [DIAL:00163253]
speaker: HVKnightEDE "Senior Knight Lorenzo" [NPC_:000A41A3]

text_content: Not all of them.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic017 "Not all of them." [DIAL:00163254]

text_content: It's amazing that you've found any of them and not gotten gruesomely mangled. Keep up the good work!
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic017 "Not all of them." [DIAL:00163254]
speaker: HVKnightEDE "Senior Knight Lorenzo" [NPC_:000A41A3]

text_content: They're all right here.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic016 "They're all right here." [DIAL:00163255]

text_content: {Had serious doubts the player could do it}Really? I mean, that's great! I knew you could do it all along. I'll get right to work installing these.|Why don't you go tell the Elder the good news. I'm sure it'll be a huge load off of his shoulders.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic016 "They're all right here." [DIAL:00163255]
speaker: HVKnightEDE "Senior Knight Lorenzo" [NPC_:000A41A3]

text_content: Just give the details.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic015 "Just give the details." [DIAL:00163256]

text_content: The items I'll need to keep the system running are a differential pressure controller, a reverse pulse cleaner, and several {HEP-uh} HEPA cartridge filters.|At present, my best guess for finding the items would be to search any of the old vaults in the area.|Those vaults were usually built much like these military bunkers, even using the same contractors in their constructions at times.|I'll mark the vaults' locations on your map. Best of luck to you.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic015 "Just give the details." [DIAL:00163256]
speaker: HVKnightEDE "Senior Knight Lorenzo" [NPC_:000A41A3]

text_content: Maybe you misheard me.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic013 "Maybe you misheard me." [DIAL:00163257]

text_content: No, I heard you quite clearly. You're being sent off to be killed like the others.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic013 "Maybe you misheard me." [DIAL:00163257]
speaker: HVKnightEDE "Senior Knight Lorenzo" [NPC_:000A41A3]

text_content: Er, what?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic012 "Er, what?" [DIAL:00163258]

text_content: {scornful, with a little hysteria}You think you're the first person the Elder's trusted with this? He sent three of our patrols out looking for those components, and they're all dead.|I was the one who supplied the Elder with the location of possible sites where we could find the components, so their deaths are my fault.|{speaking somewhat quickly, nervous}And now it's your turn. Well, don't say you weren't warned. I won't take the blame when you die horribly. But I can tell you're getting impatient.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic012 "Er, what?" [DIAL:00163258]
speaker: HVKnightEDE "Senior Knight Lorenzo" [NPC_:000A41A3]

text_content: The Elder wants me to retrieve components to help fix the air filtration system.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic002 "The Elder wants me to retrieve components to help fix the air filtration system." [DIAL:00163259]

text_content: {Beat}...So now I'm going to have your death on my conscience, too. Great.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVKnightEDETopic002 "The Elder wants me to retrieve components to help fix the air filtration system." [DIAL:00163259]
speaker: HVKnightEDE "Senior Knight Lorenzo" [NPC_:000A41A3]

text_content: Go on.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic032 "Go on." [DIAL:0016325A]

text_content: The device that creates the sandstorms above, that masks our comings and goings, was only intended to be used in case of emergencies.|It was never meant to be used with any regularity, and the other systems here were not designed to accommodate such usage.|In particular, the air filtration system simply cannot handle the quantity of sand and grit that it's been forced to cope with these last few years.|As a result, the system is failing, albeit slowly. I'm told we have scant few months before it shuts down completely.|Should that happen, it will quickly become impossible to breathe here in the bunker. Already the air quality begins to slightly worsen.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic032 "Go on." [DIAL:0016325A]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: Just tell me what you want me to do.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic031 "Just tell me what you want me to do." [DIAL:0016325B]

text_content: I would like you to find the components we need to fix this bunker's air filtration system. I cannot overstate the importance of this task.|See Senior Knight Lorenzo for the details. He's the one who brought the matter to my attention, and the only other person who is aware of it.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic031 "Just tell me what you want me to do." [DIAL:0016325B]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: One of the datastore entries mentioned the Chain That Binds. What is that, exactly?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyRamosTopic021 "One of the datastore entries mentioned the Chain That Binds. What is that, exactly?" [DIAL:0016325C]

text_content: That's an old, old principle that's been around since the Brotherhood was founded. It basically means that you have to obey a superior officer.|It's pretty much common sense, but it gets invoked a lot when people get pissy about following orders.|If you're curious, I'll give you access to the datastore entry on it. You'd probably be the first to read it in years, if not decades.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyRamosTopic021 "One of the datastore entries mentioned the Chain That Binds. What is that, exactly?" [DIAL:0016325C]
speaker: Ramos "Paladin Ramos" [NPC_:000E27E4]

text_content: How do I get access to more topics in the datastore?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic025 "How do I get access to more topics in the datastore?" [DIAL:0016325D]

text_content: Well, you'd have to get a senior-level member of the chapter to unlock a topic for you. I've given you access to what I can, but that's not much.|The majority of topics fall under Ramos's aegis, since they'd constitute a security risk. Good luck getting anything out of him.|You might have better luck with another member of the senior staff. Try talking to them about it.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyHVScribeIbsenTopic025 "How do I get access to more topics in the datastore?" [DIAL:0016325D]
speaker: HVScribeIbsen "Scribe Ibsen" [NPC_:0010AF1B]

text_content: He was going to leave if he couldn't get his radio working. So I destroyed it.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic030 "He was going to leave if he couldn't get his radio working. So I destroyed it." [DIAL:0016325E]

text_content: I see. And he's not particularly likely to come back, since he's learned that the bunkers here aren't secure enough to serve as safehouses.|It's not a foolproof solution, but indirect methods rarely are. What matters is that you drove him off without alerting him to our presence.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic030 "He was going to leave if he couldn't get his radio working. So I destroyed it." [DIAL:0016325E]

text_content: I convinced him that staying here was more dangerous than moving on.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic029 "I convinced him that staying here was more dangerous than moving on." [DIAL:0016325F]

text_content: Yes, you exploited his fear of Powder Gangers very effectively. The collar includes a microphone, you see. Part of the test.|He'll keep his distance, setting ambushes, never suspecting that these bunkers house something far more dangerous to him than criminals. Well-played.

The man's been manipulating the locals for as long as anyone can remember.|If you help him kick the NCR and Legion out, he's going to keep right on doing it. The people in Freeside will be just as bad off as they ever were.|If you can find a way to push Mr. House out of the picture as well, I think everyone will be better off.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic055 "What's your opinion on the current situation?" [DIAL:0016337D]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Helping the NCR is better than helping Mr. House, but I don't think it's the best solution for the people in New Vegas.|If the NCR can take full control of Freeside and the Strip, it's going to get worse before it gets better.|Besides, even if New Vegas eventually gets representation in the NCR senate, it's not like the NCR runs efficiently.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic055 "What's your opinion on the current situation?" [DIAL:0016337D]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: I think you're on the right track.|The only way to ensure relative safety and independence for the people of New Vegas is to prevent others from taking control of the region.|That means no NCR, no Mr. House, and no Legion.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic055 "What's your opinion on the current situation?" [DIAL:0016337D]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: It could be better. If we can find a way to work toward the independence of New Vegas, that would be ideal.|But really, as long as you don't help out the Legion, anything's better than that.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic055 "What's your opinion on the current situation?" [DIAL:0016337D]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Tell me about yourself.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic054 "Tell me about yourself." [DIAL:0016337E]

text_content: I'm really very boring. You'd get better stories out of a Freeside junkie.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic054 "Tell me about yourself." [DIAL:0016337E]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: I'm not interested.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic082 "I'm not interested." [DIAL:00163396]

text_content: {surprised}Oh. {beat}After spilling my guts to you, I wasn't expecting that kind of a response but... I understand.|If you change your mind, let me know. It would mean a lot to me.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic082 "I'm not interested." [DIAL:00163396]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Say no more. I'll do it.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic081 "Say no more. I'll do it." [DIAL:00163397]

text_content: Great! {excited}I'd like you to talk to the old-timers, the Remnants. I don't think I can convince them by myself. To them, I'm still a kid.|But you're a big part of what's happening out here. When you talk to them, they'll understand how important this all is.|I've kept in contact with them over the years, so I know where you can find them, but I doubt they'll open up to you unless I come along.|I know I'm not always the most serious guy around, but this means a lot to me. Thanks.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic081 "Say no more. I'll do it." [DIAL:00163397]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Do you want them to help NCR?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic080 "Do you want them to help NCR?" [DIAL:00163398]

text_content: That's a hard question to answer. I know I don't want the Legion to take Hoover Dam.|So militarily, yes, I want them to help NCR. If possible, I'd like to figure out a way to help the NCR win Hoover Dam without holding New Vegas.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic080 "Do you want them to help NCR?" [DIAL:00163398]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Where are you going with all this?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic079 "Where are you going with all this?" [DIAL:00163399]

text_content: The Enclave did a lot of bad things, but there were good people at Navarro. Good people with a lot of experience.|Not many of them are alive anymore, but I think they could make a difference in the fight against Caesar.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic079 "Where are you going with all this?" [DIAL:00163399]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: What happened to Navarro?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic078 "What happened to Navarro?" [DIAL:0016339A]

text_content: After the Enclave's command structure fell apart, it was only a matter of time before Navarro was overrun by NCR forces.|My mother and I left with some of the troopers from my father's old unit, the same people I've kept in contact with over the years.|Anyone who didn't get out was killed by the NCR. Even some of the ones who escaped were eventually hunted down by the Brotherhood of Steel.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic078 "What happened to Navarro?" [DIAL:0016339A]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Where did the Enclave go?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic077 "Where did the Enclave go?" [DIAL:0016339B]

text_content: A lot of different places. I only know what I was told. Some of them were cut down by the NCR and the Brotherhood. Some of them went east.|My mother never told me what happened to my father, but she and I went south with some others and integrated into the NCR.|When the NCR learned that Enclave personnel had integrated, we kept moving to the fringes. It's one of the reasons why I wound up out here.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic077 "Where did the Enclave go?" [DIAL:0016339B]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: I'm sure. I'm not interested.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic076 "I'm sure. I'm not interested." [DIAL:0016339C]

text_content: Okay, I hear you. Forget I said anything. Consider it dropped.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic076 "I'm sure. I'm not interested." [DIAL:0016339C]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: All right, let me hear it.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic075 "All right, let me hear it." [DIAL:0016339D]

text_content: Arcade, I'm not interested.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic074 "Arcade, I'm not interested." [DIAL:0016339E]

text_content: Are you sure? I didn't even get to the ostensibly "good" part.|If you're sure, I won't bring it up again. We can just go on our merry way, fighting injustice in our typical fashion.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic074 "Arcade, I'm not interested." [DIAL:0016339E]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: What are you talking about?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic073 "What are you talking about?" [DIAL:0016339F]

text_content: I wasn't always with the Followers, or with the NCR.|My late father was an officer in a group called the Enclave, a remnant of America's Pre-War government.|Memories being short around here, not a whole lot of people remember them. But they did bad things. Terrorized communities, kidnapped people.|Eventually, someone stopped them. I was born a few years later at a military base on the coast, a place called Navarro.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic073 "What are you talking about?" [DIAL:0016339F]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Not right now, Arcade.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic071 "Not right now, Arcade." [DIAL:001633A1]

text_content: {drawing the word out}Actually, I'm going to keep talking anyway. Sorry, but I really need to get this out.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic071 "Not right now, Arcade." [DIAL:001633A1]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Sure.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic070 "Sure." [DIAL:001633A2]

text_content: Any day now, Caesar's going to try to march across Hoover Dam and kick NCR out of the Mojave.|We're getting caught up in something important out here. Hell, after how you handled Benny, you're practically right in the middle of all this.|I know I'm just along for the ride, but it's made me think about the past, how I might be able to help out.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic070 "Sure." [DIAL:001633A2]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: If you don't like it, leave.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic068 "If you don't like it, leave." [DIAL:001633A4]

text_content: Don't mind if I do. Enjoy your reign as King Scumbag the First, Overlord of Westside.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic068 "If you don't like it, leave." [DIAL:001633A4]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Don't mind if I do. Enjoy your reign as Queen Scumbag the First, Overlord of Westside.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic068 "If you don't like it, leave." [DIAL:001633A4]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: They profit from crime, now I profit, too.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic056 "They profit from crime, now I profit, too." [DIAL:001633A5]

text_content: {sickened}That's one way to look at it.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic056 "They profit from crime, now I profit, too." [DIAL:001633A5]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: It's just like other armor, but heavy, right?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic040 "It's just like other armor, but heavy, right?" [DIAL:001633B3]

text_content: Not even close. Power armor isn't something you wear so much as {lightly stressed}use. It's a weapon in its own right, and takes skill to wield.|If you don't know what you're doing, you won't even be able to walk with it on. So how about a bit of quick instruction?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic040 "It's just like other armor, but heavy, right?" [DIAL:001633B3]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: I'd appreciate a lesson.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic039 "I'd appreciate a lesson." [DIAL:001633B4]

text_content: Here, I'll show you. It's easy, once you get used to it. First, we'll start with putting it on...
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic039 "I'd appreciate a lesson." [DIAL:001633B4]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: Actually, I already know how to use power armor.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic038 "Actually, I already know how to use power armor." [DIAL:001633B5]

text_content: Do you now? If I didn't already owe you a great deal I'd be highly suspicious right now. You'll have to tell me about it sometime.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic038 "Actually, I already know how to use power armor." [DIAL:001633B5]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: HardinPowerArmorTraining
name: HardinPowerArmorTraining "HardinPowerArmorTraining" [DIAL:001633B6]

text_content: ...There, I think you've got the hang of it now. You should be able to use any type of power armor you come across using what you just learned.
name: HardinPowerArmorTraining "HardinPowerArmorTraining" [DIAL:001633B6]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: Very well, then. In addition to the armor, I've given the order that all of our arms and equipment be made available for your purchase.|Finally, while you are now a member of the Brotherhood, I cannot ask any more of you. I'm sure you have goals of your own outside these walls.|You are free to come and go as you please, though I hope you'll return to us someday in a more permanent capacity.|I wish you the best, {outsider}outsid- {beat, catches himself}Brother.
name: HardinPowerArmorTraining "HardinPowerArmorTraining" [DIAL:001633B6]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: HVHardinPowerArmorTraining
name: HVHardinPowerArmorTraining "HVHardinPowerArmorTraining" [DIAL:001633B7]

text_content: I've taken care of the Van Graffs.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic036 "I've taken care of the Van Graffs." [DIAL:001633B8]

text_content: Well done. This is a small step in the right direction, but it's damn good to move forward again. Now, I believe congratulations are in order.|It is my honor to bestow up on you the title of Paladin of the Brotherhood, for your meritorious service in its name.|Normally, there'd be a ceremony and such, but everyone is too busy at the moment for such frivolity.|I can give you this, however. Your very own suit of power armor. We can't spare our best, but I had the knights assemble this one for your use.|Which reminds me, you don't even know how to use these, do you?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic036 "I've taken care of the Van Graffs." [DIAL:001633B8]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: On second thought, I'm fine not joining the Brotherhood.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic035 "On second thought, I'm fine not joining the Brotherhood." [DIAL:001633B9]

text_content: Hmph, I thought you were made of sterner stuff than that. The Brotherhood could use someone with your skills.|In any case, was there something else you wanted?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic035 "On second thought, I'm fine not joining the Brotherhood." [DIAL:001633B9]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: Now you're just wasting my time. When you make up your mind, let me know.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic035 "On second thought, I'm fine not joining the Brotherhood." [DIAL:001633B9]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: Tell me what the task is before I agree to anything.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic034 "Tell me what the task is before I agree to anything." [DIAL:001633BA]

text_content: Is that a waver of resolve I sense? The Brotherhood is not in the habit of taking on the timid.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic034 "Tell me what the task is before I agree to anything." [DIAL:001633BA]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: Yes, what is the task?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic030 "Yes, what is the task?" [DIAL:001633BB]

text_content: Back when we were stationed at HELIOS, our scouts reported that a group was establishing itself in the area as a distributor of Pre-War weapons.|Our Elder at the time, Elijah, was too concerned with getting HELIOS running and fending off the NCR, so he ordered us to leave them alone.|It's time that we correct that oversight, and show this region that the Brotherhood is still a force to be reckoned with.|I want you to visit these weapons dealers, this Van Graff family, and make an example of them. Leave no one alive.|When the job is done, report back and I'll arrange for a team to clean up the site and retrieve the weapons.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic030 "Yes, what is the task?" [DIAL:001633BB]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: {Ask to join the Brotherhood}
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic027 "{Ask to join the Brotherhood}" [DIAL:001633BC]

text_content: Yes, I thought you might, given how much time you've spent here.|That's not usually a request we agree to. Typically, we take in the young, so that they might be trained through adolescence.|In special cases, we allow exceptional individuals to conditionally join. Luckily for you, you happen to be exceptional.|The condition is that you must complete a task. This task must prove beyond a shadow of a doubt that you have what it takes to join the Brotherhood.|I happen to have something perfectly suitable in mind, though I warn you - it won't be easy. Still interested?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic027 "{Ask to join the Brotherhood}" [DIAL:001633BC]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: Had second thoughts, did you? We've made some progress since the lockdown was lifted, but the task I had in mind is still available if you want it.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic027 "{Ask to join the Brotherhood}" [DIAL:001633BC]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: About my reward...
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic022 "About my reward..." [DIAL:001633BD]

text_content: While I can't dispute that you've earned our gratitude, I'm afraid you're going to have to be patient. Such a change takes time.|Stop back in a few days, and we can speak of this again. Now, I must be off. There is much to do!
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic022 "About my reward..." [DIAL:001633BD]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: Is there anything else for me to do?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic021 "Is there anything else for me to do?" [DIAL:001633BE]

text_content: No, your role in this is done. The rest is up to us. There is much for me to do to make the transition as smooth as possible.|Come back in a few days, and I should be firmly installed as Elder.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic021 "Is there anything else for me to do?" [DIAL:001633BE]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: So what happens now?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic020 "So what happens now?" [DIAL:001633BF]

text_content: There are a number of people I'll need to talk to. The process won't be instantaneous, but with this evidence, my path is clear.|It shouldn't take more than a few days, and then we can begin moving forward again.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic020 "So what happens now?" [DIAL:001633BF]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: I'm looking for an antique rangefinder somebody might've sold you.
name: VFreeformTheStreet01VStreetSecuritronVault21Topic007 "I'm looking for an antique rangefinder somebody might've sold you." [DIAL:00163442]

text_content: Predecessor's records indicate matching item purchased by nervous man wearing metal collar.|Records indicate man requested free lodging and was directed to concrete building in Freeside. Transmitting coordinates.
name: VFreeformTheStreet01VStreetSecuritronVault21Topic007 "I'm looking for an antique rangefinder somebody might've sold you." [DIAL:00163442]
speaker: VStreetSecuritronVault21 "Securitron Mk I" [CREA:00154448]

text_content: What kind of prototype were they making?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic085 "What kind of prototype were they making?" [DIAL:001638CA]

text_content: How do you know so much about this, again?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic084 "How do you know so much about this, again?" [DIAL:001638CB]

text_content: Stop thinking so much. Thanks.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic084 "How do you know so much about this, again?" [DIAL:001638CB]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Rockets and energy weapons? That's an odd combination.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic083 "Rockets and energy weapons? That's an odd combination." [DIAL:001638CC]

text_content: McNamaraPowerArmorTraining
name: McNamaraPowerArmorTraining "McNamaraPowerArmorTraining" [DIAL:001638CE]

text_content: ...There, I think you've got the knack of it now. You should now be able to wear any kind of power armor you come across.
name: McNamaraPowerArmorTraining "McNamaraPowerArmorTraining" [DIAL:001638CE]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: I've also given the order that all of our equipment be made available to you, not just the more mundane arms.|You're a member of the Brotherhood now, and your gear should reflect that.|Lastly, you will be allowed to come and go as you please. You've done so much for us that to do otherwise would be a crime.|I just ask that you keep the Brotherhood's interests at heart in all your dealings. Remember that you will always have a home here.
name: McNamaraPowerArmorTraining "McNamaraPowerArmorTraining" [DIAL:001638CE]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: Don't I just put it on?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic038 "Don't I just put it on?" [DIAL:001638CF]

text_content: If only it were that simple. Think of power armor as a machine to be operated rather than clothing you'd wear.|With a little instruction, using it becomes as natural as simple movement, but to the ignorant, it's just so much heavy junk.|So let's bring you up to speed, shall we?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic038 "Don't I just put it on?" [DIAL:001638CF]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: Please do.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic037 "Please do." [DIAL:001638D0]

text_content: First, let's go over how to put it on...
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic037 "Please do." [DIAL:001638D0]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: I already know how to use power armor.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic036 "I already know how to use power armor." [DIAL:001638D1]

text_content: Would you like to tell me where you learned such a thing?|No, don't bother. A person as well-traveled as yourself is bound to pick up all kinds of skills, I suppose. Luckily, that's not all I have for you.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic036 "I already know how to use power armor." [DIAL:001638D1]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: I installed the device up at Black Mountain, as instructed.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic035 "I installed the device up at Black Mountain, as instructed." [DIAL:001638D2]

text_content: Yes, we've already started receiving telemetry from it. This will be a great help in our future efforts, and I thank you.|Now then, it is my great honor to bestow upon you the title of Paladin of the Brotherhood, for meritorious service above and beyond the call of duty.|I'm afraid a formal ceremony was out of the question given our current state, but I hope this will make up for it.|I had the knights refurbish a suit of our power armor for your use. It's one of the earlier models, but it should serve you well.|Now, I suppose I'm going to have to show you how to use it, aren't I?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic035 "I installed the device up at Black Mountain, as instructed." [DIAL:001638D2]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: On second thought, I'm not really interested in joining the Brotherhood at the moment.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic034 "On second thought, I'm not really interested in joining the Brotherhood at the moment." [DIAL:001638D3]

text_content: Regrettable, but understandable. Should you change your mind, return here. I will hold off on assigning the task to my brethren, for now.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic034 "On second thought, I'm not really interested in joining the Brotherhood at the moment." [DIAL:001638D3]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: That depends on the task.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic033 "That depends on the task." [DIAL:001638D4]

text_content: Do not hesitate, my friend. Learn from my mistake and go boldly, one way or the other.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic033 "That depends on the task." [DIAL:001638D4]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: Yes, what is the task?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic015 "Yes, what is the task?" [DIAL:001638D5]

text_content: As one of our patrols discovered, the mutants just to the northeast have become strangely violent in the years we were secluded.|However, this turn of events could also be an opportunity. We mostly left the equipment of the communications array there alone, out of respect.|As the inhabitants have now proven themselves hostile, no more respect will accorded them. Making their equipment fair game.|I want you to head up to the summit of Black Mountain and install this remote signal transmitter in one of their consoles.|It will allow us to tap into the radar and other detection systems running there, assuming they're still operational.|If we're going to operate on the surface again, it would be nice to do so with as much information at our fingertips as possible. Good luck.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic015 "Yes, what is the task?" [DIAL:001638D5]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: {Ask to join the Brotherhood}
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic014 "{Ask to join the Brotherhood}" [DIAL:001638D6]

text_content: You've certainly earned the right, but I'm afraid there's a slight matter of protocol that must be dealt with first.|Exceptional individuals, like yourself, {slightly stressed}are sometimes allowed to join the Brotherhood if they perform a valuable service for it.|While your actions up to this point have been commendable, I'm afraid they don't quite qualify as such a service.|However, I do have another task that fits the bill rather nicely. Would you consider undertaking it?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic014 "{Ask to join the Brotherhood}" [DIAL:001638D6]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: The task I had in mind is still available, if you're up for it.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic014 "{Ask to join the Brotherhood}" [DIAL:001638D6]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: Never mind.
name: vDialogueTestaclesDebugTestaclesTopic074 "Never mind." [DIAL:001639E6]

text_content: Female, Evil Karma.
name: vDialogueTestaclesDebugTestaclesTopic073 "Female, Evil Karma." [DIAL:001639E7]

text_content: Female, Evil Karma.
name: vDialogueTestaclesDebugTestaclesTopic073 "Female, Evil Karma." [DIAL:001639E7]
