text_content: I'll be going now.
name: vNiptonVulpesvMOSgtKilbornTopic003 "I'll be going now." [DIAL:00163A8E]

text_content: Watch yourself.
name: vNiptonVulpesvMOSgtKilbornTopic003 "I'll be going now." [DIAL:00163A8E]
speaker: vMOSgtKilborn "Sgt. Kilborn" [NPC_:00136FD3]

text_content: Any work around here?
name: vNiptonVulpesvMOSgtKilbornTopic002 "Any work around here?" [DIAL:00163A8F]

text_content: Nothing I know of, {studies the player}but if you've come from the North, means you can travel freer than most around here.|Might check the Barracks, someone might need you to hoof it somewhere. Just be careful if you go up on the roof - got a sniper watching the road.|If you're gear's in need of repair, HQ's also worth checking out - talk to Major Knight, he can help. {Beat, to himself}Provided you got a pen and plenty of ink.
name: vNiptonVulpesvMOSgtKilbornTopic002 "Any work around here?" [DIAL:00163A8F]
speaker: vMOSgtKilborn "Sgt. Kilborn" [NPC_:00136FD3]

text_content: What are those statues of?
name: vNiptonVulpesvMOSgtKilbornTopic001 "What are those statues of?" [DIAL:00163A90]

text_content: Those two? Represents unification. {Beat, a little defeated}Mostly good for shade. Won't do much else when the Legion reaches us.
name: vNiptonVulpesvMOSgtKilbornTopic001 "What are those statues of?" [DIAL:00163A90]
speaker: vMOSgtKilborn "Sgt. Kilborn" [NPC_:00136FD3]

text_content: What is this place?
name: vNiptonVulpesvMOSgtKilbornTopic000 "What is this place?" [DIAL:00163A91]

text_content: Outpost, Mojave Outpost. Watching a lot of nothing, feels like a big Brahmin pen for caravans. |They've been stopped for a while, waiting for the roads North to clear - or their clearance papers to go through.|Look like you've walked a ways, so if you need to shake the dust off, head to the Barracks, the bar's there. {Beat, shrugs}Not much, but better than nothing.
name: vNiptonVulpesvMOSgtKilbornTopic000 "What is this place?" [DIAL:00163A91]
speaker: vMOSgtKilborn "Sgt. Kilborn" [NPC_:00136FD3]

text_content: Tell me about the battle at HELIOS.
name: HVHardinHELIOS "Tell me about the battle at HELIOS." [DIAL:00163A99]

text_content: HELIOS was the worst goddamned action I've seen in a long, long career of fighting.
name: HVHardinHELIOS "Tell me about the battle at HELIOS." [DIAL:00163A99]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: Tell me about your last Elder.
name: HVHardinLastElder "Tell me about your last Elder." [DIAL:00163A9A]

text_content: Elijah was a strange one. His even becoming Elder was highly questionable, seeing as how he was a Scribe. Typically, only Paladins are eligible.|But an exception was made in his case, on account of him being a genius. Unfortunately, whatever scientific acumen he had didn't extend to tactics.|Trying to defend HELIOS was a blunder of the worst kind, and many brothers lost their lives because of it.|Many of the senior paladins, myself included, advised him to fight a retreating action, but he refused to budge. Said he almost "had it working".|We never did find out exactly what he was talking about. When the perimeter was finally overrun, the Elder had simply vanished.
name: HVHardinLastElder "Tell me about your last Elder." [DIAL:00163A9A]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: What would you do if you became Elder?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic042 "What would you do if you became Elder?" [DIAL:00163A9B]

text_content: After lifting the lockdown, the first thing I'd do is send scouts out to recon the area. We need to know what's going on out there.|Next, I'd resume patrols in the near vicinity, and begin sending search teams out to the spots the scouts reported were relatively safe.|It's standard procedure when a chapter relocates to an area, but standard procedure wasn't our last Elder's style, either.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic042 "What would you do if you became Elder?" [DIAL:00163A9B]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: Why do you dislike McNamara so much?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic041 "Why do you dislike McNamara so much?" [DIAL:00163A9C]

text_content: It's not that I dislike the Elder, but I strongly disapprove of his current style of leadership. We're safe, yes, but at what cost?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic041 "Why do you dislike McNamara so much?" [DIAL:00163A9C]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: What do you think of the lockdown?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic037 "What do you think of the lockdown?" [DIAL:00163A9D]

text_content: It's a travesty, is what it is. Every second we sit on our hands down here is another second that we're not fulfilling our sworn duty.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyEdgarHardinTopic037 "What do you think of the lockdown?" [DIAL:00163A9D]
speaker: EdgarHardin "Head Paladin Hardin" [NPC_:000E2F85]

text_content: {Telling about the NCR wanting to destroy the BoS}
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic046 "{Telling about the NCR wanting to destroy the BoS}" [DIAL:00163A9E]

text_content: Yes, I've always known they were. Luckily, they don't know exactly where we are. And even if they did, our position here is fortified.|And assuming they managed to breach the bunker, I would be forced to activate our failsafe system.|Better we all die than allow the technology we have here to fall into such unworthy hands.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic046 "{Telling about the NCR wanting to destroy the BoS}" [DIAL:00163A9E]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: I suppose it was only a matter of time. I wonder if, given the NCR's current situation, they would consider a truce of sorts?|We've given up our claim to HELIOS, and we don't have any interest in claiming Hoover Dam, so our ambitions are not at crossed purposes.|Perhaps it's time for a new strategy. Go to the NCR commander and tell her the Brotherhood is willing to put aside our enmity for the time being.|Further, tell her that we are willing to send troops to aid in their coming defense of the Dam. My guess is they're in no position to refuse.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic046 "{Telling about the NCR wanting to destroy the BoS}" [DIAL:00163A9E]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: Did you know Hardin is trying to find a way to become Elder?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic045 "Did you know Hardin is trying to find a way to become Elder?" [DIAL:00163A9F]

text_content: Oh yes, he's been trying for quite some time. Hardin has been strongly opposed to the lockdown from the first. It goes against his nature, you see.|Hardin's the type to fight to the last, and die rather than surrender. It's a good trait to have in a soldier, and a bad one to have in a leader.|Don't let his actions bother you. He's only doing what he thinks is best for the chapter.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic045 "Did you know Hardin is trying to find a way to become Elder?" [DIAL:00163A9F]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: Tell me about what happened at HELIOS.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic044 "Tell me about what happened at HELIOS." [DIAL:00163AA0]

text_content: We were overrun, plain and simple. My Brothers fought with great courage, but in the end the enemy was just too many.|When the tide of the battle turned for the worse, our Elder was nowhere to be found, and everything was chaos.|Fully half of our forces had already fallen. I gathered up those I could find and we fought our way here.|This place had been briefly discussed as a fallback point, though at the time none really believed that could possibly become necessary.|That's it, really. There was nothing glorious about the battle, just a nightmare of screams, blood, and death.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic044 "Tell me about what happened at HELIOS." [DIAL:00163AA0]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: What is with that crazy sandstorm on the surface?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic043 "What is with that crazy sandstorm on the surface?" [DIAL:00163AA1]

text_content: That is this base's defensive system. It serves as camouflage and masks all entry and exit from the bunker.|We use it to hide our patrols and supply runners, though we still send such out at night to be extra safe.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic043 "What is with that crazy sandstorm on the surface?" [DIAL:00163AA1]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic041 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:00163AA3]

text_content: All right. What did you wish to speak about?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic041 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:00163AA3]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: How do you get supplies?
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic040 "How do you get supplies?" [DIAL:00163AA4]

text_content: We have some personnel that are allowed to travel on the surface. They trade for what we need, and occasionally drop off what they acquire.|We make sure that they only enter or leave the bunker while the sandstorm is active, to avoid detection.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic040 "How do you get supplies?" [DIAL:00163AA4]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: Tell me about the lockdown.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic039 "Tell me about the lockdown." [DIAL:00163AA5]

text_content: It's a protective measure that was enacted after our defeat at HELIOS. The NCR was hot on our heels, and we wouldn't have survived another encounter.|It was decided that we would stay quiet for a time, heal the wounded, and try to come up with a new strategy.|However, after we had fully recuperated, our first scouting measures showed that the NCR's presence in this region had only increased in our absence.|There are now more than five times the number of NCR troops in the area as when we fought them, and we have half the number we did at HELIOS.|And so the lockdown has been extended. To go outside would be the death of us all.
name: VDialogueHiddenValleyNolanMcNamaraTopic039 "Tell me about the lockdown." [DIAL:00163AA5]
speaker: NolanMcNamara "Elder McNamara" [NPC_:000E2F84]

text_content: I must prepare myself before I go.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic028 "I must prepare myself before I go." [DIAL:00163BFC]

text_content: Then be quick about it.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic028 "I must prepare myself before I go." [DIAL:00163BFC]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: It will be an honor to fight for the Legion.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic027 "It will be an honor to fight for the Legion." [DIAL:00163BFD]

text_content: {satisfied grunt - responding to the player's readiness}Good. {LATIN}{In the sign of the bull you will conquer}{En hock SIG-no Tor-OOS VINH-chase}"In hoc signo taurus vinces."|Report to {Leh-GAH-tus LAH-nee-oos}Legatus Lanius immediately - he'll brief you on the plan of battle. Come back victorious, or don't come back.
name: VDialogueCaesarFortCaesarTopic027 "It will be an honor to fight for the Legion." [DIAL:00163BFD]
speaker: FortCaesar "Caesar" [NPC_:00121FEF]

text_content: Fine. Get lost.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic104 "Fine. Get lost." [DIAL:00163C2D]

text_content: That was the plan. Bye.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic104 "Fine. Get lost." [DIAL:00163C2D]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Why?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic103 "Why?" [DIAL:00163C2E]

text_content: Because you're helping Caesar's Legion. They are bad. You are bad. I am going. Bye.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic103 "Why?" [DIAL:00163C2E]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Why are you crazy? That's a question for someone much wiser and more patient than myself.|All I know is that you are a bad person and I don't want to be around you anymore. So if that was your goal, congratulations.|If not, I'm sorry to inform you that you are, as the locals say, "nuttier than a Bighorner dropping."
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic103 "Why?" [DIAL:00163C2E]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: If you have a problem with me, why don't you just leave right now?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic102 "If you have a problem with me, why don't you just leave right now?" [DIAL:00163C2F]

text_content: If you insist. Have a nice life.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic102 "If you have a problem with me, why don't you just leave right now?" [DIAL:00163C2F]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Whatever.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic101 "Whatever." [DIAL:00163C30]

text_content: That wasn't exactly the response I was hoping for, but I'll give you the benefit of the doubt.|Seriously, though, watch it.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic101 "Whatever." [DIAL:00163C30]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Sorry. I just lose my head sometimes.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic100 "Sorry. I just lose my head sometimes." [DIAL:00163C31]

text_content: If by "sometimes" you mean "a lot of times," I agree. Please, just... settle down, okay?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic100 "Sorry. I just lose my head sometimes." [DIAL:00163C31]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: They hide behind NCR's protection and they deserve everything coming to them.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic099 "They hide behind NCR's protection and they deserve everything coming to them." [DIAL:00163C32]

text_content: They sure don't, but I hope you get everything that's coming to you.|Have a nice life.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic099 "They hide behind NCR's protection and they deserve everything coming to them." [DIAL:00163C32]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: That's a good way to put it.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic098 "That's a good way to put it." [DIAL:00163C33]

text_content: Sure, if you're a sociopath.|{sickened}Enjoy the fruits of your labor.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic098 "That's a good way to put it." [DIAL:00163C33]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: More than collateral damage. A necessary sacrifice.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic097 "More than collateral damage. A necessary sacrifice." [DIAL:00163C34]

text_content: How noble of you.|Sorry, but I won't be sticking around to see if you have the courtesy to lay flowers on the mass grave that the Legion's going to dig for them.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic097 "More than collateral damage. A necessary sacrifice." [DIAL:00163C34]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Actually, yes, I would like to see New Vegas turned into a slavery hub.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic096 "Actually, yes, I would like to see New Vegas turned into a slavery hub." [DIAL:00163C35]

text_content: Great! You're either unimaginably cruel or profoundly insane!|Either way, I'm not going to wait around for you to help the Legion roll across Hoover Dam. Bye.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic096 "Actually, yes, I would like to see New Vegas turned into a slavery hub." [DIAL:00163C35]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: The Legion is better than the alternative.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic095 "The Legion is better than the alternative." [DIAL:00163C36]

text_content: What?! Caesar is going to enslave or kill everyone in the Mojave.|And when that's done, he'll try to destroy the NCR senate and install himself as its new military dictator.|I can't comprehend how Caesar could so extensively scramble your sense of morality to make you think the Legion is a better alternative to {emph}anything.|And you know what? I'm not going to stick around to try to figure it out. At least legionaries have the excuse of being born into it.|Have a nice life.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic095 "The Legion is better than the alternative." [DIAL:00163C36]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: NCR is broken beyond repair. Its time has come.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic094 "NCR is broken beyond repair. Its time has come." [DIAL:00163C37]

text_content: If the NCR is broken, it will fail on its own.|The people who live here don't deserve to be victims of your misguided attempts at political engineering.|Or are they just collateral damage?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic094 "NCR is broken beyond repair. Its time has come." [DIAL:00163C37]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Yes, that's exactly what I'm suggesting.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic093 "Yes, that's exactly what I'm suggesting." [DIAL:00163C38]

text_content: Okay. I just wanted you to confirm that I'm traveling in the company of an insane fascist. Thanks.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic093 "Yes, that's exactly what I'm suggesting." [DIAL:00163C38]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: I'm just trying to be open-minded.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic092 "I'm just trying to be open-minded." [DIAL:00163C39]

text_content: It's a good thing to be, but you may want to close the floodgates once you see how Caesar runs things.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic092 "I'm just trying to be open-minded." [DIAL:00163C39]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: With how messed up New Vegas is, do you really think Caesar has nothing to offer?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic091 "With how messed up New Vegas is, do you really think Caesar has nothing to offer?" [DIAL:00163C3A]

text_content: At least the mess is ours to clean up.|Wait a minute... am I going crazy or are you actually suggesting it might not be bad if the Legion takes over?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic091 "With how messed up New Vegas is, do you really think Caesar has nothing to offer?" [DIAL:00163C3A]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Enjoying your stay?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic090 "Enjoying your stay?" [DIAL:00163C3B]

text_content: In the words of Socrates, "Go fornicate yourself."
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic090 "Enjoying your stay?" [DIAL:00163C3B]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: The world needs Caesar more than it needs you.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic089 "The world needs Caesar more than it needs you." [DIAL:00163C3C]

text_content: {"The conquering cause pleased the gods, but the conquered cause pleased Cato" - week-treex cow-sah deh-ees plah-coo-eet sehd week-tah cah-toh-nee}Victrix causa deis placuit sed victa Catoni.|{sadly}Goodbye, courier.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic089 "The world needs Caesar more than it needs you." [DIAL:00163C3C]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: I thought you were interested in preserving life.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic088 "I thought you were interested in preserving life." [DIAL:00163C3D]

text_content: I know I shouldn't place one life below another, but in Caesar's case, I'll make an exception.|The whole "slavery and cultural annihilation" stance he's adopted is bit repugnant to me.|Though I guess what I think never really mattered much to you, did it?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic088 "I thought you were interested in preserving life." [DIAL:00163C3D]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: But in the end, doesn't it all just come down to numbers anyway?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic087 "But in the end, doesn't it all just come down to numbers anyway?" [DIAL:00163C3E]

text_content: If you lose your humanity, then I suppose that is all that's left.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic087 "But in the end, doesn't it all just come down to numbers anyway?" [DIAL:00163C3E]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: I'm sure he means well.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic086 "I'm sure he means well." [DIAL:00163C3F]

text_content: It isn't enough to mean well if you don't do good. I'm sure Caesar meant well, too.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic086 "I'm sure he means well." [DIAL:00163C3F]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Good thing there are still people like you around.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic072 "Good thing there are still people like you around." [DIAL:00163C40]

text_content: Kind of you to say, but there are better people than me around here. I just hope the Followers can make a difference in the long run.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic072 "Good thing there are still people like you around." [DIAL:00163C40]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: VFSMickAndRalphsCrierShout
name: VFSMickAndRalphsCrierShout "VFSMickAndRalphsCrierShout" [DIAL:00163C60]

text_content: Come to Mick and Ralph's for all your shopping needs!
name: VFSMickAndRalphsCrierShout "VFSMickAndRalphsCrierShout" [DIAL:00163C60]

text_content: If it can be bought, it can be found at Mick and Ralph's!
name: VFSMickAndRalphsCrierShout "VFSMickAndRalphsCrierShout" [DIAL:00163C60]

text_content: We've got stuff we're not even allowed to sell, people. Only at Mick and Ralph's!
name: VFSMickAndRalphsCrierShout "VFSMickAndRalphsCrierShout" [DIAL:00163C60]

text_content: VFSAtomicWranglerCrierShout
name: VFSAtomicWranglerCrierShout "VFSAtomicWranglerCrierShout" [DIAL:00163C61]

text_content: Hungry? Thirsty? Horny? The Atomic Wrangler has you covered!
name: VFSAtomicWranglerCrierShout "VFSAtomicWranglerCrierShout" [DIAL:00163C61]

text_content: Wanna get lucky? Head on down to the Atomic Wrangler!
name: VFSAtomicWranglerCrierShout "VFSAtomicWranglerCrierShout" [DIAL:00163C61]

text_content: Make a brief stop at the Atomic Wrangler, where the booze is cheaper, the tables more friendly, and the women are just like the booze!
name: VFSAtomicWranglerCrierShout "VFSAtomicWranglerCrierShout" [DIAL:00163C61]

text_content: VFSVanGraffCrierShout
name: VFSVanGraffCrierShout "VFSVanGraffCrierShout" [DIAL:00163C62]

text_content: Come to the Silver Rush for all your energy weapon needs!
name: VFSVanGraffCrierShout "VFSVanGraffCrierShout" [DIAL:00163C62]

text_content: Lasers, plasma, pistols, grenades - we've got it all at the Silver Rush!

name: vMojavevMOMajorKnightTopic025 "So is that a ""no,"" you don't want to be friends, or..." [DIAL:00163CDD]

text_content: I... would, perhaps some other time. When my orders take me to Vegas, perhaps. Wish things were different, but might take some time.
name: vMojavevMOMajorKnightTopic025 "So is that a ""no,"" you don't want to be friends, or..." [DIAL:00163CDD]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]
speaker: vMOMajorKnight "Major Knight" [NPC_:0013D6A4]

name: vMojavevMOMajorKnightTopic024 "Forget it, then, you're a waste of time." [DIAL:00163CDE]

text_content: Wait... wait a minute. Look. Some things in the NCR are... aren't ideal. But I want to help.
name: vMojavevMOMajorKnightTopic024 "Forget it, then, you're a waste of time." [DIAL:00163CDE]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]
speaker: vMOMajorKnight "Major Knight" [NPC_:0013D6A4]

text_content: {Slight conspiratorial}If you need something repaired... let me know, I can sign the work order. As long as caps change hands, I can put them back in yours.
name: vMojavevMOMajorKnightTopic024 "Forget it, then, you're a waste of time." [DIAL:00163CDE]

text_content: Didn't realize NCR was so spineless.
name: vMojavevMOMajorKnightTopic023 "Didn't realize NCR was so spineless." [DIAL:00163CDF]

text_content: Now wait a minute - Republic's a sight better than... other alternatives. Women are serving here, after all. The rest... well, might take some time.|And they're more accepting back West, like I said. In the meantime...
name: vMojavevMOMajorKnightTopic023 "Didn't realize NCR was so spineless." [DIAL:00163CDF]
quest: vMojave "Can You Find it in Your Heart?" [QUST:00144122]

text_content: {Quieter, doesn't want to be overheard}This isn't the Republic. Oddly enough, Legion's a little more forgiving about... friendships. Out here, it's not as accepted.|{Slightly apologetic}Not that I mind being friends, it's just being open about it in the Outpost... well, I have to work here.
name: vMojavevMOMajorKnightTopic021 "What do you mean?" [DIAL:00163CE1]

name: vMojavevMOLaceyTopic009 "Anything you can tell me about the Outpost?" [DIAL:00163D01]

text_content: Let's get going.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic116 "Let's get going." [DIAL:00163D2F]

text_content: Hold on a second. I need to talk to you about something else.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic116 "Let's get going." [DIAL:00163D2F]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: You've certainly done your part.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic115 "You've certainly done your part." [DIAL:00163D30]

text_content: I've been wondering about Daisy and the others for so long, I still haven't figured out what I should do.|I mean, I'm not like them. I was born at Navarro and my father served with them, but I wasn't really part of the Enclave.|It seems presumptuous of me to think that I could join the fight, even if this is a cause worth fighting for.|Because I know when fighting breaks out at the dam, all hell is going to break loose in Freeside. They're going to need every doctor they can get.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic115 "You've certainly done your part." [DIAL:00163D30]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: That's their story Arcade, not yours.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic114 "That's their story Arcade, not yours." [DIAL:00163D31]

text_content: Oh, I know. I was only a boy when they went through hell together. I'm glad you're helping me reunite them.|Even if I'm still just a spectator in all of this, I know they can still do some good.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic114 "That's their story Arcade, not yours." [DIAL:00163D31]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: They're loyal to you, too.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic113 "They're loyal to you, too." [DIAL:00163D32]

text_content: Sometimes I wonder how much of my father they see in me. They went through a lot together, but my family went through it, too.|I'm glad they've watched out for me all these years. Maybe someday I can return the favor.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic113 "They're loyal to you, too." [DIAL:00163D32]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: It seems pointless to do all of that without a goal.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic112 "It seems pointless to do all of that without a goal." [DIAL:00163D33]

text_content: I'm sure Henry has goals. He was just more concerned with the "how" than the "why" of things. Being in the Enclave didn't really mean much to him.|I guess I'm lucky that I'm part of the Followers. Helping people as a doctor is important, but with the Followers, it feels different.|It feels like we're working toward something more important. That's more than the sum of good deeds that we do.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic112 "It seems pointless to do all of that without a goal." [DIAL:00163D33]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: His work was what mattered to him.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic111 "His work was what mattered to him." [DIAL:00163D34]

text_content: Not everyone dreams of being a revolutionary, I suppose. Maybe we can't all change the world.|Maybe it's enough just to do good for the short time that we're here. No one's going to sing Doc Henry's praises when he's gone.|But he's probably saved more lives than I ever will.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic111 "His work was what mattered to him." [DIAL:00163D34]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Why worry about it? You don't have to be your father.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic110 "Why worry about it? You don't have to be your father." [DIAL:00163D35]

text_content: I grew up without him. I'll always feel like something is missing from my life. But you're right.|It's not like I'm the only kid in the wasteland who's grown up without a dad. Johnson always said my father was a good man.|If that's the only thing about me that's like him, that's enough for me.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic110 "Why worry about it? You don't have to be your father." [DIAL:00163D35]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: I'm sure your father would be proud of you.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic109 "I'm sure your father would be proud of you." [DIAL:00163D36]

text_content: I wonder if he would. It's pointless, I know, but sometimes I wonder what he wanted me to be.|Maybe being a doctor in the middle of Nevada wasn't exactly what he had in mind for his little boy.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic109 "I'm sure your father would be proud of you." [DIAL:00163D36]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Some people can't stop reliving their glory days.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic108 "Some people can't stop reliving their glory days." [DIAL:00163D37]

text_content: Not much glory in the Enclave. Most of her old comrades are long gone.|I know life as a salvager can't compare to being a vertibird pilot but... at least it's life. That has to count for something.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic108 "Some people can't stop reliving their glory days." [DIAL:00163D37]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: It was an important part of her life. Why shouldn't she enjoy it?
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic107 "It was an important part of her life. Why shouldn't she enjoy it?" [DIAL:00163D38]

text_content: As screwed up as it sounds, at least she was part of something. Granted, it was something... admittedly, pretty bad, but it was something.|If you spent the first half of your life flying Enclave troopers in a vertibird, I suppose picking over Pre-War rocket parts doesn't quite compare.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic107 "It was an important part of her life. Why shouldn't she enjoy it?" [DIAL:00163D38]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: A man should know when to let go.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic106 "A man should know when to let go." [DIAL:00163D39]

text_content: It's been decades, you know. By now, he's been out of the Enclave longer than he was in.|Most people know when to hang it up and start over. But not Moreno.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic106 "A man should know when to let go." [DIAL:00163D39]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Don't be too hard on him. It's part of who he is.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic105 "Don't be too hard on him. It's part of who he is." [DIAL:00163D3A]

text_content: I suppose you're right. When you're part of something for that long, maybe it's impossible to let go without losing part of yourself.|Moreno may be a stubborn son of a bitch, but at least he's loyal.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic105 "Don't be too hard on him. It's part of who he is." [DIAL:00163D3A]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Of course, Caesar! You can hardly even hold his men responsible, given how they're practically raised to worship him as a living deity.|What's the point of surviving the war? Why did the founders of the Followers crawl their way out of vaults to bring knowledge back to the wasteland?|So we could act like the last two thousand years didn't happen? Play dress up so we can fight ancient wars all over again?|{defiantly}No way is he getting away with this. I'm not letting it happen. You're not letting it happen.

speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: You're right. Freeside needs doctors. It needs you.

text_content: You're right. They'll need every ally they can get at the dam.

text_content: That was just talk. It's not the same for you.

text_content: No, I think it {emph.}is the same for me. Maybe for a different reason, but... you can't hold on to a past you've never had.|For better or worse, I am not my father. I never had a life with the Enclave, and it would be silly for me to try to start one now.|I'll stay with you until the Legion moves on the dam, but once the attack starts, I'm going to have to go to back to Freeside. It's where I belong.|I need to take care of something, but I'll see you soon enough. Thanks for all of the help. It means a lot to me.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic142 "That was just talk. It's not the same for you." [DIAL:0016773B]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: You aren't like the others, Arcade. You're still young. It's up to you to decide who you want to be.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic141 "You aren't like the others, Arcade. You're still young. It's up to you to decide who you want to be." [DIAL:0016773C]

text_content: True enough. Maybe I can't fill my father's shoes. I wouldn't even know how.|But if following in his footsteps for a while means I can do some good out here, I will do my best.|I need to go do something. I won't be gone long, but I'll catch up with you later. Thanks for your help with the others. It means a lot to me.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic141 "You aren't like the others, Arcade. You're still young. It's up to you to decide who you want to be." [DIAL:0016773C]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: Well you... you're different.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic140 "Well you... you're different." [DIAL:0016773D]

text_content: I am, but they're still my family. I think you were right the first time. If there's something I can do to help hold the dam, I'll do it.|Look, there's something I have to do, but I promise I'll be back in a while. Trust me. And thanks again for your help. It means a lot to me.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic140 "Well you... you're different." [DIAL:0016773D]
speaker: VFSArcadeGannon "Arcade Gannon" [NPC_:0010C767]

text_content: You were born at Navarro, but you are your own man. They have their fight, and you have yours.

text_content: True enough, I suppose. Getting them back together must be worth more than me spraying plasma all over the dam.|Back to Freeside it is. I need to make a stop before I settle in. I'll be back in a while. Thanks again for your help. It means a lot to me.
name: VDialogueArcadeGannonVFSArcadeGannonTopic139 "You were born at Navarro, but you are your own man. They have their fight, and you have yours." [DIAL:0016773E]

text_content: VIntroNarration
name: VIntroNarration "VIntroNarration" [DIAL:0016950B]

text_content: {paragraph 1}War. War never changes.
name: VIntroNarration "VIntroNarration" [DIAL:0016950B]

text_content: {paragraph 2}When atomic fire consumed the earth, those who survived did so in great underground vaults.
name: VIntroNarration "VIntroNarration" [DIAL:0016950B]

text_content: {paragraph 2}When they opened, their inhabitants set out across the ruins of the Old World to build new societies, establishing villages, forming tribes.
name: VIntroNarration "VIntroNarration" [DIAL:0016950B]

text_content: {paragraph 3}As decades passed, what {slight emphasis}had been the American southwest united
name: VIntroNarration "VIntroNarration" [DIAL:0016950B]

text_content: {paragraph 3}beneath the flag of the New California Republic, dedicated to Old World values of democracy and the rule of law.
name: VIntroNarration "VIntroNarration" [DIAL:0016950B]

text_content: {paragraph 4}As the Republic grew, so did its needs. Scouts spread east, seeking territory and wealth in the dry and merciless expanse of the Mojave desert.
name: VIntroNarration "VIntroNarration" [DIAL:0016950B]

text_content: {paragraph 4}They returned with tales of a city untouched by the warheads that had scorched the rest of the world - and a great wall spanning the Colorado River.
name: VIntroNarration "VIntroNarration" [DIAL:0016950B]

text_content: {paragraph 5}The NCR mobilized its army and sent it east, to occupy Hoover Dam and restore it to working condition.
name: VIntroNarration "VIntroNarration" [DIAL:0016950B]

text_content: {paragraph 5}But across the Colorado, another society had arisen, under a different flag.
name: VIntroNarration "VIntroNarration" [DIAL:0016950B]

text_content: {paragraph 5}A vast army of slaves forged from the conquest of 86 tribes - Caesar's Legion.
name: VIntroNarration "VIntroNarration" [DIAL:0016950B]

text_content: {paragraph 6}Four years have passed since the Republic held the dam - just barely - against the Legion's onslaught. The Legion did not retreat.
name: VIntroNarration "VIntroNarration" [DIAL:0016950B]

text_content: {paragraph 6}Across the river, it gathers strength. Camp fires burn, training drums beat.
name: VIntroNarration "VIntroNarration" [DIAL:0016950B]

text_content: {paragraph 7}Through it all, the New Vegas Strip has stayed open for business, under the control of its mysterious overseer, Mr. House,
name: VIntroNarration "VIntroNarration" [DIAL:0016950B]

text_content: {paragraph 7}and his army of rehabilitated tribals and police robots.
name: VIntroNarration "VIntroNarration" [DIAL:0016950B]

text_content: {paragraph 8}You are a Courier, hired by the Mojave Express to deliver a package to the New Vegas Strip.
name: VIntroNarration "VIntroNarration" [DIAL:0016950B]

text_content: {paragraph 8}What seemed like a simple delivery job has taken a turn for the worse.
name: VIntroNarration "VIntroNarration" [DIAL:0016950B]

text_content: Though they were a powerful force in the west decades ago, the Enclave has not been seen or heard from in the Mojave Wasteland for years. Members who were not hunted down are believed to have traveled east - or successfully integrated into the NCR.

Due to disagreements over how technology should be controlled in the wasteland, the Brotherhood of Steel waged a long and bloody war against the NCR. Despite superior equipment and training, the Brotherhood eventually went into retreat.
The King is dedicated to the cause of independence and personal liberty in Freeside. His gang, the Kings, attempts to keep some semblance of order in the streets.

After the Legion lost the Battle of Hoover Dam, Caesar had his legate, Joshua Graham, covered in pitch, set on fire, and thrown into the Grand Canyon. Superstitious legionaries and tribals believe he lives on as the Burned Man.
Legate Lanius, the Monster of the East, is the military commander of all Caesar's forces in the field. He is legendary for his devotion to Caesar and for his ability to sense weakness in any army.
Chief Hanlon is the head of the NCR Rangers and one of of its longest serving members. He coordinates the actions of the Rangers from their headquarters at Camp Golf.
The distinctive black ranger combat armor consists of the Desert Rangers' traditional trench coat worn with Pre-War riot armor. Ranger patrol armor is hand-manufactured in the NCR.
Not sure what your reputation is with a current group? If you've earned one, you can find it in your Pip-Boy under Stats - General.

Do companions annoy you by constantly running into your bullets and missiles? Take the Spray and Pray perk to drastically reduce the amount of damage your attacks inflict on all currently hired companions.
Sad that you're too weak to keep a light machine gun on target? Take the Weapon Handling perk to remove 2 points from all weapon Strength requirements.
With Splash Damage, all of your explosions are increased in size, allowing you to carpet bomb an even larger area.
The Shotgun Surgeon perk negates 10 points of enemy Damage Threshold while you are using any shotgun - handy for taking out lightly-armored opponents who would normally foil your buckshot.
The Wild Wasteland trait converts a few normally "ordinary" occurences into zany, wacky encounters. Do not take this trait unless you prefer your Fallout experience to be a bit more goofy than usual.
Magazines provide temporary bonuses to skills but are much more common than the highly-prized skill books.
Though people around New Vegas have little interest in Pre-War tourist trinkets, there is one influential figure who has a soft spot for snow globes...
"Prospector" is a polite word for "scavenger". Prospectors can be found all over the Mojave Wasteland, usually looking for the rare unopened safe at the bottom of an irradiated mineshaft.
The higher the Charisma, the higher the Nerve. Nerve grants significant combat bonuses to all companions.

With the expansion of post-apocalyptic society across the American southwest, courier groups like the Mojave Express have appeared to take on the difficult task of carrying letters and packages over enormous distances.
Companions will heal themselves if they get a chance, but if you want to ensure they live a long life in your service, use the Companion Wheel to administer stimpaks directly.
XP for kills made by companions is awarded to the player.
All companions give the player a bonus perk while they are in the party. Keep two companions around for double the perks!
Some individuals in the wasteland have the ability to teach you special unarmed moves.
As your Unarmed skill increases, you will unlock the ability to do uppercuts (50 Unarmed) and crosses (75 Unarmed) - both inside V.A.T.S. and out.
Food heals more slowly than stimpaks, but is more common in the Mojave Wasteland. The Survival skill can increase the healing benefits of all forms of food, including Campfire crafting recipes.
Players win and winners play, but the Strip's casinos don't generally tolerate openly worn weapons or gamblers who are too lucky at the tables.
Travelers from northern NCR have been whispering about a small community of Super Mutants located high in the snow-capped mountains west of New Vegas.
Travelers along the Long 15 have complained to NCR rangers that caravans have been harassed and attacked by fearsome Super Mutants living in the irradiated ruins of Black Mountain.
If you see a shield next to a your health HUD, it means that your Damage Threshold is absorbing an enemy weapon's damage. A broken shield means they have completely negated your Damage Threshold.

If you see a red shield next to an enemy's health, it means that their armor's Damage Threshold is absorbing your weapon's damage. A broken red shield means you have completely negated their Damage Threshold.
Damage Threshold is subtracted directly from the DAM a weapon does. If DT is higher than the DAM of a weapon, very little damage gets through.
The Boomers are said to be xenophobic tribals armed with even more firepower than the Gun Runners. No one ventures into or out of their heavily guarded lands.
Stealing, hurting people, and otherwise being a nuisance can negatively impact your reputation with a group.
Whether you're good, bad, or somewhere in between, all major communities and organizations in the Mojave Wasteland will pay attention to your reputation.
Though you can see many crafting recipes at the start of the game, some recipes will not show up until you take special perks or have discovered them in the wasteland.
Crafting can be done at any Workbench, Campfire, or Reloading Bench. Some companions even have the ability to help the player craft anywhere in the wasteland.
Caravan is played for standard money of any and all kinds: caps, NCR dollars, or Legion coins. Because the players are often poor, the stakes tend to be low.
Because Caravan allows players to build decks from any cards they can find, crafty caravan guards often come up with devious decks and strategies.
Caravan is not played in casinos, but is very popular among caravan guards and other frequent travelers on the Long 15.
You can toggle "true" iron sights for firearms on and off in your Game Settings.
In Hardcore mode, keep an eye on your dehydration (H2O), starvation (FOD), and sleep deprivation (SLP) meters. If you let them get too high, you can suffer serious penalties - including death!
Travelers say there are two ways to get into the New Vegas Strip: through Freeside or via the monorail to Camp McCarran. Only military personnel and NCR VIPs are allowed to use the monorail.
.38 Special can be fired from any weapon that uses .357 Magnum. Similarly, .44 Special can be fired from any weapon that uses .44 Magnum and .223 can be fired from any weapon that uses 5.56mm.
Couriers for the Mojave Express regularly and rapidly carry packages between convenient (for the Mojave Wasteland) drop boxes in several communities.
Wearing outfits that are associated with high-profile factions can be an effective disguise... or a good way to get shot, depending on present company.

The Followers of the Apocalypse are an organization with roots in the pre-NCR Boneyard. Dedicated to teaching the poor and healing the sick, they are also considered anarchist revolutionaries by many people in positions of power.
Mr. House is the mysterious overlord of The Strip. He controls his small empire from the confines of the Lucky 38 casino, where no other living person has set foot for over two hundred years.
Not commonly seen on the front lines, the vexillarius is a standard-bearer for Caesar's Legion. Their presence on the battlefield inspires legionaries to fight to the death for the glory of Caesar.
Legionaries are the standard soldiers in Caesar's Legion. Their level of experience and overall toughness can be determined by noting the color of their armor.
Caesar's most trusted commanders are the centurions: battle-hardened front-line officers who dress in patchwork armor pieced together from their fallen foes.
Explorers are Caesar's advance scouts. Typically equipped in light armor and carrying binoculars, they are the Legion's message runners and keen eyes across the Mojave.
Troopers are volunteer and conscripted forces in NCR's military. They vary widely in devotion, experience, and even in basic equipment. What they lack in consistency they make up for in numbers.
The New California Republic Rangers are volunteer elite special forces renowned as much for their shrewd reconnaissance capabilities as their bravery and combat prowess.
Brutalized by the NCR, the once-legendary Vipers and Jackals gangs have become little more than opportunistic, petty raiders.
Though they have had a rough history, the legendary Great Khans are one of the longest-lived gangs to come out of the southwest.
Though their power in the west has diminished greatly over the years, the Brotherhood of Steel still maintains hidden, heavily fortified bunkers throughout the Mojave.
Aaron Kimball is a former war hero and the current president of the New California Republic. His insistence on defending Hoover Dam has kept NCR troops in Nevada for years.
In 2277, NCR forces defeated Caesar's Legion during the Battle of Hoover Dam. The NCR has held Hoover Dam since then, but the Legion has not made it easy for them.
At Workbenches, the Science skill can help you recycle Energy Weapon ammo and craft other useful items like Stimpaks.
All weapons have two requirements: Strength and Skill. If you don't meet the requirements, the weapon may be less accurate (if a firearm) or attack more slowly (if an Unarmed or Melee Weapon).
Despite relying on energy to harm their victims, Plasma Mines, EMP Grenades, and related items use the Explosives skill to determine their effectiveness.
Weapon mods can increase ammo capacity and damage, reduce spread and weight, or add special equipment like scopes.

A wide variety of weapon mods are available from merchants for Guns, Energy Weapons, and even a few Explosives. Attaching them is as simple as using your Pip-Boy and opening the mod menu for your weapon.
At 75% Condition, a weapon will never jam and does maximum damage. At 50% Condition, armor protects against maximum damage.
If you do not meet a weapon's Strength requirement, you may be less accurate with it or attack more slowly.
A weapon's DPS is its Damage Per Second and is calculated using the weapon's base damage (modified by condition), your weapon skill, and the weapon's rate of fire.
Energy Weapons are less common and varied than Guns, but have a small number of ammunition types and can be quite potent.
Most Energy Weapons fall into one of two categories: laser, which is fast, accurate, and low-damage, and plasma, which is slow-moving and very high-damage.
Talented Unarmed combatants in the Mojave Wasteland can teach specialized fighting styles to improve your abilities.
When your character's Melee Weapons score hits 50, you will be able to perform special power attacks and V.A.T.S. moves with different Melee Weapons.
Most Melee Weapons are completely silent, making them excellent stealth weapons.
Guns are the most common ranged weapons in the Mojave Wasteland. They are numerous and varied and ammunition is relatively easy to acquire.
Explosive weapons are best used when dealing with crowds or in situations where precision is not a high priority.
Not sure what skill a weapon uses? Look at the lower left corner of its Pip-Boy icon and compare it to the weapon skills.
It's not much to look at, but if you can't afford to get into The Strip, the Atomic Wrangler's the best place to gamble in Freeside.
Though New Vegas is littered with debris of the Pre-War world, Michael Angelo continues to create new art and signs for Mr. House in his workshop on The Strip.
The NCR has maintained an embassy on The Strip for several years, but has had little success in building friendly relations with Mr. House or the ruling families.
The Strip is the heart of New Vegas, where Mr. House and the casino families are rebuilding the city in the image of its Pre-War glory.
Freeside was built up around the intersection of Fremont Street and Las Vegas Boulevard. The influx of destitute travelers in recent months has created problems for its local residents.
The pinnacle of New Vegas refinement and class, the Ultra-Luxe casino is home to the discriminating White Glove Society and their pampered guests.
The Omerta family sells a variety of services and delights to its patrons at Gomorrah, but most visitors are there for one thing: sex.
Fully renovated by The Chairmen, the Tops is billed throughout New Vegas as a place for men to kick back, drink, laugh, and have a good time.
Mr. House's Lucky 38 casino towers over the New Vegas Strip, mysterious and impenetrable to visitors and locals alike.
The King's School of Impersonation is the "world" headquarters of the Freeside gang known as The Kings.
The Old Mormon Fort is the oldest building in New Vegas and was recently occupied by the Followers of the Apocalypse.
The Silver Rush casino was in competition with The Atomic Wrangler until the owners ran afoul of the Van Graff family.
Though Boulder City survived the Great War without much damage, the NCR intentionally razed most of the town with a series of explosions during the Battle of Hoover Dam.
Often the first place NCR travelers stop after the Mojave Outpost, Primm is also where a lot of folks realize they left New Vegas with barely enough money to make the long trek back to The Hub.
Goodsprings was a ghost town before the war but continues to be important to Long 15 travelers for its fresh water supply.
All territory east of the Colorado River is recognized as Caesar's land, an area indisputably under the control of the Legion and agents acting on Caesar's behalf.
Mojave Outpost is the site where the NCR Rangers and Desert Rangers of Nevada signed the Ranger Unification Treaty. It also marks the boundary of fully NCR-controlled territory.
The families that now run the Strip of New Vegas were little more than squabbling tribes a few decades ago.
Established long ago in California, the Crimson Caravan Company and the Gun Runners are two of NCR's oldest and most powerful merchant houses.
At the Battle of Hoover Dam, the tide turned for NCR when rangers and 1st Recon sharpshooters lured Caesar's soldiers into the booby-trapped ruins of Boulder City.
Vault 11 has been abandoned for decades, though few people know the story of its terrible past.
Two major routes lead into the city of New Vegas from the south: Interstate 15 and Highway 95.
Raising the game's difficulty will make combat more challenging but has no effect on the amount of XP you receive.
Things a bit too tough, or too easy? You can pause the game and modify the difficulty at any time.
If you start a fight you can't finish, try putting away your weapon. Your opponent just might forgive you...
If you have the Robotics Expert perk and sneak up on a hostile robot undetected, you can put that robot into a permanent shutdown state.
If you want to stay hidden, stick to the shadows, move slowly, try to stay behind your opponent... and turn off your Pip-Boy light!
Once your weapons and armor reach a certain condition level, your Repair skill can be used to maintain them, keeping them at maximum power for longer.
With the second rank of the Animal Friend perk, animals will come to your aid in combat (but not against other animals).
Perception determines when red tick marks (which indicate threats) appear on your compass.
The Medicine skill determines the effectiveness of drugs that help manage radiation, like Rad-X and RadAway.
Intelligence determines your effectiveness with the Science, Repair and Medicine skills.
Sleeping in a rented or owned bed will give you a "Well Rested" bonus that boosts your earned XP for several hours.
If someone sees you commit a crime against their faction, expect your reputation with that group to suffer.
Mister Gutsy is a combat variant of the popular Mister Handy, and is equipped with a Plasma weapon and flamethrower.
A Glowing One uses its special ability to deliver radiation to its enemies and heal any nearby Feral Ghouls.
Agility improves the speed of weapon reloads, drawing, and holstering.
Disable a robot's Combat Inhibitor, and the confused machine will go into a killing frenzy, attacking friend and foe alike.
The light generated from your Pip-Boy light actually makes you less stealthy. If you want to effectively sneak, turn it off.
Press and hold your Pip-Boy button to turn the Pip-Boy light off and on.
Made savage by excessive chem use, the Fiends of New Vegas are the most numerous and troublesome raiders of the Mojave Wasteland.
Due to their brutal initiation rituals, Great Khans are extremely tough. Don't expect them to go down easily.
Cazadores are a new predator in the Mojave Wasteland and often fight with Night Stalkers over their prey.
A weapon's DAM indicates its damage per shot, and is modified by factors like the weapon's condition and its associated skill.
The Robobrain, constructed by General Atomics International before the great nuclear war, is unique in that it uses an actual organic brain as its central processor.
The sturdy Protectron model of robot was created before the great war, and served as a security automaton in both the private and business sectors.
The Mister Gutsy model of robot was commissioned by the U.S. Army just before the atomic apocalypse of 2077.
Lakelurks use a devastating sonic attack to debilitate their foes from afar.
A Glowing One is a unique Feral Ghoul that has become a living conduit of radiation.
Ghouls, both "normal" and Feral, are not only immune to radiation... they're healed by it.
Feral Ghouls have lost the ability to reason, and will attack any human on sight.
Securitrons are a creation of Mr. House, the enigmatic de facto ruler of New Vegas.
Despite the best efforts of well-equipped hunters, Deathclaws continue to establish nests across the Mojave Wasteland.
Dogs and coyotes can be found throughout the Mojave, typically wherever humans are traveling.
Super Mutants in the Mojave Wasteland are remnants of the Master's Army and the Enclave's experiments at Mariposa Military Base.
Disabling the antennae of insects, like Giant Ants or Giant Mantises, will make them frenzy and attack anything nearby.
Night Stalkers are fearsome nocturnal predators created by splicing together coyote and rattlesnake DNA.
With the Toughness perk, you gain +3 to your Damage Threshold.
Tired of having to drop gear to make a trip back to the store? With the Long Haul perk, you can fast travel even when you are over-encumbered.
The Tag! perk allows you to select a fourth Skill to be a Tag Skill, meaning it immediately raises by 15 points.
With each rank in the Swift Learner perk, you gain an additional 10% to total Experience Points whenever Experience Points are earned.
With the Strong Back perk, you can carry 50 more pounds of equipment.
With the Solar Powered perk, you gain an additional 2 points to Strength when in direct sunlight, and slowly regenerate lost Health.
With the Sniper Perk, your chance to hit an opponent's head in V.A.T.S. is significantly increased.
With the Silent Running perk, running no longer factors into a successful sneak attempt.
With the Scrounger perk, you'll find considerably more ammunition in containers than you normally would.
The Meltdown perk creates a damaging corona of energy every time you vaporize or melt a target with lasers or plasma.
With the Robotics Expert perk, you do an additional 25% damage to any robot in combat.
Rad Resistance allows you to -- what else? -- resist radiation. This Perk grants an additional 25% to Radiation Resistance.
With the Pyromaniac perk, you do +50% damage with fire-based weapons, like the Flamer and Shishkebab.
With the Paralyzing Palm perk, you will sometimes perform a special V.A.T.S. palm strike that paralyzes your opponent for 30 seconds.
The Ninja perk grants you the power of the fabled shadow warriors, and increases your chance to do critical hits, and the damage of each.
You've been pushed around long enough! With the Nerd Rage perk, your Strength is raised to 10 and you gain 15 points to Damage Threshold whenever your Health drops to 20% or below.
With the Mysterious Stranger perk, your own personal guardian angel will appear occasionally in V.A.T.S. mode to lend a hand... with deadly efficiency.
With the Finesse perk, you gain an additional +5% chance to score a critical hit on an opponent in combat.
With the Mister Sandman perk, you can perform a special move that instantly kills any sleeping character, and will gain bonus XP for doing so.
When you take the Pack Rat perk, the weight of all lightweight items is cut in half.
With the Friend of the Night perk, you gain low-light vision after the sun goes down.
The Slayer perk increases the speed of your attacks with all Unarmed and Melee Weapons.
The Math Wrath perk optimizes your Pip-Boy's V.A.T.S. logic, reducing all AP costs by 10%.
With the Light Step perk, you'll never set off an enemy's mines or floor-based mechanical traps.
With the Life Giver perk, you gain an additional 30 Hit Points.
With the Lead Belly perk, you take 50% less radiation every time you drink from an irradiated water source.
Once you have the Heave, Ho! perk, all thrown weapons can be thrown much farther.
Fail a hack attempt and get locked out of a computer? Not if you're a Computer Whiz! With this perk, you can attempt to re-hack any computer you were previously locked out of.
With the Plasma Spaz perk, all AP costs for plasma weapons (including grenades) are reduced by 10%.
With the Intense Training perk, you can put a single point into any of your S.P.E.C.I.A.L. attributes.
With the Infiltrator perk, you gain one more chance to pick any lock broken by an unsuccessful "Force Lock" attempt.
With the Cowboy perk, attacking enemies with revolvers, lever-action firearms, dynamite, knives, and hatchets does +25% damage.
The Here and Now perk immediately grants an additional experience level, complete with all the advantages that brings.
With the Fortune Finder perk, you'll find considerably more Nuka-Cola caps in containers than you normally would.
The Run 'n Gun perk reduces accuracy penalties with one-handed Guns and Energy Weapons while walking or running.
When you choose the Explorer perk, every location in the world is revealed on your map. So get out there and explore!
With the Entomologist perk, you do an additional +50% damage every time you attack a mutated insect.
With the Educated perk, you gain two more skill points every time you advance in level.
With each rank of the Demolition Expert perk, all of your explosive weapons do an additional 20% damage.
The Retention perk greatly increases the duration of skill-boosting magazines.
With Concentrated Fire, your accuracy to hit any body part in V.A.T.S. increases slightly with each subsequent hit on that body part.
With the Comprehension perk, you gain more skill points when reading skill magazines and one additional skill point whenever a skill book is read.
With the Better Criticals perk, you gain a 50% damage bonus every time a critical hit is scored on an opponent.
With the Action Boy perk, you gain an additional 15 Action Points to use in V.A.T.S.
With the Animal Friend perk, you will never be the victim of an unprovoked attack from any animal.
Stealth is affected by many factors, including light level, sound generated, weight and bulk of worn apparel, and line-of-sight.
The NCR's military doesn't like being in the role of "peace-keeper". Crimes across the Mojave are typically punished by death.
Picking someone's pocket and placing a mine or grenade in their inventory will activate the explosive... and cause one heck of a mess.
Want to prevent an enemy from fleeing? Cripple the legs.
Running is noisier than walking and makes you easier to detect, even if you are sneaking.
Drinking water provides healing but may increase your radiation level. In Hardcore Mode, drinking water is vital for keeping your dehydration level down.
A weapon with high DPS but low DAM is best used against unarmored opponents.
You can restore Health by using a Stimpak, eating food, drinking from a water source, or sleeping in a bed.
If your weapons aren't strong enough to penetrate an enemy's armor, use armor-piercing ammo, attack from stealth, or use a weapon with higher DAM!
Two-handed weapons and medium or heavy apparel will slow you down when they're equipped.
In Casual Mode, limb damage can be repaired directly by applying Stimpaks to affected areas, using the Pip-Boy. In Hardcore Mode, a Doctor's Bag or an actual doctor is required.
For ideal shooting conditions, make sure you stop, crouch, and aim before firing.
Repair your weapons and armor regularly -- the lower their condition, the worse they will perform.
You can run faster with your two-handed weapons holstered. One-handed weapons will not slow you down.
Strength is a measure of your raw physical power. It affects how much you can carry, the power of all melee attacks, and your effectiveness with many heavy weapons.
The Speech skill governs how much you can influence someone through dialogue, and gain access to information they might otherwise not want to share.
The Lockpick skill is used to open locked doors and containers.
Guns determines your effectiveness with any weapon that uses conventional ammunition (.22 LR, .357 Magnum, 5mm, 10mm, 5.56mm, .308, .45-70 Gov't etc.).
The Science skill represents your combined scientific knowledge, and is primarily used to hack restricted computer terminals.
The Repair skill allows you to optimize and maintain weapons and apparel. At Reloading Benches, it also allows you to craft ammo for your Guns.
A high Perception grants a bonus to the Explosives, Lockpick and Energy Weapons skills.
The Melee Weapons skill determines your effectiveness with any melee weapon, from the simple lead pipe all the way up to the high-tech Super Sledge.
The Medicine skill determines the effectiveness of a Stimpak, Super Stimpak, and Doctor's Bag used to heal Health or damaged limbs.
The Unarmed skill is used for fighting without a weapon, or with weapons designed for hand-to-hand combat, like Brass Knuckles, Power Fists, and Displacer Gloves.
Raising your Luck raises all of your skill values and improves your Critical Chance with all weapons. It also slightly influences the outcome of gambling games.
The Lockpick skill is used to open locked doors and containers.
The higher your Intelligence, the more Skill Points you'll be able to distribute when you level up.
A high Endurance gives bonuses to Health, environmental resistances, and the Survival and Unarmed skills.
High Charisma gives bonuses to both the Barter and Speech skills as well as your companions' Nerve.
Agility affects your Guns and Sneak skills as well as the number of Action Points available for V.A.T.S.
The Explosives skill determines the ease of disarming any hostile mines and the effectiveness of any explosive weapon (all mines, all grenades, Missile Launcher, Fat Man, etc.).
The Energy Weapons skill determines your effectiveness with any weapon that uses Energy Cells, Microfusion Cells, EC Packs, Microfusion Breeder, or Flamer Fuel as ammunition.
In general, the higher your Barter skill, the lower your prices on purchased items. It can also be used to negotiate for better rewards in conversation.

Welcome to Hardcore Mode! There are three basic needs that Hardcore Mode requires you to monitor: dehydration (H2O), starvation (FOD), and sleep deprivation (SLP). Each of these needs must be monitored and kept in check or you will suffer penalties and, in extreme cases, death.

Your needs are continually ticking away and can be monitored on the Status screen of your Pip-Boy. When you start to suffer ill-effects from neglected needs, your HUD will display the corresponding code for that need. Be aware that waiting, sleeping, and Fast Travel will also affect your needs. If performing any of these activities would result in death, you will be prevented from doing so.

* Dehydration (H20) - Dehydration increases at a faster pace than starvation or sleep deprivation. It can be relieved by drinking water or eating certain types of food. Some drinks, such as alcohol and soda, can increase dehydration, so be careful!

* Starvation (FOD) - The onset of starvation is slower than dehydration, but quicker than sleep deprivation. It can be relieved by eating food.

* Sleep Deprivation (SLP) - Sleep deprivation is the most low-maintenance of the basic needs. Though a few chems and drinks can help offset sleep deprivation, nothing beats sleep itself.
name: Hardcore Needs

text_content:
You have established a reputation with a group of people in the wasteland! Whether that reputation is good or bad, you're finally somebody, and people associated with that group will start to react to what you've done. There are many different factions in the wasteland, and you can develop a distinct reputation with each one.

As you perform actions that benefit a group, you will gain Fame. If you peform actions that harm a group, you will gain Infamy. Your reputation with any given group is a measure of the combined total of Fame and Infamy that you have earned. The benefits and drawbacks of any given reputation depend on the group itself. You may receive discounts with merchants, provoke attacks from hired thugs, or simply be treated differently.

Though you will initially start out with a Neutral reputation with any given faction, your Fame and Infamy will eventually push your reputation in different directions. You can see all of your current reputations under the General section of your Pip-Boy.

Good Reputations:
* Smiling Troublemaker - Some good, a little bad.
* Good Natured Rascal - Good, a little bad.
* Accepted - Some good.
* Liked - Definitely good.
* Idolized - Most good.

Mixed Reputations:
* Soft-Hearted Devil - More bad than good.
* Dark Hero - More good than bad.
* Mixed - Some good, some bad.
* Unpredictable - Good and bad.
* Wild Child - Most good, most bad.

Bad Reputations:
* Sneering Punk - Some bad, a little good.
* Merciful Thug - Bad, a little good.
* Shunned - Some bad.
* Hated - Definitely bad.
* Vilified - Most bad.
name: Reputation

Slots are casino gambling machines that have three or more reels that spin when a button is pushed or lever is pulled. Each reel randomly stops on or between one of many symbols on the reel. Depending on the combination of symbols that comes up, the player will either lose his or her bet or receive a payout based on the odds of the combination coming up.

Different slot machines have different numbers of symbols and correspondingly different payout odds. You can check the payout odds from within the game at any time.
name: Slots

text_content:
Roulette is a game of chance in which a ball is spun on a spinning wheel marked with 38 colored and numbered pockets. As the ball loses momentum, it eventually drops into one of the pockets. Before the ball is spun, players place bets on individual numbers or groups of numbers, the colors red or black, or whether the number will be odd or even. If the ball lands in a pocket covered by one of the player's bets, he or she receives a reward proportional to the odds of his or her bet. Player bets fall into two categories: inside bets and outside bets.

Inside Bets - Inside bets are placed on the numbered sections of the board or on the outside edges.
* Straight-Up - A single number. The chip is entirely inside the square.
* Split - Two adjoining numbers. The chip is placed on the line between the numbers.
* Street - Three numbers in a horizontal line. The chip is placed at the edge of a line.
* Six Line - Two adjoining streets. The chip is placed at the edge between two streets.
* Corner - Four numbers in a square. The chip is placed at the intersection of the four numbers.
* Basket - 0, 1, and 2; 0, 00, and 2; or 00, 2, and 3. The chip is placed at the intersection between the three numbers.
* Top Line - 0, 00, 1, 2, and 3. The chip is placed at the corner of 0 and 1.

Outside Bets - Outside bets are played off of the main numbered section of the board and never include 0 or 00.
* 1-18, 19-36 - The first and second halves of the numbered board.
* Red, Black - Red and black numbers.
* Even, Odd - Even and odd numbers.
* 1st, 2nd, 3rd Dozen - The first (1-12), second (13-24) or third (25-36) set of numbers.
* 1st, 2nd, 3rd Column - A bet on an entire vertical column of numbers. The chip is placed at the base of the column.
name: Roulette

text_content:
Blackjack is a game played with one more standard decks of playing cards. In Fallout: New Vegas, it is played between the Courier and a casino dealer. The goal is to play a hand of two or more cards up to, but not exceeding, a combined value of 21 points. The value of each hand is determined by adding together the values of each individual card. Cards 2-10 are worth their listed value. Face cards (Jack, Queen, King) are worth 10 points. Aces are worth either 1 or 11 points, whichever is more advantageous. A hand that exceeds 21 in total value is considered a "bust" and immediately loses.

After the initial bet is made, the player and dealer are both dealt two cards. Based on the Courier's current hand, the player has different options:

* Hit - Add a new card to the Courier's hand. The player must accept the value of this card, though aces provide whatever value is most advantageous at any given time.

* Stay - Courier's hand is effectively "locked" and the dealer will deal cards into his or her own hand until his or her hand is at least 17. Note: at some casinos, dealers will continue to hit on a "soft" 17 that contains an ace. In either case, the dealer has no decision-making process and will always follow the listed rule.

* Double Down - The Courier's bet is doubled but the dealer will give the Courier's hand only a single additional card.

* Split - If the Courier's initial hand is a pair, the player may double his or her bet and split the pair into two separate hands that are played individually.

* Surrender - This option is only available immediately after the first cards are dealt. It offers the player the option to sacrifice half of his or her bet and immediately fold. It is typically only done when the player's hand is particularly bad and the dealer is showing a very strong hand (for example, an ace).

Once the dealer has completed dealing into his or her own hand following the player's choice to stay, the values of the Courier's hand and the dealer's hand are compared. Assuming neither party has busted (gone over 21), the higher value wins. In the case of a tie, the hand is considered a push. If the dealer has "blackjack" (an ace and a ten-value card), he or she automatically wins unless the Courier also has blackjack. In that case, the hand is considered a push.

Individual casinos use different numbers of card decks, pay out natural blackjack hands at different odds, and shuffle their decks with varying frequency. Pay close attention to these details to develop advanced playing strategies.
name: Blackjack

Three basic types of objects in the world can launch the crafting interface: Campfires, Workbenches, and Reloading Benches. Each station allows the creation of a subset of items. Though many recipes are visible at any time in the game, some recipes will only appear when the player completes a quest or finds a special item. You may also find that certain companions or special locations can open special crafting interfaces for the player.

Recipes have skill and ingredient requirements that must be met to proceed. If any requirement is darkened, that requirement has not been met. Any recipe that has all of its requirements fulfilled will appear fully lit. After using a recipe, the product(s) of the recipe will all immediately be available in your inventory.
name: Crafting

text_content:
Ammunition is used by almost all Guns and Energy Weapons but is sometimes used by other weapon types. Basic ammo types have no special effects, but ammo subtypes may increase damage, reduce an enemy's Damage Threshold, or even decrease spread. Effects are listed on the ammo submenu when the ammo is highlighted. Most weapons can use any ammo subtype that starts with the same name as the base ammo. Common ammo subtypes include:

* Armor Piercing: Ignores a large portion of the enemy's Damage Threshold, does slightly more damage.

* Hollow Point: Does much more damage, but is easily blocked by armor.

* Over Charge: Used by Energy Weapons, increases damage but degrades the weapon more quickly.

* Slug: Used by shotguns, slugs replace buckshot with a single, large bullet that is more accurate.

To switch ammo subtypes, equip them on this menu. Outside of the Pip-Boy, press &sXBDPadUp; to cycle through ammo subtypes for your currently equipped weapon.
name: Ammo

text_content:
Apparel can consist of many different types of gear ranging from clothing and armor to sunglasses and hats.

* DT: Some apparel grants Damage Threshold (DT) to the wearer. Your DT is the sum of all DT for currently equipped apparel plus any bonuses from perks or chems. DT is directly subtracted from incoming damage, so a higher DT provides superior protection. Though a small percentage of damage can get through even the thickest armor, a high DT is quite valuable.

* CND: Apparel's Condition (CND) affects how much protection it provides. Apparel above 50% CND provides maximum protection and only needs to be maintained.

* Light/Medium/Heavy: Medium and Heavy apparel will slow characters down when equipped.

* Repair: This option opens the Repair submenu, which allows apparel to be repaired by salvaging parts from similar items.
name: Apparel

text_content:
All weapons fall under a weapon skill category that determines how effective the weapon is: Guns, Energy Weapons, Explosives, Melee Weapons, or Unarmed. Compare the small icon below and to the left of the weapon's icon to the icon shown on the Pip-Boy's skill menu.

* DAM/DPS: These indicate the base Damage and Damage Per Second, respectively. Weapons with a low DAM have difficulty penetrating armor. If you hit a target's Damage Threshold, switch to a weapon with a higher DAM or use ammo that reduces the target's Damage Threshold (e.g. Armor Piercing).

* CND: A weapon's Condition affects the amount of damage is does. At 75% Condition or higher, a weapon does maximum damage and only needs to be maintained. A weapon with low Condition will do less damage and may jam when reloaded.
