text_content: {Dog Alive: Narration}Dog, free of the voice inside his head and no longer waiting on the voice of the Master, wandered back West. |{Narration}His hunger never ended. Often, small communities would suddenly vanish.|{Narration}They were assumed to have been hit by Wasteland creatures and dragged away... dogs, Brahmin, and humans alike.
name: NVDLC01EndingDog "NVDLC01EndingDog" [DIAL:0100AD9F]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {God Alive: Narration}Freed of both Dog and the one who held Dog's leash, the other voice resumed control. First the mind, then finally, the mutant's shell.|{Narration}His first act was to tend to the scars on the body with careful hands, slowly healing all the scars except the ragged name torn on his chest.|{Narration}He briefly thought of remaining at the Sierra Madre. But it was a monument built by humans, representing something he no longer needed.|{Narration}He began walking west, in search of others like him. As he did, he spoke of the courier who had set him free and allowed his life to begin again.
name: NVDLC01EndingDog "NVDLC01EndingDog" [DIAL:0100AD9F]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: NVDLC01EndingChristine
name: NVDLC01EndingChristine "NVDLC01EndingChristine" [DIAL:0100ADA0]

text_content: {Christine Dead: Narration}Christine, scarred by her hunt for Elijah and unable to let him go, perished in the Sierra Madre Casino.|{Narration}She never completed her mission, nor did she stop to consider what had driven her to accept the mission in the first place.|{Narration}Obsession is another form of greed, a lesson that Christine never learned.
name: NVDLC01EndingChristine "NVDLC01EndingChristine" [DIAL:0100ADA0]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: {Christine Alive: Narration}Christine, her mission complete, found new purpose as the Sierra Madre's warden. She watched over it silently - by choice.|{Narration}Over time, the Ghost People came to see her as one of the Holograms. They would watch, silently, as she walked among them.|{Narration, a little tender here}At times, Christine thought of the Courier, who had kept Elijah's hand from her throat.|{Narration}The Courier reminded her of the {slight emph}other courier she had met in the Big Empty, and wondered if the two had found each other at last.|{Narration, quiet}She did not think of them again until she heard the legends of the Divide.|{Slow, reverent - this is quietly dramatic, ends on a sad downnote}The Divide, where the two messengers, the two couriers, fought beneath an ancient flag, at the edge of the world.
name: NVDLC01EndingChristine "NVDLC01EndingChristine" [DIAL:0100ADA0]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: NVDLC01EndingDean
name: NVDLC01EndingDean "NVDLC01EndingDean" [DIAL:0100ADA1]

text_content: {Dean Dead: Narration, a little wistful at the memory}Dean Domino, entertainer, singer... thief... had his last show on the Sierra Madre stage.|{Narration}The heist he spent over two hundred years planning fell apart, just as the first, by underestimating his partner's strength.|{Narration}Not long after the Courier left the Villa, the lights in the theater shut off, one by one.|{Narration}Only Dean's Hologram remained on stage, singing silently to an empty room.|{Narration, sad shaking of head, end on a downnote}Still... as consumed as he had been with its riches and ruin, the Sierra Madre had held him captive long ago.
name: NVDLC01EndingDean "NVDLC01EndingDean" [DIAL:0100ADA1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Dean Alive: Narration, slightly upbeat}Dean Domino, entertainer, singer... thief... explored the Sierra Madre not long after he was rescued by the Courier.|{Narration}Once he left the theater, the Sierra Madre recognized him as a guest, and many doors opened to him. He had to admit, it had been built to last.|{Narration}During his search, he came across the final records of Vera and Sinclair, and realized what happened the night the bombs fell.|{Narration}He felt strangely sad for a moment, and he had no idea why.|{Narration}Shrugging it off, his mind turned instead to where the Courier had come from. Vegas still survived, out there in the Mojave.|{Narration}Its sights, sounds... and casinos, ripe for the taking.|{Narration, slightly upbeat}So giving the Sierra Madre one last nod and a wink, he set off beyond the Cloud to begin again.
name: NVDLC01EndingDean "NVDLC01EndingDean" [DIAL:0100ADA1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01LobbyStarletWelcome
name: NVDLC01LobbyStarletWelcome "NVDLC01LobbyStarletWelcome" [DIAL:0100AE58]

text_content: <Lie> We'll take the elevator up, see if there's another way to do this. After you.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic025 "<Lie> We'll take the elevator up, see if there's another way to do this. After you." [DIAL:0100B02F]

text_content: [Christine smiles slightly in relief, and moves to the elevator.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic025 "<Lie> We'll take the elevator up, see if there's another way to do this. After you." [DIAL:0100B02F]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: All right, let me see if I can find another way to do this without sending you down there.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic024 "All right, let me see if I can find another way to do this without sending you down there." [DIAL:0100B030]

text_content: [Christine smiles slightly in relief, and nods. She opens her mouth slightly, then closes it, frustrated.]|[She points at you, then makes a fist and puts it against her chest and nods.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic024 "All right, let me see if I can find another way to do this without sending you down there." [DIAL:0100B030]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: I need you to go down to the manual bypass room to regulate the power.
name: GettingChristinedownintoGalaEventposition "I need you to go down to the manual bypass room to regulate the power." [DIAL:0100B031]

text_content: [Christine glances at the elevator, her expression becomes worried, then she looks back at you, then reluctantly shakes her head.]
name: GettingChristinedownintoGalaEventposition "I need you to go down to the manual bypass room to regulate the power." [DIAL:0100B031]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: I need you to stay here and fire off the Gala Event.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic007 "I need you to stay here and fire off the Gala Event." [DIAL:0100B034]

text_content: Unless you get some Hologram guards lit up in the courtyard below? No dice.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic007 "I need you to stay here and fire off the Gala Event." [DIAL:0100B034]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Like told to wait in a DMZ}Whoa, whoa, whoa... in the middle of town here? Alone? On a {emph}rooftop, with a big lightshow in the air?|{Sarcastic}Tell you what - why don't you just find one of those Cosmic steak knives so I can slit my wrists, be less {emph}painful checking out that way.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic007 "I need you to stay here and fire off the Gala Event." [DIAL:0100B034]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: I'd like help with something else.
name: NVDLC01CasinoCompsNVDLC01HologramCashierCasinoTopic006 "I'd like help with something else." [DIAL:0100C4BE]

text_content: [The Hologram waits.]
name: NVDLC01CasinoCompsNVDLC01HologramCashierCasinoTopic006 "I'd like help with something else." [DIAL:0100C4BE]
speaker: NVDLC01HologramCashierCasino "Hologram" [NPC_:0100C4D0]

text_content: 20 Chips for 20 Pre-War Bills.
name: NVDLC01CasinoCompsNVDLC01HologramCashierCasinoTopic005 "20 Chips for 20 Pre-War Bills." [DIAL:0100C4BF]

text_content: [You count out the bills on the counter. A panel flips, followed by slow, steady series of clicks, and a stack of chips rise up from the panel.]
name: NVDLC01CasinoCompsNVDLC01HologramCashierCasinoTopic005 "20 Chips for 20 Pre-War Bills." [DIAL:0100C4BF]
speaker: NVDLC01HologramCashierCasino "Hologram" [NPC_:0100C4D0]

text_content: Let me have 5 Chips for 5 Pre-War Bills.
name: NVDLC01CasinoCompsNVDLC01HologramCashierCasinoTopic004 "Let me have 5 Chips for 5 Pre-War Bills." [DIAL:0100C4C0]

text_content: [You set the bills on the counter. A panel flips, there is a single whir, a click, then a panel rises up with a handful of Sierra Madre Chips.]
name: NVDLC01CasinoCompsNVDLC01HologramCashierCasinoTopic004 "Let me have 5 Chips for 5 Pre-War Bills." [DIAL:0100C4C0]
speaker: NVDLC01HologramCashierCasino "Hologram" [NPC_:0100C4D0]

text_content: Uh... 1 Chip for 1 Pre-War Bill.
name: NVDLC01CasinoCompsNVDLC01HologramCashierCasinoTopic003 "Uh... 1 Chip for 1 Pre-War Bill." [DIAL:0100C4C1]

text_content: [You place the bill on the counter. A panel rotates, and the bill is replaced with a single Sierra Madre Chip.]
name: NVDLC01CasinoCompsNVDLC01HologramCashierCasinoTopic003 "Uh... 1 Chip for 1 Pre-War Bill." [DIAL:0100C4C1]
speaker: NVDLC01HologramCashierCasino "Hologram" [NPC_:0100C4D0]

text_content: That's all for now. Thanks.
name: NVDLC01CasinoCompsNVDLC01HologramCashierCasinoTopic002 "That's all for now. Thanks." [DIAL:0100C4C2]

text_content: [The Hologram nods, gives a stiff farewell wave.]
name: NVDLC01CasinoCompsNVDLC01HologramCashierCasinoTopic002 "That's all for now. Thanks." [DIAL:0100C4C2]
speaker: NVDLC01HologramCashierCasino "Hologram" [NPC_:0100C4D0]

text_content: Can I turn in my Sierra Madre Chips for Pre-War Money?
name: NVDLC01CasinoCompsNVDLC01HologramCashierCasinoTopic001 "Can I turn in my Sierra Madre Chips for Pre-War Money?" [DIAL:0100C4C3]

text_content: [The Hologram points at the table before you. As you set the chips down, the tabletop rotates, and with a whir, Pre-War bills slide out.]
name: NVDLC01CasinoCompsNVDLC01HologramCashierCasinoTopic001 "Can I turn in my Sierra Madre Chips for Pre-War Money?" [DIAL:0100C4C3]
speaker: NVDLC01HologramCashierCasino "Hologram" [NPC_:0100C4D0]

text_content: I want to exchange Pre-War money for some Sierra Madre Chips.
name: NVDLC01CasinoCompsNVDLC01HologramCashierCasinoTopic000 "I want to exchange Pre-War money for some Sierra Madre Chips." [DIAL:0100C4C4]

text_content: [The Hologram makes a gesture, seems to be indicating amounts and figures.]
name: NVDLC01CasinoCompsNVDLC01HologramCashierCasinoTopic000 "I want to exchange Pre-War money for some Sierra Madre Chips." [DIAL:0100C4C4]
speaker: NVDLC01HologramCashierCasino "Hologram" [NPC_:0100C4D0]

text_content: {THEATER: Player has rescued Dean}Are you all right?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic010 "{THEATER: Player has rescued Dean}Are you all right?" [DIAL:0100C4D9]

text_content: {Relieved}Yeah, now. Talk about a captive audience. {Frowns, thinking it over}Or captive entertainer? Eh - whatever.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic010 "{THEATER: Player has rescued Dean}Are you all right?" [DIAL:0100C4D9]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks
name: NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks "NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks" [DIAL:0100C7D9]

text_content: {Confused}What did you just do... can't access the protocols. {Beat, under her breath}Didn't even think Elijah could break Madre security... hnh. Must be a Scribe, too.
name: NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks "NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks" [DIAL:0100C7D9]

text_content: {Confused}Security's down...? Hnh. {Frowns, wasn't expecting this}Doesn't matter, won't help you.
name: NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks "NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks" [DIAL:0100C7D9]

text_content: {Pained}If it's who I think it is, this is Christine... recovered. {Starts getting voice back, surveying room, professional}In what looks like an Old World hotel room, high class, two rooms - {beat}exit's sealed.
name: NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks "NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks" [DIAL:0100C7D9]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Floor's got holographic security. {Beat, recalling info, under her breath}Not latest tech, field of view targeting systems, primitive. {Under her breath}Familiar.
name: NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks "NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks" [DIAL:0100C7D9]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Floor looks like it protected the guests too well. {Somber, dead body}Checked the Suite, found the holographic woman from the Villa Fountain.
name: NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks "NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks" [DIAL:0100C7D9]

text_content: Picking up that interference frequency, same as the Villa, floor's live with speakers and radios. Keep an ear out, watch the walls.
name: NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks "NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks" [DIAL:0100C7D9]

text_content: Doors on this floor are all operated manually in an emergency, place is locked up tight. {Beat, under her breath}Must be keycards around somewhere.
name: NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks "NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks" [DIAL:0100C7D9]

text_content: {Frowns, to herself}Looks like security systems did more to kill the people here than the Bomb did. {Beat}Hope there's a way out of this casino.
name: NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks "NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks" [DIAL:0100C7D9]

text_content: {Pained}What's with my collar... Elijah? Or... no, it's you. Even better. {Beat, gathering strength}This is Christine, voice back. You got off on the wrong floor, you're trapped.
name: NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks "NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks" [DIAL:0100C7D9]

text_content: {Angry, grim}Hope you can make it past security. I've been looking forward to taking care of you since the Gala Event.
name: NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks "NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks" [DIAL:0100C7D9]

text_content: You and Elijah were working together this whole time. Should've known, just from your actions, you have his... outlook on things.
name: NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks "NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks" [DIAL:0100C7D9]

text_content: Hope you aren't dead yet... although I'm sure my collar would let me know. I could just detonate it now, but saving it for someone special.
name: NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks "NVDLC01ChristineSuitesBarks" [DIAL:0100C7D9]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrapsPlayerTopic03
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrapsPlayerTopic03 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrapsPlayerTopic03" [DIAL:0100CEBC]

text_content: {Snarls, impatience breaking through}Did you {emph}really think you could steal from me? {Beat, cold, slower}The Sierra Madre is {emph}mine.
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrapsPlayerTopic03 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrapsPlayerTopic03" [DIAL:0100CEBC]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahVaultPlayerCollarTopic01
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultPlayerCollarTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultPlayerCollarTopic01" [DIAL:0100CEBD]

text_content: {Elijah's furious about fallen for a trap & vengefully sets bomb collar tick - 10 seconds to get out at the end of this line.}You think you've outsmarted me? You can't get away. You're the one on a leash, you always were.
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultPlayerCollarTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultPlayerCollarTopic01" [DIAL:0100CEBD]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrappedTopic04
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrappedTopic04 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrappedTopic04" [DIAL:0100CEBE]

text_content: {Cold}You think you've escaped... no. No, you were never out of reach... my hand was always around your neck.
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrappedTopic04 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrappedTopic04" [DIAL:0100CEBE]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrappedTopic03
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrappedTopic03 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrappedTopic03" [DIAL:0100CEBF]

text_content: {Furious, determined, as he starts running programs}This entire structure is mine to command. Security... weapons... all this technology - mine. {Beat, evil and pleased}Now - you die.
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrappedTopic03 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrappedTopic03" [DIAL:0100CEBF]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrappedTopic02
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrappedTopic02 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrappedTopic02" [DIAL:0100CEC0]

text_content: Alarms... what... {snarls, realizes he's been set up, emph}you. Think you can run, think you can trick {emph}me?
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrappedTopic02 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrappedTopic02" [DIAL:0100CEC0]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrappedTopic01
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrappedTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrappedTopic01" [DIAL:0100CEC1]

text_content: {Slight surprise}Eh? What's this.
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrappedTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrappedTopic01" [DIAL:0100CEC1]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahVaultDiesTopic01
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultDiesTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultDiesTopic01" [DIAL:0100CEC2]

text_content: {Elijah's dying - he curses you, and collapses in agony.}Think you've won? You've won {emph}nothing.
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultDiesTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultDiesTopic01" [DIAL:0100CEC2]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahVaultCombatBarkTopic04
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultCombatBarkTopic04 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultCombatBarkTopic04" [DIAL:0100CEC3]

text_content: {Elijah taunts you, during combat scene against him, or the sentry turrets of the Vault}You came all this way... but you lost as soon as you arrived here.
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultCombatBarkTopic04 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultCombatBarkTopic04" [DIAL:0100CEC3]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahVaultCombatBarkTopic03
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultCombatBarkTopic03 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultCombatBarkTopic03" [DIAL:0100CEC4]

text_content: {Elijah taunts you, during combat scene against him, or the sentry turrets of the Vault}I'm not without weapons of my own... let me show you.
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultCombatBarkTopic03 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultCombatBarkTopic03" [DIAL:0100CEC4]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahVaultCombatBarkTopic02
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultCombatBarkTopic02 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultCombatBarkTopic02" [DIAL:0100CEC5]

text_content: {Elijah taunts you, during combat scene against him, or the sentry turrets of the Vault}Struggle all you want... the Sierra Madre will be your grave.
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultCombatBarkTopic02 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultCombatBarkTopic02" [DIAL:0100CEC5]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahVaultCombatBarkTopic01
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultCombatBarkTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultCombatBarkTopic01" [DIAL:0100CEC6]

text_content: {Elijah taunts you, during combat scene against him, or the sentry turrets of the Vault}Time is against you. It always was.
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultCombatBarkTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultCombatBarkTopic01" [DIAL:0100CEC6]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahVaultSentryDownTopic03
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultSentryDownTopic03 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultSentryDownTopic03" [DIAL:0100CEC7]

text_content: {Snarls, pissed}Aaah... Pre-War {emph}junk. I'll put you down myself.
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultSentryDownTopic03 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultSentryDownTopic03" [DIAL:0100CEC7]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahVaultSentryDownTopic02
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultSentryDownTopic02 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultSentryDownTopic02" [DIAL:0100CEC8]

text_content: {Irritated, under his breath, player's putting up a fight}Don't have {emph}time for this.
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultSentryDownTopic02 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultSentryDownTopic02" [DIAL:0100CEC8]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahVaultSentryDownTopic01
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultSentryDownTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultSentryDownTopic01" [DIAL:0100CEC9]

text_content: Pre-War tech... so easy to control, just like your Pip-Boy. Turrets, Holograms, they're all just toys.
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultSentryDownTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultSentryDownTopic01" [DIAL:0100CEC9]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrapsPlayerTopic02
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrapsPlayerTopic02 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrapsPlayerTopic02" [DIAL:0100CECA]

text_content: {Contemptuous, superior}I'll have the Sierra Madre kill you for me. {Beat, then slower, more menacing}You can't beat all the casino's defenses... it's only a matter of time now.
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrapsPlayerTopic02 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrapsPlayerTopic02" [DIAL:0100CECA]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrapsPlayerTopic01
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrapsPlayerTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrapsPlayerTopic01" [DIAL:0100CECB]

text_content: {Contemptuous, superior}Staying in the Vault? Think it'll protect you? No... I don't think so.
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrapsPlayerTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultTrapsPlayerTopic01" [DIAL:0100CECB]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Unlock it, give it back, then shut up.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic156 "Unlock it, give it back, then shut up." [DIAL:0100CEEE]

text_content: Yes. It was entrusted to me, not you.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic155 "Yes. It was entrusted to me, not you." [DIAL:0100CEEF]

text_content: Here you go.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic154 "Here you go." [DIAL:0100CEF0]

text_content: Did it make any sense?
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic153 "Did it make any sense?" [DIAL:0100CEF1]

text_content: It's a message. The news is up to you.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic151 "It's a message. The news is up to you." [DIAL:0100CEF2]

text_content: There's something I wanted to pass along.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic150 "There's something I wanted to pass along." [DIAL:0100CEF3]

text_content: He's dead.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic149 "He's dead." [DIAL:0100CEF4]

text_content: He's trapped, no chance of him escaping.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic148 "He's trapped, no chance of him escaping." [DIAL:0100CEF5]

text_content: I had to kill him before he hurt others.
name: VDialogueVeronicaVeronicaTopic147 "I had to kill him before he hurt others." [DIAL:0100CEF6]

text_content: NVDLC01DogDialogueRandomBark
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueRandomBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueRandomBark" [DIAL:0100DFB9]

text_content: {Dog voice, frightened}Get away while you can, before he comes back.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueRandomBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueRandomBark" [DIAL:0100DFB9]

text_content: {Dog voice, frightened, rocking back and forth}Makes Dog hurt self.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueRandomBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueRandomBark" [DIAL:0100DFB9]

text_content: {Dog voice, whispering, frightened}Master, help me, Master, help me. Please.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueRandomBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueRandomBark" [DIAL:0100DFB9]

text_content: {Dog voice, frightened, sad}Don't let him make me hurt myself. Hurt keeps him away.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueRandomBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueRandomBark" [DIAL:0100DFB9]

text_content: {Dog voice}So hungry.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueRandomBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueRandomBark" [DIAL:0100DFB9]

text_content: {Dog voice, frightened}I'll be good this time, I promise, Master, just keep him away.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueRandomBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueRandomBark" [DIAL:0100DFB9]

text_content: NVDLC01DogDialogueSpecificBark
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueSpecificBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueSpecificBark" [DIAL:0100DFBA]

text_content: {Dog voice}Noise makes my stomach hurt.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueSpecificBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueSpecificBark" [DIAL:0100DFBA]

text_content: {Dog voice}Turn the noise off.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueSpecificBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueSpecificBark" [DIAL:0100DFBA]

text_content: {Dog voice}Puts Dog in the cage, hiding downstairs.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueSpecificBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueSpecificBark" [DIAL:0100DFBA]

text_content: {Dog voice}He's watching, waiting for you to try and let me go.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueSpecificBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueSpecificBark" [DIAL:0100DFBA]

text_content: {Dog voice}So hungry.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueSpecificBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueSpecificBark" [DIAL:0100DFBA]

text_content: NVDLC01DogDialogueBackInYourCage
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueBackInYourCage "NVDLC01DogDialogueBackInYourCage" [DIAL:0100DFBB]

text_content: {Commanding, spoken in God's voice}Dog, back in the cage.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueBackInYourCage "NVDLC01DogDialogueBackInYourCage" [DIAL:0100DFBB]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: NVDLC01DogDialogueGodFirstTime
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGodFirstTime "NVDLC01DogDialogueGodFirstTime" [DIAL:0100E10E]

text_content: {God: Impressed, player jumped through his hoops, evil, amused. Curious}What have we here? {Beat, slight mock disappointment}You weren't who I was expecting. I'm disappointed.|{Appraising player, suspicious}Still... even if you aren't my intended guest, you take direction. Good. You can't have been an idiot to figure out how to release me from my cage...|{Looking at player's Pip-Boy and collar}...or perhaps you are, with that leash on your arm {emph}and the one around your neck... {mocking, evil}with our collars and manacles, why, we may as well be kin.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGodFirstTime "NVDLC01DogDialogueGodFirstTime" [DIAL:0100E10E]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: NVDLC01DogDialogueGodBasementBark
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGodBasementBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueGodBasementBark" [DIAL:0100E4DC]

text_content: {Malicious, whispering}Knew you would come, below the cage... down to where {emph}I am. {Beat, lower}Maybe you saw the letters I scratched on the Villa walls.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGodBasementBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueGodBasementBark" [DIAL:0100E4DC]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Malicious, encouraging taunt}A little farther. Follow my voice... that's it. {Beat}The one in the cage? Dog. {Slight anger}I had to lock him up. He keeps... disobeying me.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGodBasementBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueGodBasementBark" [DIAL:0100E4DC]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: That's me, there, on the table. The disk. {Beat, soft, creepy}My voice.|{Warning}Can't take any chances, though... you may be some victim who simply stumbled down here. If so, can't let you let Dog out... no, not yet.|{Imperious}If you're who I think you are, you came to fetch Dog, use him to drag others here. {Beat, cruel}Now I'll use {emph}you - {emph}and that Pip-Boy you're wearing.|{Taunting}You're smart. Clever. The key to Dog's cage is simple. Take my voice to the cage above. {Beat}Let me speak to the beast inside.|Then you and I... {emph}we can talk.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGodBasementBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueGodBasementBark" [DIAL:0100E4DC]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: I don't have time for this. Get in the damn elevator.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic028 "I don't have time for this. Get in the damn elevator." [DIAL:0100EC8A]

text_content: [Christine shakes her head, more insistently this time. She points at the elevator, then downwards, then holds herself tightly and shakes her head.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic028 "I don't have time for this. Get in the damn elevator." [DIAL:0100EC8A]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: I've found a way to do the bypass from here. You should be able to just use the terminal over there.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic027 "I've found a way to do the bypass from here. You should be able to just use the terminal over there." [DIAL:0100EC8B]

text_content: [Christine nods gratefully. She glances in the direction of the terminal, looks at you, smiles, gives a thumbs up.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic027 "I've found a way to do the bypass from here. You should be able to just use the terminal over there." [DIAL:0100EC8B]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: NVDLC01ChristineGalaPositionBarks
name: NVDLC01ChristineGalaPositionBarks "NVDLC01ChristineGalaPositionBarks" [DIAL:0100EC8C]

text_content: [Christine motions to you, points at the door uneasily, then makes a pulling motion with her hand. She seems hesitant to go near it.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineGalaPositionBarks "NVDLC01ChristineGalaPositionBarks" [DIAL:0100EC8C]

text_content: Well, if I can get here, others will be, soon enough. Fountain's the safest place.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic059 "Well, if I can get here, others will be, soon enough. Fountain's the safest place." [DIAL:0100ED63]

text_content: That's... a good point. All right, let me grab some smokes, and I'll meet you at the Fountain.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic059 "Well, if I can get here, others will be, soon enough. Fountain's the safest place." [DIAL:0100ED63]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Fine. Get up and follow me.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic058 "Fine. Get up and follow me." [DIAL:0100ED64]

text_content: All right... partner.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic058 "Fine. Get up and follow me." [DIAL:0100ED64]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: All right, all right... but you already got company, so tell you what - I'll meet you at the Fountain.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic058 "Fine. Get up and follow me." [DIAL:0100ED64]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Any reason you can't find your way there?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic057 "Any reason you can't find your way there?" [DIAL:0100ED65]

text_content: I know what's out there. It's why I've planted a mine field, shotguns, and explosives all the way on the road to my little boudoir here.|So we go together, or we're not going at all. I'll split my hand in Blackjack when the time's right, I'm not splitting up in this town, trust me.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic057 "Any reason you can't find your way there?" [DIAL:0100ED65]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: We'll find out more about our "contract" back at the Fountain.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic056 "We'll find out more about our ""contract"" back at the Fountain." [DIAL:0100ED66]

text_content: Fine. Get up and follow me.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic054 "Fine. Get up and follow me." [DIAL:0100ED67]

text_content: I think you can manage walking there without me. Now get going.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic053 "I think you can manage walking there without me. Now get going." [DIAL:0100ED68]

text_content: Wait, wait... wait just a minute. I'm not walking out there on my own.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic053 "I think you can manage walking there without me. Now get going." [DIAL:0100ED68]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Meet at the Fountain, and we'll hear what the next step is.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic048 "Meet at the Fountain, and we'll hear what the next step is." [DIAL:0100ED6A]

text_content: Not leaving me much choice. The Fountain, huh? {Beat}Hope the Hologram's still working and the battery's running strong.|I'll follow you, I'm not going alone, trust me. Not like I'm a coward or anything, I'm not running around town without an escort.|I'm serious. One of the locals catches us, we aren't coming back - and I'd like to keep an eye on you.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic048 "Meet at the Fountain, and we'll hear what the next step is." [DIAL:0100ED6A]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: It's starting to make sense, now that I've met you.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic046 "It's starting to make sense, now that I've met you." [DIAL:0100ED6C]

text_content: {Laughs}All right, all right... looks like marriage finally caught me.|I'm listening... partner. What's next, if we're death-til-we-part?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic046 "It's starting to make sense, now that I've met you." [DIAL:0100ED6C]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: I only need you breathing. Push me, I'll bring you to the point of death, then leave you.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic045 "I only need you breathing. Push me, I'll bring you to the point of death, then leave you." [DIAL:0100ED6D]

text_content: Agree to come with me now, or I get up from this chair and kill us both, shaped-charge or no.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic044 "Agree to come with me now, or I get up from this chair and kill us both, shaped-charge or no." [DIAL:0100ED6E]

text_content: Forget this, I'm leaving.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic043 "Forget this, I'm leaving." [DIAL:0100ED6F]

text_content: Either deal with me as an equal, or I walk.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic042 "Either deal with me as an equal, or I walk." [DIAL:0100ED70]

text_content: Just like all the rest. Strolling in here, thinking you own the place. I've been here longer than {emph}any of you tourists.|Trust me, I'm letting you off easier than the Sierra Madre ever would. Nobody's going to miss you... whoever you are, you're old news.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic042 "Either deal with me as an equal, or I walk." [DIAL:0100ED70]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: I think you're bluffing. I'm getting up, right now.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic041 "I think you're bluffing. I'm getting up, right now." [DIAL:0100ED71]

text_content: Uh... look, maybe we can make some sort of... deal, you and me.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic040 "Uh... look, maybe we can make some sort of... deal, you and me." [DIAL:0100ED72]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Frowns, suspicious}What are you talking about?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic040 "Uh... look, maybe we can make some sort of... deal, you and me." [DIAL:0100ED72]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: [FAILED] The hand's been dealt, {emph}that's the deal. You going along with my terms, or do you want your brains to be wallpaper?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic040 "Uh... look, maybe we can make some sort of... deal, you and me." [DIAL:0100ED72]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Our collars... these "neckties" are linked. I die, you die.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic039 "Our collars... these ""neckties"" are linked. I die, you die." [DIAL:0100ED73]

text_content: That's an interesting clause. {Frowns}That's a real bad contract you have. We have.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic039 "Our collars... these ""neckties"" are linked. I die, you die." [DIAL:0100ED73]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: I'm not going to help you.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic037 "I'm not going to help you." [DIAL:0100ED74]

text_content: That so?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic037 "I'm not going to help you." [DIAL:0100ED74]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: I'll cooperate. What do you want?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic021 "I'll cooperate. What do you want?" [DIAL:0100ED82]

text_content: {Slightly friendlier, let's-make-a-deal}Good, good - then we're in business. I may be a betting man, but I like it when the odds are in our favor.|If you're here with who I think, then I'd rather have you on my side than his. An... ace in the hole.|You want to live, I want what's in the Madre. Real simple.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic021 "I'll cooperate. What do you want?" [DIAL:0100ED82]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Misund...? Ummm.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic020 "Misund...? Ummm." [DIAL:0100ED83]

text_content: Christ, if that collar blows, I don't know if you'd know the difference, you'd probably still keep walking around with that dumb, blank look.|{Different than other one - speaking to an idiot, so emphasis is different}Just because I work in entertainment, doesn't mean {emph}I'm a moron.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic020 "Misund...? Ummm." [DIAL:0100ED83]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: I'm listening.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic019 "I'm listening." [DIAL:0100ED84]

text_content: You've got my attention. For the moment.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic018 "You've got my attention. For the moment." [DIAL:0100ED85]

text_content: Look - I need your help to get into the Sierra Madre.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic017 "Look - I need your help to get into the Sierra Madre." [DIAL:0100ED86]

text_content: {Irritated, bad side starts coming out}Oh, of course you do. Now, it's like we're married with these big wedding rings around our necks.|So why don't you hear {emph}my proposal first, before you start talking about what {emph}you need.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic017 "Look - I need your help to get into the Sierra Madre." [DIAL:0100ED86]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Uh... you... probably want to hear my side of things.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic016 "Uh... you... probably want to hear my side of things." [DIAL:0100ED87]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Pleased}And that's what I've missed - a rapt audience.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic016 "Uh... you... probably want to hear my side of things." [DIAL:0100ED87]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: [FAILED] You don't listen too good, do you? {Colder}Makes me think whatever you have to say isn't worth my time.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic016 "Uh... you... probably want to hear my side of things." [DIAL:0100ED87]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: <Storage Blue Node. Do not translate.>
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic015 "<Storage Blue Node. Do not translate.>" [DIAL:0100ED88]

text_content: Get up without my permission, I'll blast your ass so far through your head, it'll turn the moon cherry pie red.|So - let's keep this sweet and polite, and finish our conversation with no misunderstandings.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic015 "<Storage Blue Node. Do not translate.>" [DIAL:0100ED88]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Just because I work in entertainment, doesn't mean I'm a moron.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic015 "<Storage Blue Node. Do not translate.>" [DIAL:0100ED88]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: I heard my necktie beeping, I know what that means - I'm part of this somehow. I want out of this contract.|{Colder}And if you put me in it, I'm not going to be too happy. So whatever's going on here, if you're part of all this? You're taking orders from me.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic015 "<Storage Blue Node. Do not translate.>" [DIAL:0100ED88]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Talking level with the player, relieved to be saved}I'm not an idiot. I know the reason I'm in here now is because of the old guy - and you. |{Rueful}And {emph}you're wearing a collar, so I trust you a {emph}little more than the old guy. {Beat, throw this line away}He's more controlling than I'd like.|{Whispering}Thing is, here's where being my {emph}partner pays off. See, I know how to get into the casino vault.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic015 "<Storage Blue Node. Do not translate.>" [DIAL:0100ED88]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: So here's the short of it - piece together Little Miss Vera Keyes' song in the right order? {Beat, spreads hands}Sierra Madre opens its legs, we're in business.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic015 "<Storage Blue Node. Do not translate.>" [DIAL:0100ED88]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Hnh?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic014 "Hnh?" [DIAL:0100ED89]

text_content: {Frowns}Great, a moron - just what I need. {Beat}Look? That seat you're sitting in? It's a {emph}bomb. Go boom.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic014 "Hnh?" [DIAL:0100ED89]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: The chair's... an explosive? But...
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic013 "The chair's... an explosive? But..." [DIAL:0100ED8A]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Impressed}Sounds like you've done some blue collar construction work in your life, your Ma must be proud. Still...
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic013 "The chair's... an explosive? But..." [DIAL:0100ED8A]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: [FAILED] "Butt" is right. That heart-shaped charge in the stuffing will cause just the right amount of bleeding.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic013 "The chair's... an explosive? But..." [DIAL:0100ED8A]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Not one for sitting when the clock's ticking.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic012 "Not one for sitting when the clock's ticking." [DIAL:0100ED8B]

text_content: What are you talking about?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic011 "What are you talking about?" [DIAL:0100ED8C]

text_content: Might be a bit rude, but that chair you're sitting in - it's got a shaped charge in the seat cushion.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic011 "What are you talking about?" [DIAL:0100ED8C]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: What can you tell me about the Villa and the town?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic070 "What can you tell me about the Villa and the town?" [DIAL:0100EDB4]

text_content: Residential area, clinic, police station - should keep away from the police station, it's a Ghost People hangout.|Salida del Sol, Puesta del Sol are East Town, West Town. "Sunrise" and "Sunset." {To himself, irritated}Or were when the streets and sky weren't covered with toxic gas.|Ghost People don't come into the Villa much. West Town and East Town, though... they're thick with the Cloud {emph}and Ghost People. Like hunting grounds.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic070 "What can you tell me about the Villa and the town?" [DIAL:0100EDB4]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Tell me about the Cloud.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic069 "Tell me about the Cloud." [DIAL:0100EDB5]

text_content: The Cloud? Showed up after the Bomb. {Frowns}I think. I got used to it in small doses. Now, it covers the city.|{Slightly sad for a moment}Over the years, it kept climbing up out of the Sierra Madre, until it was curtains for the sun. Didn't see the sky again.|Doesn't seem to bother the Ghost People. Can't see through it too well, though, so sometimes I can use the Cloud for cover... if I get desperate.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic069 "Tell me about the Cloud." [DIAL:0100EDB5]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Where can I find these cards?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic068 "Where can I find these cards?" [DIAL:0100EDB6]

text_content: Around. Don't have much use for them myself, not worth the risk to get them.|I got all the basics covered, as long as I have the chips to pay for them. I don't need much.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic068 "Where can I find these cards?" [DIAL:0100EDB6]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: What other items can you get out of the machines?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic067 "What other items can you get out of the machines?" [DIAL:0100EDB7]

text_content: If it's an emergency, you can get chems for any... uh... condition. Sinclair left that for doctors and trained professionals, not the common folk. |Even security and maintenance could get special supplies out of them. Staff had codes on little cards they could use to unlock them.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic067 "What other items can you get out of the machines?" [DIAL:0100EDB7]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: How did he describe it?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic066 "How did he describe it?" [DIAL:0100EDB8]

text_content: Called it "self-sufficient." Like he was doing the residents a favor. Right.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic066 "How did he describe it?" [DIAL:0100EDB8]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Grifters?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic065 "Grifters?" [DIAL:0100EDB9]

text_content: Sinclair made sure if you spent money here, it went {emph}one direction - although that's not how {emph}he described it.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic065 "Grifters?" [DIAL:0100EDB9]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: I've never seen machines like those before.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic064 "I've never seen machines like those before." [DIAL:0100EDBA]

text_content: {Took vending machines for granted, realizes player may not}Yeah, well, machines like those weren't unusual before the Bomb. Maybe to you, they're amazing, to me, they're grifters without the personality.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic064 "I've never seen machines like those before." [DIAL:0100EDBA]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: What are the Vending Machines all over town?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic063 "What are the Vending Machines all over town?" [DIAL:0100EDBB]

text_content: Those little company stores? Sinclair's toy boxes, put in a casino chip, get a treat, {angry at self}like you're some dog doing tricks.|Take any of the casino chips, put 'em into the machine, and you'll get something out - a snack, a cola, something to mend a tear in your shirt.|Sometimes you have to know exactly what to ask for, other times, there's codes for... eh, unconventional items. For emergencies.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic063 "What are the Vending Machines all over town?" [DIAL:0100EDBB]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Is there anything else about them I should know?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic062 "Is there anything else about them I should know?" [DIAL:0100EDBC]

text_content: {Dean gets deadly serious here, his fear should foreshadow end of Act 2}Whatever we do - don't rile them up. Normally, there's only a few, maybe a pack. There's more out there, a lot more. |If they find out someone's trespassing, it'd be shaking a hornet's nest. Don't want to think how many of them could fill these streets.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic062 "Is there anything else about them I should know?" [DIAL:0100EDBC]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {After asking 1 Q}I had other questions.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic061 "{After asking 1 Q}I had other questions." [DIAL:0100EDBD]

text_content: {Slight irritation}Of course you do. Let's hear 'em.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic061 "{After asking 1 Q}I had other questions." [DIAL:0100EDBD]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: It's your time, and if you want to spend it chatting, not much I can do about it.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic061 "{After asking 1 Q}I had other questions." [DIAL:0100EDBD]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Opener}I had questions I wanted to ask.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic060 "{Opener}I had questions I wanted to ask." [DIAL:0100EDBE]

text_content: All right, keep it short, we don't have a lot of time.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic060 "{Opener}I had questions I wanted to ask." [DIAL:0100EDBE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Focus?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic055 "Focus?" [DIAL:0100EDBF]

text_content: Always had the Sierra Madre to keep my mind occupied. |Most folks, they don't have the same drive, the same need. Not worth my time. Pretty much Ghost People before the Bomb, now Ghost People after.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic055 "Focus?" [DIAL:0100EDBF]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Where did they come from?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic052 "Where did they come from?" [DIAL:0100EDC0]

text_content: {Slight exasperation, as if he's thought about this a lot, then tries to recall Hamlet quote}Friend... "there's more mysteries in heaven and earth..." wait, no, "there is more between heaven and earth..." oh, forget it.|I'd sooner ask what makes me an undying son of a bitch than spend any thought as to why {emph}they crawled to life here.|I'm counting myself lucky I still have my faculties - they sure don't. Then again, they may not have had the... focus I do.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic052 "Where did they come from?" [DIAL:0100EDC0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: I'm not a bad shot. I could probably kill one.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic050 "I'm not a bad shot. I could probably kill one." [DIAL:0100EDC1]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Studying player}Well... you seem like you know how to handle yourself. All right.|Once, I fired a lucky shot, hit a gas tank one was holding. Blew his arm off at the shoulder... and he didn't get back up after that.|So if you're {emph}that good, don't aim for the head - aim for their bombs. And if you can wait until his buddies are close by, even better.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic050 "I'm not a bad shot. I could probably kill one." [DIAL:0100EDC1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: [FAILED] Yeah, well, "probably" is something a gambler says, not a survivor. I'd keep your pistol where it belongs - in the holster.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic050 "I'm not a bad shot. I could probably kill one." [DIAL:0100EDC1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: How tough are they?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic049 "How tough are they?" [DIAL:0100EDC2]

text_content: You shoot them, they get back up. You stab them, they get back up.|That's why I have explosives all over this place - unless you blow them up, chop them up, disintegrate 'em, {shakes head}the Ghost People don't go down.|Not enough bullets in the town to spend on them. So unless you're a real good shot, save one for yourself right before they catch you.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic049 "How tough are they?" [DIAL:0100EDC2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Have you tried to deal with them?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic038 "Have you tried to deal with them?" [DIAL:0100EDC3]

text_content: Tried talking to them, bribing them, leaving food - nothing. In the years since, they haven't changed their approach, but I sure have.|They catch you, they drag you into the Cloud, and you're not coming back out. {To himself}After that, having your necktie go off would be mercy.|My advice? Stay out of their way, they don't die easy.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic038 "Have you tried to deal with them?" [DIAL:0100EDC3]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Is anyone else alive around here?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic031 "Is anyone else alive around here?" [DIAL:0100EDC4]

text_content: {Choosing his words carefully, the locals are, well, zombies}"Alive's" a tricky word. The locals, the Ghost People? Not sure it applies to them.|They're a little... uncivilized. They don't talk much. As in, at all.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic031 "Is anyone else alive around here?" [DIAL:0100EDC4]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Have other people shown up in search of the Sierra Madre?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic029 "Have other people shown up in search of the Sierra Madre?" [DIAL:0100EDC5]

text_content: Tourists, you bet. They don't stay long... and they don't stay alive long.|If they survive the Cloud, the Ghost People, the traps, then greed takes over, and they start sizing each other up for funeral suits.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic029 "Have other people shown up in search of the Sierra Madre?" [DIAL:0100EDC5]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: You're coming with me, or else.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic050 "You're coming with me, or else." [DIAL:0100EEBB]

text_content: That's not going to work for me.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic049 "That's not going to work for me." [DIAL:0100EEBC]

text_content: Look, together we can get out of this.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic048 "Look, together we can get out of this." [DIAL:0100EEBD]

text_content: [She shakes her head - once, then crosses her arms.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic048 "Look, together we can get out of this." [DIAL:0100EEBD]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: If your collar goes off, mine goes off, it's better if we guard each other.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic047 "If your collar goes off, mine goes off, it's better if we guard each other." [DIAL:0100EEBE]

text_content: We need to cooperate if we're going to get out of here.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic046 "We need to cooperate if we're going to get out of here." [DIAL:0100EEBF]

text_content: What do you mean by that?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic045 "What do you mean by that?" [DIAL:0100EEC0]

text_content: [She shakes her head again and draws a line in the air between the two of you.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic045 "What do you mean by that?" [DIAL:0100EEC0]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Look, we can have this not-talk later, let's go.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic044 "Look, we can have this not-talk later, let's go." [DIAL:0100EEC1]

text_content: Enough of this shit, we need to move.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic043 "Enough of this shit, we need to move." [DIAL:0100EEC2]

text_content: Let's just say we're in this together.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic041 "Let's just say we're in this together." [DIAL:0100EEC4]

text_content: [She frowns, narrows her eyes, then slowly shakes her head.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic041 "Let's just say we're in this together." [DIAL:0100EEC4]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Unless you want to lose your head, stop.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic040 "Unless you want to lose your head, stop." [DIAL:0100EEC5]

text_content: It's a bomb collar - mess with it, it'll go off.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic039 "It's a bomb collar - mess with it, it'll go off." [DIAL:0100EEC6]

text_content: Don't do that!
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic038 "Don't do that!" [DIAL:0100EEC7]

text_content: [She looks surprised. Then notices your collar, and raises an eyebrow.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic038 "Don't do that!" [DIAL:0100EEC7]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: If you attack me, you'll regret it.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic037 "If you attack me, you'll regret it." [DIAL:0100EEC8]

text_content: What's the matter?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic036 "What's the matter?" [DIAL:0100EEC9]

text_content: This isn't what it looks like.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic035 "This isn't what it looks like." [DIAL:0100EECA]

text_content: [The woman opens her mouth again, winces, then frowns and drags a finger across her throat in a slow motion. She looks more angry than pained now.]|[Frowning, she touches her throat again, gently, then her hand brushes her collar, then her frown deepens.]|[Her eyes narrow as she traces the edge of the collar until she finds the lock. She begins to press it with her fingers.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic035 "This isn't what it looks like." [DIAL:0100EECA]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: What happened?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic034 "What happened?" [DIAL:0100EECB]

text_content: Look, I'm here to help.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic033 "Look, I'm here to help." [DIAL:0100EECC]

text_content: [She looks shaken. As she glances at the Auto-Doc, she recoils, and her mouth opens - but again, nothing comes out.]|[She looks back at you, and her hands clench into fists - her eyes narrow, and she takes a step back, studying you.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic033 "Look, I'm here to help." [DIAL:0100EECC]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Did somebody cut your vocal cords?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic032 "Did somebody cut your vocal cords?" [DIAL:0100EECD]

text_content: Looks like someone carved a roadmap across your face.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic031 "Looks like someone carved a roadmap across your face." [DIAL:0100EECE]

text_content: Who are you?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic030 "Who are you?" [DIAL:0100EECF]

text_content: Are you all right?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic029 "Are you all right?" [DIAL:0100EED0]

text_content: [She looks at you, blinks again, then opens her mouth - but nothing comes out.]|[She touches her throat, then traces the scar beneath the chin, and her eyes widen in alarm.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic029 "Are you all right?" [DIAL:0100EED0]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanDialogueSitInvite
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueSitInvite "NVDLC01DeanDialogueSitInvite" [DIAL:0100F219]

text_content: Have a seat - came all this way, least I can do is let you rest your feet for a second.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueSitInvite "NVDLC01DeanDialogueSitInvite" [DIAL:0100F219]

text_content: Just sit there on my little casting couch - more a chair, really, but I prefer up-and-comers to relax when I interview them.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueSitInvite "NVDLC01DeanDialogueSitInvite" [DIAL:0100F219]

text_content: You're my guest. If you're going to be rude, you can show yourself out. {little quieter}Probably won't tap-dance no more when you leave, but that's on you.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueSitInvite "NVDLC01DeanDialogueSitInvite" [DIAL:0100F219]

text_content: You standing there is making me nervous. Sit down, will you?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueSitInvite "NVDLC01DeanDialogueSitInvite" [DIAL:0100F219]

text_content: Have a seat.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueSitInvite "NVDLC01DeanDialogueSitInvite" [DIAL:0100F219]

text_content: NVDLC01DogKitchenBarks
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenBarks "NVDLC01DogKitchenBarks" [DIAL:0100F312]

text_content: {1 - Sad, sing song}...going to make casino burn, no more being...
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenBarks "NVDLC01DogKitchenBarks" [DIAL:0100F312]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {2 - "No more being..."}...back in the cage. Stop what you're doing, we can...
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenBarks "NVDLC01DogKitchenBarks" [DIAL:0100F312]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {3 - "we"}...can hear you now. {Beat, cold}Not much longer, not...
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenBarks "NVDLC01DogKitchenBarks" [DIAL:0100F312]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {4 - snarling, "you're not..."}...listening to me. {Frustrated, furious, emph}Tired of being your minder, tired...
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenBarks "NVDLC01DogKitchenBarks" [DIAL:0100F312]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {5 - "tired"}...of putting Dog to sleep, he wakes up in cage, hungry, Dog wants...
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenBarks "NVDLC01DogKitchenBarks" [DIAL:0100F312]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {6 - "wants"}...to protect you, always wanted to protect you, the reason I have to take control is...
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenBarks "NVDLC01DogKitchenBarks" [DIAL:0100F312]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {7 - "The reason I have to take control is..."}...Master. Master set me free, Dog needs to...
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenBarks "NVDLC01DogKitchenBarks" [DIAL:0100F312]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {8 - "You need to"}...listen to me. {Sudden moment of weakness, slight plea}If you do this, we {emph}both...
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenBarks "NVDLC01DogKitchenBarks" [DIAL:0100F312]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {9 - "We both"}...die. Dog wants to die. Don't care anymore, tired of you, tired of place. Master will...
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenBarks "NVDLC01DogKitchenBarks" [DIAL:0100F312]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {10 - "Master will"}...help us. Please let me help us. If you don't, then you're...
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenBarks "NVDLC01DogKitchenBarks" [DIAL:0100F312]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: NVDLC01DogKitchenSuicide
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenSuicide "NVDLC01DogKitchenSuicide" [DIAL:0100F319]

text_content: {About to set fire to the kitchen, killing himself}All fire now. Burn away voice, leave Dog in peace.
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenSuicide "NVDLC01DogKitchenSuicide" [DIAL:0100F319]

text_content: {Furious, but also afraid}No! {Tries to be commanding}Dog, get back in the c-{"cage," doesn't finish as explosion rocks kitchen}
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenSuicide "NVDLC01DogKitchenSuicide" [DIAL:0100F319]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: I haven't found enough yet.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic026 "I haven't found enough yet." [DIAL:0100F3FF]

text_content: {God voice, snarls}Then {emph}nothing's going to keep me here... we need bait, or the beast is going to wake up, and you'll never see the Sierra Madre.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic026 "I haven't found enough yet." [DIAL:0100F3FF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Yes, this should be enough.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic025 "Yes, this should be enough." [DIAL:0100F400]

text_content: {God voice, pleased}You're good at fetching... this should keep him where he belongs. {Beat}For now. I'll wait... send the signal, we'll be ready.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic025 "Yes, this should be enough." [DIAL:0100F400]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: All right, let's get out of here.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic002 "All right, let's get out of here." [DIAL:0100FD81]

text_content: Very well... lead on.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic002 "All right, let's get out of here." [DIAL:0100FD81]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: You already have someone in your shadow... I'll meet you at the Villa Fountain.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic002 "All right, let's get out of here." [DIAL:0100FD81]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Meet me over at the Fountain, we'll plan our next move.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic003 "Meet me over at the Fountain, we'll plan our next move." [DIAL:0100FD82]

text_content: Very well... to the Fountain and its ghost, then.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic003 "Meet me over at the Fountain, we'll plan our next move." [DIAL:0100FD82]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: How about 500 Chips for 500 Pre-War Bills?
name: NVDLC01CasinoCompsNVDLC01HologramCashierCasinoTopic008 "How about 500 Chips for 500 Pre-War Bills?" [DIAL:0100FE23]

text_content: [You set the stack of bills down. A panel flips, there is a whir, series of clicks, and a stack of chips rises up in place of the bills.]
name: NVDLC01CasinoCompsNVDLC01HologramCashierCasinoTopic008 "How about 500 Chips for 500 Pre-War Bills?" [DIAL:0100FE23]
speaker: NVDLC01HologramCashierCasino "Hologram" [NPC_:0100C4D0]

text_content: 100 Chips for 100 Pre-War bills.
name: NVDLC01CasinoCompsNVDLC01HologramCashierCasinoTopic007 "100 Chips for 100 Pre-War bills." [DIAL:0100FE24]

text_content: [You place the bills on the counter, a panel flips, taking the bills with it... and 100 Chips appear in their place.]
name: NVDLC01CasinoCompsNVDLC01HologramCashierCasinoTopic007 "100 Chips for 100 Pre-War bills." [DIAL:0100FE24]
speaker: NVDLC01HologramCashierCasino "Hologram" [NPC_:0100C4D0]

text_content: Collect Comps
name: NVDLC01CasinoCompsNVDLC01CrHologramCasinoFriendTopic000 "Collect Comps" [DIAL:0100FE25]

text_content: [The Hologram cashier nods, then a section of the tabletop slides away, and a package rises from it.]
name: NVDLC01CasinoCompsNVDLC01CrHologramCasinoFriendTopic000 "Collect Comps" [DIAL:0100FE25]
speaker: NVDLC01CrHologramCasinoFriend "Hologram" [CREA:0100D7EB]

text_content: [The Hologram cashier nods, then a section of the tabletop slides away, and a package rises from it.]
name: NVDLC01CasinoCompsNVDLC01CrHologramCasinoFriendTopic000 "Collect Comps" [DIAL:0100FE25]
speaker: NVDLC01CrHologramCasinoFriend "Hologram" [CREA:0100D7EB]

text_content: [The Hologram cashier nods, takes a step back, then the whole tabletop slides away. A package slowly rises from the opening, steam trailing from it.]
name: NVDLC01CasinoCompsNVDLC01CrHologramCasinoFriendTopic000 "Collect Comps" [DIAL:0100FE25]
speaker: NVDLC01CrHologramCasinoFriend "Hologram" [CREA:0100D7EB]

text_content: NVDLC01WTDeanEnterBark
name: NVDLC01WTDeanEnterBark "NVDLC01WTDeanEnterBark" [DIAL:0100FE51]

text_content: {Quiet, slightly nervous}Let's head through the hole in the wall there - if we go backstage, we avoid the locals.
name: NVDLC01WTDeanEnterBark "NVDLC01WTDeanEnterBark" [DIAL:0100FE51]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahAudioLog01
name: NVDLC01ElijahAudioLog01 "NVDLC01ElijahAudioLog01" [DIAL:01010088]

text_content: {Contemptuous, commanding}Are you listening? From now on, when I talk to you, pay attention.|I've left markers on your Pip-Boy - find the three other collars in town - 8, 12, and 14, get them to the Fountain. Obey me, and you can {emph}all go free.
name: NVDLC01ElijahAudioLog01 "NVDLC01ElijahAudioLog01" [DIAL:01010088]

text_content: NVDLC01GodToDeanTopic02
name: NVDLC01GodToDeanTopic02 "NVDLC01GodToDeanTopic02" [DIAL:01010089]

text_content: You could have left the Sierra Madre. Left this Villa, joined your own kind.
name: NVDLC01GodToDeanTopic02 "NVDLC01GodToDeanTopic02" [DIAL:01010089]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Sierra Madre's mine, my heart's right where it belongs.
name: NVDLC01GodToDeanTopic02 "NVDLC01GodToDeanTopic02" [DIAL:01010089]

text_content: {Taunting}You can't abide it. There's no heart. You hate it, I can hear it in your words.
name: NVDLC01GodToDeanTopic02 "NVDLC01GodToDeanTopic02" [DIAL:01010089]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Sounds like you need your hearing checked. Sierra Madre, it's meant for me.
name: NVDLC01GodToDeanTopic02 "NVDLC01GodToDeanTopic02" [DIAL:01010089]

text_content: NVDLC01GodToDeanTopic01
name: NVDLC01GodToDeanTopic01 "NVDLC01GodToDeanTopic01" [DIAL:0101008A]

text_content: Touched by radiation, and you choose to spend your time here. You could have just left... but you're too obsessed to let go.
name: NVDLC01GodToDeanTopic01 "NVDLC01GodToDeanTopic01" [DIAL:0101008A]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: I used to know a ventriloquist with more skill than you. At least he had the sense to know his own name, without carving it into his chest.
name: NVDLC01GodToDeanTopic01 "NVDLC01GodToDeanTopic01" [DIAL:0101008A]

text_content: Mirrors tell me my name when needed... and I have a name for you, several. Thief, coward... showman. Radiation couldn't kill the truth, could it.
name: NVDLC01GodToDeanTopic01 "NVDLC01GodToDeanTopic01" [DIAL:0101008A]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: The truth, buddy, is this: you and me, we're now family as long as we got these bowties on. So watch your mouth, you don't scare me.
name: NVDLC01GodToDeanTopic01 "NVDLC01GodToDeanTopic01" [DIAL:0101008A]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic01
name: NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic01" [DIAL:0101008B]

text_content: Where the hell did you get this one. "Dog?" What, so you don't forget your name?
name: NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic01" [DIAL:0101008B]

text_content: {Curious, slow}I don't remember you. Who are you.
name: NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic01" [DIAL:0101008B]

text_content: A little slow, huh? Uh... Dean. Dean Domino. I... live here.
name: NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic01" [DIAL:0101008B]

text_content: You look like food, smell like food. Dog - hungry.
name: NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic01" [DIAL:0101008B]

text_content: All right, pal, you stay in your corner, I'll stay in mine. {Beat}Do not leave me alone with this thing.
name: NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic01" [DIAL:0101008B]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic03
name: NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic03" [DIAL:010100A8]

text_content: Look, you obviously {emph}hear good - even if you aren't much of a talker.
name: NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic03" [DIAL:010100A8]

text_content: [Christine's eyes narrow.]
name: NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic03" [DIAL:010100A8]

text_content: Don't get me wrong, that's a plus in my book.
name: NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic03" [DIAL:010100A8]

text_content: [Christine eyes narrow to slits.]
name: NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic03" [DIAL:010100A8]

text_content: Still, are you getting any shred of your voice healed up, or...? Like anything?
name: NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic03" [DIAL:010100A8]

text_content: Look, you obviously {emph}hear good - even if you aren't much of a talker.
name: NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic03" [DIAL:010100A8]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic02
name: NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic02" [DIAL:010100A9]

text_content: {Gently bringing it up, worried she remembers him}Eh... those scars? What happened, somebody... something carve you up, or...?
name: NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic02" [DIAL:010100A9]

text_content: [Christine frowns, tilts her head slightly.]
name: NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic02" [DIAL:010100A9]

text_content: {Testing the waters}Damn shame, hate to think if someone put you in there. Who bailed you out again, the new guy? Interesting.
name: NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic02" [DIAL:010100A9]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic01
name: NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic01" [DIAL:010100AA]

text_content: So... what's your story, beautiful?
name: NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic01" [DIAL:010100AA]

text_content: [Christine studies Dean, frowns.]
name: NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic01" [DIAL:010100AA]

text_content: Don't... uh... don't talk much, do you?
name: NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic01" [DIAL:010100AA]

text_content: [Christine shakes her head slowly.]
name: NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic01" [DIAL:010100AA]

text_content: {Sighs, irritated at being rebuffed}All right, then. I'll just wallflower it over here.
name: NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanToChristineTopic01" [DIAL:010100AA]

text_content: NVDLC01GodToChristineTopic02
name: NVDLC01GodToChristineTopic02 "NVDLC01GodToChristineTopic02" [DIAL:010101E7]

text_content: {Curious}Someone wanted to cut your voice, little doll. Or they didn't finish their work, or didn't know how to.
name: NVDLC01GodToChristineTopic02 "NVDLC01GodToChristineTopic02" [DIAL:010101E7]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: [Christine frowns.]
name: NVDLC01GodToChristineTopic02 "NVDLC01GodToChristineTopic02" [DIAL:010101E7]

text_content: Oh, it wasn't me... I have no use for your neck beyond what encircles it. {Snarls, to himself, disgruntled}The lack of screams when I finally kill you... that is what I'll regret.
name: NVDLC01GodToChristineTopic02 "NVDLC01GodToChristineTopic02" [DIAL:010101E7]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: NVDLC01GodToChristineTopic01
name: NVDLC01GodToChristineTopic01 "NVDLC01GodToChristineTopic01" [DIAL:010101E8]

text_content: {Amused, evil}What's this? Why... it's a little doll. {Mock curiosity}Were you carved by a craftsman, {taunting, evil}or mauled by a drunk who didn't know his tools?
name: NVDLC01GodToChristineTopic01 "NVDLC01GodToChristineTopic01" [DIAL:010101E8]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: [Christine narrows her eyes, gets into a combat stance.]
name: NVDLC01GodToChristineTopic01 "NVDLC01GodToChristineTopic01" [DIAL:010101E8]

text_content: {Chuckles}I'm not going to hurt you... yet. Much. Scars tell a story, some old, some new... {slow}and the one on the throat is fresh and red.
name: NVDLC01GodToChristineTopic01 "NVDLC01GodToChristineTopic01" [DIAL:010101E8]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic03
name: NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic03" [DIAL:010101E9]

text_content: {Getting angry}Stop looking at me, you idiot. I can hear your stomach growling from here, I don't like it.
name: NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic03" [DIAL:010101E9]

text_content: {Slow question, starts getting evil}Run from Dog? Dog knows how to hunt. Dog will find you, tear you apart.
name: NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic03" [DIAL:010101E9]

text_content: That a bet you want to take? Cause I'll see that and raise you a few bullets to the skull.
name: NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic03" [DIAL:010101E9]

text_content: Dog's been shot before, many times. Won't stop me from catching you.
name: NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic03" [DIAL:010101E9]

text_content: I hope you've got this one under control, because he's giving me a nasty itch on my trigger finger.
name: NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic03" [DIAL:010101E9]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic02
name: NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic02" [DIAL:010101EA]

text_content: Why are you so carved up - {frowns, a little incredulous}that a {emph}bear trap on your arm?
name: NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic02" [DIAL:010101EA]

text_content: {Slow, to himself}Reminds me, keeps the voice out of my head. He can't talk when the pain's howling at me.
name: NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic02" [DIAL:010101EA]

text_content: Eh... wait, so you're not just slow, you're screwy, too? {Rolls eyes}Some crew we are... we are never getting into the Sierra Madre.
name: NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic02" [DIAL:010101EA]

text_content: Dog is hungry. {Frowns at Dean}Tired of your voice... when do we eat?
name: NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic02" [DIAL:010101EA]

text_content: Don't like the way this guy is looking at me. You better be his leash.
name: NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanToDogTopic02" [DIAL:010101EA]

text_content: NVDLC01RadioFarewell
name: NVDLC01RadioFarewell "NVDLC01RadioFarewell" [DIAL:01010305]

text_content: {Soft, slow}I... we... hope you've enjoyed your stay.
name: NVDLC01RadioFarewell "NVDLC01RadioFarewell" [DIAL:01010305]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: {Soft, slow}Farewells can be a time of sadness. Letting go... difficult. {Beat, quiet}As a guest of the Sierra Madre, you know that truth more than anyone.
name: NVDLC01RadioFarewell "NVDLC01RadioFarewell" [DIAL:01010305]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: {Soft}Frederick Sinclair believed one's life could be made anew every day, that fortunes were more than the wealth in your hands.
name: NVDLC01RadioFarewell "NVDLC01RadioFarewell" [DIAL:01010305]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: {Soft, becomes more tender}Love. Life... family, those to care for, and those who will care for you.
name: NVDLC01RadioFarewell "NVDLC01RadioFarewell" [DIAL:01010305]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: {Soft, becomes more tender}To those who know these joys, the Sierra Madre holds little they don't already have.
name: NVDLC01RadioFarewell "NVDLC01RadioFarewell" [DIAL:01010305]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: {Firm}Out in the world, beyond these walls, {emph}that is your chance to begin again.
name: NVDLC01RadioFarewell "NVDLC01RadioFarewell" [DIAL:01010305]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: {Quiet}I hope you'll return, in happier times. {Beat, final farewell}Until then, the Sierra Madre... and I... will hold you in our hearts.
name: NVDLC01RadioFarewell "NVDLC01RadioFarewell" [DIAL:01010305]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: NVDLC01RadioGalaEvent
name: NVDLC01RadioGalaEvent "NVDLC01RadioGalaEvent" [DIAL:01010306]

text_content: Guests, and residents of the Villa alike, I ask you to step outside and look to the night sky.
name: NVDLC01RadioGalaEvent "NVDLC01RadioGalaEvent" [DIAL:01010306]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: It's the moment you've been waiting for, the reason we're all here - the Gala Event, the Grand Opening of the Sierra Madre Casino.
name: NVDLC01RadioGalaEvent "NVDLC01RadioGalaEvent" [DIAL:01010306]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: You are the ones who have made this momentous occasion possible, and for that, we thank you.
name: NVDLC01RadioGalaEvent "NVDLC01RadioGalaEvent" [DIAL:01010306]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: So raise your glass in celebration - {emphasize these lines, see script notes}let music fill the streets, fireworks light the sky, and promise of new beginnings fill your hearts.
name: NVDLC01RadioGalaEvent "NVDLC01RadioGalaEvent" [DIAL:01010306]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: No matter what your fortunes, no matter what your cares, let go this night, and begin again.
name: NVDLC01RadioGalaEvent "NVDLC01RadioGalaEvent" [DIAL:01010306]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: {Slightly teasing}I suggest you hurry, though - the gates of the Sierra Madre are open, but only for a brief time.
name: NVDLC01RadioGalaEvent "NVDLC01RadioGalaEvent" [DIAL:01010306]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: {Mock sinister}After that, the doors will close for the evening's festivities, and won't open again until morning.
name: NVDLC01RadioGalaEvent "NVDLC01RadioGalaEvent" [DIAL:01010306]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: NVDCL01RadioGrandOpening
name: NVDCL01RadioGrandOpening "NVDCL01RadioGrandOpening" [DIAL:0101038C]

text_content: {Draw this out}If so, the Sierra Madre Casino, in all its glory, is inviting you {beat}to Begin Again.
