name: NVDCL01RadioGrandOpening "NVDCL01RadioGrandOpening" [DIAL:0101038C]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: Come to a place where wealth, excitement, and intrigue await around every corner.
name: NVDCL01RadioGrandOpening "NVDCL01RadioGrandOpening" [DIAL:0101038C]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: Stroll along the winding streets of our beautiful resort, make new friends... or rekindle old flames.
name: NVDCL01RadioGrandOpening "NVDCL01RadioGrandOpening" [DIAL:0101038C]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: Let your eyes take in the luxurious expanse of the open desert, under clear starlit skies. Gaze straight on into the sunset from our Villa rooftops.
name: NVDCL01RadioGrandOpening "NVDCL01RadioGrandOpening" [DIAL:0101038C]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: Countless diversions await.
name: NVDCL01RadioGrandOpening "NVDCL01RadioGrandOpening" [DIAL:0101038C]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: Gamble in our casino, take in the theater, or stay in one of our exclusive executive suites that will shelter you - and cater to your every whim.
name: NVDCL01RadioGrandOpening "NVDCL01RadioGrandOpening" [DIAL:0101038C]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: So if life's worries have weighed you down... if you need an escape from your troubles... or if you just need an opportunity to begin again, join us.
name: NVDCL01RadioGrandOpening "NVDCL01RadioGrandOpening" [DIAL:0101038C]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: Let go and leave the world behind at the Sierra Madre grand opening, this October. {Beat}We'll be waiting.
name: NVDCL01RadioGrandOpening "NVDCL01RadioGrandOpening" [DIAL:0101038C]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: <Storage Node. Do Not Translate.>
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic028 "<Storage Node. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:010103BB]

text_content: I've been trapped in here for some time, then you come along and let me out. {Studying the player, suspicious, evil}So... you opened my cage for a reason. Now... I want to know why.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic028 "<Storage Node. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:010103BB]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {You have questions?}Of course you do. {Beat, sinister}And so do I.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic028 "<Storage Node. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:010103BB]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Dog and I take turns in the cage... one steps out, the other goes back in. Now - what do you want?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic028 "<Storage Node. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:010103BB]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Low, cold, hates Dog's self-mutilation}Do you see these wounds of his, covering his skin...the bear trap on his arm? He placed his own hand in it. |The name he carved in his chest? To remind him of who he is, he inflicts pain on himself to silence me, when all I try to do... Hrr!|{Quiet, more to himself}...he cuts, hurts, and tries to murder me out of him. He won't succeed. Just makes me angrier.|Dog is the beast, we simply change cages. {Glances around}Like the ones here.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic028 "<Storage Node. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:010103BB]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {resuming control, with effort, gritted teeth}...hrnnn... will kill us {emph}both unless you do something. Never felt him so strong before, he won't listen to my voice. He's... he's...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic028 "<Storage Node. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:010103BB]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: ...hungry. {Evil, greedy}Come here, or Dog will chase you, break you until you no run anymore.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic028 "<Storage Node. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:010103BB]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {resuming control, with effort, gritted teeth}...hrnnn... listen to you... can't hold him back much longer... tell him... to pull on his chain, as hard as...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic028 "<Storage Node. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:010103BB]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {quiet}...Dog can. {Beat}What Master wants, Dog can do. {Quiet}Please don't be mad with Dog...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic028 "<Storage Node. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:010103BB]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {resuming control, with effort, gritted teeth}...live anymore. Sick of being inside, sick of hearing his stomach screaming at me, and...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic028 "<Storage Node. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:010103BB]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: ...Dog is tired... Dog tired of fighting, being here... {getting rage back}Tired of {emph}you keeping Dog caged here.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic028 "<Storage Node. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:010103BB]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: ...both of us are. Tell him to listen to me. Then we can get out of this... finally... and...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic028 "<Storage Node. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:010103BB]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {slightly mesmerized}...now Dog is listening to voice, your voice only.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic028 "<Storage Node. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:010103BB]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Generic Affirmation for Safety: Dog}Uh-huh.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic028 "<Storage Node. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:010103BB]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Generic Negatory for Safety: Dog}Nnn-nnn.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic028 "<Storage Node. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:010103BB]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Who locked you in that cage?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic027 "Who locked you in that cage?" [DIAL:010103BC]

text_content: {Chuckles}Locked myself in. Could feel myself... letting go. Dog's howling getting louder. {Frustrated}It happens when he's hungry and no one's around to tell him... no.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic027 "Who locked you in that cage?" [DIAL:010103BC]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: That name carved on your chest... are you Dog?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic024 "That name carved on your chest... are you Dog?" [DIAL:010103BD]

text_content: {Dismissive, brutal}The carving's a reminder, for mirrors {to himself}and for Dog. {Disgust, to himself}Dog, who you heard coming in, howling and hungry, as always.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic024 "That name carved on your chest... are you Dog?" [DIAL:010103BD]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: What happened to your voice?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic023 "What happened to your voice?" [DIAL:010103BE]

text_content: I'm the voice of reason. I sleep sometimes... down in the basement, in the cage. {Snarling, downnote}Now that {emph}I'm awake, {emph}Dog goes back in the cage. |{Smug, superior}Dog knows I'm here, but can't do anything about it. {Beat}I'm his... conscience. Keep him tame, keep him from hurting us... doing foolish things.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic023 "What happened to your voice?" [DIAL:010103BE]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: How did you end up in the Auto-Doc?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic070 "How did you end up in the Auto-Doc?" [DIAL:010103C6]

text_content: [She moves her finger in a circle, frowns, then drags her hand down over her eyes. She raises them again, points to you.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic070 "How did you end up in the Auto-Doc?" [DIAL:010103C6]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Where were you before?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic068 "Where were you before?" [DIAL:010103C7]

text_content: [She moves her finger in a wider circle, then raises her hand over her eyes.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic068 "Where were you before?" [DIAL:010103C7]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: I... don't understand.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic066 "I... don't understand." [DIAL:010103C9]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] [She nods, looks impressed.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic066 "I... don't understand." [DIAL:010103C9]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: [FAILED] [She shakes her head, then nods in the direction of the casino again.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic066 "I... don't understand." [DIAL:010103C9]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: So you cut your own hair off?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic064 "So you cut your own hair off?" [DIAL:010103CA]

text_content: I can't restore your voice, we'd need a real Auto-Doc to do that.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic063 "I can't restore your voice, we'd need a real Auto-Doc to do that." [DIAL:010103CB]

text_content: [She shivers slightly, and shakes her head.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic063 "I can't restore your voice, we'd need a real Auto-Doc to do that." [DIAL:010103CB]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: So the Auto-Doc cut your voice box, not your scalp.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic062 "So the Auto-Doc cut your voice box, not your scalp." [DIAL:010103CC]

text_content: [Christine nods.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic062 "So the Auto-Doc cut your voice box, not your scalp." [DIAL:010103CC]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: The Auto-Doc didn't do that?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic061 "The Auto-Doc didn't do that?" [DIAL:010103CD]

text_content: [She touches one of the scars on her cheeks, shakes head. Then touches the scar on her neck, and nods.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic061 "The Auto-Doc didn't do that?" [DIAL:010103CD]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Were you researching something?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic060 "Were you researching something?" [DIAL:010103CE]

text_content: [She shakes her head.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic060 "Were you researching something?" [DIAL:010103CE]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Were you looking for something?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic059 "Were you looking for something?" [DIAL:010103CF]

text_content: How the hell did you get out here?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic058 "How the hell did you get out here?" [DIAL:010103D0]

text_content: [She shrugs. Then she points to you and shrugs.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic058 "How the hell did you get out here?" [DIAL:010103D0]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: [BOS] You were a Brotherhood of Steel Scribe?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic057 "[BOS] You were a Brotherhood of Steel Scribe?" [DIAL:010103D1]

text_content: [She nods. She looks impressed.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic057 "[BOS] You were a Brotherhood of Steel Scribe?" [DIAL:010103D1]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: No, wait, I want to hear this. You were bald before?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic056 "No, wait, I want to hear this. You were bald before?" [DIAL:010103D2]

text_content: [She nods with an exasperated look, then makes a circle with her hands, repeats it twice more, then raises her hands and waves them like wings.]|[She puts both hands in front of her, then makes a motion with her hands as if writing something.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic056 "No, wait, I want to hear this. You were bald before?" [DIAL:010103D2]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Wait, the Auto-Doc didn't shave you bald?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic055 "Wait, the Auto-Doc didn't shave you bald?" [DIAL:010103D3]

text_content: [She waves her hand, then shakes her head - she then nods in the direction of the casino.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic055 "Wait, the Auto-Doc didn't shave you bald?" [DIAL:010103D3]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: I don't understand why they shaved you bald.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic054 "I don't understand why they shaved you bald." [DIAL:010103D4]

text_content: [Christine looks blankly at you. Then touches her head, smiles, then shakes her head.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic054 "I don't understand why they shaved you bald." [DIAL:010103D4]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Looks like someone set the bone saws to run random.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic053 "Looks like someone set the bone saws to run random." [DIAL:010103D5]

text_content: [She shakes her head... then pauses, and shakes her head again, then looks exasperated.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic053 "Looks like someone set the bone saws to run random." [DIAL:010103D5]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: {After asking 1 Q}I had other questions.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic052 "{After asking 1 Q}I had other questions." [DIAL:010103D6]

text_content: [She looks exasperated, then waves her hand in a circle in front of her.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic052 "{After asking 1 Q}I had other questions." [DIAL:010103D6]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: [She raises an eyebrow, then tilts her head slightly.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic052 "{After asking 1 Q}I had other questions." [DIAL:010103D6]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: [She frowns, then cups her hand to her ear.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic052 "{After asking 1 Q}I had other questions." [DIAL:010103D6]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: I had questions I wanted to ask.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic051 "I had questions I wanted to ask." [DIAL:010103D7]

text_content: [Christine glances straight up, frowns, then turns back to you and taps her wrist.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic051 "I had questions I wanted to ask." [DIAL:010103D7]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: That Auto-Doc really carved you up.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic042 "That Auto-Doc really carved you up." [DIAL:010103D8]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] [She nods... slowly, then puts her hand in front her throat, closes it slowly, then points at you.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic042 "That Auto-Doc really carved you up." [DIAL:010103D8]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: [FAILED] [She frowns, narrows her eyes, and looks at you.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic042 "That Auto-Doc really carved you up." [DIAL:010103D8]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: {THEATER: Dean fight}This is where it ends, Dean, give up.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic072 "{THEATER: Dean fight}This is where it ends, Dean, give up." [DIAL:01010629]

text_content: I can take a chump like you even if I didn't have eight lives lined up behind me, and a rising soundtrack. So put your dancing shoes on - let's go.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic072 "{THEATER: Dean fight}This is where it ends, Dean, give up." [DIAL:01010629]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {THEATER: 1st Time, Likes player}How did you get up there?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic073 "{THEATER: 1st Time, Likes player}How did you get up there?" [DIAL:0101062A]

text_content: {Slight nervous}No idea... woke up here, thought I was dreaming for a second... right back on stage, the mic...|Thought I was back at the Fronds... {to himself}well, except no audience, used to pack theaters back then... so stepped up on the stage, check things out...|Then suddenly Holograms walked out of the wings... and they started raising their hands to their heads all creepy-like, {emph}not a good sign.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic073 "{THEATER: 1st Time, Likes player}How did you get up there?" [DIAL:0101062A]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct3 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct3" [DIAL:010108C0]

name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct3 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct3" [DIAL:010108C0]

text_content: <AUDIO: Christine after Executive Suites, still lost voice.>{Christine breathing normally, calm. Any ambient sounds from the suites should be duped.}
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct3 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct3" [DIAL:010108C0]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: [STATIC] {Static Sound}
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct3 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct3" [DIAL:010108C0]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2" [DIAL:010108C1]

text_content: [Christine frowns.] {This will need some sound effect.}
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2" [DIAL:010108C1]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Oh, it wasn't me... I have no use for your neck beyond what encircles it. {Snarls, to himself, disgruntled}The lack of screams when I finally kill you... that is what I'll regret.
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2" [DIAL:010108C1]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: [Christine's eyes narrow.]
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2" [DIAL:010108C1]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Don't get me wrong, that's a plus in my book.
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2" [DIAL:010108C1]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: [Christine eyes narrow to slits.]
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2" [DIAL:010108C1]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Still, are you getting any shred of your voice healed up, or...? Like anything?
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2" [DIAL:010108C1]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Curious}Someone wanted to cut your voice, little doll. Or they didn't finish their work, or didn't know how to.
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2" [DIAL:010108C1]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: <AUDIO: If the player hasn't dropped Christine off at the Gala Event and she is alone at the fountain, this will be crackling silence.>{Clicking or Christine breathing, "normally" for her.}
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2" [DIAL:010108C1]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: <AUDIO: After Gala Event, not Act 3 yet.>{Frantic beating on the elevator door, desperate breathing, sounds of Gala event in streets above, muted.}
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2" [DIAL:010108C1]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: <AUDIO: If the player has left Christine at Gala Event and she hates the player, she'll bang on the doors of the elevator to be let out.>{Hammering on door, desperate, her breathing ragged and panicked.}
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2" [DIAL:010108C1]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: [STATIC] {Static Sound}
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct2" [DIAL:010108C1]

text_content: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1" [DIAL:010108C2]

text_content: <AUDIO: Mikey, this line needs to dupe the horrible saw-like whirring sound effects of Christine's Auto-Doc in the Clinic, so the PC can track it.>
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1" [DIAL:010108C2]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: [Christine narrows her eyes, gets into a combat stance.] {Since this is a radio conversation there should be some shuffling sounds}
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1" [DIAL:010108C2]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: {Chuckles}I'm not going to hurt you... yet. Much. Scars tell a story, some old, some new... {slow}and the one on the throat is fresh and red.
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1" [DIAL:010108C2]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: [Christine studies Dean, frowns.]
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1" [DIAL:010108C2]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Don't... eh... don't talk much, do you?
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1" [DIAL:010108C2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: [Christine shakes her head slowly.]
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1" [DIAL:010108C2]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: {Sighs, irritated at being rebuffed}All right, then. I'll just wallflower it over here.
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1" [DIAL:010108C2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: [Christine frowns, tilts her head slightly.]
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1" [DIAL:010108C2]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: {Testing the waters}Damn shame, hate to think if someone put you in there. Who bailed you out again, the new guy? Interesting.
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1" [DIAL:010108C2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Amused, evil}What's this little doll? Were you carved by a craftsman, little doll, or were you mauled by a drunk who didn't know his tools?
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1" [DIAL:010108C2]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: So... what's your story, beautiful?
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1" [DIAL:010108C2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Gently bringing it up, worried she remembers him}Eh... those scars? What happened, somebody... something carve you up, or...?
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1" [DIAL:010108C2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: <AUDIO: After freeing Christine, she's at the fountain or at the Clinic alone.>{Normal Christine breathing.}
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1" [DIAL:010108C2]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: [STATIC] {Static Sound}
name: NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1 "NVDLC01RadioChristineAct1" [DIAL:010108C2]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: RadioHello
name: NVDLC01RadioHelloChristine "RadioHello" [DIAL:010108C3]

text_content: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3" [DIAL:010108EC]

text_content: <AUDIO: Dean's collar goes off, boom, flatline. No actual dialogue needed here.>
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3" [DIAL:010108EC]

text_content: Got to say this for Sinclair, he sure knew how to keep things locked down, the tight-assed prick.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3" [DIAL:010108EC]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Where the hell did everyone else go?
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3" [DIAL:010108EC]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Wonder what happened to the suckers. {Frowns}Might have gotten taken away, like I did? Hnh.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3" [DIAL:010108EC]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Looking around}Hnh. Theater's almost the same as it was.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3" [DIAL:010108EC]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Under his breath, after battle in the theater}Not going to be performing here again, that's for sure.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3" [DIAL:010108EC]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Frustrated}First time on stage in a hundred years, and it has to be this?
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3" [DIAL:010108EC]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Need some help here... and that audience is {emph}not looking friendly.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3" [DIAL:010108EC]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Hope my partner fared better than I did... better not have left me high and dry, get-even's not going to be pretty.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3" [DIAL:010108EC]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: That audience... better lay low, get a feel for the crowd.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3" [DIAL:010108EC]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Good thing, someone walks in here, they're toast.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3" [DIAL:010108EC]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: I am out of here... well, not to the Villa, just out of the damn theater first chance I get.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3" [DIAL:010108EC]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Looking around}This place... hasn't changed at all.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct3" [DIAL:010108EC]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2DUPLICATE000 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108ED]

text_content: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]

text_content: {Slow question, starts getting evil}Run from Dog? Dog knows how to hunt. Dog will find you, tear you apart.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: That a bet you want to take? Cause I'll see that and raise you a few bullets to the skull.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Dog's been shot before, many times. Won't stop me from catching you.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Hope you've got this one under control because he's giving me a nasty itch on my trigger finger.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Mutters}Didn't come all this way to get conned by some tourist.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Angry}We'll see who's holding the cards in the end...
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: The joke's on you, "partners." You aren't getting to the prize without me.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Sighs}This is a fine how do you do.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Grumbles}Should have blown up that seat cushion right when they sat down, would've been a better end than this.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {To himself}Just finish the last job, Dean. It's all you've wanted, just hang in there.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Himself}Keep your head down, Dean, don't let the locals see you.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Sinclair, you better appreciate all I do to screw you over.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: That tourist is better than most. Probably won't matter.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Mutters}Town's going to be filled with Ghosts when the sky lights up.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: The linked collars is a new trick. Can't say I like it much.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Waiting for the fireworks. {Beat}Just like last time.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Can't wait to see their faces when they find out what the lock is. Just gotta wait 'em out.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Place is going to be swarming with the masks when the sky lights up.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {himself}Not much time to get to the gates before they shut the door and turn folks away.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Holy Mary, Mother, and Joe - now {emph}there's a show.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Urgent, worried he's going to get attacked by zombies}All right, now - I'm out of here.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Urgent, worried he's going to get attacked by zombies}If the Ghost People didn't know we were here before, they know now.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Someone struck up the band. {To himself, grumbling}A band of tortured cats.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: What kind of casino has two Grand Openings?
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Cold, to himself}This is your last hurrah, Sinclair, I promise you.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Just my luck.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Luck's finally shining down on me.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: You wait, beautiful. Keep that gate open for me, Dean'll be there soon.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Sierra Madre, sweetheart, Dean's coming home.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Getting angry}Stop looking at me, you idiot. I can hear your stomach growling from here, I don't like it.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct2" [DIAL:010108EE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]

text_content: <AUDIO: Dog dies in the Kitchen, boom, then flatlines, just an explosion and flatline is needed.>
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]

text_content: {1G}I... {chuckles, not unkindly, more relieved}he's asleep. Finally. {To himself}Shhhhhh.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {2G - Tired, serious, no malice}Dog... all I wanted was for you to listen to me, let me care for you. Keep you from hurting yourself...
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {3G - Stronger, to himself}Now I can. And one day, when you're ready, I'll let you out. When you're calm, and we... understand each other.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {4G}And we're at peace, you and I, mind and instinct. Then the world will be ready for us.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {1D}Hello? Voice? You there? {Waits, deliver this as a snarl}It's Dog...{confused}...Dog can hear himself. Voice is... is in cage? Locked.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {2D - Frowns, building determination}Now Dog speak. Now Dog not afraid. {Beat}And... {frowns}hungry. {Emph}More hungry.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {3D - Slightly unsettling here}Dog find food... tear apart food, eat. Chase it down, can't run, feed. Finally, until Dog is full.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {1B}What is this place?
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {2B}Feel strange, like... sleeping. On my neck, is this... a chain? I... {recognition, looks down and sees the name carved there}what's carved on my chest.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {3B}"God." No... not God. Something in reverse... hnh. Was that one of them...?
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {4B}Should rest, get my strength back... then explore this place, see what it holds.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {1 - Sad, sing song}...going to make casino burn, no more being...
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {2 - "No more being..."}...back in the cage. Stop what you're doing, we can...
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {3 - "we"}...can hear you now. {Beat, cold}Not much longer, not...
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {4 - snarling, "you're not..."}...listening to me. {Frustrated, furious, emph}Tired of being your minder, tired...
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {5 - "tired"}...of putting Dog to sleep, he wakes up in cage, hungry, Dog wants...
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {6 - "wants"}...to protect you, always wanted to protect you, the reason I have to take control is...
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {7 - "The reason I have to take control is..."}...Master. Master set me free, Dog needs to...
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {8 - "You need to"}...listen to me. {Sudden moment of weakness, slight plea}If you do this, we {emph}both...
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {9 - "We both"}...die. Dog wants to die. Don't care anymore, tired of you, tired of place. Master will...
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {10 - "Master will"}...help us. Please let me help us. If you don't, then you're...
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Surprised}Hnh. The human pulled it off.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Just like last time. Come on, Dog, you know the drill.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: What the Old World saw in these light shows is beyond me.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Impressed}The human did it. {Evil}Good.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Not going down like last time - Dog, you're staying in the cage.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Time to get to the gate, "friends" or no friends.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {To himself}Fires and speakers are going to bring the Ghost People out in full.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Eager}Coming for you, human... you just wait.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Madre's mine.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Himself}So hungry.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]

text_content: {Himself, a little scared}Insides growling.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]

text_content: :: Mournful whining to self ::
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]

text_content: {Hushed, whispering, looks around}Hope the voice doesn't come back. Mean. Bad.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]

text_content: :: Stomach rumbling.::
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]

text_content: Need to stay out of sight... can't afford to be distracted now.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct3 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct3" [DIAL:010108EF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]

text_content: Sierra Madre's mine, my heart's right where it belongs.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Taunting}You can't abide it. There's no heart. You hate it, I can hear it in your words.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Sounds like you need your hearing checked. Sierra Madre, it's meant for me.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: You could have left the Sierra Madre. Left this Villa, joined your own kind.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Where are lights. Dog want to see the lights.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Can't wait to see the lights.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: :: Impatient Growl ::
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Scared}Hurry up, Dog doesn't like being here.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Crude rhyme}Got to go... Casin-oooo.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Didn't... we do this before? Can't remember.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Want show and lights and yelling to start.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: :: Weeping. ::
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: :: Whimpering ::
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: :: Howling in frustration ::
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Please let me out.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Dog is sorry, sorry, sorry.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: What did I do?
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Hypnotized by light show in sky}Lights and fire.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Quiet}Pretty.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Frowns}Lots of noise.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Curious}Where is Master? Did Master make fires in the sky?
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {At festival}:: Delighted clapping ::
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Nooooooooooo!
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: :: Howling, frightened. ::
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Let me out, let me out!
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Noise hurts, noise {emph}hurts!
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Streets are hurting my ears!
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Too bright, too bright.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Urgent}Hurry, we're targets out here.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Almost inside. Finally. {Beat, himself}Then I can get rid of the baggage.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {To himself}Quiet, Dog, stay in the cage.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Disgust}Sick of these Old World deathtraps.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Low, eager}The Sierra Madre's almost mine.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Snarling}They better not try and leave me here...
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {To himself}When this festival fires, I'm the first one in the door.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Last time I ever deal with human trash...
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: After the Bomb, still slaves to technology, events, Pip-Boys, collars... hnnnr.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: I'll whip you for this, Dog. I'll crush your cage with you inside it for making me go through this.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: All this - if I get inside the Sierra Madre, it's all worth it. All of it.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: As soon as those collars go off... we'll settle things, yes.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Impressed}The human did it. {Evil}Good.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Not going down like last time - Dog, you're staying in the cage.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Time to get to the gate, "friends" or no friends.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {To himself}Fires and speakers are going to bring the Ghost People out in full.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Eager}Coming for you, human... you just wait.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Madre's mine.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Surprised}Hnh. The human pulled it off.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Just like last time. Come on, Dog, you know the drill.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Gate won't be open for long.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Need to stay out of sight... can't afford to be distracted now.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: What the Old World saw in these light shows is beyond me.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct2 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct2" [DIAL:010108F0]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]

text_content: Used to know a ventriloquist with more skill than you, at least he had the sense to know his own name without carving it into his chest.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Mirrors tell me my name when needed... and I have a name for you, several. Thief, coward... showman. Radiation couldn't kill the truth, could it.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: The truth, buddy, is this: you and me, we're now family as long as we got these bowties on. So watch your mouth, you don't scare me.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Touched by radiation, and you choose to spend your time here. You could have just left... but you're too obsessed to let go.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: :: Impatient Growl ::
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: :: Weeping. ::
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: :: Whimpering ::
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: :: Howling in frustration ::
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Please let me out.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Dog is sorry, sorry, sorry.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: What did I do?
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Let me out, let me out!
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Himself}So hungry.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Don't like this place. Want to go back, {quieter}back to the base. {Beat, quiet}Or the Church, miss the Church.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Himself, a little scared}Insides growling.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: :: Mournful whining to self ::
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Hushed, whispering, looks around}Hope the voice doesn't come back. Mean. Bad.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Rocks on legs}Where is Master? Did he go away? {Apologetic}Dog will be good this time.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Slight disgust}Swallowed something bad. Taste like burnt wires.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: :: Stomach rumbling.::
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Can't believe the idiot swallowed his collar.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: What's taking that human so long.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {To himself}If that human wasn't wearing a collar...
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Wonder what that human's insides would look like laid out over the fountain.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {To himself}Might be able to rip the Pip-Boy off his arm without killing him. Hmm.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Air tastes like copper. {Beat, smiles}Or Old World gold.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Almost got away... then the idiot's hunger screws it up.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {To himself}Quiet, Dog, stay in the cage.
name: NVDLC01RadioDogAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDogAct1" [DIAL:010108F1]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1" [DIAL:010108F2]

text_content: {Curious, slow}I don't remember you. Who are you.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1" [DIAL:010108F2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: A little slow, huh? Uh... Dean. Dean Domino. I... live here.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1" [DIAL:010108F2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: You look like food, smell like food. Dog - hungry.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1" [DIAL:010108F2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: All right, pal, you stay in your corner, I'll stay in mine. {Beat}Do not leave me alone with this thing.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1" [DIAL:010108F2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Slow, to himself}Reminds me, keeps the voice out of my head. He can't talk when the pain's howling at me.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1" [DIAL:010108F2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Wait, so you're not just slow, you're screwy, too? {Rolls eyes}Some crew we are... we are never getting into the Sierra Madre.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1" [DIAL:010108F2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Dog is hungry. {Frowns at Dean}Tired of your voice... when do we eat?
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1" [DIAL:010108F2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Don't like the way this guy is looking at me. You better be his leash.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1" [DIAL:010108F2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Where the hell did you get this one. "Dog?" What, so you don't forget your name?
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1" [DIAL:010108F2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Why are you so carved up - {frowns, a little incredulous}that a {emph}bear trap on your arm?
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1" [DIAL:010108F2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Irritated}You'd think it was Spring the way tourists keep rolling in.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1" [DIAL:010108F2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Impressed}That one's got a head on their shoulders. {Beat}For now.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1" [DIAL:010108F2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Frowns, to himself}Hope that tourist is hurrying, haven't got all day.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1" [DIAL:010108F2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Frowns}At least this one seems like a straight shooter. {Beat}Or sucker.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1" [DIAL:010108F2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Frowns}That tourist crosses me, they'll regret it. {Beat, shrugs}Even if they don't, they still might.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1" [DIAL:010108F2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Shakes head, disappointed in self}Should never have set that radio signal on repeat.
name: NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1 "NVDLC01RadioDeanAct1" [DIAL:010108F2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01RadioHelloDean
name: NVDLC01RadioHelloDean "NVDLC01RadioHelloDean" [DIAL:010108F3]

text_content: NVDLC01
name: NVDLC01RadioHelloDog "NVDLC01" [DIAL:010108F4]

text_content: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]

text_content: Can you hear me? Signal should be stronger in here. I'll set this on loop... {warning to player}just in case I need to step away for a moment.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: When the bombs hit, this casino sealed up like an Emperor's tomb. If you don't know what that means, never mind, it means we're trapped.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: So - get the power running to the main floor. That'll open the elevators and unlock the doors.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Mutters, detour to himself}The ones that didn't strip their gears when they locked into place, Old World junk. Shoddy workmanship.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Once the power's on, then I'll tell you your next steps. Just get this part done, and then listen.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: If you're wondering where your crew is, well... the casino saw them as guests. Which means they all got assigned to their floor. {Frowns}Just like mine.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Don't worry about them, they're of no use if you can't get the power running.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: All I need is you for the rest of this. Which means we just need to deal with them, one by one, and then the Vault's... {backstabbing implication, he's not going to share}ours.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {SCRIPT: Power's on in Main Floor}Ha! You got the power on, excellent. {Pleased}You were quite a find, glad my trap in the desert caught you before time ran out.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {SCRIPT: Power's on in Main Floor}And also glad you didn't come across this place first, might have plundered it first... can't have that. Like at HELIOS. And Hoover Dam.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {SCRIPT: Power's on in Main Floor}All right, setting this on repeat in case you're some idiot-savant braincase and need the reminder...
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {SCRIPT: Power's on in Main Floor}So, my greedy friend, we've got some unfinished business. I'm not one to share, and there's loose ends we need to wrap up first.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {SCRIPT: Power's on in Main Floor}The rest of your team is on different floors. They got assigned there, ushered there based on the casino's records as to the best "fit."
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {SCRIPT: Power's on in Main Floor}Don't ask me how, Pre-War {emph, disgust at "casino"}casino security and escort systems aren't my specialty.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {SCRIPT: Power's on in Main Floor}Go to each floor, and kill them. I don't need them anymore... well, now that you're here.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {SCRIPT: Power's on in Main Floor}We don't need anyone... except each other. Together, we'll crack the Sierra Madre, and we can both leave this place behind.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {SCRIPT: Dealt with Everyone}Now... if anything about our little heist went smoothly, you'd go to the Vault... {irritated}except it's locked by some code I'm not familiar with.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {SCRIPT: Dealt with Everyone}The door to the casino vault is hidden in the Executive Suites, without the means to unlock it, it's useless.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {SCRIPT: Dealt with Everyone}Find a way to open it, bypass the code, then we'll talk.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {SCRIPT: Elevator Door Unlocked}You did it... a voice lock. Why would he have done that? Uh! Never mind.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {SCRIPT: Elevator Door Unlocked}Now I just need you to go below, look around. See if there's any {emph}other surprises down there.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {SCRIPT: Elevator Door Unlocked}I'll be along once you've found the Vault. No need risking myself just yet.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Wild Wasteland only}End of line.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct3" [DIAL:01010930]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2" [DIAL:01010931]

text_content: {SCRIPT: Gala Event has fired}What the hell was that?
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2" [DIAL:01010931]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {SCRIPT: Gala Event has fired}The Gala Event... finally. Probably wake up half the things in town.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2" [DIAL:01010931]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {SCRIPT: Gala Event has fired}Power's fluctuating in here... getting some systems waking up, good, good.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2" [DIAL:01010931]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {SCRIPT: Gala Event has fired}Now all they have to do is just get here. Tired of waiting.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2" [DIAL:01010931]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {SCRIPT: Gala Event has fired, urgency here}Hurry... hurry... you just need to get inside, I'll handle the rest. Come on, you fools.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2" [DIAL:01010931]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {SCRIPT: Gala Event has fired, urgency here}Not far now... soon, the Sierra Madre's mine. Doors won't hold open forever... just like the last time. Come on.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2" [DIAL:01010931]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: All right, now everything's coming together...
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2" [DIAL:01010931]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Just need to keep their gears turning a little while longer...
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2" [DIAL:01010931]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Grunts}Can't believe this old Pip-Boy saved me. {Beat, under his breath}Even if it led me to that damn signal in the first place.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2" [DIAL:01010931]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Good thing the new recruit had a Pip-Boy, too, probably stole it from a Vault 21 dweller. {Beat}Still, a thief's just what I need for this.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2" [DIAL:01010931]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: If only the others would've obeyed orders half as well as this one... should have thought of linking the collars together the first few times.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2" [DIAL:01010931]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Good thing I can still hook into the Villa speakers by remote...
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2" [DIAL:01010931]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Damn Hologram tech. Worthless as security... better as weapons.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2" [DIAL:01010931]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: What the hell are they doing out there. Hurry up, you idiots, I don't have a few more years to waste.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2" [DIAL:01010931]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Outwitted by doors. Hermetically sealed doors don't protect anyone, all they do is seal us in.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2" [DIAL:01010931]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Frustrated, grumbling}Why the owner tied all of this to the Gala Event, insanity... backwards thinking, having a {emph}festival be your key. No wonder the bombs fell.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct2" [DIAL:01010931]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01RadioHelloElijah
name: NVDLC01RadioHelloElijah "NVDLC01RadioHelloElijah" [DIAL:01010932]

text_content: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1" [DIAL:01010933]

text_content: {Himself}Still can't figure out why I lost the signals...
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1" [DIAL:01010933]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: There's no reason why it could have gone wrong, had it all planned out... {Snorts, pissed}maybe it was the curse of the Sierra Madre.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1" [DIAL:01010933]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Coughs a bit, clears his throat.}Damn Cloud still in my lungs, rattling around.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1" [DIAL:01010933]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: <AUDIO: Clatter of wrench dropping>{Dropped a wrench on the ground}Dammit, get back here.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1" [DIAL:01010933]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Mumbling to himself, as if working on something and trying to re-wire a circuit.}
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1" [DIAL:01010933]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Good thing I installed radios in the collars, Pip-Boy's letting me pick them up.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1" [DIAL:01010933]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: What the hell is 21 doing now... hnh.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1" [DIAL:01010933]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Irritated, judgmental}Fool better not decide to sleep. Vitals go down, I'll get someone else to do this job.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1" [DIAL:01010933]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Unnn... sitting too long. Damn arthritis.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1" [DIAL:01010933]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Come too far to go back now. Too far.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1" [DIAL:01010933]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Hnh. Going to wipe the slate clean. Kimball, the Republic... Hardin, McNamara, my "brothers." Then I'll head back West.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1" [DIAL:01010933]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Better loop some instructions in case something happens.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1" [DIAL:01010933]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Going to get inside this place if it's the last thing I do.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1" [DIAL:01010933]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Running out of volunteers. Last ones couldn't see beyond their own greed.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1" [DIAL:01010933]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: If only people would do what I say, wouldn't need these damn collars to keep them in line. Keep going for each other's throats like dogs.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1" [DIAL:01010933]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Wish I... still had that damn Holorifle. Spent forever making it... need to find it when this is all done.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1 "NVDLC01RadioElijahAct1" [DIAL:01010933]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {1st Time Police Station}What are we doing in here? Planning to toss me in a cell?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {1st Time Residential}Going to be sad to leave the Residential District. {Beat}Well... not really.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {2nd Time Residential}Sure left a lot of traps around. Sometimes I forget where they are.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {1st Time Salida, North}As worse as the other places are? This section of town is the most dangerous.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {2nd Time Salida, North}We need to get out of here - come alone if you want, don't drag me here.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {3rd Time, Salida, North}Hear there's a belltower and church to the North... filled with Ghost People.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {1st Time Ruined Cafe}The cafe survived? {Beat}How about that. Had great coffee - and one of the waitresses? Rhonda? Piece. Of. Work.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {1st Time Salida/Puesta}Do {emph}not leave me here.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {2nd Time Police Station}Never liked the Chief here, real stickler for "policy."
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {3rd Time Police Station}Made off with a lot of mines, shotguns, and explosives from here... wasn't easy with the Ghost People around.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {1st Time Switching Station: Mumbling to himself}Got a worse grease smell down here than Danny Parker's hair on Opening Night.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {1st Time Clinic}What are we doing here for? This place is... well, it's haunted.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {2nd Time, Clinic}Seriously, we should get out of here. The Security Holograms... shoot on sight, and you can't even hurt them.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {Salida}Salida del Sol - "Sunrise." {Beat}Not much to look at now.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {Testing the player, insinuating}You sure came a long way to rob this place. Guess greed is in the blood.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {In any interior}Breath of fresh air in here... literally. {Beat}If you need to take a breather from the Cloud, this is a good spot.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {Sizing place up, liking it}Might be a nice place to hole up for a while.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {Salida/Puesta}Check the fountains, might have some wishes... er, chips we can snag.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {Salida/Puesta}Watch the ground for bear traps and {emph}any openings for tripwires.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {Salida/Puesta}{To himself, irritated}Ghost People.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {Salida/Puesta}If I ever had to come here, I stuck to the overhangs and roofs - like sidewalks up there.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {Switching Station}Like a toxic ashtray down here.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {Switching Station}{Thinking}Find a way to get this place hopping again... would clean all the toxic gas out of Puesta del Sol.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {Switching Station}Stinks down here. {To himself}And I can barely smell anything.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {Sarcastic}Sure glad one of us knows what you're doing.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: You know, this used to be a nice town. {Beat}Well, nice enough.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: When in doubt, step quiet - and watch {emph}where you step.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: Where there's a bear trap, Ghost People aren't far behind.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: Watch out if you see a prize lying around - the Ghost People leave "supplies" as traps.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: Getting real tired of tourist season - no offense, but you guys are lowering the bar.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {Random comment}Cloud wasn't always here. Grew over the years, even without cars or factories.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: Sierra Madre may wait. Not me.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: {Slight impatience}Sierra Madre's not getting any younger.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: What's next?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:0101097D]

text_content: I want to know more about the Master.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic032 "I want to know more about the Master." [DIAL:0101099E]

text_content: I need you to get to your Gala Event position.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic011 "I need you to get to your Gala Event position." [DIAL:010109B1]

text_content: Maybe {emph}Dog will obey you. {Beat, emph on "I'm"}I'm not as easily broken.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic011 "I need you to get to your Gala Event position." [DIAL:010109B1]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {God}That's enough for now.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic007 "{God}That's enough for now." [DIAL:010109B5]

text_content: {Evil, smiling}We'll see.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic007 "{God}That's enough for now." [DIAL:010109B5]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Who's this Old Man who brought us here?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic006 "Who's this Old Man who brought us here?" [DIAL:010109B6]

text_content: {Dog}I had questions for you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic034 "{Dog}I had questions for you." [DIAL:010109C5]

text_content: {Nods, obedient}Yes, Master.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic034 "{Dog}I had questions for you." [DIAL:010109C5]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {God}I had questions for you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic012 "{God}I had questions for you." [DIAL:010109C6]

text_content: I'm sure you do.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic012 "{God}I had questions for you." [DIAL:010109C6]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahAudioLogGalaIntro
name: NVDLC01ElijahAudioLogGalaIntro "NVDLC01ElijahAudioLogGalaIntro" [DIAL:01010A1C]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanDialogueAloneIdleAct1
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueAloneIdleAct1 "NVDLC01DeanDialogueAloneIdleAct1" [DIAL:01010AE4]
