text_content: {Irritated}You'd think it was Spring the way tourists keep rolling in.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueAloneIdleAct1 "NVDLC01DeanDialogueAloneIdleAct1" [DIAL:01010AE4]

text_content: {Impressed}That one's got a head on their shoulders. {Beat}For now.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueAloneIdleAct1 "NVDLC01DeanDialogueAloneIdleAct1" [DIAL:01010AE4]

text_content: {Frowns, to himself}Hope that tourist is hurrying, haven't got all day.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueAloneIdleAct1 "NVDLC01DeanDialogueAloneIdleAct1" [DIAL:01010AE4]

text_content: {Frowns}At least this one seems like a straight shooter. {Beat}Or sucker.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueAloneIdleAct1 "NVDLC01DeanDialogueAloneIdleAct1" [DIAL:01010AE4]

text_content: {Frowns}That tourist crosses me, they'll regret it. {Beat, shrugs}Even if they don't, they still might.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueAloneIdleAct1 "NVDLC01DeanDialogueAloneIdleAct1" [DIAL:01010AE4]

text_content: {Shakes head, disappointed in self}Should never have set that radio signal on repeat.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueAloneIdleAct1 "NVDLC01DeanDialogueAloneIdleAct1" [DIAL:01010AE4]

text_content: NVDLC01IntroEnd
name: NVDLC01IntroEnd "NVDLC01IntroEnd" [DIAL:01010AE5]

text_content: {Downnote, wrapping up}It's letting go.
name: NVDLC01IntroEnd "NVDLC01IntroEnd" [DIAL:01010AE5]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01IntroStart
name: NVDLC01IntroSlide01 "NVDLC01IntroStart" [DIAL:01010AE6]

text_content: You've heard of the Sierra Madre Casino.
name: NVDLC01IntroSlide01 "NVDLC01IntroStart" [DIAL:01010AE6]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01DogKitchenGas
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenGas "NVDLC01DogKitchenGas" [DIAL:01010B29]

text_content: {Sniffs, slightly confused, to himself}Something... wrong in the air.
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenGas "NVDLC01DogKitchenGas" [DIAL:01010B29]

text_content: NVDLC01ChristineGenericIdle
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGenericIdleAct3 "NVDLC01ChristineGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010B71]

text_content: {Coughs, getting her voice back}The quick... the quick scribe... jumped over the lazy paladin.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGenericIdleAct3 "NVDLC01ChristineGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010B71]

text_content: {Warming up her new voice, a little tender}Mi-mo-mih.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGenericIdleAct3 "NVDLC01ChristineGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010B71]

text_content: {Warming up her new voice, a little tender}This is Knight Christine Royce, of the Brotherhood... {emphasizes last two words}Christine Royce.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGenericIdleAct3 "NVDLC01ChristineGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010B71]

text_content: {Coughs, warming up her voice}Ugh... feels like a sore throat - after chewing on nails.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGenericIdleAct3 "NVDLC01ChristineGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010B71]

text_content: {Coughs, beats}Sounds like I smoked a mile of cigarettes.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGenericIdleAct3 "NVDLC01ChristineGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010B71]

text_content: {Shakes head, feeling bleh}Feels like the Cloud crawled in my mouth and died.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGenericIdleAct3 "NVDLC01ChristineGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010B71]

text_content: {Testing out how words sound}Chris-tine. Chris-tine. Hello. Hello. Hello.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGenericIdleAct3 "NVDLC01ChristineGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010B71]

text_content: [Christine makes a sweeping motion of the room, does a deep inhalation, then gives a thumbs up.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGenericIdleAct3 "NVDLC01ChristineGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010B71]

text_content: [Christine sniffs the air, then gives a thumbs up.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGenericIdleAct3 "NVDLC01ChristineGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010B71]

text_content: {Confined space}[Christine's breathing quickens, and her eyes dart around the walls.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGenericIdleAct3 "NVDLC01ChristineGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010B71]

text_content: {Confined space}[Christine seems to be sweating heavily, and her hand is twitching slightly. She looks ready to bolt.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGenericIdleAct3 "NVDLC01ChristineGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010B71]

text_content: [Christine nods at the ground, points at her eyes, then points at the ground again, as if in warning.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGenericIdleAct3 "NVDLC01ChristineGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010B71]

text_content: [Christine motions at ground, makes a snapping motion with her hand, then taps her eyes and pantomimes walking slowly, looking in front of her.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGenericIdleAct3 "NVDLC01ChristineGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010B71]

text_content: [Christine scans the area. She seems on edge, checking the arcades and arches for movement.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGenericIdleAct3 "NVDLC01ChristineGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010B71]

text_content: [Christine makes a motion of loading a fake gun, then suiting up.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGenericIdleAct3 "NVDLC01ChristineGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010B71]

text_content: {Slight frustration}Can't believe I came all this way to have my voice stolen.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGenericIdleAct3 "NVDLC01ChristineGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010B71]

text_content: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGenericIdleAct3
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGenericIdleAct3DUPLICATE000 "NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGenericIdleAct3" [DIAL:01010B7D]

text_content: {THEATER: Dean fight}So, what, you're going to risk blowing off your own head to kill me?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic081 "{THEATER: Dean fight}So, what, you're going to risk blowing off your own head to kill me?" [DIAL:01010B89]

text_content: {Smug, confident}No, I'm not. {emph}I'll get out in time - you won't. {Already planning ahead, as if free and clear already}Once I kill you, exit stage left, and my collar will go quiet.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic081 "{THEATER: Dean fight}So, what, you're going to risk blowing off your own head to kill me?" [DIAL:01010B89]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {THEATER: Dean fight}All the world's a stage. Soon your brains will be all over it.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic080 "{THEATER: Dean fight}All the world's a stage. Soon your brains will be all over it." [DIAL:01010B8A]

text_content: {THEATER: Player has rescued Dean}Don't have time for the song and dance, Dean.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic079 "{THEATER: Player has rescued Dean}Don't have time for the song and dance, Dean." [DIAL:01010B8B]

text_content: I know you didn't do it out of the goodness of your heart. So... instead of empty words and a flourish, let me give you something more useful.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic079 "{THEATER: Player has rescued Dean}Don't have time for the song and dance, Dean." [DIAL:01010B8B]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {THEATER: Player has rescued Dean}Yeah, lucky us. Love getting shot at by Pre-War ghosts.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic078 "{THEATER: Player has rescued Dean}Yeah, lucky us. Love getting shot at by Pre-War ghosts." [DIAL:01010B8C]

text_content: Look, I'm more about the short goodbyes than long thankful speeches... {sincere}but I appreciate you bailing me out of a tight spot there - partner.|I know you didn't do it out of the goodness of your heart. So let me give you something a little more practical - a way we both come out ahead.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic078 "{THEATER: Player has rescued Dean}Yeah, lucky us. Love getting shot at by Pre-War ghosts." [DIAL:01010B8C]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {THEATER: 1st Time, Likes player}Casino security hit you like it hit me when you reached the lobby?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic077 "{THEATER: 1st Time, Likes player}Casino security hit you like it hit me when you reached the lobby?" [DIAL:01010B8D]

text_content: {THEATER: 1st Time, Likes player}Do you know what happened to the others?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic076 "{THEATER: 1st Time, Likes player}Do you know what happened to the others?" [DIAL:01010B8E]

text_content: {THEATER: 1st Time, Hates player}If you think you can take me, come down and try it.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic075 "{THEATER: 1st Time, Hates player}If you think you can take me, come down and try it." [DIAL:01010B8F]

text_content: No... no, no... I'm not leaving this spot. Why dirty my hands when the Sierra Madre can kill you for me?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic075 "{THEATER: 1st Time, Hates player}If you think you can take me, come down and try it." [DIAL:01010B8F]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Smug, a little eager}Time for a little show - I'll just grab a seat and watch how this plays out from backstage. Security can handle it from here.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic075 "{THEATER: 1st Time, Hates player}If you think you can take me, come down and try it." [DIAL:01010B8F]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {THEATER: 1st Time, Hates player}Don't act stupid. Let's get out of here.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic071 "{THEATER: 1st Time, Hates player}Don't act stupid. Let's get out of here." [DIAL:01010B91]

text_content: {Slightly defensive, angry, echoing player's "stupid" accusation}Stupid? No, playing it smart. {Emph}You're the dumb one, waltzing in here without realizing who the headliner is.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic071 "{THEATER: 1st Time, Hates player}Don't act stupid. Let's get out of here." [DIAL:01010B91]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {THEATER: 1st Time, Hates player}So, stabbing me in the back for the Sierra Madre?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic082 "{THEATER: 1st Time, Hates player}So, stabbing me in the back for the Sierra Madre?" [DIAL:01010B9B]

text_content: {Incredulous}You think {emph}I'm the bad guy here? I'm not the one slapping bomb collars on innocent folks and flicking the switch.|{Sing-song, then disdainful in second half}And I'm not stabbing you in the back. I was facing you all the time. This heist? I planned it lifetimes ago. You and that old man? Tourists.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic082 "{THEATER: 1st Time, Hates player}So, stabbing me in the back for the Sierra Madre?" [DIAL:01010B9B]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomPleadTopic01
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomPleadTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomPleadTopic01" [DIAL:01010B9D]

text_content: Hurry, would you? Get me out of this mess. {Beat}Got to sue my agent for this.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomPleadTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomPleadTopic01" [DIAL:01010B9D]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomPleadTopic02
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomPleadTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomPleadTopic02" [DIAL:01010B9E]

text_content: Get me out of here, they've got me trapped!
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomPleadTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomPleadTopic02" [DIAL:01010B9E]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomPleadTopic03
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomPleadTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomPleadTopic03" [DIAL:01010B9F]

text_content: {To himself}Hold it together, Dean, you've been in worse jams. Like Madrid. {Reflecting}Christ - Madrid.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomPleadTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomPleadTopic03" [DIAL:01010B9F]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomTauntTopic01
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomTauntTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomTauntTopic01" [DIAL:01010BA0]

text_content: {Taunt}How long you think you can keep dancing around out there? Song's going to end soon, you along with it.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomTauntTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomTauntTopic01" [DIAL:01010BA0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomTauntTopic02
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomTauntTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomTauntTopic02" [DIAL:01010BA1]

text_content: {Taunt}You won't get out of here alive. Even if you reach me, you don't have the guts to fight.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomTauntTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomTauntTopic02" [DIAL:01010BA1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomTauntTopic03
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomTauntTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomTauntTopic03" [DIAL:01010BA2]

text_content: I'm calling the tune here - this is my theater, my show, I've waited my life to get back here. You? Not even worth the time it'd take to kill you.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomTauntTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterRandomTauntTopic03" [DIAL:01010BA2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: I'm listening.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic101 "I'm listening." [DIAL:01010BD8]

text_content: What do you mean?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic100 "What do you mean?" [DIAL:01010BD9]

text_content: And if she is alive?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic099 "And if she is alive?" [DIAL:01010BDA]

text_content: Then she can make some beautiful music. I'm not banking on it.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic099 "And if she is alive?" [DIAL:01010BDA]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: So you're going to prove it now? How?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic098 "So you're going to prove it now? How?" [DIAL:01010BDB]

text_content: I didn't know at first. Then the old man showed up. You showed up. Then... that woman showed up, covered in scars.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic098 "So you're going to prove it now? How?" [DIAL:01010BDB]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: The one who makes all the hand signs, a little tight around the corners of her mouth.|I put her in the Clinic, tuned her like an instrument. If she heals up, it's not going to be her voice speaking any more.|That is, if the Sierra Madre didn't get her. If it did... well, there's enough of Vera around for me to spend a few years piecing a book together.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic098 "So you're going to prove it now? How?" [DIAL:01010BDB]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Forget Sinclair. If Vera was the key, she's dead.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic096 "Forget Sinclair. If Vera was the key, she's dead." [DIAL:01010BDC]

text_content: {Mocking, he's echoing one of his songs}I only saw her yesterday. Well, a few yesterdays.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic096 "Forget Sinclair. If Vera was the key, she's dead." [DIAL:01010BDC]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: But what did he do to you?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic095 "But what did he do to you?" [DIAL:01010BDD]

text_content: Do to me? {Frowns}What, weren't you listening? He thought he was {emph}better than me. Don't believe me? Look around.|This big casino, this big colossal monument - think it was for some woman? No, all ego, all self-righteous-in-lights, fit him perfect.|Had to take him down a few pegs, bring him down to my level. "Begin again?" Some things you don't get up from... I was going to prove it.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic095 "But what did he do to you?" [DIAL:01010BDD]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: What was your problem with Sinclair?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic094 "What was your problem with Sinclair?" [DIAL:01010BDE]

text_content: {Slight surprise, hasn't given a lot of thought to this in a long time}Problem? All high-and-mighty. Lording it over everyone. Acting so self-righteous, like nothing could touch him. He was the one with the problem.|{Colder, losing himself}Never got mad at anything. Nothing seemed to shake him. Even after... his life kept getting dragged through the dirt.|{Cold, staring into the distance}Always kept looking for the bright, shining future in everything. So... I decided to take everything from him.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic094 "What was your problem with Sinclair?" [DIAL:01010BDE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: So what happened?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic093 "So what happened?" [DIAL:01010BDF]

text_content: {Quiet, reflective}The Bomb. Vera got sealed in here. {Throwaway}A few hundred years go by, give-or-take. {Emph}Almost the end of the story - then you came along.|{Rallying}Now we finish the job. Rob the Sierra Madre, rip out its heart. Last chapter of Frederick Sinclair, close the book.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic093 "So what happened?" [DIAL:01010BDF]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Go on.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic092 "Go on." [DIAL:01010BE0]

text_content: All she had to do was get inside the Sierra Madre for the Gala, then use her voice to open the door. {Smiles}After that... smooth sailing.|{Gleeful, slight malicious}Would have been the biggest heist in history. Sinclair left holding the bag. Ruined.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic092 "Go on." [DIAL:01010BE0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Forget the history lesson, get to the point.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic091 "Forget the history lesson, get to the point." [DIAL:01010BE1]

text_content: How so?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic090 "How so?" [DIAL:01010BE2]

text_content: Sinclair was already puppy-eyed, so all I had to do was the introductions. {Disgusted}She smiled, fluttered her eyes, showed a little leg...|{A little colder, disgust chilling}...and he built this whole place for her. Made {emph}her the key to his vault, like a joke, cause of her name. {Draw this out}Her fake Hollywood name.|{Malicious, implying "been" = sex}Except Sinclair didn't know I'd been there first. I could twist her whatever direction I wanted.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic090 "How so?" [DIAL:01010BE2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Likes PC}All right, I'll head out and see what I can do on my end.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic088 "{Likes PC}All right, I'll head out and see what I can do on my end." [DIAL:01010BE4]

text_content: Go knock yourself out. I'm just going to catch my breath a bit. That performance... well, more pressure than I was expecting.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic088 "{Likes PC}All right, I'll head out and see what I can do on my end." [DIAL:01010BE4]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: So you don't know the phrase?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic087 "So you don't know the phrase?" [DIAL:01010BE5]

text_content: {Thinking}No, that I still had to figure out - still do. Sinclair wrote stuff down, was obsessive about it. Just got to find where.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic087 "So you don't know the phrase?" [DIAL:01010BE5]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Voice?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic086 "Voice?" [DIAL:01010BE6]

text_content: Yeah, the woman, the Starlet, Vera - her voice. {Grumbles to himself}Didn't realize there was so many holotapes of her still around, otherwise... eh, never mind.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic086 "Voice?" [DIAL:01010BE6]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Tell me. The short version.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic085 "Tell me. The short version." [DIAL:01010BE7]

text_content: Elevator's up in the Executive Suites. Voice-activated. Speak the right phrase, in the right tone of voice, and it's open sesame.|I was able to snag the voice, {beat downnote}or thought I had. {Normal tone}The right tone and phrasing... well, that may take some time.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic085 "Tell me. The short version." [DIAL:01010BE7]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: What do you mean?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic084 "What do you mean?" [DIAL:01010BE8]

text_content: {Confiding, superior}There's a private elevator, Sinclair's elevator. It's up in the Executive Suites, in Vera's room. {Beat, emph}Not a coincidence.|Vera. {Reluctant, quiet}She was... my other partner, before the Bomb. {Quieter}Took some legwork. Some convincing, made it happen.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic084 "What do you mean?" [DIAL:01010BE8]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueClinicBark
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueClinicBark "NVDLC01ChristineDialogueClinicBark" [DIAL:01010BF9]

text_content: [Christine stares at the headless corpses for a second. Then she makes a slow, angry scowl.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueClinicBark "NVDLC01ChristineDialogueClinicBark" [DIAL:01010BF9]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanDialogueClinicBark
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueClinicBark "NVDLC01DeanDialogueClinicBark" [DIAL:01010BFA]

text_content: {Pretending to find the scene distasteful}There's a picture, a bunch of headless saps all waiting for the pearly gates. Whoever did this... messed up.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueClinicBark "NVDLC01DeanDialogueClinicBark" [DIAL:01010BFA]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic01
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic01" [DIAL:01010C03]

text_content: {Frustrated}First time on stage in a hundred years, and it has to be this?
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic01" [DIAL:01010C03]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic02
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic02" [DIAL:01010C04]

text_content: {Looking around}Hnh. Theater's almost the same as it was.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic02" [DIAL:01010C04]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic03
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic03" [DIAL:01010C05]

text_content: Where the hell did everyone else go?
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic03" [DIAL:01010C05]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic04
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic04 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic04" [DIAL:01010C06]

text_content: Need some help here... and that audience is {emph}not looking friendly.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic04 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic04" [DIAL:01010C06]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic05
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic05 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic05" [DIAL:01010C07]

text_content: Hope my partner fared better than I did... better not have left me high and dry, get-even's not going to be pretty.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic05 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerLikedTopic05" [DIAL:01010C07]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic01
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic01" [DIAL:01010C08]

text_content: {Looking around}Hnh. Theater's almost the same as it was.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic01" [DIAL:01010C08]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic02
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic02" [DIAL:01010C09]

text_content: {Looking around}This place... hasn't changed at all.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic02" [DIAL:01010C09]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic03
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic03" [DIAL:01010C0A]

text_content: Wonder what happened to the suckers. {Frowns}Might have gotten taken away, like I did?
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic03" [DIAL:01010C0A]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic04
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic04 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic04" [DIAL:01010C0B]

text_content: That audience... better lay low, get a feel for the crowd.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic04 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic04" [DIAL:01010C0B]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic05
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic05 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic05" [DIAL:01010C0C]

text_content: Good thing, someone walks in here, they're toast.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic05 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfPlayerHatedTopic05" [DIAL:01010C0C]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfOverTopic01
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfOverTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfOverTopic01" [DIAL:01010C0D]

text_content: I am out of here... well, not to the Villa, just out of the damn theater first chance I get.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfOverTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfOverTopic01" [DIAL:01010C0D]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfOverTopic02
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfOverTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfOverTopic02" [DIAL:01010C0E]

text_content: Got to say this for Sinclair, he sure knew how to keep things locked down, the tight-assed prick.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfOverTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfOverTopic02" [DIAL:01010C0E]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfOverTopic03
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfOverTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfOverTopic03" [DIAL:01010C0F]

text_content: {Under his breath, after battle in the theater}Not going to be performing here again, that's for sure.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfOverTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterToSelfOverTopic03" [DIAL:01010C0F]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Why don't you come with me, whatever else you're here for, not my concern.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic087 "Why don't you come with me, whatever else you're here for, not my concern." [DIAL:01010C2A]

text_content: You're looking for something else. Fine, I can help.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic086 "You're looking for something else. Fine, I can help." [DIAL:01010C2B]

text_content: [She studies you again, then her expression softens slightly. She shakes her head slowly, and gives a silent sigh.]|[She nods at you, then raises an eyebrow and nods at the door.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic086 "You're looking for something else. Fine, I can help." [DIAL:01010C2B]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: What exactly is wrong? Don't you want out of here?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic085 "What exactly is wrong? Don't you want out of here?" [DIAL:01010C2C]

text_content: Look, I'm not trying to order you. But your life is tied to mine.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic084 "Look, I'm not trying to order you. But your life is tied to mine." [DIAL:01010C2D]

text_content: [She frowns, glances at the collar, looks back at you. She makes a circle with her hands, puts her hand over her eyes and squints.]|[She nods at you, then lowers her hand from her eyes, shakes her head. She draws a slow line between you.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic084 "Look, I'm not trying to order you. But your life is tied to mine." [DIAL:01010C2D]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Get going. I'll meet you at the Fountain in the center of the Villa.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic083 "Get going. I'll meet you at the Fountain in the center of the Villa." [DIAL:01010C2E]

text_content: {Christine goes to the fountain.}[Christine gives a brief nod, then turns and begins to walk.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic083 "Get going. I'll meet you at the Fountain in the center of the Villa." [DIAL:01010C2E]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Fine. Would hate to have carved you up anymore than you are.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic075 "Fine. Would hate to have carved you up anymore than you are." [DIAL:01010C2F]

text_content: [Christine's defeated expression vanishes into a stone-faced glare.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic075 "Fine. Would hate to have carved you up anymore than you are." [DIAL:01010C2F]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Glad we understand each other. Let's go.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic073 "Glad we understand each other. Let's go." [DIAL:01010C30]

text_content: {Player has no companion. Christine comes along.}[Christine narrows her eyes slightly. She slowly nods, then steps slightly behind you.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic073 "Glad we understand each other. Let's go." [DIAL:01010C30]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: {Player has a companion. Christine goes to the fountain for now.}[Christine glances at your follower, shakes her head, then points at you, her, and nods in the direction of the fountain.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic073 "Glad we understand each other. Let's go." [DIAL:01010C30]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: I let you out of the Auto-Doc. I can put you back in there just as fast.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic071 "I let you out of the Auto-Doc. I can put you back in there just as fast." [DIAL:01010C31]

text_content: [Her eyes widen, and her eyes gauge yours. She then touches her wounds, and her expression crumbles into anger, as if defeated. She slowly nods.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic071 "I let you out of the Auto-Doc. I can put you back in there just as fast." [DIAL:01010C31]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: NVDLC01IntroSlide06
name: NVDLC01IntroSlide06 "NVDLC01IntroSlide06" [DIAL:01010C40]

text_content: ... a monument to wealth.
name: NVDLC01IntroSlide06 "NVDLC01IntroSlide06" [DIAL:01010C40]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01IntroSlide05
name: NVDLC01IntroSlide05 "NVDLC01IntroSlide05" [DIAL:01010C41]

text_content: It was built before the War, a tower of gold and lights, where fortunes could be gained and lost...
name: NVDLC01IntroSlide05 "NVDLC01IntroSlide05" [DIAL:01010C41]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01IntroSlide04
name: NVDLC01IntroSlide04 "NVDLC01IntroSlide04" [DIAL:01010C42]

text_content: {beat}A bright, shining monument luring treasure hunters to their doom.
name: NVDLC01IntroSlide04 "NVDLC01IntroSlide04" [DIAL:01010C42]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01IntroSlide03
name: NVDLC01IntroSlide03 "NVDLC01IntroSlide03" [DIAL:01010C43]

text_content: {Sneer continues}Foolishness about it lying in the middle of the City of the Dead, buried beneath a blood-red cloud.
name: NVDLC01IntroSlide03 "NVDLC01IntroSlide03" [DIAL:01010C43]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01IntroSlide02
name: NVDLC01IntroSlide02 "NVDLC01IntroSlide02" [DIAL:01010C44]

text_content: {Slight sneer, hates these rumor stories, when he knows the truth}We all have, the legend, the curses.
name: NVDLC01IntroSlide02 "NVDLC01IntroSlide02" [DIAL:01010C44]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic02
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic02" [DIAL:01010C4B]

text_content: {Terminal blows up}What the blazes... piece of junk! {Beat, cold, gets it}You rigged that terminal, didn't you. Didn't want security showing you out, eh? We'll see.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic02" [DIAL:01010C4B]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic02
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic02" [DIAL:01010C4C]

text_content: {Working on a computer, trying to shut it down}Hnh. Maybe I can shut down these ghosts using the Stage Manager's old termin... {blows up}dammit! {Beat, frowns}Well, so much for that idea.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic02 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic02" [DIAL:01010C4C]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterOpenConvoPlayerLikedBark
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterOpenConvoPlayerLikedBark "NVDLC01DeanTheaterOpenConvoPlayerLikedBark" [DIAL:01010C4D]

text_content: {Relieved to see a familiar face}You... partner, are you a sight for sore eyes. Unfriendly crowd tonight, in a lethal way - if you could calm the house down, I'd be grateful.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterOpenConvoPlayerLikedBark "NVDLC01DeanTheaterOpenConvoPlayerLikedBark" [DIAL:01010C4D]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterOpenConvoPlayerHatedBark
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterOpenConvoPlayerHatedBark "NVDLC01DeanTheaterOpenConvoPlayerHatedBark" [DIAL:01010C4E]

text_content: {Gloating a bit}Hey... guess who finally showed. {Malicious}You weren't on the guest list. Guess I'll need to call security, have them show you the door.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterOpenConvoPlayerHatedBark "NVDLC01DeanTheaterOpenConvoPlayerHatedBark" [DIAL:01010C4E]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic05
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic05 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic05" [DIAL:01010C4F]

text_content: {Slow, then challenging, bravado}So... you think you have what it takes to beat {emph}me, on {emph}my stage, in {emph}my town? Come on down, we'll see.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic05 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic05" [DIAL:01010C4F]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic04
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic04 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic04" [DIAL:01010C50]

text_content: {Slightly unnerved, player's about to break his last line of defense}Don't do it. Leave that projector alone - I'm warning you.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic04 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic04" [DIAL:01010C50]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic03
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic03" [DIAL:01010C51]

text_content: {Cold}So... can't leave well enough alone, have to enter Vera's room. Some things are better left in the past, "partner."
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic03" [DIAL:01010C51]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic01
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic01" [DIAL:01010C52]

text_content: {Slightly irritated, still superior}Now, now... that's {emph}my room. You want your own dressing room, you have to work for it.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerHatedBarkTopic01" [DIAL:01010C52]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic05
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic05 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic05" [DIAL:01010C53]

text_content: Oh, man... nice job. Good thing {emph}I was distracting them while you flicked them off. {Puffing up}We're a good team - I run the show while you run the box office.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic05 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic05" [DIAL:01010C53]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic04
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic04 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic04" [DIAL:01010C54]

text_content: {Urgent}All right, now calm the audience down and let's go home. {Beat, under his breath}And when my part plays, no cracking jokes - that was the hairstyle back then, all right?
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic04 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic04" [DIAL:01010C54]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic03
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic03" [DIAL:01010C55]

text_content: {Encouraged}Hey, you're making real progress, good. {Realizes the player's close to uncovering dirty laundry, so masks it behind "show some respect"}Uh, look that's... Vera's room, so careful what you touch in there, be respectful.
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic03 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic03" [DIAL:01010C55]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic01
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic01" [DIAL:01010C56]

text_content: {Happy, excusing, then defensive}Hey, you found my old room. I mean, it's a little small... and hey, watch the hands in there, I remember where I left {emph}everything, got it?
name: NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanTheaterPlayerLikedBarkTopic01" [DIAL:01010C56]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Fine. Meet at the Fountain?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic102 "Fine. Meet at the Fountain?" [DIAL:01010C9A]

text_content: I'm in. If that's all, let's head out.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic097 "I'm in. If that's all, let's head out." [DIAL:01010C9B]

text_content: NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaGood
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaGood "NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CA2]

text_content: {Surprised}Hnh. The human pulled it off.
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaGood "NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CA2]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Just like last time. Come on, Dog, you know the drill.
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaGood "NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CA2]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Gate won't be open for long.
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaGood "NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CA2]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Need to stay out of sight... can't afford to be distracted now.
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaGood "NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CA2]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: What the Old World saw in these light shows is beyond me.
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaGood "NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CA2]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaBad
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaBad "NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CA3]

text_content: {Impressed}The human did it. {Evil}Good.
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaBad "NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CA3]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Not going down like last time - Dog, you're staying in the cage.
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaBad "NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CA3]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Time to get to the gate, "friends" or no friends.
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaBad "NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CA3]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {To himself}Fires and speakers are going to bring the Ghost People out in full.
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaBad "NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CA3]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Eager}Coming for you, human... you just wait.
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaBad "NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CA3]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Madre's mine.
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaBad "NVDLC01GodDialoguePostGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CA3]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaBad
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaBad "NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CA4]

text_content: {To himself}When this festival fires, I'm the first one in the door.
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaBad "NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CA4]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Last time I ever deal with human trash...
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaBad "NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CA4]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: After the Bomb, still slaves to technology, events, Pip-Boys, collars... hnnnr.
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaBad "NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CA4]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: I'll whip you for this, Dog. I'll crush your cage with you inside it for making me go through this.
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaBad "NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CA4]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: All this - if I get inside the Sierra Madre, it's all worth it. All of it.
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaBad "NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CA4]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: As soon as those collars go off... we'll settle things, yes.
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaBad "NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CA4]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaGood
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaGood "NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CA5]

text_content: {Urgent}Hurry, we're targets out here.
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaGood "NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CA5]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Almost inside. Finally. {Beat, himself}Then I can get rid of the baggage.
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaGood "NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CA5]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {To himself}Quiet, Dog, stay in the cage.
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaGood "NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CA5]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Disgust}Sick of these Old World deathtraps.
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaGood "NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CA5]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Low, eager}The Sierra Madre's almost mine.
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaGood "NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CA5]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Snarling}They better not try and leave me here...
name: NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaGood "NVDLC01GodDialoguePreGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CA5]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle
name: NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle "NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle" [DIAL:01010CA6]

text_content: {Snff}No toxins in the air in here.
name: NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle "NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle" [DIAL:01010CA6]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Well, {emph}this place has seen better days.
name: NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle "NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle" [DIAL:01010CA6]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: If we need to fight, you should call Dog out... as much as I hate to admit it.
name: NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle "NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle" [DIAL:01010CA6]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Thinking}Might be able to use the gas valves around here to set traps of our own.
name: NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle "NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle" [DIAL:01010CA6]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: We'll need to move faster than this if we're going to outwit the Old Man.
name: NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle "NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle" [DIAL:01010CA6]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Smirks}Happy you followed the Sierra Madre broadcast? Curiosity and greed, same thing.
name: NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle "NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle" [DIAL:01010CA6]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: It's your own fault you're here. Couldn't leave well enough alone.
name: NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle "NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle" [DIAL:01010CA6]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: That Pip-Boy... maybe I'll tear it off your arm, wear it on my neck.
name: NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle "NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle" [DIAL:01010CA6]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Air tastes like copper. {Beat, smiles}Or Old World gold.
name: NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle "NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle" [DIAL:01010CA6]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Almost got away... then the idiot's hunger screws it up.
name: NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle "NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle" [DIAL:01010CA6]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Why do you keep looking at your Pip-Boy? It won't help. {Snorts}Didn't help the Old Man.
name: NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle "NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle" [DIAL:01010CA6]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Can't believe the idiot swallowed his collar.
name: NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle "NVDLC01GodDialogueGenericidle" [DIAL:01010CA6]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: NVDLC01GodDialogueAloneIdleAct1
name: NVDLC01GodDialogueAloneIdleAct1 "NVDLC01GodDialogueAloneIdleAct1" [DIAL:01010CA7]

text_content: Can't believe the idiot swallowed his collar.
name: NVDLC01GodDialogueAloneIdleAct1 "NVDLC01GodDialogueAloneIdleAct1" [DIAL:01010CA7]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: What's taking that human so long.
name: NVDLC01GodDialogueAloneIdleAct1 "NVDLC01GodDialogueAloneIdleAct1" [DIAL:01010CA7]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {To himself}If that human wasn't wearing a collar...
name: NVDLC01GodDialogueAloneIdleAct1 "NVDLC01GodDialogueAloneIdleAct1" [DIAL:01010CA7]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Wonder what that human's insides would look like laid out over the fountain.
name: NVDLC01GodDialogueAloneIdleAct1 "NVDLC01GodDialogueAloneIdleAct1" [DIAL:01010CA7]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {To himself}Might be able to rip the Pip-Boy off his arm without killing him. Hmm.
name: NVDLC01GodDialogueAloneIdleAct1 "NVDLC01GodDialogueAloneIdleAct1" [DIAL:01010CA7]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaBad
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaBad "NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CA8]

text_content: Nooooooooooo!
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaBad "NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CA8]

text_content: :: Howling, frightened. ::
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaBad "NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CA8]

text_content: Let me out, let me out!
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaBad "NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CA8]

text_content: Noise hurts, noise {emph}hurts!
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaBad "NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CA8]

text_content: Streets are hurting my ears!
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaBad "NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CA8]

text_content: Too bright, too bright.
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaBad "NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CA8]

text_content: NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaGood
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaGood "NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CA9]

text_content: {Hypnotized by light show in sky}Lights and fire.
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaGood "NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CA9]

text_content: {Quiet}Pretty.
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaGood "NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CA9]

text_content: {Frowns}Lots of noise.
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaGood "NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CA9]

text_content: {Curious}Where is Master? Did Master make fires in the sky?
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaGood "NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CA9]

text_content: {At festival}:: Delighted clapping ::
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaGood "NVDLC01DogDialoguePostGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CA9]

text_content: NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaBad
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaBad "NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CAA]

text_content: :: Weeping. ::
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaBad "NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CAA]

text_content: :: Whimpering ::
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaBad "NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CAA]

text_content: :: Howling in frustration ::
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaBad "NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CAA]

text_content: Please let me out.
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaBad "NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CAA]

text_content: Dog is sorry, sorry, sorry.
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaBad "NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CAA]

text_content: What did I do?
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaBad "NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CAA]

text_content: NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaGood
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaGood " NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaGood " [DIAL:01010CAB]

text_content: Where are lights. Dog want to see the lights.
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaGood " NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaGood " [DIAL:01010CAB]

text_content: Can't wait to see the lights.
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaGood " NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaGood " [DIAL:01010CAB]

text_content: :: Impatient Growl ::
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaGood " NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaGood " [DIAL:01010CAB]

text_content: {Scared}Hurry up, Dog doesn't like being here.
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaGood " NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaGood " [DIAL:01010CAB]

text_content: {Crude rhyme}Got to go... Casin-oooo.
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaGood " NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaGood " [DIAL:01010CAB]

text_content: Didn't... we do this before? Can't remember.
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaGood " NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaGood " [DIAL:01010CAB]

text_content: Want show and lights and yelling to start.
name: NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaGood " NVDLC01DogDialoguePreGalaGood " [DIAL:01010CAB]

text_content: NVDLV01DogDialogueGenericIdle
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLV01DogDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010CAC]

text_content: {1st Time, Switching Station, Slight concern}Really dark down here. {Beat}Smell like oil and 'tronics.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLV01DogDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010CAC]

text_content: {1st Time, Clinic}Dog not like this place. Air smells like burnt sparks and blood.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLV01DogDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010CAC]

text_content: {1st Time, Cafe}{In cafe, stumbling over pronunciation}Cafe. Food place. Maybe something in kitchen?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLV01DogDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010CAC]

text_content: {Cafe}Like it here.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLV01DogDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010CAC]

text_content: {Salida/Puesta Only}When Dog catch a Ghost in plastic, Dog tear him apart so they don't get back up.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLV01DogDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010CAC]

text_content: {Salida/Puesta only, Snffs}Smells like... flesh in plastic... lots of food around here. We should catch some.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLV01DogDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010CAC]

text_content: {Salida/Puesta only}{Worried}Lots of marks on walls from other dead people. They not get far.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLV01DogDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010CAC]

text_content: {Hushed, whispering, looks around}Hope the voice doesn't come back. Mean. Bad.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLV01DogDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010CAC]

text_content: {Rocks on legs}Where is Master? Did he go away? {Apologetic}Dog will be good this time.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLV01DogDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010CAC]

text_content: {Slight disgust}Swallowed something bad. Taste like burnt wires.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLV01DogDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010CAC]

text_content: {Himself, sad}Always yell at Dog. Yell at Dog because gets hungry, can't stop it... always need more.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLV01DogDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010CAC]

text_content: {Himself, a little scared}Insides growling.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLV01DogDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010CAC]

text_content: {Himself}So hungry.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLV01DogDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010CAC]

text_content: Don't like this place. Want to go back, back to the Base. {Beat, quiet}Or the Church, miss the Church.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLV01DogDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010CAC]

text_content: {Relaxing}Air in here not burn chest.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLV01DogDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010CAC]

text_content: :: Mournful whining to self ::
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLV01DogDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010CAC]

text_content: :: Stomach rumbling.::
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueGenericIdle "NVDLV01DogDialogueGenericIdle" [DIAL:01010CAC]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala" [DIAL:01010CAD]

text_content: Holy Mary, Mother, and Joe - now {emph}there's a show.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala" [DIAL:01010CAD]

text_content: {himself}Not much time to get to the gates before they shut the door and turn folks away.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala" [DIAL:01010CAD]

text_content: {Urgent, worried he's going to get attacked by zombies}All right, now - I'm out of here.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala" [DIAL:01010CAD]

text_content: {Urgent, worried he's going to get attacked by zombies}If the Ghost People didn't know we were here before, they know now.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala" [DIAL:01010CAD]

text_content: Someone struck up the band. {To himself, grumbling}A band of tortured cats.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala" [DIAL:01010CAD]

text_content: What kind of casino has two Grand Openings?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala" [DIAL:01010CAD]

text_content: {Cold, to himself}This is your last hurrah, Sinclair, I promise you.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala" [DIAL:01010CAD]

text_content: Just my luck.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala" [DIAL:01010CAD]

text_content: Luck's finally shining down on me.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala" [DIAL:01010CAD]

text_content: You wait, beautiful. Keep that gate open for me, Dean'll be there soon.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala" [DIAL:01010CAD]

text_content: Sierra Madre, sweetheart, Dean's coming home.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePostGala" [DIAL:01010CAD]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaGood
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaGood "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CAE]

text_content: Sinclair, you better appreciate all I do to screw you over.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaGood "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CAE]

text_content: That tourist is better than most. Eh... probably won't matter.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaGood "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CAE]

text_content: The linked collars is a new trick. Can't say I like it much.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaGood "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CAE]

text_content: Waiting for the fireworks. {Beat}Just like last time.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaGood "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CAE]

text_content: Can't wait to see their faces when they find out what the lock is. Just gotta wait 'em out.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaGood "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CAE]

text_content: Place is going to be swarming with the masks when the sky lights up.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaGood "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaGood" [DIAL:01010CAE]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaBad
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaBad "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CAF]

text_content: {Angry}We'll see who's holding the cards in the end...
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaBad "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CAF]

text_content: {Mutters}Didn't come all this way to get conned by some tourist.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaBad "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CAF]

text_content: The joke's on you, "partners." You aren't getting to the prize without me.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaBad "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CAF]

text_content: {Sighs}This is a fine how do you do.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaBad "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CAF]

text_content: {Grumbles}Should have blown up that seat cushion right when they sat down, would've been a better end than this.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaBad "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CAF]

text_content: {To himself}Just finish the last job, Dean. It's all you've wanted, just hang in there.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaBad "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CAF]

text_content: {Himself}Keep your head down, Dean, don't let the locals see you.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaBad "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CAF]

text_content: {Mutters}Town's going to be filled with Ghosts when the sky lights up.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaBad "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePreGalaBad" [DIAL:01010CAF]

text_content: This thing on my neck isn't for show. That bomb goes off, so do I - and you, too.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic104 "This thing on my neck isn't for show. That bomb goes off, so do I - and you, too." [DIAL:01010D70]

text_content: NVDLC01ChristineSuiteIntroBad2
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01SuitesIntercomTopic001 "NVDLC01ChristineSuiteIntroBad2" [DIAL:01010D93]

text_content: Leaving me in that goddamn elevator in the dark? You'll beg me to do the same to you while the Holograms are tracing lasers across your face.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01SuitesIntercomTopic001 "NVDLC01ChristineSuiteIntroBad2" [DIAL:01010D93]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: NVDLC01ChristineSuiteIntroBad
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01SuitesIntercomTopic000 "NVDLC01ChristineSuiteIntroBad" [DIAL:01010D94]

text_content: So come on and get me, jackass. I'll have this floor's security dissect you like an Auto-Doc.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01SuitesIntercomTopic000 "NVDLC01ChristineSuiteIntroBad" [DIAL:01010D94]

text_content: So come on and get me, bitch. I'll have this floor's security dissect you like an Auto-Doc.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01SuitesIntercomTopic000 "NVDLC01ChristineSuiteIntroBad" [DIAL:01010D94]

text_content: NVDLC01ChristineSuiteIntro2
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic088 "NVDLC01ChristineSuiteIntro2" [DIAL:01010D95]

text_content: {Thinking, determined}Should be able to rewire them, failing that, shoot them, {beat, backpedals, slight frustration}although that'll alert the others, they're on a linked patrol pattern.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic088 "NVDLC01ChristineSuiteIntro2" [DIAL:01010D95]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: NVDLC01ChristineSuiteIntro
name: NVDLC01ChristineSuiteIntro "NVDLC01ChristineSuiteIntro" [DIAL:01010D96]

text_content: {More military professional}All doors are locked down, security's activated - and emitter signals are lighting up all over this floor. {Beat, comes to a decision}I'll do what I can from here.
name: NVDLC01ChristineSuiteIntro "NVDLC01ChristineSuiteIntro" [DIAL:01010D96]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: NVDLC01DogKitchenValve
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenValve "NVDLC01DogKitchenValve" [DIAL:01010DA5]

text_content: {Confused}Why pipe not break. {Puts back into}Pipe. Break. {Frowns, relaxes}Hnh. Leave it, not important.
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenValve "NVDLC01DogKitchenValve" [DIAL:01010DA5]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGateLock
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGateLock "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGateLock" [DIAL:01010ED8]

text_content: {Not really happy to hear this, it's like someone left his door unlocked in a dangerous neighborhood}Oh, looks like you already forced the gate. {Beat, under his breath}Now, everybody and their mother can walk right in, thanks.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGateLock "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGateLock" [DIAL:01010ED8]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanDialogueShortcut
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueShortcut "NVDLC01DeanDialogueShortcut" [DIAL:01010ED9]

text_content: Don't have to take the long way back - there's a shortcut across the way, you see.|It's through the Cloud - but if I'm with you, I can help you through it. {To himself, the player better not have}If you didn't already force the lock to the gate, that is.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueShortcut "NVDLC01DeanDialogueShortcut" [DIAL:01010ED9]

text_content: <Lie> Dean, I wouldn't leave you here, I swear.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic111 "<Lie> Dean, I wouldn't leave you here, I swear." [DIAL:01010EE3]

text_content: {Disdainful}Sure, nice words, nice promises... not worth a dime out here in the shadow of the Sierra Madre.|You say you wouldn't leave me here, I know better. {Low threat}And you leave me here, this Gala Event isn't going to happen, I can feel it.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic111 "<Lie> Dean, I wouldn't leave you here, I swear." [DIAL:01010EE3]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: I'm not going to let any harm come to you, all right?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic107 "I'm not going to let any harm come to you, all right?" [DIAL:01010EE7]

text_content: {Reluctant}No... you're not the type, but accidents happen, good intentions or no.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic107 "I'm not going to let any harm come to you, all right?" [DIAL:01010EE7]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Really? That wasn't the "we're both bomb-married" talk you gave me when we first met.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic107 "I'm not going to let any harm come to you, all right?" [DIAL:01010EE7]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Look, you could offer me a steel clad contract for a world tour of all major cities with Imperial Records, I still wouldn't stay here.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic107 "I'm not going to let any harm come to you, all right?" [DIAL:01010EE7]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Less painful would be me throwing you off the roof. Understand?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic103 "Less painful would be me throwing you off the roof. Understand?" [DIAL:01010EEA]

text_content: NVDLC01DogKitchenValveBroken
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenValveBroken "NVDLC01DogKitchenValveBroken" [DIAL:01010F52]

text_content: {Slightly insistent.}Pipe {emph}stay broken.
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenValveBroken "NVDLC01DogKitchenValveBroken" [DIAL:01010F52]

text_content: {Slightly angry}Pipe needs to behave, or Dog will hurt pipe.
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenValveBroken "NVDLC01DogKitchenValveBroken" [DIAL:01010F52]

text_content: {Like patting a small child}All better. {Slightly lower}Pipe be good now, keep hissing.
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenValveBroken "NVDLC01DogKitchenValveBroken" [DIAL:01010F52]

text_content: You sound like the woman in the Sierra Madre broadcast.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic023 "You sound like the woman in the Sierra Madre broadcast." [DIAL:0101106E]

text_content: {Confused}Do I? {Shakes head}It sounds off to my ears... hard to tell. Not to mention it... hurts like hell to swallow.|Might be why I got moved off to this suite... it's hers. {Quiet}That's her over there, got trapped by security like I did. Just took a different way out.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic023 "You sound like the woman in the Sierra Madre broadcast." [DIAL:0101106E]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: I wasn't the one hiding all this time.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic064 "I wasn't the one hiding all this time." [DIAL:010111F8]

text_content: You sure needed it to escape.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic063 "You sure needed it to escape." [DIAL:010111F9]

text_content: Proud that you have one? {Beat}I can hear the superiority.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic063 "You sure needed it to escape." [DIAL:010111F9]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: What do you mean?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic062 "What do you mean?" [DIAL:010111FA]

text_content: That thing on your wrist - it's a convenience. It tells you where to go, what to do, dulls your brain.|It may have helped you find the Sierra Madre broadcast, but it's just as much a crutch today as it was in the Old World.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic062 "What do you mean?" [DIAL:010111FA]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: How did you access my Pip-Boy?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic061 "How did you access my Pip-Boy?" [DIAL:010111FB]

text_content: {Snorts, contemptuous}You speak as if your fingers have never touched the keys of a RobCo terminal. No machine is foolproof, they are designed to obey us.|{Superior, lording it over the player}The Pip-Boy's operating system has vulnerabilities... {emph}advantages to those who've studied its construction, even superficially.|{Contempt}It's just a machine, though. Its real vulnerability is who wears it. And that's how {emph}you were caught.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic061 "How did you access my Pip-Boy?" [DIAL:010111FB]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Still hiding behind images and screens, I see.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic060 "Still hiding behind images and screens, I see." [DIAL:010111FC]

text_content: {Short, brutal}Hiding? Hardly. Trapped.|{Superior, dismissive}You think you were the first one to unlock the casino door? No, I did it... with other hands, other bodies. {To himself}After that, the casino wouldn't let go.|{Thinking, a little haunted}Once I was locked in, no way out... {smiles at his own cleverness}until your Pip-Boy signal came to life in the Villa. Then... then, uh, things changed. And here you are.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic060 "Still hiding behind images and screens, I see." [DIAL:010111FC]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: You've got a lot to answer for.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic059 "You've got a lot to answer for." [DIAL:010111FD]

text_content: {Scoffs}Do I? For what? {emph}Your greed? Curiosity? {Snorts}You came here on your own, no one held a gun to your head.|{Sneering}I've seen your Pip-Boy archives, your map markers and notes - you picked up the Sierra Madre signal just as I did, you couldn't resist.|{Vicious, judgmental}So if you feel {emph}I have a lot to answer for... no, the blame isn't on {emph}my shoulders. {To himself}Might as well have put the collar on yourself.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic059 "You've got a lot to answer for." [DIAL:010111FD]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: There's a chance he'll see reason.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic094 "There's a chance he'll see reason." [DIAL:010111FE]

text_content: {Disgusted}Try and reason with him, see what happens. He's so lost in his technology, I don't think he even understands why anymore.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic094 "There's a chance he'll see reason." [DIAL:010111FE]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Sympathized? Why?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic092 "Sympathized? Why?" [DIAL:010111FF]

text_content: He said he understood what it meant to track someone who had such a... impact on his past life. |He said people were like couriers, sometimes never understanding the messages they brought. {Frowns}That's who he was hunting for... some courier.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic092 "Sympathized? Why?" [DIAL:010111FF]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: He knew Elijah? How?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic091 "He knew Elijah? How?" [DIAL:01011200]

text_content: No idea. A courier. Wore an Old World flag on his back. He was the one who pulled me out there, told me where Elijah had gone.|{Reflective}Helped me heal up, listened to my story. He... sympathized.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic091 "He knew Elijah? How?" [DIAL:01011200]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: He said he knew you.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic089 "He said he knew you." [DIAL:01011201]

text_content: He saw me, before the scars, at a place far from here. It's where he found some of the technology he uses now.|{Remembering a bad experience, somber}It's a place called the Big Empty. The name's deceptive - if you know where to look.|{Still reflecting}Almost got trapped there. There was someone else, though, who came along. Knew about Elijah.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic089 "He said he knew you." [DIAL:01011201]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: "Settle it?" You're here to kill him.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic026 """Settle it?"" You're here to kill him." [DIAL:01011202]

text_content: {Cold}Those are my orders. I've seen what he's done, and I believe in those orders.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic026 """Settle it?"" You're here to kill him." [DIAL:01011202]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Sounds personal.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic021 "Sounds personal." [DIAL:01011203]

text_content: He... cut me off from someone I cared about a long time ago. He used his status to break us apart. So I had to find a new purpose, same banner.|Then he became unstable, left a trail of crimes across the wasteland. Once word reached us, I was ordered to kill him.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic021 "Sounds personal." [DIAL:01011203]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: How long have you been hunting him?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic019 "How long have you been hunting him?" [DIAL:01011204]

text_content: Too long. Thought I might have had a chance to settle it before this event happened, but then the chance slipped away again.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic019 "How long have you been hunting him?" [DIAL:01011204]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: The elevator to the vault is here, too.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic017 "The elevator to the vault is here, too." [DIAL:01011205]

text_content: {Recognition, matter-of-fact}The elevator to the casino vault is here. In the starlet's room? That seems intimate.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic017 "The elevator to the vault is here, too." [DIAL:01011205]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Now that your voice is back, what did you want to say?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic016 "Now that your voice is back, what did you want to say?" [DIAL:01011206]

text_content: Your voice... is that the Starlet's voice?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic007 "Your voice... is that the Starlet's voice?" [DIAL:01011208]

text_content: {Cold}Guess the Sierra Madre healed me. {Dismissive}It doesn't matter, and to be honest, I miss {emph}my voice.|I've had enough of you and Elijah running the show. {Beat}Now it's my turn.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic007 "Your voice... is that the Starlet's voice?" [DIAL:01011208]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: NVDLC01DogDialogueClinicBark
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueClinicBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueClinicBark" [DIAL:0101121B]

text_content: {Confused}People missing heads... make mistake coming here. {slightly eager}Make Dog hungry.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueClinicBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueClinicBark" [DIAL:0101121B]

text_content: {Curious, malicious}It looks like someone was experimenting... {more interested}although they were doing so {emph}after the collars went off.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueClinicBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueClinicBark" [DIAL:0101121B]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGhostBark
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGhostBark "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGhostBark" [DIAL:0101132D]

text_content: {Little nervous}We're not heading to the police station, are we? Ghost People hunt there.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGhostBark "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGhostBark" [DIAL:0101132D]

text_content: NVDLC01DogDialogueCloudBark
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueCloudBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueCloudBark" [DIAL:0101132E]

text_content: {A little quiet, dismissive}Hnnh. City smells bad in some places, so bad it makes people fall down.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueCloudBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueCloudBark" [DIAL:0101132E]

text_content: {Warning}Careful, the Villa's filled with pockets from the Cloud. Lethal.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueCloudBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueCloudBark" [DIAL:0101132E]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: NVDLC01ChristineCloudBark
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueCloudBark "NVDLC01ChristineCloudBark" [DIAL:0101132F]

text_content: [Christine sniffs the air, then touches her neck and frowns. She gestures at the air and taps her wrist.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueCloudBark "NVDLC01ChristineCloudBark" [DIAL:0101132F]

text_content: NVDLC01ChristineGhostBark
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGhostBark "NVDLC01ChristineGhostBark" [DIAL:01011330]

text_content: [Christine's eyes narrow. She raises an index finger, as if listening, then points ahead grimly and pulls back an imaginary trigger.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGhostBark "NVDLC01ChristineGhostBark" [DIAL:01011330]

text_content: NVDLC01ChristineVendingBark
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueVendingBark "NVDLC01ChristineVendingBark" [DIAL:01011331]

text_content: [Christine looks at the machine and frowns. She points at the narrow slot on the side and raises an eyebrow.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueVendingBark "NVDLC01ChristineVendingBark" [DIAL:01011331]

text_content: NVDLC01ChristineDialoguePoliceBark
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialoguePoliceBark "NVDLC01ChristineDialoguePoliceBark" [DIAL:01011332]

text_content: [Christine studies the area, then the Police Station. She pretends to unload a weapon and holds up the imaginary cartridge, waving it.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialoguePoliceBark "NVDLC01ChristineDialoguePoliceBark" [DIAL:01011332]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanDialogueAutoDocBark
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueAutoDocBark "NVDLC01DeanDialogueAutoDocBark" [DIAL:01011333]

text_content: {Looking around}Sinclair's little surgery carts. {To himself}Kept them around for his lady friend.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueAutoDocBark "NVDLC01DeanDialogueAutoDocBark" [DIAL:01011333]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePoliceBark
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePoliceBark "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePoliceBark" [DIAL:01011334]

text_content: {A little quiet}The police station... Ghost People love this place, no idea why. Might be the Holograms nearby.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialoguePoliceBark "NVDLC01DeanDialoguePoliceBark" [DIAL:01011334]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanDialogueVendingBark
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueVendingBark "NVDLC01DeanDialogueVendingBark" [DIAL:01011335]

text_content: {Nods}Those machines... Sinclair's little gifts, {to himself}lasted longer than he did. {Normal tone}If you need food, stims... {slightly condescending}put in a chip, hold out your hand.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueVendingBark "NVDLC01DeanDialogueVendingBark" [DIAL:01011335]

text_content: NVDLC01DogDialogueVendingBark
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueVendingBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueVendingBark" [DIAL:01011336]

text_content: {Blinks at a vending machine}Pretty circle on machine, {emph}all glowing.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueVendingBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueVendingBark" [DIAL:01011336]

text_content: {Dismissive, grumbling}Those machines feed on Sierra Madre Chips. {Beat, quieter, throw line away}There's codes that unlock other things, too.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueVendingBark "NVDLC01DogDialogueVendingBark" [DIAL:01011336]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: NVDLC01SuitesChristineVaultPasswordBark
name: NVDLC01ChristineVaultPasswordBark "NVDLC01SuitesChristineVaultPasswordBark" [DIAL:0101172A]

text_content: {Hesitates, big moment}"Begin again - {slightly quieter}but know when to let go."
name: NVDLC01ChristineVaultPasswordBark "NVDLC01SuitesChristineVaultPasswordBark" [DIAL:0101172A]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: I dealt with the other two in our team, now I need you to open something.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic018 "I dealt with the other two in our team, now I need you to open something." [DIAL:0101172B]

text_content: What? {Frowns}Open something... {beat}my voice. That's why it's hers... someone wanted to use me as a key.|All right, I can do that... hope you're ready.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic018 "I dealt with the other two in our team, now I need you to open something." [DIAL:0101172B]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: What would you use them for?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic077 "What would you use them for?" [DIAL:010117A1]

text_content: I can't argue that.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic076 "I can't argue that." [DIAL:010117A2]

text_content: Sources of food, supplies... medical assistance, ammo... make more collars, even print currency. {To himself}Make a nation.|The Cloud allows me to wipe the slate clean. Collars ensure cooperation. Holograms - defense. The Vending Machines provide... everything else.|The Sierra Madre can kill nations and build them, using its technology with the right applications.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic076 "I can't argue that." [DIAL:010117A2]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: If you secure that, that's all you want?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic074 "If you secure that, that's all you want?" [DIAL:010117A4]
