text_content: No, there is one last thing I want from the Sierra Madre. Its bounty. The machines that fill its streets, its corridors.|They provide, provide almost anything. Perhaps in the Pre-War era, they were commonplace, things to dismiss.|Now, they are far more valuable. You know it. {Derisive}They helped keep you alive.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic074 "If you secure that, that's all you want?" [DIAL:010117A4]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Working as murderous deathtraps, sure.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic073 "Working as murderous deathtraps, sure." [DIAL:010117A5]

text_content: Properly? Are you kidding me?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic072 "Properly? Are you kidding me?" [DIAL:010117A6]

text_content: The Holograms here kill trespassers. That's what I want. Dump one of those emitters in the middle of {emph}any battle, there's no defense.|{Starts rambling a bit, to himself}It's like holding light in your hands. Can't fight it... only watch it burn. {Frowns}Just one is a portable army. Arm it - anyone stands against you, dies.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic072 "Properly? Are you kidding me?" [DIAL:010117A6]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: I don't understand how an Old World casino helps you do any of that.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic071 "I don't understand how an Old World casino helps you do any of that." [DIAL:010117A7]

text_content: The Cloud is unique in my travels. Its proximity to the Sierra Madre isn't a coincidence. |Right now it protects this casino, preserves it. {Beat}It can be used to preserve other Old World relics - and cleanse them, at the same time.|And as much as I've researched hologram technology, the Big Empty facility was clear - only the Sierra Madre got Holograms working... properly.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic071 "I don't understand how an Old World casino helps you do any of that." [DIAL:010117A7]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: What do you want from the Sierra Madre?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic069 "What do you want from the Sierra Madre?" [DIAL:010117A9]

text_content: {Cold, echoing the player}What do I want. Weapons. Security. A citadel of my own.|The Madre's {emph}all these things. It's a fortress and a weapon. {Derisive}A chance... to... "begin again."|Once I unlock its archives, I can carve the Mojave into any shape I choose.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic069 "What do you want from the Sierra Madre?" [DIAL:010117A9]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: I've never heard of the place you're talking about.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic068 "I've never heard of the place you're talking about." [DIAL:010117AA]

text_content: {Frowns, still thinking about an unpleasant memory}Big Empty's a treasure box, a scientific graveyard of Old World misery. Like the Sierra Madre... there's treasures there, sleeping. {Under his breath, slightly fearful}Some, awake.|The Holorifle, the Saturnite alloy... the hologram technology, hibernation chambers, Securitrons, the collars...|...even the suits attached to those things stalking the Villa... that's only the surface of what's there. {Beat, re-focuses}Right now, the Sierra Madre is what I want.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic068 "I've never heard of the place you're talking about." [DIAL:010117AA]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: If they're Pre-War tech, where did you get them?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic067 "If they're Pre-War tech, where did you get them?" [DIAL:010117AB]

text_content: {Thinking back}A place far from here, called the Big Empty. {Beat, to himself}Almost didn't make it out.|Were two others there... a woman. And a man, a courier. {Frowns}The woman was familiar... the other... I don't know what happened to him.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic067 "If they're Pre-War tech, where did you get them?" [DIAL:010117AB]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Where did you get the collars?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic066 "Where did you get the collars?" [DIAL:010117AC]

text_content: The collars. {Frowns, snorts, sarcasm in middle}They're Pre-War tech, I suspect this great land had... compliance issues before the war.|{Frowns, more matter-of-fact}It's one of a series of models. The one on your neck? Special, easier to make adjustments. {gets disgusted}Unreliable in other ways, notably radio interference.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic066 "Where did you get the collars?" [DIAL:010117AC]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoBackIntro
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoFloorBackIntro "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoBackIntro" [DIAL:010117C7]

text_content: {AUDIO: Blend of whispering and creepy recordings play.}
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoFloorBackIntro "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoBackIntro" [DIAL:010117C7]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: This is the past you're walking through. Few have ever seen it. No one else ever will.
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoFloorBackIntro "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoBackIntro" [DIAL:010117C7]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Under his breath}I worked hard to get here, it'll give me what I need before I leave. And it'll always welcome me back.
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoFloorBackIntro "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoBackIntro" [DIAL:010117C7]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Slow, angry}Now... look for a way to wake this ghost up, remind it it's got guests.
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoFloorBackIntro "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoBackIntro" [DIAL:010117C7]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Brief crackling intro as Elijah accesses the back floor casino speakers when player first enters.}
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoFloorBackIntro "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoBackIntro" [DIAL:010117C7]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoIntro
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoIntro "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoIntro" [DIAL:010117C8]

text_content: {Crackling, screeching as Elijah calibrates the speakers in the main casino floor again. Note that Elijah isn't speaking in this line, marked him as Speaker for safety, however.}
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoIntro "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoIntro" [DIAL:010117C8]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Imperious, slight urgency, then pleased.}You inside. Can you hear me? {As if studying monitors}Power's fluctuating... emergency power. {Confirmed}Oh! You {emph}are in.
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoIntro "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoIntro" [DIAL:010117C8]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Slight contempt, dismissive}Good... thought that might be the end of you. {Beat}Unfortunately, your... "friends" also found their way here. Knocked unconscious... just like you.
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoIntro "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoIntro" [DIAL:010117C8]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Slight contempt, dismissive}Wondering what happened? You were hit by casino security. Detects anything foreign - radioactive, it subdues the "visitor," moves them if needed.
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoIntro "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoIntro" [DIAL:010117C8]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Trying to figure out echoes on the line}Hnh... getting interference from old recordings... the guests who were trapped here... eh, shut that noise off...
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoIntro "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoIntro" [DIAL:010117C8]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Slight contempt, dismissive}Looks like the casino moved your "friends" around once inside... might be useful. Or not. {Beat}Wonder if they came to help or kill you. Still...
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoIntro "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoIntro" [DIAL:010117C8]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: My signal should work through the speakers, now that you're inside. {smiling, a little eager}Heh, heh! Welcome to the Sierra Madre, in all its glory.
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoIntro "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoIntro" [DIAL:010117C8]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Sneering, emph}This is what the Old World stood for, even with bombs about to rain down on them. Now look at it.
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoIntro "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoIntro" [DIAL:010117C8]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Beautiful... now its guests are all dead. {A little quieter}Better this way. Quiet. {Under his breath}How the Mojave should be.
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoIntro "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoIntro" [DIAL:010117C8]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Going into instruction mode}Now - with the casino sleeping, it's got places closed off - won't let you go yet. We'll get there, trust me, just need to wake it up.
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoIntro "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoIntro" [DIAL:010117C8]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen
name: NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen "NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen" [DIAL:010117C9]

text_content: {Brief crackling as Elijah calibrates the speakers in the main casino floor again to inform player rest of casino is open.}
name: NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen "NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen" [DIAL:010117C9]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Going into instruction mode}Casino's woken up, paying attention to us. Good.
name: NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen "NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen" [DIAL:010117C9]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Delivered as a question, slight taunt}Wondering what happened to your team...? Looks like they got moved to other floors. {Beat, to himself}Interesting, maybe that's why... hmmm, yes... yes.
name: NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen "NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen" [DIAL:010117C9]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Perhaps the casino recognized specific guests... or guests with a voice or look close enough for them to be... assigned to that floor. We'll see.
name: NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen "NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen" [DIAL:010117C9]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Slight frustration}Had hoped with the power restored, the systems would fully awaken... {more frustration, this needs to be clear}especially the sound archives.
name: NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen "NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen" [DIAL:010117C9]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Frustration}But no... your teammates' collars on each floor are interfering with the systems.
name: NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen "NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen" [DIAL:010117C9]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: It's the white noise filters embedded in their construction... they're blocking the casino speakers, the music.
name: NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen "NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen" [DIAL:010117C9]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: You'll need to recalibrate... or destroy... each collar. To do that, you need to get close, re-set the signal - or blow their heads off.
name: NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen "NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen" [DIAL:010117C9]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: I'll leave the choice up to you - my preference? End them now. {Cold, throw away line}They're of no use.
name: NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen "NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen" [DIAL:010117C9]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Throws line away}After all, it's safe to kill them now, provided you make it quick.
name: NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen "NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen" [DIAL:010117C9]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Pissed at building's architecture and how it's hindering him}You see, the collars don't work inside the Sierra Madre... well, between floors. Else, I'd set off the collars, be done with it.
name: NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen "NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen" [DIAL:010117C9]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: So find them, deal with them, as long as you're fast and can get off the floor after killing them.
name: NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen "NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen" [DIAL:010117C9]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: The floors... whatever they lined this place with, interferes with the collar frequency... so if you kill them, you should have {emph}some time to run.
name: NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen "NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen" [DIAL:010117C9]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {To himself}Uh... just not sure how long, may not be consistent. More... less... whatever, it doesn't matter.
name: NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen "NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen" [DIAL:010117C9]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Firm}What we need is in the basement, we need to go to the top first and ride our fortunes down. {Cold, emph}After we deal with your team on the other floors.
name: NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen "NVDLC01ElijahRestofCasinoOpen" [DIAL:010117C9]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoPowerOn
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoFloorPowerOn "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoPowerOn" [DIAL:010117CA]

text_content: {Pleased, checking readouts}You woke it up... good. Emitter frequencies... lighting up everywhere...
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoFloorPowerOn "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoPowerOn" [DIAL:010117CA]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {AUDIO: Blend of whispering and creepy recordings play.}
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoFloorPowerOn "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoPowerOn" [DIAL:010117CA]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Under his breath, commenting on old recordings that came to life, interfering with signal}Damn recordings... dead echoes in the frequencies...
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoFloorPowerOn "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoPowerOn" [DIAL:010117CA]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Casino's security is shutting down... opening up its vendor and gambling programs in the back casino... {rueful}Heh! Still might be something for sale.
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoFloorPowerOn "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoPowerOn" [DIAL:010117CA]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Slightly curious, want to encourage exploration of back}Maybe something can help you now - security's shut down. After you're done looking around, head to the lobby, and we'll deal with your... friends.
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoFloorPowerOn "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoPowerOn" [DIAL:010117CA]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Brief calibrating noise as Elijah uses the speakers in the main floor's back casino again, going to congratulate player.}
name: NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoFloorPowerOn "NVDLC01ElijahMainCasinoPowerOn" [DIAL:010117CA]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueCloudTerminal
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueCloudTerminal "NVDLC01ChristineDialogueCloudTerminal" [DIAL:010118E6]

text_content: [Christine looks around, then nods toward a terminal on the far side of the room.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueCloudTerminal "NVDLC01ChristineDialogueCloudTerminal" [DIAL:010118E6]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGala02PostCloud
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGala02PostCloud "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGala02PostCloud" [DIAL:010118E7]

text_content: {Coughs}See? That... {coughs again}wasn't so bad, was it?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGala02PostCloud "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGala02PostCloud" [DIAL:010118E7]

text_content: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGala02FirstDoor
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGala02FirstDoor "NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGala02FirstDoor" [DIAL:010118E8]

text_content: [Christine points to an electrical box on the wall, and twists her hand.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGala02FirstDoor "NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGala02FirstDoor" [DIAL:010118E8]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGala02BrokenCatwalk
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGala02BrokenCatwalk "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGala02BrokenCatwalk" [DIAL:010118E9]

text_content: {To himself, broken catwalk ahead}Guess we're going the long way around.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGala02BrokenCatwalk "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGala02BrokenCatwalk" [DIAL:010118E9]

text_content: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGala02ToxicCloud
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGala02ToxicCloud "NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGala02ToxicCloud" [DIAL:010118EA]

text_content: [Christine nods at the toxic cloud below, then makes a walking motion with her fingers and slowly shakes her head.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGala02ToxicCloud "NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGala02ToxicCloud" [DIAL:010118EA]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGala02ToxicCloud
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGala02ToxicCloud "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGala02ToxicCloud" [DIAL:010118EB]

text_content: {Commenting about the toxic Cloud}Looks like we'll have to go through this pea soup. I can get you across.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGala02ToxicCloud "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGala02ToxicCloud" [DIAL:010118EB]

text_content: I found the phrase for elevator's audio lock.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic090 "I found the phrase for elevator's audio lock." [DIAL:01011905]

text_content: {Curious}You did? {Impressed}Looks like even the Old World can't keep you out when you've got a mind to get in.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic090 "I found the phrase for elevator's audio lock." [DIAL:01011905]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: You'll have to wait just a little longer.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic095 "You'll have to wait just a little longer." [DIAL:01011907]

text_content: {Slight irritation}Fine. {Warning player}I hear my collar beeping though, I've got the route to the exit all mapped out.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic095 "You'll have to wait just a little longer." [DIAL:01011907]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGala02JumpBark
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGala02JumpBark "NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGala02JumpBark" [DIAL:01011AD5]

text_content: [Christine shakes her head as you approach the edge of the catwalk. She turns away from the catwalk and begins looking around.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGala02JumpBark "NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGala02JumpBark" [DIAL:01011AD5]

text_content: NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd "NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd" [DIAL:01011B12]

text_content: {Ragged breathing, loop, trapped in Vault, alone}
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd "NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd" [DIAL:01011B12]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Deep ragged breath, then... loop back to "Fainter"}
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd "NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd" [DIAL:01011B12]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Weaker}When you die, I'll be waiting...
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd "NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd" [DIAL:01011B12]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Slow chuckle on the radio, uneasy undercurrent}Heh... now, come on, you open up. {Colder, angrier}Open up, damn you.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd "NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd" [DIAL:01011B12]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Open the vault... {trying to make a deal}I can make it worth your while, {now angry}think about what you're throwing away. {Trying to bait player, make a deal}I have other weapons, other technology I can share with you.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd "NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd" [DIAL:01011B12]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Low, trying to greed player with lure of other treasures}And the Big Empty... I know the way there. I know some of its secrets... if...
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd "NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd" [DIAL:01011B12]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Backpedals}The collars... the collars were a mistake, I see that now. Why would I kill you? After {emph}all you've done... after all {emph}we've done together.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd "NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd" [DIAL:01011B12]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Challenging, hates being ignored}Are you listening to me?!
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd "NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd" [DIAL:01011B12]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Looking around, reverent, quiet}Everything down here... I swear... so much you could use, you could rule the wastes with what's down here...
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd "NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd" [DIAL:01011B12]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: ...make your own army, re-shape the world, and if others disagree... put {emph}collars on them, I can show you how.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd "NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd" [DIAL:01011B12]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Anger/fear}Don't you leave me here. You can't do this to me. {Coughs, wheezing}
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd "NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd" [DIAL:01011B12]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Eh? Getting dark in here. Machine... machine's losing power, no. I still have Pip-Boy light... maybe... maybe... no, no, that doesn't work.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd "NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd" [DIAL:01011B12]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Scratching on metal, clawing for door, quiet, to himself}Where... where is the door. Can't find the door.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd "NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd" [DIAL:01011B12]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Rasping breath, to himself}Calm, been in worse situations... find a way out... {vicious, last part is threat}somehow, then find that Courier...
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd "NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd" [DIAL:01011B12]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Running through options, to himself}Maybe Veronica... no... no, she thinks I'm dead.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd "NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd" [DIAL:01011B12]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Himself}Must be someone... maybe that {emph}other courier, one with the flag on his back... maybe... no... no, said he'd never come to the Sierra Madre...
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd "NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd" [DIAL:01011B12]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: No way out. {Beat, frustration}Can't... can't end like this.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd "NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd" [DIAL:01011B12]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Cold, firm, addressed to the player as his final words}You. I know you can hear me. When you die, Courier... I'll be waiting. Your grave's going look just like this vault.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd "NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd" [DIAL:01011B12]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Cold, quiet, hissing whisper}When you die... I'll be waiting here... at the Sierra Madre. {Faint, quiet, as if dying}Waiting.
name: NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd "NVDLC01RadioElijahEnd" [DIAL:01011B12]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanDialogueAutoDocCorridor
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueAutoDocCorridor "NVDLC01DeanDialogueAutoDocCorridor" [DIAL:01011B60]

text_content: What, you need surgery done? Let's get out of here... those speakers on the wall are making my nerves do a dance.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueAutoDocCorridor "NVDLC01DeanDialogueAutoDocCorridor" [DIAL:01011B60]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanDialogueInClinic
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueInClinic "NVDLC01DeanDialogueInClinic" [DIAL:01011B61]

text_content: Watch for Hologram security, not as nice as the lady at the fountain, trust me.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueInClinic "NVDLC01DeanDialogueInClinic" [DIAL:01011B61]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanDialogueMedicalDistrict
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueMedicalDistrict "NVDLC01DeanDialogueMedicalDistrict" [DIAL:01011B62]

text_content: {Confused}What are we doing here? {Sarcastic}We're not going to find a doctor on call at this hour, trust me.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueMedicalDistrict "NVDLC01DeanDialogueMedicalDistrict" [DIAL:01011B62]

text_content: {Uneasy, not because of ghosts, but finding his victim, Christine}Place is haunted, got ghosts walking in it.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueMedicalDistrict "NVDLC01DeanDialogueMedicalDistrict" [DIAL:01011B62]

text_content: I don't believe you.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic095 "I don't believe you." [DIAL:01011B64]

text_content: You think I wanted to send you here without weapons, healing? No, the Sierra Madre lays you bare, strips and stores all your worldly possessions...|...it's automated to move things as the builder saw fit, Sinclair - even the guests. It's what divided your team, me, assigned us to "our floors."|No contraband, nothing foreign in his paradise - even common Pre-War vending machines were banned from the Villa.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic095 "I don't believe you." [DIAL:01011B64]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: So the casino stripped me of my gear?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic094 "So the casino stripped me of my gear?" [DIAL:01011B65]

text_content: The Villa did, as an extension of the casino, yes - and then sent it back to the owner's residence. Here, "begin again" is more than a slogan.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic094 "So the casino stripped me of my gear?" [DIAL:01011B65]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Do you know how to get out of here?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic093 "Do you know how to get out of here?" [DIAL:01011B66]

text_content: Of course. I walked all this way. {Lies}If you're worried... I'll give you a map back - or show you the way out when this is all over.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic093 "Do you know how to get out of here?" [DIAL:01011B66]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: What happened to my gear?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic092 "What happened to my gear?" [DIAL:01011B67]

text_content: It lies in the bunker - or whatever mantrap caught you. It's the Sierra Madre, its security systems strip guests to their garments.|It has... prejudices against outside material, "contraband." Almost anything with a radiation signature.|The New Vegas casinos do the same thing, manually. {Raises an eyebrow}Although preventing bloodshed, not radiation poisoning, is their main concern.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic092 "What happened to my gear?" [DIAL:01011B67]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: If Dog put a collar on me, why didn't he say so?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic091 "If Dog put a collar on me, why didn't he say so?" [DIAL:01011B68]

text_content: "Dog?" Hnh. Appropriate. It's what I called him. {Beat}You've met him. You know why he forgot - his brain was ruined by FEV, his memory, wreckage.|He may know the way back, somewhere, deep down. I doubt it. He tracks by smell and instinct. Still, he could be trained.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic091 "If Dog put a collar on me, why didn't he say so?" [DIAL:01011B68]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: So someone else with a collar placed one on me? Who?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic090 "So someone else with a collar placed one on me? Who?" [DIAL:01011B69]

text_content: The mutant. Heh! He swallowed one of the collars... after that, he was mine. The collar wasn't even necessary.|All his kind, they exist to be given orders. They're soldiers - simple, stupid. I ask him to fetch, he did... even without the threat of death.|Even when I stopped speaking to him, he continued to leave the Villa, gather victims from the mantraps, out of habit.|He must have found you in one of them. If so, he's probably forgotten - he only remembers my voice.|He put the collar on you, dragged you here, because he doesn't know any better. It's in his nature, greedy and child-like.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic090 "So someone else with a collar placed one on me? Who?" [DIAL:01011B69]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: How did you get me here?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic089 "How did you get me here?" [DIAL:01011B6A]

text_content: Everyone asks that. {Emph}Should be asking how they plan on leaving. |It only takes putting a collar on one to begin the chain. One with a collar may chain another. And that one, another. Had traps all over the wastes.|The chain ends with the super mutant. Although with him... the collar wasn't even necessary. He only needed... guidance.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic089 "How did you get me here?" [DIAL:01011B6A]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Now that I'm here, are you coming down?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic088 "Now that I'm here, are you coming down?" [DIAL:01011B6B]

text_content: I'm sick of talking to some image on a screen. If you're going to come down, do it.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic087 "I'm sick of talking to some image on a screen. If you're going to come down, do it." [DIAL:01011B6C]

text_content: {Slight reluctance}No. I am not going to take the chance while I'm so close... not this close, no. Not again... I can wait... afford to be careful.|You... you're locked down there. This is the only entrance, and I have free rein of the Sierra Madre. I have time... more than you.|{Cold}Besides, there might be more traps. I'll send more scouts in... yes, others. {Suspicious, ends on downnote}You're... resourceful, don't want to leave anything more to chance.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic087 "I'm sick of talking to some image on a screen. If you're going to come down, do it." [DIAL:01011B6C]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: What happened?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic086 "What happened?" [DIAL:01011B6D]

text_content: So you answered madness with madness?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic085 "So you answered madness with madness?" [DIAL:01011B6E]

text_content: When your life is tied to another's, sacrifice and cooperation - they can be conditioned, learned, and you can focus on the matter at hand.|Greed can be beaten. Contained. Controlled. {Beat}You know it better than anyone... or I hope you do. It doesn't matter.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic085 "So you answered madness with madness?" [DIAL:01011B6E]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: What are you talking about?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic084 "What are you talking about?" [DIAL:01011B6F]

text_content: {Disgusted}Every time, even with collars clutched at their necks... they would betray each other, kill each other, to get inside the Sierra Madre.|It... it was insanity. {Gets progressively madder here, frustrated}They could've had it all, it was so close. And... and they kept turning on each other, again and again. |Cracking the Sierra Madre was difficult... but cracking greed, that was more difficult. So the dead man's switches went in.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic084 "What are you talking about?" [DIAL:01011B6F]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: You're nothing more than a killer that aspires to mass murder.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic083 "You're nothing more than a killer that aspires to mass murder." [DIAL:01011B70]

text_content: {Frowns}You think I'm a murderer. If I was, I'd have set off your collar long ago... {getting on the teacher pedestal here}the collar ensures compliance, encourages... cooperation.|Think about it. Would you truly have gotten into the casino without those collars? No, human nature is against us, always.|{Scoffs, actually cuts the superior act for a bit, he wants to share this}Did you know... did you know that I had to keep adjusting the collars, keep changing the rules to make this moment possible?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic083 "You're nothing more than a killer that aspires to mass murder." [DIAL:01011B70]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: How did you find out about the Sierra Madre?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic082 "How did you find out about the Sierra Madre?" [DIAL:01011B71]

text_content: {Uneasy, reluctant, remembering his failure on the field of battle}It started with... a setback. Fires, blood, beneath the sun... a sun so close you could touch it. |{Beat}Moments like that, however, failures... can provide the brightest clarity.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic082 "How did you find out about the Sierra Madre?" [DIAL:01011B71]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Then we better get to killing them.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic081 "Then we better get to killing them." [DIAL:01011B72]

text_content: Hnh. Perhaps... perhaps I was too quick to put a collar on a potential ally.|Very well. I'll come down... and show you what the Sierra Madre has in store.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic081 "Then we better get to killing them." [DIAL:01011B72]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: I don't care about the Republic, they're yours to kill.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic080 "I don't care about the Republic, they're yours to kill." [DIAL:01011B73]

text_content: {Snaps at player}I know that. Their days were numbered since they occupied Hoover Dam.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic080 "I don't care about the Republic, they're yours to kill." [DIAL:01011B73]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: [NCR] If you want to kill NCR, that's fine with me.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic079 "[NCR] If you want to kill NCR, that's fine with me." [DIAL:01011B74]

text_content: {Frowns}I've read your Pip-Boy. Seen what you've done...|If you wish to end them... I could use someone like you. Resourceful. Uncompromising. NCR has many soldiers... many citizens.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic079 "[NCR] If you want to kill NCR, that's fine with me." [DIAL:01011B74]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: You want to attack NCR? All of NCR?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic078 "You want to attack NCR? All of NCR?" [DIAL:01011B75]

text_content: Attack? No, not attack them. {Cold, deadpan, quiet}Wipe the slate clean. Make the Mojave like it was meant to be... undisturbed by man.|I'll send the Cloud, the Holograms. Bring ruin in my hands until only I stand atop the HELIOS One tower again.|I'll scour Hoover Dam with the Cloud, rain its walls with spears from the sun... with an army of Old World ghosts behind me, Holograms all.|I'll kill them until it's only me, me alone... in a quiet world. {To himself}In a world that's nothing like what happened at HELIOS One.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic078 "You want to attack NCR? All of NCR?" [DIAL:01011B75]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: You're Veronica's mentor. The Elder who lost HELIOS One.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic075 "You're Veronica's mentor. The Elder who lost HELIOS One." [DIAL:01011B76]

text_content: {Remembering, didn't think this was a possibility}Veronica... she... survived HELIOS. {Nods}She would. Resourceful. |As for "losing" HELIOS One... that was the only outcome, aside from retreat. {Thinking back, sneering, frustrated}NCR, swarming like ants over Old World relics... Hoover Dam... HELIOS...|{Spits this out}I won't let those... children seize anything else. Hardin... McNamara... can't stop them... won't. {Slow, evil}So {emph}I will, with the Old World as my weapons.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic075 "You're Veronica's mentor. The Elder who lost HELIOS One." [DIAL:01011B76]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: What the hell are you motioning about?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic109 "What the hell are you motioning about?" [DIAL:01011B96]

text_content: I have no idea what your problem is.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic108 "I have no idea what your problem is." [DIAL:01011B97]

text_content: [Her face becomes angry. She points at the elevator, points downward, then wraps her arms around her and shakes her head.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic108 "I have no idea what your problem is." [DIAL:01011B97]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: [Perception] It reminds you of being trapped in the Auto-Doc.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic107 "[Perception] It reminds you of being trapped in the Auto-Doc." [DIAL:01011B98]

text_content: [She turns to you, relieved, and nods... then she turns away, and her face crumbles. She makes motions with her fingers, then clenches her fists.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic107 "[Perception] It reminds you of being trapped in the Auto-Doc." [DIAL:01011B98]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: What's wrong?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic106 "What's wrong?" [DIAL:01011B99]

text_content: [Christine studies the elevator frame, raises her hands... then sets them down... then raises them up again.]|[She gives a silent sigh of exasperation, and frowns at the elevator, and her hand brushes the side of her face, tracing the scar.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic106 "What's wrong?" [DIAL:01011B99]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: {Terrifying Presence}Get in that elevator or I'll make those scars on your face a pleasant memory.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic105 "{Terrifying Presence}Get in that elevator or I'll make those scars on your face a pleasant memory." [DIAL:01011B9A]

text_content: [Christine takes a step back from your gaze... her eyes widen in alarm, she takes one step, then two toward the elevator.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic105 "{Terrifying Presence}Get in that elevator or I'll make those scars on your face a pleasant memory." [DIAL:01011B9A]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: I mean it. Stay alive until I get back.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic104 "I mean it. Stay alive until I get back." [DIAL:01011B9B]

text_content: I'll be back for you, okay?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic103 "I'll be back for you, okay?" [DIAL:01011B9C]

text_content: [Christine tilts her head slightly, glances at your collar, then your Pip-Boy. She opens her mouth, frowns, then closes it.]|[Her face looks sad, and she taps her chest once, slowly. She nods at you, then the exit.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic103 "I'll be back for you, okay?" [DIAL:01011B9C]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Yeah, "thumbs up" - you better appreciate it.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic102 "Yeah, ""thumbs up"" - you better appreciate it." [DIAL:01011B9D]

text_content: We'll get through this.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic101 "We'll get through this." [DIAL:01011B9E]

text_content: All right, be ready.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic099 "All right, be ready." [DIAL:01011B9F]

text_content: [She narrows her eyes, determined, and gives a last nod.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic099 "All right, be ready." [DIAL:01011B9F]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Not in a hand-holding mood right now.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic098 "Not in a hand-holding mood right now." [DIAL:01011BA0]

text_content: [She frowns, then waves you away and focuses on the terminal.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic098 "Not in a hand-holding mood right now." [DIAL:01011BA0]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: <Take her hand.>
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic097 "<Take her hand.>" [DIAL:01011BA1]

text_content: [She holds it, meeting your eyes intently for a few moments. She gives your hand a gentle squeeze, then releases it and smiles slightly.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic097 "<Take her hand.>" [DIAL:01011BA1]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Are you going to be okay here?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic096 "Are you going to be okay here?" [DIAL:01011BA2]

text_content: [She nods... then gestures at your hand, offers hers.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic096 "Are you going to be okay here?" [DIAL:01011BA2]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: NVDLC01ETDeanBellTowerBark
name: NVDLC01ETDeanBellTowerBark "NVDLC01ETDeanBellTowerBark" [DIAL:01011BAC]

text_content: I'm not one for church, but there's a bell tower to the north that has a nice view of the Sierra Madre. {To himself, remembering the Cloud}Well, did, anyway.
name: NVDLC01ETDeanBellTowerBark "NVDLC01ETDeanBellTowerBark" [DIAL:01011BAC]

text_content: NVDLC01ETDeanSierraMadre
name: NVDLC01ETDeanSierraMadre "NVDLC01ETDeanSierraMadre" [DIAL:01011BAD]

text_content: {Whistles softly, appreciating}Now, {emph}there's a view. {To casino}Hello, beautiful.
name: NVDLC01ETDeanSierraMadre "NVDLC01ETDeanSierraMadre" [DIAL:01011BAD]

text_content: NVDLC01ETDogBoneBark
name: NVDLC01ETDogBoneBark "NVDLC01ETDogBoneBark" [DIAL:01011BAE]

text_content: {Slight complaint}Bones. Dog not like bones, don't taste good... {thinking to himself}unless meat on them.
name: NVDLC01ETDogBoneBark "NVDLC01ETDogBoneBark" [DIAL:01011BAE]

text_content: NVDLC01ETDogEnterBark
name: NVDLC01ETDogEnterBark "NVDLC01ETDogEnterBark" [DIAL:01011BAF]

text_content: Cage over there with things to pull, hard to pull, Dog can do it. {Beat, confused}Done it before? Not remember.
name: NVDLC01ETDogEnterBark "NVDLC01ETDogEnterBark" [DIAL:01011BAF]

text_content: NVDLC01ETDeanHouseBark
name: NVDLC01ETDeanHouseBark "NVDLC01ETDeanHouseBark" [DIAL:01011BB0]

text_content: Surprised these homes weren't robbed blind, folks leaving the key out like that. {Beat, grumbles}If only the Sierra Madre'd done the same.
name: NVDLC01ETDeanHouseBark "NVDLC01ETDeanHouseBark" [DIAL:01011BB0]

text_content: NVDLC01ETChristineSpeakerBark
name: NVDLC01ETChristineSpeakerBark "NVDLC01ETChristineSpeakerBark" [DIAL:01011BB1]

text_content: [Christine taps her collar, makes a sweeping gesture at the area, then begins to pulse her fingers outward, faster and faster.]
name: NVDLC01ETChristineSpeakerBark "NVDLC01ETChristineSpeakerBark" [DIAL:01011BB1]

text_content: NVDLC01ETDeanGasBark
name: NVDLC01ETDeanGasBark "NVDLC01ETDeanGasBark" [DIAL:01011BB2]

text_content: {Sniffing air}You smell gas? I smell gas. {Beat}Might be a valve nearby, we can use it to torch any locals that come near us.
name: NVDLC01ETDeanGasBark "NVDLC01ETDeanGasBark" [DIAL:01011BB2]

text_content: NVDLC01ETDogGalaBark
name: NVDLC01ETDogGalaBark "NVDLC01ETDogGalaBark" [DIAL:01011BB3]

text_content: Place with hard to pull things is over there... {looks at player's compass}"W" on your wrist thing? {Remembers how to say "west"}Weh-st. West.
name: NVDLC01ETDogGalaBark "NVDLC01ETDogGalaBark" [DIAL:01011BB3]

text_content: For now, just say the words, and let's settle this so we can go home.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic124 "For now, just say the words, and let's settle this so we can go home." [DIAL:01011BDB]

text_content: Don't tell me where you're going - I'll find you after this.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic123 "Don't tell me where you're going - I'll find you after this." [DIAL:01011BDC]

text_content: {Nods, sighs}I... {takes a breath}never mind. Let me get the vault open... {To herself, slowly, quiet as if memorizing it}"Begin again... but know when to let go." {Slight rueful laugh, to player}Sounds like you.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic123 "Don't tell me where you're going - I'll find you after this." [DIAL:01011BDC]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Fine. If you can't let him go, you don't leave me much choice.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic122 "Fine. If you can't let him go, you don't leave me much choice." [DIAL:01011BDD]

text_content: He won't escape, I swear.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic121 "He won't escape, I swear." [DIAL:01011BDE]

text_content: Christine, please, let go of this. Let me deal with him.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic120 "Christine, please, let go of this. Let me deal with him." [DIAL:01011BDF]

text_content: {Hopeful, slight}All right. All right, I'll... {frowns}but I'll need to leave this floor. He'll pick up my collar, and...
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic120 "Christine, please, let go of this. Let me deal with him." [DIAL:01011BDF]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Then I need to keep you from doing it.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic119 "Then I need to keep you from doing it." [DIAL:01011BE0]

text_content: I... I didn't want this to happen. {Sighs}Ending him is more important than saving you. For what it's worth... I'm sorry.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic119 "Then I need to keep you from doing it." [DIAL:01011BE0]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: If you try and kill him, I can't let you do it. If you die, you'll kill us both.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic118 "If you try and kill him, I can't let you do it. If you die, you'll kill us both." [DIAL:01011BE1]

text_content: {Quiet}I can't. It's my mission, has been. {Beat}This has to be done.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic118 "If you try and kill him, I can't let you do it. If you die, you'll kill us both." [DIAL:01011BE1]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Let him come through the suites, follow me. If he escapes, you'll still be here, waiting.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic117 "Let him come through the suites, follow me. If he escapes, you'll still be here, waiting." [DIAL:01011BE2]

text_content: {Quiet}You have to promise me. Promise me you'll deal with him... if I see him, I...
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic117 "Let him come through the suites, follow me. If he escapes, you'll still be here, waiting." [DIAL:01011BE2]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: If he kills you, I won't be able to get out.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic116 "If he kills you, I won't be able to get out." [DIAL:01011BE3]

text_content: I know. And he {pause}will kill me, I can't get the collar off. Even if I could, I need to be sure - see his eyes, his face, when he dies.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic116 "If he kills you, I won't be able to get out." [DIAL:01011BE3]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Do you trust me? If you do, let go of this.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic115 "Do you trust me? If you do, let go of this." [DIAL:01011BE4]

text_content: I can't let go. Every time I've thought about it...
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic115 "Do you trust me? If you do, let go of this." [DIAL:01011BE4]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: {Quiet}I've lost him so many times. He needs to die... what happened here, with us? {Doesn't want to think about it}He's... he's done so much worse.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic115 "Do you trust me? If you do, let go of this." [DIAL:01011BE4]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: {Know about mission}Are... are you all right? Something seems off.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic114 "{Know about mission}Are... are you all right? Something seems off." [DIAL:01011BE5]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] I...
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic114 "{Know about mission}Are... are you all right? Something seems off." [DIAL:01011BE5]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: [FAILED] No... no, you have it wrong. Look, it's now or never, all right? Let me open the elevator.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic114 "{Know about mission}Are... are you all right? Something seems off." [DIAL:01011BE5]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: {Know about mission}He'll come here, to the Suites - when he does, let him go through.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic113 "{Know about mission}He'll come here, to the Suites - when he does, let him go through." [DIAL:01011BE6]

text_content: I... can't let him leave here. Look, you've done so much, and he's not going to show himself until you go down there.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic113 "{Know about mission}He'll come here, to the Suites - when he does, let him go through." [DIAL:01011BE6]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: That's what I'm counting on.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic112 "That's what I'm counting on." [DIAL:01011BE7]

text_content: {To herself}"Begin again, but know when to let go." {Shakes head, skeptical}Let's see what happens.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic112 "That's what I'm counting on." [DIAL:01011BE7]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: We'll see. I'll take care of him.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic111 "We'll see. I'll take care of him." [DIAL:01011BE8]

text_content: You ready? The sequence is: "Begin." "Again." "Let." "Go."
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic110 "You ready? The sequence is: ""Begin."" ""Again."" ""Let."" ""Go.""" [DIAL:01011BE9]

text_content: The target's the vault, not the casino, right?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic082 "The target's the vault, not the casino, right?" [DIAL:01011BEA]

text_content: Guess it's the object of someone's obsession - or affection.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic080 "Guess it's the object of someone's obsession - or affection." [DIAL:01011BEB]

text_content: I believe he loved her, wanted to protect her. Too much.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic079 "I believe he loved her, wanted to protect her. Too much." [DIAL:01011BEC]

text_content: {To herself}Love makes people do strange things. {Beat, quiet}Won't argue that. It can drive you crazy sometimes if you can't... connect.|{Reluctant, something's wrong}If they loved each other, and they were together... I suppose that's all that mattered.|But she's in that side room, dead, because the casino wouldn't let her leave. {Beat}And who knows where he is.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic079 "I believe he loved her, wanted to protect her. Too much." [DIAL:01011BEC]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: If we stay here, the Cloud and the Holograms will answer that.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic077 "If we stay here, the Cloud and the Holograms will answer that." [DIAL:01011BED]

text_content: What does that mean?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic076 "What does that mean?" [DIAL:01011BEE]

text_content: I've got you to come down after me, it'll respond to your voice.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic074 "I've got you to come down after me, it'll respond to your voice." [DIAL:01011BEF]

text_content: {Evasive}I... just wanted to make sure you're ready. When you go down there, that may be it for us... we won't be needed anymore.|The one who made these collars, he'll follow you down there. And he won't let you leave. He's not one for sharing, never was.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic074 "I've got you to come down after me, it'll respond to your voice." [DIAL:01011BEF]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: I have no idea, let's unlock it. The phrase is contained in the lyrics to a song.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic072 "I have no idea, let's unlock it. The phrase is contained in the lyrics to a song." [DIAL:01011BF0]

text_content: {Snorts}But, you recognize the value of what's down there. You would no sooner destroy what's inside the Sierra Madre than destroy yourself.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic111 "Maybe too many safeguards, as you've discovered already." [DIAL:01011C58]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Snarling}Persist in threatening me... or the Sierra Madre's secrets, you're of no use to me, I'll set off your collar now.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic111 "Maybe too many safeguards, as you've discovered already." [DIAL:01011C58]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Wait until I get my hands on the computers, we'll see.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic109 "Wait until I get my hands on the computers, we'll see." [DIAL:01011C59]

text_content: {Success Result}[SUCCEEDED] You might destroy access to the data... not the data itself. Besides, there would be safeguards in place.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic109 "Wait until I get my hands on the computers, we'll see." [DIAL:01011C59]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: [FAILED] There's nothing you can do that I cannot undo... or recover. {Coldly smug}And I have the time now, thanks to you.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic109 "Wait until I get my hands on the computers, we'll see." [DIAL:01011C59]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: I'll trash the electronics, the vault wiring, maybe.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic108 "I'll trash the electronics, the vault wiring, maybe." [DIAL:01011C5A]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Frowns}The elevator. {Testing the player}Then you'd be trapped for certain, no probability of escape.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic108 "I'll trash the electronics, the vault wiring, maybe." [DIAL:01011C5A]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: [FAILED] {Sarcasm}The vault would be as shielded against vandalism just as the casino itself was. No... any damage you could cause would be minimal.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic108 "I'll trash the electronics, the vault wiring, maybe." [DIAL:01011C5A]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: You... you don't have any way to transmit down here.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic105 "You... you don't have any way to transmit down here." [DIAL:01011C5B]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Huh... {Beat, realizing he's been outfoxed}clever.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic105 "You... you don't have any way to transmit down here." [DIAL:01011C5B]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: [FAILED] {Contempt}Really? No, I don't think so. I can afford to wait, and your threats... meaningless.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic105 "You... you don't have any way to transmit down here." [DIAL:01011C5B]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Oh, so you're willing to risk it?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic104 "Oh, so you're willing to risk it?" [DIAL:01011C5C]

text_content: Denying you the Sierra Madre vault would be worth it.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic103 "Denying you the Sierra Madre vault would be worth it." [DIAL:01011C5D]

text_content: Sounds like I'm dead anyway, the way you're talking.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic101 "Sounds like I'm dead anyway, the way you're talking." [DIAL:01011C5E]

text_content: {Imperious, as if thinking it over}Kill yourself, and you decide this now. I can shut down your signal, prevent the collar from going off.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic101 "Sounds like I'm dead anyway, the way you're talking." [DIAL:01011C5E]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: I... I'm pretty sure I can do some damage down here. Somehow.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic100 "I... I'm pretty sure I can do some damage down here. Somehow." [DIAL:01011C5F]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] The collar? Even if you could trigger it... {scoffs}no, you'd die.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic100 "I... I'm pretty sure I can do some damage down here. Somehow." [DIAL:01011C5F]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Failure Result}[FAILED] {Contempt}Really? No, I don't think so. I can afford to wait, and your threats... meaningless.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic100 "I... I'm pretty sure I can do some damage down here. Somehow." [DIAL:01011C5F]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Then I'll find a way to unlock the secrets of this vault, take them for myself.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic099 "Then I'll find a way to unlock the secrets of this vault, take them for myself." [DIAL:01011C60]

text_content: {Slow}You've gotten far. Any farther, try to breach the vault, you'll become a corpse.|{Snarling}What's inside is mine. Anyone else touches it... tries to take it from me... they'll answer for it.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic099 "Then I'll find a way to unlock the secrets of this vault, take them for myself." [DIAL:01011C60]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: I'm not interested in the vault, I only want to leave.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic098 "I'm not interested in the vault, I only want to leave." [DIAL:01011C61]

text_content: {Slow}Then all you need to do is wait, be patient. {sneering}Hnh... you may be down there for a while. {To himself}Just as I was, trapped inside the casino.|{Snaps}Consider this punishment for following the Sierra Madre signal in the first place. {Condescending}So eager to rush ahead... now, enjoy your reward.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic098 "I'm not interested in the vault, I only want to leave." [DIAL:01011C61]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Unless you come down here, I'll destroy the vault, everything in it.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic097 "Unless you come down here, I'll destroy the vault, everything in it." [DIAL:01011C62]

text_content: {Slow}No... I don't think so. It'd most likely trigger other security measures... if you hurt the Vault at all.|The builder of the casino built it to last - the Sierra Madre withstood the {emph}war. I'm sure the Vault is protected as well.|Besides, you wouldn't have followed the signal if you didn't want this place's secrets for your own. You're curious... past the threats.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic097 "Unless you come down here, I'll destroy the vault, everything in it." [DIAL:01011C62]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ETChristineVendBark
name: NVDLC01ETChristineVendBark "NVDLC01ETChristineVendBark" [DIAL:01011C96]

text_content: [Christine nods at the Vending Machine, then makes a sweeping gesture with both arms and draws them to her chest.]
name: NVDLC01ETChristineVendBark "NVDLC01ETChristineVendBark" [DIAL:01011C96]

text_content: NVDLC01WTChristineSmallSpaceBark
name: NVDLC01WTChristineSmallSpaceBark "NVDLC01WTChristineSmallSpaceBark" [DIAL:01011C97]

text_content: [Christine's eyes dart around at the walls and the ceiling. She glances at the exit, then takes a slow breath. Sweat appears on her brow.]
name: NVDLC01WTChristineSmallSpaceBark "NVDLC01WTChristineSmallSpaceBark" [DIAL:01011C97]

text_content: NVDLC01WTDeanSneakBark
name: NVDLC01WTDeanSneakBark "NVDLC01WTDeanSneakBark" [DIAL:01011C98]

text_content: {Quiet}I am all about keeping low in this section of town... so let's see about creeping by the locals, all right?
name: NVDLC01WTDeanSneakBark "NVDLC01WTDeanSneakBark" [DIAL:01011C98]

text_content: NVDLC01WTDogInsideBark
name: NVDLC01WTDogInsideBark "NVDLC01WTDogInsideBark" [DIAL:01011C99]

text_content: {Grumbling}Tired of being inside. Want outside, get food inside Dog.
name: NVDLC01WTDogInsideBark "NVDLC01WTDogInsideBark" [DIAL:01011C99]

text_content: NVDLC01WTDeanUmbrellasBark
name: NVDLC01WTDeanUmbrellasBark "NVDLC01WTDeanUmbrellasBark" [DIAL:01011C9A]

text_content: {Walked into a nice patio, appreciative}Nice spot for sunning. {Beat, to himself}Well, if the sun ever touched here.
name: NVDLC01WTDeanUmbrellasBark "NVDLC01WTDeanUmbrellasBark" [DIAL:01011C9A]

text_content: NVDLC01WTDeanGalaBark
name: NVDLC01WTDeanGalaBark "NVDLC01WTDeanGalaBark" [DIAL:01011C9B]

text_content: If your marker's right, think the roost we're looking for is to the southeast.
name: NVDLC01WTDeanGalaBark "NVDLC01WTDeanGalaBark" [DIAL:01011C9B]

text_content: NVDLC01WTChristineRoofBark
name: NVDLC01WTChristineRoofBark "NVDLC01WTChristineRoofBark" [DIAL:01011C9C]

text_content: [Christine frowns, looks upward, then back at you. She nods her head upwards, then makes the motion of holding a gun at the ready.]
name: NVDLC01WTChristineRoofBark "NVDLC01WTChristineRoofBark" [DIAL:01011C9C]

text_content: NVDLC01WTDogRoofBark
name: NVDLC01WTDogRoofBark "NVDLC01WTDogRoofBark" [DIAL:01011C9D]

text_content: {Curious}Why leave a bear trap here, so high up. {Beat, to himself}Someone's arm must have lost it.
name: NVDLC01WTDogRoofBark "NVDLC01WTDogRoofBark" [DIAL:01011C9D]

text_content: NVDLC01WTDeanTreeBark
name: NVDLC01WTDeanTreeBark "NVDLC01WTDeanTreeBark" [DIAL:01011C9E]

text_content: {To himself, sarcastic}Ah, aren't the trees lovely this time of year, all blooming and green...
name: NVDLC01WTDeanTreeBark "NVDLC01WTDeanTreeBark" [DIAL:01011C9E]

text_content: NVDLC01WTChristineGalaBark
name: NVDLC01WTChristineGalaBark "NVDLC01WTChristineGalaBark" [DIAL:01011C9F]

text_content: [Christine flicks her finger back and forth quickly like a switch, then nods to the north.]
name: NVDLC01WTChristineGalaBark "NVDLC01WTChristineGalaBark" [DIAL:01011C9F]

text_content: NVDLC01GalaEventActivate
name: NVDLC01GalaEventActivate "NVDLC01GalaEventActivate" [DIAL:01011D27]

text_content: This is the place you need to go when everyone is in place. {Quiet}Until then... nothing more than a diseased view of the Sierra Madre.
name: NVDLC01GalaEventActivate "NVDLC01GalaEventActivate" [DIAL:01011D27]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Can you hear me...? Damn transceivers... {To himself}let me link the collars to the speaker in the tower... then... there.
name: NVDLC01GalaEventActivate "NVDLC01GalaEventActivate" [DIAL:01011D27]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: [You hear banging from the speaker, as if someone is hammering on a wall with their fists.]
name: NVDLC01GalaEventActivate "NVDLC01GalaEventActivate" [DIAL:01011D27]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: [You hear a tapping from the speaker... a series of sharp taps, then a slow, two taps.]
name: NVDLC01GalaEventActivate "NVDLC01GalaEventActivate" [DIAL:01011D27]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: {Eager}I'll pull the switches. {Beat, snarling}And when I find you, I'll pull your head from your body.
name: NVDLC01GalaEventActivate "NVDLC01GalaEventActivate" [DIAL:01011D27]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Eager, evil}Ready. {Chuckling}The both of us. I'll keep Dog locked in his cage... you just open the Sierra Madre.
name: NVDLC01GalaEventActivate "NVDLC01GalaEventActivate" [DIAL:01011D27]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Frightened, make player squirm}Dog is scared... wants out of cage. Cage you put me in. {Beat, pleading}Will pull levers, be good, just let Dog {emph}out.
name: NVDLC01GalaEventActivate "NVDLC01GalaEventActivate" [DIAL:01011D27]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Eager}Dog is ready to be good, pull switches, see the {emph}lights.
name: NVDLC01GalaEventActivate "NVDLC01GalaEventActivate" [DIAL:01011D27]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Not happy, but sees an opportunity}What are you waiting for? Rubbing it in? {Slight disgust/eager}Strike up the band already.|{Warning}Careful when you do... you think the Villa's bad now, you haven't seen anything yet.
name: NVDLC01GalaEventActivate "NVDLC01GalaEventActivate" [DIAL:01011D27]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Sees an opportunity, quiet, whispering}Come on, partner. So close now, stage is set, strike up the band.|{Slightly worried}Just get ready to run when you do... I sure will. {To himself}Think the Villa's bad now... you haven't seen half the hell this town can raise.
name: NVDLC01GalaEventActivate "NVDLC01GalaEventActivate" [DIAL:01011D27]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: There's no need for any of that, let's get out of here.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic056 "There's no need for any of that, let's get out of here." [DIAL:01011D7A]

text_content: If you try to burn the voice out of you, this casino will be destroyed, and us along with it.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic055 "If you try to burn the voice out of you, this casino will be destroyed, and us along with it." [DIAL:01011D7B]

text_content: Dog is tired of voice inside, tired of being in another cage, again. Try to...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic055 "If you try to burn the voice out of you, this casino will be destroyed, and us along with it." [DIAL:01011D7B]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: ...kill this human, Dog. Kill them. If this casino is destroyed, good, it'll kill the Old Man, too, the one who...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic055 "If you try to burn the voice out of you, this casino will be destroyed, and us along with it." [DIAL:01011D7B]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Sad}...shouts at Dog, the voice shouts, and to stop the voice, Dog needs to burn it out.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic055 "If you try to burn the voice out of you, this casino will be destroyed, and us along with it." [DIAL:01011D7B]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Dog, if you do this, you'll kill yourself.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic054 "Dog, if you do this, you'll kill yourself." [DIAL:01011D7C]

text_content: <Storage Node for Final Battle, Likes Player Topics. Do Not Translate.>
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic053 "<Storage Node for Final Battle, Likes Player Topics. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:01011D7D]

text_content: {Amused}...do this? Yes, he can. You caused this - coddled him, protected him, now I'm going to have to take control from...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic053 "<Storage Node for Final Battle, Likes Player Topics. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:01011D7D]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: ...you, you need to go, run. {Whispering, as if confiding in player}Dog is going to burn voice... burn voice out, burn it away.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic053 "<Storage Node for Final Battle, Likes Player Topics. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:01011D7D]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {God's voice, quiet, echoing}...and Dog looks just like me. {Beat, to Dog}You've hurt yourself. Inside. {Slightly tender}Do you see now, see...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic053 "<Storage Node for Final Battle, Likes Player Topics. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:01011D7D]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Dog finally gets it}...in the water. {Slow realization, quiet, to himself}Dog understands now. Dog knows what happened.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic053 "<Storage Node for Final Battle, Likes Player Topics. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:01011D7D]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {God, quiet, serious}He's right. If you merge us, then... I... we... or whatever we become... we can't help you when you reach whatever's at the Sierra Madre's end.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic053 "<Storage Node for Final Battle, Likes Player Topics. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:01011D7D]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Dog, crumbling, sad}And Dog... Dog doesn't want to unremember you, may {emph}forget you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic053 "<Storage Node for Final Battle, Likes Player Topics. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:01011D7D]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {God, correcting Dog's "Dog may forget you."}We {emph}will forget almost all that has happened here. You'll be alone - at the Old Man's mercy. Like Dog. Like me.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic053 "<Storage Node for Final Battle, Likes Player Topics. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:01011D7D]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Snarl, slightly indignant}...to stop you. You think your pull is stronger than mine? No... no, I've minded Dog, protected him far longer than you ever have. He won't...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic053 "<Storage Node for Final Battle, Likes Player Topics. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:01011D7D]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: ...listen to you. If Master sent you, Dog is listening.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic053 "<Storage Node for Final Battle, Likes Player Topics. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:01011D7D]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Exhausted}...him, just as I do. {Beat}Do you understand now? Do you understand why I have to take control? He...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic053 "<Storage Node for Final Battle, Likes Player Topics. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:01011D7D]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Despairing}...why keep hurting self, voice keeps... telling Dog to do things. Dog just wants voice to go away... away.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic053 "<Storage Node for Final Battle, Likes Player Topics. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:01011D7D]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Takes a breath, sounds weak}...too late. Too late for us... too late for you to do anything but...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic053 "<Storage Node for Final Battle, Likes Player Topics. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:01011D7D]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: ...listen to you. Your voice... Dog will listen to you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic053 "<Storage Node for Final Battle, Likes Player Topics. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:01011D7D]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Take that chain around your neck, grab the ends, and pull slow and hard until you hear a crack.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic052 "Take that chain around your neck, grab the ends, and pull slow and hard until you hear a crack." [DIAL:01011D7E]

text_content: {Nods, about to kill himself}Yes, Dog can do that. {Quiet}Dog hopes to see you soon.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic052 "Take that chain around your neck, grab the ends, and pull slow and hard until you hear a crack." [DIAL:01011D7E]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: The other voice? See it in your head - not as a voice, but as a ball, the size of your hand.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic050 "The other voice? See it in your head - not as a voice, but as a ball, the size of your hand." [DIAL:01011D80]

text_content: {Dog, Confused, curious, as if holding a ball in his hand}Dog... Dog never thought of the voice as... small. As something he could hold...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic050 "The other voice? See it in your head - not as a voice, but as a ball, the size of your hand." [DIAL:01011D80]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {God, slow suspicious}...on for much longer. What are you doing? What...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic050 "The other voice? See it in your head - not as a voice, but as a ball, the size of your hand." [DIAL:01011D80]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Dog, confused}...do you want Dog to do? {Frown}Voice is small now, Dog... {building, getting slightly evil}Dog could... Dog choke the voice, crush it into red mash.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic050 "The other voice? See it in your head - not as a voice, but as a ball, the size of your hand." [DIAL:01011D80]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Dog, listen to the other voice inside now. Go to sleep, let him come out.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic049 "Dog, listen to the other voice inside now. Go to sleep, let him come out." [DIAL:01011D81]

text_content: {Frightened}If... if other voice comes out... Dog... Dog won't wake up. Dog doesn't want to sleep, please don't make him...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic049 "Dog, listen to the other voice inside now. Go to sleep, let him come out." [DIAL:01011D81]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {God, Relieved}...go to sleep. Good. Yes... make him sleep. Please...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic049 "Dog, listen to the other voice inside now. Go to sleep, let him come out." [DIAL:01011D81]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Dog, a little sad}...don't make me go to sleep. I... {frowns, slowing speech}Dog is tired. Dog is tired, can't... keep eyes open. Sleep... Dog needs to sleep.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic049 "Dog, listen to the other voice inside now. Go to sleep, let him come out." [DIAL:01011D81]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: No, look, I wasn't the one who caged you here, all right?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic047 "No, look, I wasn't the one who caged you here, all right?" [DIAL:01011D82]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Confused}Master? {Beat, quiet, reverent}Master... Dog... Dog is listening.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic047 "No, look, I wasn't the one who caged you here, all right?" [DIAL:01011D82]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: [FAILED] {Getting more and more angry}No... no, you put Dog here, you keep him here! Like other cages you put Dog in!
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic047 "No, look, I wasn't the one who caged you here, all right?" [DIAL:01011D82]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Dog... stay back, listen to me.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic046 "Dog... stay back, listen to me." [DIAL:01011D83]

text_content: {DUPE}[SUCCEEDED]{Stops in mid-attack}Hnnh? Master? {Beat}Don't want Master to be mad... what does Master want Dog to...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic046 "Dog... stay back, listen to me." [DIAL:01011D83]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: [FAILED] {Getting more and more angry}No... Dog no listen to you, no listen to your voice anymore - will tear you apart, feed on you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic046 "Dog... stay back, listen to me." [DIAL:01011D83]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Ready for more? Come on, let's finish this.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic045 "Ready for more? Come on, let's finish this." [DIAL:01011D84]

text_content: {Snarling, then roars as he launches himself at player}Nrrrrrrh... rhhhhharrhhh!
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic045 "Ready for more? Come on, let's finish this." [DIAL:01011D84]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Forget this. Come on, let's fight, you big reject.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic044 "Forget this. Come on, let's fight, you big reject." [DIAL:01011D85]

text_content: I can't do it - fighting's more merciful than this.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic035 "I can't do it - fighting's more merciful than this." [DIAL:01011D86]

text_content: Master needs you to pull on the chain on your neck as hard as you can.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic021 "Master needs you to pull on the chain on your neck as hard as you can." [DIAL:01011D87]

text_content: {Nods, about to kill himself}Yes, Master. {Quiet}Dog hopes to see you soon.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic021 "Master needs you to pull on the chain on your neck as hard as you can." [DIAL:01011D87]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Dog... listen to me... don't do this.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic009 "Dog... listen to me... don't do this." [DIAL:01011D88]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Stops in mid-attack}Hnnh? Master? {Beat}Don't want Master to be mad... what does Master want Dog to...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic009 "Dog... listen to me... don't do this." [DIAL:01011D88]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: [FAILED] {Malicious}Dog tired of listening to you - put {emph}you in cage, piece by piece.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic009 "Dog... listen to me... don't do this." [DIAL:01011D88]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: I don't plan on running, it's time to kill you both.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic008 "I don't plan on running, it's time to kill you both." [DIAL:01011D89]

text_content: Come on, then. I won't make it easy on you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic007 "Come on, then. I won't make it easy on you." [DIAL:01011D8A]

text_content: {Snarling, evil, malicious}Dog will crush you, snap your bones, make red everywhere.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic007 "Come on, then. I won't make it easy on you." [DIAL:01011D8A]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: NVDLC01EndingFinaleAllDead
name: NVDLC01EndingFinaleAllDead "NVDLC01EndingFinaleAllDead" [DIAL:01011DE1]
