text_content: {Elijah - DUPE: Narration, echoes the beginning, but it's somber, not as bitter}You've heard of the Sierra Madre Casino.|{Christine - Narration, somber}We all have, the legend, the curses. |{Dean - Narration, somber}Some foolishness about it lying in the middle of a City of Dead. |{Dog - Narration}A city of ghosts. |{God - Narration}Beneath a blood-red cloud... |{Dean - Narration}...a bright, shining monument, reaching out, luring treasure hunters to their doom. An illusion.|{Christine - Narration}A promise that you can change your fortunes. Begin again.|{Elijah - DUPE: Narration, slow, defeated, reflecting}Finding it, though, that's not the hard part.|{Elijah - DUPE: Narration, the grand finale, downnote - this is the last sentence of the story}It's letting go.|{Dean - Narration, the grand finale, downnote - this is the last sentence of the story}It's letting go.|{Christine - Narration, the grand finale, downnote - this is the last sentence of the story}It's letting go.|{Dog - Narration, the grand finale, downnote - this is the last sentence of the story}It's letting go.|{God - Narration, the grand finale, downnote - this is the last sentence of the story}It's letting go.
name: NVDLC01EndingFinaleAllDead "NVDLC01EndingFinaleAllDead" [DIAL:01011DE1]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01EndingFinale
name: NVDLC01EndingFinale "NVDLC01EndingFinale" [DIAL:01011DE2]

text_content: {Narration, echoes the beginning, but it's somber, not as bitter}You've heard of the Sierra Madre Casino.|{Narration, somber}We all have, the legend, the curses. {Somber}Some foolishness about it lying in the middle of a City of Dead.|{Narration}A city of ghosts. Buried beneath a blood-red cloud... a bright, shining monument luring treasure hunters to their doom.|{Narration, a little quieter in this line}An illusion that you can begin again, change your fortunes.|{Narration, slow, defeated, reflecting}Finding it, though, that's not the hard part.|{Narration, the grand finale, downnote - this is the last sentence of the story}It's letting go.
name: NVDLC01EndingFinale "NVDLC01EndingFinale" [DIAL:01011DE2]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01EndingIntroVera
name: NVDLC01EndingIntroVera "NVDLC01EndingIntroVera" [DIAL:01011DE3]

text_content: {Narration}The survivors of the Sierra Madre thought about gathering at the Fountain and waiting for the Courier.|{Narration}In the end, the collars' silence made them uneasy, and the fear of turning on each other made them hesitate, and leave the goodbyes - {beat}unspoken.|{Narration}The radio message at the fountain was enough for them, and there was no need to add another farewell on top of all they had suffered.
name: NVDLC01EndingIntroVera "NVDLC01EndingIntroVera" [DIAL:01011DE3]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: NVDLC01EndingIntroElijah
name: NVDLC01EndingIntroElijah "NVDLC01EndingIntroElijah" [DIAL:01011DE4]

text_content: {Narration}You've heard stories of the Sierra Madre Casino. {Beat}We all have.|{Narration}This story's different than the others. It's all in promise of beginnings. {Beat}And the ending.
name: NVDLC01EndingIntroElijah "NVDLC01EndingIntroElijah" [DIAL:01011DE4]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01EndingPlayerElijahTeam
name: NVDLC01EndingPlayerElijahTeam "NVDLC01EndingPlayerElijahTeam" [DIAL:01011DE5]

text_content: {DUPE: Narration}In the years that followed, the legend of the Sierra Madre faded, and there were no... {emph}new visitors to the city.|{DUPE: Narration}Years later, when a mysterious blood red cloud began to roll across the Mojave, then West toward the Republic, no one knew where it had come from.|{DUPE: Narration}Only that it brought death in its wake. Attempts to find the source of the toxic cloud failed.|{Narration}The Mojave was cut off. Through the Cloud, lights were seen from HELIOS One.|{Narration}There were stories of ghosts immune to gunfire, who struck down anyone they saw with rays of light.|{Narration}The last chapter of the Mojave came when a modified REPCONN rocket struck Hoover Dam, releasing a blood-red cloud, killing all stationed there.|{Narration}All attempts to penetrate the Cloud and re-take the Dam failed, and both the NCR and Legion finally turned away from it, citing the place as cursed.|{Narration}In the years that followed, communities across the West began to die as traces of the Cloud began to drift over lands held by the NCR.|{Narration}Only two remained alive in the depths of the Cloud, at the Sierra Madre, waiting for their new world to begin again.
name: NVDLC01EndingPlayerElijahTeam "NVDLC01EndingPlayerElijahTeam" [DIAL:01011DE5]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01EndingElijahTrappedPlayer
name: NVDLC01EndingElijahTrappedPlayer "NVDLC01EndingElijahTrappedPlayer" [DIAL:01011DE6]

text_content: NVDLC01EndingPlayerTrapped
name: NVDLC01EndingPlayerTrapped "NVDLC01EndingPlayerTrapped" [DIAL:01011DE7]

text_content: {Narration}The Courier, lured by the promise of the Sierra Madre, could not escape. Once inside the vault, the casino did not let go.|{Narration}When the Courier finally passed away, the casino created a new Hologram to walk with the other ghosts that filled its casino.|{Narration}It was a pre-programmed homage intended for another. It assumed a new meaning in the likeness of the Courier.|{Narration}A means of allowing even the dead to begin again.
name: NVDLC01EndingPlayerTrapped "NVDLC01EndingPlayerTrapped" [DIAL:01011DE7]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: NVDLC01DogDevourTopic01
name: NVDLC01DogDevourTopic01 "NVDLC01DogDevourTopic01" [DIAL:01011F39]

text_content: {Growling, just fed, slightly full}Hnnhhhh... {bestial}Dog getting full.
name: NVDLC01DogDevourTopic01 "NVDLC01DogDevourTopic01" [DIAL:01011F39]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: OM NOM NOM
name: NVDLC01DogDevourTopic01 "NVDLC01DogDevourTopic01" [DIAL:01011F39]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Rhrrrrrr...
name: NVDLC01DogDevourTopic01 "NVDLC01DogDevourTopic01" [DIAL:01011F39]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: RhhhhaaarrrRRRRRRRR!
name: NVDLC01DogDevourTopic01 "NVDLC01DogDevourTopic01" [DIAL:01011F39]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Show's about to begin. People, take your places.
name: NVDLC01GalaEventQuestNVDLC01DeanTopic002 "Show's about to begin. People, take your places." [DIAL:01011F50]

text_content: I'm ready. Everyone - trigger the event.
name: NVDLC01GalaEventQuestNVDLC01DeanTopic001 "I'm ready. Everyone - trigger the event." [DIAL:01011F51]

text_content: {Slight expectation}Finally. {Beat, slightly expectant}Now, the gates will open. And so will the skies.
name: NVDLC01GalaEventQuestNVDLC01DeanTopic001 "I'm ready. Everyone - trigger the event." [DIAL:01011F51]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Let's do this. On the count of three... two... one.
name: NVDLC01GalaEventQuestNVDLC01DeanTopic000 "Let's do this. On the count of three... two... one." [DIAL:01011F52]

text_content: <Give two taps back.>
name: NVDLC01GalaEventQuestNVDLC01ChristineTopic005 "<Give two taps back.>" [DIAL:01011F53]

text_content: Only a little longer, and we'll open the casino.
name: NVDLC01GalaEventQuestNVDLC01ChristineTopic004 "Only a little longer, and we'll open the casino." [DIAL:01011F54]

text_content: Christine? We're almost ready here.
name: NVDLC01GalaEventQuestNVDLC01ChristineTopic003 "Christine? We're almost ready here." [DIAL:01011F55]

text_content: [A single tap comes from the speaker, then silence.]
name: NVDLC01GalaEventQuestNVDLC01ChristineTopic003 "Christine? We're almost ready here." [DIAL:01011F55]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Must be you, Christine. Sit tight, not like you have a choice.
name: NVDLC01GalaEventQuestNVDLC01ChristineTopic002 "Must be you, Christine. Sit tight, not like you have a choice." [DIAL:01011F56]

text_content: Save your energy, we still have to pull this off.
name: NVDLC01GalaEventQuestNVDLC01ChristineTopic001 "Save your energy, we still have to pull this off." [DIAL:01011F57]

text_content: Now, now... I'll let you out when the event's over. Maybe.
name: NVDLC01GalaEventQuestNVDLC01ChristineTopic000 "Now, now... I'll let you out when the event's over. Maybe." [DIAL:01011F58]

text_content: [The hammering stops for a second... and there's one final bang from the speaker, as if someone is smashing their fist into a wall.]
name: NVDLC01GalaEventQuestNVDLC01ChristineTopic000 "Now, now... I'll let you out when the event's over. Maybe." [DIAL:01011F58]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Fine, don't take too long, or it'll be a short recovery, trust me.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic033 "Fine, don't take too long, or it'll be a short recovery, trust me." [DIAL:01012217]

text_content: If you get the strength to leave, do so - quickly.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic032 "If you get the strength to leave, do so - quickly." [DIAL:01012218]

text_content: Go on and rest. I have to take care of something.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic031 "Go on and rest. I have to take care of something." [DIAL:01012219]

text_content: {God Calm, trying to make sense of this, takes a breath, recovering}Thank you... for whatever you have done. I will remain here, need to get my strength back.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic031 "Go on and rest. I have to take care of something." [DIAL:01012219]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: We're trapped inside a casino in a poisonous city.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic030 "We're trapped inside a casino in a poisonous city." [DIAL:0101221A]

text_content: A cage... but at least you're not in two of them now.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic029 "A cage... but at least you're not in two of them now." [DIAL:0101221B]

text_content: {God Calm, slightly curious}That... that was not the answer I was expecting.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic029 "A cage... but at least you're not in two of them now." [DIAL:0101221B]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: It'd take too long to explain.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic028 "It'd take too long to explain." [DIAL:0101221C]

text_content: {God Calm, getting his bearings, takes a breath}I feel as if I've woken up.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic028 "It'd take too long to explain." [DIAL:0101221C]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {God Calm, trying to make sense of this}I don't know you, yet I feel like I do, and a feeling of... gratitude. I... {beat, slowly realizes he's in pain}forgive me, I... I'm wounded. This chain... this bear trap on my arm...|{God Calm, trying to make sense of this}...how did I even get this far with these wounds? The pain is excruciating, I... I need to rest for a moment.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic028 "It'd take too long to explain." [DIAL:0101221C]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Your voice... it's different.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic027 "Your voice... it's different." [DIAL:0101221D]

text_content: Are you all right?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic026 "Are you all right?" [DIAL:0101221E]

text_content: Dog?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic025 "Dog?" [DIAL:0101221F]

text_content: {God Calm, different voice, calm, but disoriented}Who... who are you? What is this place?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic025 "Dog?" [DIAL:0101221F]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Just go before I change my mind.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic024 "Just go before I change my mind." [DIAL:01012220]

text_content: I promise I'll try not to get killed.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic023 "I promise I'll try not to get killed." [DIAL:01012221]

text_content: We came this far, I'll manage. Go on, let go.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic022 "We came this far, I'll manage. Go on, let go." [DIAL:01012222]

text_content: {Dog, Quiet}You were there all the time...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic022 "We came this far, I'll manage. Go on, let go." [DIAL:01012222]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {God}...all the time, you were there, and so close...|{God Calm, realization, voice changes as if seeing something}...together.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic022 "We came this far, I'll manage. Go on, let go." [DIAL:01012222]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Then I don't want you to merge, I need you here... Dog, listen to my voice. Dog?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic021 "Then I don't want you to merge, I need you here... Dog, listen to my voice. Dog?" [DIAL:01012223]

text_content: {Dog, slightly regretful}Dog understands. Need help, need Dog in case.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic021 "Then I don't want you to merge, I need you here... Dog, listen to my voice. Dog?" [DIAL:01012223]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {God, snarling, slightly judging}Of course. You... we might not get through this, otherwise. Need to survive, no matter what the cost. Now... now...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic021 "Then I don't want you to merge, I need you here... Dog, listen to my voice. Dog?" [DIAL:01012223]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: I don't want you to be under anyone's control, even mine.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic020 "I don't want you to be under anyone's control, even mine." [DIAL:01012224]

text_content: Not having your help doesn't matter if this heals you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic019 "Not having your help doesn't matter if this heals you." [DIAL:01012225]

text_content: {Dog, slightly sad}Dog understands... Dog has done... bad things, knows why voice was...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic019 "Not having your help doesn't matter if this heals you." [DIAL:01012225]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {God, respectful}...furious with him. Tired of the anger. {Beat}Thank you... Courier. Even if it's only for minutes before the Sierra Madre kills us all, then...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic019 "Not having your help doesn't matter if this heals you." [DIAL:01012225]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Dog, quiet sad}...Dog hopes you find a way to save self, like you help Dog, and...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic019 "Not having your help doesn't matter if this heals you." [DIAL:01012225]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {God, saying goodbye}...when you meet him, find a way to save yourself, as you tried to save us. {One last weak joke}Otherwise, I'll be upset with you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic019 "Not having your help doesn't matter if this heals you." [DIAL:01012225]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Now that you see, I want you to step back, listen to the voice again.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic070 "Now that you see, I want you to step back, listen to the voice again." [DIAL:01012226]

text_content: Do you know what happens if you go into the water, Dog?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic069 "Do you know what happens if you go into the water, Dog?" [DIAL:01012227]

text_content: Then... step into the water, step into yourself.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic068 "Then... step into the water, step into yourself." [DIAL:01012228]

text_content: If Dog... if Dog goes into the water... Dog can't help if Master gets mad. {Beat, sad}You were nice to Dog, Dog {emph}wants to help.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic068 "Then... step into the water, step into yourself." [DIAL:01012228]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Try to picture the voice, inside, and, uh, turn in and look at it.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic067 "Try to picture the voice, inside, and, uh, turn in and look at it." [DIAL:01012229]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Dog can {emph}see the voice. {Frowns, studying his reflection}Looks just like Dog...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic067 "Try to picture the voice, inside, and, uh, turn in and look at it." [DIAL:01012229]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: [FAILED] {Confused}Dog... Dog does not understand. Voice? The other voice? {Beat, slight frustration}What do you want Dog to do.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic067 "Try to picture the voice, inside, and, uh, turn in and look at it." [DIAL:01012229]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: As long as you're not planning to blow up the casino now, great.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic018 "As long as you're not planning to blow up the casino now, great." [DIAL:0101222A]

text_content: Now, if you've got him on a leash, I need to finish things here.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic017 "Now, if you've got him on a leash, I need to finish things here." [DIAL:0101222B]

text_content: Are you going to be all right?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic016 "Are you going to be all right?" [DIAL:0101222C]

text_content: {Firm, eager}Things here... are... under control. {Beat, anger}Find the one that dragged us here, end him.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic016 "Are you going to be all right?" [DIAL:0101222C]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: That's it, sleep, reject. Sleep like the dead.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic066 "That's it, sleep, reject. Sleep like the dead." [DIAL:0101222D]

text_content: Goodnight, Dog. You won't wake up, ever again.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic061 "Goodnight, Dog. You won't wake up, ever again." [DIAL:0101222E]

text_content: Close your eyes, and only open them if the voice tells you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic057 "Close your eyes, and only open them if the voice tells you." [DIAL:0101222F]

text_content: You did it. You... I don't feel him struggling anymore... I'm in pain, and... I hate to say it, I'm starving, but... I'm not fighting him.|{A little vulnerable here}All I wanted was him to listen to me, take {emph}care of him, keep him from hurting himself...|{Quiet, resolved}Now I can. One day, when he's ready, I'll let him out. When we... understand each other.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic057 "Close your eyes, and only open them if the voice tells you." [DIAL:0101222F]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Good... well done, Dog. I'm pleased. Now stay.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic048 "Good... well done, Dog. I'm pleased. Now stay." [DIAL:01012230]

text_content: I have some unfinished business. Are you going to be all right?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic018 "I have some unfinished business. Are you going to be all right?" [DIAL:01012231]

text_content: Yes, well, it had to be done. Now, I need you to remain here.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic017 "Yes, well, it had to be done. Now, I need you to remain here." [DIAL:01012232]

text_content: {Frowns, building determination, getting empowered}Now {emph}Dog speak. Now Dog not afraid. {Beat}And... {frowns}hungry. {Emph}More hungry.|{Dog, Slightly malicious}Dog will obey. Dog will stay here... for now.|{Slightly unsettling here}After... after that, Dog find food... tear apart food, eat. Chase it down, can't run, feed. Finally, until Dog is full.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic017 "Yes, well, it had to be done. Now, I need you to remain here." [DIAL:01012232]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Aren't you hungry? Go on - feed, piece by piece.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic015 "Aren't you hungry? Go on - feed, piece by piece." [DIAL:01012233]

text_content: No, hold it tightly by the neck - now sink your teeth into it, tear it apart.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic010 "No, hold it tightly by the neck - now sink your teeth into it, tear it apart." [DIAL:01012234]

text_content: {God's voice, quiet, horrified}No. No, Dog, no...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic010 "No, hold it tightly by the neck - now sink your teeth into it, tear it apart." [DIAL:01012234]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Dog, eager, slightly amazed}...knows now. Voice was always small... {stronger}Dog could have torn it apart, eaten it all this time, tear it...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic010 "No, hold it tightly by the neck - now sink your teeth into it, tear it apart." [DIAL:01012234]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {God}...apart, Dog... we cannot be apart, you need if... hnnnh... hrrhhaharrrrr... {Screams of being torn apart}
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic010 "No, hold it tightly by the neck - now sink your teeth into it, tear it apart." [DIAL:01012234]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Dog, Breathing heavy}...Dog... Dog is... empty. The voice... {Beat, slightly evil}Dog is hungrier than ever...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic010 "No, hold it tightly by the neck - now sink your teeth into it, tear it apart." [DIAL:01012234]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd "NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd" [DIAL:0101233E]

text_content: {1G}I... {chuckles, not unkindly, more relieved}he's asleep. Finally. {To himself}Shhhhhh.
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd "NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd" [DIAL:0101233E]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {2G - Tired, serious, no malice}Dog... all I wanted was for you to listen to me, let me care for you. Keep you from hurting yourself...
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd "NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd" [DIAL:0101233E]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {3G - Stronger, to himself}Now I can. And one day, when you're ready, I'll let you out. When you're calm, and we... understand each other.
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd "NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd" [DIAL:0101233E]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {4G}And we're at peace, you and I, mind and instinct. Then the world will be ready for us.
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd "NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd" [DIAL:0101233E]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {1D}Hello? Voice? You there? {Waits, deliver this as a snarl}It's Dog...{confused}...Dog can hear himself. Voice is... is in cage? Locked.
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd "NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd" [DIAL:0101233E]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {2D - Frowns, building determination}Now Dog speak. Now Dog not afraid. {Beat}And... {frowns}hungry. {Emph}More hungry.
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd "NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd" [DIAL:0101233E]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {3D - Slightly unsettling here}Dog find food... tear apart food, eat. Chase it down, can't run, feed. Finally, until Dog is full.
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd "NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd" [DIAL:0101233E]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {1B}What is this place?
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd "NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd" [DIAL:0101233E]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {2B}Feel strange, like... sleeping. On my neck, is this... a chain? I... {recognition, looks down and sees the name carved there}what's carved on my chest?
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd "NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd" [DIAL:0101233E]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {3B}"God." No... not God. Something in reverse... hnh. Was that one of them...?
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd "NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd" [DIAL:0101233E]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {4B}Should rest, get my strength back... then explore this place, see what it holds.
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd "NVDLC01DogKitchenEnd" [DIAL:0101233E]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Maybe you just... uh... need to hear another voice, like mine.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic080 "Maybe you just... uh... need to hear another voice, like mine." [DIAL:010124C7]

text_content: {DUPE}[SUCCEEDED] {Surprised}Master? {Grateful}Master, Dog hoped you come, voice... voice is going...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic080 "Maybe you just... uh... need to hear another voice, like mine." [DIAL:010124C7]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: [FAILED] {Snarls, draws a ragged breath as he starts fight again}No... Dog is my creature, and he's more than enough to end you here and now.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic080 "Maybe you just... uh... need to hear another voice, like mine." [DIAL:010124C7]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Look, listen to my voice, maybe... maybe I can help.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic079 "Look, listen to my voice, maybe... maybe I can help." [DIAL:010124C8]

text_content: {DUPE}[SUCCEEDED]{Nods, slowly}You... were kind to Dog. Dog will listen... Dog is glad you came...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic079 "Look, listen to my voice, maybe... maybe I can help." [DIAL:010124C8]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: I don't mean you any harm... you just need to calm down, focus.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic076 "I don't mean you any harm... you just need to calm down, focus." [DIAL:010124C9]

text_content: Dog tried. Just hard... hard to hear over voice sometimes... so loud... pain... pain...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic076 "I don't mean you any harm... you just need to calm down, focus." [DIAL:010124C9]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Snarls, but in pain, weakening}...won't shut me out, Dog. It won't silence me. This human... both of them, they mean to...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic076 "I don't mean you any harm... you just need to calm down, focus." [DIAL:010124C9]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Whispering}...help Dog, please. Please.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic076 "I don't mean you any harm... you just need to calm down, focus." [DIAL:010124C9]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Forget it. I'm sick of dragging you around anyway.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic075 "Forget it. I'm sick of dragging you around anyway." [DIAL:010124CA]

text_content: Dog knows... please... help Dog end the voice, Dog just wants it to go away. Dog...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic075 "Forget it. I'm sick of dragging you around anyway." [DIAL:010124CA]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Amused, gets second wind}...and I have more in common than we know. Soon, you'll be inside Dog, just as I am.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic075 "Forget it. I'm sick of dragging you around anyway." [DIAL:010124CA]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Bite down on it, chew until it's silent, then swallow it.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic074 "Bite down on it, chew until it's silent, then swallow it." [DIAL:010124CB]

text_content: Dog... don't do this, listen to me, my voice.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic034 "Dog... don't do this, listen to me, my voice." [DIAL:010124CC]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Surprised}Master? {Grateful}Master, Dog hoped you would come, voice... voice is going...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic034 "Dog... don't do this, listen to me, my voice." [DIAL:010124CC]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: [FAILED] {Pleading}Dog... Dog wants to, Dog does, but...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic034 "Dog... don't do this, listen to me, my voice." [DIAL:010124CC]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Dog, that voice doesn't control you, all right?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic072 "Dog, that voice doesn't control you, all right?" [DIAL:010124CD]

text_content: {Sad}Dog tried to shut it out, tried to hurt self enough to make it...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic072 "Dog, that voice doesn't control you, all right?" [DIAL:010124CD]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Evil}...quiet. Shhhhh, Dog. Let me handle this. {Malicious}I'll let you feed on this human when we're done.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic072 "Dog, that voice doesn't control you, all right?" [DIAL:010124CD]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Fine, reject. You want to die? I'll accomodate you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic071 "Fine, reject. You want to die? I'll accomodate you." [DIAL:010124CE]

text_content: {Sad, despairing}Dog doesn't want to die. But the voice keeps shouting, and...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic071 "Fine, reject. You want to die? I'll accomodate you." [DIAL:010124CE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: You're not leaving me any choice, I have to stop you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic051 "You're not leaving me any choice, I have to stop you." [DIAL:010124CF]

text_content: {Sad}Dog is sorry, so sorry, didn't want to, but...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic051 "You're not leaving me any choice, I have to stop you." [DIAL:010124CF]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Cold, malicious}...it's time for you to realize who's in control here. First, we tear you apart - then this casino, and the Old Man with it.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic051 "You're not leaving me any choice, I have to stop you." [DIAL:010124CF]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: What are you, exactly? You're acting different than before.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic005 "What are you, exactly? You're acting different than before." [DIAL:0101265A]

text_content: Dog and I take turns in the cage... one steps out, the other goes back in. Now - what do you want?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic005 "What are you, exactly? You're acting different than before." [DIAL:0101265A]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: <Storage Node. Opening Topics. Do Not Translate.>
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic004 "<Storage Node. Opening Topics. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:0101265B]

text_content: {DUPE: Low, cold, hates Dog's self-mutilation}Do you see these wounds of his, covering his skin...the bear trap on his arm? He placed his own hand in it. |The name he carved in his chest? To remind him of who he is, he inflicts pain on himself to silence me, when all I try to do... Hrr!|{Quiet, more to himself}...he cuts, hurts, and tries to murder me out of him. He won't succeed. Just makes me angrier.|Dog is the beast, we simply change cages. {Glances around}Like the ones here.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic004 "<Storage Node. Opening Topics. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:0101265B]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Dog and I take turns in the cage... one steps out, the other goes back in.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic004 "<Storage Node. Opening Topics. Do Not Translate.>" [DIAL:0101265B]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: I heard electricity and radios can cause, uh, voices in people's heads.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic002 "I heard electricity and radios can cause, uh, voices in people's heads." [DIAL:0101265C]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Snarls}That's the easy explanation, the one {emph}humans use. Pre-War technology, as if it's the cause of all ills, mind and body.|I {emph}needed to come out of the cage to protect Dog. {Disdain}From clever humans... like you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic002 "I heard electricity and radios can cause, uh, voices in people's heads." [DIAL:0101265C]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: [FAILED] {Taunting, playing games}Perhaps. Or maybe I was here all the time, watching. Waiting for you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic002 "I heard electricity and radios can cause, uh, voices in people's heads." [DIAL:0101265C]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Did you hit your head or something? You're acting odd.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic001 "Did you hit your head or something? You're acting odd." [DIAL:0101265D]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Slightly wary, player's onto something}Trauma... yes, in a manner of speaking.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic001 "Did you hit your head or something? You're acting odd." [DIAL:0101265D]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: [FAILED] {Taunting, playing games}No... sometimes it simply wakes voices up.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic001 "Did you hit your head or something? You're acting odd." [DIAL:0101265D]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: NVDLC01DogKitchenIntercom
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenIntercom "NVDLC01DogKitchenIntercom" [DIAL:01012792]

text_content: {1 - Sad, sing song}...going to make casino burn, no more being...
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenIntercom "NVDLC01DogKitchenIntercom" [DIAL:01012792]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {2 - "No more being..."}...back in the cage. Stop what you're doing, we can...
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenIntercom "NVDLC01DogKitchenIntercom" [DIAL:01012792]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {3 - "we"}...can hear you now. {Beat, cold}Not much longer, not...
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenIntercom "NVDLC01DogKitchenIntercom" [DIAL:01012792]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {4 - snarling, "you're not..."}...listening to me. {Frustrated, furious, emph}Tired of being your minder, tired...
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenIntercom "NVDLC01DogKitchenIntercom" [DIAL:01012792]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {5 - "tired"}...of putting Dog to sleep, he wakes up in cage, hungry, Dog wants...
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenIntercom "NVDLC01DogKitchenIntercom" [DIAL:01012792]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {6 - "wants"}...to protect you, always wanted to protect you, the reason I have to take control is...
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenIntercom "NVDLC01DogKitchenIntercom" [DIAL:01012792]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {7 - "The reason I have to take control is..."}...Master. Master set me free, Dog needs to...
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenIntercom "NVDLC01DogKitchenIntercom" [DIAL:01012792]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {8 - "You need to"}...listen to me. {Sudden moment of weakness, slight plea}If you do this, we {emph}both...
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenIntercom "NVDLC01DogKitchenIntercom" [DIAL:01012792]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {9 - "We both"}...die. Dog wants to die. Don't care anymore, tired of you, tired of place. Master will...
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenIntercom "NVDLC01DogKitchenIntercom" [DIAL:01012792]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {10 - "Master will"}...help us. Please let me help us. If you don't, then you're...
name: NVDLC01DogKitchenIntercom "NVDLC01DogKitchenIntercom" [DIAL:01012792]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: NVDLC01HoloVendorBuy
name: NVDLC01HoloVendorBuy "NVDLC01HoloVendorBuy" [DIAL:010127A5]

text_content: [The Hologram nods.]
name: NVDLC01HoloVendorBuy "NVDLC01HoloVendorBuy" [DIAL:010127A5]

text_content: NVDLC01HoloVendorHello
name: NVDLC01HoloVendorHello "NVDLC01HoloVendorHello" [DIAL:010127A6]

text_content: NVDLC01HoloVendorGoodbye
name: NVDLC01HoloVendorGoodbye "NVDLC01HoloVendorGoodbye" [DIAL:010127A7]

text_content: [The Hologram flickers in acknowledgement.]
name: NVDLC01HoloVendorGoodbye "NVDLC01HoloVendorGoodbye" [DIAL:010127A7]

text_content: NVDLC01WTChristineTerrifiedSoundBark
name: NVDLC01WTChristineTerrifiedSoundBark "NVDLC01WTChristineTerrifiedSoundBark" [DIAL:010127F2]

text_content: [Christine's eyes dart in the direction of the screeching sound. She looks frightened and trembles slightly, as if fighting an urge to run.]
name: NVDLC01WTChristineTerrifiedSoundBark "NVDLC01WTChristineTerrifiedSoundBark" [DIAL:010127F2]

text_content: Reach around to the chain on your neck, see if you can find a key.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic058 "Reach around to the chain on your neck, see if you can find a key." [DIAL:01012A1B]

text_content: Go to the Fountain and wait for me there.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic020 "Go to the Fountain and wait for me there." [DIAL:01012A1C]

text_content: {Eager, a little quiet}Master, Dog waited a long time... brought you many people. If Dog finds more, will bring them to the Fountain, Dog promises.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic020 "Go to the Fountain and wait for me there." [DIAL:01012A1C]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Fine. Let's go, follow me.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic019 "Fine. Let's go, follow me." [DIAL:01012A1D]

text_content: Yes, Master. Dog waited a long time... brought you many people. Dog will follow.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic019 "Fine. Let's go, follow me." [DIAL:01012A1D]

text_content: Already have a Dog with you... Dog will meet you at the Fountain. {Slightly too eager}Maybe find food on the way.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic019 "Fine. Let's go, follow me." [DIAL:01012A1D]

text_content: Shut up, reject, and give me the key. Now.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic016 "Shut up, reject, and give me the key. Now." [DIAL:01012A1E]

text_content: {Bad Node: Cringing}Yes, Master. Here, Dog sorry, Dog... just... {Beat}just let Dog out of the cage. Don't want to be here any longer.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic016 "Shut up, reject, and give me the key. Now." [DIAL:01012A1E]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Just give me the key - you want out of the cage, don't you?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic014 "Just give me the key - you want out of the cage, don't you?" [DIAL:01012A1F]

text_content: {Good Node, slightly confused}Yes, Master... Master sounds different, quieter. Master... {Beat}Dog doesn't want to be in the cage any more. Dog will be good this time, Dog promises.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic014 "Just give me the key - you want out of the cage, don't you?" [DIAL:01012A1F]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Now that you are awake, Master wants you to listen, Dog.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic013 "Now that you are awake, Master wants you to listen, Dog." [DIAL:01012A20]

text_content: {Nods, quiet}Master, Dog is here. What does Master want?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic013 "Now that you are awake, Master wants you to listen, Dog." [DIAL:01012A20]

text_content: I need your obedience. First, I'm going to show you a trick.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic012 "I need your obedience. First, I'm going to show you a trick." [DIAL:01012A21]

text_content: Does Master want Dog to fetch someone? {Beat, quiet}Dog will hunt down whoever you want, bring them here.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic012 "I need your obedience. First, I'm going to show you a trick." [DIAL:01012A21]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Dog, hidden on you is the key. Find it, and toss it to me.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic011 "Dog, hidden on you is the key. Find it, and toss it to me." [DIAL:01012A22]

text_content: Dog... Dog doesn't have a... hnh. Here it is. {Frowns}Dog... Dog didn't know it was there. {Frowns, suspicious}How did it get there?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic011 "Dog, hidden on you is the key. Find it, and toss it to me." [DIAL:01012A22]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Surprised they could hear you over the alarm bell outside.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic088 "Surprised they could hear you over the alarm bell outside." [DIAL:01012A24]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Very good. Yes... it's another layer of white noise to ensure privacy. Unfortunately, it's also acted as a dinner bell for the residents.|As long as the holographic greeter outside is active, however, I can get by them... the Holograms fascinate them. Ghost-worship, perhaps.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic088 "Surprised they could hear you over the alarm bell outside." [DIAL:01012A24]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: [FAILED] Yes... interesting that. {To himself, irritated by Ghost People outside}More like a dinner bell to some.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic088 "Surprised they could hear you over the alarm bell outside." [DIAL:01012A24]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: What do you mean?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic087 "What do you mean?" [DIAL:01012A25]

text_content: The... inhabitants of the Villa. They are difficult to kill. {Pause}They need to be chopped apart, hacked on the ground... disintegrated, if you can.|They are difficult to kill... but not to devour. {Beat}And Dog is always hungry.|If he is with you, when they fall, he will fall on them, end them. If I am with you... fighting will be far more difficult.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic087 "What do you mean?" [DIAL:01012A25]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: In that case, I will bring him along, I don't need you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic086 "In that case, I will bring him along, I don't need you." [DIAL:01012A26]

text_content: {Laughs}And so... greed, practical or otherwise, has its day.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic086 "In that case, I will bring him along, I don't need you." [DIAL:01012A26]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Even if Dog is more helpful, we can manage.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic085 "Even if Dog is more helpful, we can manage." [DIAL:01012A27]

text_content: {Chuckles, amused}I am not sure you belong here. No, you don't belong here.|Yet... {appraising player}you came this far. And I'm not interested in remaining here any longer. I'll unlock the cage.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic085 "Even if Dog is more helpful, we can manage." [DIAL:01012A27]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: I can't convince you I'm not here for the Sierra Madre or the Old Man, so I'll prove it.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic083 "I can't convince you I'm not here for the Sierra Madre or the Old Man, so I'll prove it." [DIAL:01012A29]

text_content: {Frowns}Prove it... how? Words are worthless.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic083 "I can't convince you I'm not here for the Sierra Madre or the Old Man, so I'll prove it." [DIAL:01012A29]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: I have the power to let Dog out of his cage. I'm going to prove it by not doing it.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic081 "I have the power to let Dog out of his cage. I'm going to prove it by not doing it." [DIAL:01012A2B]

text_content: {Studying the player}Hnh. No... no, you're not. {Confused here, slow, since flies in the face of reason}Even though Dog's more docile... easier to control.|{Questioning}You may regret this. This place... this place is where creatures like Dog can survive. The people that fill its streets...|He is as vicious, more vicious than them. His hunger can help you more than I can. When I am in control... this shell is difficult to... fight in.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic081 "I have the power to let Dog out of his cage. I'm going to prove it by not doing it." [DIAL:01012A2B]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Calm down. Follow me, willingly, I won't do it.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic080 "Calm down. Follow me, willingly, I won't do it." [DIAL:01012A2C]

text_content: {Echoing the player}No, you wouldn't. If you did, you won't escape this place alive. I'd shatter every one of your limbs to splinters and leave you here.|You think I'm afraid of your collar exploding, killing us? No, I'll leave you breathing, then keep walking until {emph}my collar goes cold.|I'll prop your broken body in view of the Sierra Madre so you can see what you came to steal... forever out of reach as you die.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic080 "Calm down. Follow me, willingly, I won't do it." [DIAL:01012A2C]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Goodbye, whoever you are... I'm going to let Dog out of his cage.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic079 "Goodbye, whoever you are... I'm going to let Dog out of his cage." [DIAL:01012A2D]

text_content: No! No, no, don't! I'll make you suffer for this, I promise you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic079 "Goodbye, whoever you are... I'm going to let Dog out of his cage." [DIAL:01012A2D]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {End Bad Node}Although it may not matter... I suspect the Sierra Madre will be reward enough for ones like you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic079 "Goodbye, whoever you are... I'm going to let Dog out of his cage." [DIAL:01012A2D]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: What if we go after the Old Man together?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic078 "What if we go after the Old Man together?" [DIAL:01012A2E]

text_content: No... I don't trust you. Even if you're not working with him, you'll fall into the same trap he did.|{Slow taunting}You may think you can take your revenge... that'll change. You'll start thinking there's a way to have it all.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic078 "What if we go after the Old Man together?" [DIAL:01012A2E]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: I want my freedom, too. You think I like having this collar on me?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic077 "I want my freedom, too. You think I like having this collar on me?" [DIAL:01012A2F]

text_content: {Low, quiet}They all wanted their freedom at first. Then... they realized they could get inside the Sierra Madre.|After that, their freedom wasn't important any more. They couldn't let go, just like the Old Man. So you say you want your freedom...|No... even if you feel that way, it won't last. You'll forget, get greed-blind, and you'll turn.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic077 "I want my freedom, too. You think I like having this collar on me?" [DIAL:01012A2F]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: The Old Man's voice is on my Pip-Boy, just like yours.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic076 "The Old Man's voice is on my Pip-Boy, just like yours." [DIAL:01012A30]

text_content: I can play his voice, yes. I have an audio log from him on my Pip-Boy.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic075 "I can play his voice, yes. I have an audio log from him on my Pip-Boy." [DIAL:01012A31]

text_content: {Pauses}You... {snarling}don't play it. {Snarls}If you do, I'll find a way to get out of the cage, end you. I'll murder you, crush your arms and legs until...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic075 "I can play his voice, yes. I have an audio log from him on my Pip-Boy." [DIAL:01012A31]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: If he hears the Old Man's voice, he'll do what the Old Man says.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic074 "If he hears the Old Man's voice, he'll do what the Old Man says." [DIAL:01012A32]

text_content: {Suspicious}Dog... obeys. Yes. {Wary, this was unexpected}Why... do you have some means of contacting the Old Man?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic074 "If he hears the Old Man's voice, he'll do what the Old Man says." [DIAL:01012A32]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Do you want to die? Cooperate, or you're both dead.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic073 "Do you want to die? Cooperate, or you're both dead." [DIAL:01012A33]

text_content: I could just tell Dog he has the key.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic070 "I could just tell Dog he has the key." [DIAL:01012A36]

text_content: {Frowns, slightly hesitant}Yes... you could. {Recovers}And once he was out, all starving and hungry... what do you think he would do then?|{Warning}Be careful what cage you open, because he won't go back in it without a fight. He'll tear you apart, he won't care if it kills you both.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic070 "I could just tell Dog he has the key." [DIAL:01012A36]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: The key's in there with you - and Dog.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic069 "The key's in there with you - and Dog." [DIAL:01012A37]

text_content: {Cruel, laughing}Yes, but Dog doesn't know that. We don't share everything. Sometimes it's a blessing... sometimes... it causes difficulties.|Now I think it's a blessing, it keeps you on that side of the cage. Now... you go fetch. Find your master, bring him here so we can talk.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic069 "The key's in there with you - and Dog." [DIAL:01012A37]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: I could order Dog to come with me. I bet he'd obey.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic068 "I could order Dog to come with me. I bet he'd obey." [DIAL:01012A38]

text_content: {Laughs}Dog? You're not talking to him now, are you? No, even if you could drag Dog out of his cage, you still couldn't get him out of {emph}this cage.|{Smug}I put him here for a reason... if he could have escaped, he would have. So here he stays.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic068 "I could order Dog to come with me. I bet he'd obey." [DIAL:01012A38]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: If you don't come with me, he'll set off our collars - yours and mine.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic067 "If you don't come with me, he'll set off our collars - yours and mine." [DIAL:01012A39]

text_content: Then I still win. I'd rather die in this cell than have Dog follow him any longer, follow his orders, his commands, desperate for recognition.|The Old Man... he has the need to hold on, to the past, to the Madre... I'd rather be free, let go of this shell, than have it cage me any longer.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic067 "If you don't come with me, he'll set off our collars - yours and mine." [DIAL:01012A39]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Why did you surround yourself with all these radios?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic066 "Why did you surround yourself with all these radios?" [DIAL:01012A3A]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] They were here when I arrived... so I made use of them, in a manner of speaking. More their... voices, really.|These collars... they don't just track us. You can eavesdrop on them as well. Tune to a frequency, and you can hear everything someone is saying.|{Slightly amused}So perhaps it's a good thing that Dog swallowed his collar. Anyone listening would find it difficult to hear past the... digestion.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic066 "Why did you surround yourself with all these radios?" [DIAL:01012A3A]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: [FAILED] I was afraid Dog would get lonely. The voices, as static and whispering as they are... are still company.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic066 "Why did you surround yourself with all these radios?" [DIAL:01012A3A]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: So... you're locked in there? Where's the key?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic000 "So... you're locked in there? Where's the key?" [DIAL:01012A3B]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] The key? Why it's the Old Man, the one who brought us here.|I hid the key on me so Dog wouldn't know... I just need the Old Man to show up, so he and I can talk.|If Dog was in control when the Old Man appeared... well, he would just do whatever he commanded, as always. And I can't have that.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic000 "So... you're locked in there? Where's the key?" [DIAL:01012A3B]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: [FAILED] It's close, safe, as you know.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic000 "So... you're locked in there? Where's the key?" [DIAL:01012A3B]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: [FAILED] It's close, safe. I did lock myself in, after all.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic000 "So... you're locked in there? Where's the key?" [DIAL:01012A3B]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Wait. So you... or Dog... doesn't know the key is on him?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic064 "Wait. So you... or Dog... doesn't know the key is on him?" [DIAL:01012A3D]

text_content: {Sarcastic}Dog and I don't share... everything. What {emph}I know, {emph}he doesn't.|What he knows... what little he knows... I don't. For example, your arrival is a surprise. I wished {emph}that I could have remembered, I'm sure Dog knew.|{To himself, angry}And when he's feeding, well... I sometimes have to find out about it later. Now all there is to do is wait for my intended guest.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic064 "Wait. So you... or Dog... doesn't know the key is on him?" [DIAL:01012A3D]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: If you locked him... you... in, what if you couldn't get out?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic063 "If you locked him... you... in, what if you couldn't get out?" [DIAL:01012A3E]

text_content: {Malicious, slightly smug}Oh, I have the key, always did. {Disgusted}Hid it on the chain behind my neck before Dog came bursting out, eating everything he could.|Wanted to make sure whoever came to fetch Dog spoke to {emph}me first, got within reach. Instead... I get you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic063 "If you locked him... you... in, what if you couldn't get out?" [DIAL:01012A3E]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: So why did you bring me here?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic062 "So why did you bring me here?" [DIAL:01012A3F]

text_content: What is he doing here?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic061 "What is he doing here?" [DIAL:01012A40]

text_content: {Taunting}Heard the call of the Sierra Madre, just like you did... {emph}exactly the same way.|{Slow, reflective here}Finds out it's more than a story, {sarcasm bleeds in}comes to this shining poisonous grail, this jewel of the desert.|{Anger comes back}Dog knows him more than I do. Dog's always nodding, always obeying him, because he's weak and hungry and greedy for master's affection.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic061 "What is he doing here?" [DIAL:01012A40]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Scorched by the sun?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic060 "Scorched by the sun?" [DIAL:01012A41]

text_content: {More reflective than normal, not malicious}The Old Man... this "Elijah," tried to hold the sun in his hands, arrogance, was cast down for it. Icarus' crime was to fly too high, Elijah...|{Anger comes back}Elijah wanted to bring the sun down to {emph}him. Hnh! {Snorts}Arrogance.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic060 "Scorched by the sun?" [DIAL:01012A41]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: No idea, I was unconscious the whole time.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic058 "No idea, I was unconscious the whole time." [DIAL:01012A43]

text_content: I don't remember, only woke up when my Pip-Boy went active.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic057 "I don't remember, only woke up when my Pip-Boy went active." [DIAL:01012A44]

text_content: {Thinking}Must have already been in the cage... already had the collar in me. You're lucky Dog didn't devour you... otherwise, we'd be closer than we are now.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic057 "I don't remember, only woke up when my Pip-Boy went active." [DIAL:01012A44]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Why do you say that?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic056 "Why do you say that?" [DIAL:01012A45]

text_content: I don't remember you... that isn't surprising. What is... is that it was when Dog was out of his cage... free, hungry.|He knows not to eat anything he catches in the traps... after that, however... so he dragged you here, you got spared.|{Thinking}Dog must have fed {emph}after you arrived... once he was fed, that allowed me out of the cage, and put him inside. {Beat, curious}Do you remember how long you were out?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic056 "Why do you say that?" [DIAL:01012A45]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: So you know the way back?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic055 "So you know the way back?" [DIAL:01012A46]

text_content: The way back doesn't matter... try to leave, try to disobey, and your collar ends the journey faster than you can say, "begin again."|You're clever, you'd be able to find a way back if you left the Villa. Dog can... I can find the way back, if "back" is where I even wanted to go.|Until the Old Man lets you go, you're going nowhere. This beautiful paradise, with all its toxins and death... it's home.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic055 "So you know the way back?" [DIAL:01012A46]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: You brought me here to the Villa.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic053 "You brought me here to the Villa." [DIAL:01012A48]

text_content: Me? You think I want to haul bodies around the wastes like a Brahmin at the whip? {Snarling, spitting}No, Dog does it, when the Old Man says fetch, Dog fetches.|You were in a man-trap, and Dog made his rounds, and dragged you here. When, I don't know. But... it must have been... recent. Before the cage.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic053 "You brought me here to the Villa." [DIAL:01012A48]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: This Old Man, what do you know about him?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic052 "This Old Man, what do you know about him?" [DIAL:01012A49]

text_content: Elijah. Human, weak like all of you are. Feeling age circling him like starved dogs, howling for blood. |To me, he reeks of age and failure. And madness. {Beat}To me, he is simply the "Old Man." To Dog, he is "Master." His name, meaningless.|Running out of years, hopes and dreams running through his withered hands like sand from the Big Empty... and scorched by the sun.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic052 "This Old Man, what do you know about him?" [DIAL:01012A49]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Why do you say I'm the same as the Old Man?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic051 "Why do you say I'm the same as the Old Man?" [DIAL:01012A4A]

text_content: {Disgust, player doesn't get it}You're not him anymore than I'm Dog. But that collar around your neck...|...you're an extension of the Old Man's grasp, clumsy, perhaps, but a tool, yes. And once you get acclimated to the Sierra Madre...|...then you'll feel the same overpowering hunger the Old Man does. And then you'll {emph}be him, not just his hand.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic051 "Why do you say I'm the same as the Old Man?" [DIAL:01012A4A]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Do you know how I got here?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic050 "Do you know how I got here?" [DIAL:01012A4B]

text_content: {Amused}Of course I know. {Snarling}Even if I don't see it happen - down in the cage, I hear echoes of the footfalls, the click of the collars.|{Furious}Every time I see one of you, I know exactly how you got here - you couldn't help yourselves, anymore than Dog can help himself.|{Accusing}You heard the voice, the promise, and then you walked right into one of the Old Man's traps. Then... then Dog comes for you, drags you here.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic050 "Do you know how I got here?" [DIAL:01012A4B]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Forget it. I had other questions.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic049 "Forget it. I had other questions." [DIAL:01012A4C]

text_content: Maybe you shouldn't go around shoving Old World tech in your stomach.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic048 "Maybe you shouldn't go around shoving Old World tech in your stomach." [DIAL:01012A4D]

text_content: {Sneers}As if I had a choice. Sometimes instinct takes over, and that's when {emph}I go into the cage. {Beat, superior}It's like curiosity that way.|{Taunting}After all, you wouldn't have put that collar on by choice... perhaps it was {emph}your curiosity that caused that hand to close on your neck.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic048 "Maybe you shouldn't go around shoving Old World tech in your stomach." [DIAL:01012A4D]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: How the hell did you... or whoever... eat one of these collars?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic047 "How the hell did you... or whoever... eat one of these collars?" [DIAL:01012A4E]

text_content: {Frowns}They... detach. When segmented, they look like nothing more than metallic Radscorpions... and if they're attached to neck flesh, warm, red... |{Angry}Dog doesn't {emph}care what's on the body he's crushing in his hands, he'll mangle it, twist it, make it fit until he's full.|{Quiet}Dog can't help himself... hungry... greedy. And now the collar's inside, alive again. And we're trapped here until it goes cold.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic047 "How the hell did you... or whoever... eat one of these collars?" [DIAL:01012A4E]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: If that collar inside you is active, I didn't switch it on.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic046 "If that collar inside you is active, I didn't switch it on." [DIAL:01012A4F]

text_content: {Suspicious}Really. Yet it led you here, to me. And now you're here, and it's burning a hole in my guts. Maybe it's crying for its owner.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic046 "If that collar inside you is active, I didn't switch it on." [DIAL:01012A4F]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: If you weren't expecting me, who were you waiting for?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic045 "If you weren't expecting me, who were you waiting for?" [DIAL:01012A50]

text_content: Don't play stupid, I already have to mind {emph}one child. {Beat}You {emph}must have figured it out by now.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic045 "If you weren't expecting me, who were you waiting for?" [DIAL:01012A50]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {To himself}The Old Man obsessed with the Sierra Madre... riddled with greed. {Beat, predatory}Hoped you might be him when I woke up. All you are is his hand...|...you're the same kind of greed. Followed the radio, the broadcast, and now you're here, all confused. Not for long. You'll figure it out.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic045 "If you weren't expecting me, who were you waiting for?" [DIAL:01012A50]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: I need to get you out of there.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic044 "I need to get you out of there." [DIAL:01012A51]

text_content: No... no, I don't think so. Even in here, I have more control than you do.|I'm not leaving until the one who controls the collars shows... not his voice, not his hand, not his lackey... him.|And when he comes to see me, we'll settle things. So go on, go back to your master, tell him I'm waiting for him. Dog may follow him - I won't.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic044 "I need to get you out of there." [DIAL:01012A51]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Why did you lock yourself in the cage?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic043 "Why did you lock yourself in the cage?" [DIAL:01012A52]

text_content: No... why did {emph}I lock him in the cage. {Beat, malicious}I locked him in because I could feel him... getting hungry again. There wasn't much time.|If Dog roams, he gets into trouble... eats things he shouldn't, listens to others he shouldn't... so he's safer in here. We're safer in here.|I hoped if I locked him in here... the one he obeys would come for him. {Disgust}Instead, I get you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic043 "Why did you lock yourself in the cage?" [DIAL:01012A52]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: I was looking for someone with a collar like mine. Where is your collar?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic042 "I was looking for someone with a collar like mine. Where is your collar?" [DIAL:01012A53]

text_content: {Angry}It's close. Closer than I'd like... {frustrated}Dog's been into things, needs to think before he eats, chew before he swallows. He's... eager that way.|Now the collar's a part of me. Inside. {Slow, feeling it in his gut}I can feel its electronic heartbeat, clicking and burning down below... {thinking}like before.|{Suspicious}It was cold and heavy before going in the cage... {suspicious}now you're here, and it's pulling and kicking again, tugging like a leash. Interesting.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic042 "I was looking for someone with a collar like mine. Where is your collar?" [DIAL:01012A53]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: I can't leave until we get through this.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic054 "I can't leave until we get through this." [DIAL:01012A8D]

text_content: Of course you can't. This cage is locked tight... from you and the Old Man.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic054 "I can't leave until we get through this." [DIAL:01012A8D]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Sounds like Dog might be more willing to get out of the cage than you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic005 "Sounds like Dog might be more willing to get out of the cage than you." [DIAL:01012A8E]

text_content: Something tells me I could walk Dog through unlocking a door.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic065 "Something tells me I could walk Dog through unlocking a door." [DIAL:01012A91]

text_content: So Dog could just open the door at any time?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic059 "So Dog could just open the door at any time?" [DIAL:01012A92]

text_content: Wait, the casino already opened?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic063 "Wait, the casino already opened?" [DIAL:01012A9F]

text_content: So the Gala Event was triggered at least once?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic084 "So the Gala Event was triggered at least once?" [DIAL:01012AA0]

text_content: Uh-huh. Master ordered it. "Take places." Then... {frowns}Master went away. {Starts getting quieter}Left Dog... Dog in cage.|Casino open long time ago, not sure when... voice keeps putting Dog in cage. Haven't seen Master since, only hear voice on your arm and from walls.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic084 "So the Gala Event was triggered at least once?" [DIAL:01012AA0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Um... do you want to talk about it?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic062 "Um... do you want to talk about it?" [DIAL:01012AA1]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Slightly wary, warming up}The lights were pretty. In the sky. Pointed at casino. {Beat, like wonder}And the casino opened up.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic062 "Um... do you want to talk about it?" [DIAL:01012AA1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: [FAILED] {Clams up}Uh-uh. Dog... Dog wants to stop talking now.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic062 "Um... do you want to talk about it?" [DIAL:01012AA1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: This is important - do you remember what happened exactly?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic060 "This is important - do you remember what happened exactly?" [DIAL:01012AA2]

text_content: {Clams up, quiet}Dog can't remember. {Beat, quiet}Don't want to go, can't make him stay there.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic060 "This is important - do you remember what happened exactly?" [DIAL:01012AA2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Dog, do you know why you have to go to the position on this map?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic059 "Dog, do you know why you have to go to the position on this map?" [DIAL:01012AA3]

text_content: We need to get you to the Gala Event. Get you to your place.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic003 "We need to get you to the Gala Event. Get you to your place." [DIAL:01012AA4]

text_content: Dog... Dog has heard that before. Was there pretty lights? {Frowns, gets a little more focused}There... were things to pull? Hard to pull, but Dog did. And... {quiet}a cage.|...and Dog was hungry there. Dog... {frowns}was someone else there, with Dog. Then... {pained, doesn't want to remember the girl's screams}then there was noise, then... lights... and streets... screamed.|...Dog doesn't want to go to cage. It's inside Dog now, Dog can see the cage, hear the noises. {Beat}The way to casino... it'll hurt you. Inside.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic003 "We need to get you to the Gala Event. Get you to your place." [DIAL:01012AA4]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: I guess... the alarm outside sure is a racket, though.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic082 "I guess... the alarm outside sure is a racket, though." [DIAL:01012AA5]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {DUPE}Very good. Yes... it's another layer of white noise to ensure privacy. Unfortunately, it's also acted as a dinner bell for the residents.|As long as the holographic greeter outside is active, however, I can get by them... the Holograms fascinate them. Ghost-worship, perhaps.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic082 "I guess... the alarm outside sure is a racket, though." [DIAL:01012AA5]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: [FAILED] {DUPE}Yes... interesting that. {To himself, irritated by Ghost People outside}More like a dinner bell to some.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic082 "I guess... the alarm outside sure is a racket, though." [DIAL:01012AA5]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: <Play Elijah Audio Tape.>
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic072 "<Play Elijah Audio Tape.>" [DIAL:01012AA6]

text_content: If I can't prove it to you, then forget this, I'm bringing Dog out.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic071 "If I can't prove it to you, then forget this, I'm bringing Dog out." [DIAL:01012AA7]

text_content: {Dog}That's enough for now.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic090 "{Dog}That's enough for now." [DIAL:01012AB9]

text_content: Hnnh-hnn.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic090 "{Dog}That's enough for now." [DIAL:01012AB9]

text_content: {Nods}Yes, Master.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic090 "{Dog}That's enough for now." [DIAL:01012AB9]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Nods}Nnnh-Hnnn.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic090 "{Dog}That's enough for now." [DIAL:01012AB9]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: I need you to stay here and trigger the switches.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic089 "I need you to stay here and trigger the switches." [DIAL:01012ABA]

text_content: {Complaining}Dog doesn't understand... {to himself}too hungry, hard to hear words... {slightly petulant and evil here}Master, when can Dog {emph}feed.|{Quiet, this is a little creepy in its hopefulness}If Dog was fed like last time, Dog would listen. If the feeding was quiet.|{Slightly fearful}Maybe voice could make Dog stay, Dog not want to be in cage, Dog want to be free, find Master.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic089 "I need you to stay here and trigger the switches." [DIAL:01012ABA]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Snarling, clutching ears at start after unpleasant noise}Nnnh... getting tired of hearing your orders. {Slow, appraising his health}Dog's clawing at the cage, hungrier than usual.|{Narrows eyes, suspicious}You must {emph}need something, I can see it in your eyes. {Glancing around}The Gala... of course. How could I forget?|{Slow, taunting}If you want me to... heel... if you want Dog to obey, then he'll need to be fed, {beat, a little quieter, not happy about what happened}like last time.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic089 "I need you to stay here and trigger the switches." [DIAL:01012ABA]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Those scars on your body - where did you get them?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic088 "Those scars on your body - where did you get them?" [DIAL:01012ABB]

text_content: {Shrugs, a little sad/sheepish}Hurt self. Hurt makes the voice go away... it doesn't like pain.|{Pissed}Dog doesn't like pain, either, but keeps voice quiet, so Dog will hurt self until voice dies. Dog hurt self enough, voice go away, never come back.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic088 "Those scars on your body - where did you get them?" [DIAL:01012ABB]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Can you tell me how you got to the Sierra Madre?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic087 "Can you tell me how you got to the Sierra Madre?" [DIAL:01012ABC]

text_content: {Confused}Here? Followed voice in air, then here... here as long as can remember. {Hushes voice a bit}Don't like this place... hard to find things to eat sometimes.|{To himself}Better than the cage. {Frowns, petulant/angry}Dog doesn't {emph}like being locked up. Voice in air didn't say anything about a cage and nothing to eat.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic087 "Can you tell me how you got to the Sierra Madre?" [DIAL:01012ABC]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Do you know how to wake him up?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic109 "Do you know how to wake him up?" [DIAL:01012AC2]

text_content: Sometimes when Dog gets tired. Or eats too much, gets full. Sometimes... {frowns}when Dog goes to the cage... then voice wakes up.|{Getting irritated, pissed}The voice locks Dog in when it comes up, always trying to keep Dog from food. Voice did it at the cage where you found me. {Happy, draw this out}Then Master came.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic109 "Do you know how to wake him up?" [DIAL:01012AC2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: What's the other voice?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic108 "What's the other voice?" [DIAL:01012AC3]

text_content: {Hushed}Other voice... don't wake him up. When voice wakes up, Dog goes to sleep and voice climbs up in Dog's head.|{To himself}The voice puts Dog in places... puts him in cages and locks him in.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic108 "What's the other voice?" [DIAL:01012AC3]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Where's your collar?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic107 "Where's your collar?" [DIAL:01012AC4]

text_content: {Quiet, bad dog}Lost it. Got hungry. {Beat}Made the other voice mad, madder than it ever was, mad enough to lock Dog up.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic107 "Where's your collar?" [DIAL:01012AC4]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: I want to hear more about the Master.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic106 "I want to hear more about the Master." [DIAL:01012AC5]

text_content: {Brightening up}He takes care of Dog. He tells Dog what to do. Told Dog to come here, put collars on people.|Sometimes people fight. Dog holds them until they go quiet, don't make any noise. {Beat}If collars don't fit or go too quiet... {shrugs}find others for Master.|{Strangely intense}Master makes the other voice go away - the other voice hates Master, Dog can feel it. Master's voice is like pain, protects Dog.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic106 "I want to hear more about the Master." [DIAL:01012AC5]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Sounds like good trade.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic105 "Sounds like good trade." [DIAL:01012AC6]

text_content: {Pleased, agreeing with player here}Master always feed Dog if not in cage. Master lets Dog do what Dog wants. {Grumbling}Not like other voice in cage. Always mad with Dog, shouting at him.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic105 "Sounds like good trade." [DIAL:01012AC6]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Where does the voice come from?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic104 "Where does the voice come from?" [DIAL:01012AC7]

text_content: {Slight anger, frustration}Don't know where other voice come from. Wish would go away. Always trying to stop Dog, caging Dog.|{Thinking}Voice started talking not long ago, Dog think... was always there. Start talking when Master showed up? {Irritated}Making Dog sleep, go to cage.|Voice hates Master. It okay... {Curious}voice {emph}always hide when Master around, go quiet, watch Master as he does things. Voice scared of Master, Dog thinks.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic104 "Where does the voice come from?" [DIAL:01012AC7]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Sound nice. It still there?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic103 "Sound nice. It still there?" [DIAL:01012AC8]

text_content: Where Church now?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic102 "Where Church now?" [DIAL:01012AC9]

text_content: Maybe you go back someday.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic101 "Maybe you go back someday." [DIAL:01012ACA]

text_content: All gone. {Beat, a little sadder}All gone. {Beat, slightly stronger}It better now that found {emph}new Master.|{Slightly evil}New Master tells Dog what to do, rewards Dog, like old Master. Dog goes get people, drag them here... like vat. Dog knows how to do that.|{Deliver this gruesomely}If people fight, Dog hit them until they stop. And if more than one, Dog can eat them, so Dog hunts hard for as {emph}many as he can find.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic101 "Maybe you go back someday." [DIAL:01012ACA]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Must been hard to see you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic100 "Must been hard to see you." [DIAL:01012ACB]

text_content: Why you want to look like ground?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic099 "Why you want to look like ground?" [DIAL:01012ACC]

text_content: When put it on, hard to see. Hard to see... Dog was told not to be seen then. Same as now, except different.|Dog and others... had to hide in Base. And Church. The Master was there. Master was... {frowns}spoke like many people. Smart. Like Lou-Lieutenant.|{Remembering back, slight tender}Dog misses the Church. {Beat}When got dark, no people, Dog could sit on floor and look up at ceiling. {Beat}Could... take off wrist-collar then.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic099 "Why you want to look like ground?" [DIAL:01012ACC]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Nuh-uh!
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic098 "Nuh-uh!" [DIAL:01012ACD]

text_content: {Nods}Is true. Dog wore it right on his hand, where bear trap is now... he thinks.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic098 "Nuh-uh!" [DIAL:01012ACD]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {God}I had other questions for you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic038 "{God}I had other questions for you." [DIAL:01012ACE]

text_content: {Irritated}More? Don't push your luck.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic038 "{God}I had other questions for you." [DIAL:01012ACE]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Malicious, taunting}You're a brave one. Sure you're ready for the answers?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic038 "{God}I had other questions for you." [DIAL:01012ACE]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: What do you eat?
