name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic097 "What do you eat?" [DIAL:01012ACF]

text_content: {Eager}Dog eats whatever he can catch. Sometimes they run, but Dog is strong, moves fast.|{Sad}Sometimes... makes voice mad when I eat... {brightens up, "but..."}Master doesn't mind.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic097 "What do you eat?" [DIAL:01012ACF]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Voice in the air?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic096 "Voice in the air?" [DIAL:01012AD0]

text_content: {Frowns, getting complicated}Dog hears many voices... one in air. {Scared, thinking about God}The... other one. {Brightens up a bit}And Master. Master is the nicest. {Frowns}Gets mean, mad sometimes. But lets Dog feed.|Master was quiet for a long time until Dog heard him on your arm... {frowns, confused}did you eat him? {Sympathizes with player for eating a human being}Dog gets hungry, too. {Quiet}Being hungry makes the voice... mad.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic096 "Voice in the air?" [DIAL:01012AD0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Don't like it here, either.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic095 "Don't like it here, either." [DIAL:01012AD1]

text_content: Me hear voice, too? Then got here, bad place.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic094 "Me hear voice, too? Then got here, bad place." [DIAL:01012AD2]

text_content: {Nods gravely}Dog trapped here, too. This place not like West. Air like copper wire. Gut heavy, hurts, beeps sometimes.|Back West... in bone cities... {Beat, slight wonder}Dog wore a collar on wrist, turned him into color of ground, turned him into color of sky.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic094 "Me hear voice, too? Then got here, bad place." [DIAL:01012AD2]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: {Dog}I had other questions for you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic093 "{Dog}I had other questions for you." [DIAL:01012AD3]

text_content: Dog is getting tired, Master. {Grumbling, slight threat}When can Dog eat?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic093 "{Dog}I had other questions for you." [DIAL:01012AD3]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Too much talking makes Dog's head hurt. {Beat}Getting hungry.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic093 "{Dog}I had other questions for you." [DIAL:01012AD3]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Can you tell me about the voice?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic092 "Can you tell me about the voice?" [DIAL:01012AD4]

text_content: Your name is carved on your chest. Is that part of it?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic091 "Your name is carved on your chest. Is that part of it?" [DIAL:01012AD5]

text_content: Yes... {frowns}no... don't know what the word means, everyone says the same, except the voice. {Hushed, frightened}The voice says it backward.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic091 "Your name is carved on your chest. Is that part of it?" [DIAL:01012AD5]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Is that why you have a bear trap locked on your arm?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic086 "Is that why you have a bear trap locked on your arm?" [DIAL:01012AD6]

text_content: Dog put his hand in it, hurts. Made the voice go away, now can't get it off. Don't want it off, hurt keeps voice sleeping... {angrier, yet pleased}bleeding.|{Confiding in player}It also keeps {emph}others quiet, too. Dog hits them with metal bear teeth until their voices stop, makes Master's voice come back.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic086 "Is that why you have a bear trap locked on your arm?" [DIAL:01012AD6]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: <Lie> Just... stay here in the courtyard, I'll go get food.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic037 "<Lie> Just... stay here in the courtyard, I'll go get food." [DIAL:01012AD7]

text_content: {Suspicious}All right... for a moment there, I thought... hnh. I'll wait here then, come back when you've found a carcass. Or three.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic037 "<Lie> Just... stay here in the courtyard, I'll go get food." [DIAL:01012AD7]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: If I bring food, will that calm Dog down?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic036 "If I bring food, will that calm Dog down?" [DIAL:01012AD8]

text_content: It always does... makes him sleepier. Weaker. Easier to keep out of trouble. As for the type of food...|Make sure it isn't struggling, if you can. {To himself, rueful, irritated}It's hard enough to choke down half of what I suspect he eats. And make sure it's not a bomb collar.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic036 "If I bring food, will that calm Dog down?" [DIAL:01012AD8]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Yeah, well, I'll make Dog help me. Can't be hard to figure all this wire stuff out.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic035 "Yeah, well, I'll make Dog help me. Can't be hard to figure all this wire stuff out." [DIAL:01012AD9]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Getting really angry}You think you can figure out what to... {quieter, studying the player, slightly respectful}hnh. Of course you can.|{Resolved}I'll stand at my post. {Then threat comes out}Once you trigger the event... well, we'll see who makes it to the Sierra Madre.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic035 "Yeah, well, I'll make Dog help me. Can't be hard to figure all this wire stuff out." [DIAL:01012AD9]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: [FAILED] No... you can barely give me instructions, let alone order Dog. Bark your orders somewhere else.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic035 "Yeah, well, I'll make Dog help me. Can't be hard to figure all this wire stuff out." [DIAL:01012AD9]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Have orders for you - for going, staying, all that.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic006 "Have orders for you - for going, staying, all that." [DIAL:01012AF1]

text_content: {Nods}Dog is listening.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic006 "Have orders for you - for going, staying, all that." [DIAL:01012AF1]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: The Master sounds like he treats you well.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic065 "The Master sounds like he treats you well." [DIAL:01012AF6]

text_content: Could I find my way back?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic064 "Could I find my way back?" [DIAL:01012AF7]

text_content: Maybe. Not sure you could find way back once leave. Dog has to smell and hunt for path back here sometimes... {frowns}Cloud keep moving.|It okay... no one {emph}ever leave except Dog... and Dog not want to leave. {Beat, drops this more like threat}You here until Master lets you go.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic064 "Could I find my way back?" [DIAL:01012AF7]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Do you know the way back?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic043 "Do you know the way back?" [DIAL:01012AF8]

text_content: Might find way back if Master lets you go. If he not want you to go, he makes head red spray. {Thinking, to himself}Then Dog has to find another one.|{Confused, never thought about anyone leaving before}To leave...? Go through gate, walk. Hard to find way, Dog can do it, too hard for most to come here. {It's why...}Why so quiet in streets.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic043 "Do you know the way back?" [DIAL:01012AF8]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Did you bring me here?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic042 "Did you bring me here?" [DIAL:01012AF9]

text_content: {Affirmative}Dog fetches. Dragged you here... Dog thinks. You not struggle like others. Trap makes you sleep, make your voice go to cage.|Dog doing what he was told. Tried to catch as many as he can, can eat the others.|No eat you, though. Master talk through you, like voice inside Dog. {Beat}Dog missed hearing Master, not hear Master for long time.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic042 "Did you bring me here?" [DIAL:01012AF9]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Can you tell me about the other voice inside you?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic041 "Can you tell me about the other voice inside you?" [DIAL:01012AFA]

text_content: Can you tell me more about the Gala Event going off?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic040 "Can you tell me more about the Gala Event going off?" [DIAL:01012AFB]

text_content: Do you know how long ago?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic036 "Do you know how long ago?" [DIAL:01012AFC]

text_content: If the casino already opened, what are we doing here?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic033 "If the casino already opened, what are we doing here?" [DIAL:01012AFD]

text_content: {Shrugs}Don't know. {Beat}Dog keep bringing people here.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic033 "If the casino already opened, what are we doing here?" [DIAL:01012AFD]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: So Master vanished around that time.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic031 "So Master vanished around that time." [DIAL:01012AFE]

text_content: {Nods}Master went away until you show up with him on your arm.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic031 "So Master vanished around that time." [DIAL:01012AFE]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Dog, do you know why you have to go to the position on the map?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic029 "Dog, do you know why you have to go to the position on the map?" [DIAL:01012AFF]

text_content: {Confused}Hard to pull things...? Dog has to pull very, very hard to... {beat, slow fear/curious}are we going there?|Dog not want to stay and pull things... hard to do... {quieter}and cage there.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic029 "Dog, do you know why you have to go to the position on the map?" [DIAL:01012AFF]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: What does Dog know?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic101 "What does Dog know?" [DIAL:01012B0A]

text_content: {Snarl}Ask him. Or better, don't. It wouldn't be an interesting conversation, much like this one.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic101 "What does Dog know?" [DIAL:01012B0A]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: What's Elijah doing here?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic100 "What's Elijah doing here?" [DIAL:01012B0B]

text_content: {Taunting}Heard the call of the Sierra Madre, just like you did... {emph}exactly the same way.|{Slow, reflective here}Finds out it's more than a story, {sarcasm bleeds in}comes to this shining poisonous grail, this jewel of the desert.|{Anger comes back}Dog knows him more than I do. Dog's always nodding, always obeying him, because he's weak and hungry and greedy for master's affection.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic100 "What's Elijah doing here?" [DIAL:01012B0B]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: I want to know more about the man who brought us here.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic099 "I want to know more about the man who brought us here." [DIAL:01012B0C]

text_content: {Global}Where is your collar?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic098 "{Global}Where is your collar?" [DIAL:01012B0D]

text_content: {Global}Did getting hit in the head cause you to start acting this way?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic097 "{Global}Did getting hit in the head cause you to start acting this way?" [DIAL:01012B0E]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {DUPE: Slightly wary, player's onto something}Trauma... yes, in a manner of speaking.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic097 "{Global}Did getting hit in the head cause you to start acting this way?" [DIAL:01012B0E]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: [FAILED] {DUPE: Taunting, playing games}No... sometimes it simply wakes voices up.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic097 "{Global}Did getting hit in the head cause you to start acting this way?" [DIAL:01012B0E]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Why can't you control him?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic096 "Why can't you control him?" [DIAL:01012B0F]

text_content: The instinct is stronger than me. Dog is stronger than me. He's just a child... he knows when he does wrong, he just can't help himself.|I don't know when I first spoke, or when I first started thinking for myself, it was so long ago. I... slept for a long time... before...|...I want to believe I was the one in control. Once. I don't know anymore. Then Dog got a new Master. A new voice. And I woke up, to protect him.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic096 "Why can't you control him?" [DIAL:01012B0F]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: You care about him.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic095 "You care about him." [DIAL:01012B10]

text_content: He's my brother - kin. Without him, I wouldn't exist. Maybe I was nothing more than his conscience, trying to rein him in. Useless.|I... I just need him to show restraint, let go of the needs, the hungers. Ease the burden... just once, so I can have my thoughts to myself.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic095 "You care about him." [DIAL:01012B10]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Does not being in control bother you so much?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic094 "Does not being in control bother you so much?" [DIAL:01012B11]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Starts weakening here, tired}I've watched over Dog for so long. Tried to stop him from... hurting others, killing others, {frustrated anger}quiet that mindless howling instinct of his.|He doesn't understand, he has the brain of a child... he knows when he does wrong, he just can't help himself.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic094 "Does not being in control bother you so much?" [DIAL:01012B11]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: [FAILED] No... because all I need to do is bide my time. I'll settle this... myself, as I always planned.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic094 "Does not being in control bother you so much?" [DIAL:01012B11]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Can't you do anything?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic093 "Can't you do anything?" [DIAL:01012B12]

text_content: {Echoing, emph}Do anything? {Hurt and frustration coming through}Me... me, Dog puts in the cage, hurts himself to try and drown out my voice, when all I want to do... |...aah... hrrr, never mind, useless. Finally had to start fighting back, screaming on my own. Had to take matters into my own hands, lock Dog up.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic093 "Can't you do anything?" [DIAL:01012B12]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: What does Elijah make Dog do that angers you so much?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic092 "What does Elijah make Dog do that angers you so much?" [DIAL:01012B13]

text_content: Gather others, drag them here... fetch, like an animal... and hurt them if they resist. |Dog doesn't even blink, even hear their cries when he's twisted their arms full circle... fragile things, screaming on the ground...|To listen to him... commanding Dog... to hurt others... and Dog just nods, eager and willing to serve.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic092 "What does Elijah make Dog do that angers you so much?" [DIAL:01012B13]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Sounds like it makes you mad.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic091 "Sounds like it makes you mad." [DIAL:01012B14]

text_content: Mad? Mad doesn't even begin to describe... there's not a {emph}word for the hate I feel inside. It's consuming... twists every thought to red.|{Snarling}After all that's laid ruin to the world... again and again, I thought at last, we could be free... thought Dog could be free.|No... no, the world's always got another cage, waiting, keeping everything you want... just out of reach.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic091 "Sounds like it makes you mad." [DIAL:01012B14]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Well... true enough. Sure uses the word "Master" a lot.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic090 "Well... true enough. Sure uses the word ""Master"" a lot." [DIAL:01012B15]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Slow, thoughtful}The "Master" - Elijah... reminds Dog of someone from long ago. His leader, commander. Commanders.|The Master was a strong personality... personalities as well. Dog is slavish, was conditioned to serve the Master until death.|The Old Man... Elijah merely came along and opened that door in Dog's mind. Now Dog does whatever the Old Man wants.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic090 "Well... true enough. Sure uses the word ""Master"" a lot." [DIAL:01012B15]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: [FAILED] Habit. Conditioning. It doesn't matter.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic090 "Well... true enough. Sure uses the word ""Master"" a lot." [DIAL:01012B15]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Why does that make him go away?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic089 "Why does that make him go away?" [DIAL:01012B16]

text_content: Dog is afraid of me as long as {emph}the Master isn't around.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic089 "Why does that make him go away?" [DIAL:01012B16]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {God}We need to discuss tactics - and positioning.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic041 "{God}We need to discuss tactics - and positioning." [DIAL:01012B17]

text_content: {Low, threatening}Orders - for me. This should be good.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic041 "{God}We need to discuss tactics - and positioning." [DIAL:01012B17]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: How do you switch back and forth between voices?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic040 "How do you switch back and forth between voices?" [DIAL:01012B18]

text_content: All it takes is the right... command. Whenever Dog hears the... {corrects self}his Master giving orders, I go back in the cage.|So that leash on your wrist... and the one on your neck. {Beat}I won't truly be free to... express myself until every trace of that voice is destroyed.|Still... if you ever want to speak to me, bark my audio log at him, the one in the police station. That'll call me out.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic040 "How do you switch back and forth between voices?" [DIAL:01012B18]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: He can't have possibly have set up a deadman's switch like that.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic112 "He can't have possibly have set up a deadman's switch like that." [DIAL:01012B28]

text_content: Really. As much hatred as I hold for him, he is much, much smarter than many I've met... {sarcastic}no offense meant, of course.|He seems to not only understand the workings of Pre-War tech, he seems to breathe it. And... these collars, commandeering your Pip-Boy...|Are the marks of someone who makes mistakes - but he's not leaving much to chance when it comes to ensuring our compliance.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic112 "He can't have possibly have set up a deadman's switch like that." [DIAL:01012B28]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Then how are the collars active again?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic111 "Then how are the collars active again?" [DIAL:01012B29]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Interesting... so it seems you have another link we don't. And... you're to blame for this.|Yes... he wears a Pip-Boy on his wrist, just as you do. If he's feeding commands and signals, then I would be careful.|He's most likely installed a contingency switch in the Pip-Boy. If the signal gets cut off, or you try and remove it... well, then we'll all die.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic111 "Then how are the collars active again?" [DIAL:01012B29]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: [FAILED] That I don't know. The collars came back to life... I'm not sure how.|{Snarling, low}I felt it when you woke me up... that kicking in my gut, the collar was coiled with a charge again, like a snake.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic111 "Then how are the collars active again?" [DIAL:01012B29]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: What are you talking about?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic110 "What are you talking about?" [DIAL:01012B2A]

text_content: Ask Dog. It doesn't matter... it's in the past, as much as I try to forget it, it's always... with us.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic110 "What are you talking about?" [DIAL:01012B2A]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: So what happened then?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic109 "So what happened then?" [DIAL:01012B2B]

text_content: Dog happened. When the collars came off... he got... hungry. And all my work, all my effort... wasted because of his hunger, his greed.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic109 "So what happened then?" [DIAL:01012B2B]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Does the casino block the signal?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic108 "Does the casino block the signal?" [DIAL:01012B2C]

text_content: It {emph}should have... the casino's construction is unusual. Signals in there get... scrambled, some alloy in the architecture... I don't know.|I wasn't sure until the collars de-activated that I had won. Trapped him in his cage. Dog... {corrects self}I... could be free.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic108 "Does the casino block the signal?" [DIAL:01012B2C]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Couldn't he have commanded you to rescue him?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic107 "Couldn't he have commanded you to rescue him?" [DIAL:01012B2D]

text_content: No... I saw to that...
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic107 "Couldn't he have commanded you to rescue him?" [DIAL:01012B2D]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: If he got trapped, why didn't he set off the collars?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic106 "If he got trapped, why didn't he set off the collars?" [DIAL:01012B2E]

text_content: {Smiles}Because he couldn't. As soon as he made his way into the casino, it sealed up... |...and the casino's construction allowed me an opportunity to escape. The collars... unhooked. I... was free.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic106 "If he got trapped, why didn't he set off the collars?" [DIAL:01012B2E]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: If the casino opened up, then why are we here?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic105 "If the casino opened up, then why are we here?" [DIAL:01012B2F]

text_content: Because something got left inside. The Old Man... Elijah. |He's trapped in there. As I hoped he would be.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic105 "If the casino opened up, then why are we here?" [DIAL:01012B2F]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: He said the casino opened up.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic104 "He said the casino opened up." [DIAL:01012B30]

text_content: {Impressed}Very good. As for the casino... yes, it did.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic104 "He said the casino opened up." [DIAL:01012B30]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Something about lights and colors, not much else.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic103 "Something about lights and colors, not much else." [DIAL:01012B31]

text_content: {Sneers}There was more. Only he truly recalls, though... and should. I won't spoil it for you, especially when we have more... pressing matters.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic103 "Something about lights and colors, not much else." [DIAL:01012B31]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Dog said he triggered the Gala Event once already.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic102 "Dog said he triggered the Gala Event once already." [DIAL:01012B32]

text_content: {Amused}He did, yes. A team did, with collars linked just like yours. Did he tell you everything, or just about the pretty lights?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic102 "Dog said he triggered the Gala Event once already." [DIAL:01012B32]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Do you know anything else?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic039 "Do you know anything else?" [DIAL:01012B33]

text_content: Dog might know more, you should ask him. Beware the answer, because I think Dog got hungry, he couldn't help himself.|{Frustrated he couldn't keep his little brother out of trouble}I tried, I always try, and he... he keeps giving in.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic039 "Do you know anything else?" [DIAL:01012B33]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: What do you know about the Gala Event?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic010 "What do you know about the Gala Event?" [DIAL:01012B34]

text_content: {Snarls}The Gala Event is the way to bring the Old Man out. {Suspicious}He won't show himself until the casino doors are open.|So triggering the Event is key... and the key. The question becomes... can we trust each other to do this? We'll see.|If we go there, you'll have to give {emph}me control. If you bring Dog out, then... I'll make sure you pay in blood.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic010 "What do you know about the Gala Event?" [DIAL:01012B34]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Global}I heard electricity and radios can cause, uh, voices in people's heads.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic115 "{Global}I heard electricity and radios can cause, uh, voices in people's heads." [DIAL:01012B44]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {DUPE: Snarls}Hmm... Hrrr... That's the easy explanation, the one {emph}humans use. Pre-War technology, as if it's the cause of all ills, mind and body.|I {emph}needed to come out of the cage to protect Dog. {Disdain}From clever humans... like you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic115 "{Global}I heard electricity and radios can cause, uh, voices in people's heads." [DIAL:01012B44]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: [FAILED] {DUPE: Taunting, playing games}Perhaps. Or maybe I was here all the time, watching. Waiting for you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic115 "{Global}I heard electricity and radios can cause, uh, voices in people's heads." [DIAL:01012B44]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Any reason why you're assigned to this point on the map?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic114 "Any reason why you're assigned to this point on the map?" [DIAL:01012B45]

text_content: {Taunting}Maybe it's familiar, comfortable. Practice makes perfect.|And as much as it bruises my ego, some things require... brute strength. {Beat}In the right combination.|{Grumbling, to himself}Besides, none of your assembled band of thieves look able to rip a 200 year rusted power switch down like a machete to fire up an entire town.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic114 "Any reason why you're assigned to this point on the map?" [DIAL:01012B45]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: I don't know what you're talking about.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic147 "I don't know what you're talking about." [DIAL:01012B4D]

text_content: [She sighs silently, then shakes her head and motions to the West.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic147 "I don't know what you're talking about." [DIAL:01012B4D]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: I... can only type with two fingers?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic146 "I... can only type with two fingers?" [DIAL:01012B4E]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] [She slowly nods, looks impressed.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic146 "I... can only type with two fingers?" [DIAL:01012B4E]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: [FAILED] [She sighs silently, then shakes her head and motions to the West.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic146 "I... can only type with two fingers?" [DIAL:01012B4E]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Why do you think he wants you to go the Puesta del Sol Switching Station?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic145 "Why do you think he wants you to go the Puesta del Sol Switching Station?" [DIAL:01012B4F]

text_content: [She frowns, then makes a motion as if typing at keys... then she points at you, raises her left wrist and pantomimes talking into it.]|[She points at you, then her, looks right and left, raises two fingers, tries to type, pauses, and slowly shakes her head.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic145 "Why do you think he wants you to go the Puesta del Sol Switching Station?" [DIAL:01012B4F]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: You sure seem eager to go.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic144 "You sure seem eager to go." [DIAL:01012B50]

text_content: [She points at the Fountain, then at your Pip-Boy... pauses, then points at her collar, then yours.]|[She encircles her throat with her hand, then slowly releases it. Then she motions again to the West.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic144 "You sure seem eager to go." [DIAL:01012B50]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: <Wait.>
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic143 "<Wait.>" [DIAL:01012B51]

text_content: No worries, I'll just stand here like a piece of furniture until you're done.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic142 "No worries, I'll just stand here like a piece of furniture until you're done." [DIAL:01012B52]

text_content: Careful, that's my arm, all right?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic141 "Careful, that's my arm, all right?" [DIAL:01012B53]

text_content: [Her finger stabs through the red buttons, narrowing in on the local map. She scrolls to the Sierra Madre's main gate, frowns, backs out.]|[She calls up the local map of the Puesta del Sol Switching Station, zooms in. Her intent expression loses some of its edge as she notes the marker.]|[She looks up at you, points at marker on your Pip-Boy, points West and tilts her head.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic141 "Careful, that's my arm, all right?" [DIAL:01012B53]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: I had to get shot in the face for this. Get your own!
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic140 "I had to get shot in the face for this. Get your own!" [DIAL:01012B54]

text_content: I don't want you messing with this.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic138 "I don't want you messing with this." [DIAL:01012B56]

text_content: [Christine snarls, makes a dismissive wave, and goes back to studying the Fountain intently - then looks at the casino, then the Fountain again.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic138 "I don't want you messing with this." [DIAL:01012B56]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: What? What do you want?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic137 "What? What do you want?" [DIAL:01012B57]

text_content: [She frowns, and snaps her fingers at your Pip-Boy.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic137 "What? What do you want?" [DIAL:01012B57]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: No fucking way am I giving this to you.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic136 "No fucking way am I giving this to you." [DIAL:01012B58]

text_content: <Show her the Pip-Boy.>
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic135 "<Show her the Pip-Boy.>" [DIAL:01012B59]

text_content: [Christine studies the Pip-Boy intently, turning your arm around as if your wrist's a sensor module she just found.]|[She doesn't seem interested in the screen - she studies the exterior, then the casing. She seems to be making sure it's intact.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic135 "<Show her the Pip-Boy.>" [DIAL:01012B59]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: He leaves audio logs, too.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic134 "He leaves audio logs, too." [DIAL:01012B5A]

text_content: [Christine holds out her hand, and motions at your Pip-Boy.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic134 "He leaves audio logs, too." [DIAL:01012B5A]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: We need to trigger the event like he says.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic133 "We need to trigger the event like he says." [DIAL:01012B5B]

text_content: That's the hologram projector in the Fountain. What of it?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic065 "That's the hologram projector in the Fountain. What of it?" [DIAL:01012B5C]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] [She nods, and raises her hands, palms facing each other, then rotates in a 180 degree arc and back again.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic065 "That's the hologram projector in the Fountain. What of it?" [DIAL:01012B5C]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: [FAILED] [She rolls her eyes, opens her mouth to speak, then stops, her face tensing up in frustration.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic065 "That's the hologram projector in the Fountain. What of it?" [DIAL:01012B5C]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: What? What is it?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic004 "What? What is it?" [DIAL:01012B5D]

text_content: That's our captor. He likes giving orders.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic000 "That's our captor. He likes giving orders." [DIAL:01012B5E]

text_content: [She circles her finger around the Fountain and moves her fingers and thumb together rapidly, as if talking.]|[She frowns, stops moving her hand, then points at the Pip-Boy at your wrist.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic000 "That's our captor. He likes giving orders." [DIAL:01012B5E]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: You make a pretty lousy transmitter, you know.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic151 "You make a pretty lousy transmitter, you know." [DIAL:01012B6B]

text_content: [She glares at you. After a second, she pauses, and smiles slightly, shaking her head. She then makes a circle of the skyline with her finger.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic151 "You make a pretty lousy transmitter, you know." [DIAL:01012B6B]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: He'd have to be broadcasting from somewhere nearby.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic150 "He'd have to be broadcasting from somewhere nearby." [DIAL:01012B6C]

text_content: Think he might be close, then. Any idea where?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic149 "Think he might be close, then. Any idea where?" [DIAL:01012B6D]

text_content: [She surveys the area, focusing upwards. She glances at the casino, frowns. She then looks West, then East.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic149 "Think he might be close, then. Any idea where?" [DIAL:01012B6D]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: She's been broadcasting all this time?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic130 "She's been broadcasting all this time?" [DIAL:01012B74]

text_content: The bombs fell, and the emergency signal went out.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic129 "The bombs fell, and the emergency signal went out." [DIAL:01012B75]

text_content: So... it's not an invitation, it's a call for help.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic128 "So... it's not an invitation, it's a call for help." [DIAL:01012B76]

text_content: Yeah. The Sierra Madre's last song, one only a few people are ever going to hear. A little sad, but what can you do?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic128 "So... it's not an invitation, it's a call for help." [DIAL:01012B76]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: What do you mean about the Sierra Madre broadcast?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic127 "What do you mean about the Sierra Madre broadcast?" [DIAL:01012B77]

text_content: Well, Vera's beautiful voice doesn't run on casino power, exactly. Her broadcast is tied into the emergency broadcast signal for the Sierra Madre.|You know, in case of attack? Well, guess what - the night of the Gala Event, the emergency signal went out all right.|But because the broadcast had been hooked up to the Gala Event, instead of an emergency signal, you get Vera's voice on the radio. Great, huh?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic127 "What do you mean about the Sierra Madre broadcast?" [DIAL:01012B77]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Why would security shut down for the Gala?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic126 "Why would security shut down for the Gala?" [DIAL:01012B78]

text_content: How is the Gala tied to the casino? That makes no sense.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic125 "How is the Gala tied to the casino? That makes no sense." [DIAL:01012B79]

text_content: The Gala Event's tied into the casino's generators?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic124 "The Gala Event's tied into the casino's generators?" [DIAL:01012B7A]

text_content: {Frowns, remembers player doesn't know this}Right, look - so, not everything about the Villa was the pinnacle of bright ideas.|In order to pull off the Gala, old Sinclair had to get creative... the Sierra Madre announcement, for example. Not just for the casino, not at all.|The Gala's tied to the casino, draws on its power. Might cause it to reset itself, open the doors for a bit like it was supposed to.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic124 "The Gala Event's tied into the casino's generators?" [DIAL:01012B7A]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Any advice to getting through this?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic123 "Any advice to getting through this?" [DIAL:01012B7B]

text_content: Well... considering my life's on the line, too, yeah, a few things.|First off, keep everyone together. Keep checking behind you, make sure your partners are following... {emph}don't let them wander.|Also, don't go running crazy everywhere. Almost every inch of this town is lethal. So if you're not sure, take it real slow.|And speaking of slow, don't go shouting, or attracting attention. Go quiet. The Ghost People find you, it's over.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic123 "Any advice to getting through this?" [DIAL:01012B7B]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: What happened to the people who came to the Villa?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic122 "What happened to the people who came to the Villa?" [DIAL:01012B7C]

text_content: Dead. Either got killed by one of the Villa's attractions, locals, or the beautiful weather.|Can tell you right now - they didn't stick close to each other, and when they did, they let down their guard at the wrong moment.|Some left signposts to others, trying to help them out - just led to them getting killed by someone a little more greedy than they were.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic122 "What happened to the people who came to the Villa?" [DIAL:01012B7C]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: So the visitors all killed each other?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic121 "So the visitors all killed each other?" [DIAL:01012B7D]

text_content: Sure. First, they figure they can get out, escape. {Beat, slow, emph}Then they start thinking it over, start thinking about how they can have it all.|They start weighing the odds, taking risks... and then taking each other out. Bomb collars or not.|Although... it's odd, the bomb collars weren't linked before like they are now. Guess someone learned what the problem was.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic121 "So the visitors all killed each other?" [DIAL:01012B7D]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: I found some medical records in the Villa Clinic. You brought her in for treatment, right?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic120 "I found some medical records in the Villa Clinic. You brought her in for treatment, right?" [DIAL:01012B7E]

text_content: {Slight surprise}The Clinic? {Beat, a little wary}Yeah, I did bring her in. Before the Gala... well, before the first Gala Event. A few lifetimes ago.|She was a stress case, throat was shot, all nerves. When she wasn't doped up on Med-X or Superstimming her pain away...|...look, never mind. I don't want to speak bad about her. She was a classy woman, good singer, and if she couldn't act her way out of a box...|...she was Sinclair's world, and that's all that mattered. He didn't need to know any of that, any of her history.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic120 "I found some medical records in the Villa Clinic. You brought her in for treatment, right?" [DIAL:01012B7E]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: So you met her before she met Sinclair?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic119 "So you met her before she met Sinclair?" [DIAL:01012B7F]

text_content: Introductions? You knew her before?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic118 "Introductions? You knew her before?" [DIAL:01012B80]

text_content: Of course. What, some kind of surprise to you that I knew people once? Used to have my name in lights, all right?|Knew a dozen Veras, or whatever her name was. Uh... "Vera Keyes." Figured I could pay Sinclair back, introduce the two...|{To himself}...guy was a slouch in the dame department, had to pick up the slack somehow.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic118 "Introductions? You knew her before?" [DIAL:01012B80]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Can you tell me about her?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic117 "Can you tell me about her?" [DIAL:01012B81]

text_content: Vera was a big star, back before the Bomb. Not the best actress, but... well, she had other talents. Nice voice, nice legs.|For some reason, Sinclair... he built this place... she caught his eye. {Shrugs}Once he was hooked, that was it, had to have her.|So made the introductions, and guess what? He builds this place for her, like some kind of Cleopatra obsession. {Beat, looks around}Wasn't always a deathtrap.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic117 "Can you tell me about her?" [DIAL:01012B81]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Before, you mentioned the Hologram at the Fountain - Vera? Do you know her?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic116 "Before, you mentioned the Hologram at the Fountain - Vera? Do you know her?" [DIAL:01012B82]

text_content: What happens during the Gala Event?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic115 "What happens during the Gala Event?" [DIAL:01012B83]

text_content: Oh, it'll light up the casino, light up the sky... set the speakers in the Villa to play beautiful, soothing music.|...and when I say soothing music, I mean with the speakers being the state they are, things'll be screaming, all right. Think air raid sirens.|That means it'll wake up everything in town like a hornet's nest. Not sure what a hornet is? Forget it - basically, trouble.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic115 "What happens during the Gala Event?" [DIAL:01012B83]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Interesting? Interesting how?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic114 "Interesting? Interesting how?" [DIAL:01012B84]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Yeah... maybe the drain in power, that'll cause the security systems to shut down enough to let us in. But... getting back out?|No, the place'll close up tighter than an opening at the Fronds. {To himself}Or Danny Parker's sphincter when he has to tip a doorman.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic114 "Interesting? Interesting how?" [DIAL:01012B84]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: [FAILED] Interesting... in the sense that having some light show open the Sierra Madre? Interesting to me, who would have thought?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic114 "Interesting? Interesting how?" [DIAL:01012B84]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: And the woman? The Auto-Doc victim - what about her?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic113 "And the woman? The Auto-Doc victim - what about her?" [DIAL:01012B85]

text_content: Little Miss Silence...? Maybe she needs to be in some place where she can be seen, but being heard isn't important?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic113 "And the woman? The Auto-Doc victim - what about her?" [DIAL:01012B85]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: What about Christine?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic112 "What about Christine?" [DIAL:01012B86]

text_content: Christine, that her name? Nice name. I mean, you can't see it on posters, but... never mind.|I don't know. She might need to hold some place where speaking isn't important. Like stage tech? Lighting? Got me.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic112 "What about Christine?" [DIAL:01012B86]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: And me? I've had prime billing in Europe, New York... and this gig doesn't feel like that.|Don't get me wrong, I can hold an audience, conduct a score from the rooftops, but I'm guessing I'm the odd man out in this whole heist.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic112 "What about Christine?" [DIAL:01012B86]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Any idea why he wants you there?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic083 "Any idea why he wants you there?" [DIAL:01012B87]

text_content: Partner, I'm not sure this guy's operating with a full deck. My bet? Process of elimination, lowest common denominator. |He figures the "Strong Man"'s needed somewhere, {to himself}even if it sounds like the Strong Man's {emph}two minds about it.|Plus, I'm guessing wherever ol' Doggy Boy's needed doesn't need smarts. {Beat, to himself}I hope not, or we're royally jones'd.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic083 "Any idea why he wants you there?" [DIAL:01012B87]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: According to the marker, you're slated for a spot in Puesta del Sol.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic074 "According to the marker, you're slated for a spot in Puesta del Sol." [DIAL:01012B88]

text_content: No... looks like a {emph}rooftop in Puesta del Sol. In better days, nice view. Now? It's the last place anyone wants to stand when this event goes off.|That place during Spring, Summer, and Fall, a little bit in Winter, is a prime resort spot for Ghost People. Not the best of neighborhoods.|If we're going there, I'm not going alone. And if you have any bright ideas about telling me to stroll over there - or leave me there? No thanks.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic074 "According to the marker, you're slated for a spot in Puesta del Sol." [DIAL:01012B88]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: "Vera" Hologram? You know the holographic woman?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic008 """Vera"" Hologram? You know the holographic woman?" [DIAL:01012B89]

text_content: Yeah - don't you? Or... {Frowns}guess Vera Keyes got lost along with the rest of the holo-archives when the bomb hit, huh?|{Little wistful}Ghost in name and image. Still a looker, though. {Quiet}Got to hand it to Sinclair, sure can pick 'em. Well, or get picked. Whichever.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic008 """Vera"" Hologram? You know the holographic woman?" [DIAL:01012B89]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Know anything about this Gala Event we're supposed to trigger?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic003 "Know anything about this Gala Event we're supposed to trigger?" [DIAL:01012B8A]

text_content: {Chewing it over}Supposed to be the Grand Opening of the Sierra Madre. Lot of lights, music, the works.|{Slowly}And he's going to use the Gala Event... to open the casino? But... {Thinking}that's... interesting.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic003 "Know anything about this Gala Event we're supposed to trigger?" [DIAL:01012B8A]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DogDialogueAboutTape
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueAboutTape "NVDLC01DogDialogueAboutTape" [DIAL:01012BAA]

text_content: {Warning}Can't take any chances, though... you may be some victim who simply stumbled down here. If so, can't let you let Dog out... no, not yet.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueAboutTape "NVDLC01DogDialogueAboutTape" [DIAL:01012BAA]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Imperious}If you're who I think you are, you came to fetch Dog, use him to drag others here. {Beat, cruel}Now I'll use {emph}you - {emph}and that Pip-Boy you're wearing.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueAboutTape "NVDLC01DogDialogueAboutTape" [DIAL:01012BAA]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Taunting}You're smart. Clever. The key to Dog's cage is simple. Take my voice to the cage above. {Beat}Let me speak to the beast inside.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueAboutTape "NVDLC01DogDialogueAboutTape" [DIAL:01012BAA]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: Then you and I... {emph}we can talk.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueAboutTape "NVDLC01DogDialogueAboutTape" [DIAL:01012BAA]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: NVDLC01ChristineSuitesCollarOn
name: NVDLC01ChristineSuitesCollarOn "NVDLC01ChristineSuitesCollarOn" [DIAL:01012BB3]

text_content: {Smug, player walked into a trap}That's it... signal frequency's hot, let's see how you deal with this.
name: NVDLC01ChristineSuitesCollarOn "NVDLC01ChristineSuitesCollarOn" [DIAL:01012BB3]

text_content: {Anger, player's rushing at her for melee combat}Switching frequency, asshole.
name: NVDLC01ChristineSuitesCollarOn "NVDLC01ChristineSuitesCollarOn" [DIAL:01012BB3]

text_content: {Anger, player's rushing at her for melee combat}Switching frequency, bitch.
name: NVDLC01ChristineSuitesCollarOn "NVDLC01ChristineSuitesCollarOn" [DIAL:01012BB3]

text_content: NVDLC01ChristineSuitesCollarOff
name: NVDLC01ChristineSuitesCollarOff "NVDLC01ChristineSuitesCollarOff" [DIAL:01012BB4]

text_content: {First bark}Need to reset this damn thing... switching the frequencies... come on, come on...
name: NVDLC01ChristineSuitesCollarOff "NVDLC01ChristineSuitesCollarOff" [DIAL:01012BB4]

text_content: {Under her breath, slight frustration}Resetting signal... resetting signal.
name: NVDLC01ChristineSuitesCollarOff "NVDLC01ChristineSuitesCollarOff" [DIAL:01012BB4]

text_content: NVDLC01SuitesCollarScanning
name: NVDLC01SuitesCollarScanning "NVDLC01SuitesCollarScanning" [DIAL:01012BB5]

text_content: {Under her breath, pissed}Think you can run? The longer you try and keep your distance, this scanning frequency will flush you out.
name: NVDLC01SuitesCollarScanning "NVDLC01SuitesCollarScanning" [DIAL:01012BB5]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahAct1Intro
name: NVDLC01ElijahAct1Intro "NVDLC01ElijahAct1Intro" [DIAL:01012BD5]

text_content: NVDLC01ChristineVaultHelpTopic01
name: NVDLC01ChristineVaultHelpTopic01 "NVDLC01ChristineVaultHelpTopic01" [DIAL:01012BE8]

text_content: {Breaks into player's frequency while he's being blasted with turrets, urgency}Seeing what I can do to shut those turrets down from up here... come on... come on...|...got it, two of 'em down... can't shut down the others - he's cut off access. {frustrated}Dammit! {Beat, cold}Put him down, bury him - whatever it takes!
name: NVDLC01ChristineVaultHelpTopic01 "NVDLC01ChristineVaultHelpTopic01" [DIAL:01012BE8]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanVaultHelpTopic01
name: NVDLC01DeanVaultHelpTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanVaultHelpTopic01" [DIAL:01012BE9]

text_content: {Uncertain of controls}Is... is this thing on? You hear me down there? {Beat, studying dials}Trying to help you out here... disable the speakers, play a little music...|{snaps fingers as music kicks in, ohhh yeah}...and that's more like it, got a beat you can swing to. {Beat}And they won't set off your collar any more - {lower, tougher}just hit that guy where it hurts.
name: NVDLC01DeanVaultHelpTopic01 "NVDLC01DeanVaultHelpTopic01" [DIAL:01012BE9]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahVaultPlayerCollarTopic04
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultPlayerCollarTopic04 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultPlayerCollarTopic04" [DIAL:01012BEA]

text_content: {Rage}You think you've escaped?! You can't outrun me, you were always under my control! Do you hear me?! {Beat, takes it up a notch}Do you hear me?!
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultPlayerCollarTopic04 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultPlayerCollarTopic04" [DIAL:01012BEA]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahVaultPlayerCollarTopic03
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultPlayerCollarTopic03 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultPlayerCollarTopic03" [DIAL:01012BEB]

text_content: {Snarling, player's making good time}You won't get out. {Beat, ominous}I'll bring the whole Sierra Madre down on you, bury you here with {emph}all the others.
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultPlayerCollarTopic03 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultPlayerCollarTopic03" [DIAL:01012BEB]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahVaultPlayerCollarTopic02
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultPlayerCollarTopic02 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultPlayerCollarTopic02" [DIAL:01012BEC]

text_content: {Cold, steady, menacing}Think you can escape? No, that hand on your throat is mine, always was.
name: NVDLC01ElijahVaultPlayerCollarTopic02 "NVDLC01ElijahVaultPlayerCollarTopic02" [DIAL:01012BEC]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahAct2Intro
name: NVDLC01ElijahAct2Intro "NVDLC01ElijahAct2Intro" [DIAL:01012C25]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanDialogueStashBark
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueStashBark "NVDLC01DeanDialogueStashBark" [DIAL:01012E50]

text_content: {First Time}Hey, those are my emergency supplies! {Beat, backpedaling, knows how it sounds}Uh... I-I mean... I know we're in a bad spot here... just, uh, leave me something, all right?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueStashBark "NVDLC01DeanDialogueStashBark" [DIAL:01012E50]

text_content: {Grumbles, slight frustration}Yeah, go on... help yourself. Why not?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueStashBark "NVDLC01DeanDialogueStashBark" [DIAL:01012E50]

text_content: Leave me {emph}something, will you?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueStashBark "NVDLC01DeanDialogueStashBark" [DIAL:01012E50]

text_content: {Grumbles}Never should have left those stupid handprints. Dead giveaway.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueStashBark "NVDLC01DeanDialogueStashBark" [DIAL:01012E50]

name: NVDLC01RadioAMBMusicTheater "NVDLC01RadioAMBMusicTheaterPerformance" [DIAL:01012E91]

text_content: TheaterPerformance - 'Saw Her Yesterday'
name: NVDLC01RadioAMBMusicTheater "NVDLC01RadioAMBMusicTheaterPerformance" [DIAL:01012E91]

name: NVDLC01RadioAMBMusicEND "NVDLC01RadioAMBMusicEND" [DIAL:01012E92]

text_content: Gala
