name: NVDLC01RadioAMBMusicVeraEnd "NVDLC01RadioAMBMusicVeraAttack" [DIAL:01012F67]

text_content: END MUSIC {plays when player triggers Vera Hologram in lobby or unlocks vault access}
name: NVDLC01RadioAMBMusicVeraEnd "NVDLC01RadioAMBMusicVeraAttack" [DIAL:01012F67]

text_content: NVDLC01RadioAMBMusicSTART
name: NVDLC01RadioAMBMusicSTART "NVDLC01RadioAMBMusicSTART" [DIAL:01012F68]

text_content: I'm not following you.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic131 "I'm not following you." [DIAL:01012FA0]

text_content: Odd Man out... dead weight. Someone you need holding the toolbox, the nurse passing the scalpel, the chauffer driving you to the concert.|Any guy with {emph}hands is who he needs up on that rooftop. Guess he thinks I don't rate, looking like I do. {Beat}Poor him.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic131 "I'm not following you." [DIAL:01012FA0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Is there one console that runs them or several?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic145 "Is there one console that runs them or several?" [DIAL:01013255]

text_content: Keep going. What else?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic144 "Keep going. What else?" [DIAL:01013256]

text_content: That's the radios and speakers - what about a central sound system?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic143 "That's the radios and speakers - what about a central sound system?" [DIAL:01013257]

text_content: The speakers are all controlled by a central console. {Thinking}It's the farthest from the only door out of here...|...so you'd need to do a full circuit of the corridor to get to it. Once there, you'll need to shut it down, and I don't have the code.|If you have the code, you can turn off {emph}all the speakers, make them settle down. Getting backstage should buy us time, just take it slow.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic143 "That's the radios and speakers - what about a central sound system?" [DIAL:01013257]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Good thing you mentioned that before I ran back there, "partner."
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic142 "Good thing you mentioned that before I ran back there, ""partner.""" [DIAL:01013258]

text_content: Look, I'm in danger here, all right, not exactly thinking with a level head, so cut me some slack. {Beat}Please.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic142 "Good thing you mentioned that before I ran back there, ""partner.""" [DIAL:01013258]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: One problem at a time. Take a breath, try and remember.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic140 "One problem at a time. Take a breath, try and remember." [DIAL:0101325A]

text_content: Calm down, think. Do you know specifically where?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic139 "Calm down, think. Do you know specifically where?" [DIAL:0101325B]

text_content: Uh... let's see. Um, once you break right, watch each turn in the corridor, one'll be on your right past my dressing room - and up.|Oh, my dressing room - may have left the radio on, right by the table... uh, if you could just shut it off instead of blowing it u... uh, never mind.|{Remembering}And there was a speaker in the prop room, too - on the wall between the entrances. And... well, walk slow - there's bound to be more.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic139 "Calm down, think. Do you know specifically where?" [DIAL:0101325B]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: What about the speakers in here?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic138 "What about the speakers in here?" [DIAL:0101325C]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Slight frustration - what's the player getting at?}Yeah... yeah, so what? We got bigger problems with the Holograms... no, no, wait, you're right.|{Frustrated}The Theater piped music and sound backstage, which means those little squealers are in the corridors back there, too.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic138 "What about the speakers in here?" [DIAL:0101325C]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: [FAILED] {Urgent}What about them? The speakers won't kill you if you leave them alone, don't worry about them, just get backstage.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic138 "What about the speakers in here?" [DIAL:0101325C]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: This casino's security system is pissing me off.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic137 "This casino's security system is pissing me off." [DIAL:0101325D]

text_content: {Slight nervous}You are preaching to the choir. Sinclair and his security... don't even get me started. Those Holograms...
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic137 "This casino's security system is pissing me off." [DIAL:0101325D]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Uh... anything else you can tell me that'd help? Anything?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic136 "Uh... anything else you can tell me that'd help? Anything?" [DIAL:0101325E]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Uh... right. Uh... let's see... when you get the door open, there'll be an exit door dead ahead. {Emph}Don't take it.|It's most likely filled with toxins from the vents. So hug the wall, make as much space between you and the door... or it's Cloud Nine in a casket.|Past that... {thinking}is my dressing room. Under the table there's a footlocker. It's tucked back a bit, so you might miss it. Inside, a gun, some ammo.|Not much help against the ghosts, still, if you're about to give up, call it quits? {Beat, punchline}Throw it to {emph}me so I can eat a bullet first.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic136 "Uh... anything else you can tell me that'd help? Anything?" [DIAL:0101325E]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: [FAILED] Anything else? I've told you all I can think of! Now, come on, get going.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic136 "Uh... anything else you can tell me that'd help? Anything?" [DIAL:0101325E]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: All right, I'll head for the door on the left.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic135 "All right, I'll head for the door on the left." [DIAL:0101325F]

text_content: {DUPE}Good, go, and don't get yourself killed - do that, and we're both done.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic135 "All right, I'll head for the door on the left." [DIAL:0101325F]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Good, go, and don't get yourself killed - do that, and we're both done.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic135 "All right, I'll head for the door on the left." [DIAL:0101325F]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Nervous}Look... just get rid of them, all right? Tried to slip off stage, then they all started changing color and raising their hands... {emph}not a good sign.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic135 "All right, I'll head for the door on the left." [DIAL:0101325F]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: So how do I get you out of there?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic134 "So how do I get you out of there?" [DIAL:01013260]

text_content: Trust me - as soon as you can, run to the door to the {emph}left - use the key you got out of the music rag there, and camp out.|As bad as things are, it's going to get a lot worse if either of us pops - so get backstage... {under his breath}until we get a better plan.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic134 "So how do I get you out of there?" [DIAL:01013260]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: I didn't see any security coming in - only the speakers.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic133 "I didn't see any security coming in - only the speakers." [DIAL:01013261]

text_content: Wait, what Holograms? What are you talking about?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic132 "Wait, what Holograms? What are you talking about?" [DIAL:01013262]

text_content: {Uneasy}Look... those ghosts are going to come out of the wings behind you in a second, the security types, {emph}not the "friendly" bald types.|And if you got in here, the door's probably locked tight behind you - so {emph}don't back up or run for the exit, you're not going to make it.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic132 "Wait, what Holograms? What are you talking about?" [DIAL:01013262]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: All right, makes sense. Where's the music?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic146 "All right, makes sense. Where's the music?" [DIAL:01013271]

text_content: The Holotape should be where I left it... no, wait. It's... it's in Vera's dressing room, probably. May... may be a key to her room on my desk.|Anyway... snag the key out of my room, and look around Vera's room, the Holotape has to be there. As for getting it to the projection booth...|Well... sometimes Vera used to watch from the projection booth, so she must have had a master key... look around her room, might be there.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic146 "All right, makes sense. Where's the music?" [DIAL:01013271]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Yeah, but if I run, what about the Security Holograms?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic141 "Yeah, but if I run, what about the Security Holograms?" [DIAL:01013272]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Thinking}Yeah... yeah, right. So... let's see... security's here because the show hasn't started. Guests aren't allowed in, so...|...guess we need to start the show. Okay... so when they were setting this place up... we had rehearsals...|{relaxes a bit}...and heh... Sinclair even set up hologram recordings of the shows so we could watch and critique our performances before a fake audience. {Beat, slight anger}Whatever.|Thing is, when the recording queued up, a nice, calm, appreciative audience appeared in the Theater - no security with their head-blasting zap rays.|So, find the music, get it to the projector room upstairs, then play it...? Might reset security, worth a shot.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic141 "Yeah, but if I run, what about the Security Holograms?" [DIAL:01013272]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: [FAILED] One thing at a time - and buying time is what we need, all right? Think in the now, it'll sort itself out. {Beat}I hope.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic141 "Yeah, but if I run, what about the Security Holograms?" [DIAL:01013272]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: So I go to the locked door, right?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic147 "So I go to the locked door, right?" [DIAL:01013276]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] What? Oh, my left - your right. So, yeah, run to the door on your right. {Beat}Heh, almost got you killed there. {To himself}Us killed there.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic147 "So I go to the locked door, right?" [DIAL:01013276]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: [FAILED] Right, the locked door to the left. Watch out, the guards are going to materialize in any second, crouch and take it slow.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic147 "So I go to the locked door, right?" [DIAL:01013276]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: That's all I wanted to know. I'll head out, see what I can do on my end.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic179 "That's all I wanted to know. I'll head out, see what I can do on my end." [DIAL:0101327B]

text_content: What were you blackmailing her with?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic178 "What were you blackmailing her with?" [DIAL:0101327C]

text_content: What {emph}wasn't I blackmailing her with. {Flippant}Chem use, indiscretions, more chem use... the usual Hollywood tune.|Like Sinclair, people are the architects of their own misfortunes. Leave themselves wide open for someone to waltz right in and take what they want.|As long as they take a single step into the trap. Get a few pictures, get a little dirt, and that person's your piano.|Vera? Med-X was her thing, even Superstimmed herself for the after-rush. Sick.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic178 "What were you blackmailing her with?" [DIAL:0101327C]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: What did you want her to do?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic177 "What did you want her to do?" [DIAL:0101327D]

text_content: Sinclair built this whole town to accommodate her. Same with the casino's voice lock. He wanted to make sure she had access to everything.|And since I already had access to Vera... well, that meant I had access to the vault, too.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic177 "What did you want her to do?" [DIAL:0101327D]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Were you blackmailing Vera Keyes to break into the Sierra Madre?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic176 "Were you blackmailing Vera Keyes to break into the Sierra Madre?" [DIAL:0101327E]

text_content: "Blackmail" is such a strong word. I asked her, she said yes, then... she started to get cold feet.|I blame Sinclair... he was such a victim, that maybe she felt it would be too easy... it doesn't matter.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic176 "Were you blackmailing Vera Keyes to break into the Sierra Madre?" [DIAL:0101327E]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: I found this Holotape in your safe.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic175 "I found this Holotape in your safe." [DIAL:0101327F]

text_content: Yeah? Little bit of two-reel memories... we're here to steal from the Sierra Madre, not from each other.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic175 "I found this Holotape in your safe." [DIAL:0101327F]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01StarletHolotapeDeath
name: NVDLC01StarletHolotapeDeath "NVDLC01StarletHolotapeDeath" [DIAL:01013280]

text_content: Sinclair?! Sinclair, I'm trapped. Please, oh god, the security systems won't let me out, they're keeping me here.
name: NVDLC01StarletHolotapeDeath "NVDLC01StarletHolotapeDeath" [DIAL:01013280]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: Sinclair! Sinclair!
name: NVDLC01StarletHolotapeDeath "NVDLC01StarletHolotapeDeath" [DIAL:01013280]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: {Quiet}We all pay for what we've done. I'm so sorry, Sinclair. Sorry, I... I should have trusted you.
name: NVDLC01StarletHolotapeDeath "NVDLC01StarletHolotapeDeath" [DIAL:01013280]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: I'm going to die here, amongst the ghosts. I... I'm still being recorded by the holographic system.
name: NVDLC01StarletHolotapeDeath "NVDLC01StarletHolotapeDeath" [DIAL:01013280]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: The doors, they... they sealed. I... I can hear the other guests, screaming to be let out, to let go.
name: NVDLC01StarletHolotapeDeath "NVDLC01StarletHolotapeDeath" [DIAL:01013280]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: Let go? Let go of what?
name: NVDLC01StarletHolotapeDeath "NVDLC01StarletHolotapeDeath" [DIAL:01013280]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: I came so far to be here... now, now I just want to leave. Please... let me leave.
name: NVDLC01StarletHolotapeDeath "NVDLC01StarletHolotapeDeath" [DIAL:01013280]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: Sinclair? Sinclair, where did you go? Why did you leave me here? Why...
name: NVDLC01StarletHolotapeDeath "NVDLC01StarletHolotapeDeath" [DIAL:01013280]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: Sinclair, is that you?
name: NVDLC01StarletHolotapeDeath "NVDLC01StarletHolotapeDeath" [DIAL:01013280]
speaker: NVDLC01Starlet "Starlet" [NPC_:01006EDA]

text_content: NVDLC01StarletHolotapeAudition
name: NVDLC01StarletHolotapeAudition "NVDLC01StarletHolotapeAudition" [DIAL:01013281]

text_content: ...would you stop? {Laughs}Such a kidder.|{Getting serious}This is Vera Keyes, auditioning for Love Sets Sail... {frowns}god, this script. Don't get me wrong, I'm happy to have the w...{"work"}|...is that a plane over head? Those bombers are nothing but big hornets buzzing around the sky these days...|...is it gone. All right. This is Vera Keyes, auditioning for "Love Sets Sail."|"Malcolm... ever since our freighter went down, I feel like my heart's fallen to the bottom of the ocean along with my... ugh"{Laughing}|...along with my career. God... heh... all right, all right...
name: NVDLC01StarletHolotapeAudition "NVDLC01StarletHolotapeAudition" [DIAL:01013281]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail
name: NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail "NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail" [DIAL:01013282]

text_content: {Dean walking in on Vera as she's getting ready}Pretty as a picture.
name: NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail "NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail" [DIAL:01013282]

text_content: {Surprise, uncomfortable at the sudden arrival}Uh... Dean, I... didn't hear you come in.
name: NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail "NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail" [DIAL:01013282]

text_content: I'm not wearing my dancing shoes, so I walk a little softly now. {Mock menacing}What, you think I was a Chinaman, come to cut your American throat?
name: NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail "NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail" [DIAL:01013282]

text_content: Dean, really.
name: NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail "NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail" [DIAL:01013282]

text_content: {Slightly predatory}What... no hug? Come here.
name: NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail "NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail" [DIAL:01013282]

text_content: Dean, I'm getting ready.
name: NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail "NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail" [DIAL:01013282]

text_content: You sing like a bird, pop the safe, and we're as through as through can be.
name: NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail "NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail" [DIAL:01013282]

text_content: {Wants to back out}Dean... I just... about tonight, I... I don't know.
name: NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail "NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail" [DIAL:01013282]

text_content: {Vera's starting to get cold feet, Dean doesn't like this}You don't know? I ask one simple favor of you, and you tell me "no?"
name: NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail "NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail" [DIAL:01013282]

text_content: I didn't say no. I just said that... I don't think...
name: NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail "NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail" [DIAL:01013282]

text_content: You're right, you don't think.
name: NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail "NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail" [DIAL:01013282]

text_content: I don't need you - I'll send you back to the farm, worse off than you were, because you'll have seen the Sierra Madre, and had to let it {emph}all go.
name: NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail "NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail" [DIAL:01013282]

text_content: I could have gotten any leggy dame out of Hollywood to get out here and play Sinclair's heart strings.
name: NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail "NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail" [DIAL:01013282]

text_content: You just happened to be the one I caught, and it was really your own fault, a little too much into the chems and meds, and...
name: NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail "NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail" [DIAL:01013282]

text_content: {Placating, but still leaving the hooks in}Aw, shhh, don't cry. Look, I'm not trying to hurt {emph}you. Just one last little job, a little less dirty, a little less messy. He trusts you, Vera.
name: NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail "NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail" [DIAL:01013282]

text_content: {Placating, but cold}And so do I. After this, I promise you, all those other Holotapes, they'll go away.
name: NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail "NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail" [DIAL:01013282]

text_content: Of course, Dean.
name: NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail "NVDLC01DeanHolotapeBlackmail" [DIAL:01013282]

text_content: Everyone's still alive on each floor - including you.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic174 "Everyone's still alive on each floor - including you." [DIAL:01013283]

text_content: Still trying to find out. Not sure.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic173 "Still trying to find out. Not sure." [DIAL:01013284]

text_content: All right... even if they all end up dead, though, you say there's a way to recover the song from the Sierra Madre archives.|Just set up links to each floor, then use the lobby terminal to tie it all together? Easy. Just a little legwork.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic173 "Still trying to find out. Not sure." [DIAL:01013284]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Christine is dead. Dog... well...
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic172 "Christine is dead. Dog... well..." [DIAL:01013285]

text_content: {Frustrated}Dead? For the love of... chopping up her voice box was a gamble anyway. So much for back-up plans.|Still... there's a way to recover the song from the Sierra Madre archives, right? Just set up links to each floor, then use the lobby terminal?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic172 "Christine is dead. Dog... well..." [DIAL:01013285]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Christine is alive. Dog... well...
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic171 "Christine is alive. Dog... well..." [DIAL:01013286]

text_content: Forget that walking stomach, not interested in being his lunch... just glad the girl's all right. Where is she? Is she here?|Wait... no, if the Sierra Madre assigned people to floors, she's got to have been sent to Vera's room, right? That's irony for you.|Perfect, couldn't have worked out better. So - what, you're heading to the main terminal now that you've got this floor unlocked?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic171 "Christine is alive. Dog... well..." [DIAL:01013286]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: <Lie> If Christine's throat surgery was your plan, too late, she's dead.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic170 "<Lie> If Christine's throat surgery was your plan, too late, she's dead." [DIAL:01013287]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Dead? After all I went through... after all that hauling her body through the streets?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic170 "<Lie> If Christine's throat surgery was your plan, too late, she's dead." [DIAL:01013287]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: [FAILED] Really... "partner." Now, now... you can't pull one over on Dean... but you tried, didn't you?|So you don't want to share... keep her from me, huh? All we have to do is make her sing, and it's all ours.|Although... why lie to me? I'm hurt. I mean, we don't even {emph}need her if you get the terminals live, and the music kicking.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic170 "<Lie> If Christine's throat surgery was your plan, too late, she's dead." [DIAL:01013287]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: If you were using Christine's voice box to smuggle Vera's voice in, she's dead.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic169 "If you were using Christine's voice box to smuggle Vera's voice in, she's dead." [DIAL:01013288]

text_content: And here I thought I was being clever. {To himself}Teach me to hold my cards a little closer to the chest... whole heist was a gamble anyway.|Still... there's a way to recover the song from the Sierra Madre archives, right? Just set up links to each floor, then use the lobby terminal?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic169 "If you were using Christine's voice box to smuggle Vera's voice in, she's dead." [DIAL:01013288]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Wait, you were trying to smuggle one inside? Where is it?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic168 "Wait, you were trying to smuggle one inside? Where is it?" [DIAL:01013289]

text_content: It's safe. I hope. Right now, let's focus on getting everyone {emph}else to safety, all right? Everybody else all right?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic168 "Wait, you were trying to smuggle one inside? Where is it?" [DIAL:01013289]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: <Do Not Translate: Additional Storage Nodes>
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic167 "<Do Not Translate: Additional Storage Nodes>" [DIAL:0101328A]

text_content: So - what, you're heading to the main terminal now that you've got this floor unlocked?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic167 "<Do Not Translate: Additional Storage Nodes>" [DIAL:0101328A]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Frowns}Hnh. You got a point. {Frowns, warning}You better not let me down. Try and get into the Sierra Madre without me? You'll wish you hadn't.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic167 "<Do Not Translate: Additional Storage Nodes>" [DIAL:0101328A]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {Slight hesitation}All right... look, if the Holograms are here to keep me company, then... I don't mind staying here for a while.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic167 "<Do Not Translate: Additional Storage Nodes>" [DIAL:0101328A]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: But listen... {Frowns, warning}when this thing goes off, try and get into the Sierra Madre without me? You'll wish you hadn't.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic167 "<Do Not Translate: Additional Storage Nodes>" [DIAL:0101328A]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: The terminal can tie the fragments together, just need to wrap it up.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic166 "The terminal can tie the fragments together, just need to wrap it up." [DIAL:0101328B]

text_content: Now that I've got the signal established to this floor, yes.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic165 "Now that I've got the signal established to this floor, yes." [DIAL:0101328C]

text_content: All right - well, thanks for bailing me out.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic165 "Now that I've got the signal established to this floor, yes." [DIAL:0101328C]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Yes, that's the next step. You going to be all right?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic164 "Yes, that's the next step. You going to be all right?" [DIAL:0101328D]

text_content: {Brushoff, needs player to leave}I'll be fine, don't worry about me. Go on ahead, I'm going to try and unwind.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic164 "Yes, that's the next step. You going to be all right?" [DIAL:0101328D]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: If it means I can get out of this alive, yes, that's why I'm here.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic163 "If it means I can get out of this alive, yes, that's why I'm here." [DIAL:0101328E]

text_content: At least you're honest, can't blame you. I'd have done the same if there was a trigger to my head... or a collar on my neck.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic163 "If it means I can get out of this alive, yes, that's why I'm here." [DIAL:0101328E]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: No - believe it or not, I wasn't going to leave you to die.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic162 "No - believe it or not, I wasn't going to leave you to die." [DIAL:0101328F]

text_content: You know... people can still surprise me. All right, I believe you. You got spine. {Raises an eyebrow}Guess the bombs left a little human goodwill behind.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic162 "No - believe it or not, I wasn't going to leave you to die." [DIAL:0101328F]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: The one who put these collars on us wanted me to deal with everyone first.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic161 "The one who put these collars on us wanted me to deal with everyone first." [DIAL:01013290]

text_content: Figures... wish he'd show himself, although I'm betting he's not doing that until we've cracked the vault.|{Thinking}That means we'll still need a copy of the song to get into the vault... and after all I went through to smuggle a copy inside.|Wait... you said this guy wanted you to deal with all of us first? What, is everyone else here?
