name: NVDLC01ElijahBarkCasinoGate "NVDLC01ElijahBarkCasinoGate" [DIAL:01013770]

text_content: This gate to the Sierra Madre's sealed, locked. For now. Do as I say, and it won't be locked for much longer.
name: NVDLC01ElijahBarkCasinoGate "NVDLC01ElijahBarkCasinoGate" [DIAL:01013770]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahBarkMojaveGate
name: NVDLC01ElijahBarkMojaveGate "NVDLC01ElijahBarkMojaveGate" [DIAL:01013771]

text_content: That's the way out - after you break into the Sierra Madre's vault. Try to leave, I'll set off your collar.
name: NVDLC01ElijahBarkMojaveGate "NVDLC01ElijahBarkMojaveGate" [DIAL:01013771]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahBarkClinicSpeakers
name: NVDLC01ElijahBarkClinicSpeakers "NVDLC01ElijahBarkClinicSpeakers" [DIAL:01013784]

text_content: Damn speakers at end of hall - red light means they're shielded. Must be a way to shut them off somewhere else.
name: NVDLC01ElijahBarkClinicSpeakers "NVDLC01ElijahBarkClinicSpeakers" [DIAL:01013784]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahBarkHologram
name: NVDLC01ElijahBarkHologram "NVDLC01ElijahBarkHologram" [DIAL:01013785]

text_content: Picking up an emitter signature - watch for security Holograms, dangerous. {Beat}Don't shoot them - attacking them is useless.
name: NVDLC01ElijahBarkHologram "NVDLC01ElijahBarkHologram" [DIAL:01013785]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahBarkDetonateCollar
name: NVDLC01ElijahBarkDetonateCollar "NVDLC01ElijahBarkDetonateCollar" [DIAL:010137BF]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaComplete
name: NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaComplete "NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaComplete" [DIAL:010137C0]

text_content: I can hear the event firing off. Now get to the main gate of the Sierra Madre, quickly.|Get there soon or the doors will seal, and you'll be trapped outside.
name: NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaComplete "NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaComplete" [DIAL:010137C0]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Get there soon or the doors will seal, and you'll be trapped outside.
name: NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaComplete "NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaComplete" [DIAL:010137C0]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaChristine
name: NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaChristine "NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaChristine" [DIAL:010137C1]

text_content: Get the mute down the elevator and into the Manual Override Chamber.
name: NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaChristine "NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaChristine" [DIAL:010137C1]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahBarkSwitchingStation
name: NVDLC01ElijahBarkSwitchingStation "NVDLC01ElijahBarkSwitchingStation" [DIAL:010137C2]

text_content: There - the Switching Station. That's where you'll need to bring the mute.
name: NVDLC01ElijahBarkSwitchingStation "NVDLC01ElijahBarkSwitchingStation" [DIAL:010137C2]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaDean
name: NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaDean "NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaDean" [DIAL:010137C3]

text_content: You're at the Ghoul's Gala area... now, make him stay.
name: NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaDean "NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaDean" [DIAL:010137C3]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaPlayer
name: NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaPlayer "NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaPlayer" [DIAL:010137C4]

text_content: The bell tower. That's where you'll trigger the Gala Event. It's a ways up. I'm sure you'll find a way to climb up there.|{Grumbling to himself}And once you get near the top... look for a ladder. It's easy to miss.
name: NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaPlayer "NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaPlayer" [DIAL:010137C4]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Grumbling to himself}And once you get near the top... look for a ladder. It's easy to miss.
name: NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaPlayer "NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaPlayer" [DIAL:010137C4]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaDog
name: NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaDog "NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaDog" [DIAL:010137C5]

text_content: You're at one of the Gala locations, you'll need to bring the mutant here. Only he has the strength to operate the levers, I've found.
name: NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaDog "NVDLC01ElijahBarkGalaDog" [DIAL:010137C5]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGhostDeadBark
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGhostDeadBark "NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGhostDeadBark" [DIAL:010137D7]

text_content: [Christine nods at you, then the Ghost Person on the ground, makes a neck-chopping motion.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGhostDeadBark "NVDLC01ChristineDialogueGhostDeadBark" [DIAL:010137D7]

text_content: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGhostDeadBark
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGhostDeadBark "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGhostDeadBark" [DIAL:010137D8]

text_content: He's not dead... it's a trick. {Beat}Get an axe.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGhostDeadBark "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGhostDeadBark" [DIAL:010137D8]

text_content: Better make sure he's dead. {Quiet, more to himself}Poke him with a stick or something.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueGhostDeadBark "NVDLC01DeanDialogueGhostDeadBark" [DIAL:010137D8]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahKitchenArrivalTopic02
name: NVDLC01ElijahKitchenArrivalTopic02 "NVDLC01ElijahKitchenArrivalTopic02" [DIAL:0101383E]

text_content: Must be a back entrance to the kitchen - check the main casino side corridors. Find it.
name: NVDLC01ElijahKitchenArrivalTopic02 "NVDLC01ElijahKitchenArrivalTopic02" [DIAL:0101383E]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahKitchenArrivalTopic01
name: NVDLC01ElijahKitchenArrivalTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahKitchenArrivalTopic01" [DIAL:0101383F]

text_content: Hurry up and deal with the FEV reject, he's of no use to us.
name: NVDLC01ElijahKitchenArrivalTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahKitchenArrivalTopic01" [DIAL:0101383F]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahTheaterArrivalTopic01
name: NVDLC01ElijahTheaterArrivalTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahTheaterArrivalTopic01" [DIAL:01013840]

text_content: If that Ghoul's still alive... correct that. Or break him.
name: NVDLC01ElijahTheaterArrivalTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahTheaterArrivalTopic01" [DIAL:01013840]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahSuitesArrivalTopic02
name: NVDLC01ElijahSuitesArrivalTopic02 "NVDLC01ElijahSuitesArrivalTopic02" [DIAL:01013841]

text_content: Floor's buzzing with emitter signatures. Watch out for Holograms.
name: NVDLC01ElijahSuitesArrivalTopic02 "NVDLC01ElijahSuitesArrivalTopic02" [DIAL:01013841]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahSuitesArrivalTopic01
name: NVDLC01ElijahSuitesArrivalTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahSuitesArrivalTopic01" [DIAL:01013842]

text_content: Find the mute and deal with her. She's somewhere on this floor.
name: NVDLC01ElijahSuitesArrivalTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahSuitesArrivalTopic01" [DIAL:01013842]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahSuitesCollarTriggerTopic01
name: NVDLC01ElijahSuitesCollarTriggerTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahSuitesCollarTriggerTopic01" [DIAL:01013843]

text_content: Your collar's ticking. Get out of that floor!
name: NVDLC01ElijahSuitesCollarTriggerTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahSuitesCollarTriggerTopic01" [DIAL:01013843]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahSuitesElevatorLockTopic02
name: NVDLC01ElijahSuitesElevatorLockTopic02 "NVDLC01ElijahSuitesElevatorLockTopic02" [DIAL:01013844]

text_content: The door to the vault is voice-activated. Which means we need the starlet's voice. Or recordings of it.
name: NVDLC01ElijahSuitesElevatorLockTopic02 "NVDLC01ElijahSuitesElevatorLockTopic02" [DIAL:01013844]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahSuitesElevatorLockTopic01
name: NVDLC01ElijahSuitesElevatorLockTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahSuitesElevatorLockTopic01" [DIAL:01013845]

text_content: The elevator to the casino vault is locked, find a way to open it.
name: NVDLC01ElijahSuitesElevatorLockTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahSuitesElevatorLockTopic01" [DIAL:01013845]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahKitchenCollarTriggerTopic01
name: NVDLC01ElijahKitchenCollarTriggerTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahKitchenCollarTriggerTopic01" [DIAL:01013846]

text_content: Now get out, before your collar blows!
name: NVDLC01ElijahKitchenCollarTriggerTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahKitchenCollarTriggerTopic01" [DIAL:01013846]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahTheaterCollarTriggerTopic01
name: NVDLC01ElijahTheaterCollarTriggerTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahTheaterCollarTriggerTopic01" [DIAL:01013847]

text_content: Get to the door before the collar explodes, move!
name: NVDLC01ElijahTheaterCollarTriggerTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahTheaterCollarTriggerTopic01" [DIAL:01013847]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahTheaterDealWithDeanTopic01
name: NVDLC01ElijahTheaterDealWithDeanTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahTheaterDealWithDeanTopic01" [DIAL:01013848]

text_content: Now, deal with the Ghoul. This has gone on long enough.
name: NVDLC01ElijahTheaterDealWithDeanTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahTheaterDealWithDeanTopic01" [DIAL:01013848]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahTheaterBackstageDoorTopic01
name: NVDLC01ElijahTheaterBackstageDoorTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahTheaterBackstageDoorTopic01" [DIAL:01013849]

text_content: Door's sealed. Must be a key to the backstage. Hunt for it.
name: NVDLC01ElijahTheaterBackstageDoorTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahTheaterBackstageDoorTopic01" [DIAL:01013849]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: How did you get here from the Gala Event? And onto this floor?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic275 "How did you get here from the Gala Event? And onto this floor?" [DIAL:0101387E]

text_content: {Deliver this slow, thoughtful, seems like a dupe, isn't}The Gala went off, the Switching Station opened up - {to herself, rueful}thought the screeching in the Auto-Doc was bad, Station worse.|Got outside, saw the light show, and it was enough to make me run to the casino.|Also... it seemed like the lights and speakers were helping to guide me... guess your master wanted a back-up in case you died.|As for being assigned to this floor... maybe it's because of my new voice. Your guess is as good as mine. {Beat, sarcastic}Maybe it recognized me as a guest.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic275 "How did you get here from the Gala Event? And onto this floor?" [DIAL:0101387E]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: How did you get to the main gate? Then get here?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic067 "How did you get to the main gate? Then get here?" [DIAL:0101387F]

text_content: {Deliver this angrier, seems like a dupe, isn't}The Gala went off, the Switching Station opened up - thought the screeching in the Auto-Doc was bad, Station worse.|Got outside, saw the light show, and it was enough to make me run to the casino.|Also... it seemed like the lights and speakers were helping to guide me... guess your master wanted a back-up in case you died.|As for being assigned to this floor... maybe it's because of my new voice. Your guess is as good as mine. {Beat, sarcastic}Maybe it recognized me as a guest.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic067 "How did you get to the main gate? Then get here?" [DIAL:0101387F]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: {THEATER: 1st Time, Hates player}How did you get from the Gala Event to here?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic199 "{THEATER: 1st Time, Hates player}How did you get from the Gala Event to here?" [DIAL:01013884]

text_content: {Sounds like dupe of another line, isn't, this one's angrier, smug}Me? I was halfway off the rooftop, through the service tunnel and bee-lining for the gate before the light show started...|...and before Vera finished her Gala speech... I knew what'd happen with "music" in the streets and lights in the sky... Ghost People. Lots of them.|But that was your problem. {Beat}Anyway, front gate was open, no way I was letting {emph}you get in first. {Slight confusion}I walk in... there's a flash... and I'm here.|Must have been Sinclair's security... he always had a thing about letting any threats into the casino. Security system's twitchy that way.|{Smug}Me, though, I'm a guest here, so I guess I got the royal treatment after all.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic199 "{THEATER: 1st Time, Hates player}How did you get from the Gala Event to here?" [DIAL:01013884]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: {THEATER: 1st Time, Likes player}How did you get from the Gala Event to here?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic108 "{THEATER: 1st Time, Likes player}How did you get from the Gala Event to here?" [DIAL:01013886]

text_content: {Sounds like dupe of another line, isn't, this one's friendlier, more confused}I was already was halfway off the rooftop, through the service tunnel and making a break for the gate before the light show started...|...and before Vera finished her Gala speech... I knew what'd happen with "music" in the streets and lights in the sky... Ghost People. Lots of them.|Also meant the front gate was open, and no way was I missing it after all these years. Then... I walk in... and...
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic108 "{THEATER: 1st Time, Likes player}How did you get from the Gala Event to here?" [DIAL:01013886]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: NVDLC01DogDialogueKitchenNotListen
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueKitchenNotListen "NVDLC01DogDialogueKitchenNotListen" [DIAL:0101388B]

text_content: {Snarling}I'm in control. The Master won't help Dog now... and it won't help you.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueKitchenNotListen "NVDLC01DogDialogueKitchenNotListen" [DIAL:0101388B]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: {Snarling}Not listen, {emph}Dog out of cage now.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueKitchenNotListen "NVDLC01DogDialogueKitchenNotListen" [DIAL:0101388B]

text_content: If you have the key in there, the "Old Man" can order Dog to open the cage.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic000 "If you have the key in there, the ""Old Man"" can order Dog to open the cage." [DIAL:01013892]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahKitchenGasTopic03
name: NVDLC01ElijahKitchenGasTopic03 "NVDLC01ElijahKitchenGasTopic03" [DIAL:010138A1]

text_content: Don't let him spot you! If he does, talk him down before he has a chance to ignite the gas.
name: NVDLC01ElijahKitchenGasTopic03 "NVDLC01ElijahKitchenGasTopic03" [DIAL:010138A1]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahKitchenGasTopic02
name: NVDLC01ElijahKitchenGasTopic02 "NVDLC01ElijahKitchenGasTopic02" [DIAL:010138A2]

text_content: Shut off the gas valves, or that idiot'll kill us all.
name: NVDLC01ElijahKitchenGasTopic02 "NVDLC01ElijahKitchenGasTopic02" [DIAL:010138A2]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahKitchenGasTopic01
name: NVDLC01ElijahKitchenGasTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahKitchenGasTopic01" [DIAL:010138A3]

text_content: That idiot's opened the gas valves! A single spark - or he sets off his collar, the casino's going to burn. Us along with him.
name: NVDLC01ElijahKitchenGasTopic01 "NVDLC01ElijahKitchenGasTopic01" [DIAL:010138A3]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: What weapons are you good at?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic001 "What weapons are you good at?" [DIAL:010138CE]

text_content: Dog is better at the baser instincts than I... I merely have the brain for it.|His sinew and muscle are difficult to move consciously... he's always hungry, clumsy, heavy.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic001 "What weapons are you good at?" [DIAL:010138CE]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: What weapons are you good at?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic022 "What weapons are you good at?" [DIAL:010138CF]

text_content: Dog good at punching... hitting people with metal bear jaw until they go quiet.|{Thinking}Dog sometimes pick up club when thing need to hit is big, need to punch in many places.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic022 "What weapons are you good at?" [DIAL:010138CF]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: What weapons are you skilled with?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic047 "What weapons are you skilled with?" [DIAL:010138D0]

text_content: Not one for fighting if we can avoid it. Still, wasn't bad at the pistol range and over the years, I've learned how to handle a knife...|{Little quieter}...and explosives a bit. A bit. {To himself}Made a lot of mistakes along the way. Still have my fingers, though.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic047 "What weapons are you skilled with?" [DIAL:010138D0]
speaker: NVDLC01Dean "Dean Domino" [NPC_:010012FE]

text_content: Oh, is that all? Guess that'll do.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic279 "Oh, is that all? Guess that'll do." [DIAL:010138D1]

text_content: [She makes a disapproving frown, shakes her head.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic279 "Oh, is that all? Guess that'll do." [DIAL:010138D1]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: You seem like you've been well-trained.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic278 "You seem like you've been well-trained." [DIAL:010138D2]

text_content: [She shrugs slightly, then waits.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic278 "You seem like you've been well-trained." [DIAL:010138D2]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Energy Weapons, Explosives, Melee, Unarmed, and Guns. Is that all?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic277 "Energy Weapons, Explosives, Melee, Unarmed, and Guns. Is that all?" [DIAL:010138D3]

text_content: [She nods. Once.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic277 "Energy Weapons, Explosives, Melee, Unarmed, and Guns. Is that all?" [DIAL:010138D3]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: What weapons are you skilled at?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic276 "What weapons are you skilled at?" [DIAL:010138D4]

text_content: [Christine draws a jagged lightning bolt in the air, pantomimes throwing a grenade, and then pulls an imaginary knife from behind her back.]|[Then she moves her feet shoulder width apart, holds hands up in a martial arts stance, then turns both hands into pistols, pantomimes rapid-firing.]|[She then holds one pistol up, takes aim as if sighting along the barrel and does a single shot, ends with a nod.]
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic276 "What weapons are you skilled at?" [DIAL:010138D4]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: Always in the mood for another drink. What's the recipe?
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic110 "Always in the mood for another drink. What's the recipe?" [DIAL:010139B8]

text_content: Sounds... interesting.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic051 "Sounds... interesting." [DIAL:010139B9]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahAct2Introduction
name: NVDLC01ElijahAct2Introduction "NVDLC01ElijahAct2Introduction" [DIAL:01013A0A]

text_content: {Pleased}Good, well done... now, for the festivities, {colder}and your parts in all this.|The owner of the Sierra Madre... {disgusted, thinks this was an idiotic move}for whatever reason... keyed the Grand Opening to the Gala Event itself.|It needs to be fired off in order for the casino doors to open. {Grumbles}As I've discovered, {emph}one person can't do it.|So, get your team in position indicated on your Pip-Boy, then trigger it properly.|You're so close now, don't let me down. {Beat}Otherwise, I'll have to rely on the {emph}next team.
name: NVDLC01ElijahAct2Introduction "NVDLC01ElijahAct2Introduction" [DIAL:01013A0A]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: What do you need me to do now?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic014 "What do you need me to do now?" [DIAL:01013A0B]

text_content: Gather the three others needed for this job, return them here. After that, I'll have more instructions for you.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic014 "What do you need me to do now?" [DIAL:01013A0B]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Take the others to their positions to trigger the Gala Event. After that, the doors of the Sierra Madre should open.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic014 "What do you need me to do now?" [DIAL:01013A0B]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Will exposure kill me?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic011 "Will exposure kill me?" [DIAL:01013A0D]

text_content: {Hardcore Only}No... while it will erode your health, {need to be clear, slow, here}it will only bring you to the point of death, no farther. At that point...
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic011 "Will exposure kill me?" [DIAL:01013A0D]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: The air here is lethal only if you enter concentrated pockets of the Cloud. Too long inside one, you'll die, so be careful where you step.|I've seen some survive concentration of the Cloud for short periods of time if healthy enough - others were too weak.|Rebreathers, chemical suits... there is no protection against it, it decays all it touches. {Beat, slight anger}I've found fighting it useless.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic011 "Will exposure kill me?" [DIAL:01013A0D]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Where is my gear?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic010 "Where is my gear?" [DIAL:01013A0E]

text_content: {Low anger, this is frustrating}The Sierra Madre has many... defenses, means of screening guests for illicit or dangerous items. Your arrival here, weaponless, was {emph}not my intention.|The Casino, this Villa... it takes anything with even a trace of radioactivity, traces of unknown substances... and returns it home. The bunker.|The process is automated, and the casino itself has other, similar "services." I was unable to find a workaround, except to send others in as tools.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic010 "Where is my gear?" [DIAL:01013A0E]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Why is my vision blurring?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic009 "Why is my vision blurring?" [DIAL:01013A0F]

text_content: It is the Cloud covering the Villa. The longer you are outside, the more its toxins seep into your system... through the lungs {emph}and the skin.|It will eat at you the longer you are outside... so wherever you go, move fast, or you'll soon find yourself too weak to move.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic009 "Why is my vision blurring?" [DIAL:01013A0F]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: It is the Cloud that surrounds the Villa. It shouldn't prove lethal in the time you are here... prolonged exposure would be hazardous, however.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic009 "Why is my vision blurring?" [DIAL:01013A0F]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Cold, serious/warning}Fall asleep... and you will not wake up.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic009 "Why is my vision blurring?" [DIAL:01013A0F]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Is there anyone alive around here?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic008 "Is there anyone alive around here?" [DIAL:01013A10]

text_content: {Lower, apprehensive... even he's concerned about these guys}Yes... the inhabitants... avoid them if you can, they are difficult to kill.|{Be clear, slow in this second half, part of combat "rules"}Whatever has created them, bullets, explosions, energy... it can make them inert for a time, then they seem to crawl back up, restored.|Perhaps it's the Cloud... perhaps something in their physiology.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic008 "Is there anyone alive around here?" [DIAL:01013A10]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: How did I get here?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic007 "How did I get here?" [DIAL:01013A11]

text_content: {Emph}I brought you here. {Beat}There are mechanisms in place once the traps across the Mojave are sprung.|For now, your sole focus should be the Sierra Madre, and how to get inside. Until then, you won't leave alive.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic007 "How did I get here?" [DIAL:01013A11]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: What is this place?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic006 "What is this place?" [DIAL:01013A12]

text_content: {Amused}Unfamiliar with the legend of the Sierra Madre? {Cold, precise}The casino exists. You are one of the few who look upon it. |Where you're standing is the Villa beneath the casino above. {Softer, more to himself}The wreckage... the Villa... lies in the shadow.|{Irritated/grumbling throughout}The Villa is a dumping ground of failed construction... Pre-War junk that has aged poorly.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic006 "What is this place?" [DIAL:01013A12]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Elijah Hologram}I had other questions.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic005 "{Elijah Hologram}I had other questions." [DIAL:01013A13]

text_content: {Contemptuous, commanding}I am short on patience. And you are short on time.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic005 "{Elijah Hologram}I had other questions." [DIAL:01013A13]

text_content: {Contemptuous, commanding}Ask.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic005 "{Elijah Hologram}I had other questions." [DIAL:01013A13]

text_content: No, I'm not helping you.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic003 "No, I'm not helping you." [DIAL:01013A14]

text_content: {Finality, cold, presses the button}Then you are of no use to me.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic003 "No, I'm not helping you." [DIAL:01013A14]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: I'm not going to help you.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic002 "I'm not going to help you." [DIAL:01013A15]

text_content: {Cold, imperious}When you came into the bunker, you saw a victim, their head blown off for disobedience. |The city is filled with other stories, {emph}many such stories. Is "no" your choice?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic002 "I'm not going to help you." [DIAL:01013A15]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: What do you want?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic001 "What do you want?" [DIAL:01013A16]

text_content: {Imperious}That structure you see above the Fountain - the Sierra Madre Casino... {snide}you need to break inside. {Smile}A... heist. {Beat, to himself}Too many years in the making.|{Beat, here's the catch}But to get inside, avoid its traps... you'll need to gather the team. {Beat, frustrated}As I've found, one cannot do it alone.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic001 "What do you want?" [DIAL:01013A16]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: {Cold, clear, these are the "rules"}Around the Villa are three other collars like yours - Collar 8, 12, and 14. Find all three and get them here, to the Fountain. Then, we'll talk more.|{Lower, warning}And should you get any ideas about killing each other and taking the treasure of the Sierra Madre for yourself - a warning.|{Emph}All your collars are linked... one of you dies, you {emph}all die. If that's what it takes to make you cooperate, so be it.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic001 "What do you want?" [DIAL:01013A16]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Collar? What are you talking about?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic000 "Collar? What are you talking about?" [DIAL:01013A17]

text_content: {Slow taunt, contempt of Pip-Boy}It's like that Pip-Boy on your wrist, except filled with explosives. {Smug, to himself}A little radio of the Old World, just needed some tuning.|Do what I say, and the collar won't go off... refuse, try and run, {emph}disobey me? I'll kill you and find someone else.|There's no escape from here until I let you go. {Quieter, threaten}The sooner you accept your {emph}situation, the better.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic000 "Collar? What are you talking about?" [DIAL:01013A17]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: NVDLC01ElijahAct1Introduction
name: NVDLC01ElijahIntroduction "NVDLC01ElijahAct1Introduction" [DIAL:01013A18]

text_content: {Contemptuous, commanding}Are you listening? Good. From now on, when I talk, {emph}listen - and follow my instructions.|Play stupid, play clever, make the mistake of saying "no?" That collar on your neck'll go off and take your head with it.
name: NVDLC01ElijahIntroduction "NVDLC01ElijahAct1Introduction" [DIAL:01013A18]

text_content: That's all I needed to know.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahProxyTopic004 "That's all I needed to know." [DIAL:01013A29]

text_content: {Slight smug}Good. {Colder}If {emph}necessary, I will guide you through the Villa's broadcast systems - if you get lost, return here, and I'll direct you.|I've downloaded instructions on an audio log to your Pip-Boy in case you can't read... if you {emph}forget why you're here, let my voice remind you.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahProxyTopic004 "That's all I needed to know." [DIAL:01013A29]

text_content: Then go. The Sierra Madre may wait... I will not.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahProxyTopic004 "That's all I needed to know." [DIAL:01013A29]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Who are these people I'm gathering?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahProxyTopic003 "Who are these people I'm gathering?" [DIAL:01013A2A]

text_content: {Slower here, doesn't want to reveal too much}One is a trusted ally... obedient, collar or no, {to himself}although the collar helps. {Beat, dismissive/cruel}The other two... well, we'll have to see what the traps caught.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahProxyTopic003 "Who are these people I'm gathering?" [DIAL:01013A2A]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: All right. So find the other three people with bomb collars, bring them back here?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic016 "All right. So find the other three people with bomb collars, bring them back here?" [DIAL:01013A2B]

text_content: I've downloaded the instructions and markers on your Pip-Boy... in case you forget. {Beat, contempt}And yes, I have access to that device on your wrist.|Get the other three here, after that... I'll have more instructions for you.|Do this, I'll let you go. {Beat}I'll let {emph}all of you go.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic016 "All right. So find the other three people with bomb collars, bring them back here?" [DIAL:01013A2B]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Radios and speakers can set off my collar?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic015 "Radios and speakers can set off my collar?" [DIAL:01013A2C]

text_content: Yes. But not immediately. {Clear, slow here}You'll hear a beep from your collar's detonator - when you do, step back, scan the area, and find the signal source.|There are damaged speakers, and shielded ones... the damaged ones you can destroy at range - don't get close, you {emph}can't switch them off like a radio.|The damaged speakers are sparking, ha... hard to miss. The casings are resistant to vandalism - punching or hitting them will {emph}not destroy them.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic015 "Radios and speakers can set off my collar?" [DIAL:01013A2C]

text_content: Radios and speakers?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic012 "Radios and speakers?" [DIAL:01013A2D]

text_content: {Building irritation}Yes, music was intended to be broadcast all over the Villa... over time, however, the radio signal has decayed and emits a different frequency.|Speakers and radios interfere with the bomb collar frequency, and can trigger the detonators... prematurely.|It is an unfortunate side effect, one I did not anticipate. I was unable to calibrate the collars to block the signals - so you'll have to make do.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic012 "Radios and speakers?" [DIAL:01013A2D]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: How are you speaking to me?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahProxyTopic001 "How are you speaking to me?" [DIAL:01013A2E]

text_content: {Slight contempt}Confused? {Cold}Don't be. I'm commandeering the hologram technology of the Villa.|Numbers, equations, circuits... all can be controlled, provided there's a connection, and the knowledge to use it.|This Villa, the casino... a treasure trove of such devices. The Holograms included.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahProxyTopic001 "How are you speaking to me?" [DIAL:01013A2E]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Who are you?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahProxyTopic000 "Who are you?" [DIAL:01013A2F]

text_content: Someone who followed the call of the Sierra Madre, just as you did. Now that I've found it's more than a story... I intend to take what's inside.|Maybe that's why you came. Why you followed the Pip-Boy here... and straight into one of my traps. {Beat, cold}Now, this is your reward.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahProxyTopic000 "Who are you?" [DIAL:01013A2F]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Is there any place safe to rest?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic004 "Is there any place safe to rest?" [DIAL:01013A30]

text_content: {Quicker, as if should be evident}Anywhere sheltered from the Cloud... inside buildings, tunnels... any place not exposed to the outside air.|Anything the Cloud has touched has preserved it one way or another... but only the Holograms in the Villa truly remain.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic004 "Is there any place safe to rest?" [DIAL:01013A30]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: What Holograms are you talking about?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic019 "What Holograms are you talking about?" [DIAL:01013A60]

text_content: The inhabitants? There's people alive here?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic018 "The inhabitants? There's people alive here?" [DIAL:01013A61]

text_content: What are the Vending Machines in the Villa?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic002 "What are the Vending Machines in the Villa?" [DIAL:01013A63]

text_content: {More matter of fact here, like detailing specs on a car or gun, respects the vending machine tech}Assembly stations. Schematics are stored within... dispensers with unlock codes.|They use the Chips scattered around as batteries... alloys and raw material embedded in the shell.|They resemble the vending machines of the Mojave, but they are crafting devices of tremendous versatility. Once an Old World convenience, now...|...now, they are a means of survival. Use the Chips to power them. Select from the holographic display, the device will assemble it.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic002 "What are the Vending Machines in the Villa?" [DIAL:01013A63]

text_content: What is the Cloud?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic001 "What is the Cloud?" [DIAL:01013A64]

text_content: {Slight admiration as if for beautiful vista}The Cloud is what blankets the sky here... you may smell it in the air, copper and sulfur... burns the lungs and seeps into the skin.|As for its origins... I am not certain. Pre-War industrial pollutants... something in the Sierra Madre structure...|{Contemplative}It is unique across the wasteland... and deadly. It has kept this place preserved since the Great War.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic001 "What is the Cloud?" [DIAL:01013A64]

text_content: Can you tell me about the Holograms in the Villa?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic000 "Can you tell me about the Holograms in the Villa?" [DIAL:01013A65]

text_content: Why?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahProxyOldTopic001 "Why?" [DIAL:01013A66]

text_content: Most Holograms perform specific functions. The Security Holograms, ever since the bombs fell, now perform {emph}their function.|{Cold, serious}They will kill anyone they detect. {Frustrated}They are immune to guns, weapons, EMPs... even energy weapons. Still, they have limitations.|Their design limits their field of view, enough to avoid detection.|Each has an emitter - destroy or disable it, and they cease to be a threat.|{Less authoritative here, more reflective/rueful}Still... at least {emph}they still work as intended. Other technology here is more of a threat to you... notably, the Villa's radios and speakers.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahProxyOldTopic001 "Why?" [DIAL:01013A66]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: What are these Holograms?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahProxyOldTopic000 "What are these Holograms?" [DIAL:01013A67]

text_content: {Thinking}Ghosts... they fill the Villa. {Beat}More in the Casino... much more.|They carry out the functions the dead once did. They cannot be harmed... they only perform the same rote tasks until their power dies.|They are of no consequence - except for the Security Holograms, the ones with the silhouettes of the armored Sierra Madre guards.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahProxyOldTopic000 "What are these Holograms?" [DIAL:01013A67]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: What's FEV?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic025 "What's FEV?" [DIAL:01013A70]

text_content: {Dismissive, throw away the line}A long story. FEV... a virus with an even longer story... it gave birth to the docile one, turned him into a Super Mutant long ago.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic025 "What's FEV?" [DIAL:01013A70]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Any suggestions for who I should get first?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic023 "Any suggestions for who I should get first?" [DIAL:01013A72]

text_content: Yes... {Lower, dismissive, like talking about a mule}Collar 8, the FEV reject, the Super Mutant. He's docile, predictable, and provided he's not starving, should be easy to command.|{Frowning, not sure why this is}I lost contact with him some time ago... probably after he dragged you here from the trap. Find him, he'll follow you, collar or no.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic023 "Any suggestions for who I should get first?" [DIAL:01013A72]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: How am I supposed to find them?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic021 "How am I supposed to find them?" [DIAL:01013A73]

text_content: {Authoritative, contempt for RobCo tech}Your piece of RobCo trash will help you, I've ensured it. It can latch on to the signal of the collars...|...and tune into their frequencies. The bomb collars come with radios embedded in them. You can eavesdrop easily.|It was part of their design... to listen in. They can even screen out white noise from the environment to allow greater monitoring.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic021 "How am I supposed to find them?" [DIAL:01013A73]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: You have got to be kidding. This place is filled with radio mines that can kill me?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic039 "You have got to be kidding. This place is filled with radio mines that can kill me?" [DIAL:01013ADB]

text_content: So I have to deal with them - or I explode?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic038 "So I have to deal with them - or I explode?" [DIAL:01013ADC]

text_content: Forget it, then. I'll be on my way.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic037 "Forget it, then. I'll be on my way." [DIAL:01013ADD]

text_content: I'll cooperate - if you can answer some questions for me.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic036 "I'll cooperate - if you can answer some questions for me." [DIAL:01013ADE]

text_content: I've decided I'm not going to help you.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic012 "I've decided I'm not going to help you." [DIAL:01013ADF]

text_content: {Cold, imperious}When you came into the bunker, you saw a victim, their head blown off for disobedience. |The city is filled with other stories, {emph}many such stories. Is "no" your choice?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic012 "I've decided I'm not going to help you." [DIAL:01013ADF]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Never mind, then.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic011 "Never mind, then." [DIAL:01013AE0]

text_content: I had questions.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic010 "I had questions." [DIAL:01013AE1]

text_content: How did I get here?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic009 "How did I get here?" [DIAL:01013AE2]

text_content: {Slightly amused, incredulous, emph on "get"}Hmm! Get here? {Beat, judging}You walked into one of my traps in the Mojave... following the Sierra Madre signal. Now, you're here, with that collar on your neck.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic009 "How did I get here?" [DIAL:01013AE2]

text_content: Then maybe you better tell me why I'm here.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic035 "Then maybe you better tell me why I'm here." [DIAL:01013AE3]

text_content: I'm not alone, then.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic034 "I'm not alone, then." [DIAL:01013AE4]

text_content: You've caught others?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic033 "You've caught others?" [DIAL:01013AE5]

text_content: Who's the woman Hologram in the Fountain?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic008 "Who's the woman Hologram in the Fountain?" [DIAL:01013AE6]

text_content: {Throw away line, he doesn't care}I do not know. A Pre-War icon, perhaps. {Beat, back to the matter at hand}It is of no consequence aside from being a circuit I can utilize.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic008 "Who's the woman Hologram in the Fountain?" [DIAL:01013AE6]

text_content: If I can't punch them or smash them, that doesn't leave me many options.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic007 "If I can't punch them or smash them, that doesn't leave me many options." [DIAL:01013AE7]

text_content: Aside from switching them off, what can I do?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic006 "Aside from switching them off, what can I do?" [DIAL:01013AE8]

text_content: How are they different?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahProxyOldTopic003 "How are they different?" [DIAL:01013AE9]

text_content: "Security" doesn't sound safe to me.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahProxyOldTopic002 """Security"" doesn't sound safe to me." [DIAL:01013AEA]

text_content: What is this rifle?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic032 "What is this rifle?" [DIAL:01013AEB]

text_content: {Precise, then superior}It is a Holorifle, a weapon I constructed when I arrived... I have since made superior models - and modifications.|{Dismissive}For now, that tool will have to do until you find other weapons... {warning}and I suggest you do, the Holorifle's ammo is limited.|Still, it should serve well enough. I fashioned it from the Holograms of the Villa {beat}and used it against the Villa's... living inhabitants.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic032 "What is this rifle?" [DIAL:01013AEB]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: What do you mean?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic031 "What do you mean?" [DIAL:01013AEC]

text_content: {Less superior, more didactic in this}This place is well-preserved. Few who came here ever returned. All of the treasures of the Old World lie scattered about, virtually untouched.|Search, hunt... craft what you can from what you find. The trash of the Pre-War era can keep you alive - food, knives, more. Use them.|Even the Villa's toxins... and the residue it leaves behind... can be shaped into tools and weapons. Gather it as well.|Also... there is one more thing in your possession, a rifle that will keep you alive, as surely as the collar will.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic031 "What do you mean?" [DIAL:01013AEC]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: Where is my gear?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic030 "Where is my gear?" [DIAL:01013AED]

text_content: {Low anger, this is frustrating}The Sierra Madre has many... defenses, means of screening guests for illicit or dangerous items. Your arrival here, weaponless, was {emph}not my intention.|{Irritated, then slow, final in end}The Casino, this Villa... it takes anything with even a trace of radioactivity, traces of unknown substances... and returns it home. The bunker.|{Matter of fact}The process is automated, and the casino itself has other, similar "services." I was unable to find a workaround, except to send others in as tools.|Still... I have not left you defenseless, and the Sierra Madre's security in some respects, can help you if you are resourceful enough.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic030 "Where is my gear?" [DIAL:01013AED]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: How many of these victims did you bring here?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic029 "How many of these victims did you bring here?" [DIAL:01013AEE]

text_content: {Sharp, frustrated}Too many. {Slower, more frustrated}This place is dangerous... and its quarantine measures, its hazards... have claimed many. Failures upon failures.|Do you think I wanted to place collars on you to ensure compliance? No... if robots could have done this, I would've sent them.|The Sierra Madre is a complicated lock. Cracking it open requires human hands.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic029 "How many of these victims did you bring here?" [DIAL:01013AEE]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: What's inside the Sierra Madre?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic005 "What's inside the Sierra Madre?" [DIAL:01013AEF]

text_content: {Disdain}That is for me to know. You get that far... you'll see for yourself.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic005 "What's inside the Sierra Madre?" [DIAL:01013AEF]

text_content: Are they all dead?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic028 "Are they all dead?" [DIAL:01013AF0]

text_content: {Disgust, lower}The ones brought here live on only in what they've left behind, their marks - graffiti on the walls. And victims they've killed.|Some tried to help... left supplies and healing for others who came. Their reward? They were tracked down, killed by others with baser instincts.|Some of these murderers went as far as to leave traps behind them... turning markers for help into deathtraps for anyone following them.|It killed some of them when they forgot where the traps lay... or when they desperately needed the assistance they had cut others off from.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic028 "Are they all dead?" [DIAL:01013AF0]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: I'll help. What do you want me to do?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic027 "I'll help. What do you want me to do?" [DIAL:01013AF1]

text_content: Why would you do that?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic026 "Why would you do that?" [DIAL:01013AF2]

text_content: {Theme of the game, clear, cold here}Because in some respects, breaking in to the Sierra Madre is easier than breaking human instinct. {Beat, explaining}Greed.|The Villa is filled with corpses. Some killed by the dangers here, some by me. Others... turned on each other.|Once they realized the Sierra Madre could be theirs, they cared nothing for their freedom... their survival... or each other.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic026 "Why would you do that?" [DIAL:01013AF2]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: So I need others to pull off this... heist. Who?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic022 "So I need others to pull off this... heist. Who?" [DIAL:01013AF3]

text_content: So how do I destroy the radios and speakers then?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic020 "So how do I destroy the radios and speakers then?" [DIAL:01013AF4]

text_content: Gunshots, energy blasts - {more to himself, quick}even spears thrown with great force - can puncture their exterior.|Shielded speakers can't be destroyed at all. You'll need to avoid them or switch them off via a terminal. {Beat, disdain}I... I'll leave the method up to you.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic020 "So how do I destroy the radios and speakers then?" [DIAL:01013AF4]

text_content: What do you mean?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic015 "What do you mean?" [DIAL:01013B06]

text_content: The real work? What was this, a warm-up?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic014 "The real work? What was this, a warm-up?" [DIAL:01013B07]

text_content: Perhaps you think this is a simple robbery. A cheap casino heist.|No... this is a heist of the {emph}centuries. We're not plundering the Sierra Madre - we're plundering {emph}history, taking from the Old World itself.|It won't let its secrets go easily... not without a fight. I wouldn't expect anything less.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic014 "The real work? What was this, a warm-up?" [DIAL:01013B07]

text_content: We'll head out, then.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic013 "We'll head out, then." [DIAL:01013B08]

text_content: {Start Act 2 Quests}I'd suggest taking the FEV reject to his position first... {more to himself, thinking of other dangers}although you may need his brutality and strength elsewhere first.|As easy as the Villa was to navigate... the outlying areas of the Villa are far more dangerous, thicker with the Ghost People, traps, and toxins.|Use your team as I use you... listen to your collar, watch where you step. You're no use to me dead.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic013 "We'll head out, then." [DIAL:01013B08]

text_content: What is the Gala Event?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic004 "What is the Gala Event?" [DIAL:01013B09]

text_content: A display of lights, fireworks... music in the streets, a Pre-War festival to mark the casino's opening. The bombs struck first.|It is of no consequence, only firing the event is - get the three in position, then travel to your position in Salida del Sol and trigger the Gala.|After that, the real work begins.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic004 "What is the Gala Event?" [DIAL:01013B09]

text_content: How am I supposed to get to the markers on my map?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic003 "How am I supposed to get to the markers on my map?" [DIAL:01013B0A]

text_content: {Slow}I've unlocked the West and East gates to Puesta del Sol and Salida del Sol... |{Contempt}...now that you've survived the Villa, I need to get to my position, you don't need me to hold your hand anymore.|{Contempt fades a bit}I'll keep monitoring you via the transceivers through the Villa... if I need to offer guidance, I will.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTalkingActivatorTopic003 "How am I supposed to get to the markers on my map?" [DIAL:01013B0A]

text_content: Where can I find him?
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic017 "Where can I find him?" [DIAL:01013B10]

text_content: Travel West, toward the Villa Police Station - follow the radio frequency and the alarms.|{Thinking, reflective}Although there's a great deal of interference at the source. Perhaps that's why I lost contact with him.|No matter, aside from Collar 8, there should be weapons, armor at the police station. Go West, avoid the Villa inhabitants, bring the mutant back.
name: NVDLC01ElijahDialogueNVDLC01ElijahTopic017 "Where can I find him?" [DIAL:01013B10]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

text_content: So after your speech about control, now you're going to use the collars like Elijah did?
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic280 "So after your speech about control, now you're going to use the collars like Elijah did?" [DIAL:01013B14]

text_content: {Frowns, slow}You know what... you're right. I don't need to use the same methods to kill you, and I shouldn't... it would make me as bad as Elijah is.|{Cold, low}All right - forget the proximity frequency, we'll decide this ourselves.
name: NVDLC01ChristineDialogueNVDLC01ChristineTopic280 "So after your speech about control, now you're going to use the collars like Elijah did?" [DIAL:01013B14]
speaker: NVDLC01Christine "Christine" [NPC_:010012FF]

text_content: When we were sneaking, you mentioned Lou... who's Lou?
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic077 "When we were sneaking, you mentioned Lou... who's Lou?" [DIAL:01013B17]

text_content: Lou... ten... ant? Long ago. Smart. {Beat}Gave us all things to do. Like watch. And kill. {Beat}Gone now.|Miss Lou. Miss the Base. Miss the Church. Don't like here. {Frowns}Don't want to talk about it any more, makes head hurt.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01DogTopic077 "When we were sneaking, you mentioned Lou... who's Lou?" [DIAL:01013B17]
speaker: NVDLC01Dog "Dog" [CREA:01001301]

text_content: Both Holograms are on now. It's safe for you to get to your position.
name: NVDLC01DeanDialogueNVDLC01DeanTopic205 "Both Holograms are on now. It's safe for you to get to your position." [DIAL:01013B4B]

text_content: So you're the one who knows how I got to the Villa.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic004 "So you're the one who knows how I got to the Villa." [DIAL:01013BE9]

text_content: {DUPE: Amused}Of course I know. {Snarling}Even if I don't see it happen - down in the cage, I hear echoes of the footfalls, the click of the collars.|{Furious}Every time I see one of you I know exactly how you got here - you couldn't help yourselves, anymore than Dog can help himself.|{Accusing}You heard the voice, the promise, and then you walked right into one of the Old Man's traps. Then... then Dog comes for you, drags you here.
name: NVDLC01DogDialogueNVDLC01GodTopic004 "So you're the one who knows how I got to the Villa." [DIAL:01013BE9]
speaker: NVDLC01God "God" [CREA:0100E413]

text_content: NVDLC01IntroSlide14
name: NVDLC01IntroSlide14 "NVDLC01IntroSlide14" [DIAL:01013C4C]

text_content: It's still out there, in the Wastes, preserved, just waiting for someone to crack it open. {Slow, "it" = Sierra Madre}But getting to it. {Beat}That's not the hard part.

speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

name: NVDLC01IntroSlide13 "NVDLC01IntroSlide13" [DIAL:01013C4D]

text_content: {Bitter}The war froze it in time, like a big flashbulb going off. {Slow, bitter, downnote}The Grand Opening - one big ending of humanity.
name: NVDLC01IntroSlide13 "NVDLC01IntroSlide13" [DIAL:01013C4D]
speaker: NVDLC01Elijah "Father Elijah" [NPC_:01001300]

name: NVDLC01IntroSlide12 "NVDLC01IntroSlide12" [DIAL:01013C4E]

text_content: Except - the Sierra Madre never opened.

text_content: ... but for {Elijah is thinking of himself when he says "all"}all who came to its doors.

Looks like we aren't the only ones that had the idea to check this place out. Our advance scouts encountered heavy Legion activity in the area. The troopers are gearing up to hit them tonight - hopefully before they know we're here.

text_content:
3rd Platoon, Cazador Company, 4th Ranger Battalion Action Report: Staff Sergeant Balmoral reporting. We've reached the area local tribes call "the Divide," but so far, I don't think this will be a suitable route for bringing troops to Hoover Dam. The terrain is a nightmare, we've seen evidence of hostile indigenous life, and the Geiger counters are ticking like grandfather clocks on Turbo.

Full report when the advance scouts come back at 2300, but as of now I'm recommending we abandon this mission.

We will soon play host to one of the greatest American patriots of our day, General Wellesley himself. For those of you whose family trees don't fork, the General is chief liaison officer to the Big MT Research Facility. He and his team are paying us a visit to collect our "guests" and take them someplace where they can do some good for their country beyond stinking of patchouli and shooting the LSD.

Commander Devlin

text_content: "Minor and nothing to worry about." If that last quake wasn't a 5.0 at least, I'm Dean Domino. That's it, I'm requesting a transfer before the whole plaudsfg099io8u8ioi yti xciokghpt8i9io
name: Earthquakes Part 2

text_content:
Fantastic. Now there's earthquakes. Earthquakes! Sure, Commander Devlin says they're minor ones and nothing to worry about, but come on. EARTHQUAKES. Did no one think to check fault lines before they built a massive UNDERGROUND MISSILE COMPLEX?

Your tax dollars at work, folks. Swear to God, when my term's up I'm moving to Canada.
name: Earthquakes

text_content: Swear to God, if I lose one more night of sleep over these noises I am going to strangle somebody. "Knocking pipes" my ass - do these slumlords think it's easy running the safety protocols for an entire ICBM launch complex on two hours sleep? It's a goddamn miracle nobody's started World War III over a low-flying titmouse.
name: Noise

text_content:
Listen here you pinko Commie-eyed puke, I got your lily-livered defeatest e-mails. I ignored them because they made me THROW UP IN MY MOUTH! Do you understand we're fighting a war here?! Against the REDS? And the only thing standing between you and hot atomic Armageddon is ME and my base full of GIANT NUCLEAR MISSILES? Answer me this, Specialist Buttinski: if the American people are overrun by Kremlin Joe and his Chicom cronies, what good will clean drinking water be?

Commander Devlin
name: Re: Wastewater Note

text_content:
Commander Devlin,

I apologize for e-mailing you again, but I still haven't received a response to my previous seven e-mails. Once again, we DESPERATELY need more funding to improve safety protocols at the water treatment plant. Current protocols are absolutely appalling, and I don't even want to think about the consequences of a failure on the local water supply.

Specialist Alan Rothchild
name: Wastewater Note

text_content:
Attention All Base Personnel:

DO NOT engage the protestors outside the construction zone. I know, I know, the presence of those freedom-loving no-goodniks fills my brain with the WHITE-HOT RAGE OF CAPITALIST JUSTICE, but the Political Office has something planned for them, and you mooks better not screw it up.

Commander Devlin
name: Inter-Office Email

text_content: Somebody from the Political Office should keep an eye on those guys down at the water treatment plant. That's the third request for extra funds I've had to deny this month - do they think we're made of money? I swear, it's like they want the Communists to win....
name: Report

text_content:
Dear diary,

I think we did it! We finally convinced the Death Merchants to hear our beautiful Mother Earth's cries! I just had a personal meeting with the base commander, who said they would be taking a long, hard look at our demands and preparing something special for us. I can't wait to see what it is - I bet it's a full nuclear disarmament!
name: Sunflower Summers' Diary

text_content:
If you find this, my name is James Rubinek. I'm a trader from the Hub - thought I'd found a new route to markets east. Guess now I know why no routes go through this Godforsaken place. Leg's broken, can't get out, and even if I could there's those crazed ghouls and those digging things waiting for me.

Please, get this note to my ex-wife, Anna. Tell her what happened. Tell her how I died. And I guess you can tell that cheating bitch I hope she's happy with that limp-dick Rory Spencer.
name: For whoever finds this....

text_content: Initial recon of the Divide has met with heavy resistance. These ghouls - the troopers have started calling them "Marked Men" - are smarter than the typical ferals we're used to. Yesterday we found some old Pre-War cages they've used to capture Deathclaws - God knows what they were planning to do with them, but one of the things must have escaped, judging from the carnage. I've ordered double watches until we find it.
name: Mission Report

text_content: Jesus, this place is a hellhole. I heard it was bad from some of the guys coming back, but... Jesus. Henriksen bought it when one of those unexploded warheads went off, and Jenkins... those things got him. I don't know what they were exactly - ghouls, maybe, but nasty fuckers. LT thinks they were drawn by the explosion that killed Henriksen. I think we're all gonna die here.

text_content: {Irritated, player hasn't given up}Even in this place, NCR's shadow falls. {Beat}Or is it just, you, {speaking title}Courier, without the Bear's corpse to weigh you down.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesForceGreetDUPLICATE001 "NVDLC04UlyssesForceGreet" [DIAL:02003E3B]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Irritated, player hasn't given up}So you came, {disgust}Frumentarii, {beat, title}Courier - whatever you are now. {Slight mocking}Come to carry out Caesar's law? His voice carries no weight here.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesForceGreetDUPLICATE001 "NVDLC04UlyssesForceGreet" [DIAL:02003E3B]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Irritated, player hasn't given up - hates Vegas}Your city, Vegas, lies in the other direction... with the rest of its slaves. {Beat}Or is it just, you, {speaking title}Courier, without the lights and ghosts.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesForceGreetDUPLICATE001 "NVDLC04UlyssesForceGreet" [DIAL:02003E3B]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Irritated, player hasn't given up}So you came, {disgust}Courier, to what - watch your homeland burn one last time. Kill me, perhaps.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesForceGreetDUPLICATE001 "NVDLC04UlyssesForceGreet" [DIAL:02003E3B]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Beat, disgust, a little quieter - notices player's got ED-E with him}Judging by your shadow... maybe you can't let your machine go. Doesn't matter now.|Either way, the Divide giants are awakening. The missiles here, on their way home. {Cold}There is no way to stop them.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesForceGreetDUPLICATE001 "NVDLC04UlyssesForceGreet" [DIAL:02003E3B]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You are too late. The Divide is awakening - the package, and the message within, have come full circle.|The sequence has begun, just as before. Except this time, the missiles will touch the sky instead of being locked beneath the ground.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesForceGreetDUPLICATE001 "NVDLC04UlyssesForceGreet" [DIAL:02003E3B]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Ulysses Cut-In 4}
name: NVDLC04EDEUlyssesTopic004 "{Ulysses Cut-In 4}" [DIAL:020087D4]

text_content: {Cold}Thought that explosion, that building falling deep in the Divide might have been your work... wouldn't kill you, maybe close.|Knew you'd survive... but no need to go any farther. You've brought me what I need - that machine with you, sealed in the Hopeville silo.|Needed someone to unlock it - bring it home. {Cold}Now the signal's strong enough, no need for you to carry it anymore. I can call your machine to me.
name: NVDLC04EDEUlyssesTopic004 "{Ulysses Cut-In 4}" [DIAL:020087D4]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Ulysses Cut-In 3}
name: NVDLC04EDEUlyssesTopic003 "{Ulysses Cut-In 3}" [DIAL:020087D5]

text_content: Hopeville, High Road, Ashton... tiny cracks in the Earth, {emph}nothing compared to the road carved ahead.{No sound file}|Before you... this is the {emph}edge of the Divide. Ahead lies your work, the history you burned in the earth. {Beat, emph}What you brought to the people here.
name: NVDLC04EDEUlyssesTopic003 "{Ulysses Cut-In 3}" [DIAL:020087D5]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Ulysses Cut-In 2}
name: NVDLC04EDEUlyssesTopic002 "{Ulysses Cut-In 2}" [DIAL:020087D6]

text_content: {Contacting player through radio}There you are, you went quiet for a time... knew killing the Bear wouldn't prove easy... {slight disgust, hates ED-E}you and your machine, you survived.|There's a lesson here, in the Divide. Old World history about paving and intentions could teach the Republic a thing or two - if they listened.|They have an idea of trying to do what's right, never quite getting there. Maybe you've seen it - Nipton, elsewhere.
name: NVDLC04EDEUlyssesTopic002 "{Ulysses Cut-In 2}" [DIAL:020087D6]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Contacting player through radio}Picking up the signal from your machine... was quiet for a time, thought the Road had claimed another of the Legion.{No sound file}|Too many of the Bull have already fallen here... to radiation, fire... and what burrows below.
name: NVDLC04EDEUlyssesTopic002 "{Ulysses Cut-In 2}" [DIAL:020087D6]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Contacting player through radio}There you are, you went quiet for a time... thought you might have returned to Vegas, its comforts. {Slight disgust}Maybe you took that machine with you.{No sound file}|There's a lesson here, in the Divide. Old World history about holding on to something so tightly it breaks... or falls apart.|May have seen the cracks in Vegas's walls already. If so, they'll grow, in time, no matter how much you back House.
name: NVDLC04EDEUlyssesTopic002 "{Ulysses Cut-In 2}" [DIAL:020087D6]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Contacting player through radio}There you are, you went quiet for a time. {Beat, slight disgust for machine}Then that signal came in strong from your machine, like a heartbeat.{No sound file}|Made your way through Old World towns, the tunnels that join them... now, the High Road.|For all you've seen behind you - {quieter}there's worse along this stretch. Deathclaws - hunt the Marked Men, {even quieter, for emphasis}and they also hunt what burrows below.
name: NVDLC04EDEUlyssesTopic002 "{Ulysses Cut-In 2}" [DIAL:020087D6]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

That'll end soon, can't walk the Long 15 and not have a nation's shadow fall on you.|Maybe you just need to be tested. Or you believe in nothing. {Cold accusing}We'll see.

text_content: {Half of the Marked Men have died, combat is half over}We've shown them fear, but not enough. More will come.

name: NVDLC04UlyssesFriendMarkedMenAllDead "NVDLC04UlyssesFriendMarkedMenAllDead" [DIAL:0200C67E]

text_content: {All the Marked Men are dead, combat is over.}We've broken them. The Bear and the Bull have no more shadows to throw at us.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesFriendMarkedMenAllDead "NVDLC04UlyssesFriendMarkedMenAllDead" [DIAL:0200C67E]

text_content: {To himself}Old World's running out of machines.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesFriendSentryDies02 "NVDLC04UlyssesFriendSentryDies02" [DIAL:0200C67F]

name: NVDLC04UlyssesFriendTaunt03 "NVDLC04UlyssesFriendTaunt03" [DIAL:0200C681]

text_content: You have forgotten all you were, traded glory for savagery. {Thoughtful}Fitting.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesFriendTaunt03 "NVDLC04UlyssesFriendTaunt03" [DIAL:0200C681]

text_content: NVDLC04UlyssesFriendTaunt02
name: NVDLC04UlyssesFriendTaunt02 "NVDLC04UlyssesFriendTaunt02" [DIAL:0200C682]

text_content: Mercy killings - let them rest.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesFriendTaunt02 "NVDLC04UlyssesFriendTaunt02" [DIAL:0200C682]

text_content: NVDLC04UlyssesFriendTaunt01
name: NVDLC04UlyssesFriendTaunt01 "NVDLC04UlyssesFriendTaunt01" [DIAL:0200C683]

text_content: {Dismissive}Beasts from the Divide. To the Divide, they return.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesFriendTaunt01 "NVDLC04UlyssesFriendTaunt01" [DIAL:0200C683]

name: NVDLC04UlyssesFriendMarkedMenEnter "NVDLC04UlyssesFriendMarkedMenEnter" [DIAL:0200C685]

text_content: {Marked Men enter the Temple, combat starts}They come for us,  East and West alike.
