name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatTaunt03 "NVDLC04UlyssesCombatTaunt03" [DIAL:0200C686]

text_content: {Grim, taunt}Running out of time, Courier.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatTaunt03 "NVDLC04UlyssesCombatTaunt03" [DIAL:0200C686]

text_content: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatTaunt02
name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatTaunt02 "NVDLC04UlyssesCombatTaunt02" [DIAL:0200C687]

text_content: {Taunt, dismissive}Come all this way - to die alone.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatTaunt02 "NVDLC04UlyssesCombatTaunt02" [DIAL:0200C687]

text_content: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatTaunt01
name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatTaunt01 "NVDLC04UlyssesCombatTaunt01" [DIAL:0200C688]

text_content: {Taunt, snarl}I'll end you - and your history.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatTaunt01 "NVDLC04UlyssesCombatTaunt01" [DIAL:0200C688]

text_content: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatMarkedMenKilled02
name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatMarkedMenKilled02 "NVDLC04UlyssesCombatMarkedMenKilled02" [DIAL:0200C689]

text_content: {Marked Men have been killed}Killing them is mercy.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatMarkedMenKilled02 "NVDLC04UlyssesCombatMarkedMenKilled02" [DIAL:0200C689]

text_content: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatEyebotDestroyed02
name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatEyebotDestroyed02 "NVDLC04UlyssesCombatEyebotDestroyed02" [DIAL:0200C68A]

text_content: {Dismissive contempt, under his breath}Don't need Old World medicine to kill you.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatEyebotDestroyed02 "NVDLC04UlyssesCombatEyebotDestroyed02" [DIAL:0200C68A]

text_content: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatMarkedMenKilled01
name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatMarkedMenKilled01 "NVDLC04UlyssesCombatMarkedMenKilled01" [DIAL:0200C68B]

text_content: {Marked Men have been killed, cold contempt}Kill as many as you want - the Divide will birth more.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatMarkedMenKilled01 "NVDLC04UlyssesCombatMarkedMenKilled01" [DIAL:0200C68B]

text_content: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatEyebotDestroyed01
name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatEyebotDestroyed01 "NVDLC04UlyssesCombatEyebotDestroyed01" [DIAL:0200C68C]

text_content: {Dismissive/contempt}Destroying my machines won't help you. This facility will make more.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatEyebotDestroyed01 "NVDLC04UlyssesCombatEyebotDestroyed01" [DIAL:0200C68C]

text_content: How are you speaking through ED-E?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic001 "How are you speaking through ED-E?" [DIAL:0200C7FC]

text_content: {Disgust}The idea of a machine bearing a message new to you? Thought that was how House relayed all his messages... {disdain}through his robots.{No sound file}
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic001 "How are you speaking through ED-E?" [DIAL:0200C7FC]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {"You're hiding behind a machine," and Ulysses isn't sure what the player means at first}The machine... the robot. No, not Legion... less history than that.{No sound file}
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic001 "How are you speaking through ED-E?" [DIAL:0200C7FC]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Frowns}The robot with {emph}you... {Beat, explains, disgust, hates ED-E}all of them are machines - radios, Old World tech reshaped with new hands. Historians. Couriers, carrying messages.{No sound file}|Seen them as I've walked the Divide, tending other machines. {Frowns}That one... sealed inside the Hopeville silo. {Beat to himself}Sign America is waking up.|{Cold, authoritative, hates ED-E}It will follow you, obey you. {Beat, low}Carry it until we are face to face, then there'll be no more need for it to carry {emph}my words.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic001 "How are you speaking through ED-E?" [DIAL:0200C7FC]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Maybe you better tell me who you are, and what you want.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic000 "Maybe you better tell me who you are, and what you want." [DIAL:0200C7FD]

text_content: {Slow, cold}I'm a courier. {Beat}Courier Six... was Courier Six. Like you - and {emph}not like you, in all the ways that matter.{No sound file}|{Low, slight threat}Spent too many years looking for you - now, letting you come to me.|Thought carrying that Chip would end you, no... you got lives in you, hard to kill. Storms, bullets... sand and wind, yet still you walk. For now.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic000 "Maybe you better tell me who you are, and what you want." [DIAL:0200C7FD]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Enough talking. You went to a lot of trouble to lure me here, so let's get on with this.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic007 "Enough talking. You went to a lot of trouble to lure me here, so let's get on with this." [DIAL:0200C807]

text_content: {Cold, introspective}America sleeps ahead of you, its nightmares filled with quakes, storms. You'll need to find your own path.{No sound file}|That means waking America's spears up from their slumber. There's ways - warheads set off the collapse, {beat}warheads could open the gates again.|{Challenge}You're resourceful. {Disgust for machine}That machine, robot with you - can help you find the warheads you need to destroy... {a little slower, quest object}and their trigger, the detonator.|The way ahead is below. The tools are there. The rest - up to you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic007 "Enough talking. You went to a lot of trouble to lure me here, so let's get on with this." [DIAL:0200C807]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Those... troops, NCR or Legion, the ones in the silo were already dead.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic006 "Those... troops, NCR or Legion, the ones in the silo were already dead." [DIAL:0200C808]

text_content: Are those the bodies I saw in the silo? The soldiers that look like they'd been flayed?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic004 "Are those the bodies I saw in the silo? The soldiers that look like they'd been flayed?" [DIAL:0200C80A]

text_content: If you saw their corpses, you saw mercy. Got what they deserved, coming to the Divide.{No sound file}|The Bear and Bull - NCR, Legion - came in waves. Before. And after. Right into the invisible fires... the wind, ground... collapsing beneath them.|Once under different flags, now they are equal in their hatred of the trespassers. You and I.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic004 "Are those the bodies I saw in the silo? The soldiers that look like they'd been flayed?" [DIAL:0200C80A]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: What is this place?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic003 "What is this place?" [DIAL:0200C80B]

text_content: The Divide... this place is a slice of it. Old military. Can still smell the pride - and the fear.{No sound file}|{Introspective}Hope of the Old World, wrapped in fencing, covered in storm. Got new inhabitants now other than ghosts, more recent... recruits.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic003 "What is this place?" [DIAL:0200C80B]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Fine. I'll find this trigger - then I'll come find you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic011 "Fine. I'll find this trigger - then I'll come find you." [DIAL:0200C820]

text_content: The Divide will send its worst against you - it may break you. We'll see if you're stronger.{No sound file}|Road gets rougher from here... {slight disdain}Courier. Left marks for you, colors'll tell the way - if you're smart.|They'll lead you to your home one more time, lead to the ending of it - {slow, cold}maybe remind you why you wander.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic011 "Fine. I'll find this trigger - then I'll come find you." [DIAL:0200C820]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I'm not planning to go into the Divide after you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic010 "I'm not planning to go into the Divide after you." [DIAL:0200C821]

text_content: No Courier would go to the Divide... but you will. And that's what sets us apart - we walk roads no other Courier will walk.{No sound file}|And for you... you'll want to see your home one last time, see what happened.|You're curious. You walk, leave ruin in your path... you can't leave alone. Still, the choice is yours... what I offer, it's the last I offer you.|I don't care if you walk the Divide. Turn, walk the Mojave, fight beneath the flags... but you'll wonder.|If you don't, the Divide will come to you, and the Mojave. That will be my message to you, like the message you had for me.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic010 "I'm not planning to go into the Divide after you." [DIAL:0200C821]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You think I'm coming after you? Think again.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic008 "You think I'm coming after you? Think again." [DIAL:0200C823]

text_content: The Long 15 is no more. The main supply line into NCR is cut.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic009 "The Long 15 is no more. The main supply line into NCR is cut." [DIAL:0200CA8D]

text_content: No damage done, not yet. Maybe in years. Keeps the Bear fenced... if Caesar can't drive it back, fire might.|Only delays the end for the Bull, a new wall for them to scale and cross... once they're done with the Mojave. And Hoover Dam.|Never again do you or any other courier and caravan need walk that route. Let the Mojave breathe without that asphalt scar raking it.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic009 "The Long 15 is no more. The main supply line into NCR is cut." [DIAL:0200CA8D]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Dry Wells is destroyed - that was your birthplace?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic008 "Dry Wells is destroyed - that was your birthplace?" [DIAL:0200CA8E]

text_content: No, opposite of that. It's where my tribe was taken. Where another history was put to the blade, lesson taught.|It is where we realized Vulpes did not approach us as equals. Where we realized the wolf had come, and we watched our history die.|Now it belongs to Legion... and all the death there now belongs to them as well. Not revenge... just the way of things when you {emph}own them.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic008 "Dry Wells is destroyed - that was your birthplace?" [DIAL:0200CA8E]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I wanted to hear more about Hoover Dam.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic007 "I wanted to hear more about Hoover Dam." [DIAL:0200CA8F]

text_content: Old World wall, run red with blood of Bear and Bull. It'll bleed more before the sun sets on the Mojave.|That place and I have a past, owe it a debt - and it owes me. If your path takes you there, know you're not the only one.|It's the wall by which this age will be measured, the gravestone of the Mojave. Old World never meant it as such.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic007 "I wanted to hear more about Hoover Dam." [DIAL:0200CA8F]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: What are you doing here?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic006 "What are you doing here?" [DIAL:0200CA90]

text_content: A question one could have asked you not long ago, before walking the road West into the storms.|Need to be here, see what was done. It's custom of the Bear to never see the marks it claws in the land... not {emph}my custom.|Maybe that's why you've come, too - need to see where the missile from Ashton touched ground down below, in Hopeville... the Courier's Mile.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic006 "What are you doing here?" [DIAL:0200CA90]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Need to be here, see what was done. In the Divide, in Hopeville... the Courier's Mile.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic006 "What are you doing here?" [DIAL:0200CA90]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Was hoping you could help me shape something.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic005 "Was hoping you could help me shape something." [DIAL:0200CA91]

text_content: {Nods}Let's see what gifts the Mojave has for us.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic005 "Was hoping you could help me shape something." [DIAL:0200CA91]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Looking at player's inventory}Let's make something new from the old.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic005 "Was hoping you could help me shape something." [DIAL:0200CA91]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Forget this. I'm going to teach you what crossing the wrong Courier means.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic004 "Forget this. I'm going to teach you what crossing the wrong Courier means." [DIAL:0200CA92]

text_content: I've never seen creatures like that before now.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic016 "I've never seen creatures like that before now." [DIAL:0200CAFC]

text_content: What did you mean, "slower death for the Mojave?"
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic015 "What did you mean, ""slower death for the Mojave?""" [DIAL:0200CAFD]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Nod}Death'll come from below. {Frowns}In the Divide, need to watch the sky {emph}and ground... {Dismissive, shakes head}Mojave'll be easy prey for them.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic015 "What did you mean, ""slower death for the Mojave?""" [DIAL:0200CAFD]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [FAILED] Mojave needs to survive itself first... does that, Tunnelers will be next on the list.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic015 "What did you mean, ""slower death for the Mojave?""" [DIAL:0200CAFD]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: If this is the High Road... where does it lead?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic014 "If this is the High Road... where does it lead?" [DIAL:0200CB04]

text_content: At the end of the High Road lies Ashton - its silo.|{Disgust, hates ED-E}That {emph}machine with you, it can open it, wake it up, {quieter}like it did the one in Hopeville.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic014 "If this is the High Road... where does it lead?" [DIAL:0200CB04]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Some of the flayed Hopeville soldiers looked like NCR... but fought beside others in Legion armor.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic013 "Some of the flayed Hopeville soldiers looked like NCR... but fought beside others in Legion armor." [DIAL:0200CB05]

text_content: {Quieter}You see true. Not scavengers... it's what they wore {slight beat}before this all happened.{No sound file}
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic013 "Some of the flayed Hopeville soldiers looked like NCR... but fought beside others in Legion armor." [DIAL:0200CB05]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Pain makes for strange allies... the hate the Bear and Bull shared across the battlefield, now turned against the Divide. Few survived... intact.{No sound file}|Many NCR were already here when the destruction happened. Keeping the route East open, in fear of Caesar. Fear of the Legion.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic013 "Some of the flayed Hopeville soldiers looked like NCR... but fought beside others in Legion armor." [DIAL:0200CB05]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Those Marked Men in Hopeville - some had strange masks and blades I'd never seen before.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic012 "Those Marked Men in Hopeville - some had strange masks and blades I'd never seen before." [DIAL:0200CB06]

text_content: {Quieter}You haven't seen enough of the Legion yet to see what they worship... what they hold on to, even after what happened to them.{No sound file}
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic012 "Those Marked Men in Hopeville - some had strange masks and blades I'd never seen before." [DIAL:0200CB06]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: They bear false versions of Legate Lanius' mask, the one Caesar fashioned for him. Thought it was an insult at first.... {to himself}know better now.{No sound file}|It's shaped from Divide metal, not with care and strength, but with hate. Keeps them anchored.|Crude, effective - like the blades they carry, distant mirrors of their Legate. A symbol they can hold on to - while the Divide tears at them.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic012 "Those Marked Men in Hopeville - some had strange masks and blades I'd never seen before." [DIAL:0200CB06]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: What were the creatures in the underpass?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic009 "What were the creatures in the underpass?" [DIAL:0200CB07]

text_content: Tunnelers. Predators that make their own roads beneath the ground here.{No sound file}|{Somber}Divide broke their sky, showed them the world above - and the scent of new prey.|Be a slower death for the Mojave than bombs and fire... but they'll come for its people, from where they least expect - below.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic009 "What were the creatures in the underpass?" [DIAL:0200CB07]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Enough of this. Tell me where you are.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic024 "Enough of this. Tell me where you are." [DIAL:0200CD54]

text_content: What happened here?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic023 "What happened here?" [DIAL:0200CD55]

text_content: You delivered a package. Had markings that matched those in the Divide. Not all... but enough.|Military markings, from some place the Bear had savaged in the West. {Beat, trying to draw player out here}Maybe seeing those markings on it reminded you of home... made you carry it.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic023 "What happened here?" [DIAL:0200CD55]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: This canyon is miles long - maybe longer. Where can I find you?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic022 "This canyon is miles long - maybe longer. Where can I find you?" [DIAL:0200CD56]

text_content: At the end of the Divide, through the trenches and wreckage - that's where you'll find me. My new home, here, amongst dead men.{No sound file}|You and that {slight sneer at 'machine'}machine, keep your eyes on the tower that cuts the horizon... you'll find your way. Made it this far... not much farther to go.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic022 "This canyon is miles long - maybe longer. Where can I find you?" [DIAL:0200CD56]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I'm not interested in talking - only getting through this.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic021 "I'm not interested in talking - only getting through this." [DIAL:0200CD57]

text_content: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT1HolotapeNote
name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT1HolotapeNote "NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT1HolotapeNote" [DIAL:0200CD61]

text_content: ...back again. Left that crater behind. Got a few holotapes left, ones from the medical center.|The woman... she fixed the recorder. Said it wouldn't last, repayment for me fixing her. She doesn't like debts, can respect that.|Payment enough, just to hear someone who believes in the Brotherhood of Steel. Not Elijah. Different view. Same madness.|She answered me on their philosophy, their way of seeing - the roads they walk. {Disgust}Dead-ends. Empty... as if technology can solve anything.|{Quiet, reflective}Big Empty's proof where that road leads. {Beat}Just like the Divide, and all the roads that lead to it.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT1HolotapeNote "NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT1HolotapeNote" [DIAL:0200CD61]

text_content: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs2HolotapeNote
name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs2HolotapeNote "NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs2HolotapeNote" [DIAL:0200CD67]

text_content: I walked the Great Salt Lake as Caesar's eye, then his hand.|Mongrels there, two-legs and four. Saw the walls of New Canaan the scavengers circled... hadn't the strength or fire to take. Too high, too strong.|White Legs, they were born for war, they run to it, hungry for battle... yet their hunger is to be a part of history, something larger.|Like the Legion. As always, brought them a message - from Caesar.|{Paraphrasing message from Caesar}If New Canaan burns, Caesar might {emph}see them. {Scoffs}"Might." Even the chance was a lie.|To honor Caesar - destroy the {emph}history of New Canaan, and the way they {emph}carry it - in their generations and family.|Caesar respects such strength, I told them. That - that was truth, even if "strength" wasn't the word. {Correcting}Obedience.|You must be willing to kill {emph}anyone, children, mothers, the weak, elders... if these New Canaanites value the generations, that is what you must kill.|It was like Vulpes was speaking through me. Use the night, silence, and fire to change their words to pleas, to screams.|No need for bombs when hate will do.|I... asked the White Legs to destroy a people with ancestry, going back thousands of years - another death of history, lost to time.|The New Canaanites... they supplied medicine. Food, traded with others. Civilization, a hand from the past, not history...|...but maybe a past deeper, farther than that to a place where this... {beat}God really exists.|{Dismissive}If so, his handiwork and people belong elsewhere, not in this place. Another symbol, like Bear and Bull, with no meaning in the present.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs2HolotapeNote "NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs2HolotapeNote" [DIAL:0200CD67]

text_content: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs1HolotapeNote
name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs1HolotapeNote "NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs1HolotapeNote" [DIAL:0200CD68]

text_content: {Studying weather, log to himself, thinking back}Emptiness here - like the sands of the Great Salt Lake, echoed. {Beat}The beating in the Divide sky... like storm drums of the White Legs.|{Introspective}Ran with them on the salt beds, at Caesar's command - {recalling Caesar's orders, echoing them}cut the throats of the two-headed Bear, cut all communities off.|Use storm, sky. Disease. Fire, starvation... and the violence of the ignorant to ruin all who {emph}could... might stand against him.|But the White Legs... they couldn't live on their own, like most scavengers. So gave them purpose - turned their hunger into a weapon.|The wall of New {CANE-in}Canaan... too high for Caesar. Too proud, maybe - {quiet}or maybe something there, from his past, that needed killing. Memory of Graham.|Helped them dig out Canaan supply caches, and other secrets the sands hid - bunkers, filled with powered weapons even the Brotherhood might desire.|They called these new weapons "storm drums" in the firing of shells. Taught them the power in the casings... to channel the spirits in their guns.|Me... they called me the Flag-Bearer. Glory in my hand, in my staff that still bore the weight of the Old World just as the symbol on my back did.|I learned their weapons as a means of respect. And when it came their turn to pay respect to me... history came rushing back.|{Quiet, bring to a close}Can't escape what's been done. History's there... no matter how far you walk.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs1HolotapeNote "NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs1HolotapeNote" [DIAL:0200CD68]

text_content: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT3HolotapeNote
name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT3HolotapeNote "NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT3HolotapeNote" [DIAL:0200CD69]

text_content: Have you ever wanted to speak to history - just to know the why of it? {Beat}I don't. Not any longer.|There's old stories about gods and men, past history, into myth - where the gods, they're like children... petulant, cruel.|{Emph}Those were the voices of the Big Empty, the past. Couldn't leave well enough alone, had to ask. Had to ask the why of it.|{Slight frustration}Their answers were madness. And power, stronger than me, would take a hundred Elijahs... someone tougher than him or I to best them in their Dome.|They didn't know why they were there, what had led to that point, their names - like serpents devouring themselves, cannibalizing their own thoughts.|When all seemed lost, thought it was the end - my anger gave me strength to ask them my last question.|{Echoing the question he asked the Think Tank}"Who are you, that do not know your history?"|{Slight reverence}And they awoke. For... a short time.|The flag you wear, they said. We remember. America.|It wasn't just a flag to them... it was a place, an idea they had {emph}cared for. Once.|They told me what it was like to grow in that world... all they had done to lift it up... protect it. They... didn't know it was gone, that...|...yet they had cared once. Before forgetting their history.|As they were talking... kept seeing the Courier's shadow behind them, giving each their words weight. History cast aside... a home, left behind.|I listened. I asked. Was there anything left? {Emph}Anything that still carries America's voice?|And they told me I had already been there. I and one other, walking right out of history deeper than we knew.|They told me what lies in the heart of the Divide, what can be found there. And the words to awaken it - and the one to speak them.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT3HolotapeNote "NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT3HolotapeNote" [DIAL:0200CD69]

text_content: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT2HolotapeNote
name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT2HolotapeNote "NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT2HolotapeNote" [DIAL:0200CD6A]

text_content: Big Empty - there's something hidden there, a crater, past wind and sand - so deep in the desert, there's no turning back.|Finding the crater was an accident, was following the weather patterns - the Divide sky torn like that, man's violence, not nature's.|That violence in the sky, had a source. Tracked it. Like following a river current.|Left the colors to mark my way, like always, case someone finds them, learns the pattern - the Courier might.|When I thought sand and wind would never end... came to the crater.|And there... there was an Old World facility, a weather station, at the edge, still raking the sky with electricity and generators.|And beyond it... saw the rest of the Old World hell there, all carved up like garden plots. Had to see what was there, couldn't leave it be.|{Slight irritation}Things sleep in the Big Empty, the Brotherhood woke them up - can't move quiet, any more than the two-headed Bear can.|And when they woke up, it was like all of history waking up at once. Almost didn't make it out. {Beat, quiet}Almost. Left with answers I never intended.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT2HolotapeNote "NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT2HolotapeNote" [DIAL:0200CD6A]

text_content: NVDLC04UlyssesFinalMsgHolotape
name: NVDLC04UlyssesFinalMsgHolotape "NVDLC04UlyssesFinalMsgHolotape" [DIAL:0200CD8E]

text_content: Last tape, last message. In case... you best me. If you're hearing this, you have, through blood or word.|This message, and all that lies with it - it is for you, Courier. If you want to know the... why of things.|This world, I've walked a good part of it... I stopped only because of you. What you did - gave me pause.|Long ago, I crossed the Colorado, the first among the Legion to see Hoover Dam in all its glory... an Old World wall, yet bridging two sides.|{Quieter}And beyond it, a symbol of a two-headed Bear, an idea great enough to challenge Caesar himself.|Might kill him, taking it, whether he won or lost. The Bull needs to fight, needs the challenge, without it... it falters, dies in the dust.|{To himself}Might be a lesson there, in you and me. {"I'll"}Leave the thought behind the message to you.|My message is this - the destruction that has been wrought, at the Divide - or elsewhere, if you couldn't stop me...|It can happen again. It will {emph}keep happening.|If war doesn't change, men must change, and so must their symbols. {Beat, quiet}Even if it is nothing at all, know what you follow, Courier...|...just as I followed you, to the end. Whatever your symbol...|...carry it on your back, and wear it proudly when you stand at Hoover Dam.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesFinalMsgHolotape "NVDLC04UlyssesFinalMsgHolotape" [DIAL:0200CD8E]

text_content: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs3HolotapeNote
name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs3Holotape "NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs3HolotapeNote" [DIAL:0200CD91]

text_content: The White Legs... meant to show respect, bribe me for Caesar's favor, echoing mannerisms and words...|Showed them tech caches, taught them the workings of chamber and powder, spoke of Caesar's {emph}pride in those that used such things... lies. And...|{quiet disgust}...and then... they tried to honor {emph}me - not the Legion.|They brought me before the campfire one night, showed me how they changed themselves, how they wore their hair now.|It was like my entire dead tribe in the firelight, teeth grinning red in the dark - eager corpses, blood-covered ghosts.|They... had taken my braids, the way of the Twisted Hairs, as if it showed they were {emph}like me, {emph}of me...|...while every knot in their braids spoke of raping, violence - and ignorance of what the knots {emph}meant. They thought to show respect... defiled it.|Lost myself in trying to read the braids they wove, when I remembered they had put no meaning in it. They had no history of what it meant.|They didn't even know the insult in the twists, knots... and Dry Wells came rushing back, the White Legs circled like that...|It was like looking at the dead of my tribe, reborn as ghosts - hateful, hungry, bowing to Caesar. {Quiet, bring to a close}Another history... gone, carried by me alone.
name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs3Holotape "NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs3HolotapeNote" [DIAL:0200CD91]

text_content: Find anything in the dust of Hopeville?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic017 "Find anything in the dust of Hopeville?" [DIAL:0200CD94]

text_content: Nothing but wind, sand... ash. More may reveal itself in time, not now.|If you're determined, return, might be something new surfaces.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic017 "Find anything in the dust of Hopeville?" [DIAL:0200CD94]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Wind and blood has uncovered more beneath the soil.|If you want these Old World relics, they're yours... better you carry them than the Marked Men.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic017 "Find anything in the dust of Hopeville?" [DIAL:0200CD94]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Any recipes you can teach?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic016 "Any recipes you can teach?" [DIAL:0200CD95]

text_content: I have some materials I've gathered, if you wanted to take a look.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic015 "I have some materials I've gathered, if you wanted to take a look." [DIAL:0200CD96]

text_content: Is this where you're making camp?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic014 "Is this where you're making camp?" [DIAL:0200CD97]

text_content: Not a camp - vigil, maybe. Never claimed it as mine. {More a question}If anyone owns the Divide... {"well..."}your claim is stronger than mine.|Don't feel like adding a campfire to the ones that already burn below. {Beat, making offer}If you brought Mojave gifts, might be able to shape something for the road.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic014 "Is this where you're making camp?" [DIAL:0200CD97]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Depends what history has to say about them. There's a lot the land can provide... if you know the road that led to it.|Mojave's got ways of healing most ills - if not, some tribe's usually found a way you didn't expect.|Like Healing Powders. Tribes back West only use Xander and Broc flower. There's a way the Twin Mothers in the East used to brew it, though.|Called it Bitter Drink, mixed up the Xander and Broc in a bottle, added some kick to it so your head doesn't get all clouded.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic014 "Is this where you're making camp?" [DIAL:0200CD97]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Thinking}Antivenom's helpful around the Mojave with the Bark Scorpions. Even one sting can kill you. {Beat}Tunneler bite can be just as bad.|My tribe, Twisted Hairs, had a better way than Antivenom, if you act fast.|Snakebite Tourniquet - cuts off the venom, no need to scavenge glands and blood. {Himself, slight disgust}Or drink that mess.|Part of the reason we wore our hair like we did, {corrects self}like I do now.|Here's some for the road - trick to making it's not hard. {Beat}Get bit, hook and twist it. Fast as blinking, doesn't give poison time to sink in.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic014 "Is this where you're making camp?" [DIAL:0200CD97]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Nothing more than I've already shared. We'll have to keep with what we know. {Beat}Tired of history's lessons, anyway.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic014 "Is this where you're making camp?" [DIAL:0200CD97]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I had other questions.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic013 "I had other questions." [DIAL:0200CD98]

text_content: {Matter-of-fact}Questions have a habit of making others.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic013 "I had other questions." [DIAL:0200CD98]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: The Divide's irradiated... are you sure you want to stay here?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic012 "The Divide's irradiated... are you sure you want to stay here?" [DIAL:0200CD99]

text_content: The invisible fires burn here, true enough. Still... to have helped carry out such an act, then not face it...|Not my way. If my life burns out here, so be it... until then, I wait and watch, see what the road brings.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic012 "The Divide's irradiated... are you sure you want to stay here?" [DIAL:0200CD99]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: What about the Marked Men?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic002 "What about the Marked Men?" [DIAL:0200CD9A]

text_content: That's part of why I'm here. Watch them - if they attack me, try to enter the Mojave, I answer. {Little quieter}Not looking to kill them... save them, if I can.|There might be something saving in them. {Quieter, to himself}If not, then what I do is mercy, not murder.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic002 "What about the Marked Men?" [DIAL:0200CD9A]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: What's the Courier's Mile? Is that where the Ashton missile hit?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic018 "What's the Courier's Mile? Is that where the Ashton missile hit?" [DIAL:0200CDA3]

text_content: My name for it. If you have a better one, you grant it - my choice in names won't carry past you and I.|Lies along the road, running from the Hopeville silo... straight on to where the ground burns, and wind howls even stronger than here.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic018 "What's the Courier's Mile? Is that where the Ashton missile hit?" [DIAL:0200CDA3]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Your tapes prove you've walked the Mojave, yet learned the wrong lessons.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic021 "Your tapes prove you've walked the Mojave, yet learned the wrong lessons." [DIAL:0200CDA7]

text_content: Comes down to perspective, how far one's walked, and what they've left behind.|{Challenging}If you challenge this moment, let's hear your perspective. If my words are all you have, let's hear them.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic021 "Your tapes prove you've walked the Mojave, yet learned the wrong lessons." [DIAL:0200CDA7]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: So... you think dropping bombs on the Mojave is going to solve things?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic020 "So... you think dropping bombs on the Mojave is going to solve things?" [DIAL:0200CDA8]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Thinking}The why of it... you taught me the why of it.|If you believe in something enough, you must be willing to let it burn, lest it claim you.|These governments of the two-headed bear... the Legion... they carry Old World ideas into an age that no longer needs them, where they cannot live.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic020 "So... you think dropping bombs on the Mojave is going to solve things?" [DIAL:0200CDA8]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [FAILED] Yes, that is what you proved to me at the Divide - what is here, what you showed me... it is enough.|You don't understand. {Beat}You will.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic020 "So... you think dropping bombs on the Mojave is going to solve things?" [DIAL:0200CDA8]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You've wasted enough of my time. Get ready to die.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic033 "You've wasted enough of my time. Get ready to die." [DIAL:0200CDB8]

text_content: {DUPE}I'll finish history's work. If the Divide couldn't kill you... perhaps these spears of the Old World can.|{DUPE}Let's end this, Courier, you and I. Here, with the Old World flag as witness.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic033 "You've wasted enough of my time. Get ready to die." [DIAL:0200CDB8]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Forget this. If you want an ending to things, let's do this.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic025 "Forget this. If you want an ending to things, let's do this." [DIAL:0200CDC0]

text_content: Can you share the recipe with me?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic037 "Can you share the recipe with me?" [DIAL:0200CF2F]

text_content: Can do that and one better... {looking around}just enough around to mix some. Here - might make the Twin Mothers' history live a little longer, you carrying it.|{Warning}When you drink it, down it all in one shot, or your stomach's not going to want to keep going after the second drink.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic037 "Can you share the recipe with me?" [DIAL:0200CF2F]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: What's the history of it?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic036 "What's the history of it?" [DIAL:0200CF30]

text_content: {Smiles, "you want to know the history of it?"}History? Cures a wound, leaves the bitterness that caused it. {To himself, scorn}The Twin Mothers were always about lessons.|Caesar taught them the last one, though, so that's it for them. Recipe still exists, Legion uses it on forced marches with wounded soldiers.|Wouldn't have made it through Crimson River Trail a few years back without it  - losing so much blood early on, was a Cazador feast.|Enough Xander root and Broc flower along the trail though, the Legion was able to keep pace and get where they were going.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic036 "What's the history of it?" [DIAL:0200CF30]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Have you been to Hopeville since the Ashton missile hit?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic035 "Have you been to Hopeville since the Ashton missile hit?" [DIAL:0200CF31]

text_content: {Reflective}Walk there sometimes, keep the walks short. Still... it's important to see. Something else to answer for.|Occasionally sift through the dust, the buildings... see if I can find some history. Marks of America.|If you want them, keep them... you've earned it. Nothing to be gained by me holding them, and more will surface in time.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic035 "Have you been to Hopeville since the Ashton missile hit?" [DIAL:0200CF31]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Sounds useful. Have any to spare?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic038 "Sounds useful. Have any to spare?" [DIAL:0200CF40]

text_content: You think I'd leave valuable property like you behind? No way. You might be worth some caps one day.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic125 "You think I'd leave valuable property like you behind? No way. You might be worth some caps one day." [DIAL:0200CF4E]

text_content: Run off on me like that again and I'll recycle you into tin cans. I own you, robot.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic124 "Run off on me like that again and I'll recycle you into tin cans. I own you, robot." [DIAL:0200CF4F]

text_content: Sounds like a big damn waste of time to me.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic123 "Sounds like a big damn waste of time to me." [DIAL:0200CF50]

text_content: That's what all this was about? Some old pre-War kids' show?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic122 "That's what all this was about? Some old pre-War kids' show?" [DIAL:0200CF51]

text_content: Heh heh. Robot skeet shooting. Sounds fun.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic121 "Heh heh. Robot skeet shooting. Sounds fun." [DIAL:0200CF52]

text_content: Boo hoo, poor little robot lost his daddy. Stop moping, trash can.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic120 "Boo hoo, poor little robot lost his daddy. Stop moping, trash can." [DIAL:0200CF53]

text_content: How long ago was this? And you still haven't made it? So much for upgraded navigational systems.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic119 "How long ago was this? And you still haven't made it? So much for upgraded navigational systems." [DIAL:0200CF54]

text_content: Spill any of my secrets, and I'll spill your electronic guts. Just so we're clear.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic118 "Spill any of my secrets, and I'll spill your electronic guts. Just so we're clear." [DIAL:0200CF55]

text_content: If you ask me, Whitley got too invested. It's just robot research, not having a kid.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic117 "If you ask me, Whitley got too invested. It's just robot research, not having a kid." [DIAL:0200CF56]

text_content: Big deal. You're a glorified computer, why bother switching you off to improve you?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic116 "Big deal. You're a glorified computer, why bother switching you off to improve you?" [DIAL:0200CF57]

text_content: Fine, whatever. Listen, robot: I own you now. Follow me and try to make yourself useful.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic115 "Fine, whatever. Listen, robot: I own you now. Follow me and try to make yourself useful." [DIAL:0200CF58]

text_content: You'd better level with me, trashcan, or I might stuff you back in that pod.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic114 "You'd better level with me, trashcan, or I might stuff you back in that pod." [DIAL:0200CF59]

text_content: <Apologetic beeping>{NPCRobotEdEDenied}
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic114 "You'd better level with me, trashcan, or I might stuff you back in that pod." [DIAL:0200CF59]
speaker: NVDLC04EDE "ED-E" [CREA:02004CDA]

text_content: Yeah, he's probably dead. Guess that means I own you now.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic113 "Yeah, he's probably dead. Guess that means I own you now." [DIAL:0200CF5A]

text_content: <Sad beeping>{NPCRobotEdESad}
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic113 "Yeah, he's probably dead. Guess that means I own you now." [DIAL:0200CF5A]
speaker: NVDLC04EDE "ED-E" [CREA:02004CDA]

text_content: Great. Maybe you'll actually be useful to me, then.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic084 "Great. Maybe you'll actually be useful to me, then." [DIAL:0200CF5B]

text_content: <Hopeful beeping>{NPCRobotEdEConfirmed}
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic084 "Great. Maybe you'll actually be useful to me, then." [DIAL:0200CF5B]
speaker: NVDLC04EDE "ED-E" [CREA:02004CDA]

text_content: NVDLC04EndingSlideSunset02
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideSunset02 "NVDLC04EndingSlideSunset02" [DIAL:0200D06A]

text_content: {Narration}{Male - correcting the previous statement}Men do, through the roads they walk.
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideSunset02 "NVDLC04EndingSlideSunset02" [DIAL:0200D06A]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Narration}{Female - correcting the previous statement - war never changes}Women do, through the roads they walk.
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideSunset02 "NVDLC04EndingSlideSunset02" [DIAL:0200D06A]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: NVDLC04EndingSlideSunset01
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideSunset01 "NVDLC04EndingSlideSunset01" [DIAL:0200D06B]

text_content: {Narration}It's said war - war never changes.
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideSunset01 "NVDLC04EndingSlideSunset01" [DIAL:0200D06B]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: NVDLC04EndingSlideDivide02
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideDivide02 "NVDLC04EndingSlideDivide02" [DIAL:0200D06C]

text_content: {Narration}Tunnelers and the Marked Men... avoided the lone figure, as if recognizing the Courier's right to passage... or out of fear.
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideDivide02 "NVDLC04EndingSlideDivide02" [DIAL:0200D06C]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: NVDLC04EndingSlideDivide0
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideDivide01 "NVDLC04EndingSlideDivide0" [DIAL:0200D06D]

text_content: {Narration}{Male}As for the Courier... he turned his back on his home for the second time and made his way back, navigating the treachery of the Divide.
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideDivide01 "NVDLC04EndingSlideDivide0" [DIAL:0200D06D]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Narration}{Female}As for the Courier... she turned her back on her home for the second time and made her way back, navigating the treachery of the Divide.
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideDivide01 "NVDLC04EndingSlideDivide0" [DIAL:0200D06D]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESacrificed02
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESacrificed02 "NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESacrificed02" [DIAL:0200D06E]

text_content: {Narration}As his last gesture, he sent one last signal to his counterpart in the Mojave, passing along what the Courier had taught him in the Divide.|{Narration}There was the chance... always, that ED-E's journey would continue, perhaps carried by another Eyebot in the Mojave...|{Narration}...the one from which the ED-E from the Divide had been shaped.|{Narration}For now, the Courier knew ED-E's history and could carry it, even if the Eyebot had forgotten.
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESacrificed02 "NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESacrificed02" [DIAL:0200D06E]
speaker: NVDLC04EDE "ED-E" [CREA:02004CDA]

text_content: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESacrificed01
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESacrificed01 "NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESacrificed01" [DIAL:0200D06F]

text_content: {Narration}When ED-E's circuits burned in the fires of the Divide, there was one small part that held on until the end.|{Narration}It was the fragment that held the Old World memories and the words of his creator in his last moments.
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESacrificed01 "NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESacrificed01" [DIAL:0200D06F]
speaker: NVDLC04EDE "ED-E" [CREA:02004CDA]

text_content: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDELeftBehind
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDELeftBehind "NVDLC04EndingSlideEDELeftBehind" [DIAL:0200D070]

text_content: {Narration}ED-E, the version given life by the machines of the Divide, remained frozen in the military installation where Ulysses had summoned him.|{Narration}The robot's last coded transmission back to his counterpart in the Mojave told of upgrades, unlocked memories... then silence.|{Narration}Not long after the Courier left the facility, the Eyebot's data banks were wiped, and it was disassembled as rapidly as it had been constructed.
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDELeftBehind "NVDLC04EndingSlideEDELeftBehind" [DIAL:0200D070]
speaker: NVDLC04EDE "ED-E" [CREA:02004CDA]

text_content: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESaved02
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESaved02 "NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESaved02" [DIAL:0200D071]

text_content: {Narration}Before leaving, he sent a coded signal to his original in the Mojave, passing along what the Courier had taught him in the Divide.|{Narration}With that last farewell, he set off, carrying the song of Old World hope with him, which had given him strength and purpose on his journey.|{Narration}{Downnote}And no matter what, he knew there would be a second home to return to, Navarro or not - and that his creator would be proud.
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESaved02 "NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESaved02" [DIAL:0200D071]
speaker: NVDLC04EDE "ED-E" [CREA:02004CDA]

text_content: NVDLC04EndingEDESaved01
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESaved01 "NVDLC04EndingEDESaved01" [DIAL:0200D072]

text_content: {Narration}ED-E, given second life by the machines of the Divide, freed by the Courier, continued his quest west, to Navarro...|{Narration}...or what remained of what the Eyebot considered "home." Whether he found his homeland or not, his road is unknown.|{Narration}It may be the journey meant more than the destination - just as his counterpart in the Mojave had learned.
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESaved01 "NVDLC04EndingEDESaved01" [DIAL:0200D072]
speaker: NVDLC04EDE "ED-E" [CREA:02004CDA]

text_content: NVDLC04EndingUlyssesAlive02
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideUlyssesAlive02 "NVDLC04EndingUlyssesAlive02" [DIAL:0200D073]

text_content: {Narration}He remained there, perhaps as punishment for the scars he left on the wastes - or a reminder of a history he could not forget.|{Narration}For Ulysses... his journey was over. The Courier had been the end of {"emph" refers to Ulysses}his road.
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideUlyssesAlive02 "NVDLC04EndingUlyssesAlive02" [DIAL:0200D073]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: NVDLC04EndingUlyssesAlive01
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideUlyssesAlive01 "NVDLC04EndingUlyssesAlive01" [DIAL:0200D074]

text_content: {Narration}Hopeville burned lightless in the night, invisible fires of radiation scorching it from within and without.|{Narration}It is said a man still walked its streets, with a tattered jacket, an Old World flag etched on the back...
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideUlyssesAlive01 "NVDLC04EndingUlyssesAlive01" [DIAL:0200D074]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: NVDLC04EndingUlyssesDead02
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideUlyssesDead02 "NVDLC04EndingUlyssesDead02" [DIAL:0200D075]

text_content: {Narration}...though whether done as a sign of respect, or in anger for what had been endured to reach this moment - that is unknown.|{Narration}Interpretation is something best left to history, and only the surviving Courier would ever know for certain.
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideUlyssesDead02 "NVDLC04EndingUlyssesDead02" [DIAL:0200D075]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: NVDLC04EndingUlyssesDead01
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideUlyssesDead01 "NVDLC04EndingUlyssesDead01" [DIAL:0200D076]

text_content: {Narration}At the end of the struggle, only one Courier remained in the heart of the Divide. The {emph}true Courier, Courier Six.|{Narration}The Courier tore the ancient flag of the Commonwealth from its cables, and cast it over the corpse...
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideUlyssesDead01 "NVDLC04EndingUlyssesDead01" [DIAL:0200D076]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchLegion02
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideVista02 "NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchLegion02" [DIAL:0200D077]

text_content: {Narration}{Knowingly, confidentially}But that message - it is something for Couriers to carry, and for them alone.|{Narration}{Bring it to a close}The lights flickered across the Divide, reminders that the Old World histories persist, and find meaning in the present.
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideVista02 "NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchLegion02" [DIAL:0200D077]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchLegion01
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideVista01 "NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchLegion01" [DIAL:0200D078]

text_content: {Narration}{Male}The Courier walked until he stood again upon the edge of the Divide, the last road he would walk before the second battle for Hoover Dam.|{Narration}{Male}There, beside his feet, was a final package, from one Courier to another - a footlocker, bearing a gift, and a message.
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideVista01 "NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchLegion01" [DIAL:0200D078]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Narration}{Female}The Courier walked until she stood again upon the edge of the Divide, the last road she would walk before the second battle for Hoover Dam.|{Narration}{Female}There, beside her feet, was a final package, from one Courier to another - a footlocker, bearing a gift, and a message.
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideVista01 "NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchLegion01" [DIAL:0200D078]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchNCR02
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideSingleMissileLaunch02 "NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchNCR02" [DIAL:0200D079]

text_content: {Narration}{Target: NCR}As catastrophic as the damage was for NCR, the act made the Courier stronger for having no history, and no retreat.|{Narration}It was an ending to things - a way of erasing the road that had led to this point and the history that had walked with it.
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideSingleMissileLaunch02 "NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchNCR02" [DIAL:0200D079]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {DUPE}{Narration}{Target: Legion}It was an ending to things - a way of erasing the road that had led to this point and the history that had walked with it.
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideSingleMissileLaunch02 "NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchNCR02" [DIAL:0200D079]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchNCR01
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideSingleMissileLaunch01 "NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchNCR01" [DIAL:0200D07A]

text_content: {Narration}{Target: NCR}...missiles fell on NCR and the Long 15 caravan route beyond the Mojave Outpost, the road the Courier had been walking when the tale began.|{Narration}Caravans and NCR outposts along the route were reduced to ash, an Old World gift from the Divide.
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideSingleMissileLaunch01 "NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchNCR01" [DIAL:0200D07A]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Narration}{Target: Legion}...missiles fell on the East and the Legion encampment at Dry Wells... where the Twisted Hairs had allied, then been betrayed by Vulpes and Caesar.|{Narration}Legion soldiers died, their silhouettes blasted into the ground and earth, the last word of the last of the Twisted Hairs.
name: NVDLC04EndingSlideSingleMissileLaunch01 "NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchNCR01" [DIAL:0200D07A]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: If you wanted me dead, why did you wait?

text_content: Promises to keep. To others. And the Mojave's dangerous enough - left to the land, the land has its way.{No sound file}|If I wanted you dead, we would have met sooner. Not sure that's the way this ends.|{Quieter}Might be that history needs to have its say. If not, then messages will do.

text_content: So you refused to deliver the Chip - what, to set me up to die?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic031 "So you refused to deliver the Chip - what, to set me up to die?" [DIAL:0200D12D]

text_content: {Cold}We {emph}all have death following us, only a question of how close. You dodged it - for a time. {Disdain}You're good at that, talent for it.{No sound file}|With that Chip weighing you down... a burden, lets death move a little faster without me pulling the trigger.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic031 "So you refused to deliver the Chip - what, to set me up to die?" [DIAL:0200D12D]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: It sounds like you know me, but I've never met you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic030 "It sounds like you know me, but I've never met you." [DIAL:0200D12E]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Words aren't the only way couriers meet... sometimes it's the paths we walk. But no... we've never spoken before now.{No sound file}
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic030 "It sounds like you know me, but I've never met you." [DIAL:0200D12E]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [FAILED] {Disgust, slight dismissive}I know you. What we have in common, though, isn't in the words we traded.{No sound file}
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic030 "It sounds like you know me, but I've never met you." [DIAL:0200D12E]

text_content: You were supposed to carry the Chip?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic029 "You were supposed to carry the Chip?" [DIAL:0200D12F]

text_content: Meant to? No. Never. {Emph}Your burden.{No sound file}|Weigh you down long enough to let death catch up to you... but you survived.|There was death in that package, and while the Chip is important to Old World ghosts... no, you are more dangerous than that Chip ever could be.|{Reflective}Maybe why you found each other, little piece of the Old World, speaking to you, waiting for you to wake something else up with it.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic029 "You were supposed to carry the Chip?" [DIAL:0200D12F]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic028 "[Legion] The dead in the silo, some were Legion Frumentarii, scouts. Assassins." [DIAL:0200D130]

text_content: Might have been. Once. To the Divide they came... in the Divide, they rest.{No sound file}

name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic040 "What's here? This place looks wrecked." [DIAL:0200D2B5]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] America sleeps in the Divide - giants, beneath the earth. You saw one locked in the silo beneath you. {Beat, cold}There's more.{No sound file}|Only takes a few of them, locked below ground, to tear apart the earth... and cast dust, sand... ash... into the skies above.|{Slight accusation}You'll see the extent - the miles of it, soon enough. You need to see it... walk it.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic040 "What's here? This place looks wrecked." [DIAL:0200D2B5]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [FAILED] Wasn't always like this. Old World wreckage's nothing new... after that, something you had your hand in - you'll walk it soon enough.{No sound file}
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic040 "What's here? This place looks wrecked." [DIAL:0200D2B5]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Why would they want to stay here if this place is killing them?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic039 "Why would they want to stay here if this place is killing them?" [DIAL:0200D2B6]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Nods, agreeing}There's truth in your words, {and}in what I've seen of their tactics, movements - recovery. Those wounds - they couldn't live otherwise.{No sound file}|The Divide winds have torn the skin from many of them - {beat}may be the radiation is the only thing keeping them walking.|Make camp near silos... warheads. {Thinking to himself}No way to cleanse the radiation - makes them hard to kill there, have to draw them out.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic039 "Why would they want to stay here if this place is killing them?" [DIAL:0200D2B6]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [FAILED] They're more beasts than men now. They clutch at their pain as they clutch at their weapons... anchors them.{No sound file}

speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: The rads in this place seem like they would do more damage to them.

text_content: They look like they were skinned... then got right back up.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic037 "They look like they were skinned... then got right back up." [DIAL:0200D2B8]

text_content: But... even radiation isn't enough to cause those wounds.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic036 "But... even radiation isn't enough to cause those wounds." [DIAL:0200D2B9]

text_content: I've never seen corpses mutilated like that.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic035 "I've never seen corpses mutilated like that." [DIAL:0200D2BA]

text_content: Even as the fires here burned them from within... the winds of the Divide tore their skin, exposed them... screaming... to the sky.{No sound file}|And just as the Divide tears at them, so they tear at each other, for sport - like some tribal scarification. {Beat, to himself, referring to Legion origins}Falling back to their history, maybe.|{Quieter}No matter what they suffer... {Reflective}the radiation, fire of the Divide, sustains them. Makes them stronger.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic035 "I've never seen corpses mutilated like that." [DIAL:0200D2BA]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: What are you talking about?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic034 "What are you talking about?" [DIAL:0200D2BB]

text_content: Whatever happened at the Divide, there weren't any survivors.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic033 "Whatever happened at the Divide, there weren't any survivors." [DIAL:0200D2BC]

text_content: Inhabitants? It doesn't look like anyone's alive down there.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic026 "Inhabitants? It doesn't look like anyone's alive down there." [DIAL:0200D2BD]

text_content: These new inhabitants... not natives... most of them. Came with duty, purpose... ready to kill each other. {Beat, a little quieter}The Divide was stronger.{No sound file}|{Introspective, cont}Left marks on them, too. Not Bear, not Bull - now... radiation's marked them, made them equal in history's eyes.|As vicious as the storms are, these shadows of Legion, of NCR - {"they are"}silhouettes of things to come.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic026 "Inhabitants? It doesn't look like anyone's alive down there." [DIAL:0200D2BD]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Forget this. What do you want?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic025 "Forget this. What do you want?" [DIAL:0200D2BE]

text_content: An ending. To this road, you and I. First, you need to find your way. At the end, I'll be waiting.{No sound file}
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic025 "Forget this. What do you want?" [DIAL:0200D2BE]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: < Storage Node. Do not translate. >
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic079 "< Storage Node. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200D2BF]

text_content: You may not know my voice, but we've walked the same places. The Long 15 to Primm... that wasn't the only road you ever walked.{No Sound File}|I've been to your home, the place you kept returning to... may not be the place you were born, was the place you gave life to, same thing.|People forget couriers can keep communities alive... until the day they're gone, and their breath catches in their throat.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic079 "< Storage Node. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200D2BF]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: For now, eyes alert, watch the streets below. There's still life in the Divide - threats other than the storms and wind... new inhabitants.{No Sound File}
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic079 "< Storage Node. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200D2BF]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: There's something left down there? Town looks like it was bombed.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic002 "There's something left down there? Town looks like it was bombed." [DIAL:0200D2CD]

text_content: {DUPE}[SUCCEEDED] America sleeps in the Divide - giants, beneath the earth. You saw one locked in the silo beneath you. {Beat, cold}There's more.{No sound file}|{DUPE}Only takes a few of them, locked below ground, to tear apart the earth... and cast dust, sand... ash... into the skies above.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic002 "There's something left down there? Town looks like it was bombed." [DIAL:0200D2CD]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {DUPE}[FAILED] Wasn't always like this. Old World wreckage's nothing new... after that, something you had your hand in - you'll walk it soon enough.{No sound file}
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic002 "There's something left down there? Town looks like it was bombed." [DIAL:0200D2CD]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: The Divide won't stop me from reaching you, trust me.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic042 "The Divide won't stop me from reaching you, trust me." [DIAL:0200D2D1]

text_content: You better hope you've got enough ammo when I kick down your door.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic041 "You better hope you've got enough ammo when I kick down your door." [DIAL:0200D2D2]

text_content: I don't care what you have to say. I only want to know where you are.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic005 "I don't care what you have to say. I only want to know where you are." [DIAL:0200D2D3]

text_content: Other Marked Men had NCR gear - and they weren't carrying masks or blades.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic043 "Other Marked Men had NCR gear - and they weren't carrying masks or blades." [DIAL:0200D2D4]

text_content: For the two-headed Bear... NCR... they don't have symbols in the same way Legion does.{No sound file}|They revere their mines and explosives, guns... {emph}that is their religion - {disgust}death from afar, take pride in it.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic043 "Other Marked Men had NCR gear - and they weren't carrying masks or blades." [DIAL:0200D2D4]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I could care less about history - and even less about Caesar.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic044 "I could care less about history - and even less about Caesar." [DIAL:0200D2F1]

text_content: Wasn't his time, and wouldn't have been how he wanted to die. |{Himself}Not how most would've wanted him to die, either, Bear or Bull.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic044 "I could care less about history - and even less about Caesar." [DIAL:0200D2F1]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I wasn't sure how you'd take it.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic043 "I wasn't sure how you'd take it." [DIAL:0200D2F2]

text_content: {Shrugs}Done with blame, and Caesar was big on strength making right. Seems to me you proved that philosophy to him.|If he was too weak to stop you, too weak to defend himself, then he needed to die with his beliefs.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic043 "I wasn't sure how you'd take it." [DIAL:0200D2F2]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Are you angry at all?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic042 "Are you angry at all?" [DIAL:0200D2F3]

text_content: {Shrugs}He let another hold a knife to him. If he was weak enough to allow the knife so close to his neck, maybe it needed to be his ending.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic042 "Are you angry at all?" [DIAL:0200D2F3]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Emph}Caesar would be history's hypocrite if he was angry about what happened. I'm not one for it, either.|Seems you just proved his philosophy to him. If he'd been stronger, he'd be alive, and we wouldn't be talking.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic042 "Are you angry at all?" [DIAL:0200D2F3]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic041 "< Topic Storage: Discussing Caesar's Death. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200D2F4]

text_content: {Slightly doubtful}Too soon to tell what will happen, let history weigh what you�ve done, if it gets that far.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic041 "< Topic Storage: Discussing Caesar's Death. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200D2F4]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Delivered as if "still" at beginning}Unless you do the same for the Legate that comes, you'll get no thanks from me. When {emph}that Monster arrives, he's not going to have a leash.|{Quiet}Caesar could command him. Not now. The Bear's going to burn, and burn slow.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic041 "< Topic Storage: Discussing Caesar's Death. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200D2F4]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Caesar is dead, died on the operating table.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic040 "Caesar is dead, died on the operating table." [DIAL:0200D2F5]

text_content: {DUPE}{Thinking, slow}Name's died twice to history. If the West thanks you... the East won't, in time. Fall apart, back to the tribes, maybe.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic040 "Caesar is dead, died on the operating table." [DIAL:0200D2F5]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Caesar is dead, I killed him.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic039 "Caesar is dead, I killed him." [DIAL:0200D2F6]

text_content: {Thinking, slow}Name's died twice to history. If the West thanks you... the East won't, in time. Fall apart, back to the tribes, maybe.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic039 "Caesar is dead, I killed him." [DIAL:0200D2F6]

text_content: {Quiet, bring this to a close}If you saw House, you didn�t see a man. An Old World spirit, perhaps - filthy, diseased. If so, killing him was mercy, not cruelty.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic049 "< Topic Storage: Wrapping up thoughts on House. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200D2FF]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Quiet, reverent, bring this to a close}Let House sleep in his chamber. Let him dream of the Old World {emph}he remembers, and keep those memories where they belong, in his head.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic049 "< Topic Storage: Wrapping up thoughts on House. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200D2FF]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: If Vegas falls apart, seems like more history will be lost.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic048 "If Vegas falls apart, seems like more history will be lost." [DIAL:0200D300]

text_content: Thought you might be glad House was dealt with.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic047 "Thought you might be glad House was dealt with." [DIAL:0200D301]

text_content: You don�t sound happy.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic046 "You don�t sound happy." [DIAL:0200D302]

text_content: {Shakes his head, regretful, but player did right thing, "No..."}What you did was for the best. The Old World died long ago. Anyone who believes they can make it return and everything will be as it was...|...it is a dangerous belief. {Beat}Needs to be silenced before their belief spreads.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic046 "You don�t sound happy." [DIAL:0200D302]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I reached Vegas, and I dealt with House.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic045 "I reached Vegas, and I dealt with House." [DIAL:0200D303]

text_content: {Choosing his words carefully}House spoke, acted through machines. Sometimes can judge a man by his messengers. {Referring to player}Sometimes the messengers judge him.|Wonder what happens to Vegas now. The tribes - families. We'll see.

text_content: Nah, I think I'll just go ahead and trigger the launch. I never liked either of those places.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic142 "Nah, I think I'll just go ahead and trigger the launch. I never liked either of those places." [DIAL:0200D30B]

text_content: We'll leave it to history, then.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic066 "We'll leave it to history, then." [DIAL:0200D31D]

text_content: {DUPE}{Farewell}The Divide belongs to history now. {Beat}The Mojave awaits.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic066 "We'll leave it to history, then." [DIAL:0200D31D]

text_content: I'll remember that.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic065 "I'll remember that." [DIAL:0200D31E]
