name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic065 "I'll remember that." [DIAL:0200D31E]

text_content: < Topic Storage: Talking about Joshua Graham, why Lanius should heed story. Do not translate. >
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic064 "< Topic Storage: Talking about Joshua Graham, why Lanius should heed story. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200D31F]

text_content: That Legate's mistake is he didn't die trying. His name was Joshua - Joshua Graham. Answered for his failure - twice, some say.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic064 "< Topic Storage: Talking about Joshua Graham, why Lanius should heed story. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200D31F]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Caesar had him burned and cast into the earth, into the largest canyon you've ever seen. Watched the flames trail all the way to the bottom. |Somehow Joshua walked away from that, went beyond Caesar's gaze. His footsteps trailing fire, walking from one hell - maybe to another.|{Thinking about self and player}When one is ruined like Graham was... sometimes home is the only place left. If so, he went to New Canaan, Caesar's anger written on him like a book.|Caesar's orders to the Frumentarii were to watch for him, find Graham. Kill him. {Beat}Didn't try. Could've, no good would have come of it.|{Quiet, introspective}Graham earned his life, and his nature... it'll kill him more surely than any blade of the Legion.|{Quiet, like let it rest}So if you've heard word of it or seen sign of him, let it keep. {Beat, downnote}Let his history keep.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic064 "< Topic Storage: Talking about Joshua Graham, why Lanius should heed story. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200D31F]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: What do you mean?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic063 "What do you mean?" [DIAL:0200D320]

text_content: There are other Legates, and the one before Lanius couldn't take Hoover Dam for Caesar.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic063 "What do you mean?" [DIAL:0200D320]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Other Legates? You mean Graham.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic061 "Other Legates? You mean Graham." [DIAL:0200D321]

text_content: Yes. Graham was broken on the wall of the Dam.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic061 "Other Legates? You mean Graham." [DIAL:0200D321]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Other Legates?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic060 "Other Legates?" [DIAL:0200D322]

text_content: {DUPE}There are other Legates, and the one before Lanius couldn't take Hoover Dam for Caesar.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic060 "Other Legates?" [DIAL:0200D322]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: He crosses me, I�ll break him.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic059 "He crosses me, I�ll break him." [DIAL:0200D323]

text_content: He must have a weakness.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic058 "He must have a weakness." [DIAL:0200D324]

text_content: His strength lies in his title - and it is his weakness. He will not fight a losing battle and destroy what he represents.|Put the idea of loss in him. Convince him the Bear will not be the twentieth tribe beneath his heel, it will make him pause like nothing on earth.|You do not need to convince him alone. Draw upon history. The past of other Legates are not filled with victories. Remind Lanius of this.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic058 "He must have a weakness." [DIAL:0200D324]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Any idea on how to beat him?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic057 "Any idea on how to beat him?" [DIAL:0200D325]

text_content: {Slow, reflective}Nineteen tribes could not do it. All the lights in Vegas cannot.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic057 "Any idea on how to beat him?" [DIAL:0200D325]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Why is he coming West?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic056 "Why is he coming West?" [DIAL:0200D326]

text_content: To take Hoover Dam, Legion will need something as big as the Old World itself - another symbol, forged by history.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic056 "Why is he coming West?" [DIAL:0200D326]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Well, if I were a slave or a dog, I'd be scared.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic055 "Well, if I were a slave or a dog, I'd be scared." [DIAL:0200D327]

text_content: He's just one general. I can handle him.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic054 "He's just one general. I can handle him." [DIAL:0200D328]

text_content: Lanius carries all the terrors of the East with him. He's the myth, the weapon the Legion needs.|When he arrives, he'll fall on Hoover Dam like a hammer, {quiet}break the Bear in two.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic054 "He's just one general. I can handle him." [DIAL:0200D328]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: What can you tell me about him?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic053 "What can you tell me about him?" [DIAL:0200D329]

text_content: Enough. Whatever waits at Hoover Dam, I'm ready.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic052 "Enough. Whatever waits at Hoover Dam, I'm ready." [DIAL:0200D32A]

text_content: {Farewell}Then there is nothing more to be done. {Beat}The Mojave awaits.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic052 "Enough. Whatever waits at Hoover Dam, I'm ready." [DIAL:0200D32A]

text_content: {DUPE}{Farewell}The Divide belongs to history now. {Beat}The Mojave awaits.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic052 "Enough. Whatever waits at Hoover Dam, I'm ready." [DIAL:0200D32A]

text_content: {DUPE}{Farewell}The Divide belongs to history now. {Beat}The Mojave awaits.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic052 "Enough. Whatever waits at Hoover Dam, I'm ready." [DIAL:0200D32A]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Who is Legate Lanius?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic051 "Who is Legate Lanius?" [DIAL:0200D32B]

text_content: Lanius... the "Butcher." {Somber, recognizes name}Monster, Terror of the East.|Not even his slaves have seen his face - struck them blind so they can't. Wears a mask, don't even know if it's the same man.|He put Colorado to the sword, broke the Hangdogs by throwing their hounds upon the flames, so they might burn forever in the afterlife.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic051 "Who is Legate Lanius?" [DIAL:0200D32B]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: < Topic Storage: As player turns to leave, Ulysses speaks of Lanius. Do not translate. >
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic050 "< Topic Storage: As player turns to leave, Ulysses speaks of Lanius. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200D32C]

text_content: {Reflective}Bear and Bull shed too much blood there to let it go. {Beat, "but..."}Can�t stop you from going, wouldn�t.|A warning, though - the Legate, Lanius. Whether Caesar stands or not, Lanius will come.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic050 "< Topic Storage: As player turns to leave, Ulysses speaks of Lanius. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200D32C]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Look, we don't need to fight about this - we can talk this out, right?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic047 "Look, we don't need to fight about this - we can talk this out, right?" [DIAL:0200D343]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Slight sneer}No... no, I couldn't. And I'm thinking you can't kill me, either. If you did, you'd answer for it, just as I would.{No sound file}|{Cold}Let the land do the killing for you, that's one of the things you taught me.|Killing is personal - so's vows, promises. Last bit's more important to me than the first.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic047 "Look, we don't need to fight about this - we can talk this out, right?" [DIAL:0200D343]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [FAILED] {Disgust, dismisses player}Talking... words won't settle this. The Road will. And the end.{No sound file}
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic047 "Look, we don't need to fight about this - we can talk this out, right?" [DIAL:0200D343]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: So... this is about fighting? Or...?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic046 "So... this is about fighting? Or...?" [DIAL:0200D344]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Conceding to player's request, a little less challenging. "This is about the war, right?"}War. Call it that. {Correcting, Emph}Our part in it.{No sound file}|Ulysses wasn't made for the flag he followed. He wasn't made for peace. That's the lesson.|If you follow a symbol to the end, ask yourself what that means. More important, ask what happens {emph}after the end.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic046 "So... this is about fighting? Or...?" [DIAL:0200D344]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [FAILED] {Emph}Fighting? {Disdain}Yes... but different weapons than you're used to.{No sound file}|You're wasting time. Stalling. Won't help you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic046 "So... this is about fighting? Or...?" [DIAL:0200D344]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Ulysses... that sounds like a Legion name... a Legion hero?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic045 "Ulysses... that sounds like a Legion name... a Legion hero?" [DIAL:0200D345]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Conceding to player's request, a little less challenging. "Is this about history?"}History. Yes.{No sound file}|Ulysses walked a hard road. A general, like Caesar and Oliver. He was Brahmin-stubborn, gave him strength on the battlefield.|He led his side to victory, turned two flags into one. {Frowns}That's when {emph}he lost - when the fighting was done, the sickness took hold.|Lesson there, if history's to be believed. One you should heed.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic045 "Ulysses... that sounds like a Legion name... a Legion hero?" [DIAL:0200D345]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [FAILED] {Disdain}Search history, might find meaning in it.{No sound file}|It's just a name - you have {emph}no idea who I am. {Beat, dismissive}You'll know by the end.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic045 "Ulysses... that sounds like a Legion name... a Legion hero?" [DIAL:0200D345]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: So you're the one who sent the radio message - Ulysses.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic044 "So you're the one who sent the radio message - Ulysses." [DIAL:0200D346]

text_content: {Conceding to player's request, a little less challenging. "My name is..."}Not my given name, close enough.{No sound file}|Took it from history, found it in a book. It's an Old World name.|Ulysses lived a long time ago, long before the Old World set fire to itself. He made a mark without being myth.|Had to fight during a time when his world had two flags, and he had to make them one.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic044 "So you're the one who sent the radio message - Ulysses." [DIAL:0200D346]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Forget your name. Back to the job you refused.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic050 "Forget your name. Back to the job you refused." [DIAL:0200D34F]

text_content: {Disdain, dismissive}All right... Courier. If the why of it matters to you.{No sound file}
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic050 "Forget your name. Back to the job you refused." [DIAL:0200D34F]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You're not making any sense.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic049 "You're not making any sense." [DIAL:0200D350]

text_content: Wait... so you swore not to kill me? Why?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic048 "Wait... so you swore not to kill me? Why?" [DIAL:0200D351]

text_content: {Smile/sneer}What kind of world would this be if Courier killed Courier.{No sound file}|You've got enough distance ahead of you - save your breath for the road, don't waste it on words.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic048 "Wait... so you swore not to kill me? Why?" [DIAL:0200D351]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I'm not interested in your politics.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic060 "I'm not interested in your politics." [DIAL:0200D393]

text_content: {Judging}Maybe that's why you chose Vegas... the lights can blind, make people forget themselves. Their convictions - vows. {No sound file}|Not going to waste time trying to make the blind see. {Beat}Took a chance coming here - same as I did. Now we'll see how it plays out.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic060 "I'm not interested in your politics." [DIAL:0200D393]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Maybe not. Maybe that's why you fell in with the Bear in the first place - can't see what you're following.|Not going to convince a deaf man with words. Shown strength coming in here - if strength's what you respect, then you belong East of the Colorado.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic060 "I'm not interested in your politics." [DIAL:0200D393]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: At least they're trying to help the Mojave.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic059 "At least they're trying to help the Mojave." [DIAL:0200D394]

text_content: Trying doesn't hold much weight with me. Legion doesn't {emph}try to kill people, they do it. The Bear kills people trying to {emph}protect them.{No sound file}|Irony's sharp. And Legion... their flag may be old, but it's not at war with itself.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic059 "At least they're trying to help the Mojave." [DIAL:0200D394]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: No matter now. Bear couldn't hold the Divide.|You and that machine, are all that remains of NCR here... {quieter, to himself}rest fell to radiation, fire... and what burrows below.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic059 "At least they're trying to help the Mojave." [DIAL:0200D394]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You've got a better way?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic058 "You've got a better way?" [DIAL:0200D395]

text_content: Yes. And any Courier could tell you the same, see it everywhere. The Bear...{No sound file}|...Bear's too busy carving up the Mojave with knives, roads, borders, and how things {emph}should be to see how it {emph}is.|They're stretched thin, can't protect their frontlines, their towns, think paper's power, radio means control - all of it, useless.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic058 "You've got a better way?" [DIAL:0200D395]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You have a lot of hate for NCR. That kind of hate isn't new in the Mojave.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic057 "You have a lot of hate for NCR. That kind of hate isn't new in the Mojave." [DIAL:0200D396]

text_content: No... not new. And not new among all those in the shadow of the Bear.{No sound file}|{Frowns}You know their flag, a bear with two heads. Symbol's an Old World one, had one head then, better off for it.|Their flag speaks to their spirit. They're split like any two-headed animal, trying to go in different directions, ending up nowhere.|In the Mojave, that'll only get you sand between your fingers - or over your grave.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic057 "You have a lot of hate for NCR. That kind of hate isn't new in the Mojave." [DIAL:0200D396]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: If you�re afraid of Vegas and of Mr. House - you should be.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic056 "If you�re afraid of Vegas and of Mr. House - you should be." [DIAL:0200D397]

text_content: Is New Vegas's power a threat to you?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic055 "Is New Vegas's power a threat to you?" [DIAL:0200D398]

text_content: {Dismissive}Power isn't strength. Power can wall off someone, when they {slight emph}believe it's freed them.{No sound file}|House's power... {Beat, lets it go}you've seen the wall around Vegas. He gains more power, that wall will grow. The Mojave'll become Vegas.|{Little quiet, as if speaking of a haunted graveyard}But it's more lights than strength. You'll see the way of it soon enough.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic055 "Is New Vegas's power a threat to you?" [DIAL:0200D398]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Is that why you're not Legion anymore, then?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic053 "Is that why you're not Legion anymore, then?" [DIAL:0200D39A]

text_content: {Slight surprise}What do you m... {"mean," then chuckles}I see the way of it. Have fight in you, at least. Save it for the road ahead.{No sound file}
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic053 "Is that why you're not Legion anymore, then?" [DIAL:0200D39A]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: A woman in the Legion surprise you?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic052 "A woman in the Legion surprise you?" [DIAL:0200D39B]

text_content: It's not Legion - the Legion I know, but they change, even in small ways as they march West, with every tribe they break.|{Dismissive}But yes... last I heard, you needed a weapon between your legs to carry one for Caesar.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic052 "A woman in the Legion surprise you?" [DIAL:0200D39B]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: "Brothers?" So - you're Legion, too.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic051 """Brothers?"" So - you're Legion, too." [DIAL:0200D39C]

text_content: I hold Legion to be my brothers... even as misguided as they are. And you... more so than most.{No sound file}
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic051 """Brothers?"" So - you're Legion, too." [DIAL:0200D39C]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: < Storage Node Ulysses talking about player being Legion. Do not translate. >
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic126 "< Storage Node Ulysses talking about player being Legion. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200D39D]

text_content: Heard tales of you walking the Mojave. Casting off your disguise... yet you carried that Chip, determined to take it to Vegas... not Caesar.{No Sound File}|You and that Chip deserve each other, 29 fewer coins than other traitors have carried, by history's mark.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic126 "< Storage Node Ulysses talking about player being Legion. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200D39D]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: The Mojave is behind us. I want to know what's ahead.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic071 "The Mojave is behind us. I want to know what's ahead." [DIAL:0200D3B7]

text_content: The High Road... not the Divide yet, many more miles to walk. But you got this far. {Disgust, hates ED-E}You and that machine that shadows you.|Wasn't sure if both of you'd make it - above, then below the underpass.{No sound file}
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic071 "The Mojave is behind us. I want to know what's ahead." [DIAL:0200D3B7]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Forget this. Keep your opinions about Vegas, I'll keep mine.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic070 "Forget this. Keep your opinions about Vegas, I'll keep mine." [DIAL:0200D3B8]

text_content: I doubt you've ever met House.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic069 "I doubt you've ever met House." [DIAL:0200D3B9]

text_content: No... only seen his works. Those he's broken with light and gold. His messengers.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic069 "I doubt you've ever met House." [DIAL:0200D3B9]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: But everything in Vegas speaks of someone who can't let go.|House takes a shovel to history's graves, props up the dead, then puts words in their mouths. The tribes don't even know how they were broken.|{Cold, ominous}Not a world I want to be part of, going through motions until we're all smiling faces on some robot's screen.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic069 "I doubt you've ever met House." [DIAL:0200D3B9]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: House is more pragmatic than you might think.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic068 "House is more pragmatic than you might think." [DIAL:0200D3BA]

text_content: {"I"}Believe that. Vegas runs, I've seen what it's done to those who oppose it. And I've seen its messengers.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic068 "House is more pragmatic than you might think." [DIAL:0200D3BA]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Tribes? You mean the Vegas families?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic067 "Tribes? You mean the Vegas families?" [DIAL:0200D3BB]

text_content: Families of Vegas were once tribes. Got drunk on the Vegas lights, the spirit bled out of them. Old World history, under a different flag.|Whatever traditions or rituals they had, most likely squeezed out of them by now, turned into something else.|{To himself}And if not, then I'm afraid what's going to happen when they come creeping back.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic067 "Tribes? You mean the Vegas families?" [DIAL:0200D3BB]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Vegas is one of the safest places in the Mojave, and that gives me hope.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic066 "Vegas is one of the safest places in the Mojave, and that gives me hope." [DIAL:0200D3BC]

text_content: You've been, you've seen the Wall. Safe? No... what's inside - that's what worries me.|Inside, Old World's waking up. No facts or history I've heard tells me that city ever went to sleep, and that makes me think.|The blue of the Mojave skies - isn't like the rest of the world. Don't hear a Geiger ticking there, more to fear from predators than rads.|The city - the whole Mojave, wasn't hit by bombs. Been my call, Vegas would be one of the first pieces of the Old World to burn.|Someone protected it. Wasn't chance, wasn't luck. Something larger - yet they let the rest of the world suffer. And they'll do it again.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic066 "Vegas is one of the safest places in the Mojave, and that gives me hope." [DIAL:0200D3BC]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: What did you mean before, "it's a dance?"
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic065 "What did you mean before, ""it's a dance?""" [DIAL:0200D3BD]

text_content: {Frowns}That's the wrong word. "Theater" is better - the families, the Bear all on a stage. |House. He's the one watching. {Suspicious}The why... you'd know better than I would. If you don't - you will.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic065 "What did you mean before, ""it's a dance?""" [DIAL:0200D3BD]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: House's plans for the future run longer than that.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic064 "House's plans for the future run longer than that." [DIAL:0200D3BE]

text_content: What do you have against Vegas?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic063 "What do you have against Vegas?" [DIAL:0200D3BF]

text_content: Vegas is Old World, filled with Old World ghosts. {Beat, slightly ominous}And ghosts need the living to do their work.|That's why the families are there, why the Bear stumbles there to lose itself. It's a dance, I don't know its purpose.|You've been, you've seen the Wall. It's what's inside that worries me.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic063 "What do you have against Vegas?" [DIAL:0200D3BF]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Don't be quick to discount Vegas. There's more strength there than may seem.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic062 "Don't be quick to discount Vegas. There's more strength there than may seem." [DIAL:0200D3C0]

text_content: As obsessed as you are about history, the future's what I prefer.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic061 "As obsessed as you are about history, the future's what I prefer." [DIAL:0200D3C1]

text_content: {Disdain}Your future with House has two roads. The road the tribals in Vegas walked... their spirits crushed...|...or your face on a robot servant, smiling forever in a dead casino. There's future in neither.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic061 "As obsessed as you are about history, the future's what I prefer." [DIAL:0200D3C1]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: < Storage Node Ulysses giving player final direction. Do not translate. >
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic127 "< Storage Node Ulysses giving player final direction. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200D3D4]

text_content: {Commanding}For now - find the trigger for the warheads, buried in Hopeville. Use it to keep moving... and keep alive.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic127 "< Storage Node Ulysses giving player final direction. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200D3D4]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Wait... there's more I wanted to talk about. About... all this.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic072 "Wait... there's more I wanted to talk about. About... all this." [DIAL:0200D3D5]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Smiles}"Who are you, who do not know your history?"|You came all this way for answers. Only currency I have, nothing else to be gained - {you}could turn around, walk away at any time.|If history matters to you... you'll need to earn it. {To himself, this is a hint}Any logs of mine I have already cast away in the Divide, they're lost to you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic072 "Wait... there's more I wanted to talk about. About... all this." [DIAL:0200D3D5]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [FAILED] {Dismissive}You want to know more, keep walking.|I'll give answers as you go. {Beat, warning}Not before.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic072 "Wait... there's more I wanted to talk about. About... all this." [DIAL:0200D3D5]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Are you saying... they were here before all this destruction?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic076 "Are you saying... they were here before all this destruction?" [DIAL:0200D3D9]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Nod}Makes sense. Truth favors that, matches the history of this place.|{Reflective}Were signs they were here for a long time, before Marked Men, before what happened to the Divide cracked their sky.|If so, they were buried deep. Might have been born the day America's embers started to settle. {To himself}Seen worse things twisted by radiation.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic076 "Are you saying... they were here before all this destruction?" [DIAL:0200D3D9]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [FAILED] {Dismissive}Don't know the history of them - only their patterns, how they hunt.|{Dismissive}Still, takes a long time for such patterns to develop. A longer history than what happened here.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic076 "Are you saying... they were here before all this destruction?" [DIAL:0200D3D9]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: < Storage Node: Ulysses discussing Denver and the East. Do not Translate. >
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic129 "< Storage Node: Ulysses discussing Denver and the East. Do not Translate. >" [DIAL:0200D3DA]

text_content: Walked the East, too, before the Bull came. Then... much like the Mojave before the Bear... tribes, towns, clutching to life. Bull did a better job.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic129 "< Storage Node: Ulysses discussing Denver and the East. Do not Translate. >" [DIAL:0200D3DA]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Denver? What's that?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic075 "Denver? What's that?" [DIAL:0200D3DB]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Mojave and the Divide aren't the only places I've walked.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic075 "Denver? What's that?" [DIAL:0200D3DB]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [FAILED] Another city fallen to nations, in the east... not important. {Dismissive, player isn't much of an outdoorsman}Doubt you'll ever walk that far, you'd need the land to sustain you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic075 "Denver? What's that?" [DIAL:0200D3DB]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [Legion] You've been to Denver? That's Legion territory.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic074 "[Legion] You've been to Denver? That's Legion territory." [DIAL:0200D3DC]

text_content: Mojave and the Divide aren't the only places I've walked.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic074 "[Legion] You've been to Denver? That's Legion territory." [DIAL:0200D3DC]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: < Storage Node: Ulysses is discussing tunnelers and the future. Do not Translate. >
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic128 "< Storage Node: Ulysses is discussing tunnelers and the future. Do not Translate. >" [DIAL:0200D3DD]

text_content: They'll start emerging throughout the Mojave in time, might be years. Probably less.{No sound file}|They breed fast, hunt in groups, more than enough to bring down the strongest in the Mojave. Once they draw blood...|Seen them tear apart Deathclaws... Deathclaw might get some, but the rest will swarm it, tear it apart, like Denver hounds.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04EDETopic128 "< Storage Node: Ulysses is discussing tunnelers and the future. Do not Translate. >" [DIAL:0200D3DD]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I'm not interested in talking, I only want to know where to head next.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic073 "I'm not interested in talking, I only want to know where to head next." [DIAL:0200D3DE]

text_content: What burrows below? You mean those creatures in the underpass?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic054 "What burrows below? You mean those creatures in the underpass?" [DIAL:0200D3E9]

text_content: You've been to Denver? That's Legion territory.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic088 "You've been to Denver? That's Legion territory." [DIAL:0200D3EA]

text_content: {DUPE}Mojave and the Divide aren't the only places I've walked.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic088 "You've been to Denver? That's Legion territory." [DIAL:0200D3EA]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Maybe you should tell me what happened.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic087 "Maybe you should tell me what happened." [DIAL:0200D3EB]

text_content: NCR saw the worth in that road you made. {Disgust}Staked a claim, whether it was wanted there or not - {just like it�s}true elsewhere in the Mojave.|And where the Bear tries to cling to life, the Legion comes... bearing messages. Some brought by blade. Others... by Couriers.|You knew what was coming, as sure as I know what's coming for you.|This time {emph}you carry the burden. {Beat}Walk west into the sun, and keep walking until it dies. {Beat}There - I'll be waiting.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic087 "Maybe you should tell me what happened." [DIAL:0200D3EB]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: There is no other supply line to the Mojave beyond the Long 15.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic086 "There is no other supply line to the Mojave beyond the Long 15." [DIAL:0200D3EC]

text_content: {Scoffs}Not any more. If one existed, the two-headed Bear would have claimed it. And it tried to.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic086 "There is no other supply line to the Mojave beyond the Long 15." [DIAL:0200D3EC]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You're still making assumptions about all this.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic085 "You're still making assumptions about all this." [DIAL:0200D3ED]

text_content: No, recounting history.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic085 "You're still making assumptions about all this." [DIAL:0200D3ED]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Whatever you believe happened, you have it wrong.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic084 "Whatever you believe happened, you have it wrong." [DIAL:0200D3EE]

text_content: {Raises an eyebrow, contempt}Wrong? {Beat}No, I know the truth of it.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic084 "Whatever you believe happened, you have it wrong." [DIAL:0200D3EE]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: It was you walking that road that kept the Divide alive. It grew from what you did. Settlers... camps... filling that Old World city.|{To himself}Chance for a new nation, new beginning. New way of thinking.|{Bitter}Could've breathed new life into the Mojave, bridging East, West. Like Hoover Dam... but not Old World, something {emph}you made. Road was a supply line.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic084 "Whatever you believe happened, you have it wrong." [DIAL:0200D3EE]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You're crazy. Your head's messed up worse than the Divide.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic083 "You're crazy. Your head's messed up worse than the Divide." [DIAL:0200D3EF]

text_content: {Cold, judging, low}And you've forgotten. Forgotten everything. {Beat, emph}Careless, as careless with futures then as you are now in the Mojave.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic083 "You're crazy. Your head's messed up worse than the Divide." [DIAL:0200D3EF]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I've walked a lot of hard roads, Mojave and before. Doesn't mean anything.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic081 "I've walked a lot of hard roads, Mojave and before. Doesn't mean anything." [DIAL:0200D3F1]

text_content: {Anger}It means {emph}everything - even if you {emph}deny it, cast it aside, that speaks to what you are, {emph}proves what happened here.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic081 "I've walked a lot of hard roads, Mojave and before. Doesn't mean anything." [DIAL:0200D3F1]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: < Placeholder Node: Ulysses talking about the Divide history. Do Not Translate >
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic079 "< Placeholder Node: Ulysses talking about the Divide history. Do Not Translate >" [DIAL:0200D3F3]

text_content: Never would have known the Divide had it not been for you. {Deliberate, slow, little anger here}The road you made with your tracks, again and again.|{Thinking}You were the only one willing to make the journey to and from here... a hard road. Kept the land before the Divide alive through seasons, storms...|{trying to convince himself}{emph}...can't have been just a job. {Accusing}Was something more to you. Don't feel for a place that hard unless it's home.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic079 "< Placeholder Node: Ulysses talking about the Divide history. Do Not Translate >" [DIAL:0200D3F3]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You keep saying that, as if you know where I was born - you don't.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic078 "You keep saying that, as if you know where I was born - you don't." [DIAL:0200D3F4]

text_content: Home isn't where you're born into this world. You taught me that. Part of your message, whether you meant it or not.|{Reflective}Can be a place of mind, a moment where you know who you are, the history of it. {Beat, back to player}And they can be places you breathe life into.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic078 "You keep saying that, as if you know where I was born - you don't." [DIAL:0200D3F4]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I've never been here before, at least not from this road.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic077 "I've never been here before, at least not from this road." [DIAL:0200D3F5]

text_content: Whatever they were carrying, they were fighting side by side with the ones in Legion armor.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic089 "Whatever they were carrying, they were fighting side by side with the ones in Legion armor." [DIAL:0200D405]

text_content: I'm not done talking to you yet, there's more I want to know.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic104 "I'm not done talking to you yet, there's more I want to know." [DIAL:0200D406]

text_content: Already heard you once, long ago and loud enough for history to hear. Tired of your messages.|{Slight snide}Still - curiosity drove you this far. Let's see what else it can do.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic104 "I'm not done talking to you yet, there's more I want to know." [DIAL:0200D406]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You wanted me to come to the Divide, I'm here. Now what?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic102 "You wanted me to come to the Divide, I'm here. Now what?" [DIAL:0200D408]

text_content: Your road's not done. Haven't walked it full yet, not nearly enough.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic102 "You wanted me to come to the Divide, I'm here. Now what?" [DIAL:0200D408]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I've had enough of this - whatever your game, I'm done.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic099 "I've had enough of this - whatever your game, I'm done." [DIAL:0200D40B]

text_content: {Cold}No, {emph}you are. Cut off your retreat, {emph}your supply line. Ashton missile, turned Hopeville into a furnace. |You could walk back. Still can - {slow}but the Divide will mark you, sickness will set in.|Not immediate, maybe, but in time. Slow burn, a little faster than before.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic099 "I've had enough of this - whatever your game, I'm done." [DIAL:0200D40B]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: The way ahead and below - leads to the heart of the Divide.|And there... you and I, we'll have an ending to things.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic099 "I've had enough of this - whatever your game, I'm done." [DIAL:0200D40B]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I didn't intend to set off that missile over the Divide.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic098 "I didn't intend to set off that missile over the Divide." [DIAL:0200D40C]

text_content: I had no idea the silo was active until the missile was in the air toward Hopeville.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic097 "I had no idea the silo was active until the missile was in the air toward Hopeville." [DIAL:0200D40D]

text_content: Didn't stop you, though. Like carrying the Chip to Vegas, Old World death in your hand.|Pieces of the Old World like that just need someone careless enough to take them where they need to go, to do their killing.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic097 "I had no idea the silo was active until the missile was in the air toward Hopeville." [DIAL:0200D40D]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I don't understand how a package could have done this.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic096 "I don't understand how a package could have done this." [DIAL:0200D40E]

text_content: You will. I'll show the Mojave, Bear and Bull the way of it. How Couriers can break nations.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic096 "I don't understand how a package could have done this." [DIAL:0200D40E]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: What happened here... can happen again. {Quiet, slight smug}You've already proved it, what you did in Ashton. The silo there.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic096 "I don't understand how a package could have done this." [DIAL:0200D40E]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You can't be sure it was me.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic095 "You can't be sure it was me." [DIAL:0200D40F]

text_content: No... I'm certain. What I hadn't known was that you still {emph}lived after the Divide.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic095 "You can't be sure it was me." [DIAL:0200D40F]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I'm not responsible for this, there's no way I could have known.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic094 "I'm not responsible for this, there's no way I could have known." [DIAL:0200D410]

text_content: {Emph}If you had been there when it happened. {Beat, quieter}If you had {emph}seen the Divide break, you would know it.|You carry death wherever you go - if the Mojave doesn't know it yet, it will.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic094 "I'm not responsible for this, there's no way I could have known." [DIAL:0200D410]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I've been West, it's possible, but...
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic092 "I've been West, it's possible, but..." [DIAL:0200D412]

text_content: This package... I don't recall it.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic091 "This package... I don't recall it." [DIAL:0200D413]

text_content: It was from the West. From deep in NCR. Whether made by them or not... it came here. Through your hands.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic091 "This package... I don't recall it." [DIAL:0200D413]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You said I brought it from the West?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic090 "You said I brought it from the West?" [DIAL:0200D414]

text_content: {Let a little bit of rage creep in here, this is what he hates}It was a device, a detonator. One I'd never seen before - {little quieter, to himself}or heard before.|{Emph}You carried that thing to the Divide. I know because I followed you as you walked the road, watched you do it.|You brought it here, to the community you built. And you are responsible for what happened after - when the device opened, started to speak.|When it did, the Divide answered back. {Beat}Those missiles you've seen, buried in their silos.|They exploded beneath the ground, cracked the landscape. Sand, ash... the dead... the Divide skies became a graveyard.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic090 "You said I brought it from the West?" [DIAL:0200D414]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I had nothing to do with this.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic082 "I had nothing to do with this." [DIAL:0200D415]

text_content: The logs of the Big Empty mentioned you'd spoken to history.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic116 "The logs of the Big Empty mentioned you'd spoken to history." [DIAL:0200D423]

text_content: {Slow, thinking back}I had, did. It was madness... asked them a question in anger. {Beat}Got an answer, more than I expected. |{Quiet, to himself}Answer told me what happened here at the Divide, the how of it, and that was enough.|{Resolved, closing this up}The tape has the telling of it, don't need me adding to the questions already there.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic116 "The logs of the Big Empty mentioned you'd spoken to history." [DIAL:0200D423]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: In the logs... you mentioned a tribe called the Twisted Hairs - your tribe?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic115 "In the logs... you mentioned a tribe called the Twisted Hairs - your tribe?" [DIAL:0200D424]

text_content: {Anger}Twisted Hairs are dead, lost at Dry Wells, died in Vulpes' smile. Won't discuss their fate with you, not now - their past is {emph}mine to keep.|Walk farther, see me face to face - you might earn more. Now, let the words keep you without me adding to them.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic115 "In the logs... you mentioned a tribe called the Twisted Hairs - your tribe?" [DIAL:0200D424]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I found some recordings from you on the road.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic113 "I found some recordings from you on the road." [DIAL:0200D426]

text_content: {DUPE}The tapes... {Shrugs}didn't think those would be found... weren't worth the words anyway, not like I'd forget what happened.|{DUPE}Had the tech from the Big Empty, recorder a woman gave me... on its last legs, didn't survive the road. Cast it and the tapes aside.|{DUPE}If you heard them... they're of no consequence. Ramblings, reminders for a man who doesn't need them.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic113 "I found some recordings from you on the road." [DIAL:0200D426]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: How were you planning to attack the Divide?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic112 "How were you planning to attack the Divide?" [DIAL:0200D427]

text_content: Didn't know, but Couriers can travel anywhere. They make roads into places no one else will go, guarded or not. Was going to watch, see.|The Legion... thought it might get into the community through me, just as I'd found the way by following you.|But you struck first, shattered the ground, and let your home burn instead. Nearly killed me. And everyone here, walking or still.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic112 "How were you planning to attack the Divide?" [DIAL:0200D427]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: So the Legion doesn't know what happened here?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic111 "So the Legion doesn't know what happened here?" [DIAL:0200D428]

text_content: No, they don't know the history of it. So send others to find out, more to die... at the hands of their brothers the Divide has claimed.|{Bitter}It doesn't matter, the Bear's reach was cut off. Now only the Long 15 remains. Once that's finished, Mojave will be under the flag of the Bull.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic111 "So the Legion doesn't know what happened here?" [DIAL:0200D428]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You were planning to attack the NCR here, then.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic110 "You were planning to attack the NCR here, then." [DIAL:0200D429]

text_content: I'm not interested in the history of this, we're done talking.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic109 "I'm not interested in the history of this, we're done talking." [DIAL:0200D42A]

text_content: All right. Done with words, then, won't get you where you need to go.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic109 "I'm not interested in the history of this, we're done talking." [DIAL:0200D42A]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: So what happened?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic108 "So what happened?" [DIAL:0200D42B]

text_content: Bear made its shadow felt here, more than I could handle. Heavy guard, watchful. I watched, waited.|And as I watched, studied the people. The flag, markings. Thought perhaps... if I got rid of the Bear... what you had given life to might come again.|Waited too long. Hesitated. A Courier isn't meant to stay in one place for long. And then you came, with the package. History.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic108 "So what happened?" [DIAL:0200D42B]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: This is the first I've heard of Legion coming this far West of the Colorado.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic107 "This is the first I've heard of Legion coming this far West of the Colorado." [DIAL:0200D42C]

text_content: No, when they come this far, they aren't Legion. They walk as Couriers. Like we do.|And the Divide is the reason no Legion has been seen. None belong to Caesar. Not in this place.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic107 "This is the first I've heard of Legion coming this far West of the Colorado." [DIAL:0200D42C]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Quieter}The ones that came... were following orders.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic107 "This is the first I've heard of Legion coming this far West of the Colorado." [DIAL:0200D42C]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: So you are part of the Legion. One of their scouts? Assassins?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic106 "So you are part of the Legion. One of their scouts? Assassins?" [DIAL:0200D42D]

text_content: {Echo, insulted}Assassin? {Beat, low anger}If killing needs to be done, I'll face my victims... not kill from a distance, like you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic106 "So you are part of the Legion. One of their scouts? Assassins?" [DIAL:0200D42D]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: That's what made the Legion come to the Divide.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic105 "That's what made the Legion come to the Divide." [DIAL:0200D42E]

text_content: {To himself, echoing Caesar�s orders}Caesar�s orders. {Emph}Every supply line gets cut, every community that feeds the Bear... cut its throat, starve the Mojave.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic105 "That's what made the Legion come to the Divide." [DIAL:0200D42E]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: On the High Road, you mentioned NCR and Legion fought here... before and after the Divide?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic103 "On the High Road, you mentioned NCR and Legion fought here... before and after the Divide?" [DIAL:0200D42F]

text_content: The two-headed Bear made its claim, dug its claws into the trail you made. For once, it seemed like it might succeed - cut a route to the Mojave.|Couldn't let NCR stay in the Divide. Trade route, road the military could use... can't have two roads into the Mojave.|{To himself}Not after the work we'd done to cut off New Canaan, other routes, killing caravans... all we'd done to make the West bleed.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic103 "On the High Road, you mentioned NCR and Legion fought here... before and after the Divide?" [DIAL:0200D42F]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: There's nothing to keep me from walking out of here and letting you rot.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic101 "There's nothing to keep me from walking out of here and letting you rot." [DIAL:0200D430]

text_content: Spent years looking for you. If you head back to the Mojave, it's like nothing's changed. Can live with that. Had to.|Wasn't sure if history would matter to you. If it doesn't, that answers my question.|If you turn your back on your home, so be it. I'll remain here in the Divide for you to return. And you will.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic101 "There's nothing to keep me from walking out of here and letting you rot." [DIAL:0200D430]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I'm not to blame for Ashton, the Chip, or the Divide.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic093 "I'm not to blame for Ashton, the Chip, or the Divide." [DIAL:0200D431]

text_content: {Slow, building anger}All these roads, {emph}you walked. These packages you carried. Think it wasn't your choice?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic093 "I'm not to blame for Ashton, the Chip, or the Divide." [DIAL:0200D431]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Snarls}Of course it was your choice. {Beat}You could have stayed in the Mojave. But you {emph}chose to come, couldn't let be - not in you to let go.|Came for no other reason than you were curious, restless - always have been. {Beat}Had to know the why of it - {Beat}now, I'll show you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic093 "I'm not to blame for Ashton, the Chip, or the Divide." [DIAL:0200D431]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I got your final message.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic062 "I got your final message." [DIAL:0200D442]

text_content: {Slightly amused}Didn�t think I�d be breathing to hear you say that. {Beat, �Still...�}Message isn�t important, meaning is.|Had to speak of it, in case the words got lost in paper, ink, or other's voices. Maybe even yours, in time.|Still, meant for you. Courier to Courier. {Beat}Belongs to you now, or history. Doesn't matter.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic062 "I got your final message." [DIAL:0200D442]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I found some recordings from you in Hopeville.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic117 "I found some recordings from you in Hopeville." [DIAL:0200D443]

text_content: {Surprised}The tapes... {slightly impressed}didn't think those would be found... you know the Divide better than I thought.|Had tech from the Big Empty, recorder a woman gave me... didn't survive the road, on its last legs.|Cast it and the tapes aside... weren't worth the words anyway, not like I'd forget what happened.|If you heard them... nothing but ramblings, reminders for a man who doesn't need them. {To himself}Probably more, lying from here to the Divide.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic117 "I found some recordings from you in Hopeville." [DIAL:0200D443]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: When we first spoke in Hopeville, you mentioned you'd sworn not to kill me. Why?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic118 "When we first spoke in Hopeville, you mentioned you'd sworn not to kill me. Why?" [DIAL:0200D44A]

text_content: {Frowns, slight testing}You know the why of it. If you don't - I do, and that's enough. {To himself, quieter}Shows trust only walks so far West.|{Beat, gives in}Earned more than that, though, getting this far. {Beat}We walk the same road, carry the same colors. Can't break that by making the road red.|Want more than that, walk the Divide. Answers'll come, closer you get to home... you and that machine.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic118 "When we first spoke in Hopeville, you mentioned you'd sworn not to kill me. Why?" [DIAL:0200D44A]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: So... what, they weren't that important then?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic017 "So... what, they weren't that important then?" [DIAL:0200D44C]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Hesitant}Maybe not. {Beat}Who's to say.|{Answers his own question, more to himself}You, perhaps. Found them, heard them after I cast them aside - maybe there was purpose in that.|{Quiet, downnote}If they matter... if history matters... we'll see at the end of the road.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic017 "So... what, they weren't that important then?" [DIAL:0200D44C]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [FAILED] {Dismissive}Words lost to history. {Beat, to himself, as if trying to convince himself of this}Wouldn't have left them on the road otherwise.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic017 "So... what, they weren't that important then?" [DIAL:0200D44C]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I found more recordings from you on the road.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic119 "I found more recordings from you on the road." [DIAL:0200D44F]

text_content: {A little uncomfortable}You scavenge words. Things I have no need of, no history there worth recounting.|Scour the Divide, claw at it for meaning - but my words will give you no answer.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic119 "I found more recordings from you on the road." [DIAL:0200D44F]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic120 "I... think they tell me... where you were. Things you did." [DIAL:0200D451]

text_content: You're going after the Long 15? That's more miles than Legion can hold.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic121 "You're going after the Long 15? That's more miles than Legion can hold." [DIAL:0200D457]

text_content: {Sneers, contempt}Won't {emph}hold it. Divide taught me you don't need to - just cut it off.|Then the Mojave will fall, Bear will starve, its flag will burn. It's spent too long dying, the Long 15 will end it.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic121 "You're going after the Long 15? That's more miles than Legion can hold." [DIAL:0200D457]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: What do you mean, "when it woke?"
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic131 "What do you mean, ""when it woke?""" [DIAL:0200D462]

text_content: Machine couldn't speak by itself. Needed a terminal to access it... like the terminals in the silos here, or the machine with you. |{Quiet}When it was connected, it started speaking. And the Divide answered.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic131 "What do you mean, ""when it woke?""" [DIAL:0200D462]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: But what was it?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic129 "But what was it?" [DIAL:0200D464]

text_content: {Slightly dismissive, like not important}It was a piece of machinery... military, holding memories, codes, maybe. {Frowns}When it woke, made these sounds... words.|{Somber remembering}When it spoke, the Divide became fire, the ground... tore apart like the skies. {Beat, this is the punchline}Through it all, kept calling out - maybe calling for home.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic129 "But what was it?" [DIAL:0200D464]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I don't understand why you didn't kill me in Primm.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic128 "I don't understand why you didn't kill me in Primm." [DIAL:0200D465]

text_content: {To himself}Promises to keep. 'Courier shall not kill Courier.' Always - let them live, spread the word.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic128 "I don't understand why you didn't kill me in Primm." [DIAL:0200D465]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Caesar's orders. Some time before I realized the why of it. {Beat}Wasn't just you. {Emph}All couriers.|No telling how many were Legion. Maybe all of them.|Wasn't sure about you. Until the Divide... all the NCR burning... that much death, it bears the mark of a Legion hand.|{Frowns}But you killed like NCR. Like Hanlon, with mines, bombs... missiles. Killed Legion along with the Bear. Like a coward, kills from a distance.|If you were Legion, then NCR beat you, the West changed you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic128 "I don't understand why you didn't kill me in Primm." [DIAL:0200D465]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: What's our history? How do you know me?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic127 "What's our history? How do you know me?" [DIAL:0200D466]

text_content: I knew {emph}of you, your name. Your road, to and from the Divide, what that meant for the Legion.|We never spoke, knew you through your actions. Knew you'd walked the West as I'd walked the East. Learned different lessons.|And I would never have discovered the Divide without you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic127 "What's our history? How do you know me?" [DIAL:0200D466]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I want to know more about this package I delivered.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic126 "I want to know more about this package I delivered." [DIAL:0200D467]

text_content: {Disdain}You know what it was. {Remembering}Had the symbols of America on it. New markings. From after the Great War.|{To himself}Thought it might be America come again. {Beat}Promise of another future. Another flag.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic126 "I want to know more about this package I delivered." [DIAL:0200D467]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Before I go any farther, I deserve some answers.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic125 "Before I go any farther, I deserve some answers." [DIAL:0200D468]

text_content: {Acknowledging, slow}You've seen the Divide, walked it - farther than I thought you would. {Beat, to himself}Not sure how much farther you have in you.|If you need answers, speak. You've earned them... {to himself}even if only you and I can carry them from here.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic125 "Before I go any farther, I deserve some answers." [DIAL:0200D468]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Frowns}If I have the answers, you've earned them.

text_content: I know that now. Doesn't change what was done. The Legion who died here.|Even if you were Legion, you would answer for those deaths by Caesar's law.

speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I haven't listened to them all. If there's time, I will.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic019 "I haven't listened to them all. If there's time, I will." [DIAL:0200D485]

text_content: As I said before... it's of no consequence. Never intended you to find them, never intended you to {emph}hear them.|Questions in those tapes I still haven't found answers to. You won't be the one to give them.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic019 "I haven't listened to them all. If there's time, I will." [DIAL:0200D485]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Then you learned the wrong message.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic145 "Then you learned the wrong message." [DIAL:0200D490]

text_content: {Smug, confident}Really. Who's to say the truth of it. You? No. You walked {emph}from this, turned your back on it. Now you and others will answer for it.|I'll start with the West. Let that burn. Then... if the East falters after, I'll bring the Divide there as well.|{Quiet}Burn away the flags. {Beat}Begin again.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic145 "Then you learned the wrong message." [DIAL:0200D490]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You might not believe in nations. I do.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic069 "You might not believe in nations. I do." [DIAL:0200D495]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Hesitant}Your actions have carried strength.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic069 "You might not believe in nations. I do." [DIAL:0200D495]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Hesitant}There is conviction in your words, enough to rival a Legate, perhaps Caesar. You believe what you say.

speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Hesitant}Your actions have carried strength. More importantly, not for House, but for the families on the Strip.

speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [FAILED] {Cold}Yet you follow nothing at all.|You have walked the Mojave, let the shadow of flags fall upon you, yet walk carelessly, no allegiance. Your words - empty as your actions.

speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]
