speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: What makes you think this leads home?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic149 "What makes you think this leads home?" [DIAL:0200D6EB]

text_content: All roads lead back to one's home. Not your birthplace maybe, but home.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic149 "What makes you think this leads home?" [DIAL:0200D6EB]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: This road leads nowhere. There's nothing in the Divide.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic148 "This road leads nowhere. There's nothing in the Divide." [DIAL:0200D6EC]

text_content: Many in the Mojave think the Divide's nothing but canyon and storm. {Beat}Wasn't always.|{Starts getting nostalgic}There was life, a town, farther West... not talking about an Old World town like Hopeville... more recent. Something you saw in your lifetime.|{Nostalgia increases}It had the name "the Divide," too. But rather than cracks in the earth, it was a road from the West into the Mojave, a supply line.|{Comes back to present}Took a Courier to make that road. {Beat}You. Back then, you saw the road with eyes facing East. This time... the Divide's in the other direction.|And if your eyes try to make sense of it when you reach it... {cold, downnote}home's not what it was.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic148 "This road leads nowhere. There's nothing in the Divide." [DIAL:0200D6EC]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You're not taking ED-E from me.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic154 "You're not taking ED-E from me." [DIAL:0200D6F0]

text_content: If you think you can take it from me, try.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic152 "If you think you can take it from me, try." [DIAL:0200D6F2]

text_content: {Cold}The machine you brought is mine now, it's coming home. {Snarling, talking about torturing the robot}I'll reduce it to parts, just enough to function, to be aware of what's happening.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic152 "If you think you can take it from me, try." [DIAL:0200D6F2]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: ED-E's not going anywhere.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic151 "ED-E's not going anywhere." [DIAL:0200D6F3]

text_content: What? ED-E?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic150 "What? ED-E?" [DIAL:0200D6F4]

text_content: {Derision}You gave it a name. What was it to you? Companion? Slave... weapon? All of that, nothing compared to its primary function.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic150 "What? ED-E?" [DIAL:0200D6F4]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: If you bomb the West and East... is this how things should end?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic092 "If you bomb the West and East... is this how things should end?" [DIAL:0200D6FA]

text_content: {DUPE}[SUCCEEDED] {Reluctant}History has proven this. Our history.|{Slow, considering}You seek to use your own crimes to prevent mine. There... is a strange honor in that. Perhaps the shadow of the Bull does walk with you.|{Prove it}The West, the East - they are not the Divide, and nothing you can do can prevent the missile's launch. {Testing, slow in the middle}Convincing me - changes nothing.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic092 "If you bomb the West and East... is this how things should end?" [DIAL:0200D6FA]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [FAILED] {Scoffs}You answer me with questions. {Sneers}Doubt. You were strong enough to come here - but not strong enough to speak for all the Legion.|{Cold}This is the ending they deserve... a flag is a thing of the people that gather to it, as are all symbols.|{Acknowledging player's strength, but...}You believe. Yet you do not see that killing a symbol with its own weapon carries justice of its own... just as it will when the East dies as well.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic092 "If you bomb the West and East... is this how things should end?" [DIAL:0200D6FA]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Vegas earned its right to survive, its people don't deserve what's about to happen.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic089 "Vegas earned its right to survive, its people don't deserve what's about to happen." [DIAL:0200D6FD]

text_content: {DUPE}[SUCCEEDED] {Reluctant}History has proven this. Our history.|{Slight disdain}And you think that you have this strength? Enough to hold up NCR, long enough so that Vegas may live again?|{Prove it}Even if you speak for Vegas and its ghosts, nothing you can do can prevent the missile's launch. {Testing, slow in the middle}Convincing me - changes nothing.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic089 "Vegas earned its right to survive, its people don't deserve what's about to happen." [DIAL:0200D6FD]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {DUPE}[FAILED] No... your answer is not enough.|{Cold}They deserve what comes. Vegas is born of the corrupt, the  blind, lost, that gather to it. Without them... it would fall dark.|You believe. Yet... you have been blinded by the wrong symbol. {Slightly sympathetic}Let its light give you what strength it can... today marks its end.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic089 "Vegas earned its right to survive, its people don't deserve what's about to happen." [DIAL:0200D6FD]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: There still might be a way out of this - I just need time.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic088 "There still might be a way out of this - I just need time." [DIAL:0200D6FE]

text_content: We've already handled everything it can throw at us.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic087 "We've already handled everything it can throw at us." [DIAL:0200D6FF]

text_content: The Divide? What do you mean?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic086 "The Divide? What do you mean?" [DIAL:0200D700]

text_content: {Thinking, resolved to die}Our enemies gather outside... shadows of the Bear and Bull... they will have found their way in, just as you did.|{Quiet, rueful}It was always my intention - in case I could not kill you, the Marked Men would flood this place, cut off your escape.|{This is the end sequence}If we cannot prevent what comes, then let us make our stand here. {Beat, final, somber}Two Couriers, together, at the Divide.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic086 "The Divide? What do you mean?" [DIAL:0200D700]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Even if the missiles launch, and I die here  - if I can convince you, that's enough for me.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic085 "Even if the missiles launch, and I die here  - if I can convince you, that's enough for me." [DIAL:0200D701]

text_content: {Player has convinced him, nods, slow, quiet}It is... enough.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic085 "Even if the missiles launch, and I die here  - if I can convince you, that's enough for me." [DIAL:0200D701]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I believe that one person can make... or break... a nation. You already know this.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic084 "I believe that one person can make... or break... a nation. You already know this." [DIAL:0200D702]

text_content: {Chewing it over, slight hope here}It may be... that as much destruction has been written in the earth here... you may build something else, as you built the Divide.|You have spoken truly. There is a shadow of a nation behind you, the hope of a people... yet it may not matter. The Divide still stands against us.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic084 "I believe that one person can make... or break... a nation. You already know this." [DIAL:0200D702]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Well, I just said all that because I'm betting you have some way to stop all this.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic083 "Well, I just said all that because I'm betting you have some way to stop all this." [DIAL:0200D703]

text_content: {Cold}So... you resort to trickery. You were hoping that you could deceive me, reveal that somehow I can {emph}stop all this.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic083 "Well, I just said all that because I'm betting you have some way to stop all this." [DIAL:0200D703]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Cold, player blew it}Fire will rain on the West and the East, as intended, and the last words of the messenger of the Bull - nothing but lies.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic083 "Well, I just said all that because I'm betting you have some way to stop all this." [DIAL:0200D703]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Cold, player blew it}The West will burn, as intended, and Vegas will follow. The last words of its messenger, were not for the people of the city, but lies and deceit.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic083 "Well, I just said all that because I'm betting you have some way to stop all this." [DIAL:0200D703]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Cold, player blew it}Your nation will burn, as intended, and the last words of its messenger, were not for its people, but to beg for mercy.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic083 "Well, I just said all that because I'm betting you have some way to stop all this." [DIAL:0200D703]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Because it should be given a chance? Its people don't deserve what's about to happen.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic080 "Because it should be given a chance? Its people don't deserve what's about to happen." [DIAL:0200D706]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Reluctant}History has proven this. Our history.|{Slight disdain}And you think that you have this strength? Enough for {emph}all of NCR?|{Prove it}The West is not the Divide, and nothing you can do can prevent the missile's launch. {Testing, slow in the middle}Convincing me - changes nothing.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic080 "Because it should be given a chance? Its people don't deserve what's about to happen." [DIAL:0200D706]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [FAILED] No... your answer is not enough.|{Cold}They deserve what comes... and should answer for it, as you should. The Bear is a thing of the people that gather to it, as are all symbols.|You believe. Yet... you believe in the wrong symbol. {Slightly sympathetic}Let it give you what strength it can... soon, it will be no more.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic080 "Because it should be given a chance? Its people don't deserve what's about to happen." [DIAL:0200D706]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Do you think I care if you fire missiles at NCR? Go ahead.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic079 "Do you think I care if you fire missiles at NCR? Go ahead." [DIAL:0200D707]

text_content: You destroyed your own homeland. Seeing a nation burn? Didn't think that would matter any more to you.|There's a strength in that... lack of attachment. Still, you're here now. If there's no more answers you want, then we'll end this.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic079 "Do you think I care if you fire missiles at NCR? Go ahead." [DIAL:0200D707]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You can't destroy the West, even with all the missiles here.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic078 "You can't destroy the West, even with all the missiles here." [DIAL:0200D708]

text_content: {Scoffs}No need to destroy the Bear, just cut its throat.|You taught me that at the Divide - only need to cut off the supply line, the road, to watch something greater die.|I'll turn the Long 15 into miles of fire, cut off the Mojave. NCR will fall back, lose Hoover Dam... and leave their throats exposed to the Legion.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic078 "You can't destroy the West, even with all the missiles here." [DIAL:0200D708]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: < Topic Storage: End Sequence with Ulysses in Temple. Do not translate. >
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic077 "< Topic Storage: End Sequence with Ulysses in Temple. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200D709]

text_content: And knowing that you believe in the Bear's sickness and have given it strength... then that gives more reason to lay waste to your homeland.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic077 "< Topic Storage: End Sequence with Ulysses in Temple. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200D709]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: The sickness of the Bear already lies within you, even if you uphold the East. If there were time, I would let you kill the Legion.|But no, the Legion will burn as well. Without the West to challenge it... its shore will be closer than before. It will feed on itself, die.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic077 "< Topic Storage: End Sequence with Ulysses in Temple. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200D709]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Without NCR to support it, Vegas will fall to the Legion. That grave of lights, back to dust and ghosts, as was meant.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic077 "< Topic Storage: End Sequence with Ulysses in Temple. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200D709]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: After this, only one flag will remain over the Mojave. Let that one fly, or destroy itself.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic077 "< Topic Storage: End Sequence with Ulysses in Temple. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200D709]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You don't see, listen - even when it's all around you, no matter if I nailed it into your head like a gift from Caesar.|You brought the Divide to life, Courier. You walked the road. Brought the Bear, then the Bull, brought me, following your tracks.|And when I saw the Divide you made, I saw a second chance, a new way of thinking. {Beat}My world - no longer the East.|Then you brought the West in that package. Destroyed it all. Nearly killed me, flesh and spirit.|You destroyed something larger than the Bear, greater than the Bull. And even when you could have turned away, you brought it again, in that machine.|You destroyed a nation taking its first breath. {Low}A place that could have been my {emph}home. {Beat}Now, I'll destroy yours.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic077 "< Topic Storage: End Sequence with Ulysses in Temple. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200D709]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: This is between you and me, not anyone else.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic075 "This is between you and me, not anyone else." [DIAL:0200D70B]

text_content: No... the paths we've walked. The roads, and the flags above them, carry equal blame.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic075 "This is between you and me, not anyone else." [DIAL:0200D70B]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: So, what - you intend to bomb the Mojave?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic073 "So, what - you intend to bomb the Mojave?" [DIAL:0200D70D]

text_content: No, the West. The East. It doesn't matter - the death of either one kills the other, Vegas along with it. {Beat}The West shall answer first.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic073 "So, what - you intend to bomb the Mojave?" [DIAL:0200D70D]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: No, not the Mojave. The West, all that's been built since America died. Same symbols as before the war, now a flag carried by a tribe of children.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic073 "So, what - you intend to bomb the Mojave?" [DIAL:0200D70D]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You walked the West, didn't stay. You know the reason... the Bear grows without structure, follows a symbol without knowing its history.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic073 "So, what - you intend to bomb the Mojave?" [DIAL:0200D70D]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: What happened at the Divide, what I did, was an accident. What you're doing - it's madness.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic072 "What happened at the Divide, what I did, was an accident. What you're doing - it's madness." [DIAL:0200D70E]

text_content: {Angry, low}No, now there is {emph}purpose. {Disgust}I believe you when you say you were... careless. The Divide... the Chip... the machine you brought here...|{Emph}Many messages can be taken from that, intended or not. What I do now is an act of conviction.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic072 "What happened at the Divide, what I did, was an accident. What you're doing - it's madness." [DIAL:0200D70E]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: If you blame me for the Divide, then let me answer for it, not others.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic071 "If you blame me for the Divide, then let me answer for it, not others." [DIAL:0200D70F]

text_content: {Scoffs}Blame you? No, {emph}learned from you. Both the weapon to kill a nation, and the strength to do it.|You showed me a road, a way to carry my message. {Beat, slight snide}You've already answered for what you've done. {Cold}Now the flag you follow will answer for it.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic071 "If you blame me for the Divide, then let me answer for it, not others." [DIAL:0200D70F]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Where is the package now?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic140 "Where is the package now?" [DIAL:0200D733]

text_content: {Slightly coy, knows where it is}Buried in the Divide. Part of it now.|Wherever it is, it's been silent... if it spoke again, we'd know.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic140 "Where is the package now?" [DIAL:0200D733]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Why would I have brought it here?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic139 "Why would I have brought it here?" [DIAL:0200D734]

text_content: I've walked the East. {Accusing}You've walked the West, more than I have.|Circle Junction. Reno. Vault City. Word of you at Fort Aradesh... Fort Abandon. Even further West than that, Brahmin drives on the Big Circle.|Whatever you saw out there, wasn't enough to make you stay. {Beat}Maybe the markings on the package reminded you of the road home.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic139 "Why would I have brought it here?" [DIAL:0200D734]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: This package... you said it had markings? What was it?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic138 "This package... you said it had markings? What was it?" [DIAL:0200D735]

text_content: Machinery. Simple on the outside, computer parts. Inside... more complicated.|Was the only time I'd heard a machine speak in the Divide, the only machine with a voice.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic138 "This package... you said it had markings? What was it?" [DIAL:0200D735]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: This is revenge for nearly killing you, then.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic137 "This is revenge for nearly killing you, then." [DIAL:0200D736]

text_content: Not the name I'd give it. Not the name the dead would give it.|Soldiers of the Bear died here... Legion died, too, my brothers. Still dying, both of them, all around us.|None of the people that lived here survived... yet all of the West and the East, they hold on as the Divide tears at them.|Revenge isn't the message I have for you. More than that... Courier.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic137 "This is revenge for nearly killing you, then." [DIAL:0200D736]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: So you blame me for this? An accident?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic134 "So you blame me for this? An accident?" [DIAL:0200D739]

text_content: {Anger, sneer}Blame? Accident? The names you hang on this... Courier... you carry death wherever you go, Mojave knows - or will.|I'll see you answer for this. The road doesn't end here, there's more to come, I swear to you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic134 "So you blame me for this? An accident?" [DIAL:0200D739]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: If you saw this happen, then how did you survive?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic020 "If you saw this happen, then how did you survive?" [DIAL:0200D73A]

text_content: {Disgust, bitter, implication is that he wanted to die there}Should've died there... but now that I know you live... {bitter}the machines here... {implied quotes}saved me. I was the only survivor, {to himself}or thought I was.|Your package, the message inside, awoke medical machines... close to the one that shadows you... began to build themselves, then others.|They only take what parts they find in the Divide, never roam beyond it - can't even leave the silos without a human to shadow, like hounds.|Maybe they saw the flag on my jacket, thought I was of America. If so, history saved me. A sign.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic020 "If you saw this happen, then how did you survive?" [DIAL:0200D73A]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: This place was important to the Legion?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic135 "This place was important to the Legion?" [DIAL:0200D978]

text_content: Why did NCR want to keep the route open?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic133 "Why did NCR want to keep the route open?" [DIAL:0200D979]

text_content: What do you mean?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic132 "What do you mean?" [DIAL:0200D97A]

text_content: {Agreeing}The Dam. That Old World Wall.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic132 "What do you mean?" [DIAL:0200D97A]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {DUPE}{Agreeing}The Dam. That Old World Wall.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic132 "What do you mean?" [DIAL:0200D97A]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {DUPE}{Agreeing}The Dam. That Old World Wall.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic132 "What do you mean?" [DIAL:0200D97A]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: The why of it. Hoover Dam.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic132 "What do you mean?" [DIAL:0200D97A]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: The Bear, NCR, couldn't be allowed to reach it easily. Long 15... Canaan... both bad enough.|{Disgust}Kimball, Caesar, House... you'd think their whole world was that wall, cutting the Colorado. {To himself}If I'd never laid eyes on it, never spoke of it...|...but once found, it was all Caesar could see. That, and the flag beyond it, another symbol, big enough to challenge him.|And the Divide, one of the roads to it - Legion was tasked with cutting that artery. If you can't kill the Bear in one stroke, bleed it, starve it.|That kind of murder... it's what any of the {emph}Legion would have done. Now... the Divide belongs to history.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic132 "What do you mean?" [DIAL:0200D97A]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Something wrong? You sound... mad... at my robot.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic130 "Something wrong? You sound... mad... at my robot." [DIAL:0200D97B]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Hate? No. There's nothing to hate in metal... steel, gold. {Bold}Or platinum.|{Disdain}Your machine... it's just a tool, made of wreckage of the Divide... {to himself}all that was brought here.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic130 "Something wrong? You sound... mad... at my robot." [DIAL:0200D97B]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [FAILED] {Disgust}When I speak in anger, {emph}Courier, you'll know it. {Dismissive, trying to play this down}Your machine? Worth no more hate than any {emph}other machine.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic130 "Something wrong? You sound... mad... at my robot." [DIAL:0200D97B]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: So you're saying I walked this road once from another direction - from West to East. To home.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic100 "So you're saying I walked this road once from another direction - from West to East. To home." [DIAL:0200D97C]

text_content: I don't understand. What message?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic173 "I don't understand. What message?" [DIAL:0200D9B2]

text_content: The nations of the Mojave. Cracked and broken as the Divide... its people, the same.|I have walked at Caesar's command, across the East, into the West. Far enough to know Caesar's word did not drive me. Far enough to see the end.|You've seen it. No Courier, whatever their flag can ignore it. Why you didn't stay in the West. Why you wandered.|There is no future in the Bear or Bull. The Bear is diseased, barely clings to life.|And the Bull... when the Legion reaches the sea, it will turn on itself and die.|Killing one will end both. And you made me see how one could do it. Your ignorance, carelessness - can be used with a purpose.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic173 "I don't understand. What message?" [DIAL:0200D9B2]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: If this is why you're angry, you've seen nothing yet.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic172 "If this is why you're angry, you've seen nothing yet." [DIAL:0200D9B3]

text_content: So this is revenge, then. For destroying the Divide.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic171 "So this is revenge, then. For destroying the Divide." [DIAL:0200D9B4]

text_content: And that's why you want me dead.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic170 "And that's why you want me dead." [DIAL:0200D9B5]

text_content: {Slight sympathy for the player, doesn't get it}My history isn't revenge, or hate. The road that brought us {emph}both here - isn't about that.|It's about the {emph}message you carried. The one in that package, whether you knew it or not.|{Slow, ominous}The message that {emph}one can kill a nation. Can kill a symbol. And all that gather beneath its flag.|{Slow}I don't blame you for the Divide. {Beat, punchline}I blame you for what you made me see.|{Death sentence}Now you will see what you brought to the Mojave, and that will be {emph}my message to {emph}you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic170 "And that's why you want me dead." [DIAL:0200D9B5]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: All things come to an end. If you put faith in something outside yourself, tough.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic169 "All things come to an end. If you put faith in something outside yourself, tough." [DIAL:0200D9B6]

text_content: If you cared about the Divide, then I'm sorry for what happened here.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic168 "If you cared about the Divide, then I'm sorry for what happened here." [DIAL:0200D9B7]

text_content: So you believed in this place. What it once was.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic167 "So you believed in this place. What it once was." [DIAL:0200D9B8]

text_content: {Bitter}There was hope here, another chance. A new nation, stirring to life. {Beat}A place I could have set my flag.|Not the America of old. But something larger than the tribes of the East, something larger than the houses of the West. Something better.|The Divide... could have bridged both, like Hoover Dam. {Anger, dismissive}Now like the Dam, it's too covered in blood to see what it could have been.|{Slow, accusing}You gave life to this place. I followed your road here, saw the Divide. You {emph}led me here, so that I could see.|{Bring it down}Then, you brought it to an end.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic167 "So you believed in this place. What it once was." [DIAL:0200D9B8]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I'm glad this place burned... obviously, it meant something to you, which makes it even better.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic166 "I'm glad this place burned... obviously, it meant something to you, which makes it even better." [DIAL:0200D9B9]

text_content: You think I'm responsible for this. My question is what your tie to this place is.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic165 "You think I'm responsible for this. My question is what your tie to this place is." [DIAL:0200D9BA]

text_content: If you blame me for what happened here at the Divide - why do you care?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic164 "If you blame me for what happened here at the Divide - why do you care?" [DIAL:0200D9BB]

text_content: {Reflective, Ulysses is getting to the core of the reason of why he's doing all this}The community that was once here... and the package you brought... both had markings of the Divide. Markings of America.|{Quiet, reminding the player}You've seen the marks, the symbol. As early as the Hopeville silo, maybe. Carried it etched on your weapons.|The Divide, its buildings, its people, were built around those same markings, surrounded them here...|...markings like the flag on my back. When I {emph}followed your road to the Divide those years ago, I saw the symbol I wore all around me.|An Old World symbol. Strong, to survive here - its people, strong. {"Maybe," low}Outlast the Bear, outlast the Bull. Promise of something better.|Caesar was right to want it dead. NCR was right to want to rake their claws in it.|Seeing it... changed me, just as seeing Hoover Dam changed Caesar and the NCR.|{Quiet}Seeing it end changed me, too.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic164 "If you blame me for what happened here at the Divide - why do you care?" [DIAL:0200D9BB]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [Legion] Killing NCR, cutting off their supply line at the Divide serves Legion, as do we all.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic163 "[Legion] Killing NCR, cutting off their supply line at the Divide serves Legion, as do we all." [DIAL:0200D9BC]

text_content: {Echoing player's statement}Serves the Legion?|{Quiet, accusing}I carry no hatred for duty... if that's what this was. The Divide was more than that. Its people, more than that.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic163 "[Legion] Killing NCR, cutting off their supply line at the Divide serves Legion, as do we all." [DIAL:0200D9BC]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: If you're Legion, are you angry because I destroyed the Divide supply line instead of you?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic162 "If you're Legion, are you angry because I destroyed the Divide supply line instead of you?" [DIAL:0200D9BD]

text_content: {Echoing player}The supply line - the artery for the West? {Disdain, player's missing the point}I have seen the blood of NCR at Legion hands many times.|{DUPE}{Quiet, accusing}I carry no hatred for duty... if that's what this was. The Divide was more than that. Its people, more than that.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic162 "If you're Legion, are you angry because I destroyed the Divide supply line instead of you?" [DIAL:0200D9BD]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Then what? Did the Divide explosion kill your family? Your wife - children?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic161 "Then what? Did the Divide explosion kill your family? Your wife - children?" [DIAL:0200D9BE]

text_content: [Legion] The dead? You mean your brothers in the Legion - our brothers.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic159 "[Legion] The dead? You mean your brothers in the Legion - our brothers." [DIAL:0200D9BF]

text_content: {Respectful for dead}The Legion who died here... they didn't deserve to die, like those that died in the fires of Boulder City... {sneering to self}bombs, Hanlon's gifts.|{Respectful}Their deaths were mercy compared to those who still walk. Any who die beneath the flag of the Bull... their death should be in battle.|{Quiet}But no... the dead number more than my brothers.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic159 "[Legion] The dead? You mean your brothers in the Legion - our brothers." [DIAL:0200D9BF]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [NCR] The dead? You mean the Republic troops who were here?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic158 "[NCR] The dead? You mean the Republic troops who were here?" [DIAL:0200D9C0]

text_content: {Derisive}The soldiers of the Bear? They were dead already, their symbol... diseased. Deserved to die as my brothers did at Boulder City, mines, bombs.|{Sneers}I carry nothing for them. Their deaths here were a mercy - compared to the ones that still walk the Divide.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic158 "[NCR] The dead? You mean the Republic troops who were here?" [DIAL:0200D9C0]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: When you speak of the dead - you mean the Marked Men? The Legion and NCR?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic157 "When you speak of the dead - you mean the Marked Men? The Legion and NCR?" [DIAL:0200D9C1]

text_content: {DUPE}{Derisive}The soldiers of the Bear? They were dead already, their symbol... diseased. Deserved to die as my brothers did at Boulder City, mines, bombs.|{DUPE}{Sneers}I carry nothing for them. Their deaths here were a mercy - compared to the ones that still walk the Divide.|{Quiet, respectful}As for my brothers in the Legion... they deserved to die in battle, as do all beneath the flag of the Bull.|{DUPE}{Quiet}But no... the dead number more than my brothers.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic157 "When you speak of the dead - you mean the Marked Men? The Legion and NCR?" [DIAL:0200D9C1]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: The Divide explosion... what, did I kill your family? Your wife - children?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic155 "The Divide explosion... what, did I kill your family? Your wife - children?" [DIAL:0200D9C2]

text_content: {Derisive, echoes player's comment}My family? My tribe lives... {but}its history? Died long ago, fell under the shadow of the Bull... consumed by another symbol.|No, this isn't about family - or any common blood. It's blood shared by {emph}acts, not by chance.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic155 "The Divide explosion... what, did I kill your family? Your wife - children?" [DIAL:0200D9C2]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: What happened here was an accident. Any anger you have, let it go.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic144 "What happened here was an accident. Any anger you have, let it go." [DIAL:0200D9C3]

text_content: So you're angry because I accidentally brought an explosive to the Divide?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic136 "So you're angry because I accidentally brought an explosive to the Divide?" [DIAL:0200D9C4]

text_content: {Anger}Accident? Ignorance is a {emph}choice. The Chip - a choice.|{More to himself}As for anger... it is what I carry for the dead, and all that come here.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic136 "So you're angry because I accidentally brought an explosive to the Divide?" [DIAL:0200D9C4]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: "The why of it?" You're the one who needs to answer that - why are you doing this?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic080 """The why of it?"" You're the one who needs to answer that - why are you doing this?" [DIAL:0200D9C5]

text_content: {Slow anger, being cagey here, doesn't want to show hand}Want to hear the answer of it. Not just history's answer... your answer for what happened here.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic080 """The why of it?"" You're the one who needs to answer that - why are you doing this?" [DIAL:0200D9C5]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [Legion] I'll see that you answer for it.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic142 "[Legion] I'll see that you answer for it." [DIAL:0200D9D9]

text_content: {Disgust}Then Legion kills Legion. Farther you walk from the flag of the Bull, the more West creeps into you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic142 "[Legion] I'll see that you answer for it." [DIAL:0200D9D9]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [Legion] I didn't side with the Legion until the Mojave.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic141 "[Legion] I didn't side with the Legion until the Mojave." [DIAL:0200D9DA]

text_content: {DUPE}I know that now. Doesn't change what was done. The Legion who died here.|{Slight threat}Legion doesn't know your history. I do. They find out what happened here, how many of their own died... {"they'll want justice"}they'll want an answer.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic141 "[Legion] I didn't side with the Legion until the Mojave." [DIAL:0200D9DA]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: What's so important about him?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic147 "What's so important about him?" [DIAL:0200D9DE]

text_content: What's {emph}inside that machine - that's all that mattered. All the machines here, made of wreckage from the Divide... and all that was brought here.|Inside its frame, it carries the message you brought here... and it'll do what it was programmed to do: {slow, pace this}whatever it can to get home.|The giants here will listen to it. I'll bring the Divide to your home, your nation. Let its flag burn, just like you let the Divide burn.|{Speaking to console}Big Mountain access code... Ulysses. Command override...|{Beat, quiet, like saying "launch" nukes}Navarro.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic147 "What's so important about him?" [DIAL:0200D9DE]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You want the robot? Why?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic146 "You want the robot? Why?" [DIAL:0200D9DF]

text_content: {Taunt, derisive}It's a messenger. Like us... and it shares our history.|{Taunt, then cold, he's enjoying this}If you feel its loss... remember you could have turned away at any time. Gone back home, and none of this would have happened.|{Taunt, edged}But you had to make one last delivery, and that's why I knew you'd come, Courier. Couldn't stay away, it's who you are.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic146 "You want the robot? Why?" [DIAL:0200D9DF]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Maybe there's something similar to be said about that Old World flag on your back.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic114 "Maybe there's something similar to be said about that Old World flag on your back." [DIAL:0200D9EC]

text_content: No, what it means is that what pieces survive can become worse than they were before.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic113 "No, what it means is that what pieces survive can become worse than they were before." [DIAL:0200D9ED]

text_content: It's proof that killing a symbol is going to be harder than you thought.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic112 "It's proof that killing a symbol is going to be harder than you thought." [DIAL:0200D9EE]

text_content: Back to symbols and history, then. Hard to kill... like Couriers.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic112 "It's proof that killing a symbol is going to be harder than you thought." [DIAL:0200D9EE]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You're saying when the meaning gets lost - that what happens here, can make things worse. {Beat}Happened in the Mojave. Flags of the Bear and Bull.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic112 "It's proof that killing a symbol is going to be harder than you thought." [DIAL:0200D9EE]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: So you carry two symbols then - the mark of America and the Twisted Hairs, neither dead.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic111 "So you carry two symbols then - the mark of America and the Twisted Hairs, neither dead." [DIAL:0200D9EF]

text_content: {Frowns}Both... both survived, pieces of them. Remnants, nothing more.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic111 "So you carry two symbols then - the mark of America and the Twisted Hairs, neither dead." [DIAL:0200D9EF]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: But the Twisted Hairs survived, even after Caesar.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic110 "But the Twisted Hairs survived, even after Caesar." [DIAL:0200D9F0]

text_content: No, they didn't. They were ended, completely. Became part of history's march.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic110 "But the Twisted Hairs survived, even after Caesar." [DIAL:0200D9F0]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: If you feel there is meaning in the White Legs taking the braids of my tribe... what they did... insult, not respect.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic110 "But the Twisted Hairs survived, even after Caesar." [DIAL:0200D9F0]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: In the death of that history, another was born, and you grew to respect the White Legs.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic109 "In the death of that history, another was born, and you grew to respect the White Legs." [DIAL:0200D9F1]

text_content: {Disdain}Respect the White Legs? That tribe of jackals? Never.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic109 "In the death of that history, another was born, and you grew to respect the White Legs." [DIAL:0200D9F1]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: In the log, you said they were shadows, in the way they wore their hair.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic108 "In the log, you said they were shadows, in the way they wore their hair." [DIAL:0200D9F2]

text_content: {Recognition}The braids I wore. They took that from me, thought it made them more like me, more willing to have Caesar listen.|They didn't know what the braids meant, the mark of my tribe before Caesar came... before Vulpes came for them at Dry Wells.|There was death in that meeting, even while Vulpes smiled - asked for our help against the other tribes.|All the while, they were looking to cast our history on the fire. And did. Another tribe, consumed by the Bull - nothing left.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic108 "In the log, you said they were shadows, in the way they wore their hair." [DIAL:0200D9F2]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You're wrong, and you led them to destroy your tribe at New Canaan.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic107 "You're wrong, and you led them to destroy your tribe at New Canaan." [DIAL:0200D9F3]

text_content: I'm talking about the past, in the respect they showed you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic106 "I'm talking about the past, in the respect they showed you." [DIAL:0200D9F4]

text_content: {Slight confusion, doesn't understand what the player meant}Respect...?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic106 "I'm talking about the past, in the respect they showed you." [DIAL:0200D9F4]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: The White Legs might as well have been your people.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic105 "The White Legs might as well have been your people." [DIAL:0200D9F5]

text_content: {Disdain, player has it wrong}The White Legs? To even claim they were shadows of the Twisted Hairs...|No, whatever words you heard, they were not mine.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic105 "The White Legs might as well have been your people." [DIAL:0200D9F5]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: But your tribe was New Canaan.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic104 "But your tribe was New Canaan." [DIAL:0200D9F6]

text_content: {Disdain, player has it wrong}New Canaan? My tribe?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic104 "But your tribe was New Canaan." [DIAL:0200D9F6]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Any symbol deserves a chance to defend itself, by words or acts - not... this.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic103 "Any symbol deserves a chance to defend itself, by words or acts - not... this." [DIAL:0200D9F7]

text_content: As you defend it now?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic103 "Any symbol deserves a chance to defend itself, by words or acts - not... this." [DIAL:0200D9F7]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: It hasn't proven itself wrong. That's why the Legion and NCR conflict must continue. To test it.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic102 "It hasn't proven itself wrong. That's why the Legion and NCR conflict must continue. To test it." [DIAL:0200D9F8]

text_content: Test it. As you test me? As if you believe there is some other road here.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic102 "It hasn't proven itself wrong. That's why the Legion and NCR conflict must continue. To test it." [DIAL:0200D9F8]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Nothing can prevent what comes. The missiles will launch. {Beat}These questions - your words, or mine - what do they matter to you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic102 "It hasn't proven itself wrong. That's why the Legion and NCR conflict must continue. To test it." [DIAL:0200D9F8]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: By your standards? Or history's?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic101 "By your standards? Or history's?" [DIAL:0200D9F9]

text_content: Both. {Snarls}Why do you care.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic101 "By your standards? Or history's?" [DIAL:0200D9F9]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You said in the logs yourself that technology's a dead road. These missiles will solve nothing.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic099 "You said in the logs yourself that technology's a dead road. These missiles will solve nothing." [DIAL:0200D9FB]

text_content: Those are my words. After what happened with the Brotherhood... talking with them. |Then with the rulers of the Big Empty. {Beat, rallying}But it is their philosophy that was flawed - their weapons, used with new perspective...|Those weapons can be used to kill a symbol that has already proven itself wrong.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic099 "You said in the logs yourself that technology's a dead road. These missiles will solve nothing." [DIAL:0200D9FB]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: If you believe the destruction of the Divide was just, then I cannot stop you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic098 "If you believe the destruction of the Divide was just, then I cannot stop you." [DIAL:0200D9FC]

text_content: {Anger, "Justice"}Just? {Beat, spits this out}There was no justice in it, it was an act of carelessness, a coward. Killing an idea, before it had a chance...|{Stops, realizing}I see your meaning. You're tying this to {emph}our history... but it is different. The symbol I destroy, it has already proven itself wrong.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic098 "If you believe the destruction of the Divide was just, then I cannot stop you." [DIAL:0200D9FC]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Do you really think these missiles can kill everyone?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic097 "Do you really think these missiles can kill everyone?" [DIAL:0200D9FD]

text_content: Kill them - no. The symbol they follow? Yes, as surely as you did at the Divide.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic097 "Do you really think these missiles can kill everyone?" [DIAL:0200D9FD]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: The question reminded the ones you spoke to of their purpose, why they cared.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic096 "The question reminded the ones you spoke to of their purpose, why they cared." [DIAL:0200D9FE]

text_content: {Cold, appraising}I spoke those words in anger, and I did not expect an answer. All was lost... I thought it was the end.|{Reflective}Past their graves of failed technology, they had cared about the flag they had followed... and the people beneath it. Even with them dead and gone.|{Rallying}But there's no answer in that. I do this because I care, because I believe it must be done.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic096 "The question reminded the ones you spoke to of their purpose, why they cared." [DIAL:0200D9FE]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You were trapped, needed to escape, and needed the distraction. It was the key.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic095 "You were trapped, needed to escape, and needed the distraction. It was the key." [DIAL:0200D9FF]

text_content: I never sought to escape. I went to them to get an answer or die.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic095 "You were trapped, needed to escape, and needed the distraction. It was the key." [DIAL:0200D9FF]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: It was all you could say to prevent from being killed. That's what I'm hoping for here.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic091 "It was all you could say to prevent from being killed. That's what I'm hoping for here." [DIAL:0200DA00]

text_content: When I asked that question, death was certain. I wasn't begging for mercy.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic091 "It was all you could say to prevent from being killed. That's what I'm hoping for here." [DIAL:0200DA00]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: When all seemed lost, you asked it even though you feared the answer.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic081 "When all seemed lost, you asked it even though you feared the answer." [DIAL:0200DA01]

text_content: Fear? No. Anger.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic081 "When all seemed lost, you asked it even though you feared the answer." [DIAL:0200DA01]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: {Derisive, player failed}If you've heard my words and that's all you've taken from them, then I was right to cast them aside.|{Disgust}If you ever had any ability to hear anything beyond your own footsteps... the Divide silenced it. Now, its voice will end you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic081 "When all seemed lost, you asked it even though you feared the answer." [DIAL:0200DA01]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: In the logs of the White Legs, you mentioned your tribe, and its past.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic067 "In the logs of the White Legs, you mentioned your tribe, and its past." [DIAL:0200DA04]

text_content: My tribe? That log... {disgusted at White Legs}no, it concerned the White Legs, training them to kill. For Caesar.|There is no meaning there beyond the road to New Canaan. The history of the murder of its people. And Caesar's past.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic067 "In the logs of the White Legs, you mentioned your tribe, and its past." [DIAL:0200DA04]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: "Who are you, who do not know your history?"
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic011 """Who are you, who do not know your history?""" [DIAL:0200DA05]

text_content: {Surprised}That question... {Beat, chewing it over}either you walked the Big Empty... {beat, nods}you found the last of the holotapes.|{Cold, not sure where the player is going with this}The words are mine. Whatever... "answer" you think they hold, you're wrong. It was a question, nothing more.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic011 """Who are you, who do not know your history?""" [DIAL:0200DA05]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I'll let your words answer it, from the tapes you left along the road to the Divide.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic010 "I'll let your words answer it, from the tapes you left along the road to the Divide." [DIAL:0200DA06]

text_content: {Slow, surprise}My words? {Beat, contempt}And what do {emph}my words teach you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic010 "I'll let your words answer it, from the tapes you left along the road to the Divide." [DIAL:0200DA06]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: < Topic Storage: Player mentions holotapes at end. Do not translate. >
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic003 "< Topic Storage: Player mentions holotapes at end. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200DA07]

text_content: < Placeholder Node. Do Not Translate.>
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic003 "< Topic Storage: Player mentions holotapes at end. Do not translate. >" [DIAL:0200DA07]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I still don't understand - why are you doing this?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic001 "I still don't understand - why are you doing this?" [DIAL:0200DA25]

text_content: {Cold}You've answered your own question. And you'll die with that question on your lips.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic001 "I still don't understand - why are you doing this?" [DIAL:0200DA25]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I believe destroying the symbol is never the answer. Changing it - that's something else.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic022 "I believe destroying the symbol is never the answer. Changing it - that's something else." [DIAL:0200DA27]

text_content: {Chewing it over, slight hope here}It may be... that as much destruction has been written in the earth here...|One buried this place, yet it lived on between us. One may build it again - build others. Your history has proven this, here.|There is truth in your words. But even if there is hope in change... it may not matter. The Divide still stands against us.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic022 "I believe destroying the symbol is never the answer. Changing it - that's something else." [DIAL:0200DA27]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: If you meant to kill me, you should have done it long ago.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic019 "If you meant to kill me, you should have done it long ago." [DIAL:0200DA28]

text_content: I believed in what I followed then. Kill no Courier, Caesar's words. I honored them.|Other Couriers could have been Legion - like me. Now, our allegiances are reversed.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic019 "If you meant to kill me, you should have done it long ago." [DIAL:0200DA28]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Not if you believe in what you follow. Kill no Courier, Caesar's words. I honored them.|Other Couriers could have been Legion - like me. The truth is, you serve nothing, believe nothing. Killing you... meaningless.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic019 "If you meant to kill me, you should have done it long ago." [DIAL:0200DA28]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I want you to die knowing you're wrong, and that's what history will remember.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic125 "I want you to die knowing you're wrong, and that's what history will remember." [DIAL:0200DA2C]

text_content: {Cold}We fight over how we will be remembered, then.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic125 "I want you to die knowing you're wrong, and that's what history will remember." [DIAL:0200DA2C]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: No danger there. You skipped past where you build the community, moved onto killing one.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic124 "No danger there. You skipped past where you build the community, moved onto killing one." [DIAL:0200DA2D]

text_content: {DUPE}Nothing can prevent what comes. The missiles will launch. {Beat}These questions - your words, or mine - what do they matter to you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic124 "No danger there. You skipped past where you build the community, moved onto killing one." [DIAL:0200DA2D]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Don't even suggest we're equals. You couldn't have done this without me bringing you what you need.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic123 "Don't even suggest we're equals. You couldn't have done this without me bringing you what you need." [DIAL:0200DA2E]

text_content: {Sneers, anger, player's getting to him}You were tricked. Still, you take pride in it.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic123 "Don't even suggest we're equals. You couldn't have done this without me bringing you what you need." [DIAL:0200DA2E]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Then stop this, you can't truly believe what you're doing.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic122 "Then stop this, you can't truly believe what you're doing." [DIAL:0200DA2F]

text_content: Look, just the fact we're talking should mean you don't want to do this.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic121 "Look, just the fact we're talking should mean you don't want to do this." [DIAL:0200DA30]

text_content: No. You are wrong. Words will not bridge this.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic121 "Look, just the fact we're talking should mean you don't want to do this." [DIAL:0200DA30]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: The Divide survived in you. If it felt like something fighting for, you can rebuild it.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic120 "The Divide survived in you. If it felt like something fighting for, you can rebuild it." [DIAL:0200DA31]

text_content: {DUPE}Nothing can prevent what comes. The missiles will launch. {Beat}These questions - your words, or mine - what do they matter to you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic120 "The Divide survived in you. If it felt like something fighting for, you can rebuild it." [DIAL:0200DA31]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: All you are is some echo of me, following my road, letting my history dictate yours.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic118 "All you are is some echo of me, following my road, letting my history dictate yours." [DIAL:0200DA32]

text_content: Moral ground? What I did by accident, you're doing with purpose.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic117 "Moral ground? What I did by accident, you're doing with purpose." [DIAL:0200DA33]

text_content: You're planning to kill a nation from a distance, just like NCR - just like you accused me of.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic116 "You're planning to kill a nation from a distance, just like NCR - just like you accused me of." [DIAL:0200DA34]

text_content: {Frowns}What do I care for your perspective. You walk blindly, foolishly into death, your own and others.|You do not rule my actions, and do not mistake my acts for yours.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic116 "You're planning to kill a nation from a distance, just like NCR - just like you accused me of." [DIAL:0200DA34]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: If one Courier built a community, seems to me you can do the same.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic115 "If one Courier built a community, seems to me you can do the same." [DIAL:0200DA35]

text_content: You said a home is a place you breathe life into, a moment where you know who you are.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic100 "You said a home is a place you breathe life into, a moment where you know who you are." [DIAL:0200DA36]

text_content: {Weighing the player's words}There is truth in that. History has proven it.|{Frowns, player's throwing words back at him}But Mojave's proof that no homeland is sacred... until the larger symbols are destroyed.|Whatever is built, the Bear, Bull... even Vegas... will tear it apart, convert it, either with purpose, or by accident.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic100 "You said a home is a place you breathe life into, a moment where you know who you are." [DIAL:0200DA36]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: "You can go home again, Courier." Not a message for me, for you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic076 """You can go home again, Courier."" Not a message for me, for you." [DIAL:0200DA37]

text_content: {Cold}My home in the East, Dry Wells, is no more. It is part of the Legion. |The only other home... the chance of a home... was what you built at the Divide. Then you destroyed it.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic076 """You can go home again, Courier."" Not a message for me, for you." [DIAL:0200DA37]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Nothing more to say, I've already won. Everything you hate about me, you've become.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic070 "Nothing more to say, I've already won. Everything you hate about me, you've become." [DIAL:0200DA38]

text_content: {Frowns}If you seek to anger me, words won't be enough. Your moral ground is weak here in the Divide.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic070 "Nothing more to say, I've already won. Everything you hate about me, you've become." [DIAL:0200DA38]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I don't have anything beyond words to change your mind. If you won't listen, it's over.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic068 "I don't have anything beyond words to change your mind. If you won't listen, it's over." [DIAL:0200DA39]

text_content: I don't think that's what's important here.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic023 "I don't think that's what's important here." [DIAL:0200DA3A]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Slight confusion}Our history... {frowns}the Divide. That history has been written, its lessons learned.|There is nothing more to be dug from these cracks in the earth, no more fury to be torn from its sky.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic023 "I don't think that's what's important here." [DIAL:0200DA3A]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [FAILED] If those are your last words, they are weak ones. Actions would have had more voice.|There is nothing more to be said between us. No words of yours will change what is about to happen.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic023 "I don't think that's what's important here." [DIAL:0200DA3A]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: The symbol you wear is dead, and you helped kill it. The question is - what will you do to fix it?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic132 "The symbol you wear is dead, and you helped kill it. The question is - what will you do to fix it?" [DIAL:0200DA46]

text_content: I believe the missiles can't be stopped. If you believe me, though, we might get through this.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic131 "I believe the missiles can't be stopped. If you believe me, though, we might get through this." [DIAL:0200DA47]

text_content: If we must survive to carry its message... then that is what shall be done. I will not let America die here.|But... it may not matter. Even if we lay down our weapons, the Divide... it still stands against us.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic131 "I believe the missiles can't be stopped. If you believe me, though, we might get through this." [DIAL:0200DA47]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: You interrupted its journey West, trapped it. If any part of America survived, it's cut off now.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic130 "You interrupted its journey West, trapped it. If any part of America survived, it's cut off now." [DIAL:0200DA48]

text_content: The package I brought was from Navarro, the Divide scanned ED-E's logs from the Mojave.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic129 "The package I brought was from Navarro, the Divide scanned ED-E's logs from the Mojave." [DIAL:0200DA49]

text_content: {Angry}What do you seek to gain by telling me this. If you think that the symbol I wear is a weakness...
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic129 "The package I brought was from Navarro, the Divide scanned ED-E's logs from the Mojave." [DIAL:0200DA49]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: The Eyebot was a courier, sent to the West, to make contact with the remnants of America.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic128 "The Eyebot was a courier, sent to the West, to make contact with the remnants of America." [DIAL:0200DA4A]

text_content: Its logs tell of a place where America survived... may still exist. And it's falling apart.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic127 "Its logs tell of a place where America survived... may still exist. And it's falling apart." [DIAL:0200DA4B]

text_content: {Frowns, suspicious}You lie. There was only one message in the machine, only one message in the package you brought.|The Divide bore the symbol of America... as did the package from Navarro. The origins of the machine is... of no importance.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic127 "Its logs tell of a place where America survived... may still exist. And it's falling apart." [DIAL:0200DA4B]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: It has history inside it. The logs of what's left of "America."
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic126 "It has history inside it. The logs of what's left of ""America.""" [DIAL:0200DA4C]

text_content: {Slight anger, what is this nonsense}There is nothing inside the machine except the means to awaken the missiles in the Divide. {Emph}That is its only message.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic126 "It has history inside it. The logs of what's left of ""America.""" [DIAL:0200DA4C]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: If my words won't change your mind, what about the messages in the Eyebot?
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic119 "If my words won't change your mind, what about the messages in the Eyebot?" [DIAL:0200DA4D]

text_content: The machine made from the parts of Navarro? It had only one message in its core - to get home, at any cost.|It echoes its master... and soon the missiles here will as well.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic119 "If my words won't change your mind, what about the messages in the Eyebot?" [DIAL:0200DA4D]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: At least I don't hide behind a machine like a coward.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic175 "At least I don't hide behind a machine like a coward." [DIAL:0200DA53]

text_content: Machines... bombs, things of NCR, are your tools, not mine. When we meet, this machine won't keep me from you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic175 "At least I don't hide behind a machine like a coward." [DIAL:0200DA53]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Keep talking like that, I'll see you dead.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic174 "Keep talking like that, I'll see you dead." [DIAL:0200DA54]

text_content: You already tried once, won't give you another chance.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic174 "Keep talking like that, I'll see you dead." [DIAL:0200DA54]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Sounds like the idea of a woman in the Legion surprises you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic160 "Sounds like the idea of a woman in the Legion surprises you." [DIAL:0200DA55]

text_content: You said "brothers" before. So - you're Legion, too.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic156 "You said ""brothers"" before. So - you're Legion, too." [DIAL:0200DA56]

text_content: You mentioned "casting off my disguise?" What do you mean?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic153 "You mentioned ""casting off my disguise?"" What do you mean?" [DIAL:0200DA57]

text_content: I'm no traitor, and when I walk, I don't hide my presence.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic143 "I'm no traitor, and when I walk, I don't hide my presence." [DIAL:0200DA58]

text_content: Legion wears many colors, East and West. You... maybe blinded by Vegas's light, or the promise of that Chip. |Or maybe you walked so far West, the Bear's sickness crept into you. We'll see. Your offenses before Caesar, the least of the crimes here.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic143 "I'm no traitor, and when I walk, I don't hide my presence." [DIAL:0200DA58]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [Legion] You said you'd sworn not to kill me. If you're Legion, why are we at odds?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic177 "[Legion] You said you'd sworn not to kill me. If you're Legion, why are we at odds?" [DIAL:0200DA5C]

text_content: {Frowns, slight testing}You struck first. Not just at me... at the Legion. Or so I thought. Not sure of the history of it now.|Whatever flag you follow, or followed then... either way, you got too much of the Bear's sickness in you to live. Divide's proof of that.|Want more than that, walk the road. Answers'll come, closer you get to home... you and that machine.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic177 "[Legion] You said you'd sworn not to kill me. If you're Legion, why are we at odds?" [DIAL:0200DA5C]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [Legion] Legion doesn't kill Legion. Caesar's orders?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic176 "[Legion] Legion doesn't kill Legion. Caesar's orders?" [DIAL:0200DA5D]

text_content: {DUPE}{Smile/sneer}What kind of world would this be if Courier killed Courier.{No sound file}|{DUPE}You've got enough distance ahead of you - save your breath for the road, don't waste it on words.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic176 "[Legion] Legion doesn't kill Legion. Caesar's orders?" [DIAL:0200DA5D]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [Legion] Legion does not kill Legion - but you're not that anymore. I'm going to kill you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic182 "[Legion] Legion does not kill Legion - but you're not that anymore. I'm going to kill you." [DIAL:0200DA60]

text_content: If that's all that drives you, it won't last. The Legion... it won't last either.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic182 "[Legion] Legion does not kill Legion - but you're not that anymore. I'm going to kill you." [DIAL:0200DA60]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [Legion] So... when you called me traitor in Hopeville, that title belongs to you.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic181 "[Legion] So... when you called me traitor in Hopeville, that title belongs to you." [DIAL:0200DA61]

text_content: {Angry}No, it is a title {emph}you earned. Legion or not, you have betrayed more than you know.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic181 "[Legion] So... when you called me traitor in Hopeville, that title belongs to you." [DIAL:0200DA61]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [Legion] Seeing this place. It meant more to you than the Legion?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic180 "[Legion] Seeing this place. It meant more to you than the Legion?" [DIAL:0200DA62]

text_content: Yes. And it did to you once, I'm sure of it.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic180 "[Legion] Seeing this place. It meant more to you than the Legion?" [DIAL:0200DA62]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [Legion] Are you angry that this explosion undermined the Legion's plans? It was an accident.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic179 "[Legion] Are you angry that this explosion undermined the Legion's plans? It was an accident." [DIAL:0200DA63]

text_content: {DUPE}{Anger}Accident? Ignorance is a {emph}choice. The Chip - a choice.|{DUPE}{More to himself}As for anger... it is what I carry for the dead, and all that come here.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic179 "[Legion] Are you angry that this explosion undermined the Legion's plans? It was an accident." [DIAL:0200DA63]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: [Legion] If I destroyed the NCR in this place, why do you care?
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic178 "[Legion] If I destroyed the NCR in this place, why do you care?" [DIAL:0200DA64]

text_content: {Emph}Legion died here as well. {Beat, but...}What you did... that's not {emph}all that cuts at me.
name: NVDLC04DialogueEDENVDLC04UlyssesTopic178 "[Legion] If I destroyed the NCR in this place, why do you care?" [DIAL:0200DA64]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: Is this how it must end between us? You followed the East once, you can do so again.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic027 "Is this how it must end between us? You followed the East once, you can do so again." [DIAL:0200DA6B]

text_content: I cannot go back. I wandered too far, far enough to know my home was lost to me.|{Resigned, a little sad}I could no more go back than you could return to the West. {Disgust}To NCR, and all its sickness.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic027 "Is this how it must end between us? You followed the East once, you can do so again." [DIAL:0200DA6B]
speaker: NVDLC04Ulysses "Ulysses" [NPC_:02003E40]

text_content: I don't care what happens to NCR, but I can't allow you to harm the Legion.
name: NVDLC04DialogueUlyssesNVDLC04UlyssesTopic026 "I don't care what happens to NCR, but I can't allow you to harm the Legion." [DIAL:0200DA6C]

text_content: Not all the East will burn. The Legion does not need to be destroyed, only... contained within new borders.|After that, it will fall as any culture bred on war, on forward momentum. It will falter, collapse.|I will start with their camp at Dry Wells... once my homeland. Justice of a sort.

If what Ulysses said is true, you'll need this to advance, which means there must be a warhead blocking the way forward. You'll need to find the correct warhead and detonate it.

The coordinates you received lead you to this canyon filled with storm-tossed wreckage. Beyond lies the Divide.

Lonesome Road is intended for experienced Couriers (Level 25 or higher). You cannot take companions with you on the road ahead (nor bring any you find out with you). You can carry whatever equipment and gear you have with you without restriction, however.

If the journey proves too difficult, or you need to resupply, you can retrace your steps and return to the Mojave at any time. If you are prepared, then continue on into the storms of the Divide... history awaits.

text_content:
While setting up the radios to monitor Dome and robots, thought I saw glint (scope?) from the building on other side of compound. 

Should check it out, make sure I'm not being watched... might be that Courier? 

Still, he would have come straight up rather than hiding. Instinct says it's someone else.
name: Journal Entry - Day 4 - Addendum

text_content:
Day 4, still continuing research... found way to deactivate collar after some failures, just a few headless ghouls. It's been hard to go fishing in the camp without one of them trying to run the gate and their heads exploding. Damn collars, twitchy.

...need to ration the Mentats, giving me migraines.
name: Journal Entry - Day 4

text_content: No sign of that Courier from before. He stays out of my way, I'll stay out of his. Been thinking about that "Sierra Madre" he mentioned... if he's right, I'd just need to find the casino radio frequency to track it down. Wouldn't need his help. If the working holograms and toxic gas are preserved there, might be easier to study them there with no robots to interfere. And those dispensers... might have use for those as well.
name: Journal Entry - Day 3

text_content: 2nd day at Pre-War concentration camp. Kept China citizens here before war. Radiation turned them, had to keep them in camp with collars (explains why some of these "slave collars" exist, always wondered, some were clearly Pre-War tech). Researching the collar frequencies, touchy - circuit architecture is messy, de-constructing them taking time. Must be careful, can't be spotted by local robots, or insane brains from the Dome will try to haul me back there, then... research me.
name: Journal Entry - Day 2

text_content: Some issues still remain to be ironed out before the Y-17 Trauma Harness is ready for general production: calibrating the proper amount of injury to trigger the suit remains problematic. Still, the Little Yangtze subjects could hardly protest once inside the harness. If a home base is not designated, the suit enters an unpredictable wander state. And, as we discovered while calibrating injury levels, the suit's sensors are unable to recognize when the wearer is dead - luckily, autonomous corpse retrieval is nearly as useful as autonomous casualty recovery!
name: Y-17 Trauma Harness Action Items

text_content: With my dying breath, I write that I hate the VR Simulation so much! It has killed us. Now, I will kill it.
