text_content: Another escape attempt last night. We rounded them all up and processed the escapees, but these little bastards are determined. We've got triple shifts on the camp around the clock, and the extra hours are eating up morale. Commandant says he's put in a requisition to use the camp as a field test for the new "total pacification collars" the scientists have been working on. Maybe then I can get some goddamn sleep.
name: Little Yangtze Log #03

text_content: One of the prisoners who speaks a little English - I guess he's become the unofficial spokesman - came to the commandant's office today screaming about hungry ghosts snatching his people up in the night. The commandant told him to give up the ignorant superstitions of a bygone era and had him thrown in the cooler for three weeks. Me, I've seen some of the new robots they're developing here, and I gotta wonder where they get the brains from.
name: Little Yangtze Log #02

text_content: The government shipped in the first batch of dissidents today. Three whole trainloads of Communist infiltrators. Half of them don't even speak English, so we had to show them where to go with our nightsticks. They got the point eventually. The docs are already talking about "research subjects." Guess that'll help advance the war effort.
name: Little Yangtze Log #01

text_content:
The Y-17 Trauma Harness has succeeded beyond our wildest expectations! The test harnesses were able to take over the motor functions of an injured subject and "walk" them back to home base.

We'll have to see what develops once it's recorded enough neuro-auto-muscular movements to display a wider range of behaviors... to think, if they could be programmed to replicate a wearer's shooting or fighting reflexes, we'd have something truly amazing for the war effort!
name: Y-17 Trauma Harness Testing Results

text_content:
We've had another unfortunate occurrence. While attempting to destroy Mr. Harris's Trauma Harness, the disaster control team member carrying the gun slipped and fell, dropping the weapon. Unarmed, the team had to flee and seal off the lab. Unfortunately, your K9000 Cyberdog Gun Prototype was sealed inside X-12.

-Barb
name: K9000 Cyberdog Gun Sealed in X-12

text_content:
I'm sending over the K9000 Cyberdog Gun. It should do the trick. Let me know if you have any operational questions.

-Adam
name: Assistance Granted

text_content: If it wasn't for Sinclair's request, this hologram project would've been canned long ago. In addition to the dispenser tech he wants for the Sierra Madre, he spoke to the Big MT execs about using the holograms for defense (?), that's something N.E. would have to sign off on; I can't even imagine the cost to turn the holograms into something beyond walking cameras and greeters. And why would you? It's only been a little while, and I already hate spending my time with these ghosts walking around the plant. Rather see the research money spent on actually improving the field of view sensors or adding upgrades to the emitters.
name: Requisition Order: Holograms

text_content:
Spending a lot of hours getting the Vera Keyes hologram looking right. I'm a physicist, not a sculptor - iterating on her facial features and her dress to match Sinclair's expectations... it's about enough to make me file a complaint. I don't get the sense Sinclair's doing this out of love or well, lust.

Somewhere along the line, he became cold about the whole matter, as if crafting the hologram "just right" was something he hated.
name: Vera Keyes: Hologram Progress Report

text_content: We finished up the design for the dispensers for the Sierra Madre villa as requested. That big-wig Sinclair went to the Big MT execs; he wanted emergency dispensers for his sheltered Villa in case war broke out and they needed to care for the survivors there. He's done everything he can to isolate the community and tighten security, now he just needs to guarantee a food supply and be able to ration out resources in the event of nuclear holocaust. I hear he even narrowed the streets so cars couldn't come inside town, let alone come up to the Villa.
name: Requisition Order: Dispensers

text_content: Got the funding from Sinclair. Near as I can tell, he's willing to not only bankrupt himself for these devices, he's struck a deal with the Big MT executives, letting the Villa become a lab for the supposedly-harmless prototype tech here. I've seen the Big MT execs do this with other isolated towns (Hopeville Meteorological research up north), and the whole process, it's not what I signed up for.
name: Dispenser Funding Update

text_content: I heard one of the execs mention that whether Sinclair knew it or not, the Sierra Madre would be a "test case" for the Auto-Doc and the Innovative Toxins research. Maybe they were joking, but even that kind of a joke sends a chill down my spine... if I got poisoned by one of those toxins, no way would I crawl inside one of the Y-17 Auto-Docs here if my life depended on it. The medical tech for those trauma suits alone makes me wish they'd erase their research - the suits do more thinking than the people inside them.
name: Sierra Madre: Test Case?

text_content: Got word today there was a chemical leak at the Sierra Madre, Sinclair was on the phone to ask for more help from the Think Tank Execs, so they're sending him the prototype chemical suits to protect the Villa workers. Looks like they're following up an experiment with another experiment? The whole process creeps me out, and the way they're monitoring the Sierra Madre Villa and examining the "results" - I don't think Sinclair even knows what he's really paid for. To be guineas like the Little Yangtze Chinese... maybe it'd be merciful if war did break out, put an end to this chain of horrors.
name: Requisition Order: Chemical Suits

text_content: Set up camp here after Yangtze attack. Too exposed here. Transmitter's vulnerable, hacked it, set up remote link so can access it any time. Need to find spot closer to north train tunnel with clear broadcast LOS to here. Canyons are too dangerous, can't go back to Yangtze - there is that weather station NW that drew that Courier here, but going there sounds like trouble. For now, going to scout the Waste Disposal site, then around the perimeter of that Securitron Plant, see if I can find a more defensible position.
name: Torn Journal Page

text_content:
This camp's better than the one I set up on top of Signal Hills roof, clear broadcast line to its radio tower and good vantage point on North Tunnel. Set up a turret perimeter and transmitter, should be able to control the trains via remote to escape before any robots come. The broken Securitrons make a good defense line, apparently brains in center Dome can't control them like they do the others.

No sign of Courier - or that woman. Turns out I was right at the Yangtze Camp, I was being watched there, probably Brotherhood assassin out to "sentence" me. She got hers, though. After the robot attack, saw her get hauled away to the SE by medical robots... probably joined the Lobotomite ranks here, don't have to worry about her anymore.
name: Elijah's Watch Journal

text_content:
The VR Sim is corrupted?! Dammit! Sounds like there's a bug in the software somewhere. I hope to God it doesn't screw with the suit's systems. I just got the firmware updated for Mori over the weekend. For now, let's just tell Calis we're having "power issues" and focus on the REPCONN tests until we get the suit ready for real-world tests.

-Kael
p.s. Delete this message ASAP. I don't want Calis harassing me over this.
name: FW: RE: VR Test

text_content:
Kudos for the bean pod addition for the VR Sim. I like the Jack and the Beanstalk reference, buddy! I hope Calis doesn't throw a fit. Watch your back with that guy. He's always been more than a bit wound up about simple stuff. I had to move my Battle Brew setup over to X-12's storage room after he threw a prohibitionist fit about it to the Leads.

-Mori
name: VR Test Kudos

text_content:
Attached to this message is the data I collected regarding the EM Pulse Wave Module's effect on our force field emitters. I'm sending the prototype weapon your way for testing. Please forward this on to Ohlen as soon as you can determine how we might shield our emitters from this weapon's EMP effect.

-Dr. Calis
name: Sonic Emitter Data

text_content:
We've had a small issue with one of our Y-17 Trauma Harnesses. Sadly, a member of the X-12 research team choked on a buffalo gourd seed and died while working late last night. For some reason his Y-17 Trauma Harness will not shutdown. In fact, it has begun malfunctioning and causing the late Mr. Harris to attack other employees. Do you have any prototypes you could lend us as a means to stop it?

-Barb

text_content: Per instructions from the higher ups after that *one* time the Giant Robo-Scorpion's attack routine malfunctioned, we've installed an emergency shutdown procedure. Let's hope we never have to use it - the prototype's systems will all be fried, and we won't be up and running again for weeks. The military's expecting delivery of a battle-ready model within six months, and the project has already had enough delays.

The new atomic laser is putting an incredible strain on the Giant Robo-Scorpion's generator - damn thing shut down right in the middle of weapons testing last week.

I pushed for reducing the laser's output by 25%, instead they slapped a backup generator onto the Scorpion. Dangerous, if you ask me. The systems weren't designed to handle the power from two systems at once, and if some rookie tech fires up the backup generator too early, well...
Unlock Code: 646F6E7470616E6963

Mori says some new firmware updates fixed the suit's fitment sync ability, but I'm not so sure. The legs kept binding up on me and the torso was ridiculously tight. Maybe I should stop lifting Fancy Lads from Slough's stashes.

text_content: I've been watching Mendoza stumble through the various X-13 tests and noticed a critical flaw in the tripwire emitter design. A skilled scientist or someone with advanced electronics repair knowledge could crack the casings and hack their IFF circuit to ignore the current test subject. I'll see if I can reinforce the casings after the leads visit the facility this week.
name: Independent Research

text_content: Researcher Kael's breakthrough with the Suit's software has led me to a breakthrough of my own. By adding an advanced servo buffer to the existing leg rigs, I've been able to increase the resolution of data sent to and from the central control module. Once these babies are hooked up to the torso, an agent should be able to limbo under barriers almost as fast as they can run!
name: Mk II Boot Research

text_content: I've been working with Mori on fitting the gloves to the torso and come up with a few improvements which should greatly enhance the user's manual dexterity. I adapted Redding's new rubberized dampening compound and applied it to the palms and other high-wear surfaces. Once the suit adjusts to the user, the benefits of these upgrades should be obvious.
name: Mk II Glove Research

text_content:
I've uploaded Kael's latest firmware update to the suit. I think Kael has outdone herself this time. Self-updating firmware is an ingenious addition to this system. As we upgrade the suit, it'll automatically adapt the new systems to the user's specifications during testing and unlock the features as they come online. This will save hundreds of hours of fiddling with settings.

Note to self - Make Kael a keg of my infamous 'Battle Brew.'
name: Mk II Torso Research

text_content:
What the hell is his damn problem?! All I was doing was reading the latest issue of La Fantoma!, and that grouch, Calis, called me an asshat. What the hell is an asshat, anyway? Funny, ha ha, my last name is Butz. That got old in grade school, the snobby bastard. Sorry, just needed to vent.

-Butz
name: What the hell...?!

text_content:
This is the last time I'm going to warn you, Butz. I can see that comic book poking up out of your field manual. You don't fool me, asshat. Next time I catch you slacking, I'm writing a disciplinary notice and you can spend your free time polishing emitter arrays.

-Dr. Calis
name: Get off your butt, Butz!

text_content:
Hey buddy! I've been helping the guys over in X-8 test out this new toy they've been building. Get this, it's a gun that uses a dog's brain to track targets! They asked me to play around with their gun trigger code, and I came up with this mod. Next time you're over there, would you give it a shot? Calis has me swamped setting X-13 up for the coming visit by the leads and he wants the turrets in place so we don't fail the new security requirements.

Thanks!
name: Check out this mod I've been working on!

text_content:
Everything is under control down here. If I need your assistance, I'll let you know. Paris will be along shortly to retrieve the shipment.

-Dr. Calis
name: RE: X-13 Shipment Notice

text_content:
Your shipment of cattle prods arrived today. I'd like to remind you our systems are designed to prevent infiltration by enemy agents, not internal threats. If you're doing any testing on creatures, please forward that task to the animal testing facility. As you found with the Sonic Emitter, our force fields can't handle power fluctuations well.

-Cpt. Hamm
Base Security
name: X-13 Shipment Notice

text_content:
I've noticed your work has taken a dive lately. This seems to have coincided with a marked weight gain over the past few months. I've developed an implant which has been proven to increase performance while reducing weight in lab animals. Granted, we haven't run it through any human test trials yet, but I'm sure it is perfectly safe. Also, please refrain from snacking in the lab. If you smudge another camera, I'm banning all food from the facility.

-Dr. Calis
name: Suggestion.

text_content:
I've noticed some of the creatures have been increasingly aggressive when I come into the lab in the morning. Did something change in their diet? I'll run some tests if you like.

-Asst. Paris
name: Test Subject Observations

text_content:
I went ahead and did the lab test and noticed no appreciable changes in their blood work. I'm concerned our use of the cattle prods may react with the chemistry of the injections. This is new ground we're treading. I'd hate to see your hard work lost to a change in brain chemistry. These critters could be invaluable to the war effort if we can somehow control their behavior.

-Asst. Paris
name: Test Subject Observations

text_content:
Why the hell do you keep sending me these messages? You work right across the damn ramp from me. Walk your ass over here and say what you need to say. Stop wasting my time with these incessant messages!

-Dr. Calis
name: RE: RE: RE: Test Subject Observations

text_content: While Slough is busy stuffing his face and trying to find new places to hide his junk food from Calis, I've decided to experiment with a mod from one of the techs over in X-8. I may not have been able to afford a doctorate like those eggheads upstairs, but I've been programming since I was in diapers. I found a ton of redundancies and exponential loop failures those halfwits must have missed. My fixes should speed up the refire rate of that K9 weapon they've been working on. Maybe if I leave it on one of their desks it'll actually get implemented. Lord knows they wouldn't take me seriously if I tried to take credit.
name: Independent Research

text_content:
Yes, yes. Run the tests, if it'll keep you out of my way. I'm going back down to the cages to see if a nudge from a prod will trigger their abilities. The other project leads will be stopping by in a few days and we must be able to show them progress!

-Dr. Calis
name: Test Subject Observations

Perhaps there is a physical limitation or some mental drawback to the ability, which prevents its usage under duress. I think I will pursue stress testing of the animals first thing Monday morning.

name: Target Drone Effectiveness

text_content:
The Saturnite armor plating on the Giant Robo-Scorpion has exceeded expectations - mostly. While it's virtually impervious to small arms fire, the Sonic Emitter that Parsons brought in managed to fry several of the prototype's subsystems. We'll have to look into improved EMP shielding for the next prototype.

On a more positive note, the prototype's new atomic laser is performing admirably. Some residual radiation is left behind after the weapon discharges, it may be necessary to requisition more radiation suits and meds as a precaution.

No, none of senior staff uses the bodies for anything else. Finally, in regards to the rumor that Project: Hare engages in liquidation operations against non-military targets to procure research subjects, I will not dignify them with a response. Any other questions?

Dr. Adam Figgis, MD PhD DVM DDM DD, Test Supervisor

The X-13 Facility has loaned us their EM Pulse Wave Module prototype for the Sonic Emitter for use in our Data Retrieval Test simulations. The Module allows the Sonic Emitter to disable certain force fields. DO NOT allow test subjects to leave the X-8 facility with this Module! Even though it won't work outside Big MT, it's a security nightmare. Thank you all for your attention in this matter.

Dr. Adam Figgis, MD PhD DVM DDM DD, Test Supervisor

text_content:
In light of the large number of fatalities due to the latest shipment of experimental test subjects, the shipping department is going into lockdown. I give you my personal assurance that as soon as this plague of monsters has been dealt with, I will work overtime to get your deliveries to you in a timely and efficient manner. As I am currently the only surviving member of the shipping department, however, there may still be some delays. Until then, Dr. Calis in X-13 has the passcard for the area.

Skippy, Sole Survivor
name: Shipping Department in Lockdown

text_content:
So, at Dr. Richardson's request, we opened one of those kennels from our latest shipment. The "dog" inside (and I use that term very loosely) appeared to be suffering from a truly horrendous case of mange, and upon being released it immediately attacked, killed, and attempted to swallow whole Specialist Akers. Luckily, the situation has, for now at least, contained itself, as SPC Akers was a very large man and the creature has choked to death.

Does anyone know anything about this shipment? Please Advise.
name: Re: Please Advise

text_content:
In this test, YOU will take on the role of one of those evil Commies, infiltrating an institution of HONEST AMERICAN LEARNING. (Don't worry, Citizen, it's just for pretend!) Your objective is to steal documents that a REAL dirty Commie traitor (which you're not) could use to BRAINWASH OUR CHILDREN (which you wouldn't do). This test will help us to protect our children's fragile minds from the agents of INTERNATIONAL COMMUNISM! Agents like YOU!

Just kidding! We know you're a loyal American! AREN'T YOU?
name: X-8 Test Subject Information

text_content:
Dr. Richardson,

We've just received the latest shipment of dogs for the Cyberdog experiment process, but... well, frankly, I think our supplier screwed us. The animals must be basically feral - every time we get close to the shipping kennels they let out with the most Godawful hissing and... well, rattling is the only way I can describe it. Please advise - should we open the kennels or just send them back?
name: Please Advise

text_content:
Until further notice, please do not enter the Residential Cyberdog Test area, or conduct any experiments using it. The Cyberdogs are still being programmed, and any disturbance could have dramatic influence on their progress. Restricting access in this fashion should also help to avoid any repeats of Incident: PLAYTIME, settlements for which are coming directly out of our budget.

Dr. Gail Richardson, PhD, Test Engineer, X-8 Cyberdog Project

text_content: No one told me the target had bomb things!
name: AvoidThreat "AvoidThreat" [DIAL:000000ED]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Explosives? Are you serious?
name: AvoidThreat "AvoidThreat" [DIAL:000000ED]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Better get a nuke if you want to hurt my pet.
name: AvoidThreat "AvoidThreat" [DIAL:000000ED]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: StartCombat
name: NormalToCombat "StartCombat" [DIAL:000000EE]

text_content: FIGHT!
name: NormalToCombat "StartCombat" [DIAL:000000EE]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: *Blast it with our brainial beams already!*
name: NormalToCombat "StartCombat" [DIAL:000000EE]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: Firing brainial beams and my spectral array of dissection lasers.
name: NormalToCombat "StartCombat" [DIAL:000000EE]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: Tail locking on!
name: NormalToCombat "StartCombat" [DIAL:000000EE]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Prepare to be attacked by Dr. Mobius!
name: NormalToCombat "StartCombat" [DIAL:000000EE]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Death
name: Death "Death" [DIAL:000000EF]

text_content: <Large number of bones shattering>
name: Death "Death" [DIAL:000000EF]
speaker: NVDLC03CorpseSuitLvl [NPC_:0300CE78]

text_content: <Large number of bones shattering>
name: Death "Death" [DIAL:000000EF]
speaker: NVDLC03CorpseSuitLvl [NPC_:0300CE78]

text_content: <Large number of bones shattering>
name: Death "Death" [DIAL:000000EF]
speaker: NVDLC03CorpseSuitLvl [NPC_:0300CE78]

text_content: {Thinking, slightly introspective}So that's what being killed feels like.
name: Death "Death" [DIAL:000000EF]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {Says this out loud}Burble... Spark... Burble. And... So... I... Die.
name: Death "Death" [DIAL:000000EF]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: I believe I'm dead or dying. No wait - I am dead.
name: Death "Death" [DIAL:000000EF]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: -Borous FALLS! The audience GASPS in TERROR!-
name: Death "Death" [DIAL:000000EF]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: I... I REGRET... NOTHING!
name: Death "Death" [DIAL:000000EF]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: I DID IT ALL FOR... SCIENCE.
name: Death "Death" [DIAL:000000EF]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: *{Dying, gel is running out of body}O... My name... was Dr. Zero... Not O. Zero.*
name: Death "Death" [DIAL:000000EF]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: Nooooooo!
name: Death "Death" [DIAL:000000EF]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: My Robo-Scorpion!
name: Death "Death" [DIAL:000000EF]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Ooooooh, you'll pay for this!
name: Death "Death" [DIAL:000000EF]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: You have GOT to be kidding me.
name: Death "Death" [DIAL:000000EF]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: There is no way this is happening.
name: Death "Death" [DIAL:000000EF]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: My calculations were perfect! There was no other outcome except success!
name: Death "Death" [DIAL:000000EF]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: AlertToCombat
name: AlertToCombat "AlertToCombat" [DIAL:000000F3]

text_content: AIGHH! THERE IT IS! KILL IT!
name: AlertToCombat "AlertToCombat" [DIAL:000000F3]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: LOBOTOMITE! GET THE SPRAY!
name: AlertToCombat "AlertToCombat" [DIAL:000000F3]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: Think you could hide from me? Uh, again?
name: AlertToCombat "AlertToCombat" [DIAL:000000F3]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Eureka!
name: AlertToCombat "AlertToCombat" [DIAL:000000F3]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: The eye of Mobius sees you!
name: AlertToCombat "AlertToCombat" [DIAL:000000F3]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Time for violence.
name: AlertToCombat "AlertToCombat" [DIAL:000000F3]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Ah, there's our victim.
name: AlertToCombat "AlertToCombat" [DIAL:000000F3]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NormalToAlert
name: NormalToAlert "NormalToAlert" [DIAL:000000F4]

text_content: I sense an intruder.
name: NormalToAlert "NormalToAlert" [DIAL:000000F4]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Mobius to Robo-Scorpion: Scan for unconfirmed target.
name: NormalToAlert "NormalToAlert" [DIAL:000000F4]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: If someone's out there, I, Dr. Mobius wish to say hello to you.
name: NormalToAlert "NormalToAlert" [DIAL:000000F4]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Let's be friends, you and I.
name: NormalToAlert "NormalToAlert" [DIAL:000000F4]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Radar-scan successful. Target... acquired.
name: NormalToAlert "NormalToAlert" [DIAL:000000F4]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Corpse-ify the intruder.
name: NormalToAlert "NormalToAlert" [DIAL:000000F4]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: AlertToNormal
name: AlertToNormal "AlertToNormal" [DIAL:000000F5]

text_content: HELLO. I MEAN NO HARM. ANY DEATH I BRING WILL BE SWIFT AND PAINLESS.
name: AlertToNormal "AlertToNormal" [DIAL:000000F5]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: COME OUT. UM. PLEASE.
name: AlertToNormal "AlertToNormal" [DIAL:000000F5]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: :: Whistles, as if trying to get someone to come out of hiding. ::
name: AlertToNormal "AlertToNormal" [DIAL:000000F5]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {DUPE, different filter}:: Whistles, as if trying to get someone to come out of hiding. ::
name: AlertToNormal "AlertToNormal" [DIAL:000000F5]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: CombatToNormal
name: CombatToNormal "CombatToNormal" [DIAL:000000F6]

text_content: Hmph. Not very sporting.
name: CombatToNormal "CombatToNormal" [DIAL:000000F6]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: *Hiding? {To himself}That's what I want to do right now.*
name: CombatToNormal "CombatToNormal" [DIAL:000000F6]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: {Dupe}I believe we misplaced our test subject.
name: CombatToNormal "CombatToNormal" [DIAL:000000F6]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: {Dupe} The Lobotomite is lost!-
name: CombatToNormal "CombatToNormal" [DIAL:000000F6]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: Oh, forget this.
name: CombatToNormal "CombatToNormal" [DIAL:000000F6]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Not going to waste any more energy cells on this.
name: CombatToNormal "CombatToNormal" [DIAL:000000F6]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Let's scuttle off, find something else to sting.
name: CombatToNormal "CombatToNormal" [DIAL:000000F6]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Wait for it to come to you, my pet.
name: CombatToNormal "CombatToNormal" [DIAL:000000F6]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: CombatToLost
name: CombatToLost "CombatToLost" [DIAL:000000F7]

text_content: I CANNOT SEE THE INTRUDER ANYMORE.
name: CombatToLost "CombatToLost" [DIAL:000000F7]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: By Jove's lugnuts, I need to get this monitor fixed.
name: CombatToLost "CombatToLost" [DIAL:000000F7]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: *Don't you watch the old horror vids? There is {emph}no way we killed it. It's here, trust me.*
name: CombatToLost "CombatToLost" [DIAL:000000F7]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: I believe we misplaced our test subject.
name: CombatToLost "CombatToLost" [DIAL:000000F7]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: -The Lobotomite is lost!-
name: CombatToLost "CombatToLost" [DIAL:000000F7]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: Radar-scanning.
name: CombatToLost "CombatToLost" [DIAL:000000F7]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Ping, ping, ping.
name: CombatToLost "CombatToLost" [DIAL:000000F7]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: What do you mean, you lost him? Look harder!
name: CombatToLost "CombatToLost" [DIAL:000000F7]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: It was just here! Scan for it!
name: CombatToLost "CombatToLost" [DIAL:000000F7]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: LostToNormal
name: LostToNormal "LostToNormal" [DIAL:000000F8]

text_content: Cancel the search routine already.
name: LostToNormal "LostToNormal" [DIAL:000000F8]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Divert power from receptors to mobilizers.
name: LostToNormal "LostToNormal" [DIAL:000000F8]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Back to your patrol routine, Robo-Scorpion.
name: LostToNormal "LostToNormal" [DIAL:000000F8]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: LostToCombat
name: LostToCombat "LostToCombat" [DIAL:000000F9]

text_content: Found you!
name: LostToCombat "LostToCombat" [DIAL:000000F9]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Eureka!
name: LostToCombat "LostToCombat" [DIAL:000000F9]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: *O, I found it!*
name: LostToCombat "LostToCombat" [DIAL:000000F9]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: I have discovered the teddy bear's hiding place.
name: LostToCombat "LostToCombat" [DIAL:000000F9]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: -The battle rages on!-
name: LostToCombat "LostToCombat" [DIAL:000000F9]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: {Pleased}Oh, locking on. Good.
name: LostToCombat "LostToCombat" [DIAL:000000F9]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Where the hell did it come from?
name: LostToCombat "LostToCombat" [DIAL:000000F9]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: These intruders are getting frustrating.
name: LostToCombat "LostToCombat" [DIAL:000000F9]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {Smug, evil}Attack routines loading.
name: LostToCombat "LostToCombat" [DIAL:000000F9]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Did you really think you could escape Dr. Mobius?
name: LostToCombat "LostToCombat" [DIAL:000000F9]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: AlertIdle
name: AlertIdle "AlertIdle" [DIAL:00000104]

text_content: I SWEAR, SOMETHING'S WRONG.
name: AlertIdle "AlertIdle" [DIAL:00000104]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: {Introspective}Did I imagine all this? {Beat}Just like the tortoises.
name: AlertIdle "AlertIdle" [DIAL:00000104]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: There is no movement I can detect. Not even a mouse.
name: AlertIdle "AlertIdle" [DIAL:00000104]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: -What lurks in the darkness of the Think Tank?!-
name: AlertIdle "AlertIdle" [DIAL:00000104]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: *What in the biologic fuck was that all about?*
name: AlertIdle "AlertIdle" [DIAL:00000104]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: Hmmm.
name: AlertIdle "AlertIdle" [DIAL:00000104]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: All right, everyone, calm down. Might have been a blip.
name: AlertIdle "AlertIdle" [DIAL:00000104]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Are you sure you scanned something?
name: AlertIdle "AlertIdle" [DIAL:00000104]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: An intruder is here, I'm certain of it.
name: AlertIdle "AlertIdle" [DIAL:00000104]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: LostIdle
name: LostIdle "LostIdle" [DIAL:00000107]

text_content: WHEN I FIND IT, IT'S GOING IN THE SCHR�DINGER BOX.
name: LostIdle "LostIdle" [DIAL:00000107]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: Oh, well. Now I have this adrenaline rush that's going to make me loopy all day.
name: LostIdle "LostIdle" [DIAL:00000107]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: *Guess we can go back to our rooms and lock the doors now, huh?*
name: LostIdle "LostIdle" [DIAL:00000107]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: {Dupe}I believe we misplaced our test subject.
name: LostIdle "LostIdle" [DIAL:00000107]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: {Dupe} The Lobotomite is lost!-
name: LostIdle "LostIdle" [DIAL:00000107]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: {Impatient}STILL scanning.
name: LostIdle "LostIdle" [DIAL:00000107]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {Grumbling}Need to calibrate these Robo-Sensors.
name: LostIdle "LostIdle" [DIAL:00000107]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {Grumbling}Should invest in walking eyes.
name: LostIdle "LostIdle" [DIAL:00000107]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Go back to patrol, you... piece of junk.
name: LostIdle "LostIdle" [DIAL:00000107]

text_content: StartCombatResponse
name: StartCombatResponse "StartCombatResponse" [DIAL:00080D81]

text_content: THINK TANK, FORM OF - TACTIC TRIANGLE!
name: StartCombatResponse "StartCombatResponse" [DIAL:00080D81]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: A challenge!
name: StartCombatResponse "StartCombatResponse" [DIAL:00080D81]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: You dare to cross Dr. Mobius!
name: StartCombatResponse "StartCombatResponse" [DIAL:00080D81]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: I will reduce you to atoms! {Correcting, quieter}I mean, a more chaotic, painful array of atoms.
name: StartCombatResponse "StartCombatResponse" [DIAL:00080D81]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: *{DUPE: Sarcastic}Remember that time I suggested we get bodyguards? Yeah, that woulda been nice, huh?*
name: StartCombatResponse "StartCombatResponse" [DIAL:00080D81]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: Beginning dissection. And vivisection.
name: StartCombatResponse "StartCombatResponse" [DIAL:00080D81]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: -The Lobotomite is no proof against our amazing sensors!-
name: StartCombatResponse "StartCombatResponse" [DIAL:00080D81]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: Attack!
name: StartCombatResponse "StartCombatResponse" [DIAL:00080D81]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: In the name of Dr. Mobius!
name: StartCombatResponse "StartCombatResponse" [DIAL:00080D81]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Destroy the intruder, my minion!
name: StartCombatResponse "StartCombatResponse" [DIAL:00080D81]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: You're no match for the power of Mobius!
name: StartCombatResponse "StartCombatResponse" [DIAL:00080D81]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Feel the wrath of the science of X-42!
name: StartCombatResponse "StartCombatResponse" [DIAL:00080D81]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NVDLC03IntroSlideEND
name: NVDLC03IntroSlideEND "NVDLC03IntroSlideEND" [DIAL:0300371B]

text_content: {Narration}And the great stone in the middle of the Big Empty lay untouched, filled with countless technological wonders...|{Narration}Wonders that, in the end, had been answers to the wrong question.
name: NVDLC03IntroSlideEND "NVDLC03IntroSlideEND" [DIAL:0300371B]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NVDLC03IntroSlide10
name: NVDLC03IntroSlide10 "NVDLC03IntroSlide10" [DIAL:0300371C]

text_content: {Narration}The problems began to outpace the solutions, first geometrically, then exponentially. As the war escalated, so did the questions.
name: NVDLC03IntroSlide10 "NVDLC03IntroSlide10" [DIAL:0300371C]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NVDLC03IntroSlide09
name: NVDLC03IntroSlide09 "NVDLC03IntroSlide09" [DIAL:0300371D]

text_content: {Narration}For years, the minds and computers of Big Mountain were a blaze of trajectories, weapon schematics, and nuclear theories.
name: NVDLC03IntroSlide09 "NVDLC03IntroSlide09" [DIAL:0300371D]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NVDLC03IntroSlide08
name: NVDLC03IntroSlide08 "NVDLC03IntroSlide08" [DIAL:0300371E]

text_content: {Narration}Equations and calculations marched endlessly across chalkboards and computer terminals toward one solution: Winning the war.|{Do Not Record}
name: NVDLC03IntroSlide08 "NVDLC03IntroSlide08" [DIAL:0300371E]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NVDLC03IntroSlide07
name: NVDLC03IntroSlide07 "NVDLC03IntroSlide07" [DIAL:0300371F]

text_content: {Narration}Although sheltered from the frontlines, the scientists waged their own war, fighting their battles at the atomic level.|{Do Not Record}
name: NVDLC03IntroSlide07 "NVDLC03IntroSlide07" [DIAL:0300371F]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NVDLC03IntroSlide06
name: NVDLC03IntroSlide06 "NVDLC03IntroSlide06" [DIAL:03003720]

text_content: {Narration}The Great War brought a new energy to Big Mountain and its scientists.|{Do Not Record}
name: NVDLC03IntroSlide06 "NVDLC03IntroSlide06" [DIAL:03003720]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NVDLC03IntroSlide05
name: NVDLC03IntroSlide05 "NVDLC03IntroSlide05" [DIAL:03003721]

text_content: {Narration}The nucleus of this research was the Dome, a huge stone facility that held the labs of every science known to man.|{Narration}It was a think tank where no problem could not be solved, where no question could not be answered.
name: NVDLC03IntroSlide05 "NVDLC03IntroSlide05" [DIAL:03003721]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NVDLC03IntroSlide04
name: NVDLC03IntroSlide04 "NVDLC03IntroSlide04" [DIAL:03003722]

text_content: {Narration}Sonic emitters, space age alloys, DNA hybridization, force field particle research, Auto-Doc advances in cranial, cardiac, and trauma surgery...|{Narration}...the hopes and dreams of a century became realities in the electronic forges of Big Mountain.
name: NVDLC03IntroSlide04 "NVDLC03IntroSlide04" [DIAL:03003722]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NVDLC03IntroSlide03
name: NVDLC03IntroSlide03 "NVDLC03IntroSlide03" [DIAL:03003723]

text_content: {Narration}They sought to create a new world, fueled by technology, for the benefit of all mankind.|{Do Not Record}
name: NVDLC03IntroSlide03 "NVDLC03IntroSlide03" [DIAL:03003723]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NVDLC03IntroSlide02
name: NVDLC03IntroSlide02 "NVDLC03IntroSlide02" [DIAL:03003724]

text_content: {Narration}Scientists of vision were drawn to the facility to tackle the greatest technological challenges of the era.|{Do Not Record}
name: NVDLC03IntroSlide02 "NVDLC03IntroSlide02" [DIAL:03003724]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NVDLC03IntroSlide01
name: NVDLC03IntroSlide01 "NVDLC03IntroSlide01" [DIAL:03003725]

text_content: {Narration}In the years before the Great War, Big Mountain had been the home to the brightest minds of the 21st century.
name: NVDLC03IntroSlide01 "NVDLC03IntroSlide01" [DIAL:03003725]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: I've recovered all the technological information.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03KleinTopic001 "I've recovered all the technological information." [DIAL:030039A6]

text_content: WHAT? YOU DID? YOUR SURVIVAL, LET ALONE SUCCESS, BARELY REGISTERED ON MY PROJECTIONS.|NOW, ALL I NEED TO DO IS CHECK MY TRANSMISSION DATABANK, MOBIUS IS ALWAYS FILLING IT UP WITH HIS PSYCHOTIC CALLS...|OH YES, THERE'S THE SCHEMATICS, JUST LIKE YOU SAID. HOW TRUTHFUL.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03KleinTopic001 "I've recovered all the technological information." [DIAL:030039A6]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideX8
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideX8 "NVDLC03EndingSlideX8" [DIAL:03003ABB]

text_content: {Narration}{X-8 not repeated}As the Courier made his way through the X-8 facility, the computers analyzed the test subject's movements.|{Narration}They eventually created new Cyberdogs to root out Commie traitors from the Wasteland... {more to himself}traitors like Betsy Bright... Richie Marcus...|{Narration}...although they couldn't seem to find any Commies, so they turned on themselves, howling sonic barks that echoed miles across the landscape.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideX8 "NVDLC03EndingSlideX8" [DIAL:03003ABB]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: {Narration}{X-8 was repeated}As the Courier ran through the X-8 facility multiple times, the computers analyzed the test subject's movements.|{Narration}Rather than performing a superficial observation, they realized the subject barely knew what Communism was - or even what a high school was.|{Narration}This confused them for a time, until the facility finally realized that its research had... {surprised}succeeded.|{Narration}So it let its Cyberdogs out into the wastes to help protect small communities from physical aggression rather than communist propaganda.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideX8 "NVDLC03EndingSlideX8" [DIAL:03003ABB]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideX13
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideX13 "NVDLC03EndingSlideX13" [DIAL:03003ABC]

text_content: {Narration}{X-13 not repeated}The infiltration program in X-13 continued to scan for the subject and the Stealth Suit prototype long after the test was over.|{Narration}Frustrated and unable to find its lost technology, X-13 expanded its network of laser tripwires, sensors, and Robobrains out across Big {Mountain}MT.|{Narration}This glittering blue light beam forest cleanly bisected anything that entered its depths, slicing them into small, segmented parts for easy disposal.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideX13 "NVDLC03EndingSlideX13" [DIAL:03003ABC]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: {Narration}{X-13 was repeated}{Sexually suggestive, as if the center blew its load into the suit tech}The infiltration program in X-13 felt spent, having repeatedly upgraded the Stealth Suit until it could upgrade it no more.|{Narration}It felt warm, fulfilled, and a bit sluggish. {Beat, suspicious}It realized not long after, the Stealth Suit had left it without so much as a note on the nightstand.|{Narration}So the infiltration program sent out Robobrains into the wastes looking for its wayward technology.|{Narration}It eventually found REPCONN HQ, and set up a {emph}new research center, testing and murdering Fiends who kept breaking into the facility.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideX13 "NVDLC03EndingSlideX13" [DIAL:03003ABC]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideForbiddenZone
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideMobius "NVDLC03EndingSlideForbiddenZone" [DIAL:03003ABD]

text_content: {Narration}{Mobius alive}Dr. Mobius continued his research undisturbed in the Forbidden Zone.|{Narration}As much as he had attempted to create better scorpions, he tried the same with humanity, with considerably less success.|{Narration}These failures didn't bother him overmuch. Once the rush of Mentats wore off, he forgot he had failed in any event.|{Narration}{Gentle, complimentary}After all, the bright young mind who had come to visit him in the Forbidden Zone had already exceeded his expectations.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideMobius "NVDLC03EndingSlideForbiddenZone" [DIAL:03003ABD]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {Narration}{Mobius dead}The Forbidden Zone continued to be, true to its name, forbidden. No more Robo-Scorpions were sighted in its canyons.|{Narration}Big {Mountain}MT became even emptier, devoid of Dr. Mobius' proclamations forecasting the destruction of anything that dared possess sentience.|{Narration}Still, it is said he lived on in the equations inscribed on the floor and walls of the Forbidden Zone dome...
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideMobius "NVDLC03EndingSlideForbiddenZone" [DIAL:03003ABD]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: I think you're past due for your lobotomy, Klein.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinTopic002 "I think you're past due for your lobotomy, Klein." [DIAL:0300A829]

text_content: A... FIGHT? I... I'VE NEVER BEEN IN A FIGHT. WHAT... UH, WHAT, WHAT, WHAT DO I...|AIIGGHGHH! COLLEAGUES! THINK TANK! ALERT! ALERT! WE ARE UNDER ATTACK!
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinTopic002 "I think you're past due for your lobotomy, Klein." [DIAL:0300A829]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: I'm not handing my brain over... there's some things we should discuss.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinTopic001 "I'm not handing my brain over... there's some things we should discuss." [DIAL:0300A82A]

text_content: {Disdainful}AND WHAT COULD WE POSSIBLY HAVE TO SPEAK ABOUT. YOU HAVE THE BRAIN. WE HAVE THE TECHNOLOGY. ALL YOU MUST DO... IS SURRENDER.|WITH IT, WE CAN FINALLY LEAVE THIS PLACE. I CANNOT TELL YOU HOW BORING THIS PLACE GETS, CHOPPING UP THE LANDSCAPE AND EVERYTHING IN IT.|AND WE HAVE SO MANY QUESTIONS TO ASK YOUR BRAIN FIRST. ABOUT THIS... MOJAVE PLACE. A FERTILE TESTING GROUND FOR OUR EXPERIMENTS.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinTopic001 "I'm not handing my brain over... there's some things we should discuss." [DIAL:0300A82A]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: I found my brain, now you and I are going to settle things.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinTopic000 "I found my brain, now you and I are going to settle things." [DIAL:0300A82B]

text_content: I RECOMMEND WATCHING YOUR TONE WITH ME, LOBOTOMITE.|NOW... "YOUR" BRAIN. HAND IT OVER. OR WE'LL EXTRACT IT AGAIN.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinTopic000 "I found my brain, now you and I are going to settle things." [DIAL:0300A82B]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: I've defeated your Giant Robo-Scorpion, you're next.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusTopic001 "I've defeated your Giant Robo-Scorpion, you're next." [DIAL:0300AC61]

text_content: Oh... did I leave that on? {To self}I thought I'd powered it down - {realization}was wondering what was causing the power outages.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusTopic001 "I've defeated your Giant Robo-Scorpion, you're next." [DIAL:0300AC61]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Surrender, Mobius, I don't want to fight you.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusTopic000 "Surrender, Mobius, I don't want to fight you." [DIAL:0300AC62]

text_content: Oh. Well... that's good. Were we supposed to fight? I certainly don't feel violent, but... well, these contraptions make it hard to tell.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusTopic000 "Surrender, Mobius, I don't want to fight you." [DIAL:0300AC62]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideFinale
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFinale "NVDLC03EndingSlideFinale" [DIAL:0300C1C8]

text_content: {Narration}We could say more, but the stories in the Big Empty speak for themselves.|{Narration}Now armed with the {Trans-portal-ponder, combination mish-mash of Transporter + Transponder}Transportalponder, the Courier could return to the Dome at any time and crack open the secrets of the Big Empty, one by one.|{Narration}The Sink sat vigilant, waiting for its master to return, shoes covered in Mojave dust.|{Narration}{Draw this to a close, wraps up the end movie}Only one road yet remained, and it was one the Courier had to walk alone.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFinale "NVDLC03EndingSlideFinale" [DIAL:0300C1C8]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalker "Sink CIU" [NPC_:0300F061]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideIntro
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideStart "NVDLC03EndingSlideIntro" [DIAL:0300C1C9]

text_content: {Narration}{Bad Karma}{Ruthless, authoritative}As it had been in the years before the Great War, Big {Mountain}MT... the Big Empty... became home to one of the most powerful minds of the 23rd century.|{Narration}The Courier who had been brought to the Big Empty became its new overlord, using its facilities ruthlessly and decisively when needed.|{Narration}Sometimes Science is more than a quest for discovery - it is a weapon to be used in the service of one with the strength to understand it.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideStart "NVDLC03EndingSlideIntro" [DIAL:0300C1C9]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {Narration}{Good or Neutral Karma}As it had been in the years before the Great War, Big {Mountain}MT... the Big Empty... became home to one of brightest minds of the 23rd century.|{Narration}The Courier watched over the Big Empty for years to come, caring for it, and keeping its discoveries safe until they were needed to help others.|{Narration}Which had always been Big {Mountain}MT's purpose. Past the laboratories and Science, it had always been intended as a place to build the future of all mankind.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideStart "NVDLC03EndingSlideIntro" [DIAL:0300C1C9]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideThinkTank
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideThinkTank "NVDLC03EndingSlideThinkTank" [DIAL:0300C1CA]

text_content: {Narration}{Think Tank alive}Dr. Klein and the Think Tank remained alive, unaware of the world outside.|{Narration}They looped through their daily routine, none the wiser about the world beyond... although perhaps "wiser" was the wrong word.|{Narration}The world outside belonged to the Courier, and if anyone would shape it... well, the Courier had already called dibs.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideThinkTank "NVDLC03EndingSlideThinkTank" [DIAL:0300C1CA]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: {Narration}{Think Tank dead}The Think Tank basement, filled with the lobotomized robotical frames of the doctors, now served as a graveyard.|{Narration}The monitors had recorded the battle in its entirety, including the Think Tank's final shrill terrified screams, whimpers, and pleas for mercy.|{Narration}They broadcast these humiliating last moments as a warning to anyone approaching the perimeter that other smarty-pants were not welcome.|{Narration}The {emph}Courier was the inheritor of the Big Empty, and there was room for only {emph}one will in the halls of the Think Tank Dome.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideThinkTank "NVDLC03EndingSlideThinkTank" [DIAL:0300C1CA]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: NVDLC03IntroSlide12
name: NVDLC03IntroSlide12 "NVDLC03IntroSlide12" [DIAL:0300C6DE]

text_content: {Narration}In the aftermath, Big Mountain's silent experiments went to sleep, their creators slowly dying in the new world that had been left behind.
name: NVDLC03IntroSlide12 "NVDLC03IntroSlide12" [DIAL:0300C6DE]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

name: NVDLC03IntroSlide11 "NVDLC03IntroSlide11" [DIAL:0300C6DF]

text_content: {Narration}On the night of October 23rd, 2077, the scientists received an answer that put all their questions to rest.

speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]
