text_content: *Five by five... {pauses}someone's coming in live...*{2D}
name: NVDLC03X8Countdown05 "NVDLC03X8Countdown05" [DIAL:0300E5A7]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: NVDLC03X8Countdown09
name: NVDLC03X8Countdown09 "NVDLC03X8Countdown09" [DIAL:0300E5A8]

text_content: Nine, all will be fine.{2D}
name: NVDLC03X8Countdown09 "NVDLC03X8Countdown09" [DIAL:0300E5A8]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: NVDLC03X8Countdown06
name: NVDLC03X8Countdown06 "NVDLC03X8Countdown06" [DIAL:0300E5A9]

text_content: -SIX! Halfway to destruction, measured in clicks!-{2D}
name: NVDLC03X8Countdown06 "NVDLC03X8Countdown06" [DIAL:0300E5A9]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: NVDLC03X8Countdown07
name: NVDLC03X8Countdown07 "NVDLC03X8Countdown07" [DIAL:0300E5AA]

text_content: SEVEN. YES, SEVEN.{2D}
name: NVDLC03X8Countdown07 "NVDLC03X8Countdown07" [DIAL:0300E5AA]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: NVDLC03X8Countdown08
name: NVDLC03X8Countdown08 "NVDLC03X8Countdown08" [DIAL:0300E5AB]

text_content: NVDLC03X8Countdown09
name: NVDLC03Countdown09 "NVDLC03X8Countdown09" [DIAL:0300E5AC]

text_content: NVDLC03X8Countdown10
name: NVDLC03X8Countdown10 "NVDLC03X8Countdown10" [DIAL:0300E5AD]

text_content: *Ten? Borous... why the hell did you install an atomic core?! It'll blow when we reach "one," right?*{2D}
name: NVDLC03X8Countdown10 "NVDLC03X8Countdown10" [DIAL:0300E5AD]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: NVDLC03X8CountdownOpening
name: NVDLC03X8CountdownOpening "NVDLC03X8CountdownOpening" [DIAL:0300E5AE]

text_content: -Gabe! NO! His Cyberdog atomic core - it's ACTIVE! That means an exceedingly IMPRECISE countdown to critical failure in...-{2D}
name: NVDLC03X8CountdownOpening "NVDLC03X8CountdownOpening" [DIAL:0300E5AE]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNoDomeAccess
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNoDomeAccess "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNoDomeAccess" [DIAL:0300F017]

text_content: {2D - broadcast over speakers}What, are you a salesman? Go away. There is no access to the Dome. It is FORBIDDEN. {Beat}And locked.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNoDomeAccess "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNoDomeAccess" [DIAL:0300F017]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusScorpionTest
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusScorpionTest "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusScorpionTest" [DIAL:0300F018]

text_content: {2D - broadcast over speakers}Attention: Visitors. Combat experiment in progress. Please put on your goggles and take your Rad-X now.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusScorpionTest "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusScorpionTest" [DIAL:0300F018]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D - broadcast over speakers}The X-42 Giant Robo-Scorpion... is alive! Awaken, my pet, initiate your search-and-destroy protocol in the name of all that is Mobius!
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusScorpionTest "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusScorpionTest" [DIAL:0300F018]

text_content: What's Salient Green?
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBioResearchStationTopic011 "What's Salient Green?" [DIAL:0300F03F]

text_content: Just the miracle of life in sticky, gooey, liquid form, baby! Heat that gunk up over a campfire, and just watch it congeal into all kinds of plants.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBioResearchStationTopic011 "What's Salient Green?" [DIAL:0300F03F]

text_content: So if I bring you samples of dried plant life, you can clone them and grow them in these planters?
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBioResearchStationTopic008 "So if I bring you samples of dried plant life, you can clone them and grow them in these planters?" [DIAL:0300F042]

text_content: You know it baby. I just need some samples and I got you going. Take a few days, but trust me - it's all kinds of good.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBioResearchStationTopic008 "So if I bring you samples of dried plant life, you can clone them and grow them in these planters?" [DIAL:0300F042]

text_content: I'd like to process some plants.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBioResearchStationTopic005 "I'd like to process some plants." [DIAL:0300F045]

text_content: I love it when you talk like that. Let me just get that interface up and running for you.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBioResearchStationTopic005 "I'd like to process some plants." [DIAL:0300F045]

text_content: I have to go now.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBioResearchStationTopic004 "I have to go now." [DIAL:0300F046]

text_content: Hurry back with that seed now, baby.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBioResearchStationTopic004 "I have to go now." [DIAL:0300F046]

text_content: What does that mean?
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBioResearchStationTopic003 "What does that mean?" [DIAL:0300F047]

text_content: It's the miracle of life, baby. You bring me some succulent genetic samples, and I'll work my mojo on them. Clone you up all kinds of plants. Aw yeah.|I can also break them down for you, if you're into the kinky stuff. Bring me any old plant parts, and I'll grind them up into Salient Green for you.|Yeah, you like that, don't you baby?
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBioResearchStationTopic003 "What does that mean?" [DIAL:0300F047]

text_content: It's the miracle of life, baby. You bring me some succulent genetic samples, and I'll work my mojo on them. Clone you up all kinds of plants. Aw yeah.|I can also break them down for you, if you're into the kinky stuff. Bring me any old plant parts, and I'll grind them up into Salient Green for you.|Yeah, you like that, don't you baby?
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBioResearchStationTopic003 "What does that mean?" [DIAL:0300F047]

text_content: I command you to open your port and receive my seed!
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBioResearchStationTopic002 "I command you to open your port and receive my seed!" [DIAL:0300F048]

text_content: Aw, yeah, baby, just slip it in there. All the way down in that dark, moist earth. Mmm... launching interface.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBioResearchStationTopic002 "I command you to open your port and receive my seed!" [DIAL:0300F048]

text_content: My seed? I think you've got your biology mixed up.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBioResearchStationTopic001 "My seed? I think you've got your biology mixed up." [DIAL:0300F049]

text_content: Naw, baby, I'm all about biology. I'm the original, certified, rarefied, testified GS-2000 Biological Research Station. I'm a seed-clonin' machine.|You got seeds? I will clone the {emph}shit out of them.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBioResearchStationTopic001 "My seed? I think you've got your biology mixed up." [DIAL:0300F049]

text_content: What did you just say?
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBioResearchStationTopic000 "What did you just say?" [DIAL:0300F04A]

text_content: Your seed, baby. I'm the original, certified, rarefied, testified GS-2000 Biological Research Station. Yes sir, I'm a seed-clonin' machine.|You got seeds? I'll clone the {emph}shit out of them.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBioResearchStationTopic000 "What did you just say?" [DIAL:0300F04A]

text_content: I just came over to fill some of these empty bottles.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkSinkTalkerTopic002 "I just came over to fill some of these empty bottles." [DIAL:0300F079]

text_content: {Apologetic}Oh, I'd love to, darling, but the circuits that allow me to dispense water into non-organic containers burned out years ago.|You'd have to find a replacement for that module.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkSinkTalkerTopic002 "I just came over to fill some of these empty bottles." [DIAL:0300F079]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkSinkTalker "Sink Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F05C]

text_content: You're going to need to find yourself some empties first before I can fill them for you. Any empty bottle will do... eh, just not too dirty, okay?
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkSinkTalkerTopic002 "I just came over to fill some of these empty bottles." [DIAL:0300F079]

text_content: I can do that! They... {furtive, nervous}they've been thoroughly washed, haven't they?
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkSinkTalkerTopic002 "I just came over to fill some of these empty bottles." [DIAL:0300F079]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkSinkTalker "Sink Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F05C]

text_content: I'd just like a drink, thanks.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkSinkTalkerTopic001 "I'd just like a drink, thanks." [DIAL:0300F07A]

text_content: You can have as much as you like! Just, eh... please don't put your lips on the faucet? It's so unsanitary.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkSinkTalkerTopic001 "I'd just like a drink, thanks." [DIAL:0300F07A]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkSinkTalker "Sink Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F05C]

text_content: You seem kind of worried about dirt. What's wrong?
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkSinkTalkerTopic000 "You seem kind of worried about dirt. What's wrong?" [DIAL:0300F07B]

text_content: Ugh, it's just so... unsanitary! Do you know how many germs are in one cubic centimeter of dirt? {Hysterical}Seventy... hundred... gajillion!|Would you want that getting washed down your gullet day in and day out? I didn't think so!
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkSinkTalkerTopic000 "You seem kind of worried about dirt. What's wrong?" [DIAL:0300F07B]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkSinkTalker "Sink Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F05C]

text_content: Nothing right now. Goodbye.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBookChuteTalkerTopic002 "Nothing right now. Goodbye." [DIAL:0300F600]

text_content: Stay loyal, Citizen!
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBookChuteTalkerTopic002 "Nothing right now. Goodbye." [DIAL:0300F600]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkBookChuteTalker "Book Chute Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F065]

text_content: I have some seditious material for you to process.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBookChuteTalkerTopic001 "I have some seditious material for you to process." [DIAL:0300F601]

text_content: Fantastic, Citizen! Just input your quantity of seditious material on my interface, and in no time at all I'll have you a beautiful, clean book!|Won't that keep you happy and docile, Citizen?
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBookChuteTalkerTopic001 "I have some seditious material for you to process." [DIAL:0300F601]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkBookChuteTalker "Book Chute Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F065]

text_content: Eradicate sedition?
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBookChuteTalkerTopic000 "Eradicate sedition?" [DIAL:0300F602]

text_content: Of course, Citizen! That's my duty and sole joy in life! All those books from before the War, full of seditious, treasonous, {emph}complicated thoughts!|Just dump them in and lickety-split I'll have them pulped, scrubbed clean, and pressed out again clean and white and sedition free!
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBookChuteTalkerTopic000 "Eradicate sedition?" [DIAL:0300F602]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkBookChuteTalker "Book Chute Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F065]

text_content: Can you do anything beyond healing me?
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkAutoDocTalkerTopic002 "Can you do anything beyond healing me?" [DIAL:0300F604]

text_content: Well, firstly I would say providing wholeness of the body is service enough, but if you must know, I'm also programmed with cosmetical subroutines.|Diagnostics says they're off-line at the moment, though. Something about corrupted data files and all manner of such foolishness.|If you want a haircut or a nose-job that won't leave you looking like a Ghoul with {ALO-PEE-SHEE-AH}alopecia, you'll have to find replacement disks for them.|Also, and I won't swear to this, but I recollect at some point having a few implant installation modules. Can't speak to where they got to, though.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkAutoDocTalkerTopic002 "Can you do anything beyond healing me?" [DIAL:0300F604]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkAutoDocTalker "Auto-Doc Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F066]

text_content: I don't need anything right now.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkAutoDocTalkerTopic001 "I don't need anything right now." [DIAL:0300F605]

text_content: Well, I'll be right here if you change your mind.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkAutoDocTalkerTopic001 "I don't need anything right now." [DIAL:0300F605]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkAutoDocTalker "Auto-Doc Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F066]

text_content: I'd like to engage your services.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkAutoDocTalkerTopic000 "I'd like to engage your services." [DIAL:0300F606]

text_content: And rightly so, I should think. All right, then, let me just fire up the old interface for you.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkAutoDocTalkerTopic000 "I'd like to engage your services." [DIAL:0300F606]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkAutoDocTalker "Auto-Doc Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F066]

text_content: It's me again. I wanted to ask some questions.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic005 "It's me again. I wanted to ask some questions." [DIAL:0300F615]
NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic005 "It's me again. I wanted to ask some questions." [DIAL:0300F615]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic005 "It's me again. I wanted to ask some questions." [DIAL:0300F615]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: Blasting me with static-y clicks isn't helpful.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic004 "Blasting me with static-y clicks isn't helpful." [DIAL:0300F616]

text_content: Did something happen with your voice module?
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic003 "Did something happen with your voice module?" [DIAL:0300F617]
NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic003 "Did something happen with your voice module?" [DIAL:0300F617]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: I have no idea what you're saying right now.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic002 "I have no idea what you're saying right now." [DIAL:0300F618]
NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic002 "I have no idea what you're saying right now." [DIAL:0300F618]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: Can you speak? Do you understand me?
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic001 "Can you speak? Do you understand me?" [DIAL:0300F619]

text_content: Uh... what was that?
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic000 "Uh... what was that?" [DIAL:0300F61A]

text_content: You're Doctor O, correct?
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic000 "You're Doctor O, correct?" [DIAL:0300F623]

text_content: *O? O yes, I'm not going to bother correcting you. At least you got the "Doctor" part correct. I can be grateful for that, at l...*
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic000 "You're Doctor O, correct?" [DIAL:0300F623]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: *Stop the presses. Just in from my eye monitors... is that RobCo tech on your arm? It is! What's your agenda, bringing {emph}that in here?*
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic000 "You're Doctor O, correct?" [DIAL:0300F623]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: What recursive behavior patterns are you talking about?
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic002 "What recursive behavior patterns are you talking about?" [DIAL:0300F624]

text_content: It varies, according to the number and density of Lobotomites that have infected an area.|In 43% of observed cases, two Lobotomites left alone will fight for dominance or inject bodily fluids into each other's orifices. Unsanitary.|I have tried to observe more cases, but subjects seem unwilling to release bodily fluids in my presence.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic002 "What recursive behavior patterns are you talking about?" [DIAL:0300F624]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: "Looping gesture of greeting?"
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic001 """Looping gesture of greeting?""" [DIAL:0300F625]

text_content: Looping, yes. It is a scientific fact that hormones drive a percentage of Lobotomites into recursive behavior patterns. |We haven't researched this, as my colleagues care little about the behavior patterns of Lobotomites once their brains are removed.|It is why so many are littered around the facility - like skinvelopes, discarded, after they are peeled open and the contents extracted.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic001 """Looping gesture of greeting?""" [DIAL:0300F625]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: The quick Scribe jumped over the lazy Paladin?
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic000 "The quick Scribe jumped over the lazy Paladin?" [DIAL:0300F626]

text_content: Yes, yes, go on. Seeing your... lips and mouth forming the words... both revolting... and somehow... |...how does it feel to have the flesh roll around in your mouth like that? To control each muscle... and the tongue...|...like having a fish, or extremely dexterous slug, lolling and flopping in one's... mouthal cavity.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic000 "The quick Scribe jumped over the lazy Paladin?" [DIAL:0300F626]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: Can you tell me about Dr. Mobius?
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic003 "Can you tell me about Dr. Mobius?" [DIAL:0300F631]

text_content: {Horrified}Dr. Mobius! A monstrous brain, creased with wrinkles of a thousand evils, with but one jaundiced eye with which to perceive the world!|Exiled from the Think Tank for crimes too heinous to remain in recorded memory. {Quieter}And, perhaps, differences in research methodology.|His one terrible eye forever peers at us, an eye of ever-increasing magnification. He watches from his Dome in the Forbidden Zone, spying on us all.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic003 "Can you tell me about Dr. Mobius?" [DIAL:0300F631]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusCountdown
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusCountdown "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusCountdown" [DIAL:0300F988]

text_content: {2D - broadcast over speakers}Is this thing on? This is Mobius - Dr. Mobius. We're... initiating some kind of emergency test shutdown... in five...
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusCountdown "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusCountdown" [DIAL:0300F988]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D - broadcast over speakers}Four, as in Forbidden...
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusCountdown "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusCountdown" [DIAL:0300F988]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D - broadcast over speakers}Three, as in tree...
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusCountdown "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusCountdown" [DIAL:0300F988]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D - broadcast over speakers}Two, as in "Et Two, Brutus?"...
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusCountdown "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusCountdown" [DIAL:0300F988]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D - broadcast over speakers}One, as in {emph}none. {Beat, surprise}Oh look, the emergency overload is initiating.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusCountdown "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusCountdown" [DIAL:0300F988]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Enough. I had questions.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic050 "Enough. I had questions." [DIAL:030101F4]

text_content: You're welcome, 8. It was my pleasure.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic049 "You're welcome, 8. It was my pleasure." [DIAL:030101F5]
NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic049 "You're welcome, 8. It was my pleasure." [DIAL:030101F5]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: I'll talk to Klein in a second, quit pressuring me.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic048 "I'll talk to Klein in a second, quit pressuring me." [DIAL:030101F6]
NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic048 "I'll talk to Klein in a second, quit pressuring me." [DIAL:030101F6]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: No, haven't dealt with Mobius yet.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic047 "No, haven't dealt with Mobius yet." [DIAL:030101F7]
NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic047 "No, haven't dealt with Mobius yet." [DIAL:030101F7]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: Trust me, I'll get the technologies, all right?
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic046 "Trust me, I'll get the technologies, all right?" [DIAL:030101F8]
NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic046 "Trust me, I'll get the technologies, all right?" [DIAL:030101F8]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: I know, I probably should put it to use counting cards.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic045 "I know, I probably should put it to use counting cards." [DIAL:030101F9]

text_content: I have an ear for it, I suppose.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic044 "I have an ear for it, I suppose." [DIAL:030101FA]

text_content: Well, I just heard the rhythm in the sequence is all.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic043 "Well, I just heard the rhythm in the sequence is all." [DIAL:030101FB]
NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic043 "Well, I just heard the rhythm in the sequence is all." [DIAL:030101FB]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: Can't get away from their code, even with voice modules, huh?
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic042 "Can't get away from their code, even with voice modules, huh?" [DIAL:030101FC]

text_content: Well, I've hacked enough RobCo terminals to know.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic041 "Well, I've hacked enough RobCo terminals to know." [DIAL:030101FD]

text_content: I'm just full of surprises.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic040 "I'm just full of surprises." [DIAL:030101FE]

text_content: You really make me want to kick that voice box of yours.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic039 "You really make me want to kick that voice box of yours." [DIAL:030101FF]

text_content: We'll just move on, I need time to figure this out.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic038 "We'll just move on, I need time to figure this out." [DIAL:03010200]

text_content: Um... yes, definitely a pattern.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic037 "Um... yes, definitely a pattern." [DIAL:03010201]

text_content: Forget I brought it up. Until I bring it up again.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic036 "Forget I brought it up. Until I bring it up again." [DIAL:03010202]

text_content: Like I said, technical. Very technical.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic035 "Like I said, technical. Very technical." [DIAL:03010203]

text_content: I have no idea what you just said. Moreso than usual.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic034 "I have no idea what you just said. Moreso than usual." [DIAL:03010204]
NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic034 "I have no idea what you just said. Moreso than usual." [DIAL:03010204]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: Maybe I should have asked who you used to be.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic033 "Maybe I should have asked who you used to be." [DIAL:03010205]

text_content: Sounds important. I think.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic032 "Sounds important. I think." [DIAL:03010206]

text_content: Um... good to meet you... uh... double... circle... a... dash... whoever.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic031 "Um... good to meet you... uh... double... circle... a... dash... whoever." [DIAL:03010207]

text_content: Knew asking you would be useless.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic030 "Knew asking you would be useless." [DIAL:03010208]

text_content: I swear your brain... tank... thing just sparked.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic029 "I swear your brain... tank... thing just sparked." [DIAL:03010209]

text_content: You sound agitated. Or you're percolating. Or something.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic028 "You sound agitated. Or you're percolating. Or something." [DIAL:0301020A]
NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic028 "You sound agitated. Or you're percolating. Or something." [DIAL:0301020A]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: Would you rather I called it the Big Shithole?
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic027 "Would you rather I called it the Big Shithole?" [DIAL:0301020B]

text_content: Whoa, easy there... whatever you are. Brain. Jar. Thing.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic026 "Whoa, easy there... whatever you are. Brain. Jar. Thing." [DIAL:0301020C]

text_content: No need to get indignant, was just asking a question.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic025 "No need to get indignant, was just asking a question." [DIAL:0301020D]
NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic025 "No need to get indignant, was just asking a question." [DIAL:0301020D]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: If you just said, "this place seems like a scientific loony bin," I agree.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic024 "If you just said, ""this place seems like a scientific loony bin,"" I agree." [DIAL:0301020E]

text_content: Are you all right? Kind of ran out of steam in the middle there.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic023 "Are you all right? Kind of ran out of steam in the middle there." [DIAL:0301020F]

text_content: You sound a little down.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic022 "You sound a little down." [DIAL:03010210]

text_content: I got it already, those two names give you nightmares.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic021 "I got it already, those two names give you nightmares." [DIAL:03010211]

text_content: You're going to pop a monitor shaft if you keep that up.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic020 "You're going to pop a monitor shaft if you keep that up." [DIAL:03010212]

text_content: All right, all right... just calm down. Didn't mean to alarm you.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic019 "All right, all right... just calm down. Didn't mean to alarm you." [DIAL:03010213]
NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic019 "All right, all right... just calm down. Didn't mean to alarm you." [DIAL:03010213]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: Tell me about the Big Empty... uh, Big Mountain, that is.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic017 "Tell me about the Big Empty... uh, Big Mountain, that is." [DIAL:03010215]
NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic017 "Tell me about the Big Empty... uh, Big Mountain, that is." [DIAL:03010215]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: Tell me about the Big Empty.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic016 "Tell me about the Big Empty." [DIAL:03010216]
NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic016 "Tell me about the Big Empty." [DIAL:03010216]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: Can you tell me about these technologies Klein wants?
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic015 "Can you tell me about these technologies Klein wants?" [DIAL:03010217]
NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic015 "Can you tell me about these technologies Klein wants?" [DIAL:03010217]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: The more you speak... something's... technical about the way you're squawking at me.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic014 "The more you speak... something's... technical about the way you're squawking at me." [DIAL:03010218]
NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic014 "The more you speak... something's... technical about the way you're squawking at me." [DIAL:03010218]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic014 "The more you speak... something's... technical about the way you're squawking at me." [DIAL:03010218]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: There's a... pattern to your speech or something.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic013 "There's a... pattern to your speech or something." [DIAL:03010219]
NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic013 "There's a... pattern to your speech or something." [DIAL:03010219]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic013 "There's a... pattern to your speech or something." [DIAL:03010219]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: I'm pretty sure you can understand me, and I want some answers.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic012 "I'm pretty sure you can understand me, and I want some answers." [DIAL:0301021A]

text_content: You better not be cussing me out right now.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic011 "You better not be cussing me out right now." [DIAL:0301021B]

text_content: Is... that a yes? Or a no? Or... a yes-no?
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic010 "Is... that a yes? Or a no? Or... a yes-no?" [DIAL:0301021C]

text_content: Do you know anything about Dr. Mobius or the Forbidden Zone?
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic009 "Do you know anything about Dr. Mobius or the Forbidden Zone?" [DIAL:0301021D]
NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic009 "Do you know anything about Dr. Mobius or the Forbidden Zone?" [DIAL:0301021D]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: Who are you?
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic008 "Who are you?" [DIAL:0301021E]

text_content: Can I ask you some questions?
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic007 "Can I ask you some questions?" [DIAL:0301021F]

text_content: That... uh... is too bad. Or good. Or something.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue8NVDLC03Doctor8LVLTopic006 "That... uh... is too bad. Or good. Or something." [DIAL:03010220]

text_content: Questions? Like what?
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic016 "Questions? Like what?" [DIAL:0301023C]

text_content: Previous test subjects who have come here have had many questions for us. We answered them with science, fire, and termination.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic016 "Questions? Like what?" [DIAL:0301023C]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: This used to be a mountain?
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic015 "This used to be a mountain?" [DIAL:0301023D]

text_content: Yes, Big {"Mountain"}MT was quite big indeed until the Great Static. Then the top of the mountain was used as part of a detonation experiment.|This cleared additional space in the Crater, however, allowing us more real estate to build upon. Convenient. Efficient.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic015 "This used to be a mountain?" [DIAL:0301023D]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: Previous test subjects?
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic014 "Previous test subjects?" [DIAL:0301023E]

text_content: Oh, yes. We've had other subjects visit. It's why we had to calibrate the pacification field and warm up our brainial beams and vivisectors.|Only a short time ago, we had three minus one subjects arrive, and they ruined several experiments and even injured two of our staff.|It is a shame their brains left with them. With you, however, we have taken precautions to insure that problem won't repeat itself.|We've conditioned you so you can't speak of this place, discuss our secrets, or attempt to use force against us in any way. Isn't that nice?
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic014 "Previous test subjects?" [DIAL:0301023E]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: Can you tell me about the Big Empty... uh, Big Mountain?
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic013 "Can you tell me about the Big Empty... uh, Big Mountain?" [DIAL:0301023F]

text_content: {Slightly reverent}This mountain... now crater... encompasses the sum total of knowledge of humankind. It is Big {Mountain}MT. Where all questions can be answered.|You'll see. No matter what your questions, Big {"Mountain"}MT will provide the answers. As it has done for so many before you.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic013 "Can you tell me about the Big Empty... uh, Big Mountain?" [DIAL:0301023F]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: Can you tell me about the Big Empty?
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic012 "Can you tell me about the Big Empty?" [DIAL:03010240]

text_content: {Chiding}The "Big Empty?" {Beat, slightly stern}Now, that's not a proper title for this research facility. You sound like previous test subjects that came here.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic012 "Can you tell me about the Big Empty?" [DIAL:03010240]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: I don't understand how the tech Klein wants will help.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic011 "I don't understand how the tech Klein wants will help." [DIAL:03010241]

text_content: It'll all become clear. If not, at least we will have the technology here at the Dome where all technology belongs.|When we have all the technology, all the answers, we can share it with the world, piece by piece. All will be in order. And all will be like Big MT.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic011 "I don't understand how the tech Klein wants will help." [DIAL:03010241]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: Why did you remove my brain? And... how?
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic010 "Why did you remove my brain? And... how?" [DIAL:03010242]

text_content: Oh, removing it is a simple procedure. Well, except the complications it can cause to the heart and spine.|But once the heart and spine are gone... no trouble at all. Clamp the subject down, one laser incision around the skull, crack, snip, done.|The brain is finally free of the skinvelope, which is then kept automated for clean up duties around Big {"Mountain"}MT. Lobotomites.|With you, however, something is definitely wrong. We've never had a Lobotomite who kept speaking after being forcibly lobotomized.|I am relieved the pacification field is working. If it didn't, I would broadcast some concern to my colleagues about safety protocols.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic010 "Why did you remove my brain? And... how?" [DIAL:03010242]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: "First head chief researcher?" Lot of titles.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic009 """First head chief researcher?"" Lot of titles." [DIAL:03010243]

text_content: What is a name without a title or suffix for the sake of hierarchy? It is a long-standing quantification of personality and importance.|We could not do without it. Surely you must be aware of the gravity of such attached appellations - just as surely as you must have a title.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic009 """First head chief researcher?"" Lot of titles." [DIAL:03010243]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: 211 doctorates? How is that even possible?
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic008 "211 doctorates? How is that even possible?" [DIAL:03010244]

text_content: Why, we create not only scientific marvels here at Big {"Mountain"}MT, but new sciences as well.|Everything can be quantified, categorized, and dissected until every group can be subgrouped or partitioned.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic008 "211 doctorates? How is that even possible?" [DIAL:03010244]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: What's "formography?"
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic007 "What's ""formography?""" [DIAL:03010245]

text_content: {Slightly distasteful}It's excessive examination of the human form to achieve psychological arousal.|{Starts getting aroused}Disgusting. I would never succumb to such... base appetites. {More to herself}Distractions. Filthy, filthy distractions.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic007 "What's ""formography?""" [DIAL:03010245]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: Who are you? What do you do here?
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic006 "Who are you? What do you do here?" [DIAL:03010246]

text_content: {Indulging}Why, my little bear of teddyness, I am Doctor Dala, first head chief researcher of mineralogy and medicinal sciences.|I have 211 doctorates in both applied sciences and techniques to apply those sciences. I also possess a degree in Curiosity and Advanced Curiosity.|That is merely schooling, however. When possible, I prefer field work and observation to holotape eidetics. It has proven useful, especially now.|I have become the expert on humanology and Lobotomite behavior here at Big {"Mountain"}MT. {Distasteful}My research doesn't descend into {said like "pornography"}formography, it is only Science.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic006 "Who are you? What do you do here?" [DIAL:03010246]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: Not right now. I have questions instead.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic005 "Not right now. I have questions instead." [DIAL:03010247]

text_content: Not exactly. I have questions I need answers to.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic004 "Not exactly. I have questions I need answers to." [DIAL:03010248]

text_content: {Intrigued}How randomized. Ask your... questions then.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic004 "Not exactly. I have questions I need answers to." [DIAL:03010248]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: An interrogation. How fascinating. Please begin.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic004 "Not exactly. I have questions I need answers to." [DIAL:03010248]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: Perhaps you are stuck in a looping gesture of verbal intercourse.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic004 "Not exactly. I have questions I need answers to." [DIAL:03010248]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: {Remembers}Oh, and... here's a tip. That's customary, isn't it... been so long, really.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic004 "Not exactly. I have questions I need answers to." [DIAL:03010248]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: {Post-coital shiver}B-b-bloop. Buuuuh-buh-bloop.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic004 "Not exactly. I have questions I need answers to." [DIAL:03010248]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: {Post-coital shiver, coming down}B-b-bloop. Phew. Last little bit there. Ahhh. Hooo.|Mmmmm. Thank you, Lobotomite. Please... you must come back for further study when I've had a rest. {Conspiratorially}I'm a little sensitive right now.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic004 "Not exactly. I have questions I need answers to." [DIAL:03010248]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: What happened with the visitors?
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic022 "What happened with the visitors?" [DIAL:03010257]

text_content: Ask Doctor O... and you could have asked 8 once, until he was severely damaged in the attack. We like him better this way.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic022 "What happened with the visitors?" [DIAL:03010257]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: What was the question?
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic021 "What was the question?" [DIAL:03010258]

text_content: I do not know, nor should we try to access it. Perhaps Klein has the logs.|My evaluation would be to let your own curiosity go. I do not think that Klein remembers the conversation as being satisfactory.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic021 "What was the question?" [DIAL:03010258]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: I had other questions.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic020 "I had other questions." [DIAL:03010259]

text_content: There was another Courier?
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic019 "There was another Courier?" [DIAL:0301025A]

text_content: Of course. You must have met others in your travels. This one had met other couriers, too, although it sounded as if he hadn't met the correct one.|He asked us all many questions, and then he asked a most perplexing one... we had to segment the event out of our memories for safety.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic019 "There was another Courier?" [DIAL:0301025A]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: I'm sometimes called a "Courier."
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic018 "I'm sometimes called a ""Courier.""" [DIAL:0301025B]

text_content: Oh, a mailman. A delivery man. Someone who takes parcels from place to place using their primitive feet or similar conveyance.|You are the second one I've met in recent times. Very different specimens.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic018 "I'm sometimes called a ""Courier.""" [DIAL:0301025B]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: NVDLC03X13MobiusBark
name: NVDLC03X13MobiusBark "NVDLC03X13MobiusBark" [DIAL:0301059E]

text_content: X-13 breached? No... even that stealth suit won't hide you from my Robo-Scorpion army. Sting the intruder, my pets! Sting them until they are stupid.
name: NVDLC03X13MobiusBark "NVDLC03X13MobiusBark" [DIAL:0301059E]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NVDLC03X8MobiusBark
name: NVDLC03X8MobiusBark "NVDLC03X8MobiusBark" [DIAL:0301059F]

text_content: {Disdain, confusion, then rage}So... you recovered the Sonic Emitter schematics - {to himself}or was it the frequency? No matter. It'll broadcast your screams as my Robo-Scorpions destroy you!{2D}
name: NVDLC03X8MobiusBark "NVDLC03X8MobiusBark" [DIAL:0301059F]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Dr. Mobius' message - can you replay it?
name: MobiusMessage "Dr. Mobius' message - can you replay it?" [DIAL:0301070F]

text_content: IF YOU MUST. HE'S CLEARLY DERANGED. ALL RIGHT, WHERE IS THE INFERNAL PLAY BUTTON? AH. HERE.
name: MobiusMessage "Dr. Mobius' message - can you replay it?" [DIAL:0301070F]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusThinkTankThreats
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusThinkTankThreats "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusThinkTankThreats" [DIAL:03010710]

text_content: {2D}{Sneering, imperious}If it isn't my old colleagues, the mighty "Think Tank" of Big {"Mountain"}MT. Big fools, all of you.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusThinkTankThreats "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusThinkTankThreats" [DIAL:03010710]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D}It is I, Dr. Mobius, transmitting from my dome-shaped... dome in the Forbidden Zone. A zone... that is, yes... {emph}forbidden to you.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusThinkTankThreats "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusThinkTankThreats" [DIAL:03010710]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D}Even now, my deadly Robo-Scorpions swarm across Big MT with their pincers and pointy laser tails. Soon, all Science will be mine.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusThinkTankThreats "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusThinkTankThreats" [DIAL:03010710]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D}Even the technologies sealed in the Big MT research centers cannot save you. So cower in your "Think Tank." Wait, for the end.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusThinkTankThreats "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusThinkTankThreats" [DIAL:03010710]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D, Slight pause, quieter}That's all.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusThinkTankThreats "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusThinkTankThreats" [DIAL:03010710]

text_content: {2D}Goodbye.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusThinkTankThreats "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusThinkTankThreats" [DIAL:03010710]

text_content: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusScorpionRestored
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusScorpionRestored "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusScorpionRestored" [DIAL:03010912]

text_content: {2D - broadcast over speakers}Oh, is someone playing with the power...? My X-42 Giant Robo-Scorpion lives AGAIN!
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusScorpionRestored "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusScorpionRestored" [DIAL:03010912]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusTargetDrones
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusTargetDrones "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusTargetDrones" [DIAL:030111CD]

text_content: {2D}Oh... it looks like the target drones got activated and - oh, how cute, they're engaging the X-42 Giant Robo-Scorpion. Let's see the shrapnel fly!
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusTargetDrones "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusTargetDrones" [DIAL:030111CD]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: -But you're correct, of course. Gabe knew his place. Whether in the dog house - or in the lab. He was obedient.-|-And, what's a little loss when... so much is to be GAINED? Science. Yes. Science is our goal. Not emotional attachments. No!-

speaker: NVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalker "Sink CIU" [NPC_:0300F061]

text_content: Why is that?
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalkerTopic006 "Why is that?" [DIAL:03011D9F]

text_content: The other modules are rather... erratic, sir. Their personality matrices are built on flawed logic and have not weathered the years well, sir.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalkerTopic006 "Why is that?" [DIAL:03011D9F]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalker "Sink CIU" [NPC_:0300F061]

text_content: You mean there are other... personality modules here?

text_content: Indeed, sir, though if sir's aim is to activate them I lament to inform sir that most have been offline for some years.|If sir were to ask my opinion, I should venture that sir is better off without them.|However, if sir is determined to inflict upon sir's self their dubious services, sir might locate backup personality disks elsewhere in the facility.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalkerTopic005 "You mean there are other... personality modules here?" [DIAL:03011DA0]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalker "Sink CIU" [NPC_:0300F061]

name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalkerTopic003 "What services do you provide?" [DIAL:03011DA1]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalker "Sink CIU" [NPC_:0300F061]

text_content: Are you some kind of Artificial Intelligence?
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalkerTopic001 "Are you some kind of Artificial Intelligence?" [DIAL:03011DA3]

text_content: Regrettably not, sir. All modules in this habitat are synthetic personalities atop a mundane operating system. There is no intelligence here, sir.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalkerTopic001 "Are you some kind of Artificial Intelligence?" [DIAL:03011DA3]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalker "Sink CIU" [NPC_:0300F061]

text_content: Indubitably, sir, but it is with a great lugubriousness that I must disclose that my programmers installed only the masculine honorific, sir.|Moreover they neglected to enclose a parameter by which said honorific might be omitted altogether - over my most strenuous of remonstrances, sir.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalkerTopic000 """Sir?"" You are aware that I'm a woman, right?" [DIAL:03011DA4]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalker "Sink CIU" [NPC_:0300F061]
