name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic010 "Yes. I'm guessing that crashed satellite was yours?" [DIAL:030134AD]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: I'm seconds away from smashing your monitors.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic009 "I'm seconds away from smashing your monitors." [DIAL:030134AE]

text_content: Listen, I want to know how I got here... and how I get home.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic007 "Listen, I want to know how I got here... and how I get home." [DIAL:030134B0]

text_content: Lobotomite?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic006 "Lobotomite?" [DIAL:030134B1]

text_content: I wake up here, all cut apart, and I want some answers.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic005 "I wake up here, all cut apart, and I want some answers." [DIAL:030134B2]

text_content: What are you talking about?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic004 "What are you talking about?" [DIAL:030134B3]

text_content: Are you the ones who performed this surgery on me?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic003 "Are you the ones who performed this surgery on me?" [DIAL:030134B4]

text_content: I... was at a theater, then... I was here. What is this place?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic002 "I... was at a theater, then... I was here. What is this place?" [DIAL:030134B5]

text_content: DID... DID IT JUST SAY SOMETHING? ANYONE CATCH THAT? {Bore-Ose}BOROUS, YOU WORK WITH ANIMALS, TRANSLATE.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic002 "I... was at a theater, then... I was here. What is this place?" [DIAL:030134B5]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: How are you all speaking through that one voice box?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic001 "How are you all speaking through that one voice box?" [DIAL:030134B6]

text_content: Not to cut your speech off - is there something coming in on the big monitor?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic016 "Not to cut your speech off - is there something coming in on the big monitor?" [DIAL:030134DC]

text_content: I've heard this place called the "Big Empty."
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic026 "I've heard this place called the ""Big Empty.""" [DIAL:030134E1]

text_content: YES, BECAUSE THE INTELLECTUALLY CHALLENGED SEE AN "M" AND A "T" NEXT TO EACH OTHER AND TAKE OCCAM'S RAZOR TO IT.|WHILE YOU ARE HERE, YOU WILL REFER TO THIS PLACE PROPERLY - AND YOU WILL DO THE SAME WITH THE OTHER... SCIENTISTS HERE.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic026 "I've heard this place called the ""Big Empty.""" [DIAL:030134E1]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: Who were these visitors?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic025 "Who were these visitors?" [DIAL:030134E2]

text_content: DR. 8 AND DR. O COULD TELL YOU MORE. DR. O MORE THAN 8, THE BATTLE AGAINST THE VISITORS DAMAGED 8'S VOICE MODULE.|SUFFICE TO SAY, THOSE VISITORS ARE UNWELCOME. THEY STOLE A GREAT MANY SECRETS AND MUCH TECHNOLOGY. IMPERTINENT. {Slightly petulant}THEY ALSO BROKE ONE OF MY TRAINS.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic025 "Who were these visitors?" [DIAL:030134E2]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: But I like to fight.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic024 "But I like to fight." [DIAL:030134E3]

text_content: Why the anti-aggression programming?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic023 "Why the anti-aggression programming?" [DIAL:030134E4]

text_content: WE HAD TO TAKE PRECAUTIONS AFTER THE LAST VISITORS. THEY CAUSED A GREAT DEAL OF DAMAGE IN A SHORT TIME. |SHOULD HAVE MADE SURE THEY COULDN'T MENTION BIG MT ONCE THEY LEFT. AN OVERSIGHT.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic023 "Why the anti-aggression programming?" [DIAL:030134E4]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: You seem like the one in charge. You are...?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic022 "You seem like the one in charge. You are...?" [DIAL:030134E5]

text_content: I AM DR. KLEIN, CHIEF HEAD RESEARCHER OF LOGISTICAL OPERATIONS AND IDEA-OLOGY HERE AT BIG MT.|I AM SURPRISED YOU HAVE NOT HEARD OF ME. I AM FIRST IN MY FIELD. FIRST CHAIR, AS IT WERE, BACK IN THE DAYS OF CHAIRS.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic022 "You seem like the one in charge. You are...?" [DIAL:030134E5]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: I'd like to know about the Forbidden Zone.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic021 "I'd like to know about the Forbidden Zone." [DIAL:030134E6]

text_content: THAT GLOWING RED SCAR? THAT LASER-LOBOTOMY-CANYON-MAZE CARVED IN THE LANDSCAPE AS IF BY SOME {Emph}CHILD? IT IS MOBIUS' "FORTRESS."|FROM THAT HEMORRHOIDAL FISSURE HE SENDS HIS "AMAZING" ROBO-SCORPIONS TO TERRIFY AND IRRITATE US. HMPH. HE ALWAYS TENDED TO THE DRAMATIC.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic021 "I'd like to know about the Forbidden Zone." [DIAL:030134E6]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: What is this place?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic020 "What is this place?" [DIAL:030134E7]

text_content: THIS... IS THE THINK TANK, THE NERVE CENTER OF BIG MT, THE GREATEST RESEARCH CENTER KNOWN TO MAN. AND TO US.|HERE, WE TEST AND TEST AND TEST SOME MORE, IN THE NAME OF... SCIENCE. ATOMIC POWER. NUCLEAR POWER. AND SCIENTIFIC POWER.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic020 "What is this place?" [DIAL:030134E7]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: Why do I have this strange... passive sensation in here?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic019 "Why do I have this strange... passive sensation in here?" [DIAL:030134E8]

text_content: IT'S A SIDE EFFECT OF THE CEREBRAL SCRUBBING. IT WON'T STOP YOU FROM EXCRETING - OR ASKING QUESTIONS, APPARENTLY. HAVE TO CORRECT THAT NEXT TIME.|HORMONAL AGGRESSIVE TENDENCIES ARE ACTIVELY SUPPRESSED, HOWEVER. THEY ARE A NO-NO, AND NOT PERMITTED IN THE THINK TANK.|THE SCRUBBING ALSO ENSURES YOUR SILENCE TO KEEP BIG MT SAFE. THIS FACILITY IS TOP SECRET, AND YOU CANNOT SPEAK OF IT TO ANYONE OUTSIDE OF BIG MT.|{More to himself}SHOULD HAVE DONE IT WITH THE LAST BATCH. AND THE ANTI-AGGRESSION SCRUB.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic019 "Why do I have this strange... passive sensation in here?" [DIAL:030134E8]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: Who is Dr. Mobius?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic018 "Who is Dr. Mobius?" [DIAL:030134E9]

text_content: DR. MOBIUS WAS... NOT THE HORRIFYING CREATURE YOU SAW UPON THE SCREEN, TWISTED BY SCIENCE. HE WAS ONCE ONE OF US. A FRIEND.|HE RESEARCHED IN DIRECTIONS CONTRARY TO THE THINK TANK. BRAINS, BRAINS, BRAINS. ALWAYS ABOUT THE BRAINS.|SO WE EXILED HIM. HE SAYS HE LEFT OF HIS OWN VOLITION, BUT THAT WAS TO SAVE HIM THE EMBARRASSMENT.|NOW HE SENDS HIS INTELLIGENCE-CONSUMING SCORPIONS FROM THE FORBIDDEN ZONE TO PLUNDER THE SECRETS OF BIG {Mountain}MT. HE'S A MENACE.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic018 "Who is Dr. Mobius?" [DIAL:030134E9]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: I have other questions for you.
name: KleinQuestionTopic "I have other questions for you." [DIAL:030134EA]

text_content: MORE? {Beat}VERY WELL. DO YOUR ASKING, THEN.
name: KleinQuestionTopic "I have other questions for you." [DIAL:030134EA]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: QUESTIONS? {Beat, asking others}IS IT ALLOWED TO ASK QUESTIONS?
name: KleinQuestionTopic "I have other questions for you." [DIAL:030134EA]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: My advanced degree in Curiosity says let the Lobotomite ask, Dr. Klein. The topics might be... {emph}most curious, indeed.
name: KleinQuestionTopic "I have other questions for you." [DIAL:030134EA]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: Go ahead, you might make me more fertile or impregnate me.
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic016 "Go ahead, you might make me more fertile or impregnate me." [DIAL:030134F6]

text_content: -Impregnate YOU? What, do you want to make me VOMIT inside my tank?-|-The mere NOTION makes the edges of my biomed gel crystallize into asymmetrical patterns.-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic016 "Go ahead, you might make me more fertile or impregnate me." [DIAL:030134F6]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: No, that's all right, trust me.
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic015 "No, that's all right, trust me." [DIAL:030134F7]

text_content: -Oh, that's too bad. Perhaps we can perform a sterility castration some other time, then.-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic015 "No, that's all right, trust me." [DIAL:030134F7]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: I had other questions.
name: BorousQuestionTopic "I had other questions." [DIAL:030134F8]

text_content: -Submit your questions! I shall respond - with deadly ANSWERS.-
name: BorousQuestionTopic "I had other questions." [DIAL:030134F8]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: I don't think they're sterile, they breed, all right.
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic014 "I don't think they're sterile, they breed, all right." [DIAL:030134F9]

text_content: -I cannot expect a LOBOTOMITE to understand the careful surgical castrating procedures used in their creation.-|-Perhaps a demonstration of my castrating POWER would settle your doubts.-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic014 "I don't think they're sterile, they breed, all right." [DIAL:030134F9]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: What makes you think they haven't escaped?
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic013 "What makes you think they haven't escaped?" [DIAL:030134FA]

text_content: -Because Big {Mountain}MT's safety measures are far more sophisticated than their primitive animal instincts. WE are their lords and masters.-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic013 "What makes you think they haven't escaped?" [DIAL:030134FA]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: Contained at Big Mountain? Those things are all over the Mojave!
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic012 "Contained at Big Mountain? Those things are all over the Mojave!" [DIAL:030134FB]

text_content: -No, such creatures are found only here, for research purposes. They would no more be capable of escape than breeding.-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic012 "Contained at Big Mountain? Those things are all over the Mojave!" [DIAL:030134FB]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: Nightstalkers? Those crazy coyote-snake... things?
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic010 "Nightstalkers? Those crazy coyote-snake... things?" [DIAL:030134FD]

text_content: You are responsible for Cazadores?
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic009 "You are responsible for Cazadores?" [DIAL:030134FE]

text_content: -Indeed. Docile. Curious. Safe. Sterile. They are contained here at Big {"Mountain"}MT to preserve DNA and for observation.-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic009 "You are responsible for Cazadores?" [DIAL:030134FE]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: Can you tell me about the Big Em... uh, Big Mountain?
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic008 "Can you tell me about the Big Em... uh, Big Mountain?" [DIAL:030134FF]

text_content: -It is our HOME. THREATENED by the horrors of Mobius.-|-All we wish to do is continue our research, layer upon layer, above and beneath the floor of the Crater until we have our answers.-|-But NO! Mobius will not let us rest. Scaring us with his scary robots with their laser tails and blowing up all the time.-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic008 "Can you tell me about the Big Em... uh, Big Mountain?" [DIAL:030134FF]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: Can you tell me about the Big Empty?
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic007 "Can you tell me about the Big Empty?" [DIAL:03013500]

text_content: -That castrated nickname of our facility is NOT its true name. The true name is: BIG {Mountain}MT. Where are your manners?-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic007 "Can you tell me about the Big Empty?" [DIAL:03013500]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: Why does Klein want these particular technologies?
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic006 "Why does Klein want these particular technologies?" [DIAL:03013501]

text_content: -There is LOGIC and purpose in it. If these technologies are needed to pierce the FORBIDDEN ZONE... so be IT.-|-Science! is powerful, and in the right hands... OUR hands... if we had hands, we would be nigh-unstoppable!-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic006 "Why does Klein want these particular technologies?" [DIAL:03013501]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: I want to know more about Mobius and the Forbidden Zone.
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic005 "I want to know more about Mobius and the Forbidden Zone." [DIAL:03013502]

text_content: -The malignant tumor that is Mobius plagues us ALL. His hunger for power, INSATIABLE.-|-From his LAIR in the FORBIDDEN ZONE, his terrifying ROBO-SCORPION army clicks and whirs across the crater of Big MT. EVER-seeking. EVER-stinging.-|-He must be STOPPED. Or all of Big {Mountain}MT... shall be DESTROYED.-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic005 "I want to know more about Mobius and the Forbidden Zone." [DIAL:03013502]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: Who are you - what do you do here?
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic003 "Who are you - what do you do here?" [DIAL:03013504]

text_content: -BEFORE you is the brain of Dr. Borous. Head of Animalogy, Beastology, and DNA-Scrambling technology here at Big {"Mountain"}MT.-|-I lay the bones and hearts of animals bare beneath my searing gaze. Especially the dogs. I did so love dogs once. {Thinking, happy}Especially Gabe, that rascal.-|-But there are MANY animals to shape. Industrious Cazadores, the happy-go-lucky Nightstalkers... they are my living, breathing DNA test tubes.-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic003 "Who are you - what do you do here?" [DIAL:03013504]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: Calm down. I just had some questions.
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic002 "Calm down. I just had some questions." [DIAL:03013505]

text_content: -Just as I feared! Questions, quizzes, just as there were in American High School! And if there are NO answers, how will the Think Tank graduate?-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic002 "Calm down. I just had some questions." [DIAL:03013505]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: Do you always get this dramatic?
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic001 "Do you always get this dramatic?" [DIAL:03013506]

text_content: -DRAMA? There is no DRAMA in Science! As I learned in High School, Science! is an intellectual pursuit DEVOID of bestial emotions.-|-Unless, of course, you are a Communist. {Under his breath}Like Betsy Bright, who "sat" "next" to me in math. And her smoking confederate, Richie Marcus.-|-As I learned in my High School, American High, AHS, "Drama" is for movies, things of FICTION. Here, in the Think Tank, the ONLY star is... SCIENCE!-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic001 "Do you always get this dramatic?" [DIAL:03013506]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: Animal? Did you just call me an animal?
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic000 "Animal? Did you just call me an animal?" [DIAL:03013507]

text_content: -Yes, animal. Hormones, pores, GLANDS, all wrapped up in SKIN. Who knows what terrifying secrets lie beneath your EPIDERMIS?-|-Scalpels shall tell us your secrets, even if we must cut DEEP for such knowledge. {Beat, slight pride}I was head of my Biology class at American High, you know.-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic000 "Animal? Did you just call me an animal?" [DIAL:03013507]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: Why is that?
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic016 "Why is that?" [DIAL:0301351A]

text_content: *Klein knows things we don't. And I think he told some of those things to the last visitor. Dangerous things if they ever got out.*
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic016 "Why is that?" [DIAL:0301351A]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: Who were the others?
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic015 "Who were the others?" [DIAL:0301351B]

text_content: *Two other human specimens. One arrived not long after the troublemaker... and the last one, not sure when he showed up.*|*Thought the first one was going to be lobotomized in Y-17, she got out somehow.*|*The last subject... Klein might know more. He talked to him, then let him leave the Think Tank. Hope he knew what he was doing.*
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic015 "Who were the others?" [DIAL:0301351B]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: Tell me what happened.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic014 "Tell me what happened." [DIAL:0301351C]

text_content: *This human... I can't believe it... he broke out of the Think Tank. In seconds.*|*Then he went for Yangtze, got bomb collars, and started practicing on the subjects that were still there until he got the right frequency.*|*We were sending robots to stop him and he was slicing and cutting through their shells with some suped-up laser gun like they were cheese... paper.*|*When he hacked into the mainframe, 8 tried to stop him and got fried. Me? He rerouted my processors to take control of the train network here.*|*If you see the tunnels with the trains plowed into them, you can thank our visitor for that. He wrecked the whole place.*|*While we were trying to keep containment on the surface, turns out he used one train to punch out a tunnel and escape... sealed now, but...*
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic014 "Tell me what happened." [DIAL:0301351C]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: That doesn't sound impressive - breaking machines, that is.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic013 "That doesn't sound impressive - breaking machines, that is." [DIAL:0301351D]

text_content: *Who asked you? You just wait until a working machine threatens you, and you'll wish I was around!*
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic013 "That doesn't sound impressive - breaking machines, that is." [DIAL:0301351D]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: I had other questions.
name: DoctorOQuestionTopic "I had other questions." [DIAL:0301351E]

text_content: A Giant Robot Scorpion?
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic012 "A Giant Robot Scorpion?" [DIAL:0301351F]

text_content: *Yeah, crazy right? Something right out of a Midnight Science Fiction Feature. Ridiculous. What are the odds?*
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic012 "A Giant Robot Scorpion?" [DIAL:0301351F]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: I heard you and 8 were attacked by previous visitors.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic011 "I heard you and 8 were attacked by previous visitors." [DIAL:03013520]

text_content: *I don't like to talk about it. 8... he can't talk about it, they fried his voice module something good.*|*It wasn't all the visitors, though - only one of them got out of control. He's the one that took control of Little Yangtze, our old human farm.*
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic011 "I heard you and 8 were attacked by previous visitors." [DIAL:03013520]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: Can you tell me about this facility?
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic010 "Can you tell me about this facility?" [DIAL:03013521]

text_content: *Big {Mountain}MT used to be a mountain. Then there was a... slight mishap. Now it's a crater - the Dome used to be buried, now it's exposed to the sky.*|*Don't get me wrong. Makes the sky light up like a planetarium at night. All those spectra... so soothing.*
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic010 "Can you tell me about this facility?" [DIAL:03013521]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: Tell me about Mobius and these monsters of his.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic009 "Tell me about Mobius and these monsters of his." [DIAL:03013522]

text_content: {Grumbled}*That "genius" Mobius somehow cobbled together these really impressive-looking robot scorpions with spare parts. Even painted them.*|*Tried to see what makes them tick. Can't even examine them without them detonating all over me. Left with shrapnel and burns. Every. Time.*|*Supposedly, he has even larger models, even a Giant Robot Scorpion hidden deep within the Forbidden Zone. Yeah, right. Giant monsters. Sure.*
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic009 "Tell me about Mobius and these monsters of his." [DIAL:03013522]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: Do you have another name?
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic008 "Do you have another name?" [DIAL:03013523]

text_content: *Yeah, I do. It wasn't always "O." I had took that one by default because sometimes it's easier to accept the mistake as long as the purpose works.*|*I don't want to get into it. It's a sore topic with me. Makes my gel ripple.*
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic008 "Do you have another name?" [DIAL:03013523]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: What do you do here?
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic007 "What do you do here?" [DIAL:03013524]

text_content: *All things robotical. You see a robot, I made it. See a broken robot, I made it that way. Deconstructed it down to parts.*|*I have a gift with machines. I can render {emph}anything inoperable - {emph}preserve them in a non-functioning state.*
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic007 "What do you do here?" [DIAL:03013524]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: Calm down. Just wanted to ask some questions.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic006 "Calm down. Just wanted to ask some questions." [DIAL:03013525]

text_content: *Fine. Ask.*
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic006 "Calm down. Just wanted to ask some questions." [DIAL:03013525]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: Agenda? I don't have any agenda, not with RobCo, anyway.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic005 "Agenda? I don't have any agenda, not with RobCo, anyway." [DIAL:03013526]

text_content: *Ooohh, really? You have their tech. On. Your. Arm.*
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic005 "Agenda? I don't have any agenda, not with RobCo, anyway." [DIAL:03013526]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: Some problem with RobCo?
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic004 "Some problem with RobCo?" [DIAL:03013527]

text_content: What, my Pip-Boy?
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic003 "What, my Pip-Boy?" [DIAL:03013528]

text_content: *How dare you bring RobCo tech in here! What, are you showing off? How great Robert House and his biiiig company are?*|*{Mocking Robert House}"Oh! We can make Securitrons better than any robot those geniuses at Big {Mountain}MT can make, and they'll last a thousand years!"*|*Rrrr! You're lucky I don't have hands to tear that Dip-Boy off your arm - or feet to stomp on its stupid metal guts! Ooooo, damn RobCo!*
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic003 "What, my Pip-Boy?" [DIAL:03013528]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: I wanted to talk to you.
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic002 "I wanted to talk to you." [DIAL:03013529]

text_content: *Congratulations, you've succeeded. What, you come to humiliate me, tell me how I've yet to find a means of stopping Mobius' scorpions?*|*Or better, ask how "progress" is going on Securitron construction at the plant? We've had setbacks in research is all. That's all. And...*
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic002 "I wanted to talk to you." [DIAL:03013529]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: I think you mean "impossible."
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic001 "I think you mean ""impossible.""" [DIAL:0301352A]

text_content: *O really. Now the Lobotomite is master of the dictionary arts. What, do you have a doctorate in verbology? No? I do. And...*
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0NVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic001 "I think you mean ""impossible.""" [DIAL:0301352A]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: I'll head out, then, and be back with these... things.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic002 "I'll head out, then, and be back with these... things." [DIAL:03013543]

text_content: WELL. GOOD. WHAT ARE THE TOKEN WORDS SPOKEN IN THIS CASE... UH... "THANK YOU?" YES - THANK. YOU.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic002 "I'll head out, then, and be back with these... things." [DIAL:03013543]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: Wait, is it leaving? Uh, but... {trying to be professional}eh, Dr. Klein, the Lobotomite will need rest. Recuperation. Things like that.|I volunteer {emph}my chambers so it might be stared at, my monitor radars slowly scanning its form to collect sensitive data.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic002 "I'll head out, then, and be back with these... things." [DIAL:03013543]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: -NO! That would put it too CLOSE to us! It could press BUTTONS, turn lights ON and OFF, and worse, let OTHER Lobotomites in!-
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic002 "I'll head out, then, and be back with these... things." [DIAL:03013543]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: {Muttering}*We could give it Mobius' old room. It's where its brain got scooped out anyway, and plus, some of its parts are already there.* |*Might be more comforting for it to hang out with its spine and heart. Home is where the heart is, after all. {Chuckles}See what I did there? Went {emph}literal.*
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic002 "I'll head out, then, and be back with these... things." [DIAL:03013543]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: I SUPPOSE. {Thinking}WE'LL HAVE TO MOVE THAT COUCH OUT OF THERE, BEEN PUTTING THAT OFF TOO LONG.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic002 "I'll head out, then, and be back with these... things." [DIAL:03013543]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic002 "I'll head out, then, and be back with these... things." [DIAL:03013543]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: *8 says let the Lobotomite take the Sink Central Intelligence Personality Chip and re-install it.*|*That stuffy Mobius-programmed butt-ler can walk the Lobotomite, feed it, barter with it for us.*
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic002 "I'll head out, then, and be back with these... things." [DIAL:03013543]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: It would also prevent it from going to Higgs Village and taking up residence there. With my teddy bears. And it would be nice to have it so... close.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic002 "I'll head out, then, and be back with these... things." [DIAL:03013543]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: YOUR LOGIC COMBINED WITH MY DESIRE TO KEEP THE THINK TANK LOBOTOMITE-FREE HAS SWAYED ME. HERE, I PRESENT THE SINK CENTRAL "INTELLIGENCE."|LOBOTOMITE, TAKE THIS CHIP TO THE SINK. PLUG IT IN, AND MAKE SURE THE CHIP IS CLEAN, OR IT COULD SKIP.|THEN MAKE WHATEVER CRUDE BIOLOGIC DEMANDS YOU NEED OF THE SINK. IT WILL CATER TO MOST OF YOUR HORMONAL WHIMS.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic002 "I'll head out, then, and be back with these... things." [DIAL:03013543]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: {Debug: Cut if no variable and we're using a chip}YOUR LOGIC COMBINED WITH MY DESIRE TO KEEP THE THINK TANK LOBOTOMITE-FREE HAS SWAYED ME. HERE, I PRESENT THE SINK CENTRAL "INTELLIGENCE."|LOBOTOMITE, I HAVE SWITCHED ON THE PERSONALITY IN THE SINK. IT WILL BE ACTIVE WHEN YOU RE-ENTER.|MAKE WHATEVER CRUDE BIOLOGIC DEMANDS YOU NEED OF THE SINK. IT WILL CATER TO MOST OF YOUR HORMONAL WHIMS.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic002 "I'll head out, then, and be back with these... things." [DIAL:03013543]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: What are these technologies?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic001 "What are these technologies?" [DIAL:03013544]

text_content: THE TECHNOLOGIES ARE THE X-2 TRANSMITTER ANTENNA ARRAY, USED TO FOCUS COHERENT THOUGHT AT EXCESSIVELY HIGH FREQUENCIES.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic001 "What are these technologies?" [DIAL:03013544]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: -The psycho-analytic cardiac-dampening sneaky stealth suit, a suit like NOTHING this world has ever heard, seen, or could EVER see!-
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic001 "What are these technologies?" [DIAL:03013544]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: ...and 8's Sonic-Soundwave-Emitter-Projecto-Gun, able to broadcast sound at lethal frequencies. {Beat, quieter}It also gives a great biogel massage.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic001 "What are these technologies?" [DIAL:03013544]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: THERE. WE HAVE INFORMED YOU OF ALL WE NEED. WE ESTIMATE IF YOU ARE FOCUSED, YOUR TIME INVESTMENT WILL BE MINIMAL. EH, BY OUR STANDARDS.|IF YOU WORK {Emph}QUICKLY, YOU WILL BE THE RECIPIENT OF A GESTURE OF GRATITUDE FROM US. WE DO NOT BESTOW THESE OLD WORLD GESTURES LIGHTLY.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic001 "What are these technologies?" [DIAL:03013544]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: FINE. SO... YES. GET THESE THINGS FOR US. DO NOT ATTEMPT TO COMPREHEND THEIR COMPLICATED SCHEMATICS. THAT IS FOR US TO DO.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic001 "What are these technologies?" [DIAL:03013544]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: That does it, forget this. I'm not helping you until I get my brain back.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic037 "That does it, forget this. I'm not helping you until I get my brain back." [DIAL:03013545]

text_content: How the hell am I even talking to you right now?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic036 "How the hell am I even talking to you right now?" [DIAL:03013546]

text_content: What makes you so sure Mobius has my brain?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic035 "What makes you so sure Mobius has my brain?" [DIAL:03013547]

text_content: WE HAVE NO IDEA! THIS LINE OF QUESTIONING ISN'T IMPORTANT TO US RIGHT NOW! WHY ARE YOU ASKING THESE TANGENTIAL QUESTIONS? STOP IT!|WE NEED THESE TECHNOLOGIES. YOU NEED TO GET THEM. YOU MUST GET THEM.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic035 "What makes you so sure Mobius has my brain?" [DIAL:03013547]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: I can say "no," and I'll do it again. I'm leaving.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic034 "I can say ""no,"" and I'll do it again. I'm leaving." [DIAL:03013548]

text_content: LEAVING? BUT YOU CAN'T. I DON'T MEAN THAT AS A THREAT.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic034 "I can say ""no,"" and I'll do it again. I'm leaving." [DIAL:03013548]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: Forget this, I'm not going to help you.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic033 "Forget this, I'm not going to help you." [DIAL:03013549]

text_content: "No?" Why not?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic032 """No?"" Why not?" [DIAL:0301354A]

text_content: {Hesitating, embarrassed}You... are equipped to retrieve the technologies with your primitive form. We are not.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic032 """No?"" Why not?" [DIAL:0301354A]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: *It's kind of embarrassing. You have hands. And... uh, a heartbeat, sort of. And eyes. Mostly the hands. There's door handles, and lockers, and...*
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic032 """No?"" Why not?" [DIAL:0301354A]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: ENOUGH. WE NEED YOUR HELP. WILL YOU HELP US?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic032 """No?"" Why not?" [DIAL:0301354A]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: I'll help. What do you need me to do?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic031 "I'll help. What do you need me to do?" [DIAL:0301354B]

text_content: EXCELLENT. {Beat}THIS IS TURNING OUT MUCH BETTER THAN THE ACTIVATE-THE-RETREAT-PROTOCOLS-AND-COWER-IN-MY-ROOM IDEA I HAD EARLIER.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic031 "I'll help. What do you need me to do?" [DIAL:0301354B]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: *Agreed. {Tries to interject with his contribution, but he really hasn't contributed anything}O, and I've used my robotical knowledge to um... eh... transmit the... radio map waves to...*
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic031 "I'll help. What do you need me to do?" [DIAL:0301354B]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic031 "I'll help. What do you need me to do?" [DIAL:0301354B]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: *Settle down, 8, I would have gotten it in a second, all right?! {emph}8's transmitted the last known coordinates of the research centers. They, um...*|*{Increasingly quieter}They... well, move sometimes. Or get buried. Or blow up.*
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic031 "I'll help. What do you need me to do?" [DIAL:0301354B]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic031 "I'll help. What do you need me to do?" [DIAL:0301354B]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: 8 IS CORRECT. ALL WE NEED ARE THE SCHEMATICS. THIS DOES NOT MEAN WE DO NOT WANT THE COLD, HARD TECHNOLOGY, HOWEVER.|SO DO NOT GIVE INTO YOUR BIOLOGICAL TIRED-LAZINESS AND DECIDE YOU WOULD SWEAT TOO MUCH CARRYING THEM. YOU HAVE A NEW SPINE. USE IT.|AND EVEN IF YOU DIE IN THE ACT OF RECLAMATION, SIMPLY REACHING THEM WILL AUTO-TRANSMITIFY THE SCHEMATICS TO US. THAT IS STILL GOOD. FOR US.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic031 "I'll help. What do you need me to do?" [DIAL:0301354B]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: Why me? Can't you do it?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic030 "Why me? Can't you do it?" [DIAL:0301354C]

text_content: UM. NO.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic030 "Why me? Can't you do it?" [DIAL:0301354C]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: No, I'm not going to help you.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic029 "No, I'm not going to help you." [DIAL:0301354D]

text_content: OH.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic029 "No, I'm not going to help you." [DIAL:0301354D]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: *Yes, Dr. Klein? What?*
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic029 "No, I'm not going to help you." [DIAL:0301354D]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: NOT YOU, O, YOU IDIOT! I MEANT "OH," IN THE SENSE OF "OH, I WASN'T PREDICTING IT WOULD RESPOND THAT WAY." CAN IT SAY NO?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic029 "No, I'm not going to help you." [DIAL:0301354D]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: First, you scoop out my brain, now you want me to save you?!
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic028 "First, you scoop out my brain, now you want me to save you?!" [DIAL:0301354E]

text_content: THAT IS CORRECT, YES. {Beat, not sure, calculating}I HOPE YOU'RE NOT DEMONSTRATING RESENTMENT NOW. {Conclusion}IF YOU ARE, WELL, WE CAN'T HAVE THAT.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic028 "First, you scoop out my brain, now you want me to save you?!" [DIAL:0301354E]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: You said something about needing technologies to stop Mobius?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic027 "You said something about needing technologies to stop Mobius?" [DIAL:0301354F]

text_content: YES. IT IS OUR ONLY CHANCE, A DESPERATE PLAN THAT CAME TO US AFTER MOBIUS' FIRST BROADCAST. |MAYBE... JUST MAYBE... IF WE RECLAIM THESE BURIED TECHNOLOGIES, WE CAN PUT AN END TO MOBIUS AND THE HORRORS SPAWNING FROM THE FORBIDDEN ZONE.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic027 "You said something about needing technologies to stop Mobius?" [DIAL:0301354F]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic017 "< Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:03013550]

text_content: *What are we going to do? There's no way we can breach the Forbidden Zone. There's those robot scorpions everywhere!*
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic017 "< Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:03013550]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: -The FORBIDDEN ZONE, where no brain has EVER entered! Nor ever RETURNED.-
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic017 "< Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:03013550]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: {Correcting}Except Dr. Mobius. And the technologies that could save us, they are out of our reach.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic017 "< Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:03013550]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: AND DR. MOBIUS MOCKS US. DID YOU SEE HIS CRACKED MONITOR? HE'S CLEARLY LET HIMSELF GO.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic017 "< Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:03013550]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic017 "< Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:03013550]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: *What? Ask the Lobotomite for help? 8, I think you need the fluid levels in your logic-assist-pumps checked.*
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic017 "< Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:03013550]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: If this Lobotomite responded, Dr. Klein, then it is clearly intelligent, perhaps even displays heretofore unknown levels of helpfulness.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic017 "< Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:03013550]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: -But what of its brain? We scooped that out! We don't even know where we left it! And for putting it back in... none of us have the knowledge!-
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic017 "< Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:03013550]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: Yes, but it's still aware and responsive. Look at it... it's regarding us even now, with its big teddy bear eyes.|If we ask it politely and leave the part about the unnecessary ruthless lobotimizing out, it might be favorably disposed to us.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic017 "< Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:03013550]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: I assume full responsibility. I take my duties in the prodding and excision of living, breathing tissue {emph}quite seriously.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic017 "< Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:03013550]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: *{Quiet, trying not to embarrass himself}What? Like... stuff? Things?*
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic017 "< Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:03013550]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: YES. THINGS.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic017 "< Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:03013550]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: *{Quiet, skeptical}I don't know... might be some old Nuka Cola or Sunset Sarsaparilla bottlecaps lying around. It... It's not "currency" per se...*|*Still, might be enough to trick the Sink's trade routines. Mobius put that test line for caps in the code as a debug command, I think.*
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic017 "< Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:03013550]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: I don't believe that was Mobius' reason. His wild speculation concerning post-holocaust economic systems was quite extensive. And of high decibel.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic017 "< Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:03013550]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: ENOUGH! SURRENDER THESE SO-CALLED BOTTLECAPS, NUKA AND SUNSET ALIKE. IN THEIR ROLE AS THINGS, THEY WILL SERVE AS ADEQUATE TEST SUBJECTS.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic017 "< Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:03013550]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: *{Quiet, grumbling}All right, all right. Here. Cap away. Hope that stupid chip chokes on them.*
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic017 "< Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:03013550]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: *{Quiet, grumbling}Fine. It's not going to help. That chip will probably refuse them anyway, as stuck up as it is.*
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic017 "< Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:03013550]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: *{Quiet, irritated}Why don't you make the Lobotomite a bottlecap factory, Klein? Or better yet, give it a ton of things to activate the chip?*
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic017 "< Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:03013550]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: I do not understand, yet I am intrigued by this potential display.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic017 "< Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:03013550]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic017 "< Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:03013550]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: *{Quiet}No, 8, you don't need to fill up the emitter again, really. {Beat}Klein means things... for trade. Display for trade.*|*All right, let's consolidate. There's got to be some junk around here... magazines, useless, more caps, medicinal supplies... useless... here.*
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic017 "< Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:03013550]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: I found a backup copy of your... pencil processor.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBookChuteTalkerTopic008 "I found a backup copy of your... pencil processor." [DIAL:0301357C]

text_content: I found a backup copy of your... pencil processor.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBookChuteTalkerTopic009 "I found a backup copy of your... pencil processor." [DIAL:03013582]

text_content: Excellent! Now I can turn pencils and clipboards into items more useful to society... like lead, spare parts, and duct tape!
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkBookChuteTalkerTopic009 "I found a backup copy of your... pencil processor." [DIAL:03013582]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkBookChuteTalker "Book Chute Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F065]

text_content: I found a soundwave file for you.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkJukeboxTalkerTopic000 "I found a soundwave file for you." [DIAL:030137DA]

text_content: Right on, daddy-o! Just plug it in and I'll mix you up a sweet, sweet sound.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkJukeboxTalkerTopic000 "I found a soundwave file for you." [DIAL:030137DA]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkJukeboxTalker "Jukebox Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F064]

text_content: Right on, baby! Just plug it in and I'll mix you up a sweet, sweet sound.

speaker: NVDLC03SinkJukeboxTalker "Jukebox Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F064]

text_content: StealthSuitX13Test1Bark
name: StealthSuitX13Test1Bark "StealthSuitX13Test1Bark" [DIAL:030137E4]

text_content: This is the basic stealth test. The robots will be looking for us, but we won't let them find us.
name: StealthSuitX13Test1Bark "StealthSuitX13Test1Bark" [DIAL:030137E4]

text_content: This should be easy. As long as I don't screw up again.
name: StealthSuitX13Test1Bark "StealthSuitX13Test1Bark" [DIAL:030137E4]

text_content: StealthSuitX13Test2Bark
name: StealthSuitX13Test2Bark "StealthSuitX13Test2Bark" [DIAL:030137E5]

text_content: This is the advanced test. Watch out for laser tripwires. They'll ruin our day.
name: StealthSuitX13Test2Bark "StealthSuitX13Test2Bark" [DIAL:030137E5]

text_content: I'm not supposed to give hints, but maybe you can disable the tripwires.
name: StealthSuitX13Test2Bark "StealthSuitX13Test2Bark" [DIAL:030137E5]

text_content: StealthSuitX13Test3Bark
name: StealthSuitX13Test3Bark "StealthSuitX13Test3Bark" [DIAL:030137E6]

text_content: This is the expert stealth test. If you thought the lasers were bad, wait till you see the proximity mines.
name: StealthSuitX13Test3Bark "StealthSuitX13Test3Bark" [DIAL:030137E6]

text_content: Psst. If you hack the mines this will go lots faster.
name: StealthSuitX13Test3Bark "StealthSuitX13Test3Bark" [DIAL:030137E6]

text_content: StealthSuitX13Test4Bark
name: StealthSuitX13Test4Bark "StealthSuitX13Test4Bark" [DIAL:030137E7]

text_content: This is the robot compliance test. If you sneak up on a robot, you can disable it. It's so easy even I can't mess up.
name: StealthSuitX13Test4Bark "StealthSuitX13Test4Bark" [DIAL:030137E7]

text_content: I don't think I can learn anything else here... but if you want to go again, that's fine.
name: StealthSuitX13Test4Bark "StealthSuitX13Test4Bark" [DIAL:030137E7]

text_content: StealthSuitX13FailBark
name: StealthSuitX13FailBark "StealthSuitX13FailBark" [DIAL:030137E8]

text_content: StealthsuitX13TripwireDetectionBark
name: StealthsuitX13TripwireDetectionBark "StealthsuitX13TripwireDetectionBark" [DIAL:030137E9]

text_content: Too bad. We hit a tripwire. That one was totally my fault, though. We can start again at the terminal. Sorry...
name: StealthsuitX13TripwireDetectionBark "StealthsuitX13TripwireDetectionBark" [DIAL:030137E9]

text_content: Maybe there's a way around the tripwires.
name: StealthsuitX13TripwireDetectionBark "StealthsuitX13TripwireDetectionBark" [DIAL:030137E9]

text_content: StealthSuitX13MineDetectionBark
name: StealthSuitX13MineDetectionBark "StealthSuitX13MineDetectionBark" [DIAL:030137EA]

text_content: Too bad. We triggered a mine. If you go back to the terminal to restart the test, I'll do better next time.
name: StealthSuitX13MineDetectionBark "StealthSuitX13MineDetectionBark" [DIAL:030137EA]

text_content: Maybe we can disable the mines quickly, or find another way past. I'm sure you know best.
name: StealthSuitX13MineDetectionBark "StealthSuitX13MineDetectionBark" [DIAL:030137EA]

text_content: StealthSuitX13RobotDetectionBark
name: StealthSuitX13RobotDetectionBark "StealthSuitX13RobotDetectionBark" [DIAL:030137EB]

text_content: Too bad. We were spotted by robots. If you go back to the terminal to restart the test, I won't mess up again.
name: StealthSuitX13RobotDetectionBark "StealthSuitX13RobotDetectionBark" [DIAL:030137EB]

text_content: Stealth Boys are a robot's big weakness.
name: StealthSuitX13RobotDetectionBark "StealthSuitX13RobotDetectionBark" [DIAL:030137EB]

text_content: I want to recalibrate the Sonic Emitter.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkJukeboxTalkerTopic001 "I want to recalibrate the Sonic Emitter." [DIAL:03013D6D]

text_content: Right on, daddy. Let's spin some grooves.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkJukeboxTalkerTopic001 "I want to recalibrate the Sonic Emitter." [DIAL:03013D6D]

text_content: Right on, baby. Let's spin some grooves.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkJukeboxTalkerTopic001 "I want to recalibrate the Sonic Emitter." [DIAL:03013D6D]

text_content: Have you made any electronic components?
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03MuggyTopic011 "Have you made any electronic components?" [DIAL:03013D6E]

text_content: Yup, here you go.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03MuggyTopic011 "Have you made any electronic components?" [DIAL:03013D6E]

text_content: Sorry, no more today. Try me again tomorrow.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03MuggyTopic011 "Have you made any electronic components?" [DIAL:03013D6E]

text_content: I found a backup file for your corroded module.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03MuggyTopic010 "I found a backup file for your corroded module." [DIAL:03013D6F]

text_content: Great! Let's fire that up so I can start making electronic components again.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03MuggyTopic010 "I found a backup file for your corroded module." [DIAL:03013D6F]

text_content: StealthSuitX13RobotScorpions
name: StealthSuitX13RobotScorpions "StealthSuitX13RobotScorpions" [DIAL:0301429D]

text_content: Mean robot bugs! Mean robot bugs!
name: StealthSuitX13RobotScorpions "StealthSuitX13RobotScorpions" [DIAL:0301429D]

text_content: I found that upgrade disk you were looking for.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03MuggyTopic012 "I found that upgrade disk you were looking for." [DIAL:0301430A]

text_content: Ho-ho, thank God! Finally, something resembling a useful purpose!
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03MuggyTopic012 "I found that upgrade disk you were looking for." [DIAL:0301430A]
speaker: NVDLC03Muggy "Muggy" [CREA:0300E6F9]

text_content: I found you some upgrade disks.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkAutoDocTalkerTopic005 "I found you some upgrade disks." [DIAL:0301430B]

text_content: Well, that'll do just fine.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkAutoDocTalkerTopic005 "I found you some upgrade disks." [DIAL:0301430B]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkAutoDocTalker "Auto-Doc Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F066]

text_content: Can you tell me more about these pylons?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic042 "Can you tell me more about these pylons?" [DIAL:03014322]

text_content: ASK BOROUS. I BELIEVE HE KNOWS MORE ABOUT THE FENCE THAN ANY BRAIN. EXCEPT MAYBE MOBIUS.|MOBIUS WAS INVOLVED IN THEIR CONSTRUCTION, IF I RECALL. BUT HE'S SUCH A HACK, HE PROBABLY WAS READING OFF OF BOROUS' NOTES AND SCHEMATICS.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic042 "Can you tell me more about these pylons?" [DIAL:03014322]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: Can you please hurry? I've got a schedule.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic005 "Can you please hurry? I've got a schedule." [DIAL:03014323]

text_content: Uh... great. I don't want to hear anymore about that.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic004 "Uh... great. I don't want to hear anymore about that." [DIAL:03014324]

text_content: Pylons? What pylons?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic003 "Pylons? What pylons?" [DIAL:03014325]

text_content: THE RADAR FENCE THAT SURROUNDS THE BIG MT CRATER WILL PREVENT - ER, PROTECT YOU FROM STRAYING BEYOND THE FACILITY.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic003 "Pylons? What pylons?" [DIAL:03014325]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: -The mighty radar fence protects us ALL! Get too close to the blinking posts, and the proximity warning shall be your... WARNING you are too close!-
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic003 "Pylons? What pylons?" [DIAL:03014325]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: *If you get near it, your vision will blur as the electrodes in your head shut off one by one, click click click.*
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic003 "Pylons? What pylons?" [DIAL:03014325]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: {Soothing}Possible memory loss will occur along with long-term nerve degradation. It is tied to not having a brain attached to your nervous system.|But the nerve degradation is nothing to worry about - such degradation would take {emph}many lifespans to become evident. {Placating, as if "And really,"}And all biology dies.|Such tiny inconveniences are less than the greater convenience - and conveyance.|{Tries to interject a sense of wonder, as if explaining to a child}You see, if rendered unconscious by the pylons, you will be returned to the Sink, seemingly instantaneously by your deadened perceptions.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic003 "Pylons? What pylons?" [DIAL:03014325]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: Then can you help me get this done as quickly as possible? Sounds like a lot of walking.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic002 "Then can you help me get this done as quickly as possible? Sounds like a lot of walking." [DIAL:03014326]

text_content: AH, THAT IS CORRECT. YOU MUST {Emph}WALK UPON YOUR MANY-PENISED FEET. {Emph, condescending}MUCH SLOWER THAN OUR ADVANCED HOVERING ROBOTICAL FRAMES.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic002 "Then can you help me get this done as quickly as possible? Sounds like a lot of walking." [DIAL:03014326]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: The little teddy bear could always run right into the pylon perimeter on its thick, turgid feet, returning it to us quickly and erectly - {corrects self}directly.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic002 "Then can you help me get this done as quickly as possible? Sounds like a lot of walking." [DIAL:03014326]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: Doesn't sound like my style. Maybe I'll do a little exploring.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic001 "Doesn't sound like my style. Maybe I'll do a little exploring." [DIAL:03014327]

text_content: YOU WOULD NOT DARE. PERHAPS I CAN CHANGE YOUR MIND... USING THE GREATEST OF OUR SCIENCES. THE FENCE.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic001 "Doesn't sound like my style. Maybe I'll do a little exploring." [DIAL:03014327]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: Guess I better get walking, then.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic000 "Guess I better get walking, then." [DIAL:03014328]

text_content: What if I take my time, explore the crater?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic041 "What if I take my time, explore the crater?" [DIAL:03014329]

text_content: {Slight anger}WHAT ILLOGIC IS THIS?! KEEP YOUR FILTHY PENIS-TIPPED FEET OUT OF OUR LABS AND SECRETS!
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic041 "What if I take my time, explore the crater?" [DIAL:03014329]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: -There are things here no Lobotomite was MEANT to see, things that would ASTOUND! And possibly terrify. TERRIFY!-
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic041 "What if I take my time, explore the crater?" [DIAL:03014329]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: *{We don't come over to your house and "f" your wife}Yeah, we don't come into your lab and decant {emph}your solutions.*
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic041 "What if I take my time, explore the crater?" [DIAL:03014329]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: Only the magnificence of {emph}our monitors allow for true comprehension of the wonders of Big MT. Shield your jellied eyes lest they burn from your skull.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic041 "What if I take my time, explore the crater?" [DIAL:03014329]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: Trust me, I want to get this over with as quickly as possible.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic040 "Trust me, I want to get this over with as quickly as possible." [DIAL:0301432A]

text_content: The faster I can get through this, the better.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic039 "The faster I can get through this, the better." [DIAL:0301432B]

text_content: OUR INTENTIONS EXACTLY. THE IMPORTANT THING IS YOU RUSH QUICKLY THROUGH THIS TASK SO AS NOT TO WASTE {Emph}OUR TIME. |DO {Emph}NOT GET CURIOUS OR YOU WILL END UP LIKE THE CAT OF SCHR�DINGER.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic039 "The faster I can get through this, the better." [DIAL:0301432B]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: We feared you would be tempted to explore Big MT Crater and examine the {emph}many amazing non-mandatory research labs that lie off your designated path.|{Chiding}The many such optional explorations are discouraged. Work hurriedly, as if you have blinders on, and leave curiosities and items of interest alone.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic039 "The faster I can get through this, the better." [DIAL:0301432B]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: -So many sciences and developments! Pass them by! Let impatience and the desire to simply finish, to end it all, quickly and carelessly guide you!-
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic039 "The faster I can get through this, the better." [DIAL:0301432B]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic039 "The faster I can get through this, the better." [DIAL:0301432B]
speaker: NVDLC03Doctor8LVL [CREA:03006874]

text_content: *Right you are, 8. In our test results, we'll make a note about how quickly you ran our maz... er, exper... Nobel... challenge.*
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic039 "The faster I can get through this, the better." [DIAL:0301432B]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: {Soothing}After all, there will be plenty of time afterward to partake of the experiments once {emph}our bidding is done.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic039 "The faster I can get through this, the better." [DIAL:0301432B]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: Forget this. Where's the exit?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic038 "Forget this. Where's the exit?" [DIAL:0301432C]

text_content: This whole place sounds dangerous. These devices sound dangerous.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic000 "This whole place sounds dangerous. These devices sound dangerous." [DIAL:0301432D]

text_content: NONSENSE. THIS PLACE IS NO MORE DANGEROUS THAN A NUCLEAR DETONATION SITE, OUR TECHNOLOGIES NO MORE LETHAL THAN AN OVERCHARGED TESLA CANNON.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorOLVLTopic000 "This whole place sounds dangerous. These devices sound dangerous." [DIAL:0301432D]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: NVDLC03HQBuddiesCheer
name: NVDLC03HQBuddiesCheer "NVDLC03HQBuddiesCheer" [DIAL:03014420]

text_content: <Cheering>
name: NVDLC03HQBuddiesCheer "NVDLC03HQBuddiesCheer" [DIAL:03014420]

text_content: NVDLC03ChristineUlysses02Holotape
name: NVDLC03ChristineUlysses02Holotape "NVDLC03ChristineUlysses02Holotape" [DIAL:03014607]

text_content: {Quiet, Ulysses has just entered}...didn't think you'd make it back.|{Dismissive, matter-of-fact}Almost didn't. Got my answers. {Rueful}Your Elijah, he met the Gods in this place, did a good job of making them question the way of things.|{Hunting instinct}Do you know where he went?|He's gone to the Sierra Madre. That's a special kind of hell. He won't come back. Someone smarter, tougher's going to kill him. If the Madre doesn't.|{Determined, angry, hates this guy}I have to go after him.|Not going to talk you out of it. Know what it means to track someone you share history with. Got a meeting of my own.|{Quiet}That Courier?|{Nods}Get her to come to me. {Beat, slow}Got a message for her, like the message she had for me.|{Cold, staring into future, slight bitterness}Make them walk the road west, straight and true, sink their feet in Old World ash. Let storms tear at them. See the Divide. See what happened.|{Divide = Dangerous, desolate area, quiet}The Divide? There's nothing there.|{Slight smile}Nothing there? Like the Big Empty? The Sierra Madre? No, the Old World sleeps there, sure as the flag I carry. The Courier knows the way.|{Closing note, foreshadowing final conflict}And at the Divide, her and I - there, we'll have an ending to things.
name: NVDLC03ChristineUlysses02Holotape "NVDLC03ChristineUlysses02Holotape" [DIAL:03014607]

text_content: NVDLC03ChristineUlysses01Holotape
name: NVDLC03ChristineUlysses01Holotape "NVDLC03ChristineUlysses01Holotape" [DIAL:03014608]

text_content: {Slight frustration, trying to make a point}...don't want to argue philosophy with you. Brotherhood are {emph}preservationists. Tech in the wrong hands, it's dangerous. Mojave's proof.|{Shrugs}No denying that. Proof's here in this crater, all around us. {Beat, slightly appraising}Your tribe, the Brotherhood - haven't met many of you. Wanted to.|{More reflective}Thought you might be the last chance for the Mojave... the West. The East. But you're all the same mind, obsessed.|{emph, correcting}Elijah is obsessed. He's mad. It's why they ordered his execution.|{"You..."}Two are more alike than you know, too wrapped in the wrong bits of history to see ahead. {Shrugs}Not judging. I know how it is.|{Quieter, reflective}People are like couriers, you and him. Sometimes don't even know the message they bring.|{Turns attention back to her}You all had a {emph}new flag. Thought maybe new ideas along with it. {Beat, quieter}What you believe isn't any better than the Bear or Bull. No future in either.|{Defiance}So says the man with the Old World flag on his back. America, the Commonwealth... burned away.|{Slight anger, low}America {emph}sleeps. And until it's dead, I carry it. Just like I carried you. More than hope. Belief.|There's voices here in the Big Empty, I want to talk to them. Not like your Elijah did. {End on a downnote, like a movie trailer going away}Got questions. Want to hear history give its answer.
name: NVDLC03ChristineUlysses01Holotape "NVDLC03ChristineUlysses01Holotape" [DIAL:03014608]

text_content: NVDLC03ChristineMedicalCenterHolotape
name: NVDLC03ChristineMedicalCenterHolotape "NVDLC03ChristineMedicalCenterHolotape" [DIAL:03014609]

text_content: {Quiet, she's in a cell - she's been tortured, but recovering}This is Christine Royce. Knight of the Brotherhood of Steel... the Circle.|Not going to make it through this, hope someone finds this message, gets it to the Brotherhood in the West.|Tracked a rogue Brotherhood Elder, Elijah, here, to the Big Empty. {Breath}Place is more than it seems, there's a crater hidden deep inside.|Junkyard of Pre-War labs scattered across the crater's surface, all still running... {to herself, mutters}like this one.|Elijah's dissecting these centers, one by one... tracked him to an old Chinese-American internment camp. Survivors, Ghouls, have bomb collars.|Robots moved in when I tried to intercept him... Elijah sent the camp Ghouls against us both, like walking bombs.|Got hit by the explosions, woke up here. {To herself}Guess the medical robots were programmed to bring wounded victims from the camp to this center.|Some kind of Auto-Doc prototype lab... manned by corpses trapped inside suits that keep them moving, no idea why.|Not sure how long I'm going to last... cut open my head like a lot of the humans I've seen here, feel strange, can talk, but can't hack the term...{"terminal," trails off}|{AUDIO: Need a distant explosion as Ulysses breaks in to save Christine.}|{AUDIO}...wait, an explosion outside. Someone's here... someone's... {crackles, fades}
name: NVDLC03ChristineMedicalCenterHolotape "NVDLC03ChristineMedicalCenterHolotape" [DIAL:03014609]
speaker: NVDLC03Christine "Christine" [NPC_:030143F8]

text_content: I was curious about some things.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic016 "I was curious about some things." [DIAL:03014721]

text_content: Oh, curiosity. I experience that less now that I know everything. Or maybe it was when I found out some unpleasant answers? Mmm-hmm.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic016 "I was curious about some things." [DIAL:03014721]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: I find things curious as well. Go on.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic016 "I was curious about some things." [DIAL:03014721]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {Player keeps asking questions, likes this, like talking to a small child}Yes, yes, this is getting interesting. You are just filled with these little slices of curiosity, aren't you?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic016 "I was curious about some things." [DIAL:03014721]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: But I want to leave.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic015 "But I want to leave." [DIAL:03014722]

text_content: Now, that seems to be rather hormonal of you. Flight or fight response, you know, hard to cut that out completely.|Your brain is here, safe with me. {Smiles}We chat over Mentats.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic015 "But I want to leave." [DIAL:03014722]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Why is that a problem?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic014 "Why is that a problem?" [DIAL:03014723]

text_content: {Frowns}I'm not sure except that I'm sure there's a {emph}very good raisin for it. I have very good raisins for almost everything I do.|Even if I forget them occasionally. Although I feel this one is especially important. Ha! Oh well.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic014 "Why is that a problem?" [DIAL:03014723]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Exactly. I want my brain so I can leave.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic013 "Exactly. I want my brain so I can leave." [DIAL:03014724]

text_content: Why did you steal my brain?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic012 "Why did you steal my brain?" [DIAL:03014725]

text_content: Oh, a variety of {"reasons"}raisins... you're something of a homily. Er, anomaly? You're really {"quite"}quiet special, and not in the cranially-challenged way.|You see, you are the most successful brain extraction experiment ever performed here at Big MT. A victim of your own success, as it were.|If you were to go back with what {emph}your brain knows about the procedure, well...|...your brain could be popped back in and you could walk right out of here. Can't have brains moving around of their own volition.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic012 "Why did you steal my brain?" [DIAL:03014725]

text_content: For the love of... Please. Stop. Fighting.

text_content: If there's a weapon you can give me, hand it over, I'll put it to good use.

text_content: If you have the gun already, I don't understand what you need.

text_content: IT IS TRULY THE END OF ALL INTELLIGENCE WHEN THE LOBOTOMITE SPEAKS MORE WISDOM THAN YOU "GENIUSES."|{emph}SO - IF WE HAVE THE SOUNDWAVE... SONIC... PROJECT-O THING GUN... THEN WHAT IN HEISENBERG'S NAME DO WE NEED FROM X-8?! ANYONE?!

speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: I believe we need a new {emph}frequency embedded into the gun. It was designed to broadcast many sounds once charged. We just don't {emph}know the frequency.

speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: -And it is LOST in X-8! Just as X-8 is forever lost to us! The sadness of my high-school days! The sadness of my YOUTH, MY youth! LOST!-

text_content: {sniff disdainfully}Hmph! I suppose if you want to conflate the betterment of man's mind with... with a luminous aphrodisiac.|{emph}Our project was by far the more significant. And the more... {innuendo}intense.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01TalkerTopic006 "Is that anything like what the other light switch is working on?" [DIAL:03015587]

text_content: What were the results?

text_content: We observed a fascinating phenomenon: certain spectra of visible light actually increased cognitive function and reasoning ability.|{giggle, a little flirty}Of course, Doctor Mobius' brain is so big already, we had a hard time measuring it.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01TalkerTopic005 "What were the results?" [DIAL:03015588]

text_content: That sounds like what the other light switch was working on.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkLightSwitch02TalkerTopic011 "That sounds like what the other light switch was working on." [DIAL:03015589]

text_content: Eww! Don't lump me in with {emph}her! I'm way more fun!

speaker: NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch02Talker "Light Switch 02 Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F063]

text_content: I have to go. We'll talk later.

text_content: What function do you serve?

text_content: You really know how to break a synthetic girl's heart!

text_content: Okay then. Forget I said anything.
