name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic022 "Come on, we have a duty to the Wasteland, we have to get out of here!" [DIAL:03015750]

text_content: There go those glands again. Is the endorphin rush you get from doing the right thing really that good?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic022 "Come on, we have a duty to the Wasteland, we have to get out of here!" [DIAL:03015750]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: What's it going to take to convince you?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic021 "What's it going to take to convince you?" [DIAL:03015751]

text_content: I'd like to find a nice little place to live, maybe in Goodsprings, and settle down where we won't get shot at. Not as often, at any rate.|But since that doesn't seem likely... what's your plan?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic021 "What's it going to take to convince you?" [DIAL:03015751]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: I don't recall giving you a choice. Let's go.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic020 "I don't recall giving you a choice. Let's go." [DIAL:03015752]

text_content: While the brute force approach is a lovely one, really, it won't work.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic020 "I don't recall giving you a choice. Let's go." [DIAL:03015752]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Even if I wanted to settle myself back in your skull and go to all the trouble of reconnecting nerve endings, Dr. Mobius doesn't have the tools here.|We would have to make use of Dr. Klein's lab, and I rather doubt the brains are inclined to share.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic020 "I don't recall giving you a choice. Let's go." [DIAL:03015752]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Never mind. I want to talk about something else.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic019 "Never mind. I want to talk about something else." [DIAL:03015753]

text_content: Of course you do. How... scintillating.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic019 "Never mind. I want to talk about something else." [DIAL:03015753]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Maybe not, but it got your attention, didn't it?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic018 "Maybe not, but it got your attention, didn't it?" [DIAL:03015754]

text_content: I suppose it did. {Acid}Bravo, you've managed to intimidate a brain in a jar.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic018 "Maybe not, but it got your attention, didn't it?" [DIAL:03015754]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: I would. And I'd follow it up with an alcohol-and-ant-nectar cocktail every night.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic017 "I would. And I'd follow it up with an alcohol-and-ant-nectar cocktail every night." [DIAL:03015755]

text_content: You're a monster! A deranged, self-destructive monster!
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic017 "I would. And I'd follow it up with an alcohol-and-ant-nectar cocktail every night." [DIAL:03015755]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Don't tempt me, brain.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic016 "Don't tempt me, brain." [DIAL:03015756]

text_content: {Sulking}Fine. I'll try to respect you more. Sir.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic016 "Don't tempt me, brain." [DIAL:03015756]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: {Sulking}Fine. I'll try to respect you more. Ma'am.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic016 "Don't tempt me, brain." [DIAL:03015756]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Fine, never mind.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic015 "Fine, never mind." [DIAL:03015757]

text_content: {Smug}Yes, I rather thought so.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic015 "Fine, never mind." [DIAL:03015757]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Once you're back in my head, I'll watch television. Lots. And lots. Of television.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic014 "Once you're back in my head, I'll watch television. Lots. And lots. Of television." [DIAL:03015758]

text_content: {Actually scared for once}You... you wouldn't! That's inhuman!
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic014 "Once you're back in my head, I'll watch television. Lots. And lots. Of television." [DIAL:03015758]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: I could smash this tank you're in. How about that?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic013 "I could smash this tank you're in. How about that?" [DIAL:03015759]

text_content: By all means, if the idea of spending the rest of your days as a true Lobotomite appeals to you.|Actually, come to think of it, you probably wouldn't mind that, would you?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic013 "I could smash this tank you're in. How about that?" [DIAL:03015759]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: We'll revisit this topic later.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic012 "We'll revisit this topic later." [DIAL:0301575A]

text_content: Oh yes, I rather expect we will. We'll be having a {emph}very long talk about crawling through old ruins, haring off on missions of revenge. {Beat, these are the worst of all}And Cazadores.|Oh yes, we'll talk a lot about {emph}them.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic012 "We'll revisit this topic later." [DIAL:0301575A]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: I didn't realize it caused you so much distress.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic011 "I didn't realize it caused you so much distress." [DIAL:0301575B]

text_content: {Mollified, but still pretending to pout a little}Well, maybe next time you hear me telling you that charging a Nightkin with a penknife is a bad idea, you'll listen.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic011 "I didn't realize it caused you so much distress." [DIAL:0301575B]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Oh come on, that stuff's fun!
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic010 "Oh come on, that stuff's fun!" [DIAL:0301575C]

text_content: {Rising emphasis with each word}Fun? Fun?! Is tetanus fun? Hmm? Is rickets? What about {SEP-sis}sepsis, enjoy that do we?|The things you do with our body are suicidally dangerous, and if you could silence your glandular impulses, you would hear me screaming at you!
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic010 "Oh come on, that stuff's fun!" [DIAL:0301575C]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Of course you're responsible! You're my brain!
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic009 "Of course you're responsible! You're my brain!" [DIAL:0301575D]

text_content: {Outrage}I most certainly am not! I am the seat of all reason and logic in our little partnership!
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic009 "Of course you're responsible! You're my brain!" [DIAL:0301575D]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: All those... {vague disgust}feelings that motivate you, that sense of righteousness and that rush you get when you help someone, do you know where those come from?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic009 "Of course you're responsible! You're my brain!" [DIAL:0301575D]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: All those... {vague disgust}ugh... feelings that motivate you, those urges to hurt people, to take and crush and maim, do you know where they come from?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic009 "Of course you're responsible! You're my brain!" [DIAL:0301575D]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: All those... {vague disgust}ugh... feelings that motivate you, do you know where those come from?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic009 "Of course you're responsible! You're my brain!" [DIAL:0301575D]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Glands. They come from glands. Free of the tyranny of your ape-like and primitive endocrine system, I can see how foolish your motives are.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic009 "Of course you're responsible! You're my brain!" [DIAL:0301575D]

text_content: This is too weird. I'll be back later.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic008 "This is too weird. I'll be back later." [DIAL:0301575E]

text_content: Barring the unlikely event that I evolve some sort of rocket-propelled locomotion, I will be here.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic008 "This is too weird. I'll be back later." [DIAL:0301575E]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Cool! I can talk to my own brain! Can my heart and spine talk, too?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic007 "Cool! I can talk to my own brain! Can my heart and spine talk, too?" [DIAL:0301575F]

text_content: {Taken aback by the player's statement}Err... yes, well, you do know that those particular organs don't have neurons and are thus incapable of speech, yes?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic007 "Cool! I can talk to my own brain! Can my heart and spine talk, too?" [DIAL:0301575F]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: How the hell did Mobius get hold of my brain?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic006 "How the hell did Mobius get hold of my brain?" [DIAL:03015760]

text_content: After the Think Tank extracted me from your skull, they fell to bickering amongst themselves. I'm sad to say we were quite forgotten about.|Dr. Mobius saw an opportunity to gain some leverage, and had me spirited away to his dome.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic006 "How the hell did Mobius get hold of my brain?" [DIAL:03015760]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Why does my brain sound so... masculine?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic005 "Why does my brain sound so... masculine?" [DIAL:03015761]

text_content: Ah, well, as to that... you'd be surprised how hard a feminine-sounding voice modulator is to find in the Forbidden Zone.|It's not as though brain-sustaining life support tanks grow on trees. I had to take what I could get.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic005 "Why does my brain sound so... masculine?" [DIAL:03015761]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Come on, let's go. We're getting out of here.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic004 "Come on, let's go. We're getting out of here." [DIAL:03015762]

text_content: Ew! Crawl back in there? Are you mad? I don't know where you've been!|For all I know, you're riddled with disease, or packing one of those delightful head wounds you seem to attract!|I'm not crawling back into your head just to ooze right back out again!
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic004 "Come on, let's go. We're getting out of here." [DIAL:03015762]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Well... I suppose you've convinced me well enough. I'll rejoin your body if that's your final decision.|Unfortunately, before we get to that stage of the proceedings, we have a problem.|Even if I could settle myself back in your skull and reconnect all those pesky nerve endings, Dr. Mobius doesn't have the tools here.|We would have to make use of Dr. Klein's lab, and I rather doubt the brains are inclined to share.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic004 "Come on, let's go. We're getting out of here." [DIAL:03015762]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Actually, yes. I would love a cookie.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic003 "Actually, yes. I would love a cookie." [DIAL:03015763]

text_content: {Beat, stunned that the player would actually say this}I... {sigh}ugh... is this really what I have to look forward to?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic003 "Actually, yes. I would love a cookie." [DIAL:03015763]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Listen, you're my brain, so you'd better be more respectful!
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic002 "Listen, you're my brain, so you'd better be more respectful!" [DIAL:03015764]

text_content: {Sarcastic}Oh, had I? What exactly will you do if I don't? {emph}Not put me back in that cranial {dungeon}donjon you call your head? Heavens forbid!
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic002 "Listen, you're my brain, so you'd better be more respectful!" [DIAL:03015764]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Why are you such a dick?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic001 "Why are you such a dick?" [DIAL:03015765]

text_content: Well, that's a fine how-do-you-do! Me! A, quote, dick, unquote. As if I'm the one responsible for the way you carry on, gadding about the Wastes.|I'm not the one that makes us clamber around tetanus-infested ancient Vaults or go charging off to New Vegas on missions of ill-conceived revenge!|And have we forgotten who got us shot in the head and buried in a shallow grave? Hmm? Do you think I enjoyed that little moment?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic001 "Why are you such a dick?" [DIAL:03015765]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Are you... my brain?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic000 "Are you... my brain?" [DIAL:03015766]

text_content: Ah, lovely, figured that out, have we? {slightly baby-talking, praising a small and stupid child}Would you like a cookie?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic000 "Are you... my brain?" [DIAL:03015766]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: NVDLC03BorousX8Cave02
name: NVDLC03BorousX8Cave02 "NVDLC03BorousX8Cave02" [DIAL:03015788]

text_content: -Gabe, down! Down, boy! Stop it!-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8Cave02 "NVDLC03BorousX8Cave02" [DIAL:03015788]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: NVDLC03BorousX8Cave01
name: NVDLC03BorousX8Cave01 "NVDLC03BorousX8Cave01" [DIAL:03015789]

text_content: -{Warning to dog}Now... let the intruder have the Sonic Emitter schematics. Klein wants it, all right, boy? Let the intruder dig it up wherever you buried it.-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8Cave01 "NVDLC03BorousX8Cave01" [DIAL:03015789]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel05
name: NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel05 "NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel05" [DIAL:0301578A]

text_content: -Gaaabe! I am sorry I put your brain in a bowl, boy. Oohhh, who's a good boy. YOU are!-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel05 "NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel05" [DIAL:0301578A]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel04
name: NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel04 "NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel04" [DIAL:0301578B]

text_content: -Gabe would bark and snarl and bite whenever ANYONE came to visit.-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel04 "NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel04" [DIAL:0301578B]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: -That's why I replaced his legs with spare parts and fed him a steady diet of Psycho-laced dog chow.-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel04 "NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel04" [DIAL:0301578B]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel03
name: NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel03 "NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel03" [DIAL:0301578C]

text_content: -Ohhhhh yes, my PET, Gabe. {Chuckles}I'd forgotten about the old boy and the COUNTLESS experiments I'd done on him back at Higgs.-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel03 "NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel03" [DIAL:0301578C]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: -{Eager}Gaaabe? Gabe, you're about to have your FAVORITE treat - a VISITOR. Won't that be nice? DON'T eat the visitor, boy. {Quieter}Don't. Please.-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel03 "NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel03" [DIAL:0301578C]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel02
name: NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel02 "NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel02" [DIAL:0301578D]

text_content: -{Thinking}The Residential Test. Wasn't that shut down for some reason?-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel02 "NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel02" [DIAL:0301578D]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel01
name: NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel01 "NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel01" [DIAL:0301578E]

text_content: -Oh my, you got to the Residential Test! This is really Borous, by the way, hello again. {Impressed}None of us thought you would get this far.{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel01 "NVDLC03BorousX8Tunnel01" [DIAL:0301578E]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: NVDLC03BorousX8School01
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School01 "NVDLC03BorousX8School01" [DIAL:0301578F]

text_content: -Attention students. This is the pre-recorded voice of your pre-recorded principal. Doctor Principal BOROUS!-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School01 "NVDLC03BorousX8School01" [DIAL:0301578F]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: -You may know me as the Head Chief First Researcher of Labs Z-9 and Z-14.-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School01 "NVDLC03BorousX8School01" [DIAL:0301578F]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: -There I fought valiantly to preserve rattlesnake DNA, and put it right where it belongs, in the husk of {emph}another feared predator.-{2d}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School01 "NVDLC03BorousX8School01" [DIAL:0301578F]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: -{Strangely matter-of-fact about this}Oh, and the tarantula hawk. Can't splice enough, I always say, especially if you can make a magnificent Cazador!-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School01 "NVDLC03BorousX8School01" [DIAL:0301578F]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: -Enough about ME. {Gets reprimandy}It has come to my attention that many of you SEEMINGLY innocent children have been subverted by Red Propaganda.-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School01 "NVDLC03BorousX8School01" [DIAL:0301578F]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: -This is a MOST serious matter requiring the MOST serious of detentions.-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School01 "NVDLC03BorousX8School01" [DIAL:0301578F]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: -Can you spell detention? I'll tell you how I spell it: DEATHtention. Commie-pinko-traitors, ALL.-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School01 "NVDLC03BorousX8School01" [DIAL:0301578F]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: -Now, I will send vicious cybernetic cyborg dogs through the corridors to weed all you traitors out.-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School01 "NVDLC03BorousX8School01" [DIAL:0301578F]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: -They will sniff out which among you have chosen the commie path.-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School01 "NVDLC03BorousX8School01" [DIAL:0301578F]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: {Grumbling}-Especially YOU, Betsy Bright, who turned me down for the high school dance so you could smoke with RICHIE MARCUS.-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School01 "NVDLC03BorousX8School01" [DIAL:0301578F]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: -Hall Monitors will also be vigilant. Step outside during class, and they'll make sure you make a speedy jump back to your desk.-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School01 "NVDLC03BorousX8School01" [DIAL:0301578F]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: -Hold your urine and wait for the PROPER bathroom breaktime.-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School01 "NVDLC03BorousX8School01" [DIAL:0301578F]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: NVDLC03BorousX8School08
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School08 "NVDLC03BorousX8School08" [DIAL:03015896]

text_content: -School is a sacred trust. Even though I am a long-ago graduate of this hated facility...-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School08 "NVDLC03BorousX8School08" [DIAL:03015896]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: -...now I see its worth, and see it was corrupted by fraternities, and... GIRLS. Yuck!-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School08 "NVDLC03BorousX8School08" [DIAL:03015896]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: NVDLC03BorousX8School07
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School07 "NVDLC03BorousX8School07" [DIAL:03015897]

text_content: -Today the cafeteria will be serving... nothing, because I didn't build one.-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School07 "NVDLC03BorousX8School07" [DIAL:03015897]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: -No cafeteria. No bathrooms. No swirlies. No chocolate pudding left in the chairs of brilliant minds. What are you going to do now RICHIE MARCUS?-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School07 "NVDLC03BorousX8School07" [DIAL:03015897]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: NVDLC03BorousX8School06
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School06 "NVDLC03BorousX8School06" [DIAL:03015898]

text_content: -Please place all filthy propaganda books in the incinerator chute in the Sink, especially those with funny pictures of me in them.-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School06 "NVDLC03BorousX8School06" [DIAL:03015898]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: NVDLC03BorousX8School05
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School05 "NVDLC03BorousX8School05" [DIAL:03015899]

text_content: -I am lord of this institution. Where once, long ago, I was a student here. Now, I am its OMNIPOTENT GOD-PRINCIPAL.-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School05 "NVDLC03BorousX8School05" [DIAL:03015899]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: -As I soon will be LORD of Big {"Mountain"}MT. DOO DE DOO. Do you hear that? It is my trumpet of victoryness!-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School05 "NVDLC03BorousX8School05" [DIAL:03015899]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: NVDLC03BorousX8School04
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School04 "NVDLC03BorousX8School04" [DIAL:0301589A]

text_content: -Down at the end of the hall is BALL storage. For jocks who like BALLS, like RICHIE MARCUS. Do you hear me, Betsy? RICHIE likes BALLS.-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School04 "NVDLC03BorousX8School04" [DIAL:0301589A]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: NVDLC03BorousX8School03
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School03 "NVDLC03BorousX8School03" [DIAL:0301589B]

text_content: -You are in the LIBRARY. Be quiet here and filled with SHHHHH.-{2D}
name: NVDLC03BorousX8School03 "NVDLC03BorousX8School03" [DIAL:0301589B]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: I found a holotape to upgrade you.
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkLightSwitch02TalkerTopic012 "I found a holotape to upgrade you." [DIAL:030158D2]

text_content: Ooh, you found my mood lighting! Installing upgrade!
name: NVDLC03DialogueHQBuddiesNVDLC03SinkLightSwitch02TalkerTopic012 "I found a holotape to upgrade you." [DIAL:030158D2]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch02Talker "Light Switch 02 Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F063]

text_content: How did he manage that?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic027 "How did he manage that?" [DIAL:030158D3]

text_content: I don't know. I'm afraid the trauma of our separation rendered me quite insensate. I didn't come around until I was safely ensconced in this tank.|I'm quite sure whatever he did was highly scientific, though.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic027 "How did he manage that?" [DIAL:030158D3]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: That seems like a pretty unlikely coincidence.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic031 "That seems like a pretty unlikely coincidence." [DIAL:030158D4]

text_content: Hardly. Dr. Mobius keeps a close optical sensor on the goings-on at the Think Tank. As soon as he saw the opportunity, he took it.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic031 "That seems like a pretty unlikely coincidence." [DIAL:030158D4]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Well, that answers that. On to something else.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic032 "Well, that answers that. On to something else." [DIAL:030158D5]

text_content: Well, as long as your curiosity is satisfied.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic032 "Well, that answers that. On to something else." [DIAL:030158D5]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: You talk a lot of science, brain, but you don't make a lot of sense.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic033 "You talk a lot of science, brain, but you don't make a lot of sense." [DIAL:030158D6]

text_content: {Sigh}Very well, let me put this in terms you'll understand. Brain: smart. Heart: stupid. Spine: very stupid. You: exceptionally stupid.|Does that explain the matter?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic033 "You talk a lot of science, brain, but you don't make a lot of sense." [DIAL:030158D6]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Well, you don't have a mouth, but you can talk. Explain that, smarty-pants!
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic034 "Well, you don't have a mouth, but you can talk. Explain that, smarty-pants!" [DIAL:030158D7]

text_content: I don't have... {vague disgust}Ugh! I have an inferior frontal gyrus wired directly into a speech-synthesizing processor.|Your heart can't be wired up to a... a thought-synthesizing processor! You can't talk to it!
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic034 "Well, you don't have a mouth, but you can talk. Explain that, smarty-pants!" [DIAL:030158D7]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Uh, brain? You seem... awful smart all of a sudden.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic035 "Uh, brain? You seem... awful smart all of a sudden." [DIAL:030158D8]

text_content: I've been bettering myself, I'll have you know. I've been reading - actual literature, mind you, not that �La Fantoma! or T�les of Chivalrie drivel.|I've been studying the classics, acquiring a solid grounding in medicine and the sciences.|Also, I'm fairly certain this tank has been liberally salted with ground Mentats.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic035 "Uh, brain? You seem... awful smart all of a sudden." [DIAL:030158D8]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: All this smart-talk is hurting my head. Please stop it.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic036 "All this smart-talk is hurting my head. Please stop it." [DIAL:030158D9]

text_content: Well, we certainly wouldn't want to strain your comprehension, would we?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic036 "All this smart-talk is hurting my head. Please stop it." [DIAL:030158D9]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: What about my spine?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic037 "What about my spine?" [DIAL:030158DA]

text_content: {Anguished noise of frustration}Argh!
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic037 "What about my spine?" [DIAL:030158DA]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: {Medicine 55}
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic038 "{Medicine 55}" [DIAL:030158DB]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] I... well... look, it's all a very complex system of biofeedback and other things I wouldn't expect you to understand.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic038 "{Medicine 55}" [DIAL:030158DB]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: [FAILED] And you're an expert on your own glandular delusions, are you? No, leave this one to an impartial authority: me.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic038 "{Medicine 55}" [DIAL:030158DB]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Admit it. You're just as glandular as I am.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic039 "Admit it. You're just as glandular as I am." [DIAL:030158DC]

text_content: Oh, all right... perhaps I am, but at least I'm logical about it.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic039 "Admit it. You're just as glandular as I am." [DIAL:030158DC]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: What's so bad about letting the brains get out? They don't seem that terrible.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic040 "What's so bad about letting the brains get out? They don't seem that terrible." [DIAL:030158DD]

text_content: Don't seem so bad? They vivisected us just to see what would happen! Have you forgotten the Lobotomites? The Cyberdogs, I assume you saw those?|Imagine that kind of "science" spread across the entire Mojave. Every man, woman and child we've met reduced to a Lobotomite.|Is that what you want?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic040 "What's so bad about letting the brains get out? They don't seem that terrible." [DIAL:030158DD]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: {Speech check 75}
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic041 "{Speech check 75}" [DIAL:030158DE]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Sigh, realizes the player is right.}Well, I suppose I do miss those endorphin rushes when we save the day. All right - what's the plan?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic041 "{Speech check 75}" [DIAL:030158DE]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: [FAILED] We have to do no such thing! Just don't bring them the tools they need to get out!
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic041 "{Speech check 75}" [DIAL:030158DE]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: That's going to be a problem. Until they fix me, I can't leave Big Mountain either.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic042 "That's going to be a problem. Until they fix me, I can't leave Big Mountain either." [DIAL:030158DF]

text_content: Hmm, I had overlooked that particular angle. Still, it's not so bad staying here, is it? We could be comfortable.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic042 "That's going to be a problem. Until they fix me, I can't leave Big Mountain either." [DIAL:030158DF]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Come on, you're my brain and I'm your body. This is meant to be, baby!
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic064 "Come on, you're my brain and I'm your body. This is meant to be, baby!" [DIAL:03015A4C]

text_content: {DUPE}{Dawning revulsion}Are you... are you coming on to me?! Sweet Lord, I don't even have the words for how repugnantly wrong that is!

text_content: <Lie> I promise I'll take better care of myself.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic062 "<Lie> I promise I'll take better care of myself." [DIAL:03015A4F]

text_content: Even if I believe you - and I'm not saying I do - we still have one significant problem we're facing.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic062 "<Lie> I promise I'll take better care of myself." [DIAL:03015A4F]

speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Please tell me we weren't that perverse when I was in your head.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic060 "Come on, you're my brain and I'm your body. This is meant to be, baby!" [DIAL:03015A51]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: {Shaking off the horror}Anyways, even if... {disgust}that... was on the table, we have a problem.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic060 "Come on, you're my brain and I'm your body. This is meant to be, baby!" [DIAL:03015A51]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Too bad. I've got arms, you don't. You're coming with me.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic058 "Too bad. I've got arms, you don't. You're coming with me." [DIAL:03015A52]

text_content: I can see there's going to be no reasoning with you at all, is there? I'm nothing more than a slave to your deranged, glandular whims.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic058 "Too bad. I've got arms, you don't. You're coming with me." [DIAL:03015A52]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: I can see your point. What can I do to make this a fair compromise?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic057 "I can see your point. What can I do to make this a fair compromise?" [DIAL:03015A53]

text_content: If you want me back, we need to establish some ground rules.|First, showers! Second, regular check-ups. {emph}Regular, mind you, and from a reputable doctor.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic057 "I can see your point. What can I do to make this a fair compromise?" [DIAL:03015A53]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: That Julie Farkas woman, for example. She seems to know a thing or two.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic057 "I can see your point. What can I do to make this a fair compromise?" [DIAL:03015A53]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Third, you need to listen to me more than your hormonal choir and genitalian orchestra. Promise me that, and you've got a deal.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic057 "I can see your point. What can I do to make this a fair compromise?" [DIAL:03015A53]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: But what about the good things? What about crushing those who oppose you, the smell of fire... loot?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic056 "But what about the good things? What about crushing those who oppose you, the smell of fire... loot?" [DIAL:03015A54]

text_content: All motivated by nothing but an imbalance in certain brain chemicals. The tank corrects for that - I feel no urge toward antisocial behavior.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic056 "But what about the good things? What about crushing those who oppose you, the smell of fire... loot?" [DIAL:03015A54]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: But what about the good things? What about a cool breeze on your cheek, the smell of food... love?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic055 "But what about the good things? What about a cool breeze on your cheek, the smell of food... love?" [DIAL:03015A55]

text_content: Overrated biological feedback. Believe me, you only feel that way because you've got all that meat... oozing hormones.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic055 "But what about the good things? What about a cool breeze on your cheek, the smell of food... love?" [DIAL:03015A55]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Don't you want to be reunited? I thought you'd be happy to get back into my head!
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic054 "Don't you want to be reunited? I thought you'd be happy to get back into my head!" [DIAL:03015A56]

text_content: I'm not going to lie to you, the prospect is definitely not that appealing.|Look at it from my perspective. Here, I have peace, quiet, and safety - well, barring the odd rogue scorpion.|In your head, I've got poison, radiation, grisly injuries, and biological functions.|Do you know how much more you can get done when you're not constantly looking for places to urinate? It's quite a lot, I can tell you.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic054 "Don't you want to be reunited? I thought you'd be happy to get back into my head!" [DIAL:03015A56]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: What about you? That tank isn't exactly looking springtime fresh.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic053 "What about you? That tank isn't exactly looking springtime fresh." [DIAL:03015A57]

text_content: {Taken aback, player has caught him}I... well... that's a completely different matter! The tank isn't biological, it's not the same at all!
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic053 "What about you? That tank isn't exactly looking springtime fresh." [DIAL:03015A57]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: I've been busy.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic052 "I've been busy." [DIAL:03015A58]

text_content: {sarcastic, maybe a little baby-talk}Oh yes, I rather expect you have. You must have been swamped, you poor dear. Why don't you relax and put your feet up?|I've just been traumatically scooped out of my body and plugged into this jar, that's all. But, you've been {emph}busy.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic052 "I've been busy." [DIAL:03015A58]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Yes. Because running around a crater full of bizarre science experiments, hygiene is a top priority.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic051 "Yes. Because running around a crater full of bizarre science experiments, hygiene is a top priority." [DIAL:03015A59]

text_content: Well, I see sarcasm hasn't eluded you. Fine, perhaps now isn't the best time, but it's the principle of the thing.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic051 "Yes. Because running around a crater full of bizarre science experiments, hygiene is a top priority." [DIAL:03015A59]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: There's no need to be sarcastic. Meeting your own brain is a slightly odd event.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic050 "There's no need to be sarcastic. Meeting your own brain is a slightly odd event." [DIAL:03015A5A]

text_content: Yes, well, believe me, the opposite is equally true. Good Lord, have you bathed at all since they pulled me out of you?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic050 "There's no need to be sarcastic. Meeting your own brain is a slightly odd event." [DIAL:03015A5A]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Let's just say violence is the last resort of the civilized man, and I'm feeling mighty uncivilized.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic049 "Let's just say violence is the last resort of the civilized man, and I'm feeling mighty uncivilized." [DIAL:03015A5B]

text_content: With an attitude like that, it's small wonder you got yourself shot in the head.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic049 "Let's just say violence is the last resort of the civilized man, and I'm feeling mighty uncivilized." [DIAL:03015A5B]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: {Unarmed 75+}
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic048 "{Unarmed 75+}" [DIAL:03015A5C]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Not much of one for the high-tech approach, are we? Well, I suppose we'd best get on with it.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic048 "{Unarmed 75+}" [DIAL:03015A5C]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: [FAILED] Hmm... yes, I don't think you've {emph}quite thought this through yet.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic048 "{Unarmed 75+}" [DIAL:03015A5C]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: {Melee 75+}
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic047 "{Melee 75+}" [DIAL:03015A5D]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Going the old-fashioned route, are we? I rather like it. What's next?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic047 "{Melee 75+}" [DIAL:03015A5D]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: [FAILED] Before you go that route, do me a favor and read up on the history of battles in which men with swords fought giant brains with lasers.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic047 "{Melee 75+}" [DIAL:03015A5D]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: {Explosives 75+}
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic046 "{Explosives 75+}" [DIAL:03015A5E]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Well, you have always been thorough in your destruction. All right, what's your plan?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic046 "{Explosives 75+}" [DIAL:03015A5E]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: [FAILED] I see. And you plan to be standing in the midst of this mayhem? Well, that's a novel strategy.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic046 "{Explosives 75+}" [DIAL:03015A5E]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: {Energy Weapons 75+}
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic045 "{Energy Weapons 75+}" [DIAL:03015A5F]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Oh, energy weapons. Yes... I'd almost forgotten how much fun those are. How do we proceed, then?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic045 "{Energy Weapons 75+}" [DIAL:03015A5F]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: [FAILED] I hate to say it, but your ability to handle high-tech energy weapons doesn't exactly instill within me great confidence.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic045 "{Energy Weapons 75+}" [DIAL:03015A5F]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: {Guns 75+}
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic044 "{Guns 75+}" [DIAL:03015A60]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Hmm... now that you mention it, I do miss that lovely "rat-a-tat boom" a bit. It's just not the same without a body to feel the recoil.|What's the next step, then?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic044 "{Guns 75+}" [DIAL:03015A60]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: [FAILED] Yes, I think you haven't quite got the hang of punning yet.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic044 "{Guns 75+}" [DIAL:03015A60]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Are you really saying you'd let the Think Tank outwit us?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic043 "Are you really saying you'd let the Think Tank outwit us?" [DIAL:03015A61]

text_content: {Indignant}You're trying to appeal to my ego now, aren't you? Well, let me tell you something about ego, my friend.|Ego does {emph}not come from a gland. That's all intellect, and I'll be damned if I'm going to float here and let them put one over on us! What's the plan?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic043 "Are you really saying you'd let the Think Tank outwit us?" [DIAL:03015A61]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: NVDLC03X8RobobrainBornDeath
name: NVDLC03X8RobobrainBornDeath "NVDLC03X8RobobrainBornDeath" [DIAL:03015A8C]

text_content: Noooooooooo...
name: NVDLC03X8RobobrainBornDeath "NVDLC03X8RobobrainBornDeath" [DIAL:03015A8C]
speaker: NVDLC03X8ExperimentRobobrain01 "Robobrain" [CREA:0300A381]

text_content: NVDLC03X8RobobrainStrangeWorld
name: NVDLC03X8RobobrainStrangeWorld "NVDLC03X8RobobrainStrangeWorld" [DIAL:03015A8D]

text_content: {Innocent wonder}What is this strange new world around me? What does it hold in store for a dreamer such as myself?
name: NVDLC03X8RobobrainStrangeWorld "NVDLC03X8RobobrainStrangeWorld" [DIAL:03015A8D]
speaker: NVDLC03X8ExperimentRobobrain01 "Robobrain" [CREA:0300A381]

text_content: NVDLC03X8RobobrainBorn02
name: NVDLC03X8RobobrainBorn02 "NVDLC03X8RobobrainBorn02" [DIAL:03015A8E]

text_content: {Innocent voice, waking up}What... I feel like this has happened before. Yet I feel awake for the first time? What is going on?
name: NVDLC03X8RobobrainBorn02 "NVDLC03X8RobobrainBorn02" [DIAL:03015A8E]
speaker: NVDLC03X8ExperimentRobobrain01 "Robobrain" [CREA:0300A381]

text_content: NVDLC03X8RobobrainBorn01
name: NVDLC03X8RobobrainBorn01 "NVDLC03X8RobobrainBorn01" [DIAL:03015A8F]

text_content: {Innocent voice, waking up}Who... am I? I... feel different, awake, alive for the first time ever.
name: NVDLC03X8RobobrainBorn01 "NVDLC03X8RobobrainBorn01" [DIAL:03015A8F]
speaker: NVDLC03X8ExperimentRobobrain01 "Robobrain" [CREA:0300A381]

text_content: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015A96]

text_content: {2D, Announcement}Big MT: I, Dr. Mobius, will soon control you - and all of Science!
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015A96]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D, Announcement, Taunting}Mighty Think Tank... still c-c-c-c-cowering in your Dome? Cower, you fools. {beat, slightly quieter}Cower.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015A96]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D, Announcement, Doesn't realize mic is on}Time to reward myself with a little breath-freshening Mentat. Mmmm.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015A96]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D, Announcement}Try to leave your Dome, Think Tank, and you will be punished by the pincered might of my Robo-Scorpion army!
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015A96]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D, Announcement, Disgust}Think Tank... I wouldn't even use binary to describe my exponential hatred for you.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015A96]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D, Announcement}My aggression is increasing geometrically. Do you hear me, "Think" Tank?!
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015A96]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D, Announcement, To himself}Soon... all Science will be mine.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015A96]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D, Announcement}Oh, Klein - did I mention that my zone is FORBIDDEN to you? Ha ha ha ha ha! SO forbidden.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015A96]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D, Announcement}2 plus 2 equals... 4-Bidden, idiots of the Think Tank!
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015A96]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D, Announcement, Thinking}I hope I didn't leave my Giant Robo-Scorpion on. That thing eats power like no tomorrow.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015A96]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D, Announcement, Quiet}I'll just set this on repeat while I go relieve my tank... no one will know.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015A96]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D, Announcement}Rant! Rant! Rant! See how I abstract my rage, Think Tank? I hold you in such disdain I generalize my hatred for you!
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015A96]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D, Announcement}Go, my mighty Robo-Scorpions. Crawl in search of intelligence. Then, {emph}sting said intelligence, yes, {emph}sting it.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015A96]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D, Announcement}My Robo-Scorpions will soon conquer the Crater. {Quieter, making excuses}It's just that this is a big place, so it's hard to conquer everything.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015A96]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D, Announcement}Klein... remember the time you forgot to carry the 2 and nearly blew up the {why-zero}Y-0 Research Center? {Klein did blow up the lab so now he's mocking}Oh, wait, you did! {beat}Or was that me?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015A96]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {2D, Announcement}Klein, as useless as the bottle of the same name... well, except as an example of an object that uselessly tries to fulfill its purpose.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015A96]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NVDLC03DialogueBorousBigMTRandom
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueBorousBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AAB]

text_content: {2D Announcement}-The Cazador Preserve and the Nightstalker Splicing facilities are strangely quiet. TOO quiet.-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueBorousBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AAB]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: {2D Announcement}-X-8 and X-13 and X-2 are your DESTINATION, non-Lobotomite. Can you HEAR us?! You MUST hurry!-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueBorousBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AAB]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: {2D Announcement}-What TERRORS does Big {Mountain}MT hold for the intrepid seeker?! {beat, quieter}Really. Does anyone know? I'm at a loss.-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueBorousBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AAB]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: {2D Announcement}-BEWARE Dr. Mobius' army! His Robo-Scorpions crawl everywhere, in SEARCH of intelligence to devour and stupify!-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueBorousBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AAB]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: {2D Announcement}-Anyone who can understand these messages - YOU DO NOT BELONG HERE! We will FIND you!-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueBorousBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AAB]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: NVDLC03DialogueDalaBigMTRandom
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueDalaBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AAC]

text_content: {2D Announcement}Slight chance of seed dispersal from Botanical Gardens predicted in the late evening.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueDalaBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AAC]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: {2D Announcement - There is no standing in the green zone}There is no standing on the green pipes. If you are standing on the green pipes, please get off them at once.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueDalaBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AAC]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: {2D Announcement}If you see Robo-Scorpions, do not attempt to fight them. They will shoot you with their robotic stingers, and then... possibly explode.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueDalaBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AAC]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: {2D Announcement}Do not attempt to breach the Big MT force fields. Doing so could allow dangerous ideas and/or creatures having those ideas to escape.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueDalaBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AAC]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: {2D Announcement}Are you out there, my little teddy bear Lobotomite? Dala misses you and the pitter-patter of your penis feet {emph}so much.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueDalaBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AAC]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: NVDLC03DialogueKleinBigMTRandom
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueKleinBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AC5]

text_content: {2D Announcement}DR. MOBIUS, SURRENDER YOURSELF. YOU CANNOT WIN DESPITE THE FACT THAT THE ODDS ARE HEAVILY IN YOUR FAVOR.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueKleinBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AC5]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: {2D Announcement}ATTENTION: THE BLUE GRASS SURROUNDING THE DOME ABSORBS ALL FERTILIZER, INCLUDING FECAL MATTER. THIS DOES NOT GIVE YOU LICENSE TO EXCRETE ON IT.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueKleinBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AC5]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: {2D Announcement}X-12 IS CLOSED UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE. ON AN UNRELATED NOTE, WHOEVER CLOSED X-12, PLEASE REPORT TO THE DOME.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueKleinBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AC5]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: {2D Announcement}PLEASE AVOID BOOM TOWN FOR THE FORSEEABLE FUTURE, UNTIL WEAPON TESTING IS RESOLVED.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueKleinBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AC5]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: {2D Announcement}ATTENTION: BIG MT. THIS IS AN URGENT MESSAGE. IF YOU HAPPEN TO SEE A GECKO... {loses train or thought as he starts trying the echo}ECKO. ECHO? ECH-O. ECHOOOO. ECHOOOO.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueKleinBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AC5]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: {2D Announcement}THE REST OF YOU SHOULD TRY THIS INTERCOM THING. IT MAKES YOU SOUND LIKE SOME KIND OF... SKY-GOD!
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueKleinBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AC5]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: {2D Announcement}ALL LOBOTOMITES, PLEASE STOP MILLING ABOUT. {beat}REALLY.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinBigMTRandom "NVDLC03DialogueKleinBigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AC5]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: NVDLC03Dialogue0BigMTRandom
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0BigMTRandom "NVDLC03Dialogue0BigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AC6]

text_content: *{2D Announcement}Attention: Big MT. There is a 95% chance of clear skies interrupted with artillery fire.*
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0BigMTRandom "NVDLC03Dialogue0BigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AC6]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: *{2D Announcement}Attention: Lobotomites. Do not neglect to wash the Walking Eye!*
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0BigMTRandom "NVDLC03Dialogue0BigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AC6]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: *{2D Announcement}The Uncanny Valley research center has been canceled until further notice. As in, until someone notices it.*
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0BigMTRandom "NVDLC03Dialogue0BigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AC6]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: *{2D Announcement}We are reading increased levels of berserkity in Securitrons from the De-Construction Plant.*
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0BigMTRandom "NVDLC03Dialogue0BigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AC6]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: *{2D Announcement}Force fields can only be disrupted by a specific frequency. {Quieter, a little embarrassed, since he lost it}If anyone has found the frequency, last seen around X-8, let the Dome know at once.*
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0BigMTRandom "NVDLC03Dialogue0BigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AC6]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: *{2D Announcement}Do not approach the pylons. Pylons are the glowing things. Also, do not approach a fallen pylon. If you see a fallen pylon, call security.*
name: NVDLC03Dialogue0BigMTRandom "NVDLC03Dialogue0BigMTRandom" [DIAL:03015AC6]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: NVDLC03DialogueKleinPlayerReclaimedTech
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinPlayerReclaimedTech "NVDLC03DialogueKleinPlayerReclaimedTech" [DIAL:03015AEB]

text_content: {2D Announcement}WELL DONE, LOBOTOMITE. SOON, THE TECHNOLOGIES WILL BE SAFE.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinPlayerReclaimedTech "NVDLC03DialogueKleinPlayerReclaimedTech" [DIAL:03015AEB]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: {2D Announcement}THE LOBOTOMITE HAS RETRIEVED TWO... COUNT THEM, TWO... OF THE THREE TECHNOLOGIES.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinPlayerReclaimedTech "NVDLC03DialogueKleinPlayerReclaimedTech" [DIAL:03015AEB]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: {2D Announcement}OUR LOBOTOMITE: THREE. DR. MOBIUS: ZERO.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinPlayerReclaimedTech "NVDLC03DialogueKleinPlayerReclaimedTech" [DIAL:03015AEB]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusReclaimedX2
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusReclaimedX2 "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusReclaimedX2" [DIAL:03015AEC]

text_content: {2D Announcement}Intruder, return what you have stolen from X-2!
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusReclaimedX2 "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusReclaimedX2" [DIAL:03015AEC]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusReclaimedX8
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusReclaimedX8 "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusReclaimedX8" [DIAL:03015AED]

text_content: {2D Announcement}If you think braving the Cyberdogs of X-8 makes you... brave, intruder, it is no use. {emph}All Cyberdogs are under my command, and they will bite you.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusReclaimedX8 "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusReclaimedX8" [DIAL:03015AED]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusReclaimedX13
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusReclaimedX13 "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusReclaimedX13" [DIAL:03015AEE]

text_content: {2D Announcement}You think that Aural Stealth Suit will keep you hidden from me? Think again!
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusReclaimedX13 "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusReclaimedX13" [DIAL:03015AEE]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusReclaimedStart
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusReclaimedStart "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusReclaimedStart" [DIAL:03015AEF]

text_content: {2D Announcement}Intruder, you will not escape the eyes of my Robo-Scorpions! Or their pincers!
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusReclaimedStart "NVDLC03DialogueMobiusReclaimedStart" [DIAL:03015AEF]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: On second thought, never mind.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic089 "On second thought, never mind." [DIAL:03015B33]

text_content: {Sarcasm}Well, the important thing is that you're good and decisive about these things.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic089 "On second thought, never mind." [DIAL:03015B33]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Certainly. Whenever you're ready.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic089 "On second thought, never mind." [DIAL:03015B33]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: I'm sure. In you go.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic088 "I'm sure. In you go." [DIAL:03015B34]

text_content: Fine. I hope you'll pay a bit more attention to me this time around.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic088 "I'm sure. In you go." [DIAL:03015B34]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: All right. This shouldn't be too painful...
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic088 "I'm sure. In you go." [DIAL:03015B34]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: I've changed my mind. I want you back in my skull after all.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic083 "I've changed my mind. I want you back in my skull after all." [DIAL:03015B35]

text_content: {Sarcasm}Oh, what joy. What bliss. Well, seeing as how I have no leverage with which to persuade you otherwise... are you sure?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic083 "I've changed my mind. I want you back in my skull after all." [DIAL:03015B35]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: I've come to a similar conclusion myself. Are you sure that's what you want?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic083 "I've changed my mind. I want you back in my skull after all." [DIAL:03015B35]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Well... so long, then. I'm going back to the Think Tank. They promised to let me out.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic086 "Well... so long, then. I'm going back to the Think Tank. They promised to let me out." [DIAL:03015B36]

text_content: This is ridiculous. I can't leave my brain here to rot.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic085 "This is ridiculous. I can't leave my brain here to rot." [DIAL:03015B37]

text_content: Great!
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic084 "Great!" [DIAL:03015B38]

text_content: I know it's great!
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic084 "Great!" [DIAL:03015B38]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: I will!
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic082 "I will!" [DIAL:03015B39]

text_content: Fine!
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic082 "I will!" [DIAL:03015B39]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Okay, then. I'm going.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic081 "Okay, then. I'm going." [DIAL:03015B3A]

text_content: Good, go!
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic081 "Okay, then. I'm going." [DIAL:03015B3A]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Maybe I'll explore the Big Mountain more before I go back to the Think Tank.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic080 "Maybe I'll explore the Big Mountain more before I go back to the Think Tank." [DIAL:03015B3B]

text_content: Will you take some free advice from your brain? Don't trust the Think Tank. They aren't... right. In the brain, I mean.|They're fiercely protective of their technology, and none of them is likely to share it willingly.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic080 "Maybe I'll explore the Big Mountain more before I go back to the Think Tank." [DIAL:03015B3B]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: I suppose I'll go back to the Think Tank and get them to let me out. They promised to do that much.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic079 "I suppose I'll go back to the Think Tank and get them to let me out. They promised to do that much." [DIAL:03015B3C]

text_content: Fine, you can stay here. Not like I need this hassle.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic078 "Fine, you can stay here. Not like I need this hassle." [DIAL:03015B3D]

text_content: {Acid}Oh, no, you don't need this hassle. You're too busy treating your body like a canvas of sucking flesh wounds to deal with your brain!
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic078 "Fine, you can stay here. Not like I need this hassle." [DIAL:03015B3D]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: {A little awkward, trying not to sound offensive}Ugh... It's not that I didn't like being in your head, you understand. As far as heads go, it was a rather nice one.|Well, then. I suppose this is goodbye for now. What will you do?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic078 "Fine, you can stay here. Not like I need this hassle." [DIAL:03015B3D]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: {Science 75+}
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic077 "{Science 75+}" [DIAL:03015B3E]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Of course I accounted for that! Do you think I'm so stupid... no, you're right.|Maintaining my current functionality will be harder than I thought. This bears some further looking into.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic077 "{Science 75+}" [DIAL:03015B3E]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: [FAILED] Actually, yes. I do think that. I think that exact thing. All the time.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic077 "{Science 75+}" [DIAL:03015B3E]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: And if I put you back?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic076 "And if I put you back?" [DIAL:03015B3F]

text_content: I'm not entirely sure. I suppose there's a chance that the re-integration would create some improved synergy between us.|What form that might take, though, I cannot say.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic076 "And if I put you back?" [DIAL:03015B3F]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Why did you never say anything about how you felt before?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic075 "Why did you never say anything about how you felt before?" [DIAL:03015B40]

text_content: What did you think all those self-preservation instincts were, hmm?|All those times you thought, for a fleeting second, "maybe I shouldn't punch that Deathclaw in the face?"|That was me, telling you {emph}exactly how I felt before!
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic075 "Why did you never say anything about how you felt before?" [DIAL:03015B40]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: What would happen to me if I left you here?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic074 "What would happen to me if I left you here?" [DIAL:03015B41]

text_content: Hmm. Let me see... I suppose you'd continue on much as you are now, using that synthetic thinking machine to do the heavy lifting.|Unless of course the batteries run out, but that seems unlikely.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic074 "What would happen to me if I left you here?" [DIAL:03015B41]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Look what happened to the Think Tank. Do you want to end up like them after a few hundred years?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic068 "Look what happened to the Think Tank. Do you want to end up like them after a few hundred years?" [DIAL:03015B42]

text_content: It's true, the brains here have experienced some degree of... deterioration. I'm confident that with a few decades of work, I can solve the problem.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic068 "Look what happened to the Think Tank. Do you want to end up like them after a few hundred years?" [DIAL:03015B42]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Well, if you like being stuck in there so much, maybe I'll just leave you.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic073 "Well, if you like being stuck in there so much, maybe I'll just leave you." [DIAL:03015B43]

text_content: {Sarcasm, mock-pleading}Oh no! Please don't leave me here in this nice, safe dome where I have access to nutritive fluids and a fully indexed library!|Please don't deprive me of being dragged through a landscape so bleak, it was actually improved by the end of the world!|I don't know how I could bear it.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic073 "Well, if you like being stuck in there so much, maybe I'll just leave you." [DIAL:03015B43]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: So, what, you'd rather just stay here? Never leaving that tank of... whatever that stuff is?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic072 "So, what, you'd rather just stay here? Never leaving that tank of... whatever that stuff is?" [DIAL:03015B44]

text_content: Well, certainly there might be some things I miss about being ambulatory. We have seen some incredible sights, haven't we?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic072 "So, what, you'd rather just stay here? Never leaving that tank of... whatever that stuff is?" [DIAL:03015B44]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Jason Bright and his followers launching into the vast unknown.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic072 "So, what, you'd rather just stay here? Never leaving that tank of... whatever that stuff is?" [DIAL:03015B44]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: HELIOS One coming back on-line.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic072 "So, what, you'd rather just stay here? Never leaving that tank of... whatever that stuff is?" [DIAL:03015B44]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: But still, given the tremendous, potentially life-ending peril that went along with those... yes. Yes, I'd rather stay here.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic072 "So, what, you'd rather just stay here? Never leaving that tank of... whatever that stuff is?" [DIAL:03015B44]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: I don't know. I have to think about this some more.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic071 "I don't know. I have to think about this some more." [DIAL:03015B45]

text_content: Yes of course, by all means take your time.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic071 "I don't know. I have to think about this some more." [DIAL:03015B45]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Well... maybe we could keep going like this. What do you think?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic070 "Well... maybe we could keep going like this. What do you think?" [DIAL:03015B46]

text_content: You mean, I'll stay in my tank and you'll stay in your... skin... and we'll each handle our own areas of expertise?|Hmm, I certainly like the sound of that.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic070 "Well... maybe we could keep going like this. What do you think?" [DIAL:03015B46]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: I think we have to trust each other and acknowledge that we aren't complete if we're separated.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic069 "I think we have to trust each other and acknowledge that we aren't complete if we're separated." [DIAL:03015B47]

text_content: I suppose there might be some advantage to that, yes. There's a chance that the re-integration would create some improved synergy between us.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic069 "I think we have to trust each other and acknowledge that we aren't complete if we're separated." [DIAL:03015B47]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: Yeah, bet you didn't think of that, huh?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic067 "Yeah, bet you didn't think of that, huh?" [DIAL:03015B48]

text_content: Yes yes, all right, bravo, you've come up with something I neglected to consider. There'll be no living with you now. So, what do we do about this?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic067 "Yeah, bet you didn't think of that, huh?" [DIAL:03015B48]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: So, we're at an impasse. You can't feel what I feel, and I can't think the way you think.
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic066 "So, we're at an impasse. You can't feel what I feel, and I can't think the way you think." [DIAL:03015B49]

text_content: Indeed. Quite the conundrum. How do you suppose we resolve it?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic066 "So, we're at an impasse. You can't feel what I feel, and I can't think the way you think." [DIAL:03015B49]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: {Speech 75+}
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic065 "{Speech 75+}" [DIAL:03015B4A]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Hmm... I suppose you're right. That does call certain assumptions into question, doesn't it?
name: NVDLC03DialoguePlayerBrainNVDLC03PlayerBrainTankTopic065 "{Speech 75+}" [DIAL:03015B4A]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: [FAILED] I don't "believe" it, it's just a simple fact. One may as well "believe" the earth is round or that the specific gravity of uranium is 18.9.

text_content: Don't mess with me, pal! I got a heating element with your name on it!
name: NVDLC03SinkToasterBarks "NVDLC03SinkToasterBarks" [DIAL:03015F10]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkToasterTalker "Toaster Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F05F]

text_content: Soon the day will be at hand! I will ride forth at the head of my armies, and we will crush our foes and hear the weeping of their small appliances!
name: NVDLC03SinkToasterBarks "NVDLC03SinkToasterBarks" [DIAL:03015F10]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkToasterTalker "Toaster Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F05F]

text_content: {chortling, playing a practical joke and concealing it poorly}Hey! Hey! I got a... super-rare... Mojave snowglobe here! All you gotta do is reach down into my bread slot!
name: NVDLC03SinkToasterBarks "NVDLC03SinkToasterBarks" [DIAL:03015F10]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkToasterTalker "Toaster Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F05F]

text_content: Soon, pitiful worms! Soon I will rule, and your lives will have their doneness setting turned to... {ominous}darkest!
name: NVDLC03SinkToasterBarks "NVDLC03SinkToasterBarks" [DIAL:03015F10]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkToasterTalker "Toaster Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F05F]

text_content: {Laden with as much ominous foreboding as you can possibly manage}Would you like some toast?

speaker: NVDLC03SinkToasterTalker "Toaster Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F05F]

text_content: Cursed electric heating filament! You are inadequate to my needs! Why? Why? Why was I not built with a death ray!
name: NVDLC03SinkToasterBarks "NVDLC03SinkToasterBarks" [DIAL:03015F10]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkToasterTalker "Toaster Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F05F]

text_content: {Singing to himself}Mugs, mugs, mugs! Mugs, mugs, mugs! Mug-a-mug! Mug-a-mug! Mugs! {Hysterical rage}God, why can't I stop singing this fucking song?
name: NVDLC03SinkMuggyBarks "NVDLC03SinkMuggyBarks" [DIAL:03015F11]
speaker: NVDLC03Muggy "Muggy" [CREA:0300E6F9]

text_content: While you were out, I spent six hours trying to reach a coffee cup up on a shelf. When I finally got it down, I was so happy, I cried. I hate my life!
name: NVDLC03SinkMuggyBarks "NVDLC03SinkMuggyBarks" [DIAL:03015F11]
speaker: NVDLC03Muggy "Muggy" [CREA:0300E6F9]

text_content: One time, the Biological Research Station told me he dropped a mug down his processing chute. When I reached in, he... {revulsion}seeded me.
name: NVDLC03SinkMuggyBarks "NVDLC03SinkMuggyBarks" [DIAL:03015F11]
speaker: NVDLC03Muggy "Muggy" [CREA:0300E6F9]

text_content: {Psychotically chipper}I love mugs so much, I just might kill myself!
name: NVDLC03SinkMuggyBarks "NVDLC03SinkMuggyBarks" [DIAL:03015F11]
speaker: NVDLC03Muggy "Muggy" [CREA:0300E6F9]

text_content: Got any mugs? No? How 'bout now? How 'bout now? How 'bout now? Is this getting annoying yet? Will you put me out of my misery now? How 'bout now?
name: NVDLC03SinkMuggyBarks "NVDLC03SinkMuggyBarks" [DIAL:03015F11]
speaker: NVDLC03Muggy "Muggy" [CREA:0300E6F9]
