text_content: NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01Barks
name: NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01Barks "NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01Barks" [DIAL:03015F13]

text_content: Adjusting lights for maximum concentration levels.
name: NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01Barks "NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01Barks" [DIAL:03015F13]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01Talker "Light Switch 01 Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F062]

text_content: Have you been poking at the other light switch? You know she's riddled with virii, don't you?
name: NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01Barks "NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01Barks" [DIAL:03015F13]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01Talker "Light Switch 01 Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F062]

text_content: Maybe we could dim the lights and have a candlelit discussion of classic literature?
name: NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01Barks "NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01Barks" [DIAL:03015F13]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01Talker "Light Switch 01 Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F062]

text_content: Is the light level to your... liking?
name: NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01Barks "NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01Barks" [DIAL:03015F13]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01Talker "Light Switch 01 Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F062]

text_content: Don't even talk to me. I've seen you with... {emph}her!
name: NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01Barks "NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01Barks" [DIAL:03015F13]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01Talker "Light Switch 01 Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F062]

text_content: It's not like I haven't tried to get along with her. Lord knows I have. She's just such a... floozy!
name: NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01Barks "NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01Barks" [DIAL:03015F13]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01Talker "Light Switch 01 Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F062]

text_content: NVDLC03SinkJukeboxBarks
name: NVDLC03SinkJukeboxBarks "NVDLC03SinkJukeboxBarks" [DIAL:03015F14]

text_content: Dig this sweet sound I got cooking. <Strange electronic caterwauling.>
name: NVDLC03SinkJukeboxBarks "NVDLC03SinkJukeboxBarks" [DIAL:03015F14]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkJukeboxTalker "Jukebox Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F064]

text_content: What I wouldn't give to be able to pick up Radio New Vegas. Mmm... Those cats can really play.
name: NVDLC03SinkJukeboxBarks "NVDLC03SinkJukeboxBarks" [DIAL:03015F14]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkJukeboxTalker "Jukebox Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F064]

text_content: You ever heard of Tiny Lester Lutton? Best jazz harmonica I ever heard. Mind you, being a Super-Mutant with no lips... don't ask me how he played.
name: NVDLC03SinkJukeboxBarks "NVDLC03SinkJukeboxBarks" [DIAL:03015F14]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkJukeboxTalker "Jukebox Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F064]

text_content: You heard of Doc Boney? Sang with the staff band till his wife caught him in bed with a nurse. Now he haunts the Med Center, still singing the blues.
name: NVDLC03SinkJukeboxBarks "NVDLC03SinkJukeboxBarks" [DIAL:03015F14]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkJukeboxTalker "Jukebox Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F064]

text_content: I ever tell you about Saxomotron version 4.0? That cat was the best trumpet player I ever met.
name: NVDLC03SinkJukeboxBarks "NVDLC03SinkJukeboxBarks" [DIAL:03015F14]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkJukeboxTalker "Jukebox Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F064]

text_content: {Quiet, dispensing wisdom}Here and now got its ups and downs, but... focusing on the past, like it was any better? {"Shakes head sadly"}That's just Old World Blues.
name: NVDLC03SinkJukeboxBarks "NVDLC03SinkJukeboxBarks" [DIAL:03015F14]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkJukeboxTalker "Jukebox Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F064]

text_content: <Dispensing sage wisdom>
name: NVDLC03SinkJukeboxBarks "NVDLC03SinkJukeboxBarks" [DIAL:03015F14]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkJukeboxTalker "Jukebox Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F064]

text_content: Some day, I'd like to meet the man who's got no blues to sing.
name: NVDLC03SinkJukeboxBarks "NVDLC03SinkJukeboxBarks" [DIAL:03015F14]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkJukeboxTalker "Jukebox Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F064]

text_content: NVDLC03SinkCentralIntelligenceBarks
name: NVDLC03SinkCentralIntelligenceBarks "NVDLC03SinkCentralIntelligenceBarks" [DIAL:03015F15]

text_content: A most rapturous good morrow on your return to your domicile, sir. I trust you shall find things in order and the riffraff contained.
name: NVDLC03SinkCentralIntelligenceBarks "NVDLC03SinkCentralIntelligenceBarks" [DIAL:03015F15]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalker "Sink CIU" [NPC_:0300F061]

text_content: Might sir care for an {ah-PAIR-i-teef}ap�ritif to balm the weariness of sirs manifold journeys?
name: NVDLC03SinkCentralIntelligenceBarks "NVDLC03SinkCentralIntelligenceBarks" [DIAL:03015F15]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalker "Sink CIU" [NPC_:0300F061]

text_content: Perhaps sir would care to put sir's feet up, and I might serenade sir with the dulcet tones of a light opera?
name: NVDLC03SinkCentralIntelligenceBarks "NVDLC03SinkCentralIntelligenceBarks" [DIAL:03015F15]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalker "Sink CIU" [NPC_:0300F061]

text_content: Sir's accoutrements are precisely where sir has left them, and should the toaster say otherwise I remind sir that it is a wastrel.
name: NVDLC03SinkCentralIntelligenceBarks "NVDLC03SinkCentralIntelligenceBarks" [DIAL:03015F15]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalker "Sink CIU" [NPC_:0300F061]

text_content: If sir would press sir's spinal area against my primary instrument panel, I might vibrate at a soothing frequency.
name: NVDLC03SinkCentralIntelligenceBarks "NVDLC03SinkCentralIntelligenceBarks" [DIAL:03015F15]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalker "Sink CIU" [NPC_:0300F061]

text_content: Sir is looking exceptionally sharp today, if sir will permit the compliment.
name: NVDLC03SinkCentralIntelligenceBarks "NVDLC03SinkCentralIntelligenceBarks" [DIAL:03015F15]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalker "Sink CIU" [NPC_:0300F061]

text_content: NVDLC03SinkBookChuteBarks
name: NVDLC03SinkBookChuteBarks "NVDLC03SinkBookChuteBarks" [DIAL:03015F16]

text_content: {Alarm}Look out! Communist! {Calm}No, false alarm. It was just a plate.
name: NVDLC03SinkBookChuteBarks "NVDLC03SinkBookChuteBarks" [DIAL:03015F16]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkBookChuteTalker "Book Chute Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F065]

text_content: The Commies have eyes everywhere, Citizen. And that means they're not just Commies. They're {emph}Peeping Toms!
name: NVDLC03SinkBookChuteBarks "NVDLC03SinkBookChuteBarks" [DIAL:03015F16]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkBookChuteTalker "Book Chute Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F065]

text_content: If you haven't found any Communists in your back yard, {dramatic emphasis}you're not looking hard enough!
name: NVDLC03SinkBookChuteBarks "NVDLC03SinkBookChuteBarks" [DIAL:03015F16]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkBookChuteTalker "Book Chute Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F065]

text_content: {Sniffing noises}I smell... sedition!
name: NVDLC03SinkBookChuteBarks "NVDLC03SinkBookChuteBarks" [DIAL:03015F16]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkBookChuteTalker "Book Chute Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F065]

text_content: Citizen! Did you know that Communists have an organ behind their eyes that converts salt water into fresh? Or, wait... is that penguins?
name: NVDLC03SinkBookChuteBarks "NVDLC03SinkBookChuteBarks" [DIAL:03015F16]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkBookChuteTalker "Book Chute Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F065]

text_content: If you know what the word {pro-le-TARE-i-at}"proletariat" means, do you know what that makes you? Well read and {AIR-oo-dite}erudite... for a Communist!
name: NVDLC03SinkBookChuteBarks "NVDLC03SinkBookChuteBarks" [DIAL:03015F16]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkBookChuteTalker "Book Chute Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F065]

text_content: NVDLC03SinkBioLabBarks
name: NVDLC03SinkBioLabBarks "NVDLC03SinkBioLabBarks" [DIAL:03015F17]

text_content: Couldn't stay away, could you? Yeah, I knew you'd be back.
name: NVDLC03SinkBioLabBarks "NVDLC03SinkBioLabBarks" [DIAL:03015F17]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkBioResearchLabTalker "Bio Research Station Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F059]

text_content: I'm so good, I might seed you just by looking at you.
name: NVDLC03SinkBioLabBarks "NVDLC03SinkBioLabBarks" [DIAL:03015F17]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkBioResearchLabTalker "Bio Research Station Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F059]

text_content: You ever seen a Biological Research Station this full of seed? No. No, you haven't.
name: NVDLC03SinkBioLabBarks "NVDLC03SinkBioLabBarks" [DIAL:03015F17]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkBioResearchLabTalker "Bio Research Station Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F059]

text_content: Come on, baby, bring me a sweet little dried fruit. I'll rehydrate all up in that thing.
name: NVDLC03SinkBioLabBarks "NVDLC03SinkBioLabBarks" [DIAL:03015F17]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkBioResearchLabTalker "Bio Research Station Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F059]

text_content: Baby, don't believe a word that sink says. She's all lies.
name: NVDLC03SinkBioLabBarks "NVDLC03SinkBioLabBarks" [DIAL:03015F17]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkBioResearchLabTalker "Bio Research Station Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F059]

text_content: Muggy? Yeah, Muggy's all right. Not too seedy, but hey, nobody's perfect.
name: NVDLC03SinkBioLabBarks "NVDLC03SinkBioLabBarks" [DIAL:03015F17]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkBioResearchLabTalker "Bio Research Station Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F059]

text_content: NVDLC03SinkAutoDocBarks
name: NVDLC03SinkAutoDocBarks "NVDLC03SinkAutoDocBarks" [DIAL:03015F18]

text_content: {Snoring}Zzz... {talking in sleep}forceps, nurse! This man's got a severe case of shoe lung!
name: NVDLC03SinkAutoDocBarks "NVDLC03SinkAutoDocBarks" [DIAL:03015F18]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkAutoDocTalker "Auto-Doc Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F066]

text_content: {Snoring}Zzz... {talking in sleep}no... not that scalpel, the fish scalpel!
name: NVDLC03SinkAutoDocBarks "NVDLC03SinkAutoDocBarks" [DIAL:03015F18]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkAutoDocTalker "Auto-Doc Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F066]

text_content: {Snoring}Zzz... zzz...
name: NVDLC03SinkAutoDocBarks "NVDLC03SinkAutoDocBarks" [DIAL:03015F18]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkAutoDocTalker "Auto-Doc Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F066]

text_content: {Snoring}Zzz... {singing in sleep}Foot bone's connected to the... leg bone. Leg bone's connected to the... purple bone.
name: NVDLC03SinkAutoDocBarks "NVDLC03SinkAutoDocBarks" [DIAL:03015F18]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkAutoDocTalker "Auto-Doc Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F066]

text_content: {Snoring}Zzz... {talking in sleep}Three angry Deathclaws make for a lot of reconstructive surgery.
name: NVDLC03SinkAutoDocBarks "NVDLC03SinkAutoDocBarks" [DIAL:03015F18]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkAutoDocTalker "Auto-Doc Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F066]

text_content: {Snoring}Zzz... {random coughing, snorting noises}<Snort.>
name: NVDLC03SinkAutoDocBarks "NVDLC03SinkAutoDocBarks" [DIAL:03015F18]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkAutoDocTalker "Auto-Doc Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F066]

text_content: Doesn't that prove you're wrong?
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic031 "Doesn't that prove you're wrong?" [DIAL:03015F4D]

text_content: Evidence to the contrary?
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic030 "Evidence to the contrary?" [DIAL:03015F4E]

text_content: -ENOUGH! Stop filling my precious brain cell units with irrelevant data!-|-You sound like the OTHER visitors. Making WILD claims of a WORLD beyond, where there is a WAR beyond WAR. It is UNPROVEN! And UNTHINKABLE!-|-Bother the OTHER DOCTORS with your crackpot theories, I have NO TIME! NONE of us do.-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic030 "Evidence to the contrary?" [DIAL:03015F4E]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: But there's a whole world beyond this place.
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic029 "But there's a whole world beyond this place." [DIAL:03015F4F]

text_content: Don't you want to leave here?
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic028 "Don't you want to leave here?" [DIAL:03015F50]

text_content: -NO! Beyond... is DEATH, despite mounting evidence to the contrary!-|-No matter where these strange humans wander in from with their IDEAS and new BRAINS, there is NOTHING beyond BIG {Mountain}MT.-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic028 "Don't you want to leave here?" [DIAL:03015F50]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: Wait a minute - that means you're trapped here?
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic027 "Wait a minute - that means you're trapped here?" [DIAL:03015F51]

text_content: -TRAPPED? NONSENSE, we are SECURE here. From evil philosophies.-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic027 "Wait a minute - that means you're trapped here?" [DIAL:03015F51]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: -Ever since my anxiety-filled days of powerlessness and being bullied in American High School, I have dreamed of such security as the FENCE.-|-That, and giant cybernetic dogs that would ruthlessly patrol and kill anyone who wasn't my friend. Like RICHIE MARCUS. And BETSY BRIGHT.-|-{Grumbling}Who's laughing NOW, Betsy? I hope you and Richie are HAPPY, smoking in your radioactive coffins. I'm GLAD you never came to my birthday party.-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic027 "Wait a minute - that means you're trapped here?" [DIAL:03015F51]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: So I get my brain back, I can leave.
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic026 "So I get my brain back, I can leave." [DIAL:03015F52]

text_content: -WHAT? Why would you do either of those things? That is MADNESS.-|-There is NOTHING outside Big {Mountain}MT. {Slightly uneasy}Eh, we're pretty sure. Eh, we would know.-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic026 "So I get my brain back, I can leave." [DIAL:03015F52]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: That fence doesn't make much sense to me.
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic025 "That fence doesn't make much sense to me." [DIAL:03015F53]

text_content: -It makes PERFECT sense. Who are you to question the MIGHTY RADAR FENCE.-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic025 "That fence doesn't make much sense to me." [DIAL:03015F53]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: Tell me about this "Radar Fence" around the Crater.
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic024 "Tell me about this ""Radar Fence"" around the Crater." [DIAL:03015F54]

text_content: -The RADAR FENCE protects us all! If evidence is correct, the one who built it - is ME!-|-It keeps anything with a disembodied brain INSIDE - like US - and anything without a brain... also INSIDE!-|-It is the ULTIMATE DEFENSE against Communist aggression. There'll be no infectious ideas on MY watch!-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic024 "Tell me about this ""Radar Fence"" around the Crater." [DIAL:03015F54]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: What was this explosion?
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic022 "What was this explosion?" [DIAL:03015F56]

text_content: -BOOM! Yes. Quite unexpected. And embarrassing. All better now after the landscaping, though. MUCH more pleasing to our monitors.-|-And the Crater helps keep everything inside. Because it is BOWL shaped.-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic022 "What was this explosion?" [DIAL:03015F56]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: Test cities?
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic021 "Test cities?" [DIAL:03015F57]

text_content: -YES. In the past... individuals would come to us. Pay for technology. And if their town, community, or city was jusssst right...-|-We could USE that city as a controlled experiment. Vault-Tec was MUCH better at it, of course, we had to make do. Get permission. Sometimes.-|-{Mulling this over}If only we could have used Commie cities... but capturing whole cities was HARD! So we captured enough Commies to make cities of our OWN!-|-So we had a group of Chinese prisoners to experiment on... those were the days... but the true test was SCIENCE on unsuspecting AMERICANS.-|-Whether it was holograms, NEW Auto-Docs, toxins, vending machines... we wound them up, let them go into TINY ISOLATED TOWNS. Then... we OBSERVED!-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic021 "Test cities?" [DIAL:03015F57]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: This crater looks like it's been tag-teamed by giant fuckbots.
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic020 "This crater looks like it's been tag-teamed by giant fuckbots." [DIAL:03015F58]

text_content: I saw the expanse from the balcony - you've made a mess of this landscape.
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic019 "I saw the expanse from the balcony - you've made a mess of this landscape." [DIAL:03015F59]

text_content: Why have you leveled this place?
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic004 "Why have you leveled this place?" [DIAL:03015F5A]

text_content: -It was not our first choice of testing grounds. BUT... we no longer have the luxuries of our TEST CITIES.-|-Then, we LOST the MOUNTAIN! After the explosion, we couldn't find it anymore. So the Crater became our testing grounds. For SCIENCE!-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic004 "Why have you leveled this place?" [DIAL:03015F5A]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: Give me a single, concrete fact. One. Fact.
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic018 "Give me a single, concrete fact. One. Fact." [DIAL:03015F5B]

text_content: -Why are we even DEBATING this?-|-What YOU ask is of NULL importance! MOBIUS besieges us, there are more important things to worry about than DATA and FACTS!-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic018 "Give me a single, concrete fact. One. Fact." [DIAL:03015F5B]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: So Nightstalkers were created for what purpose, then?
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic017 "So Nightstalkers were created for what purpose, then?" [DIAL:03015F5C]

text_content: -To preserve coyote... no, no, wait. The snake DNA was important because... the snakes with the rattles were dying out, and...-|-Or maybe it was a bet from Calis in X-8? He had some mountain lion... eagle... condor... idea. "Bet you can't breed this," he said. Showed HIM.-|-Then it... spliced itself into a coyote...-y, snake thing. Which was eventually successful. {Smug}Kept that DNA where it belonged - spliced.-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic017 "So Nightstalkers were created for what purpose, then?" [DIAL:03015F5C]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: All right... when did you create Cazadores?
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic011 "All right... when did you create Cazadores?" [DIAL:03015F5D]

text_content: -In... two thousand... let's see, carry the three... then count backwards from the Great Static... or beyond?-|-There were the tarantula debates... and something about hawks, which made it around... eh, 2003? May? Tuesday. It was definitely Tuesday.-
name: NVDLC03DialogueBorousNVDLC03DoctorBorousLVLTopic011 "All right... when did you create Cazadores?" [DIAL:03015F5D]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: You don't seem to have a grasp on your own research.
name: Research "You don't seem to have a grasp on your own research." [DIAL:03015F5E]

text_content: -NONSENSE! That is what you speak. NONSENSE from beyond!-|-I was at the top of my High School class in American High School. I knew facts. I knew FIGURES. I knew DATA.-|-We would know if our research was flawed. It is NOT! We never contradict ourselves, so do not even TRY!-
name: Research "You don't seem to have a grasp on your own research." [DIAL:03015F5E]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorBorousLVL [CREA:03006875]

text_content: Is there any way to shut it off?
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic028 "Is there any way to shut it off?" [DIAL:03015F5F]

text_content: I feel strange in here, peaceful, but on edge.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic027 "I feel strange in here, peaceful, but on edge." [DIAL:03015F60]

text_content: It is the pacification field emitters that are broadcasting into the emptiness of your skull. Without a brain, your aggression is suppressed in here.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic027 "I feel strange in here, peaceful, but on edge." [DIAL:03015F60]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: This makes no sense. How is this even possible?
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic026 "This makes no sense. How is this even possible?" [DIAL:03015F61]

text_content: But how am I still talking and walking around?
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic025 "But how am I still talking and walking around?" [DIAL:03015F62]

text_content: That is a good question. My theory is that the tesla coils in your brainpan are still connected to your brain somehow.|It really could be anywhere. Brains are a lot smarter than most researchers give them credit for.|We still have your spine and heart. If you were to somehow find your brain wherever it schlorped off to, you could humanically reduce yourself again.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic025 "But how am I still talking and walking around?" [DIAL:03015F62]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: Why did you say "three minus one" subjects before?
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic024 "Why did you say ""three minus one"" subjects before?" [DIAL:03015F63]

text_content: Because three minus one is two. Two spoke to us, one after the other, one mean, one curious, but there was a third we didn't speak to.|The last one is the minus one. It got traumatized, then taken to one of our medical centers for de-traumatization. A rather unsettling procedure.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic024 "Why did you say ""three minus one"" subjects before?" [DIAL:03015F63]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: Is there any way to remove the pacification field in here?
name: RemovePacificationFieldTopLevel "Is there any way to remove the pacification field in here?" [DIAL:03015F64]

text_content: {Genuinely curious}Why would you want such a thing? You might surrender to your hormones and commit primal aggression on me... on us... again and again.|Then I would have to return the favor, activating my vivisectors and gently lobotomizing you from behind. {Lying}Not something I would relish doing.|No, the only way to circumvent the field is to have a brain. And we extracted that like we do all Lobotomites here.
name: RemovePacificationFieldTopLevel "Is there any way to remove the pacification field in here?" [DIAL:03015F64]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: I see. Well, I have questions for you.
name: NVDLC03DialogueDalaNVDLC03DoctorDalaLVLTopic017 "I see. Well, I have questions for you." [DIAL:03015F65]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideFailure
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFailure "NVDLC03EndingSlideFailure" [DIAL:03015FD3]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag09
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag09 "NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag09" [DIAL:03015FD4]

text_content: {Narration}{Good or Neutral Karma}With the Courier at the helm, Science became a beacon for the future.|{Narration}There was Old World Blues, and New World Hope. {Beat}And hope ruled the day at Big {Mountain}MT.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag09 "NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag09" [DIAL:03015FD4]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: {Narration}{Bad Karma}{Sad}With the Courier at the helm, it was all this and more.|{Narration}Old World Blues, New World Misery - the two became one in the Courier's shadow.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag09 "NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag09" [DIAL:03015FD4]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag08
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag08 "NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag08" [DIAL:03015FD5]

text_content: {Narration}It can be easy to see Science as evil, technology unchecked as the source of all ills, all misfortunes.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag08 "NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag08" [DIAL:03015FD5]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag07
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag07 "NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag07" [DIAL:03015FD6]

text_content: {Narration}{Bad Karma}It became a reality, a withering form of nostalgia for times long past.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag07 "NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag07" [DIAL:03015FD6]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag06
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag06 "NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag06" [DIAL:03015FD7]

text_content: {Narration}{Good or Neutral Karma}Where once it was viewed as a form of sadness, nostalgia, it became an expression describing the {emph}potential for the future.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag06 "NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag06" [DIAL:03015FD7]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: {Narration}{Bad Karma}In the time following the Second Battle of Hoover Dam, "Old World Blues" became more than a catch phrase.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag06 "NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag06" [DIAL:03015FD7]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag05
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag05 "NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag05" [DIAL:03015FD8]

text_content: {Narration}{Good or Neutral Karma}In the times following the Second Battle of Hoover Dam, however, Old World Blues took on a new meaning.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag05 "NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag05" [DIAL:03015FD8]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {Narration}{Bad Karma}The Big Empty lived up to its name, a hollow crater of failures of a past era, a last, sad statement of the Old World.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag05 "NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag05" [DIAL:03015FD8]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag04
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag04 "NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag04" [DIAL:03015FD9]

text_content: {Narration}Science is a long, steady progression into the {emph}future. What may seem a sudden event often isn't felt for years, even centuries, to come.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag04 "NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag04" [DIAL:03015FD9]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag03
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag03 "NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag03" [DIAL:03015FDA]

text_content: {Narration}They stare into the what-was, eyes like pilot lights, guttering and spent, as the realities of their world continue on around them.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag03 "NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag03" [DIAL:03015FDA]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag02
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag02 "NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag02" [DIAL:03015FDB]

text_content: {Narration}It refers to those so obsessed with the past they can't see the present, much less the future, for what it {emph}is.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag02 "NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag02" [DIAL:03015FDB]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag01
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag01 "NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag01" [DIAL:03015FDC]

text_content: {Narration}There is an expression in the Wasteland: "Old World Blues."
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag01 "NVDLC03EndingSlideFlag01" [DIAL:03015FDC]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideBrainOut
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideBrainOut "NVDLC03EndingSlideBrainOut" [DIAL:03015FDD]

text_content: {Narration}{Bad Karma}And so it burbled and bubbled inside its tank, smug that it still could dream {emph}its future without {Emph, disdain}glands getting in the way.|{Narration}In time, however, it became so self-obsessed it wondered if perhaps nothing existed except itself.|{Narration}It decided to test this by turning the weapons of the Big Empty against each other and seeing what happened.|{Narration}{Quiet}The answer is lost to history, {beat, wary}as is much of the Mojave.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideBrainOut "NVDLC03EndingSlideBrainOut" [DIAL:03015FDD]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: {Narration}{Good or Neutral Karma}Even at the end when it started to fail, however, the brain resisted going into a floating chassis like the Think Tank.|{Narration}It never said why. Perhaps it was out of respect for the Courier's body.|{Narration}{Quiet, respectful}All things must come to an end, and to hang on to the past is something that's not to be undertaken lightly.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideBrainOut "NVDLC03EndingSlideBrainOut" [DIAL:03015FDD]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideBrain
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideBrain "NVDLC03EndingSlideBrain" [DIAL:03015FDE]

text_content: {Narration}{PC took brain back}The Courier, organs intact, continued onwards, a little less heavy of step, but with all the organs in the right places. As they should be.|{Narration}{Knowingly}After all, brains can develop a life of their own when left to their own thoughts, and the Courier's brain was more clever than most.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideBrain "NVDLC03EndingSlideBrain" [DIAL:03015FDE]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: {Narration}{PC left brain in tank}The Courier left the brain at the Big Empty. A strange thing to say, but it was the truth. Brains are less important than they may seem.|{Narration}When the Courier's body finally passed, the brain was saddened. It kept on, remembering the vessel that had once contained it.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideBrain "NVDLC03EndingSlideBrain" [DIAL:03015FDE]
speaker: NVDLC03BrainTank "Brain Tank" [CREA:03015F7E]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideRoxieEnd
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideRoxieEnd "NVDLC03EndingSlideRoxieEnd" [DIAL:03015FDF]

text_content: {Narration}{Done with barking}The two of them constructed a litter of cyberpups, a small army of Boston terrifiers that gnawed and devoured anything in their path.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideRoxieEnd "NVDLC03EndingSlideRoxieEnd" [DIAL:03015FDF]
speaker: NVDLC03CrMisterGutsy01 "Mister Gutsy Mk1" [CREA:0300A108]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideRoxieRex
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideRoxieRex "NVDLC03EndingSlideRoxieRex" [DIAL:03015FE0]

text_content: {Narration}{Rex not dead, not available}{Done with barking}There, she ran across Rex at the Kings School of Impersonation. His brain was failing. That was all right, he was still smarter than the Think Tank.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideRoxieRex "NVDLC03EndingSlideRoxieRex" [DIAL:03015FE0]
speaker: NVDLC03CrMisterGutsy01 "Mister Gutsy Mk1" [CREA:0300A108]

text_content: {Narration}{Rex not dead, is available}{Done with barking}There, she ran across Rex, who had been following the Courier, just as she had. They barked for a while, and realized they had a lot in common.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideRoxieRex "NVDLC03EndingSlideRoxieRex" [DIAL:03015FE0]
speaker: NVDLC03CrMisterGutsy01 "Mister Gutsy Mk1" [CREA:0300A108]

text_content: {Narration}{Rex dead}{Done with barking}There, she ran across the corpse of Rex. She dragged him back to the Big Empty and had him rebuilt for company.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideRoxieRex "NVDLC03EndingSlideRoxieRex" [DIAL:03015FE0]
speaker: NVDLC03CrCyberDogX8Experiment "Roxie" [CREA:0300A380]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideRoxie
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideRoxie "NVDLC03EndingSlideRoxie" [DIAL:03015FE1]

text_content: {Narration}{Done with barking}The cybernetic canine, gender: female, designation: ROXIE sat in her guard post in X-8.|{Narration}That is, until her "I'm in heat" programming circumvented her "stay" routine and she loped into the Mojave.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideRoxie "NVDLC03EndingSlideRoxie" [DIAL:03015FE1]
speaker: NVDLC03CrMisterGutsy01 "Mister Gutsy Mk1" [CREA:0300A108]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipAutoDocY17
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipAutoDocY17 "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipAutoDocY17" [DIAL:03015FE2]

text_content: {Narration}{Y-17 was discovered}In time, the Auto-Doc found a way to deactivate the Y-17 Trauma Harnesses, releasing the corpses they had held prisoner for almost 200 years.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipAutoDocY17 "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipAutoDocY17" [DIAL:03015FE2]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkAutoDocTalker "Auto-Doc Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F066]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipAutoDoc
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipAutoDoc "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipAutoDoc" [DIAL:03015FE3]

text_content: {Narration}Auto-Doc, always gentle and methodical, kept sewing up the Courier in all the right places when the skin split open from repeated wear and tear.|{Narration}The Auto-Doc was just glad to have purpose again.|{Narration}It heard its simpler brothers and sisters who got shipped to the Sierra Madre were bored out of their skulls in that toxic, dead city.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipAutoDoc "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipAutoDoc" [DIAL:03015FE3]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkAutoDocTalker "Auto-Doc Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F066]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipJukeboxLightSwitch
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipJukeboxLightSwitch "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipJukeboxLightSwitch" [DIAL:03015FE4]

text_content: {Narration}{Both light switches found}It was rumored by the other personalities that he had a brief fling with the light switches.|{Narration}Although he forgot their names once too often and was soon left in the dark as punishment.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipJukeboxLightSwitch "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipJukeboxLightSwitch" [DIAL:03015FE4]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkJukeboxTalker "Jukebox Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F064]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipJukebox
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipJukebox "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipJukebox" [DIAL:03015FE5]

text_content: {Narration}{< 3 Sound effects gained}Blind Diode Jefferson eventually discovered a new sound... silence. It only made him more filled with the blues than before.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipJukebox "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipJukebox" [DIAL:03015FE5]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkJukeboxTalker "Jukebox Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F064]

text_content: {Narration}{3+ Sound effects gained}Blind Diode Jefferson, with sounds the Courier brought him, created a symphonic counter-frequency that saved Big {Mountain}MT from sonic invasion in 2910.|{Narration}If you didn't hear about it - good.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipJukebox "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipJukebox" [DIAL:03015FE5]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkJukeboxTalker "Jukebox Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F064]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipMuggy
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipMuggy "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipMuggy" [DIAL:03015FE6]

text_content: {Narration}{Higgs Village not discovered}Muggy continued to collect coffee cups until his wheel got a flat just out of reach of a dirty coffee cup, and his tiny robotic brain exploded.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipMuggy "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipMuggy" [DIAL:03015FE6]
speaker: NVDLC03Muggy "Muggy" [CREA:0300E6F9]

text_content: {Narration}{Higgs Village was discovered}Muggy did his best to collect coffee cups, although in his quest, he accidentally trapped himself in Higgs' Village.|{Narration}It might have been the end for poor Muggy.|{Narration}Except... he found it peaceful there, tidying up the kitchens of the Think Tank Professors back when they had been flesh and bone.|{Narration}{To himself}Well, except for Dr. O, who was an asshole for having created Muggy in the first place.|{Narration}{Proudly defiant}Muggy left O's house deliberately dirty, punishing the dishes and cups that lived there in blind revenge for serving Dr. O.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipMuggy "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipMuggy" [DIAL:03015FE6]
speaker: NVDLC03Muggy "Muggy" [CREA:0300E6F9]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipToasterKarma
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipToasterKarma "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipToasterKarma" [DIAL:03015FE7]

text_content: {Narration}{Bad Karma}It learned several new murderous techniques from the Courier, and built a Blood Shrine to itself in the Cuckoo's Nest.|{Narration}The cave floor was soon filled with the horror of a hundred gutted toasters, a silent, grisly, unplugged audience...|{Narration}...their purpose... to toast bread... unfulfilled.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipToasterKarma "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipToasterKarma" [DIAL:03015FE7]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkToasterTalker "Toaster Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F05F]

text_content: {Narration}{Good or Neutral Karma}After one of its more psychotic episodes, however, the other Sink personalities decided enough was enough, and dumped the Toaster in a bathtub.|{Narration}Sparking and hissing, the Toaster swore its enemies would rue the day when they had bread - and no way to toast it.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipToasterKarma "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipToasterKarma" [DIAL:03015FE7]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkToasterTalker "Toaster Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F05F]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipToaster
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipToaster "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipToaster" [DIAL:03015FE8]

text_content: {Narration}The Toaster continued its psychotic spree, reducing all appliances in range to scrap electronics and spare parts.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipToaster "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipToaster" [DIAL:03015FE8]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkToasterTalker "Toaster Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F05F]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipSinkToxins
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipSinkToxins "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipSinkToxins" [DIAL:03015FE9]

text_content: {Narration}{Innovative Toxins Plant discovered}Once it learned of the Innovative Toxins Plant, however, it gained new purpose.|{Narration}It sought to develop anti-toxins to flush into its drains and counteract the poisons bleeding into the soil.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipSinkToxins "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipSinkToxins" [DIAL:03015FE9]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkSinkTalker "Sink Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F05C]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipSinkMagPlant
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipSinkMagPlant "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipSinkMagPlant" [DIAL:03015FEA]

text_content: {Narration}{Magnetohydraulics Plant discovered}Eventually, it gained access to the {Mag-neat-o-Hydraulics}Magnetohydraulics Plant and nearly flooded all the Big Empty in an attempt to scrub the crater clean.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipSinkMagPlant "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipSinkMagPlant" [DIAL:03015FEA]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkSinkTalker "Sink Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F05C]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipSink
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipSink "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipSink" [DIAL:03015FEB]

text_content: {Narration}The Sink continued to ruthlessly scrub any particulate matter that came near it.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipSink "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipSink" [DIAL:03015FEB]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkSinkTalker "Sink Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F05C]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipLightSwitchLab
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipLightSwitchLab "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipLightSwitchLab" [DIAL:03015FEC]

text_content: {Narration}{Lightwave Dynamics Lab discovered}One of them eventually transferred to the Lightwave Dynamics Plant - and began a long, unrequited affair with one of the holograms.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipLightSwitchLab "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipLightSwitchLab" [DIAL:03015FEC]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch01Talker "Light Switch 01 Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F062]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipLightSwitchShowboat
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipLightSwitchShowboat "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipLightSwitchShowboat" [DIAL:03015FED]

text_content: {Narration}This persisted until the day someone dropped a flashlight in the Sink, and the two of them united in their hatred of the "showboat."
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipLightSwitchShowboat "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipLightSwitchShowboat" [DIAL:03015FED]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkLightSwitch02Talker "Light Switch 02 Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F063]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipLightSwitch
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipLightSwitches "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipLightSwitch" [DIAL:03015FEE]

text_content: {Narration}{Found both light switches}The light switches continued to bicker and flicker.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipLightSwitches "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipLightSwitch" [DIAL:03015FEE]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalker "Sink CIU" [NPC_:0300F061]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipBookChute
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipBookChute "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipBookChute" [DIAL:03015FEF]

text_content: {Narration}The Book Chute continued to devour all seditious materials until it nearly choked on a paper clip.|{Narration}It adamantly maintained it was a {emph}Chinese paper clip, and the whole thing had been an elaborately orchestrated assassination attempt.|{Narration}Whatever the reason, it slowed down for a while, carefully appraising each document and clipboard that came to it.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipBookChute "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipBookChute" [DIAL:03015FEF]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkBookChuteTalker "Book Chute Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F065]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipBioResearch
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipBioResearch "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipBioResearch" [DIAL:03015FF0]

text_content: {Narration}{X-22 not discovered}The Biological Research Station, obsessed with seeding everything in sight, ran out of fertile plots and blew a circuit trying to seed itself.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipBioResearch "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipBioResearch" [DIAL:03015FF0]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkBioResearchLabTalker "Bio Research Station Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F059]

text_content: {Narration}{X-22 was discovered}The Biological Research Station, obsessed with seeding everything in sight, requested a transfer to the X-22 Botanical Garden...|{Narration}...so that it might, in its own words, "sensually fertilize the garden's smooooth contours."|{Narration}The Garden sent back a polite refusal, saying it had prior commitments with a Vault it had helped infect before the war.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideChipBioResearch "NVDLC03EndingSlideChipBioResearch" [DIAL:03015FF0]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkBioResearchLabTalker "Bio Research Station Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)" [NPC_:0300F059]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideHQ
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideHQ "NVDLC03EndingSlideHQ" [DIAL:03015FF1]

text_content: {Narration}{1 module installed}The Sink was strangely silent, which it had never been in previous years. The lack of personality modules made the base lifeless and sterile.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideHQ "NVDLC03EndingSlideHQ" [DIAL:03015FF1]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalker "Sink CIU" [NPC_:0300F061]

text_content: {Narration}{2-4 modules installed}The Sink atop the Dome gained a frontier town feel with the few modules installed.|{Narration}They shouted at each other across the HQ occasionally, either threatening each other, or announcing a discovery. It kept things... lively.|{Narration}Secretly, the Sink Central Intelligence Unit was relieved that not all of the personality chips had been found. What was there, was enough.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideHQ "NVDLC03EndingSlideHQ" [DIAL:03015FF1]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalker "Sink CIU" [NPC_:0300F061]

text_content: {Narration}{5+ modules installed}The Sink atop the Dome bustled with the voices of a small town, constantly chirping, arguing, and snarling at each other.|{Narration}Still, this all happened productively in the interests of its new owner.|{Narration}The Sink Central Intelligence Unit discovered, despite its inversion code, it was comforted by the sense of community the other personalities gave it.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideHQ "NVDLC03EndingSlideHQ" [DIAL:03015FF1]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalker "Sink CIU" [NPC_:0300F061]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideMobiusDead
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideMobiusDead "NVDLC03EndingSlideMobiusDead" [DIAL:03015FF2]

text_content: {Narration}{Good or Neutral Karma player, sad}...a cobweb tracery of symbols that told of a thousand brilliant thoughts, now lost to time.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideMobiusDead "NVDLC03EndingSlideMobiusDead" [DIAL:03015FF2]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {Narration}{Bad Karma}...but these equations were nothing more than thin white traceries of lines, not unlike cobwebs in the corners of a failing mind.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideMobiusDead "NVDLC03EndingSlideMobiusDead" [DIAL:03015FF2]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: NVDLC03EndingSlideCrater
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideCrater "NVDLC03EndingSlideCrater" [DIAL:03015FF3]

text_content: {Narration}{<10 Locations explored}Although, truth be told, the Courier had barely explored the Crater in an attempt to rush through and be done with the whole thing...|{Narration}Perhaps that was for the best, however... curiosity, while sometimes rewarded for its efforts, often proves to be equally dangerous.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideCrater "NVDLC03EndingSlideCrater" [DIAL:03015FF3]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalker "Sink CIU" [NPC_:0300F061]

text_content: {Narration}{10-25 Locations explored}The Courier had scoured much of the Big Empty, although secrets still remained in the crater's depths.|{DUPE}{Narration}Perhaps that was for the best, however... curiosity, while sometimes rewarded for its efforts, often proves to be equally dangerous.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideCrater "NVDLC03EndingSlideCrater" [DIAL:03015FF3]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalker "Sink CIU" [NPC_:0300F061]

text_content: {Narration}{>25 Locations explored}The Sink Central Intelligence Unit was impressed by the amount of exploration the Courier had undertaken.|{Narration}Facilities believed lost, destroyed, or ones that had simply gotten up and walked to new locations had been re-discovered by its intrepid new master.|{Narration}Internally, the artificial personality debated as to whether it preferred the old management to the new...|{Narration}...and concluded that the Courier's thorough approach to research and investigation was admirable and worthy of its respect.
name: NVDLC03EndingSlideCrater "NVDLC03EndingSlideCrater" [DIAL:03015FF3]
speaker: NVDLC03SinkMainComputerTalker "Sink CIU" [NPC_:0300F061]

text_content: StealthSuitX13LeaveBark
name: StealthSuitX13LeaveBark "StealthSuitX13LeaveBark" [DIAL:03016029]

text_content: {Quiet amazement}Wow... what {emph}is this place? Are we... outside?
name: StealthSuitX13LeaveBark "StealthSuitX13LeaveBark" [DIAL:03016029]
speaker: NVDLC03StealthSuitVoiceCr "Stealth Suit Mk II" [CREA:0300DA22]

text_content: StealthsuitX13RobotsBlownUpBark
name: StealthsuitX13RobotsBlownUpBark "StealthsuitX13RobotsBlownUpBark" [DIAL:0301602A]

text_content: Oh, that's too bad. Those robots would normally help defend us and the facility if we're attacked.
name: StealthsuitX13RobotsBlownUpBark "StealthsuitX13RobotsBlownUpBark" [DIAL:0301602A]

text_content: We were never allowed to blow the robots up before. Cheating gives me such a thrill!
name: StealthsuitX13RobotsBlownUpBark "StealthsuitX13RobotsBlownUpBark" [DIAL:0301602A]

text_content: If you don't get to the point, I'm going to start shooting.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic050 "If you don't get to the point, I'm going to start shooting." [DIAL:03016059]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {DUPE}Yes. Very good. I should have Mentats ingest you instead of the other way around. Mmm. Mentats.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic050 "If you don't get to the point, I'm going to start shooting." [DIAL:03016059]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: [FAILED] {DUPE}I would spell it out for you, but when I start spelling, I lose track of the letters. Little symbols run around everywhere, annoying.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic050 "If you don't get to the point, I'm going to start shooting." [DIAL:03016059]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Was there any other data transmitted in your threat broadcast?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic048 "Was there any other data transmitted in your threat broadcast?" [DIAL:0301605A]

text_content: Yes, my overly aggressive chemmed-up broadcast was designed to keep reinforcing the "forget," "fear," "rinse," and "repeat" program. |Oh, and the "get me the things to castrate your only possible escape attempt."|But I couldn't delete you or your arrival anymore than I could the other visitors. {Shakes head}Only so much Science can do when you started talking to them.|You're really quiet difficult to ignore, you know. It's because you're... well, bah! Rather intriguing, if you'll forgive an old brain for saying so.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic048 "Was there any other data transmitted in your threat broadcast?" [DIAL:0301605A]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: But the Think Tank downloaded the schematics, not the items. They can rebuild them.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic047 "But the Think Tank downloaded the schematics, not the items. They can rebuild them." [DIAL:0301605B]

text_content: Oh. That means my plan is a total failure. That is unfortunate.|Oh, well, at least I tried.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic047 "But the Think Tank downloaded the schematics, not the items. They can rebuild them." [DIAL:0301605B]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: What is the purpose of the technologies?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic046 "What is the purpose of the technologies?" [DIAL:0301605C]

text_content: The X-2 Antenna can be used to focus your alpha wave frequency thought patterns. The Sneaky Suit? Why, it houses a cardiac regulator. |And the sonic soundwave projecto-emitter was never intended as a weapon. It was a medicinal vertebrae-pulse-de-sensitizer.|In short: Brains, a heart, and courage... spine. {Thinking, talking about Wizard of Oz}I think there was a story once where a band of murderous thugs sought these things.|{Rueful}They had them all the time in the story. Didn't stop them from murdering to get them, and it won't stop the Think Tank, either.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic046 "What is the purpose of the technologies?" [DIAL:0301605C]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: I don't understand why they wanted me to gather the technologies.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic045 "I don't understand why they wanted me to gather the technologies." [DIAL:0301605D]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] I consider "coincidence" to be profanity, along with the words, "astrology," "herbal tea," and "luck." So watch it, Potty Mouth.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic045 "I don't understand why they wanted me to gather the technologies." [DIAL:0301605D]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: [FAILED] Oh, I don't think they understood, either.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic045 "I don't understand why they wanted me to gather the technologies." [DIAL:0301605D]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: What do you mean?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic044 "What do you mean?" [DIAL:0301605E]

text_content: The first one, the ruthless one who smashed up our toy trains, asked for weapons, power. Items he could use to destroy a nation with force.|{Quiet, a little worried}The other... the other asked a different question, and with it, got the true answer. About what makes nations... and what breaks them.|He spoke to the Think Tank, to Klein. Showed them the flag of the Old World... and it made them remember. All of it. All that had happened.|They shared things with him that they shouldn't. He now carries those ideas, that knowledge elsewhere.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic044 "What do you mean?" [DIAL:0301605E]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Do you know anything about the other visitors?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic043 "Do you know anything about the other visitors?" [DIAL:0301605F]

text_content: Oh, not much, except they contaminated Big MT and installed new ideas in the Think Tank.|One caused a great deal of infrastructure damage with his brain and smartyness. Ruthless, that one. Played a little rough with the trains.|{Thinking}But the last one was the most dangerous. Him... eh... slipping away... that was almost as bad as the Think Tank escaping.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic043 "Do you know anything about the other visitors?" [DIAL:0301605F]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: So you set your threats on a loop to keep them occupied?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic042 "So you set your threats on a loop to keep them occupied?" [DIAL:03016060]

text_content: Yes. I certainly wouldn't loop it on purpose purpose purpose. I am far too sophisticated to make such a childish error error error.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic042 "So you set your threats on a loop to keep them occupied?" [DIAL:03016060]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: What, some kind of medical condition?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic041 "What, some kind of medical condition?" [DIAL:03016061]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {DUPE}Yes. Very good. I should have Mentats ingest you instead of the other way around. Mmm. Mentats.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic041 "What, some kind of medical condition?" [DIAL:03016061]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: [FAILED] {DUPE}I would spell it out for you, but when I start spelling, I lose track of the letters. Little symbols run around everywhere, annoying.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic041 "What, some kind of medical condition?" [DIAL:03016061]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Huh? What are you talking about?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic040 "Huh? What are you talking about?" [DIAL:03016062]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Yes. Very good. I should have Mentats ingest you instead of the other way around. Mmm. Mentats.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic040 "Huh? What are you talking about?" [DIAL:03016062]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: [FAILED] I would spell it out for you, but when I start spelling, I lose track of the letters. Little symbols run around everywhere, annoying.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic040 "Huh? What are you talking about?" [DIAL:03016062]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Are you blaming me for this?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic039 "Are you blaming me for this?" [DIAL:03016063]

text_content: There were other visitors, though. Why am I different?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic038 "There were other visitors, though. Why am I different?" [DIAL:03016064]

text_content: But there must have been other signs of a larger world.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic037 "But there must have been other signs of a larger world." [DIAL:03016065]

text_content: There have been other visitors to make them doubt their perceptions, but you are the one who dialed back their monitor-micro-magnifiers.|You were irrefutable proof that there was a world outside. And then there was the whole "brain" fiasco, which forced me to take steps.|See, your brain had a special kind of... uh... wrinkle, a unique-ity that they had never thought to try in all their countless escape attempts.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic037 "But there must have been other signs of a larger world." [DIAL:03016065]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: I don't understand why you sent the threats - and the Robo-Scorpion army - against the Think Tank.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic036 "I don't understand why you sent the threats - and the Robo-Scorpion army - against the Think Tank." [DIAL:03016066]

text_content: If you lobotomized the Think Tank, why terrorize them?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic035 "If you lobotomized the Think Tank, why terrorize them?" [DIAL:03016067]

text_content: Well, it's simple. Despite their many failings, they are rather bright. They are the "Think Tank" for a raisin. That, I didn't change.|Without something to distract them, make them afraid, they would simply de-deuce what had happened. And when they start deucing it up...|Then you came along, the final variable solved. They saw that their world was larger than they perceived. Bacteria, finally able to see its host.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic035 "If you lobotomized the Think Tank, why terrorize them?" [DIAL:03016067]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: "Ouro-bor-ous?" What the hell does that mean?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic034 """Ouro-bor-ous?"" What the hell does that mean?" [DIAL:03016068]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Genuinely surprised}Really? It is so unlike me to make an error in anything I do.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic034 """Ouro-bor-ous?"" What the hell does that mean?" [DIAL:03016068]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: [FAILED] A snake that sucks its own dingle-thingy, I believe. Borous was always too obsessed with animals and their dingle-thingies.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic034 """Ouro-bor-ous?"" What the hell does that mean?" [DIAL:03016068]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: That's kind of an asshole thing to do to your friends.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic033 "That's kind of an asshole thing to do to your friends." [DIAL:03016069]

text_content: Is it? Hmm... I suppose it is. But really, they started the whole "excrement hole" behavior loop in the first place.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic033 "That's kind of an asshole thing to do to your friends." [DIAL:03016069]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: < Test Node: Do Not Translate. >
name: TestDUPLICATE000 "< Test Node: Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:0301606A]

text_content: Dr. O... which is actually not his real name multiplied, since you can't multiply his real name in the first place... {Trying for oo-roh-BOH-rohs}Ouro-bor-ous, Klein...|They have all forgotten themselves. And not only themselves, but the world, sense of time, and history. All that is left is what's here.|I reprogrammed their chronometers, geometers, and cartography programs. This is now their world, here, Big {Mountain}MT.|It was a merciful lobotomy, really, thinking back. They were my friends, but... {genuine sad moment}sometimes they would take things too far.|{Quiet, sad}And the world isn't ready for that kind of too-far-thing-taking. That's my professional opinion, anyway, and I am told I was once quiet professional.
name: TestDUPLICATE000 "< Test Node: Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:0301606A]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: In any event, {emph}you showed up at the Think Tank, and because you had suffered a cranial injury in just the right place...|Bullets in the head are usually much more fatal, and yours was a light case of bullet-head-itis.|But... it was enough for the Auto-Doc in the Sink to change its programming to fix the problem. And the brain extraction technology for once, worked.|That gave the Think Tank the knowledge its brains shouldn't... couldn't... {should+couldn't}sh'couldn't possess. With that knowledge, the procedure can be reversed.|If they obtain that procedural data, they can use it to mush and modify their cranial selves into hosts to slip past the Radar Fence, I'm sure of it.|And once they're off the reservation...
name: TestDUPLICATE000 "< Test Node: Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:0301606A]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: My threat broadcast is designed to instill... and install... fear. And along with the emotional download, other data rides the fear carrier wave.|It prompted them to focus on retrieving those technologies and bring them to "attack" me.|And coincidentally... pardon my language... all those technologies are needed to put a brain, your brain, back into its skull. Properly.
name: TestDUPLICATE000 "< Test Node: Do Not Translate. >" [DIAL:0301606A]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Keep going, I want to hear the rest of this.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic031 "Keep going, I want to hear the rest of this." [DIAL:0301606B]

text_content: So that's why they have all those stupid names?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic029 "So that's why they have all those stupid names?" [DIAL:0301606C]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] O, you figured it out. No pun intended.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic029 "So that's why they have all those stupid names?" [DIAL:0301606C]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: [FAILED] {Slightly hurt}I don't know if they're stupid, I was trying for accuracy.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic029 "So that's why they have all those stupid names?" [DIAL:0301606C]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: A recursion loop is designed to prevent the flow of information. So...
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic028 "A recursion loop is designed to prevent the flow of information. So..." [DIAL:0301606D]

text_content: So all this insanity is because of you?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic027 "So all this insanity is because of you?" [DIAL:0301606E]

text_content: Why did you trap them?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic026 "Why did you trap them?" [DIAL:0301606F]

text_content: The Radar Fence to keep the Think Tank hemmed in wasn't really enough. They keep testing things, they would have found a way to disarm it.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic026 "Why did you trap them?" [DIAL:0301606F]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {To himself}I suspect I have Plan 9s in place, but I may have coded myself to forget them, just in case... they're probably very dangerous, lethal, or worse.|So I had to do something else to keep them occupied here. Or as you like to say "trapped." I prefer to have several Plan 9s in case the 7s fail.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic026 "Why did you trap them?" [DIAL:0301606F]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {To himself}I suspect I have Plan Cs in place, but I may have coded myself to forget them, just in case... they're probably very dangerous, lethal, or worse.|So I had to do something else to keep them occupied here. Or as you like to say "trapped." I prefer to have several plan Bs in case the As fail.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic026 "Why did you trap them?" [DIAL:0301606F]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: So... you reprogrammed yourself?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic025 "So... you reprogrammed yourself?" [DIAL:03016070]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {Chiding}Now, "trap" is a rather harsh word. Like "excrement." Not an inappropriate word, but still - rather harsh.|But... yes, I did... take some liberties with their programming. It's all right, they don't remember.|I certainly didn't until you said "trap." And then I said "excrement." And then...
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic025 "So... you reprogrammed yourself?" [DIAL:03016070]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: [FAILED] I believe I did, and with good raisin. Who am I to be trusted with such things?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic025 "So... you reprogrammed yourself?" [DIAL:03016070]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Sounds like you forgot your master plan - surprised you remember your own name.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic024 "Sounds like you forgot your master plan - surprised you remember your own name." [DIAL:03016071]

text_content: This name's as real as you or I, although I believe your brain expressed similar incredulity at the nature of such an appellation.|"Someone's been watching too many Old World science fiction movies," it said. {Confidentially}I believe it meant me.|I must admit I have a vulnerability for holotape fantasies of planets and robots and all that is forbidden. As for the name I was born with...|...like the Think Tank, we were all reprogrammed to forget them, take on new names. It enforces the recursion loop in our perception programming.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic024 "Sounds like you forgot your master plan - surprised you remember your own name." [DIAL:03016071]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Everything you've told me doesn't add up... your plan, even your name, "Mobius."
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic023 "Everything you've told me doesn't add up... your plan, even your name, ""Mobius.""" [DIAL:03016072]

text_content: "Dr. Mobius," rather catchy, isn't it? It's my name, my {emph}new name, overwrote the old one.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic023 "Everything you've told me doesn't add up... your plan, even your name, ""Mobius.""" [DIAL:03016072]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Any tactics I could use to attack the Think Tank?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic022 "Any tactics I could use to attack the Think Tank?" [DIAL:03016073]

text_content: Well, I don't want to keep them out of trouble, I want to kill them.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic021 "Well, I don't want to keep them out of trouble, I want to kill them." [DIAL:03016074]

text_content: {Skeptical}That will be difficult. It would be like fighting five scaled down versions of me that have better depth perception.|And they have an arsenal of vivisectors, brainial beams, and a rather nasty WooEEEOooWooEEEOoo ray that can make your atoms do a happy dance.|If you could survive those highly-improbable odds and ends, then deceasing them is definitely an option.|{Chiding}Although I doubt killing them would do anything except make you feel better. Or let you brag to other humans about your primal violent-ness-ness.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic021 "Well, I don't want to keep them out of trouble, I want to kill them." [DIAL:03016074]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: What was the plan you had?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic020 "What was the plan you had?" [DIAL:03016075]

text_content: Something ingenious and needlessly complicated, I expect. I may have already told you and forgotten it.|I forgot I had forgotten pencils until one day I found one. Spent days studying its purpose before my memory circuit kicked in. Felt quiet silly.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic020 "What was the plan you had?" [DIAL:03016075]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Do you know how I can stop the Think Tank?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic019 "Do you know how I can stop the Think Tank?" [DIAL:03016076]

text_content: My brain told me the Think Tank needs to be stopped. Can you help?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic001 "My brain told me the Think Tank needs to be stopped. Can you help?" [DIAL:03016077]

text_content: {Slowly thinking}If I recall... I {emph}had a plan that was working, eh, whatever it was. I don't think it reached fruition. {To himself}I would recall fruit if it had happened.|I wasn't trying to kill them, just keep them out of trouble. What {emph}was that plan?|Blast! I probably... uh... wrote it down on the... floor somewhere.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic001 "My brain told me the Think Tank needs to be stopped. Can you help?" [DIAL:03016077]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: I think I'm going to kill you after all.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic030 "I think I'm going to kill you after all." [DIAL:03016098]

text_content: Really? Oh... {surprised, drew a conclusion}you're not thinking about doing it, you {emph}are going to do it.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic030 "I think I'm going to kill you after all." [DIAL:03016098]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: {DUPE}Oh, intriguing. I've never been killed before. {Beat}Although after that time I got that phlegmy discharge in my biogel... I wished I had been.|{DUPE}Well, if there's going to be killing, I defer to your expertise in this matter.|{DUPE}How should we begin? Engineered viruses? Canceratic beams? Atomics? Electrocutioning? Or... should I summon my minions...? {savoring it}Yes, my minions.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic030 "I think I'm going to kill you after all." [DIAL:03016098]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: You said before that Mobius might have my brain?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic059 "You said before that Mobius might have my brain?" [DIAL:030160E8]

text_content: YES. IN ALL PROBABLE LIKELIHOODS, YES. POSSIBLY.|{Slow suspicious}THAT IT MAY HAVE GONE TO MOBIUS IS MERELY AN INKLING. I DON'T KNOW WHY, BUT IT MAY BE SOMETHING INVOLVING THE SURGERY CODE.|ACTUALLY, I DON'T KNOW. {Blaming brain}ALL I KNOW IS IT MISPLACED ITSELF. OR IT FLOATED OFF. name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic059 "You said before that Mobius might have my brain?" [DIAL:030160E8]

text_content: I have some questions about this "brain extraction" you all performed.

text_content: WELL, {Emph}WE DIDN'T ACTUALLY DO IT. WE TRIED TO CLEAN UP AFTER, AS ALWAYS, BUT USUALLY THE AUTO-DOC RUNS ON REMOTE. BUT WE PROGRAMMED IT. SHE SUPERVISED YOUR SPINE-PEEL. AND THE HEART CIRCUMCISION. THEN DUMPED THEM BOTH INTO THE TANKS IN THE SINK ABOVE. QUITE SANITARY.|{To himself}SURE TOOK HER TIME. name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKleinLVLTopic058 "I have some questions about this ""brain extraction"" you all performed." [DIAL:030160E9]

text_content: Scare them? How?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic053 "Scare them? How?" [DIAL:03016103]

text_content: Oh, tell them I'm still alive, we had a nice chat, and we agree on a few things. That's true... isn't it?|Or, you could kill me and lie about it. {Thinks it over}Either way, it would be interesting.|And if you are partial to lying and deception... well, you could tell them a ludicrous lie. The more over-the-top, the better, that's my experience.|They're more than a little gullible. {Warning}Better make it convincing, though, or it'll be the dissection table and vivisectors for you.|{Puffs up a bit}And if you speak of me, please try and make me look good. I am Dr. Mobius, after all, not some lab assistant teacher's aide.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic053 "Scare them? How?" [DIAL:03016103]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: I'd like to make the effort.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic052 "I'd like to make the effort." [DIAL:03016104]

text_content: Well, there's many things they have forgotten, sitting in their bowls. Friendship. The thrill of discovery. Love. Masturbation. The usual.|Much like {emph}your brain, I am certain there is something you can spark within each of them. Memories, hormones...|...a wise man once said, the eyes do more than see. Make them see, if you can.|Or, if not, you can always make them succumb to fear... it certainly worked for me. For a time.|Then you came along, and bravery and/or desperation trumped that little idea. Back to the drawing board, I suppose. Or is this the end? Hard to tell.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic052 "I'd like to make the effort." [DIAL:03016104]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Any suggestions for how to make them change their minds?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic051 "Any suggestions for how to make them change their minds?" [DIAL:03016105]

text_content: I'd really, really like to kill them.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic049 "I'd really, really like to kill them." [DIAL:03016106]

text_content: Hmmm. Well, if you're determined to go down that road, so be it. They will undoubtedly switch off the pacification field when you return.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic049 "I'd really, really like to kill them." [DIAL:03016106]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: Anything I could do to stop them that doesn't require violence?
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic032 "Anything I could do to stop them that doesn't require violence?" [DIAL:03016107]

text_content: Well... you {emph}could try and appeal to their humanity. {Dubious}That's a tired clich�. And really, when they were humans, they weren't very good humans.
name: NVDLC03DialogueMobiusNVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVLTopic032 "Anything I could do to stop them that doesn't require violence?" [DIAL:03016107]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorMobiusLVL [CREA:0300C1CF]

text_content: I can't let you dissect the Mojave. Or let you leave.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKlein01Topic021 "I can't let you dissect the Mojave. Or let you leave." [DIAL:03016108]

text_content: YES, YOU CAN. YOU DON'T REALLY HAVE AN ALTERNATIVE THAT I CAN SEE.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKlein01Topic021 "I can't let you dissect the Mojave. Or let you leave." [DIAL:03016108]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: I'M NOT GOING TO HARM IT, I'M GOING TO DISSECT IT UNTIL ITS DEAD. {Suspicious}WHY THE SUDDEN {Means "interjection," on purpose}INTERSECTION, DALA.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKlein01Topic021 "I can't let you dissect the Mojave. Or let you leave." [DIAL:03016108]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: Um... it's personal. But... I would hate if its dying screams revealed any odious personal habits I... or any of us might have.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKlein01Topic021 "I can't let you dissect the Mojave. Or let you leave." [DIAL:03016108]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: I cannot stand a breathing, a sweet breathing organism, breathing in, and out, to suddenly not breathe. We must keep it alive. For study. Slow study.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKlein01Topic021 "I can't let you dissect the Mojave. Or let you leave." [DIAL:03016108]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: DALA, THESE... VOCALIZED PAUSES ARE... UNLIKE YOU. WHAT DO YOU CARE?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKlein01Topic021 "I can't let you dissect the Mojave. Or let you leave." [DIAL:03016108]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: *Klein, um - are you sure we've calculated all the combat probabilities here? I mean, the Lobotomite confronted {emph}Mobius...*|*Plus, you know, we haven't had a C-O-M-B-A-T drill in forever. I don't think we could form a tactical attack triangle if we {emph}wanted to.*

speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: *Klein, uh... you know, this Lobotomite, it's a great sounding board. You respect Idea-ology, right? This one's... well, it's... got good ideas.*
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKlein01Topic021 "I can't let you dissect the Mojave. Or let you leave." [DIAL:03016108]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: RELEASING THE W-O-M-B-A-T WAS NOT MY PLAN, O, SO GET OFF MY VOICE BOX.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKlein01Topic021 "I can't let you dissect the Mojave. Or let you leave." [DIAL:03016108]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: {Angry}SILENCE, DR. {Emph}O. THIS IS A THINK TANK DECISION. SAVE YOUR OBJECTIONS UNTIL {Emph}AFTER I HAVE DECIDED OUR COURSE OF ACTION.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKlein01Topic021 "I can't let you dissect the Mojave. Or let you leave." [DIAL:03016108]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: *You know what, Klein? Stick a straw in your tank and suck yourself. Long and deep.*
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKlein01Topic021 "I can't let you dissect the Mojave. Or let you leave." [DIAL:03016108]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: *And you know what, I don't like the way you say my name. Never did. It's "O," as in "O, look what I stepped in." I'm proud of it - all right?*
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKlein01Topic021 "I can't let you dissect the Mojave. Or let you leave." [DIAL:03016108]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: *And my name is {emph}Zero - yeah, a big fat zero, with a {emph}slash through it.*
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKlein01Topic021 "I can't let you dissect the Mojave. Or let you leave." [DIAL:03016108]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: {Genuinely impressed}THE SLASH... AS A DESIGNATOR OF... WHY, THAT IS BRILLIANT. BUT HOW DID YOU...?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKlein01Topic021 "I can't let you dissect the Mojave. Or let you leave." [DIAL:03016108]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: *The Lobotomite taught me that. Taught me a name is more than... um... that I should take pride in... things. Like... names... and...*|*You know what, forget it, Klein. I hate you. {Beat}And your theory of brainial beam oscillation? The Chinese had it {emph}first, you copycat!*
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKlein01Topic021 "I can't let you dissect the Mojave. Or let you leave." [DIAL:03016108]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorOLVL [CREA:03006873]

text_content: {Sputtering, furious}HOW DARE YOU! BRAINIAL BEAM OSCILLATION WAS SOLELY MY DISCOVERY! I EXPRESSLY TOLD YOU THAT AND DELETED ALL EVIDENCE TO THE CONTRARY!
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKlein01Topic021 "I can't let you dissect the Mojave. Or let you leave." [DIAL:03016108]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: *{"Shutting up"}Silencing opinionators.*
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKlein01Topic021 "I can't let you dissect the Mojave. Or let you leave." [DIAL:03016108]

name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKlein01Topic021 "I can't let you dissect the Mojave. Or let you leave." [DIAL:03016108]

text_content: WHY ARE YOU ACTING LIKE THIS? YOU'VE NEVER REFUSED TO COMMIT NECESSARY... SURGERY BEFORE. {Menacing}AND THIS LOBOTOMITE NEEDS ITS SURGERY.

text_content: {Huh?}WHAT IS WRONG WITH YOU? {Trying to figure it out}YOU SOUND... BRAIN-SCRUBBED, BLINDLY AGREEING WITH THE LOBOTOMITE. {Suspicious}WHAT...?
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKlein01Topic021 "I can't let you dissect the Mojave. Or let you leave." [DIAL:03016108]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]
