speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: -{Quiet, sad - actually leveling out}I, for one, cannot bear to let this continue.-|-I don't see what is to be gained by throwing another body into our labs... especially one that has done us a service, gone where we feared to go.-|-This Lobotomite doesn't deserve our knives. speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: Dr. Klein, I must... {intentional misuse of word}intersect. Please... do not harm the Lobotomite.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKlein01Topic021 "I can't let you dissect the Mojave. Or let you leave." [DIAL:03016108]
speaker: NVDLC03DoctorDalaLVL [CREA:03006872]

text_content: WHY AM I EVEN LISTENING TO YOU FOOLS? THE DETERMINATORS ARE GREATER THAN THE HESITATORS. SO HESITATORS, BE QUIET.

text_content: WE ARE BIGGER, SMARTER, AND FLOATIER THAN YOU, LOBOTOMITE. WE DON'T WISH TO FIGHT YOU, SO SURRENDER YOUR BRAIN. NOW.

speaker: NVDLC03DoctorKleinLVL [CREA:0300D628]

text_content: Mobius and I talked it over, reached an understanding.
name: NVDLC03DialogueKleinNVDLC03DoctorKlein01Topic020 "Mobius and I talked it over, reached an understanding." [DIAL:03016109]

text_content: Do you think I killed Mobius?

text_content:
October 28th
Five days on foot, still can't sleep. 

Outside it's like nothing happened. Sky looks wrong, that's all.

Hike back to overturned NatGuard truck near Toquerville? After blisters heal, maybe.

Looks like USGS team was researching something here in cave. Cleared out when bombs fell, left equipment behind.  Probably thought they had families to run back to.

October 29th
Char, must've said this out loud a thousand times walking here. Maybe writing it will feel more like you heard. 

You were right.

I was north of Spanish Fork. Took the 77 along Provo Bay to steer clear of town. Would've been home in an hour. Engine died, truck just stopped. So did a Chryslus in other lane. Knew right away. 

First nuke hit SLC inside a minute. I was looking South - Lucky Man! Flash behind me so bright world looked on fire. Old couple from the Chryslus starts screaming they can't see.

Didn't watch you die, Char. Saved my eyes. Counted 12 more flashes next 7 minutes. Ground shook each time, 18 seconds later. 

When nothing hit for half hour, took a look. Globe of fire where you and Alex died. Didn't kid myself. 

Didn't know what to do. Grabbed my pack and rifle. 

Saw to the old couple. Sat them up against car, let them hold and comfort each other. Told them I was going to get help, everything be okay. One bullet through both heads. Instant. 

Five day hike back to Zion. 

You told me. Stop running off to the wild. Man belongs with his family. 

You were right. You were right. You were right. You were right. Wasn't there to hold you and my boy. Died without me. Never touch you or him again.

Should shoot myself. What I deserve. 

Can't. Maybe soon.

October 31st
Black rain falling outside. Geiger jumping. Should let it kill me but bottling water from back of cave all the same.

November 2nd
Sounds dead outside, but can't look. Geiger goes lethal 15 feet from cave mouth. 

Do the math. Radiation goes down before water runs out or I never leave this cave.
name: Year: 2077

text_content:
January 1st
Happy New Year.

Two months in cave. Still lethal outside. Don't get it. In army they said 2-4 weeks cleared fallout. 

Less than a month's water left. Been mopping condensation off cave walls, wringing shirt into bottles. Trading calories for H2O. Food stocks holding. Thanks, USGS.

If there was even a chance I'd see the two of you again, I'd run outside.

January 10th
Sounded like windstorm out there for 2 days. Radiation down 500. What happened?

January 15th
Took a peek. Snow. It glows green.

January 28th
Radiation low enough I could risk short exposure outside.

More important, cave stream now drinkable if I use Rad drugs.

January 30th
There is nothing alive out there.
name: Year: 2078

text_content:
May 5th
The comeback goes on. 

Add prickly pear to list of survivors with honey mesquite, and banana yucca. Odd nodules / mutations but safe to eat. Harvesting oh so careful, never take more than a fifth. Mouth waters every time I'm about to eat something that isn't from a can.

May 7th
Clouds of those stinging flies near fallen tree I call The Napper. Little flashes in the cloud. Something dragonfly-sized that zaps them midair then scoops them up. Something new. 

May 19th
Bighorn sheep! A family - ram, ewe, and little one 

Fucking Goddammit

May 20th
The sheep were different. Brawny. Ewe had curved horns just like the ram.

Seen some tiny lizards but this is first time seen animals that big. 

Fingers crossed. 5-10 years breeding, fresh meat, hides, horns. 

I know it's time to go back, Char. When winter has passed.
name: Year: 2083

text_content:
June 14th
Just got back. Tired. Good scrounging along the way. Ended up dragging back a cart of stuff.

Write tomorrow. Sleep.

June 15th
Departed April 10th. Walk to SLC took 15 days. Would've been 7-9 back in the old days, but had to circle pockets of radiation and foraged along way.

Don't know what I was thinking. Imagined I'd find my house, dig through rubble, find - something.  Your bones I hoped, and Little Nut's. Would've buried them. Here in Zion maybe.

SLC is mostly craters. Warped steel girders where highrises sat. Mounds of bricks.

Never found our house. Didn�t even find street. What wasn�t a crater was scorched clean. 

Want to believe it was fast, a flash, both of you vaporized. Lies to make me feel better. I'll never know. Which part of city got hit first? Northeast and you both died in a blink. Farther away and you burned alive screaming or the blast broken glass and bits of brick and wood splinters shredding you like hamburger. Look at it coward and listen don't turn away face it. If you'd been brave lucky man you would've found a spot and blown your brains out.

But not you. You took your time walking back, made a shopping trip of it. Scrounger.

The truck was still there on the 77 north of Spanish Fork. The Chryslus too, but no sign of the old couple's bones.

Outside Nephi I caught a trail. Three men, tracks heading toward Fountain Green. Thought about following but didn't. Stupid fantasy of friends, more likely cannibals.

June 20th
Took two days to build door and electrify it.

No soliciting, assholes. Home sweet fucking home.
name: Year: 2084

text_content:
September 20th
I count 28 of them. 11 adult males, 8 females, 9 children aged 2 - 10. Some rifles and pistols in bad repair. Old world clothes, ratty. 

September 22nd
Got close enough last night to hear them talk. Spanish, I think. From Mexico?

Heard them say "paradeeso" a bunch. Think that means paradise. Here to stay, then. 

Seem harmless. SEEM.

October 5th
The one I call "Maria" is pregnant. Think the father is "Jose" but she spends a lot of time with "Pablo" too.

October 7th
"Pedro" ran out to pee in the stream and would've seen me if he looked to his left. Too close. Need to give them space.

November 10th
"Jose" broke his leg chasing a bighorn. Too far from camp for them to hear. Told myself to leave it be but couldn't. 300 yards from their camp did my best Jose screaming imitation until a bunch of them came looking, then strung them along to the crest where they could hear the real Jose. 

Probably useless. Compound fracture, broke the skin.

November 11th
"Infec-shee-own." So many goddamn words nearly the same, think I'd be fluent. But anyway Jose's leg has got it so he's going to die. Nature for you. Of course they're giving prayer a try.

November 12th
Left bottle of antibiotics on a rock outside their camp last night. They thanked God (Dee-os) of course. As though that asshole saw fit to burn the world but still cared enough to leave some medicine on a rock. 

November 15th
Jose will always limp but otherwise he'll be okay. Good deed for the month.

Will they make it through the winter?
name: Year: 2095

text_content:
February 11th
Fuckers killed all the men. I think they would've taken the women alive but Maria and Selena opened fire and some of the others went for their guns so they shot them down and some of the kids with them. 

If I could've warned them.

February 12th
Elena and Carmen and 5 children still alive, being kept in a pen. 

There are more than 100 of these assholes in blue suits. Every suit says "22" on the back. Why? Armed to the teeth with submachine guns, pistols. Estimate 60% male. Everyone seems to follow the dark-haired guy but can't get close enough to tell. Assholes are disciplined - patrols, sentries - they mean business. 

Say I go in at night and get the women and children out. Where to next? 

But I have to get them out. Have to.

February 13th
Recon during night. Well-organized, sentries along most approaches, but stream not covered.

Are they sick? Lots of coughing fits. Tuberculosis?

Women and children still in pen. Will try to infiltrate by stream tomorrow night.

February 14th
They ate them. 

February 19th
Ambush along riverside trail. 6 males killed. Heard their coughing a mile away.

Used their grenades to booby-trap bodies, kept half. Secured 6 SMGs, 500 rounds 10mm, 6 frags. 

February 20th
Ambush along riverside trail. 2 males died checking bodies. Killed 2 more with rifle. Shot 1 through calf and let asshole crawl off to spread message. Coughed like I'd shot him through lungs.

February 23rd
Ambush half-mile east of coal pits wash. 8 males killed.
name: Year: 2096

text_content:
February 28th 
Ambush in the narrows. 6 males killed. Took a 10mm through thigh, steel jacket, missed femoral. Lucky. Used tourniquet to make sure no blood spattered on rocks back to cave. Have set traps all along entrance passage but if they find me it will be matter of time. Still, 24 confirmed kills in 10 days = at least 1/3rd their combat force, not bad for an old man. 

March 2nd 
Lucky lucky lucky lucky. Patrol was small - 3 men. Screaming woke me - point man caught under deadfall. Panic fire ricocheted into the cave, almost hit me. Crawled forward and killed them all with SMGs. Nearly used frags, stupid, finger in pin when remembered ricochets. 

Leaving at once. No other patrols in area but they'll be searching narrows for these 3. Taking as much food as I can drag with me and heading to cave south.
name: Year: 2096 (II)

text_content:
January 13th 
The Coughers are gone finally. All 34 that still lived. Ate their dead for strength, then struck out SE. 

Victory. 10 months of killing. All I feel is cold.  

They deserved every goddamn bit of it.

January 17th 
Thought I was dreaming but the screams were real. For a moment thought they'd tricked me, just pretended to leave Zion, then sent a patrol to track me down. But the screams were a woman's. 

Edged around corner in passageway to have a look. One Vaulter, ankle deep in bear trap. Leveled my SMG but the way she was crying stopped me. 

How she screamed when she saw me. Been their boogey man a long time. 

Name's Sylvie. Claims she ran away from them. Calls them evil people, "children of the devil." Turns out they were sick after all, something they caught in a Vault they lived in. She never came down with it (yet).

So help me, I've wound up being her nurse.

January 18th
Her story matches what I learned from my "interrogations" last year, but according to her - let's just say it was bad to be a woman in that group. So when they left, she slipped away. 

She knows next to nothing about living outside a Vault. Says she wants to learn.
name: Year: 2097

text_content:
September 9th
Never been so scared in my life. 

Canada wasn't scary, just sickening, the criminality of it. 

The end of the world wasn't scary. When I knew you and Alex were dead, I didn't have anything left to be scared about. I just went on for some reason. 

I wasn�t scared fighting the Vaulters. It was like I kept daring them to finish me. When I killed them, I think it was the closest I came to feeling happy in years. 

Sylvie is pregnant. And I am terrified.

Ridiculous old man. A father again at 47. In this world?

She's so excited and so - trusting. Says it's God's will that we have this child. Like nothing can go wrong.

You see, Char, she doesn�t know about you and Alex. Never told her. Almost did sometimes but what you and I had, it seemed wrong to share it. 

More like an old man not wanting his young wife to know how he failed the one who come before her.

Hiking into Toquerville for medical books and supplies. This will be done right.

I'm sorry, Char. Hope you can forgive me.
name: Year: 2100

text_content:
March 5th
Baby was breech. Would've been a son. Michael.

Did my best to turn him. Failed. Must've done Caesarean too late. Had to put Sylvie out and she never woke up. 

Buried them south of the narrows. 

Well. This time I was by their side. So much better. 

I think I can finally do it. Blow my fucking brains out all over this goddamn cave.
name: Year: 2101

text_content:
August 22nd
10 sets of tracks 1/2 mile NE of canyon entrance. Barefoot???

August 23rd
Saw them through scope. Corpses walking around.  Finally gone crazy. Dementia maybe.

August 24th
I'm not crazy, they're real. Goddammit they are real. 

Rushed me the moment they saw me, snarling like animals. They look like corpses but don't smell rotted. 

I'll be putting them out of their misery. Doing for them what I never could for myself. 

September 3rd
The last of them. All gone.
name: Year: 2108

text_content:
February 5th
Happy birthday to me, happy birthday to me, happy birthday you useless old dinosaur, happy birthday to me. 

Happy 60th. What do you get a man who has everything?

A bottle of whiskey and a 12 gauge slug through the roof of the mouth! Whoo! 

Come now. What do I have to do to prove to myself that I've lived long enough? 

I'm a shriveled old man. White beard. Seen enough sunrises and sunsets. Saw the big sunset, been hanging on through the long night 36 years now. Ridiculous. 

Not kidding myself into thinking there's anything on the other side of this. Fine. Things weren't so bad before I was born. 

Char and Alex. Sylvie and Michael-who-could've-been. 

Thoughts of the beloved dead before dying. 

Goodbye, Zion. 

February 6th
Fucking didn't do it, coward as usual. Maybe two bottles next year.
name: Year: 2113

text_content:
April 25th 
24 of them, half boys, half girls. Youngest is 8 maybe, oldest 13-14. Dirty and scrawny, been on foot a long time. Children's crusade. 

Struck camp on nearly the same spot as los mexicanos. 30 years and a lifetime ago. 

I've spent 2 nights listening to them. English. Literate. One of them reads stories while the little ones fall asleep. 

They escaped someplace they call "The School" but can't figure out where it was. When they want a little one to behave they tell him to stop or "The Principal will get you." 

Principal better not show up or I'll blow his goddamn head off. I can still shoot straight.
name: Year: 2123

text_content:
January 2nd 
I've been leaving notes for them, and gifts. 

They like the books. Started with stories but moved on to weapons manuals, medical books, practical stuff. 

In the notes, well it's embarrassing, almost like those cards people used to give to each other, everything sweet and loving. I tell them to read and to learn and to make the most of their new home. I tell them that I'm giving them Zion as a gift to make up for all the sorrows of their lives so far and all the sorrows man has visited on man. I tell them to be kind to each other and modest. I tell them never to hurt each other but that if someone else comes along and tries to hurt them to strike back with righteous anger. Stuff like that. I sign every note "The Father," because well, just because. 

January 18th
Have I mentioned that I'm dying? 

Mind's still sharp. Lungs are the problem. Might be cancer. Cough's been getting worse for months, finally there's blood in it. Getting harder to visit my little friends, breath's so short. 

I've given away most of what I own. They'll find the rest in the caves when they get a little older.

I don't want them to find me though. �The Father" is a broke-down old man? Disappointment.

It's time. I don't want another birthday.

January 23rd 
It's cold enough that I won't last long on the high mound up next to Red Gate. I think I've got enough breath left in me to make it. I'll just lie down and stare at the sky. Feels right.

I hope they'll do well. I hope no harm comes to them, from within or without. Did my best to prepare them with the last few notes. Said something kind about each one of them, what makes each one special. Told them The Father was pleased by their kind natures and that it would be up to them to handle things on their own from now on, that I'd be silent but still watching and still caring. 

Lying, then. Oh yes.

Lied to you, Char. And Alex.  And Sylvie. Told you I'd be with you forever. But I wouldn't go back and unsay it once if I could. 

What was the point of it all? So many failures. 

But I never forgot your face. Or Little Nut's. Or (sorry) Sylvie's. They used to say that happened after a while but it never did for me. 

Maybe the only point of all this living was to keep those pictures in my head going for as long as I could. It was the only life I could give you. Not a day went by without.

It wasn't choice. I chose to die again and again. Just never did. Body had its own drive.

Well, the little ones will need it. Species will need it if it's to continue. That blind drive onward. 

I wish them well. It's been a gift to me, at the end of it all, to behold innocence. 

Goodbye, Zion. 

Randall Dean Clark
Feb 5th, 2053 - Jan 2124
name: Year: 2124

text_content:
If you are reading this message then do yourself a favor and turn and run straight out of this canyon. 

For near 11 months my people have been engaged in daily battle with an evil spirit of this place. Arriving February of last year with a party 118 strong, we were attacked by primitives and forced to defend ourselves. Whereupon something began killing us in wide numbers. We have done our absolute best to find and kill this thing, thinking it was a man because it uses our firearms against us and traps of all kinds. But no man could defy our efforts as this thing has. It is more evil than any man could be.

We have been reduced to just 34 of our number. We have lost six overseers before me. Some have perished from the sickness in their lungs we carried out of the  Vault, but that number is small next to the count of friends this thing has murdered. 

Now that I am finally made overseer, we are leaving straight away and will not return. If you have come to this seeming paradise seeking the fresh water, abundant game, and shelter you suppose you will find here, do not be deceived. You will find only death here. Leave at once and put miles between you and this place.

May God have mercy on us all,

J. Hendricks
Overseer
V22 Expedition
name: BEWARE - A VENGEFUL SPIRIT STALKS THESE CANYONS

text_content:
Hi Mandy,

This is Horace Applebaum out at the Zion General Store. I placed an order three weeks ago for the De-Luxe Mountain Man All-In-One Survival Kits - you know, the ones that come with a compass, a pair of walkie-talkies, and a full first aid kit?

I'm writing to you because, as of today (06/15/2057), I still haven't received the shipment. I'm fresh out of the kits here, and with the summer tourist season picking up I really need the new ones ASAP.

Thanks,
Horace
name: Re: Shipping Error

text_content:
Mandy,

Who the hell is running this shipping company? I've just received three crates of Dinky the Dinosaur(TM) Officially-Licensed Dino-Action Dolls! These things were supposed to go to some tourist trap in Nevada, how the hell did they get here?

Mandy, what the hell can I do with this stuff? Maybe if we file off the Dinky trademarking we can turn them around as kiddie souvenirs and make a few bucks, but I'm still looking at a major loss here.

Whatever's going on in your shipping department, take care of it, or I'll find somebody else to handle my orders, I swear to God.

Yours,
Horace

PS - I still haven't received that order of survival gear I requested last month. You know, things I can actually sell to people?
name: Re: Shipping Problems (AGAIN!)

Dear Scoutmaster Mitchum,

Thanks for following up! You'll be happy to know that the Li'l Scout Lunchboxes you ordered have arrived. You can pick them up from the General Store when you arrive in Zion. The General Store is open Monday through Saturday, 7 am till nightfall. We look forward to seeing you and your scouts on Independence Day!

All the best,
Horace Applebaum

text_content: Don't worry. I think leaving Zion is for the best.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic003 "Don't worry. I think leaving Zion is for the best." [DIAL:050093A4]

text_content: It may be. I hope it is. To tell the truth, if something goes wrong, more Sorrows could die in the escape than in Joshua's proposed attack.|Even knowing that, it's a risk I have to take. With your help, and Joshua's, even if we're attacked, we can defend the Sorrows and escape.|We'll be traveling at night, in small groups, across the valley. With luck, the White Legs won't know what's happened until the next morning.|But if the White Legs realize what's happening... Joshua and I will need {emph}you to help us escape. Don't hold back. I promise you, the White Legs won't.|Once our path is clear, I'll give you everything you need to get back to the Mojave, but the Pine Creek tunnel must be collapsed behind us.|It's the only way to delay the White Legs' pursuit long enough for us to get a head start. Good luck, and may God be with us.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic003 "Don't worry. I think leaving Zion is for the best." [DIAL:050093A4]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: I think Joshua's right. We should fight the White Legs.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic002 "I think Joshua's right. We should fight the White Legs." [DIAL:050093A5]

text_content: {sigh}No. Why? {beat}Why? Haven't you seen enough of what's going on here to see that the Sorrows don't need to butcher the White Legs for a piece of land?|What Joshua wants is more than an attack. He wants a slaughter. And he needs more than you and the Dead Horses to do it.|The Sorrows can't be pushed into this. You and Joshua don't have the right to force them into it. Please, consider what I'm saying.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic002 "I think Joshua's right. We should fight the White Legs." [DIAL:050093A5]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: I checked on everything in the valley and got you the map of Grand Staircase.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic001 "I checked on everything in the valley and got you the map of Grand Staircase." [DIAL:050093A6]

text_content: I appreciate it. Well, that's it. This is all we need. Now all that's left is to quietly pack up and try to get out of here without being noticed.|That's assuming that Joshua won't try to stop me. {beat}And that he hasn't talked you into fighting the White Legs despite what I've said.|Don't worry. I don't hold it against you. You're a - {stops himself from saying Gentile} an outsider. Fighting seems like the practical solution. But there's more than that at stake.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic001 "I checked on everything in the valley and got you the map of Grand Staircase." [DIAL:050093A6]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Joshua told me you needed a few things. I think this is everything.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic000 "Joshua told me you needed a few things. I think this is everything." [DIAL:050093A7]

text_content: Well I'll be. I was starting to lose hope we'd be able to get any of this, much less all of it. Tribals are smart but... well, they're ignorant.|Letting go of a taboo is difficult for them, so I knew it would have to be one of us. Turns out all it took was a Gentile. Or, uh... no offense.|These supplies are a godsend, but if we're going to evacuate Zion without drawing more White Leg attention, I need you to go back into the valley.|Specifically, I need you to scout out some locations for White Legs and try to recover a map of Grand Staircase, a wilderness area to the east.|There's also the matter of the roads. We're going to be heading out of the east side of the park, but I'm not sure the way is clear.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic000 "Joshua told me you needed a few things. I think this is everything." [DIAL:050093A7]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

name: NVDLC02DialogueShamanNVDLC02SorrowShamanTopic001 "I have the sacred datura here." [DIAL:050094A7]

text_content: These roots make sacred vision tea. You drink, you see path before you. Ready?

name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02CaravanMasterTopic000 "I'm ready to go to Zion." [DIAL:05009655]

name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02CaravanMasterTopic000 "I'm ready to go to Zion." [DIAL:05009655]

name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic009 "No, not yet." [DIAL:050096CA]

text_content: Hurry! There isn't any time to waste! We have to get out of here and collapse the tunnel behind us!
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic009 "No, not yet." [DIAL:050096CA]

text_content: Yes, go!
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic008 "Yes, go!" [DIAL:050096CB]

text_content: You've done more than I could have ever hoped for. Thank you. And may God protect you for all of your days. Goodbye.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic008 "Yes, go!" [DIAL:050096CB]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: You let them die! They needed you! Why didn't you help them?!|Nevermind. I don't have time for this. Take the map. Just take it and go!
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic008 "Yes, go!" [DIAL:050096CB]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Your power is broken. You cannot hope to prevail here. Leave this valley in peace.
name: NVDLC02DialogueSaltUponWoundsNVDLC02SaltUponWoundsTopic002 "Your power is broken. You cannot hope to prevail here. Leave this valley in peace." [DIAL:05009846]

text_content: We leave, but always fight, White Legs! We strong warriors for Caesar!
name: NVDLC02DialogueSaltUponWoundsNVDLC02SaltUponWoundsTopic002 "Your power is broken. You cannot hope to prevail here. Leave this valley in peace." [DIAL:05009846]
speaker: NVDLC02SaltUponWounds "Salt-Upon-Wounds" [NPC_:05008A3A]

text_content: Time to die, General Gobbledegook!
name: NVDLC02DialogueSaltUponWoundsNVDLC02SaltUponWoundsTopic001 "Time to die, General Gobbledegook!" [DIAL:05009847]

text_content: You mock White Legs! You die now!
name: NVDLC02DialogueSaltUponWoundsNVDLC02SaltUponWoundsTopic001 "Time to die, General Gobbledegook!" [DIAL:05009847]
speaker: NVDLC02SaltUponWounds "Salt-Upon-Wounds" [NPC_:05008A3A]

text_content: Wait! There's no reason this has to end in bloodshed!

text_content: Why the weight limit?
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic002 "Why the weight limit?" [DIAL:05009EB0]

text_content: You ain't never been to Zion, have you? We'll be passing through a whole mess of narrow slot canyons and high, rough passes.|A big pack'll get you wedged in like a Super Mutant crawling through a storm drain, and too much weight will kill you in the thin air.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic002 "Why the weight limit?" [DIAL:05009EB0]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: Actually, let me take care of some more things first.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic001 "Actually, let me take care of some more things first." [DIAL:05009EB1]

text_content: Fair enough. Come on back when you're ready.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic001 "Actually, let me take care of some more things first." [DIAL:05009EB1]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: Yes, I'm sure.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic000 "Yes, I'm sure." [DIAL:05009EB2]

text_content: Well, all right then. Let's get moving. We've got a long road ahead of us...
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic000 "Yes, I'm sure." [DIAL:05009EB2]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: {Caravan Master reactivity}
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic005 "{Caravan Master reactivity}" [DIAL:05009EFE]

text_content: Hang on - ain't you the one that wiped out the Crimson Caravan's Vegas branch not too long ago?|Ought to thank you for that - knocking McLafferty out of the running gives Happy Trails a market to expand into.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic005 "{Caravan Master reactivity}" [DIAL:05009EFE]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: Wait a minute, I recognize you. Yeah... you're Alice McLafferty's rising star, ain't you?|You sure you want to be here? McLafferty's non-competes are pretty rigid.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic005 "{Caravan Master reactivity}" [DIAL:05009EFE]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: Damn good thing you came along, too. We had another prospect with a Pip-Boy, but he done skedaddled. Something must've spooked the boy.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic005 "{Caravan Master reactivity}" [DIAL:05009EFE]

text_content: Why are you called Follows-Chalk?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic003 "Why are you called Follows-Chalk?" [DIAL:05009FDC]

text_content: Our advance scouts leave chalk signs to mark places rich with game. I'm not a full scout yet, so I follow the marks and guide the hunters.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic003 "Why are you called Follows-Chalk?" [DIAL:05009FDC]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic002 "I don't have any more questions. Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:05009FDD]

text_content: Ask away.

name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic001 "I want to know more about you." [DIAL:05009FDE]

name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic024 "I had some other questions." [DIAL:0500A0DD]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: Warlords? How dangerous are they?
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic022 "Warlords? How dangerous are they?" [DIAL:0500A0DE]

text_content: Dangerous enough we won't be going near them if we can help it. I got no desire for my head to decorate some little gas station fort's walls, thanks.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic022 "Warlords? How dangerous are they?" [DIAL:0500A0DE]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: Degenerate tribes?
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic021 "Degenerate tribes?" [DIAL:0500A0DF]

text_content: That's right. The folks that lived in Zion before the war, they didn't just get a little savage, they're downright feral.|Most of them don't even speak English any more - you got to get yourself a New Canaanite translator to talk to them.|The ones you really got to watch out for are the White Legs, from the Great Salt Lake. They'll attack just about anyone that ain't one of theirs.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic021 "Degenerate tribes?" [DIAL:0500A0DF]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: Tell me about the raiders.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic020 "Tell me about the raiders." [DIAL:0500A0E0]

text_content: They're about what you'd expect - crazy, jacked up on chems, violent as hell, and not too bright.|The worst are the {eighties}80s, but we won't be passing through their turf on this run.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic020 "Tell me about the raiders." [DIAL:0500A0E0]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: You don't know what happened to their mission?
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic019 "You don't know what happened to their mission?" [DIAL:0500A0E1]

text_content: Nope - hence this caravan. If we don't make contact with the New Canaanites, Happy Trails might as well just shrivel up and die.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic019 "You don't know what happened to their mission?" [DIAL:0500A0E1]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: Do you know anything about their religion?
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic018 "Do you know anything about their religion?" [DIAL:0500A0E2]

text_content: I ain't a prayin' man myself. They paid for their goods and dealt square with us, that's all I ever cared about.|But don't think that just because they're religious that they're pacifists. They take care of their own, and they're damn fine marksmen too.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic018 "Do you know anything about their religion?" [DIAL:0500A0E2]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: {Barter 45+}
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic017 "{Barter 45+}" [DIAL:0500A0E3]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] You ain't wrong. Losing the Salt Lake City run really stung us. If we can't re-establish contact with this run, we'll be in real trouble.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic017 "{Barter 45+}" [DIAL:0500A0E3]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: [FAILED] We do all right, don't you worry about us. Got enough in the kitty to pay you, anyways.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic017 "{Barter 45+}" [DIAL:0500A0E3]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: Why can't you get to Salt Lake City?
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic016 "Why can't you get to Salt Lake City?" [DIAL:0500A0E4]

text_content: Without New Canaan's mission in Zion, the only ways to Salt Lake City are down the old I-80 or up through Ogden.|The highway's too risky - NCR's rangers are so busy here in the Mojave they don't have the manpower to keep the raiders off.|Ogden's just too far - we'd lose more in travel expenses than we'd ever earn.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic016 "Why can't you get to Salt Lake City?" [DIAL:0500A0E4]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: All right, I'll come back when I'm carrying less than 75 pounds.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic015 "All right, I'll come back when I'm carrying less than 75 pounds." [DIAL:0500A0E5]

text_content: There's a chest over yonder, you can store your extra in that. It'll be safe as can be until you get back.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic015 "All right, I'll come back when I'm carrying less than 75 pounds." [DIAL:0500A0E5]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: There's a chest over yonder, you can store your extra in that. It'll be safe as can be until you get back.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic015 "All right, I'll come back when I'm carrying less than 75 pounds." [DIAL:0500A0E5]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: Who is Joshua Graham, and why shouldn't I talk about him?
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic014 "Who is Joshua Graham, and why shouldn't I talk about him?" [DIAL:0500A0E6]

text_content: Just don't. It makes the New Canaanites powerful uncomfortable, and it scares the britches off the tribals.|Don't talk about the Burned Man either, while you're at it. Trust me on this one, it's for your own good.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic014 "Who is Joshua Graham, and why shouldn't I talk about him?" [DIAL:0500A0E6]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: Tell me more about the job.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic013 "Tell me more about the job." [DIAL:0500A0E7]

text_content: The job is simple - help us get this caravan into Zion and find New Canaan. The pay is 25 caps per day, half up front, half on return.|You'll get a bonus if we make it into Zion, plus another bonus if we reach New Canaan.|Oh, one more thing - don't mention the name Joshua Graham to anyone. {Repeat for emphasis}Anyone.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic013 "Tell me more about the job." [DIAL:0500A0E7]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: How about a game of Caravan to kill some time?
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic012 "How about a game of Caravan to kill some time?" [DIAL:0500A0E8]

text_content: Should have figured you for a player. All right, let's play.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic012 "How about a game of Caravan to kill some time?" [DIAL:0500A0E8]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: Another one, huh? Sure, why not?
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic012 "How about a game of Caravan to kill some time?" [DIAL:0500A0E8]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: I haven't been through Utah recently - what's the situation like?
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic011 "I haven't been through Utah recently - what's the situation like?" [DIAL:0500A0E9]

text_content: Well, it ain't good, I'll tell you that. It's not like the Mojave or the NCR - hell, even Arizona under Caesar is safer.|You got raiders all over the damn place, tribes of degenerates that'll eat you as soon as look at you, regional warlords... the works.|Not too many decent places to stop and trade. New Canaan's one of the only ones left I know about.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic011 "I haven't been through Utah recently - what's the situation like?" [DIAL:0500A0E9]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: I understand this caravan is headed to Zion. What can you tell me about the area?
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic010 "I understand this caravan is headed to Zion. What can you tell me about the area?" [DIAL:0500A0EA]

text_content: Well, I ain't never been inside, myself. Did some trading with the New Canaanites from their mission there, but that was all on the outskirts.|All the old ways in and out were destroyed after the War, but we got ourselves the location of a pass the New Canaanites use - that's our way in.|That's why I wanted someone with a Pip-Boy on the caravan - the map'll be helpful for checking the topography, keeping us on the trail.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic010 "I understand this caravan is headed to Zion. What can you tell me about the area?" [DIAL:0500A0EA]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: What can you tell me about New Canaan?
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic009 "What can you tell me about New Canaan?" [DIAL:0500A0EB]

text_content: Don't know much about the place, but I can tell you about the people. The New Canaanites were some kind of religious group from before the War.|They control the old city of Ogden, a ways north of Zion, and they got themselves a nice defensible mission in the canyon itself - or they did.|They trade a fair bit with the tribes in Zion - well, the ones that don't try and kill them, anyways.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic009 "What can you tell me about New Canaan?" [DIAL:0500A0EB]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: Tell me about Happy Trails Caravan Company.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic008 "Tell me about Happy Trails Caravan Company." [DIAL:0500A0EC]

text_content: We're a smaller company out of Sac-Town, up in the northern part of the NCR. We run some business through New Reno, there on the "Little Loop."|Had a nice run to Salt Lake City, too - but then we lost contact with New Canaan, and that went all to hell.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic008 "Tell me about Happy Trails Caravan Company." [DIAL:0500A0EC]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: {Pack Rat Perk}
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic007 "{Pack Rat Perk}" [DIAL:0500A0ED]

text_content: Heh. All right, I'll believe you - Lord knows I ain't going to pat you down to find out for myself.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic007 "{Pack Rat Perk}" [DIAL:0500A0ED]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: {Strong Back Perk}
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic006 "{Strong Back Perk}" [DIAL:0500A0EE]

text_content: Heh. I do believe you could.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic006 "{Strong Back Perk}" [DIAL:0500A0EE]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: {Ambush Forcegreet}
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic023 "{Ambush Forcegreet}" [DIAL:0500A107]

text_content: NVDLC02RadioStation
name: NVDLC02RadioStation "NVDLC02RadioStation" [DIAL:0500A108]

text_content: Who were those tribals who attacked me?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic005 "Who were those tribals who attacked me?" [DIAL:0500A49B]

text_content: White Legs - nasty bunch. They been raiding deeper into Zion ever since New Canaan was wiped out.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic005 "Who were those tribals who attacked me?" [DIAL:0500A49B]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Tell me more about Joshua Graham.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic004 "Tell me more about Joshua Graham." [DIAL:0500A49C]

text_content: He's been the chief of our tribe since he came back to the Valley. He went off to the civilized world years ago, to fight a war. That didn't go well.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic004 "Tell me more about Joshua Graham." [DIAL:0500A49C]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Why do you need a map of Grand Staircase?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic011 "Why do you need a map of Grand Staircase?" [DIAL:0500A49D]

text_content: Grand Staircase is farther east, deeper into the Colorado Plateau.|The White Legs were able to reach us here, but it's only because Zion is close to the Long 15. They can't pursue us east of here. It's too wild.|Throughout our history, we have called many places Zion. This valley is full of God's beauty, but it's just a place. Zion is more than this.|We cannot use any and all means available just to protect stone and water and a piece of sky. We have to hold on to our faith. Far more enduring.|If we sacrifice grace for a piece of land, we may live in this valley, but we will no longer dwell in Zion. It's better for us to leave now.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic011 "Why do you need a map of Grand Staircase?" [DIAL:0500A49D]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Take all I have.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic015 "Take all I have." [DIAL:0500A666]

text_content: Your generosity is... {sighs, not sure what to say} well, I just can't thank you enough.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic015 "Take all I have." [DIAL:0500A666]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Here's one healing powder.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic014 "Here's one healing powder." [DIAL:0500A667]

text_content: Thanks. Even one dose can make a difference.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic014 "Here's one healing powder." [DIAL:0500A667]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Is there any other way I can help the Sorrows?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic013 "Is there any other way I can help the Sorrows?" [DIAL:0500A668]

text_content: If you could part with it, healing powder would be welcome. We have enough Stimpaks for now, but we can't rely on that small supply.|Broc and Xander plants can be found throughout the valley and you might even find some on White Legs you come across.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic013 "Is there any other way I can help the Sorrows?" [DIAL:0500A668]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: You mentioned you need healing powder. I have some, if you're still interested.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic012 "You mentioned you need healing powder. I have some, if you're still interested." [DIAL:0500A669]

text_content: {sighs, relieved}That's great news. We can use anything you can offer.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic012 "You mentioned you need healing powder. I have some, if you're still interested." [DIAL:0500A669]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: NVDLC02JedBarks
name: NVDLC02JedBarks "NVDLC02JedBarks" [DIAL:0500A7BB]

text_content: Come on, down this path. We're almost there.
name: NVDLC02JedBarks "NVDLC02JedBarks" [DIAL:0500A7BB]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: Holy hell, it's the White Legs! What are they doing this far south?
name: NVDLC02JedBarks "NVDLC02JedBarks" [DIAL:0500A7BB]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: Let's end this, then.
name: NVDLC02DialogueSaltUponWoundsNVDLC02SaltUponWoundsTopic007 "Let's end this, then." [DIAL:0500A841]

text_content: Ha! Yes, end!
name: NVDLC02DialogueSaltUponWoundsNVDLC02SaltUponWoundsTopic007 "Let's end this, then." [DIAL:0500A841]
speaker: NVDLC02SaltUponWounds "Salt-Upon-Wounds" [NPC_:05008A3A]

text_content: Then see how strong my spears are, warrior.
name: NVDLC02DialogueSaltUponWoundsNVDLC02SaltUponWoundsTopic006 "Then see how strong my spears are, warrior." [DIAL:0500A842]

text_content: This good fight will be!
name: NVDLC02DialogueSaltUponWoundsNVDLC02SaltUponWoundsTopic006 "Then see how strong my spears are, warrior." [DIAL:0500A842]
speaker: NVDLC02SaltUponWounds "Salt-Upon-Wounds" [NPC_:05008A3A]

text_content: Daniel and the Sorrows are weak prey, not fit for such mighty warriors.
name: NVDLC02DialogueSaltUponWoundsNVDLC02SaltUponWoundsTopic005 "Daniel and the Sorrows are weak prey, not fit for such mighty warriors." [DIAL:0500A843]

text_content: Sorrows {emphasis for agreement}are weak. We go, find true warriors to test us!
name: NVDLC02DialogueSaltUponWoundsNVDLC02SaltUponWoundsTopic005 "Daniel and the Sorrows are weak prey, not fit for such mighty warriors." [DIAL:0500A843]
speaker: NVDLC02SaltUponWounds "Salt-Upon-Wounds" [NPC_:05008A3A]

text_content: I've already crushed your warriors. Retreat now and rebuild your tribe, or die in obscurity.
name: NVDLC02DialogueSaltUponWoundsNVDLC02SaltUponWoundsTopic004 "I've already crushed your warriors. Retreat now and rebuild your tribe, or die in obscurity." [DIAL:0500A844]

text_content: ...I go. But rebuild my tribe, and come we back stronger than before!
name: NVDLC02DialogueSaltUponWoundsNVDLC02SaltUponWoundsTopic004 "I've already crushed your warriors. Retreat now and rebuild your tribe, or die in obscurity." [DIAL:0500A844]
speaker: NVDLC02SaltUponWounds "Salt-Upon-Wounds" [NPC_:05008A3A]

text_content: Well, all of the Bighorners are dead. Problem solved!
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic022 "Well, all of the Bighorners are dead. Problem solved!" [DIAL:0500AA6C]

text_content: That's... not really what I was hoping for. I guess... I guess at least we don't have to worry about the Bighorners attacking the camp now. Hoy....
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic022 "Well, all of the Bighorners are dead. Problem solved!" [DIAL:0500AA6C]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Well, I returned the calf to its herd. Had to kill a few Bighorners to do it, though.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic021 "Well, I returned the calf to its herd. Had to kill a few Bighorners to do it, though." [DIAL:0500AA6D]

text_content: Sure, hey, I understand. I wish it could have been done different, but at least the calf is back with its herd.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic021 "Well, I returned the calf to its herd. Had to kill a few Bighorners to do it, though." [DIAL:0500AA6D]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Well, I returned the calf to its mother, and didn't even kill any of the Bighorners.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic020 "Well, I returned the calf to its mother, and didn't even kill any of the Bighorners." [DIAL:0500AA6E]

text_content: Hoo! Glad to hear it! That'll be some happy mama, huh? Thank you - really. It means a lot to me.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic020 "Well, I returned the calf to its mother, and didn't even kill any of the Bighorners." [DIAL:0500AA6E]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: That sounds like way too much work. Maybe later.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic019 "That sounds like way too much work. Maybe later." [DIAL:0500AA6F]

text_content: Oh sure, that's just what the hunters said. Well... I guess let me know if you change your mind.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic019 "That sounds like way too much work. Maybe later." [DIAL:0500AA6F]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: All right, I'll look into it.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic018 "All right, I'll look into it." [DIAL:0500AA70]

text_content: That's great! I'll help any way I can.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic018 "All right, I'll look into it." [DIAL:0500AA70]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Maybe I can help with that.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic017 "Maybe I can help with that." [DIAL:0500AA71]

text_content: Yeah? Hey, thanks - most of the hunters don't listen when I tell them the problem.|Just one thing - try not to kill any Bighorners if you can, yeah? You'll drive the herd off, and we'll have to range farther on our hunts.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic017 "Maybe I can help with that." [DIAL:0500AA71]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Tell me a little about this area - any interesting wildlife?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic014 "Tell me a little about this area - any interesting wildlife?" [DIAL:0500AA72]

text_content: Mostly it's the mountain Bighorners - whole herd of them up on the cliffs there. Usually they're not too aggressive, but lately... hoo!|My guess is one of the calves got lost somewhere along the way. Bighorners are communal - one missing calf, and the whole herd gets ornery.|If that calf doesn't turn up soon, they might very well come down into the valley and attack the camp.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic014 "Tell me a little about this area - any interesting wildlife?" [DIAL:0500AA72]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: You change your mind about helping out?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic014 "Tell me a little about this area - any interesting wildlife?" [DIAL:0500AA72]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Mostly it's the mountain Bighorners - whole herd of them up on the cliffs there. Usually they're not too aggressive, but lately... hoo!|My guess is one of the calves got lost somewhere along the way. Bighorners are communal - one missing calf, and the whole herd gets ornery.|If that calf doesn't turn up soon, they might very well come down into the valley and attack the camp.|You might try luring the baby out with some banana yucca. These Bighorners go crazy for the stuff.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic014 "Tell me a little about this area - any interesting wildlife?" [DIAL:0500AA72]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: I'll do what I can, but I need to defend myself if I'm attacked.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic006 "I'll do what I can, but I need to defend myself if I'm attacked." [DIAL:0500AB07]

text_content: Of course you do - I understand. You know, I heard stories about rangers from Back When - they carried lightning sticks that stunned the animals.|I've never been to any of the Back When places, but they might have left one when they died.|You might also try luring the baby out with some banana yucca - the mountain Bighorners love the stuff.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic006 "I'll do what I can, but I need to defend myself if I'm attacked." [DIAL:0500AB07]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: What can I do to help?
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic000 "What can I do to help?" [DIAL:0500B4C0]

text_content: I don't have time for this. Go away.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic009 "I don't have time for this. Go away." [DIAL:0500B8BF]

text_content: {Fine}Lah, I meant no offense - if you won't talk to me, talk to Joshua Graham - he's at our camp on the Eastern Virgin.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic009 "I don't have time for this. Go away." [DIAL:0500B8BF]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Civilized lands? What do you mean?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic008 "Civilized lands? What do you mean?" [DIAL:0500B8C0]

text_content: I mean the Lands Beyond the Valley - the place where the cities never fell. Where people don't live in tribes and forage just to survive.|Joshua keeps saying it isn't paradise out there, but how can it not be, compared to this?|Sorry, I'm getting distracted - Joshua will want to know about you - please, go to our camp on the Eastern Virgin. Tell him how you came to be here.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic008 "Civilized lands? What do you mean?" [DIAL:0500B8C0]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Who is this Joshua?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic007 "Who is this Joshua?" [DIAL:0500B8C1]

text_content: Joshua Graham - he leads our tribe. Thanks to him, the Dead Horses are strong, and safe from our enemies.|He'll want to talk to anyone coming up from south-ways. Guess that means just you, now. Come, I can take you to him.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic007 "Who is this Joshua?" [DIAL:0500B8C1]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Wait, what about Caesar?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic024 "Wait, what about Caesar?" [DIAL:0500BD39]

text_content: When Joshua first came to us, he was servant to a man he called Caesar. He led his master's armies, and we were ready to follow him into war.|Then he lost his master's army to a tribe called Enseeyar, the Sunset People. When he returned, he was as you saw him - burned, broken, but changed.|He led us away from Caesar, led us to our own destiny in Zion.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic024 "Wait, what about Caesar?" [DIAL:0500BD39]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Why is it so important that we fight the White Legs?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic023 "Why is it so important that we fight the White Legs?" [DIAL:0500BD3A]

text_content: {Bewildered - doesn't really understand how this is a question, like "Why is it important to breathe?"}Well... because they're our enemies. What else would we do? They take our land, they kill our scouts, they poach our hunting grounds.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic023 "Why is it so important that we fight the White Legs?" [DIAL:0500BD3A]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: What's with the shell casings in your club?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic016 "What's with the shell casings in your club?" [DIAL:0500BD3B]

text_content: We decorate our clubs with them to honor Joshua Graham. They were the weapons of his old tribe, so now they are ours.|Can't say they seem that dangerous to me, but Joshua says they "won the West."
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic016 "What's with the shell casings in your club?" [DIAL:0500BD3B]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: What do you know about the New Canaanites?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic015 "What do you know about the New Canaanites?" [DIAL:0500BD3C]

text_content: Little bit. I met some of their missionaries a few times, but I've never been to their city. Joshua could tell you more - or Daniel, I imagine.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic015 "What do you know about the New Canaanites?" [DIAL:0500BD3C]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Do you remember anything about Joshua from before he became your leader?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic013 "Do you remember anything about Joshua from before he became your leader?" [DIAL:0500BD3D]

text_content: Only a little - I was very young. He was... different. Prouder, yes, but harder, crueler, more driven. Really, I was terrified of him. We all were.|When he came back, I almost didn't believe he was the same man. He was humbler. He wanted to protect, not destroy.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic013 "Do you remember anything about Joshua from before he became your leader?" [DIAL:0500BD3D]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: What did Joshua do for you?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic012 "What did Joshua do for you?" [DIAL:0500BD3E]

text_content: If it wasn't for Joshua, the Dead Horses would still be the whipping boys of the Zion Valley.|He taught us how to hold our territory, to protect ourselves. He guided us away from Caesar, and showed us how Caesar would have destroyed us.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic012 "What did Joshua do for you?" [DIAL:0500BD3E]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Tell me about your tribe.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic011 "Tell me about your tribe." [DIAL:0500BD3F]

text_content: We came up in the Land of the Dead Horse, though why the Back When folks called it that I got no hint.|We raided, we fought... we lost. Our enemies drove us back into Zion, and we would have died if it hadn't been for Joshua. Joshua, and his Caesar.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic011 "Tell me about your tribe." [DIAL:0500BD3F]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: What are all those tattoos?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic010 "What are all those tattoos?" [DIAL:0500BD40]

text_content: Dead Horses mark ourselves to commemorate our hunts. When a hunter takes a great beast, or when a youth goes on his first hunt, he gets a tattoo.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic010 "What are all those tattoos?" [DIAL:0500BD40]
