text_content: I see. That's fascinating.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic013 "I see. That's fascinating." [DIAL:0500D687]

text_content: I'm sure Daniel could tell you more. His knowledge of the Father is greater than my own.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic013 "I see. That's fascinating." [DIAL:0500D687]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: That doesn't sound like what I've heard about the New Canaanites....
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic012 "That doesn't sound like what I've heard about the New Canaanites...." [DIAL:0500D688]

text_content: Perhaps you do not fully understand the New Canaanites. I have seen the Father's images.|His holy bride and holy son were given unto the world to save it. They dwelt in the caverns of the mountains, caverns which can still be seen today.|The people sinned against Him, and were punished with the End That Came in Fire and the loss of the holy tongue. Only the New Canaanites were spared.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic012 "That doesn't sound like what I've heard about the New Canaanites...." [DIAL:0500D688]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Wait, you think the survivalist is... God?
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic011 "Wait, you think the survivalist is... God?" [DIAL:0500D689]

text_content: I do not know this "survivalist," but the Father in the Caves is the god of the New Canaanites. |I have seen the holy books, and once I even saw an image of the holy child and his mother.|Do not the New Canaanites' books say the Father gave the world his child?
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic011 "Wait, you think the survivalist is... God?" [DIAL:0500D689]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Do you have any family?
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic009 "Do you have any family?" [DIAL:0500D68B]

text_content: {Fond reminiscing}I do. A fine husband and three children. I miss them each day, but I take comfort in knowing they are safe.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic009 "Do you have any family?" [DIAL:0500D68B]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Tell me more about your tribe.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic008 "Tell me more about your tribe." [DIAL:0500D68C]

text_content: We have dwelt in the Narrows since the End That Came In Fire, when the Father in the Caves punished the world and made us forget the holy tongue.|We have had good relations with the other tribes in the valley. At least, before Salt-Upon-Wounds brought his White Legs here.|We have Daniel to thank for our continued existence. His advice and help has kept the White Legs from overrunning us so far.|I do not know how long even he can protect us, though.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic008 "Tell me more about your tribe." [DIAL:0500D68C]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Who or what is the Father in the Cave?
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic007 "Who or what is the Father in the Cave?" [DIAL:0500D68D]

text_content: Have you not heard of the god of the New Canaanites? He is our protector and our judge. He helped our ancestors find their place here in Zion.|He gave us many gifts, but we are not to seek him out. His caves are forbidden to us. Those who seek them out are taken from us.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic007 "Who or what is the Father in the Cave?" [DIAL:0500D68D]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Give me some info on this Daniel. Who is he?
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic006 "Give me some info on this Daniel. Who is he?" [DIAL:0500D68E]

text_content: Daniel is a wise man, and a great friend to the Sorrows. He taught me to speak the language of New Canaan - the {maybe slightly mispronounce this}English from the holy books.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic006 "Give me some info on this Daniel. Who is he?" [DIAL:0500D68E]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: What's your deal?
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic005 "What's your deal?" [DIAL:0500D68F]

text_content: Waking Cloud is my name. I am midwife to the Sorrows. It sounds ill-omened, no? "Midwife to sorrows."
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic005 "What's your deal?" [DIAL:0500D68F]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Nothing else. Talk to you later.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic000 "Nothing else. Talk to you later." [DIAL:0500D923]

text_content: Go with fortune, friend.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic000 "Nothing else. Talk to you later." [DIAL:0500D923]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: That's all I wanted to know for now.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic021 "That's all I wanted to know for now." [DIAL:0500DA27]

text_content: Then I will look forward to our next speaking.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic021 "That's all I wanted to know for now." [DIAL:0500DA27]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: I had other questions.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic020 "I had other questions." [DIAL:0500DA28]

text_content: Certainly. I am happy to share my knowledge.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic020 "I had other questions." [DIAL:0500DA28]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: About your husband... I'm afraid he was killed by White Legs during the evacuation.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic019 "About your husband... I'm afraid he was killed by White Legs during the evacuation." [DIAL:0500DA29]

text_content: {Shocked, disbelieving}What? No... you must be mistaken. Daniel would have told me!
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic019 "About your husband... I'm afraid he was killed by White Legs during the evacuation." [DIAL:0500DA29]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Safe? Where are they?
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic018 "Safe? Where are they?" [DIAL:0500DA2A]

text_content: When we learned that Salt-Upon-Wounds had defiled Zion with his presence, Daniel ordered the children, the old, and the sick evacuated from the camp.|My husband volunteered to lead the hunters that went with them for protection.|I try not to worry about them, but we have had no news for so long, and Daniel seems sad when I ask him about it. Sad... and a little frightened.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic018 "Safe? Where are they?" [DIAL:0500DA2A]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: What do you do when you're not delivering babies?
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic017 "What do you do when you're not delivering babies?" [DIAL:0500DA2B]

text_content: I tend to other hurts and sicknesses that afflict our tribe. I also scout the valley for the herbs I use in my medicines.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic017 "What do you do when you're not delivering babies?" [DIAL:0500DA2B]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Midwife? I haven't seen any children around.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic016 "Midwife? I haven't seen any children around." [DIAL:0500DA2C]

text_content: The children and the old have already been evacuated from the camp. They are safe enough, unless the White Legs come for us in force.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic016 "Midwife? I haven't seen any children around." [DIAL:0500DA2C]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Have you known him long?
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic015 "Have you known him long?" [DIAL:0500DA2D]

text_content: Six years. He attended the birth of my third child. {Fond reminiscence}It was a hard birth. The River nearly carried my water to the Father, and my child's with it.|Daniel knew the ways of New Canaan's medicine. He stepped in and saved both of our lives.|After the birth, I asked Daniel if he would teach me what he knew of childbirth. He agreed, and so here I am.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic015 "Have you known him long?" [DIAL:0500DA2D]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Holy books?
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic014 "Holy books?" [DIAL:0500DA2E]

text_content: Yes - the language of the New Canaanites is the holy tongue, for it is the language their sacred books are written in.|The Father in the Caves brought it to them after the Judgment, but the ancestors of the Sorrows sinned against Him. They were denied the true tongue.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic014 "Holy books?" [DIAL:0500DA2E]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: You're right. Now, what are you going to do about it?
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic027 "You're right. Now, what are you going to do about it?" [DIAL:0500DAA1]

text_content: About Daniel... I don't yet know. But I am a woman of the Sorrows, and I will have restitution for my husband.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic027 "You're right. Now, what are you going to do about it?" [DIAL:0500DAA1]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: I agree. It was arrogant and cruel - not exactly the kind of thing a friend would do.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic026 "I agree. It was arrogant and cruel - not exactly the kind of thing a friend would do." [DIAL:0500DAA2]

text_content: Arrogant... yes. I thought Daniel respected me, saw the Sorrows as his equals... but he manipulates us for his own ends.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic026 "I agree. It was arrogant and cruel - not exactly the kind of thing a friend would do." [DIAL:0500DAA2]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: He was only doing what he thought was best for the tribe. It wasn't an easy choice for him.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic025 "He was only doing what he thought was best for the tribe. It wasn't an easy choice for him." [DIAL:0500DAA3]

text_content: Perhaps... I will have to have a {emphasis}very long talk with Daniel when all of this is over. Thank you for telling me this truth.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic025 "He was only doing what he thought was best for the tribe. It wasn't an easy choice for him." [DIAL:0500DAA3]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: I'm afraid so. Daniel kept it from you because he thought the grief would distract you.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic022 "I'm afraid so. Daniel kept it from you because he thought the grief would distract you." [DIAL:0500DAA6]

text_content: How... how {emphasis}dare he? What gives him the right? I thought Daniel was my friend, but he cares nothing for the Sorrows!
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic022 "I'm afraid so. Daniel kept it from you because he thought the grief would distract you." [DIAL:0500DAA6]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Let's talk more later.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic016 "Let's talk more later." [DIAL:0500DD3E]

text_content: Until then.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic016 "Let's talk more later." [DIAL:0500DD3E]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: That's all for now, but I'll be back.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic025 "That's all for now, but I'll be back." [DIAL:0500DD3F]

text_content: Yeah, reckon you will.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic025 "That's all for now, but I'll be back." [DIAL:0500DD3F]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: I understand. I'll respect your beliefs, then, but we need to search the cave.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic046 "I understand. I'll respect your beliefs, then, but we need to search the cave." [DIAL:0500E71E]

text_content: I understand. I would prefer to leave as soon as possible, though.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic046 "I understand. I'll respect your beliefs, then, but we need to search the cave." [DIAL:0500E71E]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: The Father in the Caves was just a man who lived a long time ago.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic045 "The Father in the Caves was just a man who lived a long time ago." [DIAL:0500E71F]

text_content: You speak as one who has not heard the tales, who has not seen the sacred images. If you knew, you would not mock.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic045 "The Father in the Caves was just a man who lived a long time ago." [DIAL:0500E71F]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Holy wrath. Right. I'll keep an eye out for that. Bet it looks a lot like a bear trap.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic044 "Holy wrath. Right. I'll keep an eye out for that. Bet it looks a lot like a bear trap." [DIAL:0500E720]

text_content: Do not mock that which you do not know! Such talk can only anger the Father.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic044 "Holy wrath. Right. I'll keep an eye out for that. Bet it looks a lot like a bear trap." [DIAL:0500E720]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: I don't have time for your religious superstitions. It's just a cave, that's all.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic043 "I don't have time for your religious superstitions. It's just a cave, that's all." [DIAL:0500E721]

text_content: It is a holy place! If we go any deeper, we will suffer for it!
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic043 "I don't have time for your religious superstitions. It's just a cave, that's all." [DIAL:0500E721]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: What are you talking about?
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic042 "What are you talking about?" [DIAL:0500E722]

text_content: The Father in the Caves! The Holy Father who gave the Sorrows His succor and gave the New Canaanites His son!|Many of the caves around the valley are sacred to him, and those who would trespass are punished by holy wrath!
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic042 "What are you talking about?" [DIAL:0500E722]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: < Waking Cloud talks about the Survivalist's cave >
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic041 "< Waking Cloud talks about the Survivalist's cave >" [DIAL:0500E723]

text_content: {Fearful, but more awe - this is a sacred place}We should not be here! This place... it belongs to the Father in the Caves! We must not profane it with our touch!
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic041 "< Waking Cloud talks about the Survivalist's cave >" [DIAL:0500E723]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: How would we do that?
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic040 "How would we do that?" [DIAL:0500E724]

text_content: Did Daniel not give you some of the New Canaanites' fire clay? That could easily collapse a cave and trap the beasts inside.|Look around and see if you can find a cave nearby. It may prove easier than slaying the beasts.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic040 "How would we do that?" [DIAL:0500E724]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: I'll be sure to tell Daniel to bring some bear-monster-thing snacks, then.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic039 "I'll be sure to tell Daniel to bring some bear-monster-thing snacks, then." [DIAL:0500E725]

text_content: We'd better get to work then.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic038 "We'd better get to work then." [DIAL:0500E726]

text_content: I stand with you.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic038 "We'd better get to work then." [DIAL:0500E726]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Big deal, I've killed worse.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic037 "Big deal, I've killed worse." [DIAL:0500E727]

text_content: I hope that is truth, and not a boast. But I will respect your leadership.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic037 "Big deal, I've killed worse." [DIAL:0500E727]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: What do you propose?
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic036 "What do you propose?" [DIAL:0500E728]

text_content: Fighting so many at once is a dangerous prospect, unless you are a truly mighty warrior.|This many so close together suggests a nest nearby - if we find it and destroy it, we might have better luck.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic036 "What do you propose?" [DIAL:0500E728]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Let's take care of it then.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic035 "Let's take care of it then." [DIAL:0500E729]

text_content: As you say.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic035 "Let's take care of it then." [DIAL:0500E729]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: These traps must have come from somewhere - I bet the White Legs who placed them are still around.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic033 "These traps must have come from somewhere - I bet the White Legs who placed them are still around." [DIAL:0500E72B]

text_content: I would suspect you are right. Perhaps we should try to find them before they lay more traps?
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic033 "These traps must have come from somewhere - I bet the White Legs who placed them are still around." [DIAL:0500E72B]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: What should we do about it?
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic032 "What should we do about it?" [DIAL:0500E72C]

text_content: Disarm the traps if you can - or find the White Legs who placed them and drive them off.|Our advance scouts should be able to deal with them if they don't have to fight off raiders at the same time.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic032 "What should we do about it?" [DIAL:0500E72C]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Okay then, let's get down there and take care of business.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic030 "Okay then, let's get down there and take care of business." [DIAL:0500E72E]

text_content: I will follow your command - but I advise caution if it is possible.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic030 "Okay then, let's get down there and take care of business." [DIAL:0500E72E]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: So the totems are sacred to them somehow? Good to know.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic029 "So the totems are sacred to them somehow? Good to know." [DIAL:0500E72F]

text_content: Yes. If their war totems were to... "disappear," they would likely lose the will to fight.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic029 "So the totems are sacred to them somehow? Good to know." [DIAL:0500E72F]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Any advice on how to deal with the situation?
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic028 "Any advice on how to deal with the situation?" [DIAL:0500E730]

text_content: You might rush them and take them by surprise. We would be badly outnumbered then, though, and these will be strong fighters.|We might also use their superstition against them. White Leg warriors believe that to lose their totems on the eve of battle is a terrible omen.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic028 "Any advice on how to deal with the situation?" [DIAL:0500E730]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: < Waking Cloud talks about the Yao Guai >
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudYaoGuai "< Waking Cloud talks about the Yao Guai >" [DIAL:0500E731]

text_content: Yao Guai - even our strongest hunters could not hope to kill so many. There must be a nest nearby.
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudYaoGuai "< Waking Cloud talks about the Yao Guai >" [DIAL:0500E731]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: < Waking Cloud talks about the sappers / traps >
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudTraps "< Waking Cloud talks about the sappers / traps >" [DIAL:0500E732]

text_content: This is the only sure path from the Narrows to Pine Creek! They will be cut to ribbons by these traps!
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudTraps "< Waking Cloud talks about the sappers / traps >" [DIAL:0500E732]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: < Waking Cloud talks about the White Leg Camps >
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudCamps "< Waking Cloud talks about the White Leg Camps >" [DIAL:0500E733]

text_content: Those tents down there - that is a White Leg war camp. Do you see the war totems they've erected around the tents?|White Leg warriors pray to them for strength and savagery before battle. This is no raiding band.
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudCamps "< Waking Cloud talks about the White Leg Camps >" [DIAL:0500E733]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: All right, let's go.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic025 "All right, let's go." [DIAL:0500E8F9]

text_content: {Glad to hear it}Goot sists. We head east, then. Joshua is at our tribe's camp in the Eastern Virgin.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic025 "All right, let's go." [DIAL:0500E8F9]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: You'd be surprised what "civilized" tribes will fight over.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic029 "You'd be surprised what ""civilized"" tribes will fight over." [DIAL:0500EE5B]

text_content: Now you sound like Joshua. He always tells me the tribal life is better, that I should stay here and forget the outside world.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic029 "You'd be surprised what ""civilized"" tribes will fight over." [DIAL:0500EE5B]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Small? Have you ever seen Hoover Dam? It's bigger than some of these mountains.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic028 "Small? Have you ever seen Hoover Dam? It's bigger than some of these mountains." [DIAL:0500EE5C]

text_content: Hah! {Suddenly realizing the player isn't lying}...Really? That's... my gods. Must be some mighty civilized folks who built that.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic028 "Small? Have you ever seen Hoover Dam? It's bigger than some of these mountains." [DIAL:0500EE5C]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: The only recent war I know of is when Caesar's Legion attacked Hoover Dam. Is that where he fought?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic027 "The only recent war I know of is when Caesar's Legion attacked Hoover Dam. Is that where he fought?" [DIAL:0500EE5D]

text_content: I don't know, he doesn't talk about it much. Maybe - but how can two civilized tribes fight over something as small as a dam?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic027 "The only recent war I know of is when Caesar's Legion attacked Hoover Dam. Is that where he fought?" [DIAL:0500EE5D]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: What happened to him?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic026 "What happened to him?" [DIAL:0500EE5E]

text_content: Well, before he left, he didn't have those bandages all over his face. That tell you something?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic026 "What happened to him?" [DIAL:0500EE5E]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: You see his face, you'll understand.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic026 "What happened to him?" [DIAL:0500EE5E]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Typical. Just when I get a useful minion....
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic032 "Typical. Just when I get a useful minion...." [DIAL:0500EF02]

text_content: Hey, it's not my fault! And what's this "minion" stuff? {That's it}Dahs eet - see you around, "civilized" man.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic032 "Typical. Just when I get a useful minion...." [DIAL:0500EF02]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Hey, it's not my fault! And what's this "minion" stuff? {That's it}Dahs eet - see you around, "civilized" woman.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic032 "Typical. Just when I get a useful minion...." [DIAL:0500EF02]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Give my regards to Joshua, then.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic031 "Give my regards to Joshua, then." [DIAL:0500EF03]

text_content: I will. {Goodbye my friend}Goot gonen, ahk iss.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic031 "Give my regards to Joshua, then." [DIAL:0500EF03]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Are you sure? You've been a useful companion so far.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic030 "Are you sure? You've been a useful companion so far." [DIAL:0500EF04]

text_content: Sorry - Joshua was pretty clear. Get you to Daniel, then come on home. You can take it up with him if you'd like.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic030 "Are you sure? You've been a useful companion so far." [DIAL:0500EF04]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: No way, pal. I'm not traipsing around the desert with a barbarian who doesn't wear pants.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic042 "No way, pal. I'm not traipsing around the desert with a barbarian who doesn't wear pants." [DIAL:0500F180]

text_content: I don't think he'll like that answer much. You change your mind, I'll be around the Dead Horses camp. {Goodbye}Goot gonen.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic042 "No way, pal. I'm not traipsing around the desert with a barbarian who doesn't wear pants." [DIAL:0500F180]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: I could use a guide. Let's go.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic041 "I could use a guide. Let's go." [DIAL:0500F181]

text_content: {Good}Goot! I really wasn't looking forward to talking to Joshua if you turned me down.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic041 "I could use a guide. Let's go." [DIAL:0500F181]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Hey... as long as we're traveling together, think you could help me out with a little wildlife problem?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic041 "I could use a guide. Let's go." [DIAL:0500F181]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Let's move then.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic041 "I could use a guide. Let's go." [DIAL:0500F181]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Who is this Joshua?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic040 "Who is this Joshua?" [DIAL:0500F182]

text_content: Joshua Graham - he leads our tribe. Thanks to him, the Dead Horses are strong, and safe from our enemies.|I'm sure he will want to talk to you. You can find him just south of here, in the Angel Cave.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic040 "Who is this Joshua?" [DIAL:0500F182]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: White Legs? Who are they?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic038 "White Legs? Who are they?" [DIAL:0500F184]

text_content: Nasty bunch of raiders from up by Great Salt Lake. White Legs killed your friends at the Southern Passage.|Not many survive White Leg raids - {slightly aside, to himself}not even by running. {Normal again}Joshua will want to hear about what happened to you.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic038 "White Legs? Who are they?" [DIAL:0500F184]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: I had no reason to stay for that fight.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic037 "I had no reason to stay for that fight." [DIAL:0500F185]

text_content: But... {confused, stating something that seems blindingly obvious}they were White Legs! The enemy! You are a very strange outsider, but I think Joshua will want to speak to you anyways.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic037 "I had no reason to stay for that fight." [DIAL:0500F185]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Okay, I'll go talk to him.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic036 "Okay, I'll go talk to him." [DIAL:0500F186]

text_content: I won't keep you. Maybe we talk again after.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic036 "Okay, I'll go talk to him." [DIAL:0500F186]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Hang on, I want to know more about what's going on.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic035 "Hang on, I want to know more about what's going on." [DIAL:0500F187]

text_content: Joshua will answer all your questions. He doesn't like being kept waiting, though - go talk to him as soon as you can.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic035 "Hang on, I want to know more about what's going on." [DIAL:0500F187]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Who are you?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic034 "Who are you?" [DIAL:0500F188]

text_content: I'm called Follows-Chalk. Joshua sent me to scout for any outsiders coming up from the Southern Passage.|We can talk more about that later, though - it's not smart to keep Joshua waiting.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic034 "Who are you?" [DIAL:0500F188]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: What is this place?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic033 "What is this place?" [DIAL:0500F189]

text_content: This is the eastern fork of the Virgin River, and it's the place we Dead Horses call home. Joshua says it is a temple to God's glory on earth.|We can talk more about it later, though - it's not smart to keep Joshua waiting.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic033 "What is this place?" [DIAL:0500F189]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: < Follows Chalk greets the player at the Eastern Virgin. >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkVirginGreeting "< Follows Chalk greets the player at the Eastern Virgin. >" [DIAL:0500F18A]

text_content: Glad you made it. Joshua's just to the south, inside the Angel Cave. You'll want to talk to him straight away.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkVirginGreeting "< Follows Chalk greets the player at the Eastern Virgin. >" [DIAL:0500F18A]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: NVDLC02JedForceGreet
name: NVDLC02JedForceGreetTOPIC "NVDLC02JedForceGreet" [DIAL:0500F18B]

text_content: All right, people. Been a long couple weeks, but here we are. {a big deal - Wha-la!}Zion.
name: NVDLC02JedForceGreetTOPIC "NVDLC02JedForceGreet" [DIAL:0500F18B]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: I know your feet hurt, I know you're tired. But I need everyone's mind on the trail ahead.
name: NVDLC02JedForceGreetTOPIC "NVDLC02JedForceGreet" [DIAL:0500F18B]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: {anxious}Ain't the trail ahead worries me, Jed. Those descents we made, through that slot canyon back up there.
name: NVDLC02JedForceGreetTOPIC "NVDLC02JedForceGreet" [DIAL:0500F18B]
speaker: NVDLC02Stella "Stella" [NPC_:0500F19E]

text_content: Ain't no way we're getting back out the way we come. And then what?
name: NVDLC02JedForceGreetTOPIC "NVDLC02JedForceGreet" [DIAL:0500F18B]
speaker: NVDLC02Stella "Stella" [NPC_:0500F19E]

text_content: {exasperated}Goddammit, Stella, heard you the first time, and the fifteenth, too
name: NVDLC02JedForceGreetTOPIC "NVDLC02JedForceGreet" [DIAL:0500F18B]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: The New Canaanites will know a way. And if they don't, we got the maps on our friend's Pip-Boy over there.
name: NVDLC02JedForceGreetTOPIC "NVDLC02JedForceGreet" [DIAL:0500F18B]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: {raising voice, giving orders}Enough lollygagging! Get moving and keep an eye out for tribals!
name: NVDLC02JedForceGreetTOPIC "NVDLC02JedForceGreet" [DIAL:0500F18B]

text_content: Like I care. Let's just go. I'm ready.
name: NVDLC02DialogueCaravanMasterNVDLC02JedTopic026 "Like I care. Let's just go. I'm ready." [DIAL:0500F18C]

text_content: No objections.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic008 "No objections." [DIAL:0500F29C]

text_content: {flat}God's will.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic008 "No objections." [DIAL:0500F29C]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Let him keep his dignity. Give him a fighting chance.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic007 "Let him keep his dignity. Give him a fighting chance." [DIAL:0500F29D]

text_content: He never had any dignity to begin with. None of them did.|But for your sake... for the Sorrows' sake, I'll let him die on his feet.|Stand up and look at what's come for you!
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic007 "Let him keep his dignity. Give him a fighting chance." [DIAL:0500F29D]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Joshua, you've already won. Look around you. There's no need to kill him.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic006 "Joshua, you've already won. Look around you. There's no need to kill him." [DIAL:0500F29E]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] He has a debt to pay for what he's done and I've come to collect. And so he's chosen to cower in the water like a dumb animal.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic006 "Joshua, you've already won. Look around you. There's no need to kill him." [DIAL:0500F29E]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: < NVDLC02MQ04 Finale Force Greet >
name: NVDLC02JoshuaMQ04Finale "< NVDLC02MQ04 Finale Force Greet >" [DIAL:0500F29F]

text_content: Don't listen to this... thing! His cries are those of a mad beast caught in a thicket! He gave no mercy to my family, and I will give none to his.
name: NVDLC02JoshuaMQ04Finale "< NVDLC02MQ04 Finale Force Greet >" [DIAL:0500F29F]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: NVDLC02JoshuaTauntSUW
name: NVDLC02JoshuaTauntSUW "NVDLC02JoshuaTauntSUW" [DIAL:0500F2A0]

text_content: We warned you at Syracuse, and you persisted.
name: NVDLC02JoshuaTauntSUW "NVDLC02JoshuaTauntSUW" [DIAL:0500F2A0]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: You took advantage of us at New Canaan to drive us out, and like the dogs of Caesar you are, you followed us to Zion.
name: NVDLC02JoshuaTauntSUW "NVDLC02JoshuaTauntSUW" [DIAL:0500F2A0]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: And now you stand on holy ground, a temple to God's glory on Earth. But the only use for an animal in our temple is sacrifice!
name: NVDLC02JoshuaTauntSUW "NVDLC02JoshuaTauntSUW" [DIAL:0500F2A0]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Kale watcha nei conserva oh! You understand me, don't you? Don't you?!
name: NVDLC02JoshuaTauntSUW "NVDLC02JoshuaTauntSUW" [DIAL:0500F2A0]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Whatever. Joshua, put a cap in General Gobbledigook here.
name: NVDLC02DialogueSaltUponWoundsNVDLC02SaltUponWoundsTopic008 "Whatever. Joshua, put a cap in General Gobbledigook here." [DIAL:0500F2A1]

text_content: {Killer!}{Bye-KAH kur}Baika-ker! You devil!
name: NVDLC02DialogueSaltUponWoundsNVDLC02SaltUponWoundsTopic008 "Whatever. Joshua, put a cap in General Gobbledigook here." [DIAL:0500F2A1]
speaker: NVDLC02SaltUponWounds "Salt-Upon-Wounds" [NPC_:05008A3A]

text_content: You're right. We're going to kill you, but not like this. Defend yourself!
name: NVDLC02DialogueSaltUponWoundsNVDLC02SaltUponWoundsTopic003 "You're right. We're going to kill you, but not like this. Defend yourself!" [DIAL:0500F2A2]

text_content: {You can't fight me!}{YOO-can no ni-KUM-pah mee}Yoocan no nikumpa me! {Die, you!}{deh-YAI, you!}Deyai-yoo!
name: NVDLC02DialogueSaltUponWoundsNVDLC02SaltUponWoundsTopic003 "You're right. We're going to kill you, but not like this. Defend yourself!" [DIAL:0500F2A2]
speaker: NVDLC02SaltUponWounds "Salt-Upon-Wounds" [NPC_:05008A3A]

text_content: Whoa. This isn't what I signed up for. Let me talk to Joshua about this.
name: NVDLC02DialogueSaltUponWoundsTopic000 "Whoa. This isn't what I signed up for. Let me talk to Joshua about this." [DIAL:0500F2A3]

text_content: Him hear you. You talk!
name: NVDLC02DialogueSaltUponWoundsTopic000 "Whoa. This isn't what I signed up for. Let me talk to Joshua about this." [DIAL:0500F2A3]

text_content: Let's do it.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic004 "Let's do it." [DIAL:0500F2A4]

text_content: God be with you.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic004 "Let's do it." [DIAL:0500F2A4]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: < NVDLC02MQ04 Intro Force Greet >
name: NVDLC02JoshuaMQ04ForceGreet1 "< NVDLC02MQ04 Intro Force Greet >" [DIAL:0500F2A5]

text_content: Thank you for this. I know Daniel doesn't approve, but destroying the White Legs is the only way to ensure the Sorrows can remain in Zion.|You and I will lead a group of Dead Horse warriors and Sorrows hunters into Three Marys from this position.|Our objective is to find the White Legs' leader, Salt-Upon-Wounds, and prevent him from fleeing.|Show no quarter to the White Legs we come across. Make no mistake about why we are here. This is an extermination.
name: NVDLC02JoshuaMQ04ForceGreet1 "< NVDLC02MQ04 Intro Force Greet >" [DIAL:0500F2A5]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: I prefer to travel alone, thanks.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic048 "I prefer to travel alone, thanks." [DIAL:0500F2FE]

text_content: The lone Bighorner is the most vulnerable to its enemies. In the herd lies strength - if you reconsider your choice, I will be here. {in peace, go}{PAHZ pah-tah-soo-ba}Paz patasooba.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic048 "I prefer to travel alone, thanks." [DIAL:0500F2FE]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Sounds good. Let's go.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic047 "Sounds good. Let's go." [DIAL:0500F2FF]

text_content: Before we depart, our shaman, White Bird, asked me to convey his desire to speak with you.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic047 "Sounds good. Let's go." [DIAL:0500F2FF]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Certainly. We should make haste, then.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic047 "Sounds good. Let's go." [DIAL:0500F2FF]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: < Follows-Chalk bark about tree trunk containers >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkTreeTrunk "< Follows-Chalk bark about tree trunk containers >" [DIAL:0500F3EE]

text_content: Hold up, see that log over there? Take a closer look. There might be some good stuff tucked in there.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkTreeTrunk "< Follows-Chalk bark about tree trunk containers >" [DIAL:0500F3EE]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: What would you suggest I do instead?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic043 "What would you suggest I do instead?" [DIAL:0500F3EF]

text_content: Hmm... you might try luring the baby out with some banana yucca. These Bighorners go crazy for the stuff.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic043 "What would you suggest I do instead?" [DIAL:0500F3EF]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: What do you know about the White Legs?
name: NVDLC02DialogueStellaNVDLC02StellaTopic004 "What do you know about the White Legs?" [DIAL:0500F412]

text_content: Used to be they raided northeast of Caliente, time to time. But then the Desert Rangers fell apart ten years ago, absorbed into the NCR.|Soon enough the White Legs were swarming all over that stretch of I-15. Folks learned not to head north if they wanted to keep their scalps.|Eventually the White Legs destroyed the bridges across the Virgin River, over in Arizona. End of discussion.
name: NVDLC02DialogueStellaNVDLC02StellaTopic004 "What do you know about the White Legs?" [DIAL:0500F412]
speaker: NVDLC02Stella "Stella" [NPC_:0500F19E]

text_content: Were the 80s a gang, or a tribe?
name: NVDLC02DialogueStellaNVDLC02StellaTopic003 "Were the 80s a gang, or a tribe?" [DIAL:0500F413]

text_content: What's the difference? Raiders is raiders.|Bunch of them swept in to town and dragged off two working girls. Deputies and me gave pursuit, straight into 80s territory.|By the time we caught up with the girls, there wasn't much left of them. So we turned for home.|Made it back to Caliente without further losses, but we was watched the whole way. Never seen so few people cover so much land. Goddamn creepy.|If the 80s had wanted to kill us, we would've been dead. Guess they figured we weren't worth the trouble.
name: NVDLC02DialogueStellaNVDLC02StellaTopic003 "Were the 80s a gang, or a tribe?" [DIAL:0500F413]
speaker: NVDLC02Stella "Stella" [NPC_:0500F19E]

text_content: Tell me about Caliente.
name: NVDLC02DialogueStellaNVDLC02StellaTopic002 "Tell me about Caliente." [DIAL:0500F414]

text_content: Place lived up to its name, that's for sure.|When you got fresh water and a trickle of geothermic power, always be some gang of assholes wants to kill you for it.|Spent more years and took more bullets than I care to admit protecting that hellhole from dangers, within and without.|If it wasn't the 80s or the White Legs raiding, it was someone from town drunk off his ass trying to win an argument with a shotgun.|Got tired of shooting the folks I was supposed to protect. So... now I do this.
name: NVDLC02DialogueStellaNVDLC02StellaTopic002 "Tell me about Caliente." [DIAL:0500F414]
speaker: NVDLC02Stella "Stella" [NPC_:0500F19E]

text_content: What was that like to grow up in New Reno?
name: NVDLC02DialogueStellaNVDLC02StellaTopic001 "What was that like to grow up in New Reno?" [DIAL:0500F415]

text_content: Imagine New Vegas if there was no Mr. House-type fella keeping the peace, then give everybody a gun and a Jet addiction.|Town's run by a bunch of crime families, no law to speak of. Make trouble, and you wind up buried in Golgotha, outside town.|The scuzz factor's off the charts. Non-stop whoring and drugs. Couldn't walk down the street without getting asked to star in a porn movie.|So I got my ass out of there while I still owned it. Guess I figured the answer to every problem was rule of law. Naive, huh?
name: NVDLC02DialogueStellaNVDLC02StellaTopic001 "What was that like to grow up in New Reno?" [DIAL:0500F415]
speaker: NVDLC02Stella "Stella" [NPC_:0500F19E]

text_content: What are you doing here?
name: NVDLC02DialogueStellaNVDLC02StellaTopic000 "What are you doing here?" [DIAL:0500F416]

text_content: Earning my keep. Jed hired me on as a caravan guard for this expedition of his.|The work suits me. I've tried staying put in one place, but it never works out.|Grew up in New Reno, and I couldn't put that snakepit behind me fast enough.|Then I wound up wasting the prime of my life playing Sheriff in Caliente, little town north on the 93. Talk about a pain in the ass.|You ask me, best to keep moving. At least the scenery changes.
name: NVDLC02DialogueStellaNVDLC02StellaTopic000 "What are you doing here?" [DIAL:0500F416]
speaker: NVDLC02Stella "Stella" [NPC_:0500F19E]

text_content: Fine. What do you need?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic019 "Fine. What do you need?" [DIAL:0500F4C9]

text_content: Sorry, but I'm not going on a scavenger hunt for you.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic018 "Sorry, but I'm not going on a scavenger hunt for you." [DIAL:0500F4CA]

text_content: The choice is yours, of course, but you're not going to find a way back to the Mojave without our help.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic018 "Sorry, but I'm not going on a scavenger hunt for you." [DIAL:0500F4CA]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: I'll see what I can do.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic017 "I'll see what I can do." [DIAL:0500F4CB]

text_content: Thank you. Follows-Chalk can help you find your way around the valley.|He's inexperienced, but he knows enough of our language to ignore the taboos about Pre-War buildings.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic017 "I'll see what I can do." [DIAL:0500F4CB]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Thank you. Now obviously, taboos against Pre-War buildings won't be a matter for you - but take caution when you go rooting around in them.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic017 "I'll see what I can do." [DIAL:0500F4CB]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Taboo?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic016 "Taboo?" [DIAL:0500F4CC]

text_content: The Sorrows believe in a spirit that lives in the caves, say the spirit punished them once for trespassing.|They put special marks around the cave entrances to keep people out. It doesn't work on the White Legs, of course, but the Dead Horses are spooked.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic016 "Taboo?" [DIAL:0500F4CC]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Why don't you or Daniel do it?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic015 "Why don't you or Daniel do it?" [DIAL:0500F4CD]

text_content: We are responsible for leading and protecting the Sorrows and Dead Horses. They are smart people, but not as worldly as you or I.|I am preparing the Dead Horses for war and Daniel is preparing the Sorrows for... other things.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic015 "Why don't you or Daniel do it?" [DIAL:0500F4CD]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: How about I go find dear Daniel and shake the information out of him?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic014 "How about I go find dear Daniel and shake the information out of him?" [DIAL:0500F4CE]

text_content: There are many reasons why that would be a bad idea. I will illuminate three.|First, do not believe that because Daniel is a missionary he is incapable of or unwilling to defend himself.|Second, if you harm Daniel or any of the Sorrows or Dead Horses, I will find you. Make no mistake. God willing, you will not leave this valley.|Lastly, waging war against good people is bad for the soul. This may not seem important to you now, but it's the most important thing I've said.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic014 "How about I go find dear Daniel and shake the information out of him?" [DIAL:0500F4CE]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Don't try to get me to help you. I'm not interested.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic013 "Don't try to get me to help you. I'm not interested." [DIAL:0500F4CF]

text_content: There are only so many ways you could have entered Zion from the south. You descended by routes that you cannot safely ascend to return to the Mojave.|I'm not telling you this as a trick. Whether you want to help us or not, you can't get back without Daniel's assistance.|I'm sure he'll be willing to assist you, but we have other responsibilities at the moment.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic013 "Don't try to get me to help you. I'm not interested." [DIAL:0500F4CF]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: I'm not going to leave without offering to help. What can I do?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic012 "I'm not going to leave without offering to help. What can I do?" [DIAL:0500F4D0]

text_content: {referring to the parable of the good samaritan}You're a good neighbor to us. We all go through periods of darkness. In such times, we can turn to the Lord, but it's good to have friends.|Daniel and I need Pre-War tools to help us navigate beyond Zion. Should we need to evacuate, these instruments will be vital to us.|Normally, we would have some of the Dead Horses or Sorrows look for them, but many Pre-War buildings in the valley are taboo. They won't go inside.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic012 "I'm not going to leave without offering to help. What can I do?" [DIAL:0500F4D0]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Nice guns.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic011 "Nice guns." [DIAL:0500F4D1]

text_content: In the Great Basin and Colorado Plateau, all tribes are known for a specific weapon.|White Legs are known for their big submachine guns, "storm drums." They broke into an armory near Spanish Fork and have been using them for years.|Of course, the Dead Horses have their wooden war clubs and even the Sorrows have their Yao Guai gauntlets.|This type of .45 Automatic pistol was designed by one of my tribe almost four hundred years ago. Learning its use is a New Canaanite rite of passage.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic011 "Nice guns." [DIAL:0500F4D1]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Pray? God? What are you talking about?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic010 "Pray? God? What are you talking about?" [DIAL:0500F4D2]

text_content: I am a New Canaanite. We believe we are the heirs of a spiritual tradition given to our ancestors thousands of years ago.|We have made and kept covenants with our Lord, God, to honor his laws. In exchange, we are promised eternal salvation after this life.|A day will come when our Lord returns to judge us all. Until then, we must honor his laws and start others along the path of salvation if we can.|That's why we trade with others and work the tribes. We have more than food and medicine to offer. Good news is our most valuable commodity.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic010 "Pray? God? What are you talking about?" [DIAL:0500F4D2]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: How do I get out of here?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic009 "How do I get out of here?" [DIAL:0500F4D3]

text_content: Even though you made your way in, there's no easy way back. Without a map, you'll die in the wilderness.|Daniel, one of our missionaries, can help you, but you've caught us at an... inconvenient time. We're under continual threat from the White Legs.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic009 "How do I get out of here?" [DIAL:0500F4D3]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: I came here with the Happy Trails Caravan Company to make contact with the New Canaanites.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic005 "I came here with the Happy Trails Caravan Company to make contact with the New Canaanites." [DIAL:0500F4D4]

text_content: Happy Trails. {quietly remembering}I remember. {small smile}They were good friends.|{darker}I have bad news for your employers. New Canaan was destroyed, its citizens scattered. All because of the White Legs. And Caesar, of course.|The White Legs want to join the Legion. Caesar's rite of passage is the destruction of the New Canaanites, almost assuredly because of me.|The good news is that we can help you find your way back. Daniel, one of the other New Canaanites, has made many maps of the region.|The bad news is that we can't help you right now. Not with everything that's going on.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic005 "I came here with the Happy Trails Caravan Company to make contact with the New Canaanites." [DIAL:0500F4D4]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: PER check.
name: NVDLC02DialogueRickyNVDLC02RickyTopic044 "PER check." [DIAL:0500F5A5]

text_content: {laughs uncomfortably}Well, yeah, okay. You caught me.
name: NVDLC02DialogueRickyNVDLC02RickyTopic044 "PER check." [DIAL:0500F5A5]
speaker: NVDLC02Ricky "Ricky" [NPC_:0500F19D]

text_content: Yeah, so don't bring it up again!
name: NVDLC02DialogueRickyNVDLC02RickyTopic044 "PER check." [DIAL:0500F5A5]
speaker: NVDLC02Ricky "Ricky" [NPC_:0500F19D]

text_content: PER check.
name: NVDLC02DialogueRickyNVDLC02RickyTopic043 "PER check." [DIAL:0500F5A6]

text_content: {laughs uncomfortably}Well, yeah, okay. You caught me.
name: NVDLC02DialogueRickyNVDLC02RickyTopic043 "PER check." [DIAL:0500F5A6]
speaker: NVDLC02Ricky "Ricky" [NPC_:0500F19D]

text_content: Yeah, so don't bring it up again!
name: NVDLC02DialogueRickyNVDLC02RickyTopic043 "PER check." [DIAL:0500F5A6]

name: NVDLC02DialogueShamanNVDLC02SorrowShamanTopic012 "Okay then... I guess... I guess I don't have any questions after all." [DIAL:0500F6C8]

text_content: Crazy old man. I'm not doing anything for you.
name: NVDLC02DialogueShamanNVDLC02SorrowShamanTopic009 "Crazy old man. I'm not doing anything for you." [DIAL:0500F6C9]

text_content: Spirits guide you whether you listen or not. Smarter to listen, hmm?
name: NVDLC02DialogueShamanNVDLC02SorrowShamanTopic009 "Crazy old man. I'm not doing anything for you." [DIAL:0500F6C9]
speaker: NVDLC02SorrowShaman "White Bird" [NPC_:050094B9]

text_content: Okay then. I guess I'll just... go then.
name: NVDLC02DialogueShamanNVDLC02SorrowShamanTopic007 "Okay then. I guess I'll just... go then." [DIAL:0500F6CA]

text_content: Go! Return maybe yes, return maybe no. But go.
name: NVDLC02DialogueShamanNVDLC02SorrowShamanTopic007 "Okay then. I guess I'll just... go then." [DIAL:0500F6CA]
speaker: NVDLC02SorrowShaman "White Bird" [NPC_:050094B9]

text_content: Wait a minute, what if I don't want to do any of that?
name: NVDLC02DialogueShamanNVDLC02SorrowShamanTopic000 "Wait a minute, what if I don't want to do any of that?" [DIAL:0500F6CB]

text_content: <White Bird stares at you wordlessly.>
name: NVDLC02DialogueShamanNVDLC02SorrowShamanTopic000 "Wait a minute, what if I don't want to do any of that?" [DIAL:0500F6CB]
speaker: NVDLC02SorrowShaman "White Bird" [NPC_:050094B9]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic050 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0500F6CC]

text_content: What would you speak of?
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic050 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0500F6CC]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: What's with this obsession you seem to have with "civilization?"
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic050 "What's with this obsession you seem to have with ""civilization?""" [DIAL:0500F6CF]

text_content: Let me tell you a story. When I was a boy, a man came through the valley with one of the caravans. Tall man, big mustache, carried a guitar.|I asked what he did for his living, and the interpreter told me he was a singer.|"What is that?" I asked. The man explained that he went from place to place and sang for people, who gave him food and shelter and care in return.|I couldn't believe that there was a place in this world where a man could do that. I promised myself then that one day I'd explore that world myself.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic050 "What's with this obsession you seem to have with ""civilization?""" [DIAL:0500F6CF]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Ya? What did he say?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic050 "What's with this obsession you seem to have with ""civilization?""" [DIAL:0500F6CF]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: < Follows-Chalk Taboo Area Bark >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkTabooBark "< Follows-Chalk Taboo Area Bark >" [DIAL:0500F6D0]

text_content: For as long as I remember, the Dead Horses have thought that places of the old world were taboo. Doesn't look so spooky to me.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkTabooBark "< Follows-Chalk Taboo Area Bark >" [DIAL:0500F6D0]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: < Follows Chalk Narrows Bark >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkNarrowsBark "< Follows Chalk Narrows Bark >" [DIAL:0500F6D1]

text_content: The Narrows up ahead, that's the Sorrows' territory. They're peaceful enough, but you don't want to make them mad.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkNarrowsBark "< Follows Chalk Narrows Bark >" [DIAL:0500F6D1]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: < Follows-Chalk Three Marys Bark >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkMarysBark "< Follows-Chalk Three Marys Bark >" [DIAL:0500F6D2]

text_content: Heads up, this is the Three Marys. White Legs territory. You sure you want to head in there?
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkMarysBark "< Follows-Chalk Three Marys Bark >" [DIAL:0500F6D2]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Where do they come from?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic046 "Where do they come from?" [DIAL:0500F6D3]

text_content: That's the weird part - normally the White Legs keep to the Great Salt Lake. I don't know what brought them down this far south.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic046 "Where do they come from?" [DIAL:0500F6D3]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Wait, what? New Canaan was wiped out? How?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic045 "Wait, what? New Canaan was wiped out? How?" [DIAL:0500F6D4]

text_content: That's what Joshua said. White Legs came down from Great Salt Lake in force - fell on New Canaan before they could mount a defense.|Joshua found some of the survivors led by a man named Daniel. Most of them have fled the valley, but Daniel stayed on with the Sorrows tribe.|He and Joshua have been arguing over whether to stand and fight the White Legs or take the Sorrows and the Dead Horses out of the valley.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic045 "Wait, what? New Canaan was wiped out? How?" [DIAL:0500F6D4]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: You've got a funny idea about what the Mojave's like, but I'll go with you and see your boss.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic044 "You've got a funny idea about what the Mojave's like, but I'll go with you and see your boss." [DIAL:0500F6D5]

text_content: {Glad to hear it}Goot sists. Maybe while you're there you can tell me about where you came from, yeah?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic044 "You've got a funny idea about what the Mojave's like, but I'll go with you and see your boss." [DIAL:0500F6D5]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Tell me about Waking Cloud's family.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic018 "Tell me about Waking Cloud's family." [DIAL:0500F71A]

text_content: {a bit of apprehension}What uh... what do you want to know, exactly? I'm sure she could tell you much better than I.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic018 "Tell me about Waking Cloud's family." [DIAL:0500F71A]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: NVDLC02OpeningRickyWithdrawal
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationB01 "NVDLC02OpeningRickyWithdrawal" [DIAL:0500F720]

text_content: {going through withdrawal}I ain't feeling good, man. I feel like shit! I got the shakes, got the sweats. This fucking sucks!
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationB01 "NVDLC02OpeningRickyWithdrawal" [DIAL:0500F720]

text_content: NVDLC02OpeningRickyHigh
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationA01 "NVDLC02OpeningRickyHigh" [DIAL:0500F721]

text_content: {high on Psycho}Oh man, yeah! Trigger finger is feeling {emphasis}itch-ay! {yelling out to the canyon}Come on, assholes! Show yourselves and Deadeye Ricky'll blow your fucking heads off!
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationA01 "NVDLC02OpeningRickyHigh" [DIAL:0500F721]

text_content: < Follows Chalk Eastern Virgin Bark >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkVirginBark "< Follows Chalk Eastern Virgin Bark >" [DIAL:0500F856]

text_content: Ah, the Eastern Virgin. What's the phrase? "House sweet house?"
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkVirginBark "< Follows Chalk Eastern Virgin Bark >" [DIAL:0500F856]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: < Follows-Chalk Pine Creek Bark >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkPineCreekBark "< Follows-Chalk Pine Creek Bark >" [DIAL:0500F857]

text_content: That's Pine Creek up there. Supposedly it's one of only two ways out of Zion Valley. Of course, without a map, good luck surviving.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkPineCreekBark "< Follows-Chalk Pine Creek Bark >" [DIAL:0500F857]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: I like your bear glove. Where can I get one?
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic049 "I like your bear glove. Where can I get one?" [DIAL:0500F858]

text_content: A Sorrow's Yao Guai Fist is a sacred symbol. It shows that we belong to the tribe and have willingly undertaken a dangerous quest to aid the tribe.|Each Sorrow makes his own - and only after hunting and slaying a Yao Guai that threatened our people.|Our shaman, White Bird, oversees the rites. Perhaps if you spoke to him, he would allow you to undertake such a quest.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic049 "I like your bear glove. Where can I get one?" [DIAL:0500F858]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Maybe later, if there's time.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic053 "Maybe later, if there's time." [DIAL:0500F8AB]

text_content: I do hope you will reconsider. I will point out his cave on your map, should you wish to speak to him later.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic053 "Maybe later, if there's time." [DIAL:0500F8AB]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Okay, I'll talk to him.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic052 "Okay, I'll talk to him." [DIAL:0500F8AC]

text_content: Excellent. His cave overlooks the camp - I will show you where.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic052 "Okay, I'll talk to him." [DIAL:0500F8AC]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Any idea what he wants?
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic051 "Any idea what he wants?" [DIAL:0500F8AD]

text_content: He did not say. White Bird is notoriously close-lipped. But he is wise, and you would do well to speak to him.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic051 "Any idea what he wants?" [DIAL:0500F8AD]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Wildlife problem? What kind of wildlife?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic047 "Wildlife problem? What kind of wildlife?" [DIAL:0500F8AE]

text_content: All right, let's go.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic022 "All right, let's go." [DIAL:0500F8AF]

text_content: Right.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic022 "All right, let's go." [DIAL:0500F8AF]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: < NVDLC02MQ05 Intro Force Greet >
name: NVDLC02JoshuaMQ05ForceGreet "< NVDLC02MQ05 Intro Force Greet >" [DIAL:0500F8B0]

text_content: I'll see you on the other side.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic020 "I'll see you on the other side." [DIAL:0500F8B1]

text_content: Go with God, brother.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic020 "I'll see you on the other side." [DIAL:0500F8B1]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Go with God, sister.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic020 "I'll see you on the other side." [DIAL:0500F8B1]

text_content: < Joshua Graham tells the player he's looking for another way to SUW. >
name: NVDLC02JoshuaMQ04LeaveForceGreet "< Joshua Graham tells the player he's looking for another way to SUW. >" [DIAL:0500F8B2]

text_content: This is taking too long. We can't let Salt-Upon-Wounds escape. I'm going to find a way around. God willing, we will finish this together.
name: NVDLC02JoshuaMQ04LeaveForceGreet "< Joshua Graham tells the player he's looking for another way to SUW. >" [DIAL:0500F8B2]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Maybe later, if there's time.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic053DUPLICATE000 "Maybe later, if there's time." [DIAL:0500F8DB]

text_content: As you wish. I will point out his cave on your map, should you wish to speak to him later.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic053DUPLICATE000 "Maybe later, if there's time." [DIAL:0500F8DB]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Okay, I'll talk to him.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic052DUPLICATE000 "Okay, I'll talk to him." [DIAL:0500F8DC]

text_content: Excellent. His cave overlooks the camp - I will show you where.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic052DUPLICATE000 "Okay, I'll talk to him." [DIAL:0500F8DC]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Any idea what he wants?
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic051DUPLICATE000 "Any idea what he wants?" [DIAL:0500F8DD]

text_content: He did not say. White Bird is notoriously close-lipped. But he is wise, and you would do well to speak to him.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic051DUPLICATE000 "Any idea what he wants?" [DIAL:0500F8DD]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Wildlife problem? What kind of wildlife?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic047DUPLICATE000 "Wildlife problem? What kind of wildlife?" [DIAL:0500F8DE]

text_content: < NVDLC02MQ05 Intro Force Greet >
name: NVDLC02JoshuaMQ05ForceGreetDUPLICATE000 "< NVDLC02MQ05 Intro Force Greet >" [DIAL:0500F8E0]

text_content: I'll see you on the other side.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic020DUPLICATE000 "I'll see you on the other side." [DIAL:0500F8E1]

text_content: < Joshua Graham tells the player he's looking for another way to SUW. >
name: NVDLC02JoshuaMQ04LeaveForceGreetDUPLICATE000 "< Joshua Graham tells the player he's looking for another way to SUW. >" [DIAL:0500F8E2]

text_content: This is taking too long. We can't let Salt-Upon-Wounds escape. I'm going to find a way around. God willing, we will finish this together.
name: NVDLC02JoshuaMQ04LeaveForceGreetDUPLICATE000 "< Joshua Graham tells the player he's looking for another way to SUW. >" [DIAL:0500F8E2]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: I could talk to him, maybe he'll open up more to me.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic055 "I could talk to him, maybe he'll open up more to me." [DIAL:0500F926]

text_content: Perhaps he will. I sometimes feel he thinks he must protect me. If he has news, I would know of it.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic055 "I could talk to him, maybe he'll open up more to me." [DIAL:0500F926]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: <Lie> Daniel isn't avoiding talking about your family. He's just preoccupied with all of this.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic054 "<Lie> Daniel isn't avoiding talking about your family. He's just preoccupied with all of this." [DIAL:0500F927]

text_content: This is true? You spoke to him? Oh, that is a relief. {Thank you, friend.}{GRAH-sahs nah-NAY}Grasas, na'ne.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic054 "<Lie> Daniel isn't avoiding talking about your family. He's just preoccupied with all of this." [DIAL:0500F927]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Follows-Chalk seems like he's interested in seeing more of the world.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic021 "Follows-Chalk seems like he's interested in seeing more of the world." [DIAL:0500F928]

text_content: I thought he might. It's been some time since I've visited... {emph}civilized places. I don't have fond memories of them.|But I have always seen these places from the outside. I'd rather not influence him more than I already do. Why don't you talk to him?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic021 "Follows-Chalk seems like he's interested in seeing more of the world." [DIAL:0500F928]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: <Lie> That a man must follow his heart no matter where it leads him.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic054 "<Lie> That a man must follow his heart no matter where it leads him." [DIAL:0500F92D]

text_content: Really? He said that? Hoo! I'm going to do it. After all this is over, I'm going to go explore civilization!|{Thank you, my friend}Dank ni, ahk iss - I never would have had the {guts}growans to ask him myself.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic054 "<Lie> That a man must follow his heart no matter where it leads him." [DIAL:0500F92D]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: <Lie> That it's a den of corruption and vice, and the Dead Horses' way of living is better.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic053 "<Lie> That it's a den of corruption and vice, and the Dead Horses' way of living is better." [DIAL:0500F92E]

text_content: Oh. Well, I guess that's about what I could expect from him. I'd like a minute alone to think about this. {Thanks}Dank ni.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic053 "<Lie> That it's a den of corruption and vice, and the Dead Horses' way of living is better." [DIAL:0500F92E]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Really? Maybe I could talk to him about it for you. Be a neutral party.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic049 "Really? Maybe I could talk to him about it for you. Be a neutral party." [DIAL:0500F92F]

text_content: You'd do that? Sure, sounds smart to me. He might not get so mad at you.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic049 "Really? Maybe I could talk to him about it for you. Be a neutral party." [DIAL:0500F92F]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: What does Joshua think of this?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic048 "What does Joshua think of this?" [DIAL:0500F930]

text_content: I, umm, I haven't told him yet. Never had the {guts}growans.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic048 "What does Joshua think of this?" [DIAL:0500F930]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Enough with the drama. I just want to get home.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic037 "Enough with the drama. I just want to get home." [DIAL:0500F9FB]

text_content: I understand. The safest way for you to resolve this is to help me and the Dead Horses defeat the White Legs.|Daniel wants to evacuate the Sorrows from the valley. I think this will be much more difficult for everyone, you included.|You can rationalize, if you'd like. A lucky coincidence of my faith and your pragmatism leading to different goals by the same means.|But you'll have to help convince Daniel, because I can't do it alone. The good Lord knows I've tried.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic037 "Enough with the drama. I just want to get home." [DIAL:0500F9FB]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Fair enough. What do you want me to do about it?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic036 "Fair enough. What do you want me to do about it?" [DIAL:0500F9FC]

text_content: Talk to Daniel about fighting the White Legs. He wants to evacuate the valley, believes it is best for the Sorrows, physically and spiritually.|He knows I disagree, but believes my desire to fight is the result of my... history of violence.|Perhaps if he heard an argument from you, he could be convinced. In any case, it's important enough to try.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic036 "Fair enough. What do you want me to do about it?" [DIAL:0500F9FC]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: I don't know if you've figured this out yet, but I don't believe what you believe.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic035 "I don't know if you've figured this out yet, but I don't believe what you believe." [DIAL:0500F9FD]

text_content: Then as a Gentile, you should find this to be even more beneficial. If the Sorrows stay in Zion, you will always have a link to New Canaan.|If the Sorrows leave Zion, so too do the New Canaanites. What's more, you'll have more White Legs coming farther south.|You may not be concerned over matters of faith, but this is a case where faith and practicality coincide.|No one wants the White Legs here. We just need to convince Daniel that it's our responsibility to ensure that doesn't happen.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic035 "I don't know if you've figured this out yet, but I don't believe what you believe." [DIAL:0500F9FD]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Hmm. Okay.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic034 "Hmm. Okay." [DIAL:0500F9FE]

text_content: You're not so certain. Fair enough. We all have doubts.|Blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed. But you can be a Thomas for now. Fight the White Legs enough and you'll see the truth.|I just hope that by the time you understand, there will still be time to convince Daniel that we have to fight for Zion to save it, and the Sorrows.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic034 "Hmm. Okay." [DIAL:0500F9FE]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Fair enough, I guess.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic033 "Fair enough, I guess." [DIAL:0500F9FF]

text_content: I and the Dead Horses are prepared to do what must be done to protect Zion from the White Legs.|And though Daniel won't accept it yet, there are many Sorrows who are also prepared. They may not be warriors, but this is their home.|If you have a chance to speak with Daniel about this, ask him to consider defending Zion instead of abandoning it.|He has good intentions, but I fear that if we evacuate the Sorrows from this place, it will be lost to them, and us, forever.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic033 "Fair enough, I guess." [DIAL:0500F9FF]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: I do. They're little more than raiders, if that.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic032 "I do. They're little more than raiders, if that." [DIAL:0500FA00]

text_content: Then you must bear witness of this revelation to Daniel. The obviousness of it escapes him.|We both desire a non-violent solution to this problem. Where we differ is that only one of us believes it is possible.|Speak your heart to Daniel when the opportunity presents itself. There may yet be time to save Zion.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic032 "I do. They're little more than raiders, if that." [DIAL:0500FA00]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: And what kind of tribe is that?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic031 "And what kind of tribe is that?" [DIAL:0500FA01]

text_content: God told Moses that the tribes of Cain would not be welcome in Zion. The White Legs are as close as I have seen, beyond hope, beyond redemption.|But if the Sorrows die in a state of ignorance, their salvation may be delayed as well, passing from life in this world to a spiritual prison.|We have a responsibilty to protect this place and those who have come to dwell in it. If you feel the same way, speak with Daniel.|There may yet be time to save Zion from those who are too ignorant to understand what they have come to destroy.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic031 "And what kind of tribe is that?" [DIAL:0500FA01]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Yes, what has to be done is you have to get these tribes out of here.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic030 "Yes, what has to be done is you have to get these tribes out of here." [DIAL:0500FA02]

text_content: The Sorrows need help. We brought the White Legs here, the New Canaanites. This is their home, Zion, God's gift to them.|In abandoning it, we will gain nothing and will lose more than you realize. Please think about this, and look in your heart.|The light of the mind alone cannot burn away all darkness.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic030 "Yes, what has to be done is you have to get these tribes out of here." [DIAL:0500FA02]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: I need to think about it.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic029 "I need to think about it." [DIAL:0500FA03]

text_content: Of course. Think on it, and look in your heart. The light of the mind alone cannot dispel the whole world's darkness.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic029 "I need to think about it." [DIAL:0500FA03]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: I'll talk to him about it. Maybe he can be persuaded.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic028 "I'll talk to him about it. Maybe he can be persuaded." [DIAL:0500FA04]

text_content: Thank you. It will be for the best.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic028 "I'll talk to him about it. Maybe he can be persuaded." [DIAL:0500FA04]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]
