text_content: You'll get no argument from me. These White Legs are human garbage.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic027 "You'll get no argument from me. These White Legs are human garbage." [DIAL:0500FA05]

text_content: They're still God's children, but if they turn against their brothers and sisters, won't listen to reason...|If they pollute the Lord's temples on Earth, like Zion, who are we to stand by and let them continue?|Daniel does not yet see things the way we do. He is the John to our Matthew and Mark. When you have a moment, speak with him.|There may still be time to save Zion from the White Legs, to keep God's children here, in this living temple.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic027 "You'll get no argument from me. These White Legs are human garbage." [DIAL:0500FA05]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Why are you talking to me about it?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic026 "Why are you talking to me about it?" [DIAL:0500FA06]

text_content: Daniel and I don't agree on everything, but in our hearts, we both want what's best for the Sorrows and Dead Horses.|You've seen what the White Legs do, and I think you know what has to be done. If Daniel hears it from someone other than me, well...|Zion may not be lost to us after all.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic026 "Why are you talking to me about it?" [DIAL:0500FA06]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: This conversation just got pretty dark. What was that about happy... dashing the little ones?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic025 "This conversation just got pretty dark. What was that about happy... dashing the little ones?" [DIAL:0500FA07]

text_content: Happy are those who do the work of the Lord. Zion belongs to God and the people of God. It is a natural temple and monument to his glory.|When our Lord entered the temple and found it polluted by money-changers and beasts, did he {emph.}ask them to leave? Did he cry? Did he simply walk away?|No. He {emph.}drove them out. It is one thing to forgive a slap across my cheek, but an insult to the Lord requires... no, it {emph.}demands correction.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic025 "This conversation just got pretty dark. What was that about happy... dashing the little ones?" [DIAL:0500FA07]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: You don't want to leave Zion. You'd rather kill every last one of the White Legs.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic024 "You don't want to leave Zion. You'd rather kill every last one of the White Legs." [DIAL:0500FA08]

text_content: Given those two choices, yes. In the best of all possible worlds, they would just leave us in peace. But they won't.|I don't enjoy killing, but when done righteously, it's just a chore, like any other.|Practiced hands make for short work. And the good Lord knows there's much to be done here.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic024 "You don't want to leave Zion. You'd rather kill every last one of the White Legs." [DIAL:0500FA08]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: No, and I don't really care.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic023 "No, and I don't really care." [DIAL:0500FA09]

text_content: Living in willful ignorance is an ugly thing, but God often speaks loudest in the wild places of his creation, like Zion.|Zion is a place, and a state of being, that has been lost to us several times in the past. Each loss is a new fall of man.|And after each fall, we weep in strange new lands and dream of Zion, dream of visiting vengeance upon those who took it from us.|But this is the waking world in which we live. There is no need to cry, no need to dream. We can act now and stop the White Legs here.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic023 "No, and I don't really care." [DIAL:0500FA09]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Well, I'm guessing you're pretty mad about something.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic021DUPLICATE000 "Well, I'm guessing you're pretty mad about something." [DIAL:0500FA0A]

text_content: The White Legs didn't just force my people out of New Canaan. They butchered everyone who wasn't fast enough to get away.|The elderly, the ill, children. Those who stopped to help the wounded. It made no difference to them. They can't be reasoned with, the White Legs.|Daniel believes that if we leave, if the Sorrows leave, the White Legs will stop. He doesn't understand what this kind of tribe is like.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic021DUPLICATE000 "Well, I'm guessing you're pretty mad about something." [DIAL:0500FA0A]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Are the New Canaanites really a tribe?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic047 "Are the New Canaanites really a tribe?" [DIAL:0500FB18]

text_content: We wear more clothing than them and understand more about technology, but we're still a tribe, a linked family of families.|The Boneyard, Phoenix, New Vegas, they're just places, metal and stone. New Canaan dies, but the tribe lives on.|When the walls come tumbling down, when you lose everything you have, you always have family. And your family always has tribe.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic047 "Are the New Canaanites really a tribe?" [DIAL:0500FB18]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Why haven't I seen any Sorrows in the valley?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic046 "Why haven't I seen any Sorrows in the valley?" [DIAL:0500FB19]

text_content: The Sorrows have many skilled hunters among them, but no warriors. They have not had to deal with war or raiders for decades.|Even though they can hunt a full-grown Yao Guai, they don't know how to deal with the White Legs. That's why we're here.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic046 "Why haven't I seen any Sorrows in the valley?" [DIAL:0500FB19]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Does the valley belong to the Dead Horses?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic045 "Does the valley belong to the Dead Horses?" [DIAL:0500FB1A]

text_content: The valley belongs to God, but no. The Dead Horses live at Dead Horse Point, up the Colorado River. They came here because I asked them to.|Before I... returned to the fold, I visited them years earlier. I looked much different then, but I left an impression on them.|I taught them how to hunt more efficiently, how to maintain their weapons and Pre-War equipment. When I returned, they showed their appreciation.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic045 "Does the valley belong to the Dead Horses?" [DIAL:0500FB1A]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Why did the White Legs attack my caravan?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic044 "Why did the White Legs attack my caravan?" [DIAL:0500FB1B]

text_content: They attack everyone who isn't a White Leg, especially caravans. They don't know how to survive on their own, so they have to raid.|But as for why they are here, they are trying to wipe us out. All of us.|They want to join Caesar's Legion, and they can only prove their worth by destroying the New Canaanites and everyone we shelter.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic044 "Why did the White Legs attack my caravan?" [DIAL:0500FB1B]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Do you ever "fall?"
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic043 "Do you ever ""fall?""" [DIAL:0500FB1C]

text_content: Every day. Some days are... harder than others.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic043 "Do you ever ""fall?""" [DIAL:0500FB1C]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Ha ha ha! Wait... you don't actually believe that, do you?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic042 "Ha ha ha! Wait... you don't actually believe that, do you?" [DIAL:0500FB1D]

text_content: I know it may be hard for you to accept or even to understand. In my heart, I believe that though I am a sinner, I have been saved.|And I believe there is something beyond this rock and this air and this water around us, something more that is waiting for us.|I have been baptized twice, once in water, once in flame. I will carry the fire of the holy spirit inside until I stand before my Lord for judgment.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic042 "Ha ha ha! Wait... you don't actually believe that, do you?" [DIAL:0500FB1D]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Huh. If you say so.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic041 "Huh. If you say so." [DIAL:0500FB1E]

text_content: Whether there is a God or not, his existence doesn't depend on what you believe or what I say.|There is much to be skeptical of in this world, so it no longer surprises me to learn how many people don't really believe in anything.|But I believe that our Lord was made flesh as Jesus Christ and died to redeem me. And you. And the Sorrows. Even the White Legs. Everyone.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic041 "Huh. If you say so." [DIAL:0500FB1E]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Sounds like a good deal.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic040 "Sounds like a good deal." [DIAL:0500FB1F]

text_content: In a world filled with misery and uncertainty, it is a great comfort to know that, in the end, there is light in the darkness.|Every day, we move closer to our judgment. We must do our best to walk in the footsteps of our Lord and teach others how to do the same.|For many of us, the road is a difficult one, but the path is always there for us to follow, no matter how many times we may fall.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic040 "Sounds like a good deal." [DIAL:0500FB1F]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: What's going on with all of these... tribes?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic039 "What's going on with all of these... tribes?" [DIAL:0500FB20]

text_content: A great deal. There are three, make that four, tribes here in Zion. You've already met the White Legs on the way in.|In this camp, you'll find Dead Horses. In the Narrows, the Sorrows. And finally there's Daniel and myself. We're New Canaanites.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic039 "What's going on with all of these... tribes?" [DIAL:0500FB20]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Do you run the show around here?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic038 "Do you run the show around here?" [DIAL:0500FB21]

text_content: I wouldn't say that. I am the acting war chief for the Dead Horses. They look up to me for such matters, but I only have the authority they give me.|Daniel is the spiritual leader and main link of the New Canaanites to the Sorrows. He's up in the Narrows right now.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic038 "Do you run the show around here?" [DIAL:0500FB21]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic051 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0500FB2C]

text_content: Of course.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic051 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:0500FB2C]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Do they speak... our language?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic050 "Do they speak... our language?" [DIAL:0500FB2D]

text_content: Most don't. It's been hundreds of years since the war. They've developed their own languages.|Take the Dead Horses. We think they were originally refugees from a place called {"rehz"}"Res," east of the Grand Canyon.|They speak a combination of Res and a language spoken by travelers who were visiting Res when the bombs fell. Over time, the two languages blended.|I was a translator years ago, but it's hard to keep up with all of the tribal variations.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic050 "Do they speak... our language?" [DIAL:0500FB2D]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Thanks for the offer, but I'll handle it myself.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic048 "Thanks for the offer, but I'll handle it myself." [DIAL:0500FB2F]

text_content: I don't think so.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic048 "Thanks for the offer, but I'll handle it myself." [DIAL:0500FB2F]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: The Divide blocked all of their northern land routes?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic071 "The Divide blocked all of their northern land routes?" [DIAL:0500FB37]

text_content: Not all of them. But they couldn't take 127 north to get around the mountains.|As if Death Valley weren't enough, they had the Divide and Big Empty to deal with.|From what the Legion's explorers reported, the Big Empty may as well have been a wall to any living thing approaching it.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic071 "The Divide blocked all of their northern land routes?" [DIAL:0500FB37]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: What's at the Divide?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic070 "What's at the Divide?" [DIAL:0500FB38]

text_content: I don't know for certain, and I don't think NCR knows, either. Whatever happened at the Divide was too much for them to handle.|Our {froo-mehn-tah-ree}frumentarii told us what they saw. Only fools and madmen would march into a place like that. All roads wind down to the same spot, the grave.|They said all that's left there is a gaping wound cut into the Earth, cursed and damned. No place for God-fearing folk.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic070 "What's at the Divide?" [DIAL:0500FB38]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: I'm guessing you don't like Caesar very much.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic069 "I'm guessing you don't like Caesar very much." [DIAL:0500FB39]

text_content: Love the sinner, hate the sin. With Caesar, it's often very difficult to see through all of that sin to the person inside.|I can say that we were both lucky that NCR's supply lines and land routes north of Mojave Outpost were destroyed before the Battle of Hoover Dam.|Something bad happened near Death Valley, at a place called the Divide. NCR couldn't cut across anymore and it slowed down their reinforcements.|Terrible storms ripped entire companies apart before they even got to Nevada soil. The aftermath of Hoover Dam could have been even worse for Caesar.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic069 "I'm guessing you don't like Caesar very much." [DIAL:0500FB39]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Do you know about Mr. House?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic068 "Do you know about Mr. House?" [DIAL:0500FB3A]

text_content: I had heard of him, but when we were preparing to enter the Mojave, he didn't seem relevant to what was happening.|From what I've learned since Hoover Dam, he handled the Mojave tribes in a fashion not entirely dissimilar from Caesar. It's too bad.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic068 "Do you know about Mr. House?" [DIAL:0500FB3A]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: What do you think of NCR?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic066 "What do you think of NCR?" [DIAL:0500FB3C]

text_content: Better than Caesar, but that's not a high standard. Too much love of money and ownership, not enough love of God and giving.|Any society that derives its power and authority from the will of man alone lives apart from God and will crumble in the end.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic066 "What do you think of NCR?" [DIAL:0500FB3C]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: What do you know about the war between Caesar and NCR?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic065 "What do you know about the war between Caesar and NCR?" [DIAL:0500FB3D]

text_content: I try not to involve myself with matters of the Mojave anymore. All I know is from before the Battle of Hoover Dam.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic065 "What do you know about the war between Caesar and NCR?" [DIAL:0500FB3D]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Are you in much pain? Is there anything I can do to help?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic064 "Are you in much pain? Is there anything I can do to help?" [DIAL:0500FB3E]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] You are kind to offer, but no, there's nothing you can do. We don't use chems, but I learned long ago that I'm immune to their effects.|It never stops burning. My skin. Every day, I have to unwind the bandages and replace them with fresh ones.|Exposing my body to the air is like living through it again. But it's better to be clean than comfortable.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic064 "Are you in much pain? Is there anything I can do to help?" [DIAL:0500FB3E]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: How did you survive?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic063 "How did you survive?" [DIAL:0500FB3F]

text_content: I survived because the fire inside burned brighter than the fire around me. I fell down into that dark chasm, but the flame burned on and on.|The next morning, I woke up and crawled out of the northern edge of the Grand Canyon, that cursed place. It took me three months to reach New Canaan.|It was as though the prodigal son had returned. They welcomed me like I had never left, never done anything to shame them.|The fire that had kept me alive was love. Their love. God's love. I will never be able to repay the debt I owe to them, but I must try.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic063 "How did you survive?" [DIAL:0500FB3F]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: How did you end up as Caesar's legate?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic062 "How did you end up as Caesar's legate?" [DIAL:0500FB40]

text_content: This way lies the path to hell. Edw- Caesar needed me to translate. Translation became giving orders. Giving orders became leading in battle.|Leading in battle became training, punishing, terrorizing. A series of small mistakes before a great fall.|And I stayed in that darkness until after Hoover Dam. After I failed Caesar and he had me burned alive, thrown into the Grand Canyon.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic062 "How did you end up as Caesar's legate?" [DIAL:0500FB40]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Was one of those men Caesar?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic061 "Was one of those men Caesar?" [DIAL:0500FB41]

text_content: No, not then. Back then he was just Edward. Smart man. Young, but we all were. We thought we could hike into the Grand Canyon and talk to Blackfoots.|We did, and the Blackfoots were friendly enough at first, but eventually... I've thought back to that day so many times. I must have mistranslated.|Something must have been mixed up, because the Blackfoots decided we weren't going to leave. The rest is history, assuming Edward hasn't changed it.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic061 "Was one of those men Caesar?" [DIAL:0500FB41]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: What are those bandages for?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic059 "What are those bandages for?" [DIAL:0500FB43]

text_content: [FAILED] {irritated}For injuries I suffered long ago.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic059 "What are those bandages for?" [DIAL:0500FB43]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Were you always with the New Canaanites?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic057 "Were you always with the New Canaanites?" [DIAL:0500FB45]

text_content: I was born in Ogden, what people came to call New Canaan. Things were more peaceful when I was growing up.|When I was a young man, I went out into the world to do missionary work as all New Canaanites do.|I traveled along the Long 15 and followed 89 south into Arizona. Along the way, I met two men from a group called the Followers of the Apocalypse.|Edward Sallow and Bill Calhoun. They came to teach the tribes. Calhoun was a good man. Edward was the one who got us into trouble down the road.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic057 "Were you always with the New Canaanites?" [DIAL:0500FB45]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Can I ask you some personal questions?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic056 "Can I ask you some personal questions?" [DIAL:0500FB46]

text_content: Right now, I'd like you to focus on helping Daniel. Maybe there will be time later.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic056 "Can I ask you some personal questions?" [DIAL:0500FB46]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: It's not something I enjoy, but I pray to God that someone may learn from my mistakes. What would you like to know?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic056 "Can I ask you some personal questions?" [DIAL:0500FB46]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: I have a few questions for you.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic055 "I have a few questions for you." [DIAL:0500FB47]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic054 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0500FB48]

text_content: God be with you.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic054 "Goodbye." [DIAL:0500FB48]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Fine, I'll look into getting those supplies for Daniel.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic053 "Fine, I'll look into getting those supplies for Daniel." [DIAL:0500FB49]

text_content: Do you have anything to trade?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic052 "Do you have anything to trade?" [DIAL:0500FB4A]

text_content: We do. Though the White Legs destroyed New Canaan, they didn't destroy all of our supply caches.|All forms of currency are recognized here. Caps, NCR dollars, even Legion coin. Take a look.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic052 "Do you have anything to trade?" [DIAL:0500FB4A]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Yes. Take a look.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic052 "Do you have anything to trade?" [DIAL:0500FB4A]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: NVDLC02OpeningConversationStart
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationStart "NVDLC02OpeningConversationStart" [DIAL:0500FFC0]

text_content: {angry that Jed dismissed your concerns}{under your breath}Sorry to bother you with reality, ol' Jed. Who cares if we can't get back out the way we come?  That's not a problem.
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationStart "NVDLC02OpeningConversationStart" [DIAL:0500FFC0]

text_content: NVDLC02AmbushJedAlertBark01
name: NVDLC02AmbushJedAlertBark01 "NVDLC02AmbushJedAlertBark01" [DIAL:0500FFC1]

text_content: {Jed becomes alerted by a sound ahead of the party. Stops dead on his tracks, cautious.} Shhhhh! Hold on, now...{finger to his lips, he shushes the rest of the crew.} Could swear I heard something up ahead.
name: NVDLC02AmbushJedAlertBark01 "NVDLC02AmbushJedAlertBark01" [DIAL:0500FFC1]

text_content: NVDLC02AmbushGuard02Bark01
name: NVDLC02AmbushGuard02Bark01 "NVDLC02AmbushGuard02Bark01" [DIAL:0500FFC2]

text_content: {Takes initiative, and moves forward to explore threat.}I'll take a look, boss! Keep me covered!
name: NVDLC02AmbushGuard02Bark01 "NVDLC02AmbushGuard02Bark01" [DIAL:0500FFC2]

text_content: NVDLC02AmbushJedBark04
name: NVDLC02AmbushJedBark04 "NVDLC02AmbushJedBark04" [DIAL:0500FFC3]

text_content: {Notices the player being hit, and falling down, and rushes to aid}On your feet! Keep fighting!{helps player on her/his feet} Come on now, I got ya...
name: NVDLC02AmbushJedBark04 "NVDLC02AmbushJedBark04" [DIAL:0500FFC3]

text_content: NVDLC02AmbushStellaBark02
name: NVDLC02AmbushStellaBark02 "NVDLC02AmbushStellaBark02" [DIAL:0500FFC4]

text_content: {Blinded by anger, Stella charges forth against the ambushers.}Enough of this! We're sitting ducks here! {pauses to catch her breath}Here I come! I was a sheriff once, goddamn it!
name: NVDLC02AmbushStellaBark02 "NVDLC02AmbushStellaBark02" [DIAL:0500FFC4]

text_content: NVDLC02AmbushStellaBark01
name: NVDLC02AmbushStellaBark01 "NVDLC02AmbushStellaBark01" [DIAL:0500FFC5]

text_content: {Ticked off by Ricky, and the ambush, she grinds her teeth}Shut the hell up, Ricky! Might as well be waving at them!
name: NVDLC02AmbushStellaBark01 "NVDLC02AmbushStellaBark01" [DIAL:0500FFC5]

text_content: NVDLC02AmbushRickyBark02
name: NVDLC02AmbushRickyBark02 "NVDLC02AmbushRickyBark02" [DIAL:0500FFC6]

text_content: {Whimpering, cowardly trying to hide from incoming fire.}I don't deserve this! My Pip-Boy don't even work! Why the fuck you hire me?
name: NVDLC02AmbushRickyBark02 "NVDLC02AmbushRickyBark02" [DIAL:0500FFC6]

text_content: NVDLC02AmbushRickyBark01
name: NVDLC02AmbushRickyBark01 "NVDLC02AmbushRickyBark01" [DIAL:0500FFC7]

text_content: {High, recklessly shooting in all directions.}You want some, assholes? You just pissed off the wrong guy! And that means Ricky!
name: NVDLC02AmbushRickyBark01 "NVDLC02AmbushRickyBark01" [DIAL:0500FFC7]

text_content: NVDLC02AmbushGuardBark01
name: NVDLC02AmbushGuardBark01 "NVDLC02AmbushGuardBark01" [DIAL:0500FFC8]

text_content: {Alarmed, just recognized that they've been ambushed}Ambush! Tribals, and they mean blood!
name: NVDLC02AmbushGuardBark01 "NVDLC02AmbushGuardBark01" [DIAL:0500FFC8]

text_content: NVDLC02AmbushJedBark03
name: NVDLC02AmbushJedBark03 "NVDLC02AmbushJedBark03" [DIAL:0500FFC9]

text_content: {Notices Stella falling down}Stella!... Oh no! {as he runs to her fallen body, small pause}Don't you die on me, woman, you hear?
name: NVDLC02AmbushJedBark03 "NVDLC02AmbushJedBark03" [DIAL:0500FFC9]

text_content: NVDLC02AmbushJedBark02
name: NVDLC02AmbushJedBark02 "NVDLC02AmbushJedBark02" [DIAL:0500FFCA]

text_content: {Trying to calm his crew under an onslaught of fire, and flying tomahawks.}Holy hell! Stay low, people, stay low...
name: NVDLC02AmbushJedBark02 "NVDLC02AmbushJedBark02" [DIAL:0500FFCA]

text_content: NVDLC02AmbushJedBark01
name: NVDLC02AmbushJedBark01 "NVDLC02AmbushJedBark01" [DIAL:0500FFCB]

text_content: {Alarmed, recognizes that they've been ambushed}Goddammit, ambush! Cover, people! Watch yourselves!
name: NVDLC02AmbushJedBark01 "NVDLC02AmbushJedBark01" [DIAL:0500FFCB]

text_content: NVDLC02OpeningConversationB10
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationB10 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationB10" [DIAL:0500FFCD]

text_content: {Ricky is going through withdrawal}Didn't nobody do this to you but yourself, junkie. Now try suffering in silence for once.
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationB10 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationB10" [DIAL:0500FFCD]

text_content: NVDLC02OpeningConversationB09
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationB09 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationB09" [DIAL:0500FFCE]

text_content: {self-pitying}You ain't got no heart, Stella! I swear, you're a monster, and you're gonna regret treating me like this!
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationB09 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationB09" [DIAL:0500FFCE]
speaker: NVDLC02Ricky "Ricky" [NPC_:0500F19D]

text_content: NVDLC02OpeningConversationB04
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationB04 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationB04" [DIAL:0500FFD3]

text_content: {Ricky is whining}You ain't sick! You're a goddamn junkie, that's what you are! So shut it!
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationB04 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationB04" [DIAL:0500FFD3]

text_content: NVDLC02OpeningConversationB03
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationB03 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationB03" [DIAL:0500FFD4]

text_content: {going through withdrawal}{sob of self-pity}You don't know how this feels, Stella! I'm sick! Never been so sick my whole life!
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationB03 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationB03" [DIAL:0500FFD4]

text_content: NVDLC02OpeningConversationB02
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationB02 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationB02" [DIAL:0500FFD5]

text_content: {Ricky is whining}Enough! Another word of your bitching and I'll put you out of your misery myself!
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationB02 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationB02" [DIAL:0500FFD5]

text_content: NVDLC02OpeningConversationA10
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationA10 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationA10" [DIAL:0500FFD9]

text_content: {fed up, under your breath}Goddammit, never should joined this assbackwards caravan...
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationA10 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationA10" [DIAL:0500FFD9]

text_content: NVDLC02OpeningConversationA09
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationA09 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationA09" [DIAL:0500FFDA]

text_content: Dream on, {mocking}Stella. Ricky ain't about to die for nobody. Ricky's fucking in-vin-cible, yessir!{chuckle}
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationA09 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationA09" [DIAL:0500FFDA]

text_content: NVDLC02OpeningConversationA08
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationA08 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationA08" [DIAL:0500FFDB]

text_content: {Ricky just boasted he has plenty of drugs}Sounds like you got enough for a fatal overdose, then. Do us all a favor, will ya?
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationA08 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationA08" [DIAL:0500FFDB]

text_content: NVDLC02OpeningConversationA07
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationA07 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationA07" [DIAL:0500FFDC]

text_content: {Ricky has Fixer to handle his addiction}Best fix for you'd be a bullet in the brainpan. Now shut it.
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationA07 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationA07" [DIAL:0500FFDC]

text_content: NVDLC02OpeningConversationA06
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationA06 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationA06" [DIAL:0500FFDD]

text_content: Don't worry, {mocking}Stella! This was my last hit, but thanks to ol' Johnny-come-lately over there, Ricky got some Fixer to take the edge off.
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationA06 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationA06" [DIAL:0500FFDD]

text_content: Don't worry, {mocking}Stella! This was my last hit, but thanks to ol' Janey-come-lately over there, Ricky got some Fixer to take the edge off.
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationA06 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationA06" [DIAL:0500FFDD]

text_content: Don't worry, {mocking}Stella! Ol' Ricky won't be running out of Psycho any time soon! Ol' Ricky's downright flush! Yes indeed!
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationA06 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationA06" [DIAL:0500FFDD]

text_content: NVDLC02OpeningConversationA03
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationA03 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationA03" [DIAL:0500FFE0]

text_content: {Ricky is yelling}Shut your mouth, you goddamn junkie! Or I'll plant one between your shoulder blades, I swear!
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationA03 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationA03" [DIAL:0500FFE0]

text_content: NVDLC02OpeningConversationC03
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationC03 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationC03" [DIAL:0501007B]

text_content: {to yourself, under your breath}{continuing imaginary conversation with Jed, mocking him}"That's right, little lady. Everything will be just fine with Jed to protect you. Quite the leader is what I am, hell yes."
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationC03 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationC03" [DIAL:0501007B]

text_content: NVDLC02OpeningConversationC02
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationC02 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationC02" [DIAL:0501007C]

text_content: {to yourself, under your breath}{continuing conversation with imaginary Jed}Oh I'm sure you're right, Jed. What's the worst can happen to us out here? Nothing. Perfectly safe, fucking perfectly...
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationC02 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationC02" [DIAL:0501007C]

text_content: NVDLC02OpeningConversationC01
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationC01 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationC01" [DIAL:0501007D]

text_content: {to yourself, under your breath}{mocking Jed}"Heard you the fifteenth time, Stella. What's it matter if we're trapped here? Everything will be just fine."
name: NVDLC02OpeningConversationC01 "NVDLC02OpeningConversationC01" [DIAL:0501007D]

text_content: NVDLC02EndingDaniel
name: NVDLC02EndingDaniel "NVDLC02EndingDaniel" [DIAL:050100FB]

text_content: {Narration - Daniel died}In the shadow of Daniel's death, those Sorrows who survived the assault on Zion Valley mourned his loss, as was their custom.|{Narration}Word of Daniel's passing reached the New Canaanites several weeks later. They prayed that their brother would be well-received by their Lord.
name: NVDLC02EndingDaniel "NVDLC02EndingDaniel" [DIAL:050100FB]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: {Narration - Flight from Zion}After leading the Sorrows from their home in Zion to safety in Grand Staircase, Daniel continued to wonder if he'd made the right choice.|{Narration}He spent his life evangelizing the beliefs of his people to a new generation of young men and women, as his ancestors had for centuries before him.|{Narration}He was happy with his family, but for the rest of his life there were nights when he awoke with sadness to find he had been dreaming of Zion.
name: NVDLC02EndingDaniel "NVDLC02EndingDaniel" [DIAL:050100FB]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: {Narration - Crush the White Legs}For years after the defeat of the White Legs, Daniel did his best to minister to the Sorrows' spiritual needs.|{Narration}Try as he might, he could not hold back the tribe's increasing militancy and reverence of Joshua Graham.|{Narration}Demoralized, he returned to his family and Dead Horse Point. His failures haunted him for the rest of his days.
name: NVDLC02EndingDaniel "NVDLC02EndingDaniel" [DIAL:050100FB]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: NVDLC02EndingJoshuaGraham
name: NVDLC02EndingJoshuaGraham "NVDLC02EndingJoshuaGraham" [DIAL:050100FC]

text_content: {Narration - Joshua died}After a long and troubled life, Joshua Graham finally found rest in Zion.|{Narration}In the end, his unswerving militancy had accomplished what the NCR's finest sharpshooters and Caesar's wrath could not.|{Narration}The New Canaanites took comfort in the belief that their brother's soul would again dwell in Zion at the end of days.
name: NVDLC02EndingJoshuaGraham "NVDLC02EndingJoshuaGraham" [DIAL:050100FC]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: {Narration - Crush the White Legs, SUW spared}The threat of the White Legs ended, Joshua Graham helped the Sorrows and Dead Horses tend to their fallen comrades and secure Zion.|{Narration}The Courier's words had stayed Joshua's wrath in his darkest hour, and in sparing Salt-Upon-Wounds, he was changed.|{Narration}While he continued to advocate militant opposition to the enemies of New Canaan, he sometimes showed quarter to those who crossed his family.|{Narration}Eventually this new spirit would diminish the myth of the Burned Man in distant lands - a small price for the peace it brought to Joshua Graham.
name: NVDLC02EndingJoshuaGraham "NVDLC02EndingJoshuaGraham" [DIAL:050100FC]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: {Narration - Crush the White Legs, SUW executed}With the White Legs crushed, Joshua Graham led the Sorrows and Dead Horses in tearing apart and burning the corpses of their enemies.|{Narration}He set about training his army in the "Way of the Canaanite," and soon the New Canaanites and tribes of Zion were feared well into the Mojave.|{Narration}Legends of the Burned Man grew even more depraved, and terrifying.
name: NVDLC02EndingJoshuaGraham "NVDLC02EndingJoshuaGraham" [DIAL:050100FC]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: {Narration - Crush the White Legs, SUW defeated in combat}Though the Courier had stopped Joshua Graham from executing Salt-Upon-Wounds, the war chief still fell in battle.|{Narration}The White Legs defeated at Three Marys, Joshua led the Sorrows and Dead Horses in tending to their comrades and burning the corpses of their foes.|{Narration}He continued to advocate militant opposition to the enemies of New Canaan and showed little quarter to those he fought. And yet he was changed.|{Narration}He no longer reveled in the brutality and cruelty for which he had been known in his former life.|{Narration}His inner demons, if not extinguished, were at the least... {slight beat}appeased.
name: NVDLC02EndingJoshuaGraham "NVDLC02EndingJoshuaGraham" [DIAL:050100FC]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: NVDLC02EndingWakingCloud
name: NVDLC02EndingWakingCloud "NVDLC02EndingWakingCloud" [DIAL:050100FD]

text_content: {Narration - Daniel hides the truth}Waking Cloud turned bitter and resentful toward Daniel and the New Canaanites when she learned her husband's death had been concealed from her.|{Narration}She poisoned some of her tribe against New Canaanite teachings, making relations between the groups difficult from time to time.
name: NVDLC02EndingWakingCloud "NVDLC02EndingWakingCloud" [DIAL:050100FD]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: {Narration - Daniel tells Waking Cloud}Waking Cloud was distraught when she learned of her husband's death, but took comfort from her tribe, and the compassion of the New Canaanites.|{Narration}She forgave Daniel for having concealed her husband's fate from her, and learned to accept his fate.|{Narration}When her grief faded, she took a husband from the Dead Horse tribe. At her bidding, he stayed close to home.
name: NVDLC02EndingWakingCloud "NVDLC02EndingWakingCloud" [DIAL:050100FD]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: NVDLC02EndingFollowsChalk
name: NVDLC02EndingFollowsChalk "NVDLC02EndingFollowsChalk" [DIAL:050100FE]

text_content: {Narration - Civilization's bad}Follows-Chalk took the Courier's words to heart and decided that the big cities of the Mojave Wasteland and NCR were best left unexplored.|{Narration}Though he sometimes dreamed of distant lands, he continued to support his family at Dead Horse Point, and eventually his wanderlust faded.
name: NVDLC02EndingFollowsChalk "NVDLC02EndingFollowsChalk" [DIAL:050100FE]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: {Narration - Civilization is cool}Follows-Chalk took the Courier's words to heart and decided that he would behold the sights and sounds of distant lands with his own eyes and ears.|{Narration}After returning to Dead Horse Point, he quarreled with his family and other tribe members about his ambitions.|{Narration}One morning, they awoke to discover that Follows-Chalk had set off alone, westward, into the wilderness.|{Narration}He was never seen again.
name: NVDLC02EndingFollowsChalk "NVDLC02EndingFollowsChalk" [DIAL:050100FE]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: NVDLC02EndingHappyTrails
name: NVDLC02EndingHappyTrails "NVDLC02EndingHappyTrails" [DIAL:050100FF]

text_content: {Narration - Daniel killed}Already weakened by several seasons of bad trading, the Happy Trails Caravan Company was devastated by the failure of its expedition.|{Narration}The New Canaanites never reestablished ties with the caravan.|{Narration}Their experiences with outsiders near the Great Salt Lake and in Zion had been far too negative.|{Narration}Within six months, the Happy Trails Caravan Company was bankrupted and dissolved.
name: NVDLC02EndingHappyTrails "NVDLC02EndingHappyTrails" [DIAL:050100FF]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: {Narration - Flight from Zion}Already weakened by several seasons of bad trading, the Happy Trails Caravan Company was initially discouraged by the results of its expedition.|{Narration}The fate of New Canaan, and the evacuation of the Sorrows from Zion, made the prospect of trading seem fruitless.|{Narration}When Daniel told his family about the exploits of Happy Trails' employee, the Courier, however, New Canaan decided to repay the company's kindness.|{Narration}Twice per year, New Canaanites made the dangerous journey west to trade with the company in the city of New Reno.|{Narration}The Happy Trails Caravan Company could not survive on such trading alone, but the New Canaanite's generosity made tough times go easier.
name: NVDLC02EndingHappyTrails "NVDLC02EndingHappyTrails" [DIAL:050100FF]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: {Narration - Crush the White Legs}The defeat of the White Legs in Zion marked a turning point in the fortunes of the Happy Trails Caravan Company.|{Narration}Every two months, the caravan met with the New Canaanites in Zion Valley to trade. Happy Trails soon returned to prosperity.|{Narration}The vigilance of the Sorrows and Dead Horses in defending southwestern Utah, initially startling to Happy Trails caravans, soon proved a blessing.|{Narration}The tribes united against the 80s, driving them back from Highway 50, and thus opening yet another trading route for Happy Trails caravans.
name: NVDLC02EndingHappyTrails "NVDLC02EndingHappyTrails" [DIAL:050100FF]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: NVDLC02EndingDeadHorses
name: NVDLC02EndingDeadHorses "NVDLC02EndingDeadHorses" [DIAL:05010100]

text_content: {Narration - Joshua Dead}Having revered Joshua Graham as a living legend for so many years, the Dead Horses found it difficult to accept his death.|{Narration}New Canaanite missionaries sought to remain in contact with the tribe, but lacking Joshua's authority, their influence dwindled.|{Narration}Still, as an expression of enduring respect for their lost spiritual leader, the Dead Horses helped protect the lands where New Canaanites settled.|{Narration}As generations passed, the Dead Horses came to worship a spirit of the land, a harsh spirit of divine justice. They called it Joshua.
name: NVDLC02EndingDeadHorses "NVDLC02EndingDeadHorses" [DIAL:05010100]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: {Narration - Flight from Zion}Having helped Daniel and the Sorrows escape from Zion, the Dead Horses returned to their home at Dead Horse Point.|{Narration}The tribe continued to learn from the New Canaanites, and over many years built a flourishing community along the banks of the Colorado.|{Narration}Though the tribes' bond would endure, it was Joshua Graham's legend the Dead Horses would revere, not the tenets of New Canaan's faith.
name: NVDLC02EndingDeadHorses "NVDLC02EndingDeadHorses" [DIAL:05010100]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: {Narration - Crush the White Legs}Having helped eradicate the White Legs from Zion, the Dead Horses returned to Dead Horse Point in triumph.|{Narration}They remained neutral toward the Sorrows, but as years went on, there were periods of competitive friction, even violence, between the tribes.|{Narration}The New Canaanites - Daniel especially - intervened regularly as mediators, but found it difficult to reconcile the tribes' conflicts.
name: NVDLC02EndingDeadHorses "NVDLC02EndingDeadHorses" [DIAL:05010100]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: NVDLC02EndingSorrows
name: NVDLC02EndingSorrows "NVDLC02EndingSorrows" [DIAL:05010101]

text_content: {Narration - Flee from Zion, saved lots}Daniel succeeded in leading the Sorrows out of Zion, as he had wanted to do from the start.|{Narration}The Courier protected the Sorrows during the evacuation, ensuring that most reached their destination unharmed.|{Narration}Over the weeks and months to come, Daniel would see to the Sorrows' resettlement in Grand Staircase.|{Narration}Their adjustment to their new home was not without difficulty, but eventually the Sorrows came to accept the loss of Zion.
name: NVDLC02EndingSorrows "NVDLC02EndingSorrows" [DIAL:05010101]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: {Narration - Flee from Zion, many died}Daniel evacuated the Sorrows from Zion, but due to the Courier's neglect, the White Legs butchered many along the way.|{Narration}Those who survived barely reached Grand Staircase, but once there, the Dead Horses and New Canaanites helped them settle.|{Narration}The unfamiliarity of their new surroundings, and the loss of loved ones, evoked a terrible and lasting grief among the Sorrows.|{Narration}For two generations, many would die still lamenting the loss of Zion.
name: NVDLC02EndingSorrows "NVDLC02EndingSorrows" [DIAL:05010101]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: {Narration - Crush the White Legs, SUW spared}The Sorrows fought beside Joshua Graham and the Dead Horses, eradicating the threat the White Legs posed to Zion.|{Narration}Seeing the Courier convince Joshua Graham to spare Salt-Upon-Wounds, the Sorrows learned that retribution could be tempered by mercy.|{Narration}Though he despaired at the Sorrows' loss of innocence, Daniel took some small consolation in the Courier's lesson, and prayed it would take root.
name: NVDLC02EndingSorrows "NVDLC02EndingSorrows" [DIAL:05010101]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: {Narration - Crush the White Legs, SUW executed}The Sorrows fought beside Joshua Graham and the Dead Horses, eradicating the threat the White Legs posed to Zion.|{Narration}Watching as the Courier encouraged Joshua Graham to execute Salt-Upon-Wounds, the Sorrows learned that New Canaan offered no mercy to the wicked.|{Narration}The Sorrows' transformation from a peaceful, timid tribe into a merciless, warlike people broke Daniel's heart.|{Narration}Over time, the Sorrows became ever more ruthless in their dealings - even with each other.|{Narration}Daniel traveled to and fro between the New Canaanites and Zion, continuing to plead for a return to the old ways whenever he visited.|{Narration}Eventually, the Sorrows grew tired of his blather, and turned their backs on him.
name: NVDLC02EndingSorrows "NVDLC02EndingSorrows" [DIAL:05010101]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: {Narration - Crush the White Legs, SUW killed in combat}The Sorrows fought beside Joshua Graham and the Dead Horses, eradicating the threat the White Legs posed to Zion.|{Narration}When the Courier and Joshua Graham felled Salt-Upon-Wounds, their victory was celebrated with a great feast.|{Narration}The Sorrows' transformation from a peaceful, timid tribe into a proud and warlike people broke Daniel's heart.|{Narration}He tried to take solace in the knowledge that they would remain in Zion, but it was a small comfort. The Sorrows' innocence was lost.
name: NVDLC02EndingSorrows "NVDLC02EndingSorrows" [DIAL:05010101]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: NVDLC02EndingWhiteLegs
name: NVDLC02EndingWhiteLegs "NVDLC02EndingWhiteLegs" [DIAL:05010102]

text_content: {Narration - Daniel dead}With Daniel dead, the White Legs soon overran Zion and drove the Sorrows and Dead Horses from the Valley.|{Narration}The White Legs plundered all of the Pre-War buildings the Sorrows had marked off-limits, their squalor an affront to Zion's natural beauty.|{Narration}By year's end, little trace remained that the Sorrows had ever made the valley their home.
name: NVDLC02EndingWhiteLegs "NVDLC02EndingWhiteLegs" [DIAL:05010102]
speaker: NVDLC02SaltUponWounds "Salt-Upon-Wounds" [NPC_:05008A3A]

text_content: {Narration - Flight from Zion}After the White Legs drove the Sorrows from Zion, they celebrated by destroying all traces of the valley's former inhabitants.|{Narration}They appealed to the Legion for assimilation, but were denied.|{Narration}Their failure to eradicate the New Canaanites in Grand Staircase and farther up the Colorado had not gone unnoticed.|{Narration}The White Legs made a half-hearted effort to find the New Canaanites, but were driven off by Dead Horses trained in the ways of Joshua Graham.|{Narration}The White Legs lost all hope of joining the Legion and disintegrated into a number of petty raiding bands, leaving Zion Valley a polluted cistern.
name: NVDLC02EndingWhiteLegs "NVDLC02EndingWhiteLegs" [DIAL:05010102]
speaker: NVDLC02SaltUponWounds "Salt-Upon-Wounds" [NPC_:05008A3A]

text_content: {Narration - Crush the White Legs, SUW spared}Demoralized by the Dead Horse and Sorrows attack the Courier and Joshua Graham led against them, the White Legs retreated to Great Salt Lake.|{Narration}Their days were numbered. Word soon reached the 80s tribe that the White Legs' spirit was broken, their war chief a dim shadow of his former self.|{Narration}By year's end, the 80s would overrun the White Legs' camps, scattering the tribe to the winds and claiming the Great Salt Lake for its own.
name: NVDLC02EndingWhiteLegs "NVDLC02EndingWhiteLegs" [DIAL:05010102]
speaker: NVDLC02SaltUponWounds "Salt-Upon-Wounds" [NPC_:05008A3A]

text_content: {Narration - Crush the White Legs, SUW executed}Joshua Graham's chilling execution of Salt-Upon-Wounds seared into their minds, the surviving White Legs retreated to the Great Salt Lake.|{Narration}Unable to shake the memory of their brutal defeat and the Dead Horses' savagery in battle, the White Legs feared further reprisals.|{Narration}They fled north, out of Utah, into Wyoming. The wilderness was harsh, and the first winter claimed over half the tribe.|{Narration}When spring came, the survivors parted ways in small bands. And so the White Legs died a quiet, {ig-no-MIHN-ee-us}ignominious death.
name: NVDLC02EndingWhiteLegs "NVDLC02EndingWhiteLegs" [DIAL:05010102]
speaker: NVDLC02SaltUponWounds "Salt-Upon-Wounds" [NPC_:05008A3A]

text_content: {Narration - Crush the White Legs, SUW killed in combat}Despite their defeat at Three Marys, and the death of their war chief, the White Legs were determined to pursue the other New Canaanites.|{Narration}But when they finally tracked down their prey in Colorado, they discovered the tables had been turned.|{Narration}The White Legs who survived the New Canaanites' ambushes were hunted down by Dead Horses before they could reach the safety of the Great Salt Lake.|{Narration}When word of the White Legs' diminished numbers reached the 80s tribe, war was declared, and by year's end, the White Legs had been wiped out.
name: NVDLC02EndingWhiteLegs "NVDLC02EndingWhiteLegs" [DIAL:05010102]
speaker: NVDLC02SaltUponWounds "Salt-Upon-Wounds" [NPC_:05008A3A]

text_content: NVDLC02EndingFinale
name: NVDLC02EndingFinale "NVDLC02EndingFinale" [DIAL:05010103]

text_content: {Narration - Finale}And with that, the Courier walked out of the history of the tribes of Zion and back to the gathering storm of the Mojave Wasteland.
name: NVDLC02EndingFinale "NVDLC02EndingFinale" [DIAL:05010103]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: NVDLC02EndingStart
name: NVDLC02EndingStart "NVDLC02EndingStart" [DIAL:05010104]

text_content: {Narration - Intro}And so it was that the conflict between the New {KAY-neh-nites}Canaanites and the White Legs was finally resolved.|{Narration}The Courier's involvement had tipped the scale, shifting the fragile balance of power.
name: NVDLC02EndingStart "NVDLC02EndingStart" [DIAL:05010104]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: Never mind. Keep living the dream.
name: NVDLC02DialogueRickyNVDLC02RickyTopic026 "Never mind. Keep living the dream." [DIAL:050101BA]

text_content: That's right. Stick your nose where it don't belong and it's gonna get stung.
name: NVDLC02DialogueRickyNVDLC02RickyTopic026 "Never mind. Keep living the dream." [DIAL:050101BA]
speaker: NVDLC02Ricky "Ricky" [NPC_:0500F19D]

text_content: I had to kill the Bighorners, but I saved the little one.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic051 "I had to kill the Bighorners, but I saved the little one." [DIAL:050101BC]

text_content: That's... not really what I was hoping for, but... I guess I can give the little guy a home. What the hell.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic051 "I had to kill the Bighorners, but I saved the little one." [DIAL:050101BC]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Come on. I got you everything you needed. Just give me the damned map.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic024 "Come on. I got you everything you needed. Just give me the damned map." [DIAL:05010289]

text_content: Okay. You better listen close because I'm not going to repeat myself. You were not invited here. This is not your home.|We have what you might call a {emph}compulsion to help you on account of our beliefs, but if you continue to {emph}spit in our eye with insults and profanity...|You'll find out what happens when our patience wears out. People died at New Canaan because we bickered and debated about what to do.|That was a mistake. Complaining to me now, also a mistake. I'm not going to add sin upon sin by listening to your grumbling.|You want the map? Get out in that valley. Help us. One of the Sorrows, Waking Cloud, will go with you. She knows how to get around the valley unseen.|She's also a midwife and has three kids of her own, so she'll be more tolerant of your whining.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic024 "Come on. I got you everything you needed. Just give me the damned map." [DIAL:05010289]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: If it will get me out of here, sure.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic023 "If it will get me out of here, sure." [DIAL:0501028A]

text_content: Listen, I understand that you want to go home. But we didn't ask you to come to Zion. As far as I'm concerned, you're an uninvited guest.|In better times, I'd drop everything to help you out, but I have to ensure the safety of the Sorrows first.|And don't think you're alone in this. One of the Sorrows, Waking Cloud, has volunteered to help you in the valley.|She's an experienced hunter and has a special gift for staying out of sight when she needs to. Should make things easier for you.|After that, all that's left is to evacuate the Sorrows safe and sound. I'll give you a map and supplies, everything you need to get back home.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic023 "If it will get me out of here, sure." [DIAL:0501028A]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Anything to help. I'll do what I can.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic022 "Anything to help. I'll do what I can." [DIAL:0501028B]

text_content: I appreciate the enthusiasm. There aren't a lot of people in the wasteland with kindness to spare for anyone who isn't kin.|Since you've been poking around the valley, you might see more activity from the White Legs.|One of the Sorrows hunters, Waking Cloud, has volunteered to help guide you through the valley. She has a special talent for staying out of sight.|After this, it's just a matter of getting everyone out of here safe and sound. And hopefully you can head back to the Mojave without any more trouble.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic022 "Anything to help. I'll do what I can." [DIAL:0501028B]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Who are you to be asking me questions?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic021 "Who are you to be asking me questions?" [DIAL:0501028C]

text_content: {angry}I'm someone who's responsible for protecting a lot of innocent people from raiders and {emph}mercenaries who might try to take advantage of them.|I think you need a little perspective on what the heck is going on in Zion. There's a Dead Horse warrior camp at Eastern Virgin. Get there.|My friend Joshua Graham can fill you in on some of the trouble we've been having with White Legs in these parts. Listen to what he says.|Now if you'll excuse me, I've had enough of your sass for one day.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic021 "Who are you to be asking me questions?" [DIAL:0501028C]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Oh, heh. I just walked here. No big deal.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic020 "Oh, heh. I just walked here. No big deal." [DIAL:0501028D]

text_content: {annoyed}Okay. Can you do me a favor and "just walk" down to Eastern Virgin?|There's a group of Dead Horse warriors there with my colleague, Joshua Graham. I'd like you to talk to him about the route you took to enter Zion.|We've had a lot of problems with White Legs in the area and I'd feel more comfortable if you spoke with him about the situation here. Thanks.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic020 "Oh, heh. I just walked here. No big deal." [DIAL:0501028D]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: I came in with the Happy Trails Caravan. We were attacked by tribals. I'm the only survivor.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic019 "I came in with the Happy Trails Caravan. We were attacked by tribals. I'm the only survivor." [DIAL:0501028E]

text_content: That's... {sighs}I'm so sorry. That's terrible. We've been having a lot of problems with the White Legs here in Zion lately.|In fact, that's why I'm here. I'm Daniel, a New Canaanite missionary to this tribe, the Sorrows.|It's important that you speak to my colleague, Joshua Graham, at the Dead Horses camp at Eastern Virgin. We can speak again later.|Again, I'm very sorry for the deaths of your friends.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic019 "I came in with the Happy Trails Caravan. We were attacked by tribals. I'm the only survivor." [DIAL:0501028E]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Joshua's a New Canaanite and he's obviously willing to attack the White Legs.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic033 "Joshua's a New Canaanite and he's obviously willing to attack the White Legs." [DIAL:05010491]

text_content: Joshua is a living bible of all mankind's miseries of war! The debt he has levied through his actions, he repays {emph}every {emph}day!|He is a monument both to God's unending forgiveness and to humanity's unfathomable capacity for cruelty. It's written on every inch of his body!|When you look at him, do you only see a man of God? Beneath those bandages, he is {emph}burned {emph}flesh. As he burns, so does he consume everyone around him.|Joshua wants to fight because the White Legs have stoked the naked flame inside of him. You, {emph}you see the light, but do not yet feel the heat.|I can pray that you never will, but it isn't up to me and it isn't up to God. It's up to Joshua.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic033 "Joshua's a New Canaanite and he's obviously willing to attack the White Legs." [DIAL:05010491]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: If you're willing to defend the Sorrows, why not pursue the White Legs?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic032 "If you're willing to defend the Sorrows, why not pursue the White Legs?" [DIAL:05010492]

text_content: There is an important difference between killing in defense and waging war. Even a Gentile like you should know that.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic032 "If you're willing to defend the Sorrows, why not pursue the White Legs?" [DIAL:05010492]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: You're right to leave, but I don't think you should kill any of the White Legs.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic031 "You're right to leave, but I don't think you should kill any of the White Legs." [DIAL:05010493]

text_content: You're free to hold that opinion, but you're not responsible for these people. If I have to kill to prevent their blood from being spilled, so be it.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic031 "You're right to leave, but I don't think you should kill any of the White Legs." [DIAL:05010493]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: That's an awful lot of responsibility to take on.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic030 "That's an awful lot of responsibility to take on." [DIAL:05010494]

text_content: The New Canaanites interfered in their lives. {emph}We did that. And we've done it before, with others. Always with good intentions, but things go wrong.|When that happens, we can't just abandon them, let them die at the hands of New Canaan's enemies.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic030 "That's an awful lot of responsibility to take on." [DIAL:05010494]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Why are you so eager to evacuate Zion? You don't seem to be a pacifist.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic029 "Why are you so eager to evacuate Zion? You don't seem to be a pacifist." [DIAL:05010495]

text_content: There's an old saying that goes, "If you want peace, get ready for war."|You've got me figured half-right. I'll shoot dead any White Leg that tries to creep into this camp, but it's only to protect the Sorrows.|The Lord helps those who help themselves, but the Sorrows don't know how. Joshua and I do. Since I got them into this mess, I need to get them out.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic029 "Why are you so eager to evacuate Zion? You don't seem to be a pacifist." [DIAL:05010495]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: I'll be taking the map now.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic028 "I'll be taking the map now." [DIAL:05010496]

text_content: You just don't learn, do you?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic028 "I'll be taking the map now." [DIAL:05010496]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Fine.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic027 "Fine." [DIAL:05010497]

text_content: Fantastic.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic027 "Fine." [DIAL:05010497]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Sorry, I uh... didn't mean to insult you or whatever.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic026 "Sorry, I uh... didn't mean to insult you or whatever." [DIAL:05010498]

text_content: [FAILED] Corrected action is the most sincere form of apology.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic026 "Sorry, I uh... didn't mean to insult you or whatever." [DIAL:05010498]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: I apologize, Daniel. I think stress got the best of me.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic025 "I apologize, Daniel. I think stress got the best of me." [DIAL:05010499]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] {sigh}I understand. But I hope {emph}you can understand why it's so important for us to leave here as soon as we can.|I... {emph}we couldn't save New Canaan. This is a chance to make up for that, to start again. We can't fail.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic025 "I apologize, Daniel. I think stress got the best of me." [DIAL:05010499]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: I understand.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic070 "I understand." [DIAL:050106B7]

text_content: Thank you. If I can help you in some other way, don't hesitate to ask.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic070 "I understand." [DIAL:050106B7]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Yeah, but I'm helping you so... come on.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic069 "Yeah, but I'm helping you so... come on." [DIAL:050106B8]

text_content: [FAILED] If you need healing, just ask me. I can help you with addiction, radiation poisoning, even broken bones. But I can't give you supplies.

text_content: Most of the Sorrows and Dead Horses are protected. I'm out there getting shot up by White Legs.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic068 "Most of the Sorrows and Dead Horses are protected. I'm out there getting shot up by White Legs." [DIAL:050106B9]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Fair enough. Just be careful and hopefully you won't need these.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic068 "Most of the Sorrows and Dead Horses are protected. I'm out there getting shot up by White Legs." [DIAL:050106B9]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: But I have... caps. Many of them. Let me show you all of my fine caps.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic067 "But I have... caps. Many of them. Let me show you all of my fine caps." [DIAL:050106BA]

text_content: [FAILED] {laughing softly while speaking}I'm sure your caps are fine, but I have to hold on to the supplies I have here. Sorry.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic067 "But I have... caps. Many of them. Let me show you all of my fine caps." [DIAL:050106BA]

text_content: I'm trading Pre-War goods and supplies from the Mojave Wasteland. You need those too, don't you?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic066 "I'm trading Pre-War goods and supplies from the Mojave Wasteland. You need those too, don't you?" [DIAL:050106BB]

name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic051 "Radiation sickness." [DIAL:050106C8]

speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: It looks like you have a few nasty injuries, but nothing I haven't seen before. Want me to fix you up?

speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic046 "That's too bad, because I'm going to tell her." [DIAL:050106CD]
