text_content: Aren't you the guy in charge around here?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic045 "Aren't you the guy in charge around here?" [DIAL:050106CE]

text_content: That's not an easy thing to be. I don't like doing this, but I can't see any good coming from telling Waking Cloud her husband died.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic045 "Aren't you the guy in charge around here?" [DIAL:050106CE]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: You're the New Canaanite who's supposed help lead these people, not hide things from them.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic044 "You're the New Canaanite who's supposed help lead these people, not hide things from them." [DIAL:050106CF]

text_content: {sigh}I know. You're right. I shouldn't have hidden it from her in the first place. I just... we can't fail here again.|Zion can't become the next New Canaan. The Sorrows don't deserve that. They don't deserve any of this.|Sometimes I look at them and wonder if they would have been better off if those old trails had stayed forgotten.|If we had never found any of them. {long sigh}Tell Waking Cloud if you think that's best. I won't stop you.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic044 "You're the New Canaanite who's supposed help lead these people, not hide things from them." [DIAL:050106CF]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Settle down. I'm not telling her squat.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic043 "Settle down. I'm not telling her squat." [DIAL:050106D0]

text_content: Good. I'll tell her after we've helped the rest of the Sorrows reach safety.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic043 "Settle down. I'm not telling her squat." [DIAL:050106D0]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: I don't think you should hide this from her, but I see your point. I won't say anything.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic042 "I don't think you should hide this from her, but I see your point. I won't say anything." [DIAL:050106D1]

text_content: And I don't like hiding it from her, but I'm between a rock and a hard place here.|Her people... honestly, we {emph}all need her help. As much as it pains me to say it, there will be time to mourn later.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic042 "I don't think you should hide this from her, but I see your point. I won't say anything." [DIAL:050106D1]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: It's her husband! Don't you think she has a right to know?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic041 "It's her husband! Don't you think she has a right to know?" [DIAL:050106D2]

text_content: To every thing, there is a season. Who are you or I to put this heavy burden on her now?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic041 "It's her husband! Don't you think she has a right to know?" [DIAL:050106D2]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: O... kay, let's talk about something else then.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic040 "O... kay, let's talk about something else then." [DIAL:050106D3]

text_content: {sighing, relieved}Good. Fine, whatever you'd like to know.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic040 "O... kay, let's talk about something else then." [DIAL:050106D3]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: What's the matter? Did something happen?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic039 "What's the matter? Did something happen?" [DIAL:050106D4]

text_content: Her three children are safe. They made it north weeks ago and met up with New Canaanites heading east.|Her husband didn't make it. He died protecting their children from a White Leg attack.|Do {emph}not tell Waking Cloud. She is one of the only Sorrows who can communicate easily with us and her tribe needs her to be strong right now.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic039 "What's the matter? Did something happen?" [DIAL:050106D4]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Did you help the rest of her family leave Zion?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic038 "Did you help the rest of her family leave Zion?" [DIAL:050106D5]

text_content: {sighing, a bit apprehensive}I did.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic038 "Did you help the rest of her family leave Zion?" [DIAL:050106D5]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: She said one of her births was difficult and you helped her through it.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic037 "She said one of her births was difficult and you helped her through it." [DIAL:050106D6]

text_content: {a bit relieved}Oh, well that's true. Waking Cloud is a talented midwife. She's certainly brought more children into the world than I have.|But there are some problems she's never dealt with. One of them came up when she was having her third child and...|I really didn't do much. I'm surprised she mentioned it.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic037 "She said one of her births was difficult and you helped her through it." [DIAL:050106D6]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: The use of violence only leads to more violence.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic036 "The use of violence only leads to more violence." [DIAL:050106D7]

text_content: Try walking alongside a tribal child, a refugee, and holding her hand for three days because her parents were killed by NCR prospectors.|After the prospectors have stalked the remainder of the tribe, they fire off a few shots to scare them, and the tribe bunches together for safety.|A grenade comes rolling in and kills another six people. The only reason you survive is because someone else's body absorbed the shrapnel.|You're left sprawled out on the ground with ringing in your ears and a little girl's hand in your hand because that's all that's left of her.|After you've done that, if you can look me in the eye and tell me it's better to stand aside, maybe then I'll listen to you.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic036 "The use of violence only leads to more violence." [DIAL:050106D7]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: That makes sense. Let's talk about something else.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic035 "That makes sense. Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:050106D8]

text_content: What would you like to know?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic035 "That makes sense. Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:050106D8]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Joshua's come up with a reasonable alternative. Why not help them fight?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic034 "Joshua's come up with a reasonable alternative. Why not help them fight?" [DIAL:050106D9]

text_content: Joshua doesn't just want to fight the White Legs. He wants to annihilate them. The stakes are too high for their tribe.|Hurting them won't dissuade them. If they can't join Caesar's Legion, they'll die out in a generation. They've never learned how to survive.|Food preservation, tanning, even basic hunting and cooking seem beyond them. They only survive by scavenging and raiding, but that can't last.|They'll only stop if Joshua and the Dead Horses can kill their war chief and their entire war band. That's exactly what he intends to do.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic034 "Joshua's come up with a reasonable alternative. Why not help them fight?" [DIAL:050106D9]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: This is the way the world is. They're part of it, whether you like it or not.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic089 "This is the way the world is. They're part of it, whether you like it or not." [DIAL:050106FF]

text_content: No. This is how we made the world. And we brought it to them.|Joshua must be waiting for you. I'll stay here with the others.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic089 "This is the way the world is. They're part of it, whether you like it or not." [DIAL:050106FF]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: And you have the right to pull them off of their land?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic088 "And you have the right to pull them off of their land?" [DIAL:05010700]

text_content: I've already explained to them that we're leaving! They've accepted it! What is Joshua going to tell them about being a warrior?|What are you going to tell them about how to live with themselves after they got lost in the moment, killed someone who didn't {emph}deserve to die?|Or does that not matter? Is that just an acceptable consquence if it means holding on to this valley?|Maybe there is no place left in this world for mercy. But even if it tramples me into the dust, I will never accept it. And I will never condone it.|Joshua must be waiting for you. I'll stay here with the others as I told them I would.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic088 "And you have the right to pull them off of their land?" [DIAL:05010700]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Let's talk about something else.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic087 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:05010701]

text_content: Of course.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic087 "Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:05010701]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Why won't you tell me about what happened at New Canaan?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic086 "Why won't you tell me about what happened at New Canaan?" [DIAL:05010702]

text_content: It's not a subject I'm fond of discussing. It's over and done with, anyway. Why are you so interested?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic086 "Why won't you tell me about what happened at New Canaan?" [DIAL:05010702]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: I'd like to talk to you about Mordecai.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic085 "I'd like to talk to you about Mordecai." [DIAL:05010703]

text_content: {emph}I'd like you to drop it. It's a private matter.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic085 "I'd like to talk to you about Mordecai." [DIAL:05010703]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: I understand. Let's talk about something else.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic084 "I understand. Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:05010704]

text_content: Thanks. What would you like to know?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic084 "I understand. Let's talk about something else." [DIAL:05010704]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: I'm just curious, that's all.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic083 "I'm just curious, that's all." [DIAL:05010705]

text_content: [FAILED] It's understandable, but this is something for me to work out with the Lord. And I hope you can understand that.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic083 "I'm just curious, that's all." [DIAL:05010705]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: You're the man in charge. If something's troubling you, it could affect all of us.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic082 "You're the man in charge. If something's troubling you, it could affect all of us." [DIAL:05010706]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] I never thought I'd be in charge of anything. Don't know why. Bishop Mordecai was old. He had been sick for years.|He couldn't walk anymore. It wasn't a problem for the rest of us. {laughing a bit}He made it out to be more trouble than it really was. Just his way, I guess.|When the White Legs came... {sigh}he was upstairs. We couldn't get him out in time. The house caught fire at the base and worked its way up. Fast.|He didn't die of smoke. I wish he had. Sometimes I wake up and for a minute or two, I think all of it was a dream. But it's not. It wasn't.|I wish all of this were some fevered vision of what could have been. Instead of what is, what we let happen.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic082 "You're the man in charge. If something's troubling you, it could affect all of us." [DIAL:05010706]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Why don't you teach them something useful instead of filling their heads with nonsense?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic081 "Why don't you teach them something useful instead of filling their heads with nonsense?" [DIAL:05010707]

text_content: We teach them practical skills for this life and we prepare them for what's to come.|The Sorrows could master all the wonders of the Old World. conquer the Great Basin north to south. But without God's love, they would have nothing.|It is shelter in the storm, food in times of hunger, warmth and light in the cold and darkness. What can compare to that in value and versatility?|You don't agree. That's your choice. It can be their choice, too. No one is forced to follow the narrow path.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic081 "Why don't you teach them something useful instead of filling their heads with nonsense?" [DIAL:05010707]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Sounds kind of far-fetched, even for the wasteland.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic080 "Sounds kind of far-fetched, even for the wasteland." [DIAL:05010708]

text_content: Good news is an amazing thing in this world we've {emph}unmade. We're so used to going to sleep with nightmares that we can't imagine waking up to a dream.|But that's what we believe, every word of it. It's the cornerstone of our faith and how we choose to live.|With every step {emph}you take, you put one foot in front of the other and {emph}know that you'll be pulled back down to this Earth.|{emph}We know that God is watching over us, waiting for us to come back home. To us, there's no difference. Walking and living. It's all belief, all faith.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic080 "Sounds kind of far-fetched, even for the wasteland." [DIAL:05010708]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Interesting.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic079 "Interesting." [DIAL:05010709]

text_content: Heh. That's actually a better response than I usually get from wastelanders. No offense.|Tell you what. There's a lot going on right now but why don't you take this. Read it. Maybe you'll hate it. Maybe you'll be bored.|But if you have questions, assuming we get through all this, let me know. It used to be my job to answer those questions. Maybe it will be again.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic079 "Interesting." [DIAL:05010709]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: That's it?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic078 "That's it?" [DIAL:0501070A]

text_content: [FAILED] As far as you're concerned, it is. This really isn't the time to talk about it, all things considered.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic078 "That's it?" [DIAL:0501070A]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: If you don't acknowledge your past now, it'll come back to you later.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic077 "If you don't acknowledge your past now, it'll come back to you later." [DIAL:0501070B]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] True enough. We can't escape it no matter how hard we try. Best we can do is own up, trust in the Lord to forgive.|Joshua was gone, so were a lot of the other New Canaanites. White Legs must have been watching for a long while, counting who remained.|We didn't think the White Legs were a real threat. Maybe it was overconfidence. Maybe sloth. Either way, we didn't see them coming.|They attacked at night. They killed without regard to age or infirmity. Armed or unarmed. They beat children to-{cut off, overcome with emotion momentarily}|{pause}Beat them to death in their beds while they were sleeping. {pause}And now we're all that's left. Maybe thirty of us. {"lesson learned"}Pride goeth before destruction.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic077 "If you don't acknowledge your past now, it'll come back to you later." [DIAL:0501070B]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Were you close to Mordecai?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic076 "Were you close to Mordecai?" [DIAL:0501070C]

text_content: Look, I've got a lot to do here. My personal relationship... it's not important right now. Can't see how it concerns you, anyway.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic076 "Were you close to Mordecai?" [DIAL:0501070C]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: What happened at New Canaan?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic075 "What happened at New Canaan?" [DIAL:0501070D]

text_content: {uncomfortable talking about it}We lost it. Our community, everything. But the past is gone. We have to look forward.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic075 "What happened at New Canaan?" [DIAL:0501070D]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: The White Legs are here already, so what's your plan?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic074 "The White Legs are here already, so what's your plan?" [DIAL:0501070E]

text_content: To remove the Sorrows from harm's way. I have to give credit to the White Legs for finding their way here, though I imagine many died in the process.|But they can't follow us east, not into the Grand Staircase. They don't know how to live off of the land. We head there, we can find some safety.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic074 "The White Legs are here already, so what's your plan?" [DIAL:0501070E]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Has this happened before, the White Legs attacking other tribes?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic073 "Has this happened before, the White Legs attacking other tribes?" [DIAL:0501070F]

text_content: Yes. But not just White Legs. Raiders too. Prospectors. Slavers. Anyone who thinks they can exploit the ignorant and the innocent.|We lost the Tar Walkers. And the Crazy Horns. We did our best, but we made mistakes. We paid for them, but they paid more.|I'd like to get out from under that debt someday. Until then, it's enough to stop ourselves from getting deeper in the hole.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic073 "Has this happened before, the White Legs attacking other tribes?" [DIAL:0501070F]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: What does a bishop do? Is that your boss?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic072 "What does a bishop do? Is that your boss?" [DIAL:05010710]

text_content: Yeah, Bishop Mordecai is...|{sad, remembering that he died}Sorry. Mordecai was my bishop. He was killed by White Legs during the attack on New Canaan. He was responsible for our congregation there.|I don't know who my next bishop will be. {resolved}But that's a problem for tomorrow. There are plenty of troubles here for us today.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic072 "What does a bishop do? Is that your boss?" [DIAL:05010710]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Salvation? From what, the wasteland?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic071 "Salvation? From what, the wasteland?" [DIAL:05010711]

text_content: A spiritual wasteland, yes. We believe that before this life, our souls existed elsewhere. And after we die, our souls will leave this world.|During our time here, we have the burden of choice. The choices we make determine where we go in the spirit world, and how we will face judgment.|New Canaanites believe, as many once did, that God was made flesh here on Earth as a man named Jesus Christ. He sacrificed his life to save us.|Every sin, every terrible thing that you, me, or any one of us have done for all time, was washed away by his blood. We just have to accept his love.|That's why we visit the tribes, to spread the good news. For all we know, we New Canaanites may be all that remains of Christ's followers.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic071 "Salvation? From what, the wasteland?" [DIAL:05010711]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: You said you "used to" help the Sorrows with problems. What do you do now?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic065 "You said you ""used to"" help the Sorrows with problems. What do you do now?" [DIAL:05010712]

text_content: I'm trying to make amends for allowing our problem to become their problem. The New Canaanites, I mean.|The White Legs have always fought with us, and with Joshua returning, Caesar has motivated the White Legs to stamp out the New Canaanites entirely.|That means the tribes we work with, too. It's already hap-{stopping himself} I just want to prevent something terrible from happening to the Sorrows.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic065 "You said you ""used to"" help the Sorrows with problems. What do you do now?" [DIAL:05010712]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: What do you do here?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic055 "What do you do here?" [DIAL:05010713]

text_content: I used to help the Sorrows with various medical problems and general issues they were having, but my bishop sent me here as a missionary.|We New Canaanites believe that there is a path to salvation for everyone and it's important that we set people on that path if they are willing.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic055 "What do you do here?" [DIAL:05010713]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: I had some other questions for you.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic092 "I had some other questions for you." [DIAL:0501072C]

text_content: What's on your mind?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic092 "I had some other questions for you." [DIAL:0501072C]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Uh... you might want to have a chat with them. They think your "Lord" and the "Father" are the same.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic091 "Uh... you might want to have a chat with them. They think your ""Lord"" and the ""Father"" are the same." [DIAL:0501072D]

text_content: Oh. {realizing}Ah. {sighs}Of course. How stupid of me. They probably also think Mary is the mother and Jesus is the child.|No wonder they picked up on things so easily. I guess it just goes to show how difficult it is to communicate sometimes.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic091 "Uh... you might want to have a chat with them. They think your ""Lord"" and the ""Father"" are the same." [DIAL:0501072D]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: What do you know about the Father in the Caves?
name: NVDLC02DanielFather "What do you know about the Father in the Caves?" [DIAL:0501072E]

text_content: Father in the? Oh, right. He's some spirit the Sorrows used to believe in, watched over them from the caves in the valley.|They marked some of the caves around here because they think they'll be punished for going inside.|I think as more of them learn the teachings of the New Canaanites, they'll lose their old superstitions.
name: NVDLC02DanielFather "What do you know about the Father in the Caves?" [DIAL:0501072E]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: What did you say about a courier? Who were you expecting?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic074 "What did you say about a courier? Who were you expecting?" [DIAL:05010732]

text_content: Caesar would never admit this openly, but he knows that I'm alive. I've killed enough of his frumentarii and assassins that have come looking.|I've heard one of them travels the Mojave as a courier. Most of Caesar's agents meet a fitting end in NCR territory, but maybe this one survived.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic074 "What did you say about a courier? Who were you expecting?" [DIAL:05010732]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Fine by me. I prefer the wilderness.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic073 "Fine by me. I prefer the wilderness." [DIAL:05010733]

text_content: Then let him know. Follows-Chalk needs more guidance in his life. I'd prefer it not come from me.|If people want to look to me for how to fight, I will show them how. I believe God put me on this Earth for that very reason.|But to live like me, think like me... no. There are better people for them to look to for such things.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic073 "Fine by me. I prefer the wilderness." [DIAL:05010733]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Hmm. Okay.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic072 "Hmm. Okay." [DIAL:05010734]

text_content: Whatever you tell him, I'm sure it will be fine.|It's still his choice to make. I just want him to make it without looking to me for approval. He's a man. He can make his own decisions.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic072 "Hmm. Okay." [DIAL:05010734]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: You know that means I'm going to encourage him to leave, right?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic067 "You know that means I'm going to encourage him to leave, right?" [DIAL:05010735]

text_content: Follows-Chalk needs more guidance in his life. Just not from me.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic067 "You know that means I'm going to encourage him to leave, right?" [DIAL:05010735]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Who are you to decide this?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic060 "Who are you to decide this?" [DIAL:05010736]

text_content: [FAILED] I am the right hand of the Lord and the instrument of his vengeance!
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic060 "Who are you to decide this?" [DIAL:05010736]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: If what you believe is true, he'll pay for it later. The Sorrows don't need to see you do this.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic058 "If what you believe is true, he'll pay for it later. The Sorrows don't need to see you do this." [DIAL:05010737]

text_content: {initial anger}I want to take from them what they took from me, from my family. {becoming sad}In this life. I want them to suffer. I want all of them to die in fear and pain.|I want to have my revenge. Against him. Against Caesar. I want to call it my own, to make my anger God's anger. To justify the things I've done.|Sometimes I tell myself that these wild fires never stop burning. But I'm the one who starts them. Not God. Not them.|I can always see it in my mind. The warmth and the heat. It will always be a part of me. {pause}But not today.|[SUCCEEDED] Go. Get out of here. Go back. Back to the Great Salt Lake.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic058 "If what you believe is true, he'll pay for it later. The Sorrows don't need to see you do this." [DIAL:05010737]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Wait, Joshua! Don't!
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic003 "Wait, Joshua! Don't!" [DIAL:05010738]

text_content: [FAILED] No! He and his tribe have worked hard for their wages. Who am I to deny them?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic003 "Wait, Joshua! Don't!" [DIAL:05010738]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: NVDLC02JoshuaMQ4SUWFinished
name: NVDLC02JoshuaMQ4SUWDefeated "NVDLC02JoshuaMQ4SUWFinished" [DIAL:05010741]

text_content: There. That's it. It's finished. When they hear what happened here, the White Legs will crawl back to their Great Salt Lake.|If Caesar doesn't kill them, they'll wither and die like the cursed mongrels they are.|Come. Let's find Daniel. Tomorrow will be here soon. And there is still much work to be done.
name: NVDLC02JoshuaMQ4SUWDefeated "NVDLC02JoshuaMQ4SUWFinished" [DIAL:05010741]

text_content: {quietly}That's it. It's finished. Thank you for... staying with me. I couldn't have done this on my own.|Let's go find Daniel. Tomorrow will be here soon. {beat}And there is much to do.
name: NVDLC02JoshuaMQ4SUWDefeated "NVDLC02JoshuaMQ4SUWFinished" [DIAL:05010741]

text_content: It's the same end he would have met if he had died on his knees. But I suppose this was for the sake of the Dead Horses and Sorrows.|Still, thanks to your help and the grace of God, the White Legs won't be troubling Zion anymore.|Let's go find Daniel. Tomorrow will be here soon enough. And there is much to do.
name: NVDLC02JoshuaMQ4SUWDefeated "NVDLC02JoshuaMQ4SUWFinished" [DIAL:05010741]

text_content: You don't think Lanius can lead the Legion?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic078 "You don't think Lanius can lead the Legion?" [DIAL:0501074B]

text_content: I think only Caesar can lead the Legion. I've never met anyone who could take his place. I couldn't. I never had a mind for logistics.|I don't know Lanius, but from what I've heard, he has no interest in leading anyone unless it's in battle.|No. The Legion dies with Caesar. What follows now are just the last steps of a man who does not yet realize that he's walking dead.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic078 "You don't think Lanius can lead the Legion?" [DIAL:0501074B]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: We'll see.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic077 "We'll see." [DIAL:0501074C]

text_content: The Lord shall reveal all things in good time.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic077 "We'll see." [DIAL:0501074C]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: They won't. I'll make sure the Legion has very little to go home with.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic076 "They won't. I'll make sure the Legion has very little to go home with." [DIAL:0501074D]

text_content: Hmm. Good. You're doing God's work, whether you believe it or not.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic076 "They won't. I'll make sure the Legion has very little to go home with." [DIAL:0501074D]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Caesar is dead. I saw to it personally. I thought you should know.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic075 "Caesar is dead. I saw to it personally. I thought you should know." [DIAL:0501074E]

text_content: {pause}I have to admit, it's hard to believe. That even after all he did to me, all he {emph}tried to do to find and erase me from this world, he went first.|No doubt this will be good for the Mojave. I can only hope Arizona and the tribes don't suffer as the Legion falls apart around them.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic075 "Caesar is dead. I saw to it personally. I thought you should know." [DIAL:0501074E]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: I've met Caesar, you know. What do you think he would say if I told him you were here?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic000 "I've met Caesar, you know. What do you think he would say if I told him you were here?" [DIAL:0501074F]

text_content: I think that would put him - and you - in a difficult position. Caesar has agents looking for me, but he won't admit I'm alive.|And even if you killed me, he can't acknowledge that. To do so would be to admit I had never died. That Caesar made a mistake.|No. He lives by his lies and shall die by his lies. There is no escaping it.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic000 "I've met Caesar, you know. What do you think he would say if I told him you were here?" [DIAL:0501074F]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: I've got your number, that's all. Just wanted you to know.
name: NVDLC02DialogueRickyNVDLC02RickyTopic045 "I've got your number, that's all. Just wanted you to know." [DIAL:05010941]

text_content: {unnerved, keeping voice down}Fine, just keep it to yourself, all right? Don't be such a fucking jerk about it.
name: NVDLC02DialogueRickyNVDLC02RickyTopic045 "I've got your number, that's all. Just wanted you to know." [DIAL:05010941]
speaker: NVDLC02Ricky "Ricky" [NPC_:0500F19D]

text_content: Just wait here a few minutes. Don't do anything crazy.
name: NVDLC02MQ05bNVDLC02MQ05bDancingFlameTopic004 "Just wait here a few minutes. Don't do anything crazy." [DIAL:05010B05]

text_content: We wait, but not forever!
name: NVDLC02MQ05bNVDLC02MQ05bDancingFlameTopic004 "Just wait here a few minutes. Don't do anything crazy." [DIAL:05010B05]
speaker: NVDLC02MQ05bDancingFlame "Dancing Flame" [NPC_:0500B4D0]

text_content: Sure, whatever. We go smash White Legs.
name: NVDLC02MQ05bNVDLC02MQ05bDancingFlameTopic003 "Sure, whatever. We go smash White Legs." [DIAL:05010B06]

text_content: We go!
name: NVDLC02MQ05bNVDLC02MQ05bDancingFlameTopic003 "Sure, whatever. We go smash White Legs." [DIAL:05010B06]
speaker: NVDLC02MQ05bDancingFlame "Dancing Flame" [NPC_:0500B4D0]

text_content: Fine, but at least let me handle it alone. You're no match for hardened White Leg warriors.
name: NVDLC02MQ05bNVDLC02MQ05bDancingFlameTopic002 "Fine, but at least let me handle it alone. You're no match for hardened White Leg warriors." [DIAL:05010B07]

text_content: Just get out of here, you're no match for hardened White Leg warriors.
name: NVDLC02MQ05bNVDLC02MQ05bDancingFlameTopic001 "Just get out of here, you're no match for hardened White Leg warriors." [DIAL:05010B08]

text_content: [SUCCEEDED] Because you are friend to Sorrows... very well. We go. Angry ghosts will do for White Legs.
name: NVDLC02MQ05bNVDLC02MQ05bDancingFlameTopic001 "Just get out of here, you're no match for hardened White Leg warriors." [DIAL:05010B08]
speaker: NVDLC02MQ05bDancingFlame "Dancing Flame" [NPC_:0500B4D0]

text_content: [FAILED] No! We not let White Legs defile our ancestors! We go! We fight!
name: NVDLC02MQ05bNVDLC02MQ05bDancingFlameTopic001 "Just get out of here, you're no match for hardened White Leg warriors." [DIAL:05010B08]
speaker: NVDLC02MQ05bDancingFlame "Dancing Flame" [NPC_:0500B4D0]

text_content: No, I smash White Legs alone. You stay here so you not get dead.
name: NVDLC02MQ05bNVDLC02MQ05bDancingFlameTopic000 "No, I smash White Legs alone. You stay here so you not get dead." [DIAL:05010B09]

text_content: Hmph. Since you are friend to Sorrows... we go. But you kill White Legs!
name: NVDLC02MQ05bNVDLC02MQ05bDancingFlameTopic000 "No, I smash White Legs alone. You stay here so you not get dead." [DIAL:05010B09]
speaker: NVDLC02MQ05bDancingFlame "Dancing Flame" [NPC_:0500B4D0]

text_content: < Waking Cloud Generic Barks >
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudGenericBarks "< Waking Cloud Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B0A]

text_content: It is good to travel with another. I spend so long scouting on my own that I forget what human company is like.
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudGenericBarks "< Waking Cloud Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B0A]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: I have seen many strange plants in the valley - plants that seem to hunger for human flesh. Where they come from, I do not know.
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudGenericBarks "< Waking Cloud Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B0A]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: White Leg attacks grow more frequent each day - I fear for our people and for our valley if something is not done.
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudGenericBarks "< Waking Cloud Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B0A]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: {Praying to herself}Oh Father, guide and protect us your humble children as we labor in the vineyards, and make us strong to resist those who would steal Zion from us.
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudGenericBarks "< Waking Cloud Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B0A]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: I wish you could have met my family. You would like them, I think.
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudGenericBarks "< Waking Cloud Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B0A]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Zion used to be a place of peace, you know. Daniel says that it is holy in the eyes of the Father. I hope someday you will see it as it was.
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudGenericBarks "< Waking Cloud Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B0A]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: {Praying}Father, I ask that you guide this man who is the vessel of your will. Show him the light of your wisdom and the peace of your love. Amen.
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudGenericBarks "< Waking Cloud Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B0A]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: {Praying}Father, I ask that you guide this woman who is the vessel of your will. Show her the light of your wisdom and the peace of your love. Amen.
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudGenericBarks "< Waking Cloud Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B0A]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Daniel says that most people outside the valley do not keep to the Father's ways. Perhaps when you leave you will carry His word with you?
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudGenericBarks "< Waking Cloud Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B0A]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: When Salt-Upon-Wounds took New Canaan, he ordered the White Legs to salt the earth so nothing could grow again. What kind of monster could do that?
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudGenericBarks "< Waking Cloud Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B0A]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: I know you are eager to leave Zion, but... perhaps you might find peace if you stayed. Think about it, yes?
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudGenericBarks "< Waking Cloud Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B0A]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: < Waking Cloud Docks Bark >
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudDocksBark "< Waking Cloud Docks Bark >" [DIAL:05010B0B]

text_content: The river is lovely at this time of day, don't you think?
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudDocksBark "< Waking Cloud Docks Bark >" [DIAL:05010B0B]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: The river is lovely at this time of night, don't you think?
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudDocksBark "< Waking Cloud Docks Bark >" [DIAL:05010B0B]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: < Waking Cloud Burial Mounds Bark >
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudBurialMoundsBark "< Waking Cloud Burial Mounds Bark >" [DIAL:05010B0C]

text_content: Please be respectful here - these are the bones of our ancestors.
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudBurialMoundsBark "< Waking Cloud Burial Mounds Bark >" [DIAL:05010B0C]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: < Waking Cloud Ghost of She Bark >
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudGhostofSheBark "< Waking Cloud Ghost of She Bark >" [DIAL:05010B0D]

text_content: So this is the Ghost of She's lair. I was never brave enough to try to find it....
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudGhostofSheBark "< Waking Cloud Ghost of She Bark >" [DIAL:05010B0D]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Civilization isn't perfect, but neither is tribal life. You should go see it for yourself.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic061 "Civilization isn't perfect, but neither is tribal life. You should go see it for yourself." [DIAL:05010B0E]

text_content: Really? You think so? Hoo! I'm going to do it. After all this is over, I'm going to go explore civilization!|{Thank you, my friend}Dank ni, ahk iss - I never would have had the {guts}growans to ask him myself.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic061 "Civilization isn't perfect, but neither is tribal life. You should go see it for yourself." [DIAL:05010B0E]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: You should stay here with your people. You have a duty to them.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic059 "You should stay here with your people. You have a duty to them." [DIAL:05010B0F]

text_content: I see. Well, thanks for your telling. I'd like a minute alone to think about this. {Thanks}Dank ni.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic059 "You should stay here with your people. You have a duty to them." [DIAL:05010B0F]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: He said he has a hard time being objective about the whole idea, and that I should give you advice.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic052 "He said he has a hard time being objective about the whole idea, and that I should give you advice." [DIAL:05010B10]

text_content: He said that? Well, I guess you have been out there more recently than he has. So... what's your advice?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic052 "He said he has a hard time being objective about the whole idea, and that I should give you advice." [DIAL:05010B10]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: < Waking Cloud Three Marys Bark >
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudMarysBark "< Waking Cloud Three Marys Bark >" [DIAL:05010B11]

text_content: {Nervous}We should not be here! The Three Marys is where the White Legs make their camp! We should leave, quickly.
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudMarysBark "< Waking Cloud Three Marys Bark >" [DIAL:05010B11]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: < Waking Cloud Narrows Bark >
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudNarrowsBark "< Waking Cloud Narrows Bark >" [DIAL:05010B12]

text_content: I am always a little sad to leave the Narrows, and happy to return.
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudNarrowsBark "< Waking Cloud Narrows Bark >" [DIAL:05010B12]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: < Waking Cloud Eastern Virgin Bark >
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudVirginBark "< Waking Cloud Eastern Virgin Bark >" [DIAL:05010B13]

text_content: It has been some time since I visited the Dead Horses. Our tribes don't have much contact with each other.
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudVirginBark "< Waking Cloud Eastern Virgin Bark >" [DIAL:05010B13]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: < Waking Cloud Pine Creek Bark >
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudPineCreekBark "< Waking Cloud Pine Creek Bark >" [DIAL:05010B14]

text_content: This is Pine Creek, one of the only ways out of Zion Valley. Watch out - many dangerous beasts lair nearby.
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudPineCreekBark "< Waking Cloud Pine Creek Bark >" [DIAL:05010B14]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: < Waking Cloud Taboo Bark >
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudTabooBark "< Waking Cloud Taboo Bark >" [DIAL:05010B15]

text_content: These are places of the time before. We should not be here - it is forbidden!
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudTabooBark "< Waking Cloud Taboo Bark >" [DIAL:05010B15]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Tell me about the Ghost of She.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic023 "Tell me about the Ghost of She." [DIAL:05010B16]

text_content: That is a sad story. I do not like to tell it, but if you are asking, it must be at White Bird's request. That, I will honor.|Long ago, a girl lived among this tribe. She was a curious child, and a clever one, and her mother had a devil's time watching over her.|One day, the child slipped away from camp and went to play in the caves nearby. The girl did not know that a Yao Guai slept in that cave.|The girl died. The tribe wept, for the girl had died before her naming day, and her ghost would remain restless and wandering upon the earth.|Many hunters tried to kill the beast, but it eluded them, or drove them off. The shaman said that since it had consumed the girl, the two were one.|So we call the beast Ghost of She, for the child had no name to be called. That is the story of the Ghost of She. It is a sad story. It is our story.
name: NVDLC02DialogueWakingCloudNVDLC02WakingCloudTopic023 "Tell me about the Ghost of She." [DIAL:05010B16]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: Who or what is the Ghost of She?
name: NVDLC02DialogueShamanNVDLC02SorrowShamanTopic015 "Who or what is the Ghost of She?" [DIAL:05010B17]

text_content: Sad story. Not for your ears from my lips. Ask midwife. She speak to your ears.
name: NVDLC02DialogueShamanNVDLC02SorrowShamanTopic015 "Who or what is the Ghost of She?" [DIAL:05010B17]
speaker: NVDLC02SorrowShaman "White Bird" [NPC_:050094B9]

text_content: < Follows-Chalk Generic Barks >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGenericBarks "< Follows-Chalk Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B18]

text_content: Feels good to be doing some actual scouting, not just following.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGenericBarks "< Follows-Chalk Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B18]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: I hear some odd things about the civilized lands outside Zion. Is there really a giant thunder-lizard people live inside?
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGenericBarks "< Follows-Chalk Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B18]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: The spitter plants and the green monster men aren't native to Zion. Wonder where they came from?
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGenericBarks "< Follows-Chalk Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B18]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: So I finally get to explore all those taboo places without the other scouts yelling at me? Can't wait!
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGenericBarks "< Follows-Chalk Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B18]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: {Talking himself/his home up; wants to impress the player}Bet they don't have anything as nasty as Yao Guai out where you come from, huh?
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGenericBarks "< Follows-Chalk Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B18]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Those, um, what did you call them? {Maybe mispronounce a little}Walkie talkies? Those are going to be loads better than signal drums and smoke signs.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGenericBarks "< Follows-Chalk Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B18]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: That compass thing always knows where north is, huh? Even if it can't see the stars?
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGenericBarks "< Follows-Chalk Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B18]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: That Back When medicine smells funny. Guess it works though.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGenericBarks "< Follows-Chalk Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B18]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: There can't really be a place where people go into big buildings and give away all their money just to watch someone flip paper squares on a table...
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGenericBarks "< Follows-Chalk Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B18]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Way I heard it, Salt-Upon-Wounds butchered everyone in New Canaan and nailed their corpses to the cliffs.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGenericBarks "< Follows-Chalk Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B18]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Why do you carry all those bottlecaps, anyway? They jangle like crazy.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGenericBarks "< Follows-Chalk Generic Barks >" [DIAL:05010B18]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: < Follows-Chalk Ant Burrow Bark >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkAntBurrowBark "< Follows-Chalk Ant Burrow Bark >" [DIAL:05010B19]

text_content: Look sharp, lots of giant ants around here. We call 'em picnic-killers. Don't really know what that means. Something from Back When, I guess.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkAntBurrowBark "< Follows-Chalk Ant Burrow Bark >" [DIAL:05010B19]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: < Follows-Chalk Campground Bark >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkCampgroundBark "< Follows-Chalk Campground Bark >" [DIAL:05010B1A]

text_content: Must have been nice, when Zion was friendly enough folks could make camp wherever they pleased and not worry about White Legs and deadly critters.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkCampgroundBark "< Follows-Chalk Campground Bark >" [DIAL:05010B1A]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: < Follows-Chalk Overlook Bark >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkOverlookBark "< Follows-Chalk Overlook Bark >" [DIAL:05010B1B]

text_content: "Scenic Overlook." What do you suppose that means?
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkOverlookBark "< Follows-Chalk Overlook Bark >" [DIAL:05010B1B]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: < Follows-Chalk Aerie Bark >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkAerieBark "< Follows-Chalk Aerie Bark >" [DIAL:05010B1C]

text_content: See that tower? Back When, folks used them to talk to each other on the air. Not like with signal drums, they could actually talk! Amazing, huh?
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkAerieBark "< Follows-Chalk Aerie Bark >" [DIAL:05010B1C]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: < Follows-Chalk Bus Bark >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkBusBark "< Follows-Chalk Bus Bark >" [DIAL:05010B1D]

text_content: See this? This is why your own two feet are better than any cart, whether it's pulled by critters or goes on its own.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkBusBark "< Follows-Chalk Bus Bark >" [DIAL:05010B1D]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: < Follows-Chalk Plane Bark >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkPlaneBark "< Follows-Chalk Plane Bark >" [DIAL:05010B1E]

text_content: That thing actually flew once, like a big metal bird? {Wistful}Bet you don't have to follow chalk marks up there....
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkPlaneBark "< Follows-Chalk Plane Bark >" [DIAL:05010B1E]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: < Follows-Chalk Vault 22 Bark >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkVault22Bark "< Follows-Chalk Vault 22 Bark >" [DIAL:05010B1F]

text_content: You ever seen anything like these green men? Sure as anything they aren't from around here.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkVault22Bark "< Follows-Chalk Vault 22 Bark >" [DIAL:05010B1F]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: < Follows-Chalk Perk Bark >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkPerkBark "< Follows-Chalk Perk Bark >" [DIAL:05010B20]

text_content: Some kind of view up here, neh? If you know how to look, you can spot all kinds of landmarks from up here. Look, I'll show you.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkPerkBark "< Follows-Chalk Perk Bark >" [DIAL:05010B20]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: NVDLC02ToadieGreet
name: NVDLC02ToadieGreet "NVDLC02ToadieGreet" [DIAL:05010BB5]

text_content: Hoi! {Outsider seek Joshua Graham?}{AUS-land-er ZOOK-uh Joshua Graham?}Owslandr zookuh Joshua Graham?
name: NVDLC02ToadieGreet "NVDLC02ToadieGreet" [DIAL:05010BB5]
speaker: NVDLC02DeadHorseEV06 "Dead Horse Disciple of Canaan" [NPC_:0500E932]

text_content: I've already got the roots you need.
name: NVDLC02DialogueShamanNVDLC02SorrowShamanTopic013 "I've already got the roots you need." [DIAL:05010BB6]

text_content: Umm... what?
name: NVDLC02MQ01NVDLC02DeadHorseEV06Topic000 "Umm... what?" [DIAL:05010BB7]

text_content: Show respect, {AUS-land-er}owslandr! Joshua Graham greatest warchief!
name: NVDLC02MQ01NVDLC02DeadHorseEV06Topic000 "Umm... what?" [DIAL:05010BB7]
speaker: NVDLC02DeadHorseEV06 "Dead Horse Disciple of Canaan" [NPC_:0500E932]

text_content: Am I... looking for Joshua? Yes, I am. Can you tell me where he is?
name: NVDLC02MQ01NVDLC02DeadHorseEV06Topic001 "Am I... looking for Joshua? Yes, I am. Can you tell me where he is?" [DIAL:05010BB8]

text_content: {Somewhat pleased}You know our tongue - smart {AUS-land-er}owslandr.|Joshua in high place of cave. You show respect, utman! Joshua is greatest warrior. You show him no respect, he show you thunder and fire!
name: NVDLC02MQ01NVDLC02DeadHorseEV06Topic001 "Am I... looking for Joshua? Yes, I am. Can you tell me where he is?" [DIAL:05010BB8]
speaker: NVDLC02DeadHorseEV06 "Dead Horse Disciple of Canaan" [NPC_:0500E932]

text_content: If you're too dumb to speak my language, you're too dumb to talk to me. Get lost.
name: NVDLC02MQ01NVDLC02DeadHorseEV06Topic002 "If you're too dumb to speak my language, you're too dumb to talk to me. Get lost." [DIAL:05010BB9]

text_content: Yes, I'm looking for him. Is he here?
name: NVDLC02MQ01NVDLC02DeadHorseEV06Topic003 "Yes, I'm looking for him. Is he here?" [DIAL:05010BBA]

text_content: He in high place of cave. You show respect, {AUS-land-er}owslandr! Joshua is greatest warrior. You show him no respect, he show you thunder and fire!
name: NVDLC02MQ01NVDLC02DeadHorseEV06Topic003 "Yes, I'm looking for him. Is he here?" [DIAL:05010BBA]
speaker: NVDLC02DeadHorseEV06 "Dead Horse Disciple of Canaan" [NPC_:0500E932]

text_content: I'll make sure to be on my best behavior, then.
name: NVDLC02MQ01NVDLC02DeadHorseEV06Topic004 "I'll make sure to be on my best behavior, then." [DIAL:05010BBB]

text_content: You wise for {AUS-land-er}owslandr.
name: NVDLC02MQ01NVDLC02DeadHorseEV06Topic004 "I'll make sure to be on my best behavior, then." [DIAL:05010BBB]
speaker: NVDLC02DeadHorseEV06 "Dead Horse Disciple of Canaan" [NPC_:0500E932]

text_content: Umm... okay. Thanks for that. I sure would hate to be shown thunder and fire.
name: NVDLC02MQ01NVDLC02DeadHorseEV06Topic005 "Umm... okay. Thanks for that. I sure would hate to be shown thunder and fire." [DIAL:05010BBC]

text_content: {Not amused at all}Ha ha. Funny {AUS-land-er}owslandr. Maybe soon dead owslandr.
name: NVDLC02MQ01NVDLC02DeadHorseEV06Topic005 "Umm... okay. Thanks for that. I sure would hate to be shown thunder and fire." [DIAL:05010BBC]
speaker: NVDLC02DeadHorseEV06 "Dead Horse Disciple of Canaan" [NPC_:0500E932]

text_content: Back off, savage - I'm just here for a map out of this shithole valley, not kowtow to your messiah.
name: NVDLC02MQ01NVDLC02DeadHorseEV06Topic006 "Back off, savage - I'm just here for a map out of this shithole valley, not kowtow to your messiah." [DIAL:05010BBD]

text_content: {"Shit!"}Shaiss! Would kill you myself, but Joshua says no harm to visitors until harm done to us.|Go, {AUS-land-er}owslandr. Meet Joshua. We see how long you talk like that.
name: NVDLC02MQ01NVDLC02DeadHorseEV06Topic006 "Back off, savage - I'm just here for a map out of this shithole valley, not kowtow to your messiah." [DIAL:05010BBD]
speaker: NVDLC02DeadHorseEV06 "Dead Horse Disciple of Canaan" [NPC_:0500E932]

text_content: Vow of secrecy? Fine, forget about it.
name: NVDLC02DialogueRickyNVDLC02RickyTopic042 "Vow of secrecy? Fine, forget about it." [DIAL:05010BCD]

text_content: Forget it? Uh uh. Ricky remembers everything! But he keeps his secrets, too!
name: NVDLC02DialogueRickyNVDLC02RickyTopic042 "Vow of secrecy? Fine, forget about it." [DIAL:05010BCD]
speaker: NVDLC02Ricky "Ricky" [NPC_:0500F19D]

text_content: What do you know about Salt-Upon-Wounds?
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudSUW "What do you know about Salt-Upon-Wounds?" [DIAL:05010C00]

text_content: He is war chief of the White Legs, and the worst butcher of them all. The tribes he has crushed are many. The warriors he has slain, countless.
name: NVDLC02WakingCloudSUW "What do you know about Salt-Upon-Wounds?" [DIAL:05010C00]
speaker: NVDLC02WakingCloud "Waking Cloud" [NPC_:05009665]

text_content: < Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 8 >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGuideBark8 "< Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 8 >" [DIAL:05010C3A]

text_content: Here we are. Joshua's just ahead there, in the Angel Cave.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGuideBark8 "< Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 8 >" [DIAL:05010C3A]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: < Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 7 >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGuideBark7 "< Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 7 >" [DIAL:05010C3B]

text_content: Nearly there now. Watch out for traps in the water. Got to keep the White Legs out somehow, neh?
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGuideBark7 "< Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 7 >" [DIAL:05010C3B]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: <Follows-Chalk Guide Wrong Way Barks >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGuideBarkWrongWay "<Follows-Chalk Guide Wrong Way Barks >" [DIAL:05010C3C]

text_content: Hang on, you're going the wrong way!
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGuideBarkWrongWay "<Follows-Chalk Guide Wrong Way Barks >" [DIAL:05010C3C]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: I thought we were going to the Dead Horses camp?
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGuideBarkWrongWay "<Follows-Chalk Guide Wrong Way Barks >" [DIAL:05010C3C]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Hold up, you're getting all turned around. Check your map and backtrack a little.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGuideBarkWrongWay "<Follows-Chalk Guide Wrong Way Barks >" [DIAL:05010C3C]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Where are you going? That's not the way to the camp!
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGuideBarkWrongWay "<Follows-Chalk Guide Wrong Way Barks >" [DIAL:05010C3C]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: I'm happy to travel with you, but you're not headed toward the Dead Horses anymore.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGuideBarkWrongWay "<Follows-Chalk Guide Wrong Way Barks >" [DIAL:05010C3C]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: <Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 6 >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGuideBark6 "<Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 6 >" [DIAL:05010C3D]

text_content: Down this path to the north. Hope you don't mind getting wet.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGuideBark6 "<Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 6 >" [DIAL:05010C3D]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: <Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 5 >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGuideBark5 "<Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 5 >" [DIAL:05010C3E]

text_content: You see the dead sentries? Shamans say our enemies' souls are trapped in them, but Joshua says it shows we're serious about fighting White Legs.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGuideBark5 "<Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 5 >" [DIAL:05010C3E]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: <Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 4 >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGuideBark4 "<Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 4 >" [DIAL:05010C3F]

text_content: Follow the old road south, nearly there.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGuideBark4 "<Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 4 >" [DIAL:05010C3F]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: <Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 3 >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGuideBark3 "<Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 3 >" [DIAL:05010C40]

text_content: Keep headed north, around this rock pile.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGuideBark3 "<Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 3 >" [DIAL:05010C40]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: <Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 2 >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGuideBark2 "<Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 2 >" [DIAL:05010C41]

text_content: You can take the path north here if you want, or head east over the ridge. There's a nice view from the top of that cliff, if you want a look.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGuideBark2 "<Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 2 >" [DIAL:05010C41]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: <Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 1 >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGuideBark1 "<Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 1 >" [DIAL:05010C42]

text_content: We follow this path for a while. Nice view of the river, neh?
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkGuideBark1 "<Follows-Chalk Guide Bark 1 >" [DIAL:05010C42]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: I have some gear that needs repairs.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic079 "I have some gear that needs repairs." [DIAL:05010C79]

text_content: I have some gear that needs repairs.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic002 "I have some gear that needs repairs." [DIAL:05010C7A]

text_content: Let me have a look. My tribe may take too much pride in its mechanical talents, but in truth we are intrigued by the workings of a fine firearm.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic002 "I have some gear that needs repairs." [DIAL:05010C7A]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: Let me have a look.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic002 "I have some gear that needs repairs." [DIAL:05010C7A]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: I'm sorry, I don't understand you.
name: NVDLC02MQ01NVDLC02DeadHorseEV06Topic007 "I'm sorry, I don't understand you." [DIAL:05010C7D]

text_content: {Repeating himself; "Outsider seeks Joshua Graham?"}{AUS-land-er ZOOK-uh Joshua Graham?}Owslandr utman zookuh Joshua Graham? {Searching for english words}You look for Joshua Graham?
name: NVDLC02MQ01NVDLC02DeadHorseEV06Topic007 "I'm sorry, I don't understand you." [DIAL:05010C7D]
speaker: NVDLC02DeadHorseEV06 "Dead Horse Disciple of Canaan" [NPC_:0500E932]

text_content: Huh, I think I know that guy. Small world.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic039 "Huh, I think I know that guy. Small world." [DIAL:05010D0B]

text_content: Is it? I always heard it was rather large outside the valley. Well, wherever he is, I hope he's well.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic039 "Huh, I think I know that guy. Small world." [DIAL:05010D0B]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: I know that guy! I got him a job!
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic055 "I know that guy! I got him a job!" [DIAL:05010D0C]

text_content: A job as a singer? {Full of wonder; just got told Santa Claus is real}Then it really is true....
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic055 "I know that guy! I got him a job!" [DIAL:05010D0C]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Any idea where to start looking for these pre-War supplies Daniel needs?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic056 "Any idea where to start looking for these pre-War supplies Daniel needs?" [DIAL:05010D63]

text_content: Best place to look for Back When stuff is the taboo places. Sorrows and Dead Horses don't go in there, and even White Legs don't like them much.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic056 "Any idea where to start looking for these pre-War supplies Daniel needs?" [DIAL:05010D63]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: What taboo places?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic057 "What taboo places?" [DIAL:05010D64]

text_content: Lots of them around the valley - places built by the folk from Back When. You'll know them when you see them - scouts mark them with hand prints.|The hand prints are a warning to keep out - angry ghosts live inside. Not that I believe in angry ghosts. They're just spooky old places. Right?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic057 "What taboo places?" [DIAL:05010D64]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Where should we start looking?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic058 "Where should we start looking?" [DIAL:05010D65]

text_content: Lots of Back When places to choose from, but for the things we need, best to start with the really closed up places.|Three I know of: a building down by the river called a "Fishing Lodge," the old ranger station in the northwest, and the general store right by it.|Closer to home, might be something you can salvage from the place where the little ones fell, just west of the Eastern Virgin.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic058 "Where should we start looking?" [DIAL:05010D65]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: What's this "place where the little ones fell?"
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic062 "What's this ""place where the little ones fell?""" [DIAL:05010D66]

text_content: In the river, there's a twisted pile of metal and glass, all full of bones. Joshua says they were scouts, but they looked awful small to me.|Lots of that old stuff, how do you say it... {stilted, forced pronunciation}electronics? Maybe you could use some of it.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic062 "What's this ""place where the little ones fell?""" [DIAL:05010D66]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: White Legs? Those are the people who attacked us?
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic063 "White Legs? Those are the people who attacked us?" [DIAL:05010D67]

text_content: Yah, and they're still back there! Let's go get them!
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic063 "White Legs? Those are the people who attacked us?" [DIAL:05010D67]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: If you're willing, I'll take the help.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic064 "If you're willing, I'll take the help." [DIAL:05010D68]

text_content: {Glad to hear it}Goot sists. Let's show them what we're made of!
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic064 "If you're willing, I'll take the help." [DIAL:05010D68]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Forget it, I'm out of here.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic065 "Forget it, I'm out of here." [DIAL:05010D69]

text_content: You're not going to fight? But... okay. You better come with me, then. Joshua will want to see you.
name: NVDLC02DialogueFollowsChalkNVDLC02FollowsChalkTopic065 "Forget it, I'm out of here." [DIAL:05010D69]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: < Follows-Chalk post-ambush greeting >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkPostAmbushForceGreet "< Follows-Chalk post-ambush greeting >" [DIAL:05010D6A]

text_content: Hoo! That's for the White Legs! Sorry we weren't fast enough to save your friends, though. The Dead Horses will remember them in our prayers.|You should come with me now - Joshua Graham will want to meet a visitor from the civilized lands.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkPostAmbushForceGreet "< Follows-Chalk post-ambush greeting >" [DIAL:05010D6A]

text_content: < Follows-Chalk Yao Guai Bark >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkYaoGuaiBark "< Follows-Chalk Yao Guai Bark >" [DIAL:05010EEF]

text_content: {Hushed, tense, big scary monster ahead!}Freeze! Don't move a muscle. Yao Guai.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkYaoGuaiBark "< Follows-Chalk Yao Guai Bark >" [DIAL:05010EEF]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: Hoo! That was some kind of lucky. Guess that one was all full of gecko, neh? Don't get used to it, though. Yao Guai are plenty mean as a rule.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkYaoGuaiBark "< Follows-Chalk Yao Guai Bark >" [DIAL:05010EEF]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: What do you know of Salt-Upon-Wounds?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic049 "What do you know of Salt-Upon-Wounds?" [DIAL:05010F4A]

text_content: He's a butcher. Believe me, I know the godless fire that burns in his heart. I've been burned by it myself.|He's not the kind to let his subordinates do all the killing. No, he likes to have a hand in it, with that spear of his.|He's fashioned himself an abomination before the eyes of the Lord. I'm happy to serve as an instrument of divine justice.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic049 "What do you know of Salt-Upon-Wounds?" [DIAL:05010F4A]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: What do you know of the White Legs?
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic095 "What do you know of the White Legs?" [DIAL:05010F4B]

text_content: They're hateful savages who live only to plunder and destroy. Their leader is a devil called Salt-Upon-Wounds.|War is what all he knows. Everything he has, everything that tribe has, was taken by force, raiding and scavenging.|It's said there's no man deadlier at close range, that that powerfist of his has smashed a hundred skulls.|Maybe that's true, but so what? It's a low form of leadership. A tribe that knows only war has no future. And so he'll lead them to Caesar.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic095 "What do you know of the White Legs?" [DIAL:05010F4B]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Here, take five of my healing powders.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic094 "Here, take five of my healing powders." [DIAL:05010F4C]

text_content: That's very generous of you. Five doses will help a great deal.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic094 "Here, take five of my healing powders." [DIAL:05010F4C]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: Here, take three of my healing powders.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic093 "Here, take three of my healing powders." [DIAL:05010F4D]

text_content: Thanks. That will help a good deal.
name: NVDLC02DialogueDanielNVDLC02DanielTopic093 "Here, take three of my healing powders." [DIAL:05010F4D]
speaker: NVDLC02Daniel "Daniel" [NPC_:05008A38]

text_content: How do you know so much about what happened to me?
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic080 "How do you know so much about what happened to me?" [DIAL:050110D1]

text_content: The Dead Horses are capable scouts. Nothing passes into or out of Zion without my hearing of it.
name: NVDLC02DialogueJoshuaNVDLC02JoshuaTopic080 "How do you know so much about what happened to me?" [DIAL:050110D1]
speaker: NVDLC02Joshua "Joshua Graham" [NPC_:05008A39]

text_content: < Follows-Chalk Taboo Marks Bark >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkTabooMarksBark "< Follows-Chalk Taboo Marks Bark >" [DIAL:0501115B]

text_content: See those handprints? Dead Horses and Sorrows mark them on taboo places, places from Back When. Good thing for you I don't buy into that stuff.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkTabooMarksBark "< Follows-Chalk Taboo Marks Bark >" [DIAL:0501115B]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: < Follows-Chalk Mural Bark >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkMuralBark "< Follows-Chalk Mural Bark >" [DIAL:0501115C]

text_content: These paintings show the Dead Horses' victories against other tribes. Lots more of them since Joshua came to us.
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkMuralBark "< Follows-Chalk Mural Bark >" [DIAL:0501115C]
speaker: NVDLC02FollowsChalk "Follows-Chalk" [NPC_:050094D0]

text_content: NVDLC02StellaForceGreetTOPIC
name: NVDLC02StellaForceGreetTOPIC "NVDLC02StellaForceGreetTOPIC" [DIAL:05011185]

text_content: {anxious}Ain't the trail ahead worries me, Jed. Those descents we made, through that slot canyon back up there?
name: NVDLC02StellaForceGreetTOPIC "NVDLC02StellaForceGreetTOPIC" [DIAL:05011185]
speaker: NVDLC02Stella "Stella" [NPC_:0500F19E]

text_content: Ain't no way we're getting back out the way we come. And then what?
name: NVDLC02StellaForceGreetTOPIC "NVDLC02StellaForceGreetTOPIC" [DIAL:05011185]
speaker: NVDLC02Stella "Stella" [NPC_:0500F19E]

text_content: NVDLC02JedForceGreetPt2TOPIC
name: NVDLC02JedForceGreetPt2TOPIC "NVDLC02JedForceGreetPt2TOPIC" [DIAL:05011186]

text_content: {exasperated}Goddammit, Stella, heard you the first time, and the fifteenth, too.
name: NVDLC02JedForceGreetPt2TOPIC "NVDLC02JedForceGreetPt2TOPIC" [DIAL:05011186]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: The New Canaanites will know a way. And if they don't, we got the maps on our friend's Pip-Boy over there.
name: NVDLC02JedForceGreetPt2TOPIC "NVDLC02JedForceGreetPt2TOPIC" [DIAL:05011186]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: {raising voice, giving orders}Enough lollygagging! Get moving and keep an eye out for tribals!
name: NVDLC02JedForceGreetPt2TOPIC "NVDLC02JedForceGreetPt2TOPIC" [DIAL:05011186]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: NVDLC02DialogueRickyNVDLC02RickyTopic046 "Goodbye." [DIAL:050112B9]

text_content: {sneering}Yeah, whatever.
name: NVDLC02DialogueRickyNVDLC02RickyTopic046 "Goodbye." [DIAL:050112B9]
speaker: NVDLC02Ricky "Ricky" [NPC_:0500F19D]

text_content: Goodbye.
name: NVDLC02DialogueStellaNVDLC02StellaTopic005 "Goodbye." [DIAL:050112BA]

text_content: Catch you another time, then.
name: NVDLC02DialogueStellaNVDLC02StellaTopic005 "Goodbye." [DIAL:050112BA]
speaker: NVDLC02Stella "Stella" [NPC_:0500F19E]

text_content: < Follows-Chalk Fire Force-Greet >
name: NVDLC02FollowsChalkFireForceGreet "< Follows-Chalk Fire Force-Greet >" [DIAL:05011504]

text_content: NVDLC02IntroSlidesFinale
name: NVDLC02IntroSlidesFinale "NVDLC02IntroSlidesFinale" [DIAL:05011532]

text_content: {Narration}Probably just a tribal ghost story. But New Canaan's been silent for a long time. Maybe it's a coincidence. Maybe the Malpais Legate is dead.|{Narration}Or maybe Joshua Graham did crawl out of that canyon and finally found his way back home.
name: NVDLC02IntroSlidesFinale "NVDLC02IntroSlidesFinale" [DIAL:05011532]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: NVDLC02IntroSlides12
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides12 "NVDLC02IntroSlides12" [DIAL:05011533]

text_content: {Narration}He got his wish. Joshua Graham disappeared. And in his place came legends of the Burned Man walking the wastes.
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides12 "NVDLC02IntroSlides12" [DIAL:05011533]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: NVDLC02IntroSlides11
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides11 "NVDLC02IntroSlides11" [DIAL:05011534]

text_content: {Narration}All this talk bothered Caesar, so he forbade anyone from speaking his name. Wanted to erase Joshua Graham from history.
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides11 "NVDLC02IntroSlides11" [DIAL:05011534]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: NVDLC02IntroSlides10
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides10 "NVDLC02IntroSlides10" [DIAL:05011535]

text_content: {Narration}Not long after, some of the slaves and tribals started to talk. Said Graham wasn't dead. Shouldn't have been any surprise.
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides10 "NVDLC02IntroSlides10" [DIAL:05011535]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: NVDLC02IntroSlides09
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides09 "NVDLC02IntroSlides09" [DIAL:05011536]

text_content: {Narration}He had Graham covered in pitch, lit on fire, and thrown into the Grand Canyon. People say he didn't even scream on the way down.
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides09 "NVDLC02IntroSlides09" [DIAL:05011536]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: NVDLC02IntroSlides08
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides08 "NVDLC02IntroSlides08" [DIAL:05011537]

text_content: {Narration}Caesar had to make an example for the others, to show them that even at the highest level, failure wouldn't be tolerated.
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides08 "NVDLC02IntroSlides08" [DIAL:05011537]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: NVDLC02IntroSlides07
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides07 "NVDLC02IntroSlides07" [DIAL:05011538]

text_content: {Narration}Well at Hoover Dam, the Malpais Legate finally met his match. Hanlon and Oliver kicked his New Canaanite butt right back over the river.
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides07 "NVDLC02IntroSlides07" [DIAL:05011538]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: NVDLC02IntroSlides06
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides06 "NVDLC02IntroSlides06" [DIAL:05011539]

text_content: {Narration}Legend goes that Graham was the meanest, toughest son of a bitch in the whole damned Legion.|{Narration}The New Canaanites wouldn't talk about him. They were ashamed. Guess I can't blame 'em.
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides06 "NVDLC02IntroSlides06" [DIAL:05011539]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: NVDLC02IntroSlides05
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides05 "NVDLC02IntroSlides05" [DIAL:0501153A]

text_content: {Narration}Turns out Caesar's first war chief, the Malpais Legate, was a New Canaanite. Joshua Graham.
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides05 "NVDLC02IntroSlides05" [DIAL:0501153A]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: NVDLC02IntroSlides04
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides04 "NVDLC02IntroSlides04" [DIAL:0501153B]

text_content: {Narration}But then the Legion appeared in Arizona. I reckon you know all about them.
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides04 "NVDLC02IntroSlides04" [DIAL:0501153B]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: NVDLC02IntroSlides03
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides03 "NVDLC02IntroSlides03" [DIAL:0501153C]

text_content: {Narration}We've seen our share of cults, but the New Canaanites, they were honest traders. Good fighters, too. Raiders wouldn't tangle with 'em.
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides03 "NVDLC02IntroSlides03" [DIAL:0501153C]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: NVDLC02IntroSlides02
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides02 "NVDLC02IntroSlides02" [DIAL:0501153D]

text_content: {Narration}Didn't know much about them, except that they were religious folks. Sent out missionaries to talk to the tribes.
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides02 "NVDLC02IntroSlides02" [DIAL:0501153D]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: NVDLC02IntroSlides01
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides01 "NVDLC02IntroSlides01" [DIAL:0501153E]

text_content: {Narration}A few decades back, folks in the NCR started to hear about a community in northern Utah called New Canaan.
name: NVDLC02IntroSlides01 "NVDLC02IntroSlides01" [DIAL:0501153E]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]

text_content: NVDLC02IntroSlidesStart
name: NVDLC02IntroSlidesStart "NVDLC02IntroSlidesStart" [DIAL:0501153F]

text_content: {Narration}The paths we're following are slow going, so you might as well keep your ears open and listen to what old Jed has to say.
name: NVDLC02IntroSlidesStart "NVDLC02IntroSlidesStart" [DIAL:0501153F]
speaker: NVDLC02Jed "Jed Masterson" [NPC_:05009E7B]
